materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Breakdown voltage of a uniform-field Si avalanche region via ionization integral
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the McIntyre local-model electron/hole multiplication gain of a Si p-i-n multiplication layer using Chynoweth ionization coefficients for electrons and holes, by nested quadrature of the ionization integral. Find the breakdown voltage by root-finding for the condition where the ionization integral equals unity, then scan width dependence.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Position-dependent gain and excess noise in an abrupt p+n Si APD
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: For the linear field of a one-sided abrupt junction, compute the position-dependent multiplication M(x) and McIntyre's excess noise from integrals over the depletion region with field-dependent alpha and beta. Compare F(M) with McIntyre's closed-form expression for an effective k ratio.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Doping dependence of abrupt-junction breakdown voltage compared with Sze–Gibbons scaling
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine the depletion-approximation field profile with Okuto–Crowell ionization coefficients. Solve the ionization-integral breakdown condition across substrate dopings from 1e14 to 1e18 cm^-3 for Si and GaAs, and fit the log-log slope against the empirical universal breakdown formula.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Punch-through and breakdown of an InGaAs/InP SACM avalanche photodiode
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Build the piecewise electric-field profile of a separate absorption-charge-multiplication stack from layer dopings and the charge-sheet density. Find the punch-through voltage and the InP breakdown voltage from the hole-initiated ionization integral, and compute gain versus bias. Check that the InGaAs field stays below its tunneling threshold.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Dead-space multiplication theory for thin GaAs avalanche layers
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the Hayat recurrence integral equations for the mean gain and mean-square gain with hard-threshold dead-space ionization probability densities. Discretize on a spatial grid and iterate to a fixed point. Compare the excess noise factor against local McIntyre theory as layer thickness shrinks.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Temperature coefficient of APD breakdown voltage from temperature-dependent ionization coefficients
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use Okuto–Crowell coefficients with phonon-temperature-dependent parameters. Solve the breakdown condition for a fixed multiplication-layer width at several temperatures and extract dV_br/dT by finite differences. Then compute the bias tracking needed to hold gain at 10.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Gain-bandwidth product of an APD from Emmons' frequency response
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate Emmons' frequency-dependent multiplication with avalanche build-up time proportional to M·k·tau_transit. Find the -3 dB bandwidth versus gain by root-finding and extract the asymptotic gain-bandwidth product for Si and InGaAs/InP k ratios, including transit-time and RC limits.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: SPAD avalanche triggering probability and photon detection efficiency versus overbias
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the coupled nonlinear Oldham–McIntyre boundary-value ODEs for electron and hole avalanche-initiation probabilities across a field profile with solve_bvp. Integrate them with the absorption profile to get photon detection efficiency versus excess bias above breakdown.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Purcell enhancement of an inhomogeneous quantum-dot ensemble in a micropillar
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the Purcell factor Fp = 3Q(lambda/n)^3/(4 pi^2 V) with a Lorentzian spectral detuning factor and a dipole-orientation and position factor. Average the spontaneous-emission enhancement over a Gaussian QD energy distribution by quadrature, and find the fraction of dots with Fp above 5.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Dipole emission rate inside a planar Fabry–Perot microcavity
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate the in-plane-wavevector-resolved emission of horizontal and vertical dipoles between two mirrors with Fresnel reflection coefficients, using Airy-function cavity factors. Report the total decay rate enhancement and the fraction emitted into the normal-direction mode versus emitter position.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Micropillar fundamental mode, mode volume and Purcell factor from step-index fiber theory
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the HE11/LP01 eigenvalue equation with J0, J1, K0 and K1 Bessel functions for a GaAs pillar in air to get the effective index and transverse mode profile. Integrate the mode volume with the axial standing wave and compute the Purcell factor versus pillar diameter.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Light-extraction efficiency of planar LEDs with Fresnel transmission and an encapsulant dome
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate polarization-averaged Fresnel transmission over the escape cone for isotropic internal emission from GaN or AlGaInP into air or into an epoxy layer and dome. Compare with the simple (1/2)(1 - cos theta_c) estimate and compute the extraction gain from encapsulation.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Boron predeposition and drive-in: junction depth and sheet resistance
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the erfc predeposition dose and the Gaussian drive-in profile with Arrhenius diffusivities, and find the junction depth against background doping by root-finding. Integrate q·mu(N)·N with Caughey–Thomas mobility over the profile to obtain sheet resistance.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Pearson IV ion-implantation profile from range moments
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Construct the Pearson IV distribution from projected range, straggle, skewness and kurtosis by solving the Pearson differential equation and normalizing numerically to the dose. Compute peak concentration and junction depth, and compare with the Gaussian approximation for B and As implants into Si.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Annealed Gaussian implant with reflecting surface and retained dose
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evolve a Gaussian implant under diffusion using the analytic solution with an image source for a reflecting (no-flux) surface, versus an absorbing surface using erfc terms. Compute the retained dose fraction by quadrature, the peak shift and the junction depth after anneal.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Concentration-dependent arsenic diffusion via Boltzmann similarity transformation
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: With extrinsic diffusivity D = D_i(1 + beta n/n_i) and a constant surface concentration, transform Fick's law with eta = x/sqrt(t) into a nonlinear ODE. Solve it as a boundary-value problem to get the box-shaped profile, and compare junction depth with the constant-D erfc result.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Boltzmann–Matano extraction of concentration-dependent interdiffusion coefficient
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Given a smooth diffusion-couple profile C(x) (generated synthetically), locate the Matano plane by equal-area integration. Compute D(C) = -(1/2t)(dx/dC)∫(x - x_M)dC using cumulative quadrature and spline derivatives, and validate it against the known input D(C).

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Effective thermal budget of a ramped anneal from Arrhenius diffusivity integration
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate D(T(t)) = D0 exp(-Ea/kT(t)) over a ramp-up, soak and ramp-down furnace schedule to obtain the effective Dt. Apply it to Gaussian drive-in profiles and find the equivalent isothermal time at the soak temperature. Quantify the ramp contribution for different ramp rates.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Thin-film source diffusion with surface evaporation (radiation boundary condition)
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the analytic solution of diffusion into a semi-infinite solid with Robin boundary flux h(C_s - C), expressed with erfc and exp·erfc terms. Compute the time evolution of the surface concentration and the integrated dose loss, and recover the Dirichlet and Neumann limits.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Lateral diffusion under a mask edge in two dimensions
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Superpose 2D Green's-function solutions for a predeposited source confined to x < 0, giving erfc lateral factors times the vertical profile, and integrate for the Gaussian drive-in case. Trace the junction contour by root-finding and compute the lateral-to-vertical junction depth ratio.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Quantum-well intermixing blue shift from Al–Ga interdiffusion
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model Ga/Al interdiffusion of a GaAs/AlGaAs quantum well as an erf-shaped composition profile, which maps to a graded conduction-band potential and effective mass. Solve the 1D BenDaniel–Duke Schrödinger equation by finite differences and compute the ground-state transition blue shift versus diffusion length.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Self-consistent LED junction temperature with temperature-dependent efficiency
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine a Shockley diode with a temperature-dependent bandgap (Varshni) and internal quantum efficiency with a junction-to-ambient thermal resistance. Solve the fixed point of dissipated power, which is electrical power minus light output, for Tj versus drive current, and report the resulting light output saturation.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Thermal resistance of a stripe laser from line-source Green's function integration
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate the 2D steady heat-conduction Green's function of a uniform stripe heat source of width w on a substrate of thickness h with an isothermal heat sink, using an image series. Average over the stripe to obtain the thermal resistance per length versus stripe width.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: VCSEL gain–cavity detuning and the temperature of minimum threshold
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model the cavity mode red-shifting at about 0.07 nm/K and the gain peak at about 0.3 nm/K, with a Lorentzian/Gaussian gain spectrum whose peak gain falls with temperature. Compute threshold carrier density versus temperature and find the temperature of minimum threshold for a given room-temperature offset.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Operating temperature and annual yield of a PV module from energy balance
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the module steady-state energy balance with absorbed irradiance, wind-dependent convection and sky/ground radiation for module temperature by root-finding. Apply a linear power temperature coefficient and integrate power over a synthetic daily irradiance and ambient profile to get energy yield and thermal loss.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Fang–Howard variational 2DEG density in a modulation-doped AlGaAs/GaAs heterojunction
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use the Fang–Howard trial wavefunction with analytic energy terms, minimized over the variational parameter b. Couple it to the depleted AlGaAs donor layer, spacer and conduction band offset through charge neutrality, and solve for the sheet density n_s versus spacer thickness and doping by root-finding.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Polarization-induced 2DEG in AlGaN/GaN HEMTs by self-consistent Schrödinger–Poisson
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Iterate finite-difference Schrödinger and Poisson equations with spontaneous and piezoelectric polarization sheet charges, surface barrier pinning and Fermi–Dirac subband filling. Compute n_s versus AlGaN thickness and compare with the analytic sheet-charge model, including the critical thickness for 2DEG onset.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Subband structure of a delta-doped Si layer in GaAs
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Self-consistently solve for the V-shaped potential of a Si delta layer with a few times 1e12 cm^-2, with the ionized donor sheet smeared over a few nm. Obtain subband energies, wavefunctions and occupations, and track the number of occupied subbands versus doping density with under-relaxed iteration.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Second-subband occupation onset in a double-side-doped quantum well
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Self-consistently solve a symmetrically modulation-doped GaAs quantum well with Hartree potential flattening the well bottom. Find the total sheet density at which the second subband begins to fill, and compute the subband spacing E2 - E1 versus density and well width.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Triangular-well subbands from Airy zeros versus WKB
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute subband energies of an electron in a triangular well at a heterojunction or MOS interface, for a given field, from Airy-function zeros. Compare with the WKB (n + 3/4)^(2/3) formula and with finite-difference eigenvalues, and compute the average electron distance from the interface.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Electron slab in a wide parabolic AlGaAs quantum well
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Self-consistently fill a parabolically graded AlxGa1-xAs well with remote-doped electrons. Show the Hartree flattening into a quasi-uniform slab whose width grows with density, and compute subband energies, occupied-subband count and slab width against the uniform-jellium estimate.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Gate-tuned tunneling gap in a coupled double quantum well
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Self-consistently solve two GaAs wells separated by a thin AlGaAs barrier under gate bias. Compute the symmetric–antisymmetric splitting versus bias and density imbalance, find the balance point of minimum splitting, and report the layer charge distribution.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Surface electron accumulation in InN: Thomas–Fermi versus Schrödinger–Poisson
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model the InN surface accumulation from Fermi-level pinning with a nonparabolic Kane conduction band. Solve the modified Thomas–Fermi Poisson equation with nonparabolic density, and a Schrödinger–Poisson version, and compare the accumulated sheet density and band-bending profile.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Laser lineshape from a white-plus-flicker frequency noise spectrum
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Starting from a frequency-noise PSD S_nu(f) = h0 + k/f, compute the phase variance and field autocorrelation by quadrature and Fourier transform to the optical lineshape. Compare the FWHM with the beta-separation-line estimate and with the pure Lorentzian limit.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Delayed self-heterodyne beat spectrum for linewidth extraction
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the closed-form delayed self-heterodyne power spectrum for a Lorentzian laser with finite fiber delay tau_d, which shows coherent oscillation fringes. Extract the laser linewidth by fitting, and quantify the error of the naive half-FWHM rule when tau_d is comparable to the coherence time.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Adiabatic and transient chirp of a directly modulated laser
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: From small-signal rate equations with gain compression and alpha, derive the FM/IM transfer ratio Delta_nu/(Delta P/P) = (alpha/4 pi)(i omega + kappa) versus modulation frequency. Compute the adiabatic chirp coefficient kappa and the transition frequency between adiabatic and transient chirp.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Damping K-factor and maximum modulation bandwidth with gain compression
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: From the small-signal modulation response, compute resonance frequency f_r and damping gamma = K f_r^2 + gamma_0 with K = 4 pi^2 (tau_p + epsilon/(v_g dg/dN)). Find the -3 dB bandwidth versus bias by root-finding, and the maximum intrinsic bandwidth 2 sqrt(2) pi/K versus photon lifetime.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Two-dimensional Elliott absorption of a multi-subband quantum well
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Apply the strict 2D Elliott formula, with bound states E_n = -Ry/(n - 1/2)^2 and continuum Sommerfeld factor 2/(1 + exp(-2 pi/sqrt(x))), to heavy- and light-hole subband pairs with confinement energies and overlaps. Broaden and sum to obtain the QW absorption spectrum.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Fractional-dimensional exciton model for finite quantum wells
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Map a GaAs/AlGaAs well width to an effective dimension alpha between 2 and 3 using He's prescription, then compute binding energies Ry/(n + (alpha - 3)/2)^2. Evaluate the fractional-dimension Elliott absorption continuum using Gamma-function Sommerfeld factors versus well width.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Temperature-dependent exciton linewidth and absorption from LO-phonon broadening
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine the Varshni gap shift with an exciton linewidth Gamma(T) = Gamma0 + sigma T + Gamma_LO/(exp(E_LO/kT) - 1) in a broadened Elliott model. Compute alpha(E, T) for GaN or ZnO, and the temperature at which the exciton peak dissolves into the continuum by a peak-contrast criterion.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Excitonic Mott transition by carrier screening with the Hulthén potential
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Approximate the screened Coulomb interaction by the Hulthén potential, whose bound states and continuum Sommerfeld factor are analytic. Compute the binding energy and the screened Elliott spectrum versus Debye or Thomas–Fermi screening length, and find the carrier density at which the 1s state unbinds.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Brus-equation sizing of CdSe quantum dots from the first exciton peak
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Brus expression: infinite-well confinement, 1.786 e^2/(4 pi eps R) Coulomb term and the polarization correction. Invert it by root-finding to estimate diameters from measured peak energies, and compare with an empirical sizing polynomial to quantify the model's error at small sizes.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Colloidal QD concentration from size-dependent molar extinction coefficients
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use empirical sizing curves and the power-law extinction coefficient epsilon_1S ∝ D^2.65 for CdSe, CdTe and PbS. Compute the particle concentration from first-exciton absorbance via Beer–Lambert with a linewidth correction, and propagate size uncertainty to the concentration error.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Inferring quantum-dot size dispersion from inhomogeneous exciton linewidth
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Map a Gaussian or log-normal size distribution through E(R), including the Jacobian dE/dR, to the inhomogeneous first-exciton absorption band. Convolve with homogeneous broadening and fit the size standard deviation from the observed FWHM and asymmetry.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Radiative lifetime and oscillator strength of quantum-dot excitons versus size
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the band-edge exciton oscillator strength from the Kane energy and electron–hole envelope overlap, with the dielectric local-field factor. Obtain the radiative lifetime tau_rad in solvent versus dot radius, and compare with the bulk-exciton coherence-volume enhancement regime.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Nonparabolic confinement energies of PbSe quantum dots with a two-band Kane model
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use the two-band hyperbolic dispersion E(k) = ±sqrt((Eg/2)^2 + (hbar^2 Eg/2m*) k^2) with quantized k from spherical Bessel zeros. Compute the size-dependent gap, the overestimate of the parabolic model at small radii, and fit an effective exponent of E(R) - Eg ∝ R^-n.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Fluence-dependent multiexciton populations and PL yield via Poisson statistics
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: For pulsed excitation with mean exciton number <N> = sigma·j, compute Poisson occupation probabilities, ground-state bleach saturation and the time-integrated photon yield. Use Auger rates scaling as n^2(n-1)/2 relative to the biexciton Auger time, and sum the cascade for emitted photons per pulse versus fluence.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Germanium density of states from EPM Brillouin-zone sampling
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Diagonalize the local EPM Hamiltonian for Ge on a uniform k-grid in the irreducible wedge with symmetry weights, or a full grid. Accumulate a Gaussian-broadened DOS, identify the L-valley conduction minimum, and compute the integrated valence-electron count as a check.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Strain-induced valley splitting in biaxially strained Si via continuous pseudopotential
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use a continuous V(q) fitted to reproduce the Si form factors. Apply biaxial tensile strain to the lattice and reciprocal vectors, and compute the splitting of the Delta2 and Delta4 conduction valleys and the change of indirect gap. Extract the uniaxial deformation potential Xi_u.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Imaginary dielectric function of Si from EPM joint density of states
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Sample the Brillouin zone and compute interband transition energies from EPM bands, with momentum matrix elements built from the plane-wave coefficients. Accumulate a broadened epsilon_2(omega), locate the E1 and E2 critical-point peaks, and check the f-sum rule.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Longitudinal and transverse electron masses of silicon from EPM
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Locate the conduction-band minimum along Gamma-X by minimization of the EPM lowest conduction eigenvalue. Compute longitudinal and transverse effective masses from second derivatives, and compare the derived density-of-states and conductivity masses with experiment.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Gamma–X crossover in AlGaAs from virtual-crystal pseudopotentials
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Interpolate the GaAs and AlAs form factors linearly with composition (virtual crystal approximation) and diagonalize the zincblende EPM Hamiltonian. Track the Gamma, X and L conduction edges versus x, find the direct–indirect crossover composition, and estimate a gap bowing parameter.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: sp3s* tight-binding band structure of GaAs compared with EPM
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Assemble the Vogl–Hjalmarson–Dow 10x10 sp3s* Hamiltonian with Bloch phase factors for zincblende GaAs and diagonalize it along L-Gamma-X. Compare band energies at high-symmetry points and the Gamma effective mass with an EPM calculation, quantifying the tight-binding limitations.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Hall factor for power-law scattering with arbitrary degeneracy
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute r_H = <tau^2>/<tau>^2 for tau ∝ E^s, with averages taken as energy integrals weighted by -df/dE and E^(3/2), evaluated as Fermi–Dirac integrals by quadrature. Map r_H versus reduced Fermi level for acoustic, ionized-impurity and neutral-impurity exponents, and verify the Boltzmann and degenerate limits.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Pisarenko relation and Seebeck coefficient versus carrier density
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate S = (k/e)[(r + 5/2)F_{r+3/2}/((r + 3/2)F_{r+1/2}) - eta] for a parabolic band with scattering parameter r. Solve for eta from carrier density, and compare with the nondegenerate Pisarenko formula and the degenerate Mott formula across 1e17-1e21 cm^-3.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Energy-resolved Matthiessen mobility with acoustic and Brooks–Herring scattering
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine acoustic deformation-potential and Brooks–Herring ionized-impurity rates at the energy level, tau(E)^-1 = sum_i tau_i(E)^-1, and compute mu = e<tau>/m* by quadrature over the Maxwellian. Compare with naive mobility-level Matthiessen for n-Si versus temperature and doping.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Magnetoconductivity tensor and magnetoresistance for energy-dependent relaxation time
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute sigma_xx(B) and sigma_xy(B) as energy integrals of tau/(1 + omega_c^2 tau^2) and omega_c tau^2/(1 + omega_c^2 tau^2) for power-law tau. Obtain rho_xx(B) and the low-field coefficient Delta rho/(rho B^2) from <tau^3><tau>/<tau^2>^2 - 1, and show saturation at high field.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Optimal reduced Fermi level for thermoelectric zT of a parabolic band
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute Seebeck, conductivity and electronic thermal conductivity (Lorenz number) from Fermi-integral transport functions with acoustic scattering. Add lattice thermal conductivity, maximize zT over eta for several material quality factors B, and report the optimal carrier density.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Two-band Hall coefficient and bipolar thermal conductivity of a narrow-gap semiconductor
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute intrinsic electron and hole densities with temperature-dependent gap, and each band's conductivity, Hall and Seebeck contributions. Combine into the total Hall coefficient (finding its sign reversal temperature), the total Seebeck coefficient and the bipolar thermal conductivity term for a Bi2Te3-like material.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Transport integrals in a nonparabolic Kane band
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: With dispersion gamma(E) = E(1 + alpha E), compute the modified density of states and velocity and the acoustic-phonon relaxation time in the nonparabolic band. Evaluate carrier density, mobility and Seebeck coefficient by quadrature for n-InSb, and quantify the deviation from parabolic results versus doping.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Bound-to-bound versus bound-to-continuum QWIP absorption spectra
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Vary the well width so the excited state moves from bound to quasi-bound to continuum, using a box-normalized continuum. Compute the oscillator-strength-weighted Lorentzian absorption spectra and compare peak position and spectral width across the three designs.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Temperature and doping dependence of intersubband absorption via subband population difference
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Find the 2D Fermi level self-consistently from the sheet density, including two subbands. Integrate the occupancy difference between subbands and compute peak absorption coefficient and integrated absorbance versus temperature and doping.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: QWIP detectivity and background-limited infrared performance temperature
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine the absorption quantum efficiency, photoconductive gain, dark current and generation-recombination noise into a detectivity D*. Compute the 300 K background photon flux by Planck integration over the spectral response, and solve for the BLIP temperature where dark and photocurrent noise are equal.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Nonparabolic intersubband energies in InGaAs/AlAsSb wells for telecom wavelengths
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the finite-well bound states with an energy-dependent effective mass from the Kane model by self-consistent root-finding. Compare the 1→2 transition energy and dipole length with the parabolic result for deep wells.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Resonant second-order susceptibility of an asymmetric step quantum well
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the three-level wavefunctions of a step well with a finite-difference eigenvalue solver. Integrate the dipole matrix elements z12, z23 and z13, and evaluate the doubly resonant chi(2) for second-harmonic generation versus pump wavelength.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Composition-driven type-I to type-II crossover in GaAsSb/GaAs
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use bowing-parameter gaps and valence-band-offset interpolation, including a strain correction. Compute the band offsets versus Sb fraction, locate the composition where the conduction band offset changes sign, and give the spatially indirect transition energy.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Kroemer C–V extraction of heterojunction conduction-band offset
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Generate synthetic apparent carrier profiles from a modeled isotype n-n heterojunction. Integrate the apparent-density dipole moment using Kroemer's formula to recover the band offset and interface charge.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Thermionic current over a heterojunction spike (Perlman–Feucht model)
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the spike barrier height versus bias from the depletion electrostatics. Evaluate the thermionic-emission current with the effective Richardson constant and compare it with the diffusion-limited current to locate the regime crossover.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Band alignment of a MoS2/WSe2 van der Waals heterobilayer with interlayer dipole
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine monolayer electron affinities and gaps with an interlayer dipole computed from a transferred-charge sheet capacitor model. Classify the type-II alignment and compute the interlayer exciton energy.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: ABC-model peak IQE and peak-efficiency current density
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the cubic J = qd(An + Bn^2 + Cn^3) for carrier density and compute IQE versus J. Derive the closed-form peak current and peak IQE in terms of A, B and C, and verify them numerically.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Efficiency droop from thermionic electron leakage over an AlGaN blocking layer
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Add to the ABC model a leakage current that grows with the quasi-Fermi level, using a Boltzmann escape integral over the barrier height. Quantify how the droop onset and magnitude depend on the blocking-layer offset.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Luminous efficacy and correlated color temperature of a phosphor-converted white LED
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model the spectrum as a blue Gaussian plus a converted phosphor Gaussian with Stokes loss, and use analytic multi-Gaussian CIE colour-matching functions. Integrate to get the luminous efficacy of radiation, the chromaticity coordinates and the CCT from McCamy's formula.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Thermal droop from temperature-dependent ABC coefficients
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use an Arrhenius SRH coefficient A(T), a B(T) ∝ T^-3/2 radiative coefficient and an activated Auger C(T) to compute IQE versus current at several temperatures. Report the hot/cold factor at a fixed operating current.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Lateral current crowding and local IQE in a mesa LED
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the current-spreading length from the sheet resistances and the specific contact and junction resistances. Evaluate the exponentially decaying current density across the mesa and integrate the position-dependent ABC efficiency to obtain the device IQE.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Berry curvature and valley Chern number of the massive Dirac MoS2 model
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the analytic Berry curvature of a gapped two-band Dirac Hamiltonian with spin-orbit-split valence bands. Integrate it over k with quadrature to obtain valley Chern numbers and check the half-integer values.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Pauli-blocked interband absorbance of doped massive Dirac fermions
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the optical conductivity Re σ(ω) of a gapped Dirac monolayer with Fermi–Dirac occupation by integration over k. Obtain the absorbance versus photon energy and Fermi level, showing the Burstein–Moss onset shift.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Carrier density and Fermi level in a spin-orbit-split TMD conduction band
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use the 2D step density of states with valley and spin degeneracies and a conduction-band spin splitting. Invert n(E_F, T) analytically with logarithm expressions to locate the onset of occupation of the upper spin band.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Variational trion binding energy in a Keldysh-screened monolayer
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use a Chandrasekhar-type two-parameter trial function with the Rytova–Keldysh potential, evaluating the Coulomb matrix elements by Hankel-space quadrature. Minimize the energy to get the trion binding energy versus screening length.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Anisotropic exciton in monolayer black phosphorus with Keldysh screening
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use an anisotropic variational wavefunction with different reduced masses along the armchair and zigzag directions. Evaluate the Keldysh energy by 2D quadrature and minimize to obtain the binding energy and the anisotropy ratio of the exciton radii.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Fermi–Dirac integral F_1/2: quadrature, Joyce–Dixon approximation and inversion
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate F_1/2(η) by robust quadrature and compare it with the Blakemore and Joyce–Dixon approximations. Invert it to obtain the reduced Fermi level from carrier density and quantify the approximation errors.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Intrinsic carrier density of silicon from Varshni gap and temperature-dependent masses
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine the Varshni E_g(T) with temperature-dependent density-of-states masses to compute n_i(T) from 200 to 600 K. Locate the intrinsic Fermi level offset from midgap.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Hole density and Mg ionization fraction in p-GaN
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the neutrality equation for a deep Mg acceptor of about 200 meV with donor compensation and a degeneracy factor of 4. Compute the hole density and ionization fraction versus temperature and Mg concentration, including the decrease in activation energy with density.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Gamma and L valley populations in GaAs at high temperature and doping
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Find the common Fermi level across the Γ and L valleys, using their density-of-states masses and a temperature-dependent valley separation. Compute the fraction of electrons in the L valleys versus temperature.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Fermi level pinning in semi-insulating GaAs by EL2 compensation
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve charge neutrality with shallow acceptors, shallow donors and a midgap EL2 deep donor. Find the conditions for semi-insulating behaviour and compute the resistivity versus EL2 concentration.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Schottky diode I–V with image-force lowering and bias-dependent ideality
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the image-force barrier lowering from the maximum depletion field and evaluate the thermionic-emission current with series resistance. Extract the effective ideality factor versus bias and doping.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Padovani–Stratton specific contact resistance across emission regimes
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute E00 versus doping, then evaluate the specific contact resistance in the thermionic, thermionic-field and field-emission limits. Identify the doping at which the regimes cross over.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Numerical WKB tunneling current through an image-force Schottky barrier
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate the WKB transmission through a parabolic-plus-image-force barrier, multiplied by the Fermi–Dirac supply function, over energy. Compare the resulting specific contact resistance with the analytic Padovani–Stratton forms.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Cowley–Sze Schottky barrier with an interfacial layer and surface states
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the charge balance between the metal, the interface states with a neutral level and the depletion region for the barrier height. Compute the pinning factor and the predicted C–V intercept.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Thermionic-diffusion theory with quantum reflection and phonon scattering
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine the Crowell–Sze recombination and diffusion velocities with energy-dependent quantum-mechanical transmission integrated over the Maxwellian flux. Compute the effective Richardson constant versus field.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Minority-carrier injection ratio of a Schottky diode
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compare the thermionic majority current with the diffusion-limited minority hole current from the n-type substrate. Compute the injection ratio versus barrier height, doping and current level, including the high-injection drift enhancement.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Hot-electron cooling in GaAs by polar LO-phonon emission
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the Fröhlich energy-loss rate per carrier for a Maxwellian electron temperature, including phonon absorption. Integrate dT_e/dt to obtain the cooling curve after excitation with excess energy.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Relaxation-time thermalization of a nonthermal photoexcited distribution
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Relax an initial Gaussian distribution toward the Fermi–Dirac distribution whose μ and T conserve density and energy, solved by 2D root-finding at each step. Track the entropy and the approach to equilibrium.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Band-filling differential transmission transients in pump–probe spectroscopy
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the absorption change from phase-space filling with time-dependent quasi-Fermi distributions for electrons and holes. Produce ΔT/T spectra versus probe energy and delay, with optional convolution with the pulse.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Gamma–L intervalley transfer and return kinetics in GaAs after a high-energy pump
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use rate equations with intervalley deformation-potential scattering rates evaluated from the density of final states. Compute the transient Γ-valley population, which controls the delayed rise of the band-edge signal.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Displacive coherent-phonon transient reflectivity convolved with a Gaussian pulse
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model the reflectivity change as a damped cosine plus a step response, with an analytic convolution with the pulse via error functions. Fit the phonon frequency, dephasing and initial phase.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Drude–Smith analysis of transient THz photoconductivity
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the complex conductivity σ(ω) for Drude and Drude–Smith models and the resulting thin-film THz transmission change from the Tinkham formula. Fit the scattering time and backscattering parameter.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Exciton Rabi oscillations and pulse-area theorem with T1 and T2 decay
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate the optical Bloch equations for a two-level exciton driven by a sech or Gaussian pulse. Compute the final inversion versus pulse area and detuning, including the damping effect of dephasing.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Free-carrier interband absorption from time-domain k-resolved polarization
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate the linear polarization equations without Coulomb terms on a k-grid under weak delta-pulse excitation. Fourier transform the macroscopic polarization to obtain the square-root absorption edge.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Heavy-hole–light-hole quantum beats in four-wave mixing
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model a V-type three-level system with a shared ground state. Compute the time-integrated FWM signal versus delay, showing beats at the HH–LH splitting, and extract the dephasing times.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Valley-selective optical Stark shift of excitons under circularly polarized pumping
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the AC Stark shift of the K and K' excitons from a dressed two-level model with detuned sigma+ pumping. Compute the resulting pump–probe differential absorption lineshape for each valley.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Rabi flopping washout in band-to-band free-carrier Bloch equations
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate the uncoupled k-resolved two-level equations for an intense pulse across a parabolic band. Integrate the final occupations over k to obtain the excitation density versus pulse area, showing how dephasing of the k-distribution suppresses the oscillations.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Phonon-induced damping of quantum-dot Rabi rotations
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the weak-coupling damping rate from the super-Ohmic deformation-potential spectral density evaluated at the Rabi frequency. Integrate the damped Bloch equations to give occupation versus pulse area at several temperatures.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Injection-dependent SRH lifetime versus trap energy
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the full SRH lifetime with n1 and p1 for traps across the gap and asymmetric capture cross sections. Compute τ(Δn) curves and the crossover injection level for several trap depths.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Temperature-dependent lifetime spectroscopy for defect energy extraction
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Generate τ_SRH(T) including temperature-dependent n_i and capture cross sections. Fit the Arrhenius high-temperature slope and use the defect parameter solution surface to identify the trap level.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Surface recombination velocity from an interface-trap continuum with fixed charge
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Find the surface carrier densities from the band bending set by fixed charge, then integrate the extended SRH rate over the energy distribution of interface states. Compute the effective surface recombination velocity versus injection.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Trap filling and PL quantum yield versus fluence in halide perovskite films
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use rate equations with a finite density of trap states, plus radiative and Auger terms. Compute the steady-state PLQY versus excitation density and the trap-filling threshold.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Auger-1 limited lifetime of n-HgCdTe versus composition and temperature
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Beattie–Landsberg–Blakemore τ_A1 using the Hansen gap formula and the overlap-integral parameter. Compute the intrinsic lifetime and the R0A diffusion limit for LWIR compositions.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Förster radius from the spectral overlap integral
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Normalize the donor emission and acceptor molar absorption spectra and integrate J(λ) = ∫F_D ε_A λ^4 dλ. Compute R0 for several values of κ², refractive index and donor quantum yield.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: FRET efficiency and donor decay with a Gaussian distance distribution
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Average the rate k(r) = (1/τ_D)(R0/r)^6 over a Gaussian distribution of donor–acceptor distances. Compute the multi-exponential donor decay and the apparent versus true mean distance.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Distance scaling of Förster quenching near an acceptor plane and half-space
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate the r^-6 dipole rates over a 2D acceptor sheet and a semi-infinite acceptor layer to obtain the d^-4 and d^-3 laws. Compute the donor quantum yield versus distance from the interface.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Exciton–exciton annihilation from fluence-dependent PL decays
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use the analytic solution of dn/dt = −kn − γn² with a time-dependent γ(t) for diffusion-limited annihilation. Fit the annihilation rate and convert it to a diffusion coefficient with the Smoluchowski reaction radius.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Förster to Dexter crossover in short-range triplet energy transfer
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compare the r^-6 Förster rate with the exponential Dexter rate built from an overlap integral and an attenuation length. Find the crossover distance and the total transfer efficiency versus separation.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Kinetic Monte Carlo Förster hopping in a polydisperse nanocrystal solid
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Simulate excitons hopping on a cubic lattice of quantum dots with Gaussian size dispersion and size-dependent overlap integrals. Compute the mean squared displacement, diffusion length and energetic red-shift.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Inokuti–Hirayama donor decay with random acceptors in 1D, 2D and 3D
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the donor survival function exp(−t/τ − cΓ(1 − d/6)(t/τ)^(d/6)) in each dimension. Compare it with Monte Carlo averages over random acceptor configurations and extract the acceptor concentration.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Diffusion-limited triplet quenching with a transient Smoluchowski rate
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the time-dependent rate k(t) = 4πRD(1 + R/√(πDt)) and integrate it to obtain the phosphorescence decay under quencher doping. Derive the Stern–Volmer plots and the triplet diffusion length.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Quadratic Stark shift of e1–hh1 transition: perturbation theory versus exact Airy solution
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: For an infinite GaAs quantum well in a uniform field, compute the field-induced e1 and hh1 shifts using second-order perturbation sums over unperturbed states (Bastard formula). Compare with exact Airy-function eigenvalues obtained by root finding.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Quasi-bound state lifetime in a tilted finite quantum well from Airy transfer matrix
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model a GaAs/AlGaAs well under bias with piecewise Airy functions. Locate quasi-bound resonances from peaks of the energy-dependent phase or density of states, then extract the tunneling escape lifetime from the Lorentzian resonance width versus field.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Field dependence of electron–hole overlap and excitonic absorption strength in a GaAs well
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the electron and heavy-hole envelope functions in a biased finite well by finite differences. Compute the squared overlap integral versus field and scale the excitonic oscillator strength to predict how the peak absorption drops.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Enhanced linear Stark shift in asymmetric coupled quantum wells
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the electron and hole states of two tunnel-coupled wells of unequal width under bias with a finite-difference Schrödinger solver. Compute the transition energy versus field and extract the effective linear Stark coefficient. Compare it with the quadratic shift of a single well.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Extinction ratio and insertion loss of a QCSE electroabsorption modulator
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model the absorption as a Gaussian-broadened exciton peak plus a continuum step, whose position and strength follow the field-dependent Stark shift and overlap. Combine this with the waveguide confinement factor and device length to compute transmission versus bias, extinction ratio and insertion loss at the operating wavelength.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Permanent dipole and polarizability of a quantum-dot exciton from Stark-shift fitting
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model a lens-like quantum dot as a separable harmonic confinement with different electron and hole centers. Compute the exciton energy versus vertical field by numerical diagonalization, then fit a quadratic to extract the built-in dipole and the polarizability.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Chirp alpha parameter of an electroabsorption modulator via Kramers–Kronig
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the field-induced absorption change spectrum from a Stark-shifted broadened exciton model. Obtain the refractive-index change by numerical Kramers–Kronig principal-value integration, then evaluate the chirp parameter Δn/Δk versus bias and wavelength.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: QCSE in tensile-strained Ge/SiGe quantum wells for silicon modulators
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the direct-gap Γ-valley electron and heavy-hole subbands of Ge wells on a relaxed SiGe buffer, including the strain shift of the gap. Evaluate the Stark shift and overlap versus field to estimate the operating wavelength near 1.4–1.55 µm.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Defect formation energy diagram and charge transition levels of a vacancy
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Given total-energy differences for several charge states, chemical potentials, the VBM and a correction term, build formation energy versus Fermi level lines. Take their lower envelope and compute all thermodynamic transition levels, including negative-U ordering.
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.area: Defect formation energies and charge transitions

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Self-consistent Fermi level and native-defect concentrations in ZnO
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine Boltzmann defect concentrations for several charged native defects with Fermi–Dirac free-carrier densities from parabolic bands. Solve charge neutrality for the Fermi level by bracketing root finding as a function of temperature and oxygen chemical potential.
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.area: Defect formation energies and charge transitions

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Finite-size correction of charged-defect supercell energies by Makov–Payne extrapolation
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the Madelung point-charge correction and the quadrupole L^-3 term for cubic supercells of increasing size. Fit synthetic supercell energies to extrapolate the isolated-defect formation energy, then compare corrected and raw transition levels.
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.area: Defect formation energies and charge transitions

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Configuration-coordinate luminescence lineshape and Huang–Rhys factor of a deep defect
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: From parabolic one-dimensional configuration-coordinate curves, compute the thermal and optical transition levels, the Franck–Condon shifts and the Huang–Rhys factor. Build the temperature-dependent emission lineshape as a Poisson-weighted sum of broadened phonon replicas.
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.area: Defect formation energies and charge transitions

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Multiphonon nonradiative capture coefficient versus temperature in a 1D CC model
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute vibrational overlap integrals between displaced harmonic oscillators, numerically or via Hermite polynomials. Combine them with a thermal-occupation-weighted sum and an energy-conserving Gaussian smearing to get the capture coefficient C(T) and its Arrhenius-like activation.
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.area: Defect formation energies and charge transitions

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Self-compensation limit of p-type doping by native donor formation
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model an acceptor dopant with a solubility limit together with a compensating donor whose formation energy falls as the Fermi level drops. Solve charge neutrality versus dopant chemical potential to find the maximum achievable hole density and the Fermi-level pinning energy.
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.area: Defect formation energies and charge transitions

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Deep-level transient spectroscopy: trap energy and capture cross section from rate windows
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Simulate capacitance transients for traps with given activation energy and cross section, using T^2-corrected emission rates. Compute DLTS spectra for several boxcar rate windows and extract the trap signature from an Arrhenius plot of the peak temperatures.
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.area: Defect formation energies and charge transitions

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Interband magneto-absorption of bulk GaAs and reduced-mass extraction from a fan chart
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the absorption as a sum over Landau-level pairs, each with a 1D inverse-square-root density-of-states edge, convolved with Lorentzian broadening. Locate the peak positions versus B and fit the fan chart to recover the reduced mass and the gap.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Energy-dependent cyclotron mass in InSb from the Kane two-band model
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use the nonparabolic Kane dispersion to compute the cyclotron mass at the Fermi energy versus carrier density, and the nonparabolic Landau levels versus field. Compare the predicted cyclotron resonance energies with the parabolic approximation.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Tilted-field coincidence method for the effective g-factor of a 2DEG
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute spin-split Landau levels whose Zeeman energy depends on the total field while the orbital energy depends only on the perpendicular component. Find the tilt angles where spin-up and spin-down levels coincide and invert them for |g*|m*.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Fock–Darwin spectrum and far-infrared Kohn modes of a parabolic quantum dot
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the Fock–Darwin single-particle levels versus magnetic field and the dipole-allowed transition energies ω±. Include the filling of levels with N electrons and the field-dependent ground-state angular momentum transitions.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Magnetoplasmon dispersion of a 2DEG grating-coupler cyclotron resonance
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the 2D plasma frequency at grating wavevectors including dielectric screening by the substrate and a gate. Combine it with the cyclotron frequency into magnetoplasmon modes and evaluate the Drude magneto-transmission spectrum versus B.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Diamagnetic shift of excitons from a variational anisotropic hydrogen model
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Variationally minimize the exciton energy in a magnetic field using an anisotropic trial function and quadrature of the expectation values. Extract the weak-field diamagnetic coefficient and the exciton radius, and show the crossover toward Landau-like behavior at high field.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Bilayer graphene Landau levels and allowed magneto-optical transitions
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the two-band chiral Landau levels E ∝ sqrt(n(n−1)) together with the four-band corrections from interlayer hopping by diagonalizing in a truncated oscillator basis. Enumerate the Δ|n| = 1 transitions and their field dependence.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Valence-band Landau levels from the Luttinger Hamiltonian in axial approximation
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Build the 4×4 Luttinger Hamiltonian in a magnetic field using ladder operators and diagonalize it in a truncated harmonic-oscillator basis for kz = 0. Obtain the heavy- and light-hole Landau ladders and their mixing for GaAs parameters.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Varshni versus Bose–Einstein fits of temperature-dependent band-gap data
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Fit synthetic PL-gap data for GaAs or InP by nonlinear least squares to the Varshni and the O'Donnell–Chen Bose–Einstein models. Compare dEg/dT, the low-temperature plateau behavior and the inferred average phonon energy.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: InGaN quantum-well composition for green emission including bowing and confinement
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine the Varshni gap of InN and GaN, composition bowing and finite-well confinement energies. Invert for the indium fraction that gives 530 nm emission at a chosen well width and junction temperature.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Direct–indirect crossover of GaAsP versus temperature for red LEDs
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Interpolate the Γ and X valley energies of GaAs1−xPx with separate bowing and Varshni parameters. Find the crossover composition versus temperature and the shortest achievable direct-gap emission wavelength.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Band anticrossing in dilute-nitride GaInNAs for 1.3 µm emission
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the E± conduction subbands from the two-level band-anticrossing model with composition-dependent coupling. Include the In-content and strain shifts, and solve for the N fraction that reaches the 1.3 µm gap.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Valence-band anticrossing and spin-orbit crossover in GaAsBi alloys
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model Bi incorporation with a 6-band valence anticrossing that raises the heavy/light-hole edge, together with a composition-dependent spin-orbit splitting. Compute Eg(x) and Δso(x) and find where Δso exceeds Eg to suppress CHSH Auger.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: HgCdTe cutoff wavelength design using the Hansen empirical gap formula
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Hansen Eg(x, T) relation for Hg1−xCdxTe and invert it to find the composition for 10 µm cutoff at 77 K. Compute the cutoff drift with temperature and the composition tolerance for ±0.5 µm.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Mixed-halide perovskite composition for a 1.68 eV tandem top cell
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use the bowed band gap of MAPb(I1−xBrx)3 to invert for the target gap. Evaluate the detailed-balance tandem efficiency versus x using a blackbody-approximated solar spectrum and numerical integrals for the photocurrent and radiative recombination.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Composition of compressively strained InGaAs well for a 980 nm pump laser
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the unstrained InGaAs gap with bowing, then add the hydrostatic and shear deformation-potential shifts for coherent growth on GaAs and the quantum-well confinement energy. Solve for the indium content that lases at 980 nm.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: S-shaped PL peak temperature dependence from band-tail localization
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine a Varshni gap with an Eliseev-type localization correction −σ²/kT, and also simulate PL from a Gaussian tail with thermal redistribution. Fit both to an S-shaped peak-energy curve to extract the disorder parameter σ.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Si1−xGex band gap: X-like/L-like branches and strained-layer gap on Si
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the piecewise relaxed SiGe gap with its kink near x ≈ 0.85. Compute the reduced indirect gap of pseudomorphic SiGe on Si from the strain deformation potentials, and invert for the composition giving a target gap.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Mode degeneracy lifting in gain-coupled versus index-coupled DFB lasers
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Generalize the coupling coefficient to complex values κ = κi + iκg and solve for the threshold gains of the two band-edge modes. Compute the threshold difference versus the gain-coupling fraction.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Si/SiGe modulation-doped quantum well 2DEG density versus spacer thickness
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Self-consistently solve the Schrödinger and Poisson equations for a strained-Si channel between SiGe barriers with a remote donor layer and a surface Fermi-level pinning condition. Compute the 2DEG density and subband energies versus spacer thickness.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Gate-voltage charge control and quantum capacitance in a GaAs HEMT
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Iterate Schrödinger–Poisson for a Schottky-gated AlGaAs/GaAs HEMT over a range of gate biases. Extract the 2DEG density versus Vg, the threshold voltage and the gate capacitance, separating the geometric and quantum (centroid and DOS) contributions.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Density-of-states bottleneck in an InGaAs-channel MOS capacitor
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve Schrödinger–Poisson for a thin high-k/InGaAs gate stack with a low-mass channel, including a nonparabolic Γ valley. Compute the inversion charge and gate C-V, and show the capacitance reduction from the low quantum capacitance.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Exchange-correlation correction to subband energies in a self-consistent 2DEG
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Add the Hedin–Lundqvist LDA exchange-correlation potential to a Schrödinger–Poisson loop for a GaAs heterojunction. Compute how it changes the subband splitting, the second-subband onset and the confinement width relative to the Hartree result.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Radial Schrödinger–Poisson for a core–shell nanowire electron gas
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the cylindrical radial Schrödinger equation for each angular momentum together with the radial Poisson equation in a GaAs/AlGaAs core–shell nanowire with shell doping. Obtain the self-consistent tubular electron density and the 1D subband ladder.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Tunable effective gap of an n-i-p-i doping superlattice under photoexcitation
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Self-consistently compute the space-charge band modulation of a GaAs nipi superlattice. Then add photoexcited electron and hole populations to find how the effective gap and subbands change with excess carrier density.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Catastrophic optical mirror damage threshold from facet heating
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the 1D steady heat equation near a laser facet with heat sources from surface recombination and temperature-dependent absorption that shrinks the local gap. Find the optical power at which the iterated facet temperature runs away.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Transient thermal impedance of a laser on a multilayer submount by Stehfest inversion
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Derive the Laplace-domain thermal impedance of a 1D multilayer stack (chip, solder, submount, heatsink) using thermal transmission matrices. Numerically invert it with the Stehfest algorithm to obtain Zth(t) and the effective thermal time constants.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Thermal lensing in a broad-area diode laser
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the lateral temperature profile from a stripe heat source over a substrate by line-source integration. Convert it to a lateral index profile via dn/dT and solve the lateral waveguide modes to find the induced number of guided modes and the beam narrowing.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Heating-induced wavelength chirp of a pulsed DFB laser
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model the active-region temperature during a current pulse with a two-time-constant thermal response. Map the temperature to the Bragg wavelength through dn/dT and thermal expansion, then compute the intra-pulse frequency chirp and the time-averaged linewidth broadening.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Cell temperature and efficiency of a concentrator solar cell versus concentration
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine a detailed-balance or diode-model cell (Voc rising logarithmically with concentration, temperature-dependent J0 and series-resistance loss) with a thermal resistance to ambient. Solve self-consistently for cell temperature and efficiency, and find the optimal concentration.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Characteristic temperatures T0 and T1 and maximum operating temperature of a laser
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: From exponential temperature laws for threshold current and slope efficiency combined with junction self-heating via the thermal resistance, compute L–I curves at several heatsink temperatures. Find the maximum heatsink temperature for a required output power.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Temperature-driven mode hopping of a Fabry–Perot laser
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Track the gain-peak shift (from Varshni) against the cavity-mode shift (from dn/dT) with heatsink temperature. Determine the lasing mode as the one nearest the gain peak, and compute the staircase λ(T) and its mean slope.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Marcatili versus effective index method for a rectangular channel waveguide
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the propagation constant of the fundamental E^y_11 mode of a buried rectangular InP/InGaAsP waveguide with Marcatili's separable approximation and with the effective index method. Compare both with a 2D finite-difference eigen-solution.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Optimizing SCH thickness for maximum quantum-well confinement in a laser
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use a multilayer transfer-matrix mode solver for a five-layer separate-confinement heterostructure with a thin quantum well. Compute the QW confinement factor versus SCH width and find its optimum.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Internal optical loss from free-carrier absorption in doped claddings
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the transverse mode profile of a p-i-n laser waveguide. Evaluate the modal loss as the overlap of mode intensity with layer-wise free-carrier absorption coefficients that scale with doping, and explore doping-profile trade-offs.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Far-field divergence of a laser diode from its transverse near field
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the fundamental transverse mode of the vertical waveguide and Fourier-transform the near field with an obliquity factor to obtain the far-field intensity pattern. Extract the FWHM divergence versus core thickness.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Laser-to-fiber coupling efficiency from mode overlap integrals
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the elliptical laser mode, approximated by fitted Gaussians or taken from a slab solver, and its normalized overlap integral with a single-mode fiber Gaussian mode. Include lateral offset and longitudinal gap, and compare with a tapered spot-size converter mode.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Waveguide photodetector external quantum efficiency versus length
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine the absorber confinement factor from a slab mode solver with the material absorption coefficient, the free-carrier loss in the claddings and the facet coupling. Compute the quantum efficiency versus device length and the length needed for 90% of the maximum.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Hakki–Paoli net modal gain extraction from subthreshold ASE spectra
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Generate Fabry–Perot amplified spontaneous emission spectra from a gain model and the Airy cavity function. Extract the net modal gain from the peak-to-valley fringe ratio and compare it with the input gain, including resolution-limited errors.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Threshold current density of a three-level quantum cascade laser
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve steady-state rate equations for the upper, lower and injector populations using the scattering lifetimes, compute the population inversion versus current density, and combine with the gain cross section, waveguide and mirror losses to obtain Jth and slope efficiency.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: TE/TM gain polarization of strained quantum wells from heavy- and light-hole splitting
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the heavy- and light-hole subband edges of a strained InGaAsP well. Combine them with polarization-dependent momentum matrix-element factors and Fermi inversion to get the TE and TM gain spectra versus strain, and find the strain for polarization-insensitive gain.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Space-charge-limited current with traps in a single-carrier diode
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the coupled Poisson and drift-diffusion equations for a single carrier type with an exponential or single-level trap distribution. Reproduce the Ohmic, trap-limited and Mott–Gurney J ∝ V² regimes and the trap-filled-limit voltage.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: High-frequency MOS capacitor C–V from the numerical Poisson solution
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the 1D Poisson equation in a p-Si MOS capacitor versus gate voltage with Newton iteration. Compute the low- and high-frequency C–V curves (frozen minority carriers for the latter), and extract the flat-band and threshold voltages and the minimum capacitance.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Internal quantum efficiency versus bias of a p-i-n LED by drift-diffusion
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the drift-diffusion equations of a double-heterostructure p-i-n with band offsets entering as position-dependent potentials. Include radiative, SRH and Auger recombination in the active region, and compute the radiative fraction of the total current versus bias.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Graded-bandgap drift field and collection efficiency in a solar cell absorber
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Include a position-dependent band gap and electron affinity, such as a CIGS Ga grading, as quasi-fields in Scharfetter–Gummel drift-diffusion. Compute the spectral collection efficiency and Jsc versus grading strength, compared with an ungraded absorber.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Specific detectivity of an extrinsic photoconductor with G-R noise and gain
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute responsivity, generation-recombination noise current and D* of a biased photoconductor versus bias field. Photoconductive gain is the lifetime-to-transit-time ratio, and Johnson noise of the load is included.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: BLIP detectivity versus cutoff wavelength and cold-shield f-number
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate the 300 K Planck photon flux below the cutoff over a cold-shield field of view to get background-limited D* versus cutoff wavelength and f-number. Compare photovoltaic and photoconductive limits.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Receiver sensitivity of a p-i-n photodiode with transimpedance amplifier noise
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine shot noise, feedback-resistor thermal noise and amplifier voltage noise filtered by the input capacitance, using Personick bandwidth integrals. Find the minimum average optical power that reaches Q=6 (BER 1e-9) versus bit rate.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Microbolometer NETD from Johnson, 1/f and thermal fluctuation noise
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model a VOx microbolometer pixel through its thermal conductance, heat capacity and TCR. Integrate each noise spectrum over the readout bandwidth and convert to NETD using the derivative of Planck radiance through f/1 optics.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: NETD of a photon-detector focal plane array from well-capacity limits
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate the temperature derivative of the band-limited Planck photon flux for MWIR and LWIR bands. Compute the integration time set by well capacity and the resulting shot-noise-limited NETD.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Dark-current components of an InGaAs/InP photodiode versus bias and temperature
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Sum diffusion, SRH depletion generation and band-to-band tunneling currents of a p-i-n junction. Compute Arrhenius activation energies and the bias at which tunneling dominates the noise and D*.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Dark current and detectivity of an nBn barrier infrared detector
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model a unipolar-barrier detector in which depletion G-R current is suppressed and only diffusion current remains. Compare its D* versus temperature with a conventional p-n diode and extract the activation energies.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: SPAD dark count rate from thermal generation and trap-assisted tunneling
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate the SRH generation rate, with Hurkx field-enhancement factor, over the depletion region and weight it by the avalanche triggering probability. Report dark count rate versus temperature and excess bias.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Shot-noise-limited heterodyne versus direct detection NEP of a photodiode
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute SNR for coherent heterodyne detection with a strong local oscillator and for thermal-noise-limited direct detection. Find the LO power needed to reach the quantum limit and compare the two NEPs.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Gain-bandwidth tradeoff of a trap-sensitized hybrid quantum-dot photoconductor
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model photoconductive gain set by trap lifetime and its dependence on intensity through trap filling. Compute frequency-dependent responsivity, 1/f-plus-shot noise and NEP versus modulation frequency.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Pyroelectric detector responsivity and D* versus chopping frequency
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine thermal and electrical time constants in the current/voltage responsivity of a pyroelectric element. Add Johnson, dielectric-loss and thermal fluctuation noise, then find the frequency of peak D*.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Quantum-dot infrared photodetector dark current and detectivity with capture probability
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model QDIP dark current from thermionic emission out of dot levels using a 3D-carrier density with capture probability and photoconductive gain. Compute D* versus temperature and compare with a QWIP.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Six-escape-cone light extraction of a cuboid LED chip with absorbing substrate
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate angle-dependent Fresnel transmission over the top and four side escape cones, including path-length absorption through the chip. Compare transparent and absorbing substrates.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Resonant-cavity LED extraction enhancement integrated over the escape cone
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the angle- and wavelength-dependent Airy enhancement of an emitter between a DBR and a metal mirror. Integrate over the emission spectrum and the escape cone to get the extraction gain versus cavity detuning.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Separating IQE and extraction efficiency from EQE-versus-current fitting
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Fit measured EQE(I) to an ABC model with unknown extraction efficiency, using the peak-efficiency normalization method (Dai et al.). Recover the A/B/C ratios, the absolute IQE and the extraction efficiency.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Nonuniform hole distribution across InGaN multi-quantum wells and droop
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Distribute injected holes over N wells with an exponential decay length set by hole transport. Compute the per-well ABC recombination and the overall IQE versus current, comparing it with a uniform-injection model.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: OLED power partition into air, substrate, waveguide and surface-plasmon modes
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate the dipole power spectrum over in-plane wavevector for a multilayer OLED stack using Fresnel coefficients. Split the integral into outcoupled, substrate, waveguided and SPP fractions versus emitter-cathode distance.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Extraction of TM-polarized emission from AlGaN deep-UV LEDs
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate the angular emission patterns of TE and TM dipoles inside the escape cone with polarization-resolved Fresnel transmission. Compute extraction efficiency versus the TE/TM ratio set by Al content.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Electroluminescent cooling: wall-plug efficiency above unity at low bias
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine a diode I-V with an ABC IQE and extraction efficiency to compute WPE = optical power / IV at biases below hν/q. Find the conditions on extraction efficiency and IQE that give net cooling.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Multipass extraction in a thin-film LED with a back reflector and reabsorption
