materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model photons trapped outside the escape cone as making repeated passes, with mirror reflectivity and active-layer reabsorption. Sum the geometric series to get extraction efficiency versus mirror reflectance and film thickness.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Phase-space-filling saturation of B and C coefficients in efficiency droop
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use a density-dependent ABC model with B(n) = B0/(1+n/n*) and similar saturation of C. Compute IQE, the peak-efficiency current and the droop at high current, and compare with the constant-coefficient model.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Cody model of Urbach energy temperature dependence
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine static disorder with an Einstein-phonon thermal contribution to get the Urbach energy E_U(T). Generate exponential band tails and fit the static and dynamic parameters to absorption edges at several temperatures.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Bias in Tauc-plot band-gap extraction from Urbach-tailed absorption
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Generate direct and indirect absorption spectra with Urbach tails, then apply linear Tauc fits over different energy windows. Quantify the extracted-gap error versus Urbach energy and fitting range.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Sub-gap absorption from JDOS convolution with a band-tail distribution
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Numerically convolve the square-root direct JDOS with a generalized exponential/Gaussian tail kernel (Katahara–Hillhouse). Fit the resulting continuous absorption to extract the gap and the tail parameter.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Burstein–Moss shift in degenerate n-InAs with a nonparabolic conduction band
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Find the Fermi level from a Kane density of states. Compute the Pauli-blocked direct absorption edge, including the hole recoil energy, and the optical-gap shift versus electron density.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Tensile-strain extension of Ge-on-Si direct absorption at 1550 nm
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Shift the Γ gap and split heavy/light holes using deformation potentials for biaxial tensile strain. Compute direct-gap absorption with the valence-split JDOS and the resulting C/L-band responsivity of a Ge photodetector.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Two-photon absorption spectra from Sheik-Bahae band-gap scaling
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the two-band TPA dispersion function F(2ħω/Eg) with Eg⁻³ scaling. Compute β(λ) for GaAs, InP and Si-like gaps and the photon energy of maximum TPA.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Three-valley Monte Carlo velocity-field curve and valley populations in GaAs
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Run nonparabolic Γ, L and X valleys with polar-optical, acoustic and intervalley scattering in an ensemble MC. Obtain the steady-state drift velocity, negative differential mobility and valley occupancy versus field.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Transient velocity overshoot in GaAs after a field step
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Apply a step electric field to a thermalized GaAs ensemble in a three-valley MC. Track the average velocity, energy and L-valley fraction versus time and distance to quantify overshoot.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Field-dependent diffusion coefficient from Monte Carlo velocity autocorrelation
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Record velocity fluctuations in a steady-state MC simulation and integrate the autocorrelation function to get longitudinal diffusion coefficients versus field. Compare with the low-field Einstein relation.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Impact ionization coefficient from Monte Carlo with a Keldysh soft threshold
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Add a Keldysh-form impact ionization rate to a high-field MC. Compute ionization events per unit length versus inverse field and fit Chynoweth parameters.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Monte Carlo peak velocity and threshold field in wurtzite GaN
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use a nonparabolic Γ valley plus an upper valley with strong polar-optical and intervalley scattering in an ensemble MC. Extract the peak velocity, threshold field and saturation velocity at 300 K and 600 K.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Low-field Monte Carlo mobility of n-Si with Brooks–Herring impurity scattering
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Include screened ionized-impurity scattering with anisotropic angle selection in a Si MC. Compute the low-field mobility versus donor density and compare with the Caughey–Thomas fit.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Spin-orbit split-off energy of Ge and GaAs from empirical pseudopotentials
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Add a spin-orbit term to the local EPM Hamiltonian in a doubled plane-wave basis. Diagonalize at Γ and along Λ to obtain Δ0 and the heavy/light-hole splitting.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Zone folding in a short-period Si/Ge (001) superlattice by supercell EPM
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Build a tetragonal supercell plane-wave Hamiltonian from continuous Si and Ge atomic pseudopotentials. Diagonalize at folded k-points to show quasi-direct gap formation versus period.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Antisymmetric form factors and the gap trend of the Ge–GaAs–ZnSe isoelectronic series
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Keep the symmetric form factors fixed and scale the antisymmetric ones. Diagonalize the EPM Hamiltonian to track the Γ, X and L gaps and the ionic gap at X across the isoelectronic sequence.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: SPAD afterpulsing probability from trap emission and hold-off time
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model carriers captured during an avalanche that are released from multiple trap levels with Arrhenius emission rates. Weight the release events by the recovering triggering probability to get afterpulsing probability versus hold-off time and temperature.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Excess noise of a staircase APD with stepwise ionization probability
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model a Capasso staircase APD in which each band-edge step ionizes with probability p, with weak hole feedback. Compute the mean gain and excess noise factor versus number of stages using branching statistics.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Callaway lattice thermal conductivity with Umklapp, boundary and point-defect scattering
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate the Debye-model Callaway expression with a Matthiessen-combined phonon relaxation time. Compute κ_L(T) for Si and isotope-enriched Si and locate the low-temperature peak.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Compatibility factor and efficiency of a thermoelectric leg with temperature-dependent properties
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate Snyder's reduced-current formalism along a leg with S(T), ρ(T) and κ(T). Compute the leg efficiency versus relative current and compare segmented and single-material legs.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Energy-filtering Seebeck enhancement from a barrier in the transport distribution
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Cut off the transport function below a barrier energy (hot-carrier filtering). Recompute σ, S, κ_e and the power factor with Fermi integrals, then optimize barrier height and Fermi level.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Lorenz number versus reduced Fermi level and the single-parabolic-band approximation
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute L(η) from Fermi–Dirac transport integrals for several scattering exponents. Express it as a function of Seebeck coefficient and quantify the error of the Kim et al. formula L = 1.5 + exp(−|S|/116).

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Thermoelectric generator maximum power with electrical and thermal contact resistances
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Build a composite model of a TEG module with contact resistances and heat-exchanger thermal resistances. Optimize leg length and load ratio for maximum power density and efficiency.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Explicit single-diode solar cell I-V and maximum power via Lambert W
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Write the single-diode model with Rs and Rsh in closed form using the Lambert W function. Maximize power, then compute fill factor and its sensitivity to Rs and Rsh.
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.area: Solar cell equivalent circuits and parameter extraction

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Five-parameter PV module model from datasheet key points
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the nonlinear system for Iph, I0, n, Rs and Rsh from Isc, Voc, (Imp, Vmp) and the dP/dV=0 condition. Predict the I-V curve at another irradiance and temperature.
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.area: Solar cell equivalent circuits and parameter extraction

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Tiedje–Yablonovitch limiting efficiency of crystalline silicon versus thickness
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine Lambertian absorptance of an indirect-gap absorption model with radiative and Auger recombination. Solve for the J-V and find the optimal wafer thickness and maximum efficiency.
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.area: Solar cell equivalent circuits and parameter extraction

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Detailed-balance efficiency of an intermediate-band solar cell
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Implement the Luque–Martí model with three absorption thresholds and the current balance at the intermediate band. Optimize the gap and IB position for maximum efficiency.
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.area: Solar cell equivalent circuits and parameter extraction

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Short-circuit current from EQE and the spectral mismatch factor
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate an EQE curve against reference and simulator spectra. Compute the spectral mismatch factor relative to a reference cell and the corrected Jsc.
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.area: Solar cell equivalent circuits and parameter extraction

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Ross–Nozik limiting efficiency of a hot-carrier solar cell
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the detailed-balance current and the hot-carrier temperature and chemical potential with energy-selective contacts. Maximize efficiency versus absorber gap and extraction energy.
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.area: Solar cell equivalent circuits and parameter extraction

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Free spectral range and group index of a dispersive Fabry–Perot laser cavity
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute longitudinal mode positions with a Sellmeier/Afromowitz-type n(λ). Derive the group index and the wavelength-dependent mode spacing, and verify the FSR formula.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Littrow external-cavity diode laser composite reflectivity and mode-hop-free tuning
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine the chip facet and grating feedback into a wavelength-dependent effective reflectivity. Compute the threshold gain of compound-cavity modes and the pivot condition for mode-hop-free tuning.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Mode selectivity of a cleaved-coupled-cavity laser
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the effective reflectivity of a two-segment coupled cavity versus wavelength with a gap phase. Determine the threshold gain margin between the main and side modes.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Single-layer dielectric facet coating design and resulting laser threshold
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute facet reflectance versus coating index and thickness with thin-film interference. Choose an AR/HR combination and evaluate mirror loss, threshold gain and front-facet slope efficiency.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Gain ripple of a semiconductor optical amplifier from residual facet reflectivity
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Fabry–Perot amplifier gain formula with single-pass gain and small facet reflectivities. Compute peak-to-valley ripple and find the maximum reflectivity that keeps ripple under 1 dB.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Threshold of a microring laser from coupling and intrinsic quality factors
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Relate intrinsic loss, bus-coupling and total Q to threshold modal gain and output coupling efficiency. Optimize the coupling gap for maximum slope efficiency.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Sidewall-roughness scattering loss of a semiconductor waveguide (Payne–Lacey)
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Payne–Lacey integral for propagation loss from exponential-autocorrelation roughness of a slab waveguide. Compute loss versus core width and correlation length, and its effect on laser threshold.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Exact quadratic Stark shift in a parabolic quantum well
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve electron and hole states in a parabolic well under a field by finite differences. Verify the exact shift −e²F²/2k and the overlap reduction, and compare with a square well of equal ground energy.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Wannier–Stark ladder and oblique transitions in a biased GaAs/AlAs superlattice
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Diagonalize a biased superlattice Hamiltonian to get Wannier–Stark levels spaced by eFd. Compute localization lengths and the oscillator strengths of the n=0, ±1 oblique transitions versus field.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Size-dependent Stark shift of a colloidal CdSe quantum dot by basis expansion
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Expand electron and hole states in spherical Bessel functions of the dot. Diagonalize the field term to get the Stark shift, polarizability and overlap reduction versus radius.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Optical bistability of a self-electro-optic effect device from load-line analysis
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine the QCSE absorption-versus-voltage curve of a p-i-n MQW diode with a series resistor load line. Find the multiple self-consistent operating points and the bistable input-power range.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Optimal well width for an electroabsorption modulator figure of merit
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute field-induced exciton shift, overlap-weighted absorption and broadening versus well width. Maximize Δα/α0 at a fixed drive voltage, trading Stark shift against oscillator-strength loss.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Blue-shifting Stark effect in a stepped asymmetric quantum well
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve a step-potential well under positive and negative bias by finite differences. Show the bias-polarity-dependent blue and red shifts of the e1–hh1 transition and their overlap changes.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: MSM photodetector dark current from back-to-back Schottky barriers and responsivity
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute dark current of a biased metal-semiconductor-metal detector from thermionic emission over reverse-biased barriers with image-force lowering. Evaluate responsivity with finger shadowing and the dark-current-limited NEP.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Effective-mass discontinuity effect on resonances and peak voltage of an InGaAs/AlAs RTD
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use BenDaniel–Duke boundary conditions in a piecewise-constant transfer matrix to get resonance energies and widths. Integrate the Tsu–Esaki current with and without the mass jump to quantify the shift in peak voltage and peak current.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Intrinsic bistability of an RTD from self-consistent well charge buildup
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve for the well sheet charge from sequential tunneling rates with a Lorentzian resonance. Feed the Hartree electrostatic shift of the resonance back into the rates and iterate. Trace both I–V branches to obtain the hysteresis loop width.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Wigner phase delay and dwell time of electrons in a double-barrier structure
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the complex transmission amplitude by transfer matrices. Take the energy derivative of its phase to get the Wigner delay, and integrate |ψ|² over the barrier region to get the dwell time. Compare both at resonance with ħ/Γ.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Coherent versus sequential tunneling current with scattering-broadened resonance (Stone–Lee)
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Add a scattering width to the elastic resonance width in a Breit–Wigner transmission. Integrate Tsu–Esaki currents for both pictures and show the reduced peak transmission alongside an approximately conserved peak current. Quantify the rise in valley current.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Negative differential conductance and maximum oscillation frequency of an RTD oscillator
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: From a model I–V (Tsu–Esaki integral), extract the most negative differential conductance and combine it with the depletion capacitance and series resistance. Evaluate f_max = (1/2πC)·sqrt(|G|/R_s − G²).

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Peak current of a degenerately doped Si Esaki tunnel diode from Kane band-to-band tunneling
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the WKB/Kane interband tunneling probability through the junction field. Integrate it over the overlapping Fermi–Dirac occupied and empty states to obtain the forward I–V, then locate the peak current density and peak voltage.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Direct and Fowler–Nordheim tunneling current through a thin SiO2 gate oxide
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate the WKB transmission through a trapezoidal or triangular oxide barrier over the electron supply function (Tsu–Esaki form). Compare the result with the analytic Fowler–Nordheim expression and identify the crossover voltage versus oxide thickness.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Goldsmid–Sharp band gap from peak Seebeck versus exact two-band calculation
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the Seebeck coefficient of a two-band semiconductor versus temperature using Fermi–Dirac transport integrals with a charge-neutral Fermi level. Locate the maximum S and compare Eg = 2e·S_max·T_max with the true gap for different mobility and mass ratios.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Hicks–Dresselhaus quantum-well thermoelectric figure of merit versus well width
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use 2D subband transport integrals with a confinement energy and well-width-dependent density of states. Optimize the reduced chemical potential at each width to obtain zT_2D, and compare with the bulk optimum for Bi2Te3-like parameters.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Cahill–Pohl minimum lattice thermal conductivity from Debye integrals
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Cahill–Pohl expression for each acoustic polarization by numerical quadrature over x = ħω/kT up to Θ_i/T, using sound velocities and atomic density. Compare with Callaway-type crystalline values for Si, Bi2Te3 and amorphous SiO2.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Resonant impurity level Seebeck enhancement in Tl-doped PbTe
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Add a Lorentzian resonant density of states to a parabolic band, solve for the Fermi level at fixed hole density, and compute the Seebeck coefficient from transport integrals. Compare the result against the Pisarenko curve.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Grain-boundary barrier limited mobility and Seebeck in nanocrystalline thermoelectrics (Seto model)
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the grain-boundary barrier height from charge balance of trapped carriers and the thermionic-limited effective mobility. Add the energy-filtering correction to S, then evaluate the power factor versus grain size and doping.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Solid-state thermionic heterostructure refrigerator cooling power and efficiency (Mahan model)
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate the Richardson-like thermionic emission over a barrier with a Fermi–Dirac emitter, including back-flow and heat conduction through the barrier. Find the optimum barrier height and the maximum cooling power density and COP versus temperature difference.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Short-base versus long-base diode saturation current with finite contact recombination
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the minority-carrier diffusion equation in a quasi-neutral region of finite width with a surface recombination velocity at the contact. The resulting J0 has the closed-form tanh/coth expression. Map J0 versus W/L and S between the ohmic and passivated limits.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Sah–Noyce–Shockley depletion recombination current and bias-dependent ideality factor
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate the SRH rate across the depletion region, using the depletion-approximation potential and quasi-Fermi-level splitting qV. Add the ideal diffusion current, then compute the local ideality factor n(V) going from ≈2 to 1.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Reverse leakage of a silicon p-n diode: generation versus diffusion activation energies
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the depletion generation current (∝ n_i W/τ_g with bias-dependent W) and the diffusion current (∝ n_i²) versus temperature. Find the crossover temperature and the apparent Arrhenius activation energies, Eg/2 versus Eg.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: High-injection p-i-n diode: conductivity modulation and ideality factor of two
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the ambipolar diffusion equation in the intrinsic base under high injection to get the base carrier profile and current. Show that the ideality factor approaches 2 and compute the base voltage drop versus current density.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Reverse-recovery storage time of a switched p+n diode (Kingston analysis)
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve erf(sqrt(t_s/τ)) = I_F/(I_F + I_R) for the storage time and compute the subsequent recovery transient. Compare with a numerical time-dependent diffusion solution in a long n region.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Separating area and perimeter recombination currents from a diode size series
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Generate dark I–V curves for circular diodes of several radii, with area diffusion, area SRH and perimeter n≈2 components. Fit J/A against P/A at each bias to extract the perimeter recombination current per unit length.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Forward-voltage temperature coefficient of a silicon diode thermometer
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: From J = J0(T)·exp(qV/nkT), with J0 containing n_i²(T) from Varshni Eg(T) and mobility and lifetime power laws, compute V(T) at constant current. Evaluate dV/dT and the deviation from linearity between 77 and 400 K.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Monte Carlo ray tracing of absorption in a random-pyramid textured silicon wafer
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Trace rays through 54.74° pyramids with Fresnel reflection, refraction and Beer–Lambert absorption in a wafer with a partial back reflector. Compute absorptance and path-length enhancement versus wavelength and compare them with 4n².

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Extracting the path-length enhancement factor from measured absorptance
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Invert the Green/Tiedje-type expression A = αW·Z/(1 + αW·Z) and its generalization with imperfect back reflectance to obtain Z(λ) from synthetic absorptance data. Assess how Z changes with the absorption depth.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Angle-restricted light trapping beyond 4n² (Campbell–Green limit)
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the enhanced limit 4n²/sin²θ for an absorber whose escape is restricted to a cone of half-angle θ. Integrate the resulting absorptance against the AM1.5 spectrum for thin Si to get photocurrent versus acceptance angle.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Yu–Fan nanophotonic light-trapping limit by guided-mode counting with a grating
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Count guided modes per unit frequency in a thin high-index slab, accessible via a periodic grating of given period in 1D and 2D. Use the Yu–Fan statistical coupled-mode theory to compute the maximum enhancement factor relative to 4n².

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Free-carrier parasitic absorption limiting light-trapping gain in doped silicon
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Generalize the Lambertian absorptance to two competing absorption channels, band-to-band and free-carrier (∝ Nλ²). Compute the useful absorptance and photocurrent loss versus doping and thickness.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Haze from interface roughness and partial randomization in thin-film silicon cells
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use scalar scattering theory, haze = 1 − exp[−(4πσ n/λ)²], to set the fraction of diffuse light. Combine specular double-pass and Lambertian absorption in a thin a-Si/μc-Si film to compute absorptance and Jsc versus RMS roughness.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Multiple-bounce front reflectance of upright and inverted pyramid textures
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use deterministic 2D/3D geometric ray tracing on pyramid facets to find the fraction of rays undergoing two or three bounces. Combine these fractions with Fresnel reflectance to get total reflectance versus wavelength, with and without an antireflection coating.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Optical efficiency of a quantum-dot luminescent solar concentrator
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine the escape-cone fraction 1 − sqrt(1 − 1/n²), the QD PL quantum yield and spectral reabsorption from the absorption–emission overlap. Solve a multiple-generation balance to get the edge-collected photon fraction versus concentrator length.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Harrison LCAO valence-band offsets of III–V and II–VI semiconductors
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the valence-band maximum energies from Harrison's universal tight-binding parameters and atomic term values, using the sp³ bonding/antibonding p-level formula. Predict offsets for pairs such as GaAs/AlAs and ZnSe/GaAs, and check the common-anion rule.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Type-II band alignment of tensile-strained Si on relaxed SiGe
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Apply model-solid theory with hydrostatic and uniaxial deformation potentials to compute strain-split Δ valleys in Si and the valence bands in SiGe. Obtain the conduction- and valence-band offsets and the alignment type versus Ge fraction.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: High-k oxide/silicon band offsets from charge-neutrality-level alignment
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Align the charge-neutrality levels of Si and oxides (HfO2, Al2O3, ZrO2), with pinning factor S derived from the optical dielectric constant. Compute conduction- and valence-band offsets and test them against tunneling-leakage barrier requirements.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Effective band gap of an InAs/GaSb type-II superlattice from Kronig–Penney
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Using the broken-gap alignment, compute the electron miniband in InAs wells with GaSb barriers and the heavy-hole miniband in GaSb with an effective-mass Kronig–Penney model. Obtain the superlattice gap and cutoff wavelength versus layer thicknesses.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Emitter injection efficiency enhancement in an AlGaAs/GaAs heterojunction bipolar transistor
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the electron and hole injection currents of a wide-gap emitter. The ratio is enhanced by exp(ΔEv/kT) relative to a homojunction. Compute current gain versus Al fraction and emitter doping.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Accumulation–depletion electrostatics of an n-N isotype heterojunction
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate Poisson's equation exactly with Boltzmann statistics on both sides of an n-GaAs/N-AlGaAs junction. Determine the interface field from charge matching and compute the potential split, accumulation sheet density and band diagram.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Surface inversion of c-Si at an a-Si:H/c-Si heterojunction with interface defects
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve charge neutrality between the a-Si:H emitter charge, interface defects and the c-Si space charge using the exact Poisson integral. Obtain the c-Si band bending and whether strong inversion occurs versus the valence-band offset.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Two-terminal tandem I–V by series voltage addition and current-mismatch fill factor
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model top and bottom subcells with single-diode equations. Invert each to V(I) and sum voltages at a common current to build the tandem J–V. Compute efficiency and FF versus top-cell thickness to show the FF rise under mismatch.
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.area: Solar cell equivalent circuits and parameter extraction

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Optimal front-grid finger spacing balancing shading and emitter resistance
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the fractional power losses from emitter sheet resistance (∝ s²), finger resistance, contact resistance and shading for a Si cell grid. Minimize the total loss to find the optimum finger pitch and width.
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.area: Solar cell equivalent circuits and parameter extraction

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Temperature coefficients of Voc, Jsc and maximum power from the single-diode model
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine J0(T) ∝ T³·exp(−Eg/kT) with Varshni Eg(T) and a gap-dependent Jsc. Solve the single-diode model for its maximum power point at each temperature, then compute the coefficients dVoc/dT and dPmax/dT.
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.area: Solar cell equivalent circuits and parameter extraction

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Low-irradiance efficiency loss from shunt resistance and second-diode recombination
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the two-diode model with Rs and Rsh from 10 to 1000 W/m². Compute Voc, FF and efficiency versus irradiance and locate the irradiance at peak efficiency.
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.area: Solar cell equivalent circuits and parameter extraction

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Voltage-dependent collection (Hecht) in thin-film CdTe or a-Si p-i-n cells
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Multiply the photocurrent by the Hecht collection function of the drift length relative to the internal field (V_bi − V). Solve the resulting light J–V, show the dark/light curve crossover, and compute the FF versus μτ.
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.area: Solar cell equivalent circuits and parameter extraction

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Luminescent coupling between subcells in a GaInP/GaAs tandem
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Add to the bottom-cell photocurrent a fraction of the top-cell radiative recombination current, set by the top cell's diode equation and external radiative efficiency. Solve the series tandem and compute the efficiency gain versus current mismatch.
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.area: Solar cell equivalent circuits and parameter extraction

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: LED junction temperature from electroluminescence high-energy slope and peak shift
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model the EL spectrum as sqrt(E − Eg)·exp(−E/kT) convolved with Gaussian broadening, with Eg(T) given by Varshni. Fit synthetic spectra to extract the junction temperature, and compare slope-based and peak-shift-based estimates.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Photon-reabsorption redshift of PL in thick direct-gap films
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate the internal emission spectrum, obtained from absorption via van Roosbroeck–Shockley, over the generation depth profile with escape attenuation exp(−α(E)z/cosθ) within the escape cone. Compute the observed peak shift versus excitation wavelength and thickness.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Quantum-well electroluminescence spectrum with band filling versus injection
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Multiply the step-like 2D joint density of states (two subbands) by Fermi factors at quasi-Fermi levels set by the sheet carrier density, then convolve with Lorentzian broadening. Compute the spectral blue shift and FWHM versus current density.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Donor–acceptor pair PL peak shift with excitation intensity (Thomas–Hopfield)
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the pair-distance distribution and the Coulomb term E = Eg − (E_D + E_A) + e²/(4πεr). Model saturation of distant slow-recombining pairs with distance-dependent rates, giving the PL peak energy versus excitation intensity.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: LO-phonon replicas of free-exciton photoluminescence in ZnO
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use Segall–Mahan-type lineshapes, with the n-th replica proportional to (E − E_x + nħω_LO)^(l+1/2)·exp(−E/kT) and Poisson intensity weights. Fit replica spacings and intensity ratios to extract the exciton temperature and coupling strength.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Thermal quenching of integrated PL with two nonradiative activation channels
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Fit I(T) = I0/[1 + C1·exp(−E1/kT) + C2·exp(−E2/kT)] to synthetic data by nonlinear least squares with parameter uncertainties. Discuss the identifiability of the two energies.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Electron–hole droplet luminescence lineshape in silicon
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Convolve the electron and hole Fermi–Dirac distributions at the droplet density, with their density-of-states masses, using phonon-assisted energy conservation. Compute the EHD line, then fit density and temperature to its width.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Fröhlich coupling constant and Feynman variational polaron mass in polar semiconductors
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute α from ε∞, ε0, ω_LO and m*. Minimize the Feynman variational free energy by numerical quadrature to get the polaron binding energy and effective mass for GaAs, CdTe, GaN and MAPbI3.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Phonon-confinement Raman lineshape of silicon nanocrystals (Richter–Wang–Ley)
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate a Gaussian-weighted Lorentzian over the Brillouin zone, using the optical-phonon dispersion and a confinement envelope for a sphere of diameter D. Compute the Raman peak shift and asymmetric broadening versus D.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: LO-phonon–plasmon coupled modes in n-type GaAs versus carrier density
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Find the zeros of the dielectric function combining a lattice oscillator and the Drude plasma to obtain the L+ and L− coupled-mode frequencies. Compute the Raman lineshape from Im(−1/ε) versus electron density.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Folded acoustic phonons in a GaAs/AlAs superlattice from the Rytov model
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the Rytov elastic-continuum dispersion cos(qd) = f(ω) for the layer sound velocities and densities. Compute the folded doublet frequencies at the Raman wavevector and the minigap at the zone centre and zone edge.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Raman thermometry from the Stokes/anti-Stokes intensity ratio
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute I_AS/I_S = (ω_L + ω)⁴/(ω_L − ω)⁴ · exp(−ħω/kT), with an optional resonance-enhancement correction. Invert synthetic ratios to temperature and estimate the temperature uncertainty from photon-counting noise.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Onsager–Braun field-dependent charge-transfer state dissociation in organic blends
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Braun dissociation rate with the Bessel-function field term J1(2√(−2b))/√(−2b). Average the dissociation probability over a distribution of electron–hole separations, then compute the collection probability versus field and temperature.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Marcus charge-transfer-state absorption and the open-circuit voltage of organic cells
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Fit the Marcus Gaussian CT absorption band (E_CT, λ, f) to a synthetic EQE tail and compute Voc,rad via detailed balance. Combine with an EL quantum efficiency to predict Voc and the energy loss relative to E_CT.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Reduced Langevin recombination versus extraction: fill factor of bulk-heterojunction cells
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the Langevin rate with a reduction factor. Form the Bartesaghi figure of merit θ = γG·d⁴/(μ_n·μ_p·V²) and predict FF from the empirical-analytic relation, then compare FF versus thickness and mobility.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Scan-rate-dependent J–V hysteresis from mobile-ion Debye-layer charging in perovskite cells
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model ion accumulation as a first-order relaxation of interfacial voltage with an ionic RC time. The resulting screening of the bulk field changes the collection efficiency. Compute forward and reverse scans and the hysteresis index versus scan rate, recovering a bell-shaped curve.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Exciton harvesting efficiency versus domain size in a bulk heterojunction
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve exciton diffusion with decay inside a spherical domain whose surface quenches excitons, using a series or closed-form solution. Compute the volume-averaged dissociation yield versus radius/L_D and the domain size for 90% harvesting.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Saha equilibrium of free carriers and excitons in 3D versus 2D halide perovskites
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the Saha mass-action law, with 3D and 2D forms, for the free-carrier fraction versus excitation density and temperature. Use exciton binding energies of MAPbI3 and a layered (PEA)2PbI4 to compare dissociation regimes.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Gaussian-disorder density of states: Fermi level, Voc and temperature dependence
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate a Gaussian DOS with Fermi–Dirac occupation to find the quasi-Fermi levels versus carrier density. Compute Voc versus temperature and light intensity, showing the disorder-induced Voc loss −σ²/2kT.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Coulomb-enhanced optical gain of bulk GaAs from quasi-equilibrium Bloch equations
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the stationary screened Hartree–Fock SBE as a k-space integral equation, using statically screened Coulomb angle-averaged kernels and Fermi distributions. Compute the gain spectrum and compare it with the free-carrier result to show the Coulomb enhancement.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Terahertz emission from Bloch oscillations in a biased superlattice
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate miniband SBE (cosine miniband, with dipole coupling to the next band) after ultrashort excitation in a static field. Compute the intraband current, its THz emission spectrum at the Bloch frequency eFd/h, and the dephasing-limited linewidth.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Biexciton signatures in polarization-resolved four-wave mixing of a quantum well
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model ground, two exciton (σ±) and biexciton states with Bloch equations driven by co- and cross-circularly polarized pulse pairs. Compute the FWM spectra and delay traces showing the biexciton-binding-energy beats that are present only in the allowed polarization configurations.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Laplace DLTS separation of closely spaced emission rates by regularized inversion
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Synthesize multi-exponential capacitance transients from two traps with similar emission rates plus noise. Recover the rate spectrum by Tikhonov-regularized inverse Laplace transform (NNLS on a log-rate grid), then extract each trap's activation energy from Arrhenius fits across temperature.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Thermal admittance spectroscopy conductance peaks of a shallow trap
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model junction capacitance and conductance versus frequency and temperature for a trap with emission rate e_n(T): C(ω) step, G/ω peak at ω=2e_n. Locate the peaks numerically and Arrhenius-fit e_n/T² to obtain the activation energy and capture cross section.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Walter defect density of states from admittance spectra of a CIGS cell
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Simulate C(ω,T) from a Gaussian defect distribution in the gap by integrating the occupancy-response kernel over trap energy. Reconstruct N_t(E) with the Walter derivative formula −(V_bi/qW)(ω dC/dω)/kT and the energy mapping E=kT ln(2ν0/ω), and compare it with the input distribution.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Poole–Frenkel field-enhanced emission and double-correlation DLTS field dependence
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute emission-rate enhancement from the 3D Hartke angular-averaged Poole–Frenkel barrier lowering for a Coulombic donor-like trap. Simulate the field-resolved DDLTS signal versus junction field and fit the sqrt(F) slope to identify the trap's charge state.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Fill-pulse dependence of DLTS amplitude: point defects versus dislocation logarithmic capture
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model trap filling with exponential capture n(t) for point defects, and with Coulomb-barrier-limited logarithmic capture for line defects whose barrier grows with occupancy. Fit the simulated amplitude-versus-pulse-width data to extract the capture cross section and to classify the defect type.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Lambda-region correction of DLTS trap concentration in a Schottky diode
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the transition distance λ=sqrt(2ε(E_F−E_T)/q²N_d) and the depletion widths under reverse and fill biases. Evaluate the corrected relation between ΔC/C and N_T, then quantify how much the naive 2N_d ΔC/C formula underestimates N_T versus bias.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Alloy-broadened DLTS peaks from a Gaussian distribution of trap energies
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate the boxcar rate-window DLTS signal over a Gaussian distribution of activation energies to simulate broadened peaks in an alloy. Fit peak width versus rate window to recover the mean energy and the broadening σ.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Photoinduced current transient spectroscopy of traps in semi-insulating GaAs
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model photocurrent decay after optical excitation as emission from several traps, with mobility-lifetime weighting of each component. Build two-gate PICTS spectra versus temperature and extract trap signatures from Arrhenius plots.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Deep-level optical spectroscopy: Lucovsky versus phonon-broadened photoionization cross sections
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the photoionization cross section σ°(hν) with the delta-potential Lucovsky model, and with a Chantre–Bois style Gaussian phonon broadening convolution. Fit synthetic steady-state photocapacitance spectra to extract the optical threshold and the Franck–Condon shift.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Thermally activated capture cross section and apparent DLTS activation energy
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Include a multiphonon capture barrier σ=σ∞exp(−E_σ/kT) in the emission rate and simulate DLTS Arrhenius data. Show that the apparent activation energy equals E_c−E_T+E_σ, and separate the two contributions using capture-time measurements.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Interface-state density distribution from constant-capacitance DLTS of a MOS capacitor
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model emission from a continuum D_it(E) of interface states, including the capture-cross-section energy dependence, and integrate it into the DLTS rate-window signal. Invert the signal-versus-temperature data to recover D_it across the upper half of the gap.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Non-exponential capacitance transients for trap density comparable to doping
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the exact depletion capacitance during trap emission from the full Poisson charge balance when N_T/N_d is not small. Compare the result with the small-signal exponential approximation and quantify the resulting errors in emission rate and in N_T.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Isothermal capacitance transient spectroscopy peak analysis
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the ICTS signal S(t)=t·dC/dt for multi-trap transients at fixed temperature; each trap peaks at t=1/e_n. Use peak positions and heights from isothermal scans to obtain emission rates and concentrations, then Arrhenius-fit across temperatures.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Phonon-assisted tunneling enhancement of deep-level emission in high fields
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Makram-Ebeid–Lannoo or Ganichev phonon-assisted tunneling emission enhancement exp(F²/F_c²), with the characteristic tunneling time set by the trap's vibrational parameters. Compare it with Poole–Frenkel enhancement over the field range and identify the crossover field.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Charge-pumping current and interface trap density of a MOSFET
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Implement the Groeseneken charge-pumping model, I_cp=qfA·D_it·ΔE, with emission-limited energy window boundaries set by the rise and fall times and the capture cross sections. Compute I_cp versus base level and pulse slope, then extract D_it and the mean cross section.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Generation lifetime and leakage of gold-doped silicon from DLTS-derived trap parameters
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Take the Au acceptor and donor activation energies and capture cross sections from Arrhenius fits. Compute the SRH generation lifetime τ_g versus temperature and the resulting reverse leakage of a p+n diode, including the multi-level occupation of the gold center.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Diode ideality factor from recombination through exponential band-tail states
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate the SRH rate over an exponential tail density of states of characteristic energy E_t for a disordered absorber. Show that the ideality factor approaches 2/(1+kT/E_t) or a similar form, and compute n versus temperature and tail energy.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Amphoteric two-level defect recombination versus injection in a solar absorber
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Implement Sah–Shockley statistics for a defect with three charge states, using two transition levels and four capture cross sections. Compute the steady-state occupation fractions and the recombination lifetime versus injection level, and compare them with two independent SRH centers.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Band-gap extraction from the temperature dependence of diode saturation current
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model J0(T) ∝ T^(3+γ/2)·exp(−E_g(T)/kT) with a Varshni gap and temperature-dependent diffusivity. Fit Arrhenius plots of synthetic data and show the bias introduced by ignoring the prefactor exponent and the gap's temperature dependence.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Radiative versus SRH dark current crossover in a GaAs diode
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the radiative dark-current limit from the van Roosbroeck–Shockley integral over absorption and the blackbody spectrum. Add SRH depletion and diffusion currents, and find the bias and temperature at which radiative recombination dominates.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Zener band-to-band tunneling versus avalanche reverse breakdown in silicon junctions
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate the Kane band-to-band tunneling generation rate over the field profile of abrupt junctions with varying doping. Compare the resulting voltage with the avalanche ionization-integral breakdown to locate the doping where the breakdown mechanism changes, using the sign of the temperature coefficient.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Self-heating and series-resistance distortion of a high-current diode I–V
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve self-consistently for junction temperature T_j=T_a+R_th·IV and current through the Shockley equation with series resistance and temperature-dependent n_i. Find the apparent high-current ideality factor and the possible negative-resistance region.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Drift-field narrow base diode with exponentially graded doping
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the minority-carrier transport equation in a base with exponential doping, which gives a built-in field η=ln(N_0/N_W). Compute the saturation current and the base transit time versus η, and compare them with the uniform-base results.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Local-field factor and intrinsic absorption coefficient of nanocrystals in solvent
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the Maxwell–Garnett local-field factor |f_LF|²=|3n_s²/(ε_NC+2n_s²)|² from a bulk complex dielectric function. Evaluate the high-energy absorption cross section per nanocrystal and its dependence on solvent refractive index and on volume fraction.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Ostwald ripening size distribution and spectral evolution of growing nanocrystals
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Lifshitz–Slyozov–Wagner asymptotic size distribution and the t^(1/3) growth of the mean radius. Map them through a Brus-type sizing curve to compute the time evolution of the first-exciton peak position and width.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Dielectric self-polarization energy of carriers in a nanocrystal by image-charge series
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Brus image-charge self-energy series Σ(l+1)(ε−1)/(lε+l+1)(r/R)^(2l) for a carrier in a sphere with dielectric mismatch, regularized at the surface. Average it over the 1S wavefunction and compute the net gap correction versus solvent dielectric constant.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Dark–bright exciton splitting and temperature-dependent PL lifetime of CdSe dots
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model the exchange splitting ΔE_ab ∝ 1/R³ and a three-level system with thermal population of bright and dark states. Compute PL decay rate versus temperature and fit synthetic data to extract the splitting and both radiative rates.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Thickness-quantized transition energies of CdSe nanoplatelets with dielectric confinement
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute heavy- and light-hole exciton energies for n-monolayer CdSe nanoplatelets using a finite-barrier well with nonparabolic electron mass. Add a dielectric-enhanced 2D binding energy from an image-charge potential and compare the results with the discrete absorption peaks.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Aspect-ratio dependence of the band gap of colloidal nanorods
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model nanorods as cylinders with infinite or finite barriers, using radial confinement from Bessel-function zeros and axial box quantization plus Coulomb correction. Compute the gap versus length at fixed diameter and the crossover from dot-like to wire-like behavior.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Multi-Gaussian decomposition of CdSe quantum-dot absorption into excitonic transitions
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Fit an absorption spectrum with a sum of Gaussian transitions (1S_e–1S3/2, 1S_e–2S3/2, 1P_e–1P3/2 and others) on a smooth background. Extract transition energies and integrated oscillator strengths versus size and compare them with effective-mass predictions.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Size-dependent radiative rate and PL spectrum of silicon nanocrystal ensembles
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine a confinement gap E(d) for indirect-gap Si dots with a size-dependent phonon-assisted radiative rate and a nonradiative rate. Integrate over a lognormal size distribution to compute the ensemble PL peak and its redshift relative to the mean-size gap.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Size-dependent sign change of the band-gap temperature coefficient in PbS quantum dots
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine the bulk positive dE_g/dT of PbS with size-dependent confinement and thermal expansion of the dot radius, using a hyperbolic-band confinement model. Compute dE/dT versus diameter and find the size where it changes sign.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Tung pinch-off model for nanoscale low-barrier patches in Schottky diodes
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the saddle-point barrier of circular low-barrier patches with Tung's pinch-off formula, which depends on patch strength, doping and bias. Integrate thermionic emission over a Gaussian distribution of patch parameters to obtain effective barrier height, ideality factor and T0 behavior.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Schottky barrier height and doping from C–V with Debye and kT corrections
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute 1/C² versus V for a Schottky diode including the kT/q term, image-force lowering and a nonuniform doping profile. Extract doping profile N(W) from the slope and the barrier height from the intercept, and compare with I–V barrier extraction.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Cheung–Cheung and Norde extraction of Schottky parameters with series resistance
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Generate thermionic I–V curves with ideality and series resistance. Implement the Cheung dV/dlnI and H(I) functions and the modified Norde function F(V), and compare the extracted barrier height, ideality and R_s with the true values.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: MIS tunnel Schottky diode with interfacial oxide transmission factor
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Include tunneling through a thin interfacial layer via exp(−α·sqrt(χ)·δ) and the voltage division across the oxide that sets bias-dependent ideality. Compute I–V versus oxide thickness and the effective barrier increase.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Thermionic emission into 2D semiconductors with modified Richardson scaling
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Derive and evaluate thermionic current from a metal into a 2D channel with step density of states, J ∝ T^(3/2)·exp(−qΦ/kT). Compare barrier heights extracted from Richardson plots with T² versus T^(3/2) scaling for a MoS2 contact.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Circular transmission line model with Bessel-function contact resistance
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the CTLM resistance R_T between concentric contacts with the exact modified-Bessel-function expressions in r/L_T. Fit simulated gap-dependent resistances for sheet resistance and specific contact resistivity, and compare with the linear-TLM correction approximation.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Graphene–silicon Schottky junction with bias-tunable graphene Fermi level
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Couple thermionic emission to a barrier that depends on the graphene Fermi level shift E_F=ħv_F·sqrt(πn), where the induced charge is set by the depletion charge. Solve self-consistently for I–V and the apparent bias-dependent barrier and ideality.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Zero-bias Schottky RF detector: curvature responsivity and noise-equivalent power
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: From thermionic I–V with series resistance and junction capacitance, compute the curvature coefficient γ=I''/(2I'), the voltage responsivity with impedance mismatch and frequency rolloff, and the Johnson-limited NEP. Optimize the barrier height for a given input power.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Fermi-level depinning by an ultrathin interlayer: optimal thickness for contact resistivity
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model barrier reduction from attenuated metal-induced gap states versus insulator thickness alongside a growing tunneling resistance through the insulator. Compute specific contact resistivity versus thickness and find the minimum for a metal/TiO2/n-Si contact.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Bell–Kaiser threshold fitting of ballistic electron emission microscopy spectra
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute BEEM collector current versus tip bias from the Bell–Kaiser planar-tunneling model, including transverse momentum conservation, I_c ∝ (V−Φ_b)². Also apply the Ludeke–Prietsch 5/2-power variant, fit both to synthetic spectra and compare the barrier heights.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: AlGaN composition for 265 nm deep-UV LED emission at operating temperature
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine composition-dependent Varshni parameters and bowing for Al_xGa1−xN with quantum-well confinement and polarization-field shifts. Invert numerically for the Al fraction giving 265 nm emission at 300 K and at an elevated junction temperature.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Pässler model fit of band-gap temperature dependence with phonon dispersion
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Implement Pässler's analytic E_g(T), which has a slope parameter, an average phonon temperature and a dispersion exponent. Fit low-temperature-rich gap data for GaN or ZnO and compare residuals and extrapolated slopes with the Varshni and Bose–Einstein models.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: CuPt ordering-induced band-gap reduction in GaInP
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model the gap reduction ΔE_g(η)=η²·ΔE_g(1) and the valence-band crystal-field splitting for partially ordered Ga0.5In0.5P. Compute emission and absorption energies versus order parameter and infer η from a measured PL peak.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: AlGaInP lattice-matched to GaAs: amber emission and direct–indirect crossover
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Interpolate Γ and X gaps of (Al_xGa1−x)0.5In0.5P with bowing and temperature dependence. Find the direct–indirect crossover composition and the composition for 590 nm, and estimate the Γ–X separation that controls carrier leakage versus temperature.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Direct–indirect crossover of GeSn alloys under biaxial strain
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute Γ and L conduction-band edges of Ge1−xSn_x with bowing and deformation potentials for biaxial strain on a Ge buffer. Map the Sn content–strain plane where the alloy becomes direct and find the direct gap at the crossover.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Band inversion composition of Pb1−xSnxTe versus temperature
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use the linear-in-x, temperature-dependent L-point gap of PbSnTe, which passes through zero and changes sign. Compute the inversion composition versus temperature and the cutoff wavelength of normal-gap compositions for IR detectors.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Anomalous bowing in Sn–Pb halide perovskites for narrow-gap bottom cells
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Fit E_g(x) of MA(Sn_xPb1−x)I3 with a large bowing parameter that places the minimum gap at intermediate x. Find the compositions giving a target 1.25 eV gap and the Shockley–Queisser-optimal bottom-cell gap under a 1.8 eV top cell.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: InAsSb composition for long-wave infrared detection with large bowing
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine the InAs1−xSb_x bowing parameter with Varshni temperature dependence and an optional strain correction. Compute the cutoff wavelength versus composition and temperature, and invert for the composition giving 10 µm cutoff at 77 K.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: AlGaInAs lattice-matched to InP for 1.3 µm uncooled lasers
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Constrain the Al_xGa_yIn1−x−yAs composition to the InP lattice constant by Vegard's law. Compute the gap with ternary bowing interpolation, the conduction-band offset to InP, and the composition giving 1.3 µm emission at 85 °C including confinement.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Electron–phonon versus thermal-expansion contributions to the band-gap shift
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Split dE_g/dT into a lattice-dilation term from the hydrostatic deformation potential, the bulk modulus and a temperature-dependent expansion coefficient (Debye integral), and an electron–phonon two-oscillator Bose–Einstein term. Fit E_g(T) of Si or MAPbI3 to separate the two contributions.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Band gap of Cu2ZnSn(S,Se)4 versus anion ratio and its Voc-limited efficiency
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Interpolate the CZTSSe gap with bowing in S/(S+Se). Compute the radiative-limit Voc and the efficiency versus composition, including a band-tail deficit, to find the optimal sulfur fraction.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Spectral hole burning in an inhomogeneously broadened exciton ensemble
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate two-level Bloch equations over a Gaussian distribution of transition energies under a narrowband pump. Compute the pump-induced change of probe absorption, a hole of width related to the homogeneous linewidth and power broadening, and extract T2.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Two-dimensional coherent spectroscopy rephasing lineshapes of quantum-well excitons
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the third-order rephasing response of an ensemble of two-level excitons with homogeneous dephasing and Gaussian inhomogeneity via perturbative Bloch solutions. Construct the 2D spectrum and extract homogeneous and inhomogeneous widths from the cross-diagonal and diagonal cuts.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Coherent control of injection current by ω/2ω quantum interference
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use a two-band semiconductor model with one-photon (2ω) and two-photon (ω) interband amplitudes. Compute the k-resolved carrier injection, and integrate over k for the net current versus relative phase and intensities, showing the phase-controlled directional photocurrent.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Normal-mode splitting of quantum-well excitons in a planar microcavity
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Couple a linear exciton polarization equation, with oscillator strength and dephasing, to a damped cavity field. Compute transmission or reflection spectra versus detuning and the vacuum Rabi splitting versus number of wells, giving polariton anticrossing curves.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Autler–Townes splitting of the 1s exciton under an intense terahertz field
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve a three-level density-matrix model (ground, 1s, 2p) with a THz field resonant with 1s–2p and a weak optical probe. Compute probe absorption versus THz intensity and detuning and extract the dressed-state splitting.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Nonlinear spontaneous and piezoelectric polarization charges in (Al,In,Ga)N on GaN
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute pseudomorphic strain, nonlinear piezoelectric polarization using the Bernardini–Fiorentini quadratic strain coefficients, and bowed spontaneous polarization for AlGaN, InGaN and AlInN. Evaluate the interface sheet charge versus composition and identify polarization-matched AlInN.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Built-in field partitioning between wells and barriers in an InGaN/GaN MQW
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Apply periodic boundary conditions (zero average potential drop) to find well and barrier fields from the polarization difference and the layer thicknesses. Include an optional applied p-i-n bias, and compute the field and emission shift versus barrier-to-well thickness ratio.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Polarization field versus growth-plane inclination in semipolar InGaN wells
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Rotate the strain and piezoelectric tensors to an inclined growth plane (Romanov model). Compute the normal polarization discontinuity and field versus angle, and find the angle where the field vanishes for a given In content.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Polarization-induced 3D electron slab in compositionally graded AlGaN
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the bound charge density ρ=−∇·P for a linearly graded AlGaN layer and the resulting free-carrier density without donors. Solve a Thomas–Fermi Poisson equation for the mobile slab and its temperature-independent conductivity.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Polarization-engineered GaN/InGaN/GaN tunnel junction band bending
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the depletion widths and band bending set by the InGaN interlayer polarization charges plus doping. Find the interlayer thickness where the bands align for interband tunneling, and estimate the WKB tunneling probability versus In content.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: GaN/AlN quantum-well emission below the GaN gap from giant built-in fields
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute MV/cm fields in GaN/AlN wells from polarization differences. Solve tilted-well Schrödinger equations by shooting or Airy functions for electrons and holes, and find the well width where emission drops below the bulk GaN gap.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Polarization-induced two-dimensional hole gas at a GaN/AlN heterointerface
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the negative polarization sheet charge at a metal-polar GaN-on-AlN interface. Solve 1D Poisson with heavy-hole and light-hole valence subbands (triangular-well variational or numerical) for the 2DHG density versus GaN thickness.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Sheet charge and 2DEG density in ScAlN/GaN heterostructures
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Interpolate spontaneous and piezoelectric polarization and lattice parameters of Sc_xAl1−xN, and find the lattice-matched composition. Compute the 2DEG density versus barrier thickness with a surface-barrier charge-balance model and compare it with AlGaN/GaN.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Numerov shooting for subbands in wells with position-dependent mass
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Implement Numerov integration for (1/m(z))-weighted Schrödinger equations on a grid, with node counting and bisection on energy. Validate against analytic finite-well roots and apply it to an arbitrary stepped profile.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Monolayer well-width fluctuation splitting of quantum-well photoluminescence
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute e1–hh1 transition energy versus well width for GaAs/AlGaAs with finite barriers. Evaluate dE/dL and the energy splitting between islands differing by one monolayer (0.283 nm), and the resulting PL linewidth for random fluctuations.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Multi-subband electron density versus Fermi level in a doped quantum well
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute all bound subbands of a finite well and the 2D sheet density n=Σ(m*kT/πħ²)ln(1+exp((E_F−E_i)/kT)). Invert for E_F at a given doping and temperature, and give subband occupation fractions.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Weighted mobility and density-of-states mass from Seebeck and conductivity data
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use single-parabolic-band Fermi integrals to invert measured Seebeck coefficients for reduced Fermi level and compute the density-of-states effective mass. Obtain Snyder's weighted mobility from S and σ, and examine the temperature scaling that diagnoses the scattering mechanism.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Optimal band gap for thermoelectric zT with bipolar conduction
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use a two-band parabolic model with conduction and valence Boltzmann transport integrals plus lattice thermal conductivity. Optimize zT over doping at each band gap, and find the minimum gap (in units of kT) needed to avoid bipolar degradation.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Thomson coefficient and Kelvin relations from a computed Seebeck curve
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute S(T) for a doped semiconductor with fixed carrier density from Fermi-integral transport. Derive the Thomson coefficient τ=T·dS/dT and Peltier coefficient Π=ST, and evaluate Thomson heat in a leg under a temperature gradient.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Rattler resonant phonon scattering in filled skutterudite lattice thermal conductivity
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Add a resonant scattering rate Cω²/((ω0²−ω²)²) to a Callaway/Debye model with Umklapp, boundary and point-defect terms. Integrate κ_L(T) and fit the rattler frequency and strength to data for a filled CoSb3.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Quantum-wire thermoelectric figure of merit versus wire width
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate 1D Boltzmann transport integrals with the 1D density of states for the lowest subband of a square wire, using a constant mean free path or relaxation time. Compute zT versus width and chemical potential following Hicks–Dresselhaus 1D, and compare it with bulk.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Quantum-confined Stark effect in a type-II GaAsSb/GaAs quantum well
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve electron and hole states in a type-II well (electrons in GaAs, holes in GaAsSb) under applied field. Show the near-linear Stark shift and field-tuned overlap, in contrast to the quadratic type-I behavior, and compute the transition energy and oscillator strength versus field.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Back-surface-field effective recombination velocity and long-wavelength IQE of a silicon cell
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the effective SRV of a p+/p high-low junction from its closed-form expression. Insert it into the Hovel base diffusion solution and integrate the IQE over red/NIR wavelengths to quantify the Jsc gain.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Donolato reciprocity collection probability and AM1.5 short-circuit current versus depth
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the adjoint diffusion equation analytically for the collection probability fc(x) in emitter, depletion and base. Integrate fc against Beer–Lambert generation over a tabulated AM1.5 spectrum to obtain Jsc and depth-resolved losses.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Basore inverse-IQE plot for effective diffusion length extraction
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Generate long-wavelength IQE from the Hovel base solution with finite rear SRV and plot 1/IQE versus absorption length. Fit the linear region to extract the effective diffusion length, then compare it with the true L and rear SRV.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Bifaciality factor of a PERT silicon cell from front and rear IQE
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the minority-carrier diffusion equation in the base for front and rear illumination with different surface recombination velocities. Integrate both IQEs with the solar spectrum and an albedo spectrum to obtain the bifaciality factor.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Gärtner photocurrent of a semiconductor–electrolyte photoelectrode
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine depletion-region drift collection and bulk diffusion (the Gärtner equation) for a hematite or BiVO4 photoanode. Integrate over wavelength to obtain photocurrent versus bias through the potential-dependent depletion width.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Temperature dependence of silicon Jsc from band-gap shrinkage and absorption shift
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Shift the Si absorption coefficient with a Varshni gap and evaluate the Hovel IQE with temperature-dependent diffusion length. Integrate with AM1.5 to compute dJsc/dT.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Blue-response loss from a heavily doped emitter dead layer
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model the emitter as a near-surface dead layer of zero collection plus an active region with low lifetime and high SRV. Compute the IQE at 300–500 nm and the resulting Jsc loss versus dead-layer thickness.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Front-surface-field collection in a rear-junction n-type silicon cell
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the hole diffusion equation in a thick n-base for carriers generated near the front FSF and collected at the rear emitter. Compute IQE and Jsc versus base diffusion length and FSF effective SRV, and compare with a front-junction design.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Radial-junction nanowire solar cell collection via cylindrical diffusion
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve radial minority-carrier diffusion in a core–shell nanowire with modified Bessel functions I0 and K0 plus core surface recombination. Integrate over radius and wavelength to obtain collection efficiency versus wire radius and diffusion length.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Diffusion length from modulated photocurrent phase via complex diffusion length
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Replace L by the complex diffusion length L/sqrt(1+iωτ) in the base collection solution. Compute the magnitude and phase of the AC photocurrent versus frequency, then extract τ and D by fitting.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Parasitic CdS window absorption and partial collection in CdTe cells
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine Beer–Lambert absorption in the CdS window with partial collection of its photocarriers and Gärtner collection in the CdTe absorber. Compute EQE and the Jsc loss versus CdS thickness.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Goodman surface photovoltage method for minority-carrier diffusion length
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the SPV of a thick wafer as a function of absorption coefficient from the diffusion solution with surface recombination. Find the photon flux needed for constant SPV versus 1/α and extrapolate the linear plot to −L.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: McIntyre exact gain probability distribution of an avalanche photodiode
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate McIntyre's closed-form distribution P(m) for electron injection using gamma functions in log space, for several k and mean gains. Verify its normalization, mean and excess noise factor, and compare its tail with a Gaussian.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Junction-curvature breakdown of cylindrical and spherical planar-diffused junctions
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the depletion field of cylindrical and spherical one-sided junctions with radius-dependent geometry. Find the reverse bias at which the ionization integral reaches unity and compare it with the plane-junction breakdown versus junction depth.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Bit-error rate of an APD receiver with the Webb–McIntyre–Conradi distribution
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model the output of an APD for Poisson photon counts plus Gaussian amplifier noise using the WMC approximation. Integrate the output distribution to find the BER versus decision threshold and the received power needed for BER = 1e-9.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: BVCEO of a bipolar transistor from avalanche multiplication in the collector junction
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the hole and electron multiplication factors from Si ionization integrals across the base–collector field. Find BVCBO from M→∞ and BVCEO from the condition (M−1)β = 1, then compare with the empirical n-power law.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Extracting α(E) and β(E) from pure electron and hole injection multiplication
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Generate Mn(V) and Mp(V) for a p-i-n diode with known coefficients. Invert the Stillman–Wolfe local-field expressions to recover α and β versus field, and assess sensitivity to the uncertainty in the i-region width.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Read IMPATT diode avalanche resonance and negative resistance
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use the avalanche-region ionization integral to set the avalanche frequency. Combine the Read small-signal avalanche inductance with the drift-region transit-time factor to compute device impedance versus frequency and the negative-resistance band.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Effective transport energy and mobility in a Gaussian density of states
