materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the Baranovskii transport-energy integral equation for a Gaussian DOS with Miller–Abrahams rates. Average the upward-hop rates to compute the temperature-dependent mobility and compare with ln μ ∝ −(σ/kT)².

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Mott versus Efros–Shklovskii variable-range hopping crossover temperature
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Optimize hop distance and energy for constant and Coulomb-gap DOS to obtain the T^{-1/4} and T^{-1/2} laws. Compute the crossover temperature from the Coulomb-gap width and fit simulated conductivity data.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Nearest-neighbor impurity hopping conduction ε3 in compensated n-Ge
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Apply the percolation bond criterion to Miller–Abrahams resistors to obtain ρ3 ∝ exp(1.73/(N^{1/3}a)). Add the compensation-dependent activation energy ε3 and combine with band conduction to reproduce the low-temperature resistivity curve.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Extended Gaussian disorder model density-dependent mobility enhancement
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Pasveer EGDM parametrization of mobility versus carrier density, temperature and field. Compare it with the density dependence obtained by state filling of a Gaussian DOS computed by quadrature.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Generalized Einstein relation in a filled Gaussian density of states
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute D/μ = n/(q dn/dE_F) by quadrature of Fermi–Dirac occupation of a Gaussian DOS. Show the enhancement over kT/q as a function of carrier density and disorder width σ.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Dispersive time-of-flight photocurrent from multiple trapping in an exponential tail
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Write the multiple-trapping model in the Laplace domain for an exponential trap distribution and invert numerically (Stehfest or Talbot). Obtain the TOF current with t^{-(1−α)} and t^{-(1+α)} slopes and the transit-time kink.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Derrida exact drift velocity of a 1D random hopping chain: Miller–Abrahams versus Marcus
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate Derrida's closed-form steady-state velocity for a periodic chain with random Gaussian site energies. Average over disorder realizations to compare the field and temperature dependence of mobility for Miller–Abrahams and Marcus rates.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Energetic relaxation of a hopping packet toward −σ²/kT
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use kinetic Monte Carlo on a Gaussian DOS to track the mean carrier energy versus time after random injection. Compare it with the equilibrium value −σ²/kT and extract the logarithmic relaxation regime and equilibration time.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Seebeck coefficient of a doped Gaussian-disordered organic semiconductor
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the transport energy and Fermi level of a Gaussian DOS by quadrature. Evaluate the Seebeck coefficient S = (E_tr − E_F)/(qT) versus doping, including the shift of E_tr with filling.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Gummel-number collector current and Early voltage of a Gaussian-base BJT
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate the base doping (with band-gap narrowing) to obtain the Gummel number and collector current density. Compute the Early voltage from the bias-dependent depletion of the base charge.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Pao–Sah double integral versus charge-sheet model for MOSFET drain current
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Pao–Sah double integral over surface potential and quasi-Fermi potential with a 1D Poisson field relation. Compare with the Brews charge-sheet current from subthreshold to saturation.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Shockley JFET pinch-off voltage and saturation transfer characteristic
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the gradual-channel drain current of a symmetric double-gate JFET from depletion widths. Obtain the pinch-off voltage, IDSS and transfer curve, and compare with the square-law approximation.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: MOSFET subthreshold swing with depletion and interface-trap capacitance
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the surface potential versus gate voltage from the exact bulk-charge relation. Compute the weak-inversion diffusion current and subthreshold swing versus doping, oxide thickness and interface trap density Dit.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Drain-induced barrier lowering from the quasi-2D characteristic length
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the quasi-2D Poisson model for the surface potential along a short channel using the characteristic length λ. Compute the barrier-height reduction and threshold roll-off versus channel length and drain bias.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Hyperabrupt varactor C–V tuning ratio from a power-law doping profile
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate Poisson's equation for N(x) ∝ x^m to obtain the depletion width and capacitance versus reverse bias. Compute the capacitance exponent, the tuning ratio and the LC tank frequency tuning range.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Arora/Masetti silicon mobility and Irvin resistivity–doping conversion
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Masetti and Arora doping- and temperature-dependent electron and hole mobilities. Compute resistivity versus doping and invert it numerically to convert a measured resistivity into a doping level.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Klaassen unified mobility: majority versus minority carriers in silicon
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Implement the Philips unified mobility model with lattice, impurity, screening and electron–hole scattering terms. Compare majority and minority electron mobility versus doping at 300 K.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Caughey–Thomas high-field velocity saturation of electrons and holes in silicon
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine low-field mobility with the Canali temperature-dependent saturation velocity and β parameter. Compute v(E), differential mobility, and the current–voltage characteristic of a short resistor.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Polar-optical-phonon limited electron mobility of GaAs versus temperature
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the POP-limited mobility from the Howarth–Sondheimer/Ehrenreich variational integral with Fröhlich coupling. Combine it with acoustic and ionized-impurity terms via Matthiessen's rule to obtain μ(T).

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Alloy-disorder scattering limited mobility of In_xGa_{1-x}As versus composition
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Harrison–Hauser alloy scattering rate ∝ x(1−x)ΔU² with composition-dependent effective mass. Combine it with phonon and impurity terms to find the mobility minimum and its composition.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Acoustic deformation and piezoelectric scattering in wurtzite GaN mobility
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute energy-dependent deformation-potential and piezoelectric relaxation times and average them over the Boltzmann distribution by quadrature. Combine with POP and impurity terms to find the peak-mobility temperature.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Sakaki L^6 interface-roughness limited mobility of a thin quantum well
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the subband-energy fluctuation from well-width derivatives and the Gaussian roughness correlation integral. Evaluate the 2D mobility versus well width and roughness parameters (Δ, Λ).

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Universal MOSFET effective mobility versus effective field (Takagi)
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine Coulomb, phonon and surface-roughness mobility components through Matthiessen's rule. Use the effective field computed from depletion and inversion charge to reproduce the universal curve and its temperature dependence.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Threading-dislocation scattering limited mobility in n-GaN
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Pödör/Look dislocation scattering mobility with Debye screening by quadrature. Combine it with lattice terms to compute Hall mobility versus dislocation density and carrier density.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Erginsoy neutral-impurity scattering in low-temperature compensated germanium
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine the temperature-independent Erginsoy neutral-impurity mobility, using the freeze-out neutral density from charge neutrality, with Brooks–Herring and acoustic scattering. Compute the mobility below 30 K.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Dorkel–Leturcq carrier–carrier scattering mobility reduction under high injection
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Add electron–hole scattering to lattice and impurity mobilities using the Dorkel–Leturcq model. Compute ambipolar mobility and conductivity modulation of a p-i-n base versus injection level.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Polar-optical and acoustic phonon limited 2DEG mobility in AlGaN/GaN
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute 2D POP and deformation-potential mobilities using Fang–Howard form factors. Combine them via Matthiessen's rule to obtain the 2DEG mobility from 10 to 600 K.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Ballistic-limited apparent mobility in short-channel transistors
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine the diffusive long-channel mobility with the ballistic mobility μ_B = q v_th L/(2kT) using Matthiessen's rule. Compute the apparent mobility versus channel length for Si and InGaAs and the length where ballistic effects dominate.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Persistent photoconductivity stretched-exponential decay from a barrier distribution
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model PPC decay as a superposition of thermally activated capture rates over a Gaussian distribution of capture barriers. Integrate to obtain the decay transient and fit a Kohlrausch stretched exponential to extract τ(T) and β.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Haynes–Shockley pulse drift and spreading for mobility, diffusion and lifetime
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the drifting, diffusing and decaying Gaussian carrier packet at a detector a distance d away for several fields. Fit arrival times, widths and amplitudes to recover μ, D and τ and verify the Einstein relation.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Trap density of states from modulated photocurrent phase spectroscopy
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the modulated photocurrent of a photoconductor with an exponential band tail by integrating the multiple-trapping response. Apply the Oheda/Brüggemann formula N(E_ω) ∝ sinφ/|I| to reconstruct the DOS and compare with the input.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: DeVore spectral photoconductive response with front-surface recombination
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve steady-state diffusion of excess carriers in a slab with absorption depth 1/α and front/back SRV. Integrate the excess carriers over thickness to obtain the photoconductance spectrum and its short-wavelength roll-off.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Intensity-dependent photoconductive gain of a nanowire with surface depletion
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model surface Fermi-level pinning, the radial depletion region and hole trapping with thermionic recombination over the surface barrier. Compute the photoconductive gain versus light intensity and nanowire radius, showing the inverse-intensity law.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Uni-traveling-carrier photodiode bandwidth from absorber diffusion and quasi-field
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve electron diffusion with a graded-doping quasi-field in the p-absorber in the frequency domain. Combine with the collector transit-time and RC responses to compute the 3 dB bandwidth versus absorber thickness.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Space-charge saturation current of a p-i-n photodiode at high optical power
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the field collapse in the intrinsic region from photogenerated carriers drifting at saturated velocities using Poisson's equation. Find the photocurrent at which the field reaches zero and its dependence on bias and i-layer width.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Spherical quantum-dot quantum-well CdS/HgS/CdS electron levels
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Match spherical Bessel and Hankel solutions with BenDaniel–Duke conditions across the three-layer onion structure. Find 1s and 1p energies versus HgS shell thickness by root finding.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Lens-shaped InAs self-assembled dot in the adiabatic approximation
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the local vertical finite well at each radius to get an effective lateral potential, then solve the 2D radial problem for s, p and d shells. Compare the shell spacing with a harmonic-oscillator fit.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Numerical derivation of the Brus 1.786 Coulomb coefficient and correlation correction
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the six-dimensional electron–hole Coulomb expectation value for infinite-barrier sinc ground states by reduced radial quadrature. Add a variational correlation factor to obtain the exciton energy in the intermediate-confinement regime.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Pyramidal InAs/GaAs quantum dot ground state by 3D finite differences
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Discretize the effective-mass Hamiltonian with position-dependent mass on a 3D grid containing a square-based pyramid. Solve with a sparse eigensolver for the lowest states and their dependence on base size.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Intraband 1S_e–1P_e transition energy and oscillator strength of colloidal dots
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute finite-barrier spherical-dot 1S and 1P electron levels with nonparabolic mass. Evaluate the radial dipole matrix element and oscillator strength to predict mid-IR absorption versus size.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Bir–Pikus valence-band splitting under uniaxial [001] and [111] stress
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Add strain terms to the 6×6 Luttinger–Kohn Hamiltonian with deformation potentials b and d. Compute band-edge splitting and HH/LH mixing versus stress magnitude in GaAs and Ge, including spin–orbit coupling.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Electron g-factor of InGaAs versus composition from the Roth formula
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate g* = 2 − (2Ep/3)Δ/(Eg(Eg+Δ)) with composition-interpolated parameters and bowing. Find the composition where g* changes sign in AlGaAs and the magnitude of g* in InGaAs.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Nonparabolic optical effective mass and plasma frequency of degenerate n-InN
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the Fermi-surface optical mass from the Kane dispersion and the Fermi level versus density by quadrature. Obtain the screened plasma frequency and its Drude reflectivity minimum versus electron density.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Hopfield quasicubic A, B, C exciton splittings of wurtzite GaN
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Diagonalize the 3×3 crystal-field plus spin–orbit valence Hamiltonian at Γ. Fit the crystal-field and spin–orbit splitting parameters (Δcr, Δso) to A, B, C transition energies and predict their shifts under biaxial strain.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Sech versus Lorentzian broadening artifacts in quantum-well gain spectra
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Convolve a step-like quantum-well gain with Lorentzian and sech lineshapes. Compare spurious sub-gap absorption, peak-gain shift and differential gain, and check consistency with the Bernard–Duraffourg transparency point.
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.area: Optical gain in bulk and quantum wells

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Quantum-wire gain spectrum with broadened 1D density-of-states singularities
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the 1D subband JDOS with inverse-square-root singularities and Lorentzian broadening by careful quadrature. Obtain gain versus linear carrier density and differential gain, and compare with a quantum well.
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.area: Optical gain in bulk and quantum wells

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Spontaneous emission spectrum and radiative current from gain via the McCumber relation
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Convert a computed quantum-well gain spectrum into a spontaneous emission rate using the Fermi-inversion factor. Integrate over energy to obtain the radiative current density at threshold and the population-inversion factor nsp.
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.area: Optical gain in bulk and quantum wells

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: SOA saturation output power and noise figure from the inversion factor
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate the gain-saturation propagation equation along an amplifier with a density-dependent material gain. Compute fiber-to-fiber gain, 3 dB saturation output power and noise figure 2nsp(G−1)/G.
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.area: Optical gain in bulk and quantum wells

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Direct-gap optical gain in tensile-strained n-doped germanium on silicon
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Partition injected and doped electrons between L and Γ valleys using Fermi–Dirac integrals. Compute Γ-valley gain minus free-carrier absorption versus doping and tensile strain to find the net-gain window.
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.area: Optical gain in bulk and quantum wells

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Fröhlich surface optical phonon modes of a polar semiconductor nanocrystal
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve ε(ω)·l + ε_m(l+1) = 0 for l-pole surface phonon frequencies of a CdSe sphere in a matrix, using the TO–LO dielectric function. Compute SO-mode frequencies and their dependence on the host dielectric constant.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Two-mode Raman behavior of AlGaAs from the modified random-element-isodisplacement model
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the MREI equations of motion for the GaAs-like and AlAs-like TO and LO frequencies versus alloy composition. Fit the composition dependence to determine x from measured Raman peaks.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Interface optical phonon dispersion in a GaAs/AlAs quantum well
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use the dielectric continuum model with the frequency-dependent dielectric functions of both materials. Solve the symmetric and antisymmetric interface-mode dispersion versus in-plane wavevector q·d by root finding.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Hydrostatic-pressure Raman shift from mode Grüneisen parameters and Murnaghan EOS
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine the Murnaghan equation of state for volume versus pressure with ω ∝ V^{-γ} for the LO and TO modes. Compute the pressure coefficients and the LO–TO splitting change, and infer the pressure dependence of the effective charge.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: GaInAsSb lattice-matched to GaSb for 2–2.6 µm mid-infrared lasers
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Build quaternary band-gap and lattice-constant interpolation from binary and ternary bowing parameters. Solve the lattice-match constraint together with the target-gap equation for (x,y) using Varshni temperature corrections.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: In_xAl_{1-x}N band gap and lattice match to GaN with composition-dependent bowing
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the InAlN gap with a composition-dependent bowing b(x)=b0/(1+Cx²). Find the GaN lattice-matched composition from Vegard's law on the a-parameter, then compare the gap and wavelength against a constant-bowing model.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: MgZnO composition for solar-blind detection within the wurtzite phase limit
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model the wurtzite and rocksalt MgZnO gaps with separate bowing laws. Find the Mg content giving a 280 nm cutoff and check it against the wurtzite solubility limit, including the Varshni shift at the operating temperature.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: CdZnTe band gap and intrinsic resistivity for room-temperature radiation detectors
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the Cd1-xZnxTe gap from a bowing law with Varshni temperature dependence. From it, get the intrinsic carrier density and maximal resistivity versus Zn content, and invert for the composition reaching 10^10 Ω·cm.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Temperature coefficient dλ/dT of an InGaAs/GaAs quantum-well laser emission
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine the Varshni gaps of well and barrier with a finite-well solution whose confinement energy changes through the band offsets and effective masses. Compute λ(T) and its derivative, and separate the bulk-gap and confinement contributions.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: ZnCdSe/ZnSSe blue-green laser composition lattice-matched to GaAs
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Find the S fraction in ZnS_ySe_{1-y} that lattice-matches GaAs. Then solve for the Cd fraction in a strained ZnCdSe well emitting at 490–520 nm, using bowing, strain shifts and finite-well confinement.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Least-squares extraction of composition-dependent bowing from InGaN gap data
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Fit synthetic band-gap-versus-composition data with constant and composition-dependent bowing models. Use nonlinear least squares with parameter uncertainties and AIC model selection, then propagate the fit errors to the predicted green-emission composition.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Ge-lattice-matched SiGeSn ternary: decoupling lattice constant and direct gap
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Interpolate the Γ and L gaps and the lattice constant of Si_xGe_{1-x-y}Sn_y with bowing. Trace the lattice-matched-to-Ge line and find where the alloy becomes direct and its gap along that line.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Vissenberg–Matters percolation mobility in an exponential density of states
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Vissenberg–Matters closed-form mobility versus carrier density and temperature for an exponential DOS. Its ingredients are the percolation criterion, a Gamma function and the critical bond number. Extract the apparent activation energy and the density exponent.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Correlated disorder model: dipole-induced energy correlations and Poole–Frenkel mobility
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute site energies on a lattice from randomly oriented dipoles via Ewald-free direct sums, giving spatially correlated disorder. Run kinetic Monte Carlo with Miller–Abrahams rates to show the extended ln μ ∝ √F range compared with uncorrelated GDM.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: AC hopping conductivity and frequency exponent s(T) in the correlated-barrier-hopping model
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate pair-approximation relaxation-time distributions to obtain σ(ω) ∝ ω^s for quantum tunneling and correlated-barrier hopping. Compare the predicted temperature dependence of s, which distinguishes the two mechanisms.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Wavefunction-shrinkage positive magnetoresistance in the Mott variable-range-hopping regime
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the magnetic-field correction to the Mott hopping exponent in the weak-field (∝B²T^-3/4) and strong-field limits. Do this via the Shklovskii percolation result, and locate the crossover field versus temperature and localization length.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Trap-limited hopping mobility with a Gaussian trap distribution in a Gaussian host
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use kinetic Monte Carlo on a lattice whose DOS is a host Gaussian plus a deeper Gaussian trap fraction. Compute mobility versus trap concentration and depth, and compare with the effective-medium transport-energy prediction.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Field-enhanced diffusion and anomalous Einstein ratio in the Gaussian disorder model
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Run kinetic Monte Carlo of independent carriers in a GDM lattice under field. Extract the drift velocity and the longitudinal diffusion coefficient from the packet mean and variance, and show that D/μ exceeds kT/q as field and disorder grow.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Electron hopping mobility in a polydisperse quantum-dot solid with Marcus rates and charging energy
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Assign quantum-dot sizes from a log-normal distribution, which set their confinement energies and charging energies. Use Marcus hopping rates with nearest-neighbor tunneling couplings, and compute mobility versus size dispersion by kinetic Monte Carlo.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Spurious solutions in 8-band k·p and Foreman's rescaling of the Kane parameter
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Diagonalize the 8-band Kane Hamiltonian for InAs with Luttinger-derived remote-band parameters and detect the unphysical band bending at large k. Implement Foreman's Ep rescaling that sets the remote conduction-band term to zero.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Six-band Luttinger–Kohn valence bands of silicon with small spin-orbit splitting
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Build the 6×6 Luttinger–Kohn Hamiltonian including the split-off band for Si. Compute the dispersions along [100], [110] and [111], and quantify the strong heavy/light-hole nonparabolicity caused by the small Δso compared with a 4-band model.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Crystal-field valence-band crossover in AlGaN from the wurtzite 6×6 k·p Hamiltonian
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Interpolate Δcr, Δso and the A-parameters between GaN and AlN, adding biaxial strain terms. Diagonalize the 6×6 Hamiltonian at Γ and near Γ to find the Al content at which the crystal-field split-off band becomes topmost.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Rashba spin-orbit coefficient of an asymmetric InGaAs quantum well from 8-band theory
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve for the ground subband of a biased or step-asymmetric InGaAs well. Evaluate the Rashba coefficient as an expectation value of the 8-band k·p field term, including interface contributions, and compute the spin splitting at the Fermi wavevector.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Kane fermions: linear dispersion of gapless HgCdTe at the critical composition
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use the three-band Kane model with a composition- and temperature-dependent Γ6–Γ8 gap. Find the critical Cd fraction at which the gap closes, and compute the conical electron dispersion, the flat-band velocity and the density-of-states effective mass versus energy.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Temperature-dependent electron effective mass of InAs and InSb from Kane theory
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine the Varshni gap with the two- or three-band Kane mass formula, including lattice dilation of Ep, to get m*(T). Then compute the resulting temperature dependence of the conduction-band effective density of states and the intrinsic carrier density.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: In-plane hole transport mass of biaxially compressed Ge from strained 6-band k·p
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Add Bir–Pikus strain to the 6-band Hamiltonian and diagonalize it on an in-plane k-grid. Compute the strain dependence of the top band's density-of-states and conductivity masses, using a Boltzmann-weighted average for p-channel devices.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Thermal crosstalk in a 2D VCSEL array by Green's-function superposition
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model each VCSEL as a disk heat source on a semi-infinite substrate with a closed-form or quadrature disk Green's function. Superpose the sources to get each emitter's temperature rise and the resulting wavelength shifts across the array.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: VCSEL thermal resistance with anisotropic DBR conductivity and alloy-scattering kappa
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute AlGaAs alloy thermal conductivities and the effective in-plane and cross-plane conductivities of the DBR stack. Evaluate the thermal resistance of a disk source on a layered structure via a Hankel-transform integral, and compare with the 1/(4κa) estimate.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Thermal runaway criterion of a reverse-biased diode with temperature-activated leakage
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Couple the generation and diffusion leakage current I(T), which rises exponentially with T, to a thermal resistance load line. Solve the steady state with root finding and locate the saddle-node bifurcation that sets the maximum stable bias.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Heat-sink fin array thermal resistance for a high-power LED luminaire
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the natural-convection heat transfer coefficient from Nusselt correlations and the fin efficiency tanh(mL)/(mL). Combine them with the base spreading resistance to get the total junction-to-ambient resistance, and optimize the fin spacing.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Active-region temperature rise of a quantum cascade laser under pulsed operation
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the 1D transient heat equation through a layered stack with very low cross-plane superlattice conductivity using a Laplace or series solution. Compute the active-region temperature versus pulse width and duty cycle.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Heat-generation partition in an operating solar cell
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: For a detailed-balance single-junction cell at its maximum power point, integrate over the spectrum to split absorbed power into thermalization, sub-gap transmission, recombination, Peltier/junction and electrical output. Report the heat load versus band gap.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Radiative sky cooling of a PV module through the atmospheric window
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate the module's spectral emissivity against the blackbody spectrum and a model atmospheric transmittance to obtain net radiative cooling. Solve the module energy balance for the temperature reduction and efficiency gain.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: 3ω method thermal conductivity of a thin film on a substrate
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate Cahill's line-heater integral for the in-phase and quadrature temperature oscillations of a heater on a substrate. Add the thin-film 1D resistance term and fit synthetic 3ω data to extract the film's thermal conductivity.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Cauer structure function from an LED thermal transient measurement
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the time-constant spectrum of a synthetic heating curve by deconvolving its log-time derivative. Convert the resulting Foster network to a Cauer ladder by continued-fraction transformation, and build the cumulative structure function to identify layer resistances.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: GaN/AlN quantum-well intersubband transitions at 1.55 µm with built-in polarization fields
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the Schrödinger equation with nonparabolic mass for a GaN well in AlN that carries a piezoelectric and spontaneous field and a large offset. Compute the e1–e2 energy and dipole versus well width to reach telecom wavelengths.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Interface-roughness intersubband linewidth from the Unuma model
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the intra- and intersubband interface-roughness scattering rates using wavefunction values at the interfaces and a Gaussian correlation function. Combine them to get the e1–e2 absorption linewidth versus well width and roughness parameters.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Resonant third-harmonic susceptibility of an asymmetric coupled quantum well
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Find the subband energies and dipole matrix elements of a four-level asymmetric coupled well. Evaluate the χ(3)(3ω) sum over states with dephasing and choose the coupling-barrier width that maximizes triply resonant enhancement.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Intersubband absorption saturation intensity from T1 and T2
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use a two-level density-matrix model with LO-phonon T1 and dephasing T2 to compute the intensity-dependent absorption coefficient. Obtain the saturation intensity of a doped GaAs well and its dependence on doping and linewidth.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Thomas–Reiche–Kuhn oscillator-strength sum rule for a finite quantum well
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute bound-state and discretized continuum oscillator strengths from the ground subband of a finite well using a large-box finite-difference basis. Verify the sum rule and show how bound-to-continuum strength grows as the well narrows.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Intersubband polariton Rabi splitting of doped quantum wells in a microcavity
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the plasma-like coupling strength from the sheet density, the oscillator strength and the cavity overlap factor. Diagonalize the Hopfield-type polariton Hamiltonian and plot the anticrossing versus detuning and doping.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Normal-incidence absorption of a p-type GaAs/AlGaAs QWIP from valence-band mixing
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute heavy- and light-hole subbands at finite in-plane k with a 4-band Luttinger finite-difference model. Evaluate the TE- and TM-polarized hole intersubband matrix elements and integrate over occupied k to compare the normal-incidence absorption.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Nonparabolicity-induced asymmetric broadening of intersubband absorption lines
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Calculate the e1 and e2 dispersions in a narrow InGaAs well with an energy-dependent mass, so the transition energy shrinks with in-plane k. Integrate over the Fermi–Dirac occupied k-space with Lorentzian broadening to obtain the asymmetric lineshape versus doping and temperature.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: 45° facet versus 1D grating coupling quantum efficiency of a QWIP
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the polarization projection for 45° facet coupling, and the diffracted-order angles and TM fraction for a lamellar grating. Combine them with multipass intersubband absorption to compare net quantum efficiency versus wavelength.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: LO-phonon intersubband scattering rate from the Fröhlich form-factor integral
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the Fröhlich LO-emission rate between two subbands by numerically integrating the wavefunction form factor over phonon wavevector and in-plane angle. Map the lifetime versus subband spacing to show the resonance at ħω_LO.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Kazarinov–Suris resonant tunneling injection in a resonant-phonon THz QCL
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the anticrossing gap 2ħΩ of the injector and upper levels from a double-well calculation. Evaluate the Kazarinov–Suris current versus detuning and upper-state lifetime, and find the peak current density and its alignment bias.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Wannier–Stark subbands of a biased QCL period with nonparabolic shooting
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve a nonparabolic Schrödinger equation by shooting across one-and-a-half periods of a GaInAs/AlInAs cascade under bias. Identify the upper, lower and injector states, and compute the laser transition energy and dipole versus applied field.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Thermal backfilling and characteristic temperature T0 of a mid-IR QCL
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine rate equations with Fermi–Dirac backfilling of the lower laser level from the injector and the temperature-dependent LO-phonon upper-state lifetime. Compute J_th(T) and fit T0.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Quantum cascade detector responsivity and R0A from transfer-rate sums
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the subband ladder of a QCD period, the LO-phonon transfer rates between states and the absorption probability. Evaluate the peak responsivity, the zero-bias resistance from equilibrium transfer currents, and the Johnson-limited detectivity.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Electron temperature of QCL subbands from energy-balance rate equations
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the coupled population and energy-balance equations, with LO-phonon emission and absorption rates evaluated at an electron temperature above the lattice temperature. Compute the steady-state Te and the resulting reduction in inversion.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Interface-roughness versus LO-phonon depopulation of the lower QCL laser level
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the interface-roughness scattering rate between the lower laser level and the extraction states, using interface wavefunction amplitudes. Compare it with LO-phonon rates and assess its effect on lower-level lifetime and inversion.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Miniband structure of a chirped-superlattice QCL injector by transfer matrix
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use transfer matrices with a nonparabolic mass to compute transmission and quasi-bound states of a biased chirped superlattice. Identify the miniband width and minigap that block escape from the upper laser level.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Shockley–Queisser limit under concentration and restricted emission angle
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate the AM1.5D spectrum and blackbody emission to compute detailed-balance J–V and efficiency versus concentration factor and emission solid angle. Show that full concentration and angular restriction raise the limit equivalently.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Three-junction series-constrained optimum band gaps by detailed balance
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute detailed-balance subcell J–V curves under AM1.5G, impose current matching through series voltage addition, and optimize the three gaps with scipy. Map the efficiency sensitivity around the optimum.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Thermophotovoltaic detailed-balance efficiency with a selective emitter
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate the emitter's Planck spectrum with a step or bandpass emissivity, together with sub-gap photon recycling. Compute TPV power density and efficiency versus cell gap and emitter temperature.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Detailed-balance limit with multiple exciton generation or singlet fission
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Modify the photon-to-carrier yield into a staircase quantum yield above multiples of Eg (Hanna–Nozik). Include the matching modification of emission, and compute the efficiency versus gap for the MEG and singlet-fission scenarios.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Trupke detailed-balance limit of a solar cell with a rear upconverter
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model the upconverter as a two-step detailed-balance absorber/emitter that converts sub-gap photons. Solve the coupled chemical-potential balance equations and compute the efficiency versus host gap.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Indoor photovoltaic detailed-balance limit under white-LED illumination
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Build a phosphor-converted LED spectrum from Gaussian blue and phosphor bands scaled to a given illuminance in lux. Compute the detailed-balance efficiency versus band gap and its optimum, compared with AM1.5.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Thermoradiative cell power from a warm emitter facing a cold sky
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Apply generalized Planck emission at a negative chemical potential to integrate the net photon flux between a cell at T_cell and a cold environment. Compute the power density versus gap and the maximum nighttime output.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Solar-to-hydrogen efficiency limit of a tandem photoelectrochemical cell
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the detailed-balance J–V of top and bottom absorbers in series. Intersect it with the water-splitting load curve (1.23 V plus Tafel overpotentials) to map STH efficiency versus the two gaps.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Urbach-tail absorptance and its penalty on the Shockley–Queisser Voc
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Replace the step absorptance with a band-edge absorber that has an exponential Urbach tail. Integrate the radiative dark current, which the tail enhances, and compute the Voc and efficiency loss versus Urbach energy and thickness.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Detailed-balance efficiency of a laser power converter under monochromatic light
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute detailed-balance J–V under a narrowband beam with photon energy above Eg, including radiative recombination. Get the efficiency versus intensity and photon-energy excess, and the optimal gap for a 1064 nm beam.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Van der Pauw sheet resistance and Hall mobility from four-terminal data
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the transcendental van der Pauw equation for sheet resistance from two resistance configurations using Newton's method. Combine it with field-reversed Hall voltages to extract carrier density and mobility, and propagate the uncertainties.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: TRPL lifetime extraction by instrument-response reconvolution fitting
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Convolve multiexponential decay models with a measured-shape instrument response function on a time grid. Fit Poisson-weighted photon counts by least squares, and compare amplitude- and intensity-averaged lifetimes and the reduced χ².

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Photoreflectance band-gap extraction with Aspnes third-derivative lineshapes
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Fit photoreflectance spectra containing several transitions with the Aspnes third-derivative functional form, Re[C e^{iθ}(E−Eg+iΓ)^{-m}]. Extract the transition energies and broadenings, and compare 3D and excitonic exponents.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Built-in field from Franz–Keldysh oscillations in electroreflectance
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Locate the extrema of the Franz–Keldysh oscillations in an electromodulation spectrum. Fit the asymptotic relation (4/3)[(E_n−Eg)/ħθ]^{3/2} = nπ+φ to obtain the electro-optic energy, and convert it to the surface field and doping.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Complex refractive index of a wafer from terahertz time-domain transmission
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: FFT the reference and sample pulses and form the complex transmission ratio including Fresnel and Fabry–Pérot factors. Solve iteratively for n(ω) and κ(ω), and derive free-carrier conductivity with a Drude fit.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: HRXRD composition of a pseudomorphic InGaAs layer with tetragonal-distortion correction
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Convert the measured (004) peak splitting to the out-of-plane lattice constant via Bragg's law. Remove the tetragonal distortion using the composition-dependent Poisson ratio, then solve self-consistently for the In fraction under Vegard's law.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: White-light reflectometry fit of dielectric film thickness on silicon
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the spectral reflectance of a SiNx film on Si with Cauchy dispersion using the Airy formula. Fit measured spectra for thickness and Cauchy coefficients, using an FFT initial guess to resolve thickness ambiguity.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Drude plasma-edge reflectance fit for carrier density and optical mass
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model the IR reflectance of degenerate n-InP with a Drude-plus-Lorentz-phonon dielectric function. Fit the spectra for plasma frequency and damping, then combine these with Hall density to extract the optical effective mass.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: AM1.5-weighted double-layer antireflection coating optimization on silicon
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute normal-incidence reflectance of a MgF2/ZnS (or SiO2/SiNx) bilayer on dispersive Si with characteristic matrices. Optimize both thicknesses to minimize photon-flux-weighted reflectance from 300 to 1100 nm.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Ultrathin GaAs solar cell with a back mirror: absorption and Jsc versus thickness
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use transfer matrices for ARC/GaAs/metal-mirror stacks to compute the position-resolved absorption. Integrate it against the AM1.5 photon flux to get the ideal Jsc versus absorber thickness, and compare with single and double passes.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Current matching of a monolithic perovskite/silicon tandem by transfer-matrix absorption
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the layer-resolved absorption of the full tandem stack, with a thick Si layer handled incoherently. Integrate photocurrents for each subcell, and optimize perovskite thickness and interlayer index for current matching.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Schottky diode I–V by drift-diffusion with thermionic-emission boundary conditions
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Discretize Poisson and electron continuity equations with Scharfetter–Gummel fluxes, using a thermionic-recombination-velocity boundary at the metal. Solve with Newton's method and compare the I–V with pure thermionic-emission and diffusion theories.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Open-circuit voltage decay of a p+n diode by transient drift-diffusion
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate the time-dependent continuity equations implicitly after the forward current is interrupted, with zero terminal current imposed. Compute Voc(t) and extract the minority-carrier lifetime from the dVoc/dt slope.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Bipolar transistor Gummel plot and current gain falloff by 1D drift-diffusion
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the n-p-n structure with Scharfetter–Gummel discretization and Newton's method for a sweep of base-emitter biases. Compute collector and base currents and the β roll-off at high injection, which follows from base conductivity modulation.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Warm-optics self-emission degrading BLIP detectivity of a cooled MWIR photodiode
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate the Planck photon flux from a warm window, a cold filter and scene emission over the band, each weighted by its emissivity, solid angle and transmission. Combine the fluxes into background shot noise and compute D* relative to the ideal-scene BLIP value as a function of window temperature and emissivity.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Radiation-exchange-limited detectivity of an ideal thermal detector versus temperature
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute temperature-fluctuation noise from the Stefan–Boltzmann radiative conductance of a blackbody thermal detector viewing a background. Derive NEP and D* as functions of detector and background temperature, and compare with photon-detector BLIP D* integrated over the same spectrum.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Hooge 1/f noise corner and bandwidth-integrated NEP of a photoconductor
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model the current noise PSD as the sum of Hooge 1/f noise (alpha_H/N), G-R noise with a lifetime Lorentzian, and Johnson noise. Find the 1/f corner frequency and integrate the PSD over a measurement bandwidth to obtain NEP and D* versus bias and carrier number.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Rule 07 HgCdTe dark-current benchmark and implied D* versus cutoff and temperature
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Implement the Rule 07 empirical dark-current density with its cutoff-wavelength piecewise scaling and combine it with shot and Johnson noise to obtain D*. Find, for several cutoff wavelengths, the temperature at which dark-current-limited D* equals the background-limited D* computed from a Planck flux integral.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: SPAD count-rate saturation with paralyzable and nonparalyzable dead time
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Derive detected count rate versus incident photon rate for the two dead-time models, using Poisson arrival statistics and photon detection efficiency. Invert measured rates for true flux and compute counting SNR and the effective dynamic range including dark counts.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Afromowitz model of AlGaAs refractive index below the band gap
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Build Afromowitz's model of epsilon_2 with a truncated power-law shape between E_g and the cutoff energy E_f, with E_0, E_d and E_g varying with composition. Kramers–Kronig integrate it in closed form and numerically to get n(E, x), then compute the GaAs/AlGaAs index step at a lasing wavelength.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Effective electron number and static dielectric constant of silicon from optical sum rules
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate a model epsilon_2(E) for silicon (Tauc–Lorentz critical-point peaks) to obtain the f-sum effective electron count n_eff(E) and the static dielectric constant from the KK zero-frequency sum rule. Compare both with the 4 valence electrons per atom and with epsilon_infinity ≈ 11.7.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Wemple–DiDomenico single-oscillator analysis of semiconductor refractive index dispersion
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Linearize below-gap n(E) data as 1/(n²−1) versus E² to extract the oscillator energy E_0 and dispersion energy E_d. Then derive the static index and the moments M_-1 and M_-3 of the epsilon_2 spectrum, and compare oscillator parameters across several compound semiconductors.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Bruggeman versus Maxwell-Garnett effective optical constants of porous silicon
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the Bruggeman self-consistency equation (choosing the physical complex root) and the Maxwell-Garnett formula for silicon–air composites over the spectrum. Compute n, k, the absorption edge shift and normal-incidence thin-film reflectance versus porosity.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Marcus–Levich–Jortner hopping rate with a quantized vibrational mode versus temperature
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the MLJ rate as a Poisson-weighted sum over high-frequency vibronic channels with classical low-frequency reorganization. Compare it with Marcus and Miller–Abrahams rates versus driving force (including the inverted region) and temperature, and convert it to a dimer-chain mobility via the Einstein relation.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Lang–Kobayashi bifurcation diagram versus feedback rate toward coherence collapse
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate the Lang–Kobayashi delay differential equations with a fixed-step method of steps and a history buffer. Record intensity extrema after transients as the feedback rate is swept, and identify the Hopf onset of relaxation-oscillation undamping and the transition to chaos.
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.area: Laser dynamics with feedback and injection

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Resonance-frequency enhancement in the modulation response of an injection-locked laser
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Linearize the locked-laser rate equations to obtain the small-signal transfer function. Compute the enhanced resonance frequency, the low-frequency dip and the 3-dB bandwidth versus injection ratio and detuning, and compare them with the free-running response.
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.area: Laser dynamics with feedback and injection

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Sommerfeld-factor suppression of quantum-wire absorption from 1D Bloch equations
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the linear semiconductor Bloch equations in k-space for a 1D wire with a regularized Coulomb potential. Obtain the absorption spectrum with a 1D exciton bound state, and show that the above-gap 1D singularity is suppressed (Sommerfeld factor below 1) relative to free-carrier absorption.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Nernst–Ettingshausen coefficient versus scattering exponent and reduced Fermi level
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Boltzmann transport integrals with tau ∝ E^r and Fermi–Dirac integrals to obtain the isothermal Nernst coefficient of a single parabolic band. Map its sign change with scattering mechanism and its decay with degeneracy.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Polar-optical-phonon limited Seebeck and power factor via Howarth–Sondheimer integrals
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute conductivity and Seebeck coefficient of a polar semiconductor when energy-dependent relaxation times are inadequate for inelastic LO-phonon scattering. Use the Howarth–Sondheimer variational expressions evaluated by quadrature, and compare with an elastic relaxation-time approximation versus doping.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Negative-U DX-center compensation limiting free electrons in Si-doped AlGaN
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model the Si donor with a shallow d0/d+ level and a DX− state whose formation energy depends on Al fraction. Solve charge neutrality self-consistently for the Fermi level and compute the free-electron density and doping efficiency versus composition and Si concentration.
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.area: Defect formation energies and charge transitions

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Freysoldt–Neugebauer–Van de Walle finite-size correction for a charged supercell defect
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the lattice energy of a Gaussian model charge in a neutralizing background by Ewald summation in a dielectric medium. Add the potential-alignment term from planar-averaged model potentials, and evaluate the corrected formation energy for cubic supercells of increasing size.
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.area: Defect formation energies and charge transitions

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Vertical versus diagonal QCL transitions: upper-state lifetime times dipole squared figure of merit
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model a coupled-well active region whose dipole matrix element and upper-state LO-phonon lifetime both vary with injection barrier thickness. Compute the gain figure of merit (tau_3(1 − tau_2/tau_32) z_32²) and find the barrier thickness that maximizes it at fixed bias.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Second-class Elliott absorption: Cu2O yellow P-exciton series and continuum
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the dipole-forbidden Elliott absorption, with P-exciton line strengths scaling as (n²−1)/n⁵ and a continuum Sommerfeld factor that includes the (1+1/x²) term. Lorentzian-broaden the series for Cu2O parameters and compare peak heights with those of allowed transitions.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Thermally averaged radiative lifetime of free excitons in a GaAs quantum well
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine the intrinsic radiative rate of zero-momentum quantum-well excitons with a Boltzmann distribution of center-of-mass momenta. Integrate over the light-cone fraction to get the effective lifetime versus temperature, which grows linearly with T.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Variational exciton binding energy in a uniaxial anisotropic-mass bulk crystal
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Minimize a Faulkner-type anisotropic hydrogenic trial energy with different in-plane and axial masses and dielectric constants. Evaluate the energy integrals in closed form with arctan/artanh expressions, and obtain the binding energy and the Bohr radii versus mass anisotropy.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Field-ionization rate and Stark broadening of 3D excitons
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the hydrogenic tunneling ionization rate of a Wannier exciton in a uniform field, using exciton Rydberg and Bohr radius scaling. Convert the rate into a lifetime broadening of the 1s absorption peak and compute the field at which the exciton peak washes out.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Ridley lucky-drift impact ionization coefficient and avalanche gain in amorphous selenium
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate Ridley's lucky-drift expression for α(E), built from the phonon mean free path, the energy relaxation length and the ionization threshold. Integrate dM/dx in a uniform-field a-Se layer to get the gain versus field and thickness for an avalanche (HARP) photoconductor.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Multiplication-width optimization of InAlAs APDs: tunneling dark current versus breakdown
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: For a uniform-field InAlAs avalanche layer, compute the breakdown field from ionization integrals and the Kane band-to-band tunneling current density at breakdown, both as functions of width. Add the local-model excess noise and find the width that maximizes SNR at a given gain.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Thermal-mismatch bow ('smile') of a soldered laser bar via Timoshenko bimetal theory
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Apply Timoshenko's bilayer curvature formula to a GaAs bar soldered onto a Cu or CuW heat sink, using the CTE mismatch and the cool-down from the solder temperature. Compute the bar curvature, the emitter height deviation across a 10 mm bar and the residual interface stress.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Transient-grating decay rates versus grating period: ambipolar diffusion and lifetime
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model the decay rate of a sinusoidal carrier grating as Γ = 1/τ + 4π²D_a/Λ² and compute the diffraction-efficiency transient. Fit synthetic multi-period data to extract D_a and τ, and from these the ambipolar mobility via the Einstein relation.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Femtosecond laser excitation of silicon: carrier density and lattice heating toward melting
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate van Driel-type rate equations for the carrier density, including one- and two-photon absorption and free-carrier absorption, with Auger recombination and carrier–lattice energy transfer. Find the fluence at which the lattice reaches the melting temperature.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Wavelength exponent of free-carrier absorption for acoustic, optical and impurity scattering
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute free-carrier absorption from the Drude formula with frequency-dependent scattering times, using quantum-mechanical expressions averaged over a Maxwellian distribution. Show how the λ^p exponent arises and fit the composite α(λ) of n-GaAs.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Epsilon-near-zero wavelength and plasmonic figure of merit of Al-doped ZnO films
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use a Drude–Lorentz dielectric function with a nonparabolic optical mass versus carrier density to find where Re ε = 0. Compute −Re ε/Im ε and the ENZ bandwidth versus doping for a transparent conducting oxide.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Band-gap narrowing in heavily doped Si and Ge from the Jain–Roulston model
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the exchange and correlation terms of the Jain–Roulston model, including the N^{1/3}, N^{1/4} and N^{1/2} contributions, for majority- and minority-band shifts. Compute the effective intrinsic density enhancement n_ie²/n_i² versus doping.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Photoluminescence quantum yield from integrating-sphere measurements (de Mello method)
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Implement the three-measurement de Mello analysis, with the sample out of the beam, indirectly illuminated and directly illuminated. Integrate laser and emission spectral regions to obtain the absorptance and PLQY, and propagate measurement uncertainties.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Adachi model dielectric function of GaAs from critical-point contributions
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Sum Adachi's analytic contributions from the E0, E0+Δ0, E1 and E1+Δ1 critical points and the E2 damped oscillator. Compute ε(ω), n, k and the absorption of GaAs from 1 to 6 eV.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Thermo-optic coefficient dn/dT of Si and GaAs from a temperature-dependent oscillator model
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine a single-oscillator or Sellmeier index with a Varshni-shifting gap and a thermal-expansion term. Compute dn/dT versus wavelength below the gap and the resulting thermal phase shift of a waveguide.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Refractive-index change near an inhomogeneously broadened quantum-dot absorption line
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model the ensemble absorption as a Voigt or Gaussian line and obtain the dispersive part from the Faddeeva function. Compute Δn(λ) and the linewidth enhancement factor for a quantum-dot ensemble at a given occupation.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Dyakonov–Perel spin relaxation time in bulk n-GaAs versus temperature and density
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate τ_s⁻¹ ∝ γ² τ_p E³ averaged over Fermi–Dirac distributions, using the cubic Dresselhaus coefficient and the momentum relaxation time from mobility. Show the crossover from the degenerate to the nondegenerate regime.
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.area: Spin relaxation and spintronics in semiconductors

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Elliott–Yafet versus Dyakonov–Perel spin relaxation crossover in narrow-gap semiconductors
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the Elliott–Yafet rate, which scales as ∝ (Δ/(Eg+Δ))²(E/Eg)²/τ_p, and the Dyakonov–Perel rate, which scales as ∝ τ_p, for InSb, InAs and GaAs. Find the mobility or temperature at which the dominant spin relaxation mechanism switches.
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.area: Spin relaxation and spintronics in semiconductors

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Faraday rotation spectrum from spin-polarized carriers in GaAs
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model σ+ and σ− absorption edges shifted by spin-dependent band filling, and obtain n± via Kramers–Kronig. Compute the Faraday rotation angle versus photon energy and spin polarization for a given sample thickness.
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.area: Spin relaxation and spintronics in semiconductors

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Inverted Γ-point band ordering of α-Sn from empirical pseudopotentials
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Assemble the EPM Hamiltonian of diamond-structure α-Sn from its form factors and diagonalize at Γ, L and X. Identify the negative Γ7⁻–Γ8⁺ ordering, the zero-gap semimetal and the L-valley energies.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Linewidth narrowing and broadening of a laser under weak optical feedback
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the feedback phase equation and the linewidth Δν = Δν0/[1 + C cos(ω0τ + arctan α)]² for C < 1. Map the linewidth versus external-cavity length and feedback level, and locate the minimum-linewidth phase.
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.area: Laser dynamics with feedback and injection

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Monroe transport energy in an exponential band tail of amorphous silicon
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the Monroe condition for the transport energy E_t(T) in an exponential density of states N0 exp(E/E0)/E0. Compute the hopping-limited drift mobility and activation energy versus temperature, including the crossover to multiple trapping.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Small-polaron Austin–Mott conductivity of transition-metal-oxide glasses
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate σ = ν0 e² c(1−c) e^{−2αR}/(kTR) exp(−W/kT), using the Holstein activation energy W = W_H/2 + W_D/2 below θ_D/2. Compute σ(T) and its dependence on the site occupancy c for vanadate glasses.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Incomplete ionization of nitrogen donors on hexagonal and cubic sites in 4H-SiC
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve charge neutrality with two inequivalent donor levels, each with its own degeneracy and ionization energy, using Fermi–Dirac statistics and compensation. Compute the free-electron density and ionized fraction versus temperature from 100 to 700 K.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Nonradiative open-circuit voltage loss from Rau's reciprocity relation
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the radiative saturation current J0,rad from a measured EQE spectrum folded with the 300 K blackbody, then V_oc,rad. Subtract kT ln(1/EQE_EL) to get the actual V_oc, and compare solar cell technologies.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Small-pixel effect in CdZnTe detectors from the Shockley–Ramo weighting potential
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the weighting potential of a pixel electrode on a planar detector from its Fourier-series solution. Integrate the induced charge for electron and hole drift with trapping, and compare the pulse-height spectra of planar and pixelated geometries.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Fano-limited energy resolution of Si, Ge, CdTe and diamond X-ray detectors
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Estimate the pair-creation energy with the Klein formula from the band gap and phonon energy, then compute the FWHM resolution from Fano noise plus electronic ENC. Compare 5.9 keV and 60 keV resolution across materials.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Betavoltaic cell efficiency from a Ni-63 or tritium beta spectrum
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate the Fermi beta spectrum, with a Fermi function approximation, together with an energy-deposition depth profile. Combine the collection probability and pair-creation energy to get the short-circuit current, open-circuit voltage and conversion efficiency of a Si or SiC betavoltaic.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Photon-enhanced thermionic emission converter efficiency versus temperature and band gap
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine the elevated conduction-band population from photoexcitation with Richardson emission over the electron affinity barrier. Include radiative and nonradiative recombination, back emission from the anode and the anode work function, then find the optimal cathode temperature and band gap.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Quantum efficiency of a negative-electron-affinity GaAs photocathode from the Spicer diffusion model
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate QE(λ) = P(1−R)/(1 + 1/(αL)) for a semi-infinite NEA cathode, and its finite-thickness version with back-interface recombination. Fit the escape probability and diffusion length to synthetic spectral data.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Photon-recycling factor of radiative lifetime in GaAs double heterostructures
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the Asbeck photon-recycling factor by integrating the emission spectrum over the reabsorption escape probability for a slab with total internal reflection. Obtain the effective radiative lifetime versus active-layer thickness.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Radiative recombination coefficient B from absorption via van Roosbroeck–Shockley
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate n²α(E)E² exp(−E/kT) using an absorption model with Urbach tail and band-to-band terms to get the thermal radiative rate. Divide by n_i² to obtain B for GaAs, InP and Si versus temperature.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Half-wave voltage–length product of a GaAs/AlGaAs Pockels waveguide modulator
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the electro-optic phase n³r41E/2 with the overlap between the optical mode and the field across a p-i-n waveguide. Obtain VπL versus intrinsic thickness, including the Franz–Keldysh-free wavelength limit.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Quasi-phase-matching period of orientation-patterned GaAs for mid-IR difference-frequency generation
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use a temperature-dependent GaAs Sellmeier equation to compute the wavevector mismatch for given pump and signal wavelengths. Obtain the QPM period, the temperature and wavelength acceptance bandwidths, and the d_eff-scaled conversion efficiency.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: MRI-model depth resolution function for SIMS profiles of semiconductor delta layers
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Construct the Hofmann mixing–roughness–information depth resolution function and convolve it with true delta-doped or quantum-well profiles. Compute the measured FWHM and decay lengths, and fit the MRI parameters to synthetic profiles.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Universal volume scaling of biexciton Auger lifetimes in colloidal quantum dots
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Apply τ_XX ∝ V scaling to dots of different size, and include the radiative biexciton rate. Compute the biexciton PL quantum yield, and the sustained gain lifetime versus radius for CdSe and PbSe.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Nonlinear transmission of a silicon waveguide with two-photon and free-carrier absorption
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate the propagation equations dI/dz = −αI − βI² − σ_FCA N I, with steady-state N set by TPA generation and carrier lifetime. Compute output versus input power and the lifetime needed to avoid FCA saturation.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Mott–Schottky analysis of a semiconductor photoelectrode for flat-band potential and doping
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the space-charge capacitance of an n-type electrode versus potential, including kT/q and Helmholtz-layer corrections. Fit synthetic 1/C² data to extract V_fb and N_D, and convert V_fb into band-edge positions versus the reversible hydrogen electrode.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Steady-state photocarrier grating method for ambipolar diffusion length in a-Si:H
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Ritter–Zeldov–Weiser expression for photocurrent ratio β versus grating period. Include fringe visibility and dark-conductivity factors, and fit synthetic data to extract the ambipolar diffusion length.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Polarization anisotropy of nanowire absorption from quasi-static dielectric mismatch
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the internal field reduction factor 2ε_m/(ε+ε_m) for light polarized perpendicular to a thin semiconductor nanowire. Obtain the absorption polarization ratio versus wavelength for InP and CdSe wires in different environments.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Photon transfer curve analysis of an image sensor: conversion gain and read noise
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model the signal variance versus mean as shot noise plus read noise plus fixed-pattern noise. Fit synthetic flat-field data to get conversion gain, read noise and full-well capacity, then compute dynamic range and SNR.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Effective Richardson constants of Si and Ge from anisotropic multi-valley masses
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Sum √(m_y m_z)-type projected masses over the equivalent ellipsoidal valleys for (100), (110) and (111) interfaces, and add the light- and heavy-hole contributions. Compute A* for electrons and holes and the resulting thermionic current ratios.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Resonant spin amplification in time-resolved Kerr rotation of n-GaAs
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Sum the decaying spin precession contributions from a periodic pump-pulse train, which gives a geometric series in exp(−T_rep/T2*). Include g-factor inhomogeneity, then compute the Kerr signal at negative delay versus magnetic field and extract g and T2*.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Mid-infrared surface plasmon polaritons on heavily doped silicon
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use the Drude permittivity of n++ Si, including mobility versus doping, in the SPP dispersion relation. Compute the propagation length, field penetration depth and figure of merit versus doping and wavelength.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Form birefringence of GaAs/AlAs multilayers for birefringent phase matching
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute ordinary and extraordinary effective indices of an oxidized GaAs/AlOx or GaAs/AlAs stack from Rytov's zeroth-order effective-medium formulas with Sellmeier dispersion. Find the phase-matched wavelengths for second-harmonic generation.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Liptay analysis of Stark electroabsorption in an organic semiconductor film
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Fit an electroabsorption spectrum, which scales with field squared, as a combination of the zeroth, first and second derivatives of the absorption spectrum. Extract the change in polarizability Δp and the dipole moment |Δμ| of the excited state.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Photoexcited electron spin polarization in bulk versus strained GaAs versus excitation energy
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine heavy-hole, light-hole and split-off transition strengths with their selection rules and absorption onsets. Compute the initial spin polarization versus photon energy, showing the 50% limit and its lifting by strain splitting of the heavy- and light-hole bands.
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.area: Spin relaxation and spintronics in semiconductors

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Electrical and thermal efficiency of a photovoltaic–thermal hybrid collector
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Apply the Hottel–Whillier–Florschuetz model with a fin efficiency, collector efficiency factor F′ and heat-removal factor F_R. Include temperature-dependent PV efficiency, then compute combined efficiency versus inlet temperature and flow rate.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Marcus–Gerischer interfacial electron-transfer rate at a semiconductor–electrolyte junction
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate the overlap of the conduction-band density of states with the Gaussian redox-acceptor density of states, which depends on the reorganization energy. Compute the rate constant and current versus band-edge overpotential and the Marcus inverted region.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Leaky-mode resonant absorption of a single silicon nanowire from Mie cylinder theory
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate Lorenz–Mie Bessel and Hankel series coefficients for TE and TM illumination of an infinite Si cylinder. Compute the absorption efficiency spectra versus diameter and identify the TM01 and TM11 leaky-mode resonances.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Charge-diffusion modulation transfer function of a back-illuminated CCD
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use the Seib closed-form expression for lateral diffusion in a field-free layer, with an absorption-depth distribution, to compute the MTF versus spatial frequency and wavelength. Combine it with the pixel aperture MTF.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Exciton binding energy with polaronic screening in halide perovskites (Pollmann–Büttner)
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Pollmann–Büttner effective electron–hole potential, which interpolates between ε∞ and ε0 with polaron radii. Variationally compute the exciton binding energy for MAPbI3 and CsPbBr3 and compare it with the static and high-frequency limits.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Photo-Dember field and terahertz emission from an InAs surface
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the transient diffusion dipole from the electron–hole mobility asymmetry and the absorption depth with closed-form ambipolar expressions. Evaluate the THz far-field amplitude versus excitation wavelength for InAs, InSb and GaAs.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Free-carrier Faraday rotation for optical effective mass determination
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Drude magneto-optical rotation θ = e³Nλ²Bd/(8π²ε0c³n m*²), including nonparabolic mass versus density for n-InSb or n-GaAs. Fit synthetic rotation-versus-λ data to extract m*.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Electron-beam generation profile for cathodoluminescence: Kanaya–Okayama range and Everhart–Hoff depth-dose
