materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the Kanaya–Okayama penetration range and the Everhart–Hoff universal depth-dose polynomial versus beam energy. Integrate the generation profile with diffusion and surface recombination to get the cathodoluminescence intensity versus beam energy.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Thermionic versus tunneling escape times from quantum wells in a biased MQW p-i-n
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Schneider–Klitzing thermionic escape time over the field-lowered barrier and a WKB tunneling escape time for electrons and holes. Compute the photocurrent collection efficiency versus field and temperature.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Shallow acceptor binding energies from Luttinger parameters (Baldereschi–Lipari spherical model)
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the hole-mass anisotropy parameter μ and effective Rydberg from γ1, γ2, γ3 and the dielectric constant. Solve the coupled radial equations of the spherical model numerically for the 1S3/2 acceptor ground state in Si, Ge, GaAs and InP.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Many-valley piezoresistance coefficients of n-type silicon from valley repopulation
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Shift the six Δ valleys of Si with uniaxial stress using the shear deformation potential and repopulate them with Boltzmann or Fermi–Dirac statistics. Sum the anisotropic conductivity tensors to obtain π11 and π12 versus temperature and doping.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Self-phase-modulation spectral broadening in an AlGaAs waveguide below the half-gap by split-step
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the nonlinear Schrödinger equation with GVD, Kerr nonlinearity, two-photon absorption and linear loss using the split-step Fourier method. Return the output spectrum and RMS spectral width versus input peak power and compare them with the lossless SPM estimate.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Kerr-induced optical bistability of an AlGaAs microring resonator
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine the steady-state intracavity power of an all-pass ring with a Kerr resonance shift proportional to stored power. Solve the cubic for the multivalued transmission, the hysteresis switching thresholds and the minimum detuning needed for bistability.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Four-wave-mixing wavelength conversion efficiency in an SOA versus pump–probe detuning
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Sum the carrier-density-pulsation, carrier-heating and spectral-hole-burning contributions as complex Lorentzian responses with their α-factors. Compute conversion efficiency versus up- and down-detuning, including the asymmetry from the phase interference.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: THz generation by optical rectification in ZnTe: velocity mismatch and crystal-length spectrum
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the THz refractive index of ZnTe from a TO-phonon oscillator and the optical group index from a Sellmeier model. Evaluate the phase-mismatch sinc², absorption and pump bandwidth factors to give the generated THz spectrum and coherence length versus crystal thickness.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Net gain of a silicon Raman amplifier limited by TPA-induced free-carrier absorption
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate the coupled pump and Stokes intensity equations with Raman gain, TPA, and free-carrier absorption whose density is set by TPA and the effective carrier lifetime. Find net Stokes gain versus pump intensity and lifetime, including the optimal pump level.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Maker-fringe second-harmonic generation from a zincblende GaAs plate versus rotation angle
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Project the d14 tensor of a (111) or (110) GaAs plate onto the internal fundamental and SH polarizations with Fresnel factors. Evaluate the sinc² Maker fringe envelope versus incidence angle, including the coherence length from dispersion.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Interferometric autocorrelation of chirped pulses with a two-photon-absorption GaAsP photodiode
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model the photocurrent as the time-integrated square of the summed delayed fields of a linearly chirped Gaussian pulse. Compute the fringe-resolved autocorrelation, its 8:1 peak-to-background ratio and its envelope, and retrieve pulse width and chirp.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Hovel spectral response of an AlGaAs/GaAs heteroface solar cell
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine window-layer absorption with closed-form emitter, depletion-region and base photocurrents including surface recombination velocities. Return IQE versus wavelength and AM1.5-like Jsc versus window thickness and emitter depth.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Grain-boundary-limited effective diffusion length in a columnar polycrystalline solar cell
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve minority-carrier diffusion in a cylindrical or square columnar grain with recombination velocity at the grain boundary using Bessel or Fourier eigenfunction series (Card–Yang approach). Compute the effective diffusion length and the IQE/Jsc penalty versus grain size.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Electrical shading of an interdigitated back-contact solar cell by lateral collection
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve 2D diffusion in the wafer cross-section with alternating emitter and BSF regions at the rear using a Fourier-series method. Obtain the position-dependent collection probability and the Jsc loss versus BSF width, wafer thickness and diffusion length.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Södergren diffusion model of IPCE in a dye-sensitized TiO2 photoanode
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve steady-state electron diffusion with first-order recombination in a mesoporous TiO2 film under Beer–Lambert generation for front and back illumination. Compute collection efficiency and IPCE versus film thickness relative to the diffusion length.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Radiation degradation of a space solar cell from the diffusion-length damage coefficient
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use 1/L² = 1/L0² + K·Φ to degrade the base diffusion length with electron fluence. Recompute the base collection integral and Voc to give remaining factors for Isc, Voc and Pmax versus 1 MeV equivalent fluence.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Quantum-well solar cell: extra photocurrent versus added dark current
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Add a multi-quantum-well absorber with step-like 2D absorption into the intrinsic region of a GaAs p-i-n cell. Compute the Jsc gain from sub-gap absorption against the extra radiative and SRH dark current from the wells to get efficiency versus number of wells.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Tunnel-oxide passivating contact: J0 versus contact resistivity trade-off
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute WKB tunneling transmission of electrons and holes through an ultrathin SiOx barrier together with interface recombination screened by the doped poly-Si field. Return the selectivity, J0, ρc and the optimal oxide thickness that maximizes efficiency potential.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Frequency-noise spectrum and relaxation-oscillation side peaks of a semiconductor laser lineshape
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Build the Vahala–Yariv frequency-noise spectrum including the α-coupled relaxation-oscillation resonance. Integrate the phase-noise autocorrelation and Fourier-transform it to get the optical lineshape with satellite peaks at ±f_R and their relative amplitudes.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Linewidth narrowing of a hybrid laser with a dispersive ring-resonator mirror
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: From the complex reflectivity of a ring-resonator reflector, compute the Kazarinov–Henry parameters A and B (phase and amplitude derivatives). Evaluate the linewidth reduction factor (1+A+B)² versus detuning from the ring resonance and coupling coefficients.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Intrinsic linewidth of a quantum cascade laser including thermal photons
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the QCL Schawlow–Townes linewidth with near-zero α-factor and the thermal photon occupation n_th at mid-IR and THz frequencies. Compute linewidth versus output power, temperature and wavelength from the population-inversion factor.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Spectral-hole-burning gain compression coefficient from intraband relaxation
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Derive ε from the density-matrix nonlinear gain: the dipole matrix element, intraband relaxation time and differential gain give the compression of a quantum-well laser. Compute ε versus τ_in and wavelength and the resulting damping contribution.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Interstitial iron concentration in boron-doped silicon from FeB pair dissociation
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute SRH lifetimes of Fe_i and FeB pairs from their trap levels and capture cross sections versus injection. Locate the crossover injection level and invert lifetime before and after optical dissociation (Zoth–Bergholz) to get [Fe].

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Differential versus actual carrier lifetime under injection-dependent recombination
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: For an ABC recombination model, compute the actual lifetime n/R(n) and the small-signal differential lifetime (dR/dn)⁻¹ versus injection. Quantify their discrepancy and the error made when modulation-frequency or QSSPC transient data are interpreted naively.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Boron–oxygen light-induced degradation kinetics and stabilized lifetime in Cz-silicon
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model the formation and regeneration of the BO defect with Arrhenius rate constants depending on [B], [O] and injection. Integrate the closed-form kinetics to get normalized defect density, SRH lifetime and implied Voc versus illumination time and temperature.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Threading-dislocation density limit on InGaN LED internal quantum efficiency
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model dislocations as nonradiative line sinks with a diffusion-limited capture rate (Karpov–Makarov-type cylindrical diffusion). Combine with radiative and Auger terms to get IQE versus dislocation density, diffusion length and current density.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: CHCC Auger coefficient activation energy and its impact on 1.55 µm InGaAsP laser T0
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the threshold activation energy of the CHCC Auger process from band gap and mass ratio, and the temperature-dependent coefficient C(T). Combine with radiative current at threshold density to predict the characteristic temperature T0.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Interband absorption edge of an InGaAs/InP superlattice from miniband joint density of states
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute electron and hole Kronig–Penney minibands, then integrate the miniband joint density of states over k_z with in-plane parabolic dispersion. Show the 3D-to-2D crossover of the absorption edge shape versus barrier thickness.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Dynamic localization of a superlattice miniband under THz driving
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: For a tight-binding miniband driven by an ac field, compute the effective miniband width scaled by J0(eEd/ħω). Find the field-collapse points and the resulting dc Esaki–Tsu-type current suppression and absolute negative conductance regions.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Boron redistribution at the Si/SiO2 interface during thermal oxidation
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine Deal–Grove oxide growth with segregation coefficient m and diffusion in the receding silicon. Use the Grove moving-boundary analytic solution to get surface depletion of boron and the profile versus oxidation time and temperature.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Fair–Tsai phosphorus kink-and-tail profile in a heavily doped emitter
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Assemble the three-region phosphorus diffusion model: concentration-dependent surface region, kink concentration and enhanced-diffusivity tail. Evaluate the profiles, junction depth and sheet resistance versus surface concentration and time.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Transient enhanced diffusion of implanted boron from the +1 interstitial model
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model interstitial supersaturation decaying exponentially during anneal so that D_B(t) = D*·(1+S(t)). Integrate the effective Dt to obtain broadened Gaussian profiles and the junction-depth increase versus implant dose and anneal temperature.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Implantation through a screen oxide: dose-matching profile in the silicon substrate
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use Gaussian or Pearson range moments in SiO2 and Si and apply the dose-matching method across the interface. Compute retained dose, peak shift and junction depth in Si versus oxide thickness and energy.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Kick-out zinc diffusion in GaAs with diffusivity proportional to concentration squared
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the nonlinear diffusion equation with D ∝ C² via Boltzmann similarity shooting. Obtain the steep box-like profile, its front position versus √t, and compare it with the constant-D erfc profile.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Up-diffusion of a heavily doped buried layer into a lightly doped epitaxial layer
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the erfc out-diffusion from a semi-infinite heavily doped substrate into an epi layer with background doping over growth and anneal steps. Return the metallurgical junction position and the effective epi thickness lost.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Amorphous layer thickness from Gaussian damage-energy deposition in implanted silicon
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Build a Gaussian nuclear-damage-energy profile from range moments scaled by dose. Find the depths where deposited energy exceeds the critical amorphization density, giving the amorphous layer thickness versus dose, ion mass and energy.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Neutron transmutation doping of silicon: phosphorus concentration and resistivity versus fluence
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute 30Si(n,γ)31Si→31P production from isotope abundance, thermal cross section and fluence, including the decay waiting time. Convert to resistivity with a doping-dependent mobility and compute the dose for target resistivity.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Dynamic Franz–Keldysh effect: THz-driven absorption edge with ponderomotive shift
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute the time-averaged interband absorption under a strong THz field using the Jauho–Johnsen formalism with Bessel-function sidebands. Return the ponderomotive blue shift and the sub-gap absorption tail versus γ = U_p/ħω.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Photoinduced halide segregation threshold in mixed-halide perovskites
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine the mixing free energy of MAPb(I1−xBrx)3 with the free-energy gain of photocarriers funneling into I-rich domains. Compute the critical excitation intensity and composition window for segregation versus carrier lifetime and temperature.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Space-charge-limited photocurrent in organic blends with imbalanced mobilities
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Goodman–Rose photocurrent regimes: square-root voltage dependence and 3/4 intensity exponent when the slow carrier's space charge dominates. Compute the crossover to linear behavior versus mobility ratio, lifetime and thickness.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Efficiency roll-off of phosphorescent OLEDs from triplet–triplet annihilation and polaron quenching
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the steady-state triplet balance with a recombination-zone width, including TTA and triplet–polaron quenching. Obtain EQE(J) analytically, the roll-off current J0 at half efficiency, and compare the two mechanisms.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Scott–Malliaras injection-limited current at a metal/organic semiconductor contact
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the injection current including image-force barrier lowering and diffusion-controlled surface recombination (back-flow) with Langevin rate. Compute J–V versus barrier height and mobility and the transition to space-charge-limited conduction.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Vibronic progression and H-aggregate 0-0/0-1 ratio in P3HT absorption (Spano model)
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Sum Franck–Condon-weighted Gaussian vibronic replicas with the weak-exciton-coupling modification of the 0-0 peak by free exciton bandwidth W. Fit or compute A00/A01 versus W and extract exciton bandwidth from spectra.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Heikes-formula Seebeck coefficient of small-polaron hopping oxides
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the generalized Heikes formula, including spin and orbital degeneracy factors, versus carrier fraction for oxides such as cobaltates or doped SrTiO3. Combine it with Austin–Mott conductivity to compute power factor versus filling.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Polarization-induced 2DEG density at a MgZnO/ZnO heterointerface
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute spontaneous and piezoelectric polarization difference versus Mg content and the resulting interface sheet charge. Solve charge balance with surface barrier and triangular-well subband energies for n_s versus cap thickness.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Interface-induced valley splitting in a strained Si/SiGe quantum well
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use the two-valley effective-mass model with a sharp interface valley-coupling term weighted by the envelope density at the interface. Compute valley splitting versus well width, vertical electric field and interface sharpness.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Cryogenic freeze-out of phosphorus in silicon with doping-dependent activation energy
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve charge neutrality with donor ionization, including excited-state partition function and an activation energy reduced as N_D^{1/3} toward the Mott transition. Return ionization fraction and electron density from 4 K to 300 K.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Anderson band diagram of an n-ZnO/p-Cu2O heterojunction
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use electron affinities, gaps and doping to compute band offsets and the partition of V_bi across both sides. Return the depletion widths and the spike or cliff in the conduction band versus doping ratio, along with the resulting Voc ceiling.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Kraut core-level XPS determination of a heterojunction valence-band offset
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Fit core-level peaks and the valence-band edge of synthetic bulk and interface spectra with Voigt profiles and a linear edge extrapolation. Combine with the Kraut formula to get ΔEv with propagated uncertainty, for example for GaN/AlN.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Excitation-power blue shift of type-II ZnSe/BeTe quantum-well photoluminescence
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Separated electrons and holes create a sheet-charge field forming triangular confining wells. Compute the self-consistent transition energy versus photoexcited density and show the E ∝ P^{1/3} law via Airy ground states.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Thermal-mismatch strain and wafer bow of GaN on silicon after growth cooldown
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate temperature-dependent thermal expansion coefficients of GaN and Si from growth temperature to room temperature for mismatch strain and stress. Evaluate wafer curvature and bow with Stoney's formula versus layer thickness.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Saturated modal gain of a quantum-dot laser versus inhomogeneous broadening
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Sum homogeneously broadened dot transitions over a Gaussian size distribution with dot density, confinement factor and degeneracy. Return the maximum ground-state modal gain and gain spectrum versus inhomogeneous linewidth and occupation.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Threshold current density of an interband cascade laser from Auger-limited carrier density
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use the type-II W-well gain-versus-density relation to find threshold density per stage for given internal loss and mirror loss. Compute J_th = qN_th(B·n + C·n²)·d/N_stages and its dependence on stage number and temperature.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Superluminescent diode output spectrum, bandwidth and coherence length
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate single-pass amplified spontaneous emission along the cavity with a Gaussian/parabolic gain spectrum and negligible facet feedback. Return output power, spectral narrowing with gain, and the coherence length from the spectrum autocorrelation.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Intervalence-band absorption in p-type InGaAsP from heavy-hole to split-off transitions
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute absorption from hh to split-off band transitions with parabolic masses, Boltzmann hole populations and a constant matrix element. Integrate the joint density of states for α_IVBA versus hole density and wavelength, then find the loss at 1.3 and 1.55 µm.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Rec.2020 color-gamut coverage of narrow-band quantum-dot emitters
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute chromaticity coordinates of Gaussian RGB emitters with analytic multi-lobe CIE color-matching fits. Integrate the gamut-triangle overlap with the Rec.2020 primaries versus peak positions and linewidths.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Optical gain and current-dependent bandwidth of a heterojunction phototransistor
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine primary photocurrent from base–collector absorption with current gain β from emitter injection efficiency and base recombination. Compute optical gain versus photocurrent, plus the bandwidth from the emitter diffusion capacitance that falls at low injection.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Position response and nonlinearity of a lateral-effect position-sensitive photodiode
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Solve the resistive-sheet current division for a light spot in a 1D lateral-effect photodiode with finite contact resistance and leakage. Compute the position response function and its nonlinearity error versus resistive-layer parameters.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Hole-tailing photopeak shape of a planar TlBr gamma-ray detector from depth-dependent Hecht efficiency
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate Hecht charge-collection efficiency over exponential photon interaction depth with distinct electron and hole μτ. Build the photopeak lineshape with low-energy tailing and Fano broadening versus bias.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Responsivity, time constant and D* of a semiconductor thermopile detector
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Model N series thermocouples with Seebeck coefficients, thermal conductance of legs and membrane, and absorbed power. Compute responsivity versus chopping frequency, Johnson-noise limited D*, and optimal leg geometry.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Solar-blind rejection ratio of a back-illuminated AlGaN p-i-n photodiode
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Combine window-layer filtering with Urbach-tailed absorption edges of AlGaN window and absorber layers. Compute the responsivity spectrum and the 280 nm/350 nm rejection ratio versus Al fractions and thicknesses.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Thermally broadened Coulomb-blockade conductance peaks of a quantum dot
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Beenakker sequential-tunneling linear conductance with charging energy and level spacing. Show peak lineshape cosh⁻²(δ/2.5kT) in the classical regime versus the quantum regime and temperature dependence of peak height.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Kroemer n0·L criterion and transit-time frequency of a GaAs Gunn diode
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Use an analytic two-valley velocity–field curve to get the negative differential mobility. Compute the dielectric relaxation-limited n0·L product for domain formation and the transit-time oscillation frequency versus device length.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Optical-phonon-emission model of saturation velocity versus temperature
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate v_sat = sqrt(8E_op/3πm*)·sqrt(tanh(E_op/2kT)) for Si, Ge, GaAs and GaN. Compare the temperature dependence with empirical data fits and Caughey–Thomas-style forms.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Kane band-to-band tunneling current and subthreshold swing of a homojunction TFET
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Integrate the Kane BTBT generation rate over the source–channel tunneling window, with gate-controlled field from a characteristic-length model. Compute I_D–V_G and point subthreshold swing below 60 mV/dec for Si, Ge and InAs.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: C–V of a linearly graded p-n junction: 1/C³ analysis for grading constant
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Compute depletion width and capacitance of a linearly graded junction with a gradient-dependent built-in potential solved self-consistently. Extract grading constant and V_bi from 1/C³ versus V and compare with abrupt 1/C² analysis.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Base transit time reduction in a SiGe HBT with graded germanium profile
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Kroemer double-integral base transit time with bandgap-grading-induced quasi-field and n_i² enhancement. Compute τ_B and fT improvement versus Ge ramp and base width.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Dyakonov–Shur plasma-wave THz detection response of a HEMT channel
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the closed-form photoresponse ΔU(ω) of a gated 2DEG channel for resonant (ωτ ≫ 1) and overdamped regimes. Use plasma-wave velocity from gate swing and compute responsivity versus frequency, gate length and mobility.

materials/semiconductors|quad_models.title: Haynes rule and Rashba giant oscillator strength of donor-bound excitons
materials/semiconductors|quad_models.gist: Apply Haynes' rule localization energy proportional to donor binding energy for shallow donors in Si, GaN and ZnO. Compute the Rashba oscillator-strength enhancement (a_loc/a_B)³ and radiative lifetime of bound excitons.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Wannier-Stark ladder eigenstates via Bessel functions and their localization
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Construct the exact Wannier-Stark eigenstates c_n = J_{n-m}(2J/F) of a biased tight-binding chain. Compute their participation ratio and spatial width versus F/J from Bessel sums, and verify the equally spaced ladder by diagonalizing a finite chain.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Super-Bloch oscillations under near-resonant combined DC and AC fields
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Derive the effective hopping J·J_n(F1/ω) and detuning δ = F0 - nω for a lattice driven near the n-th resonance. Compute the giant super-Bloch amplitude and period, and compare with direct numerical integration of the Schrödinger equation on a finite chain.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Anomalous Hall conductivity of a massive 2D Dirac fermion versus chemical potential
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Integrate the Berry curvature of a massive Dirac Hamiltonian over occupied states by radial quadrature, including the Fermi-level dependence. Recover the closed form σ_xy = (e²/2h)·m/max(|μ|,|m|).

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Orbital magnetic moment and valley g-factor in gapped graphene
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the orbital moment m(k) = -i(e/2ħ)⟨∇u|×(H-E)|∇u⟩ for a hexagonal-boron-nitride-like honeycomb model, by finite differences and with the analytic massive Dirac result. Extract the valley-contrasting band-edge moment and the effective g-factor.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Berry curvature dipole and nonlinear Hall response in a tilted massive Dirac model
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the Berry curvature dipole D_x = ∫ f0 ∂_x Ω d²k for a tilted massive Dirac Hamiltonian at finite temperature by 2D quadrature. Map its dependence on chemical potential and tilt, including the peak just above the gap edge.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Flat-band Chern number and flatness ratio of a checkerboard lattice model
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: For the Sun-Yao-Fradkin-Kivelson checkerboard model with NN, NNN and NNNN hoppings, compute the Chern number of the lowest band by FHS. Compute the flatness ratio of gap to bandwidth over a hopping-parameter sweep.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Kane-Mele Z2 from the Pfaffian of the time-reversal sewing matrix
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Construct the sewing matrix w_mn(k) = ⟨u_m(-k)|Θ|u_n(k)⟩ with a smooth gauge and implement a numerical Pfaffian for antisymmetric matrices. Evaluate (-1)^ν = Π_TRIM Pf[w]/√det[w] for the Kane-Mele model.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Strong and weak indices of the Fu-Kane-Mele diamond-lattice model
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute parity products at the eight TRIM of the 3D diamond-lattice Fu-Kane-Mele model with spin-orbit coupling. Map how a bond-length distortion δt1 drives strong-TI and weak-TI phases.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Helical edge-state decay lengths in the continuum BHZ model
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve the continuum BHZ boundary problem analytically for the two decay constants λ1,2 and the edge velocity. Verify the edge dispersion and penetration depth against diagonalization of a finite-width lattice ribbon.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Kitaev chain Majorana number via Pfaffians of the Majorana Hamiltonian
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Write the 1D Kitaev chain in the Majorana basis and evaluate the Z2 invariant M = sign(Pf[A(0)]·Pf[A(π)]) with a numerical Pfaffian. Compare with the closed-form phase boundary |μ| < 2t and with the Majorana edge-mode splitting in finite chains.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Wannier charge centers on time-reversal-invariant planes of a 3D TI
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute Wilson-loop Wannier-center flow on the kz = 0 and kz = π planes of a 4-band cubic TI model. Extract the 2D Z2 indices of both planes and combine them into the 3D strong index, cross-checking with Fu-Kane parities.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Long-wavelength limit of an fcc Born-von Kármán force-constant model
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Build the dynamical matrix of an fcc lattice with nearest-neighbour central and angular force constants and compute acoustic dispersions. Extract elastic constants from the small-q slopes and compare with the analytic C_ij expressions, including the Cauchy-relation violation.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Triangular-lattice DOS from its lattice Green's function
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the triangular-lattice tight-binding DOS from the closed-form elliptic-integral Green's function and cross-check with k-space quadrature. Characterize the asymmetric band, the logarithmic van Hove singularity at E = 2t and the step discontinuity at the band edge.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Density of states and van Hove singularities

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Watson integrals and Pólya return probabilities for cubic lattices
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the lattice Green's function at the band edge, G(0) = (1/π³)∫∫∫ d³k/(3 - Σcos k_i), for sc, bcc and fcc lattices by singularity-aware quadrature. Compare with Watson's closed forms and compute the random-walk return probabilities 1 - 1/G.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Density of states and van Hove singularities

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Sommerfeld coefficient enhancement near a 2D van Hove singularity
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Using the square-lattice DOS with next-nearest-neighbour hopping, compute the electronic specific heat C(T)/T by Fermi-window quadrature as μ is tuned through the saddle point. Show the logarithmic enhancement and the non-Sommerfeld temperature dependence at the van Hove energy.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Density of states and van Hove singularities

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Mexican-hat band edge and inverse-square-root DOS in biased bilayer graphene
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Diagonalize the four-band continuum Hamiltonian of bilayer graphene with interlayer bias U and compute the low-energy dispersion, which has a ring minimum. Obtain the DOS by radial quadrature and characterize the 1/√(E-E0) band-edge divergence and the gap versus U.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Density of states and van Hove singularities

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: 1D chain with next-nearest hopping: extra van Hove singularities
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: For E(k) = -2t1 cos k - 2t2 cos 2k, find all stationary points by root-finding and compute ρ(E) = Σ 1/|E'(k)| exactly. Show how the number and positions of the 1/√ singularities change at t2/t1 = 1/4.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Density of states and van Hove singularities

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Graphene Fermi velocity and trigonal warping with next-nearest hopping
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: From the honeycomb tight-binding model with t and t', compute the Fermi velocity 3ta/2ħ and the particle-hole asymmetry. Quantify the trigonal warping of constant-energy contours by Fourier-analyzing k_F(θ) at several energies.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Graphene DOS in closed form and carrier density versus Fermi level
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Implement the Hobson-Nierenberg elliptic-integral expression for the honeycomb DOS and verify it against k-grid histograms. Integrate it to obtain carrier density n(E_F), comparing the Dirac-cone E_F² law with the full result up to the M-point van Hove singularity.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Quantum capacitance of graphene with temperature and disorder broadening
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute C_Q(V) = e² ∂n/∂μ for graphene by integrating the Dirac DOS convolved with a Gaussian disorder width against Fermi-function derivatives. Find the finite minimum at neutrality, and solve the series-capacitance electrostatics for μ(V_gate).

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Armchair nanoribbon band gaps and the three width families
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Use the transverse quantization k_p = pπ/(N+1) in the honeycomb model to compute armchair ribbon gaps versus width N. Show the 3p, 3p+1 and 3p+2 families and the metallic family, and compare with direct diagonalization of the ribbon Hamiltonian.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Graphene Landau levels and magneto-optical transition energies
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute relativistic Landau levels E_n = sgn(n)v_F√(2eħB|n|) and the allowed magneto-optical transitions |n| → |n|±1 with their B-dependence. Cross-check the low-lying levels by diagonalizing a Harper-type honeycomb Hamiltonian at rational flux.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Graphene plasmon dispersion from the RPA Dirac polarizability
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Implement the closed-form Wunsch/Hwang-Das Sarma static and dynamic polarizability of doped graphene, and solve 1 - v_q Re Π(q,ω) = 0 for the plasmon branch. Compare with the long-wavelength √q Drude result and locate Landau damping at the interband edge.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Lifshitz-Kosevich dHvA simulation, FFT frequency and cyclotron mass fit
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Generate oscillatory magnetization from the LK formula with thermal R_T and Dingle R_D factors, resample it on a uniform 1/B grid and Fourier-analyze to extract frequencies. Fit the amplitude versus temperature to recover the cyclotron mass.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Onsager frequency and cyclotron mass on a square-lattice Fermi surface
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the area enclosed by the constant-energy contour of the 2D tight-binding band by quadrature as a function of filling, and convert it to the dHvA frequency F = ħA/2πe. Obtain m* = (ħ²/2π)dA/dE, showing the electron-to-hole switch and the divergence at half filling.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Berry phase from Landau fan diagrams: Dirac versus Schrödinger carriers
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Simulate SdH oscillations for parabolic and Dirac 2D carriers with LK damping, and identify resistivity minima as integer Landau indices. Fit n versus 1/B linearly to extract the intercept, which encodes the Berry phase (0 versus π), and check its robustness to damping.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Belly and neck extremal areas of an fcc tight-binding Fermi surface
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: For the fcc nearest-neighbour band at copper-like filling, compute cross-sectional areas of the Fermi surface in planes perpendicular to [111] by 2D contour quadrature. Locate the belly maximum and neck minimum, and report their dHvA frequencies.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Weyl semimetal Landau levels, chiral level and oscillation phase
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the 3D Weyl-node Landau levels E_n(kz) = ±v√(2eħB|n| + ħ²kz²) together with the chiral n = 0 branch. Obtain the oscillatory DOS at fixed Fermi energy by kz quadrature with broadening, and extract the frequency and phase offset of the oscillations.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Dirac-comb gaps versus nearly-free-electron prediction 2|V_G|
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: For the Dirac-comb limit P·sin(qa)/(qa) + cos(qa) = cos(ka), compute the first several gaps exactly. Compare them with the NFE first-order estimate 2|V_G| from the potential's Fourier coefficients, and identify the weak and strong barrier regimes where the estimate fails.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: 2D nearly-free-electron square lattice: gaps at X and M
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Diagonalize the 4×4 degenerate-perturbation matrix at the M point and the 2×2 matrix at X for a square-lattice potential with V10 and V11. Compare the predicted gap splittings and degeneracies with a converged plane-wave calculation.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Finite-gap Lamé potential: exactly n gaps from Jacobi elliptic functions
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Build the periodic potential n(n+1)m·sn²(x|m) with scipy.special.ellipj and compute its band structure by Floquet discriminant integration. Verify that exactly n gaps open, and compare the band edges with the known Lamé polynomial eigenvalues.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Skyrmion topological charge on a lattice via Berg-Lüscher solid angles
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Discretize a Belavin-Polyakov skyrmion on a square lattice and triangulate each plaquette. Sum the signed solid angles Ω = 2atan2(...) to get the topological charge, and study its integer convergence as the core radius shrinks to the lattice scale.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Lattice relaxation of a chiral-magnet skyrmion by projected gradient descent
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Relax a discrete Heisenberg spin lattice with bulk DMI and Zeeman field from a seeded skyrmion, using normalized-spin projected gradient descent. Compute the relaxed energy relative to the ferromagnet and the topological charge, and find the field at which the skyrmion collapses.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Emergent magnetic field and topological Hall resistivity of a skyrmion lattice
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the emergent field b_z ∝ m·(∂x m × ∂y m) for a skyrmion profile by quadrature, and verify one flux quantum per skyrmion. Combine the skyrmion density with spin polarization and the normal Hall coefficient to estimate the topological Hall resistivity.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Thiele equation: skyrmion Hall angle from gyrovector and dissipation tensor
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: From a relaxed or ansatz skyrmion profile, compute the gyrovector G = 4πQ and the dissipation dyadic D = ∫ ∂_i m·∂_j m d²r by radial quadrature. Solve the Thiele equation for the drift velocity and the skyrmion Hall angle versus damping α and nonadiabaticity β.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Domain-wall energy and the DMI threshold for spiral ground states
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the Bloch/Néel wall profile θ(x) = 2atan(e^{x/Δ}), its width √(A/K) and its energy 4√(AK) - πD by quadrature. Determine the critical DMI D_c = 4√(AK)/π above which a spiral ground state is favoured.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Triple-Q skyrmion lattice: charge per magnetic unit cell
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Build a hexagonal skyrmion crystal as a normalized superposition of three helices plus a uniform magnetization. Compute the topological charge per magnetic unit cell on a fine grid, and map the uniform-component threshold where the charge changes from -1 to 0.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Half-integer topological charge of merons in easy-plane magnets
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: For meron profiles with in-plane far field and a core polarity, compute the topological charge Q = pw/2 by radial quadrature over finite disks. Discretize the profiles to show convergence, and treat meron-antimeron pairs as a check.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Kane interband tunneling current from the WKB imaginary-k integral
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: In a two-band Kane model, compute the imaginary wavevector κ(E) inside the gap and the WKB exponent ∫κ dx under uniform field by quadrature. Recover the closed form exp(-π√m E_g^{3/2}/(2√2 eħF)), and obtain the field dependence of the tunneling current.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Landau-Zener and Zener tunneling between bands

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Landau-Zener transitions with fast dephasing: Kayanuma limit
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Integrate the Lindblad equation for a Landau-Zener sweep with pure dephasing. Show that the strong-dephasing limit approaches the incoherent formula P = (1 - exp(-πΔ²/ħv))/2, and map the crossover as the dephasing rate increases.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Landau-Zener and Zener tunneling between bands

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Rosen-Zener pulse: exact sech-envelope transition probability
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: For coupling V(t) = V0 sech(t/T) with constant detuning Δ, integrate the two-level equations numerically. Compare with the closed form P = sin²(πV0T)sech²(πΔT/2), including the oscillation in pulse area.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Landau-Zener and Zener tunneling between bands

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Kibble-Zurek defect density in the transverse-field Ising chain via Landau-Zener
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Map a linear quench of the transverse-field Ising chain to independent Landau-Zener problems for each momentum k, and integrate the excitation probability over k. Obtain the defect density n ∝ τ_Q^{-1/2}, and compare exact mode-by-mode ODE integration with the Landau-Zener approximation.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Landau-Zener and Zener tunneling between bands

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Christoffel velocities in hexagonal crystals: closed-form quasi-P and quasi-SV branches
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: For a transversely isotropic crystal (e.g. Zn, Mg), solve the 2x2 quasi-P/quasi-SV block of the Christoffel equation and the separate pure-SH velocity as functions of polar angle. Check the closed forms against numerical eigenvalues of the full 3x3 Christoffel matrix and locate angles of maximal shear-wave splitting.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Piezoelectric stiffening of acoustic velocities in wurtzite ZnO
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Augment the hexagonal Christoffel tensor with the piezoelectric term (e·n)(e·n)/(n·ε·n) to obtain stiffened velocities versus propagation angle. Evaluate the direction-dependent electromechanical coupling coefficient K^2 for each mode.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Lieb lattice compact localized states and flat-band degeneracy on a torus
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Construct the plaquette-localized compact states of the Lieb lattice and verify they are zero-energy eigenstates. Build finite periodic Lieb clusters and count the flat-band degeneracy, including the extra non-contractible loop states that complete the band touching.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Flat bands in kagome and Lieb lattices

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Quantum metric of the Lieb flat band and the superfluid-weight lower bound
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the flat-band projector of the gapped Lieb lattice with a sublattice staggering, then the quantum geometric tensor by finite differences on a k-grid. Integrate the quantum metric and Berry curvature over the Brillouin zone to obtain the Peotta-Törmä bound D_s ≥ |C| and the metric-based superfluid weight.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Flat bands in kagome and Lieb lattices

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Mean-field BCS superfluid weight of the attractive Hubbard kagome flat band
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve the uniform-pairing BCS gap equation on the kagome lattice with attractive U at flat-band filling. Evaluate the superfluid weight from the band-resolved conventional and geometric terms, showing D_s ∝ U·⟨g⟩ from the quantum metric.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Flat bands in kagome and Lieb lattices

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Sawtooth chain flat band at t'=√2t and its compact localized states
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Diagonalize the two-band sawtooth chain and find the hopping ratio at which one band becomes exactly flat. Build the V-shaped compact localized states and measure the bandwidth as t' is detuned from √2t.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Flat bands in kagome and Lieb lattices

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Dimerized Lieb lattice: flat-band robustness and gapped Dirac cone
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Add SSH-like alternating hoppings to the Lieb lattice and track the spectrum at the M point. Show that the chiral-symmetric flat band survives while the dispersive bands gap, and compute the gap and the flat-band weight on each sublattice.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Flat bands in kagome and Lieb lattices

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Berry phase interpolation and Landau levels of the α-T3 dice model
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: For the α-T3 lattice's low-energy pseudospin-1 Hamiltonian, compute the Berry phase π cos(2φ) of the dispersive bands as a function of α. Derive the Landau levels in closed form, including the zero-energy flat-band level, and check the magnetic oscillation phase.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Flat bands in kagome and Lieb lattices

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Kagome hexagon-ring states: counting flat-band degeneracy and the band-touching state
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Construct localized hexagon-ring states on an L×L periodic kagome cluster and compute the rank of their span with an SVD. Show that the flat-band degeneracy L^2+1 equals the number of contractible rings plus winding-loop states minus linear dependencies.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Flat bands in kagome and Lieb lattices

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: 3D static Lindhard function: closed form, quadrature and the 2k_F Kohn anomaly
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the static 3D Lindhard susceptibility by direct numerical integration over the Fermi sphere and compare with the analytic log formula. Locate the logarithmic derivative singularity at q=2k_F and the q→0 Thomas-Fermi limit.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: 1D Lindhard susceptibility: logarithmic 2k_F divergence and its thermal cutoff
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute χ0(q,T) for a 1D free or tight-binding electron gas by Fermi-Dirac quadrature. Show that the 2k_F peak grows as ln(E_F/T), and extract the prefactor to set up the mean-field Peierls criterion.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: RPA plasmon dispersion and Landau damping onset in the 3D electron gas
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve Re ε(q,ω)=0 using the Lindhard dynamic dielectric function for metallic r_s. Obtain the plasmon dispersion ω_p + αq^2 and the wavevector where it enters the particle-hole continuum, then compute the loss function Im(-1/ε).

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Real-space screened Coulomb potential: Thomas-Fermi Yukawa versus Lindhard Friedel tail
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Fourier-transform 4πe²/(q²ε(q)) to real space with oscillatory quadrature using either Thomas-Fermi or Lindhard ε. Compare the exponential Yukawa decay with the cos(2k_F r)/r^3 Friedel tail, and evaluate the screening charge's sum rule.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Stern 2D electron gas plasmon: √q dispersion from the dynamic Lindhard function
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Implement Stern's analytic dynamic polarizability of a parabolic 2DEG and solve 1 - v(q)Π(q,ω)=0 for GaAs parameters. Compare the result with the long-wavelength √q law and find where the plasmon meets the intraband continuum edge.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Finite-temperature Lindhard function via the Maldague integral
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Obtain χ0(q,T) of a 3D or 2D electron gas by integrating the T=0 Lindhard function over chemical potential with the Maldague kernel. Compare the result with direct Fermi-Dirac quadrature and track the thermal smearing of the 2k_F feature and of the Thomas-Fermi wavevector.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Mermin relaxation-time dielectric function and electron energy-loss spectra
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Build the number-conserving Mermin dielectric function from complex-frequency Lindhard functions. Compute the energy-loss function for aluminum-like parameters at several damping rates and compare plasmon peak widths with the Drude limit.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Penn model static dielectric constant of semiconductors
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Penn isotropic gap-model dielectric function ε(0) = 1 + (ħω_p/E_g)^2(1 - Δ + Δ^2/3) with Δ=E_g/4E_F, along with the q-dependent Levine-Louie extension. Fit Penn gaps to the dielectric constants of Si, Ge and GaAs.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: RKKY exchange range functions in 3D and 2D from the Lindhard response
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Fourier-transform the static Lindhard susceptibility to obtain the RKKY coupling J(r) in 3D, in closed form F(x) = (sin x - x cos x)/x^4, and in 2D via Bessel functions. Locate the sign changes and the asymptotic decay laws.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Bohm-Staver sound velocity from Lindhard-screened ionic plasma oscillations
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the longitudinal phonon dispersion of a jellium-embedded ion lattice as Ω_p^2/ε(q) using the Lindhard ε. Recover the Bohm-Staver velocity sqrt(Z m/3M) v_F at small q and the Kohn-anomaly kink at 2k_F.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Triclinic metric tensor: reciprocal lattice, d-spacings and Bragg angles
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: From lattice parameters (a, b, c, α, β, γ), build the direct and reciprocal metric tensors and compute reciprocal basis vectors and cell volume. Evaluate d_hkl and Bragg angles for Cu Kα, and verify a_i·b_j = 2πδ_ij along with zone-axis relations.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: High-symmetry k-path generation and cumulative path coordinates for fcc
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Generate the Γ-X-W-K-Γ-L-U path in Cartesian reciprocal coordinates with point densities proportional to segment lengths. Return the cumulative-distance axis and evaluate a nearest-neighbor tight-binding band along it, checking degeneracies at the special points.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: X-ray structure factors and powder intensities of rocksalt, zincblende and diamond
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute F_hkl using Cromer-Mann Gaussian atomic form factors f(sinθ/λ). Derive the extinction rules and powder intensities with multiplicity and the Lorentz-polarization factor, comparing the relative peak heights of NaCl versus KCl and Si versus GaAs.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Zigzag graphene nanoribbon edge flat band and analytic decay length
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Diagonalize finite-width zigzag ribbons and identify the edge band for 2π/3<k<π. Compare the sublattice-resolved amplitudes with the analytic edge-state decay |2cos(k/2)|^n, and extract the localization length versus k.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Haldane model zigzag ribbon: chiral edge-state velocity and edge localization
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Build the Haldane Hamiltonian on a zigzag strip and identify in-gap states localized at opposite edges via a position-weighted expectation. Extract their group velocities and penetration depths versus the Semenoff mass across the topological transition.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Phosphorene zigzag nanoribbon quasi-flat edge bands from a five-hopping model
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Use the anisotropic four-band tight-binding model of black phosphorus to build zigzag and armchair ribbons. Show that zigzag ribbons host a quasi-flat, fully detached edge band in the gap, then measure its bandwidth and localization.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Mean-field Hubbard edge magnetism and gap in zigzag graphene ribbons
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Self-consistently solve the collinear Hubbard mean-field equations on a zigzag ribbon using Fermi-Dirac occupations. Obtain the antiferromagnetic inter-edge ground state, its edge moments and the resulting band gap versus width and U.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Finite SSH chain end-state hybridization splitting versus length
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Diagonalize open SSH chains of N cells and compute the splitting of the two near-zero end states. Compare it with the analytic exponential (v/w)^N law and the localization length 1/ln(w/v).

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Hofstadter strip edge spectrum at flux 1/q and gap-resolved edge counting
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Diagonalize the Harper-Hofstadter model on a cylinder at rational flux and count the chiral edge-state crossings within each gap. Verify that the counts equal the gap Chern numbers given by the Diophantine equation, using Laughlin spectral flow under an inserted flux.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Ferromagnetic magnons on cubic lattices: spin stiffness and Bloch T^{3/2} law
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute LSWT magnon dispersions for sc, bcc and fcc Heisenberg ferromagnets and extract the stiffness D. Integrate the Bose occupation over the Brillouin zone to obtain M(T), and compare with the Bloch ζ(3/2) coefficient at low T.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Spin waves and linear spin-wave theory

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Tyablikov RPA Curie temperature of Heisenberg ferromagnets from lattice Green's integrals
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the RPA formula k_B T_c = (S(S+1)/3)/⟨1/ε(k)⟩ via Brillouin-zone quadrature of the inverse magnon dispersion for sc, bcc and fcc lattices. Compare the result with mean-field and known high-temperature-series values.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Spin waves and linear spin-wave theory

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: J1-J2 square-lattice LSWT: breakdown of Néel order near J2/J1≈0.38
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the LSWT magnon dispersion of the frustrated J1-J2 Heisenberg antiferromagnet in the Néel phase. Integrate the moment correction as a function of J2/J1 to find where the ordered moment vanishes.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Spin waves and linear spin-wave theory

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Antiferromagnetic magnon specific heat and the T^3 law with anisotropy gap
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the magnon heat capacity of a 3D antiferromagnet by Brillouin-zone quadrature of the LSWT dispersion, with and without an easy-axis anisotropy gap. Extract the low-T T^3 coefficient from the spin-wave velocity and the exponential suppression due to the gap.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Spin waves and linear spin-wave theory

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya nonreciprocal magnon dispersion in ferromagnetic films
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Add interfacial DMI to a Heisenberg ferromagnet chain or film and derive the asymmetric dispersion ω(k)≠ω(-k). Compute the frequency shift Δf ∝ D k that Brillouin light scattering measures, and the wavevector of minimum energy.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Spin waves and linear spin-wave theory

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Kittel FMR and Damon-Eshbach surface spin waves in a thin film
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Kittel resonance frequency for film, sphere and needle demagnetizing factors. Compute the magnetostatic Damon-Eshbach dispersion versus k·d, including its group velocity and decay length, for permalloy and YIG parameters.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Spin waves and linear spin-wave theory

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Imperfect nesting in quasi-1D Bechgaard-salt Fermi surfaces
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Model the warped open Fermi sheets ε = -2t_a cos k_a - 2t_b cos k_b - 2t_b' cos 2k_b and evaluate χ0(Q) near the nesting vector. Show how t_b' suppresses the logarithmic divergence and estimate the critical t_b' for an SDW instability at given coupling.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Cuprate t-t'-t'' Lifshitz transition at the van Hove filling
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Find the hole doping at which the Fermi surface of a cuprate tight-binding band passes through (π,0), changing from hole-like to electron-like. Compute the DOS at E_F versus doping and the Sommerfeld coefficient peak.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Iron-pnictide two-pocket model: hole-electron nesting and χ0 at (π,0)
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Use a minimal two-orbital or two-pocket model with a hole pocket at Γ and electron pockets at (π,0). Compute pocket areas and carrier balance, then show how the bare susceptibility peak at (π,0) degrades with ellipticity and doping.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Fermi-surface line integrals: DOS at E_F and Drude plasma frequency
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: For a 2D tight-binding band, compute N(E_F) = ∮dl/(4π²|v|) and the plasma-frequency tensor ∮v_iv_j dl/|v| along root-found Fermi contours. Cross-check both against Gaussian-smeared k-grid sums.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Honeycomb van Hove filling: hexagonal Fermi surface nesting at M points
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: At 3/8 or 5/8 filling of the graphene band, the Fermi surface becomes a nested hexagon through the M points. Compute χ0(q) over the Brillouin zone and show the three degenerate nesting peaks at M that underlie chiral density-wave and superconducting proposals.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Rashba 2DEG: chemical potential versus density through the band-crossing ring
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the two Rashba-split Fermi circles and the DOS, including the 1/√E divergence of the ring minimum below the crossing point. Invert n(μ) piecewise to obtain the Fermi momenta and spin-split carrier densities across the regime change.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: SSH half-filled chain: dimerization energy via elliptic integrals and gap versus coupling
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Write the SSH electronic energy at half filling in terms of the complete elliptic integral E(k) and add the elastic energy K(2u)². Minimize over the dimerization u to obtain the gap 2Δ versus the electron-phonon coupling λ and check the asymptotic Δ∝exp(-1/2λ).
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Charge density waves and Peierls instability

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Mean-field Peierls transition temperature and BCS-like 2Δ/k_BT_c ratio
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve the finite-temperature Peierls gap equation for a 1D linearized band with cutoff for Δ(T). Obtain T_c and show that 2Δ(0)/k_BT_c = 3.53, along with the BCS-like temperature dependence of the order parameter.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Charge density waves and Peierls instability

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Holstein model mean-field CDW on the square lattice at half filling
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Self-consistently solve for the checkerboard charge order parameter in the mean-field Holstein model with dispersionless phonons, by Brillouin-zone quadrature at finite T. Compute the gap versus coupling and the mean-field T_c, including the van Hove enhancement.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Charge density waves and Peierls instability

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: SSH soliton: relaxed domain-wall profile, midgap state and creation energy
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Relax the dimerization pattern of an odd-length open SSH chain by iterating the self-consistent bond equations. Fit the tanh soliton profile and width ξ, identify the zero-energy midgap state, and compare the soliton creation energy with 2Δ/π.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Charge density waves and Peierls instability

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Spin-Peierls instability of the XY chain via Jordan-Wigner fermions
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Map the dimerized XY chain to free fermions and evaluate the ground-state energy gain versus dimerization δ. Show δ² ln δ behavior, minimize with a lattice stiffness, and compute the resulting spin gap.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Charge density waves and Peierls instability

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Finite-temperature SSH order parameter and specific-heat jump at T_c
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Minimize the SSH free energy with Fermi-Dirac occupations over the dimerization at each T, using quadrature over the Brillouin zone. Obtain Δ(T), the second-order transition at T_c, and the electronic specific-heat discontinuity.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Charge density waves and Peierls instability

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Heisenberg chain ground-state energy with S^z and momentum sectors versus Bethe ansatz
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Build sparse S=1/2 Heisenberg rings resolved by total S^z and translation momentum, then find the ground state with Lanczos (eigsh). Extrapolate e0(N) in 1/N² to the Bethe value 1/4 - ln 2.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: XXZ chain spin stiffness from twisted boundaries and the Bethe-ansatz Luttinger parameter
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Insert a twist φ into the XXZ ring and compute the ground-state energy curvature by ED. Compare the resulting stiffness with the exact Bethe-ansatz formula π sin γ/(4γ(π-γ)), with Δ = cos γ, and extract the Luttinger parameter K versus Δ.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Majumdar-Ghosh J1-J2 chain: dimer ground states, degeneracy and gap
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Diagonalize the frustrated J1-J2 Heisenberg ring at and around J2/J1=1/2. Verify the exact twofold-degenerate dimer product states and energy -3N/8 J1, then estimate the singlet-triplet gap and dimer correlations.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Lanczos continued-fraction dynamical structure factor of the Heisenberg chain
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Run a Lanczos recursion starting from S^z_q|GS⟩ to get the coefficients a_n and b_n, then evaluate S(q,ω) as a continued fraction with Lorentzian broadening. Compare the spectral support with the des Cloizeaux-Pearson lower boundary and the two-spinon upper boundary.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Level-spacing ratio across the many-body localization crossover in random-field XXZ chains
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Diagonalize the random-field Heisenberg chain in the S^z=0 sector over disorder realizations and compute the mean adjacent-gap ratio ⟨r⟩ in the middle of the spectrum. Track its crossover from GOE (0.53) to Poisson (0.386) as disorder increases.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Aubry-André wave-packet spreading exponents across the self-dual transition
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evolve a localized state on the quasiperiodic Aubry-André chain with expm_multiply. Extract the spreading exponent of ⟨x²⟩(t): ballistic for λ<1, anomalous near λ=1 and frozen for λ>1, and compare with the inverse participation ratio of eigenstates.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Discrete Talbot revivals in a tight-binding lattice
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Propagate periodic input patterns of period N on a tight-binding chain or 2D lattice. Compute the fidelity of returning to the initial state, and show exact revivals only for N∈{1,2,3,4,6}, with closed-form Bessel-sum amplitudes.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: TM plane-wave bands of a square lattice of dielectric rods
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Plane-wave expansion for E-polarized light in a 2D square array of circular rods, with the analytic Bessel J1 Fourier coefficients of the dielectric; solve the generalized eigenproblem along Γ-X-M-Γ and locate the first TM gap versus filling fraction.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Photonic and phononic crystal band structures

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Locally resonant mass-in-mass chain: negative effective mass and subwavelength gap
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: 1D chain of masses each containing an internal spring-coupled resonator: compute the dispersion analytically, the frequency-dependent effective mass m_eff(ω), and the hybridization gap bounded by the local resonance and the band edge set by the mass ratio.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Photonic and phononic crystal band structures

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Slow-light group index at the band edge of a weak Bragg grating
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Coupled-mode theory for a sinusoidal index grating gives a hyperbolic dispersion near the Bragg frequency; compute the group index from numerical differentiation of exact transfer-matrix bands and compare it with the coupled-mode formula as the detuning shrinks.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Photonic and phononic crystal band structures

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Long-wavelength photonic-crystal index: PWE slope versus Maxwell-Garnett
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Extract the effective refractive index of a 2D rod lattice from the slope of the lowest PWE band at small k for TE and TM, and compare it with the Maxwell-Garnett (TE) and volume-average (TM) mixing formulas as a function of filling fraction.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Photonic and phononic crystal band structures

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Scalar-wave bands of an fcc lattice of dielectric spheres and the L-point pseudogap
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Scalar Helmholtz plane-wave expansion for fcc dielectric spheres, using the spherical Bessel j1 form factor; compute bands along L-Γ-X-W and the stop-band width at L versus dielectric contrast and filling.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Photonic and phononic crystal band structures

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Antiplane-shear band gap of a steel-in-epoxy 2D phononic crystal
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Plane-wave expansion of the SH elastic wave equation with position-dependent density and shear modulus for steel cylinders in epoxy on a square lattice; compute the bands and the absolute SH gap versus filling fraction.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Photonic and phononic crystal band structures

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Projection operators for symmetry-adapted sp3 orbitals in Td
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Generate the 24 Td operations as 3x3 matrices, form the four-dimensional permutation representation of tetrahedral bonds, decompose it into A1+T2, and construct the symmetry-adapted combinations with projection operators.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Symmetry analysis and group theory of bands

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Glide-mirror band sticking in a nonsymmorphic 1D chain
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: A two-site zigzag chain with glide symmetry: compute the glide eigenvalues ±e^{ik/2} of the Bloch bands numerically, show their exchange across the Brillouin zone, and prove the enforced twofold degeneracy at the zone boundary that survives generic hopping perturbations.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Symmetry analysis and group theory of bands

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Chern number modulo 4 from C4 rotation eigenvalues at high-symmetry momenta
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: For a C4-symmetric two-band Chern insulator, compute the rotation eigenvalues of occupied states at Γ, M and X, apply the Fang-Gilbert-Bernevig formula for C mod 4, and cross-check against a Fukui-Hatsugai lattice Chern number.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Symmetry analysis and group theory of bands

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Lea-Leask-Wolf cubic crystal-field levels of a J=4 rare-earth ion
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Construct the Stevens operators O4^0, O4^4, O6^0 and O6^4 for J=4 with sympy or numpy, diagonalize the cubic crystal-field Hamiltonian versus the LLW parameter x, and label the Γ1, Γ3, Γ4, Γ5 multiplets by their degeneracies.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Symmetry analysis and group theory of bands

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Jackson versus Lorentz kernels: resolution and positivity of KPM reconstructions
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Expand a delta function and a step function in Chebyshev series truncated at N moments, apply Dirichlet, Fejér, Jackson and Lorentz kernels, and measure Gibbs oscillations, positivity and the broadening width (≈πσ/N) of each kernel.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: KPM local density of states near a vacancy in graphene
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the Chebyshev moments of the LDOS on sites next to a single vacancy in a large honeycomb flake, reconstruct the LDOS showing the zero-energy quasi-localized resonance, and contrast it with the bulk linear DOS.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Chebyshev propagation of e^{-iHt} with Bessel-function coefficients
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Expand the time-evolution operator as Σ(2-δn0)(-i)^n J_n(at) T_n(H̃), choose the truncation from Bessel decay, evolve a wave packet on a large sparse lattice, and compare the accuracy and cost with exact diagonalization and Crank-Nicolson.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Finite-temperature density and energy from Chebyshev expansion of the Fermi function
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute Chebyshev coefficients of the Fermi function by Gauss-Chebyshev quadrature, combine them with stochastic trace moments of a tight-binding Hamiltonian, and obtain the electron density and internal energy versus μ and T, including the temperature-dependent number of moments needed.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: KPM momentum-resolved spectral function of a disordered chain
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute Chebyshev moments of ⟨k|δ(E-H)|k⟩ for an Anderson chain averaged over disorder realizations, reconstruct A(k,E), and extract the disorder-induced linewidth, comparing it with the Born-approximation scattering rate 2π W²ρ(E)/12.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: KPM density of states of the Hofstadter model and gap labeling
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Build a large sparse square-lattice Hamiltonian with Landau-gauge Peierls phases at flux p/q, compute the DOS by KPM, integrate it to obtain the integrated DOS on gap plateaus, and check the gap-labeling (Diophantine) values.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Stochastic trace estimation error for Chebyshev moments: Gaussian versus Rademacher vectors
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Estimate Tr[T_n(H)] with Gaussian, Rademacher and random-phase vectors, measure the variance of the moments and of the resulting DOS versus the number of vectors R and system size N, and confirm the 1/(RN) self-averaging scaling.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Resonant level model: Lorentzian spectral function, phase shift and Friedel sum
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: A single level hybridized with a flat conduction band: compute the impurity Green's function, the phase shift δ(E)=π/2-arctan((ε_d-E)/Δ), and the occupancy from both spectral integration and the Friedel sum rule, including finite-bandwidth corrections.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Anderson Hartree-Fock local moment formation and the Uρ>1 criterion
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve the self-consistent mean-field equations n_σ=(1/π)arccot((ε_d+U n_{-σ})/Δ) for the Anderson impurity model, map the magnetic/nonmagnetic phase boundary in the (ε_d/U, Δ/U) plane, and recover the symmetric-point criterion U=πΔ.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Large-N slave-boson mean-field Kondo resonance of the infinite-U Anderson model
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve the Read-Newns saddle-point equations for the renormalized level ε̃_f and width Δ̃ with a flat band of half-width D, obtain the Kondo scale T_K ≈ D exp(-π|ε_f|/NΔ), and compute the resulting quasiparticle spectral function and specific-heat coefficient.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Schrieffer-Wolff exchange and the Haldane Kondo temperature versus U
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute J from the Schrieffer-Wolff transformation of the Anderson model, evaluate the Haldane formula T_K=√(UΔ/2)exp(πε_d(ε_d+U)/(2UΔ)), and compare it with the weak-coupling expression D√(ρJ)exp(-1/ρJ) across the Kondo regime.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: STM spectroscopy of a Kondo adatom: Fano lineshapes and Frota fits
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Model the differential conductance of a magnetic adatom as interference between tip-substrate and tip-impurity channels, giving a Fano lineshape with parameter q. Generate synthetic spectra and fit both Fano and Frota functions to extract the resonance width and T_K.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Kondo resistivity minimum from the log term plus Bloch-Grüneisen phonons
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Combine the Kondo impurity term c[ρ0 - ρ1 ln T] with Bloch-Grüneisen phonon resistivity evaluated by quadrature of the x^5 integral, find T_min numerically, and verify the c^{1/5} scaling of T_min with impurity concentration.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Residual resistivity of 3d impurities in copper from d-wave virtual bound states
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Use virtual-bound-state phase shifts for l=2 constrained by the Friedel sum rule on the excess valence Z, and compute the residual resistivity from Σ(l+1)sin²(δ_l-δ_{l+1}) across the 3d series, reproducing the double-humped trend for magnetic versus nonmagnetic impurities.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Kondo Fermi-liquid Wilson ratio from slave-boson susceptibility and specific heat
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: From the slave-boson quasiparticle resonance, compute the impurity spin susceptibility and Sommerfeld coefficient by Fermi-function quadrature, form the Wilson ratio, and compare the large-N mean-field value with the exact R_W=2 for the spin-1/2 Kondo model.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Yu-Shiba-Rusinov bound states of a classical magnetic impurity in a superconductor
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: From the Nambu T-matrix of a classical spin J in a BCS host, compute the subgap bound-state energy ε=Δ(1-α²)/(1+α²) with α=πρJS, the particle and hole spectral weights, and the quantum phase transition at α=1, with a Dynes-broadened LDOS.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Anderson impurity in graphene: pseudogap hybridization and Kramers-Kronig level shifts
