physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Use a linear-in-energy hybridization from the graphene DOS, compute the real part of the self-energy by a principal-value Kramers-Kronig quadrature, solve for the impurity spectral function, and show how the resonance position and width depend on ε_d and gating.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: HgTe quantum-well critical thickness from k·p subband mass inversion
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Model the E1 and H1 subbands of a HgTe/CdTe well with simple confinement formulas parametrized by well width, find the width where the BHZ mass M(d) changes sign, and evaluate the Z2 invariant and gap on both sides of the transition.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Topological Anderson insulator from the SCBA renormalized BHZ mass
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve the self-consistent Born approximation for on-site disorder in a lattice BHZ model, with the self-energy obtained by Brillouin-zone quadrature, and show that the renormalized mass changes sign so a trivial insulator acquires a quantized spin Chern number at intermediate disorder.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Mirror Chern number of a rocksalt SnTe-like tight-binding model
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: In a minimal p-orbital model with spin-orbit coupling, block-diagonalize the Hamiltonian on the (110) mirror plane by mirror eigenvalue, compute the Chern number of each mirror sector by link-variable integration, and show C_M=2 in the band-inverted phase.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Time-reversal polarization and Z2 spin pumping in a 1D Kramers pump
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the partner-resolved Wannier centers of a time-reversal-symmetric Rice-Mele-like spin pump over a half cycle, evaluate the Fu-Kane time-reversal polarization at t=0 and T/2, and verify the Z2 change through Pfaffian sign changes.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: D'yakonov-Perel spin relaxation tensor with Rashba and Dresselhaus fields
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Average the precession-vector correlations over the Fermi circle to obtain the in-plane and out-of-plane DP relaxation rates. Show the anisotropy between the [110] and [1-10] directions and the divergence of one lifetime at α=β, including cubic Dresselhaus corrections.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Rashba-Edelstein current-induced spin polarization from Boltzmann theory
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve the relaxation-time Boltzmann equation for both Rashba helicity bands in an electric field, sum the shifted-Fermi-surface spin expectation values by angular quadrature, and compare the induced spin density with the analytic Edelstein result as a function of density.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Cubic Dresselhaus spin splitting in bulk zincblende semiconductors
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the bulk inversion asymmetry field Ω(k)∝γ_D(k_x(k_y²-k_z²),...) for GaAs, map the spin splitting over directions on the Fermi sphere, show it vanishes along [100] and [111], and compute the angle-averaged splitting for a degenerate electron gas.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Rashba nanowire with Zeeman field and s-wave pairing: Majorana criterion
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Diagonalize the 4x4 BdG Hamiltonian of a 1D Rashba wire under a perpendicular Zeeman field and proximity pairing, show the helical gap, track the k=0 gap closing at V_Z²=Δ²+μ², and evaluate the Pfaffian Z2 index on both sides.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Aharonov-Casher conductance oscillations in a Rashba quantum ring
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Diagonalize the Meijer-Frustaglia ring Hamiltonian with Rashba coupling, compute the spin-dependent geometric and dynamic Aharonov-Casher phase versus α, and evaluate the transmission of a symmetric two-terminal ring showing the conductance minima as α varies.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Hexagonal warping of a topological-insulator surface state and its out-of-plane spin
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Use the Fu warped Dirac Hamiltonian H=v(k×σ)_z+λ(k_+³+k_-³)σ_z/2, compute constant-energy contours, their snowflake shape and the out-of-plane spin texture versus energy, and calculate the nesting-relevant contour curvature for Bi2Te3 parameters.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Coherent one-phonon S(q,ω) of a diatomic chain with resolution
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: From the eigenvectors of a 1D diatomic harmonic chain, compute the coherent one-phonon structure factor with scattering lengths, Bose factors and the Debye-Waller factor. Convolve it with a Gaussian energy resolution and check the first-moment sum rule ħ²q²/2M.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Incoherent multiphonon neutron scattering from a Debye phonon DOS
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the incoherent S(Q,ω) of a harmonic solid in the incoherent approximation by expanding exp(2W·γ(t)) into n-phonon terms obtained by repeated convolution of the weighted DOS. Show the shift of spectral weight to multiphonon terms at large Q and high T, and verify detailed balance.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Magnetic form factors of Cu2+ and Mn2+ in the dipole approximation
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate ⟨j0(Q)⟩ and ⟨j2(Q)⟩ from the analytic exponential fits, combine them with the Landé g-factor into F(Q), and compute the Q-dependence of magnetic neutron intensity, including the separation of magnetic and nuclear peaks by their form-factor falloff.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Resolution focusing of a dispersive mode with a tilted Gaussian resolution ellipsoid
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Convolve a linear acoustic or magnon dispersion with a correlated 2D Gaussian resolution function in (q,ω), compute the observed peak width analytically and by quadrature, and show the focusing and defocusing sides of a constant-q scan.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Damped harmonic oscillator fits of inelastic X-ray spectra and sound dispersion
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Model S(q,ω) as an elastic line plus a Bose-weighted damped harmonic oscillator convolved with a Lorentzian resolution, fit synthetic IXS spectra at several q, and extract the apparent sound velocity and the Γ∝q² damping law.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Powder-averaged spin-wave spectrum of a square-lattice antiferromagnet
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Average the single-crystal one-magnon S(Q,ω) of a Heisenberg square-lattice antiferromagnet over spherical shells of |Q| with Fibonacci-sphere or Lebedev-type quadrature, include the magnetic form factor, and produce the S(|Q|,ω) powder map with its dispersion-edge features.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Spin-dimer triplet excitations: interference factor and powder averaging
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: For isolated Heisenberg dimers, compute the singlet-triplet neutron cross-section with its 1-cos(Q·d) interference factor, its powder average 1-sin(Qd)/(Qd), and the thermal population factor; use the first powder maximum to infer the dimer separation.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Hubbard local-field correction and the compressibility sum rule in the electron gas
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the static dielectric function ε(q)=1-v_qχ0/(1+v_qG(q)χ0) with the Hubbard G(q), compute the q→0 compressibility, compare it with the RPA and Hartree-Fock compressibility, and locate the density where the compressibility becomes negative.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Screening length across the nondegenerate-degenerate crossover in doped semiconductors
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the Thomas-Fermi/Debye screening wavevector q²=(e²/ε)∂n/∂μ using Fermi-Dirac integrals F_{1/2} and F_{-1/2} evaluated by quadrature, invert n(μ,T) numerically, and show the crossover from Debye-Hückel to Thomas-Fermi screening versus density and T.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Lindhard stopping power of the electron gas for slow and fast ions
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the dielectric stopping formula dE/dx ∝ ∫dk/k ∫ω Im[-1/ε(k,ω)]dω with the analytic Lindhard Im ε and the plasmon pole contribution. Recover the low-velocity linear friction law and the high-velocity Bethe logarithm.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Remote-impurity-limited mobility of a modulation-doped 2DEG with Lindhard screening
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the momentum relaxation rate from a sheet of ionized donors at setback d in the Born approximation, with the 2D static Lindhard (Thomas-Fermi at q<2k_F) screening and transport weight (1-cosθ), and obtain the mobility scaling with setback and density.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Hashin-Shtrikman bounds and universal anisotropy index of cubic polycrystals
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: From C11, C12 and C44 compute the Voigt, Reuss and Hashin-Shtrikman bounds on bulk and shear moduli, the Zener ratio and the universal anisotropy index A^U, and compare bound widths across several cubic metals.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Slack formula lattice thermal conductivity from Debye temperature and Grüneisen parameter
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate Slack's expression κ ∝ M̄ θ_a³ δ n^{1/3}/(γ² T) with the acoustic Debye temperature derived from sound velocities and the γ-dependent prefactor, and compare the predictions for several diamond- and rocksalt-structure crystals.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Sawtooth de Haas-van Alphen magnetization of a 2DEG at fixed N versus fixed μ
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the T=0 and finite-T ground-state energy of a 2DEG with Landau-level filling at fixed electron number, differentiate to obtain the sawtooth magnetization, and compare it with the grand-canonical Lifshitz-Kosevich harmonic sum that lacks the sharp jumps.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Quantum-limit field and field-dependent chemical potential in a 3D low-density metal
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: With 3D Landau levels and the √(E-E_n) DOS summed over levels at fixed density, solve for μ(B) numerically. Find the field where the system enters the n=0 quantum limit, and show how μ oscillates and then drops toward the lowest level.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Reststrahlen reflectivity of a polar crystal and the Lyddane-Sachs-Teller relation
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Use a damped Lorentz oscillator ε(ω)=ε∞(ω_LO²-ω²-iγω)/(ω_TO²-ω²-iγω) to compute normal-incidence reflectivity, extract the high-reflectance band between ω_TO and ω_LO, and verify the LST relation ε0/ε∞=(ω_LO/ω_TO)² for GaAs and NaCl.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Surface phonon polaritons at a polar crystal interface
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve the TM surface-mode condition k=(ω/c)√(ε1ε2/(ε1+ε2)) with a Lorentz-oscillator ε(ω) such as SiC or hBN in-plane, compute the dispersion, propagation length and confinement within the Reststrahlen band, and identify the Fuchs-Kliewer frequency.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Hopfield exciton-polariton dispersion and the longitudinal-transverse splitting
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve c²k²/ω²=ε∞+f ω_T²/(ω_T²+ħω_T k²/M-ω²) for the upper and lower polariton branches with spatial dispersion, compute their photon and exciton Hopfield coefficients, and relate the oscillator strength to the LT splitting for a CdS-like exciton.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: fcc empty-lattice degeneracies at Γ, X, L reduced into Oh irreps
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Free-electron bands folded into the fcc Brillouin zone. Group the degenerate plane-wave stars at Γ, X and L, build their permutation representations under the little groups, and reduce them with Oh/D4h/D3d character tables to label every level.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Symmetry analysis and group theory of bands

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Double-group splitting of zincblende p bands into Γ8 and Γ7
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Construct spin-orbital representation matrices of Td double-group elements for p⊗spin-1/2 states. Reduce the characters into Γ8+Γ7 and verify the splitting by diagonalizing an L·S Hamiltonian, with the 4- and 2-fold degeneracies.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Symmetry analysis and group theory of bands

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Kagome tight-binding eigenstate irreps and the protected quadratic touching at Γ
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Diagonalize the three-band kagome model at Γ, K and M and apply C6v representation matrices to the eigenvectors to obtain irrep labels. Show that the flat-band/quadratic-band touching at Γ is a two-dimensional irrep.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Symmetry analysis and group theory of bands

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Chern-number parity from inversion eigenvalues at the four 2D TRIM
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: For an inversion-symmetric two-band Chern model, compute parity eigenvalues of occupied states at the four TRIM. Compare (-1)^C from their product with the Chern number obtained by Berry-curvature quadrature across a mass-parameter sweep.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Symmetry analysis and group theory of bands

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Screw-axis-enforced band sticking on the A plane of hcp s-orbitals
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Build a two-sublattice hcp s-orbital tight-binding model. Construct the 6_3 screw and mirror operations with k-dependent phases and verify that their algebra forces twofold degeneracy on the kz=π/c face, then quantify the splitting when the screw is broken.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Symmetry analysis and group theory of bands

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Dipole selection rules at Γ from Oh direct-product reductions
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Using the Oh character table, reduce Γi⊗Γ15(vector) for all irreps to get allowed dipole transitions between Γ-point states. Verify the result numerically by evaluating momentum matrix elements between symmetry-adapted plane waves.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Symmetry analysis and group theory of bands

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Sr2RuO4 three-orbital α, β, γ Fermi sheets and Luttinger count
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Build a t2g (xz, yz, xy) tight-binding model with SOC and find μ for 4 electrons by Brillouin-zone quadrature. Extract the three Fermi contours by angular root finding and verify that the enclosed areas satisfy Luttinger's theorem.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Stoner SDW instability: critical U and ordering vector in the t-t' square lattice
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the static bare susceptibility χ0(q) over the Brillouin zone for a t-t' band at given filling. Locate its maximum (commensurate versus incommensurate) and obtain the RPA critical coupling Uc=1/χ0max as a function of t' and density.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Kagome van Hove filling: sublattice interference in χ0 at M
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: At the kagome van Hove filling, compute the sublattice-resolved bare susceptibility χ0_ab(q) with orbital-weight matrix elements. Show how sublattice interference suppresses on-site nesting at M compared with the naive band-only nesting function.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Chemical potential of a compensated semimetal with anisotropic ellipsoidal pockets
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Model electron and hole ellipsoids with different mass tensors and degeneracies, as in Bi-like semimetals. Impose charge neutrality using Fermi-Dirac integrals and solve for μ(T) by root finding, tracking carrier densities versus temperature.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Ong's geometric Hall conductivity from mean-free-path curves of tight-binding Fermi contours
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: For a 2D tight-binding Fermi contour, compute l(k)=τ v(k) along the contour and the signed area swept by the l-vector. Evaluate σxy from Ong's formula and track the Hall-coefficient sign change through the van Hove filling.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Gaussian-broadened Fermi-surface nesting function of a cuprate band
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate ξ(q)=Σk δ(εk)δ(εk+q) with Gaussian-broadened deltas for a t-t'-t'' band on a dense k-grid. Map its peaks along high-symmetry lines and check convergence of peak positions with broadening and grid size.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Anisotropic triangular lattice Fermi contours for κ-organic salts
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: For hoppings t and t' on an anisotropic triangular lattice at half filling, find μ from the electron count. Extract the Fermi contour by polar-angle root finding and compute the contour DOS and Fermi-velocity anisotropy versus t'/t.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Harrison construction for aluminum: Fermi-sphere occupation of successive fcc zones
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Place a free-electron Fermi sphere for trivalent fcc Al and count reciprocal-lattice vectors closer than kF for each k. Integrate by Monte Carlo/grid quadrature the occupied volume in the first through fourth zones and the electrons per zone.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Stoner ferromagnetism criterion from a tight-binding DOS near van Hove filling
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the square-lattice DOS and solve the self-consistent spin-split mean-field equations for magnetization m(U,n). Determine the Stoner threshold U·N(EF)=1 and the enhancement of the Pauli susceptibility.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Independent boson model spectral function and finite-temperature phonon sidebands
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: For a localized level linearly coupled to an Einstein mode, compute sideband weights with modified Bessel functions I_n and the Huang-Rhys factor at temperature T. Check sum rules and the first-moment polaron shift.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: ARPES electron-phonon kink from the Debye-model self-energy at finite temperature
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute ReΣ(ω) and ImΣ(ω) by quadrature of a Debye α²F with Fermi and Bose factors. Construct the renormalized dispersion and spectral function A(k,ω), and extract λ from the slope ratio across the kink.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Holstein nonadiabatic small-polaron hopping mobility and its Arrhenius limit
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate Holstein's multiphonon hopping rate via the Bessel-function sum and the Einstein relation for mobility. Show the crossover from tunneling at low T to activated hopping with E_a=E_p/2 at high T.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Bardeen-Shockley deformation-potential mobility of 2D semiconductors
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Implement the Takagi 2D acoustic-phonon-limited mobility formula from the deformation potential, elastic modulus and effective masses. Compute mobilities for model MoS2 and phosphorene parameters, including anisotropic masses.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Polar-optical-phonon scattering rates in GaAs from the Fröhlich golden rule
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Derive the absorption and emission rates 1/τ(E) with asinh closed forms and verify them by angular quadrature. Include the emission threshold at ħω_LO, and compute the energy-loss rate and momentum-relaxation time.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Gilat-Raubenheimer linear extrapolation DOS for the fcc tight-binding band
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Implement Gilat-Raubenheimer cube-section DOS using band gradients on a cubic grid for fcc nearest-neighbor hopping. Compare its convergence with histogram sampling and locate the band-edge divergence.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Density of states and van Hove singularities

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Anisotropic square lattice: splitting of the van Hove peak at tx≠ty
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the DOS of an anisotropic rectangular tight-binding lattice through complete elliptic integrals. Show the single log peak splitting into two at ±2|tx-ty| with step-like edges between them.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Density of states and van Hove singularities

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: AB bilayer graphene DOS with trigonal warping and Lifshitz pockets
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Diagonalize the four-band AB bilayer model with γ0, γ1 and γ3 and compute the DOS by broadened k-sampling. Locate the Lifshitz transition energy where the three trigonal pockets merge and its van Hove signature.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Density of states and van Hove singularities

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Broadening scaling of the square-lattice van Hove peak height
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the Lorentzian-broadened square-lattice DOS at the band center for a range of widths η. Verify that the peak height grows as log(1/η) and extract the prefactor predicted by the elliptic-integral form.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Density of states and van Hove singularities

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Higher-order van Hove singularity with power-law DOS in a tuned square lattice
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Tune further-neighbor hoppings so a saddle point's Hessian degenerates. Compute the DOS near the critical energy and fit the power-law exponent, contrasting it with the ordinary logarithmic singularity.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Density of states and van Hove singularities

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: SCBA Landau-level DOS of a 2DEG with short-range disorder
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve the self-consistent Born approximation for Landau-level broadening, giving semicircular levels of width ∝√B. Compute the DOS versus energy and field and compare it with phenomenological Gaussian broadening.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Density of states and van Hove singularities

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Dyson singularity at the band center of the random-hopping chain
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the integrated DOS of a chain with random off-diagonal hopping by Dyson-Schmidt node counting with Riccati recursion. Show the 1/(E log³E) divergence of the DOS at E=0, which an on-site disordered chain does not have.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Density of states and van Hove singularities

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Dephasing-damped Bloch oscillations in the Haken-Strobl tight-binding chain
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Integrate the Haken-Strobl density-matrix equation for a chain in a DC field. Compare the damping of Bloch oscillations and the long-time diffusion constant with the closed-form velocity-correlation result.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: E×B drift of semiclassical electrons on a square lattice in crossed fields
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Integrate semiclassical equations with Lorentz force and electric field on the square-lattice band. Compute the drift velocity and compare it with E/B in the low-density limit, along with deviations near the van Hove energy.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Harmonically trapped lattice wave packets: pendulum dynamics in quasimomentum
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: A tight-binding chain in a parabolic trap maps semiclassically to a pendulum. Compute oscillation periods via complete elliptic integrals, the crossover to Bloch-like localized orbits, and compare with exact numerical propagation.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Self-trapping transition in the discrete nonlinear Schrödinger dimer
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve the nonlinear dimer population dynamics in closed form with Jacobi elliptic functions. Identify the Kenkre-Campbell self-trapping threshold χ=4V and the diverging period, and check with ODE integration.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Conical diffraction of a Dirac-point wave packet in a honeycomb lattice
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Launch a Gaussian packet centered at K in a honeycomb lattice and propagate it exactly. Show ring formation with radius growing at the Dirac velocity, and compare with the continuum Bessel-function solution.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Non-exponential decay of a site coupled to a semi-infinite chain
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the survival amplitude of an impurity level coupled to a semi-infinite tight-binding lead by Fourier quadrature of the exact Green's function. Show the exponential regime, the bound-state plateau and the power-law tail at long times.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: CrI3-like honeycomb ferromagnet: magnon Dirac cones and DM-induced gap
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Apply linear spin-wave theory to a honeycomb Heisenberg ferromagnet with next-nearest DM interaction. Obtain the two magnon branches, the Dirac-point gap 6√3·D·S and the Berry curvature of the lower band.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Spin waves and linear spin-wave theory

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Two-sublattice ferrimagnet: acoustic and optical magnon branches
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Use Holstein-Primakoff with Bogoliubov diagonalization for a square-lattice ferrimagnet with S1≠S2. Compute the quadratic acoustic and gapped optical branches, the spin stiffness and the zero-point spin reductions.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Spin waves and linear spin-wave theory

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: 1D Heisenberg antiferromagnet LSWT: des Cloizeaux-Pearson comparison and infrared divergence
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the LSWT magnon dispersion and ground-state energy of the spin-S chain and compare them with the exact spinon result. Show the logarithmic divergence of the sublattice-magnetization correction with system size.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Spin waves and linear spin-wave theory

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Takahashi modified spin-wave theory for the 2D ferromagnet at finite T
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Impose zero magnetization through a chemical potential in modified spin-wave theory. Solve self-consistently for the gap and the exponentially divergent correlation length ξ(T), consistent with Mermin-Wagner.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Spin waves and linear spin-wave theory

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Pyrochlore Heisenberg ferromagnet: four magnon bands including two flat bands
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Build the 4x4 LSWT Hamiltonian of the pyrochlore ferromagnet and diagonalize it along high-symmetry paths. Identify the two flat bands, the band touching points and their contribution to the magnon DOS.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Spin waves and linear spin-wave theory

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Chiral magnon splitting in a d-wave altermagnet
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Apply LSWT to a collinear antiferromagnet with sublattice-dependent anisotropic exchange that breaks the PT-related degeneracy. Compute the nonrelativistic splitting of the two magnon chiralities across the Brillouin zone and its d-wave nodes.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Spin waves and linear spin-wave theory

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Moment Debye temperatures θ(n) from the diatomic chain phonon DOS
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the closed-form phonon DOS of a diatomic chain and its frequency moments. Evaluate the moment Debye temperatures θ(n) and relate them to low-T, high-T and entropy limits of the thermodynamics.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Graphene low-temperature heat capacity dominated by quadratic flexural phonons
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Model the LA and TA linear branches and the ZA quadratic branch of graphene. Integrate their heat capacities and show C∝T from the ZA mode at low T, with the crossover to T² and the Dulong-Petit limit.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Anharmonic correction to Dulong-Petit from classical quartic oscillator partition functions
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the classical partition function of a quartic-perturbed oscillator by quadrature. Obtain the heat capacity and its linear-in-T anharmonic correction, comparing with first-order perturbation theory.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Tunneling two-level systems: linear specific heat of glasses and crossover to Debye T³
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Integrate Schottky heat capacities over a flat distribution of tunneling-system splittings to obtain C∝T. Add the Debye phonon term and locate the crossover temperature and the C/T³ plot shape.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Dimensional crossover of phonon heat capacity in thin films with quantized modes
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Quantize transverse acoustic modes in a film of thickness d and sum the 2D subbands. Compute C(T) showing the crossover from 3D T³ to 2D T² behavior as the thermal wavelength exceeds d.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Vibrational entropy stabilization of bcc versus fcc from force-constant DOS
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute phonon DOS of nearest-neighbor fcc and bcc spring models and their vibrational free energies F(T). Find the temperature at which the softer bcc phase overcomes a given static energy difference.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Debye-plus-Einstein heat capacity fit for acoustic and optical branches
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Generate C_V(T) from an exact diatomic-chain DOS. Fit a composite Debye (acoustic) plus Einstein (optical) model, and evaluate fitted θ_D and θ_E against the mass ratio.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Decomposing heavy-fermion specific heat into electronic, Debye, Schottky and nuclear terms
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Build a composite model of γT, Debye T³, crystal-field Schottky and nuclear quadrupole T⁻² terms. Fit it to synthetic data by nonlinear least squares and compute the magnetic entropy recovered.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Commensurate twist angles, moiré lattice constants and supercell atom counts
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Enumerate commensurate (m,n) twisted bilayer structures and compute their angles, superlattice vectors and atoms per cell. Compare with the moiré period a/(2 sin θ/2) and build the moiré reciprocal lattice.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Twisted bilayer graphene van Hove peak energy versus twist angle
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the BM-model DOS by k-sampling with Gaussian broadening over the moiré Brillouin zone. Track the flat-band van Hove peak separation versus twist angle and its collapse near the magic angle.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Twisted homobilayer TMD topological moiré bands and their Chern numbers
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Build the layer-pseudospin continuum model of twisted MoTe2/WSe2 with intralayer potential and interlayer tunneling. Diagonalize on a grid and compute the top-band Chern number with the Fukui method versus twist angle.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Corrugation ratio w0/w1 and gaps isolating the twisted bilayer flat bands
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Vary w0/w1 to model lattice relaxation in the BM model. Compute the single-particle gaps between flat and remote bands at Γ and their bandwidth, identifying the ratio regime of isolated flat bands.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Graphene on hBN: secondary Dirac points from a sublattice moiré potential
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Build a continuum Dirac model with a moiré superlattice potential of hBN form and diagonalize it in a plane-wave basis. Locate the secondary Dirac points or gaps at the moiré zone corners near ħv|G|/2.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Wilson-loop winding of twisted bilayer flat bands and fragile topology
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the 2x2 non-Abelian Wilson loop of the two BM flat bands along k2 for each k1. Show the opposite winding of its eigenphases, which is protected by C2T, and track its loss when sublattice mass breaks C2.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Interband optical conductivity of a Weyl semimetal with Pauli blocking
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Kubo interband conductivity of isotropic Weyl nodes by quadrature with finite μ and T. Recover σ=e²ω/(24πħv) per node and the 2μ Pauli-blocking edge, together with the intraband Drude weight.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Kubo-Greenwood DC conductivity of the 2D Anderson model
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Diagonalize finite disordered square lattices and evaluate the Kubo-Greenwood σ(E) from current matrix elements with Lorentzian-broadened deltas. Average over disorder and show the conductivity suppression with increasing W.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Critical-point lineshapes of ε2(ω) in a 3D two-band tight-binding semiconductor
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the joint DOS and ε2(ω) for a two-band cubic model with constant dipole matrix element. Identify the M0 onset and the M1/M2 saddle-point features, and obtain ε1 by Kramers-Kronig.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Kramers-Kronig phase retrieval of n and k from normal-incidence reflectivity
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Generate reflectivity from a multi-Lorentz-oscillator dielectric function and recover the phase via the Kramers-Kronig integral with high- and low-frequency extrapolations. Reconstruct n(ω) and k(ω) and evaluate the errors.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Valley-selective circular dichroism of a massive Dirac TMD monolayer
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the k-resolved circular polarization η(k) and the σ+ and σ- absorption of a two-valley massive Dirac model. Show full valley selectivity at the band edge and its decay at higher photon energy.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Cyclotron-resonance Faraday rotation of a 2DEG from the Drude tensor
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the magneto-Drude σxx and σxy tensor and the circular-polarization transmission of a 2DEG sheet. Obtain the Faraday rotation and ellipticity versus frequency and field, with resonance at ω_c.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Optical conductivity of AB bilayer graphene and the γ1 interlayer resonance
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Kubo conductivity of the four-band AB bilayer model by Brillouin-zone quadrature with broadening. Identify the sharp peak at ħω=γ1, the low-energy universal value and their μ dependence.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Shift current of the Rice-Mele chain from the shift vector
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the second-order shift conductivity σ(ω) of the Rice-Mele model from the shift vector and interband Berry connections by k-quadrature. Determine the spectrum's sign changes versus staggered potential.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Finite-size gap of BHZ lattice ribbons from hybridizing helical edge states
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Diagonalize the lattice BHZ model on ribbons of width N and extract the edge-state gap at the crossing momentum. Show its exponentially decaying, oscillating dependence on width, set by the complex decay wavevector.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Edge-state density of chiral graphene edges versus chiral angle
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Build graphene ribbons with chiral edge terminations (n,m) and count zero-energy edge states per unit edge length. Compare with the Akhmerov-Beenakker boundary-condition prediction as a function of chiral angle.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Benalcazar-Bernevig-Hughes quadrupole insulator: corner modes in finite flakes
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Diagonalize the BBH model on an open N×N flake and identify the four zero-energy corner states. Compute their localization lengths and the quantized corner charge ±e/2 versus the hopping ratio.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Zigzag MoS2 nanoribbon edge bands in the three-band d-orbital model
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Build Mo-terminated zigzag ribbons with the three-band nearest-neighbor (dz², dxy, dx²−y²) model and diagonalize them. Identify the in-gap edge bands, their edge-weight localization and metallicity.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Sancho-Rubio decimation of surface Green's functions and edge LDOS
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Implement Lopez Sancho-Rubio iterative decimation for semi-infinite graphene zigzag and QWZ half-planes. Compute the momentum-resolved edge spectral function and compare edge-state dispersions with finite-ribbon diagonalization.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Gated silicene ribbons: helical edge states and the topological transition at E_z=λ_SO
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Diagonalize buckled Kane-Mele zigzag ribbons with a perpendicular staggered potential from the gate. Follow the bulk-gap closing at E_z=λ_SO and the loss of the helical edge-state crossing.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Zigzag graphene ribbon in a transverse electric field: edge-band splitting
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Add a linear transverse potential to zigzag ribbons and diagonalize. Track the splitting of the flat edge bands, the field-dependent gap opening and the shift of edge-state weight between the two edges.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Lieb-lattice optical conductivity: flat-band to dispersive-band interband transitions
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Kubo interband conductivity of the three-band Lieb lattice with a sublattice gap by Brillouin-zone quadrature with Lorentzian broadening. Identify the absorption edges from flat-to-dispersive transitions and the Drude weight versus filling.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Optical Hall conductivity of a massive Dirac layer and thin-film Faraday rotation
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute σxy(ω) of a 2D massive Dirac model from the Kubo formula, including its resonance at 2|m| and its quantized DC limit. Feed σxx and σxy into thin-film transmission formulas to obtain the Faraday rotation angle.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Drude weight collapse across the Aubry-André transition via Kohn's flux curvature
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Thread a flux through a ring with an incommensurate Aubry-André potential and compute the many-fermion ground-state energy versus flux. Extract the Drude weight from the curvature and show it vanishes for λ>2.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Universal low-frequency microwave conductivity of a d-wave superconductor
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Use a Kubo bubble with a d-wave BCS gap and impurity broadening, integrated over the Fermi surface and energy. Show the T→0 conductivity approaches the Lee universal value ∝ v_F/v_Δ, independent of the scattering rate.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Nodal-line semimetal optical conductivity: frequency-independent interband plateau
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Integrate the Kubo interband conductivity of a two-band nodal-ring model over 3D k-space with Pauli blocking. Show the flat plateau proportional to the ring radius for ħω above 2μ and its crossover to ω-linear behavior at high frequency.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Anisotropic optical conductivity of tilted Dirac cones in 8-Pmmn borophene
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute σxx(ω) and σyy(ω) for a tilted anisotropic Dirac Hamiltonian using Kubo quadrature with Pauli blocking. Characterize the tilt-induced split absorption onsets between ω1 and ω2 and the anisotropic Drude weights.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Minimal conductivity of graphene from the Kubo formula with constant broadening
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Kubo-Greenwood DC conductivity of the Dirac Hamiltonian with a constant self-energy Γ at the Dirac point and versus μ. Recover the universal 4e²/(πh) limit and the crossover to Drude-like linear-in-density behavior.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Extended Drude analysis: frequency-dependent scattering rate and mass enhancement
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Generate σ(ω) for a Fermi liquid with 1/τ(ω,T)=a[(ħω)²+(πk_BT)²] using a memory-function Kramers-Kronig construction. Invert it with the extended Drude formulas to recover 1/τ(ω) and m*(ω)/m.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Interband optical absorption window of a Rashba two-dimensional electron gas
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the Kubo interband conductivity between Rashba-split subbands at fixed density. The absorption window is bounded by 2αk_F± transitions; compare numerical angular and radial quadrature with the closed-form result.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Wiedemann-Franz Lorenz number of a tight-binding band from transport integrals
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the Boltzmann transport integrals L0, L1 and L2 of a 1D or 2D cosine band numerically. Obtain σ, the Seebeck coefficient and κ_e, then compare the Lorenz number and thermopower with Sommerfeld expansions versus temperature.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Dykhne-Davis-Pechukas formula for nonlinear sweeps through avoided crossings
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Locate the complex degeneracy points of the adiabatic energies for nonlinear detuning protocols by root finding. Compute the transition probability from the imaginary part of the complex phase integral and compare it with ODE integration.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Landau-Zener and Zener tunneling between bands

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Twisted Landau-Zener: geometric-phase correction to the transition probability
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Add a time-dependent azimuthal twist of the coupling phase to the LZ Hamiltonian. Compute the modified transition probability numerically and compare it with Berry's geometric-amplitude asymptotics, showing the asymmetry between sweep directions.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Landau-Zener and Zener tunneling between bands

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: RPA correlation energy of the 3D electron gas from imaginary-frequency Lindhard
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the analytic Lindhard function at imaginary frequency. Integrate ln(1−vχ0)+vχ0 over q and ω to obtain the RPA correlation energy per electron versus r_s, and compare with the Gell-Mann-Brueckner high-density limit.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: RPA static structure factor and pair-correlation negativity of the electron gas
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Obtain S(q) from the fluctuation-dissipation theorem by integrating the RPA response over imaginary frequency. Fourier-transform 1+(S−1) to get g(r) and show g(0) becomes negative for r_s greater than about 1.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Charged-impurity-limited conductivity of graphene with RPA static screening
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Use the Hwang-Das Sarma static polarizability of doped graphene to screen Coulomb impurities. Compute the Boltzmann transport rate by angular quadrature and show the conductivity is linear in carrier density.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Quantum-wire plasmon dispersion with a harmonic-confinement Coulomb form factor
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Build the 1D Lindhard function and the Bessel-K-type intrasubband Coulomb matrix element for a Gaussian wire. Solve the RPA plasmon dispersion ω(q)∝q√|ln qa| and compare with the long-wavelength asymptotics.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Quinn-Ferrell quasiparticle lifetime from the electron-gas energy-loss function
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Integrate Im[-1/ε_RPA(q,ω)] over the allowed phase space to obtain the hot-electron decay rate. Verify the (E−E_F)² Fermi-liquid scaling and the Quinn-Ferrell coefficient at small r_s.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Lindhard-screened Ashcroft pseudopotential pair interaction of liquid sodium
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Combine the empty-core pseudopotential with the Lindhard dielectric function, optionally with a Hubbard local-field correction. Fourier-transform to the effective ion-ion pair potential and locate its Friedel-oscillation minima relative to the nearest-neighbor distance.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Thin metal film plasmons: symmetric and antisymmetric surface branches
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve the electrostatic boundary problem of a Drude slab for the coupled surface plasmons, ω±²=(ωp²/2)(1±e^{-qd}). Compute the slab energy-loss function and its thickness dependence.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Graphite Slonczewski-Weiss-McClure electron and hole pockets
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Diagonalize the SWMcC k·p Hamiltonian along kz near the H-K-H edge. Find the Fermi level that gives electron-hole compensation, then compute pocket volumes, carrier densities and the extremal-area ratios.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Bilayer-split cuprate Fermi surface: bonding and antibonding sheets and Luttinger count
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Add the interlayer hopping t⊥(cos kx−cos ky)²/4 to a t-t' band. Find μ at fixed total hole doping, extract both Fermi contours by root finding, and identify the doping at which the antibonding sheet crosses the van Hove point.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Mott-formula thermopower anomaly across a 3D Lifshitz neck transition
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Track the Fermi surface of a 3D tight-binding band through a neck-forming critical energy. Compute the DOS and transport functions by BZ quadrature, and obtain the Mott thermopower showing the √|μ−μc| anomaly.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Mean-field d-wave Pomeranchuk instability of the square-lattice Fermi surface
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Self-consistently solve for the forward-scattering nematic order parameter that deforms the band by δ(cos kx−cos ky) at fixed density. Compute the critical coupling near van Hove filling and the distorted Fermi contour.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Antiferromagnetic hot spots of electron-doped cuprates versus doping
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Determine μ from doping for a t-t'-t'' band and find, by root finding, where the Fermi contour crosses the antiferromagnetic zone boundary. Track the hot spot positions until they merge at the zone diagonal.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Large versus small Fermi surface in the mean-field periodic Anderson model
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Hybridize a conduction band with a renormalized f level and solve the mean-field constraints with the Luttinger count. Compute the hybridization gap, heavy-band masses and Fermi-surface volume including versus excluding f electrons.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Triangular-lattice bare susceptibility: tracking the peak wavevector with filling
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the static χ0(q) of the nearest-neighbor triangular lattice on dense BZ grids for many fillings. Follow how the maximum moves between the K and M points and relate it to the Fermi-contour shape.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Smearing methods for metallic Brillouin-zone integration: convergence comparison
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the band energy and Fermi level of a 2D or 3D tight-binding metal on Monkhorst-Pack grids using Fermi-Dirac, Gaussian, Methfessel-Paxton and Marzari-Vanderbilt smearing. Quantify the error versus grid density and smearing width.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: YRZ pseudogap ansatz: hole-pocket Fermi arcs and Luttinger-volume violation
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Build the Yang-Rice-Zhang Green's function with a d-wave pseudogap. Find the hole-pocket contours as poles at ω=0 and the Luttinger zeros, then compute the pocket area versus doping compared with the Luttinger count.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Z2 invariant of spinful px-py honeycomb bismuthene from Fu-Kane parities
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Construct a four-band px,py honeycomb tight-binding model with on-site atomic spin-orbit coupling. Compute the inversion eigenvalues at the four TRIM, form the Z2 product, and map the gap and topology versus SOC strength.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: 1T'-WTe2 quantum spin Hall gap and Z2 from a four-band model
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Use a minimal four-band inversion-symmetric model of monolayer 1T' WTe2 with spin-orbit coupling. Compute parity eigenvalues at the TRIM, the Z2 index, and the indirect bulk gap by BZ minimization.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Spin-orbit Lieb lattice quantum spin Hall phase and its Z2 index
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Add intrinsic SOC to the Lieb lattice and apply a staggered sublattice potential. Compute the Z2 index from the spin Chern number of the Sz-conserving sectors and locate the transition in the SOC versus staggering plane.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Class DIII helical p-wave superconductor: Z2 from the BdG time-reversal Pfaffian
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Build a 2D lattice BdG Hamiltonian for a helical p±ip superconductor. Compute the Z2 invariant from Pfaffians of the sewing matrix at the TRIM and determine the topological region versus chemical potential.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Flux insertion and Kramers-pair pumping in a quantum spin Hall cylinder
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Thread flux through a Kane-Mele or BHZ cylinder and track the edge-localized eigenstates as the flux goes from 0 to π. Show that Kramers partners switch, which signals nontrivial Z2.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Scattering-matrix Z2 invariant of a disordered BHZ strip
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the reflection matrix of a finite disordered BHZ strip using transfer matrices or recursive Green's functions with clean leads. Evaluate the Fulga-Akhmerov Pfaffian Z2 index and its sample-averaged value versus disorder strength.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Intrinsic spin Hall conductivity of p-doped Luttinger semiconductors
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Use the spherical Luttinger Hamiltonian with heavy- and light-hole bands. Compute the Murakami-Nagaosa-Zhang spin Hall conductivity from Fermi-sea integrals versus hole density and the γ2/γ1 ratio.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Orbital Hall conductivity of a p-orbital square lattice
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Build a px,py,pz tight-binding model with orbital-dependent hopping. Compute the orbital Berry curvature using the L_z current operator and integrate it to obtain the intrinsic orbital Hall conductivity versus filling.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Anomalous Hall effect of a noncollinear 120° antiferromagnet on the kagome lattice
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Couple kagome electrons to a fixed coplanar inverse-triangular spin texture with SOC. Integrate the Berry curvature of the resulting bands to obtain σxy versus filling and the symmetry-allowed in-plane components.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Stochastic series expansion of the S=1/2 Heisenberg chain: energy and susceptibility
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Implement SSE with diagonal updates and directed loops for a periodic Heisenberg chain. Estimate the energy and uniform susceptibility versus T and compare with exact diagonalization of the same chain.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Quantum Monte Carlo for lattice models

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Checkerboard world-line QMC for the XY chain versus free fermions
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Trotterize the XY chain with a checkerboard decomposition and sample world lines with local plaquette moves. Measure energy versus Trotter step and β, and compare with the exact Jordan-Wigner result.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Quantum Monte Carlo for lattice models

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: SSE simulation of the transverse-field Ising chain magnetization
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Use SSE with constant and bond operators and cluster updates for the TFIM chain. Measure ⟨σx⟩ and the Binder ratio versus field at low T and compare with the free-fermion results.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Quantum Monte Carlo for lattice models

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Continuous-time path integral of a single spin in a transverse field
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Sample kink configurations in imaginary time of a spin-1/2 in a transverse field using the Poisson-process representation. Measure ⟨σz σz(τ)⟩ and the kink-number distribution, and compare them with the exact two-level results.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Quantum Monte Carlo for lattice models

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Typical density of states as an Anderson-transition order parameter in 3D
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute local DOS on many sites of the 3D Anderson model with KPM. Form the geometric-mean typical DOS and its ratio to the average DOS versus disorder to locate W_c≈16.5.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: KPM phonon density of states of an isotope-disordered harmonic lattice
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Expand the spectrum of the mass-weighted dynamical matrix of a square or cubic lattice with random masses in Chebyshev polynomials. Convert to the frequency DOS and compare it with the virtual-crystal Debye form.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Bianco-Resta local Chern marker from a Chebyshev-expanded ground-state projector
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Approximate the Fermi projector of a finite QWZ flake by a Chebyshev expansion of the step function. Evaluate the local Chern marker C(r) in the bulk and at the edges, and show it remains quantized with weak disorder.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Harper-equation Landau levels versus Onsager quantization with Wilkinson-Rammal corrections
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute Hofstadter eigenvalues at small flux and compare them with semiclassical levels from Onsager quantization of square-lattice orbits. Include the first-order correction to identify the Maslov phase.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Quantum oscillations in a hybridization-gap insulator (Knolle-Cooper model)
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the Landau-level spectrum and the grand potential of an inverted electron-hole model with a hybridization gap. Show that dHvA oscillations survive at the unhybridized frequency with an anomalous temperature dependence.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Oscillatory electronic specific heat in the Lifshitz-Kosevich regime
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Differentiate the LK oscillatory free energy twice in temperature to obtain the magneto-thermal oscillations. Locate the sign change and peak positions in X=2π²k_BT/ħω_c and verify the result against direct summation over Landau levels.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Shoenberg magnetic interaction: harmonic generation from B-versus-H self-consistency
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve B=H+4π(1−N)M(B) self-consistently with the LK magnetization. Compute the Fourier harmonic content of M versus 1/H and the onset of diamagnetic domain instability where 4π dM/dB exceeds 1.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Aharonov-Bohm subband oscillations in topological-insulator nanowire conductance
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Quantize the TI surface Dirac cone on a cylinder with flux Φ, including the π Berry phase. Compute Landauer conductance versus Fermi energy and flux, showing the h/e period and the topological mode at Φ=Φ0/2.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Magneto-intersubband oscillations in a two-subband 2DEG
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the SCBA-free Lorentzian Landau-level DOS of two subbands and evaluate the magnetoresistance in a Born-like model. Extract the MISO frequency set by the subband splitting and show it survives thermal smearing.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Fermi-surface reconstruction by charge order: small pocket frequency versus wavevector
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Fold a cuprate t-t' band with a biaxial charge-density-wave potential at wavevectors Q. Find the reconstructed electron pocket by contour extraction, then compute its area, dHvA frequency and cyclotron mass versus Q and gap.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Torus orbits of a Dirac nodal-line semimetal: extremal areas and oscillation phase
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: For a nodal-ring dispersion, compute extremal Fermi-surface cross sections versus field angle, including the torus-hole orbit. Determine the Berry phase of each orbit from whether it links the nodal line.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Stoner-Wohlfarth hysteresis loops and the switching astroid
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Minimize the uniaxial-plus-Zeeman energy of a single-domain particle by tracking metastable minima as the field is swept. Compute loops versus field angle, coercive and switching fields, and the random-orientation powder loop.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Macrospin LLG switching time versus damping and applied field
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Integrate the Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert equation for a uniaxial macrospin under a reversed field. Measure the reversal time versus α and h, and compare it with the analytic precessional and damping-limited estimates.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Slonczewski spin-transfer-torque critical switching current of a nanopillar
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Integrate the LLGS equation for an in-plane macrospin with easy-plane demagnetization and spin-polarized current. Determine the critical current numerically and compare it with I_c∝α(H_k+2πM_s)/η.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Spin-torque oscillator steady precession frequency versus current
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Find the limit cycles of the LLGS macrospin under supercritical current and applied field. Compute the oscillation frequency and orbit amplitude versus current and show the redshift of the in-plane precession mode.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Demagnetizing factors of general ellipsoids from Osborn integrals
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the ellipsoid demagnetizing tensor by numerical quadrature and by Carlson elliptic integrals, then verify that the trace equals 1. Compute the shape-anisotropy energy and the Kittel FMR frequencies for spheroids.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Cubic magnetocrystalline anisotropy: easy axes and torque curves from K1, K2
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Minimize the cubic anisotropy energy on the sphere to determine easy axes in the K1-K2 plane. Compute the (001) and (110) torque curves and the anisotropy fields along the principal directions.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Standing spin-wave resonances in a thin ferromagnetic film with surface pinning
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve the exchange-dipole boundary problem with Rado-Weertman pinning conditions by root finding. Obtain perpendicular standing spin-wave mode fields and intensities, and fit the exchange stiffness from the mode spacing.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Meiklejohn-Bean exchange-bias loop shift and coercivity
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Minimize the coherent-rotation energy of a ferromagnet coupled to an antiferromagnet with its own anisotropy. Compute hysteresis loops, the exchange-bias field and coercivity versus AFM thickness, and find the critical thickness.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Stochastic LLG thermal equilibrium of a macrospin versus the Langevin function
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Integrate the stochastic LLG equation with Brown's thermal field using a Heun scheme. Check that ⟨m_z⟩ reproduces the Langevin function, with anisotropy corrections, and that the fluctuation-dissipation relation holds.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Spin-orbit-torque switching of a perpendicular magnet with damping-like torque
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Integrate the macrospin LLG equation with damping-like and field-like SOT terms and an in-plane assist field. Map the switching phase diagram in current versus field and compare the critical current with the Lee et al. analytic expression.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Gyrotropic vortex-core frequency in a soft magnetic disk
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Combine the Thiele equation with the two-vortex side-charge-free magnetostatic stiffness, computed by integrals over the disk. Obtain the gyrotropic frequency versus aspect ratio L/R and compare it with ω≈(20/9)γM_sL/R.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Breathing of a Bloch-oscillating Gaussian wave packet on a tight-binding chain
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: For a 1D nearest-neighbor chain in a DC field, compute the time-dependent center and width of an initially broad Gaussian packet with nonzero mean momentum. Use the closed-form Bessel/propagator solution and quadrature over the momentum distribution, then compare the width oscillation amplitude with the semiclassical spread of band velocities.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Interaction-induced dephasing of Bloch oscillations in the discrete nonlinear Schrödinger lattice
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Integrate the tilted DNLS (Gross-Pitaevskii lattice) equations for a Gaussian condensate. Measure how the decay time of the center-of-mass oscillation and the momentum-distribution broadening depend on nonlinearity, and compare with the linear Wannier-Stark revival.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Transverse Berry-curvature drift of Bloch-oscillating packets in the Harper-Hofstadter lattice
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: At rational flux, evaluate the magnetic-subband Berry curvature and integrate the semiclassical equations including anomalous velocity under a weak force. This gives the transverse displacement per Bloch period, which is checked against the subband Chern number and full quantum evolution (Price-Cooper scheme).

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Potential-step scattering on a tight-binding chain: lattice versus continuum transmission
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Derive the transmission coefficient T(k) for a 1D chain with an on-site step V0 from Bloch-wave matching and compare it with the continuum Schrödinger result. Average T over a Gaussian wave packet's momentum distribution by quadrature and verify by time-evolving the packet.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Spin precession during Bloch oscillations in a Rashba spin-orbit-coupled chain
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: For a 1D chain with spin-dependent hopping t exp(iασ_y) in a static field, compute the spin expectation values along the semiclassical k(t) orbit and from exact evolution. Report the precession angle per Bloch period and the field values at which the spin returns to its initial orientation.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Frequency-doubled Bloch oscillations of repulsively bound pairs in the Bose-Hubbard chain
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve the two-boson problem in a tilted Bose-Hubbard chain exactly in the center-of-mass and relative basis. Show that for U much larger than J the doublon center oscillates with half the single-particle period, and extract the effective pair hopping 2J²/U from the bound-state band.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Belavin-Polyakov skyrmion on a square lattice: discrete exchange corrections and collapse
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the lattice Heisenberg exchange energy of the Belavin-Polyakov profile as a function of radius R by direct summation. Fit the deviation from 4πJ|Q| to a 1/R² lattice correction and determine the radius below which the discrete skyrmion number changes.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Skyrmion-skyrmion repulsion from the asymptotic modified-Bessel tail
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Linearize the chiral-magnet Euler-Lagrange equation around the uniform state to get K1 Bessel tails of the in-plane components. Compute the far-field pair interaction energy versus separation by overlap integrals and compare it with direct energies of superposed two-skyrmion configurations.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Thiele stability of cylindrical magnetic bubble domains in thin films
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Use Thiele's closed-form magnetostatic force function for a cylindrical domain in a perpendicular film, built from elliptic integrals, together with the wall energy. Compute the equilibrium bubble radius versus bias field and the collapse and strip-out fields.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Helix wavevector selection in the frustrated J1-J3 triangular-lattice Heisenberg magnet
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Minimize the Fourier-transformed exchange J(q) of the J1-J2-J3 triangular lattice to obtain the spiral ordering wavevector as a function of couplings. Locate the ferromagnet-to-spiral Lifshitz point that sets the size of frustration-stabilized skyrmions.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Helicity selection: interfacial, bulk and D2d DMI favor Néel, Bloch or antiskyrmions
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: For a 360° wall profile ansatz with general helicity and vorticity, compute the DMI energy integrals for each DMI symmetry class. Minimize over helicity and radius to show which texture is stabilized and how large the energy gain is.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Skyrmion in a confined nanodisk: radial profile with DMI edge-twist boundary
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve the radial Euler-Lagrange BVP for θ(r) in a disk with exchange, interfacial DMI and anisotropy, imposing the DMI-modified Neumann boundary condition, by shooting or collocation. Report the skyrmion radius and edge tilt angle versus disk radius.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Emergent monopole charge of 3D hedgehog spin textures via lattice solid angles
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: On a cubic lattice, compute the emergent magnetic flux through each cube face by triangulated Berg-Lüscher solid angles. Sum the flux to locate integer monopole and antimonopole charges in hedgehog-antihedgehog textures and in a 3Q hedgehog lattice.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Hopf invariant of a discretized hopfion texture by FFT Biot-Savart
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Build a hopfion texture n(r) on a periodic grid, then compute the emergent field and its vector potential in Fourier space. Integrate A·B to obtain the Hopf invariant and study convergence with grid resolution for Hopf charge 1 and 2.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Chiral soliton lattice period versus transverse field via elliptic integrals
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: For the monoaxial chiral helimagnet sine-Gordon model (CrNb3S6-like), solve for the elliptic modulus that minimizes the free energy at fixed field. Compute the soliton-lattice period and magnetization, including the divergence at the critical field H_c = (π²/16) D²/J.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Padé analytic continuation of Matsubara Green's functions of the Hubbard atom and dimer
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Generate exact Matsubara Green's functions with added Gaussian noise, continue them to real frequency with Thiele continued-fraction Padé, and assess peak positions and weights versus noise level and the number of frequencies used.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Quantum Monte Carlo for lattice models

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Binning and jackknife error analysis of world-line QMC for a Heisenberg dimer
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Run a Metropolis world-line simulation of an S=1/2 dimer and record energy and susceptibility time series. Compute integrated autocorrelation times by binning and jackknife errors for derived quantities, and verify that the error bars are consistent with the exact thermal values.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Quantum Monte Carlo for lattice models

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Variational Monte Carlo of a Jastrow-Néel state for the 4×4 Heisenberg antiferromagnet
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Sample a long-range Jastrow-dressed Néel wavefunction in the Sz=0 sector with Metropolis moves. Optimize the Jastrow parameters for the variational energy and staggered structure factor, and compare with the exact 4×4 ground-state energy.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Quantum Monte Carlo for lattice models

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: DQMC antiferromagnetic structure factor of the half-filled 4×4 Hubbard model
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Implement finite-temperature determinant QMC with numerically stabilized UDV products for the half-filled 4×4 Hubbard model. Measure S(π,π) versus temperature and U, and confirm the absence of a sign problem from particle-hole symmetry.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Quantum Monte Carlo for lattice models

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Spin Bott index of the disordered Kane-Mele model
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: On a finite periodic Kane-Mele flake with Anderson disorder, project the ground-state projector onto spin sectors via P S_z P. Compute the Bott index of each sector from log-determinants of projected position exponentials and map how the quantized spin Chern number collapses with disorder.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Surface Dirac cone counting in strong versus weak Wilson-Dirac TI slabs
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Diagonalize (001) slabs of a cubic 4-band Wilson-Dirac model at the surface time-reversal momenta. Count surface Kramers pairs in the bulk gap and relate the parity of the count to the strong and weak Z2 indices across the mass phases.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Quantum anomalous Hall transition in exchange-split magnetically doped BHZ wells
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Add spin-dependent exchange terms to the lattice BHZ model (Liu-Qi model). Compute the Chern number of the occupied bands by Fukui link variables versus exchange strength and identify the critical exchange at which one spin block un-inverts.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Half-quantized surface Hall conductance of a magnetized topological-insulator slab
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: In a 3D Wilson-Dirac slab with surface Zeeman exchange, compute the layer-resolved Chern marker from the projected Berry curvature. Show that each magnetized surface contributes ±e²/2h and that the total depends on the relative surface magnetizations (QAH versus axion insulator).

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Helical edge conductance through a magnetic barrier: Landauer gap tunneling
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Model a QSH edge as a 1D Dirac channel with a finite-length Zeeman barrier that opens a mass gap. Compute the transmission by transfer matrices and the conductance versus barrier length and temperature by Fermi-function quadrature.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Thickness-oscillating hybridization gap of Bi2Se3 thin-film surface states
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Discretize the four-band Zhang k·p model along z for a film of thickness d. Compute the surface-state hybridization gap and its sign oscillations versus d, then classify the resulting 2D layers as trivial or quantum spin Hall from the sign of the effective mass inversion.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Electron-hole puddles: residual density and graphene minimum conductivity from Gaussian disorder
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Average the Dirac carrier density over a Gaussian distribution of local potential, using closed-form Gaussian integrals of |μ-V|². Obtain the residual density n* and an effective-medium estimate of minimum conductivity versus impurity density.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Graphene electronic heat capacity: intrinsic T² law and crossover to Sommerfeld
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the electronic specific heat of a linear-DOS Dirac band at fixed carrier density, solving for μ(T) at each T, by Fermi-function quadrature. Extract the zeta-function T² coefficient at neutrality and the crossover temperature to the linear-in-T doped regime.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Kekulé-O versus Kekulé-Y bond textures in graphene: gap and valley locking
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: In the √3×√3 supercell tight-binding model with modulated hoppings, show that Kekulé-O folds K and K' to Γ and opens a gap proportional to the bond modulation. Show that Kekulé-Y keeps a gapless spectrum with two Dirac cones of different velocities, computing both dispersions.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Zero modes of triangular zigzag graphene flakes and Lieb's sublattice imbalance
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Build triangular and hexagonal nanoflakes with zigzag and armchair edges and diagonalize their tight-binding Hamiltonians. Count the zero-energy states versus size, relate the count to N_A-N_B, and compute the Lieb total spin of the half-filled Hubbard ground state.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Infinite-mass Dirac quantum dot in graphene: Bessel-function confinement spectrum
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve the Berry-Mondragon boundary condition J_m(kR) = ±J_{m+1}(kR) by root bracketing to get the angular-momentum-resolved levels of a circular graphene dot. Compare with a sublattice-mass-confined lattice dot and fit the 1/R scaling of the level spacing.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Smooth graphene p-n junction: Cheianov-Fal'ko angular transmission and conductance
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the WKB transmission exp(-π k_F d sin²θ) across a linear potential step. Integrate over transverse modes to get the junction conductance per width versus density and junction width, and compare with numerical transfer-matrix transmission of the Dirac equation.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Logarithmic Fermi velocity renormalization in graphene and the cyclotron mass
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Use the one-loop Coulomb renormalization v(k) = v0[1 + (α/4) ln(Λ/k)] to compute the cyclotron mass m* = ħk_F/v(k_F) versus carrier density. Fit Elias-type data to extract the effective coupling α.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: ABC rhombohedral multilayer graphene: chiral k^N bands and diverging DOS
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Diagonalize the N-layer ABC tight-binding k·p Hamiltonian to obtain the low-energy band E ∝ k^N. Compute the DOS divergence ∝ E^{2/N-1} by quadrature and determine the energy where the effective two-band model breaks down.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Graphene RKKY interaction: sublattice-dependent sign and 1/r³ decay
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the static spin susceptibility between two sites of undoped graphene from the lattice Green's function via Brillouin-zone quadrature. Show ferromagnetic same-sublattice and antiferromagnetic opposite-sublattice coupling with 1/r³ decay, and identify the K-K' oscillation factor.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Phonon mean-free-path accumulation function of κ in a Callaway-Debye solid
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the spectral Callaway conductivity with Umklapp, isotope and boundary rates. Convert it to a cumulative κ(Λ) over mean free path by sorting and quadrature, and report the median MFP versus temperature.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Fuchs-Sondheimer suppression of in-plane phonon conductivity in thin films
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Combine bulk spectral MFPs from a Debye-Callaway model with the Fuchs-Sondheimer reduction function, which requires a nested angular quadrature with a specularity parameter. Compute in-plane κ versus film thickness and temperature.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Nanowire thermal conductivity with Ziman wavelength-dependent boundary specularity
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Use the Ziman specularity p(λ) = exp(-16π³η²/λ²) to set a frequency-dependent Casimir boundary rate in a Callaway integral. Compute κ(T) of Si nanowires versus diameter and roughness η, and locate where the T³ Casimir regime holds.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Cross-plane superlattice thermal conductance from coherent Rytov miniband velocities
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: From the Rytov longitudinal dispersion of a layered superlattice, compute the miniband group velocities and the Landauer-Boltzmann cross-plane conductance by integrating over frequency. Show its non-monotonic period dependence compared with the incoherent interface-resistance model.
