physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Magnon thermal conductivity of an insulating ferromagnet with boundary scattering
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Use a quadratic magnon dispersion with a Zeeman gap and a boundary-limited relaxation time to evaluate the Boltzmann magnon κ_m(T) through Bose-Einstein integrals. Show the T² law and its exponential field suppression.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Ballistic phonon thermal conductance quantum of a nanowire with discrete modes
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Sum Landauer phonon transmissions over the dilatational, torsional and flexural branches of an elastic wire using Bose-function quadrature. Show that the low-T conductance approaches 4 × π²k_B²T/3h and track the crossover as higher subbands populate.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Electronic thermal conductivity of metals: Wilson formula and Wiedemann-Franz violation
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Bloch-Wilson electron-phonon thermal resistivity, including the vertical-scattering term, with transport integrals J_n(θ/T). Combine it with impurity scattering to compute L(T)/L0 and its dip at intermediate temperature.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Chemical potential of a cubic tight-binding band versus temperature and Sommerfeld expansion
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve the electron-count equation by root finding for a simple-cubic band DOS obtained from the Bessel-integral representation. Compare μ(T) with the Sommerfeld correction -(π²/6) T² g'/g and show where it fails near the M1 kinks.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Simple-cubic half-filling nesting: χ0(π,π,π) divergence and mean-field Néel T_N(U)
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the static bare susceptibility at the perfect-nesting vector of the half-filled simple-cubic band by Brillouin-zone quadrature with the DOS reduction. Extract its logarithmic T dependence and solve the Stoner condition Uχ0 = 1 for T_N versus U.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: d-wave altermagnet spin-split Fermi surfaces and the spin-splitter conductivity
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: For a two-sublattice tight-binding model with spin-dependent d-wave hopping, extract the spin-resolved Fermi contours at fixed filling. Compute the spin-polarized Boltzmann conductivity tensor and the 45° spin-splitter angle versus altermagnetic strength.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Hofstadter butterfly of the honeycomb lattice at rational flux
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Build the Peierls-substituted honeycomb magnetic unit cell at flux p/q and diagonalize it over the magnetic BZ to generate the butterfly. Verify the relativistic √n Landau levels at low flux and the subband Chern numbers from the Diophantine equation.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Total bandwidth of the Harper spectrum and Thouless's 9.33/q scaling
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: For flux p/q at continued-fraction approximants of the golden mean, compute the band edges of the Harper equation from Chambers' relation using the k=0 and k=π/q determinants. Sum the bandwidths and fit q × measure → 9.33.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Weiss commensurability oscillations: Landau-band widths in a 1D periodic modulation
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the first-order Landau-level broadening of a 2DEG in a weak cosine potential using Laguerre-polynomial matrix elements. Evaluate the band-conductivity correction with Fermi-function quadrature to obtain magnetoresistance minima at 2R_c/a = n - 1/4.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Landau diamagnetism from Landau-level sums via Euler-Maclaurin and zeta regularization
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the grand potential of a 3D free electron gas from the exact Landau-level sum and the Euler-Maclaurin/Poisson expansion. Extract χ_L = -χ_P/3 and its ratio to Pauli paramagnetism for a band mass m*.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Landau-level collapse in graphene under an in-plane electric field
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Use the Lorentz-boost solution of the Dirac equation in crossed E and B fields to compute E_n ∝ (1-β²)^{3/4} √n, where β = E/(v_F B). Verify by diagonalizing a Peierls honeycomb ribbon with a linear potential.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Metal-dielectric multilayer bands with Drude permittivity
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Use the transfer-matrix Bloch condition for a periodic stack of Drude-metal and dielectric layers, with a frequency-dependent complex ε. Compute the band structure and Bloch damping, identify the plasma-like gap edge, and compare with effective-medium hyperbolic-dispersion limits.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Photonic and phononic crystal band structures

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Flexural Bloch waves of a periodically supported Euler-Bernoulli beam
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Build the 4×4 transfer matrix of a beam span with point supports or attached masses and solve its Bloch eigenvalue problem. Compute the flexural pass and stop bands, including Bragg gaps and the resonant gaps of attached oscillators.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Photonic and phononic crystal band structures

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Acoustic duct with periodic Helmholtz resonators: Bragg versus resonance gaps
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Model each unit as a duct segment plus a side-branch resonator impedance and compute the Bloch dispersion from the transfer-matrix trace. Determine how the Bragg and Helmholtz gaps merge as the resonator frequency approaches the Bragg frequency.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Photonic and phononic crystal band structures

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Photonic graphene: TM Dirac cone of a honeycomb rod lattice via plane waves
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve the TM plane-wave eigenproblem for dielectric rods on a honeycomb lattice with the analytic circular form factor. Locate the Dirac point at K, extract the cone group velocity, and show gap opening when the two rod radii differ.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Photonic and phononic crystal band structures

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Magnonic crystal of alternating exchange stiffness: spin-wave transfer-matrix gaps
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: For exchange spin waves in a 1D film with alternating stiffness and magnetization layers, match the magnetization and its exchange-weighted derivative at interfaces. Compute the Bloch bands and the first gap width versus contrast and bias field.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Photonic and phononic crystal band structures

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Single-level quantum-dot heat engine: power, efficiency and Curzon-Ahlborn comparison
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Use Landauer integrals with a Lorentzian dot transmission between hot and cold leads to compute charge and heat currents. Maximize power over level position and bias, and compare the efficiency at maximum power with η_C/2 and the Curzon-Ahlborn efficiency.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Boxcar transmission and Whitney's maximum efficiency at given output power
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Use a transmission function equal to 1 inside an energy window and 0 outside in the Landauer formalism. Optimize the window edges and bias to obtain the maximum power quantum A(πk_BΔT)²/h and the efficiency-versus-power trade-off curve.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Mahan-Sofo delta-function transport distribution and the best thermoelectric
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Model the transport distribution as a Lorentzian of width Γ, add lattice thermal conductivity, and compute ZT by Fermi-function quadrature. Show that ZT is maximized as Γ→0 and how the result depends on the ratio κ_L/σ0.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Quantum point contact thermopower peaks between conductance plateaus
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Use Büttiker saddle-point mode transmissions with Fermi-function quadrature to compute G and S versus gate energy. Confirm the Mott-formula peaks of height ≈ (k_B/e) ln2/(N+1/2) at plateau transitions.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Vacuum thermionic energy converter efficiency with radiative losses
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Combine Richardson currents from emitter and collector with work functions, a bias voltage and Stefan-Boltzmann radiative loss. Optimize the output voltage for power and efficiency and compare with the Carnot limit at several emitter temperatures.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Graphene Seebeck coefficient from Boltzmann theory with charged-impurity scattering
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Use the energy-dependent conductivity σ(ε) ∝ ε² of screened charged impurities in Dirac transport integrals. Compute S(n, T) exactly by quadrature, compare it with the Mott formula, and show the sign change and peak near neutrality.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: NIS tunnel-junction electronic refrigerator: cooling power and optimal bias
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Integrate the BCS DOS with Dynes broadening against Fermi functions to compute the charge current and the heat extracted from the normal metal. Find the optimal bias near Δ/e and the maximum cooling power versus T_N.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Superconducting tunnel junction quasiparticle I-V with Dynes-broadened BCS DOS
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the SIS tunnel current integral between two BCS superconductors at finite temperature. Reproduce the sum-gap onset and the thermal difference-gap feature, and extract Δ from dI/dV peaks.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Ambegaokar-Baratoff Josephson critical current versus temperature
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve the BCS gap equation for Δ(T) by quadrature and root finding. Compute I_c R_n = (πΔ/2e) tanh(Δ/2k_BT) and the asymmetric-gap generalization by Matsubara summation.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Hatano-Nelson chain: non-Hermitian skin effect, point-gap winding and directional drift
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the complex spectrum winding number of the asymmetric-hopping chain under periodic boundaries and the exponential skin localization under open boundaries. Track the directional drift of a wave packet and compare with the imaginary-gauge transformation prediction.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Diffraction-free propagation at k=π/2 in waveguide arrays and third-order broadening
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Show that discrete diffraction vanishes at Bloch momentum π/2 in a coupled-waveguide array. Compute the residual broadening from third-order dispersion, which has an Airy-like profile, and compare with exact Bessel-function propagation.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Kitaev honeycomb model: Majorana bands, gapless phase region and ground-state energy
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve the Kitaev model in the zero-flux sector as free Majoranas and compute the ground-state energy by Brillouin-zone quadrature over (Jx, Jy, Jz). Map the gapless B-phase triangle, then add the three-spin term to compute the gap and Chern number ±1.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Conductance steps of graphene zigzag nanoribbons from Sancho-Rubio leads
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Obtain the lead self-energies of a zigzag ribbon by Sancho-Rubio decimation. Evaluate the Caroli transmission Tr[Γ_L G Γ_R G†] versus energy and verify integer plateaus matching the counted propagating subbands.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Aharonov-Bohm oscillations of a tight-binding ring between two leads
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Couple a Peierls-phase tight-binding ring to two semi-infinite chains whose self-energies are analytic. Compute the Landauer transmission versus flux and energy, and extract the h/e periodicity and the visibility of the oscillations.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: BTK differential conductance of normal-superconductor junctions with barrier strength Z
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Blonder-Tinkham-Klapwijk Andreev and normal reflection probabilities. Integrate them against the derivative of the Fermi function to obtain dI/dV curves versus Z and temperature, then fit the gap Δ.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Büttiker-probe dephasing: ballistic-to-Ohmic resistance crossover in a 1D chain
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Attach a voltage probe to every site of a tight-binding chain and compute the multi-terminal transmissions from Green's functions. Solve the zero-current probe conditions and show that the resistance grows linearly with length once dephasing is present.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Double-barrier tight-binding resonance: Breit-Wigner width versus barrier height
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the transmission of a chain containing two on-site barriers with exact lead self-energies. Fit each resonance to a Breit-Wigner Lorentzian and compare the fitted width with the WKB escape rate through one barrier.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Shot-noise Fano factor of diffusive wires from transmission eigenvalues
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Obtain the transmission matrix t of a disordered strip by recursive Green's functions and diagonalize t†t. Compute F = Σ T_n(1-T_n)/Σ T_n and check its approach to the Dorokhov value 1/3.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Slonczewski free-electron tunneling magnetoresistance versus Jullière's formula
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute spin-resolved transmission through a rectangular barrier between exchange-split free-electron ferromagnets, integrating over transverse momentum. Evaluate TMR versus barrier height and compare it with the Jullière polarization model.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Koster-Slater impurity bound state below the square-lattice band
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Use the elliptic-integral form of the square-lattice Green's function to solve 1 = V G_00(E) for a split-off bound state. Compute the threshold behavior of the binding energy and the local DOS on the impurity site.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Disordered quantum Hall strip: edge-channel conductance quantization from RGF
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Place a disordered Peierls-phase square-lattice strip between clean leads and compute the two-terminal conductance by recursive Green's functions. Show that the plateaus at integer multiples of e²/h survive disorder until the bulk gap closes.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Armchair carbon nanotube conductance reduction by a single vacancy
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Represent a (n,n) nanotube as a chain of rings and compute the lead self-energies by decimation. Evaluate the transmission with one site removed and locate the resonant backscattering dips inside the 2G0 plateau.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Coherent potential approximation DOS of a binary alloy on the Bethe lattice
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve the self-consistent CPA equation for the coherent self-energy of an A_xB_{1-x} alloy with the semicircular Bethe-lattice Green's function. Compute the DOS versus concentration and identify the split-band regime.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Zincblende GaAs EPM with antisymmetric form factors: direct Γ gap
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Add the antisymmetric pseudopotential components to the zincblende structure factor. Compute GaAs bands along L-Γ-X and the direct Γ gap, and show that the X-point degeneracy splits when the antisymmetric part is switched on.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Germanium EPM: L-valley conduction minimum and anisotropic effective masses
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute Ge EPM bands and confirm that the conduction minimum lies at L. Extract the longitudinal and transverse effective masses by finite-difference curvature along and perpendicular to Γ-L.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Hydrostatic deformation potential of Si gaps from strained EPM
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Rescale the lattice constant and interpolate the pseudopotential form factors with a smooth V(q). Recompute the Γ, X and L gaps and extract the hydrostatic deformation potentials dE/dlnV.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Silicon EPM density of states via Monkhorst-Pack sampling and Gaussian smearing
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Sample the irreducible Brillouin zone on Monkhorst-Pack grids and diagonalize the Si EPM Hamiltonian at each point. Build the smeared DOS and check that the valence bandwidth and the gap converge with grid density.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Triatomic linear chain: three phonon branches and gap structure
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Diagonalize the 3×3 dynamical matrix of a chain with three masses per cell. Compute the acoustic and two optical branches, both gaps at the zone center and zone edge, and the long-wavelength sound velocity.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Square lattice with central and angular forces: dispersion and Cauchy violation
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Build the 2×2 dynamical matrix of a square lattice with nearest- and next-nearest central springs plus an angular term. Compute the branches along Γ-X-M-Γ and extract C11, C12 and C44 from the slopes to test the Cauchy relation.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Rigid-ion diatomic cubic crystal: LO-TO splitting from the nonanalytic term
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Add the nonanalytic Born-charge term to a short-range rocksalt force-constant model. Compute the direction-dependent LO-TO splitting at Γ and verify the Lyddane-Sachs-Teller relation.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: 1D Coulomb ion chain: q√|ln q| acoustic phonon dispersion
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Sum the dynamical-matrix contributions of an unscreened Coulomb chain using Clausen functions or a converged lattice sum. Compute the long-wavelength logarithmic correction to the dispersion and compare it with the asymptotic form.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Localized vibration mode of a light substitutional impurity in a chain
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Use the phonon Green's function of the monatomic chain to find the split-off frequency above the band for a mass defect. Compute its spatial decay length and the impurity mean-square displacement.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Mean-square displacement in 1D, 2D and 3D harmonic lattices and Mermin-Wagner divergence
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Integrate coth(ħω/2kT)/ω over the Brillouin zones of nearest-neighbor harmonic lattices in one, two and three dimensions. Show the divergence of <u²> with system size in low dimensions and estimate the Lindemann ratio in 3D.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Inverting a measured chain dispersion into interplanar force constants
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Given ω(q) of a monatomic chain with long-range couplings, recover the force constants C_n by a cosine Fourier transform of Mω². Test the reconstruction against synthetic data with noise.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Hexagonal skyrmion-lattice period and phase boundary by circular-cell approximation
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Minimize the energy density of a skyrmion-lattice unit cell, approximated as a circle, over its radius and profile. Compare the result with the spiral and ferromagnetic states to obtain the transition fields.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Skyrmionium: zero net topological charge and energy versus radius
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Relax a 2π-rotation skyrmionium texture on a lattice. Verify that its total charge Q = 0 while the inner and outer ring charges are ±1, and compare its energy and size with a skyrmion at the same parameters.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Brundobler-Elser sum rule tested on a generic three-level Landau-Zener model
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Numerically propagate a three-level linear-sweep Hamiltonian with arbitrary couplings. Verify that the diagonal survival probability of the extremal-slope state equals exp(-2π Σ|V|²/|Δβ|).
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Landau-Zener and Zener tunneling between bands

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Parabolic level glancing: Suominen transition probability versus Landau-Zener
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Integrate a two-level system whose detuning varies quadratically in time, with levels that touch without crossing. Compare the numerical probabilities with the Suominen asymptotic formulas and with naive Landau-Zener estimates.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Landau-Zener and Zener tunneling between bands

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Landau-Zener transitions with Gaussian transverse noise: Pokrovsky-Sinitsyn averaging
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Propagate an ensemble of Landau-Zener trajectories with stochastic transverse-field noise. Compare the averaged final probabilities with the analytic fast-noise result.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Landau-Zener and Zener tunneling between bands

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Marginal Fermi liquid ARPES lineshapes and linear-in-ω MDC widths
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Construct A(k,ω) from the Varma marginal-Fermi-liquid self-energy. Fit Lorentzians to momentum distribution curves to recover a width that is linear in max(ω,T) and the logarithmic mass renormalization.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Fermi-edge fitting: separating temperature and instrumental resolution in ARPES
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Convolve a Fermi-Dirac edge with a Gaussian resolution function. Fit simulated noisy spectra for the chemical potential, temperature and resolution width, and quantify the correlation between temperature and resolution in the fit.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Self-energy extraction from MDC dispersion and Kramers-Kronig consistency
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: From MDC peak positions and widths of a model spectral function, extract Re Σ and Im Σ relative to a bare band. Check their consistency by a numerical Kramers-Kronig transform.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Graphene ARPES dark corridor from sublattice interference matrix elements
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Weight the graphene π-band spectral function by the photoemission interference factor |1 ± e^{iφ_k}|². Compute constant-energy maps around K showing the suppressed intensity on one side of the Dirac cone.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Tomonaga-Luttinger liquid spectral function: power-law suppression at E_F
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the momentum-integrated spinful Luttinger-liquid spectral function from its real-time correlator. Extract the anomalous exponent α as a function of the Luttinger parameter K, including finite-temperature scaling.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: d-wave superconductor ARPES: Bogoliubov back-bending and gap anisotropy
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Construct the BCS spectral function with Dynes broadening for a cuprate tight-binding band. Extract the back-bending momentum and gap magnitude along the Fermi surface and fit the result to |cos kx - cos ky|.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Plasmaron satellites from a plasmon-pole GW self-energy
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the GW self-energy of the electron gas in a single plasmon-pole approximation. Construct A(k,ω) and locate the plasmaron satellite energies and weights relative to the quasiparticle peak.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Doniach-Šunjić asymmetric core-level lineshape in metals
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Doniach-Šunjić profile convolved with a Gaussian. Fit simulated XPS core-level spectra to extract the asymmetry α and lifetime width, and relate α to the s-wave phase shift through Anderson orthogonality.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Photon-energy kz mapping with the free-electron final state and inner potential
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Convert emission angle and photon energy to k∥ and kz using the inner potential and work function. Simulate a photon-energy scan of a 3D tight-binding band and recover the periodicity in kz.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Final-state lifetime kz broadening of 3D band dispersions in ARPES
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Integrate a 3D band's spectral function over a Lorentzian distribution in kz set by the photoelectron mean free path. Show how the band-edge features and apparent dispersions distort as the inelastic length decreases.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Momentum distribution jump and quasiparticle weight from a Fermi-liquid spectral function
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Integrate A(k,ω) f(ω) over frequency for a Fermi-liquid self-energy αω² + βT². Compute n(k), the jump Z at k_F and its thermal smearing, and verify the frequency sum rule.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Negative thermal expansion from transverse membrane modes in a 2D lattice
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the mode Grüneisen parameters of the flexural (out-of-plane) and in-plane branches under tension for a triangular spring network. Integrate them with heat-capacity weights to find the temperature range of negative expansion.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Pressure-temperature phase boundary of two polymorphs from QHA Debye free energies
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Model each phase with a static EOS plus a Debye free energy that has a volume-dependent θ_D. Equate the Gibbs energies to trace the phase boundary and check its slope against Clausius-Clapeyron.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Mie-Grüneisen-Debye thermal pressure and high-temperature isotherms
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Combine a Vinet cold curve with the Debye thermal energy and a volume-dependent γ(V). Compute P(V,T) isotherms, thermal pressure and the thermal expansion at high pressure.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: f-sum rule check of the RPA dynamic structure factor of the electron gas
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute S(q,ω) from Im[-1/ε_RPA], including the plasmon delta-function weight. Verify the f-sum rule and the perfect-screening sum rule numerically as functions of q and r_s.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Hartree-Fock Fermi-velocity log divergence and its cure by Lindhard screened exchange
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the exchange self-energy of the 3D electron gas with the bare and the static-Lindhard screened Coulomb interaction. Compare the log singularity of the HF velocity at k_F with the finite screened-exchange result.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: STLS self-consistent local-field correction of the 3D electron gas
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Iterate the Singwi-Tosi-Land-Sjölander equations that couple the static structure factor S(q) and the local-field factor G(q) through Lindhard-based response. Compute the correlation energy and the pair-correlation function g(0) versus r_s.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Hybertsen-Louie plasmon-pole parameters from the static Lindhard dielectric function
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Fit a generalized plasmon-pole model to ε^{-1}(q,0) and the f-sum rule. Compare the pole energy ω̃(q) with the exact RPA loss-function peak across q.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Cutler-Mott thermopower near a mobility edge
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Use a conductivity function σ(E) ∝ (E - E_c)^s above the mobility edge. Evaluate the Fermi-weighted transport integrals for thermopower and conductivity versus temperature and Fermi level, including the universal limit at E_F = E_c.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Parabolic quantum well: equally spaced subbands and the generalized Kohn theorem
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve a parabolic graded-alloy well by finite differences and compare its levels with the harmonic-oscillator values. Show self-consistently that adding electrons does not shift the intersubband absorption frequency.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Strained InGaAs/GaAs quantum well: heavy-light hole splitting from Bir-Pikus
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the biaxial strain from lattice mismatch and shift the HH and LH band edges with deformation potentials. Solve the separate hole wells to obtain the strain-modified HH1-LH1 splitting versus indium content.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Variational quantum-well exciton binding energy versus well width
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Minimize a separable-envelope exciton trial energy over the in-plane Bohr radius by numerical quadrature of the Coulomb term. Show the crossover from the 3D Rydberg to the 4× 2D limit as the well narrows.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Depolarization shift of intersubband absorption in a doped quantum well
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the subband wavefunctions and the Coulomb overlap integral S. Evaluate the collective plasmon-shifted absorption frequency ω̃² = ω²(1+α) versus sheet density and compare it with the bare spacing.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Polarization-field GaN/AlGaN quantum well: built-in field and emission redshift
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the built-in field from the spontaneous and piezoelectric polarization discontinuities. Solve the tilted well for electrons and holes to obtain the redshifted transition energy and the electron-hole overlap versus width.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Fano lineshape of the Raman optical phonon in heavily doped silicon
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Fano interference profile of a discrete phonon coupled to an electronic continuum. Fit simulated spectra for the asymmetry parameter q, the linewidth and the frequency shift as functions of carrier density.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Ferrell-Glover-Tinkham missing spectral weight and London penetration depth
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Integrate the difference between normal-state and Mattis-Bardeen superconducting σ1(ω) to get the condensate weight. Convert it to a penetration depth and compare with Tinkham's πΔ tanh(Δ/2kT) formula versus temperature.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Anomalous X-ray scattering factor f' from f'' across a K-edge
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Model f''(E) near an absorption edge as a step plus white-line Lorentzian with power-law tails. Obtain f'(E) by subtracted Kramers-Kronig quadrature and locate the anomalous-dispersion minimum at the edge.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Franz-Keldysh electrorefraction Δn from electroabsorption via Kramers-Kronig
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the field-induced change in absorption Δα(ω) of a direct-gap semiconductor from Airy functions. Transform it by Kramers-Kronig into the refractive-index change Δn(ω) and find the extrema of Δn below and above the gap.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Singly subtractive Kramers-Kronig with an anchor point to cure truncation
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Reconstruct n(ω) from a band-limited absorption spectrum k(ω), first by standard Kramers-Kronig and then by singly subtractive Kramers-Kronig anchored at one known refractive index. Compare the error of both methods versus window width.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Optical sum rule of a dimerized chain: integrated σ1 equals kinetic energy
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute intraband (Drude) and interband Kubo optical weights of a half-filled or doped SSH chain at finite temperature. Verify that their total equals -⟨K⟩/L of the tight-binding kinetic energy, and track how weight moves between the two terms as dimerization varies.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Static refractive index from the zero-frequency Kramers-Kronig integral of interband ε2
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Build ε2(ω) of a parabolic direct-gap semiconductor (M0 edge plus a high-energy cutoff). Evaluate ε1(0) = 1 + (2/π)∫ε2/ω dω and test how the static index scales with the gap, in the spirit of Moss's rule.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Cole-Cole and Havriliak-Negami relaxation: Kramers-Kronig consistency and dielectric strength
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Generate ε'(ω) and ε''(ω) for Cole-Cole and Havriliak-Negami dielectric relaxations. Reconstruct each from the other by log-frequency Kramers-Kronig quadrature and recover Δε = (2/π)∫ε'' d ln ω.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Faraday rotation from magnetic circular dichroism of a Zeeman-split line
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Model σ± absorption of a Zeeman-split Gaussian or Lorentzian line to get the MCD spectrum. Compute the Faraday rotation spectrum by Kramers-Kronig transformation and compare it with the Becquerel derivative formula.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Full π-band graphene optical conductivity and the M-point van Hove peak
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the interband Kubo-Greenwood σ1(ω) of nearest-neighbor tight-binding graphene by Brillouin-zone integration with broadening. Recover the universal e²/4ħ plateau, the logarithmic peak at ħω = 2t, and the trigonal-warping deviations.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Optical conductivity of the α-T3 dice lattice versus α
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute interband Kubo absorption of the α-T3 lattice by BZ quadrature, separating flat-to-dispersive from dispersive-to-dispersive transitions. Show how the low-frequency conductivity and the absorption threshold depend on α and on doping.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Peierls CDW insulator optical absorption with Lee-Rice-Anderson coherence factors
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute σ1(ω) of a mean-field 1D Peierls insulator including case-I coherence factors. Show the inverse-square-root edge at 2Δ and the ω^-2 tail, and check that all spectral weight is transferred to the interband term.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Semi-Dirac anisotropic optical conductivity power laws
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: For the semi-Dirac dispersion (quadratic along x, linear along y), compute σxx(ω) and σyy(ω) from the interband Kubo formula by 2D quadrature. Verify the √ω and 1/√ω scaling laws and their prefactors.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Linear dichroism of monolayer phosphorene from an anisotropic two-band k·p model
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Use an anisotropic two-band continuum model of phosphorene to compute σxx and σyy interband absorption. Show that the absorption edge appears only for armchair polarization, and compute the dichroism ratio versus photon energy.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Small-polaron optical absorption band of the Holstein model
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Reik-Heese/Emin Gaussian polaron absorption σ(ω) centered at 2E_b, with temperature-dependent width from coth(ħω0/2kT). Check the band against the polaron f-sum weight and track the peak shift and width versus temperature.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Quantized circular photogalvanic injection rate of a tilted Weyl node
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the CPGE injection-current tensor of a k·p Weyl node with tilt and finite chemical potential by integrating Berry curvature over the optically resonant surface. Show that the trace is quantized at the monopole charge inside the Pauli-unblocked window.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Kubo-Greenwood with Lorentzian spectral functions versus Boltzmann conductivity
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the dc conductivity of a 2D square-lattice band from the Kubo-Greenwood spectral-function formula with constant broadening Γ. Compare with the Boltzmann result σ = e²τ⟨v²⟩N(E_F) with τ = ħ/2Γ, and quantify their agreement as Γ → 0.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Interband absorption across the mean-field SDW gap of the half-filled Hubbard model
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve the Hartree-Fock Néel state of the square-lattice Hubbard model to get the gap. Compute the interband optical conductivity with SDW coherence factors, and track the absorption edge and the weight transferred from the Drude peak versus U.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Optical conductivity of the Hubbard dimer from the Lehmann representation
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Exactly diagonalize the two-site Hubbard model at half filling and compute the current matrix elements. Build σ1(ω) from the Lehmann representation, locate the charge-transfer peak at (√(U²+16t²) - U)/2 ... relative energies, and verify the optical sum rule against the kinetic energy.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Optical conductivity of the Fibonacci quasiperiodic chain and its gap structure
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Diagonalize finite Fibonacci tight-binding chains and compute the Kubo-Greenwood σ1(ω) with small broadening. Relate the absorption gaps to the hierarchical spectral gaps and check the optical sum rule.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Wurtzite versus zincblende Madelung constants as functions of u and c/a
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute Ewald Madelung constants of the wurtzite structure versus the internal parameter u and the c/a ratio. Compare with zincblende and find the ideal-geometry difference that underlies wurtzite/zincblende polytype energetics.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Site Madelung potentials in fluorite CaF2 and cubic perovskite SrTiO3
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Use Ewald summation to compute the electrostatic potential at each inequivalent ionic site of the fluorite and perovskite structures. Assemble the total Madelung energies and the cation-anion site-potential differences.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Dipolar ground states of classical magnetic dipoles on cubic lattices by Luttinger-Tisza
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Build the Ewald-summed dipolar interaction matrix in k-space for sc, bcc and fcc lattices. Minimize its lowest eigenvalue over the Brillouin zone to identify ferromagnetic or antiferromagnetic ground states, and report their dipolar energies.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Point-charge electric field gradient at nuclei in wurtzite from Ewald sums
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the Ewald-summed electric-field-gradient tensor V_zz at the cation site of wurtzite as a function of c/a and u. Show that it vanishes at the ideal cubic-like geometry, and convert it to a quadrupole coupling using a Sternheimer factor.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: PT-symmetric SSH chain with staggered gain and loss: edge-state energies
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Diagonalize open SSH chains with alternating ±iγ on-site potentials. Compute the bulk PT-breaking threshold γ_c = |t1 - t2| and the complex energies of the edge states in the topological phase, which break PT at any γ.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Non-Hermitian band theory and skin effect

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Generalized Brillouin zone of an extended Hatano-Nelson model from polynomial roots
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: For a single-band chain with nearest and next-nearest asymmetric hoppings, find the GBZ from the roots of the characteristic polynomial using the condition |β_M| = |β_{M+1}|. Compare the resulting continuum spectrum with large open-chain eigenvalues.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Non-Hermitian band theory and skin effect

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Higher-order exceptional points: ε^{1/N} eigenvalue splitting and Petermann factors
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Perturb an N×N Jordan-block Hamiltonian, representing an Nth-order EP in a unidirectional chain, by ε. Verify the ε^{1/N} splitting of eigenvalues and compute eigenvector condition numbers and Petermann factors near the EP.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Non-Hermitian band theory and skin effect

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Non-reciprocal chain as a directional amplifier: exponential end-to-end gain
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the Green's function G(ω) = (ω - H + iκ/2)^-1 of an open Hatano-Nelson-type driven-dissipative chain. Show that end-to-end gain grows exponentially with length exactly when ω lies inside the PBC point-gap winding region.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Non-Hermitian band theory and skin effect

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Lossy 2D Dirac cone: exceptional points and bulk Fermi arcs
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: For H = v(kxσx + kyσy) + iγσz (the Kozii-Fu type), compute the complex spectrum, the exceptional ring at |k| = γ/v, and the arc where Re E = 0. Evaluate the resulting spectral function A(k, ω=0) with real broadening.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Non-Hermitian band theory and skin effect

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Pseudospectra of the Hatano-Nelson Toeplitz matrix versus its winding region
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute ε-pseudospectra of large open Hatano-Nelson matrices from the minimum singular values of (z - H). Show that they fill the PBC ellipse as N grows even though the OBC eigenvalues lie on a line, and connect this to winding numbers.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Non-Hermitian band theory and skin effect

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Bloch-Zener oscillations in a binary lattice: interferometric band populations
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Integrate the Schrödinger equation of a tilted two-band binary tight-binding chain. Compute the final upper-band population after one Bloch period, and compare it with a two-crossing Landau-Zener-Stückelberg model including the dynamical phase.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Landau-Zener and Zener tunneling between bands

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Resonantly enhanced Zener tunneling between Wannier-Stark ladders
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: For a tilted binary chain, compute Wannier-Stark ladder spectra versus field and locate the anticrossings at F_n ≈ Δ/(n d). Show that interband decay of an initially lower-band state peaks at these resonant fields, with splittings from exact diagonalization.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Landau-Zener and Zener tunneling between bands

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Stückelberg interferometry through two Dirac points in a honeycomb lattice
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Drive a Bloch state of a gapped honeycomb lattice through two avoided Dirac crossings by a constant force. Compute the interband transition probability numerically and compare with the Lim-Fuchs-Montambaux two-crossing LZ formula with its Stückelberg phase.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Landau-Zener and Zener tunneling between bands

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Adiabatic-impulse approximation versus exact Landau-Zener probabilities
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Implement Damski's adiabatic-impulse model, in which the freeze-out time comes from the gap rate condition. Compare its excitation probability with the exact exp(-2πδ) result and with numerical integration across sweep rates.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Landau-Zener and Zener tunneling between bands

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Doublon production in a Hubbard dimer under a linearly ramped field
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Integrate the time-dependent two-site Hubbard model as the potential bias is swept through the U-resonances. Compute the doublon fraction and compare it with sequential Landau-Zener predictions using the many-body anticrossing gaps.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Landau-Zener and Zener tunneling between bands

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Demkov-Kunike tanh-crossing model: exact hypergeometric transition probability
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Integrate a two-level system with detuning Δ0 + Δ1 tanh(t/T) and sech coupling. Compare the result with the exact Demkov-Kunike formula and with Landau-Zener and Rosen-Zener limits.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Landau-Zener and Zener tunneling between bands

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Landau-Zener sweep of a qubit coupled to a quantized cavity mode
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Integrate a Jaynes-Cummings Hamiltonian with linearly swept qubit detuning in a truncated Fock space. Compute the final photon-number distribution, and compare the qubit flip probability with the exact Sinitsyn-type no-go prediction for zero initial photons.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Landau-Zener and Zener tunneling between bands

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Floquet Kitaev chain: Majorana π modes under periodic chemical-potential driving
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the BdG Floquet operator of a Kitaev chain with a periodically driven μ(t) by time-ordered products. Map the 0- and π-Majorana phase diagram versus drive amplitude and frequency, and verify the edge modes in open chains.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Floquet engineering of periodically driven lattices

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Linearly polarized light on graphene: Bessel-renormalized hoppings and Dirac-point merging
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the high-frequency effective hoppings t_j J0(A·δ_j) for linearly polarized light on graphene. Find the drive amplitude and polarization angle at which the two Dirac points merge, and check against exact quasienergies.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Floquet engineering of periodically driven lattices

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Laser-assisted tunneling: Floquet-engineered Hofstadter flux and Chern bands
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: For a tilted 2D lattice with a resonant running-wave modulation, derive effective Peierls phases and J1-Bessel amplitudes. Verify the effective flux and band Chern numbers against exact quasienergy bands from the time-ordered propagator.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Floquet engineering of periodically driven lattices

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Floquet-Volkov sidebands of a Dirac surface state in time-resolved photoemission
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute photoemission sideband intensities of a 2D Dirac cone in a mid-IR field from generalized Bessel functions. Include Floquet-Bloch dressing and its gap opening at ħω/2, and predict intensity versus polarization and in-plane momentum.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Floquet engineering of periodically driven lattices

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: High-frequency van Vleck expansion versus exact Floquet spectra of a driven chain
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute effective Hamiltonians of a shaken tight-binding chain to orders 1/ω and 1/ω². Compare their spectra with exact quasienergies from the stroboscopic propagator, and quantify the error scaling and the breakdown near resonances.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Floquet engineering of periodically driven lattices

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Kicked Harper model: quasienergy spectrum and localization versus kick strength
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Diagonalize the Floquet operator of the kicked Harper model on rational approximants. Compute the quasienergy butterfly versus effective flux and the inverse participation ratios that signal the localization transition.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Floquet engineering of periodically driven lattices

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Circularly polarized light turns a nodal-line semimetal into Floquet Weyl nodes
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Apply a high-frequency circular drive to a two-band nodal-ring model and derive the effective Hamiltonian. Locate the resulting Weyl nodes, compute their chiralities from Berry flux, and report their separation versus drive strength.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Floquet engineering of periodically driven lattices

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Multivalley silicon conductivity effective mass and Hall factor
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the conductivity tensor of six ellipsoidal Δ-valleys with energy-dependent τ from Boltzmann Fermi-window integrals. Extract the conductivity mass 3/(1/m_l + 2/m_t) and the combined mass-anisotropy and scattering Hall factor.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Two-carrier magnetoresistance and Hall coefficient of a compensated semimetal
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute ρxx(B) and ρxy(B) from two-band Drude-Boltzmann conductivity tensors. Show nonsaturating B² magnetoresistance at exact compensation, saturation away from it, and the field-dependent sign changes of R_H.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Ziman resistivity of liquid metals from Percus-Yevick structure and Ashcroft pseudopotential
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Combine the analytic hard-sphere Percus-Yevick S(q) with a Lindhard-screened Ashcroft empty-core form factor. Evaluate the Ziman integral up to 2k_F to obtain liquid Na and K resistivities and their sensitivity to packing fraction.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Acoustic-phonon resistivity of graphene and the Bloch-Grüneisen crossover
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Boltzmann resistivity of Dirac carriers scattered by deformation-potential acoustic phonons. Show the T⁴ to linear-T crossover near T_BG = 2ħk_F v_s/k_B and the density independence of the high-T slope.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Chiral-anomaly negative longitudinal magnetoresistance of a Weyl semimetal
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve the Son-Spivak Boltzmann model with intervalley relaxation τ_v to get σ_zz(B) = σ0 + C B². Compute the coefficient from the Fermi-surface Berry-curvature density, and study its dependence on chemical potential and temperature.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Anisotropic conductivity and Seebeck of a quasi-2D layered tight-binding band
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute in-plane and out-of-plane σ and S of an orthorhombic band with t_z ≪ t in the constant-τ approximation by BZ quadrature. Track the anisotropy ratio and the Seebeck sign changes with filling and temperature.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Friedel sum rule fixes the screening of a charged impurity in a metal
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute partial-wave phase shifts of a Yukawa-screened impurity potential from the variable-phase (Calogero) equation at k_F. Adjust the screening length so that the Friedel sum (2/π)Σ(2l+1)δ_l equals Z, and compare with Thomas-Fermi.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Static Lindhard susceptibility of a Rashba two-dimensional electron gas
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the static charge susceptibility of a Rashba-split 2DEG including chirality overlap factors by 2D quadrature. Locate the cusps at intra- and inter-branch nesting vectors, and analyze the resulting Friedel-oscillation beating.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Zeeman-split Lindhard functions: charge and longitudinal spin response
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute spin-resolved Lindhard functions of a partially polarized 3D or 2D electron gas. Combine them into charge and longitudinal spin susceptibilities with two Kohn anomalies at 2k_F↑ and 2k_F↓, and check their q → 0 Pauli and compressibility limits.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Logarithmic screening in a 3D Dirac semimetal and the running fine-structure constant
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the static interband plus intraband RPA polarization of a doped 3D Dirac cone with a momentum cutoff. Extract the log(Λ/q) charge renormalization, the Thomas-Fermi wavevector ∝ α μ, and the effective coupling versus scale.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Static polarizability of bilayer graphene and its chiral screening
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the two-band static polarization of chiral quadratic bilayer graphene (Hwang-Das Sarma) by numerical integration with chirality factors. Compare it with the 2DEG Lindhard function and extract the large-q behavior and 2k_F features.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Lindhard function of an anisotropic-mass electron gas and directional Kohn anomalies
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the static Lindhard function of an ellipsoidal Fermi surface by rescaling coordinates and by direct quadrature. Show that the Kohn anomaly position depends on direction, and compute the direction-dependent Thomas-Fermi screening of a point charge.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Gate-screened acoustic plasmons in 2D: linear dispersion and velocity versus gate distance
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve for plasmons of a 2DEG or graphene layer near a metallic gate using the screened Coulomb interaction (1 - e^{-2qd}). Extract the acoustic velocity versus d, and compare it with the Landau-damping boundary at v_F.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Zero sound of a neutral Fermi liquid from the Landau kinetic equation
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve (s/2) ln((s+1)/(s-1)) - 1 = 1/F0 for the zero-sound velocity ratio s = c0/v_F versus the Landau parameter F0. Compare it with first sound, and include F1 effective-mass corrections as in ³He.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Plasmons of a gapped 2D Dirac layer and the onset of interband damping
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the dynamic RPA polarizability of a massive 2D Dirac layer as found in TMDs or gapped graphene. Find the plasmon branch and the q-dependent particle-hole continuum edges, and determine where the plasmon enters interband damping.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Optical and acoustic plasmons of a photoexcited electron-hole plasma
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Find the RPA modes of a two-component 3D electron-hole plasma with unequal masses from the zeros of 1 - v_q(χ_e + χ_h). Obtain the optical plasmon and the heavy-component acoustic mode, and analyze the Landau damping of the acoustic mode versus mass ratio.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Fu-Kane parities of a cubic topological Kondo insulator mean-field model
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute parity eigenvalues of the d-f hybridized bands at the eight TRIM of a cubic SmB6-like lattice model. Determine the strong and weak Z2 indices versus f-level position and renormalized hybridization.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Spin Chern number of the BHZ model persisting under time-reversal-breaking Zeeman field
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Project S_z onto the occupied bands of the BHZ model with Zeeman coupling and compute the Chern numbers of the split spin sectors. Map the region where the spin Chern number survives despite broken time-reversal symmetry and Z2 being undefined.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Entanglement spectrum flow of a Kane-Mele cylinder as a Z2 diagnostic
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the single-particle entanglement spectrum from the ground-state correlation matrix restricted to half of a Kane-Mele cylinder at each k_y. Show helical spectral flow in the Z2-odd phase and its absence in the trivial staggered-potential phase.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Nonparabolic Kane conduction band: electron density versus Fermi level in InSb
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Use the two-band Kane dispersion E(1+E/Eg)=ħ²k²/2m* to build a nonparabolic DOS. Integrate it against Fermi-Dirac occupation by quadrature to get n(E_F,T), then compare with the parabolic Fermi-Dirac-integral result.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Roth formula: conduction-band g-factor and effective mass across III-V semiconductors
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the three-band Kane expressions for m0/m* and g* from Ep, Eg and Δ_so for GaAs, InP, InAs and InSb. Track both quantities versus band gap and with temperature through a Varshni Eg(T).

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Burstein-Moss shift in degenerate n-InN with Kane nonparabolicity
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the Fermi wavevector from density and the absorption-edge energy using nonparabolic conduction and parabolic valence bands. Subtract a closed-form band-gap renormalization to obtain the optical gap versus carrier density.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Tamm surface state of a semi-infinite tight-binding chain with modified end site
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Find the existence condition and energy of a localized end state when the terminal site energy is shifted. Use the surface Green's function in closed form, and compare the decay length with finite-chain diagonalization.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Debye-Waller B factor from the Debye model and thermal decay of Bragg intensities
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the mean-square displacement of a monatomic cubic crystal by integrating the Debye-model phonon DOS with coth factors. Apply exp(-2M) to powder-line intensities versus temperature and scattering vector.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Superlattice reflections from Glazer octahedral tilts in perovskites
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Generate oxygen positions for a^0a^0c^- and a^-a^-a^- tilt systems in a doubled cell. Compute structure factors to identify the half-integer R-point reflections and their intensity growth with tilt angle.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: hcp powder diffraction pattern: extinction rules, multiplicities and Lorentz-polarization factor
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Enumerate hkl reflections of hcp Mg, compute two-atom structure factors and the extinction condition for h+2k=3n with odd l. Combine multiplicities and the Lorentz-polarization factor to get relative powder intensities.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Laue interference fringes of a thin epitaxial film and thickness extraction
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the N-layer Laue interference function around a Bragg peak with layer-spacing strain. Locate the fringe minima to recover film thickness, and include instrumental Gaussian smoothing.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Spin-zero angles in de Haas-van Alphen harmonics of a quasi-2D metal
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Combine the Lifshitz-Kosevich spin factor cos(pπgm*/2m0) with the angle-dependent cyclotron mass m*/cosθ of a cylindrical Fermi surface. Find the angles where the fundamental or harmonic amplitudes vanish.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Maki-Stephen vortex-state damping of dHvA oscillations below H_c2
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Add the Maki-Stephen extra Dingle-like factor, which depends on Δ(H) from a mean-field field dependence, to a Lifshitz-Kosevich amplitude. Fit the apparent extra scattering rate below H_c2.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Holland model: longitudinal and transverse phonon contributions to silicon κ(T)
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate Holland's split-branch Callaway integrals with separate Umklapp forms, isotope scattering and boundary scattering for L and T phonons. Reproduce the κ(T) peak and the branch-resolved fractions.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Klemens 2D Umklapp-limited thermal conductivity of graphene and flake-size logarithm
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the 2D Klemens integral for in-plane acoustic branches with a boundary-limited low-frequency cutoff. Obtain κ as a function of flake size and temperature, including the ln(L) growth.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Lindemann melting curve from a Grüneisen-scaled Debye temperature
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Combine a Murnaghan V(P) equation of state, Grüneisen scaling θ_D(V) and the Lindemann criterion. Obtain T_m(P), compare it with the Simon-Glatzel form, and examine the initial slope dT_m/dP.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Anisotropic thermal expansion of a layered hexagonal crystal from directional Grüneisen parameters
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Combine in-plane and out-of-plane mode Grüneisen parameters with Einstein/Debye heat capacities and the hexagonal elastic compliance tensor. Obtain α_a(T) and α_c(T), including possible negative in-plane expansion.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Spontaneous quantum anomalous Hall state of a triangular Kondo lattice with tetrahedral order
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Build the four-sublattice tight-binding Hamiltonian for conduction electrons coupled to a tetrahedral spin texture. Compute band Chern numbers with link variables and the Hall conductance at 1/4 and 3/4 filling.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Born-von Kármán bcc phonons along Γ-H-P-Γ-N with two neighbor shells
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Build the bcc dynamical matrix from first- and second-neighbor force constants and diagonalize it along the high-symmetry path. Fit the force constants to elastic constants and identify the T1 branch softening along Γ-N.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Tarasov model heat capacity of layered crystals: T² to T³ crossover
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Combine 2D and 3D Debye integrals per Tarasov with in-plane and interlayer characteristic temperatures. Compute C(T) and locate the crossover temperature using graphite-like parameters.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Triangular central-force spring network: phonon dispersion and DOS van Hove points
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Diagonalize the 2×2 dynamical matrix of a nearest-neighbor triangular spring lattice. Histogram ω on a fine mesh to get the DOS, and identify saddle-point singularities at M and the maximum at K.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Voigt line profiles from the Faddeeva function and Gaussian-Lorentzian width separation
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate Voigt profiles with scipy's wofz and compare them with the Olivero FWHM approximation. Fit synthetic Raman/PL lines to separate homogeneous and inhomogeneous widths.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Knight shift and Korringa relation with Stoner-enhanced Pauli susceptibility
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the Knight shift from the Pauli susceptibility of a model DOS and evaluate 1/T1T. Show how the Korringa ratio deviates from unity under the Stoner enhancement 1/(1-IN(E_F)).

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Hebel-Slichter coherence peak in NMR 1/T1 of an s-wave superconductor
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Integrate the BCS coherence factor with the Dynes-broadened DOS and Fermi factors to get (1/T1)_s/(1/T1)_n versus T/Tc. Study the peak height as a function of broadening and compare with a d-wave T³ law.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Helicon wave dispersion in an alkali metal in a strong magnetic field
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Derive the helicon dispersion ω=c²k²ω_c/ω_p² from the Drude conductivity tensor in a field. Compute the resonance frequencies of a finite plate of sodium and the Hall-angle-limited damping.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Normal-fluid density of superfluid helium-4 from phonon and roton integrals
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Integrate the Landau momentum-flux integral over a phonon-roton dispersion with Bose occupations to obtain ρ_n(T)/ρ. Evaluate the phonon and roton contributions separately, along with the Landau critical velocity.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Bogoliubov quantum depletion and Lee-Huang-Yang energy of a weakly interacting BEC
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Integrate the Bogoliubov amplitudes to get the condensate depletion and the regularized ground-state energy correction. Verify the closed forms 8/(3√π)√(na³) and 128/(15√π)√(na³), then add thermal depletion.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Brillouin-function magnetization of paramagnetic salts versus the Langevin limit
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute M(B/T) for Gd3+, Fe3+ and Cr3+ salts from Brillouin functions with the appropriate J and g. Fit synthetic data to extract J and compare with the classical Langevin limit.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Weiss molecular-field magnetization M(T) and Curie-Weiss susceptibility for spin S
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve the self-consistent Brillouin equation for M(T) by root finding for several S values. Extract the critical exponent β=1/2 near Tc, the low-T spin-wave-free approach and the Curie-Weiss susceptibility above Tc.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: London penetration depth temperature dependence: s-wave versus d-wave
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Integrate quasiparticle Fermi-function derivatives over energy and Fermi-surface angle to get λ⁻²(T)/λ⁻²(0). Compare the exponential s-wave behavior with the linear-in-T d-wave law.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Weak-coupling BCS gap Δ(T), entropy and the 1.43 specific-heat jump
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve the BCS gap equation with a Debye cutoff by root finding. Compute the entropy and electronic specific heat by quadrature, and verify Δ(0)=1.764k_BTc and ΔC/γTc=1.43.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Abrikosov-Gor'kov Tc suppression by magnetic impurities via the digamma function
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve ln(Tc0/Tc)=ψ(1/2+α/2πTc)-ψ(1/2) for Tc as a function of pair-breaking rate. Find the critical concentration and the gapless-superconductivity regime.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Werthamer-Helfand-Hohenberg upper critical field with Maki and spin-orbit parameters
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve the WHH digamma equation for H_c2(T) with Pauli paramagnetic limiting α and spin-orbit scattering λ_so. Compare with the orbital limit 0.693 Tc|dH_c2/dT|.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Little-Parks Tc(Φ) oscillations of a thin superconducting cylinder
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Use de Gennes pair-breaking with fluxoid quantization to compute Tc versus flux through the cylinder. Include a wall-thickness correction that gives a parabolic background.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Josephson junction Fraunhofer pattern for nonuniform critical-current densities
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute Ic(Φ) as |∫J(x)e^{2πiΦx/Φ0L}dx| for uniform, edge-enhanced and Gaussian current profiles. Then reconstruct J(x) from a pattern by Dynes-Fulton inversion.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Beasley-Mooij-Orlando BKT transition of thin superconducting films
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Combine the dirty-limit superfluid stiffness from Ambegaokar-Baratoff/Tinkham with the universal Nelson-Kosterlitz jump. Obtain T_BKT/Tc0 versus sheet resistance.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Aslamazov-Larkin paraconductivity and the Lawrence-Doniach 2D-3D crossover
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate AL fluctuation conductivity in 2D, 3D and the layered Lawrence-Doniach form versus reduced temperature ε. Fit synthetic data to extract the coherence length ξ_c.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Fermi level of doped silicon versus temperature with donor freeze-out
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve charge neutrality including ionized donors, intrinsic carriers with a Varshni gap, and Fermi-Dirac integrals. Identify the freeze-out, extrinsic and intrinsic regimes from n(T) and E_F(T).

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: High-temperature series and Padé approximants for the square-lattice Heisenberg susceptibility
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Sum known high-temperature series coefficients of χ(T) and build Padé approximants. Locate the susceptibility maximum and compare with Curie-Weiss behavior and QMC reference values.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Quantum Monte Carlo for lattice models

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Mott criterion for hydrogenic donors across semiconductors
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute effective-mass donor binding energies and Bohr radii from m* and ε. Apply the Mott criterion n_c^{1/3}a_B≈0.26 and compare predicted critical densities for Si, Ge, GaAs and InSb.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Finite-barrier spherical quantum dot levels and the Brus gap
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Match spherical Bessel and modified Bessel solutions with BenDaniel-Duke conditions to get electron and hole ground levels versus radius. Add the Coulomb term to obtain the Brus optical gap.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Anomalous skin effect surface resistance of a metal: Reuter-Sondheimer limit
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the surface impedance for specular and diffuse reflection by quadrature of the nonlocal conductivity kernel. Track the crossover from the classical √ω skin effect to the mean-free-path-independent anomalous limit.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Anderson-Hasegawa double exchange: canting, bandwidth reduction and de Gennes state
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Use the hopping reduction t cos(θ/2) on a cubic band and minimize the band energy plus superexchange over canting angle versus hole density. Compute the de Gennes canted-to-ferromagnetic transition.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Landau-Devonshire theory of a first-order ferroelectric transition
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Minimize the P²-P⁴-P⁶ free energy to get P(T), the T0 and Tc thermal hysteresis and the dielectric susceptibility on both sides. Include a field-induced shift of Tc.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Hot-electron bolometer: electron-phonon T⁵ heat flow, electron temperature and NEP
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve the steady balance P=ΣV(T_e⁵-T_ph⁵) for the electron temperature and compute the thermal conductance G. Combine thermal-fluctuation and Johnson noise to get the noise-equivalent power and time constant.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Supercollision versus momentum-conserving hot-carrier cooling in graphene
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Bloch-Grüneisen-limited acoustic cooling power and the disorder-assisted Song-Levitov supercollision power P∝T_e³-T_l³. Find the crossover temperature versus mean free path.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Rayleigh surface acoustic wave velocity versus Poisson ratio
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve the Rayleigh secular equation for v_R/v_T in an isotropic solid by root finding. Compute the depth profiles of the longitudinal and transverse displacement components and compare with the Viktorov approximation.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Hydrodynamic nonlocal correction to the surface plasmon dispersion of a jellium metal
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Use the hydrodynamic Drude model with Thomas-Fermi pressure β to derive and solve the q-dependent surface plasmon condition of a semi-infinite metal. Extract the linear dispersion coefficient and compare it with the local ω_p/√2 result.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Anisotropic 2D plasmons of a phosphorene-like electron gas
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Find the plasmon frequency versus wavevector direction for a 2D gas with anisotropic masses, using the long-wavelength anisotropic Drude weight and Lindhard-type particle-hole boundaries. Quantify the armchair/zigzag frequency ratio.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Bulk and edge magnetoplasmons of a two-dimensional electron disk
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the classical-disk magnetoplasmon branches ω± = ±ωc/2 + sqrt(ω0² + ωc²/4), with ω0 set by the disk dipole plasmon from 2D electrostatics. Compute the edge-mode softening with field and the edge-mode decay rate.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Coulomb drag between two 2DEG layers: T² law from Lindhard functions
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Jauho-Smith drag integral over q and ω, using imaginary parts of the 2D Lindhard functions and the dynamically screened interlayer Coulomb interaction. Extract the low-T T² law and its d⁻⁴ dependence on layer separation.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Transverse RPA magnons and Stoner continuum of a ferromagnetic Hubbard metal
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the mean-field spin-split bands of a 3D tight-binding Hubbard ferromagnet and the transverse bare susceptibility χ+-(q,ω). Locate the RPA magnon pole, its stiffness, and where it enters the Stoner continuum.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Quantum percolation DOS on a site-diluted square lattice with KPM
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Obtain the KPM density of states of tight-binding square lattices with random vacancies at several dilutions. Identify molecular-state spikes at E=0, ±1, ±√2 and the zero-energy peak weight versus vacancy concentration.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Sierpinski gasket tight-binding spectrum: decimation map versus KPM
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Use the exact renormalization map E → E(5−E) to generate the hierarchical spectrum and degeneracies of the Sierpinski gasket. Validate the result with a KPM DOS of finite-generation gaskets.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Gauge-invariant Wannier spread and optical sum rule of a gapped honeycomb (hBN) band
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the quantum metric of the lower band of a staggered-mass honeycomb model on a k-mesh and integrate it to obtain Ω_I. Verify the Souza-Wilkens-Martin sum rule by integrating Kubo σ1(ω)/ω, and track Ω_I against the mass.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Quantum geometry and the quantum metric

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: McClure orbital diamagnetism of graphene with gap and temperature
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Fukuyama/McClure orbital susceptibility of massless and massive Dirac fermions versus chemical potential. Show the sech²(μ/2T) broadening of the Dirac delta and the gap plateau, and check the integrated weight sum rule.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Quantum-metric-dipole nonlinear Hall effect in a PT-symmetric antiferromagnet
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Build a PT-symmetric antiferromagnetic square-lattice Rashba model with vanishing Berry curvature. Compute the band-normalized quantum metric dipole by BZ quadrature and the intrinsic second-order Hall conductivity versus chemical potential.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Quantum geometry and the quantum metric

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: 1D Ising chain in a field: transfer-matrix magnetization and correlation length
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Diagonalize the 2×2 transfer matrix to obtain the free energy, magnetization, susceptibility and correlation length ξ(T,h). Verify the results by brute-force enumeration of small rings.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Phillips-Kleinman pseudopotential from orthogonalized plane waves in a 1D crystal
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Model a 1D crystal of deep wells with a tightly bound core level and build OPW basis functions. Construct the Phillips-Kleinman repulsive term and show that valence bands converge with far fewer plane waves than in the bare Coulomb-like basis.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Spectral rigidity: number variance and Δ3 statistic of GOE versus Poisson spectra
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Unfold eigenvalue spectra from random matrices and from weakly and strongly disordered 3D Anderson lattices. Compute Σ²(L) and Δ3(L) and compare with the logarithmic GOE and linear Poisson predictions.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Disorder, Anderson localization and transfer matrices

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Graphene G-band Kohn anomaly: nonadiabatic phonon shift versus Fermi level
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Lazzeri-Mauri phonon self-energy of the Γ-E2g mode, including the logarithmic singularity at 2|E_F| = ħω and thermal broadening. Compute the G-band frequency shift and linewidth versus gate-tuned E_F.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Matsubara Fourier transforms with high-frequency tail correction
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Transform G(iω_n) to G(τ) for a model Lorentzian spectral function, subtracting the analytic 1/(iω_n) and 1/(iω_n)² tails. Benchmark the error against the exact G(τ) and the density obtained from G(β⁻).

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Ozaki continued-fraction pole expansion versus Matsubara sums for the Fermi function
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Obtain the Ozaki poles and residues from a tridiagonal eigenproblem. Compare their convergence with plain Matsubara truncation for density and susceptibility sums of a tight-binding band.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Lifshitz van der Waals free energy between Drude metals as a bosonic Matsubara sum
