physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Lifshitz formula with a primed bosonic Matsubara sum and k-integral for Drude and plasma-model plates. Compute the pressure versus separation and the thermal n=0 contribution.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Field-induced magnon Bose-Einstein condensation in a dimer magnet
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Use a Hartree-Fock Bose-gas treatment of triplons with a 3D tight-binding dispersion to compute Tc(H) near the critical field and the phase-boundary power law. Also compute the condensate-induced transverse magnetization.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Van Vleck paramagnetism of Eu3+ and Sm3+ from multiplet susceptibilities
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Sum the Curie and Van Vleck contributions over thermally populated J multiplets with Landé factors and spin-orbit spacings. Compute χT versus temperature and the nonzero Eu3+ susceptibility at low T.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Crystal-field susceptibility anisotropy of a Ce3+ J=5/2 ion in tetragonal symmetry
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Diagonalize the Stevens-operator Hamiltonian with B20, B40 and B44 to obtain three Kramers doublets and their g-tensors. Compute χ∥(T), χ⊥(T) and the Schottky heat capacity.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: EPR resonance fields of an S=1 center with zero-field splitting D and E
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Diagonalize the S=1 spin Hamiltonian versus field along principal axes at fixed microwave frequency. Find the allowed and half-field resonance fields by root finding, and simulate an orientation-averaged powder spectrum.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Pake doublet: powder dipolar NMR lineshape of a spin pair
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Average the (3cos²θ−1) dipolar splitting over a powder, both analytically and by quadrature with Gaussian broadening. Recover the internuclear distance from the horn separation and the second moment.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: EXAFS χ(k) of fcc copper and Fourier-transform radial peaks
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Build single-scattering EXAFS for Cu shells with model backscattering amplitude and phase, Debye-Waller factors and mean free path. Fourier transform the k³-weighted χ(k) to locate shell peaks and their phase-shifted positions.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Compton profile of an electron gas with hydrogenic core electrons
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute J(p_z) for a free-electron Fermi sphere (inverted parabola) and for hydrogenic 1s/2s cores via momentum-density quadrature. Check the normalization sum rule and extract k_F from the valence edge.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Surface superconductivity Hc3/Hc2 ≈ 1.695 from the Weber equation
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve the linearized Ginzburg-Landau eigenproblem at a superconductor-vacuum boundary using parabolic cylinder functions. Minimize over the nucleation center to obtain the Saint-James-de Gennes ratio.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Kulik-Omelyanchuk current-phase relations of short ballistic and diffusive junctions
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Integrate the Andreev current over transmission eigenvalue distributions: a ballistic delta distribution and the diffusive Dorokhov density. Compute I(φ), the critical current, I_cR_N, and the skewness versus temperature.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Abrikosov parameter β_A of square and triangular vortex lattices
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Build lowest-Landau-level Abrikosov solutions using theta-function series and compute ⟨|ψ|⁴⟩/⟨|ψ|²⟩². Show β_A = 1.1596 (triangular) < 1.18 (square), and compute the magnetization slope near Hc2.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Cooper problem: bound-pair energy above a filled Fermi sea in 2D and 3D
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve the Cooper eigenvalue equation with a constant shell attraction for arbitrary coupling. Compare with the weak-coupling exponential, and contrast with two-body binding in vacuum for 2D and 3D.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Bean critical-state magnetization loops of a superconducting slab
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the piecewise field profiles and magnetization of a slab under cycled applied field with constant J_c. Include the Kim field dependence, and extract J_c from the hysteresis width and the full-penetration field.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Meservey-Tedrow spin-polarized tunneling into a Zeeman-split superconductor
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the tunneling conductance into a spin-split BCS DOS with Dynes broadening and a ferromagnet polarization P. Extract P from the four-peak asymmetry and examine the effect of temperature.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Bernard-Duraffourg optical gain spectrum of bulk GaAs
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the gain spectrum from the parabolic joint DOS and quasi-Fermi-level inversion factors with Lorentzian broadening. Find the transparency density, peak gain versus carrier density and the gain bandwidth.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Ioffe-Regel resistivity saturation in the parallel-resistor model
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Combine Bloch-Grüneisen-like ideal resistivity with a shunt saturation resistivity at the Ioffe-Regel limit. Fit high-T curvature in A15-type metals and estimate the mean free path at saturation.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Gurzhi hydrodynamic electron flow: Poiseuille profile and channel resistance
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve the Stokes-Ohm equation for viscous electron flow in a channel with no-slip or partial-slip boundaries. Compute the resistance versus width and temperature, showing the Gurzhi minimum.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Spin Hall magnetoresistance of a heavy-metal/ferrimagnet bilayer versus thickness
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Chen et al. drift-diffusion SMR formula with complex spin-mixing conductance. Extract the spin Hall angle and spin diffusion length from the thickness dependence.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Valet-Fert CPP giant magnetoresistance of a magnetic multilayer
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Use the two-current series-resistor limit and the full Valet-Fert spin-accumulation solution. Compute parallel and antiparallel resistances and GMR versus number of repeats and spacer spin diffusion length.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Bruggeman effective-medium conductivity and percolation threshold of composites
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve the symmetric Bruggeman equation for the conductivity of a two-phase composite with spherical and spheroidal grains. Locate the percolation threshold and the critical behavior near it in 2D and 3D.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Maxwell-Wagner-Sillars interfacial relaxation of a layered dielectric
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Derive the effective complex permittivity of a lossy bilayer capacitor. Compute the Debye-like relaxation time, dielectric strength and loss peak versus layer conductivities and thicknesses.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Resonant magnetopolaron anticrossing of Landau levels with LO phonons
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Model the Johnson-Larsen resonance in GaAs/InSb with a two-level Fröhlich coupling between N=0 + phonon and N=1 states. Compute the cyclotron-resonance splitting and pinning near ωc = ω_LO.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Slave-boson RVB d-wave gap of the t-J model versus doping
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve the Kotliar-Liu mean-field equations for d-wave bond pairing and the Gutzwiller-renormalized hopping on the square lattice. Plot the pairing gap, superconducting order ∝ δΔ and dome location versus hole doping.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Doniach phase diagram: Kondo temperature versus RKKY scale
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compare T_K ~ D exp(−1/Jρ) with T_RKKY ~ J²ρ for a model conduction band. Locate the critical coupling, and add a lattice-coherence correction using a band-integrated RKKY sum.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Electronic Raman response of a d-wave superconductor in B1g and B2g channels
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the BZ integral of the Tsuneto-Raman response with vertices cos kx − cos ky and sin kx sin ky. Show the 2Δ0 pair-breaking peaks and the low-frequency ω³ versus ω power laws.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Octet-model quasiparticle interference wavevectors of a d-wave cuprate
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Find the banana-tip points of constant-energy contours for a t-t' band with a d-wave gap. Compute the seven octet scattering vectors versus bias, and invert them to reconstruct Δ(θ) on the Fermi surface.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Vogl sp3s* tight-binding bands of silicon and GaAs
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Build the 10×10 sp3s* Slater-Koster Hamiltonian along L-Γ-X. Reproduce the indirect silicon gap via the excited s* orbital, and compute effective masses at the conduction minima.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Friedel rectangular d-band model of transition-metal cohesive energies
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the d-band bond energy versus d-occupancy for a rectangular DOS, together with second-moment (Finnis-Sinclair) widths. Reproduce the parabolic trend of cohesive energies across the 4d series.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Blinc-de Gennes pseudospin model of KDP ferroelectrics and the isotope effect
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve the mean-field transverse-field Ising equations for the polarization and Tc as functions of tunneling Ω. Reproduce the large KDP/DKDP Tc shift and the quantum critical Ω_c.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Coulomb blockade thermometry: conductance-dip width of tunnel-junction arrays
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the weak-blockade conductance dip of an N-junction array from the analytic lineshape. Verify the universal FWHM = 5.439 NkT/e and the dip depth as primary temperature references.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Tunnel-junction shot-noise thermometry: thermal-to-shot crossover
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate S_I = 2eI coth(eV/2kT) including amplifier background. Fit V-dependent noise to extract temperature without calibration, and study the effect of finite frequency and junction nonlinearity.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Szigeti effective charges from LO-TO splittings of alkali halides and zincblende crystals
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Combine the Lyddane-Sachs-Teller relation with the Szigeti local-field formula to extract transverse and Szigeti effective charges from ε0, ε∞, ωTO and reduced mass. Compare ionicity trends across NaCl-type and zincblende compounds.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Loudon model: angular dispersion of extraordinary polar phonons in wurtzite crystals
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Use uniaxial A1 and E1 TO/LO frequencies to solve the Loudon secular equation for ordinary and extraordinary polar phonons as a function of the angle between q and the c-axis. Include the mixed-mode character that sets angle-dependent Raman peak positions in GaN or ZnO.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Lamb vibrational modes of an elastic nanosphere for low-frequency Raman
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Solve the free-surface transcendental equations for spheroidal (l=0,2) and torsional modes of an isotropic sphere using spherical Bessel functions. Express the Raman-active frequencies in the scaling form ω ∝ v_s/d and compare them across nanocrystal sizes.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Bir-Aronov-Pikus electron spin relaxation in p-type GaAs
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the BAP exchange-scattering spin relaxation rate, including the nondegenerate-to-degenerate crossover of the holes through Fermi-Dirac integrals and screening of the exchange interaction. Compare it with D'yakonov-Perel rates as a function of acceptor density and temperature.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Bistritzer-MacDonald tunneling amplitude from the Hankel transform of interlayer hopping
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Take a Slater-Koster-type radial interlayer hopping t(r) between graphene layers, compute its 2D Fourier transform t(q) by Hankel quadrature, and evaluate w = t(K)/A_cell. Analyse the sensitivity of w and the predicted first magic angle to the hopping decay length.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Interlayer exciton trapping in a TMD heterobilayer moiré potential
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Model the exciton center-of-mass motion in a three-harmonic moiré potential. Compute the harmonic trap frequencies at the potential minima and the tight-binding miniband width from a plane-wave expansion, comparing them as a function of twist angle and potential depth.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Kondo conductance of a quantum dot: Goldhaber-Gordon scaling curve and T_K
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Model the linear conductance G(T) of a unitary-limit Kondo dot using the empirical scaling function with s≈0.22 plus a gate-dependent Haldane T_K(ε_d). Fit synthetic G(T, V_g) data to extract T_K across the Coulomb valley and verify the universal collapse.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Kadowaki-Woods ratio of heavy fermions with ground-state degeneracy N
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute γ and the T² resistivity coefficient A for an N-fold degenerate Fermi liquid from a Lorentzian Kondo resonance. Verify the generalized Kadowaki-Woods scaling A/γ² ∝ 1/[N(N−1)/2] and compare Yb and Ce compounds.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Antiferromagnetic magnon-polaritons and the magnetic reststrahlen band in MnF2
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Combine the resonant permeability μ(ω) of a uniaxial antiferromagnet, with its two AFMR branches split by field, with Maxwell's equations. Obtain the polariton dispersion, the negative-μ stop band, and the far-infrared reflectivity versus field.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Spin waves and linear spin-wave theory

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Maryland model: exact localization length of a quasiperiodic tangent potential
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Diagonalize the Grempel-Fishman-Prange chain with V tan(παn + φ) at irrational α. Compare the numerical Lyapunov exponent with the closed-form result cosh γ = [√((2t+E)²+V²) + √((2t−E)²+V²)]/(4t), and confirm that all states are localized.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Gap labeling in metallic-mean quasiperiodic chains: silver and bronze means
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Generate substitution chains for the metallic means and compute their spectra by diagonalization. Verify that the integrated density of states in each major gap equals {nτ_m} mod 1, then identify the labels n for the largest gaps.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Coherent destruction of tunneling in an AC-driven double well
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the one-period Floquet propagator of a driven two-site model numerically and extract the quasienergy splitting versus drive amplitude. Show that it collapses at the zeros of J0(A/ħω), and compare the time-averaged tunneling dynamics with the high-frequency Bessel prediction.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Floquet engineering of periodically driven lattices

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Tien-Gordon photon-assisted tunneling steps in an SIS junction
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Weight the BCS quasiparticle I-V curve with J_n²(eV_ac/ħω) sideband factors to obtain the pumped I-V curve. Compute the photon step heights versus microwave amplitude and use the result for SIS mixer response estimates.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Floquet engineering of periodically driven lattices

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Body-centered cubic tight-binding DOS: elliptic-integral form and log² center singularity
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Reduce the bcc nearest-neighbour DOS to a single integral over complete elliptic integrals and evaluate it by quadrature. Characterize the ln²|E| divergence at the band center and verify the result against histogram sampling and the number sum rule.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Density of states and van Hove singularities

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Graphene in a 1D cosine superlattice: Bessel-function velocity anisotropy
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Expand the Dirac Hamiltonian with a periodic scalar potential V cos(Gx) in plane waves to obtain the renormalized Dirac-cone velocities. Compare v_y/v0 with the analytic J0(2V/ħv0G) prediction and locate the new Dirac points that appear at its zeros.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Wigner-Seitz cellular method for sodium: band bottom and cohesive energy
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Integrate the radial Schrödinger equation in an ion pseudopotential, applying the dψ/dr=0 boundary condition at r_s to find the band-bottom energy. Add the Fermi, exchange and correlation energies to obtain the cohesive energy and equilibrium r_s.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Nonorthogonal tight-binding chain from Slater 1s overlap and hopping integrals
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the closed-form two-center overlap S(R) and hopping integrals for Slater 1s orbitals. Solve the generalized eigenproblem E(k) = (ε + 2t cos ka)/(1 + 2S cos ka) for a hydrogen chain, and quantify the bandwidth asymmetry relative to the orthogonal model.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Curvature-induced secondary gaps in nominally metallic carbon nanotubes
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Apply the curvature-modified hopping shift to zone-folded graphene bands. Compute the small gap E_g ∝ cos(3θ)/d² for metallic (n,m) tubes versus diameter and chiral angle, and show that armchair tubes remain gapless.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Quantum size effect in thin metal films: Fermi-energy oscillations with thickness
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Fill jellium-slab subbands with infinite or finite walls at fixed bulk density. Compute E_F, the step-like DOS and the total energy per area versus thickness, then extract the λF/2 oscillation period.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: First-moment sum rule of S(q,ω) for Heisenberg magnets
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Hohenberg-Brinkman first-moment sum rule, which relates ∫ω S(q,ω)dω to bond energies weighted by (1 − cos q·d). Verify it against single-mode LSWT spectra of a ferromagnet and a dimer system, and extract nearest-neighbour correlations.
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.area: Spin waves and linear spin-wave theory

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Second-harmonic susceptibility from an anharmonic Lorentz oscillator and Miller's rule
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Derive χ(2)(2ω; ω, ω) for a classical oscillator with a quadratic anharmonicity as the product of three linear susceptibilities. Evaluate Miller's δ for III-V semiconductors from refractive-index data, including dispersion near resonance.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Akhiezer ultrasonic attenuation in silicon from phonon relaxation
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Akhiezer attenuation α(ω, T) = C_V T γ² ωτ / [2ρv³(1 + ω²τ²)], with thermal phonon relaxation time τ from thermal conductivity and a Debye heat capacity. Compute the f·Q product limit of Si and quartz resonators versus frequency and temperature.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Zener thermoelastic damping in silicon microbeam resonators: Lifshitz-Roukes formula
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute thermoelastic Q⁻¹ for a flexural beam from the Lifshitz-Roukes closed form, using material parameters that depend on temperature. Locate the Debye-like peak versus beam thickness and frequency, and compare with Zener's single-relaxation approximation.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Dysonian ESR lineshape of conduction electrons in a thick metal plate
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the absorption-dispersion mixed Dyson lineshape in the thick-plate limit, where the skin depth is much smaller than the plate thickness, for several ratios of diffusion time to T2. Derive the A/B asymmetry ratio and fit synthetic derivative spectra to recover T2 and the g-factor.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: BPP NMR relaxation: T1 minimum and hopping activation energy in ionic conductors
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate Bloembergen-Purcell-Pound spectral densities with an Arrhenius correlation time to compute T1 and T2 versus temperature at several Larmor frequencies. Extract the activation energy and the attempt frequency from the T1 minimum and its slopes.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: XMCD sum rules: spin and orbital moments from model L2,3 edges
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Construct L3 and L2 absorption spectra as Lorentzian white lines on an arctangent edge step, adding a circular-dichroism signal. Apply the Thole-Carra sum rules by numerical integration to recover m_orb, m_spin and their ratio, including the error from the edge-step choice.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Chudley-Elliott jump diffusion: quasielastic neutron linewidths Γ(Q)
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Compute the Lorentzian half-width Γ(Q) for lattice jump diffusion on a Bravais lattice and its powder average, which reduces to a sin(Qd)/Qd form. Compare it with Fick's law DQ² and fit synthetic QENS widths for the jump length and residence time.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Positron annihilation lifetime in metals from electron-gas enhancement factors
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the positron annihilation rate λ = πr0²c·n·γ(r_s) using Boronski-Nieminen and Brandt-Reinheimer enhancement factors. Add a core-electron contribution, and compute lifetimes for simple metals versus r_s and in vacancies of lower density.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Electron inelastic mean free path from Penn's optical-data algorithm
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Extend a Drude-Lorentz energy-loss function Im(−1/ε) into (q, ω) with a plasmon-pole dispersion. Doubly integrate it to get the inverse inelastic mean free path versus electron energy, reproducing the universal curve minimum for Al and Si.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Giant orbital diamagnetism of bismuth from the Wolff 3D Dirac model
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Fukuyama-Kubo interband orbital susceptibility of a gapped anisotropic 3D Dirac electron. Show its logarithmic enhancement when the chemical potential lies in the gap, then compute χ(μ, T) for Bi-like parameters.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Inelastic electron tunneling spectroscopy: thermally and modulation-broadened phonon peaks
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Model the conductance step at eV = ħω_ph and convolve d²I/dV² with the thermal (≈5.4 k_BT) and lock-in modulation (≈1.22 V_m) broadening functions. Fit synthetic IETS spectra for vibration energies and step heights.

physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.title: Tersoff-Hamann STM corrugation of a close-packed metal surface versus tip height
physics/condensed_matter|quad_models.gist: Express the surface LDOS as a Fourier series in surface reciprocal vectors that decays as exp(−√(κ² + G²) z). Compute the constant-current corrugation amplitude versus tip-sample distance and barrier height, and its strong suppression for higher-order components.

physics/optics|waves.title: Quasi-phase-matched SHG in MgO:PPLN: poling period and first- versus third-order growth
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the QPM poling period for 1064→532 nm from the extraordinary-index Sellmeier equation. Integrate the coupled equations with a sign-alternating d(z), show staircase SH growth, and compare the first-order and third-order effective coefficients 2d/(mπ).

physics/optics|waves.title: Random duty-cycle and period errors in periodically poled gratings
physics/optics|waves.gist: Generate PPLN domain sequences with Gaussian-distributed domain-wall position errors. Compute the SHG phase-matching curve as the Fourier transform of d(z) and average over realizations to obtain the degradation of peak efficiency and the growth of the pedestal.

physics/optics|waves.title: Linearly chirped QPM grating for broadband SHG acceptance bandwidth
physics/optics|waves.gist: Build an aperiodically poled grating with a linearly varying period. Compute the undepleted SHG transfer function versus fundamental wavelength by numerically integrating d(z)exp(iΔk z), and compare its bandwidth and ripple with the uniform-grating sinc².

physics/optics|waves.title: Temperature tuning curve of SHG in PPKTP using thermo-optic Sellmeier
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use temperature-dependent Sellmeier coefficients and thermal expansion of the poling period to compute Δk(T) for 775→387.5 nm SHG. Evaluate the sinc² tuning curve, the optimal phase-matching temperature, and the FWHM temperature acceptance.

physics/optics|waves.title: Boyd–Kleinman focusing function for Gaussian-beam second-harmonic generation
physics/optics|waves.gist: Numerically evaluate the double integral h(σ,ξ) for focused Gaussian-beam SHG without walk-off. Optimize over the phase mismatch σ for each focusing parameter ξ=L/b and recover the optimum ξ≈2.84 with h≈1.07.

physics/optics|waves.title: Cascaded χ(2) effective Kerr nonlinear phase shift at large phase mismatch
physics/optics|waves.gist: Integrate the full SHG coupled equations at large Δk. Extract the nonlinear phase acquired by the fundamental versus intensity and compare it with the effective n2 ∝ -d²/Δk from the cascading approximation, including the sign change with Δk.

physics/optics|waves.title: Type-I critical phase matching angle and walk-off in BBO
physics/optics|waves.gist: From the ordinary and extraordinary Sellmeier equations of BBO, solve for the type-I phase-matching angle θ_pm(λ) via root finding on n_e(θ,2ω)=n_o(ω). Compute the spatial walk-off angle and the angular acceptance bandwidth.

physics/optics|waves.title: Hong–Ou–Mandel dip from a Gaussian joint spectral amplitude
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the coincidence probability versus delay for SPDC photon pairs at a 50:50 beam splitter by integrating the symmetrized joint spectral amplitude with FFTs. Relate dip visibility to spectral purity via Schmidt decomposition (SVD) of the JSA.

physics/optics|waves.title: Beam-splitter transformation of two-mode Fock states |n,m⟩
physics/optics|waves.gist: Apply the beam-splitter unitary to input Fock states via binomial expansion of the transformed creation operators. Compute the full output photon-number distribution, verify the HOM suppression for |1,1⟩, and verify the even-only outputs for |n,n⟩.

physics/optics|waves.title: Quadrature squeezing spectrum of a degenerate OPO below threshold
physics/optics|waves.gist: Linearize the input-output equations of a degenerate OPO to obtain the squeezed and antisqueezed quadrature noise spectra versus analysis frequency and pump parameter. Include escape efficiency and detection loss, and find the maximum observable squeezing in dB.

physics/optics|waves.title: Photon-counting statistics of Fock, coherent and thermal light under loss
physics/optics|waves.gist: Apply Bernoulli thinning (binomial convolution) to photon-number distributions for transmission η through a lossy channel. Compute the Mandel Q parameter and g2(0) versus η, and show that Q scales linearly with η while g2(0) is invariant.

physics/optics|waves.title: Hanbury Brown–Twiss g2 of simulated chaotic light with Lorentzian spectrum
physics/optics|waves.gist: Synthesize a stochastic chaotic field by filtering complex Gaussian noise in Fourier space with a Lorentzian line. Estimate g2(τ) from intensity autocorrelations via FFT and verify the Siegert relation g2=1+|g1|² with coherence time 1/(πΔν).

physics/optics|waves.title: Photon-number distribution of displaced squeezed states
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute P(n) for a displaced squeezed coherent state using the closed-form Hermite-polynomial expression. Show the photon-number oscillations for amplitude squeezing and verify the mean, variance and sub-Poissonian Mandel Q.

physics/optics|waves.title: RCWA diffraction efficiencies of a binary lamellar dielectric grating, TE
physics/optics|waves.gist: Implement the Fourier modal method for a 1D binary grating under TE incidence: Toeplitz permittivity matrix, eigenmodes of the grating layer and boundary matching. Compute reflected and transmitted order efficiencies and verify energy conservation and convergence with truncation order.

physics/optics|waves.title: TM RCWA convergence with Li's inverse factorization rule for metallic gratings
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute TM diffraction efficiencies of a deep lamellar gold grating using both the naive Laurent formulation and Li's inverse-rule formulation. Compare their convergence of the −1 order efficiency versus number of retained harmonics.

physics/optics|waves.title: Guided-mode resonance filter reflectance spectrum
physics/optics|waves.gist: Apply RCWA to a subwavelength grating on a thin high-index waveguide layer to compute the zero-order reflectance spectrum. Locate the resonance near the slab-mode phase-matching condition and extract its linewidth versus grating modulation depth.

physics/optics|waves.title: Aluminum wire-grid polarizer extinction ratio by RCWA
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model a subwavelength aluminum wire grid with Drude-Lorentz permittivity. Compute TE and TM zero-order transmittance in the visible with RCWA (inverse rule for TM), and report extinction ratio versus wire height and fill factor.

physics/optics|waves.title: Sinusoidal surface-relief grating: RCWA versus Raman–Nath Bessel efficiencies
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute transmitted order efficiencies of a sinusoidal phase grating versus groove depth with staircase RCWA. Compare with the thin-grating prediction J_m²(φ) and identify where the scalar approximation fails as period approaches wavelength.

physics/optics|waves.title: Zero-order transmission of a 2D crossed grating of square holes
physics/optics|waves.gist: Implement 2D Fourier modal method with a block-Toeplitz permittivity matrix for a square lattice of holes in a dielectric slab. Compute zero-order transmittance spectra at normal incidence for both polarizations and check C4 symmetry.

physics/optics|waves.title: Laguerre–Gauss beam propagation and Gouy phase verification by angular spectrum
physics/optics|waves.gist: Generate LG_p^l fields from generalized Laguerre polynomials and propagate them numerically with the FFT angular-spectrum method. Extract the on-axis-reference Gouy phase and verify the (2p+|l|+1)arctan(z/z_R) law and beam-width scaling.
physics/optics|waves.area: Optical vortices and orbital angular momentum

physics/optics|waves.title: Fork hologram diffraction and topological charge of diffracted orders
physics/optics|waves.gist: Construct a binary or blazed fork grating encoding charge l. Compute the far field by FFT, isolate the diffraction orders and determine their topological charges m·l from phase winding around their nulls.
physics/optics|waves.area: Optical vortices and orbital angular momentum

physics/optics|waves.title: Fractional spiral phase plate: OAM decomposition and vortex splitting
physics/optics|waves.gist: Apply a spiral phase exp(iαφ) with non-integer α to a Gaussian beam. Compute integer OAM weights (sinc² in l−α) and propagate to the far field to locate the vortex chain of individual phase singularities.
physics/optics|waves.area: Optical vortices and orbital angular momentum

physics/optics|waves.title: Topological charge readout via triangular-aperture far-field diffraction
physics/optics|waves.gist: Diffract an LG beam of charge l through an equilateral triangular aperture and compute the Fraunhofer pattern by FFT. Count the triangular lattice spots (|l|+1 per side) and detect the orientation flip for negative charge.
physics/optics|waves.area: Optical vortices and orbital angular momentum

physics/optics|waves.title: Perfect vortex beams from Fourier transforms of Bessel–Gauss beams
physics/optics|waves.gist: Create Bessel–Gauss beams of order l with an axicon plus spiral phase and compute their Fourier-plane field by FFT. Show that the ring radius is nearly independent of l, and quantify the residual width variation.
physics/optics|waves.area: Optical vortices and orbital angular momentum

physics/optics|waves.title: Inferior mirage over a heated road surface
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model air index from a near-surface temperature profile via the Gladstone–Dale relation. Integrate the ray equation for rays from a distant object to an observer and compute the apparent inverted image positions and the shadow zone.

physics/optics|waves.title: Intermodal dispersion of α-profile graded-index fibers from ray transit times
physics/optics|waves.gist: Trace meridional rays in a power-law index profile fiber and compute axial transit time per length versus launch angle. Find the α that minimizes the delay spread and compare with the WKB optimum α≈2−2Δ.

physics/optics|waves.title: Maxwell fish-eye lens: circular ray paths and perfect imaging
physics/optics|waves.gist: Trace rays in n(r)=n0/(1+(r/a)²) from a point source and verify the circular trajectories against the analytic result. Show that all rays reconvene at the inverse image point and compute residual imaging error from integration tolerance.

physics/optics|waves.title: Astronomical refraction through an exponential spherical atmosphere
physics/optics|waves.gist: Trace rays from the observer through a spherically stratified refractivity profile using the Bouguer invariant n r sinθ. Compute total refraction angle versus apparent zenith angle and compare with the plane-parallel tan(z) formula near the horizon.

physics/optics|waves.title: Helical skew rays and angular-momentum invariant in parabolic GRIN fibers
physics/optics|waves.gist: Integrate 3D ray trajectories in a parabolic-index fiber for skew launch conditions. Verify conservation of the ray invariants β and l, and compute the radial turning points and the helical period.

physics/optics|waves.title: Evaporation duct trapping of microwave rays over the sea
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use a modified-refractivity M(h) log-linear evaporation-duct profile on a flat-earth transformation. Integrate ray paths to find the maximum trapping elevation angle and the skip distance versus duct height.

physics/optics|waves.title: Goos–Hänchen shift of a Gaussian beam at total internal reflection
physics/optics|waves.gist: Decompose a Gaussian beam into plane waves via FFT and apply TE/TM Fresnel reflection coefficients beyond the critical angle. Compute the reflected beam's centroid shift versus incidence angle and compare with Artmann's phase-derivative formula.
physics/optics|waves.area: Hyperbolic media and evanescent wave optics

physics/optics|waves.title: Imbert–Fedorov transverse shift for circularly polarized beams under TIR
physics/optics|waves.gist: Build a 2D angular spectrum of a circularly polarized Gaussian beam with transverse polarization coupling and apply Fresnel coefficients. Compute the out-of-plane centroid shift versus angle and helicity and compare with the analytic IF expression.
physics/optics|waves.area: Hyperbolic media and evanescent wave optics

physics/optics|waves.title: Frustrated total internal reflection between two prisms
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use a three-layer transfer matrix with an evanescent air gap to compute TE and TM transmittance versus gap thickness and angle. Compare with the asymptotic exp(−2κd) decay and extract the effective decay constant.
physics/optics|waves.area: Hyperbolic media and evanescent wave optics

physics/optics|waves.title: Purcell enhancement of a dipole above a hyperbolic metamaterial
physics/optics|waves.gist: Evaluate the Sommerfeld integral over in-plane wavevector of the TM/TE reflection coefficient of a multilayer stack to obtain the normalized decay rate of perpendicular and parallel dipoles. Separate propagating and evanescent (high-k) contributions versus distance.
physics/optics|waves.area: Hyperbolic media and evanescent wave optics

physics/optics|waves.title: Pendry silver superlens transfer function for evanescent waves
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the TM transmission coefficient versus transverse wavevector through a thin silver slab with lossy Drude permittivity. Propagate a two-slit object by angular spectrum FFT and quantify resolution enhancement over a dielectric spacer.
physics/optics|waves.area: Hyperbolic media and evanescent wave optics

physics/optics|waves.title: Negative refraction and lateral beam shift through a hyperbolic slab
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate a TM Gaussian beam through a uniaxial hyperbolic slab via plane-wave decomposition with anisotropic kz(kx). Compute the transmitted beam's lateral displacement and compare with the Poynting-vector refraction angle from the dispersion relation.
physics/optics|waves.area: Hyperbolic media and evanescent wave optics

physics/optics|waves.title: Evanescent field of the HE11 mode of a silica optical nanofiber
physics/optics|waves.gist: Solve the step-index fiber eigenvalue equation with Bessel J and modified Bessel K functions for the HE11 propagation constant versus fiber radius. Compute the fraction of power outside the fiber and the evanescent decay length.
physics/optics|waves.area: Hyperbolic media and evanescent wave optics

physics/optics|waves.title: Broadband visible antireflection coating optimized over layer thicknesses
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute average reflectance of a two- or three-layer MgF2/Al2O3/ZrO2 coating on glass over 400–700 nm with dispersive indices. Minimize it with scipy.optimize and compare with the quarter-quarter and quarter-half-quarter designs.

physics/optics|waves.title: Angle tuning of an all-dielectric Fabry–Pérot narrowband filter
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model a cavity filter (HL)^N 2H (LH)^N and compute its transmission peak wavelength and bandwidth versus angle for TE and TM. Fit the blue shift to the effective-index formula λ(θ)=λ0√(1−sin²θ/n*²).

physics/optics|waves.title: MacNeille polarizing beam-splitter cube coating design
physics/optics|waves.gist: Design an HL multilayer embedded in glass with layer angles satisfying the Brewster condition at the H/L interface. Compute Ts and Tp versus wavelength and angle within the cube, and evaluate extinction ratio and angular bandwidth.

physics/optics|waves.title: Spectroscopic ellipsometry Ψ and Δ fit of SiO2 thickness on silicon
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute rp/rs of a film on absorbing substrate with complex Si indices to obtain Ψ(λ), Δ(λ) at 70°. Generate noisy synthetic data and fit the oxide thickness and Cauchy parameters with least squares.

physics/optics|waves.title: Ultrathin germanium on gold strong-interference structural color
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute reflectance spectra of nanometer-thick lossy Ge films on optically thick gold using complex characteristic matrices. Track absorption-peak shift with thickness and convert spectra to CIE xy chromaticity coordinates.

physics/optics|waves.title: Field focusing by a finite cluster of dielectric rods via Foldy–Lax multipoles
physics/optics|waves.gist: Solve the multiple-scattering system for a hexagonal patch of dielectric rods illuminated by a plane wave, using cylindrical-harmonic T-matrices. Compute the near-field intensity map and transmitted power through the patch versus frequency, showing the photonic band gap.

physics/optics|waves.title: Coupled dipole extinction spectra of plasmonic gold nanosphere dimers
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model each gold sphere as a radiation-corrected Drude polarizable dipole and solve coupled dipole equations with the full dyadic Green's function. Compute extinction spectra for longitudinal and transverse polarization versus gap, showing bonding-mode redshift.

physics/optics|waves.title: Discrete dipole approximation extinction of a small sphere versus Mie
physics/optics|waves.gist: Discretize a sphere into a cubic lattice of Clausius–Mossotti (LDR) dipoles and solve the DDA linear system iteratively. Compute Q_ext and compare with exact Mie results as dipole count and |m|kd vary.

physics/optics|waves.title: Kerker zero-backscattering condition for silicon nanospheres
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute electric and magnetic dipole Mie coefficients of a silicon sphere with dispersive index. Find wavelengths where a1=b1 (first Kerker) and evaluate forward/backward scattering ratio spectra.

physics/optics|waves.title: Mie phase function of a cloud droplet size distribution
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute Mie scattering amplitudes S1,S2 for water droplets and average over a gamma size distribution. Obtain the phase function, asymmetry parameter and rainbow/glory features, and compare with the Henyey–Greenstein fit.

physics/optics|waves.title: Coherent wave in random cylinder suspensions: Foldy effective wavenumber
physics/optics|waves.gist: Simulate multiple scattering in random configurations of small cylinders in a slab via multipole T-matrix methods. Average the transmitted coherent field and extract the effective wavenumber, comparing with Foldy's and Waterman–Truell's predictions versus concentration.

physics/optics|waves.title: Supercontinuum in photonic crystal fiber via GNLSE with Raman and self-steepening
physics/optics|waves.gist: Implement the generalized NLSE in the interaction picture with RK4IP, Taylor-series dispersion, Blow–Wood Raman response by FFT convolution, and shock term. Reproduce the Dudley 835 nm PCF benchmark spectrum and compute the −30 dB spectral width.

physics/optics|waves.title: Soliton fission length versus soliton order in anomalous-dispersion fiber
physics/optics|waves.gist: Simulate GNLSE propagation of sech pulses with different soliton numbers N. Detect the fission distance from the peak-compression point and compare with the estimate L_D/N.

physics/optics|waves.title: Dispersive-wave phase-matching wavelength from higher-order dispersion
physics/optics|waves.gist: Solve the phase-matching condition Σ β_k Δω^k/k! = γP/2 for the resonant radiation frequency of a soliton. Compare with the spectral peak in GNLSE simulations with β3 and β4.

physics/optics|waves.title: Supercontinuum coherence degradation from input quantum noise
physics/optics|waves.gist: Add one-photon-per-mode noise to the input pulse and run an ensemble of GNLSE simulations. Compute the first-order coherence |g12(λ)| spectrum versus pulse duration and soliton number.

physics/optics|waves.title: All-normal-dispersion fiber supercontinuum and optical wave breaking
physics/optics|waves.gist: Simulate femtosecond pulses in normal-dispersion fiber with GNLSE. Compute spectral flatness and the wave-breaking distance, and compare with analytic estimates from the Anderson wave-breaking formula.

physics/optics|waves.title: Silicon waveguide supercontinuum with two-photon and free-carrier absorption
physics/optics|waves.gist: Extend the NLSE with two-photon absorption, free-carrier absorption and dispersion coupled to a carrier-density rate equation. Compute output spectra and transmitted energy versus input peak power, showing the TPA-limited broadening.

physics/optics|waves.title: Optical rogue wave statistics in noise-seeded long-pulse supercontinuum
physics/optics|waves.gist: Run many GNLSE simulations of picosecond pulses with noise-driven modulation instability. Spectrally filter the long-wavelength edge and compute the heavy-tailed peak-power histogram, quantifying events above twice the significant wave height.

physics/optics|waves.title: Cross-correlation FROG spectrogram of soliton fission dynamics
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the XFROG spectrogram of a simulated supercontinuum field using a gating reference pulse and FFT short-time Fourier transforms. Identify the ejected solitons and the dispersive waves, and extract the soliton group delays.

physics/optics|waves.title: Third-order soliton breathing and soliton period
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate an N=3 soliton A=3 sech(t) with split-step Fourier and track peak intensity and spectral width versus distance. Verify periodicity z0=πL_D/2 and the maximum compression factor.

physics/optics|waves.title: Self-phase modulation spectral broadening and peak counting
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate Gaussian and sech pulses in a dispersionless Kerr medium. Compute the SPM-broadened spectrum versus maximum nonlinear phase φ_max and verify the number of spectral peaks M≈φ_max/π+1/2.

physics/optics|waves.title: Akhmediev breather and Peregrine soliton: numerical versus analytic
physics/optics|waves.gist: Initialize a CW with a weak periodic modulation at a chosen frequency and propagate it with split-step Fourier. Compare the maximum compression point and peak amplification with the analytic Akhmediev breather and its Peregrine limit (peak ×9).

physics/optics|waves.title: Periodic dispersion-managed soliton via map-averaged iteration
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate pulses through alternating anomalous and normal fiber segments with split-step Fourier. Find the periodically stationary pulse by iterative averaging, then report the breathing ratio and energy enhancement versus map strength.

physics/optics|waves.title: Zakharov–Shabat eigenvalues predicting solitons emerging from arbitrary pulses
physics/optics|waves.gist: Numerically solve the Zakharov–Shabat scattering problem for Gaussian or chirped input pulses via a Fourier collocation eigenvalue method. Predict the emergent soliton amplitudes from discrete eigenvalues and verify them with long-distance NLSE propagation.

physics/optics|waves.title: Sellmeier fit of fused silica index and its zero-dispersion wavelength
physics/optics|waves.gist: Fit a three-term Sellmeier model to tabulated n(λ) of fused silica with nonlinear least squares. Derive the group index and GVD by analytic differentiation, and locate the zero-dispersion wavelength near 1.27 μm by root finding.

physics/optics|waves.title: Fast and slow light group delay in a Lorentzian gain doublet
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model a susceptibility made of two closely spaced gain lines and obtain the group index from its KK-consistent index. Propagate a Gaussian pulse by FFT, and compare the measured peak delay and advance with the group-delay prediction.

physics/optics|waves.title: Nonlinear refractive index n2 from two-photon absorption via nonlinear Kramers-Kronig
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use the Sheik-Bahae two-band two-photon absorption spectrum β(ω) for a direct-gap semiconductor. Apply the nondegenerate nonlinear KK integral to obtain the dispersion of n2(ħω/Eg), including its sign change near 0.7 Eg.

physics/optics|waves.title: Apochromatic doublet design from Sellmeier glasses and secondary spectrum
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute Abbe numbers and partial dispersions from Sellmeier coefficients of two glasses. Solve the thin-lens achromat power split, then trace the focal shift versus wavelength to quantify the residual secondary spectrum.

physics/optics|waves.title: Kuizenga-Siegman active mode locking from the Haus master equation
physics/optics|waves.gist: Iterate the AM mode-locking master equation, with parabolic gain filtering and cosine modulation, to steady state using a spectral (FFT) method. Verify the Gaussian pulse width scaling with modulation depth to the -1/4 power and bandwidth to the -1/2 power.

physics/optics|waves.title: Kelly sidebands of a soliton fiber laser with lumped gain and loss
physics/optics|waves.gist: Simulate a ring fiber laser that combines NLSE propagation with periodic lumped amplification and output coupling. Identify the sideband frequencies in the output spectrum and compare them with the quasi-phase-matching formula for dispersive radiation.

physics/optics|waves.title: New's model of dye-laser mode locking by slow saturable absorber and gain
physics/optics|waves.gist: Map a pulse through slow-saturating absorber and gain media using the Frantz-Nodvik energy-fluence integrals, round trip by round trip. Compute the net pulse-shortening window and the steady-state pulse width.

physics/optics|waves.title: Dissipative solitons in an all-normal-dispersion fiber laser via cubic-quintic CGLE
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate a lumped cavity consisting of fiber, gain, spectral filter and saturable absorber with split-step Fourier until steady state. Compute the chirped pulse duration, the spectral steep edges and the dechirped duration after ideal compression.

physics/optics|waves.title: Carrier-envelope offset frequency of a Ti:sapphire comb versus prism insertion
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the round-trip group-phase delay mismatch from Sellmeier dispersion of the Ti:sapphire crystal, the fused-silica prism glass and air. Obtain the CEO phase slip per pulse and f_ceo as a function of prism insertion depth.

physics/optics|waves.title: Maker fringes of second-harmonic generation in a rotated quartz plate
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute SH power versus incidence angle for a plane-parallel slab, including refraction, Fresnel transmission factors and the angle-dependent phase mismatch. Fit the fringe spacing to extract the coherence length.

physics/optics|waves.title: Sum-frequency upconversion detection of a weak mid-IR signal in PPLN
physics/optics|waves.gist: Integrate the three-wave coupled equations with a strong undepleted pump to obtain the sin² upconversion of the signal. Compute the quantum efficiency versus pump power and crystal length, plus the spectral acceptance from the sinc² mismatch.

physics/optics|waves.title: Collinear optical parametric amplification gain bandwidth in BBO
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the small-signal signal gain with phase mismatch, Δk(ω) from Sellmeier equations, using the analytic g = sqrt(Γ² - Δk²/4) solution. Verify it against numerical coupled-wave integration and extract the FWHM gain bandwidth.

physics/optics|waves.title: Fourier-designed aperiodic QPM grating for simultaneous dual-wavelength SHG
physics/optics|waves.gist: Represent the domain-orientation sequence as a binary function and evaluate its spatial Fourier transform at the two required Δk values. Optimize the sequence by simulated annealing or phase-modulation design, and report the balanced conversion efficiencies.

physics/optics|waves.title: Plane-wave expansion of a 1D photonic crystal: convergence versus exact Bloch bands
physics/optics|waves.gist: Expand the inverse permittivity of a binary lattice in a truncated Fourier series and solve the resulting Hermitian eigenproblem for ω(k). Study the convergence of band-edge frequencies against the exact transfer-matrix dispersion, including Gibbs effects.
physics/optics|waves.area: Distributed Bragg reflectors and photonic bandgaps

physics/optics|waves.title: Fibonacci quasiperiodic multilayer: fractal transmission spectrum and trace map
physics/optics|waves.gist: Generate Fibonacci sequences of two dielectric layers and compute transmission with transfer matrices. Iterate the trace-map recursion and quantify the self-similar splitting of transmission bands and the scaling of band widths with generation.
physics/optics|waves.area: Distributed Bragg reflectors and photonic bandgaps

physics/optics|waves.title: Band-edge slow light in a finite 1D photonic crystal
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the transmission phase and group delay of an N-period stack near the first band edge using transfer matrices. Compare the delay enhancement and density-of-modes scaling with N² against the Bloch group velocity.
physics/optics|waves.area: Distributed Bragg reflectors and photonic bandgaps

physics/optics|waves.title: Monte Carlo photon transport in semi-infinite tissue with Henyey-Greenstein scattering
physics/optics|waves.gist: Implement MCML-style photon packets with exponential step sampling, HG direction sampling, Fresnel boundary handling and Russian roulette. Compute total diffuse reflectance and the absorbed-energy depth profile versus μs'/μa.

physics/optics|waves.title: Farrell diffusion-theory spatially resolved reflectance versus Monte Carlo
physics/optics|waves.gist: Evaluate the dipole-source diffusion model, with an extrapolated boundary, for R(ρ) from a pencil beam on a semi-infinite turbid medium. Compare with Monte Carlo radial reflectance to find where diffusion fails at small ρ.

physics/optics|waves.title: Kubelka-Munk reflectance of a paint layer over black and white substrates
physics/optics|waves.gist: Solve the two-flux KM equations for finite layer thickness over a substrate of known reflectance. Retrieve K and S from black- and white-backed measurements, and compute the hiding thickness for a contrast-ratio criterion.

physics/optics|waves.title: Time-resolved diffuse reflectance fitting to recover tissue μa and μs'
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model the Patterson time-domain diffusion reflectance and convolve it with a Gaussian instrument response via FFT. Fit noisy synthetic temporal point-spread functions by least squares to retrieve absorption and reduced scattering.

physics/optics|waves.title: Frequency-domain photon density waves in an infinite turbid medium
physics/optics|waves.gist: Derive the complex wavenumber of the modulated diffusion equation. Compute the amplitude decay and phase slope versus source-detector distance and modulation frequency, then invert the slopes to recover μa and μs'.

physics/optics|waves.title: Delta-Eddington two-stream albedo of a cloud layer
physics/optics|waves.gist: Apply delta-scaling to the HG asymmetry parameter and solve the two-stream equations for a homogeneous layer over a reflecting surface. Compute plane albedo, transmittance and absorptance versus optical depth and solar zenith angle.

physics/optics|waves.title: Chandrasekhar H-function and diffuse reflection from an isotropically scattering half-space
physics/optics|waves.gist: Solve the nonlinear integral equation for H(μ) by iteration on a Gauss-Legendre grid. Compute the bidirectional reflection function and spherical albedo versus single-scattering albedo.

physics/optics|waves.title: Coherent backscattering cone lineshape from diffusion theory
physics/optics|waves.gist: Evaluate the Akkermans-Wolf-Maynard backscattering enhancement as a function of angle for a semi-infinite medium, using Fourier transforms of the diffusion path-length distribution. Extract the cone width versus transport mean free path, including absorption rounding.

physics/optics|waves.title: Interface state between two 1D photonic crystals predicted by Zak phases
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the Zak phase of each band of two binary photonic crystals from the band-edge field symmetries. Use transfer-matrix surface impedances to predict and verify the existence of an interface state in a common gap.

physics/optics|waves.title: Lossy Fabry-Perot etalon: Airy transmission, finesse and contrast
physics/optics|waves.gist: Derive the Airy transmission and reflection of an etalon with absorbing mirrors. Compute the free spectral range, the reflectivity finesse, the peak transmission reduction from absorption, and the contrast ratio versus mirror reflectivity.

physics/optics|waves.title: Gires-Tournois interferometer group-delay dispersion versus top reflectivity
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the reflection phase of a lossless GTI by the transfer-matrix or Airy formula. Differentiate it to obtain group delay and GDD versus frequency, and find the bandwidth over which GDD stays within a tolerance.

physics/optics|waves.title: Transverse mode spectrum and degeneracies of a two-mirror resonator via ABCD
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the round-trip Gouy phase from the ABCD matrix for a range of mirror spacings. Map the Hermite-Gauss resonance frequencies and identify the transverse-mode degenerate configurations, such as the confocal geometry and other rational Gouy fractions.

physics/optics|waves.title: Fourier-transform spectrometer: interferogram, apodization and resolution
physics/optics|waves.gist: Generate the Michelson interferogram of a two-line spectrum over a finite mirror travel. Recover the spectrum by FFT with boxcar, triangle and Happ-Genzel apodization, and quantify resolution, side lobes and line-pair separability.

physics/optics|waves.title: Spectral-domain OCT A-scan with dispersion mismatch and numerical compensation
physics/optics|waves.gist: Simulate spectral interferograms from a multilayer sample with a Gaussian source. Resample the data in k, apply the FFT to obtain the depth profile, show axial broadening from glass dispersion mismatch, and compensate it by a fitted quadratic phase.

physics/optics|waves.title: Takeda Fourier-transform fringe analysis for interferometric surface retrieval
physics/optics|waves.gist: Generate a carrier-fringe interferogram of a test surface with added noise. Isolate the +1 spectral lobe by FFT filtering, remove the carrier and unwrap the phase to recover the surface height map with an RMS error estimate.

physics/optics|waves.title: Shot-noise-limited phase sensitivity of a lossy Mach-Zehnder interferometer
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model output intensities with unequal arm transmissions and finite fringe visibility. Compute the phase uncertainty from the error-propagation formula and the Fisher information, and find the optimal operating phase versus visibility.

physics/optics|waves.title: Vernier-effect sensitivity magnification in cascaded Fabry-Perot fiber sensors
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the reflection spectrum of two slightly detuned low-finesse cavities in series. Extract the envelope by Hilbert transform or peak fitting, and verify the magnification factor FSR1/|FSR1-FSR2| of the envelope shift.

physics/optics|waves.title: Defect finesse: Fabry-Perot degradation from mirror surface figure errors
physics/optics|waves.gist: Convolve the Airy function with the thickness distribution produced by a spherical bow and a Gaussian random surface. Compute the effective finesse and peak transmission versus the surface error, and compare with the 1/F_total² combination rule.

physics/optics|waves.title: Fiber ring resonator transmission and critical coupling
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use the directional-coupler matrix with round-trip loss to compute all-pass ring transmission and phase. Find the critical-coupling condition, the loaded Q and the group delay across resonance in the under- and over-coupled regimes.

physics/optics|waves.title: Daytime radiative cooling power of a SiO2/HfO2 multilayer on silver
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute angle-resolved emissivity with transfer matrices using tabulated or oscillator permittivities. Integrate it against Planck spectra, a model atmospheric transmittance and AM1.5 absorption to obtain the net cooling power and equilibrium temperature.
physics/optics|waves.area: Thermal radiation and emissivity of structures

physics/optics|waves.title: Hemispherical emissivity of a SiO2 film on aluminum via Kirchhoff's law
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model SiO2 phonon permittivity with Lorentz oscillators and Al with a Drude model. Compute s and p absorptance by transfer matrices, then angle-integrate to obtain hemispherical total emissivity versus film thickness and temperature.
physics/optics|waves.area: Thermal radiation and emissivity of structures

physics/optics|waves.title: Solar-selective multilayer absorber photothermal efficiency versus temperature
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the spectral absorptance of a metal-dielectric multilayer stack by transfer matrices. Integrate solar absorptance and thermal emittance to obtain the photothermal conversion efficiency versus operating temperature and solar concentration.
physics/optics|waves.area: Thermal radiation and emissivity of structures

physics/optics|waves.title: Thermophotovoltaic spectral efficiency of a tungsten/1D photonic crystal emitter
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the emissivity of tungsten coated with a dielectric Bragg filter by transfer matrices. Integrate it with Planck's law to obtain in-band power above the GaSb bandgap, the spectral efficiency and an ideal-cell efficiency estimate.
physics/optics|waves.area: Thermal radiation and emissivity of structures

physics/optics|waves.title: Near-field radiative heat transfer between SiC half-spaces
physics/optics|waves.gist: Evaluate the Polder-Van Hove fluctuational-electrodynamics formula with Fresnel coefficients of a Lorentz SiC permittivity. Integrate over parallel wavevector for propagating and evanescent waves, and compute the heat transfer coefficient versus gap from 10 nm to 10 μm.
physics/optics|waves.area: Thermal radiation and emissivity of structures

physics/optics|waves.title: Coherent thermal emission lobes of a SiC grating by RCWA
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute angular and spectral absorptance of a shallow lamellar SiC grating in the reststrahlen band using a Fourier modal method. Identify the narrow emission lobes arising from grating-coupled surface phonon polaritons and their dispersion with angle.
physics/optics|waves.area: Thermal radiation and emissivity of structures

physics/optics|waves.title: VO2 thermochromic emitter: emissivity switching across the phase transition
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model VO2 permittivity during the transition by Bruggeman mixing of insulating and metallic phases. Compute the emissivity of a VO2/spacer/metal stack by transfer matrices, and obtain the integrated emittance change and hysteresis-free switching contrast.
physics/optics|waves.area: Thermal radiation and emissivity of structures

physics/optics|waves.title: Two-color pyrometry temperature retrieval with gray and non-gray emissivity
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute band-integrated Planck signals at two filter bands for a surface with wavelength-dependent emissivity. Invert the ratio for temperature by root finding, and quantify the bias from non-gray emissivity and filter width.
physics/optics|waves.area: Thermal radiation and emissivity of structures

physics/optics|waves.title: Conical-mounting RCWA of a 1D dielectric grating: polarization conversion
physics/optics|waves.gist: Extend the Fourier modal method to off-plane incidence with coupled TE/TM field components. Compute diffraction efficiencies and the TE-to-TM conversion of the reflected orders versus azimuthal angle, and check energy conservation.

physics/optics|waves.title: Wood-Rayleigh anomalies in the reflectance of a gold lamellar grating
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute TM specular reflectance versus wavelength and angle by RCWA with Li's factorization rules for Drude-Lorentz gold. Locate the Rayleigh cutoffs and surface plasmon resonance dips, and compare them with the grating-coupling equation.

physics/optics|waves.title: Gradient metasurface beam deflector: supercell RCWA first-order efficiency
physics/optics|waves.gist: Build a supercell of TiO2 pillars with linearly increasing width to impose a 2π phase ramp. Compute the -1 or +1 order efficiency by RCWA versus wavelength, and compare with the local-periodic phase-library prediction.

physics/optics|waves.title: Binary Dammann grating transition-point optimization for equal-intensity fan-out
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the Fourier coefficients of a binary 0/π phase grating with variable transition points. Optimize the transitions by least squares to equalize a 1×N fan-out, and report diffraction efficiency and uniformity.

physics/optics|waves.title: Talbot self-imaging of a binary amplitude grating via angular spectrum propagation
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate the field transmitted by a binary grating using the exact angular-spectrum kernel. Verify self-imaging at the Talbot distance and the half-period shifted images at fractional distances, and quantify the paraxial breakdown for small periods.

physics/optics|waves.title: Blow-Wood versus Hollenbeck-Cantrell Raman response: gain spectra and soliton impact
physics/optics|waves.gist: Construct both silica Raman response functions and FFT them to obtain the Raman gain spectra. Propagate a fundamental soliton with each model in the GNLSE, and compare the self-frequency shift and the T_R parameter.

physics/optics|waves.title: Soliton self-compression in a gas-filled hollow-core capillary fiber
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the pressure-tunable Marcatili-Astle capillary dispersion with argon Sellmeier, together with the Kerr nonlinearity. Solve the NLSE by split-step to find the optimal compression length and compressed duration versus pressure and soliton order.

physics/optics|waves.title: Fiber-grating pulse compressor after self-phase modulation in normal-dispersion fiber
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate a pulse through normal-dispersion fiber with SPM and GVD via split-step. Apply an ideal quadratic-phase grating compressor with optimized GDD, and compute the compression ratio and pedestal energy versus fiber length.

physics/optics|waves.title: Cascaded four-wave mixing comb from two CW pumps in highly nonlinear fiber
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate the beat of two CW lasers through the NLSE with dispersion, using split-step or coupled-mode equations. Compute the growth of cascaded FWM sideband powers and compare them with the dispersionless Bessel-function solution.

physics/optics|waves.title: Self-focusing collapse of a Gaussian beam in a Kerr medium
physics/optics|waves.gist: Solve the 2D nonlinear paraxial equation by split-step FFT for several input powers. Compute the on-axis intensity versus distance, the collapse distance, and compare the threshold with the critical power and the Marburger formula.

physics/optics|waves.title: Pancharatnam three-plate achromatic half-wave retarder with dispersive quartz
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compose Jones matrices of three quartz wave plates at optimized orientations, using a Sellmeier birefringence dispersion. Compute the effective retardance and fast-axis angle versus wavelength and compare the bandwidth with a single zero-order plate.
physics/optics|waves.area: Polarization optics with Jones and Mueller calculus

physics/optics|waves.title: Lyot birefringent filter transmission from cascaded calcite plates and polarizers
physics/optics|waves.gist: Multiply Jones matrices of a Lyot stack whose plate thicknesses double from stage to stage. Compute the transmission spectrum, free spectral range and FWHM, and check them against the product-of-cos² analytic form.
physics/optics|waves.area: Polarization optics with Jones and Mueller calculus

physics/optics|waves.title: Šolc folded birefringent filter between crossed polarizers
physics/optics|waves.gist: Build the Jones matrix of N identical plates with alternating azimuths ±ρ, where ρ = π/4N. Compute the transmission passband, sidelobe structure and bandwidth versus N.
physics/optics|waves.area: Polarization optics with Jones and Mueller calculus

physics/optics|waves.title: Lu–Chipman polar decomposition of a measured Mueller matrix
physics/optics|waves.gist: Decompose a composite Mueller matrix (diattenuator, retarder and partial depolarizer, with noise added) into the product M = MΔ·MR·MD. Report diattenuation, linear and circular retardance, optical rotation and depolarization power.
physics/optics|waves.area: Polarization optics with Jones and Mueller calculus

physics/optics|waves.title: Rotating quarter-wave-plate Stokes polarimeter via Fourier analysis
physics/optics|waves.gist: Simulate the detected intensity behind a rotating retarder and a fixed polarizer, including detector noise and a retardance error. Recover the Stokes parameters from the DC, 2θ and 4θ Fourier coefficients, and quantify the bias that a non-ideal retardance introduces.
physics/optics|waves.area: Polarization optics with Jones and Mueller calculus

physics/optics|waves.title: Twisted nematic liquid-crystal cell transmission via Gooch–Tarry Jones matrix
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model a 90° twisted nematic cell as many thin rotated birefringent slices and multiply their Jones matrices. Compare the result with the analytic Gooch–Tarry expression, and find the first and second transmission minima versus dΔn/λ.
physics/optics|waves.area: Polarization optics with Jones and Mueller calculus

physics/optics|waves.title: Polarization-mode dispersion: Maxwellian DGD statistics from random birefringent fiber sections
physics/optics|waves.gist: Concatenate frequency-dependent Jones matrices of randomly oriented birefringent fiber segments. Extract the differential group delay from the eigenanalysis of the Jones matrix pair at adjacent frequencies, and show that the DGD histogram over realizations follows a Maxwellian distribution.
physics/optics|waves.area: Polarization optics with Jones and Mueller calculus

physics/optics|waves.title: Faraday optical isolator: Mueller isolation ratio versus wavelength and temperature
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compose Mueller matrices of polarizer, Faraday rotator (with a dispersive and temperature-dependent Verdet constant of TGG) and analyzer for forward and backward passes. Compute isolation in dB and its bandwidth around 1064 nm.
physics/optics|waves.area: Polarization optics with Jones and Mueller calculus

physics/optics|waves.title: Fresnel rhomb retardance versus wavelength and incidence angle
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the s–p phase difference on total internal reflection from the Fresnel coefficients, using a BK7 Sellmeier index. Combine two reflections into a retarder Jones matrix, find the design angle for λ/4, and evaluate the achromaticity and angular tolerance.
physics/optics|waves.area: Polarization optics with Jones and Mueller calculus

physics/optics|waves.title: Confocal circular-mirror resonator modes via Hankel-transform Fox–Li iteration
physics/optics|waves.gist: Reduce the round-trip diffraction integral for circular mirrors to a Hankel-type kernel for each azimuthal order. Iterate to obtain the TEM00 and TEM01 losses, and compare them with the eigenvalues of generalized prolate spheroidal functions.

physics/optics|waves.title: Diffraction losses of a positive-branch confocal unstable resonator
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use Fox–Li iteration with magnification M to obtain the lowest-loss mode of an unstable strip resonator. Plot loss versus equivalent Fresnel number, showing the periodic mode crossings, and compare with the geometric loss 1 − 1/M.

physics/optics|waves.title: Super-Gaussian graded-reflectivity-mirror unstable resonator mode
physics/optics|waves.gist: Apply Fox–Li iteration to an unstable resonator whose output coupler has a super-Gaussian reflectivity profile. Compute the converged near-field profile, its flatness, the round-trip loss, and the far-field M² versus super-Gaussian order.

physics/optics|waves.title: Talbot cavity supermode selection for a coherently coupled laser array
physics/optics|waves.gist: Fox–Li iterate an array of N gain apertures facing a plane mirror at fractions of the Talbot distance, using angular-spectrum propagation. Identify the lowest-loss supermode (in-phase or out-of-phase) and its loss discrimination versus mirror distance.

physics/optics|waves.title: Fox–Li iteration with saturable gain sheet: saturated transverse mode
physics/optics|waves.gist: Include an intensity-dependent saturable gain sheet in each round trip of a finite-mirror resonator. Iterate to the self-consistent steady state, then compute the output power, the saturated mode profile, and its departure from the cold-cavity eigenmode.

physics/optics|waves.title: Faxén wall correction of drag and trap stiffness calibration near a coverslip
physics/optics|waves.gist: Simulate a trapped bead at several heights above a surface, using the Faxén parallel drag correction and the Brenner perpendicular drag correction. Fit corner frequencies from the PSDs and show the apparent stiffness bias when bulk drag is assumed.

physics/optics|waves.title: Aliased Lorentzian and photodiode low-pass filtering in tweezer power spectra
physics/optics|waves.gist: Generate sampled bead trajectories, then filter them through a silicon-photodiode transfer function. Fit the Berg-Sørensen–Flyvbjerg aliased Lorentzian with filter parameters, and compare the recovered stiffness and diffusion constant with naive fits.

physics/optics|waves.title: Active tweezer calibration from a sinusoidal stage-drive spectral spike
physics/optics|waves.gist: Add a sinusoidal fluid-drag drive to the Langevin simulation and measure the spike power in the PSD of a volts-valued detector signal. Recover the detector sensitivity, the stiffness and the drag coefficient without assuming the viscosity.

physics/optics|waves.title: Allan variance of trapped-bead position with low-frequency drift
physics/optics|waves.gist: Simulate trap position data with an added slow drift or 1/f noise. Compute the overlapping Allan variance versus averaging time, compare the white-noise part with the analytic Ornstein–Uhlenbeck result, and identify the optimal measurement time.

physics/optics|waves.title: Nonconservative scattering-force circulation in an optical trap
physics/optics|waves.gist: Add a rotational (curl) force component to a 2D harmonic trap and simulate the Langevin dynamics. Measure the probability-current circulation and the position cross-correlation asymmetry, and compare them with the analytic linear Ornstein–Uhlenbeck steady state.

physics/optics|waves.title: Zeeman slower magnetic field profile and atomic trajectory simulation
physics/optics|waves.gist: Design the √(1−z/L) field profile that gives constant deceleration for Rb or Na at a chosen safety factor. Integrate atomic trajectories with the full Lorentzian scattering force to find the exit velocity distribution and the capture velocity.

physics/optics|waves.title: Crossed 1064 nm dipole trap for rubidium: depth, frequencies, scattering rate
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the far-detuned dipole potential and photon scattering rate including D1 and D2 lines with counter-rotating terms, for two crossed Gaussian beams. Report trap depth, harmonic trap frequencies from the Hessian, and heating rate.

physics/optics|waves.title: Bloch oscillations and Landau–Zener interband tunneling in a tilted lattice
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate a wavepacket in a lattice plus linear potential with the split-step Fourier method. Measure the Bloch period and the per-oscillation tunneling loss to excited bands, and compare the loss with the Landau–Zener formula using the band gap.

physics/optics|waves.title: Protected silver mirror: reflectance and s–p phase retardance at oblique incidence
physics/optics|waves.gist: Apply characteristic matrices to an Ag layer with SiO2 or TiO2 overcoats, using a complex metal index. Compute Rs, Rp and the reflection phase difference versus angle and wavelength, and find the overcoat thickness that zeroes the retardance at 45°.

physics/optics|waves.title: Soap-film interference colors versus thickness via CIE color matching
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the reflectance spectrum of a free-standing water film under white illumination with a transfer matrix. Integrate it against analytic multi-Gaussian CIE color-matching functions to get xyY and sRGB coordinates, then trace the Newton color sequence versus thickness.

physics/optics|waves.title: Standing-wave absorption profile in a thin-film organic solar cell stack
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute internal forward and backward fields |E(z)|² across a glass/ITO/PEDOT/absorber/Al stack with the transfer-matrix method. Obtain the position-resolved absorption, then integrate a solar-like spectrum to get photocurrent versus active-layer thickness.

physics/optics|waves.title: Berreman 4×4 matrix for a tilted uniaxial birefringent layer
physics/optics|waves.gist: Build the Berreman differential matrix for an anisotropic layer with an arbitrary optic axis and exponentiate it. Solve for the 2×2 reflection Jones matrix including s–p cross-polarization, and verify that the isotropic limit reproduces Fresnel results.

physics/optics|waves.title: Herpin equivalent index of a symmetric-period long-pass edge filter
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the characteristic matrix of a (0.5L H 0.5L) period and extract the Herpin equivalent index and phase thickness. Use them to design matching layers that suppress passband ripple, and compare the resulting R spectrum with the unmatched stack.

physics/optics|waves.title: Prism-coupler m-line spectroscopy of a planar dielectric waveguide film
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute TE and TM reflectance of a prism/air-gap/film/substrate stack beyond the critical angle with characteristic matrices. Locate the guided-mode dips in effective index, and invert two mode indices to recover the film index and thickness.

physics/optics|waves.title: Vacuum Rabi splitting in the transmission of a driven atom-cavity system
physics/optics|waves.gist: Solve the steady-state Lindblad master equation of a weakly driven JC system with cavity decay κ and atomic decay γ. Compute transmitted photon number versus probe detuning and the peak splitting, and compare with the linear-response formula 2g.

physics/optics|waves.title: Micromaser steady-state photon statistics and trapping states
physics/optics|waves.gist: Build the coarse-grained micromaser gain/loss master equation with excited atoms injected at a fixed rate. Solve the detailed-balance recursion for the photon-number distribution, compute the mean and Fano factor versus pump parameter, and locate trapping states.

physics/optics|waves.title: Monte Carlo wavefunction trajectories of a damped atom-cavity system
physics/optics|waves.gist: Implement the quantum-jump algorithm for a JC system with cavity and atomic decay. Average the trajectories to reproduce master-equation populations, and compute the photon-detection waiting-time distribution.

physics/optics|waves.title: Two-layer skin-over-muscle diffusion reflectance via Hankel transform
physics/optics|waves.gist: Solve the steady-state diffusion equation in a two-layer turbid medium analytically in the spatial-frequency domain. Invert numerically with a Hankel transform to get spatially resolved reflectance, and study its sensitivity to top-layer thickness and to the absorption of each layer.

physics/optics|waves.title: Diffusing-wave spectroscopy backscattering autocorrelation from Brownian scatterers
