physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the path-length distribution of diffuse backscattering from diffusion theory. Combine it with the single-scattering Brownian decorrelation to obtain g1(τ) for an opaque colloid, then fit synthetic data to recover particle size.

physics/optics|waves.title: Spatial-frequency-domain imaging: reflectance versus modulation frequency and optical property inversion
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute diffuse reflectance under sinusoidal illumination from the diffusion equation, using the spatial-frequency transfer function with partial-current boundaries. Build a lookup table and invert two-frequency data to recover μa and μs'.

physics/optics|waves.title: Integrating sphere multiplier and temporal response from multiple wall reflections
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model sphere radiance as a geometric series of diffuse wall reflections with port fractions, and compute the sphere multiplier. Then compute the impulse response and its time constant from the mean photon path length, and compare with a simple Monte Carlo of photons bouncing in the sphere.

physics/optics|waves.title: Letokhov random laser threshold from diffusion with gain
physics/optics|waves.gist: Solve the diffusion equation with linear gain in slab and spherical geometries. Find the critical size at which the lowest diffusion mode loss equals the gain, and compute the threshold gain versus transport mean free path, comparing with a Monte Carlo photon-generation estimate.

physics/optics|waves.title: Single-scattering Rayleigh sky polarization map and Arago-free degree of polarization
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the scattering angle between the sun and each sky direction, along with the Rayleigh Stokes vector including a molecular depolarization factor. Map the degree and angle of linear polarization over the hemisphere for several solar elevations.

physics/optics|waves.title: Radiative-reaction-corrected polarizability and the optical theorem
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compare the static Clausius–Mossotti polarizability with the radiatively corrected form α/(1 − i k³α/6π) for small lossless and lossy spheres. Verify energy conservation, σ_ext = σ_sca + σ_abs, and compare both against exact Mie results.

physics/optics|waves.title: Surface lattice resonances of silver nanoparticle chains via coupled dipoles and lattice sums
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the retarded dipole–dipole lattice sum for an infinite 1D or 2D periodic array, accelerated by convergence or Ewald methods. Solve for the effective polarizability, and obtain the extinction spectrum with sharp Rayleigh-anomaly-shifted resonances versus period.

physics/optics|waves.title: Sunset color: Rayleigh optical depth with King factor and air-mass dependence
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the wavelength-dependent Rayleigh cross section of air from refractivity and the King depolarization correction. Integrate it into an optical depth and apply a spherical-atmosphere air mass to get transmitted solar spectra and chromaticity versus solar zenith angle.

physics/optics|waves.title: Dipole emission near a glass interface: supercritical-angle fluorescence
physics/optics|waves.gist: Expand the field of a dipole above a dielectric interface into plane waves (Weyl expansion) and apply Fresnel coefficients. Compute the angular radiation pattern into the glass, the fraction of power beyond the critical angle versus height and orientation, and the total decay rate.

physics/optics|waves.title: Rayleigh–Gans–Debye scattering by fractal soot aggregates
physics/optics|waves.gist: Combine the RGD single-monomer form factor with the structure factor of a fractal aggregate, given its fractal dimension and radius of gyration. Compute angular scattering, absorption and scattering cross sections, and the Guinier and power-law regimes.

physics/optics|waves.title: Circular dichroism of a helical arrangement of gold nanoparticles by coupled dipoles
physics/optics|waves.gist: Place plasmonic dipoles along a helix and solve the coupled-dipole system for left- and right-circular plane-wave excitation, averaged over orientations. Compute the CD spectrum, its bisignate shape, and its dependence on pitch and handedness.

physics/optics|waves.title: Cooperative Lamb shift and subradiance in 2D atomic arrays
physics/optics|waves.gist: Treat atoms in a subwavelength square array as coupled two-level dipoles with the free-space Green tensor. Diagonalize the non-Hermitian coupling matrix, compute collective shifts and decay rates, and evaluate the array reflectance near the atomic resonance.

physics/optics|waves.title: Transverse and longitudinal LiNbO3 Pockels modulators: half-wave voltage from the index ellipsoid
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute field-induced index changes from the r33, r13 and r22 coefficients for different field and propagation geometries. Obtain Vπ and the intensity transfer function between polarizers, including the static natural birefringence that sets the bias.

physics/optics|waves.title: Resonant electro-optic frequency comb in a phase-modulated cavity
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model a phase modulator inside a Fabry–Pérot cavity driven at the free spectral range. Iterate the round-trip field or apply the analytic sideband recursion to compute the comb envelope, its exponential spectral roll-off, and the comb span versus finesse and modulation index.

physics/optics|waves.title: Noncollinear TeO2 acousto-optic tunable filter passband
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the anisotropic phase-matching acoustic frequency versus optical wavelength from TeO2 ordinary and extraordinary indices. Evaluate the sinc² passband with momentum mismatch, the resolution, and the angular aperture of the tunable filter.

physics/optics|waves.title: KD*P longitudinal Pockels cell: quarter-wave voltage and conoscopic angular acceptance
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the field-induced birefringence for propagation along the optic axis. Use Jones matrices for off-axis rays, including natural birefringence, to map the extinction ratio and isogyre pattern versus ray angle and applied voltage.

physics/optics|waves.title: Electro-optic sampling of terahertz pulses in ZnTe: detector response function
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the frequency-dependent response of ZnTe from the THz-optical group-velocity mismatch, the THz dielectric dispersion and the r41 coefficient. Convolve it with a THz pulse to obtain the balanced-detection signal, and compare crystal thicknesses.

physics/optics|waves.title: Serrodyne optical frequency shifting with imperfect sawtooth phase modulation
physics/optics|waves.gist: Apply a sawtooth phase modulation with finite flyback time and amplitude error to an optical carrier. Compute the output spectrum by FFT, then report the shifted-sideband efficiency and the suppression of the carrier and spurious sidebands.

physics/optics|waves.title: Quasistatic gold nanosphere resonance and refractive-index sensitivity
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use a Drude plus interband-Lorentz model of gold permittivity in the Fröhlich condition and the dipole polarizability. Compute extinction spectra versus surrounding index, then the resonance sensitivity in nm/RIU and the figure of merit.

physics/optics|waves.title: Gans theory of gold nanorods: longitudinal resonance versus aspect ratio
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute depolarization factors of prolate spheroids from the analytic eccentricity formulas, and build polarizabilities along each axis. Compute orientation-averaged absorption spectra and the longitudinal resonance wavelength versus aspect ratio.

physics/optics|waves.title: Kreibig size-dependent damping in small silver nanospheres
physics/optics|waves.gist: Modify the Drude damping as γ(R) = γ_bulk + A v_F/R. Compute absorption spectra of 2–20 nm silver spheres, and extract the plasmon linewidth and dephasing time T2 versus radius.

physics/optics|waves.title: Near-field enhancement and SERS |E|⁴ around a silver sphere from Mie multipoles
physics/optics|waves.gist: Reconstruct the scattered field outside a sphere from Mie coefficients using vector spherical harmonics. Map |E|²/|E0|² near the surface, then compute the surface-averaged and maximum SERS enhancement versus wavelength and radius.

physics/optics|waves.title: Spaser threshold: plasmonic sphere in a gain medium
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model the host as a Lorentzian gain medium with negative imaginary permittivity. Find the threshold gain at which the quasistatic dipole denominator vanishes, then compute the divergent scattering versus gain and the dependence on metal loss.

physics/optics|waves.title: Hydrodynamic nonlocal blueshift of the plasmon resonance in small spheres
physics/optics|waves.gist: Extend the Mie coefficients with the longitudinal hydrodynamic-Drude wave, using an additional boundary condition based on modified spherical Bessel functions. Compute the dipole resonance blueshift versus radius, and compare it with the local Drude result.

physics/optics|waves.title: Fluorescence enhancement and quenching of an emitter near a gold nanosphere
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the radiative and total decay rates of a radial or tangential dipole outside a sphere with multipole expansion (Ruppin/Gersten–Nitzan). Combine them with excitation enhancement to obtain the quantum yield and net fluorescence enhancement versus distance.

physics/optics|waves.title: SMF plus DCF link design: dispersion and dispersion-slope residuals
physics/optics|waves.gist: From Sellmeier-plus-waveguide fits of β2(λ) and β3(λ) for SMF and dispersion-compensating fiber, solve for the DCF length that nulls dispersion at 1550 nm. Compute the residual accumulated dispersion across the C-band and the relative dispersion slope mismatch.

physics/optics|waves.title: Airy-oscillating tail of a Gaussian pulse at the zero-dispersion wavelength
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate a Gaussian pulse with pure third-order dispersion by FFT. Extract the asymmetric oscillatory tail, compare it with the analytic Airy-function solution, and compare the RMS width with the moment formula including β2 and β3.

physics/optics|waves.title: Treacy grating-pair compressor GDD and TOD for a CPA stretcher
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the spectral phase of a grating pair versus groove density, incidence angle and separation from the exact path-length expression. Expand it to get GDD and TOD, then choose the separation and angle that cancel a fiber stretcher's phase, and report the residual pulse width by FFT.

physics/optics|waves.title: Brewster prism-pair negative GDD versus apex separation and insertion
physics/optics|waves.gist: Using Fork's formula with fused-silica or SF10 Sellmeier derivatives, compute the GDD and TOD of a prism pair versus apex separation and glass insertion. Find the separation that compensates a Ti:sapphire crystal's material dispersion.

physics/optics|waves.title: Temporal Talbot self-imaging of a pulse train in dispersive fiber
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate a periodic Gaussian pulse train through fiber by FFT. Locate the integer and fractional temporal Talbot distances z_T = T²/(π|β2|), and verify repetition-rate multiplication at fractional distances.

physics/optics|waves.title: Dispersive Fourier transform: time-stretch spectroscopy and far-field resolution
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate a structured-spectrum ultrashort pulse through large GDD and compare the temporal intensity with the scaled spectrum. Quantify the spectral resolution versus GDD using the temporal far-field (stationary-phase) condition.

physics/optics|waves.title: Dispersion-limited eye opening of an RZ Gaussian pulse train
physics/optics|waves.gist: Generate a PRBS RZ-Gaussian bit stream and propagate it through fiber of varying length by FFT. Compute the eye-opening penalty and intersymbol interference, and extract the dispersion-limited bit-rate–distance product.

physics/optics|waves.title: Pulse broadening with a broadband partially coherent source: Marcuse spectral-width parameter
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model a pulse with finite source spectral width as an ensemble of random-phase realizations and compute ensemble-averaged broadening by FFT. Compare with the analytic formula containing the source coherence parameter V_ω.

physics/optics|waves.title: MTF of a centrally obscured telescope pupil by autocorrelation
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the incoherent OTF of an annular pupil by FFT autocorrelation for several obscuration ratios. Validate against the analytic O'Neill expression and report MTF changes at mid frequencies and the encircled energy.

physics/optics|waves.title: Hopkins defocus MTF and its zeros: diffraction versus geometrical optics
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the MTF of a circular pupil with a W020 defocus term via FFT of the generalized pupil. Locate the spatial frequencies of the first contrast reversal, and compare with the geometrical-optics Bessel-function approximation.

physics/optics|waves.title: Through-focus Strehl and best-focus shift under primary spherical aberration
physics/optics|waves.gist: For pupils with W040 spherical aberration, compute the on-axis intensity and Strehl ratio versus defocus by FFT or the Richards integral. Find the best-focus position (−W040 balancing) and the depth of focus at Strehl 0.8.

physics/optics|waves.title: Gaussian-apodized pupil: sidelobe suppression versus encircled energy
physics/optics|waves.gist: Apodize a circular pupil with truncated Gaussian transmission of varying truncation ratio and compute PSFs by FFT. Report the peak sidelobe level, FWHM broadening, power throughput and encircled-energy curves.

physics/optics|waves.title: Segmented hexagonal mirror PSF with diffraction spikes and piston errors
physics/optics|waves.gist: Build an 18-segment hexagonal pupil with spider vanes and compute its PSF by zero-padded FFT. Add random segment piston errors and compute the Strehl degradation and speckle halo versus RMS piston.

physics/optics|waves.title: Wavefront coding with a cubic phase mask: defocus-invariant MTF
physics/optics|waves.gist: Add a cubic phase α(x³+y³) to a square pupil and compute MTFs over a range of defocus values by FFT. Quantify the MTF variance across focus versus α and compare with the stationary-phase asymptotic MTF.

physics/optics|waves.title: Sampled imaging system MTF: optics, pixel aperture and aliasing
physics/optics|waves.gist: Combine the diffraction OTF of an f/N lens with a pixel-aperture sinc and detector sampling. Compute the system MTF, the MTF at Nyquist versus λN/p, and the aliased spurious response from the folded spectrum.

physics/optics|waves.title: Coherent versus incoherent imaging of an edge and two-point resolution
physics/optics|waves.gist: Image an edge and two point sources through a circular pupil under coherent (amplitude transfer) and incoherent (OTF) illumination using FFTs. Compare edge ringing and the dependence of two-point resolution on relative phase.

physics/optics|waves.title: Golay-6 sparse aperture array MTF coverage and effective resolution
physics/optics|waves.gist: Construct a Golay-6 array of subapertures and compute its MTF by FFT autocorrelation. Evaluate the minimum-MTF coverage over the u–v plane and the fill-factor dependence of the practical cutoff frequency.

physics/optics|waves.title: Heralded single-photon purity from SPDC: Schmidt number and multipair g2
physics/optics|waves.gist: Discretize a Gaussian-sinc joint spectral amplitude, compute the Schmidt decomposition by SVD, and get the unheralded g2 = 1 + 1/K. Compute the heralded g2(0) versus pump power from multimode two-mode squeezed vacuum statistics.

physics/optics|waves.title: Mandel Q parameter under detector dead time and finite efficiency
physics/optics|waves.gist: Simulate photocount records for Poissonian, thermal and antibunched sources with nonparalyzable dead time. Compute the measured Mandel Q versus count rate and compare with analytic dead-time corrections.

physics/optics|waves.title: Balanced homodyne quadrature distributions of Fock states with inefficiency
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute quadrature probability distributions |ψ_n(x)|² via Hermite functions for Fock states. Include detection efficiency as a Gaussian convolution and reconstruct the photon-number distribution from simulated quadrature histograms with pattern functions.

physics/optics|waves.title: Thermal-light ghost imaging: correlation image visibility versus speckle number
physics/optics|waves.gist: Generate pseudothermal speckle fields by FFT of random phase screens and form ghost images of a binary object from bucket–reference intensity correlations. Compute visibility and SNR versus the number of realizations and speckle size.

physics/optics|waves.title: Two-layer V-coat antireflection: analytic thickness solutions versus characteristic matrix
physics/optics|waves.gist: Solve the zero-reflectance condition for a two-layer coating on glass at one wavelength (two solution branches). Verify with the characteristic-matrix method and compute the s and p reflectance spectra at 0–45° incidence.

physics/optics|waves.title: Dielectric/silver/dielectric transparent electrode: induced-transmission optimization
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use the characteristic-matrix method with Drude-Lorentz Ag to optimize the dielectric thicknesses around a thin Ag layer for maximum visible transmittance. Report the potential transmittance and the trade-off with sheet resistance.

physics/optics|waves.title: 45° dichroic beamsplitter edge: s–p polarization splitting
physics/optics|waves.gist: Design a quarter-wave-stack dichroic edge filter and compute the s and p transmittance at 45° with tilted admittances. Quantify the edge-wavelength split and reduce it with modified layer ratios.

physics/optics|waves.title: Admittance locus diagrams of multilayer coatings
physics/optics|waves.gist: Trace the optical admittance continuously through each layer of a coating at the reference wavelength using characteristic matrices. Plot the circles in the complex plane and read off the final reflectance, and diagnose AR and high-reflector designs from the endpoint.

physics/optics|waves.title: Monte Carlo thickness-error tolerance of a narrowband interference filter
physics/optics|waves.gist: Apply random Gaussian layer-thickness errors to an all-dielectric Fabry–Pérot filter and compute transmittance spectra by the matrix method. Collect statistics of center-wavelength shift, peak transmittance and bandwidth versus error level, including layer-wise sensitivity.

physics/optics|waves.title: Otto-configuration surface plasmon excitation across an air gap
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the p-polarized reflectance of a prism/air-gap/silver stack versus angle and gap width with the transfer-matrix method. Find the optimal gap for critical coupling and compare the resonance angle with the SPP dispersion relation.

physics/optics|waves.title: Coherent perfect absorption in a silicon slab: S-matrix eigenvalues
physics/optics|waves.gist: Build the two-port scattering matrix of a weakly absorbing silicon slab from transfer matrices. Find the wavelengths and loss levels where an S-matrix eigenvalue vanishes, and compute the absorbed fraction versus the relative phase of two input beams.

physics/optics|waves.title: Rapid adiabatic passage with chirped pulses versus Landau–Zener
physics/optics|waves.gist: Integrate the two-level Schrödinger/Bloch equations for a Gaussian pulse with linear frequency chirp. Map the final excited-state population versus chirp rate and pulse area, compare with the Landau–Zener formula, and test robustness to dephasing.
physics/optics|waves.area: Optical Bloch equations and atom-light interaction

physics/optics|waves.title: Ladder-system Rydberg EIT with Doppler wavelength mismatch
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the weak-probe susceptibility of a 5S–5P–nD ladder system in hot vapor by velocity-averaging the steady-state density matrix. Model counterpropagating 780/480 nm beams and extract the EIT peak and the Autler–Townes splitting scaling.
physics/optics|waves.area: Optical Bloch equations and atom-light interaction

physics/optics|waves.title: Two-pulse photon echo in an inhomogeneously broadened ensemble
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate an ensemble of Bloch vectors with random detunings through π/2–τ–π pulses. Compute the macroscopic polarization showing free-induction decay and an echo at 2τ, and its decay versus τ for homogeneous T2.
physics/optics|waves.area: Optical Bloch equations and atom-light interaction

physics/optics|waves.title: Frantz–Nodvik saturated amplification and pulse reshaping in Nd:glass
physics/optics|waves.gist: Amplify a Gaussian pulse through a saturable amplifier with stored energy using the Frantz–Nodvik solution. Compare with numerical integration of the time-dependent transport equations, and compute the output energy, leading-edge sharpening and peak shift.

physics/optics|waves.title: Regenerative amplifier pulse build-up and period-doubling bifurcation
physics/optics|waves.gist: Iterate a round-trip map with Frantz–Nodvik gain extraction and inter-pulse pump recovery at a high repetition rate. Compute the bifurcation diagram of output energy versus repetition rate and the onset of period doubling.

physics/optics|waves.title: Mode-locked laser timing jitter from Haus–Mecozzi noise theory
physics/optics|waves.gist: Add Langevin noise to the soliton-perturbation equations for pulse position and frequency in a Haus master-equation laser. Compute the timing-jitter PSD and integrated jitter, including Gordon–Haus contribution, versus GDD and gain bandwidth.

physics/optics|waves.title: Repetitively Q-switched CW-pumped laser: pulse energy versus repetition rate
physics/optics|waves.gist: Iterate rate-equation cycles of pumping and Q-switched extraction to periodic steady state for an acousto-optically Q-switched Nd:YVO4 laser. Compute pulse energy, width and peak power versus repetition rate, and compare with the analytic exp(−1/(fτ)) recovery model.

physics/optics|waves.title: Phase-locked versus random-phase longitudinal modes: pulse train via FFT
physics/optics|waves.gist: Sum N longitudinal modes with Gaussian gain-weighted amplitudes and either locked, random or quadratic (chirped) phases using FFT. Compute pulse width, peak-to-average ratio and intensity autocorrelation, including the coherence spike for random phases.

physics/optics|waves.title: Slow-light pulse delay and distortion through a cold-atom EIT medium
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use the Λ-system linear susceptibility as a frequency-domain transfer function and propagate Gaussian probe pulses by FFT. Compute the group delay, pulse broadening, transmission and delay-bandwidth product versus optical depth and control Rabi frequency.

physics/optics|waves.title: Coupled-resonator optical waveguide: tight-binding band and group delay
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model a chain of N coupled ring resonators with ring transfer matrices. Compute the transmission band, group delay ripple and group index versus intercavity coupling, and compare with the tight-binding dispersion ω(k) = ω0 + 2κ cos(kΛ).

physics/optics|waves.title: Cascaded all-pass ring resonators as a tunable optical delay line
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the phase response and group delay of single and cascaded all-pass rings with loss. Optimize the ring detunings to flatten the delay over a bandwidth and report the delay-bandwidth-loss trade-off.

physics/optics|waves.title: Stimulated Brillouin scattering slow light in optical fiber
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model the SBS gain as a complex Lorentzian with a KK-consistent index change and propagate signal pulses by FFT. Compute delay versus pump power and pulse distortion, including broadened-pump gain to increase bandwidth.

physics/optics|waves.title: Coherent population oscillation spectral hole and slow light in ruby
physics/optics|waves.gist: Derive the probe absorption from population-pulsation terms of saturated two-level rate equations to get a narrow spectral hole of width ~1/T1. Compute the group index and the delay of modulated light versus modulation frequency and pump intensity.

physics/optics|waves.title: Hot rubidium vapor D2 line: Faddeeva susceptibility, slow and fast light
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the Doppler-broadened complex susceptibility with hyperfine components using the Faddeeva function (scipy.special.wofz). Get the group index versus detuning and the pulse delay/advance between hyperfine lines versus temperature.

physics/optics|waves.title: Plasmon hybridization in a gold nanomatryoshka multishell particle
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the quasistatic polarizability of a concentric Au/SiO2/Au multilayer sphere by layer-by-layer transfer of Laplace multipole coefficients. Track the bonding and antibonding resonances versus spacer thickness against the hybridization model.

physics/optics|waves.title: Retardation redshift of large gold spheres: Meier–Wokaun versus Mie
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compare quasistatic, modified long-wavelength (dynamic depolarization plus radiative damping) and full Mie dipole extinction for Au spheres of 20–150 nm. Compute resonance shifts and linewidths versus radius.

physics/optics|waves.title: Maxwell Garnett versus Bruggeman: gold nanoparticle-doped glass absorption
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the effective permittivity of Au inclusions in silica for both mixing rules versus filling fraction. Get the absorption coefficient spectra of a thin composite film with the transfer-matrix method, and the percolation behavior in Bruggeman.

physics/optics|waves.title: Substrate-induced plasmon shift of a silver sphere via image dipole
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model a Ag nanosphere above a dielectric substrate with the quasistatic image-dipole method (Yamaguchi). Compute the parallel and perpendicular resonance shifts versus gap and substrate index, and compare with an image-multipole series.

physics/optics|waves.title: Multipole decomposition of Mie extinction in large silver spheres
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute Mie coefficients a_n and b_n with Riccati–Bessel functions for Ag spheres up to 300 nm. Separate the electric dipole, quadrupole and octupole contributions, and track the emergence and dispersion of the higher-order resonances.

physics/optics|waves.title: Plexcitonic strong coupling: silver core with J-aggregate shell
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use the quasistatic coated-sphere polarizability with a Lorentzian exciton shell to compute extinction spectra versus detuning. Extract the anticrossing and the Rabi splitting versus oscillator strength and shell thickness.

physics/optics|waves.title: Absorption–scattering crossover size of gold spheres for photothermal versus imaging contrast
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute Mie absorption and scattering efficiencies of Au spheres versus diameter and wavelength. Find the crossover diameter where scattering equals absorption, the per-volume optimal size for each, and the albedo map.

physics/optics|waves.title: Seidel sums of a thin singlet versus lens bending: Coddington minimum spherical
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute third-order spherical aberration and coma of a thin lens versus shape and position factors using Coddington's equations. Find the minimum-spherical bending and the coma-free shape, and verify with a paraxial-based Seidel surface sum.

physics/optics|waves.title: Annular Zernike polynomials by Gram–Schmidt and interferogram fitting
physics/optics|waves.gist: Orthonormalize circular Zernikes over an annular pupil numerically by Gram–Schmidt and fit noisy wavefront data by least squares. Compare the coefficients and cross-talk with a circular-Zernike fit and compute the RMS wavefront error.

physics/optics|waves.title: Maréchal approximation validity: exact Strehl for random Zernike aberrations
physics/optics|waves.gist: Draw random Zernike coefficient sets of prescribed RMS and compute exact Strehl ratios from FFT PSFs. Compare with exp(−σ²) and 1−σ², and map the error versus RMS and mode content.

physics/optics|waves.title: Stop-shift equations and coma-free stop of a spherical mirror
physics/optics|waves.gist: Apply Seidel stop-shift formulas to a spherical mirror and a singlet to compute coma, astigmatism and distortion versus stop position. Show that the stop at the center of curvature removes coma and astigmatism (Schmidt principle).

physics/optics|waves.title: Shack–Hartmann sensor modal reconstruction of Zernike wavefronts
physics/optics|waves.gist: Simulate lenslet spot centroids from an aberrated wavefront with FFT-based subaperture images. Build the Zernike derivative interaction matrix and reconstruct coefficients by pseudoinverse, including aliasing and noise propagation.

physics/optics|waves.title: Cooke triplet Seidel surface contributions from paraxial marginal and chief rays
physics/optics|waves.gist: Trace paraxial marginal and chief rays through a Cooke triplet prescription and compute surface-by-surface Seidel coefficients S_I–S_V and Petzval sum. Compare predicted transverse ray aberrations with exact ray traces.

physics/optics|waves.title: Ocular Zernike coefficients to sphero-cylindrical refraction and pupil rescaling
physics/optics|waves.gist: Convert Zernike defocus and astigmatism (and the spherical-aberration contribution) to sphere, cylinder and axis via power-vector formulas. Rescale coefficients to a smaller pupil with Schwiegerling's transformation and compare the refraction across pupil sizes.

physics/optics|waves.title: Thick-lens and two-lens cardinal points from y–nu ray trace
physics/optics|waves.gist: Trace paraxial rays with refraction–transfer (y, nu) matrices through a thick lens and separated doublets. Compute effective focal length, back and front focal distances, principal and nodal planes, and verify Gullstrand's equation.
physics/optics|waves.area: Paraxial ray tracing and lens design

physics/optics|waves.title: Aperture stop, pupils, field stop and vignetting in a two-lens relay
physics/optics|waves.gist: Identify the aperture stop by tracing a marginal ray and the pupils by imaging the stop. Trace chief and edge rays to get the field of view and vignetting fraction versus field, and verify conservation of the Lagrange invariant.
physics/optics|waves.area: Paraxial ray tracing and lens design

physics/optics|waves.title: Two-group mechanically compensated zoom lens
physics/optics|waves.gist: For a two-group zoom, solve the group separations versus effective focal length while holding the image plane fixed. Compute the cam curves, zoom ratio and track length, and check paraxial positivity constraints.
physics/optics|waves.area: Paraxial ray tracing and lens design

physics/optics|waves.title: Telephoto and retrofocus thin-lens power solutions
physics/optics|waves.gist: Solve for two thin-lens powers and separation that give a prescribed focal length with a short total length (telephoto ratio) or a long back focus (retrofocus). Verify with matrix ray tracing and compute the Petzval sum of each solution.
physics/optics|waves.area: Paraxial ray tracing and lens design

physics/optics|waves.title: Gaussian-beam mode matching into a cavity with two lenses
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate the complex q-parameter through free space and thin lenses with ABCD matrices and solve for lens positions that match a laser waist to a cavity eigenmode. Compute the mode-matching overlap efficiency versus positioning errors.
physics/optics|waves.area: Paraxial ray tracing and lens design

physics/optics|waves.title: Gullstrand schematic eye: cardinal points and refractive error versus axial length
physics/optics|waves.gist: Build the system matrix of the Gullstrand–Le Grand eye with cornea and lens surfaces, and compute the cardinal points and total power. Compute the far point, refractive error in diopters versus axial length, and the accommodation needed for near vision.
physics/optics|waves.area: Paraxial ray tracing and lens design

physics/optics|waves.title: Exact real-ray trace of a spherical singlet versus third-order aberration
physics/optics|waves.gist: Implement vector Snell ray tracing through spherical surfaces and compute the longitudinal spherical aberration versus ray height. Fit h² and h⁴ terms and compare the h² coefficient with the Seidel S_I prediction.
physics/optics|waves.area: Paraxial ray tracing and lens design

physics/optics|waves.title: Abbe sine condition and offense against sine condition of an aplanatic lens
physics/optics|waves.gist: Trace real marginal rays through a meniscus or aplanatic-sphere design and compute Conrady's offense against the sine condition (OSC) versus aperture. Relate it to the third-order coma coefficient.
physics/optics|waves.area: Paraxial ray tracing and lens design

physics/optics|waves.title: Huygens eyepiece lateral color and the separated-lens achromatism condition
physics/optics|waves.gist: Trace paraxial chief and marginal rays at F, d and C wavelengths using Abbe numbers. Compute longitudinal and lateral color versus lens separation, and verify that d = (f1+f2)/2 cancels the lateral color.
physics/optics|waves.area: Paraxial ray tracing and lens design

physics/optics|waves.title: Cassegrain telescope first-order layout and Ritchey–Chrétien conic constants
physics/optics|waves.gist: Solve the mirror radii and separation for a given focal length and back focus using paraxial ray-transfer matrices. Compute the conic constants that cancel spherical aberration and coma via mirror Seidel sums.
physics/optics|waves.area: Paraxial ray tracing and lens design

physics/optics|waves.title: Fresnel diffraction from a square aperture: Fresnel integrals versus FFT propagators
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute near-field intensity patterns from scipy Fresnel integrals and compare with transfer-function and impulse-response FFT propagation. Quantify errors versus Fresnel number and sampling criteria (critical sampling Δx² = λz/N).

physics/optics|waves.title: Petzval sum, astigmatism and field flattener design for a two-lens objective
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the Petzval sum and the third-order astigmatism Seidel sums of a thin-lens doublet. From them, derive the sagittal and tangential field-curvature curves, then solve for the field-flattener lens power that makes the Petzval surface flat.

physics/optics|waves.title: Zernike coefficient transformation under pupil decentration and rotation
physics/optics|waves.gist: Find the linear map from Zernike coefficients on a circular pupil to those on a laterally shifted and rotated subpupil. Evaluate the wavefront on a grid and refit by least squares. Validate the map for coma and spherical, which spawn tilt and defocus.

physics/optics|waves.title: Four-step phase-shifting interferogram to Zernike fit and RMS error
physics/optics|waves.gist: Simulate four phase-shifted interferograms of an aberrated surface with noise. Recover the wrapped phase with the four-step formula, unwrap it, and fit Zernike polynomials by least squares. Report the residual RMS and peak-to-valley after removing piston and tilt.

physics/optics|waves.title: Seidel aberrations of a tilted plane-parallel plate in a converging beam
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use closed-form third-order expressions to compute the spherical, coma and astigmatism a tilted glass plate introduces into an f/N converging beam. Confirm them with exact Snell's-law ray tracing and a Zernike fit of the OPD.

physics/optics|waves.title: Off-axis paraboloid field aberrations from exact ray tracing and Zernike decomposition
physics/optics|waves.gist: Trace a ray fan through an off-axis parabolic mirror for several field angles and compute the OPD relative to a reference sphere. Fit Zernike modes to show coma growing linearly and astigmatism quadratically with field. Find the diffraction-limited field of view.

physics/optics|waves.title: Seidel-to-Zernike conversion and aberration balancing for minimum RMS wavefront
physics/optics|waves.gist: Express the W040, W131, W222 and W220 Seidel terms as Zernike expansions. Find the optimal defocus and tilt that balance spherical aberration and coma to minimize RMS. Compare the resulting Strehl ratios from the Maréchal formula and an FFT PSF.

physics/optics|waves.title: Deformable-mirror fitting error with Gaussian influence functions on Kolmogorov wavefronts
physics/optics|waves.gist: Generate Kolmogorov phase screens by FFT and model actuator influence functions as Gaussians on a square grid. Find least-squares actuator commands and compute the residual fitting-error variance versus actuator pitch. Compare with the scaling law κ(d/r0)^(5/3).

physics/optics|waves.title: Schmidt camera corrector plate profile and residual spherochromatism
physics/optics|waves.gist: Derive the aspheric corrector profile that cancels the spherical aberration of a spherical mirror at a design wavelength, including the neutral-zone choice. Ray trace at other wavelengths using a Sellmeier index to compute the residual spherochromatic RMS wavefront.

physics/optics|waves.title: Geometric spot diagram and RMS spot radius from Zernike wavefront gradients
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute transverse ray aberrations from the analytic gradients of a Zernike-expanded wavefront and build spot diagrams over a pupil grid. Check the RMS spot radius against the closed-form gradient-variance formula, and compare with the Airy radius as a geometric versus diffraction criterion.

physics/optics|waves.title: Semiconductor laser L-I curve with thermal rollover via self-heating
physics/optics|waves.gist: Couple carrier-photon rate equations to a thermal model in which threshold current follows an exp(T/T0) law and gain falls with temperature. Self-consistently solve the steady-state L-I curve, the junction temperature and the rollover current of an edge-emitting diode.

physics/optics|waves.title: Schawlow–Townes–Henry linewidth versus output power and α-factor
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the spontaneous-emission-limited linewidth above threshold, including the (1+α²) Henry enhancement and the population inversion factor. Check it by stochastic Langevin simulation of the field phase diffusion and a Lorentzian fit to the FFT field spectrum.

physics/optics|waves.title: Directly modulated laser eye diagram from PRBS rate-equation simulation
physics/optics|waves.gist: Drive the single-mode rate equations with a pseudo-random bit sequence current at multi-Gb/s. Fold the output into an eye diagram, then compute the eye opening, Q-factor and extinction ratio versus bias and modulation depth.

physics/optics|waves.title: FFT-accelerated DDA with BiCGSTAB for scattering by a dielectric cube
physics/optics|waves.gist: Assemble the block-Toeplitz dipole interaction tensor on a cubic lattice and embed it in a circulant for FFT matrix-vector products. Solve for the induced dipoles iteratively with BiCGSTAB. Compute extinction and absorption of a cube and compare runtime with direct dense solves.

physics/optics|waves.title: DDA phase function and asymmetry parameter of a hexagonal ice prism
physics/optics|waves.gist: Discretize a hexagonal ice column into dipoles with lattice-dispersion-relation polarizabilities and solve the DDA system for several orientations. Compute the scattering phase function, asymmetry parameter g and single-scattering albedo, and compare with an equal-volume Mie sphere.

physics/optics|waves.title: Gap field enhancement of a gold bowtie nanoantenna by DDA
physics/optics|waves.gist: Build two opposing gold triangular prisms with a Drude–Lorentz permittivity on a dipole lattice and solve the DDA system across wavelength. Compute the extinction spectrum and the near-field |E|² at the gap center versus gap size.

physics/optics|waves.title: Radiation force and optical torque on a dielectric cube from DDA dipoles
physics/optics|waves.gist: Solve the DDA system for a cube illuminated by circularly polarized light. Compute the time-averaged force on each dipole as ½Re(p·∇E*), and the torque from (p×E*) plus r×F. Check angular-momentum transfer for an absorbing cube against absorbed power divided by ω.

physics/optics|waves.title: DDA light scattering by a biconcave red blood cell
physics/optics|waves.gist: Discretize the Evans–Fung biconcave RBC shape on a cubic lattice and solve the DDA system at visible wavelengths for edge-on and face-on incidence. Compute the forward and side scattering intensities used in flow-cytometry discrimination.

physics/optics|waves.title: Magnetic dipole resonance of a silicon nanocube via DDA multipole decomposition
physics/optics|waves.gist: Solve the DDA system for a silicon nanocube and decompose the induced polarization into electric dipole, magnetic dipole and quadrupole contributions. Identify the magnetic dipole resonance, and check that the multipole sum reproduces the total scattering spectrum.

physics/optics|waves.title: Orientation-averaged extinction of a prolate spheroid by DDA quadrature
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute DDA extinction of a dielectric spheroid over a Gauss–Legendre and uniform grid of Euler angles and two polarizations. Form the orientation average, and compare it with the closed-form average from the three principal-axis cross sections in the Rayleigh limit.

physics/optics|waves.title: DDA convergence for a gold nanorod longitudinal plasmon versus dipole spacing
physics/optics|waves.gist: Discretize a hemispherically capped gold nanorod at decreasing dipole spacings and solve the DDA system with Clausius–Mossotti and LDR polarizabilities. Track the longitudinal resonance wavelength and peak extinction. Extrapolate to zero spacing using the |m|kd validity criterion.

physics/optics|waves.title: Adiabatic taper mode-conversion loss by split-step FFT beam propagation
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate the fundamental mode of a wide slab waveguide through a linear taper using a split-step FFT BPM with an absorbing boundary. Project the output field onto the eigenmode of the narrow guide and compute transmission versus taper length to locate the adiabatic threshold.

physics/optics|waves.title: Y-branch splitter excess loss versus branching angle by Crank–Nicolson BPM
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model a symmetric Y-junction index profile and propagate the input mode with a finite-difference Crank–Nicolson BPM. Compute the output arm mode overlaps and the excess loss versus full branching angle.

physics/optics|waves.title: 1×2 multimode-interference coupler self-imaging length by BPM
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the MMI beat length L_π from the two lowest slab-mode propagation constants. Propagate the input with BPM to find the 1×2 self-imaging length, then optimize the output port positions for minimum imbalance and loss.

physics/optics|waves.title: Waveguide bend radiation loss via conformal transformation and BPM
physics/optics|waves.gist: Map a curved slab waveguide to a straight guide with the tilted equivalent index n(x)(1+x/R) and propagate with BPM using absorbing boundaries. Extract the power-loss rate versus bend radius and fit Marcuse's exponential bend-loss formula.

physics/optics|waves.title: Hadley transparent boundary versus PML absorber reflections in Crank–Nicolson BPM
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate an obliquely launched Gaussian beam through a finite window with CN-BPM. Implement Hadley's transparent boundary condition and a complex-coordinate PML. Measure the spurious power reflected back into the domain versus beam angle and absorber parameters.

physics/optics|waves.title: Wide-angle Padé BPM versus paraxial BPM for steeply tilted beams
physics/optics|waves.gist: Implement (1,1) and (2,2) Padé wide-angle finite-difference BPM operators alongside the paraxial operator. Propagate tilted Gaussian beams and compare propagation direction and phase errors against exact angular-spectrum propagation as the tilt grows.

physics/optics|waves.title: Discrete diffraction in a waveguide array: BPM versus coupled-mode Bessel solution
physics/optics|waves.gist: Simulate single-site excitation of a periodic array of identical slab waveguides with BPM, and extract the coupling constant from two-guide supermodes. Compare the output intensity pattern with the coupled-mode prediction |J_n(2Cz)|² and its ballistic spreading.

physics/optics|waves.title: Offset launch into a step-index multimode fiber: modal power distribution
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the LP modes of a step-index fiber from the Bessel eigenvalue equations. Project an offset, tilted Gaussian input onto them by overlap integrals, and propagate the superposition to obtain speckle patterns and differential mode delay.

physics/optics|waves.title: Periodic self-imaging in a graded-index multimode fiber via split-step BPM
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate an off-axis Gaussian beam in a parabolic-index multimode fiber with 2D split-step FFT BPM. Verify the self-imaging period π a/√(2Δ) and the harmonic-oscillator mode spacing extracted from the FFT of the on-axis field along z.

physics/optics|waves.title: Phase-mismatched directional coupler power transfer by coupled-mode integration
physics/optics|waves.gist: Integrate the codirectional coupled-amplitude ODEs for two nonidentical waveguides with propagation-constant mismatch Δβ. Compute the maximum power transfer and coupling length versus Δβ/κ, and compare with the analytic sin² solution.
physics/optics|waves.area: Coupled-mode theory for waveguides and gratings

physics/optics|waves.title: Silicon contradirectional grating-assisted coupler drop-port spectrum
physics/optics|waves.gist: Solve the four-wave contradirectional coupled-mode equations for two asymmetric waveguides with a grating, using transfer matrices. Compute the drop and through spectra, the bandwidth and suppression of the self-Bragg reflections.
physics/optics|waves.area: Coupled-mode theory for waveguides and gratings

physics/optics|waves.title: Sampled fiber Bragg grating multichannel reflection comb
physics/optics|waves.gist: Build a periodically sampled index modulation and solve the contradirectional coupled-mode equations by piecewise transfer matrices. Compute the multichannel reflection comb and relate channel spacing and envelope to the Fourier series of the sampling function.
physics/optics|waves.area: Coupled-mode theory for waveguides and gratings

physics/optics|waves.title: Adiabatic tapered directional coupler: broadband transfer via Landau–Zener analogy
physics/optics|waves.gist: Integrate coupled-mode equations with a z-dependent detuning sweep and coupling profile. Compute the wavelength dependence of complete power transfer and compare its robustness with a uniform coupler, using the Landau–Zener formula.
physics/optics|waves.area: Coupled-mode theory for waveguides and gratings

physics/optics|waves.title: Nonlinear Kerr directional coupler (Jensen) power-dependent switching
physics/optics|waves.gist: Integrate the coupled-mode equations with self-phase modulation terms in both guides. Compute output port power fractions versus input power, find the critical switching power 4κ/γ, and compare with the Jacobi elliptic solution.
physics/optics|waves.area: Coupled-mode theory for waveguides and gratings

physics/optics|waves.title: Layer-peeling reconstruction of a fiber Bragg grating coupling profile
physics/optics|waves.gist: Generate the complex reflection spectrum of a known apodized, chirped grating with discretized coupled-mode transfer matrices. Recover the complex coupling profile κ(z) with the discrete layer-peeling algorithm and quantify the reconstruction error.
physics/optics|waves.area: Coupled-mode theory for waveguides and gratings

physics/optics|waves.title: Cavity-mediated entanglement of two atoms: concurrence dynamics
physics/optics|waves.gist: Evolve two two-level atoms coupled to a lossy cavity mode under the Tavis–Cummings Lindblad master equation, starting with one atom excited. Compute the two-atom concurrence versus time in strong and bad-cavity regimes, including the subradiant steady value.

physics/optics|waves.title: Quantum Rabi model spectrum and ground-state photons in ultrastrong coupling
physics/optics|waves.gist: Diagonalize the full quantum Rabi Hamiltonian, including counter-rotating terms, in a truncated Fock basis. Compute energy levels, the parity structure, and the ground-state photon number versus g/ω, and compare with Jaynes–Cummings and second-order perturbation theory.

physics/optics|waves.title: Dicke superradiant burst of N atoms in permutation-symmetric basis
physics/optics|waves.gist: Evolve the collective decay master equation for N initially excited atoms in the symmetric Dicke ladder. Compute the emitted intensity versus time, the peak delay scaling as ln N/N and the peak intensity scaling as N².

physics/optics|waves.title: Absorptive optical bistability of N atoms in a driven cavity
physics/optics|waves.gist: Solve the Maxwell–Bloch mean-field steady-state equation relating input and transmitted fields for cooperativity C. Find the bistable S-curve, the turning points and the critical cooperativity C=4, and check stability by linearization.

physics/optics|waves.title: Non-Markovian emitter decay into a Lorentzian cavity reservoir via pseudomode
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the excited-state amplitude of an emitter coupled to a Lorentzian density of modes. Solve the Wigner–Weisskopf integro-differential equation numerically and compare with the equivalent pseudomode master equation, from Markovian Purcell decay to oscillatory strong coupling.

physics/optics|waves.title: Astigmatism compensation in a Z-folded Ti:sapphire cavity with Brewster crystal
physics/optics|waves.gist: Build sagittal and tangential round-trip ABCD matrices for a folded cavity with off-axis curved mirrors and a Brewster-cut crystal. Map both stability regions versus mirror separation, and solve for the fold angle that compensates astigmatism.

physics/optics|waves.title: Nonplanar ring resonator image rotation and polarization eigenmode splitting
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the image-rotation matrix and the Jones round-trip matrix of a nonplanar four-mirror ring from mirror positions. Obtain the polarization eigenmodes, their frequency splitting, and the transverse-mode Gouy frequency shifts from the 4×4 ray matrix.

physics/optics|waves.title: Kerr-lens mode-locking sensitivity from power-dependent ABCD matrices
physics/optics|waves.gist: Insert a power-dependent Kerr lens into the round-trip ABCD of a four-mirror cavity and solve self-consistently for the Gaussian eigenmode. Compute the Kerr sensitivity δ = (1/w) dw/dP at a hard aperture, and map it against the position within the stability zone.

physics/optics|waves.title: Resonator misalignment sensitivity via 3×3 ABCDEF ray matrices
physics/optics|waves.gist: Represent mirror tilts with augmented 3×3 ray matrices and solve for the perturbed optical axis of a two-mirror resonator as the round-trip fixed point. Compute axis displacement and tilt per unit mirror tilt versus g1 and g2, with divergence at the stability edges.

physics/optics|waves.title: Periodic lens waveguide: Gaussian eigenmode and stability of a lens sequence
physics/optics|waves.gist: Find the stability condition of an infinite sequence of identical lenses from the trace of the unit-cell ABCD matrix. Compute the self-reproducing complex beam parameter and the ray period, and track q-parameter instability of mismatched beams.

physics/optics|waves.title: Herriott multipass cell re-entrant condition and spot patterns
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use ABCD ray matrices for a two-spherical-mirror cell to compute spot positions on the mirrors over successive passes. Solve the re-entrant condition N θ = 2π M for mirror spacing, and compute total path length and Gaussian beam waist recovery.

physics/optics|waves.title: Gaussian-aperture resonator: complex ABCD eigenmode and mode discrimination
physics/optics|waves.gist: Include a soft Gaussian aperture as a complex ABCD element in a stable resonator. Solve for the complex eigen-q, the round-trip loss of the fundamental and higher HG modes, and the loss discrimination versus aperture size.

physics/optics|waves.title: Ruby three-level laser threshold, spiking and pump requirement
physics/optics|waves.gist: Integrate the three-level population and photon rate equations for flashlamp-pumped ruby. Compute the threshold pump rate, the spiking relaxation-oscillation train, and steady state, and compare the required inversion with a four-level system.

physics/optics|waves.title: Quasi-three-level Yb:YAG laser threshold and slope efficiency with reabsorption
physics/optics|waves.gist: Write rate equations with ground-state reabsorption and spatially averaged end pumping. Compute threshold pump power and slope efficiency versus crystal length, doping and temperature-dependent Boltzmann populations, and find the optimal length.

physics/optics|waves.title: Two-mode competition in a laser: Lamb coupling constant and bistability
physics/optics|waves.gist: Integrate Lamb's two-mode intensity equations with self- and cross-saturation coefficients. Compute steady states and their stability versus the coupling constant C, showing coexistence for C<1 and bistable winner-takes-all for C>1.

physics/optics|waves.title: Lamb dip in a Doppler-broadened gas laser output power
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the third-order Lamb theory output intensity versus cavity detuning by integrating hole-burning saturation over the Maxwell velocity distribution. Show the central Lamb dip and its width, set by the homogeneous linewidth.

physics/optics|waves.title: Rigrod analysis of output coupling optimization in a high-gain laser
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute output intensity versus output-mirror reflectivity from the Rigrod counter-propagating saturated-gain solution. Find the optimum coupling for given small-signal gain and internal loss, and compare with the low-gain limit and direct ODE integration.

physics/optics|waves.title: Nanolaser L-I curve and threshold softening with spontaneous coupling β
physics/optics|waves.gist: Integrate rate equations with spontaneous emission coupling factor β to compute L-I curves from β=1e-4 to β=1. Extract the threshold kink, define threshold by photon number unity, and compute the linewidth narrowing trend.

physics/optics|waves.title: Hagen–Rubens emissivity of metals and total hemispherical emissivity versus temperature
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute spectral emissivity of a metal from the Drude model, with temperature-dependent DC resistivity, via Fresnel reflectance and Kirchhoff's law. Integrate over angles and the Planck spectrum to get total hemispherical emissivity versus T, and compare with the √(ρT) Hagen–Rubens scaling.
physics/optics|waves.area: Thermal radiation and emissivity of structures

physics/optics|waves.title: Directional emissivity of a thick sapphire window with incoherent multiple reflections
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute angle- and polarization-dependent emissivity of an absorbing thick slab from Fresnel coefficients and internal absorption, summing incoherent multiple reflections. Use a Lorentz-oscillator infrared permittivity, and Planck-integrate to get band-averaged emittance.
physics/optics|waves.area: Thermal radiation and emissivity of structures

physics/optics|waves.title: Far-field radiative exchange between two parallel plates with spectral emissivities
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute net radiative heat flux between two infinite parallel plates with spectrally and angularly resolved emissivities from Fresnel coefficients, using the multiple-reflection exchange formula. Integrate over angles and frequency, and compare with the gray-body formula.
physics/optics|waves.area: Thermal radiation and emissivity of structures

physics/optics|waves.title: Metal-insulator-metal Salisbury-screen narrowband thermal emitter
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use the transfer-matrix method to compute absorptivity of a thin metal, dielectric spacer and metal mirror stack versus wavelength and angle. Find spacer thickness for peak emissivity at a target infrared wavelength, along with Q-factor and the Planck-weighted emitted power fraction in band.
physics/optics|waves.area: Thermal radiation and emissivity of structures

physics/optics|waves.title: Thermal camera apparent temperature error from emissivity and reflected background
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model the band-integrated signal of an 8–14 μm camera from a gray or selective surface, including reflected ambient radiation and atmospheric path transmission. Invert the Planck band integral for apparent temperature, and quantify the errors versus emissivity uncertainty.
physics/optics|waves.area: Thermal radiation and emissivity of structures

physics/optics|waves.title: Low-emissivity ITO window coating: thermal emittance versus visible transmittance
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model indium tin oxide with a Drude permittivity and compute the transmittance and reflectance of the coated glass with a mixed coherent/incoherent transfer matrix. Compute the solar-weighted visible transmittance and the 300 K Planck-weighted hemispherical emittance versus film thickness and carrier density.
physics/optics|waves.area: Thermal radiation and emissivity of structures

physics/optics|waves.title: Nonreciprocal thermal emitter violating Kirchhoff's law with magneto-optic InAs
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the angle-dependent reflectance of a magnetized InAs gyrotropic layer on a metal using a 4×4 or anisotropic transfer matrix. Show that emissivity e(θ) differs from absorptivity a(θ)=e(−θ), and maximize the contrast versus magnetic field.
physics/optics|waves.area: Thermal radiation and emissivity of structures

physics/optics|waves.title: Multiple filamentation of a noisy super-Gaussian beam in a Kerr medium
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate a high-power super-Gaussian beam with random amplitude noise using 2D split-step FFT NLSE with saturable nonlinearity. Count the emerging filaments versus P/P_cr, and compare the filament density with the fastest-growing MI wavelength.

physics/optics|waves.title: Closed-aperture z-scan transmittance and n2 extraction via Gaussian decomposition
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute far-field on-axis transmittance through a thin Kerr sample scanned through a focus, using Weaire's Gaussian decomposition and also numerical Fresnel propagation. Fit ΔT_pv versus phase shift to extract n2, and include nonlinear absorption in the open-aperture trace.

physics/optics|waves.title: Thermal blooming of a CW Gaussian beam in an absorbing liquid
physics/optics|waves.gist: Solve the steady 2D heat equation for the temperature rise from absorbed beam power. Feed it as a thermal lens dn/dT into split-step propagation, and compute far-field broadening and the transition from thin-lens to self-consistent thermal defocusing.

physics/optics|waves.title: Nonlocal nonlinearity arresting collapse in nematic liquid crystals
physics/optics|waves.gist: Couple the paraxial beam equation to a screened Poisson equation for the reorientational index response. Solve both by FFT on each step and show that collapse is suppressed above P_cr, forming nematicon breathers whose width oscillation depends on the nonlocality range.

physics/optics|waves.title: Relativistic self-focusing of an intense laser in underdense plasma
physics/optics|waves.gist: Integrate the envelope equation for spot size with relativistic mass and ponderomotive nonlinearity. Compute the critical power 17(ω/ωp)² GW, and compare the beam-radius evolution with radially symmetric NLSE simulations using a saturable relativistic index.

physics/optics|waves.title: Noncollinear OPA in BBO: magic angle for broadband gain
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use Sellmeier and index-ellipsoid relations for 400 nm-pumped type-I BBO to find the noncollinear angle that matches signal group velocity to the idler projection. Compute the small-signal parametric gain spectrum versus internal angle from the phase mismatch and the coupled-wave gain formula.

physics/optics|waves.title: Doubly resonant OPO cluster tuning and mode hops
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model a doubly resonant OPO whose signal and idler cavity resonances must coincide inside the phase-matching sinc² envelope. Compute the cluster structure and the mode-hop pattern of the output frequency as the pump frequency or cavity length is tuned.

physics/optics|waves.title: OPCPA with chirped seed: gain narrowing and saturation
physics/optics|waves.gist: Integrate the coupled three-wave equations in time for a linearly chirped broadband signal amplified by a flat-top or Gaussian pump in BBO. Compute the amplified spectrum, the gain narrowing and the energy conversion efficiency versus crystal length.

physics/optics|waves.title: Synchronously pumped OPO: cavity-length detuning tolerance
physics/optics|waves.gist: Simulate a round-trip map of coupled signal and pump pulse equations with group-velocity mismatch, gain and output coupling. Compute the steady-state signal energy and pulse duration versus cavity length detuning.

physics/optics|waves.title: Type-II KTP OPO angle-tuning curves pumped at 1064 nm
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use the biaxial KTP Sellmeier equations and the phase-matching condition in a principal plane to solve for signal and idler wavelengths versus propagation angle. Root-finding on the mismatch gives the tuning curves and their acceptance bandwidth.

physics/optics|waves.title: Optical parametric generation from vacuum noise in PPLN
physics/optics|waves.gist: Seed the coupled signal-idler equations with quantum-noise-level fluctuations. Compute the superfluorescence output spectrum, the gain-narrowed bandwidth and the exponential growth versus pump intensity and length.

physics/optics|waves.title: Spatial walk-off limited OPA gain with Gaussian beams in BBO
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use split-step angular-spectrum propagation of coupled pump, signal and idler beams that include birefringent walk-off. Compute the reduction of effective parametric gain relative to the plane-wave result versus beam waist.

physics/optics|waves.title: Angular spectrum of type-I SPDC emission cone in BBO
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the signal photon angular-spectral rate from the longitudinal phase mismatch sinc² over emission angle and wavelength. Use it to find the cone opening angle versus crystal tilt and the cone thickness.

physics/optics|waves.title: Rotation of an optically bound dimer under circular polarization
physics/optics|waves.gist: For two dipoles in a circularly polarized plane wave, compute the coupled-dipole forces and the orbital torque on the pair. Simulate the dimer rotation rate with Stokes drag and its dependence on particle separation.

physics/optics|waves.title: Optical binding between two Mie spheres via multipole T-matrix coupling
physics/optics|waves.gist: Expand the fields of two wavelength-sized spheres in vector spherical harmonics and couple them with translation addition theorems. Solve the multiple-scattering system and compute the binding force versus separation, then compare it with the dipole limit.

physics/optics|waves.title: Rayleigh particle trapping in a Richards–Wolf tightly focused beam
physics/optics|waves.gist: Evaluate the vectorial Debye–Wolf focal fields of a high-NA objective by numerical quadrature. From them compute the gradient and scattering forces on a dipolar bead, the axial equilibrium and the lateral and axial trap stiffnesses.

physics/optics|waves.title: Ring of bound particles in a Laguerre–Gauss vortex beam
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model N dipoles confined to the bright ring of an LG beam that carries orbital angular momentum, with coupled-dipole interactions. Compute the equilibrium angular configuration and the collective rotation rate driven by the azimuthal phase gradient.

physics/optics|waves.title: Optical pulling force on a dielectric sphere in a Bessel beam
physics/optics|waves.gist: Expand a non-paraxial Bessel beam in vector spherical harmonics and use Mie coefficients to compute the axial force on a sphere. Map the regions of cone angle and size where the force is negative (a tractor beam).

physics/optics|waves.title: Two-soliton interaction versus relative phase and separation
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate two co-propagating fundamental NLSE solitons with split-step Fourier for several relative phases. Measure the collapse period of in-phase pairs and the repulsion of out-of-phase pairs, and compare with Gordon's interaction formula.

physics/optics|waves.title: Gordon–Haus timing jitter in an amplified soliton link
physics/optics|waves.gist: Simulate many split-step NLSE realizations with lumped amplifiers that add ASE noise. Compute the variance of soliton arrival time versus distance and verify the cubic growth law.

physics/optics|waves.title: Path-averaged guiding-center solitons with lumped amplifiers
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate solitons through a loss-amplification periodic link with split-step NLSE using launch powers scaled by the averaging factor. Compute pulse stability and dispersive-wave shedding versus the ratio of amplifier spacing to soliton period.

physics/optics|waves.title: Sliding-frequency guiding filters suppressing soliton noise
physics/optics|waves.gist: Add periodic Gaussian spectral filters whose center frequency slides with distance to a noisy split-step NLSE soliton link. Compute the reduction of timing and frequency jitter and the elimination of linear noise background.

physics/optics|waves.title: Soliton trapping in birefringent fiber via coupled NLSEs
physics/optics|waves.gist: Solve the coupled NLSEs with group-velocity mismatch and cross-phase modulation for orthogonally polarized pulses. Find the threshold amplitude above which the components shift in frequency and co-propagate as a trapped vector soliton.

physics/optics|waves.title: Lugiato–Lefever dissipative Kerr soliton comb in a microresonator
physics/optics|waves.gist: Integrate the normalized LLE with split-step Fourier from noise while scanning the pump detuning. Identify the single-soliton step and compute the soliton comb spectrum and its existence range in detuning.

physics/optics|waves.title: Self-similar parabolic pulses in a normal-dispersion fiber amplifier
physics/optics|waves.gist: Solve the NLSE with distributed gain via split-step Fourier for arbitrary input pulses. Show asymptotic evolution to a linearly chirped parabolic pulse and compute the misfit from the analytic similariton solution.

physics/optics|waves.title: Adiabatic soliton compression in dispersion-decreasing fiber
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate a fundamental soliton through fiber whose |β2(z)| decreases exponentially, using split-step Fourier. Compute pulse width versus distance against the adiabatic √(β2) scaling and quantify the non-adiabatic radiation.

physics/optics|waves.title: Fiber-optical event horizon: dispersive probe reflection off a soliton
physics/optics|waves.gist: Simulate a weak dispersive-wave probe colliding with a soliton through cross-phase modulation in a split-step GNLSE. Compute the reflected probe frequency and compare it with the group-velocity-matching prediction.

physics/optics|waves.title: Four-wave mixing crosstalk efficiency between WDM channels
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the FWM idler generation efficiency in fiber versus channel spacing and dispersion, using the analytic phase-mismatch-with-loss formula. Validate it against split-step propagation of three CW channels.

physics/optics|waves.title: Spectral compression by SPM of negatively chirped pulses
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate pre-chirped Gaussian pulses through a nonlinear fiber with split-step NLSE. Compute the output spectral width and the compression factor versus initial chirp and nonlinear phase.

physics/optics|waves.title: Atom transit through a Gaussian cavity mode: time-dependent coupling
physics/optics|waves.gist: Solve the Jaynes–Cummings master equation with g(t) set by an atom crossing the TEM00 waist at fixed velocity. Compute the photon emission probability and the cavity output pulse shape versus transit time.

physics/optics|waves.title: Photon-number-split qubit spectrum in dispersive cavity QED
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use the dispersive JC Hamiltonian with a coherently driven, decaying cavity to compute the qubit absorption spectrum. Resolve the χn-shifted peaks and show that their weights follow the cavity photon-number distribution.

physics/optics|waves.title: Two-photon Jaynes–Cummings model: exact periodic revivals
physics/optics|waves.gist: Diagonalize the two-photon JC Hamiltonian in each invariant subspace for an initial coherent field. Compute the atomic inversion with its exactly periodic revivals and contrast it with the one-photon model.

physics/optics|waves.title: Wu–Hu breathing honeycomb photonic crystal: band inversion via PWE
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use plane-wave expansion of a triangular lattice with six-rod clusters to compute TM bands at Γ while shrinking and expanding the clusters. Track the p/d band inversion and the gap closing that signal a pseudospin topological transition.

physics/optics|waves.title: Gyromagnetic YIG-rod photonic crystal Chern number from PWE
physics/optics|waves.gist: Assemble the TM PWE eigenproblem with an anisotropic permeability tensor for a square lattice of magnetized rods. Compute the gap Chern number with the discretized Fukui–Hatsugai link method applied to the PWE eigenvectors.

physics/optics|waves.title: Split-step photonic quantum walk: winding numbers and boundary states
physics/optics|waves.gist: Construct the Floquet operator of a discrete-time split-step walk with two coin angles. Compute quasienergy bands and winding numbers, and simulate edge-bound states at an interface between distinct phases.

physics/optics|waves.title: Aubry–André waveguide array: localization transition and edge-state pumping
physics/optics|waves.gist: Diagonalize the quasiperiodic Harper model to compute the inverse participation ratio across the λ = 2J transition. Adiabatically vary the modulation phase to show edge-to-edge topological pumping.

physics/optics|waves.title: Bott index of a disordered Haldane photonic lattice
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the real-space Bott index of a finite Haldane lattice with on-site disorder by projecting onto occupied states. Map the topological-to-trivial transition versus disorder strength, including possible topological Anderson regions.

physics/optics|waves.title: 2D lattice solitons in an optically induced photorefractive lattice
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the band gap of the induced square lattice by plane-wave expansion, then find gap or semi-infinite-gap solitons by Petviashvili iteration with saturable nonlinearity. Check their stability by split-step propagation with perturbations.
physics/optics|waves.area: Optical solitons in photorefractive and Kerr media

physics/optics|waves.title: Quadratic χ(2) spatial solitons: two-component Petviashvili solution
physics/optics|waves.gist: Find coupled fundamental and second-harmonic soliton profiles versus phase mismatch with a two-field iterative scheme. Compute the power–propagation-constant curve and the Vakhitov–Kolokolov stability criterion.
physics/optics|waves.area: Optical solitons in photorefractive and Kerr media

physics/optics|waves.title: Self-bending of photorefractive solitons from diffusion nonlinearity
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate a screening soliton with split-step Fourier including the asymmetric diffusion-field term. Compute the lateral beam-center trajectory and compare it with the perturbative parabolic deflection prediction.
physics/optics|waves.area: Optical solitons in photorefractive and Kerr media

physics/optics|waves.title: Incoherent spatial soliton via coherent-density mode decomposition
physics/optics|waves.gist: Represent a partially incoherent beam as a sum of mutually incoherent modes in a noninstantaneous saturable medium. Iterate a self-consistent guided-mode solution and compute the soliton width versus coherence length.
physics/optics|waves.area: Optical solitons in photorefractive and Kerr media

physics/optics|waves.title: Snake instability of dark soliton stripes in 2D defocusing Kerr media
physics/optics|waves.gist: Seed a 1D dark soliton stripe with transverse noise and propagate with 2D split-step Fourier. Compute the growth rate of the transverse modulation and its decay into vortex pairs, and compare with linear stability theory.
physics/optics|waves.area: Optical solitons in photorefractive and Kerr media

physics/optics|waves.title: Nonlinear surface waves at a Kerr–linear dielectric interface
physics/optics|waves.gist: Solve the stationary nonlinear Helmholtz equation analytically or by shooting for TE surface waves at the interface. Compute their power versus effective index and assess stability by beam propagation.
physics/optics|waves.area: Optical solitons in photorefractive and Kerr media

physics/optics|waves.title: Solitons in a PT-symmetric Scarf-II potential
physics/optics|waves.gist: Find stationary nonlinear modes of the NLSE with a complex PT-symmetric potential. Compute the linear PT-breaking threshold and the soliton stability via linearization and split-step propagation.
physics/optics|waves.area: Optical solitons in photorefractive and Kerr media

physics/optics|waves.title: Diffuse optical tomography sensitivity banana from diffusion Green's functions
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the photon measurement density function for a source-detector pair on a semi-infinite medium using image-source diffusion Green's functions. Report the mean probing depth versus source-detector separation.

physics/optics|waves.title: Differential pathlength factor for modified Beer–Lambert NIRS
physics/optics|waves.gist: From the diffusion-theory reflectance of a semi-infinite tissue, compute the mean photon pathlength via ∂lnR/∂μa. Evaluate the DPF versus source-detector distance and optical properties, and its error in hemoglobin change estimation.

physics/optics|waves.title: Monte Carlo downwelling irradiance in ocean water with Petzold-like phase function
physics/optics|waves.gist: Trace photons through a homogeneous water column with absorption and a strongly forward-peaked phase function. Compute the depth profile of downwelling irradiance, the diffuse attenuation coefficient Kd and the average cosine.

physics/optics|waves.title: Snow albedo versus grain size from asymptotic radiative transfer
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use Kokhanovsky's asymptotic weakly absorbing semi-infinite-medium solution with ice absorption to compute spectral plane and spherical albedo versus optical grain size. Compare with two-stream results.

physics/optics|waves.title: MRAF algorithm for smooth flat-top beam shaping
physics/optics|waves.gist: Implement mixed-region amplitude freedom in an IFTA with a signal region and a free noise region. Compute RMS flatness of a top-hat profile versus efficiency trade-off as the mixing parameter varies.
physics/optics|waves.area: Scalar grating and diffractive element design

physics/optics|waves.title: Phase quantization effects on multilevel diffractive element efficiency
physics/optics|waves.gist: Quantize an IFTA-designed phase hologram to N levels with and without in-loop quantization. Compute the diffraction efficiency against the sinc²(π/N) law and the resulting spurious orders.
physics/optics|waves.area: Scalar grating and diffractive element design

physics/optics|waves.title: Harmonic multi-order diffractive lens efficiency versus wavelength
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model a kinoform whose zone phase depth is p·2π at a design wavelength. Compute the diffraction efficiency into each order via the sinc² formula as wavelength varies, and find the harmonic focal wavelengths.
physics/optics|waves.area: Scalar grating and diffractive element design

physics/optics|waves.title: Multiplane Fresnel hologram for 3D target patterns
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use a Fresnel-propagator GS loop over several axial target planes to design one phase mask. Compute per-plane efficiency, crosstalk and fidelity versus the number of planes and their spacing.
physics/optics|waves.area: Scalar grating and diffractive element design

physics/optics|waves.title: Direct binary search optimization of a binary phase hologram
physics/optics|waves.gist: Toggle pixels of a binary 0/π hologram, accepting flips that reduce the reconstruction error, with FFT-based error evaluation. Compute convergence and final efficiency and compare with thresholded GS.
physics/optics|waves.area: Scalar grating and diffractive element design

physics/optics|waves.title: Lohmann detour-phase binary amplitude computer-generated hologram
physics/optics|waves.gist: Encode a complex Fourier field into binary cells whose aperture size and offset encode amplitude and phase. Reconstruct by FFT and compute the efficiency and the phase-quantization noise.
physics/optics|waves.area: Scalar grating and diffractive element design

physics/optics|waves.title: Speckle reduction by time-averaging independent GS holograms
physics/optics|waves.gist: Generate M phase holograms from random initial phases for the same target and average the reconstructed intensities. Compute the speckle contrast versus M and compare it with the 1/√M law.
physics/optics|waves.area: Scalar grating and diffractive element design

physics/optics|waves.title: Toraldo annular phase pupil filter for sub-diffraction focal spots
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the focal intensity of a pupil with concentric π-phase annuli using Hankel-transform scalar diffraction. Optimize the ring radii to shrink the central lobe and report the sidelobe and Strehl penalties.
physics/optics|waves.area: Scalar grating and diffractive element design

physics/optics|waves.title: Gas-filled capillary dispersion: tuning zero-dispersion wavelength with pressure
physics/optics|waves.gist: Combine the Marcatili–Schmeltzer waveguide contribution with argon Sellmeier dispersion scaled by pressure. Compute β2(λ) and the zero-dispersion wavelength versus pressure and core radius.

physics/optics|waves.title: Silicon strip waveguide dispersion engineering via effective-index method
physics/optics|waves.gist: Solve the slab dispersion equations twice (effective-index method) with silicon and silica Sellmeier indices. Compute neff(λ), the group index and the GVD, and find the widths that give anomalous dispersion at 1550 nm.

physics/optics|waves.title: Mid-span optical phase conjugation compensating dispersion and SPM
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate a pulse train with split-step NLSE through two fiber spans separated by spectral inversion (conjugation). Compute the residual distortion versus power-profile asymmetry from loss.

physics/optics|waves.title: Digital chromatic dispersion compensation FIR filter for coherent receivers
physics/optics|waves.gist: Design a time-domain FIR filter that approximates the inverse dispersion all-pass response, following Savory. Compute the required number of taps and the residual error versus accumulated dispersion and sampling rate.

physics/optics|waves.title: Time-lens temporal imaging: magnification by dispersion and quadratic phase
