physics/optics|waves.gist: Implement input dispersion, a quadratic temporal phase and output dispersion satisfying the temporal imaging condition, using FFT propagation. Compute the temporal magnification and resolution of a two-pulse waveform.

physics/optics|waves.title: Modulation phase-shift method: fiber dispersion from RF phase delay
physics/optics|waves.gist: Simulate RF phase delay versus wavelength of a modulated carrier through fiber with a Sellmeier-type delay. Fit a three-term Sellmeier group delay to extract D(λ), the zero-dispersion wavelength and the slope.

physics/optics|waves.title: Autocorrelation deconvolution errors for pulses with GDD and TOD
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute intensity autocorrelations via FFT of pulses carrying quadratic and cubic spectral phase. Quantify how the Gaussian or sech² deconvolution factor misestimates the true FWHM duration.

physics/optics|waves.title: Optimal launch power in an unrepeatered-span link via the Gaussian-noise model
physics/optics|waves.gist: Evaluate the GN-model nonlinear interference integral for Nyquist WDM channels with dispersion and loss. Combine it with ASE to compute the SNR versus launch power, the optimum power and the reach.

physics/optics|waves.title: Gap map versus hole radius for the triangular air-hole lattice
physics/optics|waves.gist: Sweep the hole radius in a PWE solver and extract the TE and TM gap edges from band extrema along the high-symmetry path. Find the radius maximizing the complete gap-midgap ratio.

physics/optics|waves.title: Equifrequency contours and self-collimation in a square rod lattice
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the second-band frequency on a full 2D k-grid with PWE and extract equifrequency contours. Identify the flat-contour self-collimation frequency and the group-velocity directions.

physics/optics|waves.title: Ho versus direct Fourier factorization rules in high-contrast PWE
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compare TE band convergence for the inverse-of-ε-matrix versus the inverted-ε-coefficient factorizations with increasing plane-wave count. Quantify the error against a well-converged reference.

physics/optics|waves.title: Photonic density of states of a 2D crystal via Brillouin-zone sampling
physics/optics|waves.gist: Sample PWE eigenfrequencies over the irreducible Brillouin zone and histogram them with Gaussian broadening or linear tetrahedron interpolation. Compute the DOS, gap edges and the van Hove features.

physics/optics|waves.title: Tunable band gap of a liquid-crystal-infiltrated photonic crystal by PWE
physics/optics|waves.gist: Solve PWE with an anisotropic director-dependent permittivity in the infiltrated holes. Compute the TE/TM gap shifts as the nematic director rotates.

physics/optics|waves.title: Dodecagonal photonic quasicrystal gap via periodic approximant supercell PWE
physics/optics|waves.gist: Generate a 12-fold quasicrystal approximant tiling of rods in a large supercell and compute TM eigenfrequencies by PWE at Γ. Locate the isotropic band gap and its dependence on rod radius.

physics/optics|waves.title: Scintillation index of a Gaussian beam in weak Kolmogorov turbulence
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate beams through multiple random FFT phase screens with the angular-spectrum method. Compute the on-axis scintillation index versus Rytov variance and compare with weak-fluctuation theory.

physics/optics|waves.title: Fractional Fourier transform as Gaussian-beam propagation and Wigner rotation
physics/optics|waves.gist: Implement a discrete fractional Fourier transform and relate the fractional order to the Gouy phase of free-space propagation. Verify the rotation of the Wigner distribution of a test field.

physics/optics|waves.title: Intracavity SHG in a Nd:YVO4/LBO laser: optimum nonlinear coupling
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use Smith's intracavity doubling model, with gain saturation and the nonlinear output coupling K·P, to solve the steady-state rate equations. Find the K that maximizes green output power and compare it with the optimum linear output coupling from Rigrod theory.

physics/optics|waves.title: Resonant external enhancement cavity for frequency doubling with impedance matching
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model a bow-tie doubling cavity in which the single-pass SHG loss depends on the circulating power. Solve self-consistently for circulating power, solve for the impedance-matched input coupler reflectivity, and compute overall conversion efficiency versus input power.

physics/optics|waves.title: Thermal dephasing in high-power PPLN SHG from green absorption heating
physics/optics|waves.gist: Couple the SHG coupled-wave equations to a longitudinal temperature profile driven by absorption of the fundamental and SH light, using thermo-optic Sellmeier dispersion. Compute the distorted, shifted temperature-tuning curve and the roll-over of efficiency with pump power.

physics/optics|waves.title: Adiabatic sum-frequency conversion in a chirped-poling crystal
physics/optics|waves.gist: Integrate the undepleted-pump SFG coupled equations with a linearly varying phase mismatch Δk(z), mapped onto a two-level Landau–Zener problem. Show near-unity broadband conversion efficiency when the adiabaticity condition holds, and show its failure when it is violated.

physics/optics|waves.title: Type-II SHG in KTP versus input polarization angle with pump depletion
physics/optics|waves.gist: Integrate the three-wave type-II coupled equations for the o and e fundamental components and the SH field, starting from a linearly polarized input at angle θ. Map conversion efficiency versus θ and intensity, and show that 45° is optimal only at low drive.

physics/optics|waves.title: Nonlinear Čerenkov and Raman–Nath SHG in hexagonally poled LiTaO3
physics/optics|waves.gist: Build the 2D reciprocal lattice of a hexagonally poled χ(2) crystal and compute its Fourier coefficients for circular domains. Find the noncollinear QPM output angles and relative SH intensities of each reciprocal vector versus wavelength.

physics/optics|waves.title: Normalized SHG efficiency of a PPLN ridge waveguide from mode overlap
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the fundamental and SH guided modes of a rectangular LN waveguide with the effective-index method, then evaluate the nonlinear overlap integral and effective area. Report the normalized efficiency in %/W/cm² and its dependence on waveguide width.

physics/optics|waves.title: Seeded SHG: phase-sensitive energy flow from the Armstrong solution
physics/optics|waves.gist: Integrate the phase-matched SHG equations with a nonzero input SH seed and a chosen relative phase φ. Show conversion or back-conversion depending on φ, and compare with the analytic Jacobi-elliptic (Armstrong) solution.

physics/optics|waves.title: SHG-FROG trace generation and principal-component generalized projections retrieval
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the SHG-FROG spectrogram of a pulse with GDD and TOD using FFTs. Reconstruct the field with the PCGPA algorithm and quantify the FROG error and the recovered spectral phase.

physics/optics|waves.title: Quantum-dot g2(0) with background light and detector timing jitter
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model the antibunched g2(τ) of a single emitter with an uncorrelated Poissonian background fraction, then convolve it with a Gaussian instrument response. Recover the intrinsic g2(0) by fitting and show how jitter masks antibunching.

physics/optics|waves.title: Photon statistics of superposed coherent and thermal light
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute P(n) for a coherent-plus-thermal field from the Laguerre-polynomial formula and verify it by numerically convolving the Glauber–Sudarshan P distributions. Evaluate g2(0) and Mandel Q versus the signal-to-thermal ratio.

physics/optics|waves.title: Squeezed-vacuum-injected Mach–Zehnder interferometer: sub-shot-noise phase sensitivity under loss
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate covariance matrices through a Mach–Zehnder with a coherent state in one port and squeezed vacuum in the other, including internal and detection losses. Compute phase sensitivity versus squeezing parameter and find the optimal squeezing under loss.

physics/optics|waves.title: Maximum-likelihood RρR tomography of a single-mode state from homodyne data
physics/optics|waves.gist: Simulate homodyne quadrature samples of a photon-added or Fock-superposition state at many phases using Hermite-function projectors. Reconstruct the density matrix with Lvovsky's iterative RρR algorithm and report the fidelity versus number of samples.

physics/optics|waves.title: Franson interferometer two-photon visibility with finite pump coherence
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute coincidence rates of energy-time entangled photon pairs in two unbalanced Mach–Zehnders by integrating over the joint spectral amplitude. Obtain fringe visibility versus imbalance mismatch and pump coherence time.

physics/optics|waves.title: Two-photon NOON state phase super-resolution after HOM interference
physics/optics|waves.gist: Generate |2,0⟩+|0,2⟩ by sending |1,1⟩ through a beam splitter, apply a phase φ and recombine the paths. Compute the coincidence probability versus φ, showing the doubled fringe frequency and how distinguishability or loss degrades visibility.

physics/optics|waves.title: Multi-oscillator fit of α-quartz IR reflectance and the Lyddane–Sachs–Teller relation
physics/optics|waves.gist: Fit TO/LO phonon factorized dielectric functions to synthetic reststrahlen reflectance using nonlinear least squares. Check the generalized LST relation ε(0)/ε∞ = Π(ωLO/ωTO)².

physics/optics|waves.title: Refractive index of air from Edlén formula and Lorentz–Lorenz mixing
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the dispersion of dry air and water vapor with Edlén/Ciddor-type formulas. Combine them through the Lorentz–Lorenz density scaling to get n versus wavelength, pressure, temperature and humidity, and the resulting distance-measurement error of a laser interferometer.

physics/optics|waves.title: Graphene Kubo conductivity: interband absorption step and Kramers–Kronig reactive part
physics/optics|waves.gist: Evaluate intraband and interband Kubo conductivity of graphene versus chemical potential and temperature by numerical integration. Verify the KK relation between Re σ and Im σ, and compute the transmittance of a suspended sheet.

physics/optics|waves.title: Gold nanodisk resonances with the Kuwata modified long-wavelength approximation
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model gold nanodisks as oblate spheroids and add Kuwata's empirical retardation and radiative-damping corrections to the quasistatic polarizability. Compute the in-plane plasmon peak versus diameter and thickness.

physics/optics|waves.title: UV plasmon of aluminum nanospheres with native oxide shell
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the coated-sphere quasistatic and Mie extinction of Al/Al2O3 core-shell particles using Drude–Lorentz aluminum. Track how oxide thickness red-shifts and damps the UV resonance.

physics/optics|waves.title: Infrared LSPR of doped semiconductor nanocrystals versus carrier density
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use a Drude model with ionized-impurity damping for ITO or Cu2−xS nanocrystals in quasistatic sphere theory. Compute the LSPR position and linewidth versus free-carrier density, and invert a measured peak to estimate the density.

physics/optics|waves.title: Inhomogeneous broadening of polydisperse gold nanorod ensembles
physics/optics|waves.gist: Average Gans-theory spheroid absorption over a log-normal aspect-ratio distribution and random orientation. Compute the ensemble extinction width versus distribution width, then deconvolve to estimate the single-particle linewidth.

physics/optics|waves.title: Lightning-rod field enhancement at the apex of a gold prolate spheroid
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the quasistatic depolarization factor and the field at the tip of a prolate spheroid from the analytic spheroidal solution. Map |E/E0|² at the apex versus aspect ratio and wavelength.

physics/optics|waves.title: Plasmon quality factor and dephasing time across Ag, Au, Al and Cu
physics/optics|waves.gist: From tabulated-style Drude–Lorentz permittivities, evaluate the quasistatic plasmon quality factor Q = ω(dε'/dω)/(2ε'') and the corresponding T2 along the Fröhlich condition for different embedding media. Rank the metals by spectral region.

physics/optics|waves.title: Triaxial ellipsoid nanoparticle: three plasmon resonances from depolarization integrals
physics/optics|waves.gist: Numerically integrate the Carlson-form depolarization factors L1, L2, L3 of a general silver ellipsoid. Compute polarization-resolved and orientation-averaged absorption spectra showing three resonances.

physics/optics|waves.title: Near-field versus far-field peak offset of gold sphere resonances in Mie theory
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute far-field extinction and near-surface |E|² spectra of gold spheres from Mie multipoles. Quantify the redshift of the near-field peak relative to extinction versus radius and connect it to damped-oscillator phase.

physics/optics|waves.title: Colloidal gold color: CIE chromaticity from Mie extinction versus particle size
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute Mie extinction spectra of gold colloids of different radii and concentrations, then apply Beer–Lambert transmission under a D65 illuminant. Integrate with CIE color-matching functions to get xy chromaticity and sRGB color.

physics/optics|waves.title: Fully developed speckle from an FFT-propagated random phase screen
physics/optics|waves.gist: Generate a rough-surface field with uniform random phases inside a finite pupil and propagate it to the far field by FFT. Verify the negative-exponential intensity PDF, unit contrast and circular-Gaussian field statistics.

physics/optics|waves.title: Speckle grain size: intensity autocorrelation versus aperture diameter
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the speckle intensity autocorrelation through an FFT imaging system with a circular pupil. Compare it with the Airy-squared prediction 1+|2J1(x)/x|² and with the λz/D scaling of the grain size.

physics/optics|waves.title: Partially developed speckle from weakly rough surfaces: contrast versus σh/λ
physics/optics|waves.gist: Simulate reflection from Gaussian-correlated surfaces of RMS height σh. Compute speckle contrast versus σh/λ and the transition from specular to fully developed speckle, using the analytic characteristic-function result as reference.

physics/optics|waves.title: Pixel-integrated speckle: gamma-density statistics and degrees of freedom M
physics/optics|waves.gist: Integrate simulated speckle over square detector pixels of varying size. Fit the integrated-intensity PDF to a gamma distribution and compare the fitted M with Goodman's correlation-area formula.

physics/optics|waves.title: Longitudinal speckle correlation length along the propagation axis
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate a speckle field with angular-spectrum steps and compute the axial intensity correlation. Compare its decorrelation length with the ~λ(z/D)² theory for a circular diffuser aperture.

physics/optics|waves.title: Angular memory effect of speckle through a thick diffuser
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model a diffuser as several phase screens separated by angular-spectrum propagation. Compute the correlation between speckle patterns for tilted inputs and compare the decay with the Feng–Kane–Lee–Stone memory-effect curve versus thickness.

physics/optics|waves.title: Labeyrie speckle interferometry of a binary star through Kolmogorov turbulence
physics/optics|waves.gist: Simulate short-exposure images of a binary star through random Kolmogorov phase screens. Average the image power spectra and correct with a point-source reference to recover the binary separation and brightness ratio beyond the seeing limit.

physics/optics|waves.title: Speckle plus coherent background: modified Rician intensity statistics
physics/optics|waves.gist: Add a uniform coherent field to simulated fully developed speckle. Verify the modified Rician intensity PDF and compute contrast versus beam-to-speckle intensity ratio.

physics/optics|waves.title: Multimode-fiber speckle wavemeter: spectral speckle correlation and wavelength retrieval
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model fiber output speckle as a random superposition of modes with dispersive propagation constants. Compute the spectral correlation width versus fiber length, and reconstruct an unknown wavelength from a calibrated transmission matrix by least squares.

physics/optics|waves.title: Split-ring resonator effective permeability from Pendry's circuit model
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute μeff(ω) of a split-ring-resonator array from its geometry (ring radius, gap, lattice constant, resistance) using Pendry's formula. Find the resonance, the negative-μ band and its sensitivity to ohmic loss.

physics/optics|waves.title: Thin-wire medium plasma frequency and spatial dispersion
physics/optics|waves.gist: Evaluate Pendry's effective plasma frequency for a square lattice of thin metal wires. Add Belov's spatially dispersive permittivity and compute the TM dispersion relation and oblique-incidence slab transmission.

physics/optics|waves.title: S-parameter retrieval of effective ε and μ with branch selection
physics/optics|waves.gist: From the complex reflection and transmission of a metamaterial slab, retrieve n, z, ε and μ using the Smith/Chen inversion. Choose branches by continuity and Re z > 0, and validate the procedure on a synthetic Lorentz slab.

physics/optics|waves.title: Anisotropic Maxwell Garnett tensor for aligned spheroidal inclusions
physics/optics|waves.gist: Generalize Maxwell Garnett to aligned ellipsoids via depolarization factors to get the uniaxial effective permittivity tensor. Compute form birefringence and dichroism for silver nanorods in glass versus fill fraction.

physics/optics|waves.title: Chiral Pasteur-medium slab: optical activity and chirality-induced negative index
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model a chiral medium with Condon-type chirality κ(ω) and solve slab transmission for circular eigenpolarizations. Compute rotation angle, circular dichroism and the negative index of one circular polarization.

physics/optics|waves.title: Wiener and Hashin–Shtrikman bounds on complex effective permittivity
physics/optics|waves.gist: For a two-phase metal–dielectric composite, compute the Wiener and Bergman–Milton/Hashin–Shtrikman bounding arcs in the complex ε plane. Check that Maxwell Garnett and Bruggeman values fall inside.

physics/optics|waves.title: Hamiltonian ray tracing through a Pendry cylindrical invisibility cloak
physics/optics|waves.gist: Integrate the anisotropic-medium ray Hamiltonian for the coordinate-transformation cylindrical cloak. Verify that rays bend around the core and exit undeviated, and quantify deviation for simplified reduced parameters.

physics/optics|waves.title: Lewin model: negative permeability from Mie resonances of dielectric spheres
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use Lewin's effective-medium formula with the first magnetic Mie coefficient for an array of high-index spheres to compute μeff and εeff. Identify frequency bands where both are negative.

physics/optics|waves.title: PEC cylinder near field, surface current and creeping waves
physics/optics|waves.gist: Sum the series solution for a perfectly conducting cylinder to obtain the total near field and surface current for TM and TE. Show the shadow region, the exponential decay of creeping waves and series convergence versus ka.

physics/optics|waves.title: Oblique-incidence scattering by a dielectric fiber and cross-polarization coupling
physics/optics|waves.gist: Implement the Bohren–Huffman oblique-incidence cylinder coefficients, which couple TE and TM. Compute depolarized scattering and efficiencies versus tilt angle.

physics/optics|waves.title: Silver nanowire transverse plasmon: quasistatic ε = −1 versus full series
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the absorption and scattering cross sections per unit length of a silver nanowire under TE illumination from the exact series. Compare with the quasistatic cylinder resonance condition ε = −εm versus radius.

physics/optics|waves.title: Radiation pressure on a dielectric fiber from the cylinder series
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the force per unit length on a cylinder from the extinction and asymmetry-weighted scattering, using the scattered-field coefficients. Cross-check with a Maxwell stress-tensor integration on a circle around the fiber.

physics/optics|waves.title: Optical-fiber diameter monitoring from far-field scattering fringes
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the angular scattered intensity of a silica fiber illuminated at normal incidence. Extract the fringe period and compare it with the geometric-optics reflection/refraction interference formula used for online diameter gauging.

physics/optics|waves.title: Periodic row of dielectric cylinders: multipole lattice sums and reflectance
physics/optics|waves.gist: Solve scattering by an infinite periodic grating of cylinders with Twersky lattice sums and a multipole T-matrix. Compute zeroth-order reflectance spectra and the guided-resonance Fano features.

physics/optics|waves.title: Nighttime radiative cooling with angle-dependent atmospheric emissivity
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model atmospheric emissivity with an angular dependence ε(θ) = 1 − t^(1/cosθ) and a spectral window. Integrate Planck radiation over angle and wavelength to find the equilibrium sub-ambient temperature of selective and broadband emitters versus convective coefficient.
physics/optics|waves.area: Thermal radiation and emissivity of structures

physics/optics|waves.title: Blackbody band fractions and total emittance of a spectrally selective surface
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute F(0→λT) by series and by quadrature. Use them to obtain total emittance and solar absorptance of a two-band step-emissivity surface and its equilibrium temperature in sunlight.
physics/optics|waves.area: Thermal radiation and emissivity of structures

physics/optics|waves.title: Luminous efficacy of a tungsten filament with an IR-recycling multilayer mirror
physics/optics|waves.gist: Combine tungsten spectral emissivity with Planck's law and the photopic V(λ) curve to get efficacy. Then add a TiO2/SiO2 transfer-matrix cold mirror that reflects IR back to the filament and compute the efficacy gain with a view factor.
physics/optics|waves.area: Thermal radiation and emissivity of structures

physics/optics|waves.title: SiO2-microsphere polymer composite emissivity for radiative cooling
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the Mie absorption and scattering of silica microspheres near their phonon resonances and combine them with a polymer matrix through independent-scattering two-flux theory. Obtain IR emissivity and net cooling power versus sphere size and loading.
physics/optics|waves.area: Thermal radiation and emissivity of structures

physics/optics|waves.title: Thermal emissivity of a heavily doped silicon film via Drude transfer matrix
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model doped Si with a Drude permittivity versus carrier density and compute normal and hemispherical emissivity of a film on a substrate with the transfer matrix. Use Kirchhoff's law to find the doping that maximizes mid-IR emission.
physics/optics|waves.area: Thermal radiation and emissivity of structures

physics/optics|waves.title: Thermal emission of a SiC microsphere: super-Planckian absorption efficiency
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the Mie absorption efficiency of SiC spheres around the reststrahlen band and multiply by Planck's law to get emitted power. Show Qabs > 1 at surface-phonon resonances and evaluate total emission relative to a blackbody of the same area.
physics/optics|waves.area: Thermal radiation and emissivity of structures

physics/optics|waves.title: Transport-of-intensity phase retrieval with an FFT Poisson solver
physics/optics|waves.gist: Simulate intensities at three defocus planes by angular-spectrum propagation and form the axial intensity derivative. Solve the TIE with FFT-based inverse Laplacians and quantify phase error versus defocus step and noise.

physics/optics|waves.title: Extended ptychographic iterative engine: joint object and probe reconstruction
physics/optics|waves.gist: Simulate far-field diffraction patterns from overlapping probe positions on a complex object. Run ePIE to reconstruct both object and probe and report error versus overlap fraction.

physics/optics|waves.title: Fourier ptychographic microscopy with an LED array
physics/optics|waves.gist: Simulate low-NA images of a thin complex sample under tilted plane-wave illumination, which shifts the spectrum within the pupil. Stitch a high-resolution complex spectrum by alternating projections and measure the synthetic-NA resolution gain.

physics/optics|waves.title: Off-axis digital holography: sideband filtering, reconstruction and autofocus
physics/optics|waves.gist: Record a simulated off-axis hologram, isolate the +1 sideband by FFT filtering and propagate it with the angular spectrum. Find the in-focus plane with a sharpness metric and unwrap the recovered phase.

physics/optics|waves.title: Multi-distance single-beam phase retrieval by angular-spectrum projections
physics/optics|waves.gist: From intensity measurements at several propagation distances, iteratively propagate the field and impose the measured amplitudes. Reconstruct the phase of a test wavefront and study convergence versus number and spacing of planes.

physics/optics|waves.title: Gerchberg–Papoulis band-limited extrapolation for spectral super-resolution
physics/optics|waves.gist: Recover a band-limited signal from a truncated observation window by alternating projection between time-limiting and band-limiting constraints. Measure extrapolation accuracy versus noise and the space–bandwidth product.

physics/optics|waves.title: Kramers–Kronig holography: single-shot phase from intensity with a strong reference
physics/optics|waves.gist: With a reference wave chosen to make the field analytic (minimum-phase), recover the sample phase from one intensity image via a log-Hilbert transform. Compare with the off-axis method and test failure when the KK condition is violated.

physics/optics|waves.title: SPIDER spectral phase retrieval from a sheared spectral interferogram
physics/optics|waves.gist: Simulate a SPIDER interferogram of a chirped pulse with spectral shear Ω. Extract the phase difference by Fourier filtering and concatenate to reconstruct the spectral phase, GDD and TOD.

physics/optics|waves.title: Nonlinear polarization rotation mode locking: power-dependent transmission and pulse shaping
physics/optics|waves.gist: Solve the coupled Kerr equations for two orthogonal polarizations in a birefringent fiber, followed by a polarizer, to obtain the artificial saturable-absorber transfer function. Iterate a round-trip map to show pulse shortening and overdriving.

physics/optics|waves.title: Mamyshev oscillator: SPM regeneration between two offset spectral filters
physics/optics|waves.gist: Iterate a two-arm fiber-oscillator map of SPM, dispersion and gain with offset Gaussian filters, using split-step Fourier propagation. Find the self-starting threshold, output pulse energy and duration versus filter offset.

physics/optics|waves.title: Delay-differential Vladimirov–Turaev model of a passively mode-locked semiconductor laser
physics/optics|waves.gist: Integrate the delay-differential equations for a ring laser with gain and absorber sections. Map fundamental, harmonic and Q-switched mode-locking regimes versus pump current and absorber bias.

physics/optics|waves.title: Single-pass pulse shortening and energy transmission by a slow saturable absorber
physics/optics|waves.gist: Integrate the absorber rate equation along the pulse for a Gaussian input to obtain fluence transmission (Frantz–Nodvik absorber form). Compute pulse-width reduction and leading-edge steepening versus fluence relative to saturation.

physics/optics|waves.title: FM mode locking with an intracavity phase modulator: chirped Gaussian pulses
physics/optics|waves.gist: Apply Kuizenga–Siegman analysis to phase modulation to obtain chirped Gaussian steady-state pulses. Verify by iterating a round-trip map with gain filtering, and compare widths with AM mode locking.

physics/optics|waves.title: SESAM nonlinear reflectivity with two-photon induced absorption: parameter fitting
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model the fluence-dependent reflectivity of a SESAM with saturable and induced (TPA) absorption by integrating over a Gaussian pulse. Fit the saturation fluence, modulation depth and roll-over parameter from synthetic data.

physics/optics|waves.title: Rainbow from a water droplet: Descartes rays versus Airy theory
physics/optics|waves.gist: Trace rays through a sphere to obtain the primary and secondary rainbow angles and their dispersion with water's Sellmeier index. Compute the Airy-integral intensity profile with supernumerary bows versus droplet size.

physics/optics|waves.title: Airy beam propagation: self-acceleration and self-healing by angular spectrum
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate a finite-energy Airy beam with angular-spectrum FFTs and track its parabolic peak trajectory against theory. Block the main lobe and quantify how the beam profile reforms with propagation distance.

physics/optics|waves.title: 4f pulse shaper with pixelated spatial light modulator: replicas and smoothing
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model a Fourier-plane pulse shaper with finite pixel size and gaps applying a programmed spectral phase. Compute output pulses by FFT, showing time-domain replica pulses and finite spot-size smoothing of the phase mask.

physics/optics|waves.title: Radially polarized beam at high NA: Richards–Wolf longitudinal focal spot
physics/optics|waves.gist: Evaluate Richards–Wolf vector diffraction integrals for radially and linearly polarized pupils at NA 0.9–0.95 by quadrature. Compare the longitudinal and transverse focal intensity components and the FWHM spot areas.

physics/optics|waves.title: Confocal microscope PSF versus pinhole diameter: lateral resolution and optical sectioning
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model the confocal PSF as the excitation PSF times the detection PSF convolved with the pinhole, using paraxial defocused pupils and FFTs. Compute lateral FWHM and the axial planar-reflector response as functions of pinhole size in Airy units.

physics/optics|waves.title: 3D widefield OTF and the missing cone from a through-focus PSF stack
physics/optics|waves.gist: Build a 3D incoherent PSF by FFT propagation of a defocused circular pupil over many planes, then take the 3D FFT to get the 3D OTF. Measure the axial support and the missing-cone region, and compare with the analytic Ewald-cap autocorrelation boundary.

physics/optics|waves.title: Slanted-edge MTF measurement from an oversampled edge-spread function
physics/optics|waves.gist: Simulate a pixelated image of a slightly tilted edge blurred by a known diffraction-plus-defocus PSF. Bin the pixels by distance to the edge into a 4× oversampled ESF, differentiate to an LSF, Fourier transform to the MTF, and compare with the true system MTF.

physics/optics|waves.title: Charge-2 vortex coronagraph starlight rejection with a Lyot stop
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate an on-axis star through a focal-plane spiral phase mask and a Lyot stop using FFT Fourier-optics steps. Compute residual starlight, the contrast curve, and planet throughput versus Lyot-stop size and tip-tilt jitter.

physics/optics|waves.title: Mid-spatial-frequency mirror ripple: PSF satellite ghosts and Strehl loss
physics/optics|waves.gist: Add a sinusoidal surface ripple to a circular pupil and compute the FFT PSF. Compare satellite-peak positions and intensities with the Jacobi–Anger Bessel J_n predictions, and compare the Strehl ratio with J0² and the Maréchal formula.

physics/optics|waves.title: Polychromatic MTF of a singlet with longitudinal chromatic aberration
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use Sellmeier dispersion to get the wavelength-dependent defocus of a BK7 singlet. Compute monochromatic MTFs by pupil autocorrelation and weight them by a detector-times-source spectrum to find the polychromatic MTF and the best-focus plane.

physics/optics|waves.title: Structured illumination microscopy: three-phase Wiener reconstruction and OTF support doubling
physics/optics|waves.gist: Simulate widefield images under sinusoidal illumination at three phases and three orientations. Separate the shifted spectral bands by solving the phase-mixing matrix, then recombine them with a generalized Wiener filter to show the extended OTF support and resolution gain.

physics/optics|waves.title: Gabor in-line hologram: twin-image artifact and iterative support-constrained removal
physics/optics|waves.gist: Record an in-line hologram of a weakly absorbing object by angular-spectrum propagation. Backpropagate to show the twin image, then remove it by alternating projections that use an object-support and absorption constraint, and quantify reconstruction error versus iteration.

physics/optics|waves.title: Single-FFT Fresnel versus angular-spectrum hologram reconstruction: pixel scaling and validity
physics/optics|waves.gist: Reconstruct the same digital hologram with the one-FFT Fresnel transform (pixel size λz/NΔx) and with the convolution angular-spectrum method (fixed pixel). Determine the distance ranges where each method aliases or loses accuracy against a zero-padded reference.

physics/optics|waves.title: Digital holographic microscopy: numerical compensation of tilt and curvature phase aberrations
physics/optics|waves.gist: Simulate an off-axis DHM hologram of a phase cell whose reconstruction carries a residual carrier tilt and a spherical phase from the microscope objective. Fit and remove a low-order polynomial or Zernike background over object-free regions, and recover the quantitative optical thickness.

physics/optics|waves.title: Two-wavelength synthetic-wavelength holography for unwrapping steps beyond λ
physics/optics|waves.gist: Reconstruct phase maps of a stepped surface from holograms at two close wavelengths and form the synthetic-wavelength phase difference. Use it to resolve step heights beyond λ/2 and analyze how single-wavelength noise is amplified at the synthetic wavelength.

physics/optics|waves.title: In-line holographic 3D localization of point scatterers by backpropagation
physics/optics|waves.gist: Generate an in-line hologram of several point scatterers at different depths. Backpropagate it through a stack of z planes with the angular-spectrum method and locate each particle in 3D from intensity maxima or sharpness metrics, reporting axial localization error versus noise.

physics/optics|waves.title: Generalized phase-shifting holography with unknown reference phase steps
physics/optics|waves.gist: Record three or more interferograms with unknown phase shifts. Estimate the steps from the interferogram inner products (a Lai–Yatagai-type algorithm), reconstruct the complex object wave, and propagate it to focus, comparing the result with nominal-step reconstruction under step errors.

physics/optics|waves.title: Lensless Fourier-transform holography with a reference pinhole
physics/optics|waves.gist: Simulate far-field intensity from an object next to a small reference pinhole, as in X-ray FTH. Retrieve the object as a cross-correlation term by a single inverse FFT, and study resolution versus pinhole size and photon noise.

physics/optics|waves.title: Double-exposure holographic interferometry of a deformed plate
physics/optics|waves.gist: Reconstruct holograms of a plate before and after a known out-of-plane deflection and form the interference of the two reconstructed waves. Extract the deformation from fringe phase using sensitivity vectors for given illumination and observation directions.

physics/optics|waves.title: Parametric-resonance modulation instability in a dispersion-oscillating fiber
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate a CW pump with noise through a fiber whose β2 oscillates periodically along z. Compute the multiple MI sideband frequencies and gains with a Floquet linear-stability analysis, and compare them with split-step Fourier spectra.

physics/optics|waves.title: Optical shock formation from self-steepening in a dispersionless Kerr fiber
physics/optics|waves.gist: Integrate the NLSE with a self-steepening term by split-step Fourier and track the trailing-edge steepening of a Gaussian pulse. Find the numerical shock distance and compare it with the analytic z_s ≈ 0.39 L_NL/s.

physics/optics|waves.title: Fundamental soliton in lossy fiber: adiabatic broadening versus perturbation theory
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate a sech soliton through fiber with linear loss using split-step Fourier. Compare width and peak evolution with the perturbative prediction T(z) = T0 exp(2αz) and with linear dispersive broadening at large loss.

physics/optics|waves.title: Gordon–Mollenauer nonlinear phase noise in an amplified soliton/CW link
physics/optics|waves.gist: Run Monte Carlo split-step NLSE simulations of a multi-span link with ASE noise added at each amplifier. Compute the received phase variance and the nonlinear phase noise contribution versus launch power, and compare with the Gordon–Mollenauer formula.

physics/optics|waves.title: Fermi–Pasta–Ulam recurrence of seeded modulation instability
physics/optics|waves.gist: Seed a CW pump with weak symmetric sidebands and integrate the NLSE. Track pump and sideband power through repeated conversion–reversion cycles, and measure recurrence distance and phase shift versus modulation frequency, comparing with three-wave truncation.

physics/optics|waves.title: Pure-quartic solitons in fiber with dominant negative fourth-order dispersion
physics/optics|waves.gist: Find the stationary pulse of an NLSE with only β4 dispersion by Petviashvili iteration in Fourier space. Characterize its oscillating tails and energy–width scaling, and check propagation stability with split-step Fourier.

physics/optics|waves.title: Adaptive step-size split-step Fourier via the local-error method
physics/optics|waves.gist: Implement Sinkin's local-error method with step doubling and Richardson extrapolation for the NLSE. Benchmark accuracy against step count for higher-order soliton and supercontinuum-like inputs, and compare with fixed-step and nonlinear-phase-rotation step control.

physics/optics|waves.title: Stimulated Raman scattering in fiber: Stokes pulse growth with group-velocity walk-off
physics/optics|waves.gist: Integrate coupled pump and Stokes envelope equations with Raman gain, SPM/XPM and walk-off by split-step Fourier. Compute Stokes conversion efficiency versus fiber length and compare with the walk-off length and Smith's critical-power estimate.

physics/optics|waves.title: FFT Kolmogorov and von Kármán phase screens with subharmonic compensation
physics/optics|waves.gist: Generate phase screens by filtering complex white noise with the von Kármán spectrum, adding Lane-type subharmonics. Verify the ensemble phase structure function against 6.88(r/r0)^{5/3}, and quantify the low-frequency deficit without subharmonics.

physics/optics|waves.title: Scintillation saturation of a plane wave in strong turbulence
physics/optics|waves.gist: Run multi-screen split-step simulations of plane-wave propagation over increasing Rytov variance. Show how the scintillation index rises, peaks above unity and saturates, and compare with Andrews–Phillips strong-fluctuation expressions.

physics/optics|waves.title: Short-exposure tilt-removed Strehl and image width versus D/r0
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute instantaneous PSFs from apertures over Kolmogorov phase screens, with and without removing the Zernike tip-tilt. Obtain long- and short-exposure Strehl ratios and FWHM versus D/r0, and compare with Fried's short-exposure OTF.

physics/optics|waves.title: Isoplanatic angle from a Hufnagel–Valley Cn² profile and anisoplanatic Strehl
physics/optics|waves.gist: Integrate a Hufnagel–Valley Cn²(h) profile to get r0 and θ0. Then build layered phase screens and compute the Strehl of an on-axis-corrected wavefront at off-axis angles, comparing with exp[-(θ/θ0)^{5/3}].

physics/optics|waves.title: Infinitely extended phase screens by covariance-based row extrusion
physics/optics|waves.gist: Implement the Assémat method that extends a von Kármán phase screen row by row from conditional Gaussian statistics. Verify stationarity of the structure function along the extruded direction and use it for frozen-flow time series.

physics/optics|waves.title: Directly modulated laser two-tone intermodulation distortion for analog links
physics/optics|waves.gist: Drive single-mode rate equations with two closely spaced RF tones. Extract fundamental, second-harmonic and third-order intermodulation powers from output FFTs, and compute the spurious-free dynamic range versus modulation frequency near the relaxation resonance.

physics/optics|waves.title: Quantum-well gain spectrum from Fermi–Dirac inversion and logarithmic gain fit
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute TE material gain of a parabolic-band quantum well from the step-like 2D density of states, quasi-Fermi levels set by carrier density, and Lorentzian intraband broadening. Extract transparency density and fit peak gain to g0 ln(N/Ntr).

physics/optics|waves.title: Period-one oscillation of an optically injected diode laser: microwave frequency tuning
physics/optics|waves.gist: Integrate injected-laser rate equations with α-factor outside the stable locking region. Identify the period-one regime, and map its oscillation frequency and sideband ratio versus injection strength and detuning.

physics/optics|waves.title: Quantum cascade laser three-level rate equations: overdamped modulation response
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model a QCL with picosecond upper and lower subband lifetimes and photon lifetime in three-level rate equations. Compute threshold current, L-I slope and small-signal modulation response, showing the absence of relaxation-oscillation peaking.

physics/optics|waves.title: Injection-seeded Q-switched laser: build-up time reduction and seeded-mode selection
physics/optics|waves.gist: Integrate multimode Q-switched rate equations with a weak injected seed in one longitudinal mode. Compute pulse build-up time versus seed power and the seeded-mode energy fraction relative to free-running modes.

physics/optics|waves.title: Ground-state Hanle effect: zero-field magneto-optical resonance width
physics/optics|waves.gist: Solve density-matrix Bloch equations for an F=1→F'=0 system with a transverse magnetic field and ground-state relaxation. Compute fluorescence or transmission versus B, and its Lorentzian width versus light intensity.
physics/optics|waves.area: Optical Bloch equations and atom-light interaction

physics/optics|waves.title: Two-photon Raman transition: adiabatic elimination versus full three-level dynamics
physics/optics|waves.gist: Integrate the full Λ-system Schrödinger or Bloch equations with large single-photon detuning. Compare the effective two-photon Rabi frequency, differential light shift and spontaneous-scattering loss with the adiabatically eliminated two-level model.
physics/optics|waves.area: Optical Bloch equations and atom-light interaction

physics/optics|waves.title: Bichromatic optical force on a two-level atom from Floquet-periodic Bloch equations
physics/optics|waves.gist: Integrate optical Bloch equations for counterpropagating bichromatic beams with detuning ±δ to periodic steady state. Compute the time-averaged force versus relative phase and velocity, and compare with the ħkδ/π bichromatic-force estimate.
physics/optics|waves.area: Optical Bloch equations and atom-light interaction

physics/optics|waves.title: Silica-core gold-shell nanorice: confocal coated-spheroid quasistatic resonances
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute longitudinal and transverse polarizabilities of a coated prolate spheroid from confocal depolarization factors and Johnson–Christy gold. Map plasmon wavelengths versus aspect ratio and shell thickness, and compare with solid gold rods.

physics/optics|waves.title: Magnetoplasmonic splitting of a metal-sphere LSPR in a static magnetic field
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use a gyrotropic Drude permittivity tensor for a small sphere to compute the quasistatic polarizability tensor. Extract the splitting of σ± resonances and the magneto-optical circular-dichroism spectrum versus B and damping.

physics/optics|waves.title: Gold nanosphere in a uniaxial liquid-crystal host: polarization-split plasmon
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the quasistatic polarizability of a sphere in an anisotropic host by coordinate scaling to an effective ellipsoid. Obtain ordinary and extraordinary LSPR wavelengths and their shift with director reorientation.

physics/optics|waves.title: Complete TE and TM band gap in a honeycomb-rod plus vein photonic crystal
physics/optics|waves.gist: Assemble PWE eigenproblems for TE and TM in a 2D structure of dielectric rods on a honeycomb lattice connected by veins. Scan geometry to find overlapping gaps, and report the complete-gap center and gap-to-midgap ratio along Γ–M–K.

physics/optics|waves.title: Rotated square-rod lattice: gap enlargement by symmetry reduction
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute TM and TE bands of a square lattice of square dielectric rods with analytic structure factors for the rotated square cross-section. Find the rotation angle that maximizes the absolute gap, and relate band-degeneracy lifting to the broken point-group symmetry.

physics/optics|waves.title: Full-vector PWE with out-of-plane wavevector for 2D photonic crystals
physics/optics|waves.gist: Implement full-vector magnetic-field PWE with kz ≠ 0, where TE and TM couple, for a triangular air-hole lattice. Track how gaps close as kz grows and find the light-line-confined region relevant to photonic-crystal fibers.

physics/optics|waves.title: Fried-geometry zonal least-squares reconstruction and the waffle mode
physics/optics|waves.gist: Build the Fried-geometry slope matrix for a square grid of actuators and subapertures. Compute the SVD to identify the unsensed piston and waffle modes, reconstruct Kolmogorov wavefronts by truncated pseudoinverse, and report residual RMS.

physics/optics|waves.title: Shack–Hartmann noise propagation coefficient versus number of subapertures
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the trace of (GᵀG)⁻¹ for least-squares zonal reconstructors on Fried and Southwell grids across sizes. Fit the logarithmic growth of reconstruction noise with subaperture count and check it by Monte Carlo with noisy slopes.

physics/optics|waves.title: Pyramid wavefront sensor slopes by Fourier optics and its optical gain
physics/optics|waves.gist: Simulate a four-faceted pyramid in the focal plane with FFT propagation to four pupil images and form slope signals. Compute sensitivity and linearity versus aberration amplitude and modulation radius, and compare its noise propagation with a Shack–Hartmann.

physics/optics|waves.title: Closed-loop AO integrator: rejection transfer function and servo-lag error
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model a discrete-time integrator AO loop with frame delay and compute rejection and noise transfer functions versus gain. Integrate a frozen-flow turbulence temporal PSD to get servo-lag variance and the optimal gain, and compare with Greenwood-frequency scaling.

physics/optics|waves.title: Shack–Hartmann centroiding: pixel sampling bias, thresholding and centroid gain
physics/optics|waves.gist: Generate diffraction-limited subaperture spots by FFT, pixelate them with noise, and estimate shifts by center of gravity, thresholded CoG and correlation. Compute bias, nonlinearity and noise versus spot sampling, then the effect on reconstructed Zernikes.

physics/optics|waves.title: Minimum-variance MAP reconstructor versus least squares in Shack–Hartmann AO
physics/optics|waves.gist: Build the MAP reconstructor from the Kolmogorov Zernike covariance (Noll) and slope-noise covariance. Compare its residual wavefront variance with truncated least squares across SNR, using Monte Carlo phase screens and a modal Shack–Hartmann interaction matrix.

physics/optics|waves.title: Laser guide star cone effect: focal anisoplanatism versus beacon altitude
physics/optics|waves.gist: For layered Cn² turbulence, sample phase screens along the converging cone from a sodium or Rayleigh beacon versus the cylinder from a natural star. Compute residual phase variance and Strehl versus beacon height, and compare with Fried's d0 parameter.

physics/optics|waves.title: Berreman-mode emissivity of an epsilon-near-zero ITO film on gold
physics/optics|waves.gist: A Drude ITO film on gold is modeled with an anisotropy-free transfer matrix. Compute the p- and s-polarized absorptance (emissivity, by Kirchhoff's law) versus angle and wavelength near the ENZ point, and locate the oblique-incidence Berreman peak and its angular width.
physics/optics|waves.area: Thermal radiation and emissivity of structures

physics/optics|waves.title: Layer-resolved thermal emission from a temperature-graded multilayer
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use transfer-matrix field profiles to get the absorption in each layer of a dielectric stack on a metal. Apply local Kirchhoff reciprocity, so each layer emits at its own temperature, and sum Planck-weighted contributions to get the spectral radiance of a non-isothermal stack.
physics/optics|waves.area: Thermal radiation and emissivity of structures

physics/optics|waves.title: Dual-band infrared camouflage multilayer with 5–8 μm radiative window
physics/optics|waves.gist: Design a Ge/ZnS/metal multilayer with low emissivity in the 3–5 and 8–14 μm atmospheric windows and high emissivity in 5–8 μm, using transfer matrices. Compute band-averaged emissivities, apparent radiance contrast and radiated power at 400 K.
physics/optics|waves.area: Thermal radiation and emissivity of structures

physics/optics|waves.title: Reststrahlen-band emissivity of a thin hyperbolic hBN film
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use an anisotropic (uniaxial) 4×4 or TE/TM transfer matrix for an hBN slab with two Lorentz phonon tensors on a gold substrate. Compute the angle-resolved emissivity in the type-I and type-II hyperbolic bands and its Planck-weighted hemispherical value.
physics/optics|waves.area: Thermal radiation and emissivity of structures

physics/optics|waves.title: Ultrathin freestanding metal film: 50% absorptance bound and optimal sheet resistance
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model a thin Drude metal film with the characteristic matrix and in the thin-sheet limit. Show that absorptance peaks at 50% when the sheet resistance equals half the free-space impedance, and compute the infrared emissivity versus thickness and temperature.
physics/optics|waves.area: Thermal radiation and emissivity of structures

physics/optics|waves.title: Band emissivity of an isothermal gas slab with an Elsasser line model
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model a periodic array of Lorentz lines (Elsasser band) and compute the band-averaged transmissivity analytically, using Bessel-function integrals, and numerically. Then integrate the slab emissivity against the Planck function to get total emissivity versus path length and pressure.

physics/optics|waves.title: Discrete-ordinates diffuse reflection of a Rayleigh-scattering atmosphere
physics/optics|waves.gist: Solve the azimuthally averaged radiative transfer equation for a finite Rayleigh slab using the discrete-ordinates eigenvalue method with Gauss quadrature. Compute the plane albedo, the angular reflected radiance and convergence with the number of streams.

physics/optics|waves.title: Polarized Monte Carlo depolarization of light in a Rayleigh suspension
physics/optics|waves.gist: Trace Stokes vectors through a suspension of Rayleigh scatterers using rotation and Rayleigh Mueller matrices with rejection-sampled scattering angles. Compute the degree of linear and circular polarization of backscattered light versus source-detector separation, and the depolarization lengths.

physics/optics|waves.title: Diffuse fluorescence from a buried fluorophore via coupled diffusion Green's functions
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model excitation and emission photon fluence with semi-infinite extrapolated-boundary diffusion Green's functions at two wavelengths. Integrate over a buried fluorescent inclusion to get the surface fluorescence profile versus depth, and the ratio of fluorescence to excitation reflectance.

physics/optics|waves.title: Small-angle radiative transfer: seawater beam spread and MTF
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use Wells' small-angle approximation, in which the medium MTF is exp of a path integral of the Fourier-transformed phase function. Compute the beam-spread function of a pencil beam in forward-peaked seawater scattering by inverse Hankel transform, plus the resulting imaging MTF versus range.

physics/optics|waves.title: Scattering width of a dielectric-coated PEC wire
physics/optics|waves.gist: Derive and solve the two-boundary Bessel-Hankel coefficient system for TM and TE plane-wave incidence on a PEC core with a dielectric coating. Compute the bistatic and backscattering widths versus coating thickness and permittivity.

physics/optics|waves.title: Nonreciprocal scattering by a magnetized ferrite cylinder
physics/optics|waves.gist: Expand the fields of a gyrotropic ferrite cylinder with Polder permeability tensor in Bessel functions, with coefficients coupled through ±n asymmetry. Compute the asymmetric bistatic scattering width and the lateral deflection of scattered power.

physics/optics|waves.title: Graphene-coated dielectric nanowire: tunable localized plasmon resonances
physics/optics|waves.gist: Impose the conductive-sheet boundary condition, with Kubo graphene conductivity, on the cylinder Bessel series for TM-polarized incidence. Compute scattering and absorption cross sections, dipole and quadrupole resonance wavelengths, and their dependence on Fermi level.

physics/optics|waves.title: Dielectric cylinder above a perfectly conducting plane via image multipoles
physics/optics|waves.gist: Represent the ground plane by an image cylinder and couple the multipole coefficients of cylinder and image using the Graf addition theorem. Compute the far-field scattering pattern versus height and compare with the isolated cylinder.

physics/optics|waves.title: Sommerfeld half-plane diffraction: exact solution versus Kirchhoff–Fresnel edge
physics/optics|waves.gist: Evaluate Sommerfeld's exact solution for E- and H-polarized plane waves on a PEC half-plane using Fresnel integrals. Compare the near-edge field and shadow-boundary fringes with the scalar Fresnel knife-edge (Cornu spiral) prediction.

physics/optics|waves.title: Wedge diffraction: Macdonald Bessel series versus GTD diffraction coefficient
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the total field around a PEC wedge of arbitrary angle from the fractional-order Bessel series for line-source or plane-wave illumination. Extract the edge-diffracted field and compare with Keller's GTD coefficient away from shadow boundaries.

physics/optics|waves.title: Gaussian-beam scattering by a dielectric fiber via angular-spectrum decomposition
physics/optics|waves.gist: Decompose a 2D focused Gaussian beam into plane waves and superpose the Bessel-series cylinder responses. Compute the scattering width and near-field intensity versus beam offset, and the transition to plane-wave results as the waist grows.

physics/optics|waves.title: Weighted Gerchberg–Saxton hologram for uniform holographic optical-tweezer arrays
physics/optics|waves.gist: Implement GS and weighted-GS (Di Leonardo) phase retrieval for an SLM generating N focal spots, using FFT or direct superposition. Compare efficiency and spot-intensity uniformity versus iteration and array size.
physics/optics|waves.area: Scalar grating and diffractive element design

physics/optics|waves.title: Double-phase encoding of complex fields on a phase-only modulator
physics/optics|waves.gist: Encode a complex target field, such as a Laguerre-Gauss mode, as interleaved pairs of phase-only pixels in a checkerboard. Low-pass filter in the Fourier plane, and compute the reconstruction fidelity, efficiency and the effect of filter size.
physics/optics|waves.area: Scalar grating and diffractive element design

physics/optics|waves.title: Fresnel zone plate: primary and higher-order foci and efficiencies
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate a plane wave through binary amplitude and phase zone plates with angular-spectrum or Hankel propagation. Locate the f/m foci, compute the order efficiencies (1/m²π² for amplitude), and the focal-spot width versus number of zones.
physics/optics|waves.area: Scalar grating and diffractive element design

physics/optics|waves.title: Photon sieve versus zone plate: sidelobe suppression by pinhole apodization
physics/optics|waves.gist: Build photon sieves with randomly placed pinholes on zone-plate rings and apodized pinhole densities. Compute the focal PSF by Fresnel propagation, and compare sidelobe level and peak efficiency with an equivalent zone plate.
physics/optics|waves.area: Scalar grating and diffractive element design

physics/optics|waves.title: SLM fringing-field crosstalk degradation of blazed phase gratings
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model the pixelated SLM phase convolved with a Gaussian fringing kernel and compute far-field diffraction efficiencies by FFT. Determine the first-order efficiency loss and the growth of ghost orders versus grating period in pixels.
physics/optics|waves.area: Scalar grating and diffractive element design

physics/optics|waves.title: High-contrast silicon grating broadband reflector
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use RCWA (TM) on a suspended silicon bar grating to find period, duty cycle and thickness giving R > 99% over a broad bandwidth. Compute the reflectance map and identify the two-mode interference mechanism.

physics/optics|waves.title: Extraordinary transmission through a 1D silver slit array
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use TM RCWA with correct Fourier factorization for a lamellar silver slit grating. Compute zero-order transmission versus wavelength and slit width, separating Fabry–Pérot slit-cavity modes from surface-plasmon/Rayleigh-anomaly features.

physics/optics|waves.title: Symmetry-protected bound states in the continuum in an asymmetric dielectric grating
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use RCWA on a dielectric grating whose unit cell contains two bars with a tunable width asymmetry. Fit Fano resonances to extract the Q factor, and show the inverse-square divergence of Q as the asymmetry goes to zero.

physics/optics|waves.title: Optical diffraction tomography via the Fourier diffraction theorem
physics/optics|waves.gist: Simulate holographic fields scattered by a weak 2D phantom under rotating plane-wave illumination, using a Born or Rytov forward model. Map field spectra onto Ewald arcs in k-space and invert to recover the refractive index, comparing the Born and Rytov reconstructions.

physics/optics|waves.title: Fresnel incoherent correlation holography (FINCH) of point sources
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model self-interference of each incoherent point's light split by two diffractive lenses, followed by three-step phase shifting. Reconstruct by Fresnel back-propagation and compute the lateral resolution gain and axial sectioning versus the lens configuration.

physics/optics|waves.title: Computer-generated Fresnel hologram of a 3D point cloud via wavefront-recording plane
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute a hologram of a 3D point object directly and through an intermediate wavefront-recording plane plus angular-spectrum propagation. Compare accuracy and runtime, and reconstruct depth slices to verify focus.

physics/optics|waves.title: Richardson–Lucy deconvolution of Poisson widefield images: convergence and noise amplification
physics/optics|waves.gist: Blur a fluorescence test object with an Airy or defocused OTF and add Poisson noise. Run FFT-based Richardson–Lucy, and track the error versus iteration, the optimal stopping point and noise amplification at different photon counts.

physics/optics|waves.title: Blind deconvolution of defocus blur by alternating Richardson–Lucy updates
physics/optics|waves.gist: Jointly estimate the object and an unknown PSF from a single blurred image using alternating multiplicative RL updates, with positivity and support constraints. Measure PSF recovery accuracy and the ambiguities.

physics/optics|waves.title: Tikhonov-regularized deconvolution with L-curve and GCV parameter selection
physics/optics|waves.gist: Solve Fourier-domain Tikhonov deconvolution with identity and gradient regularizers for a motion- or defocus-blurred image. Choose the regularization weight by L-curve curvature and generalized cross-validation, and compare with the oracle error.

physics/optics|waves.title: Hadamard single-pixel camera with compressive subsampling
physics/optics|waves.gist: Simulate bucket-detector measurements of an image using Walsh–Hadamard patterns. Reconstruct by fast inverse transform from the full and sequency-ordered subsampled sets, and by an l1/TV iterative solver, and report PSNR versus sampling ratio and noise.

physics/optics|waves.title: MURA coded-aperture imaging: decoding and signal-to-noise
physics/optics|waves.gist: Generate a modified uniformly redundant array, simulate the shadowgram of an extended source, and decode by periodic correlation via FFT. Compare SNR with a pinhole camera for point and extended sources.

physics/optics|waves.title: Light-field refocusing via Fourier slice photography
physics/optics|waves.gist: Synthesize a 4D light field of a layered scene and refocus by spatial shear-and-add and by extracting 2D slices of the 4D Fourier transform. Compare the two and compute the refocusing range.

physics/optics|waves.title: Double-helix PSF pupil engineering and axial localization Cramér–Rao bound
physics/optics|waves.gist: Construct a double-helix pupil phase from superposed Gauss-Laguerre modes and compute through-focus PSFs by FFT. Derive the lobe rotation angle versus defocus and the Fisher-information axial CRLB under Poisson noise, compared with astigmatic PSFs.

physics/optics|waves.title: Paganin single-material phase retrieval in propagation-based X-ray imaging
physics/optics|waves.gist: Simulate Fresnel-propagated X-ray intensity through a homogeneous object of known δ/β. Retrieve the projected thickness with Paganin's Fourier low-pass filter, and study errors versus propagation distance and the δ/β mismatch.

physics/optics|waves.title: Partial f-sum rule and effective electron number of silver
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use a Drude–Lorentz model of silver's dielectric function to integrate ω·ε2(ω) and get N_eff(ω). Separate the free-electron and interband contributions, and verify KK consistency of ε1 by numerical Hilbert transform.

physics/optics|waves.title: Bethe small-hole transmission through a thin conducting screen
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the effective electric and magnetic dipoles induced at a subwavelength circular hole and the resulting (r/λ)⁴ transmission cross section. Add the Bouwkamp correction and analyze the radiated angular pattern versus incidence angle.

physics/optics|waves.title: Huygens metasurface of silicon nanospheres via electric–magnetic coupled-dipole lattice
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use Mie a1 and b1 polarizabilities with periodic lattice sums of the dyadic Green's function for electric and magnetic dipoles. Compute the array transmission and phase, and find the overlapping-resonance condition giving full 2π phase with near-unity transmission.

physics/optics|waves.title: Interstellar polarization from aligned oblate dielectric grains
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute size-dependent polarizabilities along and across the axis of aligned spheroidal grains using depolarization factors and radiative corrections. Integrate the dichroic extinction over a grain-size distribution to obtain the polarization curve and fit a Serkowski law.

physics/optics|waves.title: Collision-induced frequency and timing shifts of WDM solitons
physics/optics|waves.gist: Simulate collisions of fundamental solitons at different carrier frequencies in lossless and lumped-amplified fiber with split-step NLSE. Compute the residual frequency and timing shifts and compare with perturbation theory.

physics/optics|waves.title: Coupled double-defect DBR microcavity: photonic-molecule mode splitting
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use transfer matrices for two half-wave defects separated by a central Bragg mirror of N pairs. Compute the transmission doublet, show the exponential decrease of splitting with N, and fit a tight-binding coupling constant.
physics/optics|waves.area: Distributed Bragg reflectors and photonic bandgaps

physics/optics|waves.title: Cantor fractal multilayer: self-similar transmission and scaling
physics/optics|waves.gist: Generate triadic Cantor multilayers and compute transmission by transfer matrices across generations. Characterize the spectral self-similarity, scaling factors and resonance localization.
physics/optics|waves.area: Distributed Bragg reflectors and photonic bandgaps

physics/optics|waves.title: Faraday rotation enhancement in a 1D magnetophotonic crystal defect
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use 4×4 (or circular-basis 2×2) transfer matrices for a Bi:YIG defect between dielectric Bragg mirrors. Compute transmittance and Faraday rotation at the defect resonance, and the rotation-transmission tradeoff versus mirror pairs.
physics/optics|waves.area: Distributed Bragg reflectors and photonic bandgaps

physics/optics|waves.title: ISO second-moment M² of an aberrated beam
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate a Gaussian beam with spherical aberration or hard truncation through a focus using FFT or angular-spectrum methods. Compute second-moment widths versus z, fit the hyperbola to extract M², and compare with the analytic Zernike-based result.

physics/optics|waves.title: Rayleigh–Sommerfeld versus Kirchhoff versus Fresnel near a small circular aperture
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the on-axis and transverse fields of small apertures (a ~ λ to 10λ) by direct RS-I/RS-II integration and by Kirchhoff and Fresnel approximations. Map where each approximation fails versus Fresnel number and distance.

physics/optics|waves.title: Prism spectrometer: minimum deviation, angular dispersion and resolving power
physics/optics|waves.gist: Exact-ray-trace through an equilateral prism with Sellmeier glass. Find the minimum-deviation angle, the angular dispersion dθ/dλ and the resolving power from base length, and compare with the diffraction-limited Rayleigh criterion.

physics/optics|waves.title: Space-time wave packets: tunable group velocity from spectral tilt
physics/optics|waves.gist: Synthesize a 2D wave packet with transverse wavenumber tied to frequency, so its spectral support lies on a tilted plane, and propagate it with the exact angular-spectrum kernel. Measure peak group velocity versus tilt angle and finite-bandwidth diffraction-free length.

physics/optics|waves.title: Kostenbauder 4×4 matrices: pulse-front tilt and spatial chirp from gratings
physics/optics|waves.gist: Build Kostenbauder ray-pulse matrices for gratings, prisms and free space. Propagate a Gaussian pulse beam with the complex Q-matrix to compute pulse-front tilt, spatial chirp and pulse duration after a single grating and a misaligned compressor.

physics/optics|waves.title: Anamorphic prism-pair circularization of an elliptical diode-laser beam
physics/optics|waves.gist: Exact-ray-trace and use astigmatic ABCD matrices for two prisms to compute the magnification along one axis versus prism angles. Find the configuration that circularizes and preserves the beam direction, then propagate the astigmatic Gaussian q-parameters.

physics/optics|waves.title: Generalized Lorenz–Mie axial trapping force on a mesoscopic sphere
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute beam-shape coefficients of a focused Gaussian beam in the localized approximation and the GLMT radiation-pressure cross section along the axis. Find the axial equilibrium and stiffness for sphere sizes between the Rayleigh and ray-optics regimes.

physics/optics|waves.title: Debye series decomposition of Mie scattering and the glory
physics/optics|waves.gist: Decompose Mie partial-wave coefficients into Debye terms (diffraction, reflection, p-internal reflections) for a water droplet. Isolate the p=1 and p=2 contributions to near-backscatter glory rings and compare with full Mie.

physics/optics|waves.title: Rayleigh–Rice BRDF and total integrated scatter of a polished mirror
physics/optics|waves.gist: Generate rough surfaces with a K-correlation (ABC) PSD and compute the BRDF from first-order vector perturbation theory, together with the total integrated scatter. Compare with the Kirchhoff/Beckmann result for numerically generated surfaces at a range of σ/λ.

physics/optics|waves.title: Zernike phase-contrast microscopy via 4f spatial filtering
physics/optics|waves.gist: Image a weak phase object through a 4f system with a phase ring or dot in the Fourier plane using FFTs. Compute the contrast versus phase-plate retardation and attenuation, and the halo artifacts from finite ring width.

physics/optics|waves.title: Schlieren knife-edge imaging of a refractive phase object
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model a 4f schlieren system with a knife edge in the Fourier plane, applied to a Gaussian phase bump or a shock-like phase step. Compare the FFT-computed intensity with the geometric gradient approximation and assess sensitivity versus cutoff position.

physics/optics|waves.title: Arrayed waveguide grating demultiplexer: Fourier-optics transmission and crosstalk
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model an AWG as Gaussian-mode coupling through free-propagation regions, using Fresnel/Fraunhofer transforms, and an array with a linear length increment. Compute the channel transmission spectra, free spectral range, adjacent-channel crosstalk and phase-error-induced crosstalk.

physics/optics|waves.title: Discretized metalens: focusing efficiency and chromatic focal shift
physics/optics|waves.gist: Sample a hyperbolic phase profile with a finite set of pillar phases on a subwavelength lattice. Propagate with the angular spectrum to compute the focal-spot Strehl and efficiency versus number of phase levels, and the focal shift with wavelength.

physics/optics|waves.title: Focusing through an index-mismatched interface: axial focal shift and aberration
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the scalar or vectorial Debye–Török focal field through a glass/water interface, including the depth-dependent aberration phase. Obtain the actual versus nominal focal position, the peak intensity loss and the axial PSF broadening with depth.

physics/optics|waves.title: Corner-cube retroreflector far-field pattern with dihedral-angle errors
physics/optics|waves.gist: Trace rays through a corner cube to obtain the six-sector pupil with tilt phases from dihedral errors and polarization. Compute the far-field diffraction pattern by FFT, the velocity-aberration offset intensity and the peak cross section.

physics/optics|waves.title: Light-sheet illumination: Gaussian versus Bessel and lattice sheet thickness
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate Gaussian, scanned-Bessel and coherent lattice light sheets by angular spectrum. Compute sheet thickness, field of view (Rayleigh-like length) and sidelobe energy fraction versus numerical aperture and annulus width.

physics/optics|waves.title: Ball-lens fiber coupling: ray-traced spherical aberration and efficiency
physics/optics|waves.gist: Ray trace through a high-index ball lens, compute the longitudinal spherical aberration and wavefront error, and evaluate single-mode coupling efficiency by overlap with the aberrated field. Optimize the separation.

physics/optics|waves.title: Chirp-z transform for zoomed focal-plane PSF computation
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute high-resolution sections of a focal-plane field with chirp-z (Bluestein) transforms instead of zero-padded FFTs. Verify against the analytic Airy pattern and benchmark accuracy and cost for small zoomed regions.

physics/optics|waves.title: Few-mode fiber modal decomposition by correlation-filter inner products
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute LP mode fields of a step-index fiber from Bessel functions and synthesize a superposition with random weights and phases. Recover the modal powers and relative phases from far-field inner products with matched holographic filters.

physics/optics|waves.title: Laser-diffraction particle sizing: Fraunhofer kernel inversion of size distributions
physics/optics|waves.gist: Forward-model ring-detector intensities from a polydisperse sphere ensemble with the Fraunhofer (Airy) kernel and Mie. Invert with non-negative least squares plus regularization, and quantify biases for small or transparent particles.

physics/optics|waves.title: Multi-plane light conversion: wavefront-matching phase masks sorting Hermite–Gauss modes
physics/optics|waves.gist: Design 3–5 phase plates separated by free-space angular-spectrum propagation that map three HG modes to spatially separated Gaussian spots. Use the wavefront-matching (adjoint overlap) update, then report mode-dependent loss and crosstalk matrix.
physics/optics|waves.area: Scalar grating and diffractive element design

physics/optics|waves.title: Lohmann Talbot array illuminator: fractional-Talbot phase grating and spot compression
physics/optics|waves.gist: Find the binary/multilevel phase grating that becomes a sparse, high-contrast amplitude spot array at a rational fraction of the Talbot distance. Verify the design by FFT angular-spectrum propagation and compute compression ratio and efficiency.
physics/optics|waves.area: Scalar grating and diffractive element design

physics/optics|waves.title: Diffractive axilens: designed uniform extended focal segment via Fresnel propagation
physics/optics|waves.gist: Build the radially varying focal-length phase of an axilens for a chosen focal segment. Compute the on-axis intensity with a Hankel-transform Fresnel integral and compare its uniformity and width with a lens and an axicon.
physics/optics|waves.area: Scalar grating and diffractive element design

physics/optics|waves.title: Dual-wavelength phase hologram with multi-depth phase: color crosstalk minimization
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use a Gerchberg–Saxton variant to design a thick phase element whose wavelength-dependent phase delays reconstruct different targets at two wavelengths. Quantify inter-channel crosstalk and efficiency against the maximum etch depth.
physics/optics|waves.area: Scalar grating and diffractive element design

physics/optics|waves.title: Imaging microlens-array fly's-eye homogenizer: flat-top uniformity and interference modulation
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model two microlens arrays and a condenser by Fourier optics to form a top-hat in the focal plane. Compute uniformity, edge width and the interference grid that coherent illumination causes as a function of Fresnel number.
physics/optics|waves.area: Scalar grating and diffractive element design

physics/optics|waves.title: Spatially multiplexed click detector: binomial click statistics and photon-number reconstruction
physics/optics|waves.gist: Split a light pulse over N on/off detectors with a balanced beam-splitter tree. Derive the click-count distribution for Fock, coherent and thermal inputs, then invert it with EM to recover the photon-number distribution.

physics/optics|waves.title: Photon-added coherent states: Mandel Q, squeezing and Wigner negativity
physics/optics|waves.gist: Build the photon-added coherent state a†|α⟩ in a truncated Fock basis. Compute the photon-number distribution, Mandel Q, quadrature variances and the Wigner function on a grid as a function of |α|.

physics/optics|waves.title: Ponderomotive squeezing spectrum of a resonantly driven optomechanical cavity
physics/optics|waves.gist: Linearize the input–output equations of a cavity with a mechanical mirror driven on resonance. Compute the optimal-quadrature noise spectrum versus frequency and optomechanical cooperativity, including mechanical thermal noise.

physics/optics|waves.title: Unconventional photon blockade in two coupled weakly nonlinear Kerr cavities
physics/optics|waves.gist: Solve the steady-state master equation for two tunnel-coupled Kerr modes with one of them driven. Map g2(0) against detuning and coupling, and compare the result with the analytic optimal-antibunching condition.

physics/optics|waves.title: Bright amplitude squeezing of the harmonic from cavity-enhanced second-harmonic generation
physics/optics|waves.gist: Linearize the quantum Langevin equations for a doubly resonant SHG cavity. Compute the amplitude-quadrature noise spectrum of the output second harmonic versus pump power relative to the critical point.

physics/optics|waves.title: Measured squeezing degraded by local-oscillator phase jitter and detection loss
physics/optics|waves.gist: Starting from squeezed and antisqueezed variances versus pump parameter, average the homodyne variance over Gaussian phase jitter and add loss. Find the optimum pump level that maximizes observed squeezing and how it scales with jitter.

physics/optics|waves.title: Intracavity EIT: cavity transmission linewidth narrowing by a dark-state medium
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model a Λ-type atomic ensemble inside an optical cavity with a weak probe and a strong control field. Compute the steady-state transmission spectrum, the narrowed linewidth and the dependence on control Rabi frequency and atom number.

physics/optics|waves.title: Mathieu beams from an elliptic annular spectrum: elliptic caustics and propagation
physics/optics|waves.gist: Build even and odd Mathieu beams by filtering a thin annular angular spectrum with angular Mathieu functions. Propagate them with angular spectrum to verify invariance and the elliptic/hyperbolic nodal structure set by the ellipticity parameter.

physics/optics|waves.title: Self-healing of a Bessel–Gauss beam behind an opaque obstacle
physics/optics|waves.gist: Block the core of a Bessel–Gauss beam with an opaque disk and propagate it by angular spectrum. Measure the reconstruction distance and compare it with the geometric shadow estimate a/tanθ.

physics/optics|waves.title: Frozen waves: designing on-axis intensity with discrete Bessel beam superpositions
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute Fourier-series coefficients that make an on-axis intensity profile approximate a target L-shaped or step profile using Bessel beams with chosen longitudinal wavenumbers. Propagate the field to check fidelity versus the number of terms.

physics/optics|waves.title: Pearcey beam: autofocusing, form invariance and self-healing
physics/optics|waves.gist: Generate a finite-energy Pearcey beam from the cusp-catastrophe integral or its Fourier spectrum. Propagate it with FFT angular spectrum to locate the autofocus plane and peak intensity gain, and test self-healing after partial obstruction.

physics/optics|waves.title: Optical bottle beam from interfering Bessel beams: dark-region size
