physics/optics|waves.gist: Superpose two coaxial Bessel–Gauss beams with different cone angles and opposite phases to create periodic dark bottles. Compute bottle length and width from the axial beat and verify by angular-spectrum propagation.

physics/optics|waves.title: Helico-conical beams: spiral intensity propagation and focal-plane OAM structure
physics/optics|waves.gist: Apply the helico-conical phase ℓθ(K − r/R) to a Gaussian beam and propagate it by Fresnel FFT. Analyze the spiral focal intensity and its azimuthal OAM decomposition versus K and ℓ.

physics/optics|waves.title: Orbital angular momentum transfer torque on an absorbing Rayleigh particle in an LG beam
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the azimuthal radiation force and spin/orbital torque on an absorbing dipolar particle in a focused LG beam from the field and its gradients. Predict the rotation rate versus topological charge and absorption.

physics/optics|waves.title: Diffraction onto a tilted observation plane by angular-spectrum rotation
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use the rotational transformation of the angular spectrum with Jacobian and nonuniform resampling to compute the field on a plane tilted relative to the aperture. Compare the result with direct Rayleigh–Sommerfeld integration.

physics/optics|waves.title: Shifted angular-spectrum propagation to off-axis observation windows
physics/optics|waves.gist: Implement the shifted band-limited angular spectrum method that computes diffraction into a laterally offset window without padding. Check it against direct convolution for a grating sending orders far off axis.

physics/optics|waves.title: Boundary diffraction wave: Miyamoto–Wolf edge integral versus Kirchhoff aperture integral
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute circular-aperture diffraction as a geometric wave plus a line integral over the edge. Show that it agrees with the Kirchhoff area integral and isolate the edge-wave contribution to on-axis oscillations.

physics/optics|waves.title: Optimum pinhole-camera diameter from Fresnel diffraction of the pinhole
physics/optics|waves.gist: For a point source imaged by a pinhole, compute the image-plane intensity versus pinhole diameter with the Fresnel–Hankel integral. Find the diameter that minimizes the spot width and compare with Rayleigh's d ≈ 1.9√(λf).

physics/optics|waves.title: Lau effect: incoherent fringes from two gratings illuminated by extended source
physics/optics|waves.gist: Sum intensity patterns from mutually incoherent slits of a first grating that illuminate a second grating, using Fresnel propagation. Compute fringe visibility versus grating separation and verify the Lau condition.

physics/optics|waves.title: Fraunhofer diffraction of polygonal apertures: analytic vertex formula versus FFT
physics/optics|waves.gist: Evaluate the closed-form Fourier transform of an arbitrary polygon as a sum over its edges. Compare it with FFTs of rasterized apertures for triangles, hexagons and stars, and quantify staircase errors.

physics/optics|waves.title: Serrated hard aperture for high-power lasers: near-field ripple suppression
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model a soft aperture made of triangular serrations followed by spatial filtering. Use angular-spectrum propagation to compute near-field intensity modulation compared with a hard circular aperture, versus serration count and depth.

physics/optics|waves.title: Spectral beam combining with a diffraction grating: beam quality versus linewidth
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model lasers at different wavelengths combined by a grating and transform lens using angular dispersion. Compute M² degradation of the combined beam from each laser's linewidth and the grating's angular dispersion.

physics/optics|waves.title: Chirped Gaussian pulse in fiber: initial compression and minimum width
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate a linearly chirped Gaussian pulse with the dispersive transfer function. Compute width versus distance for Cβ2 < 0 and Cβ2 > 0, then extract the compression distance and minimum width and compare with analytic formulas.

physics/optics|waves.title: Super-Gaussian pulse dispersive broadening and edge-steepness dependence
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate super-Gaussian pulses of order m through a fiber with GVD using FFTs. Compute RMS width, peak oscillations and broadening rate versus m, and compare with the RMS-moment analytic result.

physics/optics|waves.title: Finite-energy Airy pulse in fiber: inverse acceleration with third-order dispersion
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate a truncated Airy pulse under β2 and β3 by spectral-domain FFT. Track the main-lobe position to show self-acceleration and its reversal at the distance set by β3.

physics/optics|waves.title: Femtosecond pulse transmitted through a Fabry–Pérot etalon: echo train and reshaping
physics/optics|waves.gist: Multiply the pulse spectrum by the complex Airy transfer function and inverse-FFT. Compute the transmitted echo train, its envelope and pulse lengthening versus finesse and round-trip time.

physics/optics|waves.title: White-light spectral interferometry: Fourier extraction of mirror group-delay dispersion
physics/optics|waves.gist: Simulate a spectral interferogram between a reference and a sample with a given spectral phase. Retrieve the phase by FFT sideband filtering, then fit GD and GDD and assess noise sensitivity.

physics/optics|waves.title: Gouy-phase carrier-envelope phase shift of a focused few-cycle pulse
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate a broadband Gaussian pulse beam through focus by summing monochromatic Gaussian-beam components with their Gouy phases. Compute the on-axis electric field and CEP shift versus z, including frequency-dependent Rayleigh range effects.

physics/optics|waves.title: Propagation-time difference of femtosecond pulses focused by a chromatic singlet
physics/optics|waves.gist: Ray-trace a singlet with Sellmeier glass to compute the delay between pulse front and phase front across the aperture (Bor's PTD). Estimate focal pulse broadening and compare with an achromat.

physics/optics|waves.title: Grating spectrometer instrument line shape and resolving power with finite slit
physics/optics|waves.gist: Combine the N-line grating interference function, Gaussian beam illumination of the grating and slit/pixel convolution. Compute the instrument function and resolving power, and check the Rayleigh criterion against mN.

physics/optics|waves.title: Astigmatic PSF for 3D single-molecule localization: calibration curve and CRLB
physics/optics|waves.gist: Add astigmatism to a pupil and compute PSFs through focus by FFT. Fit x/y widths to build the z-calibration curve and compute Cramér–Rao bounds for 3D localization under Poisson noise.

physics/optics|waves.title: Non-redundant aperture masking: interferogram Fourier sampling and closure phases
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the PSF of a 7-hole non-redundant mask with an aberrated pupil. Extract complex visibilities at the baseline frequencies and show that closure phases cancel pupil-plane phase errors.

physics/optics|waves.title: Two-photon excitation microscope PSF: squared illumination PSF and axial resolution
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the 3D illumination PSF of a high-NA objective in the scalar Debye approximation. Square it for two-photon excitation and compare lateral and axial FWHM and the OTF support with one-photon confocal imaging.

physics/optics|waves.title: STED effective PSF from a vortex depletion beam and saturation factor
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the doughnut depletion PSF of a vortex-phase pupil and the Gaussian excitation PSF by FFT. Form the effective PSF exp(−ln2·I/Isat) and check the resolution scaling with saturation intensity against the square-root law.

physics/optics|waves.title: 4Pi microscope PSF: axial interference lobes and deconvolvable sidelobes
physics/optics|waves.gist: Coherently add counter-propagating focused fields from two opposed objectives with a relative phase. Compute the axial PSF, main-lobe width and sidelobe heights versus NA and phase, and the gaps in the axial OTF.

physics/optics|waves.title: Image scanning microscopy: pixel reassignment and effective PSF
physics/optics|waves.gist: Simulate a confocal detector array where each pixel's PSF is the product of illumination and shifted detection PSFs. Apply pixel reassignment with factor 1/2 and compute the effective PSF width and signal gain versus open confocal.

physics/optics|waves.title: Phase transfer function of a comatic pupil and image centroid displacement
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the complex OTF of a pupil with primary coma by autocorrelation. Extract the phase transfer function and relate the low-frequency slope to the PSF centroid shift, which differs from the peak position.

physics/optics|waves.title: Self-focusing critical power of elliptic Gaussian beams
physics/optics|waves.gist: Run 2D NLSE split-step simulations of elliptic Gaussian input beams in a Kerr medium. Find the collapse threshold power versus ellipticity by bisection and compare with Fibich's approximate formula.

physics/optics|waves.title: Dual-rotating-retarder Mueller polarimeter: Fourier coefficients to full Mueller matrix
physics/optics|waves.gist: Simulate intensities from rotating generator and analyzer quarter-wave plates at a 5:1 rate. Recover all 16 Mueller elements from the 25 Fourier coefficients and analyze error propagation from retarder miscalibration.
physics/optics|waves.area: Polarization optics with Jones and Mueller calculus

physics/optics|waves.title: Depolarization of broadband light by a thick wave plate
physics/optics|waves.gist: Integrate Jones-propagated Stokes vectors over a Gaussian spectrum to compute the degree of polarization behind a multi-order birefringent plate. Express it versus retardance-to-coherence-length ratio and input polarization angle.
physics/optics|waves.area: Polarization optics with Jones and Mueller calculus

physics/optics|waves.title: Photoelastic fringes of a diametrically compressed disk in a circular polariscope
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute the plane-stress field of a disk under diametral load, then the local retardance and fast-axis angle. Form isochromatic and isoclinic images with Jones matrices for plane and circular polariscopes.
physics/optics|waves.area: Polarization optics with Jones and Mueller calculus

physics/optics|waves.title: Pile-of-plates polarizer: degree of polarization versus plate number and angle
physics/optics|waves.gist: Combine Fresnel transmission at Brewster and other angles for N glass plates, with incoherent multiple reflections, in a Mueller formulation. Compute the degree of polarization and p-transmittance versus N.
physics/optics|waves.area: Polarization optics with Jones and Mueller calculus

physics/optics|waves.title: Liquid-crystal polarization grating: circular-polarization-selective first-order efficiency
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model a cycloidal-director LC grating with thin-grating Jones calculus and verify it against anisotropic RCWA. Compute ±1 order efficiencies and handedness versus retardance and input Stokes vector.
physics/optics|waves.area: Polarization optics with Jones and Mueller calculus

physics/optics|waves.title: Higher-order coupled-microring add-drop filter: maximally flat passband design
physics/optics|waves.gist: Use transfer matrices of serially coupled rings to compute drop and through responses. Choose inter-ring coupling coefficients for Butterworth and Chebyshev second- and third-order responses, and evaluate roll-off versus loss.

physics/optics|waves.title: Silicon nanopillar metasurface phase library by 2D RCWA
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute zero-order transmission amplitude and phase of a square array of silicon pillars on glass versus pillar width using a truncated crossed-grating Fourier modal method. Assess 2π coverage, transmission dips and convergence.

physics/optics|waves.title: Wolter type-I X-ray telescope: grazing-incidence ray trace and PSF
physics/optics|waves.gist: Trace rays through a confocal paraboloid–hyperboloid mirror pair at grazing incidence, including Fresnel/X-ray reflectivity. Compute on- and off-axis spot diagrams, encircled energy and effective area.

physics/optics|waves.title: X-ray compound refractive lens: ABCD focusing, absorption aperture and transmission
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model a stack of parabolic beryllium lenses with thick-lens ABCD matrices and Gaussian absorption apodization. Compute focal length, effective aperture, transmission and diffraction-limited spot versus photon energy.

physics/optics|waves.title: Parratt recursion for X-ray reflectivity of a W/Si multilayer mirror
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute specular reflectivity versus grazing angle with Parratt recursion and Névot–Croce roughness factors. Locate Bragg peaks and recover the bilayer period from the Fourier transform of the Kiessig fringes.

physics/optics|waves.title: Parhelion (sundog) position versus solar elevation from ray tracing plate crystals
physics/optics|waves.gist: Monte Carlo ray-trace hexagonal plate ice crystals with horizontally oriented basal faces. Compute the azimuthal offset and color spread of the sundog versus Sun elevation, and compare with the skew-ray minimum deviation formula.

physics/optics|waves.title: Elliptical pump cavity: ray-traced transfer efficiency from flashlamp to laser rod
physics/optics|waves.gist: Trace rays from a finite-diameter lamp at one focus of an elliptical reflector to a rod at the other, including refraction into the rod. Compute transfer efficiency versus eccentricity and lamp/rod diameters.

physics/optics|waves.title: Kaleidoscopic light-pipe homogenizer: output uniformity versus rod length
physics/optics|waves.gist: Ray-trace a focused source into a square and a hexagonal mirrored/TIR rod and bin the output irradiance. Compute uniformity versus number of reflections, and show why circular rods homogenize poorly.

physics/optics|waves.title: Fresnel lens solar concentrator: chromatic aberration and flux distribution
physics/optics|waves.gist: Ray-trace sunlight with its angular size and solar spectrum through a facetted PMMA Fresnel lens. Compute the receiver flux map, chromatic spot growth and concentration ratio versus f-number.

physics/optics|waves.title: Vander Lugt matched-filter versus phase-only-filter optical correlation
physics/optics|waves.gist: Simulate a 4f correlator with classical matched, phase-only and inverse filters for target recognition in a noisy cluttered scene. Compute correlation peak sharpness, peak-to-correlation energy and discrimination.

physics/optics|waves.title: Abbe–Porter experiment: grating image synthesis with pupil-plane order filtering
physics/optics|waves.gist: Image a crossed grating through a 4f system while selecting diffraction orders with slits and pupils in the Fourier plane. Compute the resulting images, showing period doubling and orientation selection.

physics/optics|waves.title: Differential interference contrast image of a phase object: shear and bias
physics/optics|waves.gist: Form a Nomarski DIC image as the interference of two laterally sheared, bandlimited copies of a phase-object field. Compute contrast versus shear and bias retardation, and show the shadow-cast edge response.

physics/optics|waves.title: Spiral phase contrast microscopy: isotropic edge enhancement by vortex Fourier filter
physics/optics|waves.gist: Apply a spiral phase filter with central zero-order handling in the Fourier plane of a 4f system to amplitude and phase objects. Compare the isotropic edge enhancement with a 1D Hilbert filter and quantify the effect of the zero-order window.

physics/optics|waves.title: Lateral shearing interferometry: Fourier wavefront reconstruction from two orthogonal shears
physics/optics|waves.gist: Simulate shearograms of a Zernike wavefront for x and y shears, extract difference phases and reconstruct the wavefront. Use the Fourier shear-transfer-function method with regularization at its zeros, and evaluate RMS error.

physics/optics|waves.title: Multislice propagation through a weak phase sphere: projection approximation breakdown
physics/optics|waves.gist: Propagate a plane wave through a 3D dielectric sphere with the multislice split-step method and compare with the thin projection approximation. Quantify the error versus object thickness relative to depth of field (Fresnel-number criterion).

physics/optics|waves.title: Spatial heterodyne spectrometer: Fizeau fringe interferogram and Littrow spectral retrieval
physics/optics|waves.gist: Model a two-grating Michelson-type spatial heterodyne spectrometer in which each wavelength produces fringes of frequency proportional to its offset from Littrow. Recover spectra by FFT and compute resolving power and bandwidth.

physics/optics|waves.title: Double-random-phase optical image encryption in a 4f system
physics/optics|waves.gist: Encrypt an image with random phase masks in the input and Fourier planes and decrypt it with conjugate keys. Quantify decryption error versus key misalignment, phase quantization and occlusion of the ciphertext.

physics/optics|waves.title: Hermite–Gauss mode content from cavity misalignment and mode-mismatch
physics/optics|waves.gist: Expand a tilted, offset and waist-mismatched Gaussian beam onto a cavity's HG modes by overlap integrals. Predict transmitted resonance peak heights in a cavity scan, then invert peak ratios to recover the misalignment.

physics/optics|waves.title: Critical-angle Mie scattering from an air bubble in water
physics/optics|waves.gist: Compute Mie scattering by a spherical bubble with relative index m < 1 from the multipole series. Analyze the intensity oscillations near the critical scattering angle versus size parameter and compare with the physical-optics prediction.

physics/optics|waves.title: Bohren chiral-sphere Mie theory: circular differential scattering and extinction
physics/optics|waves.gist: Implement Bohren's multipole solution for an optically active sphere with left/right circular wavenumbers. Compute circular differential extinction and scattering versus size parameter and chirality.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: KdV two-soliton collision phase shifts via integrating-factor pseudospectral RK4
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the periodic KdV equation u_t + 6uu_x + u_xxx = 0 with FFT derivatives, 2/3 dealiasing and integrating-factor RK4 on a two-soliton initial state. Measure the post-collision position shifts of both solitons and compare them with the analytic phase-shift formula.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Spectral accuracy for viscous Burgers versus Cole-Hopf exact solution
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve periodic viscous Burgers with a Fourier pseudospectral method and compare against the Cole-Hopf solution, evaluated by numerical quadrature. Quantify exponential convergence in N as the viscosity is lowered and the steepening front reduces analyticity.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Damped birth-rate oscillations from complex Euler-Lotka roots
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Find the dominant complex-conjugate roots of the Euler-Lotka characteristic equation for a narrow fertility schedule using Newton's method in the complex plane. Compare the predicted damping ratio and oscillation period with birth-rate transients from a characteristic-based PDE simulation.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Infection-age Kermack-McKendrick epidemic: R0 and initial growth rate
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the infection-age-structured SIR model, with an age-dependent infectivity kernel, by integrating along characteristics coupled to the susceptible ODE. Compute R0 and the early exponential growth rate from the renewal (Lotka) equation and compare them with the simulated epidemic and final size.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Gurtin-MacCamy density-dependent population equilibrium and its stability
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Simulate the nonlinear Gurtin-MacCamy model in which fertility decreases with total population size, using an upwind characteristic scheme. Compute the nontrivial equilibrium population and test its local stability with the linearized characteristic equation, checking for Hopf oscillations.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Leslie matrix convergence to continuous Euler-Lotka growth rate
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Build Leslie matrices as age-step discretizations of a continuous McKendrick model with given survival and fertility functions. Show that log(lambda_max)/delta_a converges to the Euler-Lotka intrinsic rate r and estimate the observed order of convergence.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Lebowitz-Rubinow cell-cycle model with variable cycle length distribution
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the Lebowitz-Rubinow age-maturity cell population equation with a gamma-distributed cycle length using an upwind scheme. Compute the asymptotic growth rate from the characteristic equation 2 E[exp(-lambda T)] = 1 and compare it with the simulation.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Critical age-selective fishing mortality for zero intrinsic growth rate
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Add age-selective harvesting (logistic selectivity curve) to a McKendrick fish population model. Compute the critical fishing mortality F_crit that makes the Euler-Lotka growth rate zero by nested root finding, and validate it with PDE simulations just above and below F_crit.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Discretely monitored double-barrier knock-out and continuity correction
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Price a double-barrier knock-out call that is monitored discretely, by zeroing the solution outside the barriers at the monitoring dates of an implicit FD solver. Compare with continuous-monitoring prices shifted by the Broadie-Glasserman-Kou barrier correction.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Arithmetic Asian call via Vecer one-dimensional PDE reduction
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Price a fixed-strike arithmetic-average Asian call by solving Vecer's one-dimensional PDE with Crank-Nicolson finite differences. Validate the method on the geometric-average closed form and compare arithmetic prices with a moment-matching approximation.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: CEV local-volatility European call versus noncentral chi-square formula
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the constant-elasticity-of-variance pricing PDE with a theta-scheme on a nonuniform asset grid, using an absorbing boundary at zero for beta < 1. Compare prices with the Schroder noncentral chi-square closed form across several elasticities.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Merton jump-diffusion PIDE with IMEX stepping and FFT convolution
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Price a European call under Merton jump-diffusion by treating diffusion implicitly and the jump integral explicitly, evaluating the integral as an FFT convolution on the log-price grid. Compare with the Merton Poisson-weighted series of Black-Scholes prices.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: 1D Yee FDTD graded PML: reflection versus thickness and grading order
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Terminate a 1D Yee FDTD Maxwell solver with a polynomially graded conductivity PML. Measure the numerical reflection of a Gaussian pulse against layer thickness, grading order m and target reflection R(0), and compare with the continuous-theory prediction.
math/pde_numerics|pde.area: Absorbing boundaries and perfectly matched layers

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: 2D TE split-field Berenger PML error versus large-domain reference
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement a split-field Berenger PML for 2D TEz Yee FDTD with a point-source excitation. Compute the time history of the global and local reflection error relative to an enlarged reflection-free reference simulation for several PML thicknesses.
math/pde_numerics|pde.area: Absorbing boundaries and perfectly matched layers

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Helmholtz equation with complex-stretched PML versus exact outgoing solution
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the 1D and 2D Helmholtz equations with second-order finite differences and a complex coordinate-stretching PML using sparse linear solvers. Compare with exact outgoing (Hankel) solutions and study the error as a function of PML strength and wavelengths per layer.
math/pde_numerics|pde.area: Absorbing boundaries and perfectly matched layers

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Higdon multi-angle absorbing boundary for 2D acoustic waves
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement Higdon absorbing boundary operators of orders 1-3 with chosen exact-absorption angles for the 2D acoustic wave equation. Compute reflection versus incidence angle and show perfect absorption at the design angles.
math/pde_numerics|pde.area: Absorbing boundaries and perfectly matched layers

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Rayleigh-damping sponge layers for linear shallow-water gravity waves
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve linearized 1D shallow-water equations on a staggered grid with a Rayleigh-damping sponge layer of variable length and damping profile. Quantify the wave reflection coefficient versus sponge length relative to wavelength and compare linear and quadratic profiles.
math/pde_numerics|pde.area: Absorbing boundaries and perfectly matched layers

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Discrete transparent boundary conditions for 1D Crank-Nicolson Schrodinger
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement the Arnold-Ehrhardt discrete transparent boundary condition, a convolution in time, for Crank-Nicolson finite differences of the free Schrodinger equation. Verify reflection-free propagation of a Gaussian packet against the exact solution and compare with Dirichlet truncation.
math/pde_numerics|pde.area: Absorbing boundaries and perfectly matched layers

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Heston European call with Douglas ADI versus characteristic-function price
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the 2D Heston pricing PDE on nonuniform (S, v) grids using the Douglas ADI scheme with explicit treatment of the mixed derivative. Compare with the semi-analytic Heston price computed by Fourier inversion of the characteristic function.
math/pde_numerics|pde.area: Multi-factor and stochastic volatility pricing PDEs

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Convergence orders of Craig-Sneyd, modified Craig-Sneyd and Hundsdorfer-Verwer ADI
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Apply the Douglas, Craig-Sneyd, modified Craig-Sneyd and Hundsdorfer-Verwer ADI schemes to the Heston PDE. Measure the temporal convergence orders and stability against a semi-analytic reference across correlation values.
math/pde_numerics|pde.area: Multi-factor and stochastic volatility pricing PDEs

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Call on the maximum of two assets versus Stulz formula
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Price a call on max(S1, S2) with a 2D finite-difference ADI solver that includes the cross derivative. Compare with Stulz's bivariate-normal closed form and study the error near the nonsmooth payoff ridge.
math/pde_numerics|pde.area: Multi-factor and stochastic volatility pricing PDEs

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Heston American put with ADI and penalty or projection early exercise
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Price an American put under Heston dynamics by combining modified Craig-Sneyd ADI with an explicit projection or penalty step for the early-exercise constraint. Extract the exercise boundary as a function of variance and compare with benchmark values from the literature.
math/pde_numerics|pde.area: Multi-factor and stochastic volatility pricing PDEs

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: G2++ two-factor short-rate zero-coupon bond via ADI
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the two-factor Gaussian G2++ bond-pricing PDE with correlated factors using Douglas ADI on a bounded (x, y) grid. Compare zero-coupon bond prices and yields with the closed-form affine solution.
math/pde_numerics|pde.area: Multi-factor and stochastic volatility pricing PDEs

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Heston delta and vega from ADI grid versus COS-method Greeks
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Compute delta, gamma and vega from finite differences of the Heston ADI solution surface. Compare them with Greeks from the Fang-Oosterlee COS expansion and study their accuracy on nonuniform grids.
math/pde_numerics|pde.area: Multi-factor and stochastic volatility pricing PDEs

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Eliminating mixed derivatives by coordinate rotation in correlated two-asset PDE
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Transform the correlated two-asset log-price PDE to principal axes via eigendecomposition of the covariance matrix, which removes the cross term. Compare accuracy and ADI stability with a direct mixed-derivative stencil for a basket put.
math/pde_numerics|pde.area: Multi-factor and stochastic volatility pricing PDEs

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Heston degenerate v=0 boundary treatment and the Feller condition
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Compare boundary treatments at zero variance in Heston FD (solve the degenerate PDE with one-sided differences, Dirichlet, or extrapolation) when the Feller condition is satisfied and when it is violated. Measure the price errors against semi-analytic values.
math/pde_numerics|pde.area: Multi-factor and stochastic volatility pricing PDEs

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: WENO5 with SSPRK3 for Shu-Osher shock-entropy wave interaction
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the 1D Euler equations with fifth-order WENO-JS reconstruction, Lax-Friedrichs flux splitting and SSPRK3 for the Shu-Osher problem. Quantify resolution of post-shock entropy waves against a fine-grid reference.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Low-storage SSPRK(5,4) positivity preservation for limited advection
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement the Spiteri-Ruuth SSPRK(5,4) scheme and apply it to a positivity-limited advection semi-discretization of nonnegative profiles. Find the largest CFL that keeps solutions nonnegative and compare with the theoretical SSP bound.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Maximal stable CFL for upwind DG P1-P3 with SSP Runge-Kutta
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Assemble upwind discontinuous Galerkin advection operators of degree 1-3 on a periodic mesh and compute their spectra. Find the maximal CFL at which the spectrum fits inside each SSPRK stability region, and verify by time integration.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Symbolic order conditions and empirical convergence of SSP Butcher tableaux
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Convert Shu-Osher SSP forms into Butcher tableaux and verify the order conditions up to order four with sympy. Confirm the orders empirically on a nonlinear ODE system and on a smooth PDE semi-discretization.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Positivity of density and pressure in the 123 strong-rarefaction problem
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the 1D Euler 123 problem, with two strong rarefactions producing near-vacuum, using a Rusanov finite-volume scheme and several SSPRK integrators. Determine the CFL thresholds at which density or pressure turns negative.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Brusselator reaction-diffusion method of lines with sparse BDF Jacobian
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Semi-discretize the 1D Brusselator reaction-diffusion system and integrate it with scipy BDF using a supplied banded Jacobian sparsity pattern. Report the stiffness ratio versus grid size and compare solver cost with and without the sparsity pattern.
math/pde_numerics|pde.area: Method of lines and stiff ODE integration

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Heat-equation MOL stiffness: N^2 eigenvalue scaling and explicit versus implicit cost
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Compute the spectrum of the second-difference Dirichlet Laplacian analytically and numerically to obtain the stiffness ratio. Compare step counts and work of RK45 versus Radau and BDF as N grows, confirming the N^2 explicit step restriction.
math/pde_numerics|pde.area: Method of lines and stiff ODE integration

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Diurnal ozone kinetics-transport problem with banded BDF Jacobian
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve Hindmarsh's 2D two-species diurnal atmospheric kinetics-advection-diffusion problem with method of lines. Exploit the block-banded Jacobian in an implicit BDF integrator and report concentrations at specified times together with the solver statistics.
math/pde_numerics|pde.area: Method of lines and stiff ODE integration

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Porous medium equation Barenblatt front position with method of lines
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the 1D porous medium equation u_t = (u^m)_xx with a conservative MOL discretization and an implicit stiff integrator. Compare the free-boundary position and profile with the Barenblatt self-similar solution.
math/pde_numerics|pde.area: Method of lines and stiff ODE integration

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Frank-Kamenetskii thermal explosion ignition time via MOL and BDF
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the reaction-diffusion equation theta_t = theta_xx + delta exp(theta) in a slab with an adaptive BDF integrator and event detection for blow-up. Locate the critical delta (about 0.878) by bisection on whether ignition occurs.
math/pde_numerics|pde.area: Method of lines and stiff ODE integration

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Effective permeability of 2D lognormal media with two-point flux finite volumes
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Generate Gaussian-correlated lognormal permeability fields, solve steady Darcy flow with a TPFA finite-volume scheme and harmonic face averaging, and compute the effective permeability. Compare with the 2D geometric-mean result as the log-variance increases.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Theis well drawdown from transient radial finite differences
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the transient radial groundwater flow equation around a pumping well on a logarithmic radial grid with implicit Euler. Compare drawdown curves with the Theis well-function solution and the Cooper-Jacob approximation.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Macrodispersion from plume spatial moments in random permeability fields
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Couple a TPFA Darcy solver on lognormal permeability fields to finite-volume advection-dispersion of a solute plume. Compute the time evolution of the plume's second spatial moments and estimate the longitudinal macrodispersivity, comparing with Gelhar-Axness first-order theory.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Richards equation infiltration with Celia modified Picard iteration
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve 1D vertical infiltration with the mixed-form Richards equation and van Genuchten soil hydraulics using implicit FD with modified Picard iteration. Track cumulative infiltration and the mass-balance error, comparing with the head-based form.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Dupuit-Boussinesq unconfined aquifer between two reservoirs
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the nonlinear Boussinesq equation for an unconfined aquifer between reservoirs at different levels by implicit FD with Newton iterations. Compare the steady water table and discharge with the Dupuit-Forchheimer formula, including recharge.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Henry saltwater intrusion problem with density-coupled finite volumes
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the Henry benchmark of seawater intrusion in a coastal aquifer by coupling a variable-density Darcy pressure solve to salt advection-dispersion with sequential finite-volume steps. Report the steady 0.5 isochlor position against published benchmark values.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Mobile-immobile dual-porosity transport and breakthrough curve tailing
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the mobile-immobile transport model with first-order mass exchange using finite volumes plus implicit treatment of the exchange term. Compute temporal moments of breakthrough curves and compare them with analytic moment expressions to quantify tailing.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Pumping well capture zone in regional uniform flow
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the steady 2D head field for a pumping well superposed on uniform regional flow with a finite-volume solver. Trace streamlines by Pollock's semi-analytic particle tracking and compare the stagnation point and capture-zone width with the analytic formulas.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Grid convergence index for 2D Poisson with manufactured solution
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve a 2D Poisson problem with a manufactured solution on three or more systematically refined grids. Compute the observed order, the Richardson-extrapolated solution and Roache's GCI for point values and integral functionals, and check them against the exact error.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Observed order with non-constant refinement ratios via Celik iteration
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement the Celik et al. fixed-point iteration for the observed order p when refinement ratios differ, including detection of oscillatory convergence. Apply it to a 1D convection-diffusion boundary-layer problem on non-geometrically refined grids.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Time-step Richardson extrapolation for Crank-Nicolson heat equation
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Combine Crank-Nicolson heat-equation solutions with steps dt and dt/2 to raise the temporal order from two to four. Verify the result against an exact Fourier-series solution and study how nonsmooth initial data degrades the extrapolation.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Blasius wall shear f''(0) by Keller box and Richardson extrapolation
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the Blasius boundary-layer equation with the Keller box scheme and Newton iteration on refined grids and a truncated domain. Extrapolate the wall shear f''(0) toward 0.332057, separating domain-truncation error from discretization error.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Repeated Richardson extrapolation of square-bar torsion constant
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the Prandtl stress-function Poisson problem on a square cross-section with finite differences and compute the torsion constant from the integral of the stress function. Apply repeated Romberg-style extrapolation and compare with the series value of about 0.1406 a^4.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Degraded convergence orders in the Sod shock tube problem
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Compute L1 errors of first- and second-order finite-volume solutions of the Sod problem against the exact Riemann solution on refined grids. Show the observed order falling to about 1 (shocks) or below 1 (contacts) and examine why GCI estimates become unreliable.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Least-squares uncertainty estimation from noisy grid sequences (Eca-Hoekstra)
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement the Eca-Hoekstra least-squares procedure, which fits error models with free or fixed orders to many grid solutions that contain scatter, with safety factors. Apply it to a 2D steady convection-diffusion functional and compare with three-grid GCI.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Welge tangent shock and recovery curve versus upwind finite volumes
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: For Corey relative permeabilities, construct the Welge tangent to find the shock-front saturation, breakthrough time and the oil recovery versus pore volumes injected. Compare these with first-order upwind finite-volume solutions of the Buckley-Leverett equation.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Counter-current gravity segregation of two phases in a closed column
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the zero-net-flux gravity segregation equation for a heavy fluid initially above a light fluid in a closed column using Godunov finite volumes. Compare the rarefaction and shock structure and the time to complete segregation with characteristic theory.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: MUSCL versus upwind smearing of Buckley-Leverett shock fronts
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Compare first-order upwind and minmod/van Leer MUSCL schemes with SSPRK2 for Buckley-Leverett displacement. Measure L1 error convergence rates and front-smearing widths against the exact Welge solution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Fully implicit Newton Buckley-Leverett at large CFL
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement a fully implicit upwind Buckley-Leverett solver with Newton iterations and saturation-update damping. Compare accuracy, numerical diffusion and Newton convergence with an explicit scheme as CFL increases up to about 50.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Quarter five-spot IMPES waterflood breakthrough time
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Simulate a quarter five-spot waterflood with IMPES: TPFA pressure solve with total mobility, then explicit upwind saturation update. Compute water breakthrough time and areal sweep efficiency versus mobility ratio and grid resolution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: General Buckley-Leverett Riemann problem via Oleinik convex hull construction
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Write a solver for the Buckley-Leverett Riemann problem with arbitrary left and right saturations, using the Oleinik entropy condition through convex or concave hull construction of the flux. Validate the resulting compound shock-rarefaction waves against fine-grid Godunov simulations.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Douglas-Gunn ADI for 3D heat conduction in a cube
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement three-stage Douglas-Gunn splitting for the 3D heat equation with a product-of-sines exact solution. Report the max-norm error versus dt at large Courant numbers, together with the per-step cost scaling.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: ADI for orthotropic heat conduction in a fiber composite plate
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve variable-coefficient anisotropic diffusion (k_x ≠ k_y, piecewise layers) with ADI to steady state. Compute the effective through-thickness heat flux and compare it with the series (harmonic-mean) conductivity.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Iterative Peaceman-Rachford ADI for Poisson with Wachspress optimal shifts
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the 2D Poisson equation by iterating ADI with a cyclic set of Wachspress acceleration parameters. Measure the iteration count versus grid size and compare it with a single fixed shift and the theoretical log(N) growth.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Boundary corrections for ADI intermediate stages with time-dependent Dirichlet data
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Show that naive intermediate-stage boundary values in Peaceman-Rachford ADI degrade the order under time-dependent boundary data. Implement the consistent intermediate boundary formula and compare the observed temporal orders.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: LOD versus Peaceman-Rachford splitting for 2D Fisher-KPP invasion fronts
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve 2D Fisher-KPP reaction-diffusion with locally one-dimensional (LOD) and Peaceman-Rachford splitting, treating the reaction term by Strang splitting. Compare the radial front speed with 2√(Dr) and quantify the splitting error versus dt.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Mitchell-Fairweather fourth-order compact ADI for the 2D heat equation
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement the high-order compact Mitchell-Fairweather ADI scheme. Verify fourth-order spatial accuracy when dt ∝ dx^2 against a separable exact solution, and compare the cost per accuracy with standard Peaceman-Rachford.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: ADI-FDTD beyond the Courant limit: cavity resonance frequency error
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement the Zheng-Chen unconditionally stable ADI-FDTD scheme for 2D TE Maxwell equations in a PEC rectangular cavity. Extract the TE11 resonance by FFT of probe data and measure the frequency error versus the Courant number.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Lowest-order Raviart-Thomas mixed FEM for 2D Darcy flow
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Assemble RT0-P0 mixed finite elements on a structured triangulation for -div(K grad p) = f in saddle-point form. Verify first-order convergence of pressure and flux in L2 against a manufactured solution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Local mass conservation: RT0 mixed versus continuous P1 in heterogeneous media
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve single-phase flow through a channelized high-contrast permeability field with RT0 mixed FEM and with P1 Galerkin. Compute per-element flux imbalance and the total outflow for each method and compare them.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Taylor-Hood P2-P1 Stokes convergence versus unstable P1-P1 checkerboard pressure
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Assemble Taylor-Hood elements for Stokes flow with a manufactured solution and verify the third- and second-order velocity and pressure rates. Show the spurious pressure modes produced by equal-order P1-P1 elements.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Numerical inf-sup constants of Q1-P0 versus Taylor-Hood Stokes elements
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Compute the discrete LBB constant from the smallest eigenvalue of the pressure Schur complement relative to the pressure mass matrix on refining meshes. Show it decays for Q1-P0 and stays bounded for Q2-Q1.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Brezzi-Pitkaranta pressure stabilization of equal-order P1-P1 Stokes elements
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Add the h^2-weighted pressure Laplacian stabilization to P1-P1 Stokes in a lid-driven cavity. Study how the pressure error and the oscillation amplitude depend on the stabilization parameter.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: SUPG for skew convection with interior and boundary layers
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve 2D convection-dominated transport with an oblique velocity and discontinuous inflow data using P1 Galerkin and SUPG. Measure overshoot/undershoot magnitudes and the smeared width of the interior layer.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: MSMPR crystallizer with nucleation and growth: high-resolution size-space advection
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the crystal size population balance with size-independent growth, nucleation boundary flux and washout. Use upwind and flux-limited schemes, and compare the moments with the closed moment ODEs and the steady exponential CSD.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Self-preserving size distribution for continuum-regime Brownian coagulation
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Integrate sectional Brownian coagulation from a narrow initial distribution until it becomes self-similar. Compute the asymptotic geometric standard deviation (≈1.44) and the decay exponent of the number concentration.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Lax-Wendroff phase error and dispersive wiggles behind a square wave
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Compute the discrete phase-speed ratio of Lax-Wendroff versus wavenumber and Courant number from the amplification factor. Verify it by advecting single Fourier modes, and measure the trailing-oscillation amplitude for a square pulse.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Von Neumann amplification factors versus empirical stability of advection schemes
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Compute |G(theta)| for FTCS, Lax-Friedrichs, upwind and Lax-Wendroff. Run each scheme on random initial data across Courant numbers, measure mode growth rates and compare the observed stability boundaries with theory.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Dimensionally split upwind versus corner transport upwind for diagonal 2D advection
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Advect a 2D Gaussian diagonally with unsplit donor-cell, dimensionally split upwind and CTU. Determine each scheme's stable CFL limit and measure the anisotropy of numerical diffusion.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: TVD flux limiters on Jiang-Shu composite advection profiles
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement minmod, van Leer, MC and superbee limited Lax-Wendroff for periodic advection of a Gaussian, square, triangle and ellipse. Compute L1 errors and peak clipping, and check the TVD property.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Leapfrog advection computational mode and Robert-Asselin filter damping
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Advect a wave with leapfrog time stepping and centered space differencing, and identify the spurious computational mode. Measure how the Robert-Asselin filter coefficient damps that mode and the physical-mode amplitude error.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Conservative versus advective upwind forms for variable-velocity transport
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Advect tracer in a spatially varying periodic velocity a(x) with flux-form and advective-form upwind. Compare total mass drift and the steady-state profile c ∝ 1/a(x).

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: 1D Poisson V-cycle: weighted Jacobi smoothing and h-independent convergence
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement a recursive V-cycle with weighted Jacobi (omega = 2/3), full weighting and linear interpolation. Measure the asymptotic convergence factor versus grid levels and compare with two-grid analysis.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Jumping-coefficient diffusion multigrid with Galerkin coarse operators
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve diffusion with a coefficient contrast of 1e4 across inclusions. Compare rediscretized coarse grids with Galerkin RAP and operator-dependent (de Zeeuw-type) prolongation, measuring convergence factors versus contrast.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Multigrid-preconditioned conjugate gradient for 3D Poisson
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Use a symmetric V-cycle as a preconditioner for CG on the 7-point 3D Laplacian. Show grid-independent iteration counts, compared with the sqrt(condition) growth of unpreconditioned CG.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Full approximation scheme multigrid for the nonlinear Bratu problem
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve -Δu = λ e^u on the unit square with FAS and nonlinear Gauss-Seidel smoothing. Measure convergence factors and the center value u(0.5, 0.5) for λ up to near the fold.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Cell-centered multigrid for Neumann pressure Poisson with nullspace handling
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement cell-centered restriction and prolongation for a pressure-projection Poisson problem with homogeneous Neumann boundaries. Enforce compatibility and the zero-mean condition on every level, and measure convergence factors.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Higher-order FEM reduces Helmholtz pollution at fixed DOFs per wavelength
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the 1D Helmholtz problem with P1, P2 and P3 Lagrange elements at matched degrees of freedom per wavelength. Measure the error growth with k for each order to show the reduced pollution effect.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Sound-soft cylinder scattering with polar finite differences and DtN boundary
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve plane-wave scattering by a circular cylinder on a polar grid truncated with the exact Dirichlet-to-Neumann map. Compare the far-field pattern with the Bessel-Hankel series solution versus ka and grid resolution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Expansion-chamber muffler transmission loss by 2D Helmholtz finite differences
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Model an axisymmetric or 2D expansion chamber duct with incident-wave and anechoic boundary conditions. Compute the transmission loss spectrum, and compare it with the plane-wave formula below the first cut-on frequency.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Eyre convex splitting for Allen-Cahn: unconditional energy decay
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement convex-concave splitting of the Ginzburg-Landau energy with a Fourier spectral discretization. Verify monotone discrete energy decay for large dt, and compare with the instability of fully explicit stepping.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Allen-Cahn shrinking circle and mean-curvature flow law
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Evolve a circular domain under 2D Allen-Cahn with a semi-implicit spectral scheme and track its radius from the zero contour area. Verify R^2 = R0^2 - 2t, and check convergence as the interface width decreases.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Cahn-Hilliard equilibrium interface profile and surface tension
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Relax a 1D Cahn-Hilliard interface to equilibrium. Compare the profile with tanh(x/√2 eps) and compute the interfacial energy integral against the analytic value 2√2/3 eps.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Discrete maximum principle for stabilized semi-implicit Allen-Cahn finite differences
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement a stabilized linear semi-implicit FD scheme for Allen-Cahn. Derive the time-step condition for |u| ≤ 1, and test random initial data near and beyond the threshold.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Ohta-Kawasaki block copolymer lamellar period versus long-range interaction strength
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve Cahn-Hilliard with the Ohta-Kawasaki nonlocal term using semi-implicit spectral stepping. Measure the equilibrium lamellar wavelength from the structure-factor peak, and compare it with the scaling (eps/sigma)^{1/3}.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Two-droplet Ostwald ripening in Cahn-Hilliard: small droplet dissolution time
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Initialize two droplets of unequal radii in 2D Cahn-Hilliard and evolve them spectrally. Record the dissolution time of the smaller droplet versus radius ratio, and compare it with a quasi-static Gibbs-Thomson diffusion estimate.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Scalar auxiliary variable scheme for Cahn-Hilliard: modified energy and temporal order
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement first- and second-order SAV (BDF2) schemes for Cahn-Hilliard with a Fourier spectral discretization. Verify dissipation of the modified energy, compare it with the original energy, and measure temporal convergence orders.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Clamped square plate center deflection with the 13-point biharmonic stencil
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Assemble the 13-point ∇^4 stencil with ghost-point clamped boundary conditions. Compute the center deflection under uniform load, and Richardson-extrapolate toward 0.00126 qa^4/D.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Fundamental vibration frequency of a clamped square plate
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the plate eigenproblem ∇^4 w = λ w with the 13-point stencil and sparse eigensolvers. Report the lowest frequency parameter ω a^2 √(ρh/D) ≈ 35.99 and its convergence order.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Buckling load of a uniaxially compressed simply supported plate
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Discretize D∇^4 w + N_x w_xx = 0 by finite differences as a generalized eigenproblem. Compute the buckling coefficient k versus aspect ratio to reproduce the garland curve with minimum k = 4.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Axisymmetric clamped circular plate in polar finite differences
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Discretize the radial biharmonic operator with a regularity condition at r = 0. Compare the uniform-load deflection with w = q(a^2 - r^2)^2/64D, and the point-load deflection with its logarithmic solution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Euler-Bernoulli beam on Winkler foundation under point load
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve EI w'''' + k w = P δ(x) on a long beam with finite differences. Compare the deflection and bending moment profiles with Hetenyi's closed-form solution and its characteristic length (4EI/k)^{1/4}.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Capillary leveling of thin films: linearized fourth-order decay rates
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the thin-film equation h_t = -(h^3 h_xxx)_x for a small sinusoidal perturbation with implicit finite differences. Compare the decay rate with h0^3 k^4, and quantify nonlinear deviations at larger amplitudes.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Chebyshev collocation boundary-value problem: exponential convergence versus N
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Build the Chebyshev differentiation matrix and solve u'' = e^{4x}, u(±1) = 0, together with a variable-coefficient BVP. Plot exponential error decay versus N, and compare with second-order finite differences.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Spurious eigenvalues in Chebyshev tau versus collocation for fourth-order problems
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Discretize u'''' = λ u'' with clamped boundary conditions by Chebyshev tau and collocation. Identify the large spurious eigenvalues and show how the Gottlieb-Orszag modified formulation removes them.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Chebyshev differentiation matrix eigenvalues: N^4 stiffness and explicit time-step limits
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Compute the spectrum of the Dirichlet second-derivative Chebyshev matrix. Verify that the largest eigenvalue scales like N^4, and find the empirical RK4 stability limit for the 1D heat equation.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Falkner-Skan wall shear and separation via mapped Chebyshev Newton
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the Falkner-Skan equation on a semi-infinite domain with an algebraic Chebyshev map and Newton iteration. Trace f''(0) versus the pressure-gradient parameter β to the separation point β ≈ -0.1988.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Laminar rectangular duct flow Poiseuille number via 2D Chebyshev collocation
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve ∇^2 u = -1 on a rectangle with Kronecker-product Chebyshev collocation. Compute the friction factor-Reynolds product fRe versus aspect ratio, and compare with the Shah-London series values.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Bakhvalov versus Shishkin meshes: removing the logarithmic factor
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Generate graded Bakhvalov and piecewise-uniform Shishkin meshes for the same singularly perturbed problem. Compare their eps-uniform error constants and confirm that the Bakhvalov mesh achieves a pure N^{-1} rate.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: 2D convection-diffusion with exponential layers on tensor Shishkin meshes
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve -eps Δu + b·∇u = f on the unit square with outflow layers at two edges, using upwind differences on tensor-product Shishkin meshes. Verify eps-uniform convergence and compare with uniform meshes.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Reaction-diffusion two-layer problem: central differences on Shishkin mesh
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve -eps^2 u'' + c u = f with boundary layers at both ends using central differences on a symmetric Shishkin mesh. Verify the almost second-order eps-uniform rate (N^{-1} ln N)^2.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Interior turning-point layer: eps u'' + x u' = 0
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the turning-point problem with an erf-shaped interior layer using upwind schemes that switch direction at x = 0, on uniform and layer-adapted meshes. Compare with the exact error-function solution as eps → 0.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Nernst-Planck ion flux across a membrane: Scharfetter-Gummel versus GHK equation
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve steady Nernst-Planck transport in a constant-field membrane with Scharfetter-Gummel discretization. Compute the ionic current-voltage relation and the reversal potential, and compare them with the Goldman-Hodgkin-Katz formulas.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Roe flux expansion-shock glitch and Harten-Hyman entropy fix
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Run first-order Godunov with a Roe flux on a shock tube containing a transonic rarefaction (Toro test 1). Measure the size of the entropy-violating expansion shock with and without the Harten-Hyman fix, using the exact Riemann solution as reference.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: HLL versus HLLC resolution of isolated stationary and moving contacts
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Apply first-order HLL and HLLC fluxes to a pure density jump at uniform pressure and velocity. Quantify how many cells the contact is smeared over against time, and confirm that HLLC preserves a stationary contact exactly.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: HLLE wave-speed estimates: Davis versus Einfeldt-Roe bounds on Lax problem
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement the HLL flux with simple Davis speeds and with Einfeldt's Roe-average speeds for the Lax shock tube. Compare density L1 errors against the exact solution and check positivity over a sequence of grids.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: MUSCL-Hancock HLLC: primitive versus characteristic-variable limiting oscillations
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Build a second-order MUSCL-Hancock scheme with an HLLC flux for the Lax shock tube. Compare spurious post-shock oscillation amplitude and L1 error when slopes are limited in primitive variables versus characteristic variables.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Slowly moving shock post-shock momentum oscillations with Roe and HLL
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Simulate a slowly moving Mach-3 shock in 1D Euler with Godunov-type fluxes. Measure the amplitude and wavelength of the low-frequency post-shock oscillations in momentum and entropy for Roe, HLL and HLLC.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Woodward-Colella interacting blast waves with reflecting walls
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the two-blast-wave problem with a MUSCL-HLLC scheme and reflecting ghost cells. Report the density profile at t=0.038 and the convergence of the peak density and its location against a fine-grid reference.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Quirk odd-even decoupling: carbuncle growth with Roe versus HLLE
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Propagate a Mach-6 planar shock down a 2D duct with a perturbed centreline on a first-order finite-volume grid. Track the growth of the transverse density perturbation for the Roe flux against the dissipative HLLE flux.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Exact Riemann solver for stiffened-gas water-air shock tube
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Extend the exact Euler Riemann solver to the stiffened-gas equation of state with different parameters on each side. Compute the star pressure and the wave pattern for a high-pressure water / low-pressure air interface.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Lagrangian Godunov scheme in mass coordinates for Sod problem
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve 1D gas dynamics in Lagrangian mass coordinates with an acoustic (two-shock) Riemann solver at cell faces. Map the result back to Eulerian space and show that the contact stays sharp, unlike in an Eulerian HLL run.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: 2D Lax-Liu four-quadrant Riemann problem with dimensionally split HLLC
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve a 2D Riemann configuration with four shocks or rarefactions using Strang dimensional splitting of a 1D MUSCL-HLLC solver. Measure the diagonal symmetry error and the extrema of density in the central interaction region.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Planar Noh implosion and wall-heating density error
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the planar Noh problem, two colliding cold streams forming accretion shocks, with a Godunov HLLC scheme. Measure the anomalous density dip and temperature spike at the origin against the exact post-shock state as the grid is refined.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Quasi-1D converging-diverging nozzle normal shock location by time marching
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Integrate the quasi-1D Euler equations with area source terms and a Rusanov or HLL flux to steady state for a given back pressure. Compare the captured normal shock position with the isentropic-flow and normal-shock analytic solution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Brio-Wu MHD shock tube with HLL flux and compound wave
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the 1D ideal MHD equations for the Brio-Wu problem using an HLL flux and MUSCL reconstruction. Report the plateau values and locate the compound wave and slow shock against a high-resolution reference.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Chapman-Jouguet detonation speed in reactive Euler with one-step Arrhenius
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the 1D reactive Euler equations with a progress variable and Arrhenius heat release, using operator splitting of HLLC transport and stiff chemistry. Measure the self-sustained detonation speed and compare it with the analytic CJ speed.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Stoker wet-bed dam break exact solution versus HLL finite volumes
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Derive the intermediate depth of the Stoker dam break from the shock-rarefaction compatibility equation. Compare depth and velocity profiles and bore speed from a 1D Saint-Venant HLL finite-volume solver over a range of downstream-to-upstream depth ratios.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Thacker oscillating planar surface in a parabolic bowl

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: 2D cylindrical dam break: split Rusanov versus radial 1D reference
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve a circular dam break with a 2D dimensionally split Rusanov or HLL finite-volume shallow-water solver. Compare azimuthally averaged depth with a fine 1D radial solver that includes geometric source terms, and quantify grid-induced anisotropy.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Rossby geostrophic adjustment of a height step on Arakawa C-grid

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Inertia-gravity wave dispersion on Arakawa A, B and C grids
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Derive and numerically evaluate the discrete frequency of linear inertia-gravity waves on A-, B- and C-grid staggerings as a function of wavenumber times grid spacing and of Rossby radius over grid spacing. Verify the frequencies with small time-domain simulations.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Roll-wave instability in inclined channel flow with Chezy friction
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Linearise the friction-sloped Saint-Venant equations about uniform flow and compute the perturbation growth rate against Froude number, with instability above Fr = 2. Confirm the growth rates with periodic finite-volume simulations of a small perturbation.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Solitary-wave runup on a plane beach versus Synolakis law
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Propagate a solitary wave onto a sloping beach with a wet-dry well-balanced shallow-water solver. Compare the maximum runup with Synolakis' law R/d = 2.831 sqrt(cot beta)(H/d)^{5/4} for several wave heights.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Manning friction semi-implicit treatment and convergence to normal depth
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Add Manning bed friction to a 1D Saint-Venant solver using explicit and semi-implicit point-implicit source updates. Compare stability near dry states and convergence of steady inclined-channel flow to the analytic normal depth.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Exner bed evolution: sand-dune migration speed under Grass transport
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Couple the shallow-water equations with the Exner bed equation using a Grass sediment flux and a splitting finite-volume scheme. Measure the migration speed of a small dune and compare it with the linearised bed celerity.
