math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Sussman reinitialization with and without Russo-Smereka subcell fix
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Reinitialise a distorted level-set function to signed distance by solving the PDE phi_t + S(phi)(|grad phi| - 1) = 0 with a Godunov Hamiltonian. Measure the interface displacement and distance error with and without the subcell fix.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Single-vortex deformation test with time reversal: interface recovery
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Stretch a circular interface in the time-periodic single-vortex velocity field and then reverse it, using level-set advection with periodic reinitialisation. Compute the area loss and the L1 shape error after one period as the grid is refined.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Zhao fast sweeping for eikonal: grid-independent sweep count
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the eikonal equation with Gauss-Seidel fast sweeping in four alternating orderings, for several point and line sources. Show that the number of sweeps to convergence does not grow with grid size, and report the distance error.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Constant normal-speed expansion of a square: Steiner area law
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Propagate a square interface outward at unit normal speed using an ENO/WENO Hamilton-Jacobi scheme with Godunov Hamiltonian. Check that the corners round off as an entropy solution and that the area follows A0 + P0 t + pi t^2.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Olsson-Kreiss conservative level set versus standard level-set mass loss
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Advect a circle in a shearing flow using a smeared Heaviside conservative level set with a compression-diffusion reinitialisation step. Compare the mass conservation error with that of a standard signed-distance level-set method.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: PLIC volume-of-fluid with Youngs normals for translating circle
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Reconstruct piecewise-linear interfaces in each cell from volume fractions using Youngs' gradient normals, and advect them with directionally split geometric fluxes. Report exact volume conservation, bounded fractions, and the shape error after diagonal translation.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Ghost fluid method for a gas-gas shock-interface problem
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Track a material interface between two ideal gases with a level set, and set ghost states using the original Fedkiw ghost fluid method. Compare the pressure oscillations at the interface with those of a fully conservative mixture scheme.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Levander fourth-order staggered grid: phase-velocity error versus points per wavelength
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Derive the numerical dispersion relations of second- and fourth-order staggered velocity-stress schemes. Evaluate the phase-velocity error against points per wavelength and Courant number, and confirm it from simulated pulse travel times.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Refraction head waves and crossover distance in a two-layer model
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Simulate 2D acoustic waves in a slow layer over a fast half-space with a finite-difference scheme. Pick first arrivals at offsets to identify direct and head waves, and compare the crossover distance with ray theory.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Split Hopkinson bar: incident, reflected and transmitted strain pulses
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Model 1D longitudinal waves in an input bar, a short specimen and an output bar with a staggered velocity-stress scheme. Recover the specimen stress and strain rate from the simulated gauge signals using the classical three-wave analysis.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Viscoelastic standard linear solid memory variables: attenuation Q versus frequency
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Add memory-variable relaxation mechanisms to a 1D velocity-stress scheme to represent a standard linear solid. Measure the amplitude decay and dispersion of propagating pulses and compare the inferred Q(f) with the analytic SLS quality factor.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Phononic band gap of a periodic bilayer: transfer matrix versus FDTD
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Compute Bloch band gaps of a 1D periodic elastic bilayer from the transfer-matrix dispersion relation. Verify the gaps by finite-difference time-domain transmission of a broadband pulse through a finite stack.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: 1D spectral-element wave equation with GLL quadrature: dispersion versus order
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Assemble Gauss-Lobatto-Legendre spectral elements with a diagonal mass matrix for the 1D wave equation and step with leapfrog. Measure the phase error against polynomial degree at a fixed number of nodes per wavelength.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Adjoint-state gradient for 1D acoustic velocity inversion
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Compute the misfit gradient with respect to a 1D velocity model by correlating forward and time-reversed adjoint finite-difference wavefields. Verify the gradient against finite-difference perturbations of the misfit.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Seismic site amplification of a soft sediment layer
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Simulate vertically incident SH waves through a soft layer over bedrock with a staggered 1D scheme and a transmitting bottom boundary. Compute the surface-to-input spectral ratio and compare the resonance f0 = Vs/(4H) and its peak amplitude with the analytic transfer function.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Implicit TVD step limits: backward Euler versus Crank-Nicolson
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Show numerically that backward Euler with upwind advection is TVD at any step size, and find the Courant number above which Crank-Nicolson creates new extrema in a step profile. Compare that threshold with the theoretical SSP coefficient of 2.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Zhang-Shu maximum-principle-preserving limiter with SSPRK3
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Combine a high-order finite-volume advection scheme with the Zhang-Shu scaling limiter, which keeps point values within global bounds, and SSPRK3. Verify the discrete maximum principle and measure the order retained on smooth data.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Asymptotic-preserving IMEX SSP Runge-Kutta for Jin-Xin relaxation
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the Jin-Xin relaxation system for Burgers with IMEX Runge-Kutta schemes that have an SSP explicit part and an L-stable implicit part. Show that the scheme stays stable as the relaxation time goes to zero and converges to the relaxed conservation law.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Embedded SSPRK3(2) adaptive time stepping through Burgers shock formation
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Pair SSPRK3 with an embedded second-order SSP method to estimate the local error and control the step size for a WENO Burgers solution. Monitor accepted steps against the SSP limit and the total variation as the shock forms.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Tidal fluctuation propagation into a coastal confined aquifer
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve 1D transient groundwater flow with a sinusoidal tidal boundary head using Crank-Nicolson finite differences. Compare the amplitude decay and phase lag with distance against Ferris' analytic solution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Hantush leaky aquifer steady drawdown and leakage factor
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve radial steady flow toward a well in a leaky confined aquifer with finite volumes on a logarithmic radial grid. Compare the drawdown with the K0(r/B) Hantush-Jacob solution and compute the fraction of pumping supplied by leakage.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Pollock semi-analytical particle tracking on a finite-volume Darcy field
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Compute face fluxes from a two-point-flux Darcy solve and trace streamlines with Pollock's exact within-cell exponential method. Validate travel times against the analytic result in uniform flow, then report travel-time statistics in a layered aquifer.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Self-sharpening Langmuir sorption fronts versus Freundlich spreading
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve advection-dispersion with nonlinear equilibrium sorption using a finite-volume scheme and Picard iteration. Compare the constant-pattern traveling-wave speed and width for Langmuir isotherms with the spreading fronts produced by unfavourable isotherms.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Steady contaminant plume length with instantaneous bimolecular reaction
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve 2D steady advection-transverse-dispersion for a conservative mixing ratio with finite volumes and map it to reactant concentrations. Compare the plume length with the Cirpka/Liedl analytic expression.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Terzaghi consolidation of a clay layer: degree of consolidation
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve 1D excess pore-pressure diffusion with theta-scheme finite differences under single and double drainage. Compare the average degree of consolidation against time factor with the Fourier-series solution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Heat as groundwater tracer: Bredehoeft-Papadopulos vertical seepage profile
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve steady 1D conduction-advection of heat for vertical groundwater flow with finite differences. Fit the Peclet number from the temperature profile and compare it with the analytic exponential solution to estimate seepage velocity.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Crank-Nicolson convection-diffusion of a pulse: cell Peclet and Fourier constraints
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Study unsteady 1D convection-diffusion of a sharp pulse with central-difference Crank-Nicolson stepping. Map where negative undershoots appear as a function of cell Peclet and mesh Fourier number, and compare the map with the M-matrix positivity conditions.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: QUICK scheme boundedness for steady convection-diffusion
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve steady 1D and 2D convection-diffusion with upwind, central and QUICK (Leonard) face interpolation, using deferred correction for QUICK. Compare overshoots and accuracy across Peclet numbers for a step-inflow profile.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Floating-strike lookback put via similarity reduction to 1D PDE
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Reduce the floating-strike lookback PDE to one variable, the ratio of running maximum to spot, with a Neumann condition at ratio 1, and solve with Crank-Nicolson. Compare with the Goldman-Sosin-Gatto closed-form price.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: American put by Forsyth-Vetzal penalty iteration: quadratic convergence
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Price an American put with Crank-Nicolson and a nonlinear penalty term solved by a policy-type Newton iteration. Report the iteration count, the price convergence in the penalty parameter, and the early-exercise boundary.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Tsiveriotis-Fernandes convertible bond with credit spread
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the coupled cash-only and total convertible-value PDEs with conversion and call constraints applied at each step. Compute the convertible price and conversion premium as functions of spot and credit spread.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Avellaneda uncertain-volatility bounds for a butterfly spread
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the nonlinear Black-Scholes-Barenblatt equation, in which volatility switches with the sign of gamma, using an implicit scheme with policy iteration. Compute the upper and lower price bounds for a butterfly spread.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: CIR zero-coupon bond price from short-rate PDE versus closed form
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the Cox-Ingersoll-Ross bond pricing PDE with upwinded drift and implicit stepping, including the degenerate r = 0 boundary. Compare the bond price and yield curve with the affine closed-form solution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Leland transaction-cost nonlinear Black-Scholes hedging price
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve Black-Scholes with the Leland gamma-dependent adjusted volatility by Picard-iterated implicit finite differences. Compare with the Leland formula for convex payoffs and report the price increase against rebalancing frequency.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Pekeris waveguide normal-mode wavenumbers by finite-difference depth eigenproblem
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Discretise the depth-separated Helmholtz operator for an isovelocity water layer over a fluid half-space, using a truncated bottom. Compare the modal horizontal wavenumbers and the transmission loss from normal-mode summation with the analytic characteristic equation.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Crank-Nicolson parabolic equation for range-dependent ocean acoustics
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: March the standard parabolic approximation to the Helmholtz equation in range with Crank-Nicolson in depth over a sloping (wedge) bottom. Compute transmission loss and compare it with the normal-mode solution in the flat-bottom case.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Optimized Schwarz domain decomposition for Helmholtz with Robin transmission
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the 2D Helmholtz equation with a two-subdomain Schwarz iteration that uses Robin interface conditions. Compare the convergence factor against the Robin parameter with Fourier analysis, and contrast it with classical Dirichlet Schwarz.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Born approximation validity for scattering from a weak Gaussian inhomogeneity
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Compute the scattered field from a Gaussian refractive-index perturbation by full finite-difference Helmholtz with PML and by the first-order Born approximation. Measure the relative error against contrast and wavenumber.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Kumar cell-average technique for Smoluchowski aggregation on geometric grids
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement the cell-average technique for coagulation on a geometric pivot grid. Compare the number density and second-moment accuracy with exact constant- and sum-kernel solutions.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Quadrature method of moments versus sectional solver for Brownian coagulation
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Evolve the moments of free-molecular Brownian coagulation with QMOM, using Wheeler-type inversion to get quadrature nodes. Compare moment evolution and approach to self-preservation with a sectional reference solution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Aerosol condensational growth: fixed versus moving sectional numerical diffusion
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve size-space advection for diffusion-limited condensation growth with a fixed-section upwind scheme and a moving-section Lagrangian scheme. Quantify the spurious broadening of a monodisperse mode against the exact characteristic solution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Random scission polymer degradation: chain-length distribution and moments
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the continuous binary-breakage equation with a uniform daughter distribution and a length-proportional rate, using a conservative finite-volume scheme. Check the mass conservation and number growth against the analytic moment equations.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Shattering transition in fragmentation with a diverging small-size rate
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the fragmentation equation with a rate a(x) proportional to x^{-alpha} using finite volumes on a logarithmic grid. Measure the mass lost to dust for alpha < 0 against Filippov's analytic prediction.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Steady-state coagulation with continuous monomer source and removal

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: 1D Keller-Segel chemotaxis aggregation: peak growth with sparse BDF

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Kobayashi anisotropic phase-field dendrite: tip velocity versus anisotropy strength

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Degenerate-mobility Cahn-Hilliard: surface-diffusion coarsening exponent one-quarter

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Cahn-Hilliard wetting boundary condition: droplet contact angle versus Young's law
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Impose a cubic surface-energy Neumann condition on a wall in a 2D finite-difference Cahn-Hilliard model and relax a sessile droplet to equilibrium. Measure the contact angle from the interface contour and compare it with the prescribed Young angle.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Fan-Chen multi-order-parameter grain growth: linear mean grain area growth

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Allen-Cahn critical nucleus radius with a bulk driving-force bias
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Add a tilt term to the Allen-Cahn double-well potential and evolve circular nuclei of different radii in 2D. Bracket the critical radius that separates shrinking from growing nuclei and compare it with R* = sigma/Delta f from sharp-interface theory.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Leapfrog wave equation magic time step and exact discrete energy invariant

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: 2D Yee line-source radiation versus Hankel-function Green's function

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Low-Reynolds flow past a circular cylinder in polar vorticity-streamfunction form
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Use a log-polar mapped grid around the cylinder with far-field uniform-flow conditions and march the vorticity transport to steady state at Re 10-40. Compute the drag coefficient, the recirculation length and the separation angle.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Backward-facing step reattachment length versus Reynolds number
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve channel flow over a backward-facing step in vorticity-streamfunction variables with a parabolic inflow and convective outflow. Locate reattachment from sign changes of the wall vorticity and compare its trend with Reynolds number against benchmarks.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Thom versus Woods wall-vorticity boundary formulas: accuracy and stability
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement first-order Thom and second-order Woods wall-vorticity conditions in a driven-cavity or Couette-Poiseuille test with a known solution. Measure the convergence order of wall vorticity and the maximum stable relaxation or time step for each formula.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Lamb-Oseen vortex viscous decay with finite-difference vorticity-streamfunction
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Evolve a Gaussian vortex on a doubly periodic finite-difference grid with an FFT Poisson solve and second-order time stepping. Compare the peak vorticity and core radius growth with the exact Lamb-Oseen solution and check circulation conservation.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: De Vahl Davis differentially heated cavity: Nusselt number at Ra 10^3-10^5
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Couple Boussinesq temperature transport to vorticity-streamfunction flow in a square cavity with heated and cooled side walls. Compute the average Nusselt number and the maximum velocities, and compare with the benchmark solution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Co-rotating vortex merger: critical separation ratio
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Simulate two equal Gaussian vortices at varying separations with a viscous vorticity-streamfunction solver on a periodic grid. Detect merger from the evolution of the vorticity maxima and the separation, and estimate the critical core-size-to-separation ratio.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Arakawa Jacobian conservation of energy and enstrophy in inviscid 2D flow
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Compare the simple centered Jacobian with the Arakawa nine-point Jacobian for inviscid vorticity advection on a periodic grid. Track the drift of discrete kinetic energy and enstrophy over long runs and the appearance of nonlinear instability.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: 1D linear FEM: H1/L2 rates and nodal superconvergence for variable coefficients
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Assemble the P1 stiffness matrix and load vector with Gauss quadrature for -(a(x)u')' = f with mixed Dirichlet-Robin conditions. Verify O(h) H1 and O(h^2) L2 rates and show nodal exactness for constant coefficients with exact load integration.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Residual a posteriori estimator and adaptive refinement on the L-shaped domain
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve P1 Poisson on the L-shaped domain with the r^(2/3) corner singularity, compute element residual and jump error indicators, and refine with Dorfler marking and newest-vertex bisection. Compare the energy error versus DOFs for adaptive and uniform meshes.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Mass lumping and discrete maximum principle for P1 heat equation
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the heat equation with P1 elements and backward Euler using consistent and lumped mass matrices. Find the time-step thresholds below which consistent mass produces undershoots, and relate them to the M-matrix property of M + dt K.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Constant-strain triangle cantilever: tip deflection, shear locking and refinement
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Assemble plane-stress CST elasticity on a slender cantilever with an end shear traction. Compare the tip deflection with Timoshenko beam theory and demonstrate the slow convergence caused by shear locking of linear triangles.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Minimal surface Plateau problem with P1 FEM and Newton iteration
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Discretize the nonlinear minimal-surface operator on a square with Scherk-type or catenoidal boundary data and solve with Newton iteration on assembled Jacobians. Compute the surface area and compare with exact minimal surfaces.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Discontinuous-coefficient interface problem: fitted versus unfitted P1 meshes
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve -div(a grad u) = f with a circular inclusion where a jumps, comparing meshes aligned with the interface against meshes that cut it. Measure the degradation of the L2 and H1 convergence rates using the analytic interface solution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Prandtl torsion of an elliptic bar: P1 torsional rigidity versus exact
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the Prandtl stress-function Poisson problem on triangulated ellipses and integrate to obtain the torsion constant. Compare with the exact pi a^3 b^3/(a^2 + b^2) and evaluate the maximum shear stress.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Cooling fin efficiency with convective Robin conditions in 1D FEM
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Assemble P1 elements for a straight or tapered fin with lateral convection as a reaction term and a convective tip condition. Compute the fin heat rate and efficiency and compare with the analytic tanh(mL)-type formula.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Ridged rectangular waveguide cutoff wavenumbers by finite-difference eigenproblem
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the 2D Helmholtz eigenproblem for TE (Neumann) and TM (Dirichlet) modes of a single-ridge waveguide cross-section on a staircase grid. Compute the cutoff wavenumbers and the bandwidth improvement over an empty rectangular guide.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Acoustically lined duct attenuation from impedance-boundary Helmholtz modes
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Compute the axial wavenumbers of a 2D duct with a locally reacting impedance wall by solving the transverse Helmholtz eigenproblem with finite differences. Derive the modal attenuation rates in dB per length and compare with roots of the analytic transcendental equation.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Quantum tunneling transmission through a barrier with open-boundary finite differences
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the stationary Schrodinger equation as a variable-coefficient Helmholtz problem with exact outgoing Robin conditions on both sides. Compute the transmission coefficient versus energy and compare with analytic rectangular and double-barrier resonant tunneling results.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Singer-Turkel fourth-order compact 2D Helmholtz scheme convergence
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement the sixth-order-like compact nine-point Helmholtz stencil with corrected right-hand side for problems with a source. Compare its convergence order and error at fixed points per wavelength with the standard 5-point scheme.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Helmholtz turning point with linear wavenumber profile versus Airy solution
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve u'' + k^2(x)u = 0 with k^2 linear in x across a turning point, using an incoming-wave condition on one side and decay on the other. Compare the finite-difference solution with the exact Airy-function solution, including the reflection phase -pi/2 predicted by WKB connection.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Three-phase Buckley-Leverett with Stone II relative permeabilities: elliptic region detection
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Compute flux-Jacobian eigenvalues over the saturation triangle for water-oil-gas Stone II mobilities to locate regions of complex eigenvalues. Run upwind finite-volume displacements and report solution profiles near and away from the umbilic point.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Dykstra-Parsons layered reservoir waterflood: vertical sweep from noncommunicating Buckley-Leverett layers
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Simulate independent finite-volume Buckley-Leverett floods in layers with lognormal permeabilities under a common pressure drop. Compute vertical coverage and recovery versus injected pore volumes as functions of the Dykstra-Parsons coefficient.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Streamline time-of-flight mapping of 1D Buckley-Leverett in heterogeneous 2D fields
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the pressure equation with TPFA, trace streamlines, compute time of flight, and map the analytical 1D Buckley-Leverett solution onto it. Compare producer water cut with a full 2D upwind saturation simulation.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Buckley-Leverett across a rock-type interface: discontinuous flux and capillary oil trapping
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve saturation transport with spatially discontinuous flux and capillary pressure using an interface-coupled finite-volume flux. Compute the trapped oil saturation upstream of the interface and compare with the extended pressure-continuity condition.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Vertical-equilibrium CO2 plume migration with residual trapping: plume tip speed
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the hyperbolic sharp-interface vertical-equilibrium equation for an injected CO2 plume with hysteretic residual trapping, using an upwind finite-volume scheme. Compare the migration distance and trapped volume with the Hesse-Juanes similarity predictions.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Murman-Roe scheme admits entropy-violating shocks for the nonconvex Buckley-Leverett flux
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Compare Murman-Roe, Godunov (exact Riemann minimization) and Lax-Friedrichs fluxes on a Buckley-Leverett Riemann problem. Measure the L1 deviation from the Oleinik solution, showing that the Murman-Roe scheme converges to a nonphysical solution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Front tracking with Dafermos piecewise-linear flux for Buckley-Leverett Riemann problems
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Replace the fractional-flow curve by a piecewise-linear interpolant and solve by exact front tracking with wave interactions. Measure the L1 convergence of the front-tracking solution to the exact entropy solution as the flux breakpoints are refined.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Van der Waals thin-film rupture: self-similar minimum thickness scaling (t_r - t)^{1/5}
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve h_t + (h^3 h_xxx + A h_x/h)_x = 0 with implicit Newton steps on an adaptively refined time step. Fit the decay of the minimum thickness approaching rupture and compare the exponent with the similarity theory value 1/5.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Thermocapillary long-wave instability: critical Marangoni number and dry-spot formation
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Derive the dispersion relation of a heated film with Marangoni and capillary terms, then solve the nonlinear lubrication equation implicitly. Compare the onset Marangoni number and time to dry spot with linear predictions.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Zhornitskaya-Bertozzi positivity-preserving entropy scheme for the degenerate thin-film equation
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement the entropy-consistent mobility discretization for h_t = -(h^n h_xxx)_x and compare it with a naive arithmetic-mean mobility on near-touchdown data. Report minimum thickness positivity and discrete entropy decay.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Pendant film Rayleigh-Taylor instability: linear growth rate and drop formation time
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the thin-film equation with destabilizing gravity under a ceiling using implicit Newton steps. Compare early growth with the linear dispersion relation and measure the saturated pendant drop shape and amplitude.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Coating flow over a trench topography: capillary ridge and depression amplitudes
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the steady and transient lubrication equation for gravity- or pressure-driven films over a smoothed step-down/step-up substrate. Compute the ridge and depression heights versus trench depth and capillary number.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Surfactant-driven thin-film spreading: Marangoni front position scaling t^{1/3}
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the coupled film-thickness and insoluble surfactant transport equations (Jensen-Grotberg) with implicit finite differences. Measure the surfactant leading-edge position versus time and fit the power-law exponent.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: de Boor equidistribution with arc-length versus curvature monitors for steep layers
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Compute equidistributing meshes for tanh-type layer functions by iterative de Boor monitor integration. Compare piecewise-linear interpolation errors and convergence rates against uniform meshes.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Winslow variable-diffusion mesh generation clustering around a circular front
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the 2D Winslow mesh equations with a monitor peaked on a circle using Picard iterations of sparse elliptic solves. Report node density near the front, cell aspect ratios and minimum Jacobian versus monitor strength.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Equidistributed meshes for singularly perturbed boundary-value problems: eps-uniform second order
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Iteratively construct meshes equidistributing a solution-based monitor for eps u'' - u' = f with central differences. Show convergence that is uniform in eps, in contrast to uniform meshes.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Parabolic Monge-Ampere r-adaptivity in 2D for a moving Gaussian feature
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the parabolic Monge-Ampere mesh equation of Budd-Williams with finite differences to generate optimally transported meshes. Measure mesh skewness, equidistribution quality and interpolation error versus a uniform grid.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Bump-on-tail instability: linear growth and trapped-particle saturation amplitude
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Simulate the bump-on-tail distribution with split semi-Lagrangian Vlasov-Poisson. Measure the linear growth rate and saturated field amplitude, and relate saturation to the trapping (bounce) frequency matching the growth rate.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Hermite-Fourier spectral Vlasov with Lenard-Bernstein collisions: collisional Landau damping
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Expand f in asymmetrically weighted Hermite modes and Fourier space modes, and integrate the moment hierarchy with collisional damping. Report the damping rate versus collision frequency and Hermite truncation.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Ion-acoustic wave damping: kinetic Vlasov ions with Boltzmann electrons
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the ion Vlasov equation coupled to a nonlinear Poisson-Boltzmann electron closure via Newton iteration. Compare frequency and damping versus temperature ratio Te/Ti with the kinetic dispersion relation.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Nonlinear Landau damping: invariant conservation under spline versus Lagrange semi-Lagrangian interpolation
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Run strong-amplitude Landau damping with cubic-spline and Lagrange-interpolation semi-Lagrangian schemes. Track the drifts in mass, L2 norm, kinetic entropy and total energy, together with the long-time electric-field behaviour.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Plasma echo in Vlasov-Poisson: echo time and amplitude from two successive kicks
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Apply two external field pulses of wavenumbers k1 and k2 to a Maxwellian plasma in a high-resolution Vlasov solver. Detect the echo at the predicted time and wavenumber, and measure its amplitude.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Diocotron instability of a guiding-center electron annulus: growth rate versus mode number
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the 2D guiding-center (drift-Poisson) model with semi-Lagrangian advection and a polar Poisson solver. Compare azimuthal mode growth rates with the linear diocotron eigenvalue problem.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Modal Legendre DG for advection: superconvergence at Radau points and outflow
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Assemble modal DG mass, stiffness and upwind flux matrices for linear advection and integrate with RK. Measure the optimal p+1 L2 rate, the higher rates at right Radau points and the cell-average superconvergence.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Numerical dispersion and dissipation of semi-discrete DG from Bloch eigenanalysis
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Form the Bloch-wave eigenproblem of the upwind DG operator for degrees p = 0 to 4. Compute the physical-mode modified wavenumber, and compare the dissipation and dispersion errors with Ainsworth's asymptotic formulas.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Local DG for the heat equation with alternating fluxes: optimal order p+1
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement LDG with alternating numerical fluxes for u_t = u_xx in a modal basis. Integrate implicitly and verify optimal L2 convergence for u and q, and compare with central fluxes.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Persson-Peraire modal decay shock sensor with artificial viscosity for DG Burgers
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Compute the sensor from the highest-mode energy fraction and add element-wise artificial viscosity to a high-order DG Burgers solver. Measure the shock width in elements and the accuracy retained away from the shock.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: SIAC filter postprocessing of DG advection solutions: recovering order 2p+1
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Construct the B-spline smoothness-increasing accuracy-conserving kernel and convolve it with DG solutions of linear advection. Show the improvement from order p+1 to 2p+1 in L2 error after filtering.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: DG for 1D Maxwell in layered media: central versus upwind flux spurious modes
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Compute eigenvalues of DG discretizations of Maxwell's equations in a piecewise-constant cavity. Show spurious modes with central fluxes, their removal with upwind fluxes, and the convergence of the cavity frequencies.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Bayliss-Gunzburger-Turkel second-order radial ABC for 2D cylinder scattering
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve exterior Helmholtz scattering from a sound-hard cylinder on a polar finite-difference grid with BGT1 and BGT2 boundary conditions. Compare far-field and near-field errors with the Bessel series versus artificial boundary radius.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Galerkin least-squares Harari-Hughes stabilization eliminating 1D Helmholtz phase error
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Assemble linear FEM with the GLS stabilization parameter chosen to give an exact discrete dispersion relation. Compare relative errors at high kh with standard Galerkin.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Leaky dielectric slab resonances via complex-scaled finite-difference eigenproblem: quality factors
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Discretize the 1D Helmholtz operator with complex coordinate stretching outside a high-index slab. Solve the sparse non-Hermitian eigenproblem for resonant frequencies and Q factors, and compare with the transcendental exact condition.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Near-to-far-field transformation for scattering by a penetrable square: bistatic cross-section
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve variable-coefficient 2D Helmholtz with PML on a fine finite-difference grid. Integrate the Kirchhoff-Helmholtz representation on a contour to get the far-field pattern, and check convergence versus points per wavelength.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Reflector savings in a reflected slab reactor: critical core thickness
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve one-group diffusion in a core-reflector slab with interface current continuity using cell-centered finite volumes. Find the critical core half-thickness by root finding on k-eff and compare the reflector savings with the analytic formula.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Two-group reflected reactor: thermal flux peak in reflector and k-effective
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Assemble two-group diffusion with downscattering in a core and water reflector, and solve by power iteration with inner linear solves. Report k-eff, thermal flux peaking in the reflector and the spectral index.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Time-dependent diffusion with delayed neutrons: stable period versus inhour equation
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve space-time one-group diffusion with one delayed precursor group implicitly after a step reactivity insertion. Extract the asymptotic period and prompt jump, and compare with inhour-equation roots.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Xenon-induced spatial power oscillations in a large slab reactor
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Couple one-group diffusion with iodine-xenon balance equations and power feedback, and perturb the axial power. Determine the oscillation period and the stability or growth of the first harmonic versus core size.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Adjoint-flux first-order perturbation reactivity worth of a localized absorber
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve forward and adjoint two-group eigenproblems and compute absorber reactivity worth from the perturbation formula. Compare against direct k-eff differences versus absorber strength and position.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Source-driven subcritical multiplication and approach to criticality
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve fixed-source diffusion problems for increasing fuel loadings. Compare total neutron population with the 1/(1-k) estimate and extrapolate inverse count rates to predict the critical loading.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: 2D two-group core with partial control-rod insertion: power peaking factor
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Discretize multiregion 2D two-group diffusion with sparse finite volumes and power iteration. Compute k-eff, the pin-power distribution and the radial peaking factor versus rod insertion pattern.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Critical soluble boron concentration via secant search on two-group k-effective
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Add a boron-dependent thermal absorption cross-section to a two-group reflected slab model. Find the concentration giving k = 1 by secant iteration on repeated eigen-solves, and report the boron worth coefficient.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Diffusion synthetic acceleration of SN source iteration: spectral radius versus scattering ratio
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement slab discrete-ordinates source iteration with diamond differencing and a consistently discretized diffusion correction. Measure the empirical spectral radius with and without DSA versus scattering ratio and optical cell thickness.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Gierer-Meinhardt spike patterns: equilibrium spike height and maximal stable spike number
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Simulate 1D Gierer-Meinhardt in the small activator-diffusion limit with implicit stepping. Measure spike amplitudes and determine the critical inhibitor diffusivity beyond which multi-spike states collapse.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Turing mode selection on a disk: Bessel eigenmodes in polar finite differences
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve Schnakenberg kinetics on a disk with no-flux boundaries using a polar grid. Identify the selected (m, n) Bessel mode from linear analysis with Neumann Laplacian eigenvalues and compare with the simulated pattern.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Raman self-frequency shift of a fiber soliton: Gordon tau^{-4} law
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the generalized NLS with a Raman delayed response via split-step and frequency-domain convolution. Measure the soliton center-frequency drift rate versus pulse width and fit the exponent.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Gray soliton speed versus depth in the defocusing NLS
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Initialize dark and gray solitons on a background with phase-jump-compatible periodic domains and propagate them by split-step Fourier. Compare measured velocity with the relation v = sqrt(rho0 - rho_min).

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Manakov vector soliton collision: polarization state transformation
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve coupled Manakov NLS equations with split-step Fourier and collide two vector solitons. Compare post-collision polarization vectors and energy exchange with the exact Manakov collision formula.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: VTI anisotropic elastic wavefronts: qP velocity versus Thomsen parameters
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Simulate 2D VTI elastodynamics with a staggered velocity-stress scheme from a point source. Measure qP and qSV wavefront velocities versus angle and compare with exact and Thomsen weak-anisotropy formulas.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Scholte interface wave at a fluid-solid boundary: speed versus secular equation
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Simulate a 2D acoustic-elastic coupled staggered grid with a source near the interface. Measure Scholte wave speed and decay, and compare with the root of the Scholte secular equation.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Antiplane dynamic rupture with slip-weakening friction: rupture speed and nucleation length
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve 2D SH elastodynamics with a split-node fault and linear slip-weakening friction on a staggered grid. Measure rupture-front speed approaching the shear speed and the critical nucleation patch size.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Biot poroelastic fast and slow P-waves with a staggered-grid scheme
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Discretize Biot's low-frequency poroelastic equations with velocity-stress-pressure staggering and implicit treatment of stiff friction. Measure fast and slow wave speeds and slow-wave diffusion against Biot theory.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Reverse-time migration imaging of a point scatterer in 2D acoustics
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Generate synthetic shot data with a finite-difference wave solver, then back-propagate receiver wavefields. Apply the cross-correlation imaging condition and measure image peak location and resolution versus frequency band.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Time-fractional subdiffusion with the L1 scheme: order 2 - alpha and Mittag-Leffler solution
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Discretize the Caputo derivative with the L1 formula and space with central differences. Verify the temporal convergence order 2 - alpha and the weak-singularity effects against Mittag-Leffler modal solutions.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Space-fractional diffusion with shifted Grunwald formula: Meerschaert-Tadjeran stability
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement shifted and unshifted Grunwald discretizations of a Riemann-Liouville space-fractional derivative. Show instability of the unshifted implicit scheme and first-order convergence of the shifted one to a manufactured solution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Second-order fast marching for distance to a circle
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve |grad T| = 1 for the distance to a circular front with Sethian's second-order upwind fast marching. Measure L-infinity and L1 error rates against the exact distance and compare with first-order FMM.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Seismic traveltimes in a linear velocity-gradient medium by fast marching
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Compute first-arrival times from a surface source in v(z) = v0 + g z using fast marching. Compare with the analytic arccosh traveltime formula and report the error versus grid spacing.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Factored eikonal equation removing the point-source singularity
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Factor T = T0 * tau with T0 the homogeneous-medium distance and solve the factored eikonal by fast sweeping in a smoothly varying velocity field. Show first-order convergence is restored, whereas the unfactored solver degrades to roughly h log h.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Elliptically anisotropic eikonal via Lax-Friedrichs sweeping
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the anisotropic eikonal sqrt(grad T^T M grad T) = 1 with the Kao-Osher-Qian Lax-Friedrichs sweeping scheme. Verify traveltimes against the analytic ellipsoidal wavefront for a point source and count the sweeps to convergence.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Monotone Lax-Friedrichs scheme for u_t + u_x^2/2 = 0 versus Hopf-Lax
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Apply first-order monotone Lax-Friedrichs and Godunov Hamiltonians to the 1D Hamilton-Jacobi equation with Lipschitz data. Compute the exact viscosity solution with the Hopf-Lax formula by minimization and check the Crandall-Lions O(sqrt(h)) error bound.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Nonconvex Hamiltonian H = cos(p+1): Godunov versus Lax-Friedrichs HJ fluxes
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the Osher-Shu nonconvex Hamilton-Jacobi test u_t + cos(u_x + 1) = 0 with the Godunov (min-max) and Lax-Friedrichs numerical Hamiltonians. Compare the kink structure and convergence to the correct viscosity solution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Geodesic distance around a circular obstacle by fast marching
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Compute the shortest-path distance in a plane with an impenetrable disk using fast marching with masked nodes. Compare in the shadow region with the analytic tangent-line-plus-arc geodesic length.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Snell's-law ray path from fast-marching traveltime backtracking
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Compute eikonal traveltimes across a two-speed planar interface, then backtrack the optimal path by gradient descent on T. Verify the refraction angles satisfy Snell's law and the traveltime matches Fermat's principle.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: G-equation flame front in periodic shear flow: effective front speed
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Evolve the level-set G-equation G_t + u . grad G = s_L |grad G| in u = (A cos y, 0) with an ENO upwind Hamilton-Jacobi scheme. Extract the long-time front speed and compare with the predicted s_L + A.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Zermelo minimum-time navigation in a uniform current via semi-Lagrangian HJB
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the stationary HJB for the minimum arrival time of a boat with speed v in a uniform current w using a semi-Lagrangian value-iteration scheme. Compare with the analytic time from |x - w t| = v t.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Shape from shading by fast marching on the eikonal |grad z| = f
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Synthesize a vertically lit image of a known surface, then reconstruct the height as the solution of the eikonal equation with brightness-derived speed using fast marching. Report the height reconstruction error versus resolution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Two-phase Stefan solidification: enthalpy method versus Neumann solution
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Freeze a superheated liquid slab from a cold wall with an explicit or implicit enthalpy finite-volume scheme that has different conductivities in each phase. Compare the front position and temperatures with the two-phase Neumann similarity solution, solving its transcendental equation for lambda.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Douglas-Gallie variable time-step front tracking for one-phase melting
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Track the melt front so that it advances exactly one grid cell per time step, iterating each step for the time increment from the Stefan condition. Compare the front trajectory with the Neumann solution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Outward radial solidification around a cooled pipe
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the cylindrical-coordinate enthalpy equation for freezing of a liquid initially at its melting point around a pipe held below melting. Compare the frozen-layer radius versus time with the quasi-steady logarithmic-profile approximation for small Stefan number.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Inward melting of a solid sphere: total melting time
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Simulate melting of a sphere initially at its melting point after a surface temperature step, using a spherical enthalpy scheme. Compute the total melting time versus Stefan number and compare with the quasi-stationary asymptotic estimate.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Binary alloy solidification with a lever-rule mushy zone
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve 1D enthalpy-temperature solidification of a binary alloy whose liquid fraction follows the equilibrium lever rule between solidus and liquidus. Compute the solidus and liquidus front trajectories and the mushy-zone width versus time.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Caginalp phase-field model converging to the sharp-interface Stefan front
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Integrate the coupled phase-field and heat equations for 1D melting at decreasing interface width. Show the extracted phi = 0 front converges to the Neumann solution, and measure the error versus interface thickness.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Apparent heat capacity versus enthalpy method: temperature-history oscillations
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Smear the latent heat over a temperature interval (apparent capacity) and compare with the enthalpy formulation for one-phase melting. Quantify the staircase oscillations in nodal temperature histories and the front error versus mushy interval width.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Permafrost active-layer thaw depth under seasonal surface forcing
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Model soil freeze-thaw with an enthalpy method under a sinusoidal annual surface temperature with latent heat of pore water. Compute the maximum thaw depth over periodic steady cycles and compare with the Stefan thaw-depth formula sqrt(2 k I_thaw / L).

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Lake ice growth with convective surface cooling
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve one-phase freezing of water at its melting point under a Robin heat-transfer condition to cold air, using front tracking with a Landau-type mapping. Compare ice thickness with the quasi-steady Stefan law that includes the heat-transfer coefficient.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Frank sphere: crystal growth into an undercooled melt
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Simulate a spherical solid nucleus growing as R = lambda sqrt(t) into a supercooled liquid with radial front tracking. Compare the growth constant with Frank's similarity solution, obtained by solving the transcendental equation involving the exponential integral.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Steady ablation velocity of a heated slab with melt removal
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Apply a constant heat flux to a slab whose melt is instantly removed and track the receding surface with a moving-boundary finite-difference scheme. Show the recession speed approaches q / (rho (L + c dT)) and compute the transient approach time.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Quadratic P2 triangles for Poisson: optimal L2 and H1 rates
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Assemble six-node quadratic Lagrange triangle elements with affine maps and a degree-4 Gauss rule for a manufactured Poisson problem. Confirm O(h^3) L2 and O(h^2) H1 convergence.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Underintegration in 1D cubic elements: Gauss versus Gauss-Lobatto quadrature
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Assemble cubic Lagrange element stiffness and load with Gauss-Legendre and Gauss-Lobatto rules of varying points for a variable-coefficient 1D BVP. Determine which rules preserve the optimal O(h^4) L2 rate.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Serendipity Q2 versus Lagrange Q2 on trapezoidal meshes
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Compare 8-node serendipity and 9-node Lagrangian quadrilaterals for Poisson on progressively refined trapezoidal (non-affine) meshes. Reproduce the Arnold-Boffi-Falk loss of approximation order for serendipity elements.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: p-version FEM with integrated Legendre shape functions
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Build hierarchical integrated-Legendre bases for a 1D BVP and raise p on a fixed mesh. Show exponential energy-norm convergence for analytic solutions and only algebraic convergence for x^alpha singular solutions.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Thick-walled pressurized cylinder with isoparametric quadratic elasticity elements
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve plane-strain linear elasticity on a quarter annulus using curved isoparametric P2 or Q2 elements with symmetry boundary conditions. Compare radial displacement and hoop stress with the Lame solution and report convergence rates.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Barlow-point gradient superconvergence of quadratic 1D elements
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve a 1D variable-coefficient BVP with quadratic elements and sample derivatives at element Gauss points versus other locations. Verify O(h^3) derivative superconvergence at the two-point Gauss (Barlow) points.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: 2D P1 Helmholtz pollution with impedance boundary: k^3 h^2 law
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the 2D Helmholtz equation for a plane wave on the unit square with first-order impedance boundaries using linear triangles. Show that keeping kh fixed fails to bound the relative error, which instead scales as k^3 h^2.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Point source in a 2D hard-walled waveguide versus modal Green's function
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the Helmholtz equation in a strip with Neumann walls, a point source, and modal DtN radiation conditions at both ends. Compare the field with the exact modal-sum Green's function including evanescent modes.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Driven square cavity: discrete resonance shift of the 5-point Helmholtz operator
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the damped, driven Helmholtz equation in a Dirichlet square across frequency and locate peak response. Compare the discrete resonance frequencies with the analytic 5-point stencil eigenvalues and with the continuous eigenvalues.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Numerov scheme for 1D Helmholtz in variable media: phase error
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Discretize u'' + k(x)^2 u = 0 with the fourth-order Numerov stencil and standard central differences for a smoothly graded index profile. Compare accumulated phase error against a fine reference at fixed points per wavelength.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Exponential horn input impedance from the Webster horn equation
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the 1D Webster equation (S p')' / S + k^2 p = 0 by finite differences with a radiation impedance at the mouth. Compare the throat input impedance versus frequency, including the cutoff, with the analytic exponential-horn solution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Weyl's law for discrete Laplacian eigenvalue counting in a rectangle
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Compute Dirichlet eigenvalues of the 5-point Laplacian on a rectangle and count N(k). Compare with Weyl's law including the perimeter correction, and identify where discretization dispersion causes the count to deviate.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Lloyd's mirror interference from axisymmetric r-z Helmholtz finite differences
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the cylindrically symmetric Helmholtz equation for an underwater point source beneath a pressure-release surface, with absorbing layers at the far boundaries. Compare the transmission-loss interference pattern with the image-source analytic field.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Discrete stability constant growth with wavenumber for impedance Helmholtz
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: For 1D and 2D impedance-boundary Helmholtz finite-difference discretizations, compute the discrete solution-operator norm, the inverse of the smallest singular value in a weighted norm. Show it grows like k when the mesh resolves the wave and deteriorates in the pollution regime.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Room acoustic mode quality factors from an impedance-wall eigenproblem
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the Helmholtz eigenproblem in a 2D rectangular room with a frequency-independent wall impedance via finite differences and a quadratic eigenvalue linearization. Compute complex eigenfrequencies and Q factors and compare with Sabine-type estimates.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Ten-stage fourth-order SSPRK(10,4) versus SSPRK(5,4): effective CFL on Burgers
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement Ketcheson's low-storage SSPRK(10,4) and the Spiteri-Ruuth SSPRK(5,4) with a TVD-limited Burgers discretization. Find empirically the largest TV-diminishing time step and compare the effective SSP coefficients per function evaluation.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Downwind-biased operators in fourth-order four-stage SSP Runge-Kutta
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement Shu's SSP Runge-Kutta with negative coefficients applied to a downwind spatial operator for linear advection with a monotone flux. Verify fourth-order accuracy and test total-variation stability at the predicted CFL.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: SSP integrating-factor Runge-Kutta for stiff advection-reaction
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Combine an exact exponential integrating factor for linear decay with SSPRK stages for upwind advection. Test when the integrating-factor method preserves positivity and the SSP time-step bound as the stiffness grows.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: WENO5 linearized spectrum inside SSPRK stability regions: maximal CFL
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Compute eigenvalues of the linearized upwind-weight WENO5 advection operator and overlay them on the absolute stability regions of SSPRK3, SSPRK(5,4) and RK4. Predict the maximum stable CFL and verify it by simulation.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Modified Patankar Runge-Kutta versus SSPRK for production-destruction transport
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Apply SSPRK2 and the second-order modified Patankar-Runge-Kutta scheme to an upwind-advected stiff two-species conversion system. Compare positivity, mass conservation and accuracy at large time steps.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Optimal SSP coefficient of five-stage fourth-order Runge-Kutta by nonlinear optimization
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Maximize the SSP coefficient r over Shu-Osher-form coefficients subject to fourth-order conditions using scipy SLSQP. Recover the known optimum of about 1.508 and verify the resulting tableau's order numerically.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Relaxation Runge-Kutta restoring energy conservation for skew-symmetric Burgers
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Discretize inviscid Burgers with the energy-conservative skew-symmetric split form and integrate with SSPRK3 and RK4 with and without relaxation of the step via a scalar root solve. Show the relaxation variant conserves discrete energy to round-off before shock formation.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: AUSM+ flux for Sod and the stationary contact discontinuity
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement the Liou AUSM+ advection-upstream splitting flux for 1D Euler. Compare with the exact solution on the Sod tube and check exact preservation of a stationary contact and pressure equilibrium at a moving contact.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Approximate star-pressure estimates PVRS, TRRS and TSRS versus exact
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement the primitive-variable, two-rarefaction and two-shock Riemann approximations of the star pressure and velocity. Compare them with the exact Newton solution across Toro's five test problems and build an adaptive selector.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Isothermal Euler equations: exact Riemann solver and Roe flux
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Derive and solve the isothermal gas Riemann problem, with a logarithmic rarefaction branch and a shock Hugoniot branch, by Newton iteration. Use it to validate a Roe-averaged finite-volume scheme on shock-tube data.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Well-balanced Euler with gravity: isothermal hydrostatic atmosphere
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Discretize 1D Euler with a gravitational source using HLL fluxes with naive and hydrostatically reconstructed sources. Measure spurious velocities for an isothermal atmosphere and the propagation of a small pressure perturbation.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Steger-Warming versus van Leer flux-vector splitting on Sod
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement both flux-vector splittings for 1D Euler and run Sod and a slowly moving contact. Compare contact smearing, sonic-point glitches and L1 errors against the exact Riemann solution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Shock reflection from a solid wall: post-reflection state
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Drive a shock of given Mach number into a reflecting wall with a Godunov or HLLC finite-volume scheme. Compare the reflected shock speed and doubly shocked pressure with the analytic reflected-shock relations and examine wall heating.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Kurganov-Tadmor central-upwind scheme for Sod and Lax shock tubes
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement the second-order semi-discrete Kurganov-Tadmor scheme with minmod reconstruction and local wave-speed bounds, integrated with SSPRK2. Compare resolution with an HLLC MUSCL scheme against the exact solutions.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Nonlinear elastic bar p-system: exact Riemann solver and Godunov scheme
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the Lagrangian p-system for a bar with a nonlinear stress-strain law, building the exact Riemann solution from Hugoniot and integral-curve branches. Validate a first-order Godunov finite-volume scheme on impact problems.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Stommel gyre with bottom friction: western boundary layer width
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the steady linear Stommel streamfunction equation with a beta effect and linear drag under wind curl, using finite differences. Compare the western boundary current width and peak transport with the analytic epsilon_S = r / beta scaling.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Kelvin-Helmholtz instability of a tanh shear layer: linear growth rate
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Perturb an inviscid hyperbolic-tangent shear layer in a periodic vorticity-streamfunction solver and measure modal growth rates versus wavenumber. Compare with the Michalke Rayleigh-equation maximum growth of 0.1897 at k = 0.4446.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Barotropic Rossby wave phase speed on a beta plane
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Integrate the barotropic vorticity equation with a beta term from a small-amplitude Rossby-wave initial condition using an Arakawa Jacobian. Compare the measured westward phase speed with -beta / (k^2 + l^2).

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Lamb-Chaplygin dipole translation speed
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Initialize the Lamb-Chaplygin vortex dipole from its Bessel-function vorticity and evolve it with a 2D vorticity-streamfunction solver. Compare the translation speed with the analytic value and measure the viscous slowdown.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Kirchhoff elliptical vortex patch rotation rate
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Evolve a smoothed elliptical uniform-vorticity patch with an inviscid vorticity-streamfunction solver. Measure its angular velocity and compare with Kirchhoff's ab omega / (a + b)^2, checking shape preservation at moderate aspect ratios.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Symmetry-breaking bifurcation in a 1:2 planar sudden expansion
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Compute steady flow through a symmetric channel expansion with a vorticity-streamfunction solver over a range of Reynolds numbers. Detect the pitchfork bifurcation where the two recirculation lengths become unequal.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Stress-free Rayleigh-Benard convection: Nusselt number near onset
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve 2D Boussinesq convection in streamfunction-vorticity-temperature form with stress-free walls in a box at the critical aspect ratio. Compute Nu(Ra) above Ra_c = 27 pi^4 / 4 and compare with weakly nonlinear theory.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Vortex near a free-slip wall: image-induced drift speed
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Place a compact Gaussian vortex at distance d from a free-slip wall with psi = 0 on the boundary and evolve it inviscidly. Compare the wall-parallel drift with the point-vortex image speed Gamma / (4 pi d).

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Parisian down-and-out call with an excursion-time variable
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Augment the Black-Scholes PDE with the time spent below the barrier and solve the resulting 2D PDE with a reset condition by operator splitting. Study how the price depends on the window length between the vanilla and standard barrier limits.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Compound call-on-call option via two-stage PDE versus Geske formula
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: First solve for the underlying call, then use max(C - K1, 0) at the first expiry as terminal data for a second Crank-Nicolson solve. Compare with Geske's bivariate-normal closed form.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Barrier option with exponentially moving barrier via coordinate transformation
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Map a time-dependent barrier B(t) = B0 exp(beta t) to a fixed boundary by changing variables in the Black-Scholes PDE and solve with Crank-Nicolson. Compare with the closed-form price for this barrier shape.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Fromm's scheme: averaging Lax-Wendroff and Beam-Warming to reduce phase error
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement Fromm's second-order scheme for linear advection and compute its amplification factor and relative phase error. Compare dispersive wiggles with its parent schemes on a smooth pulse and a square wave.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Lax-Friedrichs numerical diffusion and odd-even decoupling
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Analyze the Lax-Friedrichs scheme's effective diffusion dx^2/(2 dt) (1 - C^2) via the modified equation. Demonstrate the odd-even decoupling of a grid-scale checkerboard and Gaussian variance growth at several Courant numbers.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Supraconvergence of upwind schemes on randomly perturbed grids
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Discretize linear advection with conservative first-order upwind on nonuniform random grids where local truncation error is O(1). Show that the global error still converges at first order.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Smolarkiewicz MPDATA antidiffusive correction iterations
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement the multidimensional positive-definite advection transport algorithm with iterated antidiffusive velocities for 1D and 2D advection. Measure the reduction in numerical diffusion and the accuracy order versus the number of corrective passes.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: L1 error rates for discontinuous data: h^{1/2} versus h^{2/3}
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Advect a step with first-order upwind and second-order Lax-Wendroff and measure L1 error versus mesh size at fixed Courant number. Confirm the theoretical rates of 1/2 and 2/3 for linear schemes with discontinuous solutions.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: LWR traffic flow at a traffic light with the Godunov supply-demand flux
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the Lighthill-Whitham-Richards model with Greenshields flux using the Cell Transmission Model, i.e. the Godunov demand-supply flux. Compare the queue shock and discharge rarefaction after a light turns green with the exact solution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Bott's positive-definite flux-form advection with polynomial fitting
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement Bott's area-preserving flux-form scheme with fourth-order polynomial fitting and its flux limitation for positive-definite tracers. Compare peak preservation and positivity with upwind and Lax-Wendroff for a narrow moisture-like pulse.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Lorentz-oscillator ADE FDTD: pulse group velocity near resonance
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Add an auxiliary polarization equation for a single-pole Lorentz medium to 1D FDTD. Measure group delay of narrowband pulses at frequencies around the resonance and compare with the analytic group index from the Lorentz permittivity.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Kerr nonlinear FDTD: third-harmonic generation efficiency
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement an instantaneous Kerr nonlinearity in 1D FDTD with an iterative field update. Measure the third-harmonic amplitude growth with propagation length and compare with the undepleted-pump coupled-amplitude prediction including phase mismatch.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Dey-Mittra conformal PEC versus staircasing for a circular cavity
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Compute TM_010 and higher resonances of a circular conducting cavity on a 2D Yee grid with staircase boundaries and with Dey-Mittra conformal cell updates. Compare frequency errors against Bessel zeros as the mesh is refined.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Fourth-order-in-space FDTD(2,4) dispersion and stability versus Yee
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement the FDTD(2,4) scheme with fourth-order staggered spatial differences in 1D and 2D. Derive the reduced Courant limit and compare phase error versus cells per wavelength with standard Yee.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Negative-index slab with double-Drude ADE FDTD: backward phase velocity
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Model a slab with Drude permittivity and permeability, both negative at the operating frequency, in 1D FDTD. Verify the reversed phase velocity relative to the group velocity and compare slab transmission with the analytic result.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Simply supported plate under a concentrated load: deflection and log-singular moments
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the Kirchhoff plate equation for a central point load using coupled Poisson splitting. Compare the center deflection with the Navier double series, and show that the finite-difference bending moment at the load point grows like log(1/h).

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Orthotropic Huber plate under uniform load versus Navier double series
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Discretize the orthotropic plate operator D1 w_xxxx + 2H w_xxyy + D2 w_yyyy with a generalized 13-point stencil. Compute the center deflection and moments as functions of the rigidity ratio D1/D2, and compare them with the orthotropic Navier series.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Morley nonconforming triangle for clamped plate bending
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement the six-DOF Morley element (vertex values plus edge-midpoint normal derivatives) for the clamped plate under uniform load. Verify the patch-test behavior and the O(h^2) center-deflection convergence against the Timoshenko reference value 0.00126 qa^4/D.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Clamped L-shaped plate: biharmonic corner singularity exponent and reduced convergence
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the root equation sin^2(z ω) = z^2 sin^2 ω for the re-entrant 270° corner singular exponent. Then solve the clamped biharmonic problem with the 13-point stencil on refined grids and compare the observed convergence rate with the rate predicted from the singular exponent.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Tensioned plate D Δ²w - TΔw = q: edge boundary-layer width
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Discretize a clamped tensioned strip or plate, interpolating between plate and membrane behavior. Extract the edge-layer thickness from the deflection profile and compare it with sqrt(D/T) from the exact 1D solution, with and without layer-adapted grid refinement.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: 13-point biharmonic matrix conditioning h^-4 and Laplacian-squared preconditioning
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Assemble the sparse 13-point biharmonic matrix for the clamped plate and compute its extreme eigenvalues to confirm κ ~ h^-4. Compare CG iteration counts with and without a fast-sine-transform Laplacian-squared preconditioner.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Airy stress function in a rectangular panel with sinusoidal edge traction
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the plane-stress biharmonic equation for the Airy stress function with traction boundary data converted to Dirichlet and Neumann data. Compute σ_x, σ_y and τ_xy by finite differences and compare them with the Fourier-series (Filon-type) elasticity solution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Kirchhoff plate flexural waves: explicit stability Δt ∝ h² and dispersion
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: March w_tt + (D/ρh)Δ²w = 0 with central differences in time and the 13-point stencil in space. Determine the von Neumann stability limit Δt ≤ C h^2 and verify it empirically. Measure the numerical frequency of plane-wave modes against ω = sqrt(D/ρh) k^2.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Sign change of the clamped square plate Green's function near corners
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Compute the clamped-plate deflection due to a point load placed near a corner using a refined 13-point stencil. Locate the small region of negative (upward) deflection that violates the positivity principle (Duffin/Garabedian phenomenon), and check that the region is stable under grid refinement.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Biharmonic versus harmonic inpainting of missing image regions
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Fill a masked region of a smooth test function by solving Δu = 0 or Δ²u = 0 with the known pixels as boundary data, using 5-point and 13-point stencils respectively. Compare reconstruction errors and gradient continuity across the mask boundary.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Geometric-average Asian call by degenerate 2D PDE versus Kemna-Vorst
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the two-dimensional pricing PDE in (log S, running log-average) with upwinding in the pure-advection average direction and a theta-scheme in time. Compare the price with the closed-form Kemna-Vorst geometric Asian formula.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Passport option via similarity reduction and bang-bang HJB finite differences
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Reduce the passport option value to a one-dimensional nonlinear HJB in the trading-account ratio, with optimal strategy q = -sign(x). Solve it implicitly with policy iteration and compare the at-the-money value with the Andersen-Andreasen-Brotherton-Ratcliffe benchmark.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: European option on a zero-coupon bond under Vasicek versus Jamshidian formula
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the Vasicek short-rate PDE first for the underlying long bond and then for the option on that bond, using upwind or central drift and Crank-Nicolson. Compare with the Jamshidian closed-form bond option price.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Schwartz one-factor mean-reverting commodity option via Ornstein-Uhlenbeck log-price PDE
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the pricing PDE for a European call on spot in the Schwartz mean-reverting log-price model using Crank-Nicolson with exponentially fitted drift. Compare with the closed-form lognormal price that uses the model's analytic mean and variance.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Black-Cox structural credit model: defaultable bond and credit spread term structure
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Price a defaultable zero-coupon bond on a firm-value PDE with an absorbing exponential default barrier and recovery. Compute credit spreads versus maturity and compare them with the Black-Cox first-passage closed form.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Callable bond under Vasicek short rate with call constraint
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the bond PDE in the short rate with coupon jump conditions and the constraint V ≤ call price during the call window, enforced by projection in a theta-scheme. Report the value of the embedded call option relative to the straight bond.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Spin coating film thinning versus Emslie-Bonner-Peck law
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the axisymmetric lubrication equation for a film on a rotating disk with centrifugal driving and weak capillarity, using a conservative finite-volume scheme. Compare the central thickness history with h0 (1 + 4ω^2 h0^2 t/(3ν))^{-1/2} and quantify edge-bead effects.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Constant-flux axisymmetric viscous gravity current: Huppert similarity front
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve h_t = (1/r)(r h^3 h_r)_r with an injection flux at the origin, using a degenerate-diffusion finite-volume scheme. Track the front radius and compare it with the similarity law r_N ∝ t^{1/2} and Huppert's prefactor.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Annular film on a fiber: Rayleigh-Plateau lubrication instability and bead formation
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the long-wave thin-annulus lubrication equation, which has stabilizing axial and destabilizing azimuthal curvature, using implicit Newton steps. Compare early growth rates with the linear dispersion relation and report the bead spacing after nonlinear saturation.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Source-type solution of the n=1 thin-film equation versus explicit profile
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Evolve h_t + (h h_xxx)_x = 0 from a compact initial mass using a positivity-aware implicit scheme. Compare the solution with the explicit self-similar profile h = t^{-1/5}(a^2 - ξ^2)^2/120, including the support growth ∝ t^{1/5}.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Contact-line fingering: transverse instability of a gravity-driven capillary ridge
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Compute the 1D traveling-wave ridge on an incline with a precursor film by Newton iteration. Linearize about it with transverse wavenumber q and solve the discrete eigenproblem to find the growth rate σ(q), the most unstable finger wavelength and the cutoff wavenumber.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Evaporating thin sessile droplet with one-sided evaporation: dry-out time
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the lubrication equation with capillarity, a precursor film and the evaporative mass flux E/(h+K) using implicit Newton steps. Track drop volume and contact-line position, and compute the total dry-out time and its dependence on the kinetic parameter K.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Inclined slider bearing Reynolds equation: load capacity and pressure center
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the 2D steady Reynolds lubrication equation for a finite-width tilted-pad bearing using finite differences. Compute load capacity and center of pressure versus aspect ratio, and compare with the infinite-width analytic solution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: MEMS squeeze-film damping: isothermal compressible Reynolds equation versus squeeze number
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Linearize the compressible Reynolds equation for an oscillating rectangular plate and solve the resulting complex Helmholtz-like problem. Extract damping and spring forces versus squeeze number and compare with Blech's double-series solution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Benney equation for falling films: critical Reynolds number 5 cot β / 6
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Discretize the Benney long-wave equation on a periodic domain with pseudospectral or finite differences and implicit time stepping. Measure perturbation growth rates on either side of Re_c = (5/6) cot β, and report the saturated solitary-like wave amplitude above onset.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Elastic-plated gravity current: sixth-order lubrication spreading law
