math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve h_t = (h^3 (B h_xxxxx + ...))_x for a fluid injected under an elastic sheet, with a precursor film, using implicit Newton steps. Measure the extent of the current versus time and the peeling-front exponent, and compare with similarity predictions.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Cosine bell solid-body rotation at Courant numbers above one with cubic semi-Lagrangian
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Advect a 2D cosine bell through a full revolution using backward trajectories, exact departure points and bicubic interpolation at Courant numbers from 0.5 to 8. Report normalized l1/l2/l∞ errors and the mass-conservation drift.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Departure-point iteration in deformational flow: midpoint versus SETTLS extrapolation
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Use the Nair-Lauritzen time-reversing deformational wind and compute departure points by fixed-point midpoint iteration with time-extrapolated winds (SETTLS versus linear). Measure the error after flow reversal as a function of the iteration count and the time step.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Conservative cell-integrated semi-Lagrangian remapping versus interpolating semi-Lagrangian
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Advect a 1D density in a spatially varying, compressive velocity field using two schemes: interpolating SL and CISL with piecewise-parabolic subgrid reconstruction of the departure-cell integrals. Compare mass conservation, accuracy and positivity.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Semi-implicit semi-Lagrangian 1D shallow water at large gravity-wave Courant numbers
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Combine semi-Lagrangian advection with Crank-Nicolson treatment of gravity terms, giving a Helmholtz solve per step. Measure numerical phase speeds and amplitude factors against the exact dispersion relation for gravity-wave Courant numbers up to 10.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Spurious orographic resonance in semi-implicit semi-Lagrangian flow over a mountain
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Simulate steady 1D shallow-water flow over topography with SISL time stepping. Show the spurious resonant response when the Courant number makes the discrete mountain forcing resonate (Rivest-Staniforth), and quantify how off-centering parameters suppress it.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Bermejo-Staniforth quasi-monotone semi-Lagrangian advection
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Blend high-order cubic interpolation with linear interpolation, clipping values to the min/max of the surrounding departure-cell values. Measure overshoots, error norms and mass change for a step and Gaussian profile at large Courant number.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Semi-Lagrangian error balance h^{p+1}/Δt + Δt^r and optimal time step
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Advect a smooth periodic profile with Lagrange interpolation of degree p and RK departure points of order r. Verify the Falcone-Ferretti error estimate numerically, and find the error-minimizing Δt for each grid spacing h.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Mass fixers for semi-Lagrangian advection: Priestley versus global scaling
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Apply a posteriori mass restoration to semi-Lagrangian advection of a sharp tracer in divergent flow. Compare global multiplicative scaling with Priestley's quasi-conservative weighting toward high-order/low-order differences, measuring the error, total mass and shape preservation.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Semi-Lagrangian vorticity transport for 2D Euler: enstrophy dissipation versus interpolation order
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Evolve 2D periodic vorticity with semi-Lagrangian advection and a spectral streamfunction inversion. Measure the decay of energy and enstrophy for linear, cubic and quintic interpolation, at fixed resolution and large time steps.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Constrained interpolation profile (CIP) advection: Hermite phase and amplitude accuracy
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement Yabe's CIP scheme, which advects both the value and its spatial derivative with cubic Hermite interpolation. Compare amplification and phase errors from von Neumann analysis and from square-wave and Gaussian tests against ordinary cubic semi-Lagrangian.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Fokker-Planck: transient Gaussian variance versus exact solution
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve p_t = (γ x p)_x + D p_xx with a conservative finite-volume scheme and Chang-Cooper weights, using implicit time stepping. Compare the time-dependent mean and variance and the L1 error with the exact Gaussian transition density.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Kramers phase-space equation: underdamped relaxation and position-space Smoluchowski limit
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the 2D Kramers-Klein equation in (x, v) for a harmonic well, using operator splitting with upwind transport and Chang-Cooper velocity diffusion. Compare relaxation rates with the exact damped-oscillator eigenvalues across friction regimes.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Leaky integrate-and-fire population density: stationary firing rate versus Siegert formula
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the voltage Fokker-Planck equation with absorbing threshold flux reinjected at the reset potential, using a conservative scheme. Compute the stationary firing rate versus mean input, compare with the Siegert integral, and evaluate the transient response to an input step.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: FENE dumbbell Fokker-Planck in elongational flow: polymer stress versus Peterlin closure
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the configuration-space Fokker-Planck equation for FENE dumbbells in uniaxial extension on a radial-angular or 1D-reduced grid. Compute the steady extensional viscosity versus Weissenberg number and compare with the FENE-P closure.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Salisbury screen absorber: resistive sheet subcell model in 1D Yee FDTD
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Model a thin resistive sheet a quarter wavelength in front of a perfect conductor using a modified magnetic-field jump update. Compute the broadband reflection spectrum by FFT, and compare it with transmission-line theory, including perfect absorption at 377 Ω/sq.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Surface plasmon polariton propagation at a Drude metal-dielectric interface
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Excite an SPP in a 2D TM Yee grid with Drude ADE updates. Extract the propagation constant and decay length from the field along the interface, and compare them with the analytic SPP dispersion k = (ω/c) sqrt(εm εd/(εm + εd)).

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Birefringent slab as half-wave plate: polarization conversion with 1D FDTD
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Evolve both transverse polarizations through an anisotropic dielectric slab with different ε_x and ε_y. Compute Stokes parameters of the transmitted field versus frequency, and identify the half-wave condition that rotates linear polarization by 90°.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Ground-penetrating radar hyperbola from a buried pipe in lossy soil
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Simulate a 2D TMz B-scan by moving a Ricker-pulse source and receiver above lossy soil containing a conducting cylinder. Fit the diffraction hyperbola apex and curvature, and recover the soil wave velocity and the target depth.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Knife-edge diffraction in 2D TMz FDTD versus Sommerfeld half-plane solution
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Send a plane wave via TFSF past a PEC half-plane in a Yee grid with PML. Compare the time-harmonic field amplitude in the shadow and lit regions, obtained by DFT, with Sommerfeld's exact Fresnel-integral solution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Hexagons versus stripes selection in the 2D Brusselator near Turing onset
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Simulate the Brusselator on a periodic square with semi-implicit spectral stepping slightly above the Turing threshold. Classify the final patterns by Fourier peak structure as a function of the control parameter, and compare with quadratic-coefficient amplitude-equation predictions.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Wave (oscillatory Turing) instability in a three-species reaction-diffusion model
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Derive the dispersion relation of a three-component activator-inhibitor model with a finite-wavenumber Hopf bifurcation. Compute the critical wavenumber and frequency, then confirm traveling or standing waves of that wavelength and period by method-of-lines simulation.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Differential-flow instability in an advected activator-inhibitor system
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Add differential advection of one species to a reaction-diffusion model that is Turing-stable. Compute the convective instability threshold in flow velocity from the complex dispersion relation, and verify the traveling pattern wavelength by upwind simulation.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Eckhaus band of stable stripe wavenumbers in the 1D Brusselator
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Initialize Turing stripes of prescribed wavenumber in a periodic domain and simulate with a pseudospectral IMEX scheme. Determine which wavenumbers persist and which undergo phase slips, and compare the stable band with the Eckhaus prediction from amplitude equations.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Anisotropic diffusion orients Turing stripes in Schnakenberg patterns
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Use a diffusion tensor with different x and y coefficients and compute the anisotropic dispersion relation for the most unstable wavevector. Measure the stripe orientation and wavelength from the 2D structure factor of simulated patterns.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Predator-prey Turing patterns with ratio-dependent functional response
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Linearize a diffusive ratio-dependent predator-prey model to find the Turing region in the (prey-predator diffusion ratio, parameter) plane. Simulate 2D patterns with finite differences, and compare the dominant wavelength with the predicted critical mode.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Tensor-product Legendre DG for 2D rotating Gaussian advection
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Assemble modal Q_p DG element matrices on a Cartesian mesh with upwind numerical fluxes for solid-body rotation, using SSPRK3 time stepping. Verify order p+1 L2 convergence after a full revolution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Hybridizable DG for 1D Poisson: superconvergent traces and local postprocessing
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement HDG with local solvers and a static-condensation global system for the numerical trace. Verify trace superconvergence at nodes, the flux order p+1, and the order p+2 element-wise postprocessed solution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Krivodonova hierarchical moment limiter for high-order DG advection
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Apply the moment limiter to Legendre coefficients from highest order downward for P2-P4 DG advection of a composite smooth-plus-discontinuous profile. Compare overshoots and smooth-region accuracy with the TVB minmod slope limiter.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: DGSEM with Gauss versus Gauss-Lobatto collocation: accuracy and CFL
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement nodal DG spectral elements for linear advection, using both Gauss-Legendre and Gauss-Lobatto quadrature nodes. Compare the mass-matrix lumping error, the maximal stable explicit time step and the convergence of the L2 error.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Discontinuous Galerkin in time for the heat equation: nodal superconvergence 2q+1
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Discretize u_t = u_xx with dG(q) in time and a fine spatial discretization. Solve the coupled stage systems per time slab, and verify order 2q+1 at slab endpoints versus order q+1 globally.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Upwind DG discrete ordinates in the thick diffusion limit
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve slab-geometry SN transport in an optically thick, highly scattering medium with linear DG and with step differencing, as the scattering ratio tends to 1. Show that only DG recovers the diffusion-equation solution (asymptotic preservation).

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: MINI element (P1-bubble/P1) for Stokes flow: convergence and bubble condensation
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Assemble Stokes matrices with cubic-bubble-enriched P1 velocity and P1 pressure on triangles, using static condensation of the bubbles. Measure velocity H1 and pressure L2 errors against an analytic polynomial Stokes solution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Crouzeix-Raviart nonconforming P1 Stokes elements with piecewise constant pressure
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Assemble edge-midpoint velocity DOFs and elementwise pressures for Stokes on a unit square. Verify discrete divergence-free velocities, order h in H1 and order h^2 in L2, and the absence of spurious pressure modes.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Timoshenko beam shear locking: full versus reduced integration and mixed elements
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Assemble linear Timoshenko beam elements for a cantilever with decreasing thickness. Compare the tip deflection from full Gauss integration, reduced one-point shear integration and a mixed shear-force formulation against the exact Timoshenko solution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Residual-free bubbles for 1D advection-reaction-diffusion
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Compute the element bubble functions analytically or on a subgrid, and condense them into an effective stabilized P1 scheme. Compare nodal errors with SUPG and Galerkin across Péclet and Damköhler numbers.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Nitsche's method for weak Dirichlet conditions: penalty dependence and optimal rates
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Impose Dirichlet data weakly in P1/P2 Poisson finite elements with symmetric Nitsche terms. Determine the minimum stable penalty from a local trace-inverse eigenproblem, and verify the optimal convergence rates and degradation below the threshold.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Pressure robustness failure: Taylor-Hood velocity error scaling as 1/ν
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve Stokes flow driven by a gradient force with zero exact velocity using Taylor-Hood P2-P1 elements. Show that the velocity error grows like 1/ν as the viscosity decreases, while the error from a divergence-free or grad-div stabilized variant stays bounded.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: 1D mixed finite elements for Poisson: P1 flux, P0 pressure and superconvergence
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Assemble the saddle-point system for σ = -κu', σ' = f with variable κ. Verify the optimal flux convergence and the superconvergence of the pressure at element midpoints, and check exact local conservation.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Burman-Hansbo continuous interior penalty stabilization for convection-diffusion
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Add jump-of-gradient penalties across interior faces to P1 Galerkin for a boundary-layer convection-diffusion problem. Compare accuracy and oscillation suppression with SUPG as the penalty parameter varies.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: SUPG/PSPG stabilized equal-order elements for the steady Oseen problem
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Assemble P1-P1 Oseen equations on triangles with SUPG, PSPG and grad-div terms and Tezduyar-type stabilization parameters. Measure errors against the Kovasznay-type exact solution as the Reynolds number increases.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Counter-current spontaneous imbibition versus McWhorter-Sunada semi-analytical solution
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the nonlinear capillary-diffusion saturation equation in 1D with an implicit finite-volume Newton scheme. Compare the saturation profile in the similarity variable x/√t and the √t recovery with the McWhorter-Sunada integral solution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Dynamic capillary pressure in Buckley-Leverett: non-monotone saturation overshoots
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Add Hassanizadeh-Gray dynamic capillarity τ ∂S/∂t to the capillary-regularized Buckley-Leverett equation and solve with an implicit pseudo-parabolic scheme. Map the overshoot amplitude versus τ and compare plateau values with van Duijn traveling-wave predictions.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Tracer front lagging the saturation front in a Buckley-Leverett waterflood
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the coupled water saturation and passive tracer concentration equations with upwind finite volumes, accounting for connate water. Compare the tracer front speed with the f_w/S_w secant construction and the breakthrough-time ordering.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Layered composite wall: harmonic versus arithmetic face conductivity in finite volumes
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Steady 1D conduction through a multilayer wall with conductivity jumps up to 10^4. Cell-centered finite volumes are run with harmonic and with arithmetic face averaging, and the interface temperatures, heat flux and convergence order are compared with the exact series-resistance solution for interfaces both aligned and misaligned with cell faces.
math/pde_numerics|pde.area: Heat conduction in composite and anisotropic media

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Periodic array of circular inclusions: effective conductivity versus Maxwell-Rayleigh formulas
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Effective conductivity of a square array of circular fibers in a matrix. A finite-volume cell problem uses harmonic averaging on cut cells, and the result is compared with the Maxwell-Garnett and Rayleigh multipole expansions as the volume fraction varies up to near touching.
math/pde_numerics|pde.area: Heat conduction in composite and anisotropic media

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Extreme anisotropic diffusion in magnetized plasma: perpendicular pollution of symmetric schemes
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Steady anisotropic heat conduction with a parallel-to-perpendicular conductivity ratio up to 10^9 along curved field lines. Asymmetric and Günter symmetric finite-difference flux stencils are compared through the spurious perpendicular diffusion measured from a manufactured test with known solution.
math/pde_numerics|pde.area: Heat conduction in composite and anisotropic media

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Transient two-layer slab: interface temperature history versus composite eigenfunction series
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Time-dependent conduction in a bonded two-material slab with a convective boundary. Results from finite volumes with harmonic interface conductance and Crank-Nicolson stepping are compared with an exact series built from roots of the composite-medium transcendental eigencondition.
math/pde_numerics|pde.area: Heat conduction in composite and anisotropic media

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Imperfect thermal contact: temperature jump across a Kapitza resistance in multilayers
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Conduction through layers joined by finite thermal contact conductance. The interface resistance is embedded in finite-volume face fluxes, and the temperature jumps and overall conductance are computed and checked against the analytic resistance network, including transient approach to steady state.
math/pde_numerics|pde.area: Heat conduction in composite and anisotropic media

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Thermal spreading resistance of a small heat source on a finite substrate
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Axisymmetric steady conduction from a disk heat source on a cylindrical substrate with a convectively cooled base. The r-z equation is solved with finite volumes, and the spreading resistance is compared with the Yovanovich/Kennedy series solution versus source-to-substrate radius ratio.
math/pde_numerics|pde.area: Heat conduction in composite and anisotropic media

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Homogenized conductivity tensor of an obliquely oriented laminate
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: The periodic cell problem is solved for a laminate tilted at angle theta on a Cartesian grid with full-tensor finite-volume fluxes. The effective 2x2 tensor is compared with the exact rotated harmonic-normal/arithmetic-tangential tensor, and the error is studied versus grid resolution and angle.
math/pde_numerics|pde.area: Heat conduction in composite and anisotropic media

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Mathieu characteristic values a_n(q) and b_n(q) by Fourier spectral discretization
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: The Mathieu equation y'' + (a - 2q cos 2x) y = 0 is cast as periodic eigenproblems in even/odd Fourier bases, which give tridiagonal matrices. The characteristic values and their exponential convergence in truncation are computed, and the curves are traced to locate stability-band crossings.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Gordon-Webb-Wolpert isospectral drums: finite-difference eigenvalues and Richardson extrapolation
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: The two isospectral polygonal domains built from half-squares are discretized with the five-point Laplacian. The first ten Dirichlet eigenvalues are computed with sparse eigensolvers and extrapolated in h to show they coincide to many digits while the eigenfunctions differ.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Equilateral triangle Dirichlet eigenvalues: P1 FEM versus the Lamé formula
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Dirichlet eigenvalues of an equilateral triangle are computed with linear finite elements on uniformly refined triangulations. They are compared with the exact Lamé values (16 pi^2/27)(m^2+mn+n^2)/a^2, including degeneracy splitting and O(h^2) convergence.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Hydrogenic radial Schrödinger eigenvalues on a logarithmic grid: Rydberg spectrum accuracy
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: The singular radial equation with Coulomb potential is solved after the transformation r = e^x with a symmetric finite-difference generalized eigenproblem. The computed levels are compared with -Z^2/(2n^2) for several angular momenta, and accuracy and l-degeneracy are studied.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Consistent versus lumped mass P1 Laplacian eigenvalues: upper and lower bounds
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Dirichlet eigenvalues on the unit square are computed with P1 elements using consistent and lumped mass matrices. The consistent-mass values converge from above and the lumped-mass values from below, and their average gives a fourth-order estimate.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Free-free Euler-Bernoulli beam with ghost-point finite differences: rigid and elastic modes
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: The fourth-order beam eigenproblem with zero moment and shear at both ends is discretized with ghost points. The two zero rigid-body eigenvalues and the elastic frequencies with beta L = 4.730, 7.853, ... are recovered with O(h^2) convergence.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Rotating cantilever blade: centrifugal stiffening and Southwell coefficients with Hermite elements
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Flapwise vibration of a uniform rotating cantilever is modeled with Hermite cubic elements plus a geometric stiffness from centrifugal tension. Natural frequencies are computed versus rotation speed and fitted to omega^2 = omega_0^2 + K Omega^2 to obtain the Southwell coefficients.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Cantilever with tip mass: fundamental frequency versus mass ratio
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Free vibration of a cantilever carrying a concentrated end mass is computed by finite differences with a modified shear boundary condition. Frequencies are compared with roots of the exact transcendental frequency equation and Rayleigh's approximation over a range of mass ratios.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Greenhill self-weight buckling of a vertical column by finite-difference eigenproblem
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Buckling of a heavy clamped-free column under distributed axial load is posed as a variable-coefficient fourth-order eigenproblem. The critical length parameter q L^3/EI = 7.837 is computed by finite differences and Richardson extrapolation.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Moving-load dynamic amplification of a simply supported bridge beam
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: A constant force crossing a simply supported Euler-Bernoulli beam at speed v is simulated with finite differences in space and Newmark time stepping. The peak midspan deflection relative to the static value is computed versus speed parameter and compared with the modal series solution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Cracked beam as rotational spring: natural frequency drop versus crack depth
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: A cantilever with a crack is modeled as two Hermite-element segments joined by a rotational spring whose compliance follows fracture mechanics. Frequency reductions versus crack location and depth are computed and compared with the analytic characteristic determinant, as used in damage detection.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Quarter-point quadratic elements for antiplane crack: stress intensity factor K_III
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Mode III crack in a strip solved as a Laplace problem with isoparametric 6-node triangles whose midside nodes are shifted to quarter points at the crack tip to capture sqrt(r) behavior. K_III is extracted by displacement correlation and compared with the exact value, with and without the shift.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Quadratic P2 tetrahedra for 3D Poisson on the unit cube: optimal rates
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Ten-node tetrahedral shape functions, Keast quadrature and sparse assembly are built on a Kuhn-subdivided cube mesh. Convergence of O(h^3) in L2 and O(h^2) in H1 is confirmed for a manufactured solution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: GLL spectral elements on a curved annulus: exponential p-convergence for Poisson
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Poisson is solved on an annulus with Q_N quadrilateral spectral elements using Gauss-Lobatto-Legendre nodes, exact blending of the curved geometry and tensor-product quadrature. Exponential error decay in N is compared with algebraic h-convergence at fixed degree.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: NLS soliton scattering off a Gaussian barrier: transmission versus incident velocity
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: A moving bright soliton hitting a localized repulsive potential is simulated with Strang split-step Fourier. The transmitted norm fraction is computed versus velocity, and the sharp transition is compared with the particle-like threshold sqrt(2 V_max) estimate.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Kuznetsov-Ma breather oscillation period and peak amplitude via split-step Fourier
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: The NLS is integrated from a Kuznetsov-Ma breather on a uniform background using Strang split-step Fourier with a large periodic domain. The measured breathing period and maximum amplitude are compared with exact formulas, together with splitting-error convergence.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Semi-Lagrangian scalar mixing in the double-gyre flow: variance decay versus interpolation
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: A passive scalar is advected in the time-periodic double-gyre velocity field with RK4 backward trajectories and linear, cubic and quintic interpolation. Scalar variance decay and spectra are compared with a high-resolution reference to separate physical mixing from numerical diffusion.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Stochastic-characteristic semi-Lagrangian scheme for advection-diffusion with Gauss-Hermite averaging
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Advection-diffusion is solved by averaging interpolated values at departure points perturbed by Gauss-Hermite noise nodes (Milstein-Tretyakov type). The scheme is verified against a drifting Gaussian solution, and its error is studied versus Delta t and h at large Courant numbers.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Cross-pole solid-body advection on a latitude-longitude grid: semi-Lagrangian versus Eulerian
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: A cosine bell is advected over the poles on a spherical lat-lon grid with semi-Lagrangian departure points computed in rotated Cartesian coordinates. The error norms and allowable time step are compared with an explicit Eulerian upwind scheme limited by pole convergence of meridians.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Benjamin-Ono algebraic soliton by Hilbert-transform pseudospectral integrating-factor RK4
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: The Benjamin-Ono equation is solved on a large periodic domain with the Hilbert transform applied as -i sgn(k) in Fourier space and integrating-factor RK4. The Lorentzian soliton speed and shape are compared with the exact solution, and periodic-image errors are quantified.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: KdV dispersive shock wave: leading soliton amplitude twice the step height
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: A smoothed step evolves under small-dispersion KdV, solved pseudospectrally with integrating-factor RK4 and dealiasing. The lead soliton amplitude and edge speeds are measured and compared with Gurevich-Pitaevskii Whitham-modulation predictions.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Kolmogorov flow linear instability: critical Reynolds number sqrt(2) from DNS growth rates
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: The 2D Navier-Stokes vorticity equation is forced by sin(y) in an elongated periodic box. Small perturbations are evolved pseudospectrally to measure growth rates of large-scale modes, and their zero crossing is extrapolated to the critical Reynolds number sqrt(2).

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Complex Ginzburg-Landau plane waves: Benjamin-Feir-Newell instability boundary
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: 1D CGLE is integrated with ETDRK4 Fourier stepping from perturbed plane waves. Perturbation growth rates are measured versus (alpha, beta) and wavenumber and compared with the analytic Eckhaus/Benjamin-Feir-Newell criterion 1 + alpha beta < 0.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Inviscid Burgers singularity time from Fourier analyticity-strip width
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Inviscid Burgers is solved pseudospectrally with high-precision dealiasing. The width delta(t) of the analyticity strip is fitted from the exponential tail of the energy spectrum, and its extrapolated zero is compared with the exact shock-formation time, as in Sulem-Sulem-Frisch.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Ortigueira fractional centered differences for the Riesz derivative: symbol and convergence
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: The Riesz fractional Laplacian is discretized with fractional centered difference weights computed via Gamma functions. The discrete Fourier symbol is compared with |k|^alpha, and O(h^2) convergence is verified for a space-fractional diffusion problem with known solution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Time-fractional diffusion-wave equation 1 < alpha < 2: damped oscillatory Mittag-Leffler decay
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: The Caputo diffusion-wave equation is discretized with an L1-type scheme for the second-order Caputo derivative and a reformulated first-order system. The interpolation between diffusion and waves is verified against E_alpha(-lambda t^alpha), including convergence order 3-alpha.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Average vector field discrete gradient for nonlinear Klein-Gordon: exact energy conservation
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: The phi^4 nonlinear Klein-Gordon equation is semi-discretized as a Hamiltonian system and integrated with the AVF discrete-gradient method using exact Gauss quadrature of the nonlinearity. Machine-precision energy conservation is demonstrated and contrasted with Störmer-Verlet bounded oscillation and RK4 drift.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Ablowitz-Ladik integrable lattice versus standard discrete NLS: radiation-free soliton transport
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Moving bright solitons are propagated on the integrable Ablowitz-Ladik discretization and on the standard centered-difference discrete NLS with high-accuracy time stepping. The modified conserved norm and Hamiltonian are monitored, and shed radiation and Peierls-Nabarro velocity loss are quantified.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Negative angular fluxes in diamond difference versus step-characteristic in thick absorbers
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Strongly absorbing optically thick cells are treated with diamond-difference, set-to-zero fixup and step-characteristic S_N slab sweeps. Negativity, positivity and accuracy of transmitted flux are compared against the exact exponential attenuation.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Ray effects in 2D S_N transport from a localized source in a void
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: 2D Cartesian discrete ordinates with level-symmetric quadrature and diamond-difference sweeps are applied to a small isotropic source in a weakly scattering medium. The angular oscillations of the scalar flux on a circle are measured versus S_N order and compared with the exact uncollided flux.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Henyey-Greenstein anisotropic scattering slab: S_N transmission versus delta-Eddington
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Slab radiative transfer is solved with Legendre-expanded Henyey-Greenstein phase functions in S_N source iteration. Reflectance and transmittance are computed versus asymmetry factor g, and the accuracy of delta-Eddington and isotropic-transport approximations is assessed.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Critical slab thickness in one-speed S_N transport versus diffusion theory
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: The k-eigenvalue of a bare multiplying slab is computed with S_N power iteration for several values of c. The critical half-thickness is found by secant search and compared with exact one-speed transport benchmarks and with diffusion theory using extrapolated boundaries.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Incremental versus rotational pressure-correction: temporal orders of velocity and pressure
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve a manufactured unsteady Stokes/Navier-Stokes problem on a MAC grid with standard incremental and rotational (Timmermans/Guermond-Shen) projection schemes. Measure L2 convergence orders in dt for velocity and pressure and the numerical pressure boundary-layer thickness.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Approximate cell-centered projection versus exact MAC projection: divergence residual and checkerboard modes
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Project a non-solenoidal 2D periodic field using a collocated approximate projection (wide-stencil Laplacian) and an exact staggered MAC projection. Compare the remaining discrete divergence, the idempotence error, and the spurious odd-even pressure modes.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Channel flow past a square cylinder: Strouhal number via MAC projection
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Simulate 2D incompressible flow at Re = 100 around a blocked-cell square obstacle using a Chorin projection on a staggered grid with convective outflow. Extract the vortex-shedding Strouhal number from the lift-proxy time series and compare it with literature values (about 0.14-0.15).

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Stokes' second problem: oscillating plate penetration depth and phase lag
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the unsteady diffusion equation for the velocity above an oscillating plate with Crank-Nicolson finite differences until the response is periodic. Fit the amplitude decay length and phase lag and compare with the exact Stokes-layer solution exp(-y/δ)cos(ωt - y/δ).

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Wide-gap Taylor-Couette onset: critical Taylor number versus radius ratio
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Discretize the axisymmetric linearized Couette-flow perturbation equations in the radial direction by Chebyshev collocation and minimize the critical rotation rate over axial wavenumber. Compare the result with the narrow-gap limit and tabulated values for several radius ratios.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Hartmann channel MHD flow: layer thickness and flow rate via Chebyshev collocation
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the coupled velocity and induced-field equations of pressure-driven Hartmann flow by Chebyshev collocation. Verify exponential convergence against the analytic cosh profiles and the 1/Ha Hartmann-layer thickness, using enough points to resolve the layers at Ha up to 1000.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Horton-Rogers-Lapwood porous convection onset: critical Rayleigh number 4π²
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Set up the linear stability problem for Darcy convection in a porous layer heated from below as a vertical eigenproblem using finite differences or Chebyshev collocation. Minimize over wavenumber to recover Ra_c = 4π² and k_c = π, and confirm onset with a nonlinear streamfunction-temperature simulation.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Eady baroclinic instability: growth rate versus wavenumber from a vertical eigenproblem
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Discretize the quasi-geostrophic Eady problem (uniform shear and stratification between rigid lids) in the vertical. Compute the complex phase speeds and the growth-rate curve, and compare the maximum growth rate with 0.31 f Λ/N and the short-wave cutoff.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Circular membrane eigenvalues by Chebyshev-Fourier polar collocation
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Discretize the Laplacian on the unit disk with Chebyshev collocation in r ∈ [-1,1] and Fourier collocation in θ, folding the radial grid to avoid the pole. Compare the computed Dirichlet eigenvalues with squared Bessel zeros and show spectral convergence.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Troesch's stiff boundary-value problem by Chebyshev collocation and Newton continuation
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve u'' = λ sinh(λu) with u(0)=0 and u(1)=1 for large λ using Chebyshev collocation, Newton iteration and continuation in λ. Report u'(0) against the known elliptic-function reference values and document how the convergence rate depends on λ.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Double-well tunneling splitting via mapped Chebyshev Schrödinger eigenproblem
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Compute the lowest two eigenvalues of the quartic double-well potential on the real line using an algebraically mapped Chebyshev discretization. Compare the ground-state splitting with the instanton/WKB asymptotic formula as the barrier height grows.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Two-dimensional freezing in a cooled corner: enthalpy method versus Rathjen-Jiji
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve 2D one-phase solidification of liquid initially at the fusion temperature inside a quarter-plane corner with suddenly cooled walls, using an explicit enthalpy scheme. Compare the far-field front positions with the Neumann solution and the corner (bisector) position with the Rathjen-Jiji approximation.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: American call with a discrete cash dividend: jump condition and early exercise
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the Black-Scholes PDE backward with the jump condition V(S,t_d⁻) = V(S - D, t_d⁺) and an American constraint. Determine the critical stock price for exercise just before the dividend and compare the result with the Roll-Geske-Whaley formula.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Kirsch plate with a circular hole: stress concentration with isoparametric Q8 elements
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Model a quarter of a plate with a hole under uniaxial tension using 8-node serendipity isoparametric elements, applying exact Kirsch tractions on the outer boundary. Compute the hoop-stress concentration factor and compare it with the analytic value 3.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Tapered cantilever beam natural frequencies with Hermite cubic elements
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Assemble Euler-Bernoulli Hermite beam elements with linearly varying cross-section and integrate their properties by Gauss quadrature. Compute the first frequencies of a wedge cantilever and compare them with Kirchhoff's Bessel-function solution and with the uniform-beam values.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Axially compressed beam vibrations: frequency squared versus load up to Euler buckling
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Add the geometric stiffness matrix to a Hermite-element model of a pinned-pinned beam. Show that ω₁² decreases linearly with axial load, vanishing at the Euler buckling load, and compare with the exact relation ω²(P) = ω₀²(1 - P/P_cr).

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Fisher-KPP front speed selected by exponentially decaying initial data
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Start Fisher-KPP from initial data decaying like e^{-λx} and measure the long-time front speed numerically. Verify c = λ + 1/λ for λ < 1 and the minimal speed 2 for λ ≥ 1.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Population persistence under a shifting climate envelope: critical shift speed
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve a reaction-diffusion equation with growth only inside a habitat patch that moves at speed c, written in the moving frame. Find the critical speed at which the population goes extinct and compare it with the principal-eigenvalue prediction for given patch length.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Fisher-KPP spreading in a periodic patchy habitat
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Simulate invasion fronts in a medium with periodically alternating good and bad patches and measure the average spreading speed. Compare it with the speed given by minimizing the periodic principal eigenvalue (Shigesada-Kawasaki-Teramoto formula).

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: KISS critical patch size for logistic reaction-diffusion
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve u_t = D u_xx + r u(1 - u) on [0, L] with Dirichlet boundaries, using time stepping and steady Newton continuation. Locate the critical length L_c = π√(D/r) and the bifurcation of the nontrivial steady state.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Lotka-Volterra competition invasion wave: linear determinacy of speed
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Simulate a diffusive two-species competition system where one species invades the other and measure the invasion front speed. Compare it with the linearized prediction 2√(D(1 - a)) and identify parameters where nonlinear selection breaks linear determinacy.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: WENO-JS versus WENO-M versus WENO-Z accuracy at critical points
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement the three fifth-order WENO weight families and apply them to smooth advection data with first-order critical points (f' = 0). Measure convergence orders to show the order loss of WENO-JS and its recovery by the Henrick mapping and the Borges τ₅ weights.
math/pde_numerics|pde.area: WENO reconstruction for hyperbolic conservation laws

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Component-wise versus characteristic-wise WENO5 on the Lax shock tube
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the Lax Riemann problem for 1D Euler with WENO5 and SSPRK3, reconstructing either conserved variables or Roe-averaged characteristic variables. Quantify the spurious oscillation amplitude and L1 error for each approach.
math/pde_numerics|pde.area: WENO reconstruction for hyperbolic conservation laws

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: 2D isentropic vortex advection: WENO5 convergence order for Euler
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Advect the Shu isentropic vortex through a periodic domain with dimension-by-dimension WENO5 finite differences, Lax-Friedrichs flux splitting and SSPRK3. Measure the density error after one period and its observed order under refinement.
math/pde_numerics|pde.area: WENO reconstruction for hyperbolic conservation laws

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Mean first-passage time from the backward Kolmogorov equation
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the backward equation for the MFPT of a diffusion in a tilted potential with one absorbing and one reflecting boundary using conservative finite differences. Compare the result with the double-integral exact formula and with the decay rate of the forward Fokker-Planck solution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Kompaneets equation with Chang-Cooper weights: relaxation to Bose-Einstein spectrum
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Discretize the Kompaneets equation for photons scattering off thermal electrons using Chang-Cooper weighting that preserves photon number. Verify positivity and convergence to a Bose-Einstein spectrum with the chemical potential fixed by photon number and energy.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Fast discrete-sine-transform Poisson solver versus iterative methods
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the 2D Dirichlet Poisson problem exactly by diagonalizing the 5-point Laplacian with DST-I in both directions. Verify agreement with the analytic discrete eigenvalues and compare cost scaling against CG and SOR.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Polymer flooding with adsorption: Buckley-Leverett two-front structure
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the coupled water-saturation and polymer-concentration conservation laws with Langmuir adsorption using upwind finite volumes. Identify the leading water-bank shock and the trailing polymer front, and compare their speeds with the fractional-flow tangent construction.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Logarithmic capacity of an ellipse by single-layer potential with singular quadrature
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the first-kind single-layer integral equation for the equilibrium charge density on an ellipse using Nyström discretization with Kress log-singular quadrature. Compare the logarithmic capacity with (a + b)/2 and observe exponential convergence.
math/pde_numerics|pde.area: Boundary integral and boundary element methods

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Interior Dirichlet Helmholtz eigenvalues from boundary integral determinant zeros
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Discretize the Helmholtz single-layer operator on a disk and on a stadium-like smooth domain. Locate the wavenumbers where the smallest singular value vanishes, and compare the disk values with Bessel zeros.
math/pde_numerics|pde.area: Boundary integral and boundary element methods

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Coastal Kelvin wave in rotating shallow water: phase speed and Rossby radius decay
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Simulate linear rotating shallow-water equations in a channel on an Arakawa C-grid with a coastal height perturbation. Measure the alongshore propagation speed √(gH) and the offshore e-folding scale equal to the Rossby radius.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Ekman spiral and transport with depth-dependent eddy viscosity
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the steady wind-driven Ekman layer equations for the complex velocity using finite differences. Verify the constant-viscosity spiral and the 90° transport rule, then examine how a depth-varying viscosity changes the surface deflection angle.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Viscous shock structure in compressible Navier-Stokes versus Becker's solution
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Time-march 1D compressible Navier-Stokes to a steady shock with Prandtl number 3/4. Compare the velocity profile and shock thickness with Becker's exact solution across Mach numbers.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Pressureless Euler equations: delta-shock formation and mass concentration
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the pressureless gas dynamics system for colliding streams with a positivity-preserving finite-volume scheme. Track the mass concentrating at the delta shock and its trajectory, and compare both with the generalized Rankine-Hugoniot solution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Kynch batch sedimentation with Richardson-Zaki flux: sludge and supernatant interfaces
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the Kynch conservation law for settling suspensions with a nonconvex Richardson-Zaki flux using a Godunov or Engquist-Osher scheme. Track the supernatant-suspension and sediment interfaces and compare them with the Kynch characteristic construction.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Halfar similarity solution for a shallow-ice-approximation glacier dome
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the degenerate nonlinear shallow-ice diffusion equation for ice thickness in radial or 1D geometry with a flux-conservative explicit scheme. Compare the margin position and dome height with Halfar's t^{-1/9} and t^{1/18} similarity scalings.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Premixed laminar flame speed as a nonlinear eigenvalue with one-step kinetics
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the steady 1D temperature-fuel equations with Arrhenius chemistry by Newton iteration, treating the flame speed as an unknown eigenvalue. Compare its dependence on the Zeldovich number with large-activation-energy asymptotics.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Cyclic voltammetry of a reversible couple: Randles-Sevcik peak current
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve semi-infinite planar diffusion of oxidized and reduced species with Nernstian boundary conditions under a triangular potential sweep, using implicit finite differences on an expanding grid. Compare the dimensionless peak current 0.4463 and the 57 mV peak separation with theory.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Hodgkin-Huxley cable: action potential conduction velocity in squid axon
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the HH cable equation with a semi-implicit diffusion step and explicit gating updates. Measure the conduction velocity (about 21 m/s for standard parameters) and its scaling with axon radius.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Passive dendritic cable: length constant, input resistance and transients
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the linear cable equation for a finite sealed-end cable with current injection by Crank-Nicolson. Compare the steady input resistance with the coth(L/λ) formula and the voltage decay time constants with Rall's equalizing time constants.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Ångström periodic heating method: diffusivity from amplitude decay and phase lag
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Simulate a rod with a sinusoidally heated end and lateral losses using implicit finite differences. Extract the thermal diffusivity from the amplitude ratio and phase lag between two stations using Ångström's formula, and assess bias from loss parameters.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Oceanic lithosphere cooling: half-space versus plate model seafloor depth
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve transient conduction in a cooling oceanic plate of finite thickness with a fixed basal temperature using Crank-Nicolson. Compute isostatic seafloor subsidence versus age, compare it with the half-space √t law, and locate the flattening age.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Magnetic flux expulsion by a rotating eddy (Weiss problem)
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the 2D kinematic induction equation for the vector potential in a prescribed cellular flow using finite differences. Measure the steady expelled-field structure and the boundary-layer thickness scaling Rm^{-1/3} predicted by Weiss.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Two-point flux inconsistency on skewed grids versus MPFA-O finite volumes
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve Poisson or Darcy flow on parallelogram-distorted quadrilateral grids with full permeability tensors using two-point and multipoint (MPFA-O) flux approximations. Demonstrate that TPFA is inconsistent on these grids while MPFA-O converges at second order.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Immersed interface method for Poisson with a circular singular source
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve a 2D Poisson problem with prescribed solution and flux jumps across a circle using LeVeque-Li correction terms in the 5-point stencil. Compare second-order convergence with the first-order smeared delta-function approach.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Parareal for the heat equation: iterations to fine-solver accuracy
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Combine a coarse backward-Euler propagator and a fine Crank-Nicolson propagator in the parareal algorithm for 1D diffusion. Measure the error versus iteration number and compare it with the theoretical convergence bound and the achievable parallel speedup.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Spectral deferred correction for diffusion: one order gained per sweep
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Apply implicit-Euler-based SDC sweeps on Gauss-Lobatto nodes to a 1D heat equation semi-discretized in space. Confirm that each sweep raises the temporal order by one, up to the collocation limit.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Perona-Malik anisotropic diffusion: edge preservation versus linear smoothing
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Apply explicit Perona-Malik diffusion with exponential and rational conductivity functions to a noisy piecewise-constant image. Measure edge sharpness and PSNR against isotropic heat-equation smoothing, and observe staircasing.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Amari neural field: stationary bump width versus firing threshold
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Simulate the 1D Amari integro-differential neural field with a Mexican-hat kernel, computing the convolution by FFT. Measure the stable bump width and compare it with Amari's threshold condition W(a) = h, including the unstable branch.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Ground-level pollutant plume: K-theory advection-diffusion versus Gaussian plume
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the steady 2D or 3D advection-diffusion equation downwind of an elevated point source with constant and height-dependent eddy diffusivities. Compare ground-level concentrations with the Gaussian plume formula that includes ground reflection.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: River dissolved-oxygen sag with dispersion: Streeter-Phelps critical deficit
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve coupled advection-dispersion-reaction equations for BOD and oxygen deficit downstream of a continuous discharge using finite volumes. Compare the location and magnitude of the critical deficit with the Streeter-Phelps solution as dispersion vanishes.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Aliasing instability and the 2/3 dealiasing rule in pseudospectral inviscid Burgers
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Integrate the inviscid Burgers equation before shock formation with aliased and 2/3-truncated Fourier pseudospectral schemes. Show the energy conservation and growth of spurious high-wavenumber content without dealiasing, and its suppression with truncation.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Filbet-Laurençot conservative finite volumes for Smoluchowski gelation with multiplicative kernel
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the continuous Smoluchowski equation with K=xy using the Filbet-Laurençot flux-form finite-volume scheme on a truncated grid. Track the first and second moments, detect gelation near t=1 and measure mass loss after gelation against the exact sol-mass formula.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Coagulation-fragmentation with constant kernels: relaxation to Aizenman-Bak equilibrium
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Discretize the continuous coagulation-binary-fragmentation equation with constant rates using a mass-conserving sectional scheme. Verify convergence to the exponential equilibrium distribution set by detailed balance, and measure the relaxation of the zeroth moment.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: LaMer burst nucleation: coupled nucleation-growth population balance with supersaturation depletion
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Couple a size-space advection PBE that has classical nucleation at the critical size to a solute mass balance. Compute the duration of the nucleation burst, the final particle number and the coefficient of variation of the size distribution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Boussinesq lock-exchange gravity current: front Froude number by projection
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Simulate a 2D lock-exchange release of dense fluid with Boussinesq Navier-Stokes using a MAC projection scheme and an advected density field. Measure the front speed and compare the Froude number with Benjamin's energy-conserving value of 1/2.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Ethier-Steinman 3D exact Navier-Stokes solution: projection scheme error orders
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement a 3D staggered-grid projection method on a cube with time-dependent Dirichlet data from the Ethier-Steinman exact solution. Measure velocity and pressure errors and the observed space and time orders.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Gresho vortex: kinetic energy conservation of skew-symmetric versus advective MAC forms
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Advect the inviscid Gresho vortex on a periodic MAC grid with projection, using divergence, advective and skew-symmetric discretizations of the convective term. Compare the kinetic-energy drift and the vortex profile preservation.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Stam stable fluids: numerical dissipation of semi-Lagrangian advection with FFT projection
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement Stam's unconditionally stable fluids solver, which combines semi-Lagrangian velocity advection, implicit diffusion and FFT pressure projection, on a periodic box. Quantify the effective numerical viscosity from Taylor-Green energy decay as a function of Courant number.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Order reduction of Strang splitting for reaction-diffusion with Dirichlet boundaries
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Apply Strang splitting to u_t=u_xx+f(u) with inhomogeneous Dirichlet data. Measure the observed temporal order, which drops below two because of boundary incompatibility, and show that a boundary-corrected splitting restores second order.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Spurious steady states of Lie and Strang splitting for diffusion-decay-source problems
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Split u_t=Du_xx-ku+s into diffusion and reaction substeps and compute the fixed point of the splitting map directly. Show that the steady-state error is O(dt) for Lie and O(dt^2) for Strang, compared with the exact steady solution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Oxygen in a tumor spheroid with Michaelis-Menten uptake: splitting error comparison
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve radial oxygen diffusion with Michaelis-Menten consumption using Lie and Strang splitting, with the reaction substep integrated analytically via the Lambert W function. Compute the hypoxic radius and the splitting error order against a fine monolithic reference.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Complex-coefficient fourth-order splitting for parabolic reaction-diffusion equations
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Explain the negative-step barrier for real splittings beyond order two, then implement a fourth-order composition with complex coefficients that have positive real part (Castella-Hansen type) for a Fisher-type equation. Verify fourth-order convergence and a small imaginary residual.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Lees ADI scheme for the 2D wave equation in a rectangular membrane
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement the implicit Lees alternating-direction scheme for u_tt=c^2 Δu on a rectangle. Demonstrate stability beyond the explicit CFL limit and measure the frequency error of the fundamental (1,1) mode against the exact eigenfrequency.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: ADI heat conduction on an L-shaped domain with segmented line solves
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Adapt Peaceman-Rachford ADI to a nonrectangular L-shaped region by solving separate tridiagonal systems on each grid-line segment. Verify the slowest decay rate against the first Dirichlet eigenvalue of the L-shaped domain (about 9.6397).

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Douglas ADI for 2D advection-diffusion of a Gaussian puff
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve a constant-velocity advection-diffusion problem in 2D with Douglas ADI and centered or upwind convection. Compare peak concentration and spread with the exact translating Gaussian across grid Péclet numbers and time steps.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Douglas-Russell modified method of characteristics for advection-dominated diffusion
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Combine backward characteristic tracing with interpolation and an implicit diffusion step for a 1D advection-diffusion problem at high Péclet number. Show that the error depends weakly on the Courant number, unlike Eulerian Crank-Nicolson, by comparing both with the exact solution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Effective diffusivity of cellular flow: semi-Lagrangian advection-diffusion and Pe^{1/2} scaling
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Advect and diffuse a scalar in a periodic cellular streamfunction flow using semi-Lagrangian transport plus implicit diffusion. Extract the long-time effective diffusivity from variance growth and verify the Childress-Shraiman Pe^{1/2} scaling.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Focusing 2D NLS collapse via dynamic rescaling: Townes profile emergence
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Integrate radially symmetric critical cubic NLS in dynamically rescaled variables with a finite-difference Crank-Nicolson scheme. Track the scale factor L(t), confirm that the rescaled profile approaches the Townes soliton and estimate the collapse time.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: P1 FEM on a slit domain: r^{1/2} singularity and radially graded meshes
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Assemble P1 Poisson on a square with a crack using a manufactured r^{1/2} sin(θ/2) solution. Show the reduced H1 convergence rate of 1/2 on uniform meshes and recover the optimal rate with algebraically graded meshes around the crack tip.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Dirac point source in 2D P1 FEM: reduced L2 convergence
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve -Δu=δ_x0 on a disk with P1 elements, comparing with the logarithmic Green's function. Measure L2 convergence close to O(h) and the H1 divergence, and evaluate errors away from the source to show local optimality.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Square coaxial line capacitance with P1 triangles and energy convergence
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Assemble P1 Laplace on the region between square inner and outer conductors and compute capacitance per unit length from the field energy. Verify convergence toward the conformal-mapping reference and the reduced rate caused by the reentrant corners.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Pure Neumann Poisson with P1 elements: compatibility and Lagrange multiplier constraint
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Assemble a singular Neumann stiffness matrix on the unit square and remove the constant nullspace using a Lagrange multiplier that enforces zero mean. Verify the compatibility condition, then measure H1 and L2 rates for a manufactured solution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Cell-centered finite volumes on Delaunay triangles: least-squares gradient reconstruction accuracy
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Build a Delaunay mesh, reconstruct cell gradients by weighted least squares and Green-Gauss, and use them in a MUSCL advection step. Measure gradient accuracy and the advection error order on irregular triangulations.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Gray-Scott 1D self-replicating pulses: splitting time versus feed rate
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Simulate the 1D Gray-Scott model from a localized pulse with method of lines and stiff time stepping. Detect pulse self-replication events and measure the time between splittings as a function of the feed parameter.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Extension velocities off the interface via the Adalsteinsson-Sethian orthogonality PDE
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Extend an interface speed field off the zero level set by solving ∇F·∇φ=0 with upwind iteration or fast sweeping. Measure the resulting preservation of the signed-distance property during level-set advection compared with naive extension.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Volume-preserving mean curvature flow of an ellipse via level sets
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Evolve a level-set function with normal speed κ minus its interface average, using explicit curvature discretization and periodic reinitialization. Verify that the ellipse relaxes to a circle, and measure the area drift and relaxation rate.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Interface curvature estimation: level-set finite differences versus height functions
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Compute the curvature of a circle embedded in a grid from the level-set divergence formula and from height functions built on volume fractions. Measure convergence order and noise sensitivity under perturbations.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Manufactured solutions for 1D compressible Euler: verifying MUSCL-Hancock order
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Use sympy to derive source terms for smooth manufactured density, velocity and pressure, and add them to a finite-volume Euler solver. Measure L1, L2 and Linf orders with and without limiter clipping at extrema.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Manufactured solutions expose first-order Neumann closure: global order reduction
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Verify a variable-coefficient heat solver with a symbolic manufactured solution under Neumann conditions. Show that a one-sided first-order flux closure degrades global accuracy, and that a ghost-point second-order closure restores it.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Manufactured solutions for FitzHugh-Nagumo reaction-diffusion with IMEX time stepping
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Construct symbolic source terms for the coupled FitzHugh-Nagumo PDE system and verify space-time convergence of IMEX Euler and IMEX-CNAB schemes. Separate spatial and temporal error contributions across norms.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Hole-filling porous medium solution: Aronson-Graveleau focusing exponent
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the radially symmetric 2D porous medium equation with an annular initial density that collapses toward the origin. Track the inner front radius near focusing and fit the anomalous self-similar exponent against the known numerical value.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Porous medium equation on a bounded domain: friendly giant separable asymptotics
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve u_t=(u^m)_xx with Dirichlet data and arbitrary initial conditions using conservative finite differences. Verify decay as t^{-1/(m-1)} toward the separable profile, obtained from the associated nonlinear eigenvalue ODE.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Porous medium equation with strong absorption: finite extinction and localization
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve u_t=(u^m)_xx-u^q with 0<q<1 using a positivity-preserving scheme. Measure the finite extinction time and the localization of the support, and compare with the spatially uniform extinction estimate.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Payne-Whitham traffic model: phantom jam instability and stop-and-go waves
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the second-order Payne-Whitham traffic model on a ring road with finite volumes. Compare the growth rate of small density perturbations with linear stability and characterize the saturated stop-and-go wave amplitude.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Spherical Sod explosion with geometric source terms versus 2D reference
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the radially symmetric Euler equations with geometric source terms using an HLLC finite-volume scheme. Compare the shock radius and the implosion of the reflected shock with a high-resolution reference or self-convergence study.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Natural gas storage valuation via HJB finite differences with inventory controls
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Value a gas storage facility under a mean-reverting price with injection and withdrawal rate limits, discretizing price and inventory. Solve the HJB equation backward with control maximization, and report the value function and the optimal injection and withdrawal thresholds.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Merton optimal portfolio HJB by policy iteration versus closed form
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Discretize the finite-horizon Merton portfolio HJB in wealth with a monotone scheme and solve it by policy iteration at each time step. Compare the optimal stock fraction and value with the CRRA closed-form solution.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Finite-horizon Russian option via similarity reduction and penalty free boundary
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Reduce the Russian option (payoff equal to the running maximum) to a 1D linear complementarity problem in the ratio of running maximum to spot. Solve it by penalty iteration and compare the exercise boundary with its perpetual limit.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Packed-bed thermal storage Schumann model: thermocline spreading and discharge efficiency
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the coupled fluid-solid Schumann equations with upwind finite volumes and implicit interphase exchange. Compute thermocline thickness and discharge efficiency, and verify against the Anzelius-Schumann analytic breakthrough.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Axial dispersion tubular reactor with Danckwerts boundary conditions: conversion versus Péclet
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the steady first-order axial dispersion reactor with Danckwerts conditions by finite differences. Compute conversion versus Péclet number and compare with Wehner-Wilhelm analytic conversion, recovering the plug-flow and CSTR limits.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Camassa-Holm peakon propagation: speed equals amplitude with finite volumes
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the Camassa-Holm equation in its momentum (Helmholtz) form with a conservative scheme or pseudospectral filtering. Verify that a peakon translates at speed equal to its amplitude, and measure the two-peakon interaction phase shift.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: BBM equation solitary waves: speed-amplitude relation and inelastic collisions
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Integrate the Benjamin-Bona-Mahony equation pseudospectrally with RK4 on a periodic domain. Verify solitary-wave speed versus amplitude, and quantify the radiation produced in a two-wave collision, unlike integrable KdV.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: 1D arterial blood flow: pulse wave velocity versus Moens-Korteweg
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the 1D area-flow hyperbolic model of an elastic artery with a tube law, using MacCormack or Lax-Wendroff and characteristic boundary conditions. Measure the pressure pulse propagation speed against Moens-Korteweg, and the reflection at a stenosis or bifurcation impedance.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: BGK kinetic Sod problem: approach to Euler as Knudsen number decreases
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the 1D BGK equation with a discrete velocity grid, upwind transport and implicit relaxation. Measure the L1 deviation of density and temperature from the Euler Sod solution as the Knudsen number decreases.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: D2Q9 lattice Boltzmann Poiseuille flow: bounce-back slip error versus relaxation time
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Implement BGK lattice Boltzmann on a channel with halfway bounce-back walls and a body force. Compute the velocity profile error and the effective wall location as functions of τ, showing the viscosity-dependent slip.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Free magnetic decay modes in a conducting sphere with vacuum exterior
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Discretize the poloidal scalar of the induction equation radially, applying a potential-field matching boundary at the surface. Compute the slowest decay times as eigenvalues and compare with the spherical Bessel zeros (π^2 for the dipole).

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Nonlinear hillslope diffusion of a fault scarp with Roering critical-slope flux
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Evolve a fault scarp under linear diffusion and under nonlinear transport that diverges at a critical slope. Compare the morphologic age inferred from the maximum slope decay and the erf-profile fit.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Stream-power river incision: knickpoint migration celerity
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the detachment-limited stream-power equation for a river longitudinal profile after a base-level drop, using upwind finite differences. Compare knickpoint position versus time with the characteristic celerity K A^m S^{n-1}.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Higuchi drug release from a planar matrix: moving dissolution front and sqrt(t)
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve diffusion of dissolved drug in a matrix that contains undissolved excess, with a moving dissolution front, using front tracking or an enthalpy-like formulation. Compare cumulative release with the Higuchi square-root law.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Monge-Ampère equation by wide-stencil monotone finite differences and Newton
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve det D^2u=f with Dirichlet data using standard central differences and a convergent wide-stencil discretization, both with Newton iteration. Compare accuracy on smooth radial and singular cone solutions.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Channel flow over a porous layer: Brinkman equation versus Beavers-Joseph slip
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve fully developed flow in a channel partly filled with porous media using the Stokes-Brinkman equation in finite differences. Extract the effective interface slip coefficient and compare it with Beavers-Joseph predictions.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Electroosmotic slit flow: nonlinear Poisson-Boltzmann and Helmholtz-Smoluchowski velocity
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the nonlinear Poisson-Boltzmann equation across a slit by Newton finite differences, then integrate the Stokes equation with electric body force. Compare the bulk velocity with the Helmholtz-Smoluchowski limit versus Debye length.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Thermal-diffusive premixed flame: pulsating instability threshold in Lewis number
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Simulate a 1D one-step thermal-diffusive flame with high activation energy in a moving frame. Determine the critical Zeldovich-Lewis combination at which steady propagation gives way to pulsations, and compare with the asymptotic threshold.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Decaying 2D turbulence: enstrophy cascade spectrum and vortex merger statistics
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Integrate 2D Navier-Stokes in vorticity form pseudospectrally with dealiasing and hyperviscosity from random initial data. Measure the energy spectrum slope near k^{-3}, the energy and enstrophy decay, and the vortex number decay exponent.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Counterflow heat exchanger transient response: hyperbolic finite volumes
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve coupled hot- and cold-stream energy equations with wall exchange under a step in inlet temperature, using upwind finite volumes. Compare the transient approach time and steady effectiveness with the NTU-effectiveness formula.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Kirchhoff transformation for temperature-dependent conductivity with internal heat generation
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve steady nonlinear conduction in a slab and a cylinder with k(T) linear in T by Newton finite differences. Verify against the exact solution obtained through the Kirchhoff transform.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Miscible viscous fingering: linear growth rates versus Tan-Homsy
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Couple Darcy pressure with an advection-diffusion concentration field whose viscosity is exponential in concentration, in a 2D rectilinear displacement. Extract mode growth rates from early-time simulations and compare with Tan-Homsy quasi-steady theory.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Isotachophoresis: Kohlrausch adjusted concentration and steady boundary width
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve electromigration-diffusion of leading, trailing and counter ions with current-driven electric field in a moving frame, using finite volumes. Verify the Kohlrausch-adjusted trailing concentration and the steady interface width.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Hockney-Eastwood free-space Poisson solver via zero-padded FFT convolution
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Compute the gravitational potential of a uniform sphere on a 3D grid with isolated boundaries, by FFT convolution with the Green's function on a doubled grid. Compare with the analytic potential and with a periodic FFT solver.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Gross-Pitaevskii vortex dipole translation velocity via split-step Fourier
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Imprint a vortex-antivortex pair in a homogeneous 2D condensate and evolve it with split-step Fourier. Measure the dipole translation speed versus separation and compare with the point-vortex result ħ/(m d).

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: 1D soft-Coulomb atom strong-field ionization yield with Crank-Nicolson and absorbing mask
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the 1D time-dependent Schrödinger equation for a soft-Coulomb atom in a laser pulse using Crank-Nicolson and a cos^{1/8} mask absorber. Compute the ionization probability versus peak intensity.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Child-Langmuir space-charge-limited diode current by nonlinear Poisson iteration
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the planar Poisson equation with space charge from cold electron emission, with zero cathode field, by Newton or damped iteration. Verify the V^{3/2}/d^2 current law and the potential profile x^{4/3}.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Equatorial beta-plane shallow-water waves: Kelvin, Yanai and Rossby dispersion
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Discretize the linear equatorial shallow-water equations in latitude with finite differences and solve the eigenproblem for each zonal wavenumber. Classify Kelvin, Yanai, Rossby and inertia-gravity branches against Matsuno's analytic curves.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Quenched long cylinder: transient radial conduction and peak thermoelastic hoop stress
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve transient radial heat conduction with a convective Biot condition, then compute plane-strain thermal stresses from integrals of the temperature field. Determine the peak surface hoop stress and when it occurs versus Biot number.

math/pde_numerics|pde.title: Mason-Weaver sedimentation-diffusion: barometric equilibrium and approach time
math/pde_numerics|pde.gist: Solve the Mason-Weaver equation in a closed column with no-flux boundaries, using a conservative Scharfetter-Gummel-type finite volume scheme. Verify the exponential equilibrium profile and measure the relaxation time versus Péclet number.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Classical, modified and iterated Gram-Schmidt orthogonality loss on Vandermonde bases
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Orthogonalize monomial Vandermonde matrices on [0,1] whose condition number is set by the degree, using CGS, MGS and CGS2. Measure ||I - Q^T Q||_2 against kappa(A) and fit the empirical scaling exponents (about kappa^2, kappa and machine epsilon).

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Arnoldi orthogonalization variants inside GMRES for convection-diffusion
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build the upwind finite-difference matrix of 2D convection-diffusion and run GMRES with CGS, MGS and Householder Arnoldi. Track basis orthogonality loss alongside the residual to verify Paige-type coupling: MGS loses orthogonality only as the residual reaches attainable accuracy.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Block classical Gram-Schmidt BCGS versus BCGS2 with Cholesky-QR intra-orthogonalization
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement block Gram-Schmidt for tall matrices with column blocks of graded conditioning, using Cholesky QR or Householder QR within each block. Measure orthogonality loss and factorization residual against condition number for single and repeated inter-block projection.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: CholeskyQR, CholeskyQR2 and shifted CholeskyQR3 stability on tall-skinny matrices
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Generate tall-skinny matrices with prescribed singular values and compute QR via Gram-matrix Cholesky, repeated twice, and with a stabilizing shift. Report orthogonality and residual against kappa, and identify the kappa thresholds where each variant breaks down.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Kahan-Parlett twice-is-enough criterion for selective reorthogonalization
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement Gram-Schmidt with a conditional second projection triggered when the projected norm drops below a factor of the original norm. Count reorthogonalizations and measure final orthogonality on random, Hilbert-like and nearly dependent column sets for several threshold factors.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Moving least squares versus Shepard interpolation on the Franke function
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Fit local weighted linear and quadratic polynomials with compactly supported Wendland weights to scattered samples of Franke's 2D test function. Compare RMS and max errors with inverse-distance Shepard interpolation as the number of scattered nodes grows, and estimate convergence orders.
