math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Moving least squares and scattered data fitting

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Laplace natural-neighbor coordinates from Voronoi diagrams versus MLS
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute non-Sibsonian (Laplace) natural-neighbor coordinates from Voronoi edge lengths and generator distances using scipy.spatial. Interpolate scattered data on the unit square, and compare linear reproduction, smoothness and error with quadratic MLS.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Moving least squares and scattered data fitting

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Element-free Galerkin MLS shape functions and consistency verification
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Construct MLS shape functions and their derivatives from the moment matrix on a 2D nodal cloud with cubic-spline weights. Verify partition of unity and linear/quadratic reproduction to machine precision, and report the moment-matrix condition number as a function of support radius.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Moving least squares and scattered data fitting

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Gaussian RBF interpolation ill-conditioning versus shape parameter trade-off
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Interpolate scattered 2D data with Gaussian and multiquadric RBFs, solving the dense collocation system. Plot error and condition number against the shape parameter, then compare with thin-plate splines with polynomial augmentation via the saddle-point system.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Moving least squares and scattered data fitting

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Renka's modified quadratic Shepard method with local least-squares nodal functions
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: At each node, fit a weighted quadratic to nearby points by least squares, then blend these nodal functions with modified Shepard weights. Compare accuracy with basic Shepard and with global RBF on clustered scattered data that mimics station measurements.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Moving least squares and scattered data fitting

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Normal and curvature estimation on noisy point clouds via local fits
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Sample a sphere and a torus with noise, estimate normals by local PCA (smallest covariance eigenvector), then fit local quadratic height functions by weighted least squares to get mean and Gaussian curvature. Compare against analytic values as neighborhood size and noise vary.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Moving least squares and scattered data fitting

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Generalized moving least squares gradient and Laplacian recovery from scattered data
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Use GMLS with polynomial degree m to approximate the gradient and Laplacian of a smooth field at scattered points. Measure the convergence order in fill distance for m = 2, 3, 4 and compare with the theoretical rate h^(m+1-k).
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Moving least squares and scattered data fitting

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Ordinary kriging interpolation and variance from a fitted variogram
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Fit an exponential variogram to scattered synthetic geostatistical data, assemble the ordinary kriging saddle-point system with its Lagrange multiplier, and compute predictions and kriging variances on a grid. Validate by leave-one-out cross-validation.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Moving least squares and scattered data fitting

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Least-squares spherical harmonic fitting of scattered data on the sphere
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Fit spherical harmonic expansions up to degree L to scattered values on the sphere, with random, Fibonacci-lattice or latitude-clustered nodes. Compare design-matrix condition numbers and reconstruction errors, adding Tikhonov damping for poorly distributed nodes.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Moving least squares and scattered data fitting

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Clenshaw-Curtis weights via DCT and comparison with Gauss-Legendre
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute Clenshaw-Curtis nodes and weights with Waldvogel's FFT/DCT algorithm and check them against the explicit cosine-sum formula. Compare convergence with Gauss-Legendre on exp(x), 1/(1+25x^2) and |x|^3 to reproduce Trefethen's near-equal accuracy observation.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Fejér first and second rules and Bernstein-ellipse convergence rates
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build Fejér type-1 and type-2 rules via FFT and integrate f(x) = 1/(x - z0) with poles at varying distances from [-1,1]. Fit the geometric error decay and compare it with the Bernstein ellipse parameter rho computed from the pole location.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Adaptive nested Clenshaw-Curtis quadrature with embedded error estimates
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement globally adaptive subdivision using nested CC rules on 2^k+1 points, reusing function values across levels and estimating error from successive-level differences. Test on sharply peaked and nearly discontinuous integrands, recording function evaluations against achieved accuracy.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Smolyak sparse grids with nested Clenshaw-Curtis rules on Genz functions
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Construct Smolyak sparse-grid quadrature in d = 2 to 6 dimensions from nested CC rules with combination-technique weights. Integrate Genz oscillatory and product-peak test functions, and compare error versus point count with full tensor-product grids.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Modified Clenshaw-Curtis for highly oscillatory integrals via Chebyshev moments
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Interpolate f at Chebyshev points via DCT, then integrate against exp(i*omega*x) exactly using modified Chebyshev moments from a stable recurrence. Compare accuracy and cost with standard CC and Gauss as omega grows to 10^3.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Golub-Welsch Gauss rules from Jacobi matrix eigenproblems versus Clenshaw-Curtis
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build Gauss-Legendre, Gauss-Jacobi and Gauss-Laguerre rules from the eigenvalues and first eigenvector components of symmetric tridiagonal Jacobi matrices. Verify polynomial exactness and compare node and weight accuracy and integration error with CC at equal point counts.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Gauss-Kronrod rules via Laurie's algorithm and Jacobi-Kronrod matrices
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute the (2n+1)-point Kronrod extension of n-point Gauss-Legendre by building Laurie's Jacobi-Kronrod tridiagonal matrix and solving its eigenproblem. Verify the degree of exactness and compare G7-K15 error estimates with nested CC error estimates on test integrands.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Clenshaw-Curtis on semi-infinite intervals for Debye and Planck integrals
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Map [0, infinity) to [-1, 1] with algebraic and exponential maps and apply CC to the Debye heat-capacity function and truncated Planck radiation integrals. Compare convergence across maps and against series reference values.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Algebraic convergence of Clenshaw-Curtis, Fejér and Gauss for endpoint singularities
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Integrate x^alpha (1+x)^beta-type endpoint singularities with CC, Fejér-2 and Gauss-Legendre and measure the algebraic convergence rates as functions of alpha. Add a sigmoidal variable transformation and quantify the restored convergence.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Hankel singular value decay for boundary-controlled 1D heat equation
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Discretize the heat equation with Neumann boundary input and point-sensor output by finite differences, then compute Hankel singular values for increasing grid sizes. Show mesh-independent decay, and compare step-response errors of reduced models with the a priori bound.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Model order reduction via balanced truncation

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Discrete-time balanced truncation via Stein equations
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: For a discrete-time LTI system such as a sampled-data or FIR-like filter, solve discrete Lyapunov (Stein) equations, compute Hankel singular values and balance-truncate. Verify the H-infinity error bound on the unit circle by dense frequency sampling.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Model order reduction via balanced truncation

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Low-rank ADI solution of Lyapunov equations for 2D heat diffusion
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement low-rank Cholesky-factor ADI with heuristic Penzl shifts for the gramian of a 2D sparse heat model. Track the Lyapunov residual norm against iterations and compare the resulting low-rank balanced truncation with the dense solution.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Model order reduction via balanced truncation

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Singular perturbation approximation versus balanced truncation for DC gain
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Starting from a balanced realization of an RC-ladder or thermal network, build reduced models by truncation and by singular perturbation (residualization). Compare steady-state gain errors and frequency-dependent errors, confirming that both satisfy the same H-infinity bound.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Model order reduction via balanced truncation

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Balanced POD from impulse-response snapshots for advection-diffusion
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Collect primal and adjoint impulse-response snapshots of a 1D advection-diffusion model, then form approximate gramian factors and apply the SVD of their product (Rowley's balanced POD). Compare the approximate Hankel singular values and reduced-model errors with exact balanced truncation and standard POD.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Model order reduction via balanced truncation

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Balanced truncation of unstable systems via additive stable-antistable decomposition
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Split an unstable LTI model into stable and antistable parts using an ordered real Schur form and a Sylvester equation. Balance-truncate only the stable part, and verify that the retained unstable poles and the error bound hold for the stable component.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Model order reduction via balanced truncation

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Second-order position balancing for a finite-element Euler-Bernoulli cantilever beam
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Assemble Hermite FE mass and stiffness matrices for a cantilever with tip force and tip displacement output, then compare first-order balanced truncation with second-order position-balanced reduction. Compare preservation of the second-order structure and the resonance peak errors.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Model order reduction via balanced truncation

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Frequency-limited balanced truncation for a band-limited structural model
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute frequency-limited gramians using matrix logarithms for a lightly damped modal system restricted to a frequency band [w1, w2]. Compare in-band and out-of-band errors of frequency-limited and standard balanced truncation at equal reduced order.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Model order reduction via balanced truncation

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Shifted Hessenberg QR with Wilkinson shifts and deflation counting
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Reduce nonsymmetric matrices with real spectra to Hessenberg form by Householder reflectors, then apply explicit single-shift QR with Wilkinson shifts and deflation. Record iterations per eigenvalue and the quadratic convergence of the last subdiagonal entry.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: QR algorithm with shifts and deflation

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Implicit symmetric tridiagonal QR: Wilkinson versus Rayleigh quotient shifts
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement implicit-shift bulge chasing on symmetric tridiagonal matrices from Householder tridiagonalization. Show that the Rayleigh shift stalls on symmetric 2x2 blocks with equal diagonal entries while the Wilkinson shift converges, and measure the cubic decay of the off-diagonal.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: QR algorithm with shifts and deflation

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Francis double-shift QR for polynomial roots from companion matrices
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Apply implicit Francis double-shift QR with deflation to companion matrices of polynomials with complex-conjugate roots. Extract eigenvalues from the resulting 2x2 blocks, compare with numpy.roots, and report average iterations per root.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: QR algorithm with shifts and deflation

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Unshifted QR iteration rate and its equivalence with simultaneous iteration
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Run unshifted QR on symmetric matrices with prescribed eigenvalues and verify that the subdiagonal entries decay like |lambda_{i+1}/lambda_i|^k. Show numerically that the iterates match orthogonal simultaneous iteration applied to the identity.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: QR algorithm with shifts and deflation

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Aggressive early deflation in Hessenberg QR iterations
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Add an aggressive early deflation window to a Francis double-shift QR code, using a Schur decomposition of the trailing window and spike tests. Compare total sweeps and deflations with conventional small-subdiagonal deflation on random and nonnormal Hessenberg matrices.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: QR algorithm with shifts and deflation

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Cuppen's divide-and-conquer tridiagonal eigensolver with secular equation
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Split a symmetric tridiagonal matrix into a rank-one modified block diagonal, solve the secular equation for each eigenvalue by safeguarded rational iteration, and recover orthogonal eigenvectors with Gu-Eisenstat (Löwner) corrections. Compare accuracy and orthogonality with numpy.linalg.eigh.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: QR algorithm with shifts and deflation

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Cyclic Jacobi eigenvalue algorithm and relative accuracy on graded matrices
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement cyclic one-sided or two-sided Jacobi rotations and verify the quadratic decay of the off-diagonal norm per sweep. On scaled-diagonally-dominant graded matrices, show that Jacobi computes the tiny eigenvalues with high relative accuracy, unlike tridiagonal QR.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: QR algorithm with shifts and deflation

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Sturm-sequence bisection for density of states of the 1D Anderson model
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build the random-potential tight-binding Hamiltonian, count eigenvalues below E via the negative pivots of the LDL^T recurrence, and obtain the integrated density of states by bisection. Compare with full diagonalization, and extract localization lengths from transfer matrices.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: QR algorithm with shifts and deflation

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Golub-Kahan bidiagonalization with Demmel-Kahan zero-shift QR for singular values
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Bidiagonalize matrices by Householder reflections and apply implicit zero-shift QR sweeps to the bidiagonal. Show that tiny singular values of graded bidiagonals are computed with high relative accuracy, in contrast to eigenvalues of B^T B.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: QR algorithm with shifts and deflation

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Tikhonov deconvolution with L-curve, GCV and discrepancy principle
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Discretize the Phillips Fredholm first-kind problem, add Gaussian noise, and compute Tikhonov solutions from the SVD over a lambda grid. Choose lambda by maximum L-curve curvature, GCV minimization and Morozov's discrepancy principle, then compare the resulting reconstruction errors.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Picard plot and truncated SVD versus Tikhonov filter factors for Shaw
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: For the Shaw (or Baart) test problem, plot singular values, |u_i^T b| and their ratios to diagnose the discrete Picard condition. Compare the optimal-truncation TSVD and optimal-lambda Tikhonov errors and their filter factors.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Regularized numerical differentiation of noisy data via Tikhonov
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Pose differentiation as inverting a discrete integration operator applied to noisy samples, and regularize with first- or second-difference penalties. Select lambda by GCV and compare derivative errors with finite differences and smoothing splines.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Semi-convergence of LSQR as iterative regularization for gravity surveying
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Discretize the 1D gravity surveying problem, run LSQR/CGLS on noisy data, and record error against iteration to expose semi-convergence. Compare the optimal stopping iteration with the discrepancy-principle stop and with Tikhonov at optimal lambda.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Small 2D parallel-beam CT reconstruction with Tikhonov CGLS and Kaczmarz
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Assemble a sparse ray-pixel intersection matrix for parallel-beam tomography of a Shepp-Logan phantom on a 32x32 grid. Reconstruct with damped CGLS (Tikhonov) and with ART/Kaczmarz sweeps, comparing relative errors under noise.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Unfolding a smeared particle-physics spectrum with Tikhonov curvature regularization
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build a detector response matrix from Gaussian resolution and efficiency, fold a true spectrum, and add Poisson noise. Unfold with curvature-penalized Tikhonov and with TSVD, and compare bias, variance (from covariance propagation) and chi-square.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: MINRES with block-diagonal preconditioner for MAC-grid Stokes flow
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Assemble the staggered-grid Stokes saddle-point system for lid-driven cavity flow and solve it with preconditioned MINRES using a vector Laplacian and pressure mass-matrix block preconditioner. Show that iteration counts stay mesh-independent.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: MINRES and SYMMLQ for symmetric indefinite systems

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Equality-constrained quadratic programming KKT systems with constraint preconditioners
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Solve KKT systems from equality-constrained QPs with MINRES using diagonal and Schur-complement block preconditioners. Compare with null-space CG, and track iteration counts as the Hessian conditioning varies.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: MINRES and SYMMLQ for symmetric indefinite systems

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: MINRES residual bounds for spectra on two intervals
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Construct symmetric indefinite matrices with eigenvalues in [-a,-b] union [c,d], and compare MINRES residual decay with the two-interval bound, both the equal-length closed form and numerically optimized polynomials. Study how asymmetric interval lengths affect the rate.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: MINRES and SYMMLQ for symmetric indefinite systems

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Multi-shift MINRES for tight-binding resolvents at many energies
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Exploit the shift invariance of Krylov spaces to solve (H - sigma_k I)x = b for many real shifts with a single Lanczos run. Compute local spectral quantities of a 2D tight-binding Hamiltonian and compare with individual solves.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: MINRES and SYMMLQ for symmetric indefinite systems

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Rayleigh quotient iteration with inexact MINRES inner solves
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute interior eigenpairs of a discretized Schrödinger operator by Rayleigh quotient iteration, solving the nearly singular indefinite shifted systems inexactly with MINRES. Study how the inner tolerance affects outer cubic convergence and total matrix-vector products.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: MINRES and SYMMLQ for symmetric indefinite systems

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Murphy-Golub-Wathen three-eigenvalue clustering for mixed Poisson saddle points
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Discretize mixed 1D/2D Poisson (flux-pressure) as a saddle-point system and precondition with the exact Schur complement. Verify the preconditioned eigenvalues 1 and (1 +/- sqrt5)/2, then show MINRES degradation with approximate Schur complements.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: MINRES and SYMMLQ for symmetric indefinite systems

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: MINRES versus SYMMLQ on singular Neumann Poisson systems
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Apply MINRES and SYMMLQ to the singular pure-Neumann Poisson matrix with consistent and inconsistent right-hand sides. Check convergence to the minimum-norm least-squares solution and the behavior of the null-space component.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: MINRES and SYMMLQ for symmetric indefinite systems

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Augmented system least squares with MINRES versus LSQR
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Solve overdetermined least-squares problems through the symmetric indefinite augmented system [I A; A^T 0] using MINRES with scaling parameter alpha. Compare iteration counts and accuracy with LSQR, and examine the optimal alpha relative to the smallest singular value.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: MINRES and SYMMLQ for symmetric indefinite systems

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Hager-Higham 1-norm condition estimator versus exact condition numbers
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement Hager's power-method estimator with Higham's refinement using LU solves, and estimate ||A^-1||_1 for random, Hilbert, Kahan and tridiagonal matrices. Report underestimation ratios against exact computation.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Oettli-Prager componentwise and Rigal-Gaches normwise backward errors
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Solve badly scaled systems by Gaussian elimination with and without pivoting, then compute normwise and componentwise backward errors, Skeel condition numbers and forward error bounds. Verify that forward error is at most condition number times backward error.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Wedin perturbation bound for least-squares polynomial fitting
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Perturb the design matrix and data of polynomial least-squares fits, and compare observed solution changes with the first-order bound containing kappa and kappa^2 * residual/(||A|| ||x||) terms. Show the kappa^2 effect for large-residual problems.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Condition number of the matrix exponential via the Fréchet derivative
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute the Fréchet derivative of expm using Van Loan's block-triangular 2n x 2n exponential, and assemble its Kronecker matrix to get the exact relative condition number. Compare with power-method estimates and with the normal-matrix lower bound.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Mixed-precision iterative refinement convergence versus condition number
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Factor A in float32 LU, then refine with float64 residuals for matrices with kappa from 10^2 to 10^10. Record the iterations to double-precision backward error and identify the kappa limit (about 1/u_single) beyond which refinement diverges.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Vandermonde conditioning and Lebesgue constants for polynomial interpolation
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute condition numbers of monomial Vandermonde matrices and Lebesgue constants for equispaced, Chebyshev and Legendre nodes as the degree grows. Show that barycentric Chebyshev interpolation stays accurate despite exponential Vandermonde ill-conditioning.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Davis-Kahan sin-theta bound for eigenvector perturbation versus spectral gap
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Perturb symmetric matrices with controlled eigenvalue gaps by random symmetric E, and compute the principal angles between exact and perturbed invariant subspaces. Compare them with the Davis-Kahan bound ||E||/gap across gap sizes.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Randomized range finder with power iterations versus optimal truncated SVD
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Apply the Halko-Martinsson-Tropp randomized SVD with oversampling and q power iterations to test matrices with polynomial and exponential singular value decay. Compare spectral and Frobenius errors against the Eckart-Young optimum sigma_{k+1}.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Adaptive randomized range finder with probabilistic a posteriori error estimate
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Grow an orthonormal basis incrementally until r Gaussian test vectors certify ||(I - QQ^T)A|| < eps with high probability. Verify the probabilistic bound against the exact error across matrices and tolerances.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Nyström approximation of Gaussian kernel matrices versus randomized SVD
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Approximate PSD Gaussian kernel matrices on point clouds with randomized Nyström (stabilized with shifts) and with randomized SVD at the same sketch size. Compare trace-norm and spectral errors as the kernel bandwidth varies.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Sketch-and-precondition least squares with Gaussian and SRHT embeddings
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Sketch tall ill-conditioned least-squares matrices with Gaussian or subsampled randomized Hadamard transforms, QR-factor the sketch, and use R as a right preconditioner for LSQR. Show iteration counts independent of kappa(A).

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Subspace embedding distortion of CountSketch versus Gaussian sketches
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: For random d-dimensional subspaces of R^n, measure the singular value range of S*U for CountSketch, sparse sign and Gaussian maps as functions of sketch size. Estimate the embedding dimension needed for distortion below 0.5.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Hutchinson versus Hutch++ trace estimation for log-determinants
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Estimate tr(log A) for SPD graph-Laplacian-plus-shift matrices using Hutchinson, and Hutch++ with low-rank deflation, with exact matrix functions on moderate sizes. Compare variance and error decay with the number of matvecs (1/sqrt(m) versus 1/m).

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Interpolative decomposition of far-field kernel blocks via pivoted QR
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compress the interaction matrix between well-separated particle clusters (1/r kernel) using randomized sketching followed by column-pivoted QR to select skeleton columns. Report rank versus tolerance and the ID error compared with SVD.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Single-pass streaming randomized SVD from two-sided sketches
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement Tropp et al.'s single-pass low-rank approximation using range and co-range sketches with a core solve, with A accessed only once as a stream of rows. Compare error with two-pass randomized SVD for several sketch sizes.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Randomized block Krylov versus subspace iteration for slowly decaying spectra
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compare randomized block Krylov iteration with randomized subspace iteration at equal matvec budgets on matrices with small spectral gaps. Measure per-vector principal component error and spectral-norm approximation error.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Incomplete Cholesky versus Jacobi preconditioned CG for anisotropic diffusion
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Discretize anisotropic diffusion with anisotropy ratio epsilon, implement IC(0), and compare PCG iteration counts with Jacobi and with no preconditioning across mesh sizes and epsilon. Report the preconditioned condition numbers.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Ritz values from CG coefficients and onset of superlinear convergence
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Assemble the Lanczos tridiagonal from CG alpha and beta coefficients to obtain Ritz values and running condition-number estimates. Link the convergence of the extreme Ritz values to the onset of superlinear convergence in the residual.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Effective resistances on random resistor networks via grounded-Laplacian CG
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build graph Laplacians of random geometric graphs with conductance weights, ground one node, and solve for node potentials with CG to get two-point effective resistances. Check them against Laplacian pseudoinverse values and Foster's theorem sum.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Gauss quadrature A-norm error estimates in CG with delay
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement the Strakoš-Tichý delayed estimator of ||x - x_k||_A from CG coefficients, interpreting CG as Gauss quadrature for a Riemann-Stieltjes integral. Compare estimated and true errors for several delays d on model problems.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Deflated CG with recycled eigenvectors for sequences of SPD systems
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: For a sequence of diffusion systems with slowly varying coefficients, extract approximate small-eigenvalue eigenvectors from earlier CG runs and deflate later solves. Measure iteration savings and the effective condition number after deflation.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Chebyshev semi-iteration versus CG with estimated spectral bounds
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement Chebyshev iteration for SPD systems using exact and misestimated eigenvalue bounds, and compare it with CG on Poisson and clustered-spectrum matrices. Show Chebyshev attains the bound rate while CG adapts to the spectrum.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Balanced truncation of an RC interconnect ladder with twice-the-tail error check
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build the state-space model of an n-stage RC ladder circuit, compute its Gramians from Lyapunov equations, and apply square-root balanced truncation. Compare the H-infinity error from a frequency sweep against twice the sum of the discarded Hankel singular values.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Model order reduction via balanced truncation

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Balancing-free square-root versus square-root truncation for ill-conditioned Gramians
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: For a stable SISO system whose Hankel singular values decay over many decades, compare Varga's balancing-free square-root projection with the classical square-root method. Measure projector conditioning, transfer-function error and how well the reduced poles match.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Model order reduction via balanced truncation

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Positive-real balanced truncation preserving passivity of an RLC transmission line
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Solve the positive-real Riccati equations for a lumped RLC line model, balance their solutions and truncate. Check passivity of the reduced model with the Hamiltonian-matrix imaginary-eigenvalue test and verify the positive-real error bound.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Model order reduction via balanced truncation

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: LQG balanced truncation of the linearized complex Ginzburg-Landau equation
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Discretize the globally unstable linearized Ginzburg-Landau equation and solve the control and filter Riccati equations. Compute LQG characteristic values, build reduced LQG controllers and assess closed-loop stability and cost against full order.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Model order reduction via balanced truncation

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Cross-Gramian reduction of a symmetric thermal RC network
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Solve the Sylvester equation for the cross Gramian of a symmetric SISO thermal network. Verify that the absolute values of its eigenvalues equal the Hankel singular values, then reduce through the eigendecomposition and compare with balanced truncation.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Model order reduction via balanced truncation

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Bounded-real balanced truncation of a lossy acoustic waveguide scattering model
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Model a discretized lossy duct as a contractive scattering system, solve the bounded-real Riccati equations and balance their solutions. Truncate, confirm the reduced model stays contractive, and check the bounded-real error bound.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Model order reduction via balanced truncation

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Glover optimal Hankel-norm approximation of a lightly damped flexible structure
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Construct the all-pass dilation of a balanced realization of a modal flexible-structure model to obtain its optimal Hankel-norm approximant. Verify that the Hankel error equals sigma_{k+1} and compare the H-infinity error with balanced truncation.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Model order reduction via balanced truncation

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Time-limited balanced truncation for transient response of a building thermal model
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute time-limited Gramians on [0,T] for a multi-zone building thermal model using matrix-exponential corrections to the Lyapunov equations. Reduce the model and compare transient output errors with standard balanced truncation.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Model order reduction via balanced truncation

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Balanced reduction of a multi-compartment pharmacokinetic model with steady-state matching
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Reduce a linear multi-organ pharmacokinetic compartment model by balanced truncation and by singular-perturbation residualization. Compare plasma-concentration curves, AUC and steady-state gain errors as functions of reduced order.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Model order reduction via balanced truncation

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Tanh-sinh quadrature for algebraic and logarithmic endpoint singularities
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement double-exponential tanh-sinh quadrature with level halving for integrands such as log(x)/sqrt(1-x) and x^(-0.9). Measure error versus node count and compare the convergence with Gauss-Legendre.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Filon-Simpson rule for Fourier integrals at large frequency
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Derive the Filon-Simpson weights from exact moments of piecewise quadratic interpolants times cos/sin(omega x). Show that the error stays bounded or decreases as omega grows, while composite Simpson degrades.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Vector Levin method for Bessel-kernel oscillatory integrals
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Evaluate integrals of f(x)J_nu(omega x) by writing the Bessel pair as a 2x2 first-order system and solving the coupled Levin collocation equations. Validate against adaptive quadrature over a wide frequency range.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Ooura-Mori double-exponential quadrature for semi-infinite Fourier integrals
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement the Ooura-Mori DE transformation, whose nodes approach the zeros of sin or cos, for integrals such as the integral over (0, infinity) of sin(x)/x and of cos(x)/sqrt(x). Compare its convergence with truncation-plus-Gauss approaches.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Product-trapezoidal Nyström method for second-kind Abel integral equations
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Discretize u(t) + integral of (t-s)^(-1/2)u(s) ds = f with product-integration weights that integrate the singular kernel exactly against piecewise linears. Solve the triangular system and measure the convergence order against an exact solution.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Gauss rules for logarithmic weight via modified Chebyshev algorithm
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute modified moments of -log(x) on [0,1] against shifted Legendre polynomials, run the modified Chebyshev algorithm to obtain the Jacobi matrix, and get nodes and weights from its eigendecomposition. Test the rule on log-singular integrands.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Strang versus T. Chan circulant preconditioned CG for symmetric Toeplitz systems
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Generate SPD Toeplitz matrices from a positive symbol, build the Strang and optimal T. Chan circulant preconditioners with FFT diagonalization, and run PCG. Report eigenvalue clustering of the preconditioned matrices and iteration counts versus n.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Gohberg-Semencul representation of Toeplitz inverses with FFT matvecs
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute the first and last columns of a Toeplitz inverse by Levinson recursion and assemble the Gohberg-Semencul triangular-Toeplitz product formula. Apply the inverse with FFT-based products and verify it against a dense inverse.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Circulant-preconditioned solver for shifted Grünwald fractional diffusion
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Discretize a space-fractional diffusion equation with shifted Grünwald formulas, which gives Toeplitz-like nonsymmetric systems at each time step. Solve them with FFT matvecs and Strang-circulant preconditioned GMRES, and report iteration counts versus grid size.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: DCT diagonalization of reflective-boundary blurring for image deblurring
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Assemble a 2D blurring operator with symmetric PSF and Neumann (reflective) boundary conditions and diagonalize it with the 2D DCT. Compute Tikhonov-regularized restorations and compare boundary artifacts with periodic FFT deblurring.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Schur generator algorithm for Cholesky factorization of SPD Toeplitz matrices
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement the Schur (Bareiss-type) displacement-generator recursion to compute the Cholesky factor of an SPD Toeplitz matrix in O(n^2). Compare its backward error with Levinson and dense Cholesky on ill-conditioned examples.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Three-precision GMRES-based iterative refinement with half-precision LU preconditioner
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Simulate an fp16 LU factorization by rounding, then use it as a preconditioner for GMRES correction solves inside double-precision iterative refinement (Carson-Higham GMRES-IR). Show that this converges where standard LU-IR fails as the condition number grows.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Two-sided diagonal scaling to fit half-precision range before LU factorization
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Apply Higham-Pranesh-Zounon equilibration and scaling so that matrix entries fit the fp16 range without overflow or underflow. Factor in simulated half precision and count the refinement iterations needed for double-precision accuracy, with and without scaling.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Mixed-precision iterative refinement for least squares via the augmented system
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Use a float32 QR factorization to solve corrections of the Björck augmented system [I A; A^T 0], with residuals computed in float64. Measure the convergence of the solution and the LS residual for polynomial-fitting problems of increasing condition.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Single-precision Cholesky with double-precision refinement for Matérn covariance systems
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Factor SPD Matérn kernel matrices in float32 and refine solutions with float64 residuals. Locate the condition-number threshold at which float32 Cholesky breaks down, and test whether adding jitter recovers convergence.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Stochastic rounding versus round-to-nearest in simulated low-precision LU refinement
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Emulate bfloat16 LU factorization with round-to-nearest and with stochastic rounding. Compare the growth of factorization error and the convergence rates of the resulting double-precision iterative refinement over many trials.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Mixed-precision Newton refinement of symmetric eigendecompositions
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Start from a float32 eigendecomposition of a symmetric matrix and apply Ogita-Aishima refinement iterations in float64. Track the orthogonality and residual errors, which converge quadratically, and their dependence on eigenvalue gaps.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Defect correction with float32 inner CG for a 2D Poisson problem
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Wrap a loosely converged float32 conjugate-gradient inner solver inside float64 iterative refinement for a 2D Poisson system. Study how the inner tolerance and the problem size affect the outer convergence rate and total cost.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: ILU(0)-preconditioned GMRES for 2D convection-diffusion versus Péclet number
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Discretize a 2D convection-diffusion problem with upwind finite differences, implement ILU(0) on the sparsity pattern, and run GMRES. Report iteration counts and preconditioned eigenvalue spreads as the Péclet number increases.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Modified incomplete Cholesky with row-sum compensation for the Poisson equation
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement IC(0) and MIC(0) for the 5-point Laplacian and compute the condition numbers of the preconditioned operators versus mesh size h. Confirm the scaling O(h^-2) for IC(0) and O(h^-1) for MIC(0).

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: ILU(k) level-of-fill versus threshold ILUT fill-iteration trade-off
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement symbolic level-of-fill ILU(k) and compare it with drop-tolerance ILUT (scipy spilu) on a nonsymmetric FEM-like matrix. Plot GMRES iterations versus the number of factor nonzeros.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Jacobi scaling for high-contrast layered-permeability diffusion
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Assemble a finite-volume Darcy pressure matrix with permeabilities jumping over six orders of magnitude between layers. Measure the reduction in condition number and in PCG iteration count obtained with diagonal (Jacobi) scaling.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: SSOR-preconditioned CG with optimal relaxation parameter for Poisson
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build the SSOR preconditioner for the 2D Laplacian, scan the relaxation parameter omega to minimize the preconditioned condition number, and compare the optimum with the theoretical value of order 2/(1+c h). Report PCG iteration counts.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Ordering effects on IC(0): natural, red-black and reverse Cuthill-McKee
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Reorder a 2D Poisson matrix with natural, red-black and RCM permutations before IC(0) factorization. Compare PCG iterations and the norm of the remainder matrix, reproducing the Duff-Meurant observations.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Chebyshev polynomial preconditioners versus Jacobi PCG
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Construct degree-m Chebyshev polynomial preconditioners from estimated extreme eigenvalues of an SPD stiffness matrix. Trade outer PCG iterations against the number of matrix-vector products, and compare with Jacobi preconditioning.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Frobenius-norm sparse approximate inverse preconditioner with fixed sparsity pattern
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute a SPAI preconditioner column by column from small least-squares problems with the pattern of A or A^2, for convection-diffusion matrices. Measure ||AM - I||_F, the eigenvalue clustering of AM and the GMRES iteration counts.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Manteuffel shifted incomplete Cholesky for plane-stress elasticity stiffness
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Assemble a bilinear FEM plane-stress stiffness matrix, show that IC(0) breaks down because of negative pivots, and apply diagonal shifts alpha. Find the shift that minimizes PCG iterations.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Pseudospectra of the 1D convection-diffusion operator versus Péclet number
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Discretize u'' + c u' with Chebyshev collocation and compute minimum singular values of zI - A on a grid of complex z. Show that the resolvent norm grows exponentially with Péclet number inside the parabolic region of Reddy and Trefethen.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Distance to instability via Byers bisection on Hamiltonian eigenvalues
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute the complex stability radius min over omega of sigma_min(A - i omega I) for stable non-normal matrices. Use bisection with the Hamiltonian imaginary-eigenvalue test and validate against a dense frequency sweep.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Pseudospectral abscissa via the criss-cross algorithm
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement the Burke-Lewis-Overton criss-cross algorithm, alternating horizontal and vertical searches with Hamiltonian eigenvalue problems. Compute the epsilon-pseudospectral abscissa of non-normal test matrices and relate it to transient growth bounds.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Non-normal amplification in balanced excitatory-inhibitory neural networks
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Construct E-I connectivity matrices obeying Dale's law, compute their Schur decompositions to expose hidden feedforward structure, and measure transient amplification of activity patterns. Use the Henrici departure from normality as a summary measure (Murphy-Miller).

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Lifting-scheme CDF 5/3 and 9/7 biorthogonal wavelets with perfect reconstruction
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement the predict and update lifting steps for the CDF 5/3 and 9/7 wavelets with symmetric boundary handling. Verify perfect reconstruction, including the integer-to-integer 5/3 version, and compare energy compaction on test signals.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Beylkin-Coifman-Rokhlin wavelet sparsification of a logarithmic-kernel integral operator
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Transform the dense discretized log|x-y| kernel matrix with a 2D orthogonal Daubechies DWT and threshold small entries. Measure the number of retained nonzeros versus the operator-norm error, and the growth of sparsity with N.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: 2D separable Daubechies transform compression of a synthetic edge image
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Apply a multilevel 2D separable Daubechies DWT to a piecewise-smooth image with curved edges. Keep the largest coefficients and report PSNR versus the fraction retained, compared with 2D DCT compression.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Haar wavelet collocation for Fredholm integral equations of the second kind
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Expand the unknown of u(x) - integral of K(x,t)u(t) dt = f in Haar functions, collocate at midpoints and solve the dense linear system. Measure the convergence rate and the sparsity of the thresholded collocation matrix.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Hermite interpolation via confluent divided differences versus confluent Vandermonde systems
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Interpolate function and derivative data at Chebyshev and equispaced nodes using Newton divided differences with repeated nodes. Compare accuracy and conditioning with solving the confluent Vandermonde system directly.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Fritsch-Carlson monotone cubic Hermite interpolation of thermodynamic data
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Interpolate monotone tabulated saturation-pressure or heat-capacity data with Fritsch-Carlson derivative limiting. Compare overshoot and derivative accuracy with not-a-knot cubic splines and with unlimited Hermite interpolation.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Floater-Hormann rational interpolation on equispaced nodes and Lebesgue constants
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute barycentric Floater-Hormann weights for blending degree d and interpolate the Runge function on equispaced nodes. Measure errors and estimate the Lebesgue constants versus d and n.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: AAA rational approximation of |x| and pole clustering near the singularity
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement the AAA algorithm with SVD-based least-squares barycentric weights to approximate |x| on [-1,1]. Show root-exponential convergence and the exponential clustering of poles toward zero, and remove Froissart doublets.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: AAA recovery of poles and residues of meromorphic functions
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Sample tan(pi z/2) or the Gamma function on a contour or interval and run AAA. Compute poles from a generalized eigenvalue problem and residues from the barycentric form, and compare with exact values.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Robust Padé approximation via SVD of the Toeplitz coefficient system
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute [m/n] Padé approximants of exp, log(1+z) and noisy series by solving the Toeplitz linear system. Apply the Gonnet-Güttel-Trefethen SVD-based degree reduction to remove spurious pole-zero pairs.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Vector fitting of RLC network frequency responses with pole relocation
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Fit sampled impedance data of an RLC circuit with a rational model using the Gustavsen-Semlyen iteration: linear least-squares fits followed by pole relocation via eigenvalues. Report the convergence of poles and the fitting error.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Loewner-framework rational interpolation of transfer function measurements
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build Loewner and shifted Loewner matrices from frequency-response samples of a mechanical system and determine the minimal order from singular-value decay. Construct the descriptor realization and validate it at held-out frequencies.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Chebyshev rational approximation of exp(-x) for nuclear depletion Bateman equations
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Use partial-fraction CRAM coefficients, or AAA-derived ones, for exp(-x) on [0, infinity) and apply exp(At)n0 to a stiff decay-chain matrix with shifted linear solves. Compare accuracy with Padé scaling-and-squaring.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Spectrum slicing by LDL^T inertia for finite-element plate vibration
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: For the generalized eigenproblem K x = lambda M x of a FEM membrane or plate, count eigenvalues below a shift sigma from the negative pivots of LDL^T(K - sigma M). Bisect to isolate individual natural frequencies.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Cholesky and LDL^T for symmetric systems

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Modified Cholesky factorizations for Newton's method on nonconvex functions
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement Gill-Murray and Schnabel-Eskow modified Cholesky to produce positive-definite Hessian approximations. Use them in Newton line search on Rosenbrock and a molecular-cluster potential, and compare the size of the modification and the iteration counts.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Cholesky and LDL^T for symmetric systems

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Higham's nearest correlation matrix by alternating projections with Dykstra correction
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Take an indefinite empirical correlation matrix assembled from asset returns with missing data and project it alternately onto PSD matrices and unit-diagonal matrices. Verify that Cholesky succeeds afterwards and report the Frobenius distance.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Cholesky and LDL^T for symmetric systems

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Rank-one Cholesky updating and downdating for sliding-window least squares
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Maintain the Cholesky factor of a windowed normal-equations matrix with Givens-based rank-one updates and hyperbolic-rotation downdates. Track accuracy drift against refactorization over long data streams.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Cholesky and LDL^T for symmetric systems

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Pivoted Cholesky decomposition of s-type Gaussian two-electron integral matrices
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute (ab|cd) electron repulsion integrals of s-type Gaussians on a small molecule using the Boys function. Apply greedy pivoted Cholesky to the supermatrix and report the numerical rank and error versus threshold.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Cholesky and LDL^T for symmetric systems

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Exact star discrepancy of 2D Halton, Hammersley, Sobol and random points
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute the exact star discrepancy in two dimensions by enumerating critical boxes from point coordinates. Compare its scaling with N across low-discrepancy and pseudorandom point sets.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Warnock formula for L2-star discrepancy in moderate dimensions
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement Warnock's closed-form O(dN^2) L2-star discrepancy and evaluate it for Sobol, Halton and Latin hypercube samples in d = 2 to 20. Compare against the expected random-sampling value.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Component-by-component construction of rank-1 lattice rules in weighted Korobov spaces
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build generating vectors by CBC minimization of the closed-form worst-case error for product weights. Verify the error rate close to O(N^-1) and test on smooth periodic integrands.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Randomized QMC Asian option pricing with Brownian bridge versus PCA paths
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Price an arithmetic Asian option with scrambled Sobol points, constructing Brownian paths in standard, Brownian-bridge and PCA form, the last from an eigendecomposition of the covariance. Compare variance reduction and effective dimension.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Keister integral in high dimensions: product Gauss-Hermite versus Sobol and Halton
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Evaluate Keister's integral of cos(||x||) against a Gaussian weight in d = 5 to 25 with tensor Gauss-Hermite, scrambled Sobol and Halton points. Compare error versus cost against an accurate 1D radial reference.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Spherical-radial cubature versus unscented transform for nonlinear Gaussian moments
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement third-degree spherical-radial and fifth-degree Stroud rules and the unscented transform to propagate Gaussian uncertainty through polar-to-Cartesian and ballistic maps. Compute mean and covariance and compare with Monte Carlo.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Symmetric triangle cubature rules from moment equations by Gauss-Newton
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Parametrize fully symmetric node orbits on the triangle and solve the nonlinear moment equations for Dunavant-type rules of degree 4 to 8 using least-squares Gauss-Newton. Verify exactness and positivity of the weights.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Quasi-Monte Carlo for elliptic PDE with lognormal Karhunen-Loève coefficient
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Expand a lognormal diffusion coefficient in a truncated KL basis via a covariance eigendecomposition and solve the 1D or 2D finite-difference elliptic problem per sample. Estimate the mean outflow with lattice and Sobol points versus Monte Carlo.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Duffy-transformed Gauss-Jacobi cubature for weakly singular integrals over triangles
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Integrate 1/r-type singular kernels over triangles, as arise in boundary elements, by collapsing the triangle to a square with the Duffy transformation. Apply tensor Gauss-Jacobi/Legendre rules and compare convergence with untransformed symmetric triangle rules.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Adaptive Simpson with Richardson-corrected local errors for complete Fermi-Dirac integrals
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement recursive adaptive Simpson quadrature that adds the (S2-S1)/15 correction and splits the tolerance across subintervals. Compute Fermi-Dirac integrals F_j(eta) for half-integer j, including the sqrt(x) endpoint behaviour, and compare estimated with true errors against high-precision series references.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: QAGS-style adaptive Gauss-Kronrod G7-K15 with Wynn epsilon extrapolation for singularities
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build a global adaptive G7-K15 integrator with a priority queue, using the Piessens error heuristic (200|K-G|)^1.5. Accelerate it with the Wynn epsilon algorithm over bisection levels on integrands such as x^-0.5 log x. Report the number of evaluations and the reliability of the error estimate.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Geometrically graded hp-quadrature versus adaptive bisection for algebraic endpoint singularities
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Integrate x^alpha f(x) on [0,1] with composite Gauss-Legendre on geometric meshes graded toward 0, with linearly increasing degree. Show root-exponential convergence in the number of nodes, compare with an adaptive bisection Gauss-Kronrod code, and optimise the grading ratio sigma.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Global versus local adaptive strategies for multi-peak spectral line integrals
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Integrate synthetic emission spectra made of many narrow Voigt or Gaussian lines with local recursive and global priority-queue adaptive Simpson and Gauss-Kronrod schemes. Count function evaluations, quantify missed peaks for sparse initial sampling (a Lyness-type failure), and compare to exact line areas.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Adaptive triangle cubature for the Coulomb potential of a uniformly charged triangle
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute the electrostatic potential of a uniformly charged triangle at field points on and off its plane with recursive 4-way subdivision. Each child carries a degree-5 symmetric rule, and the error estimate comes from a degree-2 versus degree-5 comparison. Validate against the closed-form analytic potential, including the vertex singularity.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Gander-Gautschi adaptlob adaptive Gauss-Lobatto-Kronrod quadrature and termination criterion
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement the adaptlob algorithm: a 4-point Gauss-Lobatto rule with 7-point Kronrod extension and termination via machine-precision comparison with a coarse global estimate. Test it on the Gander-Gautschi battery, including sqrt, discontinuous and peaked integrands, and compare its evaluation counts with adaptive Simpson.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Adaptive Gauss-Kronrod Sommerfeld integrals for a dipole above a lossy half-space
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Evaluate Sommerfeld integrals for a vertical dipole over a lossy ground, using a deformed integration path that avoids branch points and the surface-wave pole. Integrate adaptively with G7-K15 on panels and use partition-extrapolation for the oscillatory tail. Check against the reflection-coefficient limits.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Error estimator reliability of embedded Gauss-Kronrod pairs on Genz-type 1D families
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: For G7-K15, G10-K21 and G15-K31 pairs (Kronrod nodes from Laurie-free tabulation or scipy), compute the ratio of estimated to actual error over random oscillatory, peak and discontinuous test families. Measure the frequencies of under- and over-estimation for raw |K-G| and for the QUADPACK heuristic.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Optimal SOR for the 9-point Mehrstellen Laplacian beyond consistent ordering
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: For the compact 9-point Poisson stencil, which is not consistently ordered under natural ordering, scan the SOR spectral radius versus omega numerically. Compare the scan with the Young-formula prediction from the Jacobi spectral radius and with four-colour orderings, and quantify the gap in optimal convergence rate.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Stationary iterative methods: Jacobi, Gauss-Seidel, SOR

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Point versus line Jacobi and line SOR for anisotropic diffusion
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: For -eps u_xx - u_yy on a square grid, compute the spectral radii of point Jacobi, line Jacobi (tridiagonal blocks solved by Thomas) and line SOR as functions of eps. Show that line relaxation along the strong direction is robust while point methods stall as eps goes to 0.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Stationary iterative methods: Jacobi, Gauss-Seidel, SOR

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: SOR convergence for nonsymmetric 1D/2D convection-diffusion versus cell Péclet number
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Discretise convection-diffusion with central and upwind differences. Compute Jacobi and SOR spectral radii, which can be complex, over a sweep of the cell Péclet number, locate the empirical optimal omega, and identify the regime where central differencing makes the Jacobi iteration divergent.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Stationary iterative methods: Jacobi, Gauss-Seidel, SOR

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Jacobi versus Gauss-Seidel for the PageRank linear system versus damping
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Formulate PageRank on a synthetic web graph with dangling nodes as (I - alpha P^T)x = (1-alpha)v. Compare Jacobi, which is equivalent to the power method, with forward and backward Gauss-Seidel iteration counts and spectral radii for alpha from 0.5 to 0.99.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Stationary iterative methods: Jacobi, Gauss-Seidel, SOR

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Stein-Rosenberg theorem verification on random resistor-network M-matrices
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Generate grounded Laplacians and random nonnegative-offdiagonal M-matrices. Compute the Jacobi and Gauss-Seidel spectral radii and verify the Stein-Rosenberg dichotomy rho_GS < rho_J < 1 or rho_GS = rho_J = 1 or rho_GS > rho_J > 1, including constructed divergent cases.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Stationary iterative methods: Jacobi, Gauss-Seidel, SOR

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Chebyshev acceleration of SSOR versus optimal SOR for heat-plate equilibrium
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: For the steady temperature of a plate with mixed Dirichlet-Neumann edges, estimate the SSOR eigenvalue interval. Apply Chebyshev semi-iterative acceleration and compare its asymptotic rate and iteration counts with optimally relaxed SOR and with plain SSOR.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Stationary iterative methods: Jacobi, Gauss-Seidel, SOR

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Givens QR updating for recursive least-squares ARX system identification
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Identify the parameters of an ARX dynamical model by appending data rows one at a time. Update the triangular factor with Givens rotations, with optional exponential forgetting, and compare the result with batch Householder solutions and with the covariance-form RLS, whose numerical drift is measured.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Square-root-free fast Givens (Gentleman) versus standard Givens rotations
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement standard Givens QR and Gentleman's square-root-free scaled Givens with rescaling to prevent overflow. Compare flop counts, orthogonality of the implied Q and least-squares residual accuracy on dense and banded test matrices.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Banded Givens QR for B-spline least-squares curve fitting
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Assemble the banded collocation matrix of cubic B-splines on noisy data and compute its QR by Givens rotations that preserve the band. Verify the fitted spline against a dense solve and compare cost scaling with dense Householder QR as the number of knots grows.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Hierarchical hat-basis sparse grid interpolation versus full grids
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Construct piecewise-linear hierarchical bases on sparse grids in d=2-4, with zero boundary. Compute hierarchical surpluses by hierarchisation sweeps, and compare interpolation error versus point count with full tensor grids for a smooth product-of-bumps function, verifying surplus decay 4^{-|l|_1}.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Dimension-adaptive Gerstner-Griebel sparse grid quadrature for anisotropic integrands
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement dimension-adaptive Smolyak quadrature with admissible index sets and a forward-neighbour error indicator, using nested 1D trapezoid or Gauss-Patterson rules. Apply it to integrands with strongly decaying dimension importance and compare with isotropic Smolyak.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Spatially adaptive sparse grid refinement for a basket option payoff kink
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Interpolate a 2D/3D smoothed basket-option value or payoff with a kink along a hyperplane. Use a hierarchical hat-function sparse grid refined by surplus magnitude, and compare the error-versus-points curves of regular and adaptive grids.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Sparse grid combination technique for 2D Poisson finite-difference solutions
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Solve Poisson on anisotropic full grids with levels (l1,l2) satisfying l1+l2=n and l1+l2=n-1. Combine the interpolated solutions with coefficients +1 and -1, and compare the combined error and cost with the full-grid solution at level n.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Smolyak Leja-point stochastic collocation for a damped oscillator with random parameters
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build Smolyak interpolants on nested weighted Leja points for a damped harmonic oscillator response with uniform random stiffness, damping and forcing. Compute the mean and variance of the amplitude, and compare convergence with Clenshaw-Curtis Smolyak and Monte Carlo.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Sparse-grid stochastic collocation for layered random-conductivity 1D diffusion flux
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Model a 1D steady diffusion rod with piecewise-constant conductivities that are uniform random in each of d layers, whose flux is known analytically. Compute the mean and variance of the flux via Smolyak collocation and compare the error versus number of solves with tensor grids.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Sparse pseudo-spectral polynomial chaos projection and Sobol indices for Ishigami
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute Legendre polynomial chaos coefficients of the Ishigami function via Smolyak pseudo-spectral projection, which avoids internal aliasing. Derive first-order and total Sobol indices from the coefficients and compare with analytic values.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Sparse grid Lagrange interpolation of a triatomic potential energy surface
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Interpolate a 3D Morse-sum potential energy surface in internal coordinates using hierarchical polynomial Lagrange interpolation on nested Chebyshev-extrema sparse grids. Compare RMS and maximum error versus points with tensor grids, and estimate vibrational energies from the interpolant.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Hyperbolic cross Fourier approximation of periodic functions with mixed smoothness
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Approximate a 2D/3D periodic function with dominating mixed smoothness by truncating Fourier coefficients to a hyperbolic cross index set (computed via sparse FFT-free least squares or quadrature). Compare the error-versus-degrees-of-freedom curve with full tensor truncation.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Shifted inverse iteration for interior levels of a finite-difference anharmonic oscillator
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Discretise H = -d^2/dx^2 + x^2 + g x^4 with finite differences. Compute specified interior eigenpairs by shifted inverse iteration using sparse LU, and verify that the convergence ratio |lambda_k - sigma|/|lambda_j - sigma| matches the observed error decay.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Power, inverse and Rayleigh quotient iteration

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Ostrowski two-sided Rayleigh quotient iteration for nonsymmetric matrices
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compare one-sided RQI, which converges quadratically on nonsymmetric matrices, with two-sided RQI using left and right vectors, which converges cubically, on a nonnormal convection-diffusion matrix. Measure the convergence orders from error sequences, and contrast with the cubic rate on a symmetric case.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Power, inverse and Rayleigh quotient iteration

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Wielandt and Hotelling deflation for lowest vibration modes of a mass-spring chain
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute several lowest vibration modes of a nonuniform mass-spring chain (generalised eigenproblem K x = w^2 M x) via inverse power iteration with Hotelling and Wielandt deflation. Compare the accuracy degradation of successive modes with the exact eigensolution.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Power, inverse and Rayleigh quotient iteration

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: k-effective by power iteration with Wielandt shift in two-group neutron diffusion
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Assemble a 1D two-group neutron diffusion criticality problem as a generalised eigenproblem. Compute k_eff and the flux shape by outer power iteration, and show that Wielandt shift acceleration improves the dominance ratio and iteration count.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Power, inverse and Rayleigh quotient iteration

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Slow power-method convergence for nearly decomposable Courtois Markov chains
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute the stationary distribution of a nearly completely decomposable Markov chain by power iteration. Relate the slow convergence to the subdominant eigenvalue near 1, and compare with shifted inverse iteration and with aggregation-based initial guesses.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Power, inverse and Rayleigh quotient iteration

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Basins of attraction of Rayleigh quotient iteration on a graph Laplacian
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Run RQI from many random unit starting vectors on a small symmetric matrix, such as a path or cycle graph Laplacian. Record which eigenvector each run converges to, estimate basin sizes, and compare them with the eigenvector nearest the start.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Power, inverse and Rayleigh quotient iteration

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Inverse iteration eigenvectors for clustered eigenvalues of Wilkinson W21+
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute accurate eigenvalues of Wilkinson's W_{2m+1}^+ tridiagonal matrix, which has near-degenerate pairs, then compute eigenvectors by inverse iteration. Measure orthogonality loss for clustered pairs, and show how reorthogonalisation against earlier vectors restores it.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Power, inverse and Rayleigh quotient iteration

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Half-range Maxwell weight recurrence coefficients and Gauss rules for kinetic theory
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute recurrence coefficients of polynomials orthogonal with respect to x^k exp(-x^2) on [0, inf) by a discretised Stieltjes procedure. Form Gauss rules from the Jacobi matrices and use them to evaluate half-range moments, such as the Knudsen-layer integrals, accurately.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Freud weight exp(-x^4) recurrence coefficients and the string equation
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute recurrence coefficients b_n for the Freud weight exp(-x^4) by discretised Stieltjes or Lanczos. Verify the Freud string equation 4 b_n (b_{n-1}+b_n+b_{n+1}) = n, and compare with its large-n asymptotics, demonstrating the instability of forward recursion of the string equation.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Christoffel modification of Jacobi matrices via QR steps for (x-z)w(x)
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Given the Jacobi matrix of a weight w, obtain the recurrence coefficients for (x - z)w(x) and (x - z)^2 w(x) via one or two shifted QR or Cholesky steps. Verify against direct Stieltjes discretisation for Legendre and Laguerre base weights.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Gauss-Radau and Gauss-Lobatto rules via modified Jacobi matrices
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Construct Radau and Lobatto quadrature rules for Jacobi weights by modifying the last diagonal or off-diagonal entries of the Jacobi matrix, then solving its eigenproblem. Verify the exactness degrees and compare nodes and weights with scipy or analytic formulae.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Recurrence coefficients for a two-interval measure and gap-induced oscillation
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute recurrence coefficients of a measure supported on two disjoint intervals, which models a two-band density of states, and show their asymptotically periodic or quasiperiodic oscillation. Show that the Jacobi matrix eigenvalues fill the bands while a few sit in the gap.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Haydock recursion for local density of states on a 2D square lattice
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Run Lanczos (Haydock recursion) from a single site of a large tight-binding square lattice to obtain the recurrence coefficients. Evaluate the local Green's function as a continued fraction with a square-root terminator, and compare the LDOS with the exact elliptic-integral result.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Gram polynomials by three-term recurrence for Savitzky-Golay smoothing filters
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Generate discrete orthogonal Gram polynomials on equispaced points by a three-term recurrence. Build Savitzky-Golay smoothing and derivative coefficients from them, and compare them with coefficients obtained by direct least squares and Vandermonde solves for high window sizes and orders.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Szegő recurrence and Verblunsky coefficients for orthogonal polynomials on the circle
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute orthogonal polynomials on the unit circle for a smooth weight via the Szegő recurrence, with Verblunsky coefficients obtained from trigonometric moments. Verify orthogonality, the Geronimus relation to Jacobi coefficients on [-1,1], and the coefficient decay rates.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Truncated Gaussian weight orthogonal polynomials for bounded-uncertainty polynomial chaos
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute recurrence coefficients for a Gaussian density truncated to [a,b] by discretised Stieltjes on high-order Gauss-Legendre points. Build Gauss rules from them, and use them to propagate uncertainty through a nonlinear model, comparing against Monte Carlo moments.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Integrated-Legendre hierarchical versus equispaced Lagrange p-version element conditioning
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: For p up to 15, construct element stiffness and mass matrices for hierarchical Lobatto shape functions and for equispaced and GLL Lagrange bases. Compare their condition numbers, including after static condensation of interior modes.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Finite element basis functions and assembly

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: P1 triangle assembly for 2D Poisson with error and conditioning rates
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Assemble the P1 stiffness matrix and load vector on structured triangulations of the unit square, and solve a manufactured-solution Poisson problem. Verify O(h^2) L2 and O(h) H1 error rates and stiffness condition number growth of O(h^-2).
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Finite element basis functions and assembly

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Consistent versus lumped mass eigenfrequency errors for a vibrating string
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute P1 and P2 finite-element natural frequencies of a fixed-fixed string with consistent, row-sum lumped and averaged mass matrices. Compare the frequency error signs and orders against the analytic n*pi frequencies, and determine the optimal blending parameter.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Finite element basis functions and assembly

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Shear locking of bilinear Q4 elements in cantilever bending with reduced integration
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Assemble plane-stress Q4 stiffness matrices with full 2x2 and reduced 1-point Gauss integration, the latter with hourglass checks. Compute the tip deflection of a slender cantilever versus aspect ratio, compare with Euler-Bernoulli theory, and count spurious zero-energy modes.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Finite element basis functions and assembly

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Bernstein-Bézier triangle element mass matrices: closed form versus quadrature
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build degree-p Bernstein-Bézier bases on triangles, form the element mass matrix both by the closed-form multinomial formula and by quadrature, and verify agreement. Compare its condition number growth in p with nodal Lagrange bases.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Finite element basis functions and assembly

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Yserentant hierarchical basis condition numbers versus nodal basis for 2D Poisson
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Transform the P1 stiffness matrix on uniformly refined triangulations into the hierarchical basis via the nodal-to-hierarchical transformation. Compute condition numbers versus level, and verify the O(L^2) growth against O(4^L) for the nodal basis.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Finite element basis functions and assembly

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Galerkin finite elements for hydrogen radial eigenvalues with P1-P3 elements
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Solve the radial Schrödinger equation for hydrogen with P1-P3 Lagrange elements on a graded mesh by assembling stiffness, potential and mass matrices. Compute bound-state energies for l=0,1, and verify the O(h^{2p}) eigenvalue convergence against -1/(2n^2).
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Finite element basis functions and assembly

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Morozov discrepancy principle via Newton on the SVD secular equation
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: For a noisy discretised integral equation, solve ||A x_lambda - b|| = tau delta for lambda using Newton's method in log lambda with SVD-based residual and derivative formulas. Compare the resulting solution error with the optimal-lambda error as delta decreases.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Iterated Tikhonov regularization and saturation of standard Tikhonov
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement stationary iterated Tikhonov of order k for a smooth source-condition problem. Measure convergence rates of the error versus noise level delta with optimally chosen lambda, and demonstrate saturation of standard Tikhonov at the delta^{2/3} rate.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Eldén's standard-form transformation for general-form Tikhonov with derivative operators
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Transform min ||Ax-b||^2 + lambda^2 ||Lx||^2 with a first or second difference operator L to standard form via the A-weighted pseudoinverse of L and QR factorisations. Verify agreement with direct stacked least squares and with the GSVD solution.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Unbiased predictive risk estimator versus GCV for the Foxgood problem
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: On the Foxgood first-kind integral equation, compute UPRE (with known noise variance) and GCV functions from the SVD. Select Tikhonov and truncated-SVD parameters, and compare the distributions of solution errors over many noise draws.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Tikhonov-regularized Cauchy problem for the Laplace equation on an annulus
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Reconstruct the inner-boundary potential of an annulus from Dirichlet and Neumann data on the outer boundary using a Fourier-mode or boundary-collocation forward matrix. Stabilise the severely ill-posed data completion with Tikhonov, and study error versus noise level.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Bayesian MAP and posterior covariance equivalence with Tikhonov in 1D deblurring
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: For a Gaussian blur model with Gaussian noise and a Gaussian smoothness prior, compute the MAP estimate (equal to Tikhonov with lambda = sigma/gamma) and the posterior covariance. Compare 95% credible bands against the true signal coverage.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Romberg integration of the large-amplitude pendulum period elliptic integral
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute the pendulum period via the complete elliptic integral K(k) using a Romberg tableau built from trapezoidal sums. Verify the h^2, h^4, ... error orders from the Euler-Maclaurin expansion, and compare with the arithmetic-geometric mean reference.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Exponential convergence of trapezoidal rule for periodic Bessel integral representations
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Evaluate J_n(x) via its periodic integral representation with the composite trapezoidal rule. Show geometric convergence explained by vanishing Euler-Maclaurin corrections and analyticity strip width, and show that Romberg extrapolation gives no improvement here.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Generalized Richardson extrapolation for sqrt-singular integrands via Navot expansion
