math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: For integrals of x^{1/2} g(x) and x^{-1/2} g(x), derive the Navot-type error expansion of the trapezoidal or midpoint rule with fractional powers of h. Build a Richardson tableau that eliminates the h^{1.5}, h^2, ... terms, and verify the gain in accuracy.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Closed Newton-Cotes weights via moment systems and negative-weight instability
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute closed Newton-Cotes weights for n up to 30 by solving Vandermonde moment systems in exact rational arithmetic with sympy. Show that negative weights appear for n=8 and n>=10, track the growth of sum|w_i|, and demonstrate divergence on the Runge integrand.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Euler-Maclaurin summation with Bernoulli corrections for zeta values and lattice sums
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Accelerate slowly convergent series such as zeta(3), zeta(1.5) and sum 1/(n^2+a^2) by summing N terms and adding the integral and Bernoulli-number endpoint corrections. Determine the optimal truncation order before the asymptotic series diverges.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Gregory endpoint-corrected trapezoidal rules and their order verification
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Derive Gregory endpoint correction weights from finite-difference expansions of the Euler-Maclaurin terms, using a linear system for the weights. Verify orders 2 through 8 on smooth integrands, and compare with Romberg at equal numbers of function evaluations.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Ridders' Richardson extrapolation of finite-difference derivatives with error control
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement Ridders' method, which builds a Neville tableau of central differences with geometrically decreasing step sizes and chooses the entry with the smallest error estimate. Compare the achieved accuracy with the optimal fixed-step central difference amid roundoff.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Composite Newton-Cotes error orders for kinked integrands and breakpoint alignment
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Apply composite trapezoid, Simpson and Boole rules to integrands with a derivative discontinuity at an irrational point. Show that the order collapses to O(h^2) regardless of rule, and that it recovers when the panels align with the kink.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Wilkinson's 2^{n-1} growth matrix under partial versus complete pivoting
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement LU with partial and complete pivoting and apply both to Wilkinson's growth matrix. Compute growth factors and normwise backward errors, and show the solution accuracy collapse of GEPP for n around 60 against complete pivoting.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Rook pivoting LU: growth factors and comparison counts versus partial and complete
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement rook pivoting by alternating row and column searches. Measure growth factors and the number of comparisons on random Gaussian, Wilkinson-type and rank-deficient matrices, and compare rank-revealing behaviour with partial and complete pivoting.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Complete pivoting growth factors on Hadamard matrices
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute GECP growth factors for Sylvester and Paley Hadamard matrices of orders 4-32, and verify growth equal to n. Compare with random orthogonal and random ±1 matrices, in the context of the Cryer and Gould growth conjecture history.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Exponential GEPP growth in Wright's multiple-shooting boundary value matrices
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Construct the block bidiagonal multiple-shooting matrix for a linear two-point BVP. Show exponential growth of GEPP pivots for certain parameter choices, as found by Wright, and compare the backward error with complete pivoting and QR.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Statistical distribution of GEPP growth factors for random Gaussian matrices
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Sample GEPP growth factors over many random Gaussian matrices for n up to 512. Fit the scaling of the mean growth, which goes approximately as n^{2/3}, and compare the tails with random orthogonal and uniform matrices, following Trefethen-Schreiber.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Thomas algorithm stability without pivoting for diagonally dominant heat-equation tridiagonals
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Apply LU without pivoting (Thomas) to Crank-Nicolson tridiagonal systems and to column-diagonally dominant random tridiagonals. Verify the growth-factor bound of 2 and the backward error, and construct non-dominant cases where pivoting becomes necessary.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Threshold partial pivoting in sparse LU: fill versus growth trade-off
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement Markowitz-based sparse Gaussian elimination with threshold pivoting parameter u on 2D convection-diffusion matrices. Measure fill-in, growth factor and backward error as u varies from 0.01 to 1.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Björck-Pereyra algorithm versus GEPP for Vandermonde systems at Chebyshev points
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Solve primal and dual Vandermonde systems with the Björck-Pereyra Newton-form algorithm and with GEPP for monotone Chebyshev nodes. Compare componentwise forward errors with the condition number predictions, and demonstrate Higham's favourable error bounds for Björck-Pereyra.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Direct-search maximization of GEPP growth factors for small matrices
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Use Nelder-Mead or multidirectional search over n×n matrices, normalised and with fixed pivot order enforced, to maximise the GEPP or GECP growth factor for n=3-8. Compare the maxima found with the theoretical bounds and with Higham-Higham reported values.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: GMRES with Givens updates for 2D Helmholtz and complex shifted-Laplacian preconditioning
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Discretize a damped 2D Helmholtz equation with absorbing boundaries. Implement Arnoldi-GMRES with Givens-rotation least squares, and compare iteration counts versus wavenumber with no preconditioner and with a directly factorized complex shifted-Laplacian preconditioner.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Greenbaum-Pták-Strakoš matrices with prescribed spectrum and arbitrary GMRES residuals
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Construct matrices from the GPS parametrization that have a chosen eigenvalue set and a chosen nonincreasing GMRES residual sequence. Verify with your own GMRES that the spectrum alone does not determine convergence.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Flexible GMRES with inner GMRES preconditioning for variable-coefficient diffusion-reaction
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement FGMRES, which stores the preconditioned vectors, using an inexact inner GMRES as a variable preconditioner on a 2D heterogeneous diffusion-reaction problem. Compare against right-preconditioned GMRES that uses a fixed preconditioner.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: GMRES-DR harmonic Ritz deflation curing restart stagnation from small outlying eigenvalues
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement Morgan's GMRES with deflated restarting, which carries harmonic Ritz vectors across restarts. Apply it to a convection-diffusion matrix with a few near-zero eigenvalues and compare against plain GMRES(m).

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Jacobian-free Newton-GMRES with Eisenstat-Walker forcing for the 2D Bratu problem
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Solve the nonlinear Bratu equation by Newton's method. Inner GMRES uses finite-difference Jacobian-vector products and Eisenstat-Walker forcing terms; track the total Krylov iterations near the turning point.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: GMRES convergence versus eigenvector condition number for controlled non-normality
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build matrices A = V D V^{-1} with a fixed spectrum D and eigenvector matrices V of tunable condition number. Compare GMRES residuals against the kappa(V) times min-max polynomial bound, and quantify how non-normality delays convergence.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Cyclic reduction versus Thomas algorithm for the 1D Poisson tridiagonal system
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement odd-even cyclic reduction for n = 2^k - 1 and the Thomas algorithm. Count flops and compare accuracy and runtime scaling on the discrete 1D Poisson problem with a manufactured solution.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Sherman-Morrison periodic tridiagonal solver for Crank-Nicolson diffusion on a ring
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Solve the cyclic tridiagonal systems of periodic Crank-Nicolson diffusion with two Thomas solves and a Sherman-Morrison correction. Verify against the exact decay of Fourier modes and against a dense solve.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Compact-storage banded LU with partial pivoting for a clamped Euler-Bernoulli beam
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement LAPACK-style banded LU with partial pivoting in compact band storage, including the extra superdiagonals created by pivoting. Apply it to the pentadiagonal finite-difference beam operator, check deflections against the analytic solution, and verify O(n p q) cost scaling.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Block Thomas algorithm for 2D Poisson as a block-tridiagonal system
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Treat the 5-point Laplacian as block tridiagonal and implement block forward elimination and back substitution with dense diagonal blocks. Measure the O(N m^3) cost and fill in the Schur blocks against a sparse direct solve.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Buneman-stabilized versus naive block cyclic reduction for fast 2D Poisson solves
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement block cyclic reduction for the 2D Poisson equation with the naive right-hand-side recurrence and with Buneman's stable variant. Show the roundoff growth of the naive version as levels increase.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: SPIKE partitioned tridiagonal solver with reduced interface system
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Partition a diffusion tridiagonal system into blocks, compute the local spike vectors, solve the small reduced system that couples block boundaries, and recover the full solution. Compare accuracy and operation counts with sequential Thomas.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: FFT diagonalization of an Aharonov-Bohm tight-binding ring and persistent current
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build the circulant hopping Hamiltonian of an N-site ring threaded by flux and diagonalize it with the FFT. Compute the ground-state energy versus flux and the persistent current as minus dE/dphi, checking against dense eigensolvers.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: BCCB FFT solver for the 2D periodic linearized Poisson-Boltzmann equation
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the doubly periodic screened-Laplacian finite-difference operator, which is block-circulant with circulant blocks, using a 2D FFT. Solve for the potential of point charges and verify against a sparse direct solve and the Debye-Hückel decay.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Bareiss algorithm for nonsymmetric Toeplitz systems from an asymmetric convolution kernel
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement the O(n^2) nonsymmetric Bareiss Toeplitz solver on a discretized convolution equation with a one-sided exponential kernel. Compare its backward error and runtime with LU, including near-singular leading minors.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Band-Toeplitz preconditioners for Toeplitz systems whose symbol has a zero
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: For Toeplitz matrices generated by symbols such as (2-2cos theta) times a smooth function, compare circulant-preconditioned CG with the Chan-Ng band-Toeplitz preconditioner. Report iteration counts as n grows.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Cybenko-Van Loan smallest eigenvalue of SPD Toeplitz matrices via Durbin recursion
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute the minimal eigenvalue of a symmetric positive definite Toeplitz matrix from a Matérn-type covariance. Use Durbin-recursion-based secular functions combined with bisection and Newton, and compare with dense eigvalsh.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: One-sided Hestenes-Jacobi SVD and relative accuracy on column-scaled matrices
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement one-sided Jacobi SVD with column-pair rotations and a convergence threshold. Apply it to B = D1 C D2 with well-conditioned C, and show small singular values computed to high relative accuracy compared with bidiagonalization-based SVD.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Golub-Kahan-Lanczos bidiagonalization for latent semantic indexing of term-document data
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build a sparse tf-idf matrix from a synthetic multi-topic corpus and compute its leading singular triplets by Golub-Kahan-Lanczos with full reorthogonalization. Evaluate retrieval cosine scores in the rank-k space.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Proper orthogonal decomposition of traveling versus standing wave snapshots
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Form snapshot matrices of a standing wave and a traveling Gaussian pulse and compute their POD by SVD. Verify the Eckart-Young truncation error identity and contrast the slow singular-value decay of the advected pulse with the standing wave.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Total least squares via SVD for errors-in-variables Arrhenius fitting
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Fit ln k versus 1/T when both variables are noisy, using total least squares from the smallest right singular vector of the augmented matrix. Compare the slope bias of TLS and OLS in Monte Carlo trials.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: TT-SVD compression of quantics-tensorized functions with discarded-weight error bounds
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Reshape samples of a function on a 2^d grid into a d-way tensor and compress it with sequential truncated SVDs. Verify that the Frobenius error is bounded by the root sum of squared discarded singular values, and report TT ranks.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Exact dynamic mode decomposition of advection-diffusion snapshots
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Generate snapshots of a periodic advection-diffusion solution, compute the reduced operator from the SVD of the snapshot matrix, and extract DMD eigenvalues and modes. Compare them with the analytic Fourier-mode growth rates and frequencies.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Polar decomposition of deformation gradients via SVD and scaled Newton iteration
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute the rotation and stretch tensors of finite-strain deformation gradients from the SVD and from Higham's scaled Newton iteration. Compare accuracy and iteration counts, including near-singular stretches, and report principal stretches.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Restricted additive versus multiplicative Schwarz preconditioners in GMRES for convection-diffusion
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement additive, restricted additive (RAS) and multiplicative Schwarz preconditioners on a strip decomposition of 2D convection-diffusion. Compare GMRES iteration counts versus the number of subdomains and the flow direction.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Dirichlet-Neumann iteration with relaxation for two-material steady heat conduction
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Couple two conductivity subdomains through Dirichlet-Neumann alternation with a relaxation parameter. Derive and verify the optimal relaxation that depends on the conductivity ratio, and recover the interface temperature.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Static condensation of interior bubble modes in high-order 1D p-FEM
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Assemble hierarchical integrated-Legendre element matrices for a bar problem and eliminate the interior bubble modes elementwise by Schur complements. Solve the condensed vertex system, recover the interior DOFs, and verify that the result equals the full solve.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Steklov-Poincaré Schur complement spectrum versus the discrete half-Laplacian
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Form the exact interface Schur complement for two square subdomains of the 2D Laplacian. Compare its eigenvalues with those of the square root of the 1D interface Laplacian, and show condition-number growth like h^{-1}.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: 2D square-lattice density of states with logarithmic van Hove singularity
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute the tight-binding DOS by integrating over one momentum after an analytic inner reduction, using adaptive Gauss-Kronrod with breakpoints at the singular points. Compare with the closed form based on the complete elliptic integral K.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Genz-Malik adaptive cubature for 3D Gaussian orbital overlap and kinetic integrals
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement the degree-7 Genz-Malik rule with its embedded degree-5 error estimate and fourth-difference axis selection for subdivision on a 3D box. Integrate products of displaced Gaussian orbitals and verify against analytic overlaps.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: WKB Bohr-Sommerfeld levels of a quartic oscillator with turning-point singularities
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Locate the turning points by root finding, integrate the classical momentum with adaptive quadrature that handles the inverse-square-root derivative singularities, and solve the quantization condition for the energy levels. Compare with finite-difference eigenvalues.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Radiative view factors between adjacent perpendicular plates by adaptive nested cubature
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Evaluate the fourfold view-factor integral, whose integrand is singular along the shared edge, using nested adaptive Gauss-Kronrod. Compare with Hottel's closed-form result and report error-estimate reliability.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Thermonuclear reaction rates by adaptive integration over the Gamow peak
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Integrate exp(-E/kT - b/sqrt(E)) times an astrophysical S-factor using adaptive Gauss-Kronrod. Compare with the Gaussian Gamow-peak approximation over a range of temperatures, and report the number of function evaluations.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Adaptive quadrature for the Boys function across argument regimes
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Evaluate F_n(T) as the integral of t^{2n} exp(-T t^2) over [0,1] with adaptive Simpson and Gauss-Kronrod. Compare the error estimates and cost against downward recursion and the large-T asymptotic form for several n.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Sidi sin^m transformations with trapezoid rule versus adaptive Gauss-Kronrod for Beta integrals
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Apply Sidi's periodizing sin^m variable transformations to Beta-function integrands with algebraic endpoint singularities, then use the trapezoidal rule. Compare the convergence order against adaptive Gauss-Kronrod and against Euler-Maclaurin predictions.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Thin-plate spline landmark warping via augmented saddle-point system
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Fit a 2D thin-plate spline deformation through landmark correspondences by solving the kernel system bordered with affine polynomial constraints. Evaluate bending energy, verify that affine maps are reproduced exactly, and warp a grid.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Moving least squares and scattered data fitting

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Wendland compactly supported RBF interpolation: sparsity, conditioning and accuracy trade-off
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Interpolate scattered samples of a smooth function with the C2 Wendland kernel at varying support radii, using sparse matrices. Measure fill fraction, condition number and error to expose the stationary/nonstationary trade-off.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Moving least squares and scattered data fitting

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Corrected SPH kernel gradients via renormalization matrices on disordered particles
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute SPH gradient estimates of linear and quadratic fields on perturbed particle lattices, with and without the MLS-type renormalization correction matrix. Verify that linear consistency is restored and measure the error versus disorder.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Moving least squares and scattered data fitting

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: MLS data transfer between nonmatching fluid-structure interface meshes
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Transfer pressure and displacement fields between two nonconforming 1D or 2D interface discretizations using MLS with a quadratic basis. Quantify interpolation error and global force-conservation error versus support radius.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Moving least squares and scattered data fitting

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Lancaster-Salkauskas interpolating MLS with singular weights versus standard MLS
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compare the MLS approximant using smooth Gaussian weights with the interpolating version using singular inverse-distance weights. Measure the nodal interpolation defect, derivative smoothness and conditioning of the local moment matrices.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Moving least squares and scattered data fitting

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Penalized tensor-product B-spline (P-spline) fitting of noisy scattered elevation data
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Fit a bicubic B-spline surface to scattered noisy terrain samples by sparse penalized least squares with difference penalties. Choose the smoothing weight by GCV and compare the fit error with unpenalized least squares.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Moving least squares and scattered data fitting

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Block Davidson-Liu for the lowest roots of a model CIS excitation matrix
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Construct a diagonally dominant CIS-like matrix from model orbital energies and two-electron couplings. Compute the lowest k excitation energies with block Davidson-Liu, including subspace collapse and per-root convergence.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Jacobi-Davidson with GMRES correction equations for an anharmonic 2D quantum dot
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Discretize a 2D Schrödinger operator with a harmonic plus quartic potential. Compute low eigenpairs with Jacobi-Davidson, solving the projected correction equation by a few GMRES steps, and compare with exact correction solves.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Quadratic convergence of cyclic Jacobi off-diagonal norm on Hückel matrices
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Apply row-cyclic and round-robin parallel-ordered Jacobi sweeps to Hückel Hamiltonians of polycyclic hydrocarbons. Track the off-diagonal Frobenius norm per sweep, verify the asymptotically quadratic convergence, and recover the π-orbital energies.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Cardoso-Souloumiac Jacobi joint diagonalization for blind source separation
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Form time-lagged covariance matrices of linearly mixed source signals and approximately diagonalize them jointly with Jacobi rotations at closed-form angles. Recover the unmixing matrix and report the Amari separation index.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Foster-Boys localization of Hückel polyene orbitals by Jacobi rotation sweeps
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Maximize the sum of squared orbital centroids over occupied Hückel molecular orbitals of a polyene using 2x2 Jacobi rotations at analytic optimal angles. Show convergence to bond-localized orbitals.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Generalized Davidson for low vibrational levels of the Hénon-Heiles Hamiltonian
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build the 2D Hénon-Heiles Hamiltonian in a product harmonic-oscillator basis. Compute the lowest vibrational levels with generalized Davidson using zeroth-order diagonal preconditioning, and compare with full diagonalization and published values.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Harmonic Jacobi-Davidson for interior eigenvalues of the 3D Anderson model
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Target eigenvalues near the band center of the disordered 3D tight-binding Hamiltonian with harmonic Ritz extraction inside Jacobi-Davidson. Compare with standard Ritz extraction and with shift-invert Lanczos.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: fp16 versus bfloat16 simulated LU in iterative refinement: range versus precision
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Simulate LU factorization in fp16 and in bfloat16 by rounding after each operation, then refine in double precision. Compare refinement failure modes (overflow versus slow convergence) across matrices with growing condition number and dynamic range.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Mixed-precision refinement of Lyapunov solutions from float32 Bartels-Stewart
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Solve a continuous Lyapunov equation for a heat-network model with a float32 Schur-based Bartels-Stewart solver. Refine using double-precision residuals and correction solves that reuse the low-precision Schur factors, and track the residual history.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Newton-Schulz polishing of a single-precision matrix inverse
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Start from a float32 inverse of a covariance-type matrix and apply Newton-Schulz iterations in double precision. Measure the quadratic convergence of ||I - AX|| and its failure when the initial residual exceeds one.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Iterative refinement with low-rank compressed BEM factorization as approximate solver
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compress the off-diagonal blocks of a 2D single-layer BEM matrix by truncated SVD and factorize the compressed matrix. Use it inside iterative refinement against the exact matrix, and show convergence rates governed by the compression tolerance.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Residual gap and reliable updates in single-precision conjugate gradients
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Run CG on a 2D Poisson system with float32 vectors and quantify the drift between the recursive and true residuals. Implement van der Vorst-Ye reliable updates that recompute the residual in double precision, and compare the attainable accuracy.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Half-precision Thomas factorization with double residual refinement for implicit heat steps
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Factorize the backward-Euler heat tridiagonal matrix once in simulated fp16 and refine each time step's solve with double-precision residuals. Measure the number of refinement steps versus Δt/h², which controls the conditioning.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Single-precision GTH versus Gaussian elimination stationary distributions with refinement
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute stationary distributions of a nearly decoupled queueing Markov chain using float32 Grassmann-Taksar-Heyman elimination and float32 LU. Refine both in double precision, and compare componentwise relative accuracy of small probabilities.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Float32 LU Jacobians inside Newton for stiff Robertson kinetics implicit steps
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: In backward-Euler steps of the Robertson chemical kinetics system, factorize the Newton Jacobian in float32 while computing residuals in double. Measure the Newton convergence rate and final accuracy as the stiffness grows.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Implicitly restarted Arnoldi with exact shifts for Brusselator Hopf eigenvalues
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement IRA with exact shifts and implicit QR compression to find the rightmost eigenvalues of the 1D Brusselator Jacobian. Track the eigenvalues crossing the imaginary axis as the bifurcation parameter varies, monitoring Ritz residual estimates.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Krylov-Schur restart for subdominant eigenvalues of a random walk on a barbell graph
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement Stewart's Krylov-Schur method with reordered Schur forms and truncation. Compute the leading eigenvalues of a lazy random-walk transition matrix on a barbell graph and estimate the mixing time from the spectral gap.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Shift-invert Arnoldi for Turing instability eigenvalues of the 2D Gray-Scott model
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Linearize Gray-Scott around its homogeneous state on a periodic grid. Find the eigenvalues nearest a target using shift-invert Arnoldi with a sparse LU, and identify unstable wavenumbers by comparing with the dispersion relation.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Ritz residual estimates versus true residuals under non-normality in the Olmstead model
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compare the Arnoldi residual estimate |β_k e_k^T y| with explicitly computed residuals for Ritz pairs of the discretized Olmstead viscoelastic model. Assess the effects on locking decisions as non-normality and restart count increase.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Hatano-Nelson open-boundary spectra and skin-effect sensitivity via restarted Arnoldi
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute extremal eigenvalues of the non-Hermitian Hatano-Nelson chain with open and periodic boundaries using restarted Arnoldi. Compare them with the exact real open-boundary spectrum and measure rounding-induced spectral deviation versus chain length.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Exact versus Leja-point shifts in implicitly restarted Arnoldi
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement IRA with exact unwanted-Ritz-value shifts and with fast Leja shifts on an estimated unwanted region. Compare the number of matvecs needed to compute the rightmost eigenvalues of a convection-diffusion operator.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Leading Perron-Frobenius eigenvalues of Ulam-discretized chaotic maps via Krylov-Schur
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build a sparse Ulam transition matrix for a noisy double-well-like interval map. Compute its leading eigenvalues and eigenvectors with Krylov-Schur, and extract almost-invariant sets and the decay rate of correlations.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Complex-scaled resonances of a 1D double barrier by shift-invert Arnoldi
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Discretize a complex-scaled 1D Hamiltonian with a double-barrier potential. Locate the resonance eigenvalues near a complex target with shift-invert Arnoldi, check their stability under varying scaling angle, and extract widths.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Isoparametric versus straight-sided P2 triangles for Poisson on the unit disk
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Assemble quadratic Lagrange triangle stiffness matrices on a disk mesh, once with curved isoparametric boundary edges and once with straight ones. Compare L2 and H1 error rates for a radially symmetric exact solution to show the geometric error limiting straight-sided P2.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Finite element basis functions and assembly

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Trilinear hexahedral Q1 assembly for 3D Poisson and condition number scaling
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build Q1 element stiffness and mass matrices on the unit cube with tensor Gauss quadrature and assemble them into sparse global matrices. Compute extreme eigenvalues with Lanczos to verify κ(K) ~ h^-2 and κ(M) = O(1).
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Finite element basis functions and assembly

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Gauss-Lobatto-Legendre spectral element mass lumping and 1D Laplacian eigenvalues
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Construct GLL nodal Lagrange bases of degree p and form exact versus GLL-quadrature (diagonal) mass matrices for 1D spectral elements. Compare the eigenvalue errors of the Laplacian on [0,π] as functions of p and element count.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Finite element basis functions and assembly

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Crouzeix-Raviart nonconforming elements giving lower bounds for square-membrane Laplace eigenvalues
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Assemble edge-midpoint Crouzeix-Raviart stiffness and mass matrices on uniform triangulations of the unit square. Show that the discrete eigenvalues approach π²(m²+n²) from below, in contrast to the upper bounds from conforming P1.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Finite element basis functions and assembly

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Lowest-order Raviart-Thomas mixed FEM for Darcy flow saddle-point assembly
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build RT0 edge basis functions and piecewise-constant pressures on triangles and assemble the mixed velocity-pressure saddle-point system for heterogeneous Darcy flow. Solve it, check local mass conservation, and compute the discrete inf-sup constant from a generalized eigenproblem.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Finite element basis functions and assembly

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Volumetric locking of P1 versus P2 triangles in nearly incompressible plane strain
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Assemble plane-strain elasticity stiffness matrices with P1 and P2 triangles for Cook's membrane or a pressurized thick cylinder. Track tip displacement and the stiffness condition number as Poisson's ratio approaches 0.5 to show locking and its relief.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Finite element basis functions and assembly

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Wathen's eigenvalue bounds for Jacobi-scaled P1 triangle mass matrices
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Assemble P1 mass matrices on structured and distorted triangulations and compute the spectrum of D^{-1/2} M D^{-1/2}. Verify that it lies in the elementwise-derived interval [1/2, 2] independent of mesh size.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Finite element basis functions and assembly

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Lowest-order Nédélec edge elements for the 2D Maxwell cavity eigenproblem
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Assemble curl-curl and mass matrices with first-kind Nédélec edge elements on a square cavity triangulation. Solve the generalized eigenproblem, identify the large zero-eigenvalue gradient kernel, and verify that the nonzero eigenvalues match m²+n² without spurious modes.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Finite element basis functions and assembly

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Skeel componentwise condition number and row-scaling invariance for a badly scaled system
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: For a chemical-equilibrium-type linear system whose rows span many orders of magnitude, compute the normwise κ∞, Skeel's cond(A,x) and their values after row equilibration. Compare these predictors with actual forward errors under componentwise random perturbations.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Weyl and Hoffman-Wielandt bounds for perturbed molecular Hessian vibrational frequencies
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build a mass-weighted Hessian for a small molecule force-field model and perturb its force constants by symmetric noise. Verify Weyl's per-eigenvalue bound and the Hoffman-Wielandt Frobenius bound on the shifts of the squared vibrational frequencies.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Karlson-Waldén estimate of the normwise backward error for least-squares solutions
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: For polynomial and Vandermonde least-squares problems, compute the exact Waldén-Karlson-Sun backward error of approximate solutions via an SVD-based formula. Compare it with the cheap Karlson-Waldén estimate and with simple residual-based bounds.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Root condition numbers in Bernstein versus monomial bases (Farouki-Rajan)
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Represent a polynomial with clustered real roots in [0,1] in both power and Bernstein form and compute the root condition numbers with respect to relative coefficient perturbations. Verify the predicted root errors by perturbation experiments.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Markov chain stationary distribution sensitivity via the group inverse
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: For a nearly reducible birth-death or queueing chain, compute the group inverse of I-P from a QR or LU factorization. Evaluate Meyer's condition numbers and compare them with the actual changes in the stationary vector under small perturbations of P.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Sylvester equation conditioning: sep(A,B) via Kronecker SVD versus Bartels-Stewart errors
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Form the Kronecker operator I⊗A - B^T⊗I for small and medium A, B and compute sep(A,B) as its smallest singular value. Compare the resulting condition number with eigenvalue-gap estimates and with observed errors of Bartels-Stewart solutions.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Relative distance to the nearest singular matrix equals 1/κ₂
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Using the SVD, construct the minimal rank-one perturbation that makes a matrix singular. Verify the Eckart-Young/Gastinel-Kahan identity for Hilbert, Kahan and random matrices, and compare with the 1-norm distance obtained from LU-based estimates.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Cholesky backward errors and scaled condition numbers for graded SPD matrices
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Generate graded SPD matrices A = DHD with ill-conditioned D and well-conditioned H. Show that the Cholesky forward error is governed by κ(H) rather than κ(A), following Demmel-van der Sluis, using exact and estimated condition numbers.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Kenney-Laub statistical condition estimation with random perturbation directions
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Estimate componentwise condition numbers of linear system solutions by applying a few random directional derivatives through LU solves. Compare the probabilistic estimates and their confidence bounds with exact condition numbers on test matrices.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Restarted GMRES stagnation for the recirculating double-glazing convection-diffusion problem
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Discretize the IFISS double-glazing problem (recirculating wind) with upwind finite differences. Implement GMRES(m) with Givens rotations and map total matvecs and stagnation against restart length m and viscosity.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: GMRES polynomial preconditioning from harmonic Ritz roots (Loe-Morgan)
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Run a short Arnoldi process to obtain harmonic Ritz values and build the GMRES residual polynomial in product form, with Leja ordering of the roots. Apply it as a polynomial preconditioner for restarted GMRES on a nonsymmetric 2D operator and count matvecs and dot products.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Block GMRES versus sequential GMRES for multiple sources in convection-diffusion-reaction
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement block Arnoldi with block Givens/QR updates to solve a 2D convection-diffusion-reaction system for several point-source right-hand sides at once. Compare iteration counts and residual histories with independent GMRES runs.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: FOM versus GMRES peak-plateau residual relations
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Run Arnoldi on a nonsymmetric test matrix and compute FOM and GMRES residuals from the same Hessenberg matrix. Verify the Brown/Cullum-Greenbaum identity 1/r_G² = Σ 1/r_F² and show FOM peaks aligned with GMRES plateaus.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Complete GMRES stagnation for cyclic shift and shifted circulant matrices
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Apply full GMRES to the cyclic down-shift matrix with b = e_1 and show zero residual reduction until step n. Then study how a complex shift ρI + S restores geometric convergence, matching the predicted rate |ρ|^-k from polynomial approximation on the circle.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: GMRES on singular consistent systems: range-symmetric versus non-range-symmetric breakdown
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build singular systems, such as a Neumann convection-diffusion operator and the generator of a periodic Markov chain, that either satisfy N(A) = N(A^T) or violate it. Run GMRES and check the Brown-Walker conditions for convergence to a least-squares solution versus breakdown.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Inexact GMRES with Simoncini-Szyld relaxed matrix-vector product accuracy
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Simulate inexact matvecs by adding controlled perturbations whose size grows as 1/||r_k||. Compare the true and computed residual gap and the final attainable accuracy against the relaxation strategy and its theoretical bound.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Left versus right preconditioned GMRES on a stretched-grid anisotropic diffusion problem
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Use ILU(0) or Jacobi preconditioning on a strongly stretched-mesh diffusion system and run left- and right-preconditioned GMRES. Compare the minimized preconditioned residual with the true residual and quantify the misleading stopping criteria.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: GMRES residual polynomial roots as harmonic Ritz values for upwind advection
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Extract harmonic Ritz values from the GMRES Hessenberg matrix at each step for a 1D upwind advection-diffusion operator. Verify that they are the roots of the residual polynomial and track how they approach the field of values and the pseudospectral boundary.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: KL-divergence NMF of a Poisson-count synthetic spectrogram
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build a magnitude spectrogram from additive harmonic notes with Poisson noise. Apply KL multiplicative updates to recover note templates and activations, and compare the generalized KL objective and template correlation with Frobenius NMF.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Alternating nonnegative least squares via active-set NNLS for hyperspectral unmixing
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Simulate pixels as abundance-weighted endmember spectra with sum-to-one abundances. Implement ANLS NMF with Lawson-Hanson NNLS column solves and compare its convergence per iteration and per second with multiplicative updates.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: HALS coordinate-descent NMF versus multiplicative updates convergence
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement hierarchical alternating least squares with rank-one column updates for NMF of a synthetic low-rank nonnegative matrix. Compare relative error versus iteration and versus time, including the effect of zero-locking in multiplicative updates.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Successive projection algorithm for separable NMF under noise
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Generate near-separable data X = W[I, H'] + N and identify the anchor columns with SPA using QR-like orthogonal projections. Measure anchor recovery rate versus noise level and conditioning of W.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: MCR-ALS curve resolution of A→B→C kinetic spectroscopy data
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Simulate time-resolved spectra from first-order consecutive kinetics. Run multivariate curve resolution with alternating least squares, nonnegativity and closure constraints, and report recovered concentration profiles and the lack of fit.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Rotational ambiguity bands of two-component NMF via linear programming
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: For a rank-2 nonnegative data matrix from SVD, parametrize all feasible transformations T with W = UΣT^{-1} ≥ 0 and H = TV^T ≥ 0. Compute the extreme feasible profiles by linear programs and quantify the band width.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: NMF rank selection by consensus clustering cophenetic correlation
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Run many random-initialized NMFs of a synthetic gene-expression matrix with planted sample groups for each candidate rank. Build consensus connectivity matrices and select the rank from the drop in cophenetic correlation.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Lin's projected-gradient NMF with Armijo line search and KKT stationarity
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement alternating projected-gradient subproblem solves with Armijo backtracking. Monitor the projected-gradient norm as a KKT stationarity measure and compare it with multiplicative updates on a synthetic face-like parts dataset.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Chebyshev coefficient decay of the Runge function and Bernstein ellipse prediction
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute Chebyshev coefficients of 1/(1+25x²) by a DCT of values at Chebyshev points. Fit the geometric decay rate and compare it with ρ = 1/5 + √(1+1/25) from the pole location.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Algebraic Chebyshev coefficient decay for functions of finite smoothness
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: For |x|^ν and functions with jumps in a derivative, compute Chebyshev coefficients by FFT. Verify decay of order k^-(ν+1) and the corresponding algebraic convergence of interpolants in the max norm.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Chebfun-style plateau chopping rule for Chebyshev series truncation
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement an adaptive Chebyshev construction that doubles the grid and detects the rounding-error plateau in the coefficient envelope, following the Aurentz-Trefethen chop rule. Report the selected lengths for smooth, noisy and nearly singular functions.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Global extrema of oscillatory functions via colleague-matrix roots of the derivative
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Approximate a wiggly function by a Chebyshev series, differentiate it in coefficient space and find all critical points from the colleague matrix eigenvalues. Return the global minimum and verify it against dense sampling.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Chebyshev economization of truncated Taylor series for sin and exp
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Convert high-degree Taylor polynomials to the Chebyshev basis, drop the trailing terms, and convert back. Compare the max error with the original Taylor truncation and with Chebyshev interpolation of the same degree.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Olver-Townsend ultraspherical spectral method for linear boundary-value ODEs
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Assemble the banded differentiation and conversion operators between Chebyshev and ultraspherical bases, with boundary rows, for an Airy-type equation εu'' - xu = 0. Solve the almost-banded system and verify exponential convergence of coefficients.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: De Casteljau versus Bernstein-Horner evaluation accuracy for high-degree Bézier curves
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Evaluate high-degree Bernstein polynomials by de Casteljau and by the Horner-like nested Bernstein scheme. Compute running error bounds and compare observed forward errors against condition numbers in the Bernstein basis.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Bézier degree elevation and O(1/n) convergence of control polygons
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Repeatedly degree-elevate a cubic Bézier curve using the elevation matrix. Measure the Hausdorff-type distance between the control polygon and the curve and verify the asymptotic O(1/n) rate.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Chaikin corner cutting convergence to the quadratic B-spline limit curve
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Apply Chaikin's subdivision matrix repeatedly to a closed control polygon. Verify geometric convergence toward the uniform quadratic B-spline evaluated exactly, and check the eigenvalues 1, 1/2, 1/4 of the local subdivision matrix.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Four-point Dubuc-Deslauriers scheme tension range via difference-scheme norms
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: For the interpolatory four-point scheme with tension w, form the derived difference schemes and estimate the joint spectral radius from norms of their iterated powers. Determine the range of w giving C0 and C1 limit curves.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Loop subdivision eigenanalysis at extraordinary vertices of valence n
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build the local Loop subdivision matrix around a vertex of valence n and compute its eigenvalues via the Fourier block decomposition. Verify the subdominant eigenvalue conditions for tangent-plane continuity and identify the valences that need Warren's weights.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Bézier clipping for curve-line intersections and polynomial root isolation
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Represent the signed distance to a line as a Bernstein polynomial, clip the parameter interval using the convex hull of its control points, and subdivide when clipping stalls. Compare the quadratic convergence and the roots found against colleague-matrix roots.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Least-squares cubic Bézier fitting with chord-length versus centripetal parametrization
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Fit cubic Bézier segments to digitized points by linear least squares in the control points. Alternate with Newton parameter correction and compare fit residuals under uniform, chord-length and centripetal initial parametrizations.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Rational quadratic Bézier representation of circular arcs and parametric speed
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Construct weights for exact rational quadratic Bézier arcs of a given opening angle and verify the radius error at machine precision. Quantify the nonuniform parametric speed and compare with polynomial cubic approximations of the arc.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Boehm knot insertion and Oslo refinement convergence of B-spline control polygons
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement single and multiple knot insertion as refinement matrices for cubic B-splines. Show that repeated uniform insertion drives the control polygon to the curve at O(h²), and verify that the curve is unchanged at machine precision.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Mass-spring chain reconstruction from natural frequencies and modal end amplitudes
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: From the eigenvalues and first eigenvector components of a fixed-free spring-mass chain, rebuild the Jacobi matrix by Lanczos on the diagonal spectral measure. Recover the masses and spring constants and test their sensitivity to noisy data.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Inverse eigenvalue problems and Jacobi matrices

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Persymmetric Jacobi matrices from a single spectrum
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Use the persymmetric weight formula w_i ∝ 1/|∏(λ_i - λ_j)| to reconstruct a mirror-symmetric Jacobi matrix from its eigenvalues alone. Verify persymmetry and spectral reproduction, and examine accuracy as n grows.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Inverse eigenvalue problems and Jacobi matrices

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Additive inverse eigenvalue problem by Friedland-Nocedal-Overton Newton iteration
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Find a diagonal D such that A + D has a prescribed spectrum, using Newton steps with eigenvector-based Jacobians. Study quadratic convergence, solvability for random targets and behavior near multiple eigenvalues.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Inverse eigenvalue problems and Jacobi matrices

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Toda lattice flow isospectrality and its connection to the QR algorithm
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Integrate the Toda flow dL/dt = [B(L), L] for a Jacobi matrix with a stiff ODE solver. Verify that the spectrum is conserved and that L converges to a sorted diagonal, then compare time-1 snapshots with QR iterates on exp(L).
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Inverse eigenvalue problems and Jacobi matrices

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Symmetric Toeplitz inverse eigenvalue problem via Newton's method (Trench)
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Solve for the first row of a real symmetric Toeplitz matrix with a prescribed spectrum by Newton iteration on eigenvalue residuals, respecting even/odd eigenvector parity. Report convergence, multiplicity of solutions and failure cases.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Inverse eigenvalue problems and Jacobi matrices

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Rational Remez for best type (m,m) approximations of sqrt(x) on [ε,1]
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement rational Remez with eigenvalue-based linearization at each reference set for √x on [10^-4, 1]. Check equioscillation at 2m+2 points and compare error decay with Newman-type exp(-c√m) behavior and with polynomial minimax.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Minimax approximation and the Remez algorithm

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Near-minimax Chebyshev interpolation versus true minimax error ratios
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: For several analytic and nonsmooth functions, compare the max errors of Chebyshev interpolants and Remez minimax polynomials. Verify that the ratio stays below 1 + Λ_n, the Chebyshev Lebesgue constant.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Minimax approximation and the Remez algorithm

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Discrete minimax approximation by linear programming versus Remez
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Formulate best uniform polynomial approximation on a fine grid as a linear program and solve it with scipy linprog. Compare the coefficients, error levels and alternation sets with the continuous Remez solution as the grid is refined.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Minimax approximation and the Remez algorithm

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Relative-error weighted minimax polynomial for log2 on [1,2]
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Design a polynomial approximation of log2(x)/(x-1) by weighted Remez minimizing relative error, as in math-library kernels. Verify equioscillation of the weighted error and the resulting ulp-level accuracy versus degree.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Minimax approximation and the Remez algorithm

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Lawson's iteratively reweighted least squares algorithm for minimax approximation
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement Lawson's weight-update algorithm with weighted least-squares solves on a fine grid. Compare its linear convergence to the minimax error and the alternation structure with Remez for smooth and kinked targets.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Minimax approximation and the Remez algorithm

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Generalized Gauss-Laguerre rules for hydrogenic radial matrix elements
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute Gauss-Laguerre nodes and weights for weights x^α e^{-x} via Golub-Welsch. Evaluate hydrogenic radial expectation values ⟨r^k⟩ and verify exactness up to degree 2n-1 against closed forms.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Gauss-Jacobi rules for endpoint-singular integrands and exactness verification
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Construct Gauss-Jacobi rules for (1-x)^α(1+x)^β from the Jacobi recurrence matrix. Verify polynomial exactness and compare convergence on integrands with matching endpoint singularities against Gauss-Legendre.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Accuracy of Golub-Welsch weights for large n versus derivative-based formulas
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: For Gauss-Legendre with n up to several thousand, compare weights from squared first eigenvector components with weights from the derivative formula 2/((1-x²)P_n'(x)²). Quantify the relative error loss for small weights near the endpoints.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Laurie anti-Gauss rules for practical quadrature error estimation
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build the (n+1)-point anti-Gauss rule by modifying the last recurrence coefficient of the Jacobi matrix. Average it with the Gauss rule, and test how reliably the Gauss/anti-Gauss pair brackets integrals of smooth functions.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Golub-Meurant Gauss and Gauss-Radau bounds for entries of a Laplacian inverse
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Run Lanczos on a graph Laplacian with a regularizing shift to obtain Gauss and Gauss-Radau rules for the spectral measure of u. Compute monotone lower and upper bounds on u^T A^{-1} u and compare with the exact values.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Quadrature method of moments via Wheeler's algorithm for aerosol size distributions
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: From the first 2N moments of a lognormal particle size distribution, compute recurrence coefficients with Wheeler's algorithm and Gauss nodes and weights by Golub-Welsch. Verify moment reproduction and conditioning as N grows.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Rys quadrature for the weight exp(-Tx²) on [0,1] in electron repulsion integrals
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute modified moments via Boys functions and recurrence coefficients for the Rys weight, then build Gauss nodes by Golub-Welsch for several T. Verify the rules against exact Boys-function integrals of polynomials.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Smolyak Chebyshev-extrema interpolation of the 8D borehole function versus tensor grids
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build Smolyak interpolants from nested Clenshaw-Curtis point sets using hierarchical surpluses for the borehole flow function. Compare max error versus point count with full tensor grids.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Anisotropic Smolyak grids with weights from Chebyshev coefficient decay
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Estimate per-dimension analyticity rates from 1D Chebyshev coefficient decay and set a weighted Smolyak index set. Compare error versus points against isotropic sparse grids for an anisotropic exponential function.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Genz-Keister nested Hermite sparse grids for Gaussian expectations of posteriors
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Assemble Smolyak quadrature from Genz-Keister nested rules and compute posterior means and variances of a nonlinear Gaussian-prior model in 4-6 dimensions. Compare accuracy with tensor Gauss-Hermite and Monte Carlo.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Garcke penalized sparse grid regression on scattered noisy data
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Fit a hierarchical hat-basis sparse grid function to scattered noisy samples by solving the regularized normal equations with CG. Choose the penalty by validation and compare with full-grid regression in 3-5 dimensions.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Lebesgue constants of Smolyak interpolation operators with Clenshaw-Curtis versus Leja points
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute the Lebesgue functions of Smolyak interpolants in 2-3 dimensions by evaluating Lagrange basis sums on fine grids. Compare their growth with level for nested Clenshaw-Curtis and Leja sequences.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Sparse grid surrogate for a parametrized quantum ground-state energy
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Solve finite-difference eigenproblems for a 1D Schrödinger operator whose potential depends on 3-4 parameters at Smolyak nodes. Build the sparse grid interpolant of the lowest eigenvalue and report surrogate error versus number of eigen-solves.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Sparse grid interpolation of Michaelis-Menten kinetics ODE outputs in parameter space
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Integrate an enzyme kinetics ODE at Smolyak nodes over four rate-parameter ranges and interpolate product yield via hierarchical surpluses. Compare error decay and surplus magnitudes with tensor-grid surrogates.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: HODLR compression of a 1D logarithmic-kernel matrix with storage and matvec scaling
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Recursively bisect the log|x-y| kernel matrix on [0,1], compress off-diagonal blocks by truncated SVD or ACA, and measure the N log N storage, matvec cost and accuracy as N grows.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Cluster-tree H-matrix with eta-admissibility for a 2D Laplace single-layer matrix
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build a bounding-box cluster tree and a block tree under the min(diam) <= eta*dist rule for log-kernel collocation on a curve. Compress admissible blocks by ACA and report storage and error versus eta and leaf size.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Helmholtz kernel off-diagonal rank growth versus wavenumber times block diameter
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute numerical epsilon-ranks of separated blocks of exp(ik|x-y|)/|x-y| for point sets on a line and on a plane as k increases. Demonstrate how growth with kD breaks low-rank structure in the high-frequency regime.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Cauchy matrix block ranks and Zolotarev-type singular value decay bounds
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute the singular values of Cauchy matrices 1/(x_i - y_j) for separated real intervals and compare their decay with the theoretical bound from Zolotarev numbers. Use the comparison to explain the hierarchical compressibility of displacement-structured matrices.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: H-matrix accelerated BEM capacitance of a unit square plate with GMRES
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Discretize the first-kind integral equation for the surface charge on a square plate by piecewise-constant collocation and compress far-field blocks with ACA. Solve with GMRES and compare the capacitance and the cost with the dense solve.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Peeling algorithm: matvec-only randomized construction of HODLR matrices
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Recover the HODLR representation of an operator known only through products with random block-structured probes, here the inverse of a 1D variable-coefficient diffusion matrix. Quantify the number of matvecs needed and the reconstruction error per level.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Low-rank structure of separator Schur complements in nested dissection of 2D Poisson
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Form the dense Schur complement on the top-level separator of a 5-point Poisson grid. Measure the numerical ranks of its off-diagonal blocks versus grid size to justify hierarchical compression in structured sparse direct solvers.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: QMR from nonsymmetric Lanczos and the Nachtigal kappa(V) bound relative to GMRES
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement QMR without look-ahead, with Givens rotations applied to the tridiagonal Lanczos matrix. Verify numerically that the QMR residual stays below sqrt(k+1)·kappa(V_{k+1}) times the GMRES residual.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: BiCGSTAB, QMR and short-recurrence nonsymmetric solvers

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: TFQMR versus CGS for a shifted 1D Helmholtz system with absorption
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Solve a complex nonsymmetric Helmholtz discretization with impedance boundaries using transpose-free QMR and CGS. Compare residual smoothing, peak residuals and matvec cost.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: BiCGSTAB, QMR and short-recurrence nonsymmetric solvers

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: BiCGSTAB(ℓ) curing BiCGSTAB stagnation for spectra with large imaginary parts
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Apply BiCGSTAB and BiCGSTAB(2) and BiCGSTAB(4) to a convection-dominated operator with nearly imaginary eigenvalues. Track the omega≈0 stagnation of the minimal-residual step and the convergence gained from higher-degree polynomials.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: BiCGSTAB, QMR and short-recurrence nonsymmetric solvers

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: IDR(s) induced dimension reduction versus BiCGSTAB on 2D convection-diffusion-reaction
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement IDR(s) with random shadow spaces for s = 1, 2, 4, 8 and compare matvecs-to-tolerance and memory with BiCGSTAB and GMRES on a 2D nonsymmetric model problem.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: BiCGSTAB, QMR and short-recurrence nonsymmetric solvers

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Residual gap and residual replacement in BiCGSTAB
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Track the drift between the recursively updated and the true residuals in BiCGSTAB on an ill-conditioned nonsymmetric matrix. Implement the van der Vorst-Ye residual replacement and quantify the recovered attainable accuracy.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: BiCGSTAB, QMR and short-recurrence nonsymmetric solvers

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Concus-Golub-Widlund short-recurrence solver for shifted skew-symmetric systems
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Solve (I + S)x = b, where S is the skew part of a central-difference convection operator, with a three-term CG-type recurrence that the Faber-Manteuffel theorem allows. Show agreement with GMRES at much lower cost.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: BiCGSTAB, QMR and short-recurrence nonsymmetric solvers

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Two-sided Lanczos Ritz values for eigenvalues of a nonsymmetric Markov generator
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Run the nonsymmetric (bi-orthogonal) Lanczos process on the generator of a biased random walk. Compare the convergence of the tridiagonal Ritz values to the extremal eigenvalues with Arnoldi, and monitor the loss of bi-orthogonality.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: BiCGSTAB, QMR and short-recurrence nonsymmetric solvers

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Sakurai-Sugiura Hankel moment method for nonsymmetric eigenvalues inside a disk
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute resolvent moments by trapezoidal quadrature on a circle. Form block Hankel matrices, extract the enclosed eigenvalues of a random nonsymmetric matrix from the resulting pencil, and study the effect of moment order and rank truncation.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Beyn's contour method for characteristic roots of a delay differential equation
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Solve the nonlinear eigenproblem (λI - A - B e^{-τλ})v = 0 for a two-dimensional DDE with Beyn's integral algorithm on a circle. Extract the eigenvalues inside the contour and validate them by Newton refinement.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Eigenvalue counts in energy windows by stochastic contour-integral trace estimation
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Estimate the number of eigenvalues of a 2D tight-binding Hamiltonian in an interval as the trace of a quadrature-approximated spectral projector, using Hutchinson probes. Compare with exact counts from Sylvester inertia.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Beyn's method for scattering resonances of a 1D delta-shell potential
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Write the outgoing-wave matching conditions as a 2x2 analytic nonlinear eigenproblem T(k)v = 0. Locate complex resonance wavenumbers inside a contour with Beyn's algorithm and compare with roots found by Newton's method.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Multi-contour spectrum slicing for graphene nanoribbon tight-binding eigenstates
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Partition the spectrum of a zigzag nanoribbon Hamiltonian into adjacent intervals, each handled by an independent FEAST contour. Verify the completeness and orthogonality of the eigenvectors gathered across slices, including edge states near zero energy.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Fitzgibbon direct least-squares ellipse fitting via a constrained generalized eigenproblem
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Fit conic coefficients to noisy elliptical-orbit points under the quadratic constraint 4ac - b^2 = 1 by solving the scatter-matrix generalized eigenproblem. Compare the fitted center and axes with algebraic and orthogonal fits.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Total least squares and constrained fitting

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Mixed LS-TLS with exactly known columns via the Golub-Hoffman-Stewart method
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Fit a linear calibration model whose intercept column is exact while the other regressors are noisy. Use QR projection of the exact columns followed by TLS on the remainder, then compare bias with OLS and full TLS in Monte Carlo trials.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Total least squares and constrained fitting

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Deming regression as generalized TLS for comparing two noisy instruments
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Whiten the data with the known error-variance ratio and solve by SVD to fit slope and intercept between two instruments that both have measurement error. Validate against the closed-form Deming estimator and assess coverage with a bootstrap.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Total least squares and constrained fitting

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Hankel total least squares (HTLS) for NMR free-induction-decay parameter estimation
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build a Hankel matrix from a noisy multi-exponential FID, truncate its SVD to the model order, and solve the shift-invariance equation by TLS. Recover frequencies, dampings and amplitudes, then compare with a least-squares Prony fit.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Total least squares and constrained fitting

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Least squares with a norm equality constraint via the secular equation
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Solve min ||Ax - b|| subject to ||x|| = α for a polynomial-fitting problem. Use the SVD and Newton iteration on the secular equation for the Lagrange multiplier, and treat the hard case explicitly.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Total least squares and constrained fitting

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Weighting method versus null-space method for equality-constrained compositional least squares
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Fit mixture fractions constrained to sum to one by Van Loan's large-weight augmentation and by the exact null-space approach. Measure how the weighting error decays with the weight until roundoff takes over.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Total least squares and constrained fitting

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Truncated total least squares regularization for a Shaw-type deblurring problem
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Regularize an ill-posed blurring system whose operator and data are both noisy by truncating the SVD of the augmented matrix [A b]. Compare TTLS and TSVD error curves versus truncation level.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Total least squares and constrained fitting

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Lawson-Hanson least distance programming for inequality-constrained spectral fitting
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Reduce a least-squares fit with linear inequality constraints, here monotone nonnegative concentration profiles, to an LDP problem and solve it through NNLS. Verify the KKT conditions and compare with an unconstrained fit.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Total least squares and constrained fitting

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Hartley-normalized DLT homography estimation via SVD null vectors
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Estimate a planar homography from noisy point correspondences by building the DLT design matrix and taking its smallest right singular vector. Show how Hartley normalization improves the condition number and the reprojection error.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Total least squares and constrained fitting

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Quintic Hermite interpolation of orbital ephemerides from positions, velocities and accelerations
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Interpolate a Keplerian orbit between sparse epochs with piecewise quintic Hermite polynomials. Measure the position error against the exact Kepler solution versus step size, and compare with cubic Hermite.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Froissart doublets in AAA approximations of noisy data and their cleanup
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Run AAA on noisy samples of a meromorphic function. Identify spurious pole-zero pairs that have tiny residues, then remove them and refit by least squares to measure the gain in accuracy and robustness.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Thiele continued-fraction interpolation via inverse differences versus AAA for tan(x)
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build Thiele interpolants of tan on [0, 1.5] from inverse differences and compare their pole locations and accuracy with AAA barycentric approximants of matching degree.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Lightning least-squares rational approximation of sqrt(x) with exponentially clustered poles
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Fix poles clustered exponentially toward the branch point at x = 0, solve a linear least-squares problem for the coefficients, and verify the root-exponential convergence in the number of poles.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Set-valued AAA with shared poles for a family of damped-oscillator frequency responses
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Approximate several frequency-response functions of a multi-degree-of-freedom oscillator with one common set of barycentric support points. Compare the shared poles with the true modal poles and with separate AAA fits.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Padé approximants of exp(z) and scaling-and-squaring matrix exponentials
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute the diagonal [m/m] Padé coefficients of exp by solving the linear Padé system. Use them with scaling and squaring to evaluate the exponential of a stiff reaction-network matrix, and study the error versus m and the scaling parameter.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Edelman-Murakami backward error of companion-matrix rootfinding with and without balancing
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute the roots of random and scaled polynomials as companion eigenvalues. Measure the coefficientwise backward error of the computed roots, and show how balancing affects the backward error and the accuracy of the roots.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Comrade matrix rootfinding for Legendre series of Gauss-point polynomials
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build the comrade matrix from the three-term recurrence of Legendre polynomials. Compute the roots of Legendre-series expansions, including P_n itself, and compare against Golub-Welsch nodes.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Fiedler companion matrices versus the Frobenius companion matrix
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Construct pentadiagonal Fiedler companion matrices as products of elementary factors. Compare eigenvalue accuracy, backward error and balancing behavior with the classical Frobenius companion matrix on polynomials whose coefficients vary widely in scale.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Multiple-root clustering at the ε^{1/m} scale in companion eigenvalues
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute roots of (x - 1)^m q(x) by companion eigenvalues and show that the computed roots form a circle of radius about ε^{1/m}. Recover the multiple root accurately from the cluster mean.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Root distribution of Kac random polynomials near the unit circle
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Sample high-degree polynomials with Gaussian coefficients, compute their roots by companion eigenvalues, and compare the radial density with the Kac-Hammersley prediction that roots concentrate near |z| = 1.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Hermite-series comrade matrix for nodes of harmonic-oscillator wavepacket superpositions
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Find the real zeros of a finite superposition of Hermite polynomials by eigenvalues of the physicists'-Hermite comrade matrix. Compare with the node counts of oscillator eigenstates.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Common roots of two polynomials from the Sylvester resultant null space
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build the Sylvester matrix of two polynomials that share roots, determine the GCD degree from its numerical rank by SVD, and extract the common roots from the null space. Test robustness to coefficient noise.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Jónsson-Vavasis companion pencil for roots of Bernstein-basis polynomials
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Form the generalized companion pencil (A, B) for a polynomial in Bernstein form and solve it with QZ. Compare root accuracy with converting to the monomial basis and using the Frobenius companion matrix.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Aberth-Ehrlich iteration versus companion eigenvalues for Mignotte close-root polynomials
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute roots of Mignotte-type polynomials, which have two very close roots, with simultaneous Aberth iteration and with companion QR. Compare accuracy, iteration counts and conditioning of the root pair.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Low-rank bivariate Chebyshev approximation via Gaussian-elimination ACA (Chebfun2-style)
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Approximate smooth 2D functions by iterative rank-one Gaussian elimination on a sampling grid, giving Chebyshev expansions in the pivot rows and columns. Compare the rank needed with SVD truncation and track the coefficient decay.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Chebyshev collocation for finite square-well bound states with a mapped domain
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Discretize the Schrödinger equation on a truncated or mapped domain with Chebyshev differentiation matrices and solve the eigenproblem. Compare spectral convergence of the bound-state energies with transcendental-equation roots.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Gegenbauer reconstruction to remove Gibbs oscillations from Chebyshev data
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Recompute an exponentially accurate expansion on each smooth subinterval of a piecewise-analytic function from its Chebyshev coefficients, by projection onto Gegenbauer polynomials. Measure the error away from the discontinuity versus N.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Aliasing between Chebyshev interpolation and projection coefficients
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute interpolation coefficients by DCT and projection coefficients by high-accuracy quadrature for analytic functions. Verify the aliasing identity that relates them, and compare the interpolation and truncation errors.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Chebyshev-Padé (Clenshaw-Lord) approximants for functions with nearby poles
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build linear Chebyshev-Padé approximants by solving the coefficient system obtained from the Chebyshev series. Show that they beat truncated Chebyshev series in accuracy for functions with complex poles near [-1,1].

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Chebyshev-filtered subspace iteration for low eigenvalues of a 2D Schrödinger operator
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Apply Chebyshev polynomial filters, which damp the unwanted part of the spectrum, inside subspace iteration with Rayleigh-Ritz for a finite-difference 2D quantum dot Hamiltonian. Study the trade-off between filter degree and number of iterations.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Higham stability of second-kind barycentric versus modified Lagrange Chebyshev interpolation
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Evaluate Chebyshev interpolants of high degree with the first and second barycentric forms and with naive Lagrange formulas. Measure forward errors near the nodes and outside the interval to illustrate the backward-stability results.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Lyness-Moler FFT differentiation via Cauchy integrals and optimal contour radius
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute high-order Taylor coefficients and derivatives of analytic functions by the trapezoidal rule on circles of radius r. Balance truncation error against roundoff amplification to choose r, and verify against exact derivatives.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Trigonometric interpolation and periodic trapezoidal rule

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Geometric trapezoidal convergence for 1/(a - cos θ) set by the nearest singularity
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Integrate periodic integrands with complex poles by the periodic trapezoidal rule. Verify the error rate (a - sqrt(a^2 - 1))^N predicted by the width of the strip of analyticity, and contrast with Gauss-Legendre.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Trigonometric interpolation and periodic trapezoidal rule

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Trapezoidal Nyström double-layer solver for Laplace's equation inside an ellipse
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Solve the interior Dirichlet problem with the smooth second-kind double-layer equation on an ellipse using trapezoidal Nyström discretization. Show exponential convergence of interior potentials versus N and eccentricity.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Trigonometric interpolation and periodic trapezoidal rule

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Talbot-contour trapezoidal inversion of Laplace transforms
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Invert Laplace transforms such as those from anomalous diffusion and viscoelastic relaxation by applying the trapezoidal rule on a parametrized Talbot contour. Measure the geometric convergence and sensitivity to the contour parameters.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Trigonometric interpolation and periodic trapezoidal rule

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Hankel-contour trapezoidal evaluation of the matrix exponential for heat equation stepping
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute exp(tA)u0 for a 1D diffusion matrix as a contour integral of resolvents on a hyperbolic contour, using shifted sparse solves. Verify that the error decreases geometrically with the number of quadrature nodes.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Trigonometric interpolation and periodic trapezoidal rule

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Trapezoidal rule on the real line for integrands analytic in a strip
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Integrate sech-type and Gaussian-type integrands over ℝ with step h and truncation. Confirm the exp(-2πd/h) error from strip width d, and optimize h jointly with the truncation length.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Trigonometric interpolation and periodic trapezoidal rule
