math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Delves-Lyness argument-principle zero finding with Newton identities and a Hankel pencil
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute moments ∮ z^k f'/f dz by the trapezoidal rule on a circle. Recover the zeros of an analytic function enclosed by the circle from a small Hankel generalized eigenproblem, then refine them with Newton's method.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Trigonometric interpolation and periodic trapezoidal rule

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Theodorsen conformal mapping via FFT conjugate-function iteration for an airfoil-like curve
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Solve Theodorsen's integral equation for mapping the disk to a near-circular domain, applying the periodic Hilbert transform spectrally with the FFT. Verify the geometric convergence and the boundary correspondence.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Trigonometric interpolation and periodic trapezoidal rule

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Companion linearization of a damped mass-spring chain QEP and modal damping ratios
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Solve (λ^2 M + λC + K)x = 0 for a chain with discrete dashpots by first-companion linearization and QZ. Extract natural frequencies and damping ratios, and check eigenpair residuals.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Gyroscopic QEP Campbell diagram for a spinning Jeffcott rotor
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Assemble the quadratic eigenproblem with a skew gyroscopic matrix for a rotor on bearings. Track forward and backward whirl frequencies versus spin speed, and locate critical speeds.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Rayleigh versus nonproportional damping: modal decoupling error in a shear building
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compare exact complex eigenvalues of a multi-story building QEP with concentrated base dampers against the decoupled modal approximation obtained by discarding off-diagonal modal damping terms. Quantify the error in the damping ratios.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Infinite eigenvalues of a singular-mass pencil for a constrained mechanical system
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Model a frame with massless degrees of freedom and holonomic constraints as an index-structured pencil. Compute it with QZ, count the infinite eigenvalues, and compare with Guyan condensation of the massless DOFs.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Cholesky reduction versus QZ for Kx = λMx with nearly singular M
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Solve a symmetric-definite pencil with an ill-conditioned mass matrix by the standard reduction L^{-1}KL^{-T} and by QZ. Compare eigenvalue accuracy against the predicted error growth from kappa(M).

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Complex band structure of a tight-binding chain from a QEP in the Bloch factor
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute all Bloch factors λ = e^{ika} at fixed energy for a multi-orbital 1D lattice by linearizing H_{-1}/λ + H_0 + λH_1 - E. Separate propagating from evanescent modes and plot decay lengths in the band gap.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Fan-Lin-Van Dooren scaling and backward error of QEP linearizations
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute eigenpairs of badly scaled quadratic eigenproblems through companion linearizations with and without parameter scaling. Evaluate the Tisseur backward errors of the recovered eigenpairs for the original QEP.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Overdamped hyperbolic QEP and eigenvalue minimax separation for a viscous chain
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Test hyperbolicity of a heavily damped chain QEP via the discriminant condition (x^T C x)^2 > 4(x^T M x)(x^T K x), and verify the real spectrum split into primary and secondary eigenvalues. Find the critical damping where the system stops being overdamped.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Exceptional points of a string with a boundary damper QEP
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Discretize a string with a viscous damper at one end, which gives a quadratic eigenproblem. Track the complex eigenvalues as damper strength varies, locate coalescence (exceptional) points, and find the damping that maximizes decay of the lowest mode.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: MLS smoothing of noisy terrain heights with cross-validated support radius
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Fit local weighted quadratic polynomials to noisy scattered elevation samples. Choose the Gaussian weight radius by leave-one-out cross-validation computed from the MLS hat-matrix diagonal, and analyze the bias-variance trade-off.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Moving least squares and scattered data fitting

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Partition-of-unity interpolation with local RBF patches on scattered 2D data
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Cover the domain with overlapping disks and solve a small RBF interpolation system on each patch. Blend the patches with Wendland weights, then compare accuracy, conditioning and cost with global RBF interpolation.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Moving least squares and scattered data fitting

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: LOESS robust local regression of a noisy spectroscopic baseline
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Fit tricube-weighted local linear or quadratic regressions to a 1D spectrum containing outliers. Apply bisquare robustness reweighting iterations and assess baseline recovery against the true signal.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Moving least squares and scattered data fitting

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Recursive, pairwise and Kahan summation errors versus a priori bounds
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Sum random positive and mixed-sign float32/float64 vectors of increasing length by recursive, pairwise and Kahan compensated summation. Compare the measured relative errors, taken against exact rational reference sums, with the γ_{n-1}, γ_{log n} and 2u+O(nu²) bounds.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Floating-point error analysis and compensated summation

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Compensated summation of increments in long-time Störmer-Verlet Kepler integration
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Integrate an eccentric Kepler orbit for 1e6 steps with Störmer-Verlet, accumulating position updates naively and with Kahan compensated summation. Quantify how the random-walk growth of rounding error in energy and angular momentum is suppressed.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Floating-point error analysis and compensated summation

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Running error bound for Horner evaluation versus worst-case a priori bound
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement Horner evaluation with Higham's running error bound for Chebyshev-like and Wilkinson-type polynomials. Compare the running bound, the a priori γ_{2n} bound and the true error over a grid of points.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Floating-point error analysis and compensated summation

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Cancellation in Taylor-series summation of exp(-x) and the summation condition number
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Sum the Taylor series of exp(-x) for x up to 30 in double precision, both directly and as 1/exp(x). Relate the measured error to the summation condition number Σ|a_k|/|Σa_k| and to the sizes of the largest terms.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Floating-point error analysis and compensated summation

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Double-double arithmetic via error-free transforms for Hilbert-matrix systems
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement double-double addition, multiplication and a dot product from TwoSum and Dekker TwoProduct. Use the double-double residual to solve Hilbert systems of growing order, and compare the attained forward errors with float64 GEPP and with exact rational solutions.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Floating-point error analysis and compensated summation

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Strassen versus classical matrix multiplication normwise error growth
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement recursive Strassen multiplication with a crossover size. Measure normwise and componentwise errors against exact rational products for random and graded matrices, and compare them with the Higham-Brent bounds for classical and Strassen multiplication.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Floating-point error analysis and compensated summation

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Kahan's accurate discriminant b²-4ac with fused error-free products
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute the roots of nearly double-root quadratics using the naive discriminant, the stable quadratic formula, and Kahan's discriminant with TwoProduct error recovery. Report root relative errors as the discriminant approaches zero.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Floating-point error analysis and compensated summation

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Strohmer-Vershynin randomized Kaczmarz rate versus scaled condition number
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Solve consistent overdetermined Gaussian and row-scaled systems with cyclic Kaczmarz and with row-norm-sampled randomized Kaczmarz. Compare the measured expected error decay with the bound (1-κ_F^{-2})^k.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Leverage-score sampling for least-squares polynomial regression
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute exact leverage scores of a Legendre-polynomial design matrix from its thin QR. Solve sampled-and-reweighted least-squares problems with leverage-score and uniform sampling, and compare the residual ratios versus sample size with the full solution.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Frequent Directions streaming sketch of a covariance matrix
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Stream rows of a synthetic low-rank-plus-noise data matrix through Liberty's Frequent Directions algorithm, which applies repeated SVD shrinkage. Verify the covariance error bound ||AᵀA-BᵀB||₂ ≤ ||A-A_k||_F²/(ℓ-k).

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Randomized DEIM-CUR of parametrized advection-diffusion snapshot matrices
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build a snapshot matrix of 1D advection-diffusion solutions over a range of parameters. Form CUR approximations using DEIM indices from a randomized SVD, and compare the CUR error with the truncated SVD error and the DEIM error bound.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Randomized low-rank prior-preconditioned Hessian for Bayesian heat-source inversion
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: For a linear 1D heat-equation source inversion with a Gaussian prior, compute the dominant eigenpairs of the prior-preconditioned data-misfit Hessian using a randomized eigensolver. Form the low-rank posterior covariance and compare posterior variances with the dense result.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Stochastic probing estimation of the diagonal of a lattice Green's function
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Estimate diag((H-zI)^{-1}) for a 2D tight-binding lattice using Bekas-Kokiopoulou-Saad stochastic diagonal estimation, with Rademacher vectors and with Hadamard/coloring probing vectors. Measure the error versus number of solves against exact selected entries.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Sketched GMRES with Gaussian embedding versus standard GMRES
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement sGMRES, which uses a truncated-Arnoldi basis and minimizes a sketched residual ||S(b-AVy)|| via QR. Compare residual histories and basis-condition effects with full GMRES on a convection-diffusion matrix.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Paige's theorem: orthogonality loss along converged Ritz vectors
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Run plain Lanczos on a 2D discrete Laplacian and monitor |y_iᵀq_{k+1}| for each Ritz vector. Verify Paige's relation between loss of orthogonality and the bottom-component residual β_k|s_{ki}|.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Cullum-Willoughby spurious Ritz value identification without reorthogonalization
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Run long Lanczos runs without reorthogonalization on a large sparse spectrum. Identify spurious eigenvalues by comparing T_m with the T̂_m obtained by deleting its first row and column, and recover the true eigenvalue list together with multiplicity tests.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Beyn's contour method for the loaded-string rational eigenvalue problem
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Solve the NLEVP 'loaded_string' problem (K - λM + λ/(λ-σ) e_n e_nᵀ)x = 0 from a finite-element string with an attached spring-mass. Use Beyn's integral method with trapezoidal quadrature on circles, and validate the results against a linearization.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Riesz spectral projector by contour quadrature for stable/unstable mode separation
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Approximate the Riesz projector onto the eigenvalues of a linearized dynamical system that lie in a half-disk. Use trapezoidal quadrature of resolvent solves, and compare its trace, rank and invariant subspace with an ordered Schur decomposition.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Spatial Orr-Sommerfeld stability as a quartic polynomial eigenproblem
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: For plane Poiseuille flow at fixed real frequency, the Orr-Sommerfeld equation is quartic in the streamwise wavenumber α. Linearize it to a companion pencil, solve with QZ, and identify the spatially growing Tollmien-Schlichting branch.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Linear buckling eigenproblem K x = λ K_G x for stepped columns
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Assemble Hermite-cubic elastic and geometric stiffness matrices for stepped columns under several boundary conditions. Solve the definite generalized eigenproblem by Cholesky reduction, and verify convergence to Euler loads and their stepped-column corrections.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Extended Hückel orbital energies from the overlap-matrix generalized eigenproblem
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build Slater-orbital overlap matrices and Wolfsberg-Helmholz Hamiltonians for small hydrocarbons. Solve HC = SCE by Cholesky reduction and by symmetric orthogonalization, and study how near-linear-dependence in S affects the eigenvalue accuracy.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Laub's Hessenberg method for frequency-response evaluation at many frequencies
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Reduce A to upper Hessenberg form by Householder similarity once. Then evaluate G(iω) = C(iωI-A)^{-1}B at hundreds of frequencies with O(n²) Hessenberg solves, and compare accuracy and cost with dense LU at every frequency for a structural model.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Givens array square-root Kalman filter versus conventional Kalman covariance updates
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement the square-root Kalman filter by QR (Givens/Householder) triangularization of pre-arrays for a nearly unobservable tracking model. Compare covariance symmetry, positive definiteness loss and state errors with the conventional Kalman filter in float32.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Givens column insertion and deletion for stepwise regression QR updates
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Maintain the QR factorization of a regression design matrix while adding and removing predictors with Givens rotations. Check the updated R against fresh factorizations, and track the orthogonality drift over long update sequences.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Schoenberg-Whitney conditions and B-spline interpolation matrix conditioning
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Assemble B-spline collocation matrices for interpolation at Greville, Chebyshev-Demko and perturbed sites. Check the Schoenberg-Whitney conditions, and relate the condition numbers and interpolation errors to how close the conditions are to being violated.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Reinsch cubic smoothing spline with generalized cross-validation
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Fit noisy samples with the Reinsch smoothing spline by solving banded pentadiagonal systems for each smoothing parameter. Select the parameter by GCV using trace computations from banded factorizations, and compare the fit error with the optimal parameter.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: de Boor-Swartz B-spline collocation at Gauss points for boundary-layer BVPs
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Solve εu'' + u' = f with a boundary layer by B-spline collocation at Gauss-Legendre points on graded meshes, assembling almost-block-diagonal systems. Verify the superconvergence of order h^{2k} at the mesh points.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: de Boor-Fix dual functionals and spline quasi-interpolant approximation order
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Construct spline quasi-interpolants from the de Boor-Fix dual functionals and from local point-evaluation formulas. Verify polynomial reproduction, and measure the O(h^k) convergence for smooth and kinked functions without solving global systems.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Free-knot least-squares spline fitting by Golub-Pereyra variable projection
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Fit a cubic spline with a few free interior knots to sigmoidal titration-like data. Eliminate the linear B-spline coefficients by variable projection, optimize the knots with Gauss-Newton, and compare the result with fixed uniform knots.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: TT-cross interpolation with maxvol pivots for a 10-dimensional function
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build a tensor-train approximation of a smooth 10D function on a tensor-product Chebyshev grid. Use alternating cross interpolation with maxvol row/column selection, and report the TT ranks, the sampling count and the errors at random test points.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Tensor trains and low-rank tensor arithmetic

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: HOSVD versus sequentially truncated HOSVD Tucker compression of a 3D density
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compress a 3D grid of a molecular-like Gaussian electron density with truncated HOSVD and ST-HOSVD. Compare Tucker ranks, errors relative to the √(Σ discarded σ²) bound, and computational cost.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Tensor trains and low-rank tensor arithmetic

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: CP-ALS PARAFAC decomposition of synthetic fluorescence excitation-emission data
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Generate a three-way excitation × emission × sample fluorescence tensor from three fluorophores with noise. Fit a CP decomposition by alternating least squares using Khatri-Rao products, and assess component recovery and the core consistency diagnostic.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Tensor trains and low-rank tensor arithmetic

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: TT-matrix Laplacian in d dimensions and ALS linear system solution
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Assemble the d-dimensional discrete Laplacian exactly as a rank-2 TT operator. Solve Δu = f for d = 3 to 10 by alternating least squares on TT cores, and compare the solution ranks and errors with an exact separable solution.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Tensor trains and low-rank tensor arithmetic

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Newton-Krylov shooting for Brusselator limit cycles and Floquet multipliers
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Find the periodic orbit of a spatially discretized Brusselator by matrix-free Newton-GMRES shooting with a phase condition. Then compute the dominant Floquet multipliers from the monodromy operator using Arnoldi.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Pseudo-arclength Newton-Krylov continuation through folds of an autocatalytic reaction-diffusion
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Trace the S-shaped steady-state branch of a 1D cubic autocatalysis reaction-diffusion model by pseudo-arclength continuation, with bordered Jacobian-free GMRES solves. Locate the fold points from sign changes of the tangent.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Anderson acceleration versus Jacobian-free Newton-Krylov for nonlinear Poisson-Boltzmann
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Solve the 2D nonlinear Poisson-Boltzmann equation around charged inclusions by Picard iteration, Anderson-accelerated fixed point iteration, and JFNK with a Laplacian preconditioner. Compare convergence rates and work at increasing ionic strengths.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Finite-difference Jacobian-vector step size in JFNK for implicit Burgers steps
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Study how the directional-difference increment h in J v ≈ (F(u+hv)-F(u))/h affects truncation-rounding error and Newton convergence for backward-Euler viscous Burgers steps. Compare fixed h with the Pernice-Walker and Knoll-Keyes scalings.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Inexact Newton-Krylov for backward Euler porous-medium equation steps
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Solve the nonlinear systems of implicit 2D porous-medium equation time steps with Newton-GMRES under a range of fixed and adaptive forcing terms. Verify the linear, superlinear and quadratic local convergence regimes against theory.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Nadaraya-Watson versus local linear regression boundary bias on scattered data
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compare local constant (Shepard-like kernel) and local linear weighted least-squares fits on 1D/2D scattered noisy samples near domain boundaries. Verify the O(h) boundary bias of the former and the O(h²) bias of the latter.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Moving least squares and scattered data fitting

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Lieb-Liniger Bose gas ground-state energy from the Love-type integral equation
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Discretize the Lieb-Liniger rapidity-density equation on [-q,q] with Gauss-Legendre Nyström, solve with GMRES, and root-find q to obtain the dimensionless energy e(γ) across interaction strengths, checking the Tonks-Girardeau limit.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: GCRO-DR Krylov subspace recycling for a reaction-coefficient sweep
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Solve a sequence of 2D convection-diffusion-reaction systems with slowly varying reaction rate using GCRO-DR, recycling harmonic Ritz vectors between systems, and compare total matrix-vector products against restarted GMRES.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: GMRES on lower-triangular Toeplitz Volterra discretizations
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Discretize a second-kind Volterra convolution equation (renewal equation) to get a lower-triangular Toeplitz matrix, run GMRES, and relate the superlinear convergence to the nilpotent strictly lower part and the departure from normality.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Block-triangular preconditioned GMRES for the 2D Oseen equations
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Assemble a MAC-grid Oseen system linearized about a recirculating wind, apply a block-triangular preconditioner with an approximate pressure-convection-diffusion Schur complement, and report GMRES iteration counts versus viscosity and grid size.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Non-monotone restart dependence of GMRES(m): Embree's tortoise and hare
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement GMRES(m) with Givens rotations and reproduce Embree's small examples where shorter restarts converge faster, then scan m on random perturbations to map how often larger restarts lose.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Nachtigal-Reddy-Trefethen matrices where CGN, GMRES or CGS each wins
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Construct the NRT test matrices (identity-like, cyclic shift, block skew, and others), run CGN, GMRES and CGS, and verify which method wins on each in terms of matrix-vector products and residual history.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: BiCGSTAB, QMR and short-recurrence nonsymmetric solvers

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Zhou-Walker minimal residual smoothing of BiCG on 3D convection-diffusion
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Apply Zhou-Walker minimal residual smoothing to the erratic BiCG residuals of a 7-point 3D convection-diffusion system, and compare the smoothed residual curves with QMR and GMRES.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: BiCGSTAB, QMR and short-recurrence nonsymmetric solvers

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: BiCGSTAB versus GMRES for Crank-Nicolson steps of the Heston PDE
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Discretize the 2D Heston option-pricing PDE with its mixed-derivative term, solve each implicit step with ILU-preconditioned BiCGSTAB and GMRES, and compare the option price against the semi-analytic value along with work per step.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: BiCGSTAB, QMR and short-recurrence nonsymmetric solvers

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Multi-shift BiCG for Talbot-contour inversion of advection-diffusion
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Solve the shifted systems (zI - A)u = u0 at all Talbot quadrature nodes with a single shifted BiCG Krylov space for a nonsymmetric advection-diffusion operator, and reconstruct u(t) by contour summation.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: BiCGSTAB, QMR and short-recurrence nonsymmetric solvers

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Absorption probabilities of a biased 2D random walk via BiCGSTAB
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Set up the nonsymmetric harmonic-function system for hitting probabilities of a drifted lattice walk with two absorbing boundary segments, solve with BiCGSTAB and GMRES, and validate against Monte Carlo and small-grid direct solves.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: BiCGSTAB, QMR and short-recurrence nonsymmetric solvers

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Orthogonal polynomials for the Fermi-derivative weight in Sommerfeld transport integrals
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Generate recurrence coefficients for w(x) = -f'(x) = (1/4)sech²(x/2) by Lanczos on a fine discretization, form Gauss rules, and evaluate thermoelectric transport coefficients for model energy-dependent conductivities.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Hankel moment-matrix Cholesky route to recurrence coefficients and its instability
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Obtain recurrence coefficients for Legendre and Laguerre weights from Cholesky factorization of the moment Hankel matrix, track coefficient errors and Hankel condition-number growth versus degree, and compare with Stieltjes.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Legendre weight with an added point mass: Uvarov-modified recurrences
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute the recurrence coefficients and Gauss rules for dx on [-1,1] plus a Dirac mass at an interior or exterior point using the discretized Stieltjes procedure, and show how one node is captured by the mass.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Data-driven arbitrary polynomial chaos from samples of a bimodal input
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build orthonormal polynomials for the empirical measure of Gaussian-mixture samples via Stieltjes and Lanczos, project a nonlinear model output, and compare mean and variance with Monte Carlo as sample size varies.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: TEDOPA chain mapping of an Ohmic spin-boson bath
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Map an Ohmic spectral density with exponential cutoff to a semi-infinite tight-binding chain via the orthogonal-polynomial recurrence of J(ω), and verify that the chain couplings converge to their asymptotic value.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Barnard-Pothen-Simon spectral envelope reduction versus reverse Cuthill-McKee
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Order the vertices of 2D finite-element meshes by their Fiedler vector entries and compare envelope size, bandwidth and profile-solver fill against RCM.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Kernighan-Lin refinement of spectral bisection on mesh graphs
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Bisect irregular planar mesh graphs at the Fiedler-vector median, refine the partition with Kernighan-Lin swap passes, and report edge-cut reduction and balance before and after refinement.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Mohar-Poljak spectral max-cut bounds for antiferromagnetic Ising graphs
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute the largest-eigenvalue Laplacian bound on max-cut and the corresponding sign-rounded cut for small frustrated graphs (triangular lattice patches, random regular graphs), and compare both with the exact ground state found by enumeration.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Magnetic Hermitian Laplacian for detecting cyclic flow in directed graphs
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build the magnetic Laplacian with charge q for directed graphs with planted cyclic block structure, and use phases of the lowest eigenvector to recover block order where symmetrized Laplacians fail.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Newman leading-eigenvector modularity bisection on planted partition graphs
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute the leading eigenvector of the modularity matrix with matrix-free Lanczos, split by sign, apply repeated subdivision, and compare modularity and accuracy against Fiedler-vector bisection.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Greedy Fiedler-vector edge addition to maximize algebraic connectivity
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Add candidate edges one at a time by the Ghosh-Boyd heuristic (largest (v_i−v_j)²), recompute λ₂, and compare the result with exhaustive best-edge search on small ring and grid networks.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Spectral seriation of shuffled sequence data via Fiedler ordering
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build a similarity graph from overlaps of shuffled noisy fragments with a hidden linear order (Robinson matrix), order them by the Fiedler vector (Atkins seriation), and measure Kendall tau recovery versus noise.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Pseudospectra of banded Toeplitz matrices and symbol winding numbers
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute minimum-singular-value pseudospectra of large Toeplitz matrices with a limaçon-type symbol, and verify that the region where the symbol curve has nonzero winding number is contained in the ε-pseudospectrum for exponentially small ε.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: TTRD two-mode model of non-normal growth and nonlinear bootstrapping
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Integrate the Trefethen-Trefethen-Reddy-Driscoll 2×2 model, compute the transient growth envelope of the linear part from the SVD of exp(tA), and find the threshold amplitude scaling with Reynolds number.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Jordan block pseudospectral radius scaling ε^{1/n}
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute ε-pseudospectra of perturbed n×n Jordan blocks on a grid by minimum singular values, fit the pseudospectral radius against ε^{1/n}, and compare with eigenvalues of random perturbations.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Numerical range boundary and Crouzeix's bound for matrix functions
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute the field-of-values boundary by Johnson's rotation algorithm for non-normal test matrices, evaluate max ||p(A)||/max_W|p| for random polynomials, and compare the ratios with the Crouzeix constant 1+√2.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Transient growth of acoustic energy in a Galerkin Rijke-tube thermoacoustic model
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build a linearized Galerkin Rijke-tube model with a time-lag heater approximated by a Padé delay, compute linearly stable eigenvalues, and find optimal transient energy amplification via the SVD of the propagator.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Leja-ordered Newton interpolation and divided-difference stability
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Interpolate test functions at Chebyshev nodes taken in increasing versus Leja order with Newton divided differences, and compare roundoff error growth and coefficient magnitudes with barycentric evaluation.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Padua-point bivariate interpolation and Lebesgue constant growth
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Construct Padua points on the square, solve the bivariate Chebyshev interpolation system, and estimate Lebesgue constants on fine grids, checking the O(log² n) growth against tensor Chebyshev and random points.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Optimal interpolation nodes by Lebesgue-function equioscillation
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Optimize interior interpolation nodes on [-1,1] so that the local maxima of the Lebesgue function equioscillate (Kilgore-de Boor), and compare the optimal Lebesgue constants with Chebyshev and extended-Chebyshev nodes for n ≤ 20.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Equispaced least-squares polynomial fitting with degree near √N
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Fit equispaced samples of Runge-type functions by least-squares Legendre polynomials of degree n, and map the stability-convergence trade-off as n/√N varies, following the Rakhmanov and Platte-Trefethen-Kuijlaars bounds.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Vandermonde with Arnoldi for stable high-degree polynomial fitting
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement the Brubeck-Nakatsukasa-Trefethen Vandermonde-with-Arnoldi least-squares fit and its evaluation recurrence, and compare accuracy with monomial Vandermonde fits on equispaced and Chebyshev data up to degree 100.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Lebesgue constant of trigonometric interpolation and Dirichlet kernel growth
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute the Lebesgue function of equispaced trigonometric interpolation from Dirichlet kernel sums, verify the (2/π)log N growth, and show the near-best errors this gives for periodic functions with jumps or kinks.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Trigonometric interpolation and periodic trapezoidal rule

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Hale-Higham-Trefethen conformal-map contour quadrature for matrix square roots
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Evaluate A^{1/2}b for SPD stiffness matrices with a trapezoidal rule on an elliptic-function conformal map of the annulus, and verify geometric convergence with a rate set by κ(A).
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Trigonometric interpolation and periodic trapezoidal rule

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Off-band square-lattice Green's function by Brillouin-zone trapezoidal sums
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Evaluate G(E) = (1/N²)Σ_k 1/(E − ε_k) for the square lattice outside the band with 2D periodic trapezoidal sums, verify geometric convergence set by the imaginary k-singularity, and compare with the elliptic-integral closed form.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Trigonometric interpolation and periodic trapezoidal rule

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Harmonic balance frequency response of the Duffing oscillator
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Represent periodic solutions by truncated Fourier series, evaluate nonlinear residuals via FFT collocation, solve with Newton and pseudo-arclength continuation, and trace the amplitude-frequency backbone with its fold points.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Trigonometric interpolation and periodic trapezoidal rule

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Spectral curvature, length and area of smooth closed curves by FFT
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Trigonometrically interpolate a superellipse or epicycloid boundary, compute derivatives spectrally, evaluate length, area and total curvature with the periodic trapezoidal rule, and confirm geometric convergence.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Trigonometric interpolation and periodic trapezoidal rule

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Minimum-deficiency versus minimum-degree orderings on small grid graphs
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement greedy minimum-degree and minimum-fill (deficiency) elimination via simulated elimination graphs, count Cholesky fill on small 2D grids and random planar graphs, and compare both with exhaustive optimum on tiny cases.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Perfect elimination orderings of chordal graphs by maximum cardinality search
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Use maximum cardinality search to find zero-fill orderings for chordal sparsity patterns (trees, k-trees, interval graphs), verify zero fill symbolically and numerically, and contrast with natural ordering fill.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Upwind versus downwind Gauss-Seidel ordering for convection-dominated transport
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Run Gauss-Seidel on upwind-discretized 2D convection-diffusion with rotating and unidirectional winds using flow-following versus reversed orderings, and relate the iteration counts to the triangular part capturing the convection.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Column ordering and R-factor fill in sparse QR for tomography least squares
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build a sparse ray-sum matrix for a small 2D tomography grid, predict the fill of R from the Cholesky structure of AᵀA under natural, column-RCM and minimum-degree column orderings, and confirm it with Givens QR.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Cuthill-McKee level slices for recursive Green's function transport
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Partition an irregularly shaped tight-binding quantum dot device into Cuthill-McKee level sets to obtain a block-tridiagonal Hamiltonian, run the recursive Green's function algorithm, and compute Landauer transmission and block-size cost.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Chebyshev Fermi-operator expansion for a disordered tight-binding density matrix
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Expand the Fermi-Dirac function of a scaled square-lattice Anderson Hamiltonian in Chebyshev polynomials, determine the degree needed versus inverse temperature, and measure the off-diagonal decay of the density matrix.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Morse oscillator bound states from colleague roots of a shooting mismatch
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build a Chebyshev interpolant in energy of the numerical shooting mismatch function for the Morse potential, find all bound-state energies as real colleague-matrix eigenvalues, and compare with the analytic levels.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Cantilever beam natural frequencies from colleague roots of cos·cosh + 1
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Interpolate the scaled characteristic function of a clamped-free Euler-Bernoulli beam with piecewise Chebyshev series, extract all roots on an interval via colleague matrices, and compare frequencies with asymptotic formulas.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Clenshaw-Curtis spectral integration matrices for second-kind Volterra equations
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build the Chebyshev-point indefinite-integration matrix by DCT-based Clenshaw-Curtis cumulative weights, solve linear Volterra integral equations of population and renewal type, and verify spectral convergence.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Davidson exact diagonalization of the half-filled Hubbard ring
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build the sparse Hubbard Hamiltonian for 6-10 sites in a fixed (N↑,N↓) sector, find the ground state with diagonally preconditioned Davidson, and compare energy and charge gap with Lanczos and the Bethe-ansatz trend.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Kogbetliantz two-sided Jacobi SVD and its quadratic convergence
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement Kogbetliantz 2×2 SVD rotations swept cyclically over square matrices, track the off-diagonal norm decay per sweep, and compare singular-value accuracy with LAPACK on graded matrices.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Falk-Langemeyer generalized Jacobi method for Kx = λMx
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement simultaneous congruence rotations that diagonalize both stiffness and mass matrices of a spring-mass chain, and compare natural frequencies and M-orthogonality with Cholesky-reduced solves.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Davidson spectral gap of the transverse-field Ising chain versus free fermions
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute the two lowest eigenvalues of the open transverse-field Ising chain (L ≤ 14) with block Davidson in the full spin basis, and compare the gap with the exact Jordan-Wigner free-fermion result across the critical point.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Wavelet shrinkage denoising of the Doppler test signal
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Apply a periodized Daubechies DWT to noisy Doppler and Blocks signals, compare VisuShrink universal hard and soft thresholds with SureShrink, and report the mean squared error versus noise level.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Sobolev regularity of Daubechies wavelets from transition operator spectra
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build the transition (Lawton) operator matrix from |m0|² filter coefficients, compute its spectral radius, and estimate the Sobolev smoothness exponent of D2N scaling functions versus N.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Shift invariance of stationary versus decimated wavelet transforms
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement the undecimated (à trous) Haar and D4 transform, measure subband energy variation under circular shifts against the decimated DWT, and compare cycle-spinning denoising gains.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Local Hölder exponents from wavelet coefficient decay across scales
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute DWT coefficients of signals with cusp singularities |x−x0|^α, and estimate α from log-scale regression of maximal coefficients in cones of influence, comparing different numbers of vanishing moments.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Daubechies filter construction by spectral factorization of the Bezout polynomial
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Form the Daubechies halfband polynomial, select minimum-phase roots via companion-matrix rootfinding, recover the filters h for N = 2-10, and verify orthonormality and vanishing moments with accuracy versus N.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Eckart projection of translations and rotations from a molecular Hessian
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build the mass-weighted Cartesian Hessian of a model force-field triatomic, project out the six rigid-body modes with an orthonormal Eckart basis, and compute harmonic frequencies and residual near-zero modes.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Markov generator embedding from credit transition matrices via matrix logarithm
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute the principal matrix logarithm of an annual rating transition matrix by inverse scaling and squaring, detect negative off-diagonal rates, and repair them by projection onto valid generators, measuring the fit error.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Log-Euclidean versus affine-invariant interpolation of diffusion tensors
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Interpolate SPD diffusion tensors along a path using eigendecomposition-based matrix log/exp and affine-invariant geodesics, and compare determinant swelling and fractional anisotropy against linear interpolation.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Lynch-Rice-Thomas fast diagonalization solver for 3D Poisson on tensor grids
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Solve a 3D Poisson problem on a nonuniform tensor-product grid by separately diagonalizing the 1D generalized eigenproblems and applying them mode by mode, and verify accuracy and O(n⁴) cost against sparse direct solves.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Kåsa, Pratt and Taubin algebraic circle fits via generalized eigenproblems
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Fit circles to noisy arc data with the linear Kåsa fit and the constrained Pratt and Taubin generalized eigenvalue formulations, and compare radius bias versus arc length against geometric Gauss-Newton fits.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Least-squares refinement of crystal lattice parameters from powder d-spacings
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Fit metric tensor components of a monoclinic cell linearly to 1/d² values of indexed reflections, convert them to lattice parameters with error propagation from the covariance matrix, and assess the conditioning of the design.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Rotation matrices for real spherical harmonics via Ivanic-Ruedenberg recursion
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build real-spherical-harmonic rotation matrices up to l = 10 by recursion from the 3×3 rotation, and verify orthogonality, the group property, and agreement with rotating sampled functions on the sphere.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Cayley Crank-Nicolson propagation of Bloch oscillations in a tilted lattice
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Propagate a Gaussian wavepacket in a tight-binding chain under a static field with the unitary Cayley transform via banded solves, and verify the Bloch period, oscillation amplitude and norm conservation.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Tight-binding chain parameters recovered from end-site local density of states via Lanczos
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Given the discrete spectral measure (eigenvalues and squared first components) at the end site of a finite tight-binding chain, reconstruct on-site energies and hoppings with Lanczos/Stieltjes. Check the result against the true chain and test how sensitive it is to noise in the weights.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Inverse eigenvalue problems and Jacobi matrices

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Discrete Schrödinger lattice potential from Dirichlet and Robin-end spectra (Hochstadt-Hald)
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build the Jacobi matrix of a 1D lattice Schrödinger operator from two interlacing spectra that differ only in the last diagonal entry. Recover the spectral weights from the two characteristic polynomials, apply Lanczos, verify uniqueness, and show that reconstruction fails when interlacing is violated.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Inverse eigenvalue problems and Jacobi matrices

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: HITS hub and authority scores by power iteration on a citation network
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build a synthetic directed citation graph and compute hub and authority vectors by power iteration on A Aᵀ and Aᵀ A. Compare the observed linear convergence rate with the ratio λ₂/λ₁ and check the result against SVD singular vectors.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Power, inverse and Rayleigh quotient iteration

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Generalized Rayleigh quotient iteration for tapered-bar finite-element axial vibration modes
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Assemble stiffness and mass matrices for an axially vibrating tapered bar. Find the fundamental and an interior mode by shifted inverse iteration and by generalized RQI on Kx=λMx, then measure linear versus cubic convergence orders from the eigenvalue error sequences.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Power, inverse and Rayleigh quotient iteration

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Alpert multiwavelet basis construction and sparse representation of piecewise-smooth functions
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Construct Alpert's piecewise-polynomial multiwavelets of order k by orthogonalizing against moments with QR/SVD, then verify orthonormality and vanishing moments. Apply the multiresolution transform to a function with a discontinuity and count the significant coefficients per level.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Aasen LTLᵀ tridiagonal factorization of an indefinite finite-difference Helmholtz matrix
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement Aasen's pivoted symmetric factorization PAPᵀ=LTLᵀ for a 1D/2D Helmholtz matrix with interior eigenvalues on both sides of zero. Solve linear systems with it, compute inertia via the tridiagonal T, and compare growth and residuals with Bunch-Kaufman.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Cholesky and LDL^T for symmetric systems

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Cholesky of Ledoit-Wolf shrunk covariance for minimum-variance portfolio weights
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: From synthetic asset returns with fewer observations than assets, detect Cholesky failure of the sample covariance. Apply Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage toward a scaled identity and compute global minimum-variance weights via Cholesky solves, then report the condition number versus shrinkage intensity.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Cholesky and LDL^T for symmetric systems

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Detecting mechanisms in pin-jointed planar trusses via Cholesky pivot failure
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Assemble the global stiffness matrix of a 2D truss from bar elements and apply support constraints. Attempt Cholesky factorization and identify loss of positive definiteness when a bar is removed. Recover the mechanism mode from the null space and compute nodal displacements for a stable configuration.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Cholesky and LDL^T for symmetric systems

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Divergence-free matrix-valued RBF interpolation of a 2D incompressible velocity field
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build the matrix-valued kernel Φ=(−ΔI+∇∇ᵀ)φ from a Gaussian or inverse multiquadric and solve the 2n×2n interpolation system for scattered samples of a Taylor-Green-type flow. Verify analytic divergence-freeness of the interpolant and compare its error with componentwise scalar RBF interpolation.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Preconditioned MINRES for distributed optimal control of the Poisson equation
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Assemble the 3×3 block KKT saddle-point system for tracking-type optimal control with regularization β using finite differences or P1 elements. Solve with MINRES and the Rees-Dollar-Wathen block-diagonal preconditioner, showing that iteration counts are independent of mesh size and reporting how they depend on β.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: MINRES and SYMMLQ for symmetric indefinite systems

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Denman-Beavers versus plain Newton iteration for covariance matrix square roots
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute the principal square root of ill-conditioned SPD covariance matrices with unstable plain Newton, Denman-Beavers and product-form DB iterations. Track the residual ‖X²−A‖ and show error growth in plain Newton. Apply the result to whitening correlated samples.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Matrix functions: exponential, logarithm, square root

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Parlett recurrence breakdown versus blocked Schur-Parlett for nearly confluent eigenvalues
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Evaluate exp and sqrt of upper-triangular and Schur-reduced matrices with clustered eigenvalues using the scalar Parlett recurrence. Compare with a blocked Schur-Parlett scheme that uses Taylor series on diagonal blocks and Sylvester solves off the diagonal, and measure relative errors against high-precision references.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Matrix functions: exponential, logarithm, square root

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Inverse scaling-and-squaring matrix logarithm for geodesic interpolation of rigid-body rotations
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Implement logm by repeated square roots followed by a Padé approximant, and compare it with the Rodrigues closed form for rotation matrices near angle π. Use log/exp to interpolate orientations along SO(3) geodesics, verifying orthogonality and constant angular velocity.
math/nla_approx|linalg.area: Matrix functions: exponential, logarithm, square root

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Tinney scheme-2 minimum-degree ordering for power-network admittance matrix factorization
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Build the sparse nodal admittance matrix of a synthetic radial-plus-meshed transmission grid. Implement Tinney-Walker scheme-1 (static degree) and scheme-2 (dynamic minimum degree) orderings, then count LU fill-ins and flops against natural ordering.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Block triangular form via maximum transversal and Tarjan SCC for process flowsheets
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: For the sparsity pattern of a chemical process flowsheet's steady-state equations, find a zero-free diagonal by bipartite matching. Permute to block lower-triangular form using strongly connected components, then report the sizes of irreducible blocks and the reduction in fill and work for the sequential solve.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Monotone B-spline regression of a dose-response curve via constrained least squares
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Evaluate cubic B-spline bases with Cox-de Boor recursion. Fit noisy sigmoidal dose-response data under coefficient-difference monotonicity constraints using NNLS on a reparametrization, then report the EC50 and the fit residual compared with unconstrained least squares.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Lyche-Mørken knot removal for data reduction of a densely knotted B-spline
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Starting from a cubic spline interpolant with many knots, rank knots by weighted removal error using discrete least-squares approximation onto reduced spaces. Remove knots greedily to a tolerance and report retained knots versus the max-norm error.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Comparative generalized SVD of two synthetic gene-expression datasets
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute the GSVD of two matrices that share gene rows, using QR plus CS-decomposition steps. Identify generalized singular vectors exclusive to each dataset or common to both via angular distances, and recover planted dataset-specific patterns.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Principal angles between essential subspaces of two molecular-dynamics trajectory halves
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Compute PCA subspaces from the coordinate covariance of two halves of a synthetic Langevin trajectory. Obtain principal angles via the Björck-Golub QR+SVD method, compare with the unstable cosine-only approach for small angles, and report root-mean-square inner product overlap as a convergence diagnostic.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Linear noise approximation covariance of a gene regulatory network via Bartels-Stewart
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: For a linearized mRNA-protein network with feedback, solve the Lyapunov equation J Σ + Σ Jᵀ + D = 0 by Schur-based Bartels-Stewart. Report Fano factors and correlation coefficients, and check them against Gillespie simulation moments.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Harris-Engerholm-Gwinn DVR from harmonic-basis position-matrix diagonalization for a Morse-free anharmonic well
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the position operator in a truncated harmonic-oscillator basis to obtain DVR points and the transformation. Build the kinetic matrix analytically and the potential diagonally for a quartic-plus-cubic well, then compare levels with a large finite-basis variational reference.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Roothaan-Hall SCF for HeH⁺ in STO-3G with Löwdin orthogonalization and DIIS
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Using provided one- and two-electron integrals, run the closed-shell SCF via symmetric orthogonalization S^{-1/2} and Fock diagonalization. Accelerate with DIIS by solving the bordered least-squares system on commutator error vectors, then report the converged energy and iteration counts.

math/nla_approx|linalg.title: Massey least-squares team ratings from game margins via graph Laplacian
math/nla_approx|linalg.gist: Form the normal equations of a pairwise-comparison least-squares problem from synthetic season results; the normal-equation matrix is a graph Laplacian. Impose a sum-to-zero constraint by replacing one row or by pseudoinverse, solve, and study rating sensitivity through the Fiedler value of the schedule graph.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Pauli transfer matrix and chi matrix of a coherent over-rotation gate
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: For an X gate with over-rotation angle ε followed by depolarizing noise, compute the Liouville superoperator, the Pauli transfer matrix and the process (chi) matrix in the Pauli basis. Report the process fidelity with the ideal gate.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Detecting non-CP maps: transpose-mixed qubit channel Choi spectrum
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Study the family Φ_p(ρ) = (1-p)ρ + pρ^T/(something normalized). Build its Choi matrix, find the critical p at which the minimum Choi eigenvalue crosses zero, and confirm that the map stays positive but stops being completely positive.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Channel composition via Liouville multiplication versus Kraus concatenation for qutrits
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compose a qutrit dephasing channel with a qutrit amplitude-damping (V-type decay) channel. Do this once by multiplying 9x9 Liouville matrices and once by taking products of Kraus operators, then check that the resulting Choi matrices agree and compute the Kraus rank.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Ideal two-qubit process tomography reconstruction of a noisy CNOT chi matrix
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate the outputs of a CNOT followed by local depolarizing noise on the 16 tomographically complete product inputs. Reconstruct the 16x16 chi matrix by linear inversion in the Pauli basis and report the process fidelity and the dominant error terms.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Unital and entanglement-breaking tests for Pauli channels from Choi matrix
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Parametrize a qubit Pauli channel by (p_x, p_y, p_z). Compute its Choi state, test unitality, and test entanglement breaking using PPT of the Choi state (exact for qubits). Map the entanglement-breaking region of the tetrahedron on a grid.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Diamond-norm distance between unitary and dephased gates via SDP-free formula
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the diamond distance between a qubit rotation and its noisy version. Obtain a lower bound by optimizing the trace norm of the Choi-matrix difference over input states, using a parametrized maximally-entangled-to-product sweep. Compare with the closed form for unitaries, which uses the numerical range of U†V.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Lindblad generator to superoperator exponential: Choi of finite-time qubit evolution
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Vectorize a Lindbladian with detuning, decay and pure dephasing into a 4x4 Liouvillian. Exponentiate it to obtain the channel at time t, convert to the Choi matrix, and extract T1/T2 decay of the Pauli transfer matrix entries.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: General partial trace over arbitrary subsystems via tensor reshaping
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Implement a partial trace for an n-qudit register with mixed local dimensions using reshape/einsum. Apply it to the 5-qubit AKLT-like or GHZ+W superposition and verify all 1- and 2-body marginals against analytic results.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Entanglement entropy profile of a random matrix product state
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Generate a random open-boundary MPS of bond dimension χ on 10 qubits and contract it to a state vector. Compute the reduced density matrix for every bipartition cut via partial trace and verify the bound S ≤ log χ.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Quantum mutual information and conditional entropy in a four-qubit cluster state
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build the linear cluster state with CZ gates. Compute all pairwise quantum mutual informations and conditional entropies S(A|B) from partial traces, and identify subsystem pairs with negative conditional entropy.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Marginal compatibility of Dicke state reduced density matrices
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Construct the N-qubit Dicke states |D_N^k⟩ and compute their m-body reduced density matrices by partial tracing. Verify permutation symmetry, and compare the two-qubit concurrence with the analytic formula as a function of N and k.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Bipartite entanglement negativity after partial transpose in a mixed spin chain
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the thermal state of a 6-site Heisenberg XXZ chain. Trace out the outer sites to obtain a two-block state, take the partial transpose of one block, and evaluate the logarithmic negativity versus temperature to find the sudden-death temperature.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Operator Schmidt decomposition of two-qubit gates via realignment
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Realign the 4x4 unitary of CNOT, iSWAP, sqrt-SWAP and a random gate to compute the operator Schmidt coefficients. Report the Schmidt rank and the operator entanglement entropy, and relate these to the Cartan (KAK) coefficients.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Holevo quantity of superdense coding ensemble under amplitude damping
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Send Alice's half of a Bell pair through amplitude damping before encoding. Compute the Holevo quantity of the four equiprobable encoded states and compare it with the mutual information of the Bell measurement, as a function of γ.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Dense coding capacity for qutrit pairs with Weyl-Heisenberg encodings
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Generalize superdense coding to d=3 using the clock and shift operators on a noisy maximally entangled state. Compute the dense coding capacity log d + S(ρ_B) - S(ρ_AB) and verify that the Holevo quantity of the d^2 encoded states attains it.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: When does a noisy resource beat classical: dense-coding advantage threshold
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: For Bell-diagonal states with weights (λ1..λ4), compute the dense coding capacity and find the region where it exceeds 1 bit. Compare this region with the region where the states are entangled and with the coherent-information positivity region.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Superdense coding with locally depolarized encoding and dephased transmission
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Model noise on Alice's Pauli encoding gates (depolarizing) and on the transmitted qubit (dephasing). Compute the Bell-measurement error matrix, and compute the mutual information optimized over the input prior with the Blahut–Arimoto algorithm.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Pretty-good measurement decoding for dense coding with non-maximally entangled states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Use the resource cosθ|00⟩+sinθ|11⟩ with Pauli encodings. Construct the pretty-good measurement for the four encoded states and compute its success probability. Compare with the Helstrom-type bound and with the Holevo quantity versus θ.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Distributed dense coding with GHZ resource and two senders
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Two senders each encode Paulis on their qubits of a three-qubit GHZ state with local dephasing, and a receiver holds the third qubit. Compute the Holevo information of the joint ensemble and of each sender's marginal ensemble.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Entanglement-assisted classical capacity of the qubit depolarizing channel
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the Bennett-Shor-Smolin-Thapliyal capacity max_ρ I(A;B) for the depolarizing channel by evaluating the quantum mutual information of a purified input, using symmetry so the maximally mixed input is optimal. Compare with the Holevo capacity to quantify the dense-coding gain.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: GRAPE for single-qubit X gate with amplitude constraints
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Optimize N piecewise-constant x/y control amplitudes for H = Δσz/2 + u_x σx/2 + u_y σy/2 to maximize gate fidelity |Tr(U_target†U)|²/4. Use analytic first-order GRAPE gradients with amplitude clipping, and report the converged fidelity.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: GRAPE optimization of a CZ gate for two coupled transmons
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Model two qubits with fixed ZZ coupling and local xy drives. Use GRAPE with exact gradients through the propagator derivative (augmented-matrix exponential) to reach a CZ gate up to single-qubit phases, and report the infidelity versus total time.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: DRAG-like pulses from GRAPE on a three-level transmon
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Include the leakage level with anharmonicity α and optimize X-gate controls that act within the computational subspace. Compute subspace gate fidelity and leakage population, and compare the optimal quadrature with the DRAG derivative shape.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: State-transfer GRAPE in a three-spin Heisenberg chain
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Transfer an excitation from spin 1 to spin 3 of an XX chain using local z-field controls on the middle spin. Maximize the transfer fidelity |⟨ψ_target|U|ψ_0⟩|² with GRAPE and compare against the uncontrolled transfer.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Open-system GRAPE for a qubit under T1 and T2 via Liouvillian propagators
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Optimize controls for a Hadamard gate in the presence of Lindblad decay, using superoperator propagators and the average gate fidelity from the Choi or Pauli transfer matrix. Show the tradeoff between gate duration and decoherence.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Robust GRAPE against detuning ensemble for NMR inversion pulse
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Maximize the average fidelity of a π pulse over a distribution of detunings and amplitude scalings (ensemble GRAPE). Use averaged gradients, then evaluate the fidelity landscape over the inhomogeneity grid.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Krotov versus GRAPE convergence for Λ-system population transfer
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Implement both GRAPE and Krotov first-order updates for STIRAP-like transfer in a three-level Λ system with pump and Stokes controls. Compare the convergence of the target-state population and the intermediate-state occupation.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Spectrally filtered GRAPE controls with bandwidth penalty
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Add a penalty on squared differences of adjacent amplitudes to the GRAPE cost for a √iSWAP gate on two qubits with XY coupling. Compute fidelity versus smoothness weight and the power spectrum of the optimal pulses.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Quantum Fourier transform circuit from Hadamards and controlled phases
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Assemble the n-qubit QFT unitary from H and controlled-R_k gates with bit reversal. Verify it against the DFT matrix, and compute the circuit fidelity when gates with small angle k > k_max are dropped (approximate QFT).
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Quantum Fourier transform and phase estimation

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Phase estimation outcome distribution with finite t-qubit ancilla
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate QPE for a unitary eigenphase φ not representable in t bits. Compute the full outcome distribution, the probability of an estimate within error ε, and compare with the Nielsen-Chuang bound on the number of extra ancilla qubits.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Quantum Fourier transform and phase estimation

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Phase estimation of the H2 molecule ground-state energy
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Use a 2-qubit reduced H2 Hamiltonian in the STO-3G minimal basis (given Pauli coefficients) with U = e^{-iHt}. Run QPE from a Hartree-Fock input with t ancillas, and extract the energy distribution and the ground-state overlap probability.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Quantum Fourier transform and phase estimation

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Shor order finding for N=15 and N=21 via QPE simulation
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Construct the modular multiplication permutation unitary, simulate the phase-estimation register distribution for base a, and recover the order through continued fractions. Report the success probability of correctly factoring.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Quantum Fourier transform and phase estimation

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Kitaev iterative phase estimation under depolarizing noise
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate single-ancilla iterative QPE with feedback phase correction, with depolarizing noise on the ancilla at each round. Compute the bitwise error probabilities and the distribution of the final phase estimate.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Quantum Fourier transform and phase estimation

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Bayesian phase estimation with Heisenberg-limited scaling
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Perform adaptive single-ancilla experiments with controlled-U^k and a phase offset, and update a gridded posterior over φ. Show that the RMSE scales with total evolution time T as 1/T, approaching the Heisenberg limit.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Quantum Fourier transform and phase estimation

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Entanglement generated across a QFT circuit on product inputs
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Track bipartite entanglement entropy after each controlled-phase layer of the QFT for random product inputs and for periodic states. Quantify the low entanglement of QFT outputs that motivates MPS simulations.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Quantum Fourier transform and phase estimation

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Phase estimation with an imperfect eigenstate input and spectral weights
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Feed QPE a superposition of eigenstates of a 3-qubit Heisenberg ring evolution operator. Compute the outcome distribution as a mixture weighted by overlaps, and how projection probabilities onto each eigenvalue depend on t.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Quantum Fourier transform and phase estimation

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Depth-1 QAOA MaxCut on a 3-regular 8-vertex graph
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate |γ,β⟩ = e^{-iβB}e^{-iγC}|+⟩^n with the statevector method. Compute the expected cut, grid-search and refine (γ, β), and compare the approximation ratio with the 0.6924 bound for 3-regular graphs.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: QAOA depth scaling on ring graphs with INTERP angle initialization
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: For MaxCut on a 10-vertex ring, optimize QAOA for p=1..5 using interpolation-based initialization from p-1 angles and BFGS. Report the approximation ratio versus p and the (p+1)/(p+2) pattern.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Weighted MaxCut QAOA with shot-noise sampled objective
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: For a random weighted graph, estimate the cost from sampled bitstrings at N shots and optimize with COBYLA or SPSA. Compare the sampled best cut and the success probability of the exact optimum against noiseless expectation optimization.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: QAOA under depolarizing noise: density-matrix simulation of expected cut
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Apply single-qubit depolarizing channels after each layer on a 6-vertex graph using a density-matrix simulation. Show how the optimal p shifts and how the expected cut decays exponentially with circuit depth.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: QAOA for Max-Independent-Set with XY-mixer constrained dynamics
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Encode MIS with a penalty Hamiltonian versus a constraint-preserving mixer on small graphs. Compute the expected independent-set size and the feasibility probability after p=1,2, comparing the two mixers.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Number partitioning with QAOA on Ising Hamiltonian
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Map a set of 8 integers to H = (Σ s_i a_i)^2 and run QAOA at p=1..3. Compute the probability of sampling an optimal partition and the residual energy versus depth.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Barren-plateau-free check: gradient variance of QAOA versus hardware-efficient ansatz
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the variance of the cost gradient over random parameters for MaxCut QAOA and for a random layered ansatz, as functions of qubit number (4-10). Use parameter-shift gradients.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Warm-start QAOA from rounded Goemans-Williamson-like relaxation
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Solve the MaxCut SDP-free continuous relaxation with gradient ascent on angles on the unit circle. Use it to bias initial qubit states and the mixer, and compare the p=1 approximation ratio against standard QAOA.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Interleaved randomized benchmarking for a coherent Z over-rotation
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Run standard and interleaved RB with a target S gate that has a small coherent over-rotation. Extract the interleaved gate error estimate and its bounds, and compare against the exact average gate infidelity.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Gate-dependent noise and RB decay: amplitude damping on Clifford generators
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Apply amplitude damping only after the H and S generators when Cliffords are decomposed into native gates. Compute the RB decay curve by sequence averaging, fit it, and compare with the average error per Clifford computed from twirling.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Exact RB decay from twirled channel versus Monte Carlo sequences
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Twirl a noisy channel over the single-qubit Clifford group to obtain its depolarizing parameter. Compare the analytic decay curve with Monte Carlo averages over finite numbers of random sequences, and quantify the confidence interval in r.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Two-qubit Clifford group enumeration and RB with crosstalk noise
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Generate the 11520-element two-qubit Clifford group by breadth-first search over generators, modulo phase. Simulate RB with correlated ZZ crosstalk error and fit the decay to obtain the error per two-qubit Clifford.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Leakage randomized benchmarking on a qutrit-embedded qubit
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Embed single-qubit Cliffords in a three-level system with a small leakage rate to |2⟩. Fit both the computational-subspace population decay and the survival probability to extract leakage and seepage rates.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Unitarity benchmarking: separating coherent from incoherent errors
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate purity benchmarking sequences that measure Σ⟨P⟩² after random Clifford sequences. Fit the unitarity decay u^(m-1) and compare u with the unitarity of the error channel, for mixed coherent rotation plus dephasing.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Simultaneous randomized benchmarking detecting addressability errors
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Run independent and simultaneous single-qubit RB on two qubits whose errors are correlated by a conditional ZZ coupling during gates. Compute the individual and joint decay parameters, and the correlation measure δ.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Two-point measurement work distribution for a driven qubit quench
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: For a sudden quench H0 → H1 of a thermal qubit, compute the TPM work distribution P(W) and its characteristic function. Verify the Jarzynski equality ⟨e^{-βW}⟩ = e^{-βΔF} and the Crooks relation.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Work statistics in a transverse-field Ising quench across criticality
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the TPM work distribution and the Loschmidt echo for a 8-site TFIM quench from field h0 to h1 by exact diagonalization. Analyze the variance of work and the edge singularity near the critical field.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Quantum Otto engine efficiency with a coupled two-spin working medium
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Cycle a two-qubit Heisenberg-coupled working medium through adiabatic field changes and thermalizations with two baths. Compute heat, work and efficiency, and compare with the Otto and Carnot bounds versus coupling strength.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Charging power of a collective quantum battery of N spins
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Charge N two-level cells either in parallel with local drives or collectively with a global all-to-all charging Hamiltonian. Compute the stored ergotropy versus time and the maximal power, demonstrating the collective advantage scaling.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Three-level maser heat engine steady-state power from Lindblad dynamics
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Model the Scovil-Schulz-DuBois three-level engine coupled to hot and cold baths and a classical drive. Solve the steady-state Lindblad equation, then compute heat currents, output power and efficiency, checking that efficiency equals ω_s/ω_h.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Thermal operations and majorization: reachable states of a qutrit
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute thermomajorization (Lorenz) curves for diagonal qutrit states under a Gibbs state. Decide convertibility between pairs of states and compute the free energy differences that bound work extraction.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Entropy production in a qubit relaxing to equilibrium: relative entropy decomposition
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Evolve a qubit under a thermal amplitude-damping Lindbladian. Compute the entropy production Σ = D(ρ0||ρ_eq) - D(ρ_t||ρ_eq), and split it into population and coherence contributions.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: DEJMPS distillation of Bell-diagonal states with local rotations
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Implement DEJMPS on four Bell-diagonal coefficients, with the bilateral π/2 rotations, bilateral CNOT, and measurement post-selection, by explicit 16x16 density-matrix simulation. Compare its convergence rate with BBPSSW.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Entanglement pumping with fixed auxiliary pairs in a repeater node
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Repeatedly purify a target pair using fresh auxiliary Werner pairs of fixed fidelity (Dür-Briegel pumping). Compute the saturation fidelity and the number of rounds needed, compared to symmetric recurrence.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Entanglement swapping plus purification in a two-link quantum repeater
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Combine swapping of two Werner pairs with a Bell measurement, including depolarizing gate errors. Compute the end-to-end fidelity, then apply DEJMPS rounds and compute the final fidelity and resource cost per output pair.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Filtering (Procrustean) distillation of single-copy non-maximally entangled states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Apply local filtering operations to cosθ|00⟩+sinθ|11⟩ mixed with noise. Optimize the filter to maximize the post-selected fidelity, and compute the success probability-fidelity tradeoff, including Gisin's hidden nonlocality example.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Distillable entanglement bounds: coherent information versus relative entropy of entanglement
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: For isotropic two-qutrit states, compute the hashing lower bound (coherent information) and the relative entropy of entanglement upper bound in closed form using the isotropic symmetry. Map the gap between the bounds versus fidelity.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: GHZ-state purification for three-party networks
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Implement the multipartite recurrence protocol of Aschauer-Dür-Briegel on noisy GHZ states diagonal in the GHZ basis. Iterate subprotocols P1/P2 and track fidelity and success probability.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: RHP divisibility measure for Jaynes-Cummings damped qubit
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: For the exactly solvable amplitude-damping qubit with Lorentzian spectral density, compute G(t) and the intermediate maps Λ(t+ε,t) from Choi matrices. Integrate the RHP trace-norm excess to quantify non-Markovianity versus the coupling/width ratio.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Eternally non-Markovian Pauli channel: negative rates yet CP dynamics
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate the Hall-Cresser-Li-Andersson model with a decay rate γ3(t) = -tanh(t)/2. Verify complete positivity of the dynamical map via the Choi matrix for all t and RHP non-divisibility, and show the BLP measure vanishes.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Qubit coupled to a damped harmonic mode: pseudomode simulation of revivals
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Model non-Markovian decay by embedding a lossy cavity mode (pseudomode) with a Lindblad equation and trace it out. Compute the trace-distance revivals and the BLP measure versus coupling, matching the exact Lorentzian result.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Collision model memory: correlated ancillas and information backflow
