physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build a collision model where a system qubit interacts via partial SWAP with ancillas that also collide among themselves. Compute the reduced dynamics by repeated partial traces and the BLP measure versus intra-ancilla collision strength.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Entanglement-based non-Markovianity: concurrence revivals with an ancilla
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Evolve one half of a Bell state under a non-Markovian dephasing channel. Compute the concurrence with the untouched partner, and quantify non-Markovianity by integrating its increases, comparing with the BLP measure.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Time-local generator reconstruction from dynamical maps
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: From the Liouville matrix Λ(t) of a numerically simulated spin-bath model (central spin + 4 bath spins), compute L(t) = dΛ/dt Λ⁻¹. Extract the canonical decay rates and detect negative rates as signatures of non-Markovianity.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Fidelity-based and mutual-information non-Markovianity for central spin model
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: For a qubit coupled to N bath spins by Heisenberg XX interactions, compute the reduced dynamics exactly. Evaluate the quantum mutual information between the system and a reference ancilla and its increases (Luo-Fu-Song measure) versus N.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Three-qubit bit-flip code under amplitude damping: logical fidelity
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Encode a logical qubit, apply independent amplitude damping, and perform syndrome measurement with Kraus projectors and correction. Compute the logical channel's Choi matrix and its entanglement fidelity versus γ, compared with an unencoded qubit.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Local adiabatic (Roland-Cerf) schedule for adiabatic Grover search
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Integrate the Schrödinger equation for H(s)=(1-s)(1-|ψ0⟩⟨ψ0|)+s(1-|m⟩⟨m|) on n qubits with linear versus gap-adapted local schedules. Compute final success probability versus total time T and show √N versus N scaling.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Exact-cover 3-SAT instance: minimum gap and adiabatic success probability
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build the problem Hamiltonian of a random exact-cover instance with a unique solution on 8-10 qubits. Interpolate from a transverse-field driver, find the minimum spectral gap by sparse diagonalization along s, and compare success probability with the Landau-Zener-type estimate.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Diabatic error scaling with boundary-cancelling annealing schedules
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: For a two-qubit interpolating Hamiltonian, compute the final ground-state infidelity versus T for schedules whose first k derivatives vanish at the endpoints. Extract the asymptotic power law T^{-2(k+1)} from log-log fits.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Fair sampling of degenerate ground states in a frustrated Ising annealer
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Anneal a small frustrated antiferromagnetic Ising cluster with degenerate classical ground states under a transverse field. Compute the final probability distribution over degenerate ground states and its deviation from uniform, using perturbative and exact spectra.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Reverse annealing from a classical state on a small spin glass
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Start from a chosen classical configuration and evolve with s(t) going from 1 to s_p and back for a random 6-spin Sherrington-Kirkpatrick instance. Compute ground-state probability versus turning point s_p and pause time.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Open-system quantum annealing with dephasing in the instantaneous eigenbasis
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate the adiabatic master equation for a 4-qubit annealing problem with Lindblad dephasing. Find the optimal annealing time that balances diabatic and decoherent errors of the final ground-state population.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Counterdiabatic driving for a two-qubit Ising annealing protocol
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the exact counterdiabatic Hamiltonian i∑|∂n⟩⟨n| from the instantaneous eigenvectors of a 2-qubit interpolation. Evolve with and without it, and compare fidelity versus T and the integrated control cost.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: First-order transition in the ferromagnetic p-spin model annealing gap
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: In the symmetric Dicke subspace, diagonalize H(s)=-(1-s)Sx-sN(2Sz/N)^p for p=3. Compute the exponentially closing minimum gap versus N, and contrast it with p=2.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: XX catalyst effect on minimum gap in a weighted MIS instance
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Add a non-stoquastic XX catalyst term to the annealing Hamiltonian of a small weighted maximum-independent-set graph with a perturbative crossing. Scan catalyst strength and compute the minimum gap and adiabatic success probability.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Adiabatic preparation of a Heisenberg chain ground state from dimers
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Interpolate from a product-of-singlets dimer Hamiltonian to the uniform antiferromagnetic Heisenberg ring of 8-10 spins. Compute final fidelity, energy error and half-chain entanglement entropy versus ramp time.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Adiabatic Z2 ordering in a Rydberg blockade chain
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Sweep the detuning of a PXP-like Rydberg chain Hamiltonian with Rabi drive for 8-10 atoms. Compute the final overlap with the Néel Z2 state, the staggered magnetization and the minimum gap along the sweep.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Wolf-Cirac Markovianity test of a qubit channel via matrix logarithm
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Given a qubit channel's Liouville matrix, enumerate branches of its matrix logarithm. Test whether any branch is a valid Lindblad generator (Hermiticity-preserving, conditionally completely positive), and apply the test to channels from damped Rabi dynamics.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: P-divisibility versus CP-divisibility for phase-covariant qubit channels
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: For phase-covariant master equations with time-dependent rates γ±, γz, compute the RHP Choi-positivity witness and the BLP trace-distance derivative. Identify rate regimes where the dynamics is P-divisible but not CP-divisible.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Volume of accessible states measure for phase-covariant dynamics
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the determinant of the Bloch affine map of a time-dependent qubit channel as the accessible-state volume. Integrate its increases as a non-Markovianity measure, and compare it with BLP over the same rate families.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Initial system-environment correlations and trace-distance growth
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Evolve a qubit coupled to a qubit environment from correlated and from product initial states with equal reduced states. Compute the growth of trace distance above its initial value, witnessing initial correlations (Laine-Piilo-Breuer bound).

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Quantum Fisher information flow for a qubit in a detuned Lorentzian bath
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Use the exact amplitude-damping solution with detuned Lorentzian spectral density. Compute the QFI of a phase encoded in the qubit versus time, and its backflow intervals as a non-Markovianity indicator.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Non-Markovianity from convex mixing of Markovian Pauli semigroups
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Construct convex combinations of dephasing semigroups along different Pauli axes and compute the induced time-local rates. Evaluate RHP and BLP measures, showing memory effects emerge from mixing Markovian maps.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Exchange-coupled environment qubit: entropy oscillations and BLP measure
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Couple a system qubit to one or two environment qubits via XX exchange and compute the exact reduced dynamics. Evaluate the von Neumann entropy and the BLP measure maximized over antipodal Bloch-sphere pairs by numerical optimization.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Channel-capacity revivals as a non-Markovianity witness for dephasing
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: For a time-dependent qubit dephasing channel with oscillating decoherence function, compute the entanglement-assisted classical capacity and quantum capacity versus time. Integrate the capacity increases as a memory measure.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: BB84 under intercept-resend attack: Monte Carlo QBER and Eve information
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate BB84 qubit preparation, random-basis intercept-resend by Eve with probability p, Bob measurement and sifting. Compute QBER, Eve's mutual information with the sifted key, and the analytic 25% limit.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Devetak-Winter key rate for BB84 from purified Bell-diagonal states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Purify a Bell-diagonal Alice-Bob state to Eve, compute the classical-quantum state after Alice's Z measurement, and evaluate H(X|E)-H(X|Y) numerically. Compare with the analytic formula as a function of the Bell-diagonal parameters.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Device-independent QKD key rate from CHSH violation
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Evaluate the Acín et al. collective-attack DIQKD bound r=1-h(Q)-h((1+√(S²/4-1))/2) using CHSH and QBER from simulated noisy two-qubit states. Find the visibility threshold for positive key.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Optimal phase-covariant cloner attack on BB84
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Construct the Bruss-Cinchetti phase-covariant cloner as an isometry. Compute Bob's QBER and Eve's information from her clone versus the cloning angle, and find where Eve's information equals Bob's.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: B92 protocol under unambiguous state discrimination attack
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: For two nonorthogonal states with overlap cos θ, compute Bob's conclusive rate, the USD success probability 1-|⟨ψ0|ψ1⟩|, and the loss threshold beyond which an Eve performing USD and resending is undetectable.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Qubit MDI-QKD with untrusted Bell-state-measurement relay
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate Alice and Bob sending BB84 states through depolarizing and misaligned channels to a linear-optics BSM that resolves only ψ± outcomes. Compute post-selected QBERs in Z and X and the asymptotic key rate.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Entropic uncertainty with quantum memory: BB84 key rate bound
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Evaluate the Berta et al. bound H(X|E)+H(Z|B)≥log(1/c) for two-qubit states with Bob holding quantum memory. Compute the implied key rates and the tightness of the bound under depolarizing noise.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: GHZ-based quantum secret sharing (HBB99) error rates under noise
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate three-party GHZ measurements in random X/Y bases with local depolarizing noise. Compute the correlation-consistent sifting rate and the error rate, plus the change in error under an intercept-resend attack by one party.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: GRAPE Rydberg-blockade CZ gate with phase-only global laser control
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: In the perfect-blockade subspace of two atoms, optimize a piecewise-constant laser phase φ(t) at fixed Rabi frequency to realize CZ up to single-qubit phases. Compute the optimal fidelity versus gate duration.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: GRAPE GHZ preparation in a star-coupled spin cluster with global control
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: For a central spin Ising-coupled to three peripheral spins with only global x/y fields plus a central-spin field, optimize piecewise controls. Maximize fidelity with the 4-qubit GHZ state and report the minimal time reaching 0.99.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Exact GRAPE gradients via augmented-matrix Fréchet derivative
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute exact derivatives of exp(-iHΔt) using the block-triangular augmented exponential. Compare them with first-order GRAPE gradients for a two-qubit gate problem, measuring gradient error versus Δt and convergence speed.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: GRAPE electron-nuclear CNOT in an NV center with hyperfine coupling
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Model an NV electron spin-1 (two levels) coupled to a 15N nuclear spin via anisotropic hyperfine. Optimize microwave controls with GRAPE to realize a nuclear-controlled electron NOT, and report fidelity versus pulse length.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: GRAPE spin-squeezing preparation under one-axis twisting plus transverse drive
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Work in the symmetric subspace of N spins. Optimize a time-dependent transverse field combined with fixed χSz² twisting to minimize the Wineland squeezing parameter at fixed total time.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: GRAPE iSWAP with tunable XY coupling and parasitic ZZ
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Optimize piecewise flux-tunable XY coupling and local Z detunings for two qubits with an always-on ZZ crosstalk term. Compute the achievable iSWAP gate fidelity versus ZZ strength.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: SPAM-error bias in process tomography fidelity estimates
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Add state-preparation misrotation and readout bit-flip errors to single-qubit process tomography of an X gate. Quantify the bias of the reconstructed process fidelity, contrasted with SPAM-robust RB-style decays.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Direct fidelity estimation of a channel by Pauli sampling
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Implement the Flammia-Liu estimator for the entanglement fidelity of a noisy two-qubit gate, importance-sampling Pauli operators by their weight in the ideal Choi state. Compute estimator variance versus number of samples and shots.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Qutrit gate process tomography in the Gell-Mann basis
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Reconstruct the 9x9 χ matrix of a noisy qutrit Fourier gate in the Gell-Mann operator basis from simulated inputs and outputs. Compute process fidelity with the ideal gate.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Hamiltonian learning from process tomography of a two-qubit gate
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: From the reconstructed unitary or Choi matrix of an evolution exp(-iHt), extract H via the principal matrix logarithm. Project it onto two-qubit Pauli strings to estimate exchange couplings and local fields, with error versus shot noise.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Noisy photodetector POVM tomography
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Reconstruct the POVM elements of a qubit detector with dark counts and finite efficiency from outcome statistics on a tomographically complete set of probe states. Apply least squares with a positivity projection, and compute the effective measurement fidelity.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Block-diagonal versus full Fubini-Study metric for a layered ansatz
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: For a hardware-efficient RY-CZ ansatz on 4 qubits, compute the full quantum geometric tensor Re[⟨∂iψ|∂jψ⟩-⟨∂iψ|ψ⟩⟨ψ|∂jψ⟩] and its layerwise block-diagonal approximation. Compare natural-gradient update directions.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Quantum natural gradient and Fubini-Study metric

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Parameter-shift evaluation of the quantum metric tensor
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute metric-tensor entries for Pauli-rotation circuits from the four-term double parameter-shift formula on fidelities |⟨ψ(θ)|ψ(θ+s)⟩|². Validate against analytic statevector derivatives and against finite differences with shot noise.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Quantum natural gradient and Fubini-Study metric

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Variational imaginary-time evolution via McLachlan principle for H2
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Solve A θ̇=-C, where A is the real part of the QGT and C the energy gradient, for a two-qubit H2 Hamiltonian ansatz. Track energy versus imaginary time against exact exp(-Hτ) evolution.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Quantum natural gradient and Fubini-Study metric

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Bures-metric natural gradient for a noisy variational circuit
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: For a density-matrix ansatz with depolarizing noise after each layer, compute the mixed-state QFIM via SLD eigen-decomposition formulas. Use it for natural-gradient minimization and compare with pure-state QNG.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Quantum natural gradient and Fubini-Study metric

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: QFIM rank saturation and effective dimension of hardware-efficient ansätze
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the quantum Fisher information matrix rank at random parameters versus number of layers for n-qubit circuits. Identify overparameterization when the rank saturates at the dynamical Lie algebra dimension.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Quantum natural gradient and Fubini-Study metric

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Berry phase of a spin in a rotating field via discrete overlaps
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the Berry phase of spin-s ground states along a cone of half-angle θ using the gauge-invariant product of overlaps -arg∏⟨ψk|ψk+1⟩. Compare with -sΩ(θ) solid-angle formula, and verify with Fubini-Study integration.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Quantum natural gradient and Fubini-Study metric

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Multiparameter magnetometry: QFIM and quantum Cramér-Rao bound
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: For a three-qubit probe evolving under exp(-i(Bx Jx+By Jy+Bz Jz)t), compute the 3x3 QFIM by statevector derivatives for GHZ-like and random probes. Evaluate Tr(QFIM⁻¹) and the incompatibility condition Im⟨∂iψ|∂jψ⟩.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Quantum natural gradient and Fubini-Study metric

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Dihedral benchmarking of a T gate
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Sample random sequences from the dihedral group generated by X and T under noise. Fit the two-decay model to extract the average fidelity of non-Clifford T gates, and compare with the exact twirled-channel value.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Cross-entropy benchmarking of random circuits with depolarizing noise
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Generate random 5-qubit circuits from √X, √Y, √W and CZ layers. Compute ideal output probabilities, sample from the noisy density-matrix outputs, and estimate the linear XEB fidelity versus depth against the product-of-fidelities prediction.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Cycle benchmarking to learn Pauli eigenvalues of a noisy CNOT layer
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Pauli-twirl a noisy two-qubit CNOT cycle, prepare Pauli eigenstates, and measure decay of each Pauli expectation versus number of cycles. Fit the Pauli fidelities and reconstruct the Pauli error rates by Walsh-Hadamard transform.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Zeno versus anti-Zeno effect for decay into a structured reservoir
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: For an excited two-level atom coupled to a Lorentzian-plus-background spectral density, compute the effective decay rate under measurement interval τ via the Kofman-Kurizki overlap formula. Map the Zeno-anti-Zeno crossover.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Quantum Zeno effect and weak measurement

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Quantum Zeno dynamics confined to a subspace in a three-level system
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Frequently measure whether a three-level system is in a two-dimensional subspace while a Hamiltonian couples all levels. Compute the effective projected Hamiltonian PHP dynamics and leakage probability versus measurement frequency.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Quantum Zeno effect and weak measurement

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Stochastic quantum trajectories of continuous weak qubit measurement
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Apply repeated weak Kraus operators M± of strength ε for σz measurement on a qubit. Simulate many trajectories, compute the distribution of collapse times, and compare outcome statistics with Born-rule probabilities.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Quantum Zeno effect and weak measurement

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Zeno-enhanced Elitzur-Vaidman interaction-free measurement
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Chain N beam-splitter rotations of angle π/2N in a polarization or interferometer qubit with an absorbing bomb in one arm. Compute probability of detection without absorption versus N and its approach to unity.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Quantum Zeno effect and weak measurement

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Leggett-Garg inequality violation with weak and projective measurements
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute two-time correlators of σz for a precessing qubit, and evaluate the three-time LG parameter K3 versus time spacing. Compare projective measurements with weak-measurement correlators at varying measurement strength.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Quantum Zeno effect and weak measurement

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Weak measurement reversal to protect against amplitude damping
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Apply a pre-weak-measurement of strength p, amplitude damping of strength γ, then a reversing measurement of strength q. Compute success probability and fidelity versus p for optimal q=p+γ(1-p), including protection of two-qubit concurrence.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Quantum Zeno effect and weak measurement

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Zeno-type suppression of coherent errors by repeated parity checks
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Under a coherent X over-rotation on all three qubits of a bit-flip code, interleave projective stabilizer measurements at intervals τ. Compute logical fidelity versus τ and the quadratic-to-linear error accumulation crossover.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Quantum Zeno effect and weak measurement

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Direct wavefunction measurement via weak values
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Implement the Lundeen direct-measurement scheme for a discretized d-level wavefunction: weakly couple to a qubit pointer at each position, postselect on zero momentum, and reconstruct ψ(x) from weak values. Compute reconstruction fidelity versus coupling strength.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Quantum Zeno effect and weak measurement

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Minimal Kraus decomposition from Choi eigendecomposition of random channels
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Generate random CPTP qutrit channels via Stinespring isometries. Compute canonical Kraus operators from Choi eigenvectors, verify Kraus rank, and demonstrate unitary freedom between Kraus representations.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Pauli and Clifford twirling of amplitude damping
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Average the Liouville superoperator of amplitude damping over Pauli conjugations to obtain a Pauli channel, and over the 24 single-qubit Cliffords to obtain a depolarizing channel. Verify invariance of average gate fidelity under both twirls.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Degradability and quantum capacity of amplitude damping
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Construct the complementary channel of amplitude damping and solve for the degrading map for γ<1/2. Compute the single-letter quantum capacity by maximizing coherent information over input populations.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Bloch affine representation and Fujiwara-Algoet CP conditions
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Convert qubit channels between the (M,t) affine Bloch form, the Liouville matrix and the Choi matrix. Test the Fujiwara-Algoet inequalities for diagonal M against Choi positivity across a parameter grid.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Fixed points, ergodicity and mixing from superoperator spectra
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Diagonalize Liouville matrices of qubit and qutrit channels (dephasing, damping, permutation-type unitaries). Identify fixed-point states and peripheral eigenvalues, and classify channels as ergodic, mixing or neither.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Petz recovery map for a dephasing channel
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Construct the Petz map R=σ^{1/2}N†(N(σ)^{-1/2}·N(σ)^{-1/2})σ^{1/2} relative to a reference state for qubit dephasing plus damping. Compute recovered fidelity for random inputs, and check against the relative-entropy-decrease bound.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Process fidelity versus average gate fidelity for random channels
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute entanglement fidelity from Choi matrices and average gate fidelity by Haar-sampled inputs for random noisy qudit gates. Verify F_avg=(dF_pro+1)/(d+1) numerically for d=2,3,4.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Entangled-input channel discrimination via Choi-state Helstrom bound
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compare optimal success probability of discriminating two qubit channels (amplitude damping versus depolarizing of equal fidelity) using product inputs optimized over the Bloch sphere. Contrast with maximally entangled inputs using the trace norm of Choi differences.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Grover search with multiple marked items: optimal iteration count
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate Grover iterations on n qubits with M marked items, and compute success probability versus iteration k. Compare with sin²((2k+1)θ), θ=arcsin√(M/N), and find the optimal k and its failure probability.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Grover search under depolarizing oracle noise: optimal stopping
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Use density-matrix simulation with depolarizing noise after each oracle call on 6-8 qubits. Compute success probability versus iterations, and the noise-dependent optimal iteration count and maximal success.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Fixed-point amplitude amplification with Yoder-Low-Chuang phases
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute Chebyshev-based phase sequences for L-length fixed-point search. Evaluate success probability versus unknown initial overlap λ, and verify the guaranteed bound 1-δ² for λ above threshold.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Long's exact Grover search with modified phase rotations
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Replace the π phases of oracle and diffusion by a tuned phase φ so that the marked item is found with unit probability after a set number of iterations. Compute φ for given N, M and verify by simulation.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Grover-Radhakrishnan partial search over database blocks
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Find which of K blocks contains the marked item by combining global and block-local Grover iterations. Optimize iteration counts to minimize total queries for success near one, compared with full search.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Continuous-time quantum walk spatial search on complete graph and hypercube
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Evolve under H=-γA-|w⟩⟨w| on graphs. Find the critical γ maximizing success probability, and compute the optimal time scaling √N for complete graphs and hypercubes.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Multipartite entanglement along Grover iterations
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Track the geometric measure of entanglement and bipartite entanglement entropies of the Grover state for n qubits with one marked item. Locate the maximum near halfway to the optimum.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Oblivious amplitude amplification for an LCU block encoding
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Implement a linear combination of unitaries V=Σαi Ui via ancilla-prepared coefficients, giving success amplitude 1/2. Apply one round of oblivious amplitude amplification and compute the output fidelity with V|ψ⟩ for random states.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: AKLT matrix product state: string order and correlation length
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build the bond-dimension-2 AKLT spin-1 MPS. Compute the transfer-matrix spectrum to get the correlation length ln(3)^-1 and spin-spin correlations, and contract the den Nijs-Rommelse string order parameter for increasing string length.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Matrix product states and tensor networks

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Imaginary-time TEBD ground state of the Heisenberg chain versus bond dimension
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Apply second-order Trotterized imaginary-time two-site gates with SVD truncation to an open MPS of the spin-1/2 Heisenberg chain. Converge the energy for several chi and compare to exact diagonalization for L=10-12.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Matrix product states and tensor networks

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: MPO construction of the transverse-field Ising Hamiltonian and MPS energy contraction
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build the bond-dimension-3 finite-state-automaton MPO for the TFIM. Contract <psi|H|psi> and <psi|H^2|psi> for a random MPS by successive environment updates, and verify against dense matrix expectation values.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Matrix product states and tensor networks

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Perfect sampling of bitstrings from a canonical MPS
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Right-canonicalize an MPS (e.g. a TFIM ground state from SVDs) and draw computational-basis samples site by site using conditional reduced matrices. Validate the empirical distribution against exact Born probabilities via total variation distance.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Matrix product states and tensor networks

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: MPS simulation of random brickwork circuits under bond truncation
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Apply layers of Haar-random two-qubit gates to an MPS with SVD truncation at fixed chi. Track the half-chain entanglement growth and the cumulative truncation fidelity estimate, and compare to exact statevector fidelity for 12 qubits.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Matrix product states and tensor networks

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Three-tangle of GHZ-W superpositions via Cayley hyperdeterminant
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the Coffman-Kundu-Wootters three-tangle from the hyperdeterminant of the 2x2x2 coefficient tensor for states a|GHZ>+b|W>. Locate the zero of the tangle and compare with the pairwise concurrences.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Geometric measure of entanglement for symmetric Dicke states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Maximize the overlap of N-qubit Dicke states |D_N^k> with product states, using symmetric product ansatz and alternating optimization over local single-qubit states. Compare the result to the analytic formula and to GHZ.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: GME concurrence of noisy GHZ-diagonal three-qubit X states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Evaluate the Hashemi Rafsanjani-Huber-Broadbent-Eberly analytic GME concurrence for X-form density matrices. Apply it to GHZ states mixed with white noise and dephasing, and find the noise threshold p=4/7-type for genuine tripartite entanglement.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: SLOCC classification of random three-qubit pure states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Classify states as product, biseparable, W or GHZ class using single-qubit reduced-state ranks and the three-tangle with numerical tolerances. Estimate class frequencies for Haar-random and structured ensembles.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Mermin-Klyshko inequality violation of noisy N-qubit GHZ states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Construct Mermin-Klyshko Bell operators recursively for N=2-8 qubits and evaluate their expectation in white-noise-mixed GHZ states. Determine the critical visibility for violation as a function of N.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Fidelity-based witnesses for GHZ and W genuine entanglement
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute maximal biseparable overlaps (1/2 for GHZ, 2/3 for W) by optimizing over bipartite cuts via Schmidt coefficients. Apply the resulting witnesses to dephased and depolarized states to find detection thresholds.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Meyer-Wallach global entanglement of graph states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Generate n-qubit graph states from adjacency matrices via CZ gates, then compute the Meyer-Wallach measure from single-qubit purities. Compare ring, star, line and complete graphs, and verify LC-orbit invariance.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Verifying absolutely maximally entangled states: AME(4,3) and the 6-qubit candidate
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Construct the AME(4,3) qutrit state from an orthogonal Latin-square code and a 6-qubit AME state from a stabilizer code. Check that every bipartition into k <= n/2 parties yields maximally mixed marginals via partial traces.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Spin squeezing and entanglement depth of Dicke and one-axis-twisted states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the collective spin moments and the Wineland squeezing parameter for one-axis-twisted coherent spin states of N qubits. Infer the entanglement depth from Sørensen-Mølmer bounds, which are computed by optimizing over spin-j states.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: PPT and negativity of d×d Werner states versus mixing parameter
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build Werner states from projectors onto the symmetric and antisymmetric subspaces for d=2-5. Compute partial-transpose spectra and logarithmic negativity, and confirm the separability threshold at the critical mixing parameter.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Isotropic states: PPT, reduction and realignment thresholds
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: For d×d isotropic states parametrized by singlet fraction F, evaluate the partial-transpose minimum eigenvalue, the reduction-criterion operator I⊗ρ_B−ρ and the realignment trace norm. Show that all three thresholds coincide at F=1/d.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Bound entangled state from the Tiles unextendible product basis
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build the 5-element Tiles UPB in 3×3, form ρ = (I − ΣP_i)/4 and verify PPT. Show that no product vector lies in its range by sampling a dense grid and minimizing overlaps, demonstrating range-criterion entanglement.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Breuer-Hall positive map detecting PPT entangled states in 4×4
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Implement the Breuer-Hall map Φ(ρ)=Tr(ρ)I−ρ−UρᵀU† with an antisymmetric unitary on d=4. Verify positivity and non-decomposability on test states, and apply (id⊗Φ) to a PPT entangled family to find a negative eigenvalue.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Majorization versus PPT criterion for random two-qutrit states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Sample random mixed 3×3 states from the induced Hilbert-Schmidt measure. Test the Nielsen-Kempe majorization criterion and the PPT criterion, and tabulate the fraction of states detected by each.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Optimal entanglement witness from the partial transpose eigenvector
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: For a two-qubit state, construct the witness W = |v><v|^{T_B} from the negative eigenvector of ρ^{T_B}. Test it on families of rotated and noisy states and compare its detection region to the full PPT region.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Schmidt number witnesses for high-dimensional isotropic states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Use fidelity-with-maximally-entangled-state witnesses with bounds k/d to certify Schmidt number k for noisy two-qudit states. Compute the noise thresholds for each k and compare to the negativity bound.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Recurrence distillation of amplitude-damped Bell pairs without twirling
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Apply the DEJMPS bilateral CNOT step to non-Bell-diagonal states produced by local amplitude damping of |Φ+>. Use the full density matrix with partial traces and post-selection, and compare the fidelity trajectory with and without prior Bell-diagonal twirling.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Double-selection distillation protocol fidelity and yield
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate Fujii-Yamamoto double selection with three Bell-diagonal pairs per round using explicit two-qubit gate sequences and post-selection. Compare the output fidelity and success probability with DEJMPS over several rounds.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Qudit isotropic-state recurrence distillation with generalized XOR
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Implement the Alber et al. qudit recurrence protocol using generalized XOR (controlled-shift) gates on two d×d isotropic pairs, with measurement and post-selection. Iterate the fidelity map for d=2-4 and locate the distillability threshold.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Schmidt-projection entanglement concentration yield on n pure copies
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: For n copies of cos θ|00>+sin θ|11>, project onto equal-Hamming-weight Schmidt subspaces. Compute the expected number of extracted ebits per copy versus n and its convergence to the entanglement entropy.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Maximum-likelihood process tomography via iterative R-ρ-R on the Choi matrix
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate multinomial counts for Pauli-basis input preparations and measurements on a noisy qubit gate. Reconstruct a CPTP Choi matrix with the Ježek-Fiurášek iterative MLE including the trace-preservation Lagrange operator, and report process fidelity.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Error-generator taxonomy from the logarithm of a noisy gate's PTM
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the Pauli transfer matrix of a noisy gate, divide out the ideal gate and take the matrix logarithm. Project the generator onto Hamiltonian and stochastic elementary error generators in the Blume-Kohout taxonomy.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Linear-inversion gate set tomography for a single qubit
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: From simulated probabilities of germ-free fiducial sequences, reconstruct gate PTMs, the state and the POVM up to gauge using the Gram-matrix linear inversion. Compute gauge-invariant eigenvalues of each gate and compare to the truth.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Bootstrap confidence intervals of process fidelity under shot noise
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Perform linear-inversion process tomography of a qubit depolarizing-plus-rotation channel from finite shots. Parametric bootstrap the counts, and report how the mean, bias and confidence interval of the process fidelity scale with shot number.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Symplectic Pauli algebra with phase-tracked multiplication
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Represent n-qubit Paulis as binary (x|z) vectors with phase exponents. Implement products with exact phase tracking and the symplectic commutation form, and verify against explicit Kronecker-product matrices for random Paulis.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Aaronson-Gottesman tableau simulation of GHZ preparation and measurement
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Implement the CHP stabilizer tableau with H, S and CNOT updates, plus deterministic and random Z measurements via row operations. Sample measurement statistics of GHZ and cluster preparations, and check against statevector probabilities.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Stabilizer state entanglement entropy from tableau ranks
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute bipartite entanglement of stabilizer states via the Fattal et al. formula S_A = rank_GF2(stabilizers restricted to A) − |A|. Use Gaussian elimination over GF(2), and validate against statevector partial traces for random Clifford states.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Symplectic matrix of a Clifford circuit and its Pauli conjugation action
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compose symplectic matrices and phase vectors for H, S and CNOT layers to represent a Clifford circuit. Verify the symplectic condition over GF(2), and check the action C P C† against dense unitaries.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Code distance and logical operators of the five-qubit and Steane codes
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: From stabilizer generators, compute the normalizer by symplectic GF(2) nullspace and find logical X/Z by symplectic Gram-Schmidt. Determine the code distance by enumerating low-weight normalizer elements that are not stabilizers.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Local complementation orbits of small graph states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Implement local complementation on adjacency matrices over GF(2) and enumerate LC orbits of all 4- and 5-vertex connected graphs. Verify that each LC operation corresponds to a local Clifford mapping the graph-state vectors onto each other.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Stabilizer Rényi entropy of magic states and random circuits
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the Leone-Oliviero-Hamma stabilizer 2-Rényi entropy from the Pauli spectrum Tr(Pψ)^4/2^n for T states, tensor powers and Clifford+T random circuits. Verify its additivity and Clifford invariance.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Robustness of magic by linear programming over stabilizer states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Enumerate all 1- and 2-qubit stabilizer states, then solve the l1-minimizing affine decomposition of T and CCZ-like magic states with scipy.optimize.linprog. Check sub-multiplicativity of the robustness for two copies of the T state.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Gottesman-Knill check: Pauli expectations in random Clifford circuits
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist:
Compute

for random Pauli observables after random Clifford circuits using tableau propagation (±1 or 0). Cross-validate against dense statevector simulation for 6-qubit circuits.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Random-Pauli classical shadows with median-of-means for GHZ observables
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Generate snapshots by measuring an n-qubit GHZ state in random local Pauli bases. Build the inverse-channel estimators 3U†|b><b|U − I, and estimate stabilizers and two-point correlators with median-of-means, reporting error versus number of snapshots.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Global Clifford shadows for fidelity estimation with a target state
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Sample random 3-qubit Clifford unitaries (generated by composing H, S, CNOT and compared to group enumeration). Use the (2^n+1)U†|b><b|U − I estimator to predict fidelity with a target state from noisy preparations.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Shadow estimation of subsystem entanglement in the TFIM ground state
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Use random Pauli shadows of a 8-qubit TFIM ground state to estimate the second Rényi entropy of contiguous blocks with U-statistics over snapshot pairs. Compare to exact values on both sides of the critical field.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: p3-PPT condition from partial-transpose moments via shadows
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Estimate partial-transpose moments p2 and p3 from classical shadows with third-order U-statistics. Apply the Elben et al. p3-PPT test p3 < p2^2 to noisy Bell and Werner states, and find detection thresholds versus shots.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Shadow norm scaling 3^k for weight-k Pauli observables
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the exact single-snapshot variance of random-Pauli shadow estimators for weight-k Pauli strings on product and entangled states. Confirm the 3^k shadow-norm bound with empirical variance from simulated snapshots.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Cross-platform fidelity from shared randomized measurements
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Two simulated devices prepare noisy versions of a target state and measure in identical local random bases. Compute the Elben et al. fidelity estimator Tr(ρ1ρ2)/max(Tr ρ1^2, Tr ρ2^2) from Hamming-weighted outcome correlations.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Robust classical shadows with calibrated noisy readout
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Model readout noise as a local depolarizing channel before random Pauli measurement. Calibrate the noisy Pauli-twirled inverse channel from computational-state shadows, and show bias removal in estimated observables relative to naive shadows.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Helstrom measurement for two mixed qubit states with priors
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the optimal minimum-error projector from the positive eigenspace of p1ρ1 − p2ρ2. Evaluate the success probability (1 + ||p1ρ1 − p2ρ2||_1)/2 and verify it by Monte Carlo sampling of the measurement on Bloch-sphere state pairs.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Ivanovic-Dieks-Peres unambiguous discrimination POVM construction
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: For two non-orthogonal pure states with equal priors, construct the three-element optimal UD POVM. Verify positivity and completeness, compute the inconclusive rate |<ψ1|ψ2>|, and generalize to unequal priors (Jaeger-Shimony).

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Pretty-good measurement for trine and tetrahedral qubit ensembles
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Construct the square-root measurement Π_i = ρ^{-1/2} p_iρ_i ρ^{-1/2} for symmetric qubit ensembles. Compute success probability and accessible information, and compare to the optimal minimum-error bound from symmetry.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Quantum Chernoff bound for multi-copy thermal qubit discrimination
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Minimize Tr(ρ^s σ^{1−s}) over s for thermal qubit states at two temperatures to obtain the Chernoff exponent. Compare to exact n-copy Helstrom error computed in the symmetric (permutation-invariant) basis.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Discrimination with a fixed rate of inconclusive results
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Interpolate between minimum-error and unambiguous discrimination of two pure states by fixing the inconclusive probability Q. Compute the optimal error versus Q using the Chefles-Barnett/Bagan analytic reduction, and check it with a parametrized POVM optimization.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Local adaptive measurement achieving Helstrom for multiple qubit copies
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: For n copies of two pure qubit states, implement Bayesian-updated local projective measurements (Acín-Bagan-Bandyopadhyay). Show that the success probability equals the collective Helstrom bound, and contrast with fixed local measurements plus majority voting.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Quantum Neyman-Pearson tests and the Stein exponent
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: For n copies of dephased qubit states ρ and σ, construct Neyman-Pearson projectors {ρ^⊗n − e^{nλ}σ^⊗n > 0} using commuting-case structure or small-n diagonalization. Show the type-II error exponent approaches D(ρ||σ).

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Iterative optimal minimum-error measurement for N mixed states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Implement the Ježek-Řeháček-Fiurášek fixed-point iteration for the optimal POVM discriminating N mixed qutrit states. Verify optimality via Holevo-Yuen-Kennedy-Lax conditions (Σ p_iρ_iΠ_i − p_jρ_j ≥ 0).

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Kirkwood-Dirac quasiprobability negativity and anomalous weak values
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute KD distributions <a|ρ|b><b|a> for a qubit or qutrit with two bases. Relate negativity and nonreality to anomalous weak values of projectors, and scan the pre-selected state over the Bloch sphere.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Quantum Zeno effect and weak measurement

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Quantum Cheshire cat weak values in a Mach-Zehnder interferometer
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Model photon path ⊗ polarization with pre- and post-selected states. Compute weak values of path projectors and of path-resolved polarization operators, and verify by simulated weak pointer shifts in the linear-response regime.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Quantum Zeno effect and weak measurement

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Repetition code with measurement errors: space-time matching decoding
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate T rounds of noisy parity checks on a distance-d repetition code with data and measurement flips. Build the space-time detection-event graph, decode by matching, and estimate the phenomenological threshold.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Rotated distance-3 surface code under depolarizing noise with lookup decoding
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Construct the 9-qubit rotated surface code stabilizers and logical operators. Build a minimum-weight syndrome lookup table for X and Z errors, and estimate logical error rates and the pseudo-threshold by Monte Carlo.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Peeling decoder for erasure errors on the toric code
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Erase qubits with probability p, find a spanning forest of the erased subgraph, and peel leaves to produce a correction consistent with the syndrome. Estimate the logical failure rate, showing a threshold near 50%.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Exact maximum-likelihood decoding of small surface codes by coset enumeration
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: For d=3 and d=5 rotated surface codes under bit-flip noise, sum probabilities over all stabilizer cosets for each syndrome to perform optimal decoding. Compare the ML logical error with minimum-weight decoding.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Toric code Wilson loops and anyon braiding phase
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: On a 3×3 toric code, construct the ground-state projector and the e- and m-string operators. Verify that closed loops act as logical operators, and compute the −1 mutual braiding phase from the group commutator of crossing string operators.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: XZZX surface code under biased Z noise: logical error advantage
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compare CSS and XZZX rotated surface codes at d=3,5 under Pauli noise with bias η. Simulate syndromes and decode with weighted lookup or matching, and report logical error rates versus η.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Maximum-likelihood two-qubit state tomography from Pauli counts
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate multinomial counts for 9 local Pauli settings on a noisy Bell state. Reconstruct by linear inversion and by Hradil RρR iterative MLE, and compare fidelity, purity and negativity of the estimates.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Horodecki CHSH maximum from the correlation tensor of two-qubit states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the correlation matrix T_ij = Tr(ρσ_i⊗σ_j) and the maximal CHSH value 2√(m1+m2) from the largest eigenvalues of TᵀT. Compare to concurrence for random mixed states and identify entangled-but-local regions.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Uhlmann fidelity and Bures distance between Heisenberg dimer Gibbs states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute thermal states of a two-spin XXZ dimer with matrix exponentials and evaluate the Uhlmann fidelity via matrix square roots. Map out the Bures distance as a function of temperature and anisotropy, and find peaks near level crossings.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Discrete-time Hadamard walk: ballistic spreading and coin-position entanglement
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Evolve a coined quantum walk on a line with shift and Hadamard coin operators. Compute the position variance growth ~t² and the reduced coin-state entropy, approaching its asymptotic value for symmetric initial coins.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Zero-noise extrapolation of a noisy VQE energy
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate a fixed variational circuit for the 4-qubit Heisenberg ring under depolarizing noise. Use gate-folding noise scale factors λ=1,3,5 and apply Richardson and exponential extrapolation, and compare mitigated energies to the noiseless value.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Probabilistic error cancellation: quasi-probability inverse of depolarizing noise
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Decompose the inverse of a single- and two-qubit depolarizing channel into Pauli operations with quasi-probabilities. Compute the sampling overhead γ, and Monte Carlo estimate a mitigated observable with its variance scaling γ^{2N}.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Tensor-product readout error mitigation by confusion-matrix inversion
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Calibrate per-qubit asymmetric readout confusion matrices from simulated basis-state shots. Invert the Kronecker-structured matrix on measured distributions of a GHZ state, and compare with a least-squares projection onto the probability simplex.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: SWAP-test estimation of overlap and purity with finite shots
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate the ancilla-controlled SWAP circuit on two copies of mixed qubit/qutrit states. Estimate Tr(ρσ) and Tr(ρ²) from ancilla statistics, and study the variance and shot requirements for given precision.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Shor-Smolin superadditivity: repetition-code coherent information of depolarizing channel
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the coherent information of the qubit depolarizing channel with inputs from n-qubit repetition-code cat states. Find the noise range where the per-channel coherent information exceeds the single-letter hashing bound.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Deterministic Dicke-state preparation circuit and its verification
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Implement the Bärtschi-Eidenbenz split-and-cyclic-shift circuit with controlled-RY gates to prepare |D_n^k>. Verify state fidelity by statevector simulation, and count CNOT gates versus n and k.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: OTOC operator spreading in a kicked Ising chain
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the out-of-time-order commutator C(x,t) = 1 − Re<W(t)V W(t)V> for local Paulis in a Floquet kicked Ising chain of 10 spins. Extract the butterfly velocity from the light-cone front for integrable and chaotic parameters.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Entanglement Hamiltonian of a free-fermion interval via Peschel's method
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: From the correlation matrix C_ij = <c_i†c_j> of a tight-binding chain, compute the single-particle entanglement spectrum ε = ln((1−ν)/ν), and reconstruct the modular Hamiltonian. Compare with the Bisognano-Wichmann linear profile and with ED entropies.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Coherence of formation versus l1-norm coherence for qubit states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: For random and parametrized qubit density matrices, compute the l1-norm coherence, the relative-entropy coherence and the coherence of formation. Use the closed form C_f = h((1+sqrt(1-C_l1^2))/2) and check it against a numerical convex-roof minimization over pure-state decompositions.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Robustness of coherence for qutrit states via SDP and coherence witnesses
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the robustness of coherence of qutrit states as a small SDP over incoherent-diagonal mixtures, solved by an iterative projected method. Verify the dual witness and compare with the l1-norm, with which it coincides for qubits and X-type states.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Coherence generating power of single- and two-qubit gates
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the Zanardi coherence generating power of unitaries (Hadamard, sqrt(iSWAP), random Haar gates). Average the l1 or relative-entropy coherence of U|i><i|U† over the incoherent basis, compare with the closed form in terms of |U_ij|^4, and find the maximizing gates.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Relative-entropy coherence depletion along Grover search iterations
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Track the relative-entropy and l1 coherence in the computational basis of the n-qubit Grover state after each iteration. Relate the coherence decrease to the success probability and to the analytic two-amplitude form for M marked items.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Pure-state coherence transformations under incoherent operations via majorization
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Decide whether one pure qudit state can be converted to another by incoherent operations using majorization of the squared amplitudes. Compute the optimal conversion probability with the Vidal-type formula, min over k of tail sums.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Geometric coherence via fidelity to the closest incoherent state
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute geometric coherence 1 - max over incoherent sigma of F(rho, sigma) for pure qudit states (closed form 1 - max|c_i|^2) and qubit mixed states. Maximize Uhlmann fidelity over diagonal states numerically and compare with the analytic qubit formula.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Thermal coherence of transverse-field Ising Gibbs states in the sigma-z basis
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build Gibbs states of an open transverse-field Ising chain of 6-8 spins by exact diagonalization. Compute relative-entropy and l1 coherence in the product sigma-z basis as functions of temperature and field, including the low-temperature behaviour near criticality.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Wave-particle duality in a multipath interferometer from l1 coherence
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Model an N-path interferometer state with partial which-path marking by detector states. Compute the normalized l1 coherence and the path distinguishability from Helstrom discrimination of the detector states, and verify the duality inequality D^2 + C^2 <= 1.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Mana and sum-negativity of qutrit magic states via discrete Wigner function
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Construct the Gross discrete Wigner function for qutrits from phase-point operators. Compute sum-negativity and mana of the Strange, Norrell and T-type qutrit states, and of their mixtures with the maximally mixed state.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Stabilizer Renyi entropy of the transverse-field Ising ground state
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the order-2 stabilizer Renyi entropy of the exact ground state of an N <= 10 transverse-field Ising chain by summing fourth powers of all Pauli-string expectation values. Scan the field across the critical point and locate the maximum of the magic density.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Magic power of two-qubit gates: average stabilizer Renyi entropy generated
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: For gates exp(-i(a XX + b YY + c ZZ)), average the stabilizer Renyi entropy generated over all two-qubit stabilizer input states. Map this magic power over the Weyl chamber and identify maximally magic-generating gates.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Bravyi-Kitaev 5-to-1 magic state distillation Bloch-vector map
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Project five noisy copies of a T-type magic state onto the trivial syndrome of the five-qubit code and decode. Compute the output fidelity and success probability as functions of input fidelity, and find the distillation threshold.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Coherence-based non-Markovianity witness for qubit dephasing by a spin environment
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Evolve a qubit coupled by ZZ interactions to a few environment spins with random couplings. Compute the l1 coherence of the reduced state over time and quantify revivals as a measure integrated over periods of increase, compared with the BLP measure.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: BLP measure optimized over initial state pairs for a resonantly damped qubit
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: For the Jaynes-Cummings amplitude-damping map with Lorentzian spectral density, compute trace-distance dynamics for pairs of initial qubit states. Optimize the BLP integral over pairs and verify that antipodal equatorial or polar pairs are optimal in the strong-coupling regime.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Coin dynamics of a discrete-time quantum walk as a non-Markovian process
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate a Hadamard walk on a line and trace out the position to obtain the coin dynamical map at each step. Compute BLP trace-distance revivals between coin states and the non-divisibility of intermediate maps.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Loschmidt echo decoherence of a qubit coupled to a critical Ising chain
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Couple a central qubit uniformly to a transverse-field Ising chain so that each qubit branch evolves under a different field. Compute the Loschmidt echo, the decoherence factor and BLP trace-distance revivals near and away from the critical field.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Correlated two-qubit dephasing: Markovian marginals with non-Markovian global dynamics
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Two qubits dephase under a common random classical field with a chosen distribution. Compute BLP trace-distance dynamics for single-qubit reduced maps and for the two-qubit map, showing information backflow only at the global level.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Four-qubit cluster CNOT pattern with byproduct Pauli corrections
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build a four-qubit box (or linear) cluster state, entangle the input qubits, and simulate the measurement pattern that implements a CNOT. Derive outcome-dependent Pauli byproducts and verify unit process fidelity for every outcome branch.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Universal blind quantum computation on a small brickwork state
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate the UBQC protocol: the client sends qubits rotated by hidden random angles, and the server measures at angles phi + theta + r*pi. Verify correct computation outputs and show that the server's outcome distribution is independent of the client's angles.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Teleportation along a noisy one-dimensional cluster wire
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Prepare a linear cluster state with dephasing applied after each CZ, and transport a logical qubit by successive X measurements with byproduct corrections. Compute average transport fidelity versus wire length and noise, comparing simulation to the composed Pauli-channel prediction.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Generalized flow existence for open graphs via GF(2) linear algebra
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Implement the Mhalla-Perdrix gflow algorithm: solve GF(2) linear systems layer by layer to find correction sets for an open graph with inputs and outputs. Check determinism of small patterns and verify one by simulating all measurement branches.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Localizable entanglement of linear cluster states under local noise
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Measure all intermediate qubits of an N-qubit linear cluster in chosen local bases. Compute the outcome-averaged concurrence between the end qubits, maximize over measurement bases, and study how depolarizing noise degrades localizable entanglement with length.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Pauli measurement rules on graph states verified by statevector simulation
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Implement graph-state transformation rules for Z, Y and X measurements: vertex deletion, local complementation, and the X rule with a special neighbour. Verify them, including the local Clifford corrections, by explicit projection on random small graphs.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Single-qutrit Clifford randomized benchmarking
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Generate the 216-element single-qutrit Clifford group from Fourier and phase gates in the Weyl-Heisenberg setting. Run RB sequences under qutrit depolarizing and amplitude-damping noise, fit the decay, and convert it to average gate infidelity with d = 3.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Frame potential test of Clifford groups as unitary 2- but not 3-designs
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Enumerate the single-qubit (24) and two-qubit (11520 modulo phases) Clifford groups. Compute the frame potentials for t = 1, 2, 3 and compare with Haar values, confirming 3-design failure for qubits.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Mirror-circuit benchmarking of random Clifford layers on four qubits
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build mirror circuits (random Clifford layers followed by their inverses and random Pauli frames) under depolarizing and coherent noise. Compute the effective polarization versus depth and extract per-layer error rates.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: VQE for the two-site Fermi-Hubbard model via Jordan-Wigner mapping
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Map the half-filled two-site Hubbard Hamiltonian to four qubits with Jordan-Wigner Pauli strings. Optimize a number-conserving ansatz with scipy to reach the exact ground energy, and compute double occupancy versus U/t.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Hardware-efficient ansatz VQE for the six-qubit Heisenberg ring
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Construct an Ry-Rz plus CZ-ladder ansatz with L layers. Compute the energy expectation of the periodic Heisenberg Hamiltonian via statevector, optimize with BFGS from random starts, and report relative energy error and ground-state fidelity versus depth.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Qubit-wise commuting Pauli grouping and shot budget for VQE energies
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Partition the Pauli terms of a molecular-like qubit Hamiltonian into qubit-wise commuting groups with greedy graph coloring. Compute per-group variances on a trial state and the optimal shot allocation that minimizes total energy variance.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Givens-rotation particle-conserving ansatz for fermionic ground states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build a circuit of two-qubit Givens rotations that spans the fixed-particle-number subspace. Verify number conservation, and optimize it for a spinless-fermion tight-binding chain with nearest-neighbour interaction, comparing to exact diagonalization within the sector.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Variational Gibbs state preparation by free-energy minimization
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Parametrize a mixed state as a unitary ansatz acting on a product of tunable diagonal qubit states. Minimize F = Tr(rho H) - T S(rho) for a two-qubit Heisenberg model, and compare the free energy and Uhlmann fidelity with the exact Gibbs state.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: SPSA versus parameter-shift gradient descent under shot noise
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Optimize a VQE energy for a three-qubit TFIM using finite-shot Pauli estimates. Compare SPSA with parameter-shift gradient descent in terms of energy error versus total measurement shots.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: VQE ground state of the lattice Schwinger model with gauge fields eliminated
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Write the staggered-fermion Schwinger Hamiltonian with Gauss's law imposed as a long-range qubit Hamiltonian for N = 4-6 sites. Run VQE with a symmetry-respecting ansatz and compute the chiral condensate versus fermion mass.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Hamiltonian variational ansatz for the XXZ chain: fidelity versus layers
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Alternate exponentials of the even- and odd-bond XXZ terms with independent angles, starting from a dimer product state. Optimize the energy and find the minimal number of layers needed to reach the exact ground state at several anisotropies.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Symmetry-verified noisy VQE via parity post-selection
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate a noisy particle-conserving VQE circuit as a density matrix under depolarizing noise. Post-select on the correct number parity, and compute the mitigated energy and post-selection rate versus noise strength.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Uhlmann fidelity by unitary optimization over purifications
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the fidelity between mixed qudit states by maximizing |<psi_rho|(I x U)|psi_sigma>| over unitaries U with an iterative polar-decomposition update. Compare with the closed form ||sqrt(rho) sqrt(sigma)||_1 and with the Watrous SDP optimality conditions.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: EPR steerability of two-qubit Werner states with two or three Pauli measurements
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Formulate the LHS-model feasibility test for steering assemblages as an SDP over deterministic response strategies, solved by an iterative projection method. Recover the critical visibilities 1/sqrt(2) and 1/sqrt(3).

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Conditional min-entropy of two-qubit states via maximal singlet fraction
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute H_min(A|B) of two-qubit states through its operational form: d times the maximal overlap with a maximally entangled state after a channel on B. Solve the SDP iteratively and verify against Bell-diagonal closed forms.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Fully entangled fraction of two-qubit states and teleportation fidelity
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the fully entangled fraction by maximizing over local unitaries applied to a Bell state. Compare with Badziag's closed form from the eigenvalues of the real T-matrix, and convert it to optimal teleportation fidelity.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Antidistinguishability of qubit and qutrit state sets via state exclusion SDP
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Formulate minimum-error state exclusion as an SDP and solve it with an iterative measurement update. Apply it to trine states and to sets of qutrit states, finding the overlap threshold at which perfect exclusion becomes possible.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Tsirelson bound of CHSH via a Gram-matrix SDP
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Set up the level-1 NPA moment matrix for CHSH with observables A0, A1, B0, B1. Maximize the Bell expression over PSD Gram matrices with unit diagonal using an eigenvalue-projection method, and recover 2*sqrt(2) and the optimal correlators.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Optimal universal 1-to-2 qubit cloner from a Choi-matrix SDP
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Parametrize cloning channels by Choi matrices with CPTP constraints, and maximize the average single-copy fidelity over Haar inputs using symmetry and iterative updates. Recover the Buzek-Hillery fidelity 5/6 and the explicit cloner.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Two-copy symmetric extendibility test of two-qubit states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Decide whether a two-qubit state has a symmetric extension to ABB' using an SDP feasibility formulation and an iterative solver. Compare with the analytic criterion of Chen et al. for Werner and isotropic families.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Draper QFT adder for modular addition of quantum registers
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Implement the QFT-based adder, which applies controlled phase rotations between registers in the Fourier basis. Verify a + b mod 2^n on all inputs for n <= 4, and study fidelity when small rotations are truncated.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Quantum Fourier transform and phase estimation

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Semiclassical QFT with measurement and classical feed-forward
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Replace controlled phases by measure-then-rotate operations following Griffiths-Niu. Simulate the branch probabilities and show that the output distribution equals that of the coherent QFT followed by measurement in phase estimation.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Quantum Fourier transform and phase estimation

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Trotterized phase estimation of a Heisenberg dimer: Trotter-induced energy bias
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Run QPE using a first- or second-order Trotter approximation of exp(-iHt) for a two- or three-qubit Heisenberg Hamiltonian. Compute the bias of the estimated ground energy versus Trotter step and compare with commutator-based error estimates.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Quantum Fourier transform and phase estimation

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Qutrit quantum Fourier transform and diagonalization of Weyl shift operators
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Construct the d = 3 QFT for n qutrits from generalized Hadamards and controlled phase gates. Verify that it diagonalizes the shift operator X, and run qutrit phase estimation on a cyclic permutation unitary.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Quantum Fourier transform and phase estimation

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Three-box paradox: weak values of box projectors
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Pre-select (|1>+|2>+|3>)/sqrt(3) and post-select (|1>+|2>-|3>)/sqrt(3). Compute weak values of all box projectors, including the negative value at box 3, and simulate pointer shifts with a Gaussian meter at finite coupling.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Quantum Zeno effect and weak measurement

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Information-disturbance trade-off for weak qubit measurements
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Parametrize weak measurements of sigma-z by Kraus operators of strength epsilon. Compute the estimation fidelity gained and the operation fidelity lost, averaged over Haar inputs, and verify the Banaszek trade-off curve.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Quantum Zeno effect and weak measurement

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Hardy's paradox resolved by joint weak values
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Model Hardy's overlapping electron-positron interferometers as a two-qubit pre- and post-selected system. Compute weak values of single and joint path occupations, including the -1 pair occupation, and check consistency relations.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Quantum Zeno effect and weak measurement

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Qutrit Bloch vectors in the Gell-Mann basis and positivity conditions
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Map qutrit density matrices to 8-component Gell-Mann Bloch vectors. Test positivity via the characteristic polynomial coefficients (trace, Tr rho^2 and det conditions), and estimate the volume fraction of the 8-ball that corresponds to physical states.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Hilbert-Schmidt versus Bures random density matrices: purity statistics
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Generate random density matrices from Ginibre matrices (HS measure) and from (1+U)G constructions (Bures measure). Compute average purity and eigenvalue histograms, and compare with the analytic mean purities.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Nearest physical density matrix to a non-positive tomographic estimate
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Implement the Smolin-Gambetta-Smith algorithm, which zeroes negative eigenvalues and redistributes their weight. Apply it to linear-inversion estimates from finite-shot two-qubit Pauli data, and verify optimality in the 2-norm against brute-force optimization.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Thermal state of the quantum Rabi model: qubit reduced purity and Bloch vector
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Diagonalize the Rabi Hamiltonian with a truncated Fock space, form the Gibbs state, and trace out the oscillator. Compute qubit purity, Bloch vector and truncation convergence versus coupling and temperature.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Hughston-Jozsa-Wootters freedom: ensembles realizing the same density matrix
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Given a qubit or qutrit density matrix, construct the eigen-ensemble, generate other pure-state ensembles via isometries applied to its square-root decomposition, and verify that they yield the same rho. Recover the unitary relating two given ensembles.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: NMR pseudopure states by temporal averaging of thermal deviation density matrices
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Start from the high-temperature two- or three-spin Zeeman density matrix. Average the results of permutation CNOT sequences to produce a pseudopure state, and compute the effective polarization and the fidelity of its deviation part.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Maximally entangled mixed states: concurrence versus linear entropy frontier
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Construct Munro-James MEMS and compute their concurrence versus linear entropy. Sample random two-qubit states to verify the frontier, and compare it with the Werner-state curve.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Thermal concurrence of the two-qubit XXZ model in a magnetic field
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the Wootters concurrence and entanglement of formation of two-qubit XXZ Gibbs states versus temperature, anisotropy and field. Find the threshold temperature beyond which entanglement vanishes.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Logarithmic negativity of a spin-1 Heisenberg dimer at finite temperature
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build the Gibbs state of two spin-1 particles with bilinear-biquadratic coupling. Compute the negativity and log negativity via partial transpose versus temperature, and identify regimes with PPT thermal states.
