physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Entanglement of formation of isotropic qudit states via Terhal-Vollbrecht
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the EoF of d x d isotropic states from the Terhal-Vollbrecht convex-hull formula, using a numerical convex hull over the fidelity parameter. Compare it with negativity and with the qubit Wootters result.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Pairwise concurrence in the Lipkin-Meshkov-Glick ground state
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Diagonalize the LMG Hamiltonian in the symmetric Dicke subspace, and compute the two-spin reduced density matrix from collective spin moments. Track the rescaled concurrence N*C across the transition field.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Convex-roof entanglement of formation by iterative decomposition optimization
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Minimize the average entropy of entanglement over pure-state decompositions, parametrized by unitaries acting on the square-root ensemble, using gradient descent. Benchmark against Wootters for qubits and apply to random 2 x 3 states.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Entangling power of two-qubit gates from Zanardi formula and Makhlin invariants
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute entangling power as the average linear entropy generated on Haar product states, comparing Monte Carlo with the closed form. Relate it to the Weyl-chamber coordinates obtained via the magic basis.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Coherent information and quantum capacity of qutrit Weyl dephasing channels
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build qutrit dephasing channels from Weyl Z powers with a probability vector. Compute the single-letter coherent information, maximized over input states, and verify degradability so that it equals the quantum capacity.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Conditional mutual information decay in Gibbs states of a quantum spin chain
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: For thermal states of a 1D transverse-field Ising or Heisenberg chain of 8-10 spins, compute I(A:C|B) for contiguous ABC. Show its decay with the buffer size B as evidence of an approximate quantum Markov chain.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Deutsch-Jozsa and Bernstein-Vazirani under depolarizing gate noise
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate both algorithms as density-matrix circuits with depolarizing noise after each gate. Compute the probability of a correct answer versus qubit number and noise rate, and the noise threshold below which one shot beats classical guessing.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Data re-uploading single-qubit classifier
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Encode 2D data points repeatedly into single-qubit rotations interleaved with trainable rotations. Train the circuit to classify a circle dataset by fidelity cost, and report accuracy versus number of layers.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Four-component cat code: Knill-Laflamme matrix and parity-recovery fidelity under loss
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Construct the four-legged cat code words and photon-loss Kraus operators. Evaluate the Knill-Laflamme matrix, then compute the logical entanglement fidelity after a parity-jump-based recovery as a function of loss probability.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Finite-energy GKP code words in truncated Fock space under displacement noise
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build approximate square-GKP states with a Gaussian envelope e^{-Δ²n} in a large Fock basis and compute logical Pauli expectation values. Apply Gaussian random-displacement channels and estimate the logical error after ideal Steane-type rounding.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Transpose-channel recovery fidelity for cat and binomial codes under pure loss
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Construct the Petz/transpose-channel recovery for code projector P and loss channel N. Compute the resulting entanglement fidelity versus loss for cat and binomial codes, and compare the break-even points.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Quantum-jump trajectories of cat-state photon-number parity
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate Monte Carlo wavefunction trajectories of a cat state under photon loss and record the parity jump times. Verify that the jump statistics are Poissonian and that the trajectory average reproduces the master-equation parity decay.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Squeezed cat codes: bit-flip versus phase-flip rate trade-off
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build squeezed cat states S(r)|±α> in Fock space and compute the logical overlap-induced bit-flip error and the loss-induced phase-flip probability. Map the trade-off as a function of squeezing r at fixed mean photon number.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: SNAP-plus-displacement circuit optimization for cat-state preparation
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Parameterize a cavity unitary as alternating displacements and SNAP phase gates. Optimize the parameters with scipy to maximize fidelity to a target cat or binomial state, and report fidelity versus circuit depth.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Higuchi-Sudbery-Szulc polygon inequalities for three-qubit marginal spectra
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Sample random pure three-qubit states, compute all single-qubit reduced spectra by partial trace, and verify the polygon inequalities. Also test whether given mixed marginal triples are compatible with a global pure state.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Fermionic one-body reduced density matrix and Borland-Dennis constraints
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: For three fermions in six modes, build Fock-space states and compute the 1-RDM. Diagonalize it to obtain natural occupation numbers, then check the generalized Pauli (Borland-Dennis) constraints and the Slater-rank pinning.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Tripartite mutual information of unitary Choi states as a scrambling diagnostic
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Map a 2n-qubit unitary to its Choi state, partition inputs and outputs, and compute I3 from reduced entropies. Compare Haar-random, random-Clifford and local brickwork circuits, following Hosur-Qi-Roberts-Yoshida.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Eigenstate thermalization: subsystem reduced states versus Gibbs states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Diagonalize a nonintegrable tilted-field Ising chain and take reduced density matrices of mid-spectrum eigenstates on small blocks. Compute the trace distance to the canonical Gibbs reduced state at the matched temperature, as a function of system size.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Entanglement Hamiltonian of a TFIM block versus Bisognano-Wichmann ansatz
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the reduced density matrix of a block of the TFIM ground state and take its matrix logarithm to obtain the entanglement Hamiltonian. Fit it to a local Hamiltonian with linearly varying couplings and quantify the deviation.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Lightcone-reduced QAOA edge expectations on large 3-regular graphs
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute p=1,2 QAOA ⟨ZZ⟩ for each edge by simulating only the qubits in its reverse lightcone subgraph. Sum these to get the expected cut on graphs too large for full statevector simulation, and validate on small instances.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: QAOA parameter concentration and transfer across random regular graphs
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Optimize p=1-3 angles on many random 3-regular graphs and measure the spread of the optimal angles. Evaluate the approximation-ratio loss when donor angles are transferred to unseen instances of larger size.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Recursive QAOA with correlation-based variable elimination
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Run p=1 QAOA, select the edge with the largest |⟨Z_iZ_j⟩|, impose the constraint Z_i=sign·Z_j, and recurse on the reduced Ising problem. Compare the final cut with standard QAOA and brute force on small graphs.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: QAOA on Sherrington-Kirkpatrick instances: disorder-averaged energy
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate p=1,2 QAOA on random ±1 SK couplings for n≤14 qubits and optimize the angles. Compute the disorder-averaged energy per spin and compare against the large-n analytic p=1 value.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: QAOA for Max-3-SAT with three-body clause Hamiltonians
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Encode random 3-SAT clauses as diagonal cost Hamiltonians with ZZZ terms and simulate QAOA with the transverse mixer. Compute the expected fraction of satisfied clauses and the satisfying-assignment probability versus p.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: CVaR-QAOA: tail-averaged objective and ground-state probability
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Replace the expectation value with the conditional value-at-risk of the sampled cut distribution, computed from statevector probabilities. Optimize the angles for several α and compare the resulting optimal-cut probability.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Grover-mixer QAOA for Max-k-Vertex-Cover in the Hamming-weight subspace
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Construct the Dicke-state initial state and the Grover mixer projector for the feasible weight-k subspace. Simulate GM-QAOA on small graphs and compute the expected covered edges and the optimum probability versus depth.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Penalty-weight dependence of QAOA feasibility for minimum vertex cover
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Write the unconstrained QUBO with penalty λ for uncovered edges and simulate QAOA with the X mixer. Compute the feasible-solution probability and approximation ratio as functions of λ and p.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Coherent ZZ crosstalk errors and QAOA approximation ratio
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Add unwanted ZZ phases between neighbouring qubits to each QAOA layer on a ring or grid MaxCut instance. Compute the degradation of the optimized approximation ratio, and test whether re-optimizing the angles absorbs the error.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Belief-propagation decoding of the toric code and degeneracy failures
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Implement min-sum/sum-product BP on the toric-code parity-check Tanner graph for bit-flip noise. Measure convergence and logical failure rates versus p, and identify degenerate split-belief syndromes where BP fails.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Bacon-Shor subsystem code: gauge-product syndromes under depolarizing noise
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build gauge and stabilizer operators of the m×m Bacon-Shor code and extract syndromes from products of two-qubit gauge measurements. Decode with the row/column majority rule and compute logical error rates versus size.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Toric code memory lifetime at finite temperature via Metropolis anyon dynamics
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate thermal error creation and diffusion on the toric code with Metropolis updates at temperature T, decoding at intervals with matching. Compute the memory lifetime versus lattice size to show the absence of self-correction.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Planar surface code sub-threshold Λ scaling with assignment-based matching
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate independent X errors on planar surface codes of distance 3-11. Decode by minimum-weight matching with boundary nodes using scipy linear_sum_assignment, and extract the suppression factor Λ=p_L(d)/p_L(d+2).

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Correlated versus independent matching for depolarizing noise on the toric code
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Decode X and Z syndromes separately with matching, then re-weight edges using the Y-correlations found in the first pass. Compare the thresholds of the two schemes under depolarizing noise.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Surface code under mixed erasure and Pauli noise with erasure-weighted matching
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Generate heralded erasures plus unheralded Pauli errors and give erased edges zero weight in the matching. Map the logical failure rate across the erasure/Pauli plane and estimate the threshold line.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Hypergraph product codes from classical seed codes: parameters and distance
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build HGP CSS codes from repetition and Hamming parity-check matrices and verify commutation over GF(2). Compute k via ranks and the distance by brute-force logical search, and decode small instances with lookup tables.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Hard-decision renormalization-group decoder for the toric code
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Implement a Duclos-Cianci-Poulin-style RG decoder that resolves syndromes in 2×2 blocks and coarse-grains them to larger scales. Compare its threshold and runtime with a greedy matching decoder under bit-flip noise.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: 6.6.6 triangular color code: stabilizers and maximum-likelihood decoding
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Construct the distance-3 and distance-5 hexagonal color codes, verify their transversal Clifford action, and enumerate syndromes. Decode by coset-probability maximum likelihood and compute logical error rates under depolarizing noise.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: XY4 and XY8 robustness to flip-angle and detuning pulse errors
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Multiply finite-rotation unitaries for CPMG, XY4 and XY8 that include systematic flip-angle and off-resonance errors. Compute the average fidelity of the sequence to the identity versus number of cycles.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Concatenated DD of a qubit coupled to a small spin bath
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build the full Hamiltonian of a qubit with random hyperfine couplings to five to eight bath spins. Apply concatenated decoupling at levels 1-4 with exact propagators and compute the qubit fidelity versus level and pulse spacing.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: NV-center detection of a 13C nuclear spin via CPMG resonance dips
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the electron coherence M(τ) for a CPMG sequence with a hyperfine-coupled 13C using exact two-spin conditional rotations. Locate the resonance dips and compare with the Taminiau analytic formula.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Staggered XY4 decoupling of static ZZ crosstalk between two qubits
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate two qubits with residual ZZ coupling plus local quasi-static dephasing. Compare synchronous versus staggered XY4 sequences, computing the Bell-state fidelity and the residual effective ZZ from the average Hamiltonian.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Generalized filter function of a driven π-pulse under dephasing and amplitude noise
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the first-order control matrix of a Rabi π-pulse in the toggling frame for detuning and amplitude noise. Integrate it against noise spectra to predict gate infidelity, and validate with Monte Carlo noisy propagation.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Solovay-Kitaev approximation of SU(2) rotations with H and T
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build a base ε-net of short H/T words, then implement the recursive Solovay-Kitaev algorithm with balanced group-commutator decomposition. Report approximation error and sequence length versus recursion depth.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Exact Clifford+T synthesis via smallest-denominator-exponent reduction
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Represent unitaries over Z[1/√2,i] with exact integer arithmetic and reduce the sde by greedily applying H T^k. Recover the exact H/T word and the T-count for random Clifford+T products.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Möttönen state preparation with Gray-code uniformly controlled rotations
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the RY/RZ angle trees for an arbitrary n-qubit amplitude vector. Convert each uniformly controlled rotation to CNOT+rotation form via Gray-code Walsh-Hadamard angle transformation, then verify the prepared state and CNOT count.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Clements decomposition of linear-optical interferometers into MZI meshes
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Null the elements of an N×N unitary with alternating left and right Mach-Zehnder rotations to get the rectangular Clements mesh and residual phases. Reconstruct the unitary and analyse fidelity under beam-splitter imbalance.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Numerical synthesis of two-qubit gates into √iSWAP and CZ layers
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Determine the number of native-gate layers needed to reach Weyl-chamber targets (SWAP, CNOT, B gate, random). Optimize the single-qubit interleaving layers by least squares on the gate fidelity.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Toffoli from Clifford+T: 7-T circuit and relative-phase Margolus gate
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Assemble the standard 6-CNOT/7-T Toffoli circuit and a 3-CNOT relative-phase Toffoli, and verify their unitaries. Compute the relative phases and show how pairing relative-phase Toffolis in a larger circuit cancels them.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: VQE for the deuteron in a harmonic-oscillator basis
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Map the pionless-EFT deuteron Hamiltonian in N=2,3 oscillator states to qubits (Dumitrescu et al.) and optimize a one- or two-parameter ansatz. Extrapolate the binding energy to large basis size.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Qubit tapering of the H2 Hamiltonian via Z2 symmetries
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Find Pauli-string symmetries of the 4-qubit Jordan-Wigner H2 Hamiltonian via the GF(2) null space. Build the Clifford rotations, fix the eigenvalue sectors, and verify that the tapered 1-qubit Hamiltonian reproduces the ground energy.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Quantum subspace expansion for excited states from a VQE reference
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: From an optimized VQE state, build the subspace matrices H_ij=⟨ψ|O_i†HO_j|ψ⟩ and S_ij for single-excitation Pauli operators. Solve the generalized eigenproblem for excited energies and assess the sensitivity to shot noise in S.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Rotosolve sequential minimal optimization for a TFIM VQE
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Exploit the sinusoidal dependence of the energy on each rotation angle to find exact coordinate minima from three evaluations. Compare convergence of the 4-6 qubit TFIM energy against gradient descent.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Noise-induced barren plateaus: cost concentration under local depolarizing noise
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate hardware-efficient ansätze with density matrices and depolarizing noise after each layer. Compute the cost-function variance and gradient magnitudes versus depth, showing exponential concentration toward the maximally mixed value.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Singlet-preserving VQE for the J1-J2 Heisenberg model on small lattices
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Start from a dimer singlet product state and apply parameterized exchange (SWAP-power) gates that conserve total spin. Optimize the 2×3 J1-J2 energy versus J2/J1 and compare with exact diagonalization.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Energy variance and Temple bounds certifying VQE ground states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: For optimized TFIM or Heisenberg ansatz states, compute ⟨H²⟩-⟨H⟩² and derive Weinstein and Temple lower bounds on the ground energy. Check the bounds' tightness against exact energies as the ansatz depth increases.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Thermal relaxation T1/T2 qubit channel Kraus operators and physicality
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Construct Kraus operators combining amplitude damping and pure dephasing from T1, T2 and gate time. Verify completeness, then show via Choi eigenvalues that the map fails complete positivity when T2>2T1.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Qudit ladder amplitude damping: Kraus operators and population cascade
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build Kraus operators for sequential decay |k>→|k-1> in a d-level system with level-dependent rates for a fixed time step. Verify completeness and iterate to obtain the population cascade, comparing with the rate equations.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Werner-Holevo antisymmetric qutrit channel: Kraus form and output entropy
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build Kraus operators of the d=3 Werner-Holevo channel from antisymmetric generators and verify trace preservation and unitary covariance. Numerically minimize the output entropy over pure inputs.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Gaussian-distributed over-rotation averaging into an incoherent dephasing channel
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Average R_z(θ) over a Gaussian distribution of θ to obtain the Kraus/Pauli form with p=(1-e^{-σ²/2})/2. Compare repeated application against a coherent fixed-angle error, contrasting quadratic and linear infidelity accumulation.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Λ-system spontaneous emission: branching-ratio Kraus operators
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Construct Kraus operators for decay of an excited state into two ground states with given branching ratios over a time step. Verify completeness and compute how coherence between the ground states is created or destroyed.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Correlated two-qubit ZZ crosstalk plus Pauli noise channel on Bell states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build Kraus operators of a two-qubit channel mixing correlated ZZ errors with independent Pauli errors, and check completeness. Compute the Bell-state fidelity and concurrence versus correlation strength.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Collision-model thermalization via partial-swap Kraus operators
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Derive system Kraus operators from a partial SWAP with a fresh thermal ancilla qubit. Iterate collisions to show convergence to the ancilla thermal state, and compute the relaxation rate versus swap angle.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Link product of Choi matrices for channel composition and superchannels
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Implement the Chiribella link product via partial transposes and partial traces. Verify it reproduces Choi(N2∘N1), then apply a pre/post-processing superchannel to a qubit channel.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Group covariance tests of channels via Choi commutation
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Test whether a channel is U(1)- or SU(2)-covariant by checking [J, Ū⊗U]=0 over group generators. Project arbitrary channels onto covariant ones by group averaging, and verify on depolarizing, phase-covariant and amplitude damping channels.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Two-step process tensor of a qubit coupled to an ancilla environment
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Construct the multi-time Choi state (process tensor) for a qubit interacting with an ancilla between two intervention slots. Test the Markov (product-form) condition and quantify memory via the mutual information across slots.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Jordan decomposition of Hermiticity-preserving maps into CP differences
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: For a non-CP Hermiticity-preserving map, split its Choi matrix into positive and negative parts to write it as a difference of CP maps. Compute the resulting quasiprobability cost and the diamond-norm upper bound.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Heisenberg-picture adjoint maps and partial-trace Choi duality
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Construct the Choi matrix of the partial trace and of the adjoint of several channels. Verify unitality–trace-preservation duality and check ⟨A,N(ρ)⟩=⟨N†(A),ρ⟩ via Liouville transposes.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Multi-qubit Liouville superoperators with crosstalk via index reshuffling
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build the 2-qubit superoperator of local noise channels combined with a noisy CNOT, using the index permutations needed to tensor single-qubit superoperators correctly. Verify against Kraus application and convert the result to Choi form.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Crooks fluctuation theorem for a driven harmonic oscillator via TPM
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Drive a truncated-Fock oscillator with a time-dependent displacement or frequency ramp and compute forward and backward TPM work distributions. Verify Crooks and Jarzynski relations and the free-energy estimate.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Three-qubit absorption refrigerator: cooling and coefficient of performance
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Model the Linden-Popescu-Skrzypczyk refrigerator with a three-body interaction and three thermal baths using a Lindblad master equation. Compute the steady-state cold-qubit temperature, heat currents and COP versus the Carnot bound.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Coherent versus incoherent ergotropy decomposition
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Split the ergotropy into incoherent and coherent contributions using the dephased state's passive state. Evaluate both parts for qubit and qutrit states and track them under dephasing channels.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Ergotropy gap from correlations in two-qubit states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute global ergotropy and the sum of local ergotropies for Werner, X-states and random two-qubit states. Relate the gap to mutual information and entanglement measures.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Finite-time qubit Otto engine: inner friction from non-commuting drives
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate adiabatic strokes with H(t)=ω(t)σ_z+gσ_x of finite duration and thermalizing strokes. Compute work, heat, efficiency and the excess entropy from coherence generation versus stroke time.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Work characteristic function by Ramsey interferometry of a probe qubit
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Couple an ancilla qubit to a driven spin-1 system as in Dorner-Mazzola, compute the ancilla coherence giving G(u), and Fourier transform it to obtain P(W). Verify agreement with the direct TPM distribution.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Two-qubit SWAP heat engine efficiency and work fluctuations
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Model the Campisi-Pekola-Fazio SWAP engine with qubits at different frequencies coupled alternately to hot and cold baths. Compute the joint heat/work distribution, the mean efficiency 1-ω_c/ω_h, and the fluctuation relations.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Full counting statistics of heat current through a qubit between two baths
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build the counting-field-tilted Lindbladian for a qubit coupled to hot and cold baths. Compute the cumulant generating function from its dominant eigenvalue, then extract the mean current, noise, and thermodynamic uncertainty ratio.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Driven Kerr cavity: steady-state photon number and Liouvillian gap
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Coherently driven, lossy Kerr oscillator in a truncated Fock space. Compute the steady-state photon number versus drive from the Liouvillian null vector, and track the closing of the Liouvillian spectral gap near optical bistability.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Photon blockade: g2(0) of a driven Jaynes-Cummings system
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Two-level atom strongly coupled to a lossy cavity driven at the lower polariton frequency. Compute the steady state and the normalized second-order correlation g2(0) of the cavity field versus coupling strength, showing antibunching.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Optomechanical resolved-sideband cooling: steady-state phonon occupation
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Linearized optomechanical Hamiltonian with cavity loss and a thermal mechanical bath, in truncated Fock spaces. Compute the steady-state phonon number versus detuning and compare with the analytic sideband-cooling limit.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Dissipative Bell-state preparation with engineered jump operators
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Two qubits with designed Lindblad jump operators that pump into the singlet. Verify that the steady state is unique through the Liouvillian kernel dimension, then compute the fidelity convergence rate and its robustness to added local dephasing.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Liouvillian exceptional point of a driven damped qubit
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Resonantly driven qubit with amplitude damping. Compute the Liouvillian eigenvalues versus Rabi frequency, locate the exceptional point at Ω = γ/4, and show the crossover from underdamped to overdamped Rabi dynamics.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Electron shelving: quantum-jump telegraph signal in a V system
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Three-level V atom with one strong and one weak transition. Use quantum-jump Monte Carlo trajectories to generate bright and dark fluorescence periods, then compare dwell-time statistics and the ensemble average with the master-equation solution.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Redfield positivity violation versus secular Lindblad for a qubit
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Qubit in an Ohmic bosonic bath. Build the Bloch-Redfield tensor and its secular (Lindblad) approximation, propagate both, and detect transient negative eigenvalues of the Redfield density matrix for certain initial states.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Boundary-driven XXZ chain: nonequilibrium steady-state spin current
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Short open XXZ chain with Lindblad spin injection at one end and removal at the other. Compute the steady state from the vectorized Liouvillian and evaluate the spin current and magnetization profile versus anisotropy.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Two-level atom in a squeezed vacuum: quadrature-dependent dephasing
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Qubit coupled to a broadband squeezed reservoir, described by Lindblad operators that depend on the squeezing parameters N and M. Compute decay rates of the two Bloch components and show one is suppressed below γ/2.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Electromagnetically induced transparency in a Λ system
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Three-level Λ atom with probe and control fields plus spontaneous decay. Solve for the steady state versus probe detuning, extract the probe susceptibility from the coherence ρ13, and show the transparency window and its width versus control Rabi frequency.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Lehmberg master equation: sub- and superradiance of two dipole-coupled atoms
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Two two-level atoms with distance-dependent collective decay and dipole-dipole shifts. Diagonalize the collective rate matrix, compute the symmetric and antisymmetric decay rates versus separation, and simulate the population trapped in the subradiant state.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Local versus global master equations for two coupled qubits between baths
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Two coupled qubits, each attached to a thermal bath at a different temperature. Compute steady-state heat currents with local and global Lindblad generators, and show where the local approach violates the second law at strong inter-qubit coupling.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Total ergotropy of N copies approaching the free-energy bound
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: N copies of a non-thermal qubit or qutrit state. Compute the ergotropy of ρ^{⊗N} per copy by passive-state ordering of its spectrum and show convergence to the bound set by the free-energy difference. Also show that the per-copy ergotropy of a passive but non-thermal state becomes positive for large N.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Harmonic-oscillator Otto engine with a squeezed thermal hot bath
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Otto cycle on a truncated harmonic oscillator with frequency-switching strokes and thermalization to a squeezed thermal state. Compute heat, work and efficiency versus squeezing and show efficiencies exceeding the standard Carnot value for the bath temperatures.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Single-shot work of formation and distillable work via Rényi free energies
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Qutrit states block-diagonal in the energy basis with a thermal reference state. Compute the Rényi-α relative entropies, and from the α→0 and α→∞ limits obtain the single-shot extractable work and work of formation. Compare both with the average free energy.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Daemonic ergotropy from ancilla measurement feedback
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Two-qubit correlated state in which an ancilla is measured and a conditional unitary is applied to the system. Compute the averaged post-measurement ergotropy, optimize over ancilla measurement bases, and compare with the unconditional ergotropy.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Heat-bath algorithmic cooling: partner-pairing limit of qubit polarization
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Register of computation qubits plus a reset qubit coupled to a bath. Iterate the partner-pairing algorithm (a sort of the diagonal followed by reset) on the density matrix and compute the asymptotic target-qubit polarization versus register size.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Jaynes-Cummings quantum battery: ergotropy from coherent versus Fock chargers
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Qubit battery charged by a resonant cavity mode prepared in a coherent state or a Fock state. Compute the stored energy and the reduced-state ergotropy versus time, and show that the coherent charger delivers useful work while the Fock charger yields a passive-like mixed state.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Optimal equilibrium thermometry: thermal QFI of qubit and multilevel probes
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Gibbs states of qubit and N-level probes. Compute the temperature quantum Fisher information from the energy variance, find the optimal gap at each temperature, and show that the optimal multilevel probe has an effective two-level structure with a degenerate excited manifold.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Jarzynski equality from quantum-jump unraveling of a driven open qubit
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Driven qubit coupled to a thermal bath under Lindblad dynamics. Unravel into quantum-jump trajectories, define work as the change in internal energy minus the heat carried by jumps, and verify <e^{-βW}> = e^{-βΔF} numerically.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Shor nine-qubit code: exact logical error rate under depolarizing noise
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Enumerate all Pauli errors on the nine qubits, weighted by independent depolarizing probabilities. Apply syndrome lookup decoding with degeneracy and sum the probability of logical failure into an exact polynomial in p, comparing it with the unencoded qubit.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Effective logical channel of the five-qubit code under depolarizing noise
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Encode, apply independent depolarizing noise, measure the syndrome with perfect decoding and recover, then decode. Compute the logical Pauli transfer matrix and show that it is a depolarizing channel with a renormalized error rate.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: [[4,2,2]] error-detecting code: Knill-Laflamme check and post-selection
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Construct the [[4,2,2]] codewords and check the Knill-Laflamme conditions for single-qubit errors (detectable but not correctable). Compute the post-selected logical error rate and acceptance probability under depolarizing noise.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Flag-qubit syndrome extraction for the Steane code against hook errors
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate weight-4 stabilizer measurement circuits for the Steane code with and without a flag qubit, as small statevector circuits. Insert single faults at circuit locations and show that the flag catches all weight-2 hook errors that would otherwise cause logical failure.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Transversal T gate on the [[15,1,3]] quantum Reed-Muller code
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build the 15-qubit punctured Reed-Muller code from its stabilizer generators. Verify that the transversal T^† (or T) implements a logical T, and confirm the code distance and the logical operators.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Coherent versus Pauli-twirled errors on small stabilizer codes
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Three-qubit repetition code and Steane code under coherent single-qubit Z rotations, with ideal syndrome decoding. Compute the exact logical infidelity and compare with that of the Pauli-twirled (stochastic) noise, showing the amplified coherent contribution.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Shor-Laflamme weight enumerators of stabilizer codes
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the A and B weight enumerators of the five-qubit, Steane and Shor codes from their stabilizer and normalizer groups. Verify the quantum MacWilliams identity and read off the code distance.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Continuous quantum error correction of the bit-flip code via Lindblad feedback
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Three-qubit bit-flip code under continuous bit-flip noise, with correction modeled as Lindblad jump operators triggered by the syndrome projectors at rate κ. Compute the logical fidelity decay and the effective logical error rate versus κ/γ.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Max-3-Cut QAOA with qutrit encoding
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Encode a 3-coloring of a small graph in qutrits with a phase-separator cost on edges and an X-type qutrit mixer. Simulate p=1,2 QAOA and optimize the angles for the expected cut and approximation ratio.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Portfolio optimization QAOA with budget-preserving XY-ring mixer
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Mean-variance portfolio selection on n assets, with a fixed budget k imposed through Hamming-weight-preserving XY-ring mixers starting from a Dicke state. Compute the expected objective and the probability of the optimal portfolio versus depth.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: QAOA for a three- or four-city traveling salesman with penalty encoding
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Permutation-matrix one-hot encoding of TSP on 9 or 16 qubits with constraint penalties. Simulate low-depth QAOA, then compute the feasible-tour probability and the expected tour length versus penalty weight.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: QAOA for Low Autocorrelation Binary Sequences with four-body terms
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build the LABS sidelobe-energy Hamiltonian with two- and four-body Z terms for n ≤ 12. Simulate QAOA with diagonal phases, optimize the angles, and compute the probability of the optimal merit-factor sequence versus depth.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Multi-angle QAOA with per-edge and per-qubit parameters
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: ma-QAOA on small MaxCut graphs, with an independent γ per edge and an independent β per vertex. Optimize all angles and compare the depth-1 approximation ratio with standard QAOA at depths 1 to 3.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Covariance-matrix criterion and local uncertainty relations for entanglement
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Two-qubit and two-qutrit states such as Werner, isotropic and random states. Compute the symmetric covariance matrix of local orthonormal observables and test the CMC and LUR separability conditions, comparing the detection thresholds with PPT.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: de Vicente correlation-tensor criterion versus CCNR realignment
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Generalized Bloch representation of bipartite qudit states. Compute the trace norm of the correlation tensor, apply the de Vicente bound, and compare its detection power with CCNR on families of PPT-entangled and noisy states.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Generalized Choi maps detecting two-qutrit PPT-entangled states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Implement the Cho-Kye-Lee generalized Choi maps Φ[a,b,c] on 3×3 matrices and apply (id⊗Φ) to families of two-qutrit states. Find the parameter regions where PPT-entangled states are detected through negative eigenvalues.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Dür-Cirac-Tarrach classification of GHZ-diagonal three-qubit states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build GHZ-diagonal states with given weights. Compute the partial transposes across all three bipartitions, classify the states as fully separable, biseparable-type or fully inseparable, and compare with the analytic DCT conditions.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Simon criterion versus Fock-truncated partial transpose for two-mode Gaussians
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Two-mode squeezed thermal states. Compute the PPT symplectic eigenvalue from the covariance matrix, construct the same states in truncated Fock space, and compare the logarithmic negativity and the convergence with cutoff.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Smolin four-qubit state: bound entanglement and unlocking
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Construct the Smolin state as an equal mixture of Bell-pair products. Verify PPT across all 2|2 bipartitions and entanglement across 1|3, then show that a Bell measurement on two parties unlocks a Bell pair for the other two.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Bruß-Peres chessboard bound-entangled states: PPT and range criterion
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build the 3×3 chessboard states from their four parameterized vectors. Verify PPT, then demonstrate entanglement by realignment and by checking that no product vector lies in the range with its partial conjugate in the range of the partial transpose.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Bravyi-Kitaev transform matrices and Pauli-weight scaling versus Jordan-Wigner
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Construct the BK binary update, parity and flip sets for N modes and map creation and annihilation operators to Paulis. Verify the canonical anticommutation relations and compare the average and maximum Pauli weights with JW as N grows.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: 2×2 Hubbard plaquette via Jordan-Wigner: spectrum and ground-state symmetries
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Map the four-site spinful Hubbard model to 8 qubits with Jordan-Wigner. Diagonalize within fixed particle number, compute the half-filling ground-state energy, spin and double occupancy versus U, and check the results against a direct Fock-space construction.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Spinless t-V fermions as an XXZ chain: boundary twists by parity sector
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Periodic spinless fermion chain mapped by Jordan-Wigner to the XXZ model. Show that each fermion-parity sector requires periodic or antiperiodic spin boundary conditions, and verify that the spectra match after the sector-dependent twist.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Ternary-tree fermion-to-qubit encoding with log3 Pauli weight
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build the Jiang-Kalev-Mruczkiewicz-Neven ternary-tree mapping of 2N Majorana operators to Pauli strings. Verify pairwise anticommutation, and compare the maximum Pauli weight with JW and BK for small N.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Fermionic swap network for Trotterized Hubbard dynamics
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Implement fermionic SWAP gates that keep all interactions nearest-neighbor under JW for a 1D chain with long-range hopping or a ladder. Verify that the swap-network Trotter step equals the direct JW Trotter step, and count the gates.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Fermionic Gaussian states: Majorana covariance versus Jordan-Wigner correlators
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Ground states of quadratic fermion Hamiltonians, computed both from the Majorana covariance matrix and as JW qubit statevectors. Verify Wick's theorem for four-point correlators and compute entanglement entropy from both representations.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: SYK model via Jordan-Wigner Majoranas: spectrum and entanglement entropy
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build the q=4 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev Hamiltonian for N ≤ 16 Majoranas from JW strings with random Gaussian couplings. Compute the disorder-averaged spectral density and the half-system entanglement entropy of mid-spectrum eigenstates, and compare it with the Page value.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Number-penalty constrained VQE for the Hubbard dimer
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Hardware-efficient VQE for the JW-mapped two-site Hubbard model with a penalty μ(N−N0)² added to the cost. Compute the converged energy, the particle-number variance and the ground-state fidelity versus μ.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Subspace-search VQE for several low-lying states with one circuit
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: SSVQE on a small Heisenberg or TFIM chain. Apply one shared ansatz to orthogonal computational-basis inputs and minimize a weighted sum of energies, recovering the lowest k eigenvalues and comparing with exact diagonalization.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Folded-spectrum VQE for interior eigenstates
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Minimize <(H−λ)²> with a hardware-efficient ansatz to target eigenstates near a chosen energy λ in a small spin chain. Compute the resulting energies and the fidelity with the exact interior eigenvectors.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Unary versus binary boson encodings for VQE of an anharmonic oscillator
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Truncated anharmonic oscillator or bosonic mode encoded in qubits by one-hot (unary) and binary (Gray-code) maps. Compare the Pauli term counts and run VQE for the ground-state energy in each encoding.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Entanglement forging: halving qubits via Schmidt decomposition
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Ground state of a 2N-qubit spin model written as a Schmidt sum over N-qubit states. Reconstruct the energy from N-qubit expectations and cross terms, and compare the energy error with the number of Schmidt terms kept.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Quantum Krylov subspace diagonalization from real-time evolved states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build a Krylov basis of time-evolved states e^{-iHkΔt}|ψ0> for a small Heisenberg chain. Compute the overlap and Hamiltonian matrices, solve the generalized eigenproblem with thresholding, and track ground-state energy convergence versus subspace size.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: CGLMP inequality violation for two qutrits
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Evaluate the CGLMP Bell expression with Fourier-phase measurement settings. Compare the maximally entangled qutrit state with the optimal non-maximally entangled state found by eigen-decomposition of the Bell operator.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: I3322 inequality: seesaw optimization of qubit violations
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Seesaw alternating optimization over the state and the projective measurements for the I3322 Bell inequality on two qubits. Compute the maximal qubit violation, compare it with the Werner-state CHSH threshold, and give a case that CHSH misses.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Svetlichny inequality for noisy GHZ states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Three-qubit Svetlichny operator with optimized coplanar settings on GHZ states mixed with white noise. Compute the visibility threshold for genuine tripartite nonlocality and compare it with the Mermin threshold.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Eberhard inequality: detection-efficiency threshold with non-maximal states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Two-qubit states cos θ|00>+sin θ|11> with finite detector efficiency η, using no-click outcomes. Optimize the state and settings of the Eberhard inequality and find the minimal η that approaches 2/3.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Chained Braunstein-Caves Bell inequalities with N settings
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Evaluate the chained Bell expression with N equally spaced settings on singlet and Werner states. Compute the quantum value N cos(π/2N), and the noise threshold and local-content bound as N grows.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Robust self-testing of the singlet from CHSH via the swap isometry
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Model non-ideal two-qubit states and measurements with a given CHSH value. Apply the swap-isometry construction to extract the singlet fidelity, and compare it with analytic robust self-testing bounds.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Banaszek-Wódkiewicz parity Bell test on two-mode squeezed vacuum
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Displaced-parity CHSH test on a two-mode squeezed state in truncated Fock space. Compute displaced parity correlations, optimize the displacements versus squeezing, and show the violation approaching 2√2 at large squeezing.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Symmetry-resolved entanglement entropy in the XX chain
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Ground state of the XX chain, which conserves magnetization. Block-decompose the subsystem reduced density matrix by charge sector, compute the number and configurational entanglement, and verify equipartition across sectors.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Maassen-Uffink entropic uncertainty for mutually unbiased bases in prime d
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Wootters-Fields MUBs in d = 3, 5. Compute Shannon entropies of the outcome distributions for random and minimum-uncertainty states, and test the Maassen-Uffink and multi-MUB entropic bounds for tightness.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Monogamy of mutual information: stabilizer versus Haar-random states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the tripartite information I3 for random four-party partitions of Haar-random, random stabilizer and graph states. Show that stabilizer states always satisfy I3 ≤ 0, while some Haar-random mixed marginals can violate it.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: SSH chain entanglement spectrum: topological degeneracy
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Su-Schrieffer-Heeger ground state at half filling. Compute the half-chain entanglement spectrum from the correlation matrix, and verify by JW exact diagonalization the twofold degeneracy in the topological phase and its absence in the trivial phase.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Hesse SIC-POVM for qutrits from a Weyl-Heisenberg fiducial
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Generate the nine qutrit SIC states from a fiducial with Weyl-Heisenberg displacements. Verify |<ψ_i|ψ_j>|² = 1/4 and informational completeness, then reconstruct qutrit density matrices from SIC probabilities.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Joint measurability of unsharp qubit observables
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Noisy spin observables along two or three directions with sharpness η. Construct joint POVMs where they exist, and verify Busch's criterion (and its three-observable generalization) against the SDP-free analytic boundary.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Wootters-Fields mutually unbiased bases and complete-MUB tomography
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Construct d+1 MUBs in prime dimension from finite-field quadratic phases and verify mutual unbiasedness. Perform qudit state reconstruction from MUB probabilities and compare the error with SIC-POVM tomography.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Accessible information of the Peres-Wootters double-trine ensemble
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Two-qubit double-trine product states. Numerically maximize the mutual information over POVMs parameterized through Naimark dilation, and compare the results for local measurement, the pretty-good measurement and the optimal collective measurement.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Coherent-state POVM: heterodyne statistics and Husimi Q-function
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Truncated-Fock coherent states forming the heterodyne POVM. Verify the resolution of identity under a quadrature grid, compute Husimi Q-functions of Fock and cat states, and show the added vacuum noise in the quadrature variances.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Optimal covariant measurement for N-copy qubit state estimation
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Estimate a pure qubit state from N copies using a continuous covariant POVM on the symmetric subspace, discretized by a spherical design. Compute the average fidelity and verify the optimal value (N+1)/(N+2).

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Sequential unsharp measurements: CHSH violations by multiple Bobs
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Singlet shared between Alice and a sequence of Bobs, each performing an unsharp Lüders measurement of strength λ. Propagate the post-measurement states and find the sharpness ranges in which two successive Bobs both violate CHSH.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Covariant phase POVM: Holevo phase variance of N-photon states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Canonical phase measurement on states in a truncated N-photon space. Compute the Holevo phase variance for coherent, Fock superposition and optimal (sine-type) states, and its scaling with N.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Dense coding over a correlated Pauli memory channel
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Send both halves of Bell pairs over two uses of a qubit Pauli channel with Markov-correlated errors (Macchiavello-Palma model). Compute the Holevo quantity of the four-message ensemble as a function of the correlation parameter and compare with uncorrelated noise.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Linear-optical partial Bell analyzer limits dense coding to log2(3) bits
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Model polarization-entangled photon pairs on a 50:50 beamsplitter with polarizing detectors as a POVM on the Bell basis. Build the detection-outcome probability table and compute the maximal mutual information over message priors, recovering log2(3).

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Superdense teleportation of equatorial ququart states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Encode an equatorial two-qubit (ququart) state using phase-only unitaries on a hyperentangled resource and decode with a partial Bell measurement. Compute output fidelity and classical-bit cost, and compare with standard teleportation.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Scrambling without chaos: OTOC growth near the LMG saddle point
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the OTOC of collective spin operators in the Lipkin-Meshkov-Glick model in the symmetric subspace for spin coherent states near the unstable fixed point. Extract the exponential growth rate and compare it with the classical saddle-point instability exponent.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Operator weight distribution under random Haar brickwork circuits
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Heisenberg-evolve a local Pauli operator through random two-qubit Haar brickwork layers on 8-10 qubits and expand it in the Pauli basis. Compute the operator-weight distribution and right-front position versus depth, and estimate the butterfly velocity.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Hayden-Preskill recovery with the Yoshida-Kitaev probabilistic decoder
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Use a scrambling unitary (random or a Clifford 3-qubit scrambler) on a thermofield-double setup and apply the EPR-projection decoder. Compute decoding success probability and fidelity versus the number of radiation qubits collected.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Operator entanglement of the time-evolution operator in the XXZ chain
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Vectorize U(t)=exp(-iHt) of a short XXZ chain and compute the operator Schmidt spectrum across a half-chain cut. Compare growth for integrable and next-nearest-neighbour-perturbed (chaotic) chains.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: OTOC estimation from randomized measurements without time reversal
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Implement the Vermersch-Elben protocol, applying shared random local unitaries before and after Ising-chain evolution. Estimate the infinite-temperature OTOC from cross-correlations of simulated bitstring probabilities and compare with exact values.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Gibbs state of a frustrated spin-1/2 Heisenberg triangle nanomagnet
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build the Gibbs density matrix of an antiferromagnetic spin triangle with Zeeman and Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya terms. Compute purity, magnetization, susceptibility and the spectral decomposition into chirality sectors versus temperature.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Physical parameter region of two-qubit X states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Parametrize two-qubit X states by populations and coherences and derive positivity from principal minors. Map the allowed region and check it numerically against eigenvalues and Cholesky factorization attempts.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Majorana stellar representation of spin-j states and anticoherence
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Map a spin-j pure state to the roots of its Majorana polynomial and project them stereographically onto the sphere. Compute the star constellations and test first- and second-order anticoherence through vanishing spin expectations and isotropic second moments.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Spherical-tensor multipole expansion of spin-1 density matrices
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Decompose spin-1 density matrices into irreducible tensor operators T_kq to obtain orientation (k=1) and alignment (k=2) components. Verify the positivity constraints and evaluate the decomposition for a nematic state and a thermal state in a field.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: QAOA preparation of the critical transverse-field Ising chain ground state
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Use alternating ZZ and X layers on a periodic Ising ring to prepare the critical ground state, following Ho-Hsieh. Optimize angles at depths p up to N/2 and report energy and fidelity, showing exact preparation at p=N/2.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Digitized counterdiabatic QAOA with Y-type terms for small MaxCut
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Augment QAOA layers with first-order counterdiabatic Y/ZY generators on MaxCut instances of 6-8 vertices. Compare the optimized approximation ratio and ground-state probability against standard QAOA at equal depth.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Purcell decay of a transmon via a lossy readout resonator
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Diagonalize a non-Hermitian transmon-resonator Hamiltonian with a resonator loss rate, using a charge-basis transmon truncated to a few levels. Extract the dressed qubit linewidth versus detuning and compare with the Purcell formula κ(g/Δ)^2.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Transmon coupled to a two-level-system defect: swap spectroscopy
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Model a flux-tunable transmon coupled to a TLS defect, compute the avoided crossing, and simulate vacuum-Rabi swaps after an excitation pulse. Produce the swap-spectroscopy population map versus frequency and interaction time.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: AC Stark shift of a multilevel transmon under off-resonant driving
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute qubit transition shifts of a charge-basis transmon under a classical drive, using Floquet or rotating-frame diagonalization. Compare with second-order perturbation theory including the 1-2 transition, and identify the leakage-prone drive frequencies.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: MBQC on the 1D AKLT state: teleportation with random byproducts
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Use the AKLT MPS as a resource for measurement-based teleportation of a logical qubit with spin-1 measurements. Compute the induced Pauli byproduct statistics and the logical rotations applied, following Gross-Eisert.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Type-I and Type-II fusion gates for photonic cluster-state growth
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Model polarization-encoded fusion operations as Kraus/projection maps on small graph states. Compute success probabilities and the resulting graph states, and check their stabilizers against the expected graph merging rules.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Fidelity susceptibility across the anisotropic XY chain phase diagram
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the ground-state fidelity susceptibility of the XY chain with respect to field and anisotropy, both by exact diagonalization and by free-fermion momentum formulas. Locate critical lines from the peak scaling with system size.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Quantum natural gradient and Fubini-Study metric

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Sjöqvist interferometric geometric phase of mixed qubit states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the mixed-state geometric phase for a qubit transported around a cone, with spectral weights set by purity. Compare it with the pure-state Berry phase and with the visibility of an interferometric simulation.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Quantum natural gradient and Fubini-Study metric

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Reflected entropy of two-qubit mixed states via canonical purification
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Construct the canonical purification |√ρ_AB⟩ in AA*BB* and compute the reflected entropy S(AA*). Check the bounds I(A:B) ≤ S_R ≤ 2 min(S_A,S_B) for Werner and random states.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Entanglement of purification of two-qubit states by numerical optimization
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Parametrize purifications with ancilla isometries and minimize S(AA') with scipy.optimize. Compute E_P for Werner and classically correlated states and compare with mutual-information bounds.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Thermofield double of the transverse Ising chain as a Gibbs purification
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build the TFD state of a small TFIM chain from its eigendecomposition and verify that the reduced state is the Gibbs state. Compute entanglement between the copies versus β and its dynamics under H⊗I evolution.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Twist-and-untwist echo interferometry: Fisher information of OAT probes
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate one-axis twisting, a small rotation, and reversed twisting in the symmetric subspace of N spins. Compute the classical Fisher information of collective-spin measurement and compare it with the QFI and the standard quantum limit.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Symmetric logarithmic derivative and optimal measurement for mixed qubit probes
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Solve the Lyapunov equation for the SLD of a dephased qubit phase-encoded state, then compute the QFI and the SLD eigenbasis measurement. Verify that the classical Fisher information of this measurement saturates the QFI.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Ancilla-assisted estimation of amplitude-damping strength
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the QFI for the damping parameter γ with single-qubit probes and with maximally entangled probe-ancilla inputs, by numerical differentiation of output states. Compare the optimal input states and the Cramér-Rao bounds.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Mach-Zehnder QFI with coherent plus squeezed-vacuum inputs
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Represent a two-mode Fock-truncated interferometer with a coherent state and squeezed vacuum at the inputs. Compute the phase QFI versus the squeezing fraction of a fixed photon budget and compare with shot-noise and Heisenberg scaling.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Mandelstam-Tamm versus Margolus-Levitin quantum speed limits
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: For qubit, spin-j and harmonic-oscillator superpositions, compute the orthogonalization times from exact dynamics. Compare them with the energy-variance and mean-energy bounds and identify the states that saturate each.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Derandomized classical shadows for many local Pauli observables
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Implement Huang-Kueng-Preskill derandomization of Pauli measurement bases using pessimistic confidence bounds. Compare the estimation error for a set of 2-local observables on a 6-qubit Heisenberg ground state with random shadows at equal shot counts.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Locally biased classical shadows for molecular Pauli Hamiltonians
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Optimize qubit-wise probabilities of X/Y/Z bases to minimize estimator variance for a Pauli-sum Hamiltonian (e.g., four-qubit LiH-like). Simulate the biased shadows and compare energy-estimate variance with uniform shadows.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: MPS bond dimensions of GHZ, W and Dicke states from successive SVDs
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Decompose GHZ, W and Dicke statevectors into MPS by sequential SVDs and record the bond dimensions and singular values. Construct the analytic bond-dimension-2 forms and verify the contractions.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Matrix product states and tensor networks

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Correlation length of the q-deformed AKLT (KSZ) MPS family
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build the uniform MPS of the Klümper-Schadschneider-Zittartz deformed spin-1 ground states. Compute the transfer-matrix spectrum, correlation length and string order versus the deformation parameter.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Matrix product states and tensor networks

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Two-site DMRG for the spin-1 Haldane chain: gap and edge states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Implement two-site finite DMRG with an MPO for the spin-1 Heisenberg chain. Compute the ground and lowest excited energies to estimate the Haldane gap, and show the edge-spin magnetization profile in the open chain.
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.area: Matrix product states and tensor networks

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Stabilizer fidelity and stabilizer extent of n-copy T states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Enumerate the stabilizer states for n ≤ 3 qubits and compute the maximal overlap with |T⟩^⊗n. Evaluate the stabilizer extent via optimized decompositions and check its multiplicativity.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Testing gate membership in the third level of the Clifford hierarchy
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Check by Pauli conjugation whether gates such as T, CCZ, √T and controlled-S map Paulis into the Clifford group. Classify each gate's hierarchy level using Pauli-to-Clifford tests on symplectic representations.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Wigner-Yanase skew information as asymmetry of spin states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the skew information and the relative entropy of asymmetry with respect to Jz for spin coherent, Dicke, GHZ and thermal states. Compare these asymmetry resources with the QFI bounds.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Imaginarity resource theory: robustness and geometric imaginarity of qubits
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the l1 imaginarity, the robustness of imaginarity (closed form via Tr|ρ-ρ^T|) and the geometric imaginarity for qubit and qutrit states. Track their evolution under real-orthogonal and phase-changing channels.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Port-based teleportation fidelity with the pretty-good measurement
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Construct N-port resource states and Bob's PGM over port outcomes for qubits with N=2-4. Compute the entanglement fidelity and success probability and compare with the asymptotic 1-O(1/N) scaling.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Remote state preparation of equatorial qubits with one classical bit
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate Bennett et al.'s remote preparation using a Bell pair, Alice's measurement in a rotated basis, and a conditional Z correction. Compute output fidelity and compare classical-bit costs for equatorial versus general states.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Quantum random access codes 2→1 and 3→1 success probabilities
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Encode classical bit strings into qubit states on Bloch-sphere vertices and decode with Pauli measurements. Compute average and worst-case success probabilities and compare with optimal classical RACs.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Qutrit teleportation with generalized Bell measurement and Weyl corrections
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build the nine generalized Bell states and the Weyl-Heisenberg corrections for qutrit teleportation. Verify unit fidelity, then compute average fidelity with an isotropic noisy resource versus the classical bound.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Private quantum channel: exact and approximate twirls to maximal mixedness
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Encrypt qubit states with random Pauli keys (2 bits) and with reduced key sets. Compute the trace distance of the average ciphertext from I/d and the eavesdropper's Holevo information versus key length.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Gottesman-Chuang teleportation of CNOT and T gates
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Implement gate teleportation through Bell or resource states prepared with the target gate, including the conditional Clifford corrections. Verify the gate action for all measurement outcomes and the resulting state fidelities.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Barrett-Kok heralded remote entanglement with imperfect photons
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Model two emitter qubits whose photons interfere on a beamsplitter in a two-round detection scheme, including photon distinguishability and loss. Compute the heralded state fidelity and success probability.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Quantum switch of depolarizing channels: enhanced classical communication
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build the Kraus operators of the quantum SWITCH acting on two depolarizing channels with a control qubit. Compute the output state and Holevo information versus depolarizing strength, comparing with sequential and parallel use.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Entanglement catalysis: the Jonathan-Plenio example via majorization
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Check Nielsen majorization for pure bipartite transformations that fail alone but succeed with a catalyst state. Search numerically for valid two-qubit catalysts for given 4x4 Schmidt vectors.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Concurrence of assistance for two-qubit mixed states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the concurrence of assistance via the Laustsen-Verstraete-van Enk formula (trace norm of √ρ ρ̃ √ρ). Compare it with the concurrence and check the CKW-type bound in purified three-qubit states.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Cuccaro ripple-carry adder from MAJ and UMA gates
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build the Cuccaro in-place adder from CNOT/Toffoli MAJ and UMA blocks on n-bit registers. Verify addition on all computational inputs and on superposition inputs, and count gates and ancillas.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: HHL algorithm for a 2x2 linear system
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate HHL with a clock register, controlled-unitary QPE, conditional ancilla rotation and uncomputation for a Hermitian 2x2 matrix. Compute post-selection success probability and the fidelity of the solution state versus clock size.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Hadamard test estimation of Loschmidt amplitudes
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Use an ancilla-controlled time evolution to estimate Re and Im of ⟨ψ|e^{-iHt}|ψ⟩ for a small Ising chain quench. Compare finite-shot estimates with the exact Loschmidt echo and return rate.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Qubitization walk operator spectrum for a two-qubit Pauli Hamiltonian
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build PREPARE/SELECT block encodings of an LCU Hamiltonian and the qubitized walk operator. Verify that walk eigenphases equal ±arccos(E_k/λ) and recover the spectrum.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Quantum signal processing response polynomials from phase sequences
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the QSP polynomial ⟨0|U_Φ(x)|0⟩ for given phase sequences in the Wx convention. Verify Chebyshev polynomial outputs and optimize phases to approximate a sign-function target.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: qDRIFT randomized product formula versus Trotter for Pauli-sum Hamiltonians
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate qDRIFT sampling of Pauli exponentials with importance weights and first-order Trotter for a weighted Pauli Hamiltonian. Compare the diamond-norm-like error against gate count, showing the λ²t²/N scaling.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Variational quantum state diagonalization of qubit mixed states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Train a parameterized unitary on two copies of ρ to minimize the dephased Hilbert-Schmidt cost. Read off the eigenvalues and eigenvectors and compare with exact diagonalization for one- and two-qubit states.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Quantum kernel SVM with a ZZ feature map
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute fidelity kernel matrices from a two-qubit ZZ feature-map circuit on a toy dataset. Train an SVM with the precomputed kernel and evaluate how kernel concentration depends on feature-map depth.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Quantum autoencoder compressing a family of two-qubit states
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Optimize a parametrized two-qubit unitary to map a parametrized family (e.g., TFIM ground states) onto one qubit plus a fixed trash state. Compute the compression fidelity and the trash-state overlap cost.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Qutrit [[3,1,2]] code: erasure correction and Knill-Laflamme conditions
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build the three-qutrit code that also serves as a secret-sharing scheme. Verify the Knill-Laflamme conditions for single-erasure errors and construct the recovery unitary from any two qutrits.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Decoherence-free subspaces of four qubits under collective decoherence
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Find the DFS for collective dephasing and the singlet subspace for collective SU(2) noise via commutant/eigenspace computations. Verify protection of encoded states under the collective Lindblad dynamics.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Virtual distillation: exponential error suppression with M copies
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Compute error-mitigated expectation values Tr(Oρ^M)/Tr(ρ^M) for noisy GHZ or VQE states under depolarizing noise. Model the cyclic-shift circuit and compare the error decay with copy number M.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Repeated QND photon counting with Rydberg-atom Ramsey probes
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Model Haroche-style dispersive atomic probes as Kraus operators on a cavity Fock state with photon-number-dependent phase shifts. Simulate Bayesian photon-number collapse and the number of atoms needed to resolve n.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: KCBS contextuality inequality violation with a qutrit pentagram
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Construct the five KCBS projectors in a pentagram orthogonality arrangement for a qutrit. Compute the maximal violation √5 versus the noncontextual bound 2 and its robustness to white noise.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Exchange-based √SWAP and CPHASE in a double quantum dot with Zeeman gradient
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Model two spin qubits with time-dependent exchange and a magnetic field gradient. Compute the resulting gates for exchange pulses, the √SWAP-to-CPHASE crossover, and gate fidelity versus gradient strength.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: NV-center ground-state spin-1 ODMR spectrum versus magnetic field
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Diagonalize the NV spin-1 Hamiltonian with zero-field splitting, Zeeman term and field misalignment. Compute ODMR transition frequencies and strengths versus field magnitude and angle, including the ground-state level anticrossing.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Singlet-triplet qubit S-T0 oscillations with quasistatic nuclear fields
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate S-T0 precession under a hyperfine field difference averaged over a Gaussian Overhauser distribution. Compute singlet return probability and its T2* decay, comparing exchange-dominated and gradient-dominated regimes.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Radical-pair compass: singlet yield anisotropy versus field direction
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Model two electron spins plus one anisotropic hyperfine nuclear spin under an Earth-strength field. Compute singlet yield with exponential recombination kernel via eigendecomposition, versus field orientation.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: INEPT polarization transfer in a J-coupled heteronuclear spin pair
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Propagate the thermal deviation density matrix of a 1H-13C pair through the INEPT pulse sequence with product-operator rotations. Compute the transferred carbon polarization enhancement versus delay.

physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: PXP model scars: fidelity revivals from the Néel state
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Build the constrained PXP Hamiltonian on Rydberg-blockaded chains and evolve the Z2 Néel state. Compute fidelity revivals, entanglement growth and overlaps with eigenstates, compared with a random product state.
