physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.title: Discrete time crystal in a disordered kicked Ising chain
physics/quantum_info|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate the Floquet unitary of imperfect π-flips plus disordered Ising interactions. Compute stroboscopic magnetization autocorrelations and the robustness of period doubling versus pulse error.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Deficiency and linkage classes of mass-action networks
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Given reaction lists (e.g. EnvZ-OmpR, futile cycle, Edelstein), build the complex composition and incidence matrices. Find linkage classes as connected components of the complex graph and the stoichiometric rank, then compute the deficiency δ = n − l − s for each network.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Semipositive conservation laws of a MAPK cascade by double description
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the left null space of the stoichiometric matrix of a three-tier MAPK cascade. Enumerate its minimal semipositive generators (extreme rays) with a Fourier-Motzkin / double-description algorithm, and report the conserved total moieties.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Counting positive steady states of the Edelstein network across total mass
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Reduce the mass-action steady-state equations of the Edelstein network on a stoichiometric compatibility class to a univariate polynomial. Locate the positive roots by bracketing and Newton refinement, and map the interval of total mass that gives three steady states.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Craciun-Feinberg injectivity test via symbolic Jacobian determinant
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For a small mass-action network, form the species-reaction Jacobian with symbolic rate constants and expand det(−J) with sympy. Check whether all coefficients share one sign (which certifies injectivity and excludes multistationarity), and list the offending monomials for networks that fail the test.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Weak reversibility and terminal strong linkage classes via Tarjan's algorithm
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Build the directed complex graph of a reaction network and find its strongly connected components with Tarjan's algorithm. Identify the terminal strong linkage classes, decide weak reversibility, and evaluate the hypotheses of the Deficiency Zero Theorem.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Minimal siphon enumeration and persistence check for phosphorylation networks
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Represent a dual-site phosphorylation network as a Petri net and enumerate its minimal siphons by combinatorial subset search with closure checks. Test whether each siphon contains the support of a positive conservation law (the Angeli-De Leenheer-Sontag persistence criterion).

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Fold range of the distributive dual futile cycle steady states
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Parametrize the steady states of the two-site distributive phosphorylation cycle by the free substrate concentration and reduce them to one equation in total kinase. Find the saddle-node boundaries, where the derivative of the total vanishes, by root finding, and report the bistable range of total kinase.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Attractors and basin sizes of the yeast cell-cycle Boolean network
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Exhaustively enumerate all 2^11 states of the Li et al. threshold Boolean network of the budding-yeast cell cycle under synchronous update. Detect fixed points and cycles by trajectory following, compute the basin size of each attractor, and find the dominant G1 attractor fraction.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Asynchronous Boolean attractors as terminal SCCs of the state transition graph
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Build the asynchronous state transition graph of a ~10-node Boolean model (e.g. mammalian cell-cycle core). Compute its strongly connected components with Tarjan's algorithm and identify the terminal SCCs as point or complex attractors. Compare these with the synchronous attractors.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Profile likelihood of Hill coefficients in a repressilator time-course fit
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Fit a Hill-type repressilator ODE model to noisy protein time courses by Levenberg-Marquardt nonlinear least squares. Compute the profile likelihood of the Hill coefficient by constrained re-optimization over a grid of fixed values, and report its confidence interval.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: REVEAL-style Boolean rule inference by mutual information subset search
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: From discretized state-transition time series, enumerate the candidate input subsets of size ≤k for each gene. Select the minimal subset whose mutual information fully determines the gene's next state, then extract the Boolean truth table and check its consistency.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Sequentially thresholded least squares identification of a toggle switch model
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Apply SINDy to simulated noisy trajectories of a genetic circuit using a library of polynomial and Hill-type terms. Iterate least squares with hard thresholding until the support stabilizes, and report the recovered coefficients and the support accuracy.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Minimal knockout intervention sets eliminating a Boolean disease attractor
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For a T-LGL-like Boolean leukemia network, enumerate node knockout sets by increasing size. Recompute the attractors under each intervention, and return all minimal sets that eliminate the target attractor while preserving the apoptosis attractor.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: BIC hill-climbing structure learning of a gene Bayesian network
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Learn a DAG over discretized expression data by greedy hill climbing on the BIC score with edge addition, deletion and reversal moves. Enforce acyclicity at each move by topological-sort checks, and compare the learned skeleton to the generating network.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Integrated Michaelis-Menten progress curve fit via Lambert W
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Fit Vmax and Km to a single substrate depletion curve using the closed-form Lambert W solution and nonlinear least squares. Quantify the bias of Lineweaver-Burk linearization against the nonlinear estimates over repeated noisy datasets.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Enzyme inhibition mechanism selection by global nonlinear fit and AIC
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Globally fit competitive, uncompetitive, noncompetitive and mixed inhibition rate laws to initial-rate data at several inhibitor levels using Gauss-Newton least squares. Select the mechanism by AICc and report Ki and αKi with standard errors.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: D-optimal substrate design for Michaelis-Menten parameter estimation
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Maximize the determinant of the Fisher information for (Vmax, Km) over two-point designs on [0, Smax] by bounded constrained optimization. Recover the analytic optimum S* = Km·Smax/(2Km+Smax), and compare the parameter variances with a uniform design.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Bistability of a substrate-inhibited enzyme in a CSTR
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For a continuous stirred reactor with Haldane substrate-inhibition kinetics, find all steady states versus dilution rate by bracketing roots of the mass balance. Locate the fold points by solving the augmented system with a vanishing derivative, giving the hysteresis interval.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Ping-pong versus ordered bi-bi mechanism discrimination
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Generate two-substrate initial-rate data, then fit the ping-pong and ordered sequential bi-bi rate equations by nonlinear least squares over the (A, B) grid. Discriminate between them with the residual F-test and the intersection pattern of double-reciprocal lines.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Total QSSA for two substrates competing for one enzyme
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Derive the tQSSA for an enzyme with two competing substrates, where the complex concentrations satisfy a coupled quadratic system (reducing to a cubic). Solve it at each time point by Newton's method with physical root selection, and compare the product trajectories with the full ODE and with the sQSSA.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Profile-likelihood confidence intervals for cooperative Hill binding
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Fit K and the Hill coefficient n to fractional saturation data by bounded nonlinear least squares. Compute likelihood-ratio profile intervals for n by root finding on the profile deviance, and contrast them with Wald intervals at small sample sizes.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Outbreak extinction probability under negative binomial superspreading
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Solve q = G(q) for the negative binomial offspring PGF with mean R and dispersion k by fixed-point iteration and Newton's method. Map the major-outbreak probability over (R, k), and compare it with the Poisson case and with branching-process simulations.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Multitype branching extinction probabilities for age-structured transmission
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Build a multitype Poisson offspring PGF from an age-group contact matrix. Solve the vector fixed point q = G(q) by Newton's method, and report the major-outbreak probability seeded by an index case in each group.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Exact Reed-Frost final size distribution by recursion
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the exact final-size distribution of the Reed-Frost chain binomial in a population of N by solving the triangular linear recursion for the final size probabilities. Verify it against Monte Carlo chain-binomial simulations, and identify the bimodality as R0 crosses 1.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Maximum likelihood R and k from stuttering chain cluster sizes
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Derive the total-progeny distribution of a negative-binomial branching process via the Lagrange inversion (Dwass) formula. Fit R and k to observed transmission cluster sizes, such as monkeypox-like data, by maximizing the likelihood, and give profile intervals.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Generation-wise extinction probability under declining reproduction number
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Iterate the composition of generation-specific Poisson or negative binomial PGFs with R_n decreasing under rollout of control. Compute the probability that the chain is extinct by generation n and the asymptotic extinction probability.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Major outbreak probability for SEIR with Erlang-distributed stages
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Model early SEIR spread as a continuous-time multitype birth-death process with Erlang latent and infectious stages. Solve the coupled polynomial extinction equations by Newton's method, and show how the stage number alters the outbreak probability at fixed R0.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Normal moment closure steady states of the bistable Schlögl model
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Derive the first two moment equations of the Schlögl model under Gaussian closure. Find all their stationary solutions by bracketed root finding, and compare the closure means and variances with the exact birth-death stationary distribution, including any spurious roots.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Linear noise approximation and moment closure

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Lognormal closure versus exact CME for protein dimerization
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Close the moment hierarchy of 2P⇌D with production and degradation using a lognormal third-moment closure, and solve for the stationary moments by Newton's method. Compute the exact stationary distribution as the null vector of the truncated generator and tabulate the closure errors.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Linear noise approximation and moment closure

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: System-size expansion correction to mean dimer concentration
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the effective mesoscopic rate equation (O(Ω⁻¹)) correction to the macroscopic steady state of a dimerization network by solving the Lyapunov and linear correction systems. Quantify the deviation from mass-action mean concentrations as the volume shrinks.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Linear noise approximation and moment closure

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Constrained optimization of feedback strength to minimize protein noise
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Using steady-state LNA formulas for an autoregulated gene, minimize the protein coefficient of variation over feedback strength and Hill coefficient. Impose the constraint of a fixed mean protein level, solved by SLSQP with an inner Newton fixed-point solve.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Linear noise approximation and moment closure

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Flux balance analysis of a small central carbon network
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Construct the stoichiometric matrix of a ~20-reaction glycolysis/TCA/biomass toy network and maximize biomass flux with linprog under uptake bounds. Report the optimal growth rate and the dual shadow prices of the metabolites.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Flux variability analysis at suboptimal growth
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: After the FBA optimum, fix biomass ≥ 90% of its maximum. Solve 2n linear programs for the minimum and maximum of each flux, and classify reactions as blocked, essential-direction or freely variable.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Gene knockout and synthetic lethal pair scan with GPR rules
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Evaluate Boolean gene-protein-reaction rules to map single and double gene deletions to reaction bound changes. Rerun FBA for each deletion, and list the essential genes and synthetic lethal pairs whose growth falls below 5% of wild type.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Elementary flux mode enumeration by the nullspace algorithm
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Enumerate all elementary flux modes of a small metabolic network using the Schuster/Wagner nullspace (double-description) algorithm with irreversibility constraints and support minimality tests. Report the mode count and the maximal-yield mode.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Parsimonious FBA with split reversible reactions
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Split reversible reactions into forward and backward fluxes. Solve a second LP that minimizes total flux at fixed optimal growth, and compare the pFBA flux distribution and its uniqueness with plain FBA.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: MOMA quadratic programming prediction of knockout fluxes
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Predict mutant fluxes by minimizing the Euclidean distance to the wild-type FBA solution, subject to the knockout's steady-state and bound constraints, using SLSQP. Compare the predicted growth with FBA for each single knockout.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Dynamic FBA of glucose-acetate diauxic batch growth
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Couple a sequence of linear programs with Michaelis-Menten uptake bounds to Euler updates of biomass, glucose and acetate concentrations. Reproduce the diauxic shift, and report its timing and the final biomass.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Exhaustive knockout search for growth-coupled product overproduction
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Enumerate all one- and two-reaction deletions in a toy network. For each, solve FBA for growth and then minimize the product flux at that growth. Return the deletion sets that maximize the guaranteed product yield, an OptKnock-style bilevel search by enumeration.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Minimal gap filling by mixed-integer linear programming
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Given a draft network that cannot grow, select the minimal number of reactions from a universal database that restores biomass flux. Formulate this as a MILP with binary indicators and big-M bounds solved by scipy.optimize.milp, and enumerate alternative optimal solutions with integer cuts.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Sequential invasion assembly of gLV communities from a species pool
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Introduce species one at a time from a pool. For each invader, compute its invasion growth rate, integrate the dynamics to the new attractor, recompute the feasible equilibrium and remove extinct species. Iterate until no species can invade, and record the endpoint richness and turnover.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Counting alternative stable states by gLV support enumeration
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Enumerate all 2^S species subsets of a nonsymmetric competitive gLV system (S ≤ 12). Keep the subsets whose restricted equilibrium is feasible, locally stable and uninvadable, and report the number of alternative stable states as interaction strength varies.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Critical interaction scaling for loss of gLV feasibility by bisection
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For a given community matrix A = I + εB, find the critical ε at which the first equilibrium abundance hits zero by bisection on the minimum of the linear-solve solution. Identify which species is lost first.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Tilman R* coexistence of two consumers on two essential resources
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Find the joint equilibria of a two-consumer, two-resource chemostat model with Liebig's law of the minimum by root finding on the ZNGI intersections and the supply-point mass balance. Classify the supply-point regions as coexistence or exclusion.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: R0 of Ross-Macdonald malaria model as next-generation spectral radius
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Construct the F and V matrices for the host-vector Ross-Macdonald model with an extrinsic incubation period, and compute R0 as the spectral radius of FV⁻¹. Find the critical mosquito density where R0 = 1 by bisection.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Age-structured SEIR R0 and critical uniform vaccination coverage
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Build a next-generation matrix from a contact matrix, population sizes and susceptibility profiles, and compute R0 by power iteration. Bisect for the uniform vaccination coverage that reduces the spectral radius to 1.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Optimal age-targeted vaccine allocation minimizing the spectral radius
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Minimize the dominant eigenvalue of the vaccinated next-generation matrix over group coverages, subject to a total-dose budget and the bounds 0 ≤ v_i ≤ 1, using SLSQP. Compare the optimum with uniform and with high-contact-first allocations.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Type reproduction number for targeted control in a multihost zoonosis
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the Roberts-Heesterbeek type reproduction number T for a chosen host in a multihost NGM using the projection formula. Determine the critical control effort in that host alone for elimination, and compare it with R0.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Commuting metapopulation R0 and threshold mobility rate
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Build the NGM for SIR patches coupled by a commuting matrix with time-split contact rates, and compute R0 as its spectral radius. Bisect for the mobility rate at which a local outbreak in a high-transmission patch becomes globally supercritical.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Greedy node removal minimizing SIS epidemic threshold on a network
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the network R0 for SIS spreading as proportional to the adjacency spectral radius. Greedily remove the node with the largest eigenvalue drop at each step, compare the result with degree-based and eigenvector-centrality removal, and check optimality against exhaustive enumeration on small graphs.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Metapopulation capacity of a fragmented landscape
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Construct the Hanski-Ovaskainen landscape matrix M_ij = exp(−αd_ij)A_iA_j from patch areas and coordinates. Compute the metapopulation capacity λ_M as its leading eigenvalue by power iteration, and give the persistence threshold e/c.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Incidence function model equilibrium occupancy by fixed-point iteration
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Solve for the equilibrium patch occupancies p_i = C_i/(C_i + E_i − C_iE_i) of the incidence function model with the rescue effect, where connectivity C_i depends on p. Iterate the map to its fixed point with damping, and compare the result with stochastic IFM simulations.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Greedy reserve selection maximizing metapopulation capacity under a budget
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the loss of λ_M from deleting each patch, then select patches greedily to maximize λ_M within an area budget. Benchmark the greedy choice against exhaustive enumeration of patch subsets for small landscapes.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Probability of connectivity index and patch importance via shortest paths
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Build a landscape dispersal graph with link probabilities exp(−αd) and compute maximum-product probability paths by Dijkstra's algorithm on −log weights. Evaluate the PC connectivity index and each patch's removal importance dPC.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Maximum likelihood fit of incidence function model to occupancy snapshots
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Fit the IFM colonization, extinction and dispersal parameters to a single snapshot of patch occupancy, using the logistic-form equilibrium incidence likelihood. Maximize it by Nelder-Mead or L-BFGS-B and give profile intervals for the dispersal scale.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Optimal dispersal fraction in a source-sink stage-structured metapopulation
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Build a projection matrix coupling a source and a sink patch through a dispersal fraction d, and compute the growth rate as the dominant eigenvalue. Maximize it over d by golden-section search, and examine how the optimum shifts with sink quality.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Least-cost path effective distances in a resistance-raster metapopulation
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute least-cost distances between habitat patches on a resistance raster using Dijkstra's algorithm on the grid graph. Substitute them for Euclidean distances in the metapopulation capacity calculation, and compare the persistence predictions.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Evolutionarily stable dispersal rate in a Levins-type metapopulation
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Define the invasion fitness of a mutant dispersal strategy in a resident Levins metapopulation with dispersal cost and kin competition. Find the singular strategy by root finding on the selection gradient, and check its convergence and evolutionary stability.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Separatrix and basin fractions of an asymmetric toggle switch
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Locate the saddle by Newton's method, and compute the separatrix by backward integration along its stable eigenvector. Classify a grid of initial conditions by their attractor, and report the basin areas as the promoter strength asymmetry varies.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Minimum action path for noise-induced toggle switching by string method
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the Freidlin-Wentzell minimum action path between the two stable states of a toggle switch with additive or LNA-derived diffusion. Discretize the path, minimize the action with the string or minimum-action method, and estimate the quasi-potential barrier.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Mean switching time of a stochastic toggle from the truncated CME
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Truncate the two-protein toggle-switch CME to a finite lattice. Solve the backward linear system for the mean first-passage time from one stable state to the opposite basin, and compare it with Gillespie estimates and a Kramers-type formula.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Inducer hysteresis loop of a positively autoregulated gene
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For a self-activating gene with cooperative Hill feedback and an inducer-modulated basal rate, continue the steady-state branch in inducer concentration. Find the fold points by root finding on the derivative condition, and report the width of the hysteresis loop.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Lac operon bistability window in TMG concentration
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Reduce a Yildirim-Mackey-type lac operon model to a steady-state equation in permease or LacY level. Count its roots versus extracellular TMG by bracketing, and bisect for the induction and maintenance thresholds.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Maxwell point and switching rates of the one-dimensional Schlögl switch
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the exact stationary distribution of the Schlögl birth-death process by product formula and the mean first-passage times between modes by summation formulas. Bisect in the control parameter for the Maxwell point, where the two mode probabilities are equal.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Enumerating all steady states of a tristable three-gene repression circuit
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Find all equilibria of a symmetric three-node mutual-repression network using Newton's method with deflation from multiple starts. Classify each equilibrium's stability by its Jacobian eigenvalues, and track how the number of stable states changes with the Hill coefficient.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Dosing interval maximizing time in therapeutic window for oral regimen
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Use a one-compartment first-order absorption model with superposed doses at a fixed daily amount. Choose the dosing interval that maximizes the steady-state fraction of time between MEC and MTC, using bracketing root finds for the crossing times and bounded scalar optimization.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Phenytoin Michaelis-Menten elimination: steady state and dose individualization
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Solve the nonlinear one-compartment model with saturable elimination for the steady-state concentration at a given dosing rate by root finding. Estimate Vmax and Km from two steady-state dose-level pairs, then find the dose that hits a target concentration.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Time above MIC for repeated two-compartment antibiotic infusions
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute repeated-infusion concentration profiles with matrix exponentials of the linear compartment system. Find all MIC crossings in a steady-state dosing interval by bracketing (Brent) and report %T>MIC versus infusion duration.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Piecewise-constant infusion schedule tracking a target concentration by NNLS
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Build the unit-response matrix of a three-compartment model from matrix exponentials and solve nonnegative least squares for infusion rates on a time grid. The rates should make the plasma concentration track a prescribed target-controlled-infusion profile; report the tracking error and total dose.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Bayesian MAP estimation of individual vancomycin clearance from sparse levels
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Combine lognormal population priors on CL and V with a proportional error likelihood for two measured levels after repeated infusions. Minimize the negative log posterior to get individual parameters and the dose needed to reach a target AUC24.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Flip-flop kinetics: dual parameter solutions of the Bateman function
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Fit the oral one-compartment Bateman curve to concentration data from multiple starting points and identify both least-squares minima (ka>ke and ka<ke). Compare their apparent volumes and show that IV reference data resolves the ambiguity.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: D-optimal sampling times for a two-compartment pharmacokinetic study
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the Fisher information of the biexponential model parameters from sensitivity derivatives. Choose four sampling times maximizing log det(FIM) by constrained optimization with multiple restarts, and compare the result against uniform sampling.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Target-mediated drug disposition QSS model: free drug by root finding
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: In the quasi-steady-state TMDD model, solve the quadratic or implicit equation for free drug given total drug and total target at each time step inside the ODE right-hand side. Compute the nonlinear AUC and apparent clearance versus dose.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Absorption input-rate deconvolution by regularized nonnegative least squares
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Discretize the convolution of an unknown oral input rate with the IV unit impulse response (a sum of exponentials). Solve Tikhonov-augmented NNLS for the input profile, then compute the fraction absorbed over time and the bioavailability.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Limit-cycle amplitude versus carrying capacity by Poincaré shooting
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For K above the Hopf point, find the Rosenzweig-MacArthur limit cycle by Newton iteration on a Poincaré return map with numerically integrated trajectories. Report the period and the prey min/max amplitude as functions of K.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Rogers random predator equation fit via Lambert W and binomial likelihood
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Express prey eaten under depletion with the Lambert W solution of the type II functional response. Fit attack rate and handling time to feeding-trial counts by maximizing the binomial likelihood, and give profile-likelihood intervals.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Maximum sustainable prey harvest in a Rosenzweig-MacArthur system
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Add constant-effort prey harvesting. For each effort level, compute the stable attractor (equilibrium or time-averaged cycle) and maximize the long-term yield over effort by bounded scalar optimization, noting when the predator goes extinct.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Optimal diet breadth by prey profitability ranking
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Implement the contingency model of optimal foraging: rank prey types by energy per handling time and add types sequentially while the multispecies Holling II intake rate increases. Return the optimal diet set and its intake rate versus abundance of the top prey.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Marginal value theorem optimal patch residence times
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For saturating patch gain functions and given travel times, solve g'(T) = g(T)/(T+τ) by root finding for the optimal residence time in each patch type. Compute the long-term intake rate in mixed habitats by a fixed-point iteration on that rate.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: First Lyapunov coefficient and Hopf criticality in predator-prey models
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the first Lyapunov coefficient at the Hopf point symbolically with sympy from the normal-form formula. Use it to decide whether the Rosenzweig-MacArthur and Holling-Tanner Hopf bifurcations are supercritical or subcritical.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Poisson maximum likelihood fit of SIR parameters to daily incidence
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Integrate SIR ODEs and form expected daily incidence from the decrease in S. Maximize the Poisson log-likelihood over β, γ and the initial infected number using log-parameterized Nelder-Mead with restarts, and report R0.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Serial interval estimation from interval-censored transmission pairs
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Fit a gamma serial interval distribution to infector-infectee pairs whose onset dates are known only to within a day. Integrate the CDF over the censoring windows and maximize the likelihood to get the mean and SD with profile intervals.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Back-calculation of infection curve by Richardson-Lucy EM deconvolution
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Reconstruct daily infections from symptom-onset counts given an incubation-period distribution. Run the Richardson-Lucy expectation-maximization fixed-point iteration with a chi-square stopping rule and right-truncation adjustment.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Penalized change-point detection of reproduction number by optimal partitioning
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Model incidence as Poisson with mean R_seg times renewal-equation infectiousness, with R piecewise constant. Find the optimal segmentation under a BIC-type penalty by dynamic programming (optimal partitioning), returning the change points and segment R values.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Wallinga-Teunis case reproduction numbers from transmission likelihoods
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the relative likelihood that case i infected case j from the serial interval density and onset times. Sum these to get case reproduction numbers, and obtain bootstrap intervals by sampling who-infected-whom trees.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: TSIR seasonal transmission estimation from measles case reports
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Reconstruct susceptible dynamics by regressing cumulative births on cumulative cases, with a smoothing spline or local regression for the reporting rate. Then fit the log-linear TSIR model to estimate biweekly seasonal transmission and the mixing exponent α.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Delay-adjusted case fatality ratio by maximum likelihood
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Correct the naive CFR during an ongoing outbreak by convolving cases with an onset-to-death lognormal delay distribution. Maximize the binomial likelihood for the CFR at each reporting date and show convergence toward the true value.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Richards growth model fit and epidemic turning point
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Fit the generalized logistic (Richards) curve to cumulative incidence by nonlinear least squares with parameter bounds. Compute the turning point (peak incidence time), final size and the implied R0 range via the growth rate.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Negative binomial early growth rate and doubling time with profile interval
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Fit exponential growth to early daily counts under a negative binomial likelihood, estimating the dispersion jointly. Compute the profile-likelihood interval for the growth rate by bracketing root finds and convert it to a doubling time.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: L1 trend filtering of epidemic log growth rate via ADMM
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Estimate a piecewise-linear log incidence from noisy counts by minimizing squared error plus an L1 penalty on second differences. Solve with an ADMM splitting (banded linear solves plus soft-thresholding), then report the growth-rate time series and its kinks.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Message-passing SIR final size on a specific contact network
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Implement the Karrer-Newman message-passing equations for the probability that each node escapes infection on a given (loopy) graph, solved by damped fixed-point iteration. Compare predicted node infection probabilities with Monte Carlo bond percolation.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Non-backtracking matrix epidemic threshold versus adjacency eigenvalue
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Build the Hashimoto non-backtracking matrix, or its 2N×2N Ihara-Bass reduction, for a heterogeneous network. Compute its leading eigenvalue by Arnoldi and compare 1/λ_NB with 1/λ_A as SIR threshold estimates against simulations on star-heavy graphs.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: N-intertwined mean-field SIS steady-state prevalence by fixed-point iteration
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Solve v_i = (τ Σ_j A_ij v_j)/(1 + τ Σ_j A_ij v_j) for nodal infection probabilities on a given network by monotone fixed-point iteration. Report the total prevalence curve versus τ and its onset at 1/λ_max.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: k-core decomposition versus degree for identifying influential spreaders
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute k-shell indices with the Batagelj-Zaversnik peeling algorithm. Compare the mean SIR outbreak size from single seeds grouped by k-shell and by degree, and measure the rank correlation of each with spreading power.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Epidemic threshold on clustered random graphs with triangles
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For Newman's random graph with independent edges and triangles given a joint degree distribution, set up the two-variable PGF self-consistency for bond percolation. Find the transmissibility threshold and the outbreak size by root finding, and compare with an unclustered graph of the same degrees.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Critical coverage for random versus acquaintance immunization on scale-free networks
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Write the site-percolation condition for configuration-model networks under random vaccination and under acquaintance (random-neighbour) vaccination. Solve for the critical coverage by bracketing as the power-law exponent varies.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Minimum edge cut isolating a vulnerable group from an outbreak cluster
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Model contacts as a capacitated graph with super-source infected nodes and super-sink high-risk nodes. Compute the max-flow/min-cut by Edmonds-Karp to get the smallest set of contacts to remove, and compare it with degree-based removal.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Elliptic-law stability boundary for mixed interaction types
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Generate random community matrices with tunable pairwise correlation (predator-prey, mixture, competition-mutualism). Find the critical σ√(SC) at which the rightmost eigenvalue crosses zero by bisection over ensembles, and compare with the elliptic-law prediction (1+ρ).
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Random community matrices and May stability

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Lyapunov diagonal stability certificate by optimization over diagonal scalings
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For a given community matrix, search for positive diagonal D minimizing the largest eigenvalue of DA + AᵀD using constrained optimization. Classify random matrices as diagonally stable or not, and compare with plain eigenvalue stability.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Random community matrices and May stability

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Structural stability: feasibility cone solid angle and critical deviation angle
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For a competitive interaction matrix, estimate the normalized solid angle of the feasibility domain by quasi-Monte Carlo on the simplex. Find the largest angle between growth vector and cone centroid tolerated before losing feasibility by constrained optimization.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Random community matrices and May stability

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Minimal heterogeneous self-regulation required to stabilize a random community
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Choose diagonal self-regulation strengths d_i ≥ 0 that minimize Σd_i subject to the rightmost eigenvalue of A − diag(d) lying below −ε. Solve with SLSQP using eigenvalue sensitivities, and compare with the uniform shift from the circular law.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Random community matrices and May stability

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Modular community matrices: critical variance via Tang-Allesina spectrum
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Construct block-structured random matrices with tunable modularity Q. Compute the rightmost eigenvalue numerically and from the bulk-plus-outlier formula, and find by root finding the modularity that maximizes the tolerated interaction variance.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Random community matrices and May stability

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Outlier eigenvalue from nonzero mean interaction via secular equation
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Treat a random community matrix with mean interaction μ as a bulk matrix plus a rank-one perturbation. Locate the outlier eigenvalue by solving the secular equation 1 = μ uᵀ(z−B)⁻¹v with Brent's method, and compare to −(S−1)μ and to full diagonalization.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Random community matrices and May stability

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Trophic levels and trophic coherence of niche-model food webs
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Generate niche-model webs for given S and C, compute prey-averaged trophic levels by a sparse linear solve with basal-node constraints, and the trophic incoherence q. Study how q varies with connectance.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Food web structure and network ecology

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Food web modularity by spectral bisection with Kernighan-Lin refinement
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Maximize Newman modularity of an undirected food web by recursive leading-eigenvector bisection followed by Kernighan-Lin node moves. Report Q and the compartments, and compare with Q in niche-model null webs.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Food web structure and network ecology

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Food web robustness R50 under sequential species removal
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Remove species by decreasing degree, at random, or least-connected first. Propagate secondary extinctions of consumers that lose all prey by iterative graph updates, and compute the robustness R50 against connectance for niche-model webs.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Food web structure and network ecology

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Dominator tree keystone analysis of a food web
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Add a root node feeding all basal species and compute the dominator tree using the Cooper-Harvey-Kennedy iterative algorithm. Rank species by the number of species they dominate, i.e. those whose extinction would follow theirs.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Food web structure and network ecology

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Stochastic block group model fit to a food web by simulated annealing
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Fit the Allesina-Pascual group model, a directed stochastic block model, by maximizing the Bernoulli block log-likelihood over node partitions with simulated annealing and node-move proposals. Select the number of groups by BIC.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Food web structure and network ecology

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Nestedness NODF and maximally packed ordering of a pollination network
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute NODF for a plant-pollinator incidence matrix. Search row/column orderings that minimize the NTC matrix temperature (unexpected presences/absences relative to an isocline) by swap-based local search, and compare against null-model matrices.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Food web structure and network ecology

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Maximum and mean food chain length by DAG dynamic programming
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Detect and break cannibalistic or looped links with Tarjan's SCC condensation. Then compute the longest, shortest and mean basal-to-top chain lengths by dynamic programming over a topological order, and path counts for each species.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Food web structure and network ecology

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Finn cycling index of an ecosystem carbon flow network
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: From a compartment flow matrix with imports and exports, compute throughflows and the Leontief-type integral flow matrix by a linear solve. Derive the Finn cycling index and average path length.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Food web structure and network ecology

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Structural controllability driver nodes of a food web via maximum matching
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute a maximum matching of the directed food web's bipartite representation with Hopcroft-Karp. The unmatched nodes are minimal driver sets (Liu-Slotine-Barabási); compare the driver fraction across empirical-like and niche-model webs.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Food web structure and network ecology

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: HIV model R0 with treatment stages and critical treatment rate
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Build the next-generation matrix for an HIV model with acute, chronic, AIDS and treated stages that have different infectivities. Compute R0 as its spectral radius and find the treatment uptake rate giving R0 = 1 by Brent's method.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Zika R0 combining vector-borne and sexual transmission routes
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Construct F and V for a model with mosquito-human and human-human sexual transmission. Compute R0 as the spectral radius of FV⁻¹ (not the sum of route-specific R0s), and the critical mosquito reduction for elimination.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Cholera R0 with environmental reservoir and critical sanitation
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Use the Tien-Earn SIWR model with direct and waterborne transmission. Derive the next-generation matrix symbolically with sympy, verify that the analytic R0 matches the numerical spectral radius, and solve for the water-treatment rate that brings R0 below one.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Hethcote-Yorke core group gonorrhea R0 and core intervention threshold
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute R0 for a two-activity-group STI model with preferred mixing as the spectral radius of the NGM. Find by root finding the condom-use fraction in the core group alone that brings R0 below one.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Invasion reproduction number of a drug-resistant strain under treatment
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For a two-strain model with treatment-induced resistance and fitness cost, compute the sensitive strain's endemic equilibrium. Compute the resistant strain's invasion reproduction number from the NGM linearized there, and find the treatment rate threshold for resistant invasion.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Macroparasite R0 with intermediate host and critical deworming coverage
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Set up a schistosome-like life cycle (adult worms, eggs or miracidia, snail infections, cercariae) as a type-transition next-generation matrix. Compute R0 as the cycle product (square root of the spectral radius), and solve for the mass-drug-administration coverage reaching R0 = 1.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Tick-borne pathogen R0 with co-feeding transmission (Hartemink NGM)
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Build the multi-type next-generation matrix over tick stages and host types, including systemic, transovarial and co-feeding routes. Compute R0 and the contribution of each route by elasticity of the dominant eigenvalue.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Within-host viral R0 with eclipse phase and critical drug efficacy
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Linearize a target-cell-limited model with eclipse-stage infected cells around the infection-free state. Compute the within-host R0 from the NGM, and find the reverse-transcriptase and protease inhibitor efficacy combinations that bring it below one.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Monod kinetic parameters from chemostat steady states and washout rate
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Fit μmax and Ks by nonlinear least squares to steady-state substrate and biomass data at several dilution rates. Compute the predicted washout dilution rate and the biomass steady-state curve with confidence bands.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Biomass productivity-maximizing dilution rate with Pirt maintenance
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Include maintenance energy in the yield relation of the Monod chemostat. Solve for steady-state biomass analytically or by root finding, then maximize productivity D·X over D by golden-section search.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Coexistence in a two-vessel gradostat by Newton's method
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Two Monod species compete in two coupled chemostat vessels with a substrate gradient. Find all steady states by multivariate Newton from many starts, classify their stability, and map the parameter region where the species coexist although one excludes the other in a single chemostat.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Fed-batch feed profile optimization for product yield
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Parameterize the substrate feed rate of a fed-batch bioreactor (Monod growth with Luedeking-Piret product formation) as piecewise constant. Maximize final product subject to a volume constraint with SLSQP over ODE simulations.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Coexistence in a periodically forced chemostat via Floquet invasion
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Find the periodic orbit of a single Monod species under sinusoidal dilution by Newton shooting. Then compute the invader's Floquet exponent (time-averaged per-capita growth) along it to test mutual invasibility, i.e. coexistence of two species.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Baranyi growth curve fit for lag time and maximum growth rate
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Fit the Baranyi-Roberts model to log optical density or CFU time series by nonlinear least squares. Estimate lag time, μmax and the asymptote, and compare against Gompertz fits by AIC.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Cross-feeding two-species chemostat steady states
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Species A consumes glucose and secretes acetate, which species B consumes. Solve the steady-state equations by root finding over dilution rate, identify the coexistence and washout boundaries, and compute total biomass productivity.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Jukes-Cantor distances with pairwise gap deletion and UPGMA tree
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute p-distances with pairwise gap deletion and Jukes-Cantor corrected distances for an alignment. Build a UPGMA ultrametric tree by iterative cluster merging and output it in Newick format with node heights.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Neighbor-joining on Kimura two-parameter distances with Robinson-Foulds accuracy
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute K2P distances from transition and transversion proportions, build an NJ tree with the Q-matrix algorithm, and score it against the generating tree by Robinson-Foulds bipartition distance.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Maximum parsimony by exhaustive unrooted topology enumeration
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Enumerate all (2n−5)!! unrooted binary topologies for up to 8 taxa by stepwise taxon addition. Score each with Fitch's algorithm and return all most-parsimonious trees.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Balanced minimum evolution tree search by NNI hill climbing
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Start from an NJ tree and compute the balanced minimum evolution (Pauplin) length. Iteratively apply the best nearest-neighbour interchange until no improvement, and compare the final tree with NJ.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: LogDet distances versus p-distances under compositional heterogeneity
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Simulate sequences on a four-taxon tree with lineage-specific GC content. Compute paralinear/LogDet distances from divergence matrices, and show that NJ recovers the true quartet with LogDet but falls into long-branch attraction with uncorrected distances.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Bootstrap split support for neighbor-joining trees
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Resample alignment columns, recompute distances, build NJ trees, and tally bipartitions encoded as bitsets. Report bootstrap support on the original tree's splits and the majority-rule consensus.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Sankoff weighted parsimony by dynamic programming on a fixed tree
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Given a step matrix with transitions cheaper than transversions, compute the minimum cost at each node bottom-up via the Sankoff recursion. Recover an optimal ancestral reconstruction by top-down traceback.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Felsenstein pruning likelihood with branch-length optimization by Brent
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the JC69 or K80 tree likelihood by Felsenstein's pruning algorithm with conditional likelihood vectors. Optimize the branch lengths by cyclic coordinate-wise Brent maximization until convergence, and report the log-likelihood.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: IPM mesh convergence and eviction correction
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compare λ under three treatments of individuals growing out of the size range: no correction, renormalized growth, and an extended domain. Study convergence with mesh size and extrapolate λ by Richardson extrapolation.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Integral projection models for size structure

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Evolutionarily stable flowering size in a monocarpic perennial IPM
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Use a Carlina/Oenothera-type IPM with a logistic flowering probability and density-dependent recruitment. Find the ESS flowering threshold by root finding on the invasion-fitness gradient, computed from invader λ in the resident equilibrium environment.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Integral projection models for size structure

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Size-limit harvest maximizing yield subject to population persistence
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Add harvest of individuals above a size limit to a fish IPM. Maximize the yield (harvested biomass from the stable distribution) over the size limit and harvest rate, subject to λ ≥ 1, by constrained optimization.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Integral projection models for size structure

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Invasion speed of a size-structured plant via integrodifference minimization
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Couple an IPM with a Laplace seed dispersal kernel and compute the moment-generating-function-weighted kernel's dominant eigenvalue ρ(s). Minimize (1/s)·log ρ(s) over s to obtain the asymptotic spread rate.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Integral projection models for size structure

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: IPM net reproductive rate, generation time and life expectancy
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Use the fundamental operator N = (I − P)⁻¹ by a linear solve. Compute the size-dependent life expectancy, R0 as the dominant eigenvalue of FN, and generation time log R0 / log λ, and compare them across growth-rate scenarios.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Integral projection models for size structure

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Zooplankton invasion threshold in NPZ by transcritical root finding
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the critical total nutrient at which zooplankton can invade the N-P equilibrium. Solve for the zero of the zooplankton invasion growth rate with brentq and check it against direct ODE integration.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Hopf point of an NPZ model via Routh-Hurwitz root finding
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For the interior equilibrium of an NPZ model with Holling III grazing, locate the total nutrient at which the Routh-Hurwitz condition a1*a2-a3 changes sign. Use bracketing and confirm that a complex pair of eigenvalues crosses the imaginary axis.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Sverdrup critical depth for spring bloom onset by root finding
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Light decays exponentially with depth and phytoplankton growth saturates in light. Find the mixed-layer depth at which depth-averaged growth equals losses using brentq, then compute bloom onset dates for a prescribed seasonal mixed-layer cycle.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Deep chlorophyll maximum as a nonlinear boundary value problem by Newton
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Steady 1D water-column model coupling phytoplankton and nutrient through vertical diffusion, light-limited growth and a bottom nutrient source. Discretize with finite differences, solve the nonlinear system by Newton with a sparse Jacobian, and report the depth and magnitude of the chlorophyll maximum.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Huisman critical light intensity and competition in a mixed water column
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For phytoplankton species in a well-mixed water column under Lambert-Beer self-shading, compute each species' critical light at the bottom by solving the steady-state integral equation. Predict the competitive winner and verify the prediction by integrating the ODEs.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Adaptive FSP truncation size meeting a probability-leak tolerance
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For a negatively autoregulated protein birth-death CME, add an absorbing sink state that counts leaked probability. Grow the truncation by doubling followed by bisection until the leaked mass at time T is below a tolerance, and report the minimal size and the distribution.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Chemical master equation finite state projection

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Uniformization solution of a dimerization CME with error-controlled Poisson truncation
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Solve the time-dependent CME of the reaction 2M <-> D with conserved total monomer by uniformization. Choose the number of Poisson terms from a tail bound for a target error, and compare with scipy expm_multiply.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Chemical master equation finite state projection

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Iterative aggregation-disaggregation for a two-species CME stationary state
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Lump the states of a two-species gene-network CME into macro-states and alternate between solving the aggregated chain and disaggregating locally by Gauss-Seidel sweeps until the fixed point converges. Benchmark the result against a direct sparse solve.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Chemical master equation finite state projection

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Probability of viral infection establishment from an absorbing within-host CME
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Stochastic target-cell-limited infection model with infected cells and free virions on a truncated lattice. Solve the linear system for absorption probabilities into extinction versus a large-burden state, then find the inoculum size giving 50% infection probability.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Chemical master equation finite state projection

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Supply-vector coexistence cone for substitutable resources by linear programming
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For consumers with linear uptake on several resources, test which consumer subsets can coexist at a given supply point by LP feasibility of nonnegative abundances in the cone. Map coexisting sets across the supply simplex.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Evolutionarily stable uptake allocation under a budget in a consumer-resource model
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Find the uninvadable allocation of uptake effort across resources for a consumer with an energy budget. Compute invasion fitness by constrained optimization (SLSQP) against the resident equilibrium and iterate to the ESS fixed point.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Limiting similarity: species packing on a resource continuum by NNLS
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Discretize MacArthur-May Gaussian niche consumers along a resource axis. Solve for equilibrium abundances as a nonnegative least-squares or quadratic program, and find the maximal niche density at which all species persist.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Inferring consumer preference matrices from monoculture steady states by NNLS
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: From synthetic monoculture and pairwise steady-state resource depletion data in a MacArthur model, reconstruct the nonnegative uptake matrix by NNLS. Evaluate how well it predicts the outcome of a held-out community.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Hodgkin-Huxley rheobase threshold current by bisection
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Integrate the Hodgkin-Huxley equations under step currents and detect repetitive spiking by voltage crossings. Bisect for the minimal sustained current that produces firing and report the hysteresis between up and down current sweeps.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Morris-Lecar type I f-I curve and SNIC current by root finding
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: In the Morris-Lecar model with type I parameters, locate the saddle-node on invariant circle current where nullclines become tangent by solving the fold equations. Compute the f-I curve from simulations and fit the square-root scaling near onset.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: FitzHugh-Nagumo nullcline geometry and Hopf current
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Find the intersections of the cubic and linear nullclines of FitzHugh-Nagumo for a range of applied currents with polynomial root finding. Locate the Hopf currents where the Jacobian trace vanishes and classify the excitable, oscillatory and bistable regimes.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Hodgkin-Huxley limit-cycle period by Newton shooting and Floquet stability
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Find the periodic spiking orbit of Hodgkin-Huxley under constant current by Newton shooting on a Poincare section with variational equations. Compute the period and Floquet multipliers as functions of current.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Adaptive leaky integrate-and-fire firing rate from the interspike map fixed point
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For a LIF neuron with spike-triggered adaptation current, derive the map from post-spike adaptation level to the next one, using brentq to find spike times. Find its fixed point to get the steady firing rate and the adapted f-I curve.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Wilson-Cowan excitatory-inhibitory population: fixed points and Hopf boundary
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Enumerate all fixed points of the sigmoidal Wilson-Cowan equations by scanning nullcline intersections and Newton polishing. Trace the Hopf boundary in the plane of external inputs to the E and I populations by root finding on the trace.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Boltzmann gating parameters from voltage-clamp activation data by least squares
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Fit steady-state activation curves and voltage-dependent time constants of a potassium conductance to synthetic voltage-clamp data with nonlinear least squares. Insert the fitted kinetics into an HH-type model and predict the resulting spike threshold.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Anodal break excitation threshold in Hodgkin-Huxley by bisection
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Apply hyperpolarizing current pulses and detect rebound spikes after release. Bisect for the minimal pulse amplitude that triggers a rebound as a function of pulse duration, and relate the threshold to h-gate deinactivation.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Cori renewal R_t with smoothing window chosen by predictive likelihood
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute gamma-posterior R_t estimates from incidence and a discretized serial interval using the renewal equation. Select the smoothing window by maximizing the one-step-ahead negative-binomial predictive log-likelihood.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: SEIR fit to incidence with profile likelihood for the latent period
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Fit the transmission rate and initial infections of an SEIR model to Poisson incidence for each fixed latent period. Build the profile log-likelihood over the latent period and extract a likelihood-ratio confidence interval by root finding.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: R0 from post-epidemic serosurvey by inverting the final size equation
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Given binomial seroprevalence data, invert the SIR final size relation with brentq to obtain the R0 MLE. Propagate binomial uncertainty to an exact confidence interval for R0.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Kalman filter likelihood for a random-walk transmission rate
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Linearize log incidence growth as a state-space model in which the log transmission rate follows a random walk. Run the Kalman filter and RTS smoother, and maximize the innovation likelihood over the process and observation noise variances.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Weekday reporting effects and R_t by Poisson GLM via IRLS
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Model daily counts as a renewal-equation expectation multiplied by day-of-week reporting factors, with piecewise-constant R. Estimate by iteratively reweighted least squares, implemented from scratch with Newton steps, and report the reporting factors and R segments.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Seasonally forced SIRS maximum likelihood fit to multi-year influenza incidence
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Fit the forcing amplitude, phase, waning rate and reporting fraction of a seasonal SIRS model to several seasons of negative-binomial incidence. Use multistart Nelder-Mead and compare the fit with a non-seasonal model by AIC.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Longini-Koopman household chain-binomial MLE of within-household transmission
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: From final-size household data, compute the probabilities of each household outcome under a community escape probability and a within-household escape probability via Longini-Koopman recursion. Maximize the multinomial likelihood and report the secondary attack rate.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: MWC cluster size and receptor free energies fitted to FRET dose-response data
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Fit cluster size N, dissociation constants and methylation free-energy offsets to multi-condition kinase activity dose-response curves by nonlinear least squares. Report parameter correlations from the Jacobian.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Linear response kernel of a methylation adaptation model
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Linearize a CheA/CheY/methylation model around its adapted state and compute the impulse response kernel from the Jacobian eigendecomposition. Fit a biphasic kernel form to it and verify that the kernel integrates to zero, as required by perfect adaptation.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Optimal adaptation time maximizing chemotactic drift in an exponential gradient
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For run-and-tumble cells with an adaptation-model response kernel, compute the drift velocity in a shallow gradient from linear response theory. Maximize it over the adaptation time with bounded scalar optimization and validate by simulation.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Steady-state run-and-tumble density in a 1D chemoattractant profile
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Write the 1D velocity-jump (telegraph) equations with a tumble rate that depends on the local gradient. Discretize them and solve the steady state as a sparse null-space problem, then compute the chemotactic accumulation index.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Steady activity shift under exponential ligand ramps
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Solve for the steady activity of an MWC-methylation model exposed to exponential attractant ramps by balancing the methylation rate against the ramp. Recover the methylation rate constant by fitting activity shifts at several ramp rates.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Flagellar motor CW bias Hill fit and run-length distributions
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Fit a steep Hill function of CheY-P to motor clockwise-bias data by least squares. Use the fit to compute CCW and CW dwell-time distributions from two-state switching rates, and estimate the run-length change caused by a small CheY-P perturbation.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Single versus two-timescale persistent walk selection by AIC on velocity autocorrelation
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Fit exponential and biexponential velocity autocorrelation models to simulated anisotropic persistent cell tracks by nonlinear least squares. Select between them with AIC and bootstrap the selection rate.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Cell motility and random walk statistics

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Optimal intermittent search: persistence time minimizing target-finding time
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Use the Benichou intermittent-search mean first-passage time formulas for alternating ballistic and diffusive phases in 2D. Minimize the mean search time over the phase durations and check the optimum by Monte Carlo search simulations.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Cell motility and random walk statistics

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Confined diffusion: corral size from MSD saturation fit and crossover
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Simulate reflected Brownian motion of a membrane receptor in square corrals and compute its MSD. Fit the series solution for confined MSD to extract corral size and microscopic diffusivity, and locate the crossover time by root finding.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Cell motility and random walk statistics

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Metropolis-Hastings posterior for logistic growth with credible intervals
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Sample the posterior of r, K and noise sigma for logistic population counts under lognormal error with random-walk Metropolis on log parameters. Report acceptance rate, effective sample size and 95% credible intervals.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Bayesian and MCMC parameter estimation for biological models

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Adaptive Metropolis for SIR ODE parameters with Gelman-Rubin diagnostics
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Run the Haario adaptive Metropolis sampler on beta, gamma and initial infecteds of an SIR model fitted to Poisson incidence. Run multiple chains, compute R-hat and the posterior of R0.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Bayesian and MCMC parameter estimation for biological models

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Thermodynamic integration evidence: exponential versus logistic growth
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Run power-posterior MCMC at a ladder of temperatures for two growth models. Integrate the expected log-likelihood over temperature with trapezoid quadrature to obtain log marginal likelihoods and the Bayes factor.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Bayesian and MCMC parameter estimation for biological models

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: ABC-SMC for a stochastic birth-death gene expression model
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Infer transcription and degradation rates from summary statistics of Gillespie-simulated mRNA snapshots with sequential Monte Carlo ABC using decreasing tolerances and importance weights. Compare the posterior with the exact Poisson stationary likelihood posterior.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Bayesian and MCMC parameter estimation for biological models

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Laplace approximation versus MCMC for an Emax pharmacodynamic model
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Find the MAP of E0, Emax, EC50 and Hill coefficient by BFGS and form a Gaussian from the numerical Hessian. Compare its credible intervals with those from Metropolis-Hastings, especially for skewed EC50 posteriors.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Bayesian and MCMC parameter estimation for biological models

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Hierarchical Metropolis-within-Gibbs for replicate Hill dose-response curves
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Fit per-replicate EC50 values drawn from a population lognormal with conjugate Gibbs updates for the hyperparameters and Metropolis updates for the curve parameters. Report shrinkage and the posterior of the population EC50.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Bayesian and MCMC parameter estimation for biological models

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Parallel tempering for a bimodal mRNA-protein degradation rate posterior
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Protein-only time courses after induction leave the mRNA and protein degradation rates nearly exchangeable, so the posterior is bimodal. Run parallel tempering Metropolis with replica swaps and estimate the mass in each mode against single-chain mixing.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Bayesian and MCMC parameter estimation for biological models

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Hamiltonian Monte Carlo for FitzHugh-Nagumo parameters with sensitivity gradients
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute log-posterior gradients of FitzHugh-Nagumo parameters from noisy voltage traces using forward sensitivity equations. Run leapfrog HMC with step-size tuning and compare its effective samples per gradient with random-walk Metropolis.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Bayesian and MCMC parameter estimation for biological models

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Exhaustive local optima count in NK landscapes versus K
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Generate NK fitness landscapes for N=12 with random or adjacent neighborhoods, enumerate all 2^N genotypes, and count local optima under single mutations. Compare the mean count with the 2^N/(N+1) random-landscape limit as K varies.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Greedy versus random adaptive walks on NK landscapes
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Simulate steepest-ascent and random uphill adaptive walks from random starts. Compare walk-length distributions and mean final fitness across K, and the probability of reaching the global optimum.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Basins of attraction of NK local optima under steepest ascent
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Build the steepest-ascent successor map on all genotypes and compute basin sizes of local optima by path compression. Relate basin size to optimum fitness and estimate the basin size of the global peak.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Accessible mutational paths in a five-locus resistance landscape by dynamic programming
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For a combinatorially complete 5-locus fitness landscape, count fitness-monotone shortest paths from wild type to the quintuple mutant by DP on the hypercube. Compute SSWM path probabilities and identify the dominant trajectories.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Walsh-Hadamard epistasis spectrum of NK fitness landscapes
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Apply a fast Walsh-Hadamard transform to an NK landscape to obtain epistatic coefficients by interaction order. Compute the variance fraction per order and compare it with the theoretical spectrum for adjacent neighborhoods.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Path accessibility in Rough Mount Fuji landscapes versus roughness
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Generate Rough Mount Fuji landscapes on L-locus hypercubes and count accessible antipodal paths by DP. Estimate the probability that at least one path is accessible as a function of the additive-to-random ratio, and locate the 50% transition by bisection.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Quasispecies error threshold on a single-peak landscape by power iteration
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Build the Eigen mutation-selection matrix on Hamming error classes for sequence length L. Find the leading eigenvector by power iteration and bisect on mutation rate for the error threshold where the master-sequence fraction collapses.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: SSWM absorption probabilities into NK peaks by linear solve
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Construct the strong-selection weak-mutation Markov chain on all genotypes of an NK landscape using Kimura fixation probabilities. Solve the absorbing-chain linear system for the probability of reaching each local optimum from wild type and for the expected number of substitutions.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Fitness valley crossing via minimax bottleneck paths between NK peaks
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Find the path between the two highest NK optima that maximizes the minimum fitness along it, using a modified Dijkstra or maximum spanning tree. Report the valley depth and the path length.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Beddington-DeAngelis versus Crowley-Martin fit to multi-predator feeding trials
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Fit predator-interference functional responses to prey eaten across prey and predator densities by Poisson maximum likelihood. Compare the models by AIC and profile the interference parameter.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Ratio-dependent predator-prey: equilibria and extinction parameter region
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For the Arditi-Ginzburg ratio-dependent model, compute interior equilibria by root finding and their stability. Map the parameter region where trajectories collapse to the origin, detected by integration and bisection on the attack rate.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Top-predator invasion on the Hastings-Powell predator-prey cycle
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the prey-consumer limit cycle of the Hastings-Powell food chain without the top predator by Newton shooting. Compute the top predator's cycle-averaged invasion growth rate and bisect for its critical attack rate.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Prey refuge shifts the Hopf threshold in Rosenzweig-MacArthur
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Include a constant-proportion or constant-number prey refuge in a Holling II predator-prey model. Locate the Hopf carrying capacity as a function of refuge size by root finding on the Jacobian trace, and find the refuge size that stabilizes all enrichment levels.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Strong Allee effect prey with Holling II predator: equilibria and Hopf
