biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Enumerate the equilibria of a predator-prey model with cubic Allee prey growth by polynomial roots. Find the Hopf point in predator mortality and detect the bistability between coexistence and total collapse by basin sampling.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Neimark-Sacker threshold in a host-parasitoid map with type II response
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For a Nicholson-Bailey host-parasitoid model with handling time and host density dependence, find the fixed point by Newton. Locate the parameter where the Jacobian eigenvalues reach modulus one, which gives the onset of quasi-periodic cycles.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Apparent competition invasibility with a shared type II predator
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: In a two-prey one-predator model with multispecies Holling II response, compute the resident prey-predator equilibrium or cycle and the invasion growth rate of the second prey. Map the mutual invasibility region by bisection.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Minimal predator invasion wave speed in diffusive Rosenzweig-MacArthur
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Linearize the diffusive predator-prey system at the prey-only state and minimize the dispersion relation c(lambda) over the decay rate to obtain the minimal wave speed. Verify it against 1D PDE simulations by front tracking.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Goodwin oscillator critical cooperativity with unequal degradation rates
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For a three-variable Goodwin loop with distinct degradation rates, locate the steady state by root finding. Solve the Routh-Hurwitz Hopf condition for the minimal Hill exponent and recover the secant-condition limit n=8 for equal rates.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Entrainment range of a light-forced Goodwin clock by bisection on phase locking
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Apply periodic square-wave light forcing to a Goodwin clock and detect 1:1 phase locking with a stroboscopic map. Bisect on forcing period to find the edges of the Arnold tongue at several amplitudes.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Phase-locked states of two pulse-coupled clocks from a computed phase response curve
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute a Goodwin oscillator PRC by direct pulse perturbation and asymptotic phase detection. Build the phase-difference return map for two mutually pulse-coupled clocks, then find its fixed points and their stability by root finding.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Temperature compensation by optimizing activation energies to minimize period Q10
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Give the Goodwin model's rate constants Arrhenius temperature dependence. Optimize the activation energies under bounds with L-BFGS-B so that the limit-cycle period (from peak detection) varies minimally between 25 and 35 °C.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Critical transcriptional delay for oscillations in delayed negative autoregulation
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Linearize a delay-differential negative autoregulation model (Hes1-type) about its steady state. Solve the characteristic equation for the purely imaginary root and critical delay by Newton iteration, then verify with method-of-steps DDE integration.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Two-parameter Hopf boundary of an activator-repressor relaxation oscillator
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For a two-gene activator-repressor (Stricker-type dual feedback) oscillator, trace the Hopf curve in the plane of activator and repressor strength. Use natural-parameter continuation with Newton solves on the steady-state-plus-trace-zero system.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Degrade-and-fire oscillator period from the fixed point of its return map
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Model a delayed negative-feedback degrade-and-fire oscillator in which saturating enzymatic degradation produces pulses. Construct the one-dimensional peak-to-peak return map numerically and find its fixed point and period by Brent root finding.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Etienne sampling formula fit of theta and immigration probability m
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute Etienne's K(D,A) coefficients by recursive convolution of Stirling-number terms for a local community sample. Maximize the two-parameter neutral likelihood in (θ, m) with Nelder-Mead on log-transformed parameters.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Fisher's log-series alpha by root finding and comparison with neutral theta
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Solve S = α ln(1+N/α) for Fisher's α by bracketing root finding on species-abundance data generated by a Chinese restaurant process. Compare the result with the Ewens θ estimate and with expected log-series octave counts.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Ewens-Watterson neutrality test by exact integer partition enumeration
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For small samples, enumerate all integer partitions of n into k parts and weight each by the Ewens sampling formula conditional on k. Compute the exact null distribution of Simpson homozygosity and the p-value of an observed abundance vector.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Spatially implicit neutral community simulation with immigration and richness convergence
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Run zero-sum Hubbell local-community dynamics with immigration from a log-series metacommunity until stationarity. Compare the time-averaged richness with the expected species number obtained by solving the Etienne fixed-point recursion, and estimate the burn-in by change-point detection.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Mean time to monodominance in a neutral Moran community
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Write the Moran birth-death chain for the abundance of one species out of J individuals with no immigration. Solve the tridiagonal linear system for mean absorption times and fixation probabilities, and compare with the diffusion approximation.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Neutral versus lognormal abundance model selection by maximized likelihood and AIC
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Fit a Poisson-lognormal species-abundance model by maximum likelihood with numerical quadrature, and fit the Ewens/Etienne neutral model to the same abundance data. Compare the two fits with AIC and a parametric bootstrap.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Gotoh affine-gap global alignment with three-matrix traceback
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Implement Needleman-Wunsch with affine gap penalties using Gotoh's match, insert and delete matrices and BLOSUM62 scores. Perform full traceback and return the optimal score, aligned strings and percent identity.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Hirschberg linear-space global alignment via divide-and-conquer
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Implement Hirschberg's algorithm, which combines forward and reverse Needleman-Wunsch score rows to find the optimal split column recursively. Verify that it reproduces the quadratic-memory alignment score on protein sequences.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Counting co-optimal alignments and sampling one uniformly
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Extend the global alignment DP with a parallel count matrix that tallies the number of distinct optimal traceback paths. Use backward weighted choices to draw a uniformly random co-optimal alignment.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Parametric alignment: gap-open intervals with invariant optimal alignment
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Treat the alignment score as a piecewise-linear function of the gap-open penalty. Locate the breakpoints where the optimal alignment changes by recursive bisection and line intersection over score vectors (matches, mismatches, gaps).

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Center-star multiple alignment and its sum-of-pairs score
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute all pairwise global alignments and choose the center sequence that minimizes summed edit distance. Merge the pairwise alignments into a multiple alignment and evaluate its sum-of-pairs score against the 2-approximation bound.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Nussinov base-pair maximization with minimum hairpin loop and traceback
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Implement the O(n^3) Nussinov dynamic program for RNA folding with Watson-Crick and GU pairs and a minimum loop length. Trace back a dot-bracket structure and count the optimal structures.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Multistability under Liebig essential resources by support enumeration and invasibility
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For consumers obeying Liebig's law of the minimum on several resources, enumerate candidate surviving subsets. Solve each subset's equilibrium by root finding and keep the feasible, stable and uninvadable states to count alternative stable communities.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Adaptive foraging consumers: equilibrium of preference replicator dynamics
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Let consumer resource preferences evolve by replicator dynamics on per-resource gains while resources follow logistic renewal. Find the joint fixed point by damped fixed-point iteration and compare the number of survivors with fixed-preference assembly.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Top-down assembly: species removal cascades in consumer-resource communities
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Remove each consumer in turn from an assembled MacArthur community and recompute the equilibrium by constrained quadratic minimization. Count the secondary extinctions and rank species by cascade size.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Li-Rinzel calcium model oscillation window in IP3 via Hopf root finding
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For the reduced De Young-Keizer (Li-Rinzel) IP3 receptor model, compute the steady state as a function of IP3. Find the two Hopf points bounding the oscillatory IP3 window by root finding on the Jacobian trace with the determinant positive.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Fire-diffuse-fire calcium wave speed from the threshold-crossing equation
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Sum Green's-function contributions from periodically spaced release sites that fire successively with a constant delay. Solve for the delay at which calcium at the next site reaches threshold by Brent root finding, and give the wave speed as site spacing divided by delay.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Propagation failure in fire-diffuse-fire waves: critical release-site spacing
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Using the fire-diffuse-fire threshold condition, bisect on release-site spacing to find the largest spacing that still sustains a wave for given release strength and diffusion. Map the saltatory-to-failure boundary.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Free calcium with multiple buffers and rapid-buffer effective diffusion
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Solve the mass-conservation polynomial for free calcium given total calcium and several buffers with their Kd values by bracketed root finding. Compute the rapid-buffer approximation effective diffusion coefficient and buffering capacity.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: CaMKII autophosphorylation bistability window as a calcium frequency decoder
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Model CaMKII holoenzyme autophosphorylation and PP1 dephosphorylation with mean-field kinetics. Find the steady states and the saddle-node folds over calcium level by root finding and continuation to define the bistable memory window.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Linear spread speed of a Laplace-kernel integrodifference model versus FFT simulation
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Minimize (1/s) ln(R0 M(s)) over s with Brent's method for Laplace and Gaussian kernels. Compare the result with front speeds measured from FFT-convolution simulations of Beverton-Holt integrodifference dynamics.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Critical climate-shift speed for persistence of a moving-habitat population
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Shift the suitable habitat by a fixed distance each generation and compute the dominant eigenvalue of the shifted kernel operator. Bisect on shift speed for the persistence threshold and compare with the spread-speed bound.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Spread speed of an invading competitor into a resident population
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Linearize a two-species Leslie-Gower competition integrodifference model about the resident equilibrium. Compute the invader's spread speed by minimizing over s with the invader's kernel MGF, and test linear determinacy by simulation.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Maximum likelihood fit of a 2Dt dispersal kernel to seed-trap counts
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Predict seed-trap counts around point sources by numerically integrating a 2Dt (Clark) kernel. Fit the scale and shape parameters by maximizing a Poisson likelihood, then compute the kernel's mean dispersal distance and the implied spread speed.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Marine reserve network spacing: persistence eigenvalue versus reserve fraction
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Build a periodic coastline of reserves with harvested gaps and discretize the larval dispersal integral operator over one period cell. Find the minimal reserve fraction for persistence by bisection on the dominant eigenvalue.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Optimal dispersal kernel width in a periodic patchy landscape
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: On a periodic landscape of alternating good and bad habitat, compute the population growth rate as the dominant eigenvalue of the kernel operator. Maximize it over the Gaussian kernel width with bounded scalar optimization.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Extreme prey and predator densities on Lotka-Volterra orbits via Lambert W
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Use the conserved quantity to solve for the minimum and maximum prey and predator densities on an orbit with the two branches of the Lambert W function. Verify the results with Brent root finding and ODE integration.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Lotka-Volterra multiple-shooting least-squares fit to noisy predator-prey cycles
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Fit Lotka-Volterra rates and segment initial conditions to noisy predator-prey counts by multiple shooting with continuity penalties. Solve with Levenberg-Marquardt and compare the fitted period with the one from data peak detection.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Three-level Lotka-Volterra food chain feasibility and Routh-Hurwitz stability
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Solve for the interior equilibrium of a logistic-prey, predator and top-predator chain by a linear solve. Map the feasibility boundary and check Routh-Hurwitz stability, using bisection to find the critical top-predator death rate.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Kolmogorov-type predator-prey with predator interference: global stability via Lyapunov search
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For a generalized Lotka-Volterra predator-prey model with logistic prey and predator self-limitation, compute the interior equilibrium. Search for weights of a Volterra-type Lyapunov function by linear programming that certify global stability.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Predicting multispecies outcomes from pairwise coexistence assembly rules
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Determine pairwise outcomes (coexist, exclude, bistable) for all gLV species pairs from two-species equilibria. Apply Friedman-style assembly rules combinatorially to predict trio and quartet survivors and score them against full gLV solutions.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: gLV equilibria with higher-order interactions by Newton continuation
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Add cubic three-way interaction terms to a gLV competition model and follow the interior equilibrium with Newton's method as their strength increases. Detect the fold or loss of feasibility where the solution branch ends.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Critical immigration rate restoring diversity in a gLV metacommunity
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Add a constant immigration flux to every species in a competitive gLV system and solve the positive equilibrium by Newton's method. Bisect on immigration rate for the value at which all species exceed a detection threshold.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Symmetric gLV species sorting by maximizing the MacArthur Lyapunov function
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For symmetric positive-definite competition, find the unique stable equilibrium as the maximizer of the quadratic Lyapunov function over the nonnegative orthant by projected gradient ascent. Compare with ODE integration and track how species sorting changes with carrying capacities.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Implicit tau-leaping with Newton solves for a stiff reversible isomerization
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Implement implicit tau-leaping in which each step solves a nonlinear system for the state by Newton's method. Show that it is stable at large τ where explicit tau-leap fails, and quantify the variance damping relative to the exact binomial stationary distribution.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Step size meeting a weak-error tolerance for tau-leaping by bisection
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Estimate the weak error of the tau-leap mean of a birth-death-dimerization network against the exact moments. Bisect on τ for the largest step whose error is below tolerance, accounting for Monte Carlo noise.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Multilevel Monte Carlo coupled tau-leaping with optimal sample allocation
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Implement the Anderson-Higham split-propensity coupling between tau-leap levels. Estimate level variances and costs, and choose sample counts by the Lagrange-multiplier allocation that minimizes cost at a target mean-square error.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Strong and weak convergence orders of Euler-Maruyama chemical Langevin integration
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Integrate the chemical Langevin equation for a Schlögl-type network with Euler-Maruyama over a range of step sizes, using common Brownian paths. Estimate strong and weak convergence orders by log-log regression.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Euler pseudo-likelihood rate estimation from chemical Langevin trajectories
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Write the Gaussian Euler-transition pseudo-likelihood for a gene expression CLE observed at discrete times. Maximize it over the rate constants with BFGS and assess the discretization bias as the sampling interval grows.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Binomial tau-leaping eliminating negative populations in enzyme kinetics
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Implement binomial tau-leaping, where reaction counts are capped by available reactants, for a Michaelis-Menten network. Compare its negative-population frequency and accuracy against Poisson tau-leap and SSA as a function of τ.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Richardson extrapolation of tau-leap moments for a gene expression network
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Run tau-leaping at τ and τ/2 with many samples for a two-stage mRNA-protein model. Apply Richardson extrapolation to the mean and second moment and confirm the second-order weak error against exact moment ODEs.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Feigenbaum delta from superstable logistic-map parameters by Newton iteration
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Find superstable parameters of the logistic map, where the critical point lies on a period-2^n orbit, by Newton's method with extrapolated initial guesses. Compute successive ratios converging to δ≈4.669.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Ricker map period-doubling bifurcation points by Newton on cycle multipliers
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For the Ricker map, solve jointly for period-2^k orbit points and parameter values where the cycle multiplier equals −1 using Newton's method. Report the cascade's accumulation point and the Feigenbaum ratios.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Lyapunov exponent spectrum of the Ricker map and periodic window detection
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the Lyapunov exponent of the Ricker map over a fine parameter grid by orbit averaging of log|f'|. Identify periodic windows as intervals of negative exponent, refine their boundaries by bisection, and classify their periods.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Hassell map stability region and period-two boundary in parameter space
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For the Hassell density-dependent map, derive the nontrivial equilibrium and solve the multiplier = −1 condition across (λ, b) by root finding. Map the boundaries between stable, periodic and chaotic regions using bifurcation diagrams.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Period-3 window onset of the logistic map by tangent-bifurcation Newton solve
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Solve f^3(x)=x together with (f^3)'(x)=1 for the logistic map by Newton's method to locate the saddle-node at r=1+√8. Measure intermittent laminar-phase lengths just below onset and fit their scaling exponent.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Enumerating Metropolis-Stein-Stein kneading sequences of unimodal population maps
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Generate admissible MSS symbolic sequences for superstable periodic orbits up to period 7 by the shift-maximality rule. Locate the corresponding superstable parameters of the Ricker map by bracketing root finding to confirm the universal ordering.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Synchronization threshold of dispersal-coupled logistic maps via transverse Lyapunov exponent
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Couple two chaotic logistic populations through symmetric dispersal and compute the transverse Lyapunov exponent along the synchronized orbit. Bisect on dispersal fraction for the synchronization threshold.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: LPA flour-beetle model: adult cannibalism bifurcations and chaos
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For the larva-pupa-adult beetle map, compute equilibria by fixed-point root finding and the Jacobian multipliers as functions of the adult cannibalism rate. Locate the Neimark-Sacker threshold and compute the maximal Lyapunov exponent along the route to chaos.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Ricker map parameter estimation from noisy counts by synthetic likelihood
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Simulate the Ricker map with process noise and Poisson observation. Summarize series by autocovariances and polynomial regression coefficients, and maximize Wood's Gaussian synthetic log-likelihood for r with a grid search refined by Brent's method.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Nicholson-Bailey host-parasitoid stabilization by aggregation: May's k<1 criterion
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For the negative-binomial host-parasitoid map, compute the interior equilibrium by root finding and the Jacobian eigenvalue moduli as functions of the clumping parameter k. Bisect for the stability boundary and verify the k=1 threshold.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Viterbi decoding of CpG islands with a two-state hidden Markov model
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Decode CpG-island segments in a DNA sequence with the Viterbi algorithm in log space for a two-state HMM. Compare the Viterbi path with posterior decoding from forward-backward, and score segment boundaries against simulated truth.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Profile HMM Viterbi alignment of a protein to a family model
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Build a match/insert/delete profile HMM from a seed alignment using Laplace pseudocounts. Align a query sequence by Viterbi dynamic programming and report the log-odds score against a null model.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: De Bruijn graph assembly by Hierholzer Eulerian path
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Build a k-mer de Bruijn graph from error-free reads of a short genome. Find an Eulerian path with Hierholzer's algorithm and examine how repeats longer than k produce ambiguous reconstructions.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: EM motif discovery under the one-occurrence-per-sequence model
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Implement MEME-style expectation-maximization for a position weight matrix, with one motif site per sequence, against a background model. Use multiple random restarts and report the best log-likelihood, the motif and the site positions.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Gene tree reconciliation: duplication-loss count by LCA mapping
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Map each gene-tree node to the least common ancestor in the species tree of its descendant species. Classify duplications and count losses, then choose the rooting of an unrooted gene tree that minimizes total duplication-loss cost.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Genome rearrangement breakpoint graph cycles and reversal distance bound
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For signed gene-order permutations, construct the breakpoint graph. Count alternating cycles to obtain the n+1−c lower bound on reversal distance, and check it against an exact BFS reversal distance for small genomes.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: De novo peptide sequencing from a tandem mass spectrum by spectrum-graph DP
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Build a spectrum graph whose edges join peaks that differ by amino-acid residue masses. Find the highest-scoring path from zero mass to the precursor mass with DAG dynamic programming and decode the peptide sequence.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Bias-variance optimal tau-leap step under a fixed compute budget
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For a birth-death-dimerization network, model tau-leap mean-squared error of a stationary moment as squared bias (from SSA reference runs at several tau) plus Monte Carlo variance at fixed CPU budget. Fit the bias scaling and find the MSE-minimizing tau by golden-section search.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Hybrid SSA/CLE partitioning threshold minimizing error per unit cost
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Simulate a gene expression network with a hybrid scheme: reactions whose propensity exceeds a threshold are integrated by Euler-Maruyama CLE, the rest by SSA. Scan the threshold, estimate distribution error (KS distance to SSA) and runtime, and select the threshold minimizing a cost-weighted error objective.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Skellam tau-leap likelihood estimation of birth and death rates
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Treat population increments over each observation interval as Poisson births minus Poisson deaths (tau-leap approximation), giving a Skellam likelihood. Maximize it over birth and death rates with Newton/L-BFGS and compare with the exact MLE on SSA-generated data.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Stochastic total-QSSA Gillespie for Michaelis-Menten versus full enzyme SSA
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Reduce the stochastic Michaelis-Menten network to a single product-forming reaction using the tQSSA propensity (the physical root of the complex quadratic) and the standard QSSA propensity. Compare product-time distributions with the full SSA across enzyme-to-substrate ratios.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Sliding-window finite state projection for transient gene induction
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Solve the CME of a two-state gene with mRNA and protein after a step induction using a sliding FSP window. Each time window is shifted and resized from mean and standard-deviation predictions until the leaked probability is below tolerance; report the time-dependent protein distribution.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Chemical master equation finite state projection

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Stationary mRNA distribution with binomial partitioning by cell-cycle map fixed point
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Propagate an mRNA distribution through one cell cycle with an FSP matrix exponential, then apply binomial partitioning at division. Iterate the resulting linear map to its fixed point, the cycle-stationary distribution, and compare its Fano factor with the non-dividing telegraph model.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Chemical master equation finite state projection

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Optimal inducer pulse duration maximizing toggle switching probability via FSP
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Model a genetic toggle switch CME in which an inducer transiently weakens one repressor. Compute the probability of ending in the opposite basin after a pulse of duration T and a relaxation period using FSP matrix exponentials, and maximize the switching-probability-per-cost ratio over T by bounded scalar optimization.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Chemical master equation finite state projection

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Metastable states of a tristable gene circuit by PCCA+ on the CME generator
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Build the truncated CME generator of a three-gene mutual repression circuit and compute its slowest eigenvectors with sparse shift-invert. Cluster states into metastable sets with PCCA+ simplex optimization and report membership-weighted state probabilities and implied transition timescales.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Chemical master equation finite state projection

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Committor probabilities of a stochastic toggle switch from a truncated CME
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Define two basin sets of a toggle switch CME and solve the sparse Dirichlet linear system for the forward committor on the truncated lattice. Locate the stochastic separatrix as the committor-1/2 isosurface and compare it with the deterministic separatrix.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Chemical master equation finite state projection

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Critical isolation fraction with presymptomatic transmission via next-generation matrix
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Build the NGM for a model with exposed, presymptomatic, symptomatic and asymptomatic compartments in which a fraction of symptomatic cases is isolated. Compute R0 as the spectral radius and find by bisection the isolation fraction and delay giving R=1.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Elasticity of R0 to transmission parameters in a West Nile bird-mosquito model
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Construct the NGM of a bird-mosquito West Nile virus model with multiple bird species. Compute R0 and its elasticities with respect to parameters from left and right Perron eigenvectors, and verify them against finite differences.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: R0 of a vector-transmitted plant virus with roguing and critical roguing rate
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Derive the host-vector NGM for a plant virus with latent and infectious plant classes, roguing of symptomatic plants and vector turnover. Compute R0 and find the critical roguing rate for elimination by Brent root finding.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Ebola R0 with funeral transmission and critical safe-burial fraction
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Build an NGM for an SEIRF Ebola model with community, hospital and funeral transmission routes. Compute R0 and the route-specific contributions, then find the safe-burial fraction needed for R<1, and show by root finding whether it exists at a given hospitalization rate.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Tuberculosis R0 with fast and slow progression and critical treatment rate
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Construct the NGM for a TB model with fast progression, latent slow progression and treatment of active cases. Compute R0 as the spectral radius and solve for the treatment rate that brings R0 to one by bracketing.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Dengue secondary-serotype invasion reproduction number with antibody-dependent enhancement
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: At the endemic equilibrium of a single-serotype host-vector dengue model, build the invasion NGM for a second serotype whose transmissibility in previously infected hosts is enhanced by an ADE factor. Compute the invasion number and find by bisection the critical ADE factor for invasion.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Phenotypic phase plane of growth versus oxygen and glucose uptake via shadow prices
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: On a small aerobic/anaerobic core metabolism, solve the FBA LP on a grid of glucose and oxygen uptake rates. Classify phases by the dual shadow prices of the uptake constraints and locate the line of optimality.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Production envelope of growth versus product yield by parametric LP
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For a toy E. coli network with ethanol/lactate secretion, compute the minimum and maximum product flux at each fixed biomass flux by LP. Return the convex production envelope and the theoretical maximum product yield.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Loopless FBA removing thermodynamically infeasible cycles by mixed-integer programming
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Add loop-law constraints, binary direction indicators and nullspace-based potential variables to an FBA model that contains internal cycles. Solve the MILP with scipy milp and show which internal cycle fluxes vanish relative to standard FBA.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Enzyme-constrained FBA predicting overflow metabolism under a proteome budget
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Augment FBA with an enzyme capacity constraint, the sum of flux/kcat times molecular weight bounded by a protein budget, for a network with respiration and fermentation. Sweep glucose uptake and find by bisection the critical uptake at which acetate overflow begins.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Minimal cut sets as minimal hitting sets of elementary flux modes
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Enumerate the elementary flux modes of a small network producing a target metabolite. Compute all minimal cut sets that block target production as the minimal hitting sets of the target-producing EFMs (Berge duality), using combinatorial enumeration up to a given size.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: SteadyCom community growth rate of cross-feeding species by bisection
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Formulate a two-species community FBA in which both members grow at a common rate with abundance-weighted fluxes and shared exchange metabolites. Find the maximal community growth rate by bisection on LP feasibility and report species abundances.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Flux coupling analysis and blocked reactions by linear-fractional programs
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Identify blocked reactions in a small genome-scale-like network by FVA. Classify all reaction pairs as fully, partially, directionally coupled or uncoupled by computing the minimum and maximum flux ratios with Charnes-Cooper-transformed LPs.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Metabolic flux analysis from measured exchange rates with chi-square consistency
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Given a determined or overdetermined stoichiometric system with noisy measured uptake and secretion rates, estimate internal fluxes by weighted least squares. Compute the chi-square consistency statistic and identify gross measurement errors by sequential elimination.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Resource balance analysis growth rate by bisection on LP feasibility
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Model a cell whose metabolic enzyme and ribosome demands scale with growth rate under a total proteome constraint. For fixed growth rate mu, feasibility is an LP; find the maximal feasible mu by bisection and report the proteome allocation.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: MSD ballistic-to-diffusive crossover time of an OU velocity process
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck velocity model, compute the analytic MSD and its local log-slope exponent. Find by root finding the lag at which the exponent equals 1.5 and the lag at which the ballistic and diffusive asymptotes intersect, then validate on simulated tracks.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Cell motility and random walk statistics

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Run-pause segmentation of cell tracks by two-state HMM Viterbi
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Model step speeds as emissions from run and pause states with Rayleigh distributions. Fit the HMM by Baum-Welch EM, decode the most probable state sequence by Viterbi, and report dwell-time distributions and accuracy against simulated ground truth.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Cell motility and random walk statistics

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Optimal number of MSD fitting points under localization error
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For 2D Brownian tracks with static localization noise, compute the theoretical variance of MSD-regression estimates of D as a function of the number of fitted lag points (Michalet). Select the optimal count by minimizing the relative error, and compare with simulation.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Cell motility and random walk statistics

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Maximum likelihood diffusion coefficient and localization noise from MA(1) increments
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Track increments with localization noise form a Gaussian MA(1) process with a tridiagonal covariance. Maximize the exact likelihood over D and the noise variance using banded Cholesky, and compare with covariance-based estimators.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Cell motility and random walk statistics

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Anomalous diffusion exponent of fBm-like tracks by Whittle likelihood
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Simulate fractional Gaussian noise increments by circulant embedding. Estimate the Hurst exponent and diffusivity by maximizing the Whittle spectral likelihood with bounded scalar optimization, and compare with MSD log-slope estimates.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Cell motility and random walk statistics

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Mean exit time of a run-and-tumble particle from an interval
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Write the backward equations for the mean exit time of a 1D run-and-tumble particle with two velocity states from an interval. Solve the coupled boundary value problem analytically or by a finite-difference linear system, and validate against Monte Carlo.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Cell motility and random walk statistics

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Anisotropic persistent random walk parameters by maximum likelihood
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Fit the APRW model, with independent OU velocity processes along principal axes having distinct persistence and speed, to 2D cell tracks. Find the principal axis by eigendecomposition of the velocity covariance and fit per-axis exact AR(1) likelihoods by optimization.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Cell motility and random walk statistics

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Holling III NPZ model: fold bifurcations and hysteresis in total nutrient
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For a closed NPZ model with sigmoidal grazing, reduce the steady-state conditions to a scalar equation in phytoplankton. Find all equilibria by bracketing, trace them with pseudo-arclength continuation in total nutrient, and locate the fold points.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Arnold tongue of seasonally forced NPZ oscillations
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Force an oscillatory NPZ model periodically in the nutrient supply. Compute the rotation number from Poincaré section crossings and find by bisection the forcing amplitude at which 1:1 phase locking begins for each forcing period.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Evolutionarily stable phytoplankton cell size in an NPZ chemostat
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Allometric trade-offs in nutrient affinity, maximum uptake and grazing vulnerability define the invasion fitness of a mutant size in a resident NPZ equilibrium. Find the singular size from the fitness gradient by root finding and check convergence and evolutionary stability.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Size-structured phytoplankton-zooplankton diamond web equilibrium by active-set Newton
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Find the stable equilibrium of a nutrient, two-phytoplankton, two-zooplankton model by Newton iteration on candidate supports, adding or removing species according to invasion growth rates. Report how the surviving community changes with nutrient supply.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Permanence of three-species Lotka-Volterra via Hofbauer linear programming criterion
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Enumerate all boundary equilibria of a three-species LV system. Test permanence by searching, with an LP, for positive weights that make the average Lyapunov function's growth rates positive at every boundary equilibrium.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Zeeman classification of three-species competitive Lotka-Volterra systems
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For a given competitive LV system, compute all boundary equilibria and the signs of their transversal eigenvalues. Map the resulting sign pattern onto Zeeman's 33 stable equivalence classes by combinatorial matching and verify the predicted outcome by integration.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Evolutionarily stable strategies by support enumeration and replicator-LV mapping
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Enumerate all supports of an n-strategy matrix game, solve the equalization conditions for candidate Nash equilibria, and test the ESS conditions. Map the game to the equivalent (n-1)-species Lotka-Volterra system and confirm its stability with the Jacobian.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Intraguild predation coexistence window along a productivity gradient
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: In a Lotka-Volterra intraguild predation model with resource, consumer and omnivore, find by bracketing the carrying capacities at which the omnivore invades and at which the consumer is excluded. Assess interior equilibrium stability by Routh-Hurwitz.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Dispersal-induced instability in a two-patch predator-prey system
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Couple two Lotka-Volterra predator-prey patches with logistic prey through asymmetric predator and prey dispersal. Compute the eigenvalues of the symmetric equilibrium Jacobian and find by bisection the dispersal rates at which it loses stability.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Discrete-gamma rate heterogeneity shape parameter by Brent likelihood maximization
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Implement Yang's discrete gamma site-rate categories using gamma quantiles and category means. Compute the Felsenstein pruning likelihood on a fixed tree under JC+Gamma, then maximize over alpha with Brent's method and compare against simulation truth.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Joint ancestral sequence reconstruction by Pupko's dynamic programming
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Given a rooted tree with branch lengths and an HKY transition model, compute the jointly most probable assignment of ancestral states at all internal nodes for each site with Pupko's max-product DP and traceback. Compare with marginal reconstruction.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Molecular clock likelihood ratio test by node-height optimization
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Fit an unconstrained unrooted tree and a strict-clock rooted ultrametric tree (parameterized by node heights) to an alignment by numerical likelihood maximization. Compute the LRT statistic with its chi-square p-value.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Pairwise dN/dS by maximum likelihood under the Goldman-Yang codon model
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Build the 61x61 GY94 codon rate matrix with kappa and omega, using the genetic code to classify synonymous and nonsynonymous changes. Maximize the pairwise likelihood over divergence time, kappa and omega with bounded optimization.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Substitution model selection among JC, K2P, HKY and GTR by AIC
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: On a fixed topology, maximize the pruning likelihood for each nested substitution model over its rate parameters and branch lengths. Compute AIC, BIC and likelihood ratio tests to choose the best model, as in ModelTest.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Sanderson penalized likelihood rate smoothing for divergence time estimation
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Given a rooted tree with substitution counts per branch and a calibrated root age, estimate node ages and branch rates by maximizing a Poisson likelihood minus a roughness penalty. Choose the smoothing parameter by cross-validation.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Felsenstein zone: parsimony inconsistency versus maximum likelihood on four taxa
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Simulate alignments on four-taxon trees with two long non-sister branches. Choose among the three topologies by exhaustive parsimony and by ML, and find by bisection on branch length the boundary of the region where parsimony converges to the wrong tree.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Virion clearance rate and infected-cell lifespan from post-protease-inhibitor HIV decline
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Fit the Perelson 1996 model, the analytic viral load after perfect protease inhibitor with an initial shoulder, to log viral load data by nonlinear least squares. Return the virion clearance rate, infected-cell death rate and confidence intervals.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Practical identifiability of influenza target-cell-limited model by profile likelihood
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Fit an influenza TIV model with eclipse phase to log nasal titer data. Profile the likelihood over the infection rate beta, re-optimizing the other parameters at each value, to show that beta and viral production p trade off and to compute confidence intervals.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Interferon efficacy against HCV from biphasic viral decline
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Fit the Neumann 1998 HCV model with blocked virion production to viral load after interferon onset, including a delay. Estimate drug efficacy epsilon, clearance c and infected-cell loss delta by least squares with bounds.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Post-treatment control bistability in an HIV model with CTL response
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For an HIV model with a CTL response that saturates in infected cells, find all equilibria by root finding of a reduced scalar equation and classify their stability. Locate the saddle-node points bounding the bistable region of the immune parameter by continuation.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Structured treatment interruption schedule optimization in an HIV-immune model
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Parameterize an on/off ART schedule by switching times over a fixed horizon. Maximize final CD4 and immune effector levels minus a drug-cost penalty with bounded optimization over the switching times, using ODE integration for each candidate.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Time and height of peak viral load versus within-host R0
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Integrate a target-cell-limited model of acute infection and locate the viral peak by event root finding on dV/dt. Compare the peak time and height with the analytic quasi-steady approximation over a range of within-host R0.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Transmission-maximizing HIV set-point viral load
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Combine a Hill-type transmission-rate curve and a decreasing duration-of-infection curve as functions of set-point viral load to give the transmission potential. Find the optimal set point by bounded maximization and assess its sensitivity to the Hill exponent.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Defective interfering particle coinfection model equilibria and stability
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Model target cells, wild-type-infected, coinfected cells, wild-type virions and DIPs. Find all equilibria, including DIP-persistence states, by Newton from many starts, classify them by Jacobian eigenvalues, and find the DIP production threshold for invasion.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Minimum dosing frequency keeping antiviral efficacy above the critical value
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Couple one-compartment oral pharmacokinetics to an Emax efficacy function in a viral dynamics model. Find by bisection the longest dosing interval for which the trough efficacy stays above the critical efficacy 1-1/R0 at periodic steady state.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Survival of the flattest: crossover mutation rate between sharp and flat peaks
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Construct the quasispecies matrix on Hamming error classes for a landscape with a tall narrow peak and a lower mutationally robust plateau. Compute the dominant eigenvector and find by bisection the mutation rate at which the population shifts to the flat peak.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Lethal mutagenesis threshold of a viral quasispecies
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For a viral population with replicative ratio R0 and a lethal fraction of mutations, compute the mean-fitness Perron eigenvalue of a mutation-selection model with a viability landscape. Find the mutation rate at which the eigenvalue reaches the extinction value by Brent root finding.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Mutation-selection-recombination equilibria on a single peak by fixed-point iteration
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Iterate a two-locus or multilocus haploid model with mutation, single-peak selection and free recombination to its fixed points from different initial conditions. Map the region in which master and delocalized states are bistable as the recombination rate varies.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Diploid mutation-selection balance with partial dominance by root finding
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Solve the deterministic one-locus diploid recursion with mutation rate u, selection s and dominance h for its equilibrium deleterious allele frequency by Brent root finding. Show the crossover from u/(hs) to the square root of u/s as h approaches zero.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Mutation load under synergistic epistasis by mutation-count distribution fixed point
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Iterate the distribution of deleterious mutation counts under Poisson mutation and a quadratic log-fitness function to equilibrium. Compute the mutation load and compare with the multiplicative-fitness Haldane-Muller result, 1-exp(-U).

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Finite-population error threshold from Wright-Fisher mutation-selection stationary distribution
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Build the Wright-Fisher Markov chain for the number of master sequences with mutation and single-peak selection. Compute its stationary distribution by linear solve, and find the effective error threshold as a function of population size N.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Quasispecies in a periodically switching fitness landscape via Floquet growth rate
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Alternate the location of the fitness peak periodically between two sequences. Compute the dominant eigenvalue of the one-period monodromy matrix of the linear quasispecies dynamics, and find the mutation rate that maximizes long-term growth together with the error threshold.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Mutational robustness on neutral networks from the adjacency spectral radius
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Enumerate a neutral network of sequences that satisfy a constraint, such as a toy fold rule, and build its adjacency matrix. Compute the equilibrium population neutrality from the spectral radius (van Nimwegen) and compare with the network's average neutrality.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Longest repeated substring of a genome via suffix array and LCP
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Build a suffix array by prefix-doubling sort and compute the LCP array with Kasai's algorithm. Extract the longest repeated substring and the distribution of maximal repeats, and compare repeat statistics with shuffled sequences.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Exact read matching with an FM-index backward search
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Construct the Burrows-Wheeler transform, C array and occurrence tables of a reference genome. Locate all exact matches of sequencing reads by backward search, recover positions from a sampled suffix array, and verify against naive search.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Partial digest restriction mapping by backtracking
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Given a multiset of pairwise fragment lengths, reconstruct all point sets of restriction sites consistent with it using Skiena's backtracking algorithm. Report the solutions, including homometric pairs.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Greedy shortest common superstring assembly from an overlap graph
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute all pairwise suffix-prefix overlaps among reads. Greedily merge the highest-overlap pair until one contig remains, and compare the length with an exact solution by DP over subsets for small instances.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Spaced seed sensitivity by dynamic programming over homologous alignments
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For a Bernoulli match model of homologous regions, compute the probability that a spaced seed hits somewhere in a region of length L by DP over automaton states or suffixes. Enumerate seeds of fixed weight to find the most sensitive pattern.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Kinetic proofreading error-speed-dissipation trade-off by constrained optimization
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For Hopfield's proofreading scheme, compute the steady-state error fraction and product formation rate from the Markov chain linear solve. Minimize error subject to a speed constraint over the rate constants to trace the Pareto front.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Gibson-Bruck next reaction method with dependency graph and indexed priority queue
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Implement the next reaction method for a sparse gene network with a reaction dependency graph and a binary-heap indexed priority queue that reuses random numbers. Verify the distributions against the direct method and compare propensity update counts.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Loggerhead turtle stage matrix: growth rate, elasticities and management targeting
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the dominant eigenvalue and eigenvectors of the Crouse stage-structured projection matrix, together with sensitivity and elasticity matrices. Find by bisection the juvenile survival increase that raises lambda to one.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Beverton-Holt stock-recruitment fit and maximum sustainable yield
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Fit Beverton-Holt recruitment to stock-recruit data by lognormal maximum likelihood. Combine it with a per-recruit model to compute equilibrium yield versus fishing mortality, and find MSY and F_MSY by bounded maximization.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Optimal harvest under stochastic recruitment by dynamic programming (Reed escapement)
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Discretize stock size and solve the stochastic dynamic program for maximum expected discounted harvest under multiplicative lognormal growth shocks by value iteration. Verify that the optimal policy is constant escapement and compute the escapement level.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: State-dependent foraging decisions by Mangel-Clark stochastic dynamic programming
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For a forager with energy reserves choosing among patches that differ in predation risk and food gain over a finite horizon, compute the fitness-maximizing state- and time-dependent patch choice by backward induction. Simulate the resulting survival.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Cormack-Jolly-Seber survival and recapture probabilities by maximum likelihood
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: From capture histories, build the CJS likelihood with chi terms for never-resighted individuals and maximize it over survival and capture probabilities, using a logit transform. Compare time-constant and time-varying models by AIC.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Line-transect distance sampling: half-normal detection MLE and density
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Fit half-normal and hazard-rate detection functions to perpendicular distances by maximum likelihood with truncation. Select between them by AIC and estimate population density with a delta-method variance.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Flux control coefficients of a linear pathway by metabolic control analysis
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: From the elasticities of each enzyme in a linear pathway with feedback inhibition, compute flux and concentration control coefficients by the matrix method (linear solve). Verify the summation and connectivity theorems and compare with finite-difference perturbations of the kinetic model.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Most reliable signaling path in a weighted protein interaction network via Dijkstra
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Convert interaction confidences to edge weights equal to minus the log confidence and find the most probable receptor-to-transcription-factor paths with Dijkstra's algorithm. Use Yen's algorithm for the k shortest paths and score node betweenness on these paths.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: SIR epidemic peak time by quadrature of the exact orbit and root finding
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For the closed SIR model, use the conserved quantity to write I(S) and the final size via Lambert W. Compute peak prevalence at S=N/R0, then get the peak time by integrating dt = dS/(-beta S I(S)/N) and solving with Brent for the time at which prevalence first reaches a set fraction of the peak.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: SEIR endemic equilibrium and interepidemic period from Jacobian eigenvalues
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Solve for the endemic equilibrium of SEIR with births and deaths by root finding on the force of infection. Linearize there and take the dominant complex eigenpair to get the damped interepidemic period, then scan how it depends on the latent period.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Leaky versus all-or-nothing vaccine coverage capping attack rate by bisection
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Write the SIR final-size relations for a population partly vaccinated with either a leaky or an all-or-nothing vaccine of given efficacy. Solve each by Newton, then bisect on coverage to find the minimum coverage that keeps the attack rate below a target, comparing the two vaccine types.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Herd immunity threshold under gamma-distributed susceptibility via final-size root
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For SIR with gamma-distributed individual susceptibility (coefficient of variation CV), derive the closed-form susceptible-depletion relation. Solve the modified final-size equation by bracketing and compute the herd immunity threshold, both as functions of CV, and validate against a discretized multigroup ODE.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Dorfman group testing pool size minimizing expected tests per person
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Given prevalence p and an assay with sensitivity and specificity, derive the expected number of tests per individual and the misclassification rates for two-stage Dorfman pooling. Find the optimal integer pool size by enumeration and map where pooling beats individual testing using bisection in p.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Minimum ring length sustaining reentry in a Barkley excitable ring
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Simulate a single circulating pulse on 1D periodic Barkley rings of varying circumference and measure the rotation speed and period. Bisect on ring length to find the critical length below which reentry fails, giving the dispersion relation near the limit.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Alternans onset cycle length from APD restitution map fixed point
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Fit an exponential restitution curve APD = f(DI) to simulated or given data and define the pacing map APD_{n+1} = f(BCL - APD_n). Find its fixed point by root finding and bisect on the basic cycle length for the slope = 1 period-doubling point, then check it by iterating the map.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Food web intervality: minimizing diet gaps by simulated annealing species orderings
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Given the binary predation matrix of an empirical-style or niche-model food web, search over orderings of prey with simulated annealing to minimize the total number of gaps in predators' diets (the consecutive-ones problem). Compare the minimum gap count with randomized webs of equal connectance.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Food web structure and network ecology

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Maximum loop weight of a food web community matrix by cycle enumeration
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Build the interaction-strength matrix of a small food web parameterized from biomass flows. Enumerate all elementary feedback loops with Johnson's algorithm, compute each loop's weight as the geometric mean of its absolute strengths, and test the Neutel criterion relating maximum loop weight to the self-regulation needed for stability.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Food web structure and network ecology

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Trophic species aggregation by structural equivalence partition refinement
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Partition the species of a directed food web into trophic species, meaning those with identical predator and prey sets, by iterative partition refinement over hashed neighborhoods. Then compute how connectance and the fractions of top, intermediate and basal species change after aggregation.
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.area: Food web structure and network ecology

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Four-point condition check and additive tree reconstruction from a distance matrix
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Test whether a distance matrix is tree-additive by checking the four-point condition over all quartets. If it is, reconstruct the unique weighted tree by sequential leaf insertion, solving for attachment points from triples, and verify that path lengths reproduce the input distances.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Optimal leaf ordering of a UPGMA dendrogram by dynamic programming
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Build a UPGMA tree from Jukes-Cantor distances. Then flip internal nodes to minimize the sum of adjacent-leaf distances using the Bar-Joseph O(n^4) dynamic program, and compare the optimal cost against the default and the worst orderings.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Species tree minimizing deep coalescences over enumerated rooted topologies
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Given a set of rooted gene trees on five or six taxa, enumerate all rooted species-tree topologies. For each, compute the deep-coalescence cost of every gene tree by LCA mapping and lineage counting, and return the species tree(s) with the minimum total extra lineages.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Copy-number segmentation of read depth by Gaussian-emission HMM with EM
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Model binned sequencing read depth as a hidden Markov chain over copy-number states with Gaussian emissions whose means scale with copy number. Fit the transition and emission parameters by EM, decode segments with Viterbi, and report the detected breakpoints.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Transmembrane helix topology prediction by length-constrained HMM Viterbi
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Build an HMM with inside, outside and helix state chains in which helix segments are constrained to 15-25 residues through chained states. Emissions come from hydrophobicity-based residue probabilities. Decode a protein sequence with log-space Viterbi to get helix positions and membrane topology.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Recombination breakpoint detection by mosaic HMM over parental sequences
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Model a query sequence as a mosaic of aligned parental sequences, with hidden states equal to parent identity, a switching probability, and mismatch emissions. Use Viterbi to infer breakpoints and estimate the switching rate by maximizing the forward likelihood with Brent.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Hopf onset of negative-feedback MAPK cascade oscillations versus feedback strength
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: In the Kholodenko MAPK model with ERK inhibiting the first tier, find the steady state by root finding. Locate the critical feedback strength or Hill coefficient where a complex Jacobian eigenpair crosses the imaginary axis by bisection, and report the oscillation period at onset.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Molecular titration ultrasensitivity: threshold and maximal logarithmic sensitivity
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For an activator sequestered by an inhibitor with dissociation constant K, solve the quadratic binding equilibrium for free activator. Locate the input giving maximal log-log sensitivity by bounded scalar optimization, and show how the peak sensitivity scales as K becomes small relative to total inhibitor.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Effective population size from temporal allele frequencies by Wright-Fisher HMM likelihood
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Treat true allele frequencies as hidden Wright-Fisher states, with binomial sampling of observed counts at several generations. Compute the likelihood of multi-locus time-series data with the forward algorithm, and maximize over Ne with Brent to get an estimate and a likelihood interval.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Concentration control coefficients of a branched pathway via matrix MCA
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For a branched pathway with reversible Michaelis-Menten rate laws, solve the steady state by Newton and compute the elasticity matrix numerically. Obtain flux and concentration control coefficients from the link-matrix formula, and verify the summation and connectivity theorems and the branch-point relations.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Optimal enzyme allocation maximizing pathway flux under a total enzyme budget
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For a linear pathway of reversible mass-action steps, maximize the steady-state flux over enzyme levels subject to a fixed total enzyme amount using SLSQP. Verify that at the optimum the flux control coefficients equal the enzyme fractions (Heinrich-Klipp).

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Brownian ratchet polymerization velocity and stall force by root finding
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: In the Peskin-Odell-Oster polymerization ratchet, compute filament growth velocity against a load force from on and off rates and the monomer size. Find the stall force by Brent root finding of v(F) = 0, and compare the result with the thermodynamic stall force kT ln(k_on c / k_off)/delta.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Tug-of-war cargo transport: motor-state distribution and mean velocity
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Model a cargo pulled by plus and minus motors in the Muller-Klumpp-Lipowsky framework, solving force balance for the cargo velocity in each (n+, n-) state by root finding. Get the stationary distribution of motor numbers from the master-equation null space, then compute the mean velocity and the fraction of time spent in each direction.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Nucleation-elongation polymer length distribution and critical concentration by mass balance
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: In the Oosawa nucleated polymerization equilibrium, solve the total-mass conservation equation for the free monomer concentration by Brent root finding across total concentrations. Compute the polymer length distribution and identify the effective critical concentration and sharpness of the transition versus nucleus size.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Context-sensitive half-time of a three-compartment anesthetic model
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Use matrix exponentials of a three-compartment IV model (e.g., propofol) to find, for each infusion duration, the post-infusion time at which central concentration falls 50%. Each time is found by Brent root finding.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Extended-interval aminoglycoside regimen meeting peak/MIC and trough constraints
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Enumerate a grid of doses and dosing intervals for a two-compartment infusion model, with steady-state profiles from matrix exponentials. Select regimens with Cmax/MIC at or above target and trough below a toxicity limit, minimizing total daily dose.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Intrinsic clearance from hepatic extraction: well-stirred, parallel-tube and dispersion models
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Invert observed hepatic clearance for intrinsic clearance under three liver models, using Newton or bracketing for the dispersion-model transcendental equation. Compare predicted clearance changes with blood flow.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Mutual CYP inhibition between two co-administered drugs by fixed-point iteration
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Each drug's clearance is reduced by competitive inhibition from the other's unbound concentration. Solve the coupled steady-state concentrations under constant infusion by damped fixed-point iteration, and report AUC ratios.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Effect-compartment ke0 estimation by collapsing the concentration-effect hysteresis loop
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Simulate plasma concentration from a two-compartment model and an observed Emax effect series. Find ke0 by minimizing the area of the effect-site concentration-effect loop with bounded scalar optimization.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Saturable plasma protein binding: free fraction and total steady-state concentration
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: With Langmuir binding to albumin and clearance of unbound drug, solve the mass balance for unbound and total steady-state concentrations by root finding across infusion rates. Quantify the nonlinear dose dependence.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Loewe additivity isobologram and combination index for a two-drug pair
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Given Hill dose-response curves of two drugs and an observed mixture response, solve the Loewe additivity equation for the expected effect by root finding. Compute combination indices along fixed-ratio rays.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Marginal ancestral states of a discrete morphological trait under the Mk model
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Fit the Mk rate by Brent maximization of the pruning likelihood on a fixed tree. Compute marginal posterior state probabilities at each internal node via up-down (pre/post-order) passes.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Pagel's test of correlated evolution between two binary traits
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Build independent (2+2 rate) and dependent (8-rate) continuous-time Markov models on four joint states. Maximize the pruning likelihoods with multistart L-BFGS and perform a likelihood ratio test.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Maximum agreement subtree of two rooted phylogenies by dynamic programming
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the size and leaf set of the largest subtree common to two rooted binary trees. Use the classical O(n^2) node-pair dynamic programming as a topological similarity measure.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Noah's Ark problem: maximizing expected phylogenetic diversity under a budget
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: On a rooted tree with branch lengths, species-specific conservation costs and survival probabilities, choose taxa to protect. Compare greedy Faith-PD selection with exact knapsack enumeration of expected PD.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Speciation and extinction rates from branching times by birth-death likelihood
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Maximize the Nee et al. reconstructed-tree likelihood over diversification rate and turnover from node ages. Profile turnover to give a confidence interval.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Pagel's lambda phylogenetic signal by restricted maximum likelihood
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Build the Brownian-motion covariance from a tree, scale its off-diagonal elements by lambda, and maximize the Gaussian (RE)ML over lambda in [0,1] by Brent. Test against lambda=0 and lambda=1.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Root-to-tip regression with optimal root placement for serially sampled viruses
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For a dated, unrooted tree, search every branch and position along it for the root maximizing the R^2 of root-to-tip distance against sampling time. Report the clock rate and TMRCA.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Projection matrix estimation from stage-count time series by quadratic programming
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Estimate Lefkovitch entries from observed stage vectors by least squares under nonnegativity and survival column-sum constraints (Wood's method). Report the fitted lambda and stable stage distribution.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Maximal transient amplification of a stage-structured population after disturbance
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the amplification envelope max over initial vectors of ||A^t n0|| / ||n0|| via singular values of matrix powers, after standardizing by lambda. Find the peak time and the initial stage structure achieving it.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Sustainable harvest of a Leslie population by linear programming
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Choose age-specific harvest fractions maximizing stationary yield under a constraint holding the harvested population stationary (Beddington-Taylor). Solve as an LP and compare with uniform harvesting.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Lambda-consistent stage-duration Lefkovitch matrix by fixed-point iteration
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Use transition probabilities from stage durations that depend on lambda itself (Caswell's fixed-stage-duration formula), as for loggerhead-style life cycles. Iterate eigenvalue and matrix construction to self-consistency and check convergence.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Two-state kinesin model fit to force-velocity and randomness data
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Fit the force-dependent forward and backward rates of a Fisher-Kolomeisky periodic two-state stepping model. Use joint least squares on velocity and randomness parameter versus load, and compute the stall force by root finding.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Huxley 1957 cross-bridge model: steady force-velocity curve and rate fit
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Solve the steady attached-fraction equation along the strain coordinate at each shortening velocity and integrate the force. Fit attachment and detachment rate constants to Hill force-velocity data by least squares.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Actin treadmilling steady state from barbed- and pointed-end critical concentrations
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Given ATP-actin association and dissociation rates at both filament ends, solve for the steady monomer concentration where net elongation vanishes. Combine this with total-mass conservation to get the treadmilling flux.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Jet-lag re-entrainment from iterating a phase-response-curve circle map
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Model daily light exposure as a PRC-based phase map after a time-zone shift. Count cycles to re-entrain via fixed-point iteration, and optimize the timing of an extra light pulse to minimize recovery days.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Devil's staircase of a forced biological oscillator via circle-map rotation numbers
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute rotation numbers of a sine circle map modeling periodically forced pacemaker or circadian cells. Locate Arnold-tongue boundaries of low-order Farey ratios by bracketing on the locking condition.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Drift paradox: critical advection for persistence of stream populations
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Use reaction-advection-diffusion on a finite stream with an upstream no-flux and downstream outflow boundary. Find by root finding of the transcendental principal-eigenvalue condition the advection speed above which the population washes out.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: IP3 receptor steady open probability: optimal calcium in the De Young-Keizer model
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute steady open probability from the quasi-steady subunit state distribution of the De Young-Keizer IP3R model. Maximize it over cytosolic calcium for each IP3 level to trace the shifting bell-curve peak.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Infomax tuning of a Hill receptor to an environmental ligand distribution
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For a Hill-type sensor with Gaussian output noise and a lognormal ligand distribution, maximize the mutual information between input and output over K and Hill coefficient. Compare with histogram-equalization predictions.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Ligand-induced receptor dimerization steady states by Newton with conservation
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Solve the mass-action equilibrium of a bivalent ligand bridging two receptor monomers (EGFR-like) under total ligand and receptor conservation using Newton. Map dimer fraction versus dose, including the high-dose prozone.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Scaffold prozone: optimal scaffold concentration maximizing kinase pathway output
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Model a scaffold binding two kinases (Levchenko-type) and solve the equilibrium of complexes by Newton. Find the scaffold concentration maximizing the fully assembled complex, and show biphasic output.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Response time of negatively autoregulated versus simple gene expression
