biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: At matched steady-state protein levels, compute the rise time to half steady state for Hill-type negative autoregulation and constitutive expression by ODE integration plus root finding. Report the speedup versus repression strength.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Input conductance of a branched passive dendritic tree by recursive cable algebra
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Traverse a dendritic tree from the tips with sealed-end cable segment formulas to compute input conductance at the soma. Test Rall's 3/2-power rule and the equivalent-cylinder reduction.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Electrotonic length from voltage-transient time constants by transcendental root finding
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For a finite cable with a lumped soma, solve the eigenvalue equation for the decay time constants tau_n by bracketing. Invert for electrotonic length L from measured tau_0/tau_1 ratios.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Optimal myelin g-ratio maximizing conduction velocity in a nodal cable model
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Simulate saltatory conduction in a discretized myelinated axon with HH-type nodes and passive internodes using Crank-Nicolson. Maximize conduction velocity over the g-ratio at fixed outer diameter.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Action potential propagation failure at a dendritic branch point
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: In a Hodgkin-Huxley cable that branches into two daughters, bisect on daughter diameter (geometric ratio) to find the critical impedance mismatch causing conduction block.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Zuker minimum free energy RNA folding with nearest-neighbor stacking
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Implement the V/W dynamic programming with stacking energies, hairpin, bulge and interior-loop penalties. Use a linear multiloop model and trace back the MFE secondary structure.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: MicroRNA-target duplex minimum free energy with seed constraint
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the optimal intermolecular duplex between a miRNA and a 3'UTR window by stacking-energy dynamic programming, requiring seed pairing. Scan the UTR for the best sites.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: BLAST-style X-drop seed extension and high-scoring segment pairs
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Find exact word seeds between two sequences and extend them ungapped and gapped with X-drop termination under BLOSUM62. Report the HSPs and their scores.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Codon optimization by dynamic programming avoiding restriction sites under GC bounds
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Choose synonymous codons to maximize codon adaptation index while excluding specified restriction-site motifs across codon junctions. Use a k-mer-state dynamic program and penalize GC deviation from a target.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Hydrophobic segment detection by Ruzzo-Tompa maximal scoring subsequences
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Convert a protein sequence to hydropathy-based scores. Find all disjoint maximal-scoring segments in linear time and compare them with candidate transmembrane helices.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Exact three-sequence alignment by three-dimensional dynamic programming
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the optimal sum-of-pairs alignment of three sequences with linear gaps by 3D DP and traceback. Compare with progressive pairwise alignment.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Cyclopeptide sequencing from a mass spectrum by branch and bound
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Grow linear peptides by amino-acid masses and prune those whose subpeptide spectra are inconsistent with the observed spectrum. Return the cyclic peptides whose theoretical spectra match.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Double-cut-and-join distance between multichromosomal genomes
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Build the adjacency graph of two gene-order genomes with linear and circular chromosomes, and count cycles and odd paths. Compute the DCJ distance and an optimal sorting scenario.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Ground states of 2D HP lattice proteins by exhaustive self-avoiding walk enumeration
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Enumerate the self-avoiding conformations of a short HP sequence on the square lattice with symmetry reduction. Find the minimum-energy (maximal H-H contact) structures and their degeneracy.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Haplotype frequency estimation from unphased genotypes by EM
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For multilocus SNP genotypes, enumerate compatible haplotype pairs per individual. Iterate EM to maximum-likelihood haplotype frequencies and report linkage disequilibrium.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Exact Hardy-Weinberg test by enumerating heterozygote counts
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the exact conditional distribution of heterozygote counts given allele counts with Levene's recursion. Obtain the exact p-value by summing probabilities no larger than the observed.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: ABO blood-group allele frequencies by the gene-counting EM algorithm
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Estimate A, B and O allele frequencies from phenotype counts by EM fixed-point iteration. Check against direct likelihood maximization and compute standard errors from the observed information.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Inbreeding and kinship coefficients from a pedigree by the tabular method
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Topologically order a pedigree graph and build the kinship matrix recursively. Report inbreeding coefficients and verify them against Wright's path-counting formula.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Optimal contribution selection minimizing group coancestry in a captive breeding program
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Choose parental contributions to the next generation by quadratic programming. Minimize average kinship subject to nonnegativity, sex-specific sums and optional genetic gain constraints.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Hudson-Kaplan minimum recombination events from the four-gamete test
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Find incompatible SNP pairs with the four-gamete test and solve the interval-stabbing problem greedily for the lower bound Rm. Localize the recombination intervals.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Perfect phylogeny test and tree construction for binary characters
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Sort binary characters by column value and apply Gusfield's containment test for compatibility. Build the perfect phylogeny tree when one exists, otherwise report conflicting pairs.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Genetic linkage map ordering by minimizing total recombination fraction
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Estimate pairwise recombination fractions from backcross genotypes, then order markers by solving a TSP. Use nearest-neighbor construction plus 2-opt refinement, and compare with the true order.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Ideal free distribution of foragers across patches with interference
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Find patch-specific forager numbers equalizing per-capita intake under a Sutherland interference model, with unsuitable patches unoccupied. Use bisection on the common intake (water-filling).

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Smith-Fretwell optimal offspring size by tangent construction
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Given a sigmoid offspring fitness versus provisioning curve, find the optimal per-offspring investment maximizing parental fitness. Root-find the tangency condition and study the clutch size implied by a fixed budget.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Optimal switch from growth to reproduction in a bang-bang life-history model
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: In a Perrin-Sibly energy allocation model with mortality, compute lifetime reproduction as a function of switching age. Maximize it by Brent and compare with the Pontryagin switching condition.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Sequential mate choice: optimal acceptance thresholds by backward induction
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: A female samples males of random quality with search costs and a finite season. Compute time-dependent acceptance thresholds by dynamic programming, and the expected mate quality.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Faustmann optimal forest rotation age with a Chapman-Richards stand growth curve
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Maximize the net present value of infinite rotations of a forest stand over rotation age. Solve the first-order Faustmann condition by root finding and compare with the MSY rotation.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Hamilton local mate competition ESS sex ratio by best-response iteration
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For n foundresses per patch, compute the mutant fitness of a sex ratio in a resident population. Find the ESS by fixed-point iteration of best responses and compare with (n-1)/2n.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Vaccination game: Nash equilibrium coverage under perceived vaccine risk
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Using endemic SIR infection risk as a function of coverage, find the Bauch-Earn Nash coverage where vaccine and infection payoffs equal by root finding. Compare with herd immunity.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Outbreak source estimation by rumor centrality on a contact tree
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Compute rumor centrality of every node of an observed infected subtree by message passing. Identify the maximum-likelihood source and compare it with the Jordan and distance centers.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Transmission tree reconstruction by minimum spanning arborescence of genetic distances
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Build a directed graph of cases weighted by genetic distance, allowing only earlier-to-later edges. Find the optimal ancestry with Edmonds' algorithm (SeqTrack) and score its accuracy against a simulated outbreak.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Optimal measles vaccination age balancing maternal antibody interference and infection risk
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Combine maternal-antibody decay, age-dependent seroconversion and force of infection in an age-structured model. Find the vaccination age maximizing the protected fraction by bounded optimization.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Antigenic cartography of influenza strains by metric multidimensional scaling of HI titers
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Convert hemagglutination-inhibition titers to target distances and embed antigens and sera in 2D. Minimize stress with threshold handling for low titers, using multistart gradient optimization.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Max-min driving force of a metabolic pathway by linear programming
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Choose metabolite log-concentrations within physiological bounds to maximize the minimal reaction driving force (-ΔG') along a pathway such as glycolysis. Identify the bottleneck reactions from the LP.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: ARACNE network inference with data-processing-inequality pruning
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Estimate pairwise mutual information from expression data with kernel or binned estimators and threshold it. Remove the weakest edge of every triangle per the data processing inequality, then compute precision against the true network.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Feed-forward loop motif enrichment against degree-preserving randomized networks
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Count three-node motifs in a transcriptional network by enumeration. Compare with ensembles generated by edge-swap randomization to compute z-scores.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Protein complex detection by k-clique percolation in an interaction network
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Enumerate maximal cliques of a PPI graph and build the clique overlap graph. Extract k-clique communities as connected components, and evaluate them against planted complexes.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Thermodynamic lac repression model: fitting operator binding energies to fold-change data
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Fit repressor-operator binding energies with a states-and-weights fold-change formula, including allosteric inducer effects, to fold-change data across repressor copy numbers by nonlinear least squares. Predict new constructs.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Dekel-Alon cost-benefit optimum of lac protein expression
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Combine a measured-form protein cost function and lactose-dependent benefit to obtain growth rate as a function of expression level. Maximize it by Brent for each lactose level and find the level below which expression is unfavourable.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Bacterial cell size homeostasis: fixed point and variance of the adder division map
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Iterate the birth-size map under adder, sizer and timer rules with noise. Compute the fixed-point birth size and the stationary CV from the linearized stochastic map, checked by simulation.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Antibiotic sequences steering evolution on a fitness landscape graph
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Build SSWM Markov transition matrices for several drugs on a four-locus fitness landscape. Enumerate drug sequences up to length k to maximize the probability of ending at a drug-sensitive genotype.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Pump-leak model of cell volume and membrane potential by Newton's method
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Solve for steady Na+, K+ and Cl- concentrations, cell volume and membrane potential. Impose GHK fluxes, Na/K-ATPase pumping and osmotic balance with impermeant anions, and check how volume changes with pump rate.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Resting potential with divalent ions from the GHK equation by root finding
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Find the zero-current membrane potential including calcium, where no closed form exists, by bracketing the summed GHK currents. Fit relative permeabilities to reversal potentials measured under different ion substitutions.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Adair constants and P50 of hemoglobin from oxygen saturation data
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Fit four Adair stepwise constants to an oxygen dissociation curve by nonlinear least squares. Compute P50 by root finding and the maximal Hill slope.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Ion channel kinetic scheme fit to dwell-time distributions by maximum likelihood
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: For a C-C-O channel scheme, compute open and closed dwell-time densities from Q-matrix submatrix exponentials. Maximize the likelihood of simulated dwell times over the rates and compare eigenvalue time constants.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Site occupancy with imperfect detection (MacKenzie model) by maximum likelihood
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: From repeated detection histories across sites, maximize the zero-inflated binomial likelihood for occupancy and detection probability. Report profile confidence intervals.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Zippin removal-sampling population estimate by root finding
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: From catches in successive removal passes, solve the maximum-likelihood equation for catchability by bracketing. Compute the abundance estimate and its standard error.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Murray's law: optimal vessel radii minimizing pumping plus blood volume cost
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Minimize Poiseuille dissipation plus metabolic volume cost over segment radii in a small bifurcating vascular tree with prescribed flows. Verify the cube law at junctions.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Optimal stomatal conductance under Cowan-Farquhar water-use efficiency
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Couple Farquhar photosynthesis with diffusive CO2 supply via a quadratic co-limitation solution. Find the conductance where the marginal carbon gain per water lost equals lambda by root finding.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Farquhar-von Caemmerer-Berry A/Ci curve fit for Vcmax and Jmax
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Fit the Rubisco-limited and RuBP-limited photosynthesis model to A/Ci data with an automatically determined transition point. Use multistart nonlinear least squares with bounds.

biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.title: Optimal leaf area index maximizing canopy carbon gain under Beer's law
biology/quant_bio|opt_discrete.gist: Integrate light-saturating leaf photosynthesis through a canopy with exponential light attenuation, minus per-leaf respiration and construction cost. Maximize net canopy gain over LAI by Brent.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Integral fluctuation theorem for stochastic entropy production in a four-state network
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Accumulate system plus medium entropy along Gillespie trajectories of a driven four-state network started from an arbitrary initial distribution. Verify that <exp(-Δs_tot)> = 1 and report the full distribution of Δs_tot.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Thermodynamic uncertainty relation test for an enzymatic cycle current
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Estimate the mean and variance of the integrated cycle current over many Gillespie trajectories of a Michaelis-Menten-like driven cycle. Check the TUR bound Var(J)/<J>^2 >= 2/(σ t) across a range of driving strengths.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Katz-Lebowitz-Spohn driven lattice gas current and anisotropic structure factor
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Run Kawasaki-exchange Monte Carlo of a 2D half-filled lattice gas with an infinite field along one axis. Measure the steady-state current, the stripe-ordering transition temperature and the anisotropic structure factor S(kx, ky).

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Drift and giant diffusion of a Brownian particle in a tilted periodic potential
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Integrate overdamped Langevin dynamics in a tilted cosine potential with Euler-Maruyama. Compare the measured mean velocity and effective diffusion coefficient with the exact Stratonovich/Reimann quadrature formulas, including the diffusion peak near critical tilt.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Current large deviations of a ring random walk via the cloning algorithm
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Implement the Giardinà-Kurchan-Peliti population-dynamics cloning algorithm for a biased random walk on a ring. Compare the estimated scaled cumulant generating function of the current with the largest eigenvalue of the tilted generator.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Brownian gyrator torque from coupled Langevin modes at two temperatures
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate two linearly coupled overdamped coordinates in contact with baths at different temperatures. Measure the mean angular momentum and the heat flux, and compare them with the analytic covariance obtained from the Lyapunov equation.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Diffusion-limited annihilation A+A→0 density decay by kinetic Monte Carlo
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate random walkers on a 1D lattice that annihilate on contact. Measure the density decay ρ(t) ~ t^{-1/2} with its amplitude, and contrast it with the mean-field rate-equation t^{-1} law and the 2D logarithmic correction.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Binder-cumulant crossings for three- and four-state Potts models with Wolff clusters
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Use Wolff cluster updates to compute the Binder cumulant of the Potts order parameter for several lattice sizes. Locate T_c from the cumulant crossings and estimate ν, contrasting q=3 with the logarithmic corrections at q=4.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Challa-Landau-Binder energy cumulant for the weakly first-order 3D Potts model
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Use Monte Carlo of the q=3 Potts model on a simple cubic lattice to compute the energy cumulant V_L = 1 - <E^4>/(3<E^2>^2). Show that its minimum scales as 1/L^3 toward a nontrivial limit that signals a first-order transition.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Bond disorder rounding the first-order transition of the q=8 Potts model
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate the q=8 Potts model with binary random couplings and average over disorder samples. Show that the double-peaked energy histograms disappear and estimate the specific-heat and susceptibility scaling of the disorder-induced continuous transition.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Fortuin-Kasteleyn cluster percolation in Swendsen-Wang simulations of Potts models
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Run Swendsen-Wang dynamics for the q=2 and q=3 Potts models. Measure the probability that FK clusters span the lattice and their mean size, and verify that they coincide with the magnetization and susceptibility through the random-cluster mapping.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Four-state clock model as two decoupled Ising models
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate the q=4 clock model with Metropolis updates. Verify that its critical temperature is half of Onsager's Ising value and that its Binder cumulant and energy match those of two independent Ising copies.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Helicity-modulus jump of the 2D XY model
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Use Metropolis and over-relaxation updates of the XY model to compute the helicity modulus Υ(T,L). Estimate T_BKT from the intersection of Υ with 2T/π, including the Weber-Minnhagen finite-size logarithmic fit.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Suzuki-Trotter path-integral Monte Carlo of the transverse-field Ising chain
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Map the TFIM chain onto an anisotropic 2D classical Ising model with M Trotter slices and sample it with Metropolis. Extrapolate the energy and the transverse magnetization to Δτ → 0 and compare them with the Jordan-Wigner free-fermion results.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Quantum Ising chain and quantum criticality

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Stochastic series expansion QMC for the transverse-field Ising chain
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Implement Sandvik's SSE algorithm with diagonal updates and cluster updates for the TFIM. Compute the energy, the expansion-order distribution and the longitudinal susceptibility at finite β, and benchmark them against exact free-fermion values.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Quantum Ising chain and quantum criticality

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Locating the TFIM quantum critical point with QMC Binder cumulants
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Use cluster QMC of the TFIM with β proportional to L (z=1). Compute the Binder cumulant of the longitudinal magnetization across h/J, locate the crossing at h=J and extract ν from the scaling collapse.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Quantum Ising chain and quantum criticality

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Energy gap from imaginary-time correlations in QMC of the TFIM
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Measure the imaginary-time spin autocorrelation C(τ) in path-integral QMC of the TFIM chain. Fit its exponential decay to extract the gap and compare it with the exact 2|h-J| in the paramagnetic and ordered phases.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Quantum Ising chain and quantum criticality

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Variational Monte Carlo of the TFIM with a Jastrow wavefunction
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Sample |ψ|^2 for a two-body Jastrow ansatz in the σ^z basis with Metropolis. Compute the local energy and optimize the Jastrow parameters by stochastic reconfiguration, then compare with the exact ground-state energy across the transition.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Quantum Ising chain and quantum criticality

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Diffusion Monte Carlo ground state of an anharmonic quartic oscillator
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Implement walker-population diffusion Monte Carlo with branching and reference-energy feedback for V = x^2/2 + g x^4. Extract E0 and the ground-state density, then compare them with a finite-difference diagonalization.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Quantum Ising chain and quantum criticality

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Lyapunov exponent of the noisy logistic map and noise-induced chaos
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Iterate the logistic map with additive bounded noise in a periodic window. Average the Lyapunov exponent over noise realizations and find the noise amplitude at which it changes sign.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Invariant density of the logistic map at r=4 from trajectory sampling
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Histogram long orbits started from random initial conditions of the logistic map at r=4. Compare the result with 1/(π√(x(1-x))) in the KL and L1 norms, and verify the Lyapunov exponent ln 2 through the ergodic average.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Viswanath's constant from random Fibonacci recurrences
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Estimate the growth rate of |x_n| for x_{n+1} = x_n ± x_{n-1} with random signs. Compute the top Lyapunov exponent of the random 2x2 matrix product with normalized products and compare it with 1.13198824.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Escape rate from an open logistic map by Monte Carlo survival
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Iterate random initial points under the logistic map with r>4 and record when they leave [0,1]. Fit the exponential survival decay to obtain the escape rate κ and check the relation κ = λ - h_KS on the repeller.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Synchronization of uncoupled chaotic maps by common noise
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Drive two identical logistic or tent maps with the same additive noise. Compute the transverse Lyapunov exponent versus noise strength and identify where synchronization sets in, confirming it with the decay of the trajectory distance.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Phase-space chaotic fraction of the standard map by Lyapunov sampling
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Sample random initial conditions of the standard map and compute finite-time Lyapunov exponents with tangent-map QR renormalization. Classify each orbit as regular or chaotic and estimate the chaotic area fraction versus K near the last-KAM-torus breakup.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: GOE level-spacing statistics and Brody interpolation
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Sample GOE matrices, unfold the spectra with the semicircle cumulative distribution and histogram the nearest-neighbor spacings. Compare with the Wigner surmise, and fit the Brody parameter for a mixture of Poisson and GOE blocks.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Random matrix spectra in disordered systems

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Multifractal eigenstates of power-law random banded matrices
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Sample critical PRBM matrices with b-dependent variance decay. Compute the ensemble-averaged inverse participation ratio as a function of N and extract the fractal dimension D2(b) from its finite-size scaling.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Random matrix spectra in disordered systems

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Spectral form factor ramp and plateau of GUE ensembles
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Average |Σ exp(-iE_n t)|^2 over many GUE samples after unfolding. Compare the disconnected, ramp and plateau regimes with the analytic GUE form factor, and quantify the lack of self-averaging.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Random matrix spectra in disordered systems

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Metropolis sampling of the β-ensemble Coulomb log-gas
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Sample eigenvalue configurations of the β-ensemble with Metropolis moves under logarithmic repulsion and a quadratic confinement. Verify the semicircle density and the β-dependent spacing distribution at non-integer β.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Random matrix spectra in disordered systems

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Adjacency spectra of random regular graphs and the Kesten-McKay law
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Generate random d-regular graphs with the configuration model and diagonalize their adjacency matrices. Compare the spectral density with Kesten-McKay and the second eigenvalue with the Alon-Boppana bound 2√(d-1).
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Random matrix spectra in disordered systems

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Finite-size scaling of square-lattice site percolation with Hoshen-Kopelman
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Label clusters with the Hoshen-Kopelman algorithm and measure the spanning probability R_L(p) over many samples. Estimate p_c ≈ 0.5927 and ν = 4/3 from the shift and width of the spanning curves.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Newman-Ziff union-find algorithm for bond percolation
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Add bonds in random order with union-find and record the microcanonical largest-cluster and spanning observables. Convolve them with binomial weights to obtain canonical curves and verify p_c = 1/2 on the square lattice.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Mass-radius fractal dimension of incipient percolation clusters
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Grow clusters at p_c with a Leath-type epidemic algorithm and measure the mass inside radius r or the radius of gyration versus size. Compare the extracted fractal dimension with D = 91/48.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Invasion percolation with trapping and its fractal dimension
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate invasion percolation on a random-threshold lattice with a priority queue, removing trapped defender regions. Measure the invaded-cluster fractal dimension and the acceptance threshold distribution, then compare with and without trapping.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Continuum percolation threshold of overlapping random disks
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Place Poisson disks in a periodic box, connect overlapping disks with cell lists and union-find, and detect wrapping clusters. Estimate the critical filling factor η_c ≈ 1.128 by finite-size extrapolation.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Directed percolation critical point in the Domany-Kinzel cellular automaton
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Run spreading simulations from a single seed of the Domany-Kinzel automaton. Locate p_c for site directed percolation from power-law survival, and extract the exponents δ and η.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Explosive percolation under the Achlioptas product rule
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Add edges to an Erdős-Rényi-like graph by choosing the lower-product candidate of two random edges with union-find. Measure the transition sharpness and the giant-component jump scaling to test whether the transition is continuous.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Cluster-size distribution exponent on the triangular lattice
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Sample site percolation on the triangular lattice at p_c = 1/2 and histogram the cluster sizes with logarithmic binning. Fit n_s ~ s^{-τ} and check τ = 187/91 together with the scaling-function cutoff at p ≠ p_c.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Vacancy-mediated kinetic Monte Carlo phase separation of a binary alloy
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate an A-B alloy with a single vacancy using residence-time kinetic Monte Carlo and nearest-neighbor bond energies. Compare the coarsening exponent and time rescaling with direct atom-exchange Kawasaki dynamics.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Droplet nucleation rate in the metastable 2D Ising model
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Measure the mean first-passage time to reversal of a magnetized Ising lattice in a small opposing field with Metropolis dynamics. Compare its field dependence with the classical nucleation exponent derived from the critical droplet.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Kinetic roughening of ballistic deposition and KPZ exponents
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate ballistic deposition and restricted solid-on-solid growth on 1D substrates. Measure the interface width W(L,t), extract the growth exponent β = 1/3 and the roughness exponent α = 1/2, and verify the Family-Vicsek collapse.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Finite-size fluctuations of the Kuramoto order parameter
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate Kuramoto ensembles with Gaussian frequencies for several N. Show that r ~ N^{-1/2} in the incoherent phase and fit the finite-size scaling of r and of its susceptibility near K_c.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Kuramoto self-consistency with sampled Lorentzian frequencies
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Draw Lorentzian natural frequencies, integrate the Kuramoto model with RK4 and average over frequency samples. Compare r(K) with the exact r = √(1 - 2γ/K) and with the quenched-disorder fluctuations.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Noise-induced oscillations in Shinomoto-Kuramoto active rotators
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate globally coupled excitable active rotators dθ = (ω - a sin θ + K r sin(ψ-θ))dt + √(2D)dW. Map out the stationary, oscillatory and incoherent phases from the time series of the order parameter.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Kuramoto synchronization on Erdős-Rényi random networks
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Integrate Kuramoto dynamics on sparse random graphs of varying mean degree. Compare the onset coupling with the mean-field estimate K_c = 2<k>/(π g(0)<k^2>) obtained from the heterogeneous degree distribution.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Hysteresis in second-order Kuramoto oscillators with inertia and noise
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Integrate the stochastic second-order Kuramoto model (power-grid swing equations) with adiabatic forward and backward sweeps of K. Measure the width of the r(K) hysteresis loop versus inertia and noise strength.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Ising free energy by TRG versus Monte Carlo thermodynamic integration
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Compute the 2D Ising free energy with Levin-Nave TRG and SVD truncation. Compare it with Metropolis energies integrated over β and with Onsager's exact result, and quantify the bond-dimension and statistical errors.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Three-state Potts thermodynamics from TRG checked against cluster Monte Carlo
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Build the q=3 Potts tensor network and coarse-grain it with TRG to obtain f(β) and, by finite differences, the energy. Validate both against Swendsen-Wang Monte Carlo energies and the exact β_c.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Clock-model magnetization with impurity-tensor TRG and Monte Carlo
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Compute the magnetization of the q=5 clock model with an impurity tensor inserted into TRG coarse-graining. Compare it with Wolff Monte Carlo estimates across the intermediate quasi-ordered phase.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Ising Monte Carlo on random regular graphs versus the Bethe critical point
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate the Ising model on random k-regular graphs with Metropolis or Wolff updates. Locate T_c from Binder cumulants and compare it with the Bethe-lattice condition tanh(βJ) = 1/(k-1).

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Curie-Weiss model magnetization distribution and finite-size Binder scaling
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Run Monte Carlo of the fully connected Ising model with the efficient magnetization-only chain. Compare P(m) with exp(-N f_Landau(m)) and verify the N^{-1/2} finite-size scaling of the Binder cumulant at T_c.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Population-dynamics cavity solution of the Viana-Bray spin glass
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Solve the replica-symmetric cavity equations of the ±J Ising spin glass on a Bethe lattice by stochastic population dynamics. Locate the spin-glass transition from (k-1)<tanh^2(βJ)> = 1 and the Edwards-Anderson order parameter.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Mean-field random-field Ising model: Monte Carlo versus self-consistency
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate the fully connected random-field Ising model with bimodal or Gaussian fields. Compare the disorder-averaged magnetization with the self-consistent solution m = <tanh(β(Jm + h))>_h, including the tricritical point of the bimodal case.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Mean first-passage time from a cubic metastable well: Brownian dynamics versus quadrature
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Overdamped Langevin particles start in the well of U(x)=a x^2/2 - b x^3/3 and are absorbed past the barrier. The simulated MFPT versus noise strength is compared with the exact nested-integral MFPT formula, evaluated with scipy quadrature.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Finite-barrier corrections to the overdamped Kramers rate in a quartic double well
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Euler-Maruyama simulates escape over the barrier of U=x^4/4-x^2/2 for barrier-to-noise ratios from 1 to 8. The ratio of the simulated rate to the Kramers-Smoluchowski formula shows the convergence to Arrhenius behavior and the leading 1/(ΔU/D) correction.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Resonant activation over a dichotomously fluctuating potential barrier
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: An overdamped particle is placed in a potential whose barrier height switches between two values as a telegraph process. The MFPT is computed from Langevin simulation versus the switching rate, showing the minimum of Doering-Gadoua resonant activation, and checked against the static-barrier limits.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Zwanzig effective diffusion in a rough one-dimensional potential
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Brownian particles move in a smooth potential with superimposed small-scale periodic or random roughness. The long-time diffusion coefficient and MFPT across an interval are measured and compared with Zwanzig's D_eff = D/(<e^{βU1}><e^{-βU1}>) prediction.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Committor and splitting probabilities in an overdamped double well
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Langevin trajectories are launched from a grid of initial positions. The probability of reaching the right well before the left is estimated and compared with the analytic committor integral ∫e^{βU}dx, including binomial error bars.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Switching-current distribution of an underdamped Josephson junction (RCSJ model)
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: The noisy RCSJ phase equation in a tilted washboard is integrated under a linear bias-current ramp. The switching-current histogram from simulated phase-slip escape events is compared with the distribution built from Kramers underdamped escape rates.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Transition-path time distribution across a parabolic barrier
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Overdamped trajectories crossing an inverted harmonic barrier between two boundaries are simulated, and only the reactive segments are recorded. Their duration histogram and mean are compared with the Zhang-Jung-Cao/Szabo analytic transition-path time result, which depends only logarithmically on barrier height.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Defect-site condensation in a zero-range process with one slow site
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: A Gillespie simulation is run for a homogeneous-rate ZRP on a ring with one site of reduced hopping rate. Above the critical density a condensate forms on the slow site; the bulk occupation distribution is compared with the factorized geometric measure and the critical density.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Current cumulants of the symmetric exclusion process between particle reservoirs
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: A continuous-time Monte Carlo simulation of the boundary-driven SSEP accumulates the integrated current. Its mean and variance growth rates are compared with the exact Derrida-Douçot-Roche formulas for the first two current cumulants.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Mass condensation in the Majumdar-Krishnamurthy-Barma chipping-aggregation model
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Lattice Monte Carlo is run for mass diffusion/aggregation with single-unit chipping on a ring. The steady-state mass distribution is measured across densities and chipping rates, the power-law tail at the transition is identified, and an infinite aggregate appears beyond it.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Coarsening of condensates in the symmetric zero-range process
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: A ZRP with u(n)=1+b/n and b>2 is quenched from a homogeneous state and simulated with Gillespie. The decay of the number of occupied clusters and the growth of the mean cluster mass are tracked and compared with the predicted t^{1/3} (symmetric) coarsening law.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Kipnis-Marchioro-Presutti heat conduction chain: profile and long-range correlations
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Random energy redistribution between neighbors is simulated with boundary reservoirs at two temperatures. The linear temperature profile, Fourier conductivity and the non-local two-point energy correlation function are measured and checked against the exact KMP results.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Ring TASEP with a single slow bond: current suppression
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: A random-sequential TASEP is simulated on a ring containing one bond of reduced rate r. The stationary current and density profile with its macroscopic shock are measured, and the current is compared with mean-field and finite-segment approximations as r varies.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Localized shocks in TASEP with Langmuir attachment-detachment kinetics
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: An open TASEP with bulk particle attachment and detachment is simulated. The time-averaged density profile is measured, the shock position is located, and the result is compared with the Parmeggiani-Franosch-Frey mean-field hydrodynamic solution.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Absorbing-state transition of the conserved lattice gas (facilitated exclusion)
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: A 1D or 2D conserved lattice gas is simulated, in which particles with an occupied neighbor hop to empty sites. The stationary active-site density is measured versus particle density, the critical density is located, and the order-parameter exponent is estimated.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Condensation in the symmetric inclusion process at weak diffusion
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: The inclusion process (hop rate n_i(d+n_j)) is simulated on a small ring with Gillespie. Its stationary factorized negative-binomial-type measure is verified, and the emergence of condensates with the scaling of condensate number as d→0 is monitored.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Extended-particle TASEP for ribosome traffic: ring current of ℓ-mers
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Particles covering ℓ sites, modelling ribosomes on mRNA, are simulated as a TASEP on a ring. The current-density relation is compared with the exact MacDonald-Gibbs-Pipkin formula, and the maximal current and its density are located.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Finite-time Lyapunov exponent distributions of the Hénon map
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: For many random initial conditions on the Hénon attractor, finite-time largest Lyapunov exponents are computed from QR-orthonormalized tangent products. The variance is shown to decay as 1/T, and the mean is compared with the asymptotic exponent.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Lyapunov spectrum and Kaplan-Yorke dimension of the noisy Lorenz-63 system
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: The Lorenz equations with weak additive noise and their tangent dynamics are integrated with a stochastic Heun scheme. The full Lyapunov spectrum is obtained by repeated QR re-orthonormalization, and the Kaplan-Yorke dimension is computed and compared with the noise-free values.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Gauss continued-fraction map: Monte Carlo Ulam matrix and Lévy's constant
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: A transition matrix for the Gauss map x→{1/x} is built from sampled points (Ulam's method), and its leading eigenvector is compared with the invariant density 1/(ln2(1+x)). The Lyapunov exponent π²/(6 ln²2) is recovered from ergodic trajectory averages.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Grassberger-Procaccia correlation dimension of the Hénon attractor
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Points are sampled on the Hénon attractor, and the correlation integral C(r) is computed with KD-tree pair counting. A scaling region is fitted to estimate D2≈1.22, and the estimate is compared with the Kaplan-Yorke dimension from the Lyapunov exponents.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Lyapunov spectrum density of a diffusively coupled logistic map lattice
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: A coupled map lattice of logistic maps with periodic boundaries is iterated from random initial states. Its full Lyapunov spectrum is computed by QR on the sparse Jacobian, and the extensive spectral density, Kolmogorov-Sinai entropy and its dependence on coupling are studied.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Type-I intermittency laminar lengths in the Pomeau-Manneville map with noise
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: The map x→x+x^z (mod 1) is iterated near tangency with random reinjection and small noise. The laminar-phase length distribution and mean are compared with the ε^{-1/2} scaling, and the noise-induced crossover is examined.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Harmonic oscillator driven by exponentially correlated (OU) noise
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: A damped oscillator forced by OU colored noise is simulated as a three-dimensional linear SDE. The stationary position and velocity variances and the position spectrum are measured and checked against closed forms from the Lyapunov equation and the transfer-function integral.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Active Ornstein-Uhlenbeck particle in a harmonic trap
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: An AOUP in a 2D harmonic trap is simulated with exact OU active forces. The stationary position variance and kurtosis are measured, and the MSD crossover is computed; results are compared with the exact Gaussian solution and its effective-temperature interpretation.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Horsthemke-Lefever noise-induced transition in the multiplicatively driven Verhulst model
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: The logistic growth SDE with multiplicative noise on the growth rate is simulated with a Stratonovich Heun scheme. The stationary histogram is compared with the analytic gamma-like density, and the noise intensity at which the density maximum moves from x>0 to x=0 is located.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: 1/f noise from superposed OU processes with distributed relaxation times
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Many independent OU processes are summed with relaxation rates log-uniformly distributed over decades. The spectral density is estimated, the frequency range of the 1/f regime is determined, and the result is compared with the analytic integral over rate distributions.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Run-and-tumble particle in a harmonic trap: telegraph-noise stationary density
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: A 1D run-and-tumble particle in a harmonic potential is simulated with Gillespie-timed tumbles and exact deterministic motion between them. The stationary position histogram is compared with the exact beta distribution, and the transition from edge-peaked to center-peaked shape is identified.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Maximum-likelihood estimation of Ornstein-Uhlenbeck parameters from discrete samples
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: OU trajectories are sampled at spacing Δ, and the relaxation rate, mean and diffusion are estimated by maximizing the exact AR(1) transition likelihood. Bias and variance are computed over Monte Carlo replicates and compared with the Fisher-information bounds.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Fisher zeros of small three-state Potts lattices from enumerated density of states
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: All 3^N states of 3x3 and 3x4 periodic Potts lattices are enumerated to build the integer-coefficient partition polynomial in e^{βJ}. Its complex-temperature zeros are found with numpy roots, and the specific heat is checked by heat-bath Monte Carlo.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Exact enumeration of small lattice partition functions

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: ±J Ising spin glass ground states: exhaustive search versus simulated annealing
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Ground-state energies and degeneracies of random ±J instances on 4x4 or 5x4 lattices are computed by exhaustive Gray-code enumeration. The success probability of simulated annealing schedules in finding the true ground state is then measured.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Exact enumeration of small lattice partition functions

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Residual entropy of the triangular Ising antiferromagnet: enumeration, Monte Carlo, Wannier
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Ground states of small triangular tori are enumerated to obtain the residual entropy per spin. The result is compared with Monte Carlo thermodynamic integration of the specific heat from infinite temperature and with Wannier's exact 0.3383.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Exact enumeration of small lattice partition functions

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Self-avoiding walk counts by exact enumeration versus Rosenbluth sampling
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Square-lattice SAWs up to n≈20 are enumerated by depth-first search. The counts c_n are compared with Rosenbluth-weighted Monte Carlo estimates, and the connective constant μ≈2.638 is estimated by ratio analysis.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Exact enumeration of small lattice partition functions

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Lee-Yang zeros of the 4x4 Ising model in a magnetic field
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: The joint energy-magnetization density of states of a 4x4 torus is enumerated to form the partition polynomial in z=e^{-2βh}. Its zeros are computed and verified to lie on the unit circle, and the edge gap is tracked versus temperature.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Exact enumeration of small lattice partition functions

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Ground-state entropy of 2D ±J spin glasses by Wang-Landau sampling
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: The density of states of 2D ±J spin glass instances at L≈8-12 is estimated with Wang-Landau. Disorder-averaged ground-state energy and entropy per spin are extracted, together with the low-temperature specific heat.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Wang-Landau density of states of the Baxter-Wu three-spin model
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Wang-Landau sampling is applied to the triangular-lattice Baxter-Wu model with three-spin interactions. Specific heat versus temperature is reconstructed, the exact critical temperature is located, and the α=2/3 specific-heat divergence is checked by finite-size peak scaling.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Wang-Landau for the classical Heisenberg chain versus Fisher's exact solution
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Wang-Landau is run over binned continuous energies of an open classical Heisenberg chain of unit vectors. The canonical internal energy and specific heat are reconstructed and compared with Fisher's exact Langevin-function result.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Adsorption of a lattice polymer on an attractive wall by Wang-Landau
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: The joint density of states in surface contacts is estimated for a self-avoiding walk tethered to an attractive surface. The mean number of adsorbed monomers and its fluctuation versus temperature are computed to locate the adsorption transition.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Vectorial-noise Vicsek model: Binder cumulant signature of a discontinuous transition
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: The Grégoire-Chaté extrinsic (vectorial) noise variant is simulated. The Binder cumulant of the polar order is computed versus noise, and the negative dip and bimodal order histograms at larger sizes are detected as evidence for a first-order transition.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Topological k-nearest-neighbor Vicsek model flocking
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Each particle aligns with its k nearest neighbors, found with a scipy KD-tree on a periodic domain, rather than with all neighbors within a metric radius. The order-noise curves are computed and compared with metric Vicsek, including the absence of density bands.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Giant number fluctuations in the ordered Vicsek phase
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: In the ordered Vicsek phase, particle-number variance is measured in subboxes of increasing size. The anomalous scaling ΔN ∝ N^α with α>1/2 is fitted and compared with the Toner-Tu prediction and with the disordered phase.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Active Ising model: band formation and the liquid-gas flocking transition
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: The lattice active Ising model of Solon-Tailleur, with biased hopping and on-site Ising alignment, is simulated with random-sequential Monte Carlo. Coexistence bands are detected, and the phase diagram in density-temperature space is measured from local magnetization profiles.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Scale-free velocity correlations in Vicsek flocks
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Connected correlation functions of velocity fluctuations about the mean are computed in ordered Vicsek flocks. The correlation length is extracted from the first zero crossing and shown to scale with system size, in the manner of Cavagna's starling analysis.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Couzin zonal model: milling, swarming and polarized collective states
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: The Couzin model with repulsion, orientation and attraction zones, angular noise and limited turning rate is simulated. Polarization and angular-momentum order parameters are computed versus orientation-zone width to map swarm, torus and polarized phases.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Informed individuals steering a Vicsek flock: accuracy versus informed fraction
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: A fraction of Vicsek particles additionally bias their heading toward a preferred direction. The alignment of the group velocity with that direction is measured versus informed fraction, noise and group size, quantifying collective decision accuracy.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Population extinction under randomly switching environmental birth rates
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: A logistic birth-death process whose birth rate switches as a telegraph process between good and bad environments is simulated. The mean extinction time is measured versus switching rate, and the fast- and slow-switching limits are compared with averaged-rate predictions.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Wright-Fisher genetic drift: heterozygosity decay and Kimura fixation times
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Neutral Wright-Fisher binomial resampling is simulated. The heterozygosity decay rate (1-1/2N)^t and the mean fixation time versus initial frequency are measured and compared with Kimura's diffusion result -4N[p ln p+(1-p)ln(1-p)].

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Debye rotational diffusion of a dipole in a field via Legendre spectral method
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: The rotational Smoluchowski equation for a dipole on the sphere is expanded in Legendre polynomials to obtain a tridiagonal relaxation matrix. Polarization relaxation times versus field strength are computed and compared with Brownian rotational-diffusion simulations.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Survival probability with absorbing boundaries: Fokker-Planck eigenmodes versus simulation
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: The Fokker-Planck equation for a particle in a linear or harmonic potential with absorbing walls is solved by eigenfunction expansion. Survival probability and the first-passage time density are compared with Langevin simulations that include a Brownian-bridge crossing correction.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Geometric Brownian motion: Itô versus Stratonovich Fokker-Planck densities
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: GBM is simulated with Euler-Maruyama (Itô) and with Heun (Stratonovich) schemes. The time-dependent lognormal densities are compared with the corresponding Fokker-Planck solutions, isolating the noise-induced drift difference.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Stationary amplitude density of the noisy Stuart-Landau oscillator
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: The Hopf normal form with additive complex noise is simulated. The stationary amplitude distribution is compared with the exact radial Fokker-Planck solution ∝ r exp((μr²/2 - r⁴/4)/D), and the noisy crossover through the bifurcation is tracked.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Flashing ratchet current from Fokker-Planck integration and Langevin simulation
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: A Brownian particle in an asymmetric sawtooth potential that switches on and off periodically is modelled with a time-dependent Smoluchowski equation, integrated over periods on a ring. The mean drift velocity is compared with Langevin ensembles versus flashing period.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Belief propagation marginals of a random-field Ising model on Erdős-Rényi graphs
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Cavity-field BP is iterated to a fixed point for an Ising model with random local fields on a sparse ER graph. Site-by-site BP magnetizations and the Bethe energy are compared with Metropolis estimates on the same instance.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Hard-core lattice gas on random regular graphs: cavity density versus Monte Carlo
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: The replica-symmetric cavity equations for independent sets on d-regular graphs are solved to obtain density and entropy versus fugacity. Grand-canonical Monte Carlo on generated graphs is compared, and the instability of BP at the uniqueness threshold is checked.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Antiferromagnetic Potts coloring of random graphs: BP versus simulated annealing
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: BP is run for the q-state antiferromagnetic Potts model on Erdős-Rényi graphs to estimate energy and entropy. The results are compared with simulated annealing ground-state energies, and the average degree where the paramagnetic BP solution predicts uncolorability is identified.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Monomer-dimer entropy of random graphs from belief propagation and Monte Carlo
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: BP is implemented for weighted matchings on sparse random graphs to get the Bethe free entropy and dimer density versus monomer activity. These are compared with Monte Carlo estimates from a matching Markov chain plus thermodynamic integration.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Minimum vertex cover on Erdős-Rényi graphs: cavity prediction versus annealing
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Warning propagation or the Weigt-Hartmann replica-symmetric cavity solution is used to predict the minimal vertex-cover fraction versus mean degree. This is compared with simulated-annealing results on generated graphs below and above c=e.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Zero-temperature random-field Ising hysteresis on the Bethe lattice
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Single-spin-flip avalanche dynamics are simulated for the zero-temperature RFIM on random regular graphs. The resulting hysteresis loops are compared with the exact Dhar-Shukla-Sethna Bethe-lattice self-consistency, and the critical disorder for jumps is located.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: BP-guided decimation versus WalkSAT for random 3-SAT
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: BP marginals on random 3-SAT factor graphs are used to fix the most-biased variables iteratively. Success probability versus clause density is compared with the WalkSAT stochastic local search, and the solver thresholds are identified.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Community detection in the stochastic block model: BP versus Gibbs sampling
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: The Decelle-Krzakala-Moore-Zdeborová BP is implemented for two-group sparse stochastic block models. Overlap with planted labels versus signal strength is compared with Gibbs-sampling inference, and the Kesten-Stigum detectability threshold is located.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Adiabatic rocking ratchet current in an asymmetric sawtooth potential
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Overdamped Langevin particle in a piecewise-linear asymmetric potential under a slow square-wave or sinusoidal force. Computes the net current against forcing amplitude by Euler-Maruyama and compares it with the adiabatic average of the exact tilted-potential Stratonovich drift formula.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Büttiker-Landauer ratchet with spatially periodic temperature
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Brownian particle in a symmetric cosine potential whose temperature varies periodically in space with a phase shift. Computes the current from Itô-consistent Langevin simulation (including the noise-induced drift term) and checks it against the Landauer stationary Fokker-Planck flux by quadrature.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Correlation ratchet driven by Ornstein-Uhlenbeck noise
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Overdamped particle in a ratchet potential driven by zero-mean exponentially correlated noise (Doering-Horsthemke-Riordan). Computes the current against noise correlation time with exact OU updates and locates the optimal correlation time.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Current reversals of an inertial rocking ratchet
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Underdamped Langevin particle in a two-harmonic ratchet potential with sinusoidal driving (Jung-Kissner-Hänggi). Computes the time-averaged velocity against driving amplitude with a BAOAB-type integrator and identifies sign changes of the current.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Force-velocity curve and efficiency of a Jülicher-Ajdari-Prost two-state motor
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: A motor switches between two periodic potentials with chemically driven, position-dependent rates under an external load. A hybrid Langevin and stochastic-switching simulation gives velocity, ATP consumption rate, stall force and thermodynamic efficiency.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Collective flashing ratchet of exclusion particles on a lattice
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Hard-core particles hop on a ring with an asymmetric sawtooth energy landscape switched on and off stochastically. Random-sequential kinetic Monte Carlo gives the current as a function of density and flashing rate, including the density-induced current reduction.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Entropic rocking ratchet in an asymmetric periodic channel
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Overdamped 2D Brownian particle in a sawtooth-shaped channel with reflecting walls under an alternating force. Computes the rectified current by Langevin simulation and compares it with the Fick-Jacobs effective 1D entropic-potential prediction.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Feedback-controlled flashing ratchet: current versus particle number
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: N overdamped particles in a ratchet potential that is switched on only when the instantaneous mean force is positive (Cao-Dinis-Parrondo). Langevin simulation gives the center-of-mass velocity against N, compared with the open-loop periodic flashing ratchet.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Parrondo's paradox in capital-dependent games as a discrete ratchet
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Two losing coin-tossing games, one depending on capital modulo 3, combined randomly or periodically. Monte Carlo capital trajectories and exact stationary distributions of the mod-3 Markov chain give the winning drift and the parameter region of the paradox.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Kramers-Moyal reconstruction of drift and diffusion from Langevin time series
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Generate a long trajectory of a bistable SDE with state-dependent noise, then estimate the first and second Kramers-Moyal coefficients from binned conditional increments with finite-Δt corrections. Rebuild the stationary density and compare it with the true Fokker-Planck solution.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Bimodal stationary density of Lévy flights in a quartic potential
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Overdamped particle in U=x^4/4 driven by α-stable noise, sampled with the Chambers-Mallows-Stuck method. Stationary histograms for several α are compared with the exact bimodal Cauchy (α=1) solution of the fractional Fokker-Planck equation.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Feller (Cox-Ingersoll-Ross) process: exact transition sampling versus Euler schemes
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: The square-root diffusion dX=κ(θ−X)dt+σ√X dW is sampled exactly from its noncentral chi-square transition density and with truncated or reflected Euler schemes. Compares densities, boundary-hitting frequency against the Feller condition, and weak bias against Δt.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Brownian particle in a logarithmic potential: normalizability transition
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Overdamped diffusion with force −g/x at large x, so the stationary density follows a power law. Fokker-Planck stationary solutions and Langevin histograms show the normalizable-to-non-normalizable transition, with time-dependent moments in the non-normalizable regime.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Short-time propagator path-integral solution of a bistable Fokker-Planck equation
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: The transient density in a quartic double well is evolved by repeated numerical convolution with the Gaussian short-time propagator (Wehner-Wolfer) on a grid. Results are compared with ensemble Langevin histograms and with the slow relaxation rate.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Cayley tree versus Bethe lattice: central-spin Ising response
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Ising ferromagnet on finite Cayley trees with free leaves. Metropolis sampling gives the central-spin magnetization and susceptibility, compared with the exact recursion on the tree and the Bethe-lattice interior critical point, showing boundary dominance.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Curie-Weiss Potts model: first-order transition and metastability
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: q-state Potts model on the complete graph. The mean-field self-consistency is solved for the transition temperature, latent heat and spinodals, and compared with heat-bath Monte Carlo histograms of the order parameter for finite N.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Bethe-Peierls pair approximation for the square-lattice Ising model
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Derive and solve the Bethe-Peierls self-consistency for a central spin with four neighbours, giving T_c=2/ln2 and the magnetization curve. Compares Weiss, Bethe and exact Onsager results with Wolff Monte Carlo magnetization and energy.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Landau free-energy coefficients from 2D Ising magnetization histograms
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Metropolis or Wolff sampling of block magnetization distributions of the square-lattice Ising model above and below T_c. Fitting −ln P(m) to a φ^4 Landau form gives the temperature dependence of the quadratic and quartic coefficients, compared with mean-field expectations.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Critical slowing down of Glauber dynamics on the complete graph
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Kinetic Ising model with all-to-all coupling simulated with Glauber single-spin flips. Relaxation times and magnetization fluctuations are compared with the mean-field rate equation and van Kampen linear-noise theory, including the N^{1/2} critical scaling.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Site-diluted Ising ferromagnet on the Bethe lattice
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Bethe-approximation critical temperature of the diluted Ising model, (k−1)p tanh(βJ)=1, compared with Monte Carlo Binder crossings on diluted random regular graphs. Also identifies the percolation threshold below which order disappears.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Tricritical point of a mean-field Ising metamagnet
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Two-sublattice antiferromagnet with ferromagnetic intra-sublattice coupling in a uniform field. Mean-field equations map the critical line and the tricritical point, compared with Metropolis staggered-magnetization histograms on a square lattice.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Frozen stripe states after zero-temperature quenches of the 2D Ising model
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Zero-temperature Glauber dynamics from random initial conditions on L×L periodic lattices. Monte Carlo gives the probability of reaching the ground state versus a frozen stripe state, with the predicted stripe fraction about 1/3 and the time-to-freeze distribution.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Persistence exponent of 2D Ising zero-temperature coarsening
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Glauber quench from infinite to zero temperature. Tracks the fraction of spins that have never flipped, fits the power-law decay to obtain θ≈0.22, and checks finite-size saturation.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Glauber Ising chain after a quench: exact Bessel-function autocorrelation
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: 1D kinetic Ising chain quenched to zero or finite temperature. Monte Carlo gives the domain-wall density and two-time autocorrelation, compared with Glauber's exact solutions in terms of modified Bessel functions.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Logarithmically slow model A coarsening in a quenched random field
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Stochastic time-dependent Ginzburg-Landau equation in 2D with a frozen Gaussian random field. Structure-factor domain sizes show the crossover from t^{1/2} growth to pinned logarithmic growth as disorder strength increases.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Kibble-Zurek kink density in a finite-rate quench of 1D φ^4
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Overdamped stochastic φ^4 field with the quadratic coefficient ramped linearly through the transition. Counts kinks after the quench across quench times and fits the Kibble-Zurek scaling n~τ_Q^{−1/4}.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Noise-induced wandering of a bistable front in a stochastic reaction-diffusion equation
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: 1D Allen-Cahn/Nagumo SPDE with space-time white noise and a weak bias. Front-position tracking gives mean velocity and front diffusion coefficient, compared with the collective-coordinate (Goldstone-mode projection) prediction.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Voter-model coarsening in two dimensions: logarithmic interface decay
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Surface-tension-free non-conserved ordering in the 2D voter model. Kinetic Monte Carlo of the density of active bonds shows the 1/ln t decay, contrasted with Glauber Ising t^{−1/2} coarsening.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Vortex annihilation in model A coarsening of the 2D XY model
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Overdamped Langevin dynamics of planar rotors quenched from high temperature. Vortex density from plaquette winding numbers is fitted to n_v~ln(t)/t, and the effective growth law is extracted.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Number variance Σ²(L) of GUE versus Poisson spectra
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Sample GUE matrices and Poisson levels, unfold the spectra, and compute the number variance in windows of length L. The logarithmic GUE growth is compared with the exact two-point-kernel formula and the linear Poisson law.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Random matrix spectra in disordered systems

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Ginibre circular law and the count of real eigenvalues
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Sample real and complex Ginibre matrices. Checks the uniform-disk eigenvalue density and the expected number of real eigenvalues of real Ginibre matrices against √(2N/π) with its finite-N correction.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Random matrix spectra in disordered systems

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Heavy-tailed Lévy matrices: Cizeau-Bouchaud density and eigenvector localization
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Symmetric matrices with α-stable entries. Exact diagonalization gives the spectral density, compared with the semicircle and with the cavity population-dynamics density, plus IPR showing localization of large-eigenvalue states.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Random matrix spectra in disordered systems

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Rosenzweig-Porter ensemble: ergodic, fractal and localized phases
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: GOE off-diagonal elements scaled as N^{−γ/2} plus random diagonal disorder. Spacing ratios and IPR scaling exponents against γ identify the transitions at γ=1 and γ=2.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Random matrix spectra in disordered systems

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Porter-Thomas eigenvector statistics in GOE and partially chaotic spectra
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Distributions of squared eigenvector components of GOE matrices and of a crossover ensemble. Compared with the Porter-Thomas χ²₁ law, with deviations quantified by Kolmogorov-Smirnov statistics and fitted degrees of freedom.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Random matrix spectra in disordered systems

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Spectral density of sparse Erdős-Rényi graphs: cavity method versus diagonalization
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Adjacency matrices of ER graphs with mean degree c. The spectral density from population-dynamics solution of the cavity resolvent equations is compared with ED histograms, showing the approach to the semicircle and the central peak from tree components.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Random matrix spectra in disordered systems

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Susceptibility data collapse of the 2D Ising model with Wolff clusters
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Wolff simulations across L and T near T_c. A least-squares collapse of χL^{−γ/ν} against (T−T_c)L^{1/ν}, with bootstrap errors, estimates T_c, ν and γ/ν against the exact values.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Continuously varying exponents of the Ashkin-Teller model on its self-dual line
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Two coupled Ising layers with four-spin coupling K4, simulated with embedded-cluster Monte Carlo. FSS of susceptibility and the polarization operator along the self-dual line gives varying exponents, compared with the exact Baxter formula.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Site-diluted 2D Ising model: T_c(p) from Binder crossings
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Square-lattice Ising with randomly vacant sites and disorder averaging over samples. Binder crossings give T_c(p), and logarithmic corrections in susceptibility scaling are examined at moderate dilution.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Universality of the Ising Binder-cumulant crossing on triangular and honeycomb lattices
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Wolff simulations of the Ising model on triangular and honeycomb lattices with periodic boundaries. The critical Binder value U* and the crossing temperatures are compared with the square lattice and the exact lattice critical points.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Long-range 1D Ising chain: mean-field to non-classical crossover
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Ising chain with couplings 1/r^{1+σ} sampled with Metropolis using Ewald-type summed couplings on a ring. Binder crossings and susceptibility FSS for σ<1/2 and σ>1/2 show the change in the effective exponent ν.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Short-time critical dynamics of the 2D Ising model
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Metropolis evolution at T_c from ordered and from small-magnetization states. Power-law magnetization decay, Binder-cumulant growth and initial-slip exponent θ' give z, β/ν and 1/ν without equilibration.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Family random-deposition-with-relaxation model and EW universality
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Lattice deposition in which particles relax to the lowest neighbouring column. Monte Carlo roughness in 1+1D and 2+1D gives EW exponents, including logarithmic roughness in 2+1D.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Discretized KPZ equation: instability and the Lam-Shin scheme
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Integrate 1D KPZ with the naive gradient-squared discretization and with the Lam-Shin improved scheme. Compares stationary slope distributions with the exact Gaussian measure, blow-up thresholds, and the growth exponent β=1/3.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Polynuclear growth droplet: GUE Tracy-Widom height fluctuations
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Discrete-time PNG model grown from a single seed with Poisson nucleations. The rescaled height distribution at the origin is compared with the GUE Tracy-Widom law via mean, variance, skewness and kurtosis.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Zero-temperature directed polymer in a random medium
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Minimal-energy directed paths on a 2D lattice with random site energies, found by dynamic programming. Energy-fluctuation scaling t^{1/3} and transverse wandering t^{2/3} confirm KPZ exponents.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Surface roughening of on-lattice Eden clusters
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Eden growth in a strip geometry with periodic boundaries, simulated with perimeter-list kinetic Monte Carlo. Interface width scaling and corrections to KPZ exponents are measured for different Eden variants.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Anomalous scaling of the conserved Mullins-Herring growth equation
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Linear fourth-order MBE equation with noise, integrated spectrally in Fourier space. Global versus local width scaling exhibits super-roughness α=3/2, β=3/8 and anomalous local exponents.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Depinning of an elastic interface in quenched disorder (qEW)
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Discretized elastic line driven by force F through a random pinning field. Overdamped dynamics give the critical force, the velocity exponent v~(F−F_c)^β, and the roughness exponent at depinning.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Barrier crossing with position-dependent diffusion coefficient
