physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Overdamped escape over a barrier with D(x) varying across the saddle. Itô Langevin with the spurious-drift term is compared with the exact MFPT double integral, showing how the barrier-top diffusivity controls the rate.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Rouse polymer crossing a barrier: kink-mediated escape
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Bead-spring chain in a double-well external potential, simulated with Brownian dynamics. The escape rate against chain length is compared with the single-bead Kramers rate and the soliton (kink) nucleation theory.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Lévy-noise barrier escape: rate depends on well width, not height
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Overdamped double-well escape driven by α-stable noise. MFPTs from simulation scale as a power of the noise intensity and the barrier width, in contrast to Arrhenius behaviour, and are compared with the Chechkin-Metzler asymptotics.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Dynamic force spectroscopy: rupture-force distributions versus loading rate
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Brownian particle in a cubic well pulled by a linearly ramped force. Langevin rupture-force histograms at several loading rates are fitted with the Dudko-Hummer-Szabo formula to recover the intrinsic rate, barrier height and distance to the transition state.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Escape over a cusp-shaped barrier: piecewise-harmonic Kramers rate
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Overdamped escape over a barrier formed by two intersecting parabolas, where the smooth-saddle Kramers formula fails. Langevin MFPTs are compared with the exact quadrature and the cusp asymptotic rate.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Ising model on Watts-Strogatz small-world networks
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Metropolis or Wolff simulations of Ising spins on rewired rings. T_c(p) is extracted from Binder crossings, revealing the crossover to mean-field behaviour at any finite rewiring probability.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Ising ordering on two-community modular networks
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Ising spins on a stochastic block model with dense intra-community and sparse inter-community links. Monte Carlo maps parallel versus antiparallel ordering of the communities and the two-step ordering against inter-community density, compared with block mean-field theory.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Zero-temperature Glauber freezing on sparse random networks
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Quench of the Ising model to T=0 on ER and random regular graphs. Measures the probability of reaching consensus, the frozen active-link density and the freezing time against mean degree and N.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Majority-vote model critical noise on random graphs
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Nonequilibrium majority-vote spin dynamics with noise q on random regular and ER networks. Binder crossings give q_c, compared with the heterogeneous pair-approximation prediction.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Ising model on the hierarchical diamond lattice: Migdal-Kadanoff exactness
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Recursive diamond hierarchical lattice, where Migdal-Kadanoff decimation is exact. The RG flow gives K_c and ν, compared with Monte Carlo Binder crossings on finite generations.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Fragmentation transition of the coevolving voter model
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Voter dynamics in which discordant links are rewired with probability p instead of an opinion copy. Monte Carlo gives the final active-link density and the critical p_c separating consensus from fragmented networks.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Ferromagnetic Potts model on random regular graphs: first-order transition
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: q=3,4 Potts spins on random regular graphs. Belief-propagation fixed points give spinodals and the discontinuous transition temperature, compared with Monte Carlo hysteresis and energy histograms.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Ising magnetization in a field from TRG free-energy derivatives
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Square-lattice Ising tensor including a magnetic field term, coarse-grained by TRG. Magnetization from finite-difference derivatives of ln Z is compared with Metropolis results and with Yang's spontaneous magnetization as h→0.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Spin-1 Blume-Capel thermodynamics from TRG versus Metropolis
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Construct the three-state tensor of the Blume-Capel model with crystal field Δ and coarse-grain with TRG. Free energy, quadrupole density and specific heat along a Δ cut are benchmarked against Monte Carlo.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Anisotropic Ising critical line from TRG and Monte Carlo
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Square-lattice Ising with unequal couplings J_x≠J_y. Specific-heat peaks from TRG and Binder crossings from Monte Carlo locate the critical line, checked against sinh(2K_x)sinh(2K_y)=1.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Close-packed dimer entropy on the square lattice by TRG
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Tensor network with local dimer constraints contracted by TRG gives the entropy per site, compared with Kasteleyn's G/π. A Monte Carlo pocket or plaquette-flip sampler measures dimer correlations.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Frustrated J1-J2 Ising model on the square lattice: TRG versus Monte Carlo
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Ising model with competing nearest and next-nearest couplings, encoded as a plaquette tensor. TRG free energy and specific heat are compared with Metropolis simulations of the stripe-ordering transition for J2/J1>1/2.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Disorder-averaged free energy of the 2D ±J random-bond Ising model by TRG
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Site-dependent tensors for quenched random-bond realizations are coarse-grained with non-uniform TRG. Disorder-averaged free energy and energy are compared with Metropolis averages over the same samples at several antiferromagnetic bond fractions.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Porod tail and dynamic scaling of the structure factor in Glauber Ising coarsening
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Quench a 2D Ising lattice from T=∞ to T≈0.5Tc and evolve it with single-spin-flip Glauber Monte Carlo. Compute the circularly averaged structure factor S(k,t) by FFT, collapse it with L(t)~t^{1/2}, and verify the Porod k^{-3} large-k tail.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Fisher-Huse autocorrelation exponent λ from two-time aging in Model A
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Run Glauber dynamics after a 2D Ising quench and measure the two-time autocorrelation C(t,t_w) over many independent runs. Collapse it as a function of L(t)/L(t_w) and fit the decay ~(L(t)/L(t_w))^{-λ} to estimate λ≈1.25.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Interface tension from capillary-wave fluctuations in the stochastic Allen-Cahn equation
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Integrate the 2D Allen-Cahn equation with additive thermal noise in a strip that contains one flat interface. Extract the height profile h(x), compute ⟨|h_k|²⟩, and fit T/(σk²) to obtain the stiffness σ, then compare it with the mean-field tension 2√2/3.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Von Neumann n−6 law in zero-temperature q-state Potts grain growth
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate grain coarsening with zero-temperature Metropolis dynamics of a large-q Potts model on a 2D lattice. Identify grains by cluster labelling, track grain areas and neighbor counts, and test dA/dt ∝ (n−6) and mean-area growth ∝ t.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Kolmogorov-Johnson-Mehl-Avrami transformation kinetics from lattice nucleation-and-growth Monte Carlo
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Nucleate stable-phase seeds as a Poisson process on a 2D lattice and grow them at constant interface velocity. Measure the transformed fraction X(t) and extract the Avrami exponent from ln(−ln(1−X)) for continuous and site-saturated nucleation.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Thermal kink density of the stochastic 1D φ^4 chain versus the kink energy
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Integrate the overdamped Langevin equation of a discretized 1D φ^4 field in equilibrium at several temperatures. Count kinks by sign changes with smoothing, and fit the density to n∝T^{-1/2}exp(−E_k/T) with E_k=2√2/3.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Logarithmic kink coarsening of the 1D Allen-Cahn equation versus noise-assisted coarsening
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Evolve the 1D Allen-Cahn equation from random initial data, first deterministically and then with weak noise. Track the mean domain length, showing exponentially slow kink-antikink annihilation (L~ln t) without noise and diffusive growth with noise.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Three-dimensional zero-temperature Glauber quench: sponge states and blinker persistence
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Quench small 3D Ising cubes from random states with zero-temperature Glauber dynamics. Estimate the probability of reaching a ground state, classify frozen or blinking sponge-like final states, and measure how the freezing time scales with L.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Escape rate of a bistable particle driven by Ornstein-Uhlenbeck noise
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate x'=x−x³+η with OU noise of correlation time τ, using exact OU updates combined with a Heun scheme. Measure the mean first-passage times between wells and compare the rate reduction with the small-τ Hänggi-Jung prediction.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Kubo stochastic lineshape: motional narrowing from OU frequency fluctuations
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Generate oscillator phases φ=∫ω(t)dt with ω an OU process and ensemble-average exp(iφ). Fourier transform the result to obtain lineshapes, and compare with Kubo's exact formula across the slow-modulation (Gaussian) and fast-modulation (Lorentzian narrowing) regimes.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Power spectrum of harmonic noise generated by a damped stochastic oscillator
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Generate Schimansky-Geier harmonic noise from an underdamped linear oscillator driven by white noise, using its exact Gaussian propagator. Estimate the peaked spectral density and autocorrelation numerically and compare them with the analytic expressions.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Persistence exponent 1/4 of the random acceleration process
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate x''=ξ(t), which is integrated Brownian motion, with exact Gaussian updates of the joint (x,v) pair. Estimate the survival probability that x stays positive, and fit the t^{-1/4} decay predicted by Sinai and McKean.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Moment stability of an oscillator with OU-modulated stiffness
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate x''+γx'+ω0²(1+εη(t))x=0 with η an OU process. Estimate the sample Lyapunov exponent and the growth rate of the second moment, and locate the stochastic parametric instability threshold against a small-ε perturbative result.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Ising spin scaling dimension from the TRG transfer matrix versus Monte Carlo correlations
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Use the coarse-grained TRG tensor at Tc to build a cylinder transfer matrix and extract the scaling dimensions x_σ=1/8 and x_ε=1. Compare with η estimated from Wolff Monte Carlo spin-spin correlation decay at Tc.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Triangular-lattice Ising ferromagnet thermodynamics by TRG versus Metropolis
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Construct the triangular Ising partition function as a tensor network and compute the free energy and internal energy by TRG. Locate the specific-heat peak near Tc=4/ln3 and compare with Metropolis energies on periodic lattices.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Square-lattice Ising antiferromagnet in a field: TRG phase boundary versus Monte Carlo
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Compute the staggered-field-assisted free energy of the antiferromagnet in a uniform field h with TRG and locate T_N(h) from specific-heat peaks. Compare with Metropolis staggered-magnetization Binder crossings.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: TAP equations versus Monte Carlo local magnetizations in the SK model
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Iterate the Thouless-Anderson-Palmer equations with the Onsager reaction term, using damping, for given SK coupling realizations in a field. Compare the fixed-point magnetizations with long Metropolis averages of ⟨s_i⟩ on the same instances.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: SK ground-state energy by extremal optimization and finite-size extrapolation
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Find low-energy states of Gaussian SK instances with τ-extremal optimization and simulated annealing. Average over disorder for several N and extrapolate e0(N)=e∞+aN^{-2/3} toward the Parisi value −0.7633.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: 3D Gaussian Edwards-Anderson spin glass: overlap Binder crossings via parallel tempering
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate two replicas of small 3D EA Gaussian-coupling lattices with parallel tempering and compute the overlap distribution P(q) and the Binder ratio g(T,L). Estimate T_c≈0.95 from the crossings and check equilibration with the energy-link-overlap identity.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Aging and the growing coherence length in the 3D ±J spin glass
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Quench 3D ±J lattices below T_g and run Metropolis dynamics. Measure the two-time correlations C(t,t_w) and the replica four-point correlation, and fit the growth of the coherence length ξ(t_w)~t_w^{1/z(T)}.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Derrida's random energy model: freezing transition from sampled energy levels
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Sample 2^N Gaussian energies of variance N/2 for many disorder realizations and compute the exact finite-N free energy and participation ratio. Show freezing at T_c=1/(2√ln2) and compare with the large-N analytic free energy.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Nishimori-line gauge identities in the 2D ±J random-bond Ising model
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Run Monte Carlo on 2D ±J lattices at temperatures on the Nishimori line tanh(βJ)=1−2p. Verify that the disorder-averaged energy equals −J(1−2p) exactly and that ⟨s_i⟩ equals ⟨s_i s_j⟩-type gauge-related averages, contrasting with off-line temperatures.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Hopfield network retrieval capacity under zero-temperature Glauber dynamics
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Store P random patterns with Hebbian couplings in N binary neurons and run asynchronous zero-temperature dynamics from corrupted patterns. Measure the final overlap versus α=P/N and locate the retrieval breakdown near α_c≈0.138.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Spherical SK model: Langevin dynamics versus exact semicircle free energy
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate spherically constrained Langevin dynamics with GOE couplings. Compare the equilibrium energy and the condensation onto the top eigenvector below T_c=1 with the exact solution built from the semicircle law and the saddle-point Lagrange multiplier.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Paramagnetic SK spin-glass susceptibility versus 1/(1−β²) with finite-N corrections
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Measure χ_SG=N⟨q²⟩ in the SK paramagnet from two independent Metropolis replicas averaged over disorder. Compare with 1/(1−β²) and with finite-size scaling of the divergence near T_c=1.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Lyapunov spectrum of Froeschlé coupled standard maps by QR reorthonormalization
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Iterate the 4D symplectic coupled standard map with tangent vectors and repeated QR decompositions. Sample initial conditions to obtain the distribution of Lyapunov spectra, verify the pairing λ_i=−λ_{5−i}, and map the chaotic fraction versus coupling.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Mode-locked measure and fractal dimension of the critical sine circle map
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Sample Ω uniformly at K=1, compute rotation numbers by long iteration, and classify parameters as mode-locked or quasiperiodic. Estimate the fractal dimension D≈0.87 of the complement from how the unlocked measure scales with resolution.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Spatiotemporal intermittency in the Chaté-Manneville coupled map lattice
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Iterate a diffusively coupled lattice of Chaté-Manneville maps with an absorbing laminar state. Measure the turbulent fraction and the laminar-domain distributions versus coupling, and locate the directed-percolation-like transition.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Generalized dimensions D_q of the Feigenbaum attractor by box counting
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Locate the period-doubling accumulation point r_∞ and sample long orbits of the logistic map there. Compute the Rényi box-counting dimensions D_q from partition sums and compare D_0 with ≈0.538.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Fractal parameter dependence of deterministic diffusion in a lifted climbing map
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Iterate an ensemble of initial conditions under a piecewise-linear lifted map on the real line. Estimate the diffusion coefficient D(a) from the MSD on a fine parameter grid and expose its fractal, non-monotonic Klages-Dorfman structure.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: OGY control of the Hénon map: capture-time distribution
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Linearize the Hénon map around its saddle fixed point and apply small Ott-Grebogi-Yorke parameter perturbations inside a control window. Sample random initial conditions and measure the exponential capture-time distribution versus the maximum perturbation.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: On-off intermittency in noisy coupled chaotic maps near synchronization
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Couple two chaotic logistic maps near the blowout bifurcation of the synchronized state, optionally with weak noise. Measure the laminar-phase distribution of |x−y| and verify the τ^{-3/2} power law and its noise cutoff.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Phase diffusion of the noisy Rössler oscillator from Poincaré-section returns
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Integrate Rössler equations with additive noise using a stochastic Heun scheme. Define the phase via Poincaré-section crossings, and compute the phase diffusion coefficient and spectral linewidth for phase-coherent and funnel regimes.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Low-dimensional chaotic flows: Lorenz and Rössler systems

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Noise-induced preturbulent chaos in the Lorenz system below r=24.74
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Add weak noise to Lorenz-63 in the parameter range where stable fixed points coexist with a chaotic saddle. Estimate the largest Lyapunov exponent and the residence-time statistics versus noise amplitude to show noise-induced chaos.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Low-dimensional chaotic flows: Lorenz and Rössler systems

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Noise-induced hopping between coexisting periodic attractors of a driven Duffing oscillator
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate a periodically forced, damped Duffing oscillator with white noise in its bistable response regime. Classify orbits by stroboscopic amplitude and measure switching rates versus noise, fitting activation-type dependence.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Low-dimensional chaotic flows: Lorenz and Rössler systems

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Lorenz-63 lobe-switching statistics and symbolic Markov entropy
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Integrate the Lorenz attractor and encode trajectories as L/R lobe sequences. Compute residence-time distributions, estimate block entropies of the symbolic dynamics, and compare with fitted Markov-chain models of increasing order.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Low-dimensional chaotic flows: Lorenz and Rössler systems

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Chaotic scattering in the open Hénon-Heiles potential: escape basins and decay
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Launch an ensemble of trajectories above the escape energy of the Hénon-Heiles Hamiltonian with a symplectic integrator. Map exit-channel basins, measure the escape-time distribution, and estimate the basin-boundary uncertainty exponent.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Low-dimensional chaotic flows: Lorenz and Rössler systems

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Coherence resonance in the excitable FitzHugh-Nagumo model
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Drive the excitable FitzHugh-Nagumo system with white noise and detect spikes. Compute the coefficient of variation of interspike intervals and the spectral peak quality versus noise, locating the optimal coherence.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Low-dimensional chaotic flows: Lorenz and Rössler systems

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Deterministic chaos as Brownian noise: Beck's Lorenz-driven slow variable
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Couple a slow linear variable to the fast Lorenz x(t) with timescale ratio ε. Show that its statistics converge to an OU process, and compare the effective diffusion constant with the Green-Kubo integral of the Lorenz x-autocorrelation.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Low-dimensional chaotic flows: Lorenz and Rössler systems

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Nagel-Schreckenberg traffic model: fundamental diagram and jam formation
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate the parallel-update NaSch cellular automaton on a ring with random braking probability p. Measure the flow-density fundamental diagram and the jam-cluster statistics, and compare the p→0 limit with rule-184 mean-field results.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Second-class particle localizing a shock in two-species TASEP
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate TASEP on a ring of first-class particles with a single second-class particle and step-like density. Measure the drift and diffusion constant of the second-class particle and compare with ρ+−ρ− shock-speed and microscopic shock theory.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: KPZ dynamic exponent z=3/2 from tagged-particle fluctuations in ring TASEP
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Run random-sequential TASEP on large rings at half filling and track tagged-particle displacements. Show subdiffusive t^{2/3} variance growth and system-size saturation consistent with z=3/2.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: TASEP rarefaction fan from step initial conditions versus Burgers hydrodynamics
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Start TASEP from a fully occupied left half and an empty right half. Average density profiles over many runs and compare with the linear rarefaction profile ρ(x/t)=(1−x/t)/2, including the integrated current through the origin.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: TASEP through a junction: one lane splitting into two
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate an open TASEP segment feeding two outgoing lanes at a branch site. Compute densities and currents in each segment, and construct the phase diagram with effective-rate mean-field theory for the junction site.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Spontaneous symmetry breaking in the Evans-Foster-Godrèche-Mukamel bridge model
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate two oppositely moving particle species on a single open lane with symmetric injection and exit rates. Detect symmetry-broken states from the current-asymmetry distribution and measure flip times versus system size.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: TASEP with slowly varying hopping rates: hydrodynamic profiles versus Monte Carlo
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Assign a smooth position-dependent hopping rate p(x) on an open lattice. Solve the mean-field continuity equation for the steady density, including the maximal-current bottleneck, and compare with random-sequential Monte Carlo profiles.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Open TASEP with a finite particle reservoir
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Couple TASEP entry rates to the occupancy of a finite pool that recycles exiting particles. Compute current and lattice density versus total particle number, and compare with mean-field phase diagrams that include shock localization.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Hong-Strogatz conformists and contrarians in the Kuramoto model
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate Kuramoto oscillators where a fraction p has negative coupling. Identify π-states and traveling-wave states from the two subpopulation order parameters, and map the transitions versus p and the coupling ratio.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: First-order synchronization transition for uniformly distributed Kuramoto frequencies
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate Kuramoto oscillators with deterministic or random uniform frequencies. Measure the jump of r at K_c=2/(πg(0)) and its finite-size rounding and hysteresis, then compare with Pazó's analysis.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Time-delayed Kuramoto coupling: multistable synchronized frequencies
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Integrate the delayed Kuramoto model with a history buffer for identical and noisy oscillators. Find the coexisting synchronized frequencies from different initial histories and compare with the Yeung-Strogatz self-consistency Ω=ω−K sin(Ωτ).

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Chimera states in two-population Kuramoto-Sakaguchi oscillators at finite size
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate two populations with strong intra-group and weak inter-group Sakaguchi coupling. Detect the coexistence of a synchronized and a drifting group, and measure the distribution of chimera lifetimes versus N.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Explosive synchronization with frequency-degree correlations on scale-free networks
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Assign ω_i equal to the node degree on Barabási-Albert networks and integrate the Kuramoto dynamics. Sweep the coupling up and down to reveal a hysteretic first-order transition, and compare with uncorrelated frequencies.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Mirollo-Strogatz pulse-coupled oscillators: time to full synchrony
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate integrate-and-fire oscillators with a concave state function and excitatory pulse coupling using event-driven updates. Measure the time to complete synchrony from random phases versus N and coupling strength.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Swarmalators: static and active collective states from sampled initial conditions
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Integrate the O'Keeffe swarmalator model, which couples 2D positions with internal phases. Classify the static async, static phase wave, splintered and active phase-wave states using the S± order parameters.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Kac long-range Ising limit: Monte Carlo approach to mean-field theory
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate a 2D Ising model with uniform coupling J/R² within range R. Measure T_c(R) from Binder crossings and show convergence to the Curie-Weiss value as R grows, including the Ginzburg crossover.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Four-dimensional Ising model at the upper critical dimension: Landau theory and logarithms
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Run Wolff simulations of the 4D hypercubic Ising model for small L. Compare the Binder cumulant at T_c and the susceptibility scaling with mean-field exponents and their multiplicative logarithmic corrections.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Dynamic hysteresis in the kinetic Ising model under an oscillating field
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Drive mean-field and 2D Glauber Ising systems with h0 cos(ωt). Measure the loop area and the period-averaged magnetization Q versus frequency, and locate the dynamic phase transition, comparing with mean-field ODEs.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Vortex-pair density of the 2D XY model and its activation energy
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate the 2D XY model with Metropolis and overrelaxation updates. Count vortices from plaquette winding numbers, and fit the low-temperature density to an activated form to infer the vortex-pair core energy near T_BKT.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Spin-wave exponent η(T) from finite-size magnetization of the 2D XY model
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Use Wolff cluster updates of the XY model at several low temperatures to measure ⟨|m|⟩ versus L. Fit m~L^{-η/2}, compare with η=T/(2πJ), and check η(T_BKT)≈1/4.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Chiral Ising and BKT transitions in the fully frustrated XY model
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate the square-lattice XY model with half a flux quantum per plaquette. Measure the staggered chirality Binder cumulant and the helicity modulus to locate the nearby chiral and BKT transition temperatures.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Lambda transition of the 3D XY model from helicity-modulus crossings
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate the 3D XY model with Wolff updates and compute the helicity modulus Υ. Locate T_c from crossings of LΥ, and estimate ν from the slope scaling to compare with superfluid helium.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Roughening transition of the discrete Gaussian solid-on-solid model
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Metropolis-sample integer heights with Gaussian nearest-neighbor energy. Measure the height-difference correlation and the interface width growth ~ln L, and locate the BKT-type roughening temperature from the universal coefficient 1/π².

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Generalized XY model with nematic coupling: half-vortex nematic phase
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate H=−Δcos θ−(1−Δ)cos 2θ with Metropolis updates. Measure polar and nematic helicity moduli and order parameters to map the polar, nematic and disordered phases versus Δ.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Kinetic Monte Carlo of submonolayer epitaxy: island-density scaling with D/F
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate atom deposition at flux F and adatom hopping D on a square lattice, with irreversible aggregation. Measure the saturation island density and the size distribution, and verify N~(D/F)^{-1/3} from rate-equation theory.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Brownian dynamics of a Rouse chain: normal-mode relaxation times
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate a bead-spring polymer with overdamped Langevin dynamics. Project positions onto Rouse modes, compute their autocorrelation decay rates and the center-of-mass diffusion, and compare with τ_p∝N²/p² theory.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Umbrella sampling with WHAM for a double-well free-energy profile
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Run biased overdamped Langevin windows along a double-well coordinate. Combine the histograms with the WHAM self-consistent equations to reconstruct F(x), and compare the barrier height with the exact potential.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Diffusion-limited aggregation fractal dimension from random-walker growth
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Grow off-lattice or on-lattice DLA clusters by launching random walkers from a launch circle with a kill radius. Measure the radius of gyration versus mass and the mass-radius dimension D≈1.71.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Dielectric breakdown model: fractal dimension versus growth exponent η
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Solve the Laplace equation around the cluster by relaxation, and add perimeter sites with probability ∝|∇φ|^η. Measure the cluster fractal dimension for η from 0 to 2, interpolating between Eden-like and DLA-like growth.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Rock-paper-scissors lattice ecology: spiral waves and the mobility threshold
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate the Reichenbach-Mobilia-Frey cyclic-dominance model with exchange mobility on a 2D lattice. Measure the extinction probability versus mobility and the spiral wavelength from structure factors.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Bak-Tang-Wiesenfeld sandpile: avalanche size and duration distributions
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Drive the 2D abelian sandpile by random grain additions and topple sites with a queue. Collect avalanche size, area and duration distributions, and estimate exponents with finite-size scaling.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Olami-Feder-Christensen earthquake model: Gutenberg-Richter statistics versus conservation
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate the nonconservative OFC coupled-map model with open boundaries. Measure the avalanche size distribution versus the conservation parameter α, and show that the power-law exponent depends on α.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Brownian-bridge correction for discretely monitored Ornstein-Uhlenbeck first-passage times
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate exact OU updates and record when the process first crosses a threshold. Correct for crossings missed between samples using the Brownian-bridge crossing probability, and compare mean first-passage times against the Siegert quadrature formula as the time step varies.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Wong-Zakai limit: multiplicative OU noise converging to Stratonovich calculus
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Integrate dx = a x dt + b x ξ_τ(t) dt with OU noise of correlation time τ. Show that the mean of log x approaches the Stratonovich prediction rather than the Itô prediction as τ→0 at fixed noise intensity.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Barndorff-Nielsen-Shephard gamma-OU process driven by compound Poisson jumps
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate the non-Gaussian OU process whose background driving Lévy process is a compound Poisson process with exponential jumps. Verify the stationary gamma marginal with a KS test, and check the exponential autocorrelation and the jump-induced skewness.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Non-normal two-dimensional OU process: Lyapunov covariance and transient amplification
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Solve the continuous Lyapunov equation for the stationary covariance of a stable OU process with a non-normal drift matrix. Compare it with simulated ensembles, and measure the transient variance growth relative to the normal-matrix case with the same eigenvalues.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Lorenz-96 two-scale model with an AR(1) stochastic parameterization
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate the two-scale Lorenz-96 system and fit the subgrid tendency as a polynomial in the resolved variables plus OU/AR(1) residual noise. Compare the climate PDFs and autocorrelations of the reduced stochastic model with those of the full model.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Low-dimensional chaotic flows: Lorenz and Rössler

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: PERM estimates of the connective constant and γ for 3D self-avoiding walks
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Grow cubic-lattice self-avoiding walks with the pruned-enriched Rosenbluth method to estimate the walk counts c_N. Extract μ and the entropic exponent γ by fitting c_N ~ A μ^N N^(γ-1) with corrections to scaling.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Knotting probability of random equilateral polygons via the Alexander determinant
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Generate random closed equilateral polygons by crankshaft moves and project them onto a plane. Compute |Δ(-1)| from the crossing matrix to detect knots, and fit the unknotting probability to exp(-N/N0).

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Trapping-length distribution of kinetic growth walks on the square lattice
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Grow indefinitely growing self-avoiding walks that choose uniformly among free neighbours until they become trapped. Compute the distribution of trapping lengths, its mean (~71 steps), and the end-to-end scaling before trapping.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Slithering-snake versus pivot algorithm autocorrelation times for lattice SAWs
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Sample square-lattice SAWs with reptation moves and with pivot moves. Compute the integrated autocorrelation times of R_e² in each case, and compare their scaling with chain length N.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Pincus blob scaling of a force-stretched self-avoiding walk from Rosenbluth weights
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Sample cubic-lattice SAWs with Rosenbluth/PERM and reweight them by exp(f x/kT) to obtain the mean extension versus force. Verify the linear regime at small force and the Pincus law x ~ f^(1/ν - 1) at intermediate force.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Electrostatic persistence length of a Debye-Hückel polyelectrolyte chain
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Run Metropolis Monte Carlo on a bead-spring chain with screened Coulomb repulsion and bending stiffness. Extract the persistence length from tangent correlations and compare it with the Odijk-Skolnick-Fixman prediction as the Debye length varies.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Bond-fluctuation-model chain dynamics: Rouse relaxation with excluded volume
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate a single chain in the 3D bond-fluctuation lattice model with random local moves. Measure R_g(N) and the end-to-end vector relaxation time, and test τ ~ N^(1+2ν).

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Gaussian symplectic ensemble spacings from quaternion-real random matrices
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Build GSE matrices as 2N×2N complex representations of quaternion Hermitian matrices and remove the Kramers degeneracy. Compare the unfolded nearest-neighbour spacing histogram with the β=4 Wigner surmise, and the spacing ratios with the Atas formula.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Random matrix spectra in disordered systems

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Kicked-top Floquet quasienergy statistics: Poisson to circular orthogonal ensemble
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Diagonalize the kicked-top Floquet operator within one parity sector for increasing kick strength. Track the mean spacing ratio of the quasienergies, compare it with Haar-sampled COE/CUE references, and locate the integrable-chaotic crossover.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Random matrix spectra in disordered systems

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Pastur equation: spectrum of GOE plus diagonal random disorder
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Solve the self-consistent Pastur equation for the density of H = D + W, where D is random diagonal and W is GOE. Compare the result with histograms from sampled diagonalizations, including the crossover from semicircle to the disorder distribution.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Random matrix spectra in disordered systems

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Microscopic spectral density of the chiral GUE and the Bessel kernel
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Sample chiral Gaussian unitary matrices with topological index ν and rescale the smallest singular values by NΣ. Compare their density and the smallest-eigenvalue distribution with the exact Bessel-kernel formulas.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Random matrix spectra in disordered systems

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Ghost-spin Swendsen-Wang for the Ising model in a magnetic field
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Add a ghost spin coupled to every site with bond probability 1-exp(-2βh), so that Swendsen-Wang clusters can include the field. Validate the magnetization curve m(h) against Metropolis results and against 1D exact results.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Wang-Swendsen-Kotecký algorithm for the zero-temperature critical 3-state antiferromagnetic Potts model
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Implement WSK cluster flips that swap pairs of colours on connected two-colour components of square-lattice 3-colourings. Measure the staggered susceptibility and extract the critical exponent at T=0, comparing with the height-model prediction.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Phase diffusion of the stochastic Brusselator limit cycle versus system size
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate the Brusselator master equation with Gillespie in the oscillatory regime for several volumes Ω. Extract the phase diffusion constant from the decay of the autocorrelation, and verify that it scales as 1/Ω.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Ziff-Gulari-Barshad CO oxidation: kinetic Monte Carlo of surface poisoning transitions
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate CO and O2 adsorption with nearest-neighbour reaction on a square lattice. Locate the continuous O-poisoning and discontinuous CO-poisoning transitions from coverages and the CO2 production rate as the CO fraction y varies.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Ising model on Barabási-Albert networks: logarithmic growth of T_c
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Grow BA preferential-attachment graphs of several sizes and run Metropolis/Glauber Ising simulations on them. Locate T_c(N) from susceptibility peaks or Binder crossings, and compare with the mean-field prediction T_c ≈ (m/2) ln N.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Ising model on annealed uncorrelated networks as an exact test of heterogeneous mean field
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate Ising spins whose couplings are annealed with probability k_i k_j/(N⟨k⟩), using the effective global field. Compare the magnetization and T_c = ⟨k²⟩/⟨k⟩ with the heterogeneous mean-field solution for power-law degree sequences.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Ising criticality on degree-correlated networks from the branching matrix
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Build assortative and disassortative configuration-model graphs with prescribed joint degree distributions. Predict T_c from the largest eigenvalue of the tanh(βJ)-weighted branching matrix, and compare it with Monte Carlo Binder crossings.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Ulam transfer operator of the Lorenz map of successive z-maxima
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Integrate Lorenz-63, collect successive local maxima z_n, and build an Ulam transition matrix from the sampled pairs (z_n, z_{n+1}). Compute the invariant density and the second eigenvalue, which gives the mixing rate, and compare them with long-trajectory histograms.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Low-dimensional chaotic flows: Lorenz and Rössler

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Noisy phase locking of a periodically forced Rössler oscillator
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Drive a phase-coherent Rössler oscillator periodically and add white noise. Compute the Hilbert or arctangent phase, the phase-slip rate and the effective frequency across the Arnold tongue, and show how noise blurs the locking region.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Low-dimensional chaotic flows: Lorenz and Rössler

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Correlation dimension of the Lorenz attractor from noisy delay embeddings
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Delay-embed the Lorenz x(t) signal with added measurement noise and compute Grassberger-Procaccia correlation sums on random pair samples. Estimate D2 ≈ 2.05 and show how noise moves the scaling region and drives the small-r slope toward the embedding dimension.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Low-dimensional chaotic flows: Lorenz and Rössler

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Chiral active Brownian circle swimmers: effective diffusion versus angular velocity
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate 2D ABPs with intrinsic rotation frequency ω. Compare the measured long-time diffusivity and the MSD oscillations with D_eff = D_t + v²D_r/(2(D_r²+ω²)).

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Sedimentation of active colloids: effective temperature and polar ordering
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate ABPs under gravity above a wall and extract the sedimentation length of the exponential tail, which gives the effective temperature. Compare it with D_eff/(μmg) and measure the upward polarization in the dilute tail.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Survival of a one-dimensional run-and-tumble particle near an absorbing wall
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate RTPs with Poisson tumbling starting at distance x0 from an absorbing origin. Compute the survival probability and first-passage density, and verify the universal Sparre-Andersen t^(-1/2) tail and the exact finite-x0 result.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: GKL rule density classification performance versus lattice size
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Run the Gacs-Kurdyumov-Levin rule and the local majority rule on random initial conditions with density near 1/2. Compute the fraction classified correctly as a function of ρ0 and lattice size N.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Spatial block entropy and entropy density of elementary CA from random initial states
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Evolve elementary CAs such as rules 30, 90, 110 and 184 from Bernoulli initial states. Estimate the block-entropy growth H(n) and the entropy density h = lim[H(n+1)-H(n)] versus time, and compare the decay laws across Wolfram classes.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Toom's north-east-center majority rule with noise: robust bistability
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate a probabilistic 2D Toom cellular automaton with asymmetric noise. Show that both ordered phases persist at small noise, unlike symmetric majority voting, and locate the noise threshold from magnetization relaxation times.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Asymptotic density of Conway's Game of Life from random soups
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Evolve Game of Life on large periodic grids from random soups of varying initial density. Measure the decay of live-cell density and activity to the settled ash density (≈0.03), and determine its dependence on the initial density.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: FHP lattice-gas cellular automaton: tagged-particle velocity autocorrelation and diffusion
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Implement the hexagonal FHP-I lattice gas with random collision choices and follow tagged particles through the dynamics. Compute the velocity autocorrelation function, the self-diffusion coefficient and the long-time tail, and compare with the Boltzmann estimate.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: MBAR self-consistent free energies from multiple harmonic-to-anharmonic states
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Sample a series of intermediate potentials interpolating from a harmonic to a quartic oscillator using Metropolis. Solve the MBAR self-consistent equations for the relative free energies and compare them with numerical quadrature and with exponential averaging.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Lee-Kosterlitz free-energy barriers at the first-order Blume-Capel transition
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate the 2D Blume-Capel model on its low-temperature first-order line and reweight the energy histograms to equal peak heights. Show that the free-energy barrier ΔF(L) grows linearly in L, distinguishing it from the continuous segment.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Fisher zeros of the 2D Ising model from reweighted Monte Carlo energy histograms
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Use energy histograms at β_c to evaluate the partition function at complex β by reweighting. Locate the leading Fisher zero for several L, and extract ν from the scaling of its imaginary part as L^(-1/ν).

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Multicanonical Ising interface tension from the magnetization distribution
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Iterate Berg-Neuhaus multicanonical weights in magnetization for the 2D Ising model below T_c to flatten P(M). Compute the Binder interface tension from the peak-to-valley ratio and compare it with Onsager's exact σ(T).

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Fredrickson-Andersen facilitated spin model: persistence and four-point dynamic susceptibility
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate the 1-spin-facilitated FA model on a square lattice with continuous-time Monte Carlo. Compute the persistence function and the χ4(t) peak, and show how the peak grows as temperature is lowered.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: East model super-Arrhenius relaxation time from continuous-time Monte Carlo
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Run the 1D East kinetically constrained model with a rejection-free (BKL) algorithm. Extract relaxation times from the spin autocorrelation and fit them to the EITS form exp(c/T²).

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Kob-Andersen kinetically constrained lattice gas: tracer diffusion versus density
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate the 2D Kob-Andersen model, where a particle hops only if it keeps few occupied neighbours. Measure the tracer mean-squared displacement and the self-diffusion constant D(ρ) as it decays at high density.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Newman-Moore triangular plaquette model: glassy relaxation without thermodynamic transition
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Run Metropolis on the triangular plaquette model with three-spin interactions. Measure the energy autocorrelation time versus temperature and compare with the defect-dual free-energy prediction and the parabolic super-Arrhenius law.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Random organization model under periodic shear: absorbing-state transition density
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Use Corté-Pine random organization: overlapping disks after a shear cycle receive random kicks. Locate the critical density where the active fraction vanishes and estimate the order-parameter exponent.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Random sequential adsorption of disks: jamming coverage and Feder's law
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Perform RSA of equal disks in a periodic square using a grid neighbour list. Estimate the jamming coverage (~0.547) by extrapolating the t^(-1/2) approach to saturation.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Schlögl model bistability: switching times from SSA versus master-equation MFPT
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate the Schlögl autocatalytic network with the Gillespie SSA in its bistable regime. Compare mean switching times with exact birth-death first-passage sums from the one-step master equation.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Genetic toggle switch: finite state projection versus Gillespie bimodal distributions
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Truncate the two-protein mutual-repression master equation and solve for the stationary distribution with a sparse null-space computation. Validate the bimodal histogram and switching rate against SSA trajectories.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Number partitioning problem: density of states via Wang-Landau
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Apply Wang-Landau to the energy |Σ s_i a_i| of random partitioning instances. Compare g(E) and the ground-state degeneracy with exhaustive enumeration and Mertens' random-energy prediction.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Early warning signals near a noisy saddle-node in May's grazing model
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Integrate the stochastic grazing ODE while slowly approaching the fold. Measure the rising variance and lag-1 autocorrelation and compare with the linearized OU prediction from the Jacobian eigenvalue.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Bifurcation delay in a slowly swept noisy pitchfork normal form
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Sweep the parameter of dx = (μ(t)x - x³)dt + σ dW linearly through zero. Measure the jump-time distribution and compare with the noise-limited delay ~ sqrt(2ε ln(1/σ)).

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: 2D lattice Coulomb gas: vortex unbinding and dielectric constant
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Use Monte Carlo moves of integer charges interacting via the lattice Green's function. Compute the dielectric response 1/ε from charge-density fluctuations and locate the KT unbinding temperature.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Single-step growth model from flat substrate: GOE Tracy-Widom height fluctuations
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate the corner-growth/single-step model with a flat initial condition. Show the t^(1/3) scaling and compare skewness and kurtosis of rescaled heights with GOE Tracy-Widom values.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Das Sarma-Tamborenea molecular-beam epitaxy model: anomalous kinetic roughening
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate DT deposition with local diffusion toward kinks in 1+1D. Measure global and local widths, showing anomalous scaling and its distinct global and local roughness exponents.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Finite-temperature directed polymer in random medium: free-energy fluctuation exponent
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Compute the point-to-point partition function with the transfer-matrix recursion over random energies. Measure free-energy variance growth (exponent 2/3) and the temperature-dependent crossover length.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Finite-temperature Hopfield retrieval: Amit-Gutfreund-Sompolinsky overlap at low loading
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Run Metropolis on a Hebbian network with p patterns. Compare equilibrium retrieval overlap versus temperature with the mean-field m = tanh(βm) solution and its α corrections.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Spurious symmetric mixture states in the Hopfield model at finite temperature
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Initialize Glauber dynamics in three-pattern mixture states. Measure their overlap and stability versus temperature and compare with the mean-field threshold T≈0.46.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Strongly diluted asymmetric Hopfield network: Derrida-Gardner-Zippelius storage capacity
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Build randomly diluted Hebbian couplings and iterate parallel dynamics. Measure overlap versus load and compare with the exact DGZ recursion and capacity α_c = 2/π.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Temporal sequence retrieval with asymmetric Hebbian couplings
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Combine symmetric and forward-asymmetric (Sompolinsky-Kanter) couplings with noisy stochastic dynamics. Measure sequence-transition times and the critical asymmetry needed for ordered recall.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Inverse Ising problem: pseudo-likelihood coupling reconstruction from Metropolis samples
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Generate samples from a sparse random Ising model by Metropolis. Infer couplings by pseudo-likelihood maximization and compare reconstruction error against naive mean-field inversion.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Classical 3D Heisenberg ferromagnet: Wolff embedding and finite-size scaling
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Apply Wolff reflection clusters to O(3) spins on cubic lattices. Locate T_c from Binder crossings and extract ν and γ/ν by susceptibility scaling.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Three-dimensional Z2 lattice gauge theory: confinement transition by Metropolis
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate Wegner's Ising gauge theory on cubic lattices. Locate the transition from plaquette energy and specific heat, and use duality with the 3D Ising model as a check.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet: order by disorder toward coplanar states
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Run Metropolis with overrelaxation on classical kagome Heisenberg spins. Measure coplanarity order parameter growth at low T and the specific-heat value C = 11/12 from soft modes.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: F1-ATPase rotary motor: Langevin bead rotation and stall torque
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate a viscously loaded rotor in a 120°-periodic potential switched by stochastic ATP binding. Compute rotation rate versus ATP concentration and load torque.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Widom-Rowlinson lattice mixture: demixing transition by Monte Carlo
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate two species excluding unlike neighbours with grand-canonical cluster or Metropolis updates. Locate the critical fugacity from Binder cumulants of the composition order parameter.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Six-vertex F model: loop-algorithm Monte Carlo and KT antiferroelectric transition
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Sample ice-rule vertices with loop updates (Evertz). Measure staggered polarization and compare free energy with the exact Lieb solution near the infinite-order transition.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Lattice Gō protein folding: multiple-histogram heat capacity and folding temperature
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate a native-contact lattice protein at several temperatures. Combine histograms by Ferrenberg-Swendsen iteration to obtain continuous heat capacity and native-contact free-energy profiles.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Two-temperature Ising model: anisotropic nonequilibrium correlations
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate Kawasaki exchanges with direction-dependent temperatures. Measure the anisotropic structure factor and the shift of the ordering transition from the equilibrium value.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Competing Glauber and Kawasaki dynamics: nonequilibrium steady-state phase diagram
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Mix spin-flip at temperature T with infinite-temperature exchange in an Ising lattice. Map the ferromagnetic transition and the Droz-Rácz self-organized antiferromagnetic phase.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Evans-Kafri-Koduvely-Mukamel ABC model: driven phase separation on a ring
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate three-species cyclic exchanges with asymmetry q. Measure phase-separated density profiles and the transition to the disordered state at equal densities.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Determinant QMC of the half-filled Hubbard ring: double occupancy
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Implement Blankenbecler-Scalapino-Sugar DQMC with Hirsch discrete HS fields. Compute energy and double occupancy versus U and compare with exact diagonalization.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Ermak-McCammon Brownian dynamics with Rotne-Prager hydrodynamic interactions
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate sedimenting spheres with configuration-dependent mobility and correlated noise from Cholesky. Measure pair sedimentation velocities and their deviation from Stokes.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Fractional Brownian motion via Davies-Harte: first-passage persistence exponent
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Generate fBm paths with circulant embedding. Measure survival above origin and compare with persistence exponent 1 - H.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Loop-erased random walk fractal dimension in two dimensions
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Generate LERWs by chronological loop erasure on the square lattice. Measure length versus radius and compare with exact dimension 5/4.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Worm-like chain cyclization J-factor by Monte Carlo
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Sample discrete WLC conformations and estimate end-to-end closure probability. Compute J-factor versus length and compare with Shimada-Yamakawa approximation.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Restricted primitive model electrolyte: Monte Carlo osmotic coefficient versus Debye-Hückel
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate charged hard spheres with Ewald summation. Compute excess energy and osmotic coefficient versus concentration and compare with Debye-Hückel/MSA theory.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Random Euclidean TSP: annealing estimate of Beardwood-Halton-Hammersley constant
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Apply simulated annealing to random point TSP instances. Extract tour-length scaling and estimate BHH constant ≈0.7124.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Exact Metropolis and heat-bath transition matrices of a 3x3 Ising lattice: spectral gaps
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Enumerate all 512 states of a periodic 3x3 Ising model and build the full single-spin-flip Metropolis and heat-bath (Glauber) transition matrices. Compute the exact stationary distribution, the spectral gap and the exact integrated autocorrelation time of the energy and |M| versus temperature, then compare with autocorrelation estimates from simulated chains.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Exact enumeration of small lattice partition functions

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Creutz demon microcanonical Ising simulation benchmarked against the exact 4x4 density of states
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Run Creutz's demon algorithm on a 4x4 periodic Ising lattice at fixed total energy. Infer the temperature from the exponential demon-energy distribution and compare it with the microcanonical temperature from the exactly enumerated density of states g(E) of all 2^16 configurations.
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.area: Exact enumeration of small lattice partition functions

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Oslo ricepile model: avalanche-size finite-size scaling and mean transit time
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate the 1D Oslo model with random thresholds driven at the boundary. Measure the avalanche-size distribution for several system sizes, extract tau and D by moment analysis and data collapse, and verify that the mean height and the average avalanche size scale linearly with L.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Bak-Sneppen evolution model: self-organized fitness threshold and avalanche distribution
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate the 1D Bak-Sneppen model by repeatedly replacing the minimum-fitness site and its neighbours. Estimate the self-organized threshold f_c≈0.667 from the stationary fitness distribution, and estimate the f0-avalanche size exponent and the first-return time distribution.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Dhar-Ramaswamy directed abelian sandpile: exact avalanche exponents versus simulation
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate the 2D directed sandpile, where toppling sends grains to the downstream row, on cylinders of varying width. Measure the avalanche size and duration distributions, and compare the fitted exponents tau=4/3 and tau_t=3/2 with Dhar-Ramaswamy's exact random-walk mapping.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: One-dimensional power-law Kotliar-Anderson-Stein spin glass: correlation-length crossings via parallel tempering
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate the 1D Ising spin glass with Gaussian couplings decaying as r^-sigma, using parallel tempering on rings of several lengths. Compute the overlap Binder ratio and the finite-size correlation length xi_L/L, and locate T_c from crossings in the non-mean-field sigma regime.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Stochastic resonance in the Glauber-Ising chain under a weak oscillating field
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate the kinetic Ising chain with Glauber rates and a weak periodic field. Compute the magnetization power spectrum and the SNR versus temperature, and compare the resonance peak with the exact linear-response susceptibility of Glauber dynamics (Brey-Prados).

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Diffusion-limited cluster-cluster aggregation: fractal dimension of 2D colloidal gels
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate lattice DLCA, in which all clusters perform random walks with size-dependent mobility and stick irreversibly on contact. Measure the radius-of-gyration mass scaling and the box-counting dimension (D≈1.45) and the cluster-size distribution scaling in time.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Branching annihilating random walks with two offspring: parity-conserving absorbing transition
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate 1D BARW with A→3A branching and A+A→0 annihilation using kinetic Monte Carlo. Locate the critical diffusion/branching ratio from spreading experiments started from two particles, and estimate the parity-conserving class exponents for survival probability and particle number.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Nearest-neighbour exclusion lattice gas on the simple cubic lattice: sublattice ordering fugacity
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Perform grand-canonical Metropolis insertion and deletion Monte Carlo of hard-core particles that exclude nearest neighbours on the simple cubic lattice. Measure the staggered density order parameter, its Binder cumulant and the density, and locate the critical fugacity (≈1.06).

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Rényi car-parking problem: random sequential adsorption of unit segments on a line
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate continuum 1D random sequential adsorption of unit intervals and estimate the jamming coverage to compare with Rényi's constant 0.7476. Also compute the gap distribution and the algebraic approach to jamming, using event-driven insertion restricted to available gaps.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Chaperone-assisted translocation ratchet: polymer import velocity versus chaperone binding kinetics
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Use Gillespie simulation of a polymer diffusing through a pore, where chaperones bind and unbind the translocated segment and block backward steps. Compute the mean translocation velocity versus the binding equilibrium constant and compare with the Simon-Peskin-Oster ratchet formulas.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Population annealing Monte Carlo free energy of the 2D Ising model versus Kaufman
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Implement population annealing with resampling and Metropolis sweeps for the periodic 2D Ising model. Accumulate the free-energy estimator from the normalization factors and compare with Kaufman's exact finite-lattice partition function, along with the family-size diagnostics.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Axelrod culture-dissemination model: fragmentation transition versus number of trait values q
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate the Axelrod model on a square lattice with F features and q traits per feature using random sequential interactions until an absorbing state is reached. Compute the relative size of the largest cultural region versus q for several L and locate the ordered-fragmented transition.

physics/stat_phys|stochastic.title: Deffuant bounded-confidence opinion dynamics: number of opinion clusters versus confidence threshold
physics/stat_phys|stochastic.gist: Simulate pairwise compromise dynamics with confidence bound epsilon and convergence parameter mu for N agents with uniform initial opinions. Count the final opinion clusters and their sizes versus epsilon, and compare with the approximate 1/(2 epsilon) rule and the consensus threshold epsilon≈0.5.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: PIMC thermal energy of a quartic anharmonic oscillator versus a Numerov spectral sum
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Run primitive-action path-integral Monte Carlo for V=x^2/2+λx^4 to get the thermal energy from the virial estimator. Compare it with ⟨E⟩(T) built from the lowest levels, which are found by Numerov shooting with bisection on the energy.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Path-integral Monte Carlo at finite temperature

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Imaginary-time Bloch equation for the oscillator density matrix and Trotter error
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate the Bloch equation ∂ρ/∂β=-Hρ by method of lines with RK4 to obtain the harmonic thermal density matrix. Compare with the Mehler kernel, then measure the primitive Trotter-factorization error versus imaginary time step.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Path-integral Monte Carlo at finite temperature

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Exact hard-sphere pair density matrix from Numerov partial waves versus primitive approximation
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Build the relative-coordinate pair density matrix of two hard spheres from a partial-wave sum of radial box eigenstates computed by Numerov. Quantify the error of the primitive pair action as a function of β.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Path-integral Monte Carlo at finite temperature

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Thermal position variance in a Pöschl–Teller well: path integral versus eigenstate sum
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Use PIMC to sample ⟨x^2⟩_β for V=-V0 sech^2(x). Compare with a Boltzmann-weighted sum over bound states from Numerov shooting plus a box-discretized continuum, both obtained from the same radial ODE solver.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Path-integral Monte Carlo at finite temperature

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Gaussian well scattering: Born form factor versus numerically exact cross sections
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute the Gaussian Fourier-transform Born amplitude and the corresponding total cross section versus k. Compare with phase shifts from radial RK45 integration matched to Riccati–Bessel functions, for weak and strong wells.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Electron scattering from a Molière-screened Coulomb atom: Born versus partial waves
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Evaluate the Born amplitude of the three-exponential Molière screening potential analytically. Compare differential cross sections with exact Numerov phase-shift sums, using many partial waves at keV energies.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Breakdown of the Born approximation for an attractive square well
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compare the first Born amplitude for a spherical square well with exact phase shifts from radial integration as depth increases. Show that Born fails near the threshold where the first bound state appears.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Scattering length of an exponential potential: exact zero-energy ODE versus Born
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate the zero-energy radial equation for V=-V0 e^{-r/a} to obtain the s-wave scattering length. Compare with the Born estimate and with the analytic Bessel-function result as functions of strength.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Momentum-transfer cross section in a Debye-screened plasma: Born versus phase shifts
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute the transport cross section σ_tr=(4π/k^2)Σ(l+1)sin^2(δ_l-δ_{l+1}) for electron–ion Debye–Hückel scattering using Numerov phase shifts. Compare with the Born-approximation transport cross section and a Coulomb-logarithm estimate.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Matrix-Numerov versus three-point finite differences for anharmonic oscillator eigenvalues
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Build sparse second-order three-point and fourth-order matrix-Numerov generalized eigenproblems for V=x^2/2+x^4. Measure eigenvalue error versus h and apply Richardson extrapolation.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Chebyshev collocation for the quantum bouncer and Airy-zero spectrum
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve -ψ''/2+gx ψ=Eψ on [0,L] with ψ(0)=0 using Chebyshev spectral collocation. Compare the energies with scaled Airy zeros and study spectral convergence.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Charmonium spectrum in the Cornell funnel potential on a Lagrange mesh
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Use a Lagrange–Laguerre mesh to solve the radial Schrödinger equation with V=-4αs/(3r)+σr for S and P states. Compute 1S–2S and 1S–1P splittings and the wavefunction at the origin.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Number of bound levels of an argon dimer Lennard-Jones well via DVR
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Diagonalize a sinc-DVR radial Hamiltonian for Ar2 with Lennard-Jones parameters to count the vibrational levels for J=0 and J>0. Compare with the semiclassical count from the phase integral.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Critical Debye screening length for hydrogenic bound states in a plasma
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Use Numerov shooting to find the bound levels of V=-e^{-r/λD}/r for several (n,l). Locate by root finding the critical λD at which each state merges into the continuum.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: High-harmonic spectrum of a 1D soft-Coulomb atom and the cutoff law
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Propagate the length-gauge TDSE with a Crank–Nicolson scheme and absorbing mask in an 800 nm pulse. Compute the dipole acceleration via Ehrenfest, take its windowed spectrum, and compare the cutoff with Ip+3.17Up.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Classical three-step model: return energies of field-driven electron trajectories
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate Newton's equations for electrons born at rest at each ionization phase in a cosine field. Find return times and kinetic energies, and recover the 3.17Up maximum along with the short and long branches.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Even harmonics from two-color ω+2ω driving of a 1D soft-Coulomb atom
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Propagate the TDSE with Crank–Nicolson in a two-color field with variable relative phase. Compute the dipole-acceleration spectrum and measure even-to-odd harmonic intensity ratios versus phase.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Above-threshold ionization photoelectron spectrum via the window operator
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: After Crank–Nicolson propagation of a soft-Coulomb atom in an intense pulse, apply Schafer's window operator, solving (H-E)^n linear systems, to extract the electron energy spectrum. Identify the ATI peak spacing ħω and the 2Up/10Up features.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Gabor time-frequency analysis of harmonic emission times versus classical trajectories
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Apply a Gabor transform to the TDSE dipole acceleration of a 1D soft-Coulomb atom. Extract the emission times of each harmonic and compare with the short- and long-trajectory return times from Newtonian integration.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Essential-states model versus full grid TDSE for multiphoton Rabi dynamics
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute soft-Coulomb eigenstates and dipole matrix elements, then integrate a truncated few-level Schrödinger ODE with RK45 under resonant driving. Compare the level populations with full-grid Crank–Nicolson propagation.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: H–Kr Lennard-Jones phase shifts, orbiting resonances and total cross section
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate the radial equation with Numerov for many l in a Lennard-Jones potential, as in Bernstein's H–Kr problem. Match to spherical Bessel functions, then sum the total cross section versus energy to locate orbiting resonance peaks.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Shape resonance in a barrier-plus-well potential with a Breit–Wigner fit
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: For V=-V0 inside r<a plus a Gaussian barrier, compute the l=1 or l=2 phase shift with Numerov on a fine energy grid. Fit the resonance position and width with a Breit–Wigner formula.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Alpha–alpha nuclear phase shifts with Coulomb matching from integrated Coulomb waves
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate the radial equation with Woods–Saxon plus Coulomb potentials. Obtain regular and irregular Coulomb functions by integrating the pure-Coulomb ODE inward from asymptotic expansions, then match to extract the nuclear phase shifts.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Ramsauer–Townsend minimum in low-energy electron–argon model-potential scattering
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Use a polarization-plus-static model potential and compute the s- and p-wave phase shifts with Numerov. Locate the cross-section minimum where δ_0 passes through π.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Neutron reaction cross section from a complex Woods–Saxon optical potential
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate the complex radial equation for an optical potential with imaginary absorption. Compute the S-matrix elements |S_l|<1, then the elastic, reaction and total cross sections versus energy.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Symmetrized He-4–He-4 differential cross section using even partial waves
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute phase shifts for a Lennard-Jones-like He–He potential via Numerov. Build the boson-symmetrized amplitude f(θ)+f(π-θ) with only even l, and show the interference oscillations versus distinguishable particles.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Wigner time delay near a potential resonance from phase-shift energy derivatives
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute δ_l(E) finely with Numerov for a well-plus-barrier model and evaluate τ=2ħ dδ/dE. Verify that the peak time delay matches the inverse resonance width.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Loschmidt echo decay in the kicked rotor under kick-strength perturbation
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute the fidelity |⟨ψ_K(t)|ψ_{K+δK}(t)⟩|^2 by propagating two kicked-rotor Floquet maps. Identify the perturbative Gaussian and Fermi-golden-rule exponential decay regimes.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Phase error and second-order convergence of Crank–Nicolson for a coherent state
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Propagate a displaced oscillator ground state with Crank–Nicolson for many periods. Verify norm conservation to machine precision, measure the phase error of ⟨x⟩(t) versus dt, and confirm O(dt^2) scaling.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Padé [2/2] time stepping versus Crank–Nicolson for anharmonic dynamics
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Implement the fourth-order Padé propagator, a product of two tridiagonal Cayley-like factors, alongside Crank–Nicolson. Compare global wavefunction error versus dt for a quartic-oscillator packet.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Quasienergy crossings in the driven quartic double well
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Expand the double-well Hamiltonian in its lowest eigenstates, add a periodic dipole drive, and integrate the monodromy matrix over one period. Map the quasienergy spectrum and locate CDT points versus field strength.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Dynamical localization in an ac-driven tight-binding chain and effective hopping
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate the Floquet operator of a finite tight-binding chain with a cosine-driven tilt. Compare quasienergy bandwidths and packet spreading with the renormalized hopping J·J0(F/ω).

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Quantum Kapitza pendulum: high-frequency effective Hamiltonian versus exact Floquet
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Build the exact Floquet quasienergies of a rotor with a rapidly oscillating gravity term by period integration in an angular-momentum basis. Compare with the Kapitza effective potential from the Magnus expansion.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Imaginary-time Crank–Nicolson with Gram–Schmidt for anharmonic excited states
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Relax several trial functions in imaginary time with Crank–Nicolson, orthogonalizing them by Gram–Schmidt at each step, for V=x^2/2+λx^4. Obtain the four lowest energies and compare with matrix-Numerov values.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Bright soliton of the attractive 1D Gross–Pitaevskii equation by imaginary time
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Use normalized imaginary-time propagation for the 1D focusing nonlinear Schrödinger equation with weak harmonic confinement. Compare the converged profile and chemical potential with the analytic sech soliton.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Yamaguchi separable potential: analytic versus quadrature T-matrix and deuteron
