physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the momentum-space Lippmann–Schwinger equation for a rank-1 Yamaguchi potential using Gauss–Legendre quadrature with principal-value subtraction. Compare phase shifts and deuteron binding with closed-form results.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Malfliet–Tjon s-wave phase shifts: momentum-space LS versus coordinate Numerov
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Discretize the K-matrix Lippmann–Schwinger equation for the Malfliet–Tjon local potential using its partial-wave momentum-space form. Compare phase shifts with those from radial Numerov integration.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: K-matrix with principal-value subtraction versus complex-energy T-matrix
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the LS equation for a Gaussian potential both with Haftel–Tabakin principal-value subtraction and at E+iε with ε extrapolated to zero. Compare on-shell phase shifts and their convergence with mesh size.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Resonance pole search for a rank-2 separable potential in the complex k plane
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Analytically continue the separable T-matrix denominator and locate resonance poles by complex Newton iteration. Compare the pole positions with Breit–Wigner fits to real-energy phase shifts.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: 1D Lippmann–Schwinger transmission for a Gaussian barrier versus direct integration
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the 1D momentum-space LS equation with even/odd channel decomposition for a Gaussian potential. Compare the transmission probability with Numerov integration of the stationary equation.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Bohr–Sommerfeld versus Numerov eigenvalues for the Pöschl–Teller well
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute semiclassical levels from the action integral with Langer-type corrections and exact levels by Numerov shooting for V=-V0 sech^2(x). Analyze the errors versus quantum number and well depth.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: H2+ Born–Oppenheimer curve from separated spheroidal ODE eigenproblems
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the angular and radial spheroidal equations of H2+ as coupled eigenvalue problems, using shooting for the separation constant and energy. Compute the 1σg potential curve and equilibrium bond length.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Quantum defects of sodium Rydberg states from a parametric model potential
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Use Numerov shooting with a core-polarization model potential for Na to find ns, np and nd energies up to high n. Extract the quantum defects and compare with spectroscopic values.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Sodium 3p spin-orbit constant from a model-potential Numerov orbital
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the radial Schrödinger equation for the Na 3p valence electron in a parametric core potential by Numerov shooting. Evaluate ζ = (α²/2)⟨(1/r)dV/dr⟩ and compare the predicted D1–D2 splitting with experiment.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Breit–Rabi diagram of hydrogen 1s and 2s from numerical contact densities
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Obtain |ψ(0)|² for the 1s and 2s states from radial ODE solutions, verify the 1/8 hyperfine ratio, and evaluate the Breit–Rabi energies of both ground-state hyperfine manifolds versus magnetic field.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Hanle effect line shape from optical Bloch equations of a J=0→1 transition
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate the density-matrix equations for a four-level atom driven by linearly polarized light in a transverse magnetic field until steady state. Fit the fluorescence versus B to a Lorentzian whose width gives the excited-state lifetime times g_J.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Zeeman quantum beats after pulsed excitation and g-factor extraction
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate the Liouville equation with spontaneous decay for a coherently excited Zeeman multiplet in a static field. Fourier-analyze the polarization-resolved fluorescence to recover the Larmor frequency and the Landé g_J.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Single-electron levels of a Gaussian quantum dot in a perpendicular magnetic field
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the 2D radial equation with the diamagnetic term for each m by shooting, add orbital and spin Zeeman terms, and map level crossings versus B. Compare the spectrum with the Fock–Darwin limit of the parabolic dot.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Bound-electron g-factor of hydrogen-like ions from Dirac radial functions
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the radial Dirac equation for the 1s1/2 state, compute the magnetic integral ∫ f g r dr, and compare the resulting g-factor with Breit's formula (2/3)(1 + 2√(1−(Zα)²)) across Z.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Exponential-cosine-screened Coulomb potential: Born versus exact cross sections
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Derive the analytic Born amplitude of the ECSC potential relevant to dense plasmas. Compare it with differential and total cross sections from Numerov phase shifts as a function of screening parameter and energy.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Two-dimensional scattering from a Gaussian disk: 2D Born versus cylindrical partial waves
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute 2D phase shifts by integrating the radial equation and matching to Bessel and Neumann functions. Compare the resulting differential cross section with the 2D Born amplitude for a quasi-2D cold-atom potential.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Born reflection coefficient versus exact transmission for Pöschl–Teller barriers
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate the 1D Schrödinger equation through a sech² well to get exact reflection, including the reflectionless integer-λ cases. Contrast the results with the Born reflection amplitude obtained from the potential's Fourier transform.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Electron–helium static potential from a radial Poisson ODE: Born versus partial waves
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Build the static potential of He from a Clementi-type 1s density by integrating the radial Poisson equation. Compute Born and exact Numerov differential cross sections for elastic electron scattering.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Optical-theorem violation of the Born approximation for a Hulthén potential
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compare the analytic Born total cross section with Im f(0) and with the exact partial-wave σ from radial ODE integration. Quantify the optical-theorem defect versus energy and potential strength.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Second Born correction for Yukawa scattering checked against exact phase shifts
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Evaluate the first and second Born amplitudes for a Yukawa potential using the Dalitz integral. Compare the Born series with the exact amplitude reconstructed from Numerov phase shifts in the forward and backward directions.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Klein–Gordon, Dirac and Schrödinger 1s energies of pionic and electronic atoms
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the radial Klein–Gordon, Dirac and Schrödinger equations by shooting for a Coulomb potential at several Z. Compare the binding energies with their analytic forms and show the spin-0 versus spin-1/2 relativistic differences.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Finite nuclear size shift of 1s1/2 in hydrogen-like lead
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate the radial Dirac equation in a uniformly charged sphere potential, matching interior and exterior Coulomb solutions. Compute the energy shift relative to a point nucleus and its dependence on nuclear radius.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Diving of the 1s1/2 level into the negative continuum near Z≈170
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Track the Dirac ground-state energy for an extended nucleus as Z increases beyond 137 using shooting with finite-size boundary conditions. Determine the critical charge at which E = −mc².

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Spurious states of a finite-difference radial Dirac Hamiltonian and their removal
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Discretize the radial Dirac equation for hydrogen with symmetric central differences, diagonalize, and identify fermion-doubling spurious eigenvalues. Show that a staggered grid or kinetic-balance basis removes them while reproducing fine-structure energies.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Pseudospin doublets in a relativistic Dirac Woods–Saxon nuclear mean field
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the radial Dirac equation with scalar and vector Woods–Saxon potentials for neutron levels. Quantify the near-degeneracy of pseudospin partners as the sum potential is varied.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Bound states of a charged impurity in gapped graphene from the 2D Dirac equation
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the radial 2D massive Dirac equation with a regularized Coulomb potential by shooting. Compute bound-state energies versus impurity charge and locate the critical charge where levels reach the valence band edge.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Exact Dirac fine structure versus Pauli perturbation theory across Z
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute 2p1/2–2p3/2 and 2s–2p splittings from Dirac radial shooting. Compare them with mass-velocity, Darwin and spin-orbit expectation values from Schrödinger radial functions, fitting the (Zα)⁶ residual.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Relativistic hyperfine enhancement factor of ns states from Dirac radial integrals
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Evaluate ∫ f g / r² dr for Dirac s-states in finite-size nuclear potentials at high Z. Compare with the nonrelativistic contact value and the analytic Breit–Rosenthal correction.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Dirac spectra in equal scalar-plus-vector linear confinement for heavy quarkonium
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the radial Dirac equation for linear scalar and vector potentials plus a Coulomb term. Compute the spectrum and verify the spin-symmetry degeneracy when the scalar and vector strengths are equal.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Ramsey fringes with finite-duration π/2 pulses on the Bloch sphere
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate the spin-1/2 Schrödinger equation through two finite rectangular pulses separated by free precession. Compute fringe contrast and envelope versus detuning and compare with the ideal-pulse Ramsey formula.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Robustness of BB1 composite pulses to amplitude errors
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate the spin propagator through a BB1 composite π pulse and a naive π pulse under fractional amplitude error. Compute gate fidelity versus error and verify the higher-order error suppression.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Bloch equations with T1 and T2: power-broadened steady-state absorption
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate Bloch equations with relaxation under continuous driving until steady state. Extract absorption and dispersion line shapes and verify the power-broadened Lorentzian width √(1+s).

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Adiabatic inversion with a hyperbolic-secant pulse and its threshold
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate the spin under Silver–Hoult sech amplitude and tanh frequency modulation. Compute inversion efficiency versus peak amplitude and detuning and compare with the analytic adiabatic threshold.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Majorana spin flips of atoms crossing a quadrupole field zero
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate spin dynamics along straight classical trajectories through a 3D quadrupole field. Compute the flip probability versus impact parameter and velocity and compare with Majorana's analytic formula.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Neutron spin-echo polarization with a velocity spread
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate neutron spin precession through two opposite field regions with a central π flipper for a velocity distribution. Compute the echo polarization versus field asymmetry and relate it to the intermediate scattering function.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Counterdiabatic STIRAP with an auxiliary 1–3 coupling
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Derive the Demirplak–Rice counterdiabatic field from the mixing angle derivative and add it as a direct coupling. Show perfect transfer at short durations by integrating the full three-level Hamiltonian.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: STIRAP losses from intermediate-state decay in a non-Hermitian Λ system
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate the three-level equations with an imaginary energy on state 2. Compute transfer and total loss versus decay rate and pulse area, comparing with adiabatic dark-state estimates.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Two-photon detuning sensitivity of STIRAP
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute final state-3 population versus two-photon and one-photon detunings by ODE integration. Extract the resonance width and its scaling with pulse area and duration.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Multistate STIRAP along a five-level chain
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate a five-level chain with pump, Stokes and intermediate couplings. Verify transfer through the odd-N dark state and its failure when intermediate couplings are weak or mismatched.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Non-Abelian geometric phase from tripod STIRAP
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate a four-level tripod system with three cyclic pulses. Compute the 2×2 holonomy acting on the dark-state subspace and compare it with the analytic Wilczek–Zee result for the loop.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Renormalized 2D contact interaction from shrinking finite wells
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Tune finite circular wells of decreasing radius to a fixed 2D scattering length and compute the bound-state energy by radial shooting. Demonstrate convergence to E = −4ħ²/(m a² e^{2γ}) and the logarithmic running coupling.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: s-wave phase shifts and resonances of a delta-shell potential
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate the radial equation with a derivative jump at r=a and extract phase shifts versus energy. Locate narrow resonances whose widths shrink with increasing shell strength (Gottfried model).

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Double delta well: bound states and transmission resonances versus separation
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute even and odd bound-state energies and transmission through two attractive or repulsive deltas by ODE integration with jump conditions. Compare with the analytic transcendental equations as separation varies.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Nascent-delta convergence: Gaussian wells approaching a delta potential
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve for bound-state energy and transmission of normalized Gaussian wells of shrinking width by Numerov. Quantify convergence rate to the delta-function results.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Spectrum of an infinite square well with a central delta barrier
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute eigenvalues by shooting with a derivative jump at the center. Track the even–odd tunneling splitting versus delta strength and compare with the analytic tan condition.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Universal dimer binding near resonance for different short-range wells
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Tune square, Gaussian and Pöschl–Teller wells near threshold and compute dimer energies and scattering lengths from zero-energy ODE integration. Quantify deviations from −ħ²/(m a²) due to effective-range corrections.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Two delta-interacting bosons on a ring: Lieb–Liniger two-body spectrum
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the relative-motion equation on a ring with a delta jump and periodic conditions by shooting. Compare the energies with the two-particle Bethe-ansatz equations across interaction strength.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Partner potential of the quartic oscillator from a numerical ground state
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute the anharmonic ground state by Numerov, build W = −ψ0'/ψ0, and construct the partner V2. Verify numerically that the spectrum of V2 equals the excited spectrum of V1.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Supersymmetric quantum mechanics and partner potentials

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Shape invariance of the Morse potential and its numerical verification
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Construct the SUSY partner of a Morse well and check that it is a parameter-shifted Morse potential. Compare the shape-invariance energy formula with Numerov spectra of the hierarchy.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Supersymmetric quantum mechanics and partner potentials

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Broken supersymmetry with an even superpotential W = gx²
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Build V± = W² ± W' and compute both spectra by shooting. Show that the levels are pairwise degenerate with no zero mode, illustrating a vanishing Witten index.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Supersymmetric quantum mechanics and partner potentials

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Krein–Adler deletion of an excited level from the harmonic oscillator
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Use a pair of adjacent excited states in a second-order Darboux transformation to build a regular potential. Confirm by Numerov that exactly those two levels are missing from its spectrum.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Supersymmetric quantum mechanics and partner potentials

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: SUSY hierarchy of the infinite square well and csc² partner potentials
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Construct successive partner potentials of the infinite well, which take the form csc² with increasing strength. Solve each numerically to verify the shifted spectra n² − m².
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Supersymmetric quantum mechanics and partner potentials

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Thomas–Fermi–Dirac atom with exchange and finite boundary
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the TFD equation with its finite-radius boundary condition by shooting. Compare the screening function, radius and total energy with pure TF for several Z.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Latter-corrected Thomas–Fermi potential and orbital energies of argon
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Build the TF potential with Latter's −1/r tail correction and solve radial Schrödinger equations by Numerov. Compute orbital energies, including the 4s–3d ordering, and compare with Hartree–Fock values.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Nonlinear Thomas–Fermi screening of a point charge in an electron gas
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the nonlinear radial Poisson–TF equation around an impurity in a degenerate electron gas. Compare the potential with the linearized Yukawa screening and the induced charge versus impurity strength.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Thomas–Fermi–von Weizsäcker atom with gradient correction
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the TFW Euler–Lagrange equation for √ρ as a nonlinear boundary-value problem. Compare the density cusp, asymptotic decay and total energy with TF and Hartree–Fock benchmarks.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Finite-temperature Thomas–Fermi atom in a dense plasma
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the finite-T TF Poisson equation with Fermi–Dirac integrals in a Wigner–Seitz cell. Compute the mean ionization and pressure versus temperature and density.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Thomas–Fermi atom in a strong magnetic field with lowest-Landau-level electrons
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the magnetic TF equation in which density scales as B√(μ−V) and find the neutral-atom radius by shooting. Verify the Z^{1/5}B^{−2/5} radius and energy scaling.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Wannier function localization in a Kronig–Penney lattice
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute gauge-smoothed Bloch functions over the Brillouin zone by ODE integration and Fourier transform them to a Wannier function. Relate its exponential decay rate to the complex-k branch point set by the gap.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Wannier–Stark resonance widths in a tilted cosine lattice
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the stationary equation with outgoing (Airy-like) boundary conditions in a tilted lattice and locate complex resonance energies. Verify the Stark-ladder spacing Fd and extract the tunneling widths.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Zak phase of a dimerized bichromatic continuous lattice
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute Bloch functions of V = V1cos(2kx) + V2cos(kx+φ) across the zone by ODE integration and evaluate the Zak phase from overlap products. Map the topological transition as dimerization changes sign.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Tamm surface states of a terminated Kronig–Penney crystal
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Match decaying Bloch solutions of complex k inside the crystal to evanescent vacuum solutions at a surface step. Find surface-state energies in the gaps versus step height and termination.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Sawtooth lattice bands: plane-wave expansion versus monodromy ODE
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute the band structure of a 1D sawtooth periodic potential by plane-wave diagonalization and by Hill-discriminant integration. Study plane-wave convergence of the band gaps caused by the potential's slow Fourier decay.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Plasma red-shift of hydrogen Lyman lines in a Debye-screened potential
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the radial Schrödinger equation for the Debye–Hückel potential -exp(-r/λ_D)/r by Numerov shooting for 1s, 2p, 3p and 4p levels. Compute the Lyman-α, β and γ transition energies and their shifts versus λ_D, and compare with second-order perturbation theory at large λ_D.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Oscillator strength of the 1s–2p transition in a Debye plasma
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Obtain 1s and 2p radial functions of a Debye-screened hydrogen atom by shooting. Compute the dipole matrix element and the absorption oscillator strength f(1s→2p) as functions of screening length down to the 2p critical point.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Ion-sphere model: pressure ionization of hydrogenic levels in a Wigner–Seitz cell
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Use the ion-sphere potential (nuclear Coulomb plus a uniform electron background inside radius R) and solve for bound levels by shooting. Track the levels as R shrinks to find the density at which successive levels leave the bound spectrum.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Bound states and critical screening of the exponential-cosine-screened Coulomb potential
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute 1s, 2s and 2p energies of V=-exp(-r/λ)cos(r/λ)/r by Numerov shooting versus λ. Locate critical screening lengths by root-finding on the zero-energy solution and compare with the pure Yukawa values.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Hellmann pseudopotential for alkali valence levels: fitting and Rydberg series
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Model the valence electron of potassium with V=-1/r + A exp(-2κr)/r. Fit A and κ to the 4s and 4p term values using Numerov shooting, then predict the higher ns and np levels and their quantum defects.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Yukawa well bound-state counting versus Bargmann and Calogero bounds
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: For V=-g exp(-μr)/r, count s-wave and l=1,2 bound states as a function of g using zero-energy phase (node counting) integration. Compare with the Bargmann and Calogero upper bounds on the number of bound states.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Gauss–Hermite DVR for the quartic oscillator and exponential eigenvalue convergence
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Build the Hermite DVR from Gauss–Hermite nodes and the transformed kinetic matrix for H=p²/2+x⁴. Show exponential convergence of the lowest eigenvalues with basis size against high-precision reference values.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Gauss–Legendre DVR for pendular states of a polar molecule in an electric field
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Represent the rigid rotor in a field, H=BJ²-μE cosθ, for fixed M on a Legendre DVR in cosθ. Compute pendular energies and ⟨cosθ⟩ versus field strength and check the weak-field Stark limit.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Mapped Fourier grid for near-dissociation levels of Cs2 and LeRoy–Bernstein analysis
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Use an adaptive coordinate mapping driven by local de Broglie wavelength on a Fourier grid for a long-range C6 potential. Compute the highest vibrational levels and fit the LeRoy–Bernstein near-dissociation law to extract C6.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Potential-optimized DVR from a contracted harmonic basis for a stretching mode
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Construct a potential-optimized DVR by diagonalizing the position operator in a primitive 1D eigenbasis, here for a Pöschl–Teller-like stretch. Compare eigenvalue accuracy per grid point with a plain harmonic DVR.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Lagrange–Legendre mesh for Woods–Saxon single-neutron levels of lead-208
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the radial Woods–Saxon problem for neutrons in lead-208, with spin-orbit term, on a regularized Lagrange–Legendre mesh on [0,R]. Compare the single-particle spectrum with Numerov shooting and check the magic gaps.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Direct-product sinc DVR and sparse eigensolver for coupled Barbanis oscillators
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Assemble the 2D direct-product sinc DVR for the Barbanis potential with sparse kinetic Kronecker sums. Use scipy eigsh for the lowest 30 levels and compare with second-order perturbation theory.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: DVR versus FBR: quadrature error and loss of variational bounds
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: For a harmonic oscillator with a Gaussian perturbation, compare finite basis representation energies (exact integrals) with DVR energies (quadrature). Show that DVR values can fall below exact ones and quantify how the quadrature error scales with basis size.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Hydrogen Rydberg wavepacket revivals and super-revivals from spectrum curvature
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Build a Gaussian superposition of hydrogen levels centered at n≈50. Compute the classical, revival and super-revival times from derivatives of E_n, then evaluate the autocorrelation |A(t)|² to identify fractional revivals.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Quantum carpet degradation in a finite-depth square well
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute finite-well eigenstates by Numerov and evolve a Gaussian packet by spectral expansion. Produce the space-time density carpet and quantify how deviations from a quadratic spectrum wash out the full revival compared with an infinite well.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Revivals in the quantum bouncer from asymptotic Airy-zero spacings
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Obtain bouncer eigenvalues in a linear gravitational potential above a hard floor by shooting. Derive classical and revival times from finite differences of E_n at the packet's mean level, and verify them with the autocorrelation of a dropped Gaussian.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Exact revivals in the Pöschl–Teller well with continuum truncation effects
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Exploit the exactly quadratic bound spectrum of a Pöschl–Teller well, computed numerically, to show perfect revivals of a packet expanded in bound states. Measure the loss of revival fidelity from the packet's continuum component.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Rotational revivals of impulsively aligned CO2 molecules
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Kick a thermal rotor ensemble with a short nonresonant laser pulse by integrating the TDSE in the coupled J basis during the pulse. Compute the field-free alignment signal ⟨cos²θ⟩(t), including full and quarter revivals at multiples of 1/(8Bc).

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Approximate revivals in a circular hard-wall billiard from Bessel-zero spectra
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute circular-well eigenvalues for several angular momenta by radial shooting. Superpose radial states with fixed m and evaluate the autocorrelation to show how the nonquadratic Bessel-zero spectrum limits revivals.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Tunneling and revival time scales in a double-well wavepacket autocorrelation
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute double-well eigenpairs by Numerov. Evolve a packet localized in one well and separate the tunneling period from the intrawell revival time in |A(t)|² and in the left-well probability.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Schrödinger-cat states at fractional revivals of a quartic oscillator
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Evolve a coherent state in H=p²/2+x²/2+εx⁴ using a numerical eigenbasis. At the half and quarter revival times from the spectrum curvature, compute the Wigner function and the fidelity to ideal cat states.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Dunham coefficients of a Hulburt–Hirschfelder potential from numerical levels
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve for rovibrational levels of the HCl Hulburt–Hirschfelder potential. Least-squares fit ωe, ωexe, ωeye, Be and αe, and compare the fitted constants with analytic Morse-based predictions.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Rotational constants B_v and centrifugal distortion D_v of a Morse oscillator
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: For several J, compute rovibrational energies of an H2-like Morse oscillator by shooting with the centrifugal term. Extract B_v and D_v by fitting E_v(J) and compare with Pekeris' approximate formulas.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Birge–Sponer extrapolation of dissociation energy versus exact Morse bound spectrum
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute all bound vibrational levels of an anharmonic potential with a long-range tail by Numerov. Perform linear and curved Birge–Sponer extrapolations of ΔG, and compare the inferred D0 with the exact value.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Quasibound rotational levels of a Morse potential above dissociation
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Add a centrifugal barrier to a Morse potential at high J. Locate shape resonances above the dissociation limit from phase-shift energy dependence, and extract resonance positions and tunneling widths.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Bound–continuum photodissociation spectrum from a Morse ground state to a repulsive curve
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute energy-normalized continuum wavefunctions on an exponential repulsive excited state by outward Numerov with asymptotic normalization. Evaluate the continuum Franck–Condon spectrum and compare with the reflection-principle approximation.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Kratzer molecular potential: numerical rovibrational levels versus analytic formula
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the radial equation for the Kratzer potential V=-2De(re/r - re²/2r²) by Numerov for several v and J. Validate against the exact analytic levels, and compare spectroscopic constants with a Morse fit of equal De, re and ωe.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Singlet and triplet ground states of 1D soft-Coulomb helium by 2D imaginary time
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Represent two electrons on a 2D (x1,x2) grid with soft-Coulomb interactions. Relax in imaginary time while enforcing exchange symmetry or antisymmetry to obtain the lowest singlet and triplet energies, and compare with independent-electron estimates.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Lowest levels of an equilateral triangular billiard by masked imaginary-time relaxation
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Impose hard walls through a large masking potential on a 2D grid and use imaginary time with Gram–Schmidt to obtain the first several eigenvalues. Compare with Lamé's exact formula and quantify the discretization error of the boundary.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Josephson parameters of a Bose–Einstein condensate in a double-well trap
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Find the symmetric and antisymmetric stationary Gross–Pitaevskii states of a 1D double well by imaginary time with symmetry constraints. Compute the tunneling energy and on-site interaction energy for the two-mode Bose–Josephson model.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Self-consistent Hartree ground state of two electrons in a 1D harmonic quantum dot
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Iterate imaginary-time relaxation of a single orbital in the trap plus the Hartree potential from soft-Coulomb repulsion. Compare the converged energy with exact diagonalization of the two-particle problem in relative coordinates.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Chebyshev imaginary-time propagator versus split-operator for anharmonic ground states
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Implement the Chebyshev expansion of exp(-Hτ) with modified Bessel coefficients on a grid Hamiltonian. Compare ground-state energy accuracy and cost against second-order split-operator relaxation for a quartic double well.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Ground state of the Schrödinger–Newton equation by radial imaginary-time relaxation
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Relax the s-wave Schrödinger–Newton equation, with self-gravitating mean field from a radial Poisson ODE, in imaginary time. Obtain the ground-state eigenvalue and verify the scaling E∝M⁵ and the virial relation.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Aharonov–Bohm spectrum and persistent current in a finite-width annular quantum ring
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the radial equation in a parabolic-confinement annulus with flux-shifted angular momentum m-Φ/Φ0 by shooting. Compute the flux-periodic spectrum and the zero-temperature persistent current for N spinless electrons.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Landau levels and charged particles in fields

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Aharonov–Bohm scattering from a finite-radius flux tube by partial waves
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate radial equations with noninteger effective angular momentum outside a hard-core flux tube. Extract phase shifts and the differential cross section, and compare with the Aharonov–Bohm sin²(πα)/sin²(θ/2) result as the radius shrinks.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Landau levels and charged particles in fields

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Gauge invariance and convergence of Peierls-phase lattice Landau levels
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Discretize a 2D harmonic dot in a magnetic field with Peierls phases in both Landau and symmetric gauges. Show that the gauge-independent spectrum converges to Fock–Darwin values, and quantify the lattice error versus magnetic length over grid spacing.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Landau levels and charged particles in fields

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Snake states at a magnetic field reversal B(x)=B0·sign(x)
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: For each k_y, solve the 1D effective Schrödinger equation with vector potential A_y=B0|x| by shooting. Compute the dispersion of snake states and their group velocity along the field-reversal line.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Landau levels and charged particles in fields

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Hybrid magnetoelectric subbands of a parabolic quantum wire in perpendicular field
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve for the subbands of a parabolic wire in a perpendicular magnetic field and verify the hybrid frequency sqrt(ω0²+ωc²) and the enhanced effective mass. Use these to compute the number of occupied subbands (magnetodepopulation) versus B.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Landau levels and charged particles in fields

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Fitting Woods–Saxon parameters to calcium-41 neutron single-particle energies
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Adjust depth, radius, diffuseness and spin-orbit strength of a Woods–Saxon well by least squares. The fit wraps radial Numerov eigenvalue solves and targets empirical neutron single-particle levels near calcium-40.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Iterative Newton reconstruction of a symmetric potential from its Dirichlet spectrum
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Recover a symmetric potential on [0,1] from its first N Dirichlet eigenvalues. Newton iterations use eigenvalue sensitivities ∂E_n/∂V=|ψ_n|² from shooting solutions, and the result is compared with the true potential.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: RKR inversion of Dunham constants to classical turning points and requantization
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute Rydberg–Klein–Rees turning points from G(v) and B(v) by singular-integral quadrature. Requantize the resulting potential with Numerov, and quantify the accuracy of the reproduced levels for an N2-like molecule.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Fitting a two-Yukawa potential to nucleon–nucleon 1S0 phase shifts
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Least-squares fit the strengths and ranges of an attractive-plus-repulsive Yukawa potential to tabulated 1S0 phase shifts, using variable-phase integration. Report the resulting scattering length and effective range.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Semiclassical Abel inversion of a 1D spectrum into a symmetric well
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: From a smooth interpolated level-counting function n(E), reconstruct the width x(E) of a symmetric well via Abel inversion of the Bohr–Sommerfeld condition. Test by Numerov requantization for an anharmonic quartic well.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Fitting a Klapisch model potential to lithium term values
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Optimize the parameters of a Klapisch parametric core potential to reproduce lithium ns, np and nd energies, using radial Numerov eigenvalue solves inside a least-squares loop. Predict quantum defects of high Rydberg states.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Potential from a measured ground-state density with regularized inversion
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Invert V(x)=E+ψ''/(2ψ) from a noisy sampled ground-state density using Tikhonov-regularized derivatives. Verify the reconstructed potential by forward shooting and study error growth in the density tails.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Berry phase of an adiabatically rotated anisotropic 2D harmonic oscillator
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Rotate the principal axes of an anisotropic 2D oscillator through 2π and compute discretized overlap Berry phases of low eigenstates obtained on a grid. Relate the phases to quantized angular momentum content and check them against the analytic result.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Half-integer pseudorotation quantization from the molecular Aharonov–Bohm effect
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the radial vibronic problem on the E⊗e Mexican-hat lower sheet with and without the geometric vector potential. Show the shift from integer to half-integer pseudorotational angular momentum and its effect on low vibronic levels.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Pancharatnam phase of a two-level atom under noncyclic Rabi evolution
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate a detuned Rabi problem and compute the Pancharatnam geometric phase arg⟨ψ(0)|ψ(t)⟩ minus the dynamical phase for noncyclic paths. Compare with the solid angle closed by a geodesic on the Bloch sphere.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Berry phase from dragging a delta barrier adiabatically around a ring
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute ring eigenstates with a delta barrier at angle θ0 by matching conditions. Evaluate the discretized Berry phase as θ0 winds by 2π for different barrier strengths, and interpret it as the transported angular momentum.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Chern number of a spin in a field from discretized Berry curvature on a sphere
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Use the Fukui–Hatsugai plaquette overlap method on a (θ,φ) mesh to compute the Berry flux of spin-s eigenstates. Show integer Chern numbers 2m and the topological transition when the monopole is moved outside a shifted parameter sphere.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: SU(1,1) geometric phase of a Gaussian packet in a cyclically squeezed oscillator
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Evolve a Gaussian width parameter by the Ermakov or Riccati ODE while the oscillator frequency and mass are varied cyclically. Extract the geometric phase and compare it with the hyperbolic-area formula of SU(1,1).

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Regular and irregular Coulomb functions by Numerov with Wronskian checks
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute F_l(η,ρ) by outward Numerov from series initial values and G_l by inward integration from the asymptotic expansion. Check the Wronskian and compare with continued-fraction (Steed) values across η.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Coulomb scattering and Coulomb wave functions

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Mott scattering of identical carbon-12 nuclei and interference oscillations
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute the symmetrized Coulomb scattering amplitude for spin-0 bosons, using Coulomb phases from asymptotic matching of numerical solutions. Compute the Mott cross section ratio to Rutherford versus angle and energy.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Coulomb scattering and Coulomb wave functions

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Proton–proton 1S0 Coulomb-modified scattering length and effective range
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate the radial equation with Coulomb plus a short-range nuclear well and match to numerical F_0 and G_0. Extract the Coulomb-modified phase shift and fit the modified effective-range expansion for a_pp and r_pp.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Coulomb scattering and Coulomb wave functions

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Sommerfeld–Gamow factor from the numerical Coulomb wave at the origin
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Normalize numerically integrated s-wave Coulomb solutions to unit asymptotic amplitude and read |ψ(0)|². Compare with C0²(η)=2πη/(e^{2πη}-1) in both repulsive and attractive cases, and compute an astrophysical S-factor conversion.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Coulomb scattering and Coulomb wave functions

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Alpha-decay half-life of polonium-212 from exact Coulomb penetrability
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute the penetrability P_l=1/(F_l²+G_l²) at the nuclear radius from numerical Coulomb functions. Combine it with an assault frequency to estimate half-lives, and compare with the Gamow WKB result for several nuclei.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Coulomb scattering and Coulomb wave functions

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Hydrogen 1s photoionization cross section from energy-normalized Coulomb continua
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate the l=1 attractive Coulomb continuum and energy-normalize it by amplitude matching. Compute the dipole matrix element with 1s, and evaluate σ(ω) including the threshold value and high-energy power law.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Coulomb scattering and Coulomb wave functions

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Proton elastic scattering on calcium-40: ratio to Rutherford with a Woods–Saxon optical potential
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Combine Coulomb amplitudes with nuclear phase shifts from a complex Woods–Saxon potential, matched to Coulomb functions. Compute dσ/dσ_R versus angle, including diffraction oscillations.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Coulomb scattering and Coulomb wave functions

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Sommerfeld enhancement for Yukawa-mediated dark-matter annihilation
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the s-wave Schrödinger equation with an attractive Yukawa potential and extract the enhancement |ψ(0)|² versus velocity and mediator mass. Show the resonance peaks and the Coulomb limit.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Coulomb scattering and Coulomb wave functions

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Coulomb phase shifts σ_l: asymptotic matching versus the gamma-function formula
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Extract σ_l from numerically integrated regular solutions by fitting to sin(ρ-ηln2ρ-lπ/2+σ_l) at large ρ. Compare with arg Γ(l+1+iη) and study how matching radius affects accuracy.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Coulomb scattering and Coulomb wave functions

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Critical delta-shell strengths for l-wave binding in 3D
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Find bound states of V=-g δ(r-a) for l=0,1,2 by matching interior and exterior radial solutions at r=a. Compute critical couplings g_c(l)=(2l+1)/a and energies versus g, checked against a narrow-well numerical ODE.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Survival probability after a sudden quench of a delta well's strength
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Prepare the bound state of strength g1 and switch abruptly to g2. Compute the overlap with the new bound state and the time-dependent survival amplitude via numerical TDSE on a large grid with absorbing boundaries.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Ionization of a 1D delta-bound electron in a strong oscillating field
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate the TDSE for a softened delta atom in a monochromatic field. Compute ionization rates from norm decay versus intensity and frequency, and compare with Keldysh's tunneling and multiphoton limits.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Deser–Trueman shift of hydrogenic s levels by a short-range interaction
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Add a short-range square well to a Coulomb potential, with an exotic-atom mass scale, and solve for 1s and 2s shifts by shooting. Compare with the Deser–Trueman formula using the scattering length from the zero-energy short-range problem.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Persistent current in a 1D ring with a delta-function impurity
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the ring quantization condition with a delta scatterer and flux using transfer matching. Compute flux-dependent levels and the persistent current versus impurity strength, showing gap opening at half flux.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Bound states of the δ′ interaction via regularized approximating potentials
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Approximate δ′(x) by scaled antisymmetric Gaussian doublets and compute bound and scattering properties numerically as the width shrinks. Demonstrate the non-trivial limit, including resonant transmission at special coupling values.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Two atoms in a 2D harmonic trap with a regularized contact interaction
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the relative-coordinate 2D problem with a finite square well tuned to a target 2D scattering length. Compare the spectrum with the analytic Busch-type relation involving the digamma function.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Stark resonance of a delta-bound particle in a static field
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Find the complex resonance energy of a 1D delta well in a uniform field by matching outgoing Airy-type solutions, computed numerically. Compare the width with the weak-field tunneling formula Γ∝exp(-4κ³/3F).

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Unguided DMC of the harmonic oscillator with time-step extrapolation
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Branching random walk for the 1D harmonic oscillator. Compare the growth estimator with the averaged reference-energy estimator, then extrapolate the ground energy linearly to zero time step against the exact ħω/2.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Importance-sampled DMC for the hydrogen atom with an exponential guide
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Drift-diffusion-branching DMC for 3D hydrogen guided by ψ_T=e^{-αr} with α≠1. Measure time-step bias in the mixed energy and its extrapolation, checked against a Numerov ground state.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Fixed-node error for hydrogen 2s with a displaced trial node
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Run fixed-node DMC for the hydrogen 2s state with a trial nodal sphere at r_0≠2. Map the upper-bound energy error versus node displacement and compare with radial Numerov energies of the node-constrained problem.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Population-control bias of DMC in a symmetric double well
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Branching DMC ground-state energy of a quartic double well run at various target walker numbers. Quantify the 1/N population-control bias and the slow mixing between wells, with Numerov as the exact reference.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Second-order DMC propagator with Metropolis acceptance for a Morse oscillator
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compare naive first-order drift-diffusion with an Umrigar-style accept/reject second-order propagator for the Morse ground state. Fit τ versus τ² bias and compare with the analytic Morse energy.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: DMC for two Gaussian-interacting particles in a 1D harmonic trap
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Bosonic ground-state energy of two trapped particles with a repulsive Gaussian interaction obtained from DMC. Compare with separation into center-of-mass and a relative-coordinate Numerov ODE.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Inverted parabolic barrier: exact transmission versus the Kemble formula
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Numerically integrate through a truncated inverted parabola matched to plane waves. Compare T(E) with Kemble's 1/(1+e^{2πε}) result and study the effect of truncation.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Phase time, dwell time and the Hartman effect for a rectangular barrier
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Use transfer-matrix amplitudes to compute the Wigner phase time from dφ/dE and the dwell time from the integrated probability density. Show phase-time saturation with barrier width below the barrier top.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Reflection from a smooth tanh step: staircase convergence versus exact solution
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Approximate a Woods–Saxon/tanh potential step by N constant slices in a transfer matrix. Measure convergence of R(E) to the analytic hypergeometric result and the quantum reflection above the step.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Above-barrier transmission resonances of a 1D finite square well
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute T(E) for E>0 over a square well with a transfer matrix. Locate unit-transmission energies where k'L=nπ and relate the resonance widths to well depth.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Triple-barrier resonant tunneling: splitting of coupled-well resonances
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Transfer-matrix transmission through three barriers forming two coupled wells. Extract the resonance doublet splitting versus middle-barrier width and compare with the bonding–antibonding splitting from bound-state shooting.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Heterojunction transmission with position-dependent effective mass
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Transmission across a GaAs/AlGaAs step and barrier using BenDaniel–Duke derivative matching (ψ'/m continuous). Compare with naive ψ' continuity and verify probability-current conservation.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Breakdown of the thawed Gaussian approximation in a quartic oscillator
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Propagate a displaced Gaussian in V=x⁴ with Heller's equations and exactly by split-operator. Track the overlap fidelity and the time at which the local harmonic approximation fails as a function of initial energy.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Ehrenfest time of a wavepacket in an anharmonic well
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compare the quantum centroid ⟨x⟩(t) from split-operator propagation with the classical trajectory from RK4 in a Morse/quartic well. Measure the divergence time versus ħ_eff and packet width.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Feit–Fleck spectral method for Hénon–Heiles eigenvalues
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Propagate a 2D Gaussian in the Hénon–Heiles potential by split-operator FFT. Window and Fourier transform the autocorrelation to extract eigenvalues, and assess resolution versus propagation time.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Gaussian packet in a time-dependent harmonic trap via the Ermakov equation
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the Ermakov–Pinney ODE for the width of a Gaussian in an oscillator with modulated frequency. Compare with grid propagation and quantify parametric squeezing growth near 2ω resonance.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Quantum–classical correspondence of a packet in a pendulum potential near the separatrix
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Propagate a wavepacket in V=−V_0 cos x and a classical Liouville ensemble of RK4 trajectories. Compare ⟨x⟩ and ⟨cos x⟩ for energies near the separatrix where the quantum and classical dynamics diverge fastest.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Dirac–Frenkel variational Gaussian versus thawed Gaussian in a double well
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate the variational Gaussian equations of motion, which use potential averages over the Gaussian, alongside Heller's local-harmonic equations in a quartic double well. Compare with exact tunneling dynamics of ⟨x⟩(t).

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Wigner functions of Morse oscillator eigenstates and their negativity
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Obtain Morse eigenfunctions by Numerov and Wigner-transform them by FFT. Compute the negative volume versus quantum number and compare marginals with |ψ(x)|² and |φ(p)|².

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Linearized semiclassical (classical Wigner) ⟨x(t)⟩ in a Morse oscillator
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Sample the initial Gaussian's Wigner distribution, integrate classical trajectories, and average x(t). Compare with exact quantum ⟨x(t)⟩ to show agreement at short times and loss of revivals at long times.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Moyal ħ² correction in a cubic potential: Wigner–Moyal versus exact
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Evolve the Wigner function in a cubic-plus-harmonic potential with the Moyal third-derivative term, using spectral derivatives and an ODE integrator. Compare with classical Liouville evolution and the exact transformed Schrödinger evolution.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Decoherence of a cat state under amplitude damping and Wigner negativity decay
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate the Lindblad master equation for a damped oscillator in a truncated Fock basis with an ODE solver. Compute the Wigner negativity versus time and compare with the analytic fringe decay rate ∝ 2γ|α|².

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Chemical potential of a 3D isotropic condensate versus the Thomas–Fermi limit
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Find the radial GPE ground state by imaginary-time relaxation for increasing Na/a_ho. Compute μ, the energy and the radius, and compare with Thomas–Fermi μ=½(15Na/a_ho)^{2/5}ħω.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Critical atom number for collapse of an attractive trapped condensate
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Use imaginary-time radial GPE with negative scattering length to find the stability threshold N|a|/a_ho≈0.575 where the metastable solution disappears. Compare with a Gaussian variational estimate.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Vortex core profile of a uniform condensate by radial boundary-value shooting
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve f''+f'/r−f/r²+f−f³=0 for the singly quantized vortex amplitude by shooting or relaxation. Extract the core size, the asymptotic slope at the origin and the vortex energy per unit length.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Dark-soliton oscillation in a harmonically trapped 1D condensate
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Imprint a phase step on a Thomas–Fermi-like ground state and evolve it with split-step GPE. Measure the soliton oscillation frequency and compare with ω/√2.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Breathing-mode frequency of a 1D trapped condensate from noninteracting to Thomas–Fermi
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Excite the condensate by a sudden trap-frequency change and use split-step GP dynamics. Fit the width oscillation frequency, which crosses over from 2ω to √3ω with increasing interaction.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Free expansion of a released condensate: Castin–Dum scaling versus GPE
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate the Castin–Dum scaling ODEs for a cigar-shaped condensate. Compare the aspect-ratio inversion with direct 2D split-step GPE expansion from an imaginary-time ground state.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Miscible–immiscible transition of a two-component trapped condensate
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Use coupled 1D GPEs and imaginary-time relaxation to find the ground state versus g12. Compute an overlap integral and locate the phase-separation threshold g12²=g11g22, including trap effects.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Nonpolynomial Schrödinger equation for cigar condensates versus 1D GPE
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute ground states of Salasnich's NPSE and of the 1D GPE by imaginary time. Compare chemical potentials and axial widths with a radially symmetric 2D (r,z) GPE as transverse confinement varies.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Condensate in a box trap: healing-length boundary layer versus tanh profile
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Find the GPE ground state in a hard-wall box by imaginary time. Fit the edge profile to tanh(x/√2ξ) and compute the boundary-energy correction to μ versus density.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Flat-top quantum droplets in a 1D Bose mixture with beyond-mean-field correction
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Use imaginary-time relaxation of Petrov's 1D extended GPE with cubic repulsion and quadratic LHY attraction. Compare droplet profiles and μ(N) with the analytic solution, including saturation to a flat top.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Energy versus variance minimization for an anharmonic-oscillator trial function
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Use 1D VMC with trial ψ=exp(−ax²−bx⁴) for an x²+λx⁴ oscillator. Optimize by energy and by local-energy variance with correlated-sampling reweighting, and compare both with Numerov.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Random-dimer model: delocalized resonance and transmission through long chains
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Use a binary chain whose impurity sites come in pairs. Compute the transfer-matrix transmission versus energy and length, and show √N-delocalized states near the resonance energy E=ε_b.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Single-parameter scaling of the Landauer conductance distribution
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Sample transmissions of many disordered chains via transfer matrices. Verify the log-normal distribution of T and the relation var(ln T)=2⟨−ln T⟩ in the localized regime.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Wavepacket spreading and saturation in a disordered tight-binding chain
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate the time-dependent tight-binding equations with an ODE solver from a single-site initial state. Track the mean-square displacement and show saturation at a value set by ξ².

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Real spectrum of PT-symmetric x²(ix)^ε oscillators by complex-contour shooting
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate the Schrödinger ODE along rotated rays inside the Stokes wedges and match solutions at the origin. Compute eigenvalues versus ε to reproduce the Bender–Boettcher spectrum, including the ix³ case.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: WKB scaling of high pure-quartic levels versus exact shooting
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute the levels of V=x⁴ up to large n by Numerov shooting. Compare with the WKB result E_n∝(n+½)^{4/3} and the leading correction to fit the relative error decay.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Hill determinant for the quartic anharmonic oscillator and Symanzik scaling
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Truncate the recursion for power-series coefficients of x²+λx⁴ and find eigenvalues as zeros of the Hill determinant. Study convergence with truncation and fit the strong-coupling scaling E∝λ^{1/3}.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Metastable cubic oscillator: resonance width by complex scaling versus WKB
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Diagonalize a complex-rotated finite-difference Hamiltonian for V=x²/2−gx³. Extract the complex resonance energy, which is stable in θ, and compare its width with the instanton/WKB decay rate.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Linear delta expansion (order-dependent mapping) for the quartic oscillator
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Expand about a trial harmonic frequency chosen by the principle of minimal sensitivity at each order. Show convergence even at strong coupling, with Numerov as the reference.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Level-spacing statistics of the x²y² coupled quartic oscillator
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Use a sparse 2D finite-difference or DVR Hamiltonian for V=x²y²+β(x⁴+y⁴), with symmetry-sector separation. Unfold the spectrum and track the crossover from Poisson to Wigner–Dyson spacing distributions as β varies.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Bethe–Peierls contact condition in a spherical box versus shrinking square wells
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Find s-wave levels in a hard-wall sphere from the boundary condition (rψ)'/(rψ)=−1/a. Compare with square wells of shrinking range tuned to the same scattering length, solved by Numerov.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Delta-function well near a hard wall: bound-state threshold distance
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Find the bound state of an attractive delta at distance d from an infinite wall by solving the transcendental condition. Confirm it by finite-difference diagonalization and locate the critical d below which no bound state exists.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Two-channel Feshbach resonance from coupled square wells
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate coupled open/closed-channel radial ODEs with a tunable closed-channel offset. Extract the scattering length versus detuning, the resonance width and the universal dimer energy near the pole.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: McGuire trimer of three attractive delta bosons in 1D
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Reduce to 2D Jacobi coordinates with softened delta interactions. Find the ground state by imaginary-time relaxation and compare its energy with the exact McGuire result E=−4E_dimer as the softening goes to zero.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Richardson extrapolation of finite-difference Pöschl–Teller eigenvalues
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Use three-point finite-difference Hamiltonians at several spacings h. Verify O(h²) error and Richardson-extrapolate to high accuracy against the exact Pöschl–Teller levels.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Ammonia inversion splitting from a Fourier grid Hamiltonian
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Use the Marston–Balint-Kurti Fourier grid method for a double-minimum umbrella-mode potential. Compute the tunneling splittings of the ground and excited vibrational doublets and their convergence with grid size.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Prüfer-angle shooting for robust eigenvalue indexing
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate the Prüfer phase ODE for a Sturm–Liouville problem such as an anharmonic well. Count nodes from the phase and locate the n-th eigenvalue by bisection on the phase at the boundary, compared with matrix diagonalization.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Johnson log-derivative propagator for bound states
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Propagate the log-derivative outward and inward and locate eigenvalues from the mismatch function, counting nodes along the way. Apply it to a Lennard-Jones-like well and compare its efficiency and accuracy with Numerov matching.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Sparse 3D finite-difference hydrogen atom and the Coulomb singularity
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Use a 7-point Laplacian on a Cartesian grid with the Coulomb potential and solve with a sparse eigensolver. Study ground-state energy convergence versus spacing and box size, and the slow convergence caused by the cusp.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Algebraic versus exponential convergence of Fourier grids for smooth and discontinuous wells
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compare Fourier-grid eigenvalue convergence for a Gaussian well with that for a finite square well. Fit exponential versus algebraic error decay and connect the slow case to the Gibbs phenomenon at the discontinuity.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Cooley energy-correction formula for Numerov shooting in a Morse well
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Implement outward/inward Numerov integration with Cooley's first-order energy correction from the derivative mismatch. Compare its iteration count and accuracy with bisection on analytic Morse levels near dissociation.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Multiphoton resonances in continuously driven Landau–Zener–Stückelberg interferometry
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate a two-level system driven by ε(t) = ε0 + A cos ωt with a constant tunnel coupling. Compute the time-averaged upper-level population on a grid of (ε0, A), and compare the resonance positions and widths with the Bessel-function rate formula.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Landau–Zener charge-transfer cross section for Na + I ionic–covalent crossing
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Locate the Na+I⁻/NaI covalent curve crossing radius by root finding and compute the coupling from the Olson–Smith formula. Obtain the per-passage Landau–Zener probability along straight-line trajectories and integrate the double-passage probability over impact parameter to get the ion-pair formation cross section.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Winter delta-shell model: non-exponential decay of a quasi-bound state
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Expand an initially confined state inside a 3D s-wave delta-shell barrier in the exact continuum eigenfunctions, and compute the survival probability by energy quadrature. Extract the exponential decay rate, compare it with the Gamow pole width, and identify the late-time power-law tail.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Star quantum graph with a delta-coupled vertex: bound state and spectrum
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Model N edges of finite length meeting at a vertex with δ-coupling strength α and Dirichlet ends. Compute bound-state and excited eigenvalues from the secular equation by root finding, and verify them by shooting the edge ODEs with the Kirchhoff-plus-delta matching conditions.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Efimov geometric spectrum from the hyperradial ODE with a short-range cutoff
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the transcendental equation for the Efimov parameter s0 of three resonant identical bosons. Then solve the hyperradial ODE −F'' − (s0² + 1/4)F/R² = EF with a hard-core cutoff by shooting, and verify the e^{2π/s0} ≈ 515 ratio between successive trimer energies.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Colbert–Miller radial DVR for central potentials with centrifugal barriers
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Build the Colbert–Miller kinetic matrix on (0, ∞) with the l(l+1)/r² term for the 3D isotropic oscillator and a Gaussian well. Compute eigenvalues for several l and grid spacings, and measure the convergence against exact or Numerov reference values.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Spherical-Bessel DVR for a particle in a sphere with a Woods–Saxon well
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Construct the Bessel-zero DVR of Littlejohn and Cargo for a spherical cavity of radius R at fixed l, and diagonalize it with an added Woods–Saxon potential. Study eigenvalue convergence with basis size and compare against Numerov shooting with a hard-wall boundary.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Sequential diagonalization–truncation DVR for coupled Morse stretches
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: For two Morse oscillators coupled kinetically and through the potential, diagonalize 1D DVR Hamiltonians on the grid points of the other coordinate and keep the eigenvectors below an energy cutoff (Bačić–Light). Build the contracted 2D Hamiltonian and study the accuracy of local-mode levels against the cutoff.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Gauss–Laguerre DVR for 2D hydrogen and its 4/(2n−1)² spectrum
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the radial equation of a 2D hydrogen atom in polar coordinates with a Lagrange–Laguerre mesh for several angular momenta m. Verify the 2D Rydberg series E_n = −1/(2(n − 1/2)²) and its degeneracy pattern, and study convergence with mesh size and scaling parameter.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Langer-corrected WKB quantization for hydrogen and rotating Morse levels
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Find radial turning points by root finding and evaluate Bohr–Sommerfeld integrals by quadrature, both with l(l+1) and with the Langer replacement (l + 1/2)². Compare the resulting hydrogen and rotating-Morse energies with Numerov eigenvalues to show the effect of the correction.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Maslov indices for hard-wall-bounded wells: half oscillator and power-law wells
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Quantize V = |x|^ν with a hard wall at x = 0 using Bohr–Sommerfeld with Maslov phase 3/4 instead of 1/2. Compare with Numerov eigenvalues for several ν, and quantify how the error depends on quantum number.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Uniform barrier-top quantization of a quartic double well (Connor–Miller)
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Apply the uniform semiclassical quantization condition with the parabolic-connection phase φ(ε) and tunneling factor for levels near the top of a symmetric double-well barrier. Compare against standard Bohr–Sommerfeld and against exact Numerov eigenvalues across the barrier-top region.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: JWKB phase shifts versus Numerov for Lennard-Jones atom scattering
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute semiclassical phase shifts from turning-point root finding and quadrature of the Langer-corrected radial phase integral for an Ar–Ar Lennard-Jones potential. Compare them with exact Numerov phase shifts and with the resulting partial-wave cross sections over a range of energies.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Above-barrier reflection from complex turning points versus exact integration
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: For a Gaussian barrier at energies above its top, locate the complex turning points and evaluate the Pokrovsky–Khalatnikov exponent by complex contour quadrature. Compare the predicted reflection coefficient with numerically integrated reflection, including how the prefactor ratio changes with energy.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Optimizing the Slater exchange parameter α for neon and argon
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Repeat self-consistent Xα radial calculations over a grid of α values, and use root finding to locate the α that matches the reference Hartree–Fock total energy. Compare the optimal α with the Kohn–Sham value of 2/3 and with Schwarz's tabulated values.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Hartree-Fock-Slater and shell structure of atoms

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Radial shell structure of electron densities from argon to krypton
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Obtain self-consistent HFS radial densities 4πr²ρ(r), count the shell maxima and minima, and locate the shell radii by root finding. Compare the shell radii with the ⟨r⟩ values of the individual orbitals and with the smooth Thomas–Fermi density.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Hartree-Fock-Slater and shell structure of atoms

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Magic numbers of sodium clusters in the spherical jellium Kohn–Sham model
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Self-consistently solve the radial Kohn–Sham LDA equations for N electrons in a uniform positive jellium sphere using Numerov and a Poisson ODE. Compute total energies, second differences Δ₂E(N) and HOMO–LUMO gaps, and reproduce the shell closures at N = 8, 20, 40 and 58.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Hartree-Fock-Slater and shell structure of atoms

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Effective nuclear charges: Slater's rules versus self-consistent HFS orbitals
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Extract effective charges Z_eff for each orbital of several atoms from self-consistent HFS orbital energies and ⟨r⟩ values. Compare them with Slater's screening rules and with Clementi–Raimondi trends across the periodic table.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Hartree-Fock-Slater and shell structure of atoms

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Geiger–Nuttall law for polonium and uranium isotopes from WKB tunneling
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute alpha-decay half-lives across isotope chains from the Gamow WKB integral through a nuclear-plus-Coulomb barrier, with outer turning points found by root finding. Fit log₁₀T versus Z/√Q to extract the Geiger–Nuttall slope and intercept for each chain.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Proton radioactivity half-lives and their centrifugal-barrier l dependence
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute WKB penetrabilities for proton emission from spherical emitters (e.g. ¹⁵¹Lu, ¹⁸⁵Bi) through a Woods–Saxon plus Coulomb plus l(l+1) barrier. Show how half-lives depend on the emitted orbital l, and use this dependence to assign l by comparing with measured values.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Cluster radioactivity: ¹⁴C emission from ²²³Ra versus alpha emission
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Use the WKB barrier-penetration integral with a proximity or touching-sphere nuclear potential to compute half-lives for ¹⁴C and α emission from the same parent. Quantify the branching ratio and how sensitive it is to the barrier radius.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Siegert-state complex energies for alpha particles by outgoing-wave shooting
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the radial equation at complex energy for an α in a Woods–Saxon plus Coulomb potential, and impose outgoing Coulomb (Gamow) boundary conditions. Find the resonance pole with Newton iteration on the matching function, and compare its width with the WKB decay rate.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Sub-barrier heavy-ion fusion cross sections: Wong formula versus partial-wave sum
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: For ¹⁶O + ¹⁴⁴Sm, compute l-dependent barrier transmission by numerical integration with an absorbing interior boundary condition (or by WKB), and sum the partial waves into a fusion cross section. Compare with the parabolic-barrier Wong formula below and above the barrier.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Diffraction minima in electron–nucleus scattering from Fermi charge distributions
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute the nuclear charge form factor of ²⁰⁸Pb and ⁴⁰Ca from a two-parameter Fermi density by numerical Fourier–Bessel quadrature. Locate the diffraction zeros by root finding and relate them to the rms radius and surface thickness through the Helm model.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Large-R gerade–ungerade splitting of H2+ versus the Holstein–Herring formula
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute the 1sσg and 2pσu energies at large internuclear distance by solving the separated spheroidal ODE eigenproblems with high precision. Compare the exchange splitting with the asymptotic Holstein–Herring result 4R e^{−R−1}.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Heteronuclear one-electron HeH²⁺ curves from separated spheroidal equations
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the coupled angular and radial spheroidal ODE eigenproblems for one electron in the field of charges Z1 = 2 and Z2 = 1. Construct the lowest σ potential curves and identify which are bound and which are repulsive, using shooting with matched separation constants.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: 1D soft-core H2+ model: σg/σu curves and charge-resonance coupling
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Diagonalize a sinc-DVR Hamiltonian for an electron in a 1D two-center soft-Coulomb potential at varying R. Extract the gerade and ungerade curves, the transition dipole between them, and its linear growth with R that underlies enhanced ionization.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Quantum ratchet current at kicked-rotor resonance with asymmetric kicks
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Apply kicks V(θ) = K[cos θ + α sin 2θ] at the principal quantum resonance to an initial superposition of momentum states, using Floquet propagation. Compute the directed mean momentum against the initial phase and α, and compare with analytic resonance predictions.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Riss–Meyer η-trajectories of a 1D shape resonance with a quadratic CAP
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Add -iηW(x) to a finite-difference Hamiltonian for a barrier-plus-well potential and track the complex eigenvalues as η varies. Extract the resonance position and width from the stationary point of |η dE/dη|, including the first-order corrected trajectory.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Complex absorbing potentials and absorbing boundaries

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Quantum reflection of slow atoms from a −C3/z³ surface potential
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate the 1D Schrödinger ODE inward from the asymptotic region and impose a fully absorbing (incoming-wave WKB) condition near the surface. Compute the quantum-reflection probability versus incident momentum and check the threshold law R ≈ 1 − 4kb.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Complex absorbing potentials and absorbing boundaries

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Quantum Langevin capture of ions by atoms in a −C4/r⁴ potential
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: For each partial wave, integrate the radial ODE with an absorbing inner boundary to get capture probabilities. Sum over l to obtain the reactive cross section versus energy, compare with the classical Langevin rate, and examine the s-wave Wigner threshold regime.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Complex absorbing potentials and absorbing boundaries

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Double-barrier resonant transmission from absorbed norm of a broad wavepacket
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Propagate a Gaussian packet through a double barrier with Crank–Nicolson time stepping, using CAPs at both grid edges. Use the time-integrated absorbed flux on each side to get transmission and reflection, then compare with stationary transfer-matrix transmission averaged over the packet's momentum distribution.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Complex absorbing potentials and absorbing boundaries

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Microwave ionization threshold of 1D hydrogen Rydberg atoms
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Propagate the 1D hydrogen model (−1/x for x>0) from an initial level n0 in a linearly polarized microwave field, with an absorbing boundary at large x. Compute the ionization probability from the absorbed norm and the scaled 10% threshold field F0·n0⁴ versus scaled frequency.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Complex absorbing potentials and absorbing boundaries

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Gravitational quantum states of neutrons in a slit with an absorbing ceiling
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Model a qBounce-type slit as a linear gravitational potential with a mirror floor and an imaginary absorber near the ceiling. Compute the decay rates of the lowest states as complex eigenvalues of the ODE, and the transmitted neutron flux versus slit height.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Complex absorbing potentials and absorbing boundaries

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Ultracold neutron wall-loss probability from a complex Fermi pseudopotential
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve 1D reflection of a neutron from a material step with complex optical potential V − iW. Compute the per-bounce loss probability μ(E), compare with the analytic step formula, and average over an isotropic wall-collision distribution.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Complex absorbing potentials and absorbing boundaries

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: r-centroids and band strengths of the N2+ first negative system
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Obtain Morse vibrational wavefunctions for the B and X states of N2+ and compute Franck–Condon factors and r-centroids. Use them with a linear electronic transition moment to compare exact band strengths against the r-centroid approximation.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Deng–Fan potential vibrational levels: numerics versus approximate analytic formula
