physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Shoot for the rovibrational levels of the Deng–Fan (generalized Morse) potential for a diatomic such as CO. Compare with the Pekeris-type analytic expression and quantify its error as v and J increase.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Predissociation linewidths of Morse levels coupled to a repulsive state
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute bound Morse vibrational functions together with energy-normalized continuum functions of an exponential repulsive curve. Evaluate golden-rule widths Γ_v for a constant coupling and show their oscillation with v caused by continuum nodal structure.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Hydrogen Stark resonances from separated parabolic-coordinate equations
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Separate the hydrogen Stark problem in parabolic coordinates. Solve the bound ξ equation for the separation constant, and solve the open η equation with an outgoing-wave condition, giving complex energies and ionization widths of the lowest Stark states versus field.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: H–H C6 dispersion coefficient from frequency-dependent Dalgarno–Lewis equations
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the inhomogeneous radial ODE for the first-order response of hydrogen 1s at imaginary frequency iω to get α(iω). Integrate the Casimir–Polder formula to obtain C6 ≈ 6.499 a.u.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Static quadrupole and octupole polarizabilities of hydrogen 1s
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the l=2 and l=3 Dalgarno–Lewis inhomogeneous radial equations numerically. Compute the 2^l-pole polarizabilities and compare with the exact values 15 and 131.25 a.u.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Static dipole polarizability of sodium via the Sternheimer equation in a model potential
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Obtain the Na 3s valence orbital in a parametric model potential and solve the l=1 inhomogeneous radial Sternheimer ODE. Compute α, compare with the sum over 3s→np oscillator strengths, and compare with experiment.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Magnetic quenching of positronium: ortho–para Zeeman mixing and decay rates
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Diagonalize the Breit–Rabi-type hyperfine-plus-Zeeman Hamiltonian of ground-state positronium. Compute the field-dependent mixing of m=0 states, the perturbed ortho lifetime, and the time evolution of the annihilation signal from a rate ODE.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Two atoms in a harmonic trap with a p-wave resonant interaction
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the l=1 relative-motion ODE for a short-range square well in a 3D harmonic trap. Map the trap energies versus well depth, and compare with the Idziaszek–Calarco p-wave analog of the Busch formula through the scattering volume and effective range.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Reconstructing a nonsymmetric potential from two spectra (Borg's theorem)
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Recover a potential on [0,1] from its Dirichlet–Dirichlet and Dirichlet–Neumann eigenvalues. Use Newton iteration on Fourier coefficients, with the Jacobian from squared eigenfunctions computed by shooting, and examine stability under truncated data.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Firsov semiclassical inversion of classical deflection data to a repulsive potential
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute the deflection function Θ(b) for an exponential repulsive potential by quadrature at several energies. Invert with Firsov's integral formula and check the reconstruction against the original potential.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Marchenko inversion of a non-reflectionless 1D reflection coefficient
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute R(k) for a Gaussian well by ODE integration, Fourier transform it, and solve the discretized Marchenko integral equation to reconstruct V(x). Verify by recomputing R(k) from the reconstructed potential.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Logarithmic quarkonium potential: mass-independent level spacings in a Laguerre basis
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute the radial levels of V = C ln(r/r0) for charm and bottom masses by Laguerre-basis diagonalization. Verify that the spacings are independent of mass, and compute |ψ(0)|² scaling for leptonic widths.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Bound states in central potentials via Laguerre bases

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Laguerre-basis convergence for a Gaussian well with optimized scale parameter
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Diagonalize an attractive 3D Gaussian well for l = 0,1,2 in a Laguerre basis. Study eigenvalue convergence with basis size and scale parameter, and select the scale by stationarity of the eigenvalues.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Bound states in central potentials via Laguerre bases

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Spin-mixing oscillations of a spin-1 condensate in the single-mode approximation
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate the classical mean-field equations for the population ρ0 and phase θ of a spin-1 BEC with quadratic Zeeman shift q. Compute oscillation periods and locate the separatrix, where the period diverges logarithmically.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Geometric-phase frequency shift of trapped spins in a magnetic gradient
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate the Bloch equation for spins in a cylindrical cell moving through a field with a linear gradient and a motional electric field. Compute the Pendlebury false-EDM frequency shift versus orbit frequency, and compare with its adiabatic and nonadiabatic limits.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Exceptional point between resonances of an asymmetric double-barrier
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Track complex-scaled eigenvalues of a two-parameter double-barrier potential with tunable barrier heights. Locate the exceptional point where two resonances coalesce, and verify the square-root topology by encircling it in parameter space.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Complex-rotated Laguerre basis for an l=2 shape resonance in a Gaussian well
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Rotate the radial coordinate r→re^{iθ} in Laguerre-basis matrix elements for an attractive Gaussian well with a d-wave centrifugal barrier. Find the θ-stable resonance, then compare its energy and width with a phase-shift Breit–Wigner fit.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Fibonacci quasiperiodic chain: transmission scaling and critical wavefunctions
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Use transfer matrices on Fibonacci approximants to compute transmission versus length and the trace-map invariant. Compute generalized IPR scaling exponents that show critical (multifractal) states.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Modified effective-range expansion for scattering in a −α/2r⁴ polarization potential
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate the s-wave ODE for a short-range core plus a polarization tail to obtain low-energy phase shifts. Fit the O'Malley–Spruch–Rosenberg expansion with its k ln k term, and show that the standard ERE fails.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Low-energy scattering length and effective range

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Neutron potential scattering radius versus mass number from a Woods–Saxon well
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute zero-energy s-wave solutions of a real Woods–Saxon potential with nuclear radius scaling as A^{1/3}. Obtain the scattering length and R′ versus A, and identify the 3s and 4s size resonances.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Low-energy scattering length and effective range

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Image-potential states on Cu(100) with the Chulkov model potential
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the 1D Schrödinger equation for the Chulkov surface potential, combining a bulk band gap with an image tail. Compute the Rydberg series of image states, quantum defects and binding energies of the n=1,2 states.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Hydrogenic donor at the center of a finite-barrier spherical quantum dot
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the radial ODE for an electron in a spherical well plus a Coulomb donor, with effective-mass matching. Compute the donor binding energy versus dot radius, showing its maximum and its collapse at small radius.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Close-coupling rotational excitation of a rigid rotor by atom impact
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Set up the coupled-channel radial equations for an atom scattering from a rigid rotor with a P2 anisotropy, and propagate them with renormalized Numerov. Extract S-matrices and state-to-state j=0→2 cross sections versus collision energy.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Static-exchange singlet and triplet s-wave phase shifts for electron–hydrogen
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the integro-differential static-exchange equations for e⁻–H(1s) by iterating the exchange kernel with Numerov. Compute singlet and triplet phase shifts versus k, and compare their scattering lengths.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Cooper minimum in sodium 3s photoionization from a model potential
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute the 3s bound orbital and energy-normalized εp continuum orbitals in a Na model potential. Evaluate the dipole matrix element and cross section versus photon energy, and locate the Cooper minimum where the radial integral changes sign.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Confinement resonances in photoionization of endohedral H@C60
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Model C60 as an attractive spherical shell well and compute 1s bound and εp continuum radial functions for the caged atom. Obtain the oscillatory photoionization cross section, and compare with free hydrogen and a phase-shift interference model.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Bethe logarithm of hydrogen 1s from frequency-dependent radial responses
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute the p-wave response function of hydrogen 1s by solving inhomogeneous radial ODEs over a range of frequencies. Assemble the Bethe logarithm integral with subtraction of its high-frequency asymptotics, and compare with ln k0 = 2.984.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Photoassociation free–bound Franck–Condon factors for ultracold alkali pairs
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute zero-energy s-wave scattering functions on a ground-state vdW potential and bound vibrational levels of an excited −C3/R³ potential. Evaluate free–bound overlaps, and show their oscillation with the node structure set by the scattering length.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Shake-off probabilities after tritium beta decay
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Project the tritium 1s orbital onto bound and continuum states of He⁺ obtained numerically. Compute the sudden-approximation probabilities of remaining in the 1s and 2s states and of ionization, and check completeness.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Bogoliubov excitation spectrum of a 1D harmonically trapped condensate
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Find the GPE ground state, then solve the discretized Bogoliubov–de Gennes eigenproblem. Compare mode frequencies with the noninteracting ladder and with Stringari's Thomas–Fermi result ω=ω0√(n(n+1)/2).

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Λ single-particle levels in hypernuclei from a Woods–Saxon well
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Shoot for s, p, d, f Λ levels in a Woods–Saxon potential across hypernuclei from ¹³C to ²⁰⁸Pb. Fit the depth to binding energies and show the linear dependence of B_Λ on A^{-2/3}.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Thomas–Ehrman shift of the 1/2⁺ level in mirror nuclei ¹³C/¹³N
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute the neutron s-wave bound state in a Woods–Saxon well, then the proton analog with added Coulomb potential as a bound or near-threshold resonance. Quantify the anomalous Coulomb displacement relative to the d-wave state.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: One-neutron halo of ¹¹Be: ANC, radius and soft dipole strength
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Fit a Woods–Saxon well to the 2s1/2 separation energy and compute the asymptotic normalization coefficient and rms radius. Compute the E1 strength dB/dE to p-wave continuum states and compare with the analytic halo formula.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Milne amplitude-phase method for highly excited eigenvalues
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate the nonlinear Milne equation for a smooth amplitude in a quartic or Woods–Saxon well and quantize through the accumulated phase. Show uniform accuracy for high quantum numbers where Numerov needs fine grids.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Dirac oscillator radial spectrum: numerics versus exact formula
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate coupled radial Dirac equations with the Moshinsky–Szczepaniak oscillator coupling and shoot for eigenvalues. Compare with the exact spectrum, including its degeneracies and nonrelativistic limit.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: 1D soft-Coulomb hydrogen spectrum as the softening parameter vanishes
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute even and odd levels of −1/√(x²+a²) by Numerov for decreasing a. Follow the anomalous ground state's divergence and the approach of excited states to the Loudon doubly degenerate hydrogenic series.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Lang–Kohn jellium surface: self-consistent density and work function
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the 1D Kohn–Sham equations with LDA for a semi-infinite jellium of given r_s, using a planar Poisson ODE. Compute the Friedel-oscillating density, surface dipole barrier and work function.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: KLI exact-exchange optimized effective potential for beryllium
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Build the Krieger–Li–Iafrate local exchange potential from orbital Slater potentials computed with radial Poisson solves, and iterate to self-consistency. Compare the total energy, eigenvalues and −1/r asymptotics with HF and LDA.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Momentum-space hydrogen orbitals by numerical Fourier–Bessel transform versus Podolsky–Pauling
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute hydrogen nl radial orbitals with Numerov and Hankel-transform them to momentum space using spherical Bessel quadrature. Check normalization, ⟨p²⟩ via the virial theorem, and agreement with the Gegenbauer closed forms.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Length, velocity and acceleration gauge oscillator strengths with local and nonlocal potentials
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute f-values for hydrogen and for an l-dependent alkali pseudopotential from Numerov eigenstates in all three gauges. Show that the gauges agree for local potentials and that the velocity form fails when the potential is nonlocal in l.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Dipole transition rates and oscillator strengths

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Free-free Gaunt factor of hydrogenic bremsstrahlung from Coulomb continuum integrals
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate energy-normalized Coulomb continuum functions numerically. Evaluate the continuum–continuum dipole matrix elements in acceleration form so the integrals converge, sum over l to get the free-free Gaunt factor versus photon energy, and compare with the Kramers value.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Dipole transition rates and oscillator strengths

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Commutator-free fourth-order Magnus integrator versus RK4 for chirped two-level dynamics
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Propagate a strongly chirped two-level Hamiltonian with RK4, the exponential midpoint rule, and a 4th-order commutator-free Magnus scheme. Compare global error scaling, unitarity loss, and cost at equal accuracy.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Floquet–Magnus high-frequency expansion accuracy for a periodically driven spin
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute the exact monodromy matrix of a spin-1/2 under strong periodic driving by ODE integration and extract the exact Floquet Hamiltonian. Compare it with the first- to third-order Magnus/van Vleck effective Hamiltonians versus drive frequency.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Photon-assisted tunneling through a double barrier with an oscillating well
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Build a Floquet transfer matrix for a double-barrier structure whose well bottom oscillates harmonically, coupling sidebands E+nħω. Compute sideband transmission probabilities and compare with Tien–Gordon Bessel-function weights.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Lab-frame stability windows of a particle in a rotating anisotropic harmonic trap
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Write the lab-frame equations of a particle in a trap whose anisotropic axes rotate at Ω and integrate them over one period. Map stability versus Ω and anisotropy from monodromy eigenvalues, and check against rotating-frame normal-mode frequencies.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Scattering length of a Morse potential versus well depth
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate the zero-energy radial equation for a Morse potential and extract the s-wave scattering length from the asymptotic slope. Map poles and zeros versus depth, correlate the poles with appearing bound states, and compare with the analytic Morse result.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Low-energy scattering length and effective range

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Scattering length and effective range of a repulsive soft-sphere step potential
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate the s-wave radial equation for a finite repulsive spherical step of height V0. Extract a and r_e from low-k phase shifts, compare with the analytic formula a=R[1−tanh(κR)/(κR)], and show the hard-sphere limit.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Low-energy scattering length and effective range

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Hydrogen–hydrogen spin-exchange cross section from singlet and triplet phase shifts
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute partial-wave phase shifts on model singlet and triplet H–H potentials by Numerov, including scattering lengths at threshold. Form the spin-exchange cross section from sin²(δ_t−δ_s) versus collision energy, as relevant to hydrogen maser frequency shifts.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Low-energy scattering length and effective range

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Demkov exponential-coupling model: transition probability versus analytic formula
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate a two-state system with constant detuning and exponentially varying coupling over a large time window. Compare the asymptotic transition probability with the Demkov sech²-type formula across detunings.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Selective field ionization paths through a ramped alkali Rydberg Stark manifold
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Diagonalize a truncated alkali n-manifold in a field with quantum-defect couplings, then integrate the state amplitudes under a linear field ramp. Compare the final state distribution with independent-crossing LZ estimates across ramp speeds.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Fractional-occupation E(N) curvature and Janak's theorem in an LDA carbon atom
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Run spherical KS-LDA for carbon with fractional 2p occupation and compute E(N) between the cation and the neutral atom. Verify dE/dn equals the orbital eigenvalue, then quantify the curvature and the Slater transition-state ionization energy.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Immersion energy of helium in jellium from spherical Kohn–Sham LDA
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the self-consistent KS-LDA problem for a helium nucleus embedded in a uniform electron gas, with radial boundary conditions matched to the bulk. Compute the effective-medium immersion energy versus background density and its linear low-density slope.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Becke-88 GGA exchange in a spherical Kohn–Sham atom versus LDA
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Implement the B88 exchange energy and its functional derivative for spherical densities in a radial self-consistent KS code. Compare neon and argon exchange and total energies against LDA and against reference exact-exchange values.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Pruess piecewise-constant method for the near-degenerate Coffey–Evans eigenvalues
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Approximate the Coffey–Evans potential by piecewise constants with exact segment propagators. Shoot with Prüfer-angle indexing to resolve its nearly degenerate eigenvalue triplets, and study convergence versus segment count compared with Numerov.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Razavy hyperbolic double well: quasi-exact levels versus numerical shooting
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute the low levels of the Razavy potential (ζcosh2x−M)² by Numerov shooting. Compare them with the algebraic quasi-exactly solvable eigenvalues, and track the tunneling splittings versus ζ.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Born–Oppenheimer versus exact 2D eigenvalues for a light–heavy collinear model
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: For a model with one light and one heavy particle in 2D model potentials, compute adiabatic potential curves by solving the light-particle equation at each heavy coordinate. Solve the vibrational ODE on these curves and compare with exact 2D finite-difference eigenvalues versus mass ratio.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Proton-transfer tunneling splitting in a symmetric double-Morse O–H···O potential
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Construct a Lippincott–Schroeder-style double-Morse potential for a hydrogen bond. Compute the proton levels and tunneling splitting by Numerov versus O–O distance, and identify the low-barrier crossover.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Bound states in model molecular potentials

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Ring-puckering vibrations of trimethylene oxide in a quartic–quadratic potential
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the reduced-mass puckering equation with V=ax⁴−bx² by Numerov or matrix methods. Fit a and b to observed low transitions, and compute the level pattern and barrier height.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Bound states in model molecular potentials

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Electrons on liquid helium: Rydberg surface states with Stark tuning
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the 1D image-charge hydrogenic problem above a helium surface, with a finite repulsive barrier and an applied perpendicular field. Compute the 1→2 transition frequency versus field for Stark-tuning resonance.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Upsilon leptonic decay widths from wavefunctions at the origin in Buchmüller–Tye
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the bottomonium radial equation in the Buchmüller–Tye potential by Numerov to get nS levels and |R_n(0)|². Apply the Van Royen–Weisskopf formula with QCD correction for the Υ(nS)→e⁺e⁻ widths.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Yukawa fifth-force constraints from hydrogen 1S–2S level shifts
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Add a Yukawa term αe^{−r/λ}/r to the hydrogen Coulomb potential and compute the 1S and 2S shifts by Numerov. Map the bound on α versus range λ given an assumed experimental uncertainty, and compare with first-order perturbation theory.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Screened Coulomb and modified Coulomb potentials

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Manning–Rosen potential bound states: numerics versus approximate analytic formula
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute s- and l>0 levels of the Manning–Rosen potential by radial shooting. Compare with the Nikiforov–Uvarov or Greene–Aldrich approximate formulas and quantify their error versus screening parameter.
physics/quantum_mech|ode.area: Screened Coulomb and modified Coulomb potentials

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Temkin–Poet s-wave helium: adiabatic hyperspherical potential curves
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: For the s-wave-only helium model, solve the hyperangular eigenproblem at each hyperradius to get adiabatic curves. Then solve the hyperradial ODE for ground and doubly excited energies, and compare with direct 2D results.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Landau-level states bound around a repulsive antidot
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the radial equation in the symmetric gauge with a hard-disk boundary at radius R, using confluent hypergeometric shooting. Compute the energies versus angular momentum and the antidot-bound states between Landau levels.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Electron bound to a dyon: monopole-modified centrifugal barrier and Coulomb levels
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the radial Schrödinger equation for a charge bound to a Coulomb center carrying magnetic charge, with centrifugal term [j(j+1)−q²]/r² from monopole harmonics. Compare the numerical spectrum with the analytic formula and examine the lowest j=|q| levels.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Curvature-induced bound state in a bent two-dimensional quantum waveguide
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Reduce a thin bent waveguide to the 1D equation with geometric potential −κ(s)²/4 plus transverse corrections. Compute the bound-state energy below threshold for circular-arc bends versus bend angle, and compare with a 2D finite-difference solution.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Von Neumann–Wigner bound state embedded in the continuum
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Construct the von Neumann–Wigner potential from a modulated sin(kr) trial function. Verify by Numerov integration that a normalizable state exists at positive energy, and show that small perturbations turn it into a narrow resonance.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Bixon–Jortner decay of a discrete state into a quasi-continuum ladder
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate the amplitude equations for one level coupled to an equally spaced ladder. Compare the early-time decay with the golden-rule rate, and locate the recurrences at the Heisenberg time 2πħ/δ.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Bragg Mach–Zehnder atom interferometer: gravity phase and finite-pulse velocity selectivity
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate coupled momentum-state equations for π/2–π–π/2 Bragg pulses with gravity-induced Doppler shifts. Compute the output-port fraction versus kgT² phase, and quantify contrast loss from velocity spread and finite pulse duration.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Raman-dressed spin–orbit-coupled atoms: double-minimum dispersion and trapped dipole oscillations
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Compute the two-component single-particle dispersion of Raman-coupled atoms with equal Rashba–Dresselhaus SOC. Integrate the spinor TDSE in a harmonic trap and compare the dipole-oscillation frequency with the effective-mass prediction versus Raman coupling.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Ideal Fermi gas in an anharmonic 3D trap: shell-sum density versus Thomas–Fermi
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the radial equations for a quartic-perturbed isotropic trap and fill shells to N fermions. Compare the exact density and kinetic energy with the Thomas–Fermi local-density approximation and its edge failure.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Simplified Skyrme t0–t3 Hartree–Fock for oxygen-16 and calcium-40
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve spherical self-consistent Skyrme mean-field equations with a density-dependent potential and Coulomb term by Numerov and density mixing. Compute binding energies, rms radii, and single-particle levels for ¹⁶O and ⁴⁰Ca.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Neutron analyzing power on lead-208 from a spin–orbit optical potential
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Integrate the radial equations for j=l±1/2 with a complex Woods–Saxon plus Thomas spin–orbit optical potential. Build the spin-flip and non-flip amplitudes, then compute the differential cross section and analyzing power.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Collinear vibrational excitation: close coupling versus distorted-wave Born
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve coupled-channel equations for an atom colliding collinearly with an exponentially coupled harmonic oscillator. Compute the 0→1 and 0→2 probabilities, and compare with DWBA and the semiclassical forced-oscillator result versus energy.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Selective adsorption resonances of helium on a corrugated Morse surface
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Set up coupled-channel equations for diffraction channels of helium on a periodically corrugated Morse potential. Integrate them to get specular intensity versus incidence angle, and identify dips at the bound-state resonance conditions.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Wigner function of a wavepacket split by a rectangular barrier
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Propagate a Gaussian packet through a barrier by split-operator and compute its Wigner function by FFT. Separate the transmitted and reflected lobes and the interference fringes, and track the negativity volume versus time.

physics/quantum_mech|ode.title: Jackiw–Rebbi kink: zero mode and bound levels of the 1D Dirac equation
physics/quantum_mech|ode.gist: Solve the two-component 1D Dirac equation with a tanh mass kink by shooting. Verify the topologically protected zero mode, and compute the excited bound states versus kink width against the analytic spectrum.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Behler-Parrinello radial and angular symmetry functions for Lennard-Jones argon clusters
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute G2 radial and G4 angular atom-centred symmetry functions with cosine cutoff for random LJ argon clusters. Fit per-atom energies by ridge regression to total LJ energies and report test RMSE per atom.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Analytic forces and NVE dynamics from a linear symmetry-function potential
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Derive position gradients of G2/G4 symmetry functions and validate them against finite differences. Use the forces of a linear model fitted to LJ reference energies in velocity-Verlet MD and measure energy drift.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Gaussian-process potential for a Morse chain with variance-driven active learning
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Fit a GP with squared-exponential kernel on pair-distance descriptors to Morse-chain energies. Iteratively add the configurations of highest posterior variance and track the error decrease against random selection.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Linear Chebyshev cluster-expansion potential fitted to Sutton-Chen copper energies
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Build two- and three-body descriptors from Chebyshev radial bases times angular Legendre terms for strained and vacancy-containing fcc Cu. Solve a regularised least-squares fit to Sutton-Chen EAM energies and compare body orders.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Energy versus force matching for training a descriptor potential
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Fit a linear symmetry-function model to Stillinger-Weber silicon using energies only, forces only, or a weighted combination of both. Compare force RMSE and phonon-frequency accuracy as a function of training-set size.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Bootstrap committee uncertainty of a linear potential for LJ13 cluster extrapolation
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Train a bootstrap ensemble of ridge models on symmetry functions of thermalised LJ13 clusters. Show that the committee spread grows for compressed or dissociated geometries and correlates with the true error.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Learning-curve exponents for kernel regression on 2D Lennard-Jones liquid snapshots
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Represent atomic environments of 2D LJ configurations by smoothed pair-distance histograms and fit local energies with Gaussian-kernel KRR. Extract the power-law exponent of test error versus training-set size.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Fitting an EAM embedding function through Gaussian electron-density descriptors
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute a per-atom Gaussian density descriptor for perturbed fcc metal configurations. Fit pair and embedding-polynomial coefficients linearly to Sutton-Chen reference energies, then predict the vacancy formation energy.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Reverse NEMD kinetic-energy exchange for thermal conductivity of a Lennard-Jones fluid
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Exchange velocities between the hottest particle of the cold slab and the coldest particle of the hot slab. Fit the steady-state temperature gradient and divide the imposed heat flux by it to obtain the thermal conductivity.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Non-equilibrium MD and SLLOD shear flow

chemistry/md|particles.title: Boundary-driven Couette flow and slip length of a 2D fluid between atomic walls
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Shear an LJ fluid between two moving tethered walls with wall-only Langevin thermostatting. Fit the binned velocity profile and extrapolate to obtain the slip length as a function of wall-fluid interaction strength.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Non-equilibrium MD and SLLOD shear flow

chemistry/md|particles.title: Body-force-driven Poiseuille flow viscosity in a Lennard-Jones slit pore
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Apply a uniform gravity-like force to fluid atoms between fixed walls under a profile-unbiased thermostat. Fit a parabola to the velocity profile and compare the resulting viscosity with homogeneous NEMD.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Non-equilibrium MD and SLLOD shear flow

chemistry/md|particles.title: Shear thinning and normal stress differences of a 2D WCA fluid
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Run SLLOD at a range of strain rates and record viscosity together with the first and second normal-stress differences. Fit a Carreau model to the viscosity curve and report the onset strain rate of shear thinning.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Non-equilibrium MD and SLLOD shear flow

chemistry/md|particles.title: Periodic-perturbation cosine-acceleration method for Lennard-Jones viscosity
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Apply an external acceleration A cos(2πz/L) to all particles and project out the steady velocity-profile amplitude. Compute the viscosity, extrapolate to zero wavevector, and compare with SLLOD results.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Non-equilibrium MD and SLLOD shear flow

chemistry/md|particles.title: Flow alignment of a dumbbell fluid under SLLOD shear
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Shear a FENE dumbbell fluid with SLLOD and Lees-Edwards boundaries. Compute the bond order tensor, the flow-alignment angle and the nematic order parameter as functions of Weissenberg number.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Non-equilibrium MD and SLLOD shear flow

chemistry/md|particles.title: Flyvbjerg-Petersen blocking of potential-energy series from Lennard-Jones MD
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Recursively pairwise-average a correlated energy time series and compute the variance estimate with its own error at each blocking level. Detect the plateau automatically and report the error bar and statistical inefficiency.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Block averaging and statistical error analysis

chemistry/md|particles.title: Moving-block bootstrap error of a diffusion coefficient from MSD slopes
chemistry/md|particles.gist: From a single Lennard-Jones MD trajectory, resample time blocks of unwrapped displacements to build bootstrap MSD curves. Fit the diffusion coefficient on each replicate and study how the error depends on block length.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Block averaging and statistical error analysis

chemistry/md|particles.title: Validating blocking and autocorrelation estimators on AR(1) processes
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Generate AR(1) series with known correlation parameter φ and compute the exact variance of the mean. Compare the coverage of blocking, ACF-integration and naive error estimates over many realisations.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Block averaging and statistical error analysis

chemistry/md|particles.title: Block-wise error bars on Green-Kubo self-diffusion integrals
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Split a velocity time series into independent blocks, compute the VACF running integral in each, and report the mean D(t) with its standard error. Use the result to choose an integration cutoff where signal-to-noise collapses.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Block averaging and statistical error analysis

chemistry/md|particles.title: Delta-method versus blocking errors for the compressibility factor ratio estimator
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Estimate Z = PV/NkT, with P obtained from virial and kinetic contributions, using blocked covariances of correlated observables. Compare the delta-method propagated error with direct blocking of Z.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Block averaging and statistical error analysis

chemistry/md|particles.title: Benettin largest Lyapunov exponent with tangent dynamics for Hénon-Heiles
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Co-integrate the variational equations with the Hessian alongside the trajectory and renormalise the deviation vector periodically. Converge the maximal Lyapunov exponent for representative regular and chaotic orbits.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Ergodicity and chaos in Hamiltonian systems

chemistry/md|particles.title: Full Lyapunov spectrum and Kolmogorov-Sinai entropy of the FPUT beta chain
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Evolve a set of tangent vectors with repeated QR reorthonormalisation for a periodic FPUT-β chain. Obtain the Lyapunov spectrum, check pairing symmetry, and sum the positive exponents to get the KS entropy.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Ergodicity and chaos in Hamiltonian systems

chemistry/md|particles.title: Equipartition time of FPUT chains from normalised spectral entropy
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute the spectral entropy of time-averaged normal-mode energies for long-wavelength initial conditions. Extract the equipartition time from the effective-number-of-modes threshold and its power-law dependence on energy density.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Ergodicity and chaos in Hamiltonian systems

chemistry/md|particles.title: Lyapunov exponent across the solid-liquid transition of a small 2D Lennard-Jones cluster
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Run microcanonical MD of an LJ7 planar cluster at a series of total energies with tangent-space dynamics. Relate the maximal Lyapunov exponent to the onset of isomerisation and to Lindemann fluctuations.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Ergodicity and chaos in Hamiltonian systems

chemistry/md|particles.title: Lyapunov exponent of a periodic Sinai billiard via collision tangent maps
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Propagate a point particle among periodic hard-disk scatterers with analytic collision times. Apply the reflection-curvature tangent map at each collision and compare the Lyapunov exponent with Pesin/escape estimates.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Ergodicity and chaos in Hamiltonian systems

chemistry/md|particles.title: Analytic three-body Stillinger-Weber forces and NVE energy conservation
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Derive the SW angular-term forces, verify them against central finite differences, and run velocity-Verlet MD of 64-atom diamond Si. Measure the energy-fluctuation scaling with time step.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Tersoff T3 silicon relative stability of diamond, beta-tin and simple cubic
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Implement the Tersoff bond-order energy with smooth cutoff and compute E(V) curves, optimising c/a for β-tin. Construct the common-tangent transition pressure from diamond to β-tin.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Tersoff carbon: diamond, graphene and linear-chain cohesive energies
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Evaluate the 1988 Tersoff carbon potential for diamond, graphene and a linear chain at optimised bond lengths. Relate the bond order b_ij to coordination and reproduce the Pauling-like bond-energy trend.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Relaxed vacancy formation energy in Stillinger-Weber silicon
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Remove one atom from a 216-atom diamond supercell and relax the structure by conjugate-gradient minimisation using analytic SW forces. Compute the formation energy relative to the bulk and the inward relaxation of the neighbours.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Zone-centre optical phonon of Stillinger-Weber silicon from finite-difference force constants
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Build the dynamical matrix of the two-atom diamond cell at Γ and along Γ-X from finite-displacement forces in a supercell. Report the Raman optical frequency and acoustic sound velocities.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Monatomic water (mW) lattice energies of hexagonal versus cubic ice
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Implement the mW Stillinger-Weber variant with λ=23.15 and build ice Ih and Ic oxygen lattices. Minimise the density and compare lattice energies, cohesive density and the Ih-Ic energy difference.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Tersoff SiC zinc-blende versus rocksalt energetics with mixing rules
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Implement the multicomponent Tersoff potential with geometric mixing rules for Si-C interactions. Compute E(V) for zinc-blende and rocksalt SiC, and extract the lattice constant, bulk modulus and transition pressure.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Si(100) surface energy: unreconstructed versus 2×1 dimer reconstruction with Stillinger-Weber
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Build slab supercells, create symmetric dimers, and relax them with SW forces while keeping bottom layers fixed. Compute surface energies per area and the dimer bond length.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Parallel-tempering Langevin dynamics in a 1D double-well and replica round-trip times
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Run M Langevin replicas at geometric temperatures and attempt Metropolis neighbour swaps periodically. Measure swap acceptance, barrier-crossing rates at the lowest temperature, and mean round-trip times in temperature space.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Constant-acceptance temperature ladder from heat capacity for an LJ13 cluster
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Estimate C_V(T) from short simulations and space temperatures so that predicted swap acceptance, from energy-distribution overlap, is uniform. Compare round-trip times with a geometric ladder.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Hamiltonian replica exchange with barrier scaling for a dihedral torsion model
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Simulate a three-fold torsional potential with replicas that scale the barrier height by λ. Swap with the Hamiltonian-exchange criterion and reconstruct the unbiased rotamer populations and their convergence.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Multiple-histogram reweighting of parallel-tempering data for a cluster heat capacity
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Combine energy histograms from all PT replicas of a 2D LJ7 cluster with self-consistent WHAM equations for the density of states. Compute a continuous C_V(T) and locate the melting peak.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Velocity rescaling after temperature swaps and detailed balance check in REMD
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Implement REMD for coupled harmonic oscillators with momenta rescaled by √(T_new/T_old) after swaps. Verify that the canonical distribution is preserved and that acceptance depends only on potential energies.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Yoshida fourth-order composition versus velocity Verlet on the Kepler problem
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Build the triple-jump composition from leapfrog substeps and integrate an eccentric Kepler orbit. Measure global position error and energy error versus time step, and fit order-of-convergence slopes.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Omelyan PEFRL and Forest-Ruth integrators on an anharmonic chain
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Implement Forest-Ruth and position-extended Forest-Ruth-like schemes for an FPUT-β chain. Compare energy-error constants and cost per accuracy at fixed numbers of force evaluations.

chemistry/md|particles.title: RESPA resonance instability for stiff diatomics in a Lennard-Jones bath
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Split harmonic bond forces (inner) from LJ forces (outer) in reversible RESPA. Scan the outer time step to reveal energy blow-up near half-periods of the bond vibration and quantify the resonance windows.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Shadow Hamiltonian of velocity Verlet for a Lennard-Jones fluid
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Construct the fourth-order modified energy from positions, velocities and forces along a Verlet trajectory using finite-difference interpolation. Show that its fluctuations scale as Δt⁴ while the true energy fluctuates as Δt².

chemistry/md|particles.title: Phase-space area preservation of leapfrog versus RK4 for the pendulum
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Evolve a small polygon of initial conditions and compute the Jacobian determinant of the flow map numerically. Show long-time area preservation for symplectic schemes and secular drift for RK4.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Bit-reversible integer leapfrog and Lyapunov-limited reversibility in Lennard-Jones dynamics
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Run a Levesque-Verlet integer-lattice leapfrog alongside a floating-point integrator, then reverse velocities. Show exact return for the integer scheme and exponential loss of reversibility for floating point, quantified by the deviation growth rate.

chemistry/md|particles.title: RESPA with switched short- and long-range Lennard-Jones force splitting
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Partition LJ pair forces with a smooth switching function into fast near and slow far parts. Measure energy conservation and speed-up versus inner/outer step ratio and switching width.

chemistry/md|particles.title: RATTLE constrained dynamics of rigid three-site water molecules
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Implement iterative SHAKE position and RATTLE velocity corrections for O-H and H-H constraints in a small water box with LJ+Coulomb (cutoff) interactions. Monitor constraint violations, tolerance dependence and energy drift.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Finite-temperature elastic constants by the stress-fluctuation formula
chemistry/md|particles.gist: In NVT LJ solid MD, compute the Born term, stress-tensor fluctuations and kinetic contribution. Assemble C_ijkl and compare with finite-strain stress differences at the same temperature.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Sutton-Chen EAM copper elastic constants and Cauchy-relation violation
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute the virial stress of the many-body Sutton-Chen potential under ±strain and assemble the cubic constants by linear stress-strain fits. Quantify C12 − C44 caused by the embedding term.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Young's modulus and Poisson ratio of a 2D triangular spring network
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Strain a periodic triangular lattice of harmonic springs, with optional random dilution, and relax the internal coordinates. Compute 2D elastic constants and compare with the analytic √3k/2 relations as rigidity percolation is approached.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Christoffel sound velocities and Voigt-Reuss-Hill moduli from a computed elastic tensor
chemistry/md|particles.gist: From the cubic elastic constants of a model solid, solve the Christoffel eigenproblem over propagation directions for longitudinal and transverse wave speeds. Compute VRH bulk and shear moduli and the Zener anisotropy.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Born stability limits of Lennard-Jones fcc under hydrostatic tension and compression
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute pressure-dependent stress-strain coefficients B_ijkl along the isotropic deformation path. Locate the strain at which a Born criterion (bulk spinodal or shear) first fails and identify the unstable mode.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Tersoff graphene in-plane stiffness and Poisson ratio from strained sheets
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Apply uniaxial and biaxial in-plane strains to a periodic graphene sheet with the Tersoff carbon potential, relaxing the internal coordinates. Extract the 2D stiffness and the Poisson ratio from energy curvatures.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Iterative Boltzmann inversion recovering a Lennard-Jones potential from its g(r)
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Generate a target g(r) from LJ MD, then start from the potential of mean force and iterate V ← V + kT ln(g/g_target) with short MD runs. Track convergence of the potential and residual.

chemistry/md|particles.title: IBI with linear pressure-ramp correction for a WCA target fluid
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Augment IBI updates with a linear correction term that drives the virial pressure to the target value. Compare the trade-off between g(r) and pressure accuracy with and without the correction.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Henderson-theorem sensitivity: distinguishing pair potentials from noisy g(r)
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Simulate two fluids whose potentials differ by a small perturbation and compute their g(r) difference relative to statistical noise. Estimate how much sampling is needed to resolve the potential uniquely.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Boltzmann inversion of bonded distributions for a coarse-grained bead-spring polymer
chemistry/md|particles.gist: From an atomistic-like chain trajectory, map monomers to beads and histogram bond lengths, angles and dihedrals with Jacobian corrections. Invert them to bonded potentials and validate by CG simulation.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Relative-entropy minimisation for coarse-grained Lennard-Jones parameters
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Optimise ε and σ of a CG pair potential by Newton steps using ensemble averages of ∂U/∂λ in target and model ensembles. Report the converged parameters and the decrease in relative entropy.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Density transferability of an IBI potential for a 2D soft-disk fluid
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Derive an IBI potential at one density and apply it at neighbouring densities. Quantify the g(r), pressure and energy errors against the reference to illustrate the state-point dependence of the CG potential.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Collision frequency and mean free path of hard spheres versus Enskog theory
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Measure the distribution of free-flight times and distances in EDMD across packing fractions. Compare the collision rate with the Enskog prediction using the Carnahan-Starling g(σ).

chemistry/md|particles.title: Self-diffusion of hard spheres and correlated deviations from Enskog
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute MSD and VACF from event-driven trajectories, which require interpolating between events. Report the ratio D/D_Enskog as a function of density, showing the enhancement from vortex backflow.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Square-well fluid event-driven dynamics with capture, escape and bounce events
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Solve the core and well-boundary crossing times and apply energy-conserving well-crossing rules. Compute the pressure and potential energy, and compare with the Barker-Henderson first-order prediction.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Lubachevsky-Stillinger compression to random jammed hard-disk packings
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Grow particle diameters at a constant rate during EDMD of bidisperse disks with modified collision times. Extrapolate the reduced pressure to locate the jamming packing fraction and study its dependence on compression rate.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Hard-sphere fluid in a slit pore and the wall contact theorem
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Add sphere-wall collision events to EDMD and compute the wall pressure from impulse transfer. Compare it with kT times the contact density obtained from the density profile, and examine layering near the walls.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Leapfrog half-step kinetic energy and temperature bias in a harmonic crystal
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Integrate a harmonic fcc lattice with leapfrog. Compare temperatures from half-step velocities, averaged half-steps, and interpolated on-step velocities. Check the timestep-dependent bias against the analytic modified-frequency result for each normal mode.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Hessian-derived maximum stable timestep for a Lennard-Jones fcc crystal
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Build the LJ fcc dynamical matrix, find the highest phonon frequency, and predict the Verlet stability limit omega_max dt = 2. Verify the onset of energy blow-up in NVE runs near that limit.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Numerical phonon dispersion distortion in a Verlet-integrated monatomic chain
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Integrate a harmonic 1D chain with velocity Verlet and extract mode frequencies from the Fourier transform of normal-mode trajectories. Compare with the exact dispersion and the discrete-time prediction 2/dt arcsin(omega dt/2) across the Brillouin zone.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Finite-difference symplecticity test of one-step maps for a Morse oscillator
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute the one-step Jacobian M of velocity Verlet, explicit Euler and RK2 maps for a 1D Morse oscillator by central differences. Evaluate the deviation of M^T J M from J and of det M from 1 across phase space, and relate it to long-time energy behaviour.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Boris leapfrog pusher for a charged particle in crossed E and B fields
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Implement the Boris rotation scheme for a charged particle in uniform magnetic and electric fields. Measure the gyrophase error versus omega_c dt, check exact energy conservation for E = 0, and recover the E×B drift velocity.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Verlet neighbour-list skin thickness, rebuild frequency and energy conservation
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Implement a Verlet neighbour list with a cell-list build and a half-skin maximum-displacement rebuild criterion for an LJ fluid. Measure rebuild interval, pair-evaluation count and energy drift versus skin width, and identify the cost-optimal skin.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Gear fifth-order predictor-corrector versus velocity Verlet energy conservation
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Implement Gear's fifth-order predictor-corrector and velocity Verlet for LJ argon. Compare short-time energy fluctuations and long-time drift as functions of timestep to show the non-symplectic integrator's superior short-time but worse long-time behaviour.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Relaxed and unrelaxed vacancy formation energy convergence in Lennard-Jones fcc
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute E_f = E(N-1) - (N-1)/N E(N) for a vacancy in LJ fcc supercells of increasing size. Use conjugate-gradient relaxation of positions. Report the relaxation energy and extrapolate the formation energy in 1/N.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Point defects and vacancy formation energies

chemistry/md|particles.title: Octahedral, tetrahedral and dumbbell self-interstitials in Lennard-Jones fcc
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Insert an extra atom at octahedral, tetrahedral and <100> split-dumbbell sites of an LJ fcc supercell, relax each structure, and rank the interstitial formation energies. Check stability via the lowest Hessian eigenvalue.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Point defects and vacancy formation energies

chemistry/md|particles.title: Vacancy formation to cohesive energy ratio: Sutton-Chen nickel versus Lennard-Jones
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute relaxed vacancy formation and cohesive energies for Sutton-Chen many-body Ni and for pair-potential LJ. Show that the pair potential gives E_v ≈ E_coh while the embedding term lowers the ratio toward experimental values.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Point defects and vacancy formation energies

chemistry/md|particles.title: Divacancy binding energy versus separation in Lennard-Jones fcc
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Create vacancy pairs at first, second and third neighbour separations in a relaxed LJ fcc supercell. Compute the binding energy E_b = 2E_f(1v) - E_f(2v) for each shell to determine which configuration is bound.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Point defects and vacancy formation energies

chemistry/md|particles.title: Vineyard harmonic transition-state theory vacancy jump rate in a 2D Lennard-Jones crystal
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Locate the minimum and saddle for a vacancy hop in a triangular LJ crystal. Diagonalise both Hessians to obtain the Vineyard prefactor, and compare the resulting Arrhenius rate with jump counts from direct Langevin MD at elevated temperature.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Point defects and vacancy formation energies

chemistry/md|particles.title: Harmonic vacancy formation entropy and equilibrium vacancy concentration in LJ fcc
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute the vibrational formation entropy of a vacancy from log-determinant differences of perfect and defective LJ fcc Hessians. Combine it with E_f to predict equilibrium vacancy concentration versus temperature.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Point defects and vacancy formation energies

chemistry/md|particles.title: Reaction-field boundary dependence of the dipole-fluctuation dielectric formula
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Simulate a dipolar fluid with a spherical-cutoff reaction field for several ε_RF values. Apply the Neumann fluctuation formula to show that the inferred ε is approximately independent of the chosen ε_RF.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Distance-resolved Kirkwood factor G_K(r) in a Stockmayer fluid
chemistry/md|particles.gist: From dipolar-fluid trajectories, compute G_K(r), the sum of μ_i·μ_j within radius r normalised by μ². Use its plateau to estimate ε via the Kirkwood-Fröhlich relation and compare with the box-fluctuation result.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Clausius-Mossotti check for a fluid of classical Drude oscillators
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Simulate a gas of neutral atoms with harmonically bound Drude charges. Compute ε from induced-dipole fluctuations and compare with the Clausius-Mossotti prediction from the analytic polarisability q²/k.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Applied-field linear response versus fluctuation formula for dielectric constant
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Apply a weak uniform field to a dipolar fluid and measure the induced polarisation slope. Compare this with ε obtained from zero-field dipole fluctuations, and check where linearity breaks down.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Lyddane-Sachs-Teller relation from dipole autocorrelation of a diatomic ionic chain
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Simulate a 1D chain of alternating charged masses on harmonic springs. Compute ε(ω) from the polarisation autocorrelation, and verify ε(0)/ε(∞) = (ω_LO/ω_TO)² using the extracted TO frequency.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Bussi thermostat effective conserved energy and timestep dependence
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Implement Bussi rescaling with exact sampling of the kinetic-energy Ornstein-Uhlenbeck step. Accumulate the thermostat work to form the effective energy, and measure its drift versus timestep as an integration-quality diagnostic.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Andersen collision frequency effect on Lennard-Jones self-diffusion
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Thermostat an LJ liquid with Andersen stochastic collisions at varying collision frequency ν. Compute diffusion coefficients from MSD and show their suppression relative to NVE, compared with the simple estimate D(ν) = D_0/(1 + ν τ_D).

chemistry/md|particles.title: Nosé-Hoover thermal-mass dependence of temperature oscillation period
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Couple an LJ solid to a single Nosé-Hoover thermostat with different thermal masses Q. Measure the period of kinetic-energy oscillations, compare it with the linearised prediction, and assess relaxation behaviour.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Hot-solvent cold-solute artefact in a globally thermostatted binary mixture
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Simulate a heavy-light LJ binary mixture under a global Berendsen thermostat. Compute separate species temperatures, and compare with per-species coupling and with the Bussi thermostat to quantify the equipartition violation.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Gaussian isokinetic thermostat and canonical configurational sampling of LJ7 cluster
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Integrate a 2D LJ7 cluster with a Gaussian isokinetic constraint. Verify that potential-energy distributions match canonical reference data from Langevin dynamics, and check exact kinetic-energy conservation.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Rugh configurational temperature as a thermostat diagnostic
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute the configurational temperature ⟨|∇U|²⟩/⟨∇²U⟩ for LJ fluids under several thermostats and timesteps. Compare it with the kinetic temperature to detect integration errors and non-equilibrium artefacts.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Double pendulum largest Lyapunov exponent versus total energy
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Integrate the planar double pendulum symplectically together with its tangent dynamics. Compute the largest Lyapunov exponent by Benettin renormalisation across energies to map the transition from regular to chaotic motion.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Ergodicity and chaos in Hamiltonian systems

chemistry/md|particles.title: SALI chaos indicator for the x²y² quartic oscillator
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Evolve two deviation vectors for the Pullen-Edmonds quartic oscillator and compute the Smaller Alignment Index. Classify a grid of initial conditions as regular or chaotic, and report the chaotic fraction versus coupling.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Ergodicity and chaos in Hamiltonian systems

chemistry/md|particles.title: Finite-time Lyapunov exponent distributions for a 2D Lennard-Jones trimer
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute finite-time Lyapunov exponents over many trajectory segments of a planar LJ3 cluster at several energies. Analyse how the mean, variance and shape of the distribution change through the isomerisation regime.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Ergodicity and chaos in Hamiltonian systems

chemistry/md|particles.title: Microcanonical kinetic-energy distribution test of ergodicity for few soft disks
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Run NVE dynamics of a few soft-repulsive disks in a periodic box. Compare the time-averaged single-particle kinetic-energy histogram with the exact microcanonical finite-N distribution derived from the potential-energy density of states.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Ergodicity and chaos in Hamiltonian systems

chemistry/md|particles.title: Chaotic scattering time-delay fractal in the three-hill potential
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Scatter particles off three Gaussian hills in 2D and record dwell time versus impact parameter. Estimate the box-counting dimension of the singular set and the exponential escape rate.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Ergodicity and chaos in Hamiltonian systems

chemistry/md|particles.title: Frequency-map analysis of intramolecular vibrational energy redistribution in a local-mode triatomic
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Model a symmetric ABA molecule with two Morse stretches and kinetic coupling. Extract fundamental frequencies by windowed Fourier analysis, measure frequency diffusion between time halves, and map resonances that drive IVR.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Ergodicity and chaos in Hamiltonian systems

chemistry/md|particles.title: Discrete breather lifetime in a thermalised Klein-Gordon lattice
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Construct a discrete breather in a quartic Klein-Gordon chain by anti-continuum Newton iteration. Embed it in a thermal background and measure the decay of its local energy versus temperature.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Ergodicity and chaos in Hamiltonian systems

chemistry/md|particles.title: Thirumalai-Mountain energy metric for ergodic convergence in Lennard-Jones liquid and solid
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute the fluctuation metric of time-averaged single-particle energies between independent NVE trajectories. Fit the diffusive 1/t decay to obtain ergodic convergence rates for a liquid and contrast with a slowly converging crystal.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Ergodicity and chaos in Hamiltonian systems

chemistry/md|particles.title: Lyapunov exponent across the phase transition of the Hamiltonian mean-field model
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Integrate the N-rotor Hamiltonian mean-field model with tangent dynamics. Compute magnetisation and largest Lyapunov exponent versus energy density to locate the chaos peak near the critical energy.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Ergodicity and chaos in Hamiltonian systems

chemistry/md|particles.title: Primitive versus virial kinetic-energy estimators for ring-polymer harmonic oscillator
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Sample a P-bead ring polymer for a harmonic oscillator using staging-coordinate MD. Compare primitive and virial kinetic-energy estimators with (ħω/4)coth(βħω/2), and show how the primitive estimator's variance grows with P.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Normal-mode PILE thermostat efficiency in path-integral MD
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Transform ring-polymer coordinates to free-particle normal modes and apply the optimally damped PILE-L Langevin thermostat. Measure integrated autocorrelation times of energy estimators versus centroid friction for an anharmonic oscillator.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Quantum position distribution in a quartic double well by PIMD
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute the quantum thermal position density in a symmetric double well with PIMD. Validate it against grid-diagonalisation Boltzmann averages, and quantify tunnelling-enhanced barrier population versus temperature.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Proton quantum kinetic energy in a Morse O-H bond versus temperature
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Use PIMD with a virial estimator to compute the proton kinetic energy in a 1D Morse O-H potential. Compare with the harmonic quantum prediction and the classical value, and show the zero-point plateau at low temperature.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Quantum delocalisation and binding energy of a Ne13 cluster by PIMD
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Simulate an LJ Ne13 cluster with ring polymers. Compute total energy, bead radius of gyration and bond-length fluctuations as functions of bead number, and compare with classical MD at the same temperature.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Centroid potential of mean force versus Feynman-Hibbs effective potential
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Constrain the ring-polymer centroid on a grid for a quartic oscillator and integrate the mean constraint force to obtain the centroid PMF. Compare it with the quadratic Feynman-Hibbs effective potential at several temperatures.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Ring-polymer radius of gyration versus thermal de Broglie wavelength
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Sample ring polymers for a free particle and a harmonic oscillator. Compute the bead radius of gyration versus temperature and compare with analytic λ_T/√12 and harmonic closed-form results.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Bennett acceptance ratio from combined insertion and deletion energies
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Collect Widom insertion energies in an N-particle system and deletion energies in an (N+1)-particle system. Solve the BAR equation for μ_ex, and use overlapping-distribution plots to show advantages over one-sided estimates at liquid density.

chemistry/md|particles.title: WCA fluid chemical potential versus Carnahan-Starling with effective hard-sphere diameter
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Use Widom insertion in MD of the purely repulsive WCA fluid. Compare with Carnahan-Starling μ_ex using the Barker-Henderson temperature-dependent hard-sphere diameter.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Rosenbluth test-chain insertion for bead-spring oligomers in LJ solvent
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Grow test chains bead by bead into LJ solvent configurations using Rosenbluth trial positions. Compute the excess chemical potential versus chain length from Rosenbluth weights, and compare it with naive random insertion.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Henry's constant and solvation enthalpy of a small solute in LJ solvent
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Insert a smaller, weakly interacting LJ solute into LJ solvent at several temperatures to obtain Henry's constant. Use a van't Hoff analysis to separate solvation enthalpy and entropy.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Uniform chemical potential across an LJ fluid in a slit pore
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Simulate an LJ fluid between 9-3 walls and compute local Widom μ_ex(z) together with the density profile. Verify that the total μ = kT ln ρ(z) + V_wall(z) + μ_ex(z) is constant across the pore.

chemistry/md|particles.title: MBAR versus binned WHAM statistical efficiency on umbrella data
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Apply binless MBAR and binned WHAM to the same umbrella sampling data for an asymmetric double well. Compare PMF bias and variance over many independent repeats as functions of bin width and sample size.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Kästner umbrella integration versus WHAM for a barrier crossing
chemistry/md|particles.gist: From umbrella windows, compute the mean and variance of the coordinate in each window, form Gaussian estimates of dA/dξ, and integrate them. Compare the barrier height and error with WHAM.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Solvent-mediated PMF between two LJ solutes from umbrella sampling
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Restrain the distance between two solute particles in an LJ solvent with harmonic windows. Reconstruct the PMF with WHAM including the Jacobian term, and identify contact and solvent-separated minima.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Butane torsional PMF from umbrella sampling of a united-atom model
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Simulate united-atom butane with harmonic bonds, angles and the Ryckaert-Bellemans dihedral using Langevin dynamics, with umbrellas on the dihedral angle. Recover the periodic PMF with WHAM and the trans-gauche free-energy difference.

chemistry/md|particles.title: End-to-end distance PMF of a bead-spring chain versus freely jointed chain
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Bias the end-to-end distance of a short FENE bead-spring chain in implicit Langevin solvent. Compute the PMF with WHAM and compare the extracted force-extension curve with freely jointed chain theory.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Liquid and amorphous Stillinger-Weber silicon structure and bond-angle distribution
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Melt and quench SW silicon with NVT MD. Compute g(r), coordination numbers and bond-angle distributions for the liquid and amorphous states, contrasting the sixfold-like liquid with the tetrahedral amorphous network.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Tetrahedral order parameter of mW water versus temperature
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Run MD of the monatomic water model using its SW-form three-body term. Compute the Errington-Debenedetti tetrahedral order parameter distribution and density versus temperature in supercooled conditions.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Tersoff silicon phonon dispersion along Gamma-X from a finite-difference dynamical matrix
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute force constants of diamond Si with the Tersoff potential by finite displacements in a supercell. Fourier-transform them to the dynamical matrix, and obtain acoustic and optical branches along Γ-X.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Axilrod-Teller triple-dipole correction to argon fcc cohesive energy and lattice constant
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Add the Axilrod-Teller-Muto three-body term to an LJ argon fcc lattice sum. Compute the three-body contribution to the cohesive energy and the shift in equilibrium lattice constant, with convergence in triplet cutoff.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Basin-hopping global minima of small Stillinger-Weber silicon clusters
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Find the lowest-energy structures of Si_n clusters (n = 3 to 10) with the SW potential by basin hopping. Report binding energy per atom, the stability second difference, and mean coordination.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Tetrahedrality parameter λ tuning of Stillinger-Weber crystal stability
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Vary the SW three-body strength λ and compute minimum energies of diamond, bcc, fcc and β-tin lattices. Locate the λ values where the ground state switches from diamond to close-packed structures.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Persistence length of a semiflexible bead-spring chain with cosine bending potential
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Simulate a single chain with harmonic bonds and a three-body angular bending potential using Langevin dynamics. Compute the tangent-tangent correlation decay to obtain the persistence length, and compare with κ/kT.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Generalised stacking-fault energy of Stillinger-Weber silicon on shuffle and glide planes
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Rigidly slide the (111) shuffle-set and glide-set planes of SW silicon along <110> and <112>, relaxing atoms perpendicular to the plane. Compute γ-surface profiles and unstable stacking-fault energies.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Permutation-invariant Kabsch RMSD between LJ38 cluster configurations
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute minimum RMSD between LJ38 cluster snapshots by alternating Hungarian atom assignment and Kabsch SVD rotation, including inversion. Compare with fixed-labelling RMSD along an MD trajectory.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Collective variables and principal component analysis

chemistry/md|particles.title: Trajectory PCA of a Rouse bead-spring chain versus analytic Rouse modes
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Run Langevin dynamics of a harmonic bead-spring chain and diagonalise the Cartesian covariance matrix after removing centre-of-mass motion. Compare eigenvalues and eigenvectors with analytic Rouse mode amplitudes and cosine modes.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Collective variables and principal component analysis

chemistry/md|particles.title: Pentane two-dihedral distribution and the gauche-gauche pentane effect
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Simulate united-atom pentane including the 1-5 LJ interaction with Langevin dynamics. Histogram the joint (φ1, φ2) dihedral distribution and quantify the suppression of g+g- conformers relative to an independent-dihedral model.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Collective variables and principal component analysis

chemistry/md|particles.title: Quasi-harmonic and Schlitter configurational entropy from trajectory covariance
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute mass-weighted covariance matrices from trajectories of an anharmonic chain or small LJ cluster. Evaluate the Andricioaei-Karplus quasi-harmonic and Schlitter entropy estimates and their convergence with trajectory length.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Collective variables and principal component analysis

chemistry/md|particles.title: Dihedral PCA with sin/cos embedding for a three-torsion chain
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Map the dihedrals of a hexane-like united-atom chain to sin/cos coordinates and perform PCA. Construct a free-energy landscape on the first two components, and compare its conformer clustering with naive Cartesian PCA.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Collective variables and principal component analysis

chemistry/md|particles.title: Fraction of native contacts in an off-lattice Go-model hairpin folding
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Simulate a 2D Cα Go-model β-hairpin with native-contact LJ attractions. Compute the Best-Hummer-Eaton native contact fraction Q, its free-energy profile F(Q) and the folding midpoint temperature.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Collective variables and principal component analysis

chemistry/md|particles.title: Standard metadynamics free energy of a quartic double well versus hill parameters
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Overdamped Langevin particle in a 1D quartic double well biased by Gaussian hills on x. Reconstruct F(x) from the negative accumulated bias and measure the RMS error against the exact profile as a function of hill height, width and deposition stride.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Well-tempered metadynamics on the Wolfe-Quapp surface and bias-factor convergence
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Langevin dynamics on the 2D Wolfe-Quapp potential with well-tempered Gaussian hills deposited on both coordinates. Compute F = -(γ/(γ-1))V_bias on a grid and track how the free-energy error and barrier estimate converge for several bias factors γ.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Multiple-walker well-tempered metadynamics on a 1D triple-well potential
chemistry/md|particles.gist: N Langevin walkers share one well-tempered bias on a 1D triple-well potential. Measure how the free-energy error versus total simulation time depends on the number of walkers, and compare one long walker against many short ones.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Adaptive biasing force PMF of a Lennard-Jones dimer in 2D WCA solvent
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Accumulate bin-wise instantaneous mean forces along the solute-solute distance of an LJ dimer in a 2D WCA solvent. Apply the running ABF bias with a sample-count ramp, then integrate the mean force to obtain the PMF and its contact-minimum depth.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Variationally enhanced sampling with a Fourier-basis bias on a 1D potential
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Minimise the Valsson-Parrinello functional Ω[V] for a periodic 1D multi-well potential sampled by Langevin dynamics. The bias is expanded in a Fourier basis and optimised by averaged stochastic gradient descent with a uniform target distribution. Return the converged coefficients and the resulting F(s).

chemistry/md|particles.title: Path collective variables s and z for metadynamics on a three-well surface
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Define the Branduardi path CVs s and z from a discretised reference path that joins three minima of a 2D potential. Run metadynamics on s, compute the free energy along the path, and compare the barrier with the exact minimum-energy-path estimate.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Coordination-moment metadynamics of the 2D Lennard-Jones heptamer isomers
chemistry/md|particles.gist: For the planar LJ7 cluster, compute switching-function coordination numbers and their second and third central moments as CVs. Run well-tempered metadynamics in this 2D CV space and extract the free-energy differences between the hexagonal ground state and the excited isomers at low temperature.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Neighbour shells and coordination of generated fcc, bcc, hcp and diamond lattices
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Build periodic supercells for the four lattices from primitive vectors and bases. Compute the minimum-image distance shells, coordination numbers and packing fractions, and check them against the analytic shell sequences.

chemistry/md|particles.title: FIRE versus steepest-descent relaxation of random overlapping LJ configurations
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Place particles uniformly at random at liquid density, which creates strong overlaps. Relax them with capped-force steepest descent and with the FIRE algorithm, and compare the iterations needed to reach a force tolerance and the energy of the resulting starting configuration.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Planar elongational flow of a WCA fluid with Kraynik-Reinelt boundaries
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Integrate SLLOD equations for planar elongation with an isokinetic thermostat. Use Kraynik-Reinelt periodic cell remapping at the magic rotation angle, and extract the steady elongational viscosity and the Trouton ratio relative to the shear viscosity.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Non-equilibrium MD and SLLOD shear flow

chemistry/md|particles.title: Transient-time correlation function viscosity of a WCA fluid at low shear rate
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Launch many short SLLOD trajectories from equilibrium starting states. Compute the TTCF integral of the shear-stress response correlated with the initial dissipation function, and compare its noise with direct non-equilibrium averaging as the strain rate decreases.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Non-equilibrium MD and SLLOD shear flow
