chemistry/md|particles.title: Self-diffusion tensor of a sheared Lennard-Jones fluid with Taylor-dispersion removal
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Track peculiar displacements in a Lees-Edwards SLLOD simulation and remove the affine contribution to the MSD analytically. Extract the anisotropic diffusion coefficients D_xx, D_yy and D_zz and their shear-rate dependence.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Non-equilibrium MD and SLLOD shear flow

chemistry/md|particles.title: Colour-field NEMD self-diffusion of a Lennard-Jones fluid
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Apply opposite colour forces to two labelled halves of an LJ fluid under an isokinetic thermostat. Measure the colour current versus field strength, extrapolate the colour conductivity to zero field, and compare the resulting D with an equilibrium MSD estimate.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Non-equilibrium MD and SLLOD shear flow

chemistry/md|particles.title: Atomic versus molecular SLLOD thermostatting for a FENE bead-spring melt
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Shear a short-chain Kremer-Grest melt with SLLOD in Lees-Edwards boundaries. Compare the viscosity, the first normal stress difference and the profile-unbiased temperature obtained with atomic and with molecular-centre-of-mass thermostats.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Non-equilibrium MD and SLLOD shear flow

chemistry/md|particles.title: Bagnold scaling of a sheared granular soft-sphere fluid with Lees-Edwards
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Shear inelastic Hertzian or linear-dashpot spheres in Lees-Edwards boundaries with no thermostat, so the steady granular temperature is set by dissipation. Compute the stress tensor and verify the Bagnold scaling of stress with the square of the strain rate.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Non-equilibrium MD and SLLOD shear flow

chemistry/md|particles.title: Dissipative particle dynamics viscosity and Schmidt number under Lees-Edwards shear
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Integrate a Groot-Warren DPD fluid with its pairwise dissipative-random thermostat under Lees-Edwards shear. Extract the viscosity from the stress versus strain rate, compute the self-diffusion coefficient, and form the Schmidt number as a function of the friction γ.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Non-equilibrium MD and SLLOD shear flow

chemistry/md|particles.title: Evans-Searles fluctuation theorem for entropy production in SLLOD shear
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Run many short SLLOD trajectories of a small isokinetic WCA system and accumulate the time-integrated dissipation function Ω_t. Test ln[P(Ω_t = A)/P(Ω_t = -A)] = A against simulation for several durations.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Non-equilibrium MD and SLLOD shear flow

chemistry/md|particles.title: MD isotherms of LJ pressure and energy versus the Johnson MBWR equation
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Run NVT MD on a (ρ, T) grid with long-range tail corrections to collect the pressure and internal energy. Compare the results with the 33-parameter modified Benedict-Webb-Rubin equation and report the deviation map.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Joule-Thomson inversion curve of the Lennard-Jones fluid
chemistry/md|particles.gist: From a smooth fitted equation of state (virial at low density, MBWR or a fitted polynomial), compute the isenthalpic derivative condition T(∂P/∂T)_ρ = ρ(∂P/∂ρ)_T. Trace the inversion curve in reduced (T, P) units, check selected points with MD derivatives, and compare with the van der Waals prediction.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Zeno line and Batschinski unit-compressibility line of the LJ fluid
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Locate the (T, ρ) points where Z = 1 from MD pressure isotherms using interpolation and root finding. Test whether the Zeno line is straight and extrapolate it to the Boyle temperature and the Boyle density predicted from B2 and B3.

chemistry/md|particles.title: LJ liquid radial distribution function, coordination numbers and potential of mean force
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Histogram minimum-image pair distances from an NVT trajectory with ideal-gas shell normalisation. Integrate 4πρr²g(r) up to the first minimum for the coordination number, and compare w(r) = -kT ln g(r) with the bare pair potential.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Force-based low-variance RDF estimator versus histogram binning
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Implement the Borgis-Rotenberg force-integration estimator of g(r), which uses the pair forces projected onto r̂. Compare its statistical variance per frame with conventional histogramming for an LJ fluid at several bin widths.

chemistry/md|particles.title: RDF of a 2D Yukawa liquid versus coupling parameter Γ
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Run 2D MD of Yukawa (screened Coulomb) particles at fixed κ and several coupling strengths Γ, then compute 2D-normalised g(r). Track the first-peak height and the splitting of the second peak that precedes freezing.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Virial-route versus compressibility-route pressure consistency for the LJ fluid
chemistry/md|particles.gist: From one g(r), compute the pressure by the virial integral and the isothermal compressibility from the running integral of h(r) with a large-r tail correction. Compare the compressibility with numerical differentiation of the MD pressure along the isotherm.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Two-body excess entropy from g(r) and Rosenfeld scaling of diffusion
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute s2 = -2πρ∫[g ln g - g + 1] r² dr for an LJ liquid at several states. Pair it with self-diffusion coefficients from MSD, reduce D by Rosenfeld macroscopic units, and fit the exponential excess-entropy scaling law.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Charge ordering in the restricted primitive model with Wolf summation
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Run MD of soft-core ±q ions using Wolf damped-shifted Coulomb forces. Compute like and unlike RDFs, the charge-charge correlation function, and the second moment, which tests the Stillinger-Lovett condition.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Johnson analytic EAM copper: cohesive energy, lattice constant and bulk modulus
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Implement Johnson's exponential EAM density, pair and embedding functions for fcc Cu. Scan the lattice constant to find the equilibrium a0, E_coh and bulk modulus B, and verify that the potential reproduces its fitted inputs.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Finnis-Sinclair molybdenum bcc versus fcc structural energy difference
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Evaluate the Finnis-Sinclair square-root embedding with cubic pair and density functions for bcc and fcc Mo. Minimise each over volume, and report lattice constants, cohesive energies and the bcc-fcc energy difference.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Analytic EAM many-body forces and NVE energy conservation for aluminium
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Derive the EAM force F_i = -Σ_j [φ' + (F'_i + F'_j)ρ'] r̂_ij and validate it against finite differences. Then run velocity-Verlet MD of fcc Al and check that the energy drift scales as dt².

chemistry/md|particles.title: Gupta potential silver clusters: icosahedral, decahedral and cuboctahedral energetics
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Construct 13-, 55- and 147-atom Mackay icosahedra, Ino decahedra and cuboctahedra, and relax each with the Rosato-Guillopé-Legrand potential. Compute energies per atom and the size at which the preferred motif crosses over.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Size-dependent melting of EAM copper nanoparticles from heating ramps
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Heat spherical fcc Cu nanoparticles of several radii by Langevin MD. Locate the melting temperature from the caloric curve and the Lindemann index, and fit the Pawlow 1/R depression.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Rose universal binding-energy relation test of an EAM energy-volume curve
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute E(a) for an EAM metal over a large strain range and fit it to the Rose universal equation of state using the scaled length a*. Compare the fitted bulk modulus and pressure derivative B' with those obtained from direct derivatives.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Intrinsic stacking-fault energy of EAM copper from layer-stacking energies
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Build ABC stacking supercells with an inserted intrinsic fault, compute the relaxed fault energy, and compare it with the ANNNI estimate from hcp, dhcp and fcc energies.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Johnson EAM alloy model: L1₂ Ni₃Al ordering and formation energy
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Combine elemental Johnson EAM functions with Johnson's alloy pair cross term. Compute the formation energies of ordered L1₂ Ni₃Al and of random substitutional fcc supercells, giving the ordering energy and lattice-constant mismatch.

chemistry/md|particles.title: MBAR free energies across temperatures for a Langevin double well
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Combine samples from Langevin simulations of a 1D double well at K temperatures. Solve the MBAR equations by Newton or fixed-point iteration, derive the free energies and their covariance from the Fisher information, and reweight the well-population ratio to unsampled temperatures.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Zwanzig FEP forward/backward bias versus BAR for argon-to-krypton mutation
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Mutate the σ and ε of one solute particle in LJ solvent through a few λ states. Compare one-sided exponential averaging in each direction with BAR, quantifying bias versus phase-space overlap and sample size.

chemistry/md|particles.title: MBAR reweighting of LJ pressure to unsampled ε and σ parameters
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Run NVT MD of an LJ fluid at a few force-field parameter sets and evaluate all frames under the full parameter grid. Use MBAR to predict pressure and energy, with uncertainties, at unsampled parameters, and track the number of effective samples.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Linear-response versus MBAR charging free energy of an ion in Stockmayer solvent
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Charge a soft LJ ion in a Stockmayer dipolar solvent through λ windows and solve MBAR for the charging free energy. Compare the result with the two-point linear-response estimate from the mean energy gaps at λ = 0 and 1.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Bootstrap versus asymptotic MBAR uncertainty with correlated samples
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Generate correlated Gaussian-state AR(1) samples for which the exact ΔF is known. Compare the MBAR covariance estimate, an estimate using subsampling at the statistical inefficiency, and a block bootstrap, assessing coverage of the true value.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Frenkel-Ladd Einstein-crystal MBAR free energy of LJ fcc versus hcp
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Couple LJ fcc and hcp crystals to Einstein springs along λ windows with a fixed centre of mass. Solve MBAR for the absolute free energies, add the analytic Einstein term, and resolve the small fcc-hcp free-energy difference.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Thermodynamic-length optimal λ spacing for MBAR in a harmonic-to-quartic switch
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Estimate the variance of dU/dλ along a switch from a harmonic to a quartic potential and compute the thermodynamic length. Place λ states at equal length increments, and compare the MBAR error with equally spaced λ at fixed total sampling.

chemistry/md|particles.title: SHAKE iteration counts versus tolerance and timestep for a rigid-bond chain
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Apply Gauss-Seidel SHAKE to a linear chain of rigid bonds with LJ nonbonded interactions. Measure the iterations needed per step versus tolerance, timestep and chain length, along with the energy drift of constrained velocity Verlet.

chemistry/md|particles.title: M-SHAKE Newton iteration versus Gauss-Seidel SHAKE for bead-rod polymers
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Solve the bond-constraint multipliers of a branched or ring bead-rod polymer with matrix (Newton) SHAKE and with standard SHAKE. Compare the quadratic and linear convergence rates and the cost per step.

chemistry/md|particles.title: LINCS expansion-order accuracy for constrained alkane-like chains
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Implement LINCS with a truncated series inversion of (I - A) and a rotational-lengthening correction. Quantify the residual constraint deviation versus expansion order and coupling-matrix eigenvalues for chains with bond-angle coupling.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Rigid diatomic N₂-like fluid with SHAKE: energy conservation and rotational relaxation
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Model a two-site LJ fluid with constrained bond length using SHAKE/RATTLE. Measure the energy drift versus timestep and the decay times of the first- and second-rank orientational correlation functions.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Atomic versus molecular virial pressure including constraint forces for rigid propane
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute the pressure of a united-atom rigid propane fluid in two ways: from the atomic virial including SHAKE constraint forces, and from the molecular centre-of-mass virial. Show that the time averages agree while the instantaneous fluctuations differ.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Hydrogen mass repartitioning and maximum stable timestep for constrained ethane
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Model an all-atom ethane with C-H bonds constrained by SHAKE and flexible angles. Find the maximum stable timestep from energy drift, with and without moving mass from carbon to hydrogens, and relate it to the highest remaining vibrational frequency.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Quaternion rigid-body integration versus SHAKE for rigid triangular molecules
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Integrate a fluid of rigid three-site triangular LJ molecules two ways: with quaternion-based rotational dynamics, and with atomic coordinates plus three SHAKE bond constraints. Compare energy conservation, cost and agreement of the orientational statistics.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Yeh-Hummer finite-size correction of LJ self-diffusion across box sizes
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute D_PBC for several N, fit D versus 1/L, and compare the slope with the hydrodynamic term ξ kT/(6πηL) using an independently computed viscosity.

chemistry/md|particles.title: VACF Green-Kubo diffusion and the t^(-3/2) long-time tail
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute the velocity autocorrelation function of a moderately dense LJ fluid over long times with FFT correlation. Integrate it for D and compare with the MSD result, then fit the long-time tail amplitude against mode-coupling theory.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Non-Gaussian parameter and van Hove self function in supercooled Kob-Andersen liquid
chemistry/md|particles.gist: From MD trajectories of the Kob-Andersen mixture at decreasing temperatures, compute the MSD plateau, the van Hove self function G_s(r, t) and α2(t). Locate the time of maximal dynamic heterogeneity.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Single-file diffusion of soft particles in a 1D channel
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Simulate Langevin particles with soft repulsion confined to a ring. Show that the tagged-particle MSD crosses over from normal diffusion to √t scaling, and compare the prefactor with the Kollmann prediction from the structure factor.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Darken relation and Maxwell-Stefan interdiffusion in a binary LJ mixture
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute self-diffusion coefficients and the collective interdiffusion Onsager coefficient from centre-of-mass displacements of one species. Combine it with the thermodynamic factor from Kirkwood-Buff integrals and test the Darken approximation.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Rotational diffusion of rigid dumbbells from orientational correlations
chemistry/md|particles.gist: From a dumbbell fluid trajectory, compute the l = 1 and l = 2 orientational correlations and the angular MSD from integrated angular velocity. Test the Debye relation τ_l = 1/[l(l+1) D_r].

chemistry/md|particles.title: Logarithmic system-size divergence of self-diffusion in a 2D LJ fluid
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute D for 2D LJ fluids of increasing box length L. Demonstrate the ln L growth predicted by 2D hydrodynamics and fit the slope against the kT/(4πη) prefactor.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Exact modified Hamiltonian of leapfrog for the harmonic oscillator
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Derive the conserved shadow quadratic form of the Störmer-Verlet map for a harmonic oscillator, which has a modified frequency and stiffness. Show numerically that it is conserved to machine precision, and that it diverges at the ωdt = 2 stability limit.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Blanes-Casas-Sanz-Serna minimum-error two-stage splitting for harmonic models
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Parametrise the two-stage palindromic splitting by b and compute the expected energy error ρ(h, b) for Gaussian targets. Optimise b over a stability interval, and verify with energy errors on a harmonic chain and an LJ crystal.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Wisdom-Holman symplectic mapping for a Sun-Jupiter-Saturn system
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Split the planetary Hamiltonian into Keplerian drifts in Jacobi coordinates, solved with f and g functions, and interaction kicks. Compare energy error and cost against leapfrog in Cartesian coordinates over thousands of orbits.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Chin force-gradient fourth-order integrator versus Forest-Ruth for LJ clusters
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Implement Chin's 4A scheme, which uses the gradient of |F|²/m in the middle kick and has only positive substeps. Compare its error constant and cost-normalised energy error with those of Forest-Ruth for an LJ38 cluster.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Bonded/nonbonded RESPA splitting for a flexible bead-spring polymer
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Integrate FENE and harmonic bonded forces on the inner step and LJ nonbonded forces on the outer step of a Trotter-RESPA scheme. Map the energy drift and speed-up versus the outer-step ratio for a dilute chain in solvent.

chemistry/md|particles.title: NO_SQUISH symplectic splitting for free asymmetric rigid-body rotation
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Integrate the free rotation of an asymmetric top with the Dullweber-Leimkuhler-McLachlan sequence of sub-rotations about the principal axes, using quaternions. Check energy and angular-momentum conservation, second-order convergence, and the intermediate-axis instability.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Sundman time transformation for symplectic integration of eccentric Kepler orbits
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Show that naive adaptive-step velocity Verlet causes secular energy drift for e = 0.9 orbits. Implement a Sundman-transformed, extended-phase-space leapfrog that adapts the step while remaining symplectic, and compare long-time energy and precession errors.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Ermak-McCammon timestep bias for an overdamped particle in a harmonic trap
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Integrate overdamped Brownian dynamics in a harmonic potential using the Ermak-McCammon scheme. Compare the sampled stationary variance and the MSD relaxation with the exact Ornstein-Uhlenbeck results, and quantify the O(Δt) bias.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Kramers turnover of escape rate versus friction in underdamped Langevin dynamics
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Simulate BAOAB Langevin escape from a metastable cubic well across friction values from energy-diffusion to overdamped regimes. Extract rates from survival probabilities and compare with the Kramers low- and high-friction limits and the Mel'nikov-Meshkov interpolation.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Wall-hindered Brownian dynamics with position-dependent diffusion and spurious-drift correction
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Simulate a colloid near a planar wall using the Brenner/Faxén normal diffusion coefficient D(z) under gravity. Show that omitting the kT dD/dz drift term breaks the Boltzmann height distribution, and that including it recovers the distribution.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Northrup-Allison-McCammon association rate with Debye electrostatic steering
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Use BD trajectories launched from a b-surface around a spherical reactive target with a screened Coulomb interaction. Estimate the diffusion-limited association rate from return probabilities and compare it with the Debye-Smoluchowski formula for attractive and repulsive charges.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Rotne-Prager-Yamakawa Brownian dynamics of bead chains: Zimm versus Rouse diffusion
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Implement Ermak-McCammon BD with the RPY mobility tensor and Cholesky-correlated noise for bead-spring chains. Compute centre-of-mass diffusion versus chain length and compare with the Kirkwood formula and the free-draining Rouse scaling.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Fixman Chebyshev square root of the RPY mobility versus Cholesky factorisation
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Approximate the matrix square root of the RPY diffusion tensor for random bead configurations using Fixman's Chebyshev polynomial expansion. Measure noise-covariance error versus polynomial degree and check eigenvalue bounds against exact Cholesky noise.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Short-time versus long-time self-diffusion of Brownian Yukawa colloids
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Run overdamped BD of screened-Coulomb (DLVO) colloids at several volume fractions. Extract the long-time self-diffusion from the MSD, compare with the free short-time value, and test the Löwen dynamic freezing criterion D_L/D_0 ≈ 0.1.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Splitting probabilities between absorbing boundaries in a tilted cosine potential
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Launch BD trajectories from a grid of starting points between two absorbing walls in a potential combining a linear force and a cosine term. Estimate the probability of reaching the right boundary first, and compare with the exact committor integral of the Boltzmann factor.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Entropic barriers in a corrugated 2D channel versus Fick-Jacobs-Zwanzig theory
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Run BD in a periodic 2D channel of sinusoidally varying width with reflecting walls. Compute the effective axial diffusion coefficient and compare it with the Lifson-Jackson integral over the Fick-Jacobs entropic potential, with and without Zwanzig's D(x) correction.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Ewald splitting-parameter optimisation using Kolafa-Perram error estimates
chemistry/md|particles.gist: For random neutral point-charge systems, compute Ewald forces at fixed real-space cutoff and k-cutoff while scanning α. Compare RMS force errors against a converged reference and the Kolafa-Perram analytic error formulas, and locate the optimal α.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Finite-size self-energy of a single ion with neutralising background
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute the Ewald energy of a single charge in cubic boxes of varying size with a uniform background. Verify the Wigner-constant ξ/L scaling, and apply the correction to the charging free energy of an ion in a dielectric continuum.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Dispersion Ewald for r^-6 interactions and cutoff artefacts in an LJ slab
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Implement Ewald summation for 1/r^6 dispersion and validate it against direct lattice sums for an LJ crystal. Apply it to a liquid-vapour slab, comparing pressure-tensor surface tension with truncated-cutoff results.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Conditional convergence of the 1D alternating ionic chain Madelung sum
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compare direct partial sums, charge-neutral cell grouping and a 1D Ewald formula for the alternating ± chain. Recover the 2 ln 2 Madelung constant and quantify convergence rates.

chemistry/md|particles.title: 2D logarithmic Coulomb Ewald sum and the triangular Wigner lattice energy
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Derive the Ewald decomposition for the 2D log(r) interaction with a neutralising background. Compute the Madelung energies of triangular, square and honeycomb lattices for the 2D one-component plasma and check independence of the splitting parameter.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Smooth particle-mesh Ewald energy accuracy versus B-spline order and grid
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Implement SPME with cardinal B-spline charge spreading, the B-spline Euler factors and FFT convolution. Compare reciprocal-space energies and forces with direct Ewald for random charges as spline order and mesh size vary.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Analytic B-spline differentiation versus ik-differentiation in PME forces
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute SPME forces by analytically differentiating the B-splines and, separately, by ik spectral differentiation of the mesh potential. Compare force accuracy, net-force (momentum) violation and energy-force consistency.

chemistry/md|particles.title: NVE energy drift of a molten-salt simulation versus SPME accuracy parameters
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Run velocity-Verlet NVE dynamics of a small rigid-ion salt using SPME electrostatics. Measure energy drift and fluctuation as the grid, spline order and α vary, and relate drift to the RMS force error.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Linked-cell list construction, brute-force validation and O(N) scaling
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Implement head/linked-list cell construction and pair enumeration for a periodic LJ fluid. Verify that the pair set and energy match O(N²) enumeration exactly, and measure timing scaling with N and density.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Cell lists and Verlet neighbor lists

chemistry/md|particles.title: Half-shell cell stencil with Newton's third law versus full neighbour stencil
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Build 2D and 3D half-shell cell stencils that count each pair once, alongside full stencils. Check pair-count identities, force equality and momentum conservation, and compare operation counts.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Cell lists and Verlet neighbor lists

chemistry/md|particles.title: Multi-cutoff neighbour lists for a size-asymmetric binary mixture
chemistry/md|particles.gist: For a mixture of large and small LJ spheres with species-dependent cutoffs, compare single-cell-size lists with species-specific cell grids. Measure distance checks per particle and validate pair sets against brute force.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Cell lists and Verlet neighbor lists

chemistry/md|particles.title: Cell lists under Lees-Edwards sliding-brick boundaries
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Extend linked-cell neighbour search to sheared Lees-Edwards boundaries, with an offset stencil for cells crossing the shearing boundary. Validate pair lists against brute-force sheared minimum-image distances over a full strain cycle.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Cell lists and Verlet neighbor lists

chemistry/md|particles.title: Multiple-image pair enumeration when the cutoff exceeds half the box
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Implement neighbour enumeration that includes all periodic images within a cutoff larger than L/2 for small cells. Verify LJ energies of small crystal unit cells against converged lattice sums, and show the failure of minimum-image counting.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Cell lists and Verlet neighbor lists

chemistry/md|particles.title: Topological 1-2 and 1-3 exclusions in neighbour lists for bead-spring polymers
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Build Verlet lists for a bead-spring polymer melt that exclude bonded and angle-bonded pairs. Validate the nonbonded energy and forces against brute force, and count excluded pairs versus chain length.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Cell lists and Verlet neighbor lists

chemistry/md|particles.title: Fractional-coordinate cell lists for triclinic simulation boxes
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Construct cell lists in skewed triclinic cells using fractional coordinates, sizing the number of cells from the perpendicular widths of the cell. Verify against brute-force triclinic minimum-image enumeration for strongly tilted cells.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Cell lists and Verlet neighbor lists

chemistry/md|particles.title: Replica-exchange umbrella sampling across a hidden orthogonal barrier
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Sample a 2D potential with umbrella windows along x and a slow hidden barrier in y. Compare independent windows with Hamiltonian exchange between neighbouring windows using the WHAM PMF error and the y-transition count.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Exchange attempt interval and sampling efficiency in temperature REMD
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Run Langevin parallel tempering on a 2D double-well model with exchange attempts every n steps. Measure round-trip rates and integrated autocorrelation times of a slow coordinate versus n.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Infinite-swapping parallel tempering with symmetrised reweighting in a double well
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Implement the infinite-swapping limit using symmetrised mixture weights over temperature permutations for a small replica set. Reweight observables back to each temperature and compare variance with standard swap-based PT.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Rough hard spheres: translational-rotational equipartition and collision rules
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Implement event-driven dynamics of perfectly rough hard spheres with Pidduck tangential collision rules. Follow the relaxation of rotational and translational temperatures toward equipartition and compare with kinetic theory.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Hard-sphere shear viscosity via Einstein-Helfand moments with collisional transfer
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Accumulate kinetic and collisional momentum-transfer contributions to the Helfand moment during event-driven hard-sphere MD. Extract shear viscosity from the mean-square Helfand displacement and compare with Enskog theory.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Sedimentation equilibrium of hard spheres under gravity
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Perform event-driven MD with parabolic free flight and solve quadratic-in-time collision prediction. Compute the density profile above the floor and compare it with a local-density Carnahan-Starling hydrostatic solution.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Lorentz gas diffusion among fixed hard-disk scatterers versus Machta-Zwanzig
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Use event-driven dynamics of a point particle in a periodic or random array of fixed disks. Compute the diffusion coefficient from the MSD versus scatterer density and compare with the Machta-Zwanzig random-walk estimate.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Hard-sphere fcc crystal pressure versus Speedy and free-volume equations
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Run event-driven MD of an fcc hard-sphere crystal across packing fractions. Compute pressure from collision rates and compare with Speedy's empirical solid EOS and the Kirkwood free-volume cell theory near close packing.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Tangent hard-sphere chain fluid pressure versus Wertheim TPT1
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Model chains of tangent hard spheres with tethered bonds implemented as infinite square-well events in event-driven MD. Compute the compressibility factor versus density and chain length, and compare with Wertheim's TPT1 EOS.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Hexatic bond-orientational order ψ6 near hard-disk melting
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Simulate hard disks with event-driven MD at packing fractions spanning the fluid-hexatic-solid range. Compute the global ψ6 and the orientational correlation g6(r), and characterise the decay of g6.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Soret coefficient of a binary LJ mixture by NEMD heat exchange
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Apply reverse-NEMD kinetic-energy exchange to an isotope-like binary LJ mixture. Measure the steady temperature and concentration gradients and compute the Soret coefficient versus mass ratio.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Non-equilibrium MD and SLLOD shear flow

chemistry/md|particles.title: Field-driven ionic conductivity of a molten salt versus Nernst-Einstein
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Apply a uniform electric field to a thermostatted rigid-ion melt with Ewald forces. Measure the linear-response current to obtain the conductivity, and compare with the Nernst-Einstein estimate from self-diffusion to obtain the Haven ratio.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Non-equilibrium MD and SLLOD shear flow

chemistry/md|particles.title: Bulk viscosity of the Lennard-Jones fluid from Green-Kubo pressure fluctuations
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Run NVE MD of an LJ liquid, compute the autocorrelation of instantaneous pressure fluctuations about the mean, and integrate it to the bulk viscosity. Compare with the shear viscosity and its density dependence.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Non-equilibrium MD and SLLOD shear flow

chemistry/md|particles.title: Startup shear stress overshoot of a supercooled Kob-Andersen mixture under SLLOD
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Shear a quenched Kob-Andersen binary LJ glass-former from rest with SLLOD and Lees-Edwards boundaries. Record the stress-strain curve, overshoot magnitude and strain at peak versus shear rate and temperature.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Non-equilibrium MD and SLLOD shear flow

chemistry/md|particles.title: Barker-Henderson perturbation theory versus MD Lennard-Jones equation of state
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute the Barker-Henderson effective hard-sphere diameter and the first-order perturbation term using a Percus-Yevick hard-sphere g(r). Compare the resulting pressure and energy along isotherms with MD data.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Quasi-harmonic free energy versus MD pressure for Lennard-Jones fcc solid
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute the LJ fcc lattice energy and phonon frequencies on a k-grid to build the quasi-harmonic free energy and pressure versus density. Compare the QHA predictions with MD pressures and energies at increasing temperatures.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Roskilde isomorphs: density-scaling exponent from virial-energy correlations
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Use NVT MD of the LJ liquid to compute the virial-potential energy correlation coefficient and γ = ⟨ΔWΔU⟩/⟨ΔU²⟩. Trace an isomorph and check invariance of reduced structure and dynamics along it.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Low-density MD compressibility versus truncated virial series
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute B2 and B3 for the LJ potential by quadrature. Compare MD compressibility factors at low and moderate density with the truncated virial series to determine the density range over which the series is accurate at several temperatures.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Fitted Carnahan-Starling-van der Waals EOS and critical constants from MD
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Fit a hard-sphere-plus-attraction EOS with temperature-dependent diameter and attraction parameter to MD isotherms of the truncated-shifted LJ fluid. Derive the critical point from the fit and compare with literature slab values.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Tersoff amorphous silicon by melt-quench and ring-size statistics
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Melt and quench Tersoff Si with MD and relax the final structure. Compute coordination defects and shortest-path ring statistics, comparing with continuous-random-network expectations.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Ideal tensile strength of Stillinger-Weber silicon along [100] and [111]
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Apply incremental uniaxial strain with transverse stress relaxation to diamond SW Si. Compute stress-strain curves, ideal strength and critical strain along the two directions.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Tersoff silicon self-interstitial formation energies: split-110, tetrahedral, hexagonal
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Insert interstitial configurations into Tersoff diamond Si supercells, relax them with conjugate gradients, and compute formation energies and their convergence with supercell size.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Honeycutt-Thirumalai BLN 46-mer β-barrel minima and folding thermodynamics
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Implement the BLN off-lattice model with bond, angle, dihedral and bead-type-dependent LJ terms. Locate low-energy minima by quench MD and compute the heat capacity from Langevin simulations at several temperatures.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Constant-speed mechanical unfolding of a Go-model β-hairpin
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Pull the termini of a Cα Go-model hairpin with a moving harmonic spring under Langevin dynamics. Record force-extension curves and the rupture force versus pulling speed, and compare with the Bell-Evans logarithmic dependence.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Phi-value analysis by contact-energy perturbation in a Go model
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Weaken individual native contacts of a small Go protein and compute the changes in transition-state and native free energies from F(Q) profiles. Obtain residue Φ-values and identify the folding nucleus.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Anisotropic network model B-factors versus Go-model MD fluctuations
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute ANM/GNM normal modes and predicted mean-square fluctuations from the native Cα structure. Compare them with RMSF from native-state Langevin simulations of the corresponding Go model.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Contact order versus folding rate across Go-model topologies
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Build Go models of a helix bundle, a hairpin and a three-stranded sheet of similar length. Compute relative contact order and Langevin folding MFPTs near T_f, and test the correlation between them.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Transition-path time distributions in Go-model hairpin folding
chemistry/md|particles.gist: From long Langevin trajectories of a Go hairpin, identify transition paths between unfolded and native Q thresholds. Compute the transition-path time distribution and compare its mean with the 1D diffusive estimate from F(Q) and D(Q).

chemistry/md|particles.title: Folding temperature of a Go model from parallel-tempering heat capacity
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Run temperature replica exchange of a Cα Go protein. Compute the heat capacity curve and ⟨Q⟩(T), identify T_f, and check consistency between the Cv peak and the midpoint of the Q transition.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Go-model folding cooperativity: van't Hoff versus calorimetric enthalpy ratio
chemistry/md|particles.gist: From REMD data of a Go model, compute the calorimetric enthalpy by integrating the baseline-subtracted Cv and the van't Hoff enthalpy from the Cv peak. Evaluate the ratio as a two-state cooperativity criterion versus contact-energy heterogeneity.

chemistry/md|particles.title: MTK barostat exact volume distribution test with an ideal gas
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Implement Martyna-Tobias-Klein NPT equations with Nosé-Hoover chains for an ideal gas and a harmonic solid. Verify the sampled volume distribution against the exact isothermal-isobaric distribution.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Translation-rotation coupling of a Brownian ellipsoid in lab and body frames
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Simulate a 2D anisotropic Brownian ellipse with different parallel and perpendicular diffusion coefficients and rotational diffusion. Compare lab-frame non-Gaussian displacement statistics with the analytic crossover from anisotropic to isotropic diffusion.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Time-dependent Smoluchowski rate coefficient from Brownian trapping simulations
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Simulate diffusing particles around a static absorbing sphere and record the survival fraction. Compare the time-dependent rate k(t) = 4πDR[1 + R/√(πDt)] with simulation, including a timestep correction for boundary crossings.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Generalised Langevin equation with exponential memory via auxiliary variables
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Embed an exponential-memory GLE into Markovian dynamics using an auxiliary Ornstein-Uhlenbeck variable for a harmonic particle. Compute the VACF and position autocorrelation, and compare with the analytic Laplace-domain solution.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Langer multidimensional rate theory versus BD for an anisotropic saddle
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Simulate overdamped BD escape from a 2D metastable well whose saddle has anisotropic curvature and a diffusion tensor not aligned with the saddle axes. Compare rates with Langer's formula using the unstable eigenvalue and Hessian determinants.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Discrete-timestep overshoot in Brownian first-passage times and bridge correction
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute first-passage times of free diffusion to an absorbing wall with finite-Δt BD, and show the systematic overestimate. Apply the Brownian-bridge crossing probability to recover the Lévy-Smirnov distribution.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Coulomb crystal shell structure of laser-cooled ions in a harmonic trap
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Find minimum-energy configurations of N ions with direct Coulomb repulsion in an isotropic harmonic trap using damped MD. Compute shell occupancies and radial structure, comparing with the continuum uniform-density result.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Particle and molecular dynamics: pair potentials

chemistry/md|particles.title: Phonon dispersion of a 2D Yukawa dusty-plasma crystal
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Build the dynamical matrix of a triangular Yukawa lattice with lattice sums over screening κ. Compute longitudinal and transverse dispersion, and compare with current-correlation spectra from thermal MD.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Particle and molecular dynamics: pair potentials

chemistry/md|particles.title: Exact stationary variances of BBK, BAOAB and GJF Langevin schemes for harmonic oscillator
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Derive and compute the exact discrete-time stationary covariance of position and velocity for the Brünger-Brooks-Karplus, BAOAB and Grønbech-Jensen-Farago integrators on a 1D harmonic oscillator. Use linear recursion and Lyapunov-equation solves, then compare configurational and kinetic temperature errors against simulation as functions of timestep and friction.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Leimkuhler-Matthews high-friction limit versus Euler-Maruyama in a quartic double well
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Implement the BAOAB-limit (Leimkuhler-Matthews) overdamped scheme and Euler-Maruyama for Brownian dynamics in a quartic double well. Measure the weak error in the position histogram and in <x^2> against the exact Boltzmann distribution as a function of timestep to extract the convergence orders.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Geodesic g-BAOAB for a bond-constrained trimer and bond-angle distribution error
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Implement constrained Langevin g-BAOAB with SHAKE/RATTLE projections for a three-bead molecule with rigid bonds and an angle potential. Compare the sampled bond-angle distribution (including the Fixman-free constrained measure) with exact quadrature for several timesteps and numbers of geodesic substeps.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Hard-disk gas heat conduction between stochastic thermal walls versus Enskog conductivity
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Run event-driven hard-disk dynamics in a channel whose walls re-emit particles from Maxwellian distributions at two temperatures, using a collision priority queue. Measure the heat flux from wall energy exchange and the temperature profile, then compare the bulk thermal conductivity with the 2D Enskog prediction.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Mollified impulse versus impulse RESPA on the Fermi-Pasta-Ulam stiff-soft chain
chemistry/md|particles.gist: For Hairer's FPU test problem of alternating stiff harmonic and soft nonlinear springs, implement impulse (Verlet-I/r-RESPA) and mollified impulse (MOLLY) multiple-time-step methods. Track total-energy error and the near-conservation of the stiff oscillatory energy as the outer step crosses resonances.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Symplectic corrector processing of leapfrog for a nonlinear pendulum chain
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Construct kernel-plus-corrector processed integrators, with the corrector built from leapfrog compositions, that cancel the leading BCH error terms. Compare energy-error amplitude and global position error order of processed versus unprocessed leapfrog on a chain of coupled pendula.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Hoover-Holian kinetic-moment thermostat restoring ergodicity of a harmonic oscillator
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Integrate the two-variable Hoover-Holian thermostat controlling both the second and fourth velocity moments of a 1D harmonic oscillator. Verify the extended conserved quantity, and quantify ergodicity through the joint (x,p) histogram and the moments <p^4>, <x^4> compared with canonical values.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Bennett-Chandler reactive flux for a double well coupled to a harmonic bath
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Model a quartic double-well reaction coordinate bilinearly coupled to N harmonic bath oscillators (Caldeira-Leggett). Compute the TST rate from the barrier-top free energy, then the transmission coefficient from the plateau of the reactive-flux correlation of trajectories shot from the dividing surface, as a function of coupling strength.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Transition state theory and rare-event rates

chemistry/md|particles.title: Basin-hopping global minima of LJ_n clusters and Hessian normal-mode spectra
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Search for global-minimum Lennard-Jones cluster structures for n = 7 to 20 by basin hopping with L-BFGS local minimisation, and compare the energies with the known Cambridge Cluster Database values. Diagonalise the mass-weighted Hessian to obtain the vibrational frequencies, the six zero modes and the geometric-mean frequency.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Harmonic superposition heat capacity of LJ7 versus molecular dynamics
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Enumerate the four LJ7 minima by repeated quenching, then compute their energies, normal-mode frequencies and point-group permutational degeneracies. Build the harmonic superposition partition function and its heat capacity peak, and compare it with canonical Langevin MD heat capacities from energy fluctuations.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Morse-potential second virial coefficient and Boyle temperature versus range parameter
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Integrate the Mayer f-function for the Morse potential numerically with adaptive quadrature to obtain B2(T) for several range parameters. Locate the Boyle temperature by root finding, and compare with the analytic square-well B2 matched by well depth and width.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Second virial coefficient from pair potentials

chemistry/md|particles.title: Fourth-order modified Hamiltonian of Störmer-Verlet for a Morse oscillator via symbolic BCH
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Use sympy Poisson brackets and the BCH expansion to build the h² and h⁴ shadow Hamiltonians of velocity Verlet for a Morse oscillator. Evaluate them along numerical trajectories to show that the fluctuation amplitude drops from O(h²) to O(h⁴) to O(h⁶).
chemistry/md|particles.area: Shadow Hamiltonians and integrator error analysis

chemistry/md|particles.title: Shadow-Hamiltonian hybrid Monte Carlo acceptance rates in a double-well chain
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Implement standard HMC and shadow HMC, which accepts trajectories against a fourth-order shadow Hamiltonian and reweights afterwards, for a chain of coupled 1D double wells. Compare acceptance rate versus timestep and system size, and the reweighted observable accuracy against exact values.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Shadow Hamiltonians and integrator error analysis

chemistry/md|particles.title: Vibrational density of states from FFT of VACF for a disordered harmonic chain
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Run NVE velocity-Verlet MD of a 1D mass-disordered harmonic chain and compute the velocity autocorrelation by FFT. Fourier transform it, with windowing, into the vibrational density of states, and compare with the histogram of exact eigenfrequencies of the dynamical matrix.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Lechner-Dellago averaged q6 profile across an LJ fcc(100)-liquid coexistence slab
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Build a Lennard-Jones fcc(100) crystal in contact with its melt, run NVT MD, and compute per-particle averaged q̄6 from Ylm sums over neighbour shells. Bin q̄6 along the slab normal and fit a tanh profile to get the interface width and position.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Radial and angular Lindemann melting of 2D Coulomb clusters in parabolic traps
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Simulate 2D Coulomb clusters in a harmonic trap with Langevin MD. Compute the radial Lindemann index and the intershell angular fluctuation versus temperature to show that orientational melting occurs before radial melting.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Voronoi icosahedral fraction in supercooled Kob-Andersen liquid versus temperature
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Run MD of the Kob-Andersen binary mixture at several temperatures. Compute Voronoi face-index signatures with scipy.spatial and track the population of <0,0,12,0> icosahedral centres as the liquid is cooled.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Five-seven disclination density across melting of 2D r^-12 soft disks
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Run MD of 2D inverse-twelfth-power soft disks at several densities. Count Delaunay coordination defects (5-fold and 7-fold sites) and bound dislocation pairs, and relate the free-defect density to the solid-hexatic-liquid sequence.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Stillinger-cluster size distributions and Yasuoka-Matsumoto nucleation rate in LJ vapour
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Quench a Lennard-Jones vapour into the supersaturated region and run NVE/Langevin MD. Identify Stillinger distance clusters each frame and obtain the nucleation rate from threshold-crossing counts over several cluster-size thresholds.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Reentrant melting of the Gaussian-core-model fcc crystal via Lindemann ratio
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Simulate the Gaussian core model fcc crystal at several densities and temperatures. Compute the Lindemann ratio from mean-square displacements around lattice sites to trace the reentrant melting line at high density.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Morse M13 cluster caloric curves and melting versus potential range
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Run constant-energy MD of icosahedral Morse 13-atom clusters for several range parameters ρ. Build caloric curves and fluctuation heat capacities, then show how the melting temperature and latent-heat signature depend on ρ.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Avrami kinetics of crystallisation in a quenched 2D Lennard-Jones liquid
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Quench a 2D Lennard-Jones liquid below its freezing point under a Langevin thermostat. Classify particles as crystalline by local |ψ6| and fit the time-dependent crystalline fraction to the Johnson-Mehl-Avrami-Kolmogorov law.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Dielectric spectrum of a 2D charged-dumbbell polar liquid from dipole autocorrelation
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Simulate rigid charged dumbbells with SHAKE and Ewald or Wolf electrostatics. Compute the total-dipole autocorrelation and its Fourier-Laplace transform to get ε(ω), then fit Debye and Cole-Cole forms.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Parallel and perpendicular dielectric response of a Stockmayer fluid in a slit pore
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Confine a Stockmayer fluid between LJ 9-3 walls. Compute ε_parallel from in-plane total-dipole fluctuations and ε_perp⁻¹ from normal polarization fluctuations, and compare both with the bulk value.

chemistry/md|particles.title: IR spectrum of a flexible polar diatomic fluid with quantum correction factors
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Run MD of flexible charged Morse diatomics in an LJ bath. Compute the IR absorption from the Fourier transform of the total-dipole autocorrelation and apply standard, harmonic and Schofield quantum correction factors.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Thole-damped self-consistent induced dipoles: iteration versus matrix inversion polarizability
chemistry/md|particles.gist: For small clusters of polarisable atoms with Thole damping, solve for induced dipoles by Jacobi/SOR iteration and by direct dipole-field tensor inversion. Compare the molecular polarizability tensor and induction energy, and check for the polarization catastrophe.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Madelung constants of rocksalt, CsCl, zincblende and fluorite via Wolf summation
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Generate the four ionic lattices and evaluate the Madelung constant with damped-shifted Wolf sums as a function of cutoff and damping. Validate against Ewald-sum reference values.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Square-well second and third virial coefficients and Boyle temperature versus well width
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Evaluate B2 analytically and by quadrature, and B3 by Mayer-cluster Monte Carlo integration, for square-well fluids. Compute the Boyle temperature as a function of well-width ratio λ.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Second virial coefficient from pair potentials

chemistry/md|particles.title: Stockmayer second virial coefficient by orientational quadrature versus dipole expansion
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute B2(T) for the Stockmayer potential by Gauss quadrature over r and relative orientations. Compare with the series expansion in μ²/kT and quantify where truncation fails.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Second virial coefficient from pair potentials

chemistry/md|particles.title: Noro-Frenkel extended corresponding states across short-range attractive potentials
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute B2 for square-well, Yukawa-tail and Mie potentials of varying range and map each to an equivalent square well via reduced B2* and effective diameter. Compare the critical temperatures predicted by the mapping.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Second virial coefficient from pair potentials

chemistry/md|particles.title: Cross second virial coefficient B12 with Lorentz-Berthelot rules and binary interaction parameter
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute B11, B22 and B12 for LJ mixtures with Lorentz-Berthelot combining rules. Determine the mixture B2(x), and fit the binary interaction parameter k_ij that reproduces a target B12.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Second virial coefficient from pair potentials

chemistry/md|particles.title: Buckingham exp-6 second virial coefficient and the unphysical short-range collapse
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Integrate the exp-6 Mayer function with care near the spurious inner maximum and collapse region. Compare B2(T) with LJ for argon-like parameters and quantify how sensitive B2 is to the inner cutoff treatment.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Second virial coefficient from pair potentials

chemistry/md|particles.title: Asakura-Oosawa depletion potential, second virial coefficient and colloid stickiness
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Build the Asakura-Oosawa depletion pair potential for colloid-polymer mixtures. Compute the colloid B2 versus polymer reservoir density and size ratio, and locate the Vliegenthart-Lekkerkerker B2* threshold.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Second virial coefficient from pair potentials

chemistry/md|particles.title: Thermodynamic integration switching on attractions from WCA to LJ in a 2D fluid
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Run MD along the coupling path U = U_WCA + λ U_att and integrate ⟨U_att⟩_λ with Gauss-Legendre quadrature. Compare the result with first-order perturbation theory using the WCA reference.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Distance-angle restraint release free energy for a bound dimer
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Apply harmonic distance and angle restraints to a dimer bound in an LJ environment and compute the restraint free energy by TI over force constants. Compare with the analytic standard-state restraint correction.

chemistry/md|particles.title: 2D WHAM free-energy surface of a Langevin particle on a two-channel potential
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Run harmonic umbrella windows on a 2D grid over a Z-shaped two-channel potential with BAOAB. Combine 2D histograms by iterative WHAM and compare the resulting free-energy surface with the exact Boltzmann-inverted potential.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Polymer adsorption PMF of a bead-spring chain onto an attractive 9-3 wall
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Bias the chain centre-of-mass height above an LJ 9-3 wall with umbrella windows. Recombine the windows by WHAM to get the adsorption free energy versus chain length and wall strength.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Landau-Teller vibrational relaxation of a Morse diatomic in an LJ bath
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Excite a Morse solute in LJ solvent and run NVE ensembles to follow the decay of vibrational energy. Compare the relaxation time with the Landau-Teller rate from the Fourier transform of the force autocorrelation at the vibrational frequency.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Collision-induced dissociation cross-section of a Morse diatomic by atom impact
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Run quasiclassical trajectories of an atom colliding with a Morse diatomic over impact parameters and orientations. Compute the dissociation cross-section versus collision energy and its threshold behaviour.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Anderson localization of phonon modes in a mass-disordered harmonic chain
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Diagonalize the dynamical matrix of a random binary-mass chain. Compute the inverse participation ratio versus frequency and system size, and extract the localization-length scaling with ω.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Zero-temperature string method on the collinear H + H2 LEPS surface
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Implement the simplified string method with arc-length reparametrisation on the LEPS potential for collinear H3. Obtain the MEP and barrier height, and compare with a refined saddle-point Hessian analysis.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Dimer-method saddle search for adatom hopping on Morse fcc(111) with HTST rates
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Use the dimer method to find saddles for fcc-to-hcp site hops of a Morse adatom on fcc(111). Compute Vineyard harmonic TST rates from minimum and saddle Hessians.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Peierls barrier of an edge dislocation in a 2D LJ triangular crystal via NEB
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Insert an edge dislocation into a 2D Lennard-Jones crystal and relax the end states one Burgers vector apart. Compute the glide Peierls barrier with climbing-image NEB.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Finite-temperature string: minimum free-energy versus minimum energy path on a two-channel surface
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Apply the finite-temperature string method with Voronoi-restrained Langevin sampling to a potential with a narrow low-energy channel and a broad entropic one. Show the switch of the dominant pathway with temperature.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Müller-Plathe momentum-swap viscosity of a Yukawa one-component plasma
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Impose a shear flow by periodically swapping x-momenta between slabs. Extract the shear viscosity of the Yukawa OCP from the imposed momentum flux and the fitted velocity gradient, over several coupling values Γ.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Non-equilibrium MD and SLLOD shear flow

chemistry/md|particles.title: Shear melting of a 2D Yukawa crystal under Lees-Edwards SLLOD
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Apply SLLOD shear with sliding-brick boundaries to a 2D Yukawa crystal. Track ψ6 and the shear stress versus strain rate to locate the shear-induced melting threshold.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Non-equilibrium MD and SLLOD shear flow

chemistry/md|particles.title: Oscillatory-shear storage and loss moduli of a 2D soft-disk glass
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Apply sinusoidal SLLOD shear to a polydisperse soft-disk glass. Extract G′ and G″ versus frequency from the stress-strain phase lag and amplitude.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Non-equilibrium MD and SLLOD shear flow

chemistry/md|particles.title: Harmonic bonds, angles and Ryckaert-Bellemans torsions for butane with finite-difference checks
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Implement united-atom butane bond, angle and RB torsion energies with analytic Cartesian gradients. Validate all forces by central finite differences and verify zero net force and torque.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Bonded force fields: bonds, angles, dihedrals

chemistry/md|particles.title: Harmonic versus cosine-harmonic angle forces near linearity for CO2-like molecules
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Derive and implement forces for harmonic-in-θ and harmonic-in-cosθ angle potentials. Demonstrate the 1/sinθ singularity near 180°, its numerical treatment, and the effect on NVE energy drift.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Bonded force fields: bonds, angles, dihedrals

chemistry/md|particles.title: TIP4P massless virtual-site force redistribution and gradient verification
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Construct the TIP4P M-site as a linear combination of atomic positions. Redistribute M-site forces to the real atoms via the chain rule, and verify forces and virial by finite differences.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Bonded force fields: bonds, angles, dihedrals

chemistry/md|particles.title: Improper dihedral and Wilson out-of-plane terms for planar formaldehyde
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Implement the harmonic improper dihedral and the Wilson out-of-plane angle with analytic gradients. Compare the out-of-plane bending frequencies obtained from the Hessian for each form.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Bonded force fields: bonds, angles, dihedrals

chemistry/md|particles.title: Conformer enumeration and Boltzmann populations of united-atom n-hexane
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Enumerate all t/g± dihedral combinations of n-hexane and minimize each conformer with an RB torsion plus 1-4 scaled LJ force field. Compute relative energies and Boltzmann populations versus temperature.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Bonded force fields: bonds, angles, dihedrals

chemistry/md|particles.title: Analytic Hessian normal modes of a Urey-Bradley methane force field
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Build the analytic Hessian of harmonic bond, angle and Urey-Bradley terms for tetrahedral CH4. Mass-weight it, remove translations and rotations, and classify the vibrational frequencies by Td symmetry.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Bonded force fields: bonds, angles, dihedrals

chemistry/md|particles.title: Trans-gauche transition rates in a united-atom polyethylene chain
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Run Langevin MD of a decane-like UA chain with RB torsions. Detect dihedral transitions using stable-state definitions, and compute rates and their Arrhenius parameters, distinguishing end and interior dihedrals.
chemistry/md|particles.area: Bonded force fields: bonds, angles, dihedrals

chemistry/md|particles.title: NPT fluctuation formulas for thermal expansion, compressibility and Cp of a 2D LJ liquid
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Run Langevin-piston NPT MD of a 2D Lennard-Jones liquid. Compute αP, κT and Cp from volume-enthalpy fluctuations and cross-check them against finite differences of mean density and enthalpy.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Lebowitz-Percus-Verlet NVE heat capacity of an r^-12 soft-sphere fluid
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute Cv from microcanonical kinetic-energy fluctuations with the LPV formula. Verify it against the temperature derivative of the energy and the soft-sphere scaling in ρT^(-1/4).

chemistry/md|particles.title: Brillouin peak and sound speed from coherent S(k,ω) of the LJ liquid
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute the coherent intermediate scattering function F(k,t) from density modes and Fourier transform it to S(k,ω). Extract the Brillouin peak dispersion and compare the sound speed with the adiabatic thermodynamic value.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Transverse current correlations and wavevector-dependent viscosity in a Gaussian-core liquid
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute transverse current autocorrelations C_T(k,t) from MD. Fit them to extract η(k), extrapolate to k→0, and identify the shear-wave propagation gap.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Layering and adsorption of an LJ fluid near a Steele 9-3 wall
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Simulate an LJ fluid between 9-3 walls and compute density profiles. Obtain the Gibbs adsorption and layer spacing versus wall strength, and verify mechanical balance through the normal pressure.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Capillary-wave stiffness of a 2D Lennard-Jones liquid-vapour line interface
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Simulate a 2D LJ liquid strip in coexistence with its vapour and extract the interface height profile. Fit the Fourier fluctuation spectrum ⟨|h_q|²⟩ ∝ 1/(γ q²) to obtain the line tension.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Jamming of harmonic soft spheres: pressure and excess coordination scaling
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compress harmonic soft-sphere packings with FIRE minimization across the jamming density φ_J. Compute the scaling of pressure and of z − z_iso with φ − φ_J after removing rattlers.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Gay-Berne pair forces and torques and nematic order parameter
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Implement the Gay-Berne anisotropic potential with analytic forces and torques, verified by finite differences. Run rigid-body MD and compute the nematic order parameter from the Q-tensor across the isotropic-nematic transition.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Classical Lennard-Jones scattering deflection function and rainbow angle
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Compute the classical deflection angle χ(b,E) by quadrature with turning-point handling. Locate the rainbow and orbiting singularities and check them against direct trajectory integration.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Unimolecular evaporation rates of hot LJ19 clusters versus RRK theory
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Run microcanonical MD of LJ19 at high internal energies. Measure first-evaporation times, fit the exponential lifetimes, and compare them with the RRK expression using the dissociation energy and number of modes.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Quasiclassical trajectories for collinear F + H2 on a LEPS surface
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Sample H2 vibrational states with Morse action quantization and run collinear F + H2 trajectories on a LEPS surface. Compute the reaction probability and the product HF vibrational distribution versus collision energy.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Stokes-Einstein test for a large solute diffusing in an LJ solvent
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Simulate WCA solutes of increasing radius in an LJ solvent. Compare D_solute with kT/(cπηR) for stick and slip boundary conditions, using the solvent viscosity from Green-Kubo, and apply the Yeh-Hummer finite-size correction.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Thermal expansion of a 1D Lennard-Jones chain: MD versus exact transfer integral
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Run Langevin MD of a nearest-neighbour LJ chain at fixed tension. Compare the mean bond length versus temperature with the exact transfer-integral result and the low-temperature anharmonic expansion.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Dimer fraction in dilute LJ vapour versus Stogryn-Hirschfelder bound-pair partition
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Run MD of a dilute LJ gas and count bound and metastable pairs using energy and centrifugal-barrier criteria. Compare the dimer fraction with the bound-pair contribution to B2.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Knudsen diffusion in a cylindrical pore with diffuse wall reflection
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Simulate non-interacting molecules in a cylinder with Maxwell diffuse wall reflections. Compute D from the axial MSD and compare with the Knudsen formula D = (2/3) r ⟨v⟩ versus accommodation coefficient.

chemistry/md|particles.title: Temperature-programmed desorption of an LJ adatom and Redhead analysis
chemistry/md|particles.gist: Use Langevin MD of an adatom on an LJ 9-3 surface with a linear heating ramp. Obtain the desorption rate and peak temperature over heating rates, and extract the desorption energy and prefactor via Redhead and Kissinger plots.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Bryan maximum-entropy continuation of noisy fermionic G(tau) for a two-peak spectrum
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Generate synthetic fermionic G(tau) from a two-Gaussian spectral function and add correlated Gaussian QMC-like noise by Monte Carlo binning. Estimate the covariance matrix from the bins and reconstruct A(omega) with Bryan's SVD-space Newton MaxEnt, averaging over alpha with Bayesian weights.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Anharmonic oscillator excitation spectrum from PIMC correlator and MaxEnt continuation
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Run primitive-action path-integral Monte Carlo for a quartic oscillator and measure <x(tau)x(0)>, with a jackknife covariance. Continue the correlator with a bosonic-kernel MaxEnt and compare the peak position and weight with the 0->1 transition obtained by diagonalizing in the harmonic-oscillator basis.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Non-negative Tikhonov continuation of DQMC Hubbard-dimer Green's functions
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Measure unequal-time G(tau) for a two-site Hubbard model with determinant QMC. Invert the fermionic Laplace kernel by non-negative regularized least squares, choosing the regularization by an L-curve, and compare the recovered peaks with exact pole positions from ED.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Average-spectrum method with fictitious-temperature selection for a BCS-gapped spectrum
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Metropolis-sample spectral weights on a frequency grid with an entropy-free prior at a range of fictitious temperatures, for noisy G(tau) from a gapped BCS density of states. Select Theta from the kink in <chi^2>(Theta) and quantify how well the coherence peaks and gap are recovered.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Bootstrap uncertainties of MaxEnt spectral moments for a Bethe-lattice semicircular DOS
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Generate binned noisy G(tau) for a semicircular density of states. Bootstrap-resample the bins and repeat a classic MaxEnt reconstruction on each resample to obtain error bars on the spectral moments, then compare the zeroth to second moments with exact sum rules.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Stochastic pole expansion of Anderson-impurity Matsubara Green's functions
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Represent G(i omega_n) of a small discretized Anderson impurity model, solved exactly, as a sum of poles. Sample pole positions and weights with Metropolis/simulated annealing against noisy Matsubara data, and compare the averaged spectrum with the exact Lehmann spectrum.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Optical conductivity from current correlator via bosonic-kernel MaxEnt with f-sum check
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Build Lambda(tau) from a model conductivity with a Drude peak plus an interband term and add noise. Invert the kernel omega*cosh-type conductivity kernel with MaxEnt, then verify the f-sum rule and estimate the Drude weight from the reconstruction.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Renyi-2 entropy of a harmonic chain from replica path-integral Monte Carlo
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Simulate a coupled-oscillator chain on a two-replica path-integral geometry and measure Z_A/Z ratios with an incremental ratio trick. Compare S_2 with the exact covariance-matrix formula and extract c ~ 1 from logarithmic scaling near the massless limit.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Swap-operator VMC estimate of Renyi-2 entropy for free fermions on a chain
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Metropolis-sample two independent copies of a tight-binding Slater determinant and evaluate the swap operator with a sign/amplitude decomposition. Compare with exact entropies from the correlation matrix and fit the CFT log formula to get c = 1.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Entanglement growth under random Haar brickwork circuits
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Evolve qubit chains with brickwork circuits of Haar-random two-qubit gates using state vectors. Track half-chain Renyi-2 and von Neumann entropy over many realizations, and extract the entanglement velocity and the growth exponent of sample-to-sample fluctuations.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Random-singlet entanglement from strong-disorder RG on random Heisenberg chains
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Run Dasgupta-Ma decimation on long chains with random couplings drawn from a broad distribution, sampling many disorder realizations. Count singlets crossing a block boundary to obtain S(l), and verify the effective central charge ln 2 in the logarithmic scaling.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Renyi-2 mutual information of the 2D classical Ising model by replica Monte Carlo
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Compute the classical Renyi-2 mutual information between two halves of a square-lattice Ising torus. Use Metropolis/Wolff simulations of a replicated geometry with thermodynamic integration in temperature, and locate the peak and area-law coefficient near T_c.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Transverse-field Ising Renyi entropy via Trotterized replica classical Monte Carlo
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Map the transverse-field Ising chain to an anisotropic 2D Ising model on a two-sheeted replica geometry with a branch cut. Estimate S_2 by Monte Carlo ratio sampling and compare with exact free-fermion results, recovering c = 1/2 at criticality.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Initiator FCIQMC versus coupled cluster doubles breakdown in strong pairing
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Solve the CCD amplitude equations iteratively for the picket-fence pairing model, and run initiator-FCIQMC for the same model. Benchmark both against exact diagonalization to show where CCD fails at large g, and study the initiator bias as a function of walker number.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Coupled cluster doubles for pairing models

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Coupled cluster Monte Carlo stochastic sampling of CCD amplitudes for pairing
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Implement Thom's coupled cluster Monte Carlo restricted to doubles, sampling excitors and their products stochastically for the Richardson model. Compare the time-averaged amplitudes and correlation energy with the deterministic CCD solution.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Coupled cluster doubles for pairing models

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Auxiliary-field shell-model Monte Carlo for thermal pairing energy and heat capacity
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Decouple the pairing interaction with a Hubbard-Stratonovich transformation on a Trotter grid. Sample the auxiliary fields with Metropolis using canonical (number-projected) one-body traces, and compare E(T) and C(T) for equally spaced levels with exact thermal sums.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Coupled cluster doubles for pairing models

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Disorder-averaged CCD accuracy for pairing with random GOE single-particle levels
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Draw single-particle spectra from GOE matrices (ultrasmall superconducting grains) and solve both CCD and the exact pair-basis problem for each realization. Monte Carlo average the relative correlation-energy error and the pairing condensation energy as functions of g.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Coupled cluster doubles for pairing models

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: PIMC harmonic oscillator: imaginary-time position correlator, gap and virial energy
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Run primitive path-integral Monte Carlo for a 1D harmonic oscillator. Measure <x(tau)x(0)>, fit the exponential decay to obtain hbar*omega, and compare thermodynamic and virial energy estimators and their Trotter error against exact results.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Mass gap of Euclidean lattice phi^4 theory from correlator effective mass
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Metropolis-sample a 1+1D lattice scalar phi^4 field in the symmetric phase. Compute zero-momentum time-slice correlators, construct cosh effective masses with jackknife errors, and extract the mass gap from the plateau.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Determinant QMC unequal-time Green's function of a four-site Hubbard ring
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Implement BSS determinant QMC with stable matrix products and compute G(k,tau) for a 4-site Hubbard ring. Compare with G(tau) built from the exact ED spectrum and extract the single-particle gap from the decay.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Quantum rotor chain gap via classical XY Monte Carlo of the Villain mapping
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Map the 1D quantum O(2) rotor chain to an anisotropic 2D classical XY model and simulate it with Wolff cluster updates. Measure correlators along imaginary time, extract the gap versus coupling, and compare with ED in a truncated angular-momentum basis.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: PIMC density-response function of trapped particles and f-sum rule check
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Simulate distinguishable particles in a 1D harmonic trap with a soft interaction using path-integral Monte Carlo. Measure F(q,tau), and check the f-sum rule through the tau-derivative of F at tau = 0 and the symmetry about beta/2.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: McMillan Jastrow VMC ground-state energy of liquid helium-4 with Aziz potential
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Metropolis-sample N ~ 64-108 He-4 atoms in a periodic box with a McMillan (b/r)^5 Jastrow factor interacting via the Aziz HFDHE2 potential. Compute kinetic energy with Jackson-Feenberg and gradient estimators, potential energy with tail corrections, and optimize b at the equilibrium density.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Importance-sampled diffusion Monte Carlo of bulk helium-4 with mixed estimators
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Run DMC with drift-diffusion and branching using a McMillan guiding function for He-4 at equilibrium density. Compute the exact ground-state energy and mixed and extrapolated g(r), and quantify the time-step error and population bias.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Nosanow-Jastrow VMC of solid helium-4 and Lindemann ratio
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Sample an fcc/hcp crystal with a Jastrow factor times Gaussians localized on lattice sites, optimizing the Gaussian width. Compute the energy versus density, the mean-square displacement and the Lindemann ratio, and locate the liquid-solid crossing by comparison with the liquid trial function.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: PIMC kinetic energy of normal liquid helium-4 with Boltzmannon paths
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Run path-integral Monte Carlo with the primitive action and staging moves for distinguishable He-4 atoms at T ~ 2-4 K. Compute kinetic energy with thermodynamic and centroid-virial estimators and study convergence in the number of time slices.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Slater-Jastrow VMC of liquid helium-3 with plane-wave determinants
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Sample normal-liquid He-3 with spin-up and spin-down plane-wave Slater determinants times a McMillan Jastrow factor, using Sherman-Morrison determinant updates. Compare the energy per atom with the bosonic He-4 result at equal density to isolate the Fermi-statistics contribution.
