physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Finite-temperature Lanczos specific heat of Heisenberg chain in magnetization sectors
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Build sparse XXZ chain Hamiltonians in fixed-S^z sectors and apply the finite-temperature Lanczos method with random starting vectors. Compute C(T) and S(T), estimating the statistical error from the number of random vectors, and compare with full diagonalization for small L.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Kernel polynomial density of states of XXZ chain via stochastic trace estimation
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Compute Chebyshev moments of a rescaled sparse XXZ Hamiltonian in a fixed momentum and magnetization sector, estimating traces with random-phase vectors. Apply Jackson damping and compare the many-body DOS and integrated counts with full ED.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Thermal pure quantum states for entropy of a frustrated triangular-lattice cluster
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Generate microcanonical TPQ states by repeated application of (l - H/N) to random vectors on an 18-21 site triangular-lattice Heisenberg cluster. Extract the temperature, energy and entropy curves, and compare with FTLM including sample-to-sample error.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Dynamical typicality spin autocorrelation and diffusion constant in XXZ chains
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Evolve random typical states with Krylov/expm_multiply and compute the infinite-temperature spin-current or S^z_j(t) correlations of an XXZ chain. Extract the diffusion constant at Delta > 1 and the ballistic behaviour at Delta < 1, and quantify the typicality error.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Valence-bond projector QMC for a 4x4 Heisenberg lattice versus Lanczos
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Implement Sandvik's valence-bond-basis projector QMC with bond-operator strings and transition-graph overlaps. Compute the ground-state energy and the staggered spin correlations, and compare with the exact Lanczos result for the 4x4 periodic lattice.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Spectral form factor and Thouless time of random-field Heisenberg chains
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Unfold the disorder-sampled spectra of random-field XXZ chains, compute the filtered spectral form factor K(t), and extract the Thouless time at which K joins the GOE ramp as a function of disorder strength.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: 3D Anderson localization transition via MacKinnon-Kramer transfer matrices
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Compute the smallest Lyapunov exponent of quasi-1D bars of the 3D Anderson model with random on-site disorder using transfer matrices with periodic QR reorthogonalization. Perform one-parameter finite-size scaling to locate W_c ~ 16.5.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Level statistics of a kicked random Ising Floquet chain
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Build Floquet unitaries for a kicked Ising chain with random longitudinal fields and compute quasienergy gap ratios over disorder. Map the COE-to-Poisson crossover as a function of disorder and kick strength.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Eigenstate spin-glass order in the localized random transverse-field Ising chain
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Diagonalize random-bond, random-field quantum Ising chains with weak interactions, sampling disorder. Compute the Edwards-Anderson correlator chi_SG of excited eigenstates to distinguish the localized paramagnet from eigenstate spin-glass order.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Kullback-Leibler divergence of neighboring eigenstates in interacting Aubry-Andre chains
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Diagonalize interacting spinless fermions in a quasiperiodic Aubry-Andre potential, averaging over random phase offsets. Compute the KL divergence between basis-state distributions of adjacent eigenstates as a localization diagnostic and compare it with a random-disorder model.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: World-line QMC with global straight-line moves for uniform susceptibility
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Augment local world-line updates with global moves that flip straight world lines, changing the magnetization so that S^z fluctuations are sampled. Compute chi(T) of the Heisenberg chain and compare with ED and with the conserved-magnetization bias of local-only updates.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Discrete-time loop algorithm versus local updates: autocorrelation times in Heisenberg chains
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Implement the Evertz loop-cluster algorithm on the checkerboard world-line lattice, alongside local plaquette updates. Compare the integrated autocorrelation times of the energy and the staggered structure factor as T is lowered, verifying that both agree with ED.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: World-line QMC of 1D spinless t-V fermions and CDW structure factor
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Simulate spinless fermions with nearest-neighbour repulsion V on the checkerboard world-line lattice, handling boundary fermion signs. Compute the density structure factor at q = pi versus V and L to locate the CDW transition at V = 2t, with ED benchmarks.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Average sign decay in world-line QMC of frustrated J1-J2 chains
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Run world-line QMC on a J1-J2 Heisenberg chain with negative-weight plaquettes from the frustrating bonds and measure the average sign versus beta and L. Compare its exponential decay with exp(-beta N Delta f) computed from ED free energies.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Discrete world-line QMC for soft-core Bose-Hubbard chain kinetic energy
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Implement checkerboard world-line QMC with occupation-number world lines truncated at n_max for a 1D Bose-Hubbard chain. Compute the kinetic energy and on-site density fluctuations versus U/t and compare with ED of small chains.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Unrestricted Hartree-Fock trial for constrained-path AFQMC of the 4x4 Hubbard model
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Converge UHF with density mixing for the 2D Hubbard model and use the resulting determinant as the trial for constrained-path auxiliary-field QMC with importance sampling and population control. Compare the ground-state energy with exact 4x4 results.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Hartree-Fock for lattice and atomic systems

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: H2 dissociation curve: minimal-basis RHF versus Jastrow-correlated VMC
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Compute RHF energies of H2 in an STO-3G basis versus bond length, then run VMC with a Jastrow-corrected trial function (Jastrow times RHF, or a Heitler-London/James-Coolidge type). Show the RHF dissociation failure and its correction, and compare the equilibrium bond length and De.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Hartree-Fock for lattice and atomic systems

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Hybrid Monte Carlo of double-exchange model with exact fermion diagonalization
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Metropolis-sample classical core spins on a 2D lattice, diagonalizing the itinerant-electron Hamiltonian in each configuration to obtain the fermion free energy. Compute the ferromagnetic order parameter versus T and compare the T_c estimate with a mean-field calculation.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Hartree-Fock for lattice and atomic systems

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Gutzwiller-projected UHF Neel state VMC for the half-filled 2D Hubbard model
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Use self-consistent UHF Neel orbitals as a Slater determinant, multiply by a Gutzwiller factor g^D, and Metropolis-sample electron configurations. Optimize g and compare the energy, double occupancy and staggered moment with plain UHF.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Hartree-Fock for lattice and atomic systems

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Static-path approximation Monte Carlo for Hubbard-dimer thermodynamics
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Apply a static (tau-independent) Hubbard-Stratonovich field decoupling to the two-site Hubbard model and Monte Carlo integrate over the static auxiliary fields with exact one-body traces. Compare E(T) and the local moment with exact results and with finite-T Hartree-Fock.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Hartree-Fock for lattice and atomic systems

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Slater-Jastrow VMC of the 3D spin-polarized electron gas with Ewald interactions
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Metropolis-sample a plane-wave Slater determinant times a Gaskell RPA Jastrow factor for N = 19-57 electrons in a periodic box, using Sherman-Morrison updates. Compute the Ewald-summed potential energy and the total energy per electron at several r_s.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Homogeneous electron gas in periodic boxes

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: 2D electron gas: Slater-Jastrow liquid versus Gaussian Wigner-crystal VMC
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Implement 2D Ewald summation and VMC for both a Fermi-liquid Slater-Jastrow trial function and a triangular-lattice Wigner-crystal trial function with Gaussian localized orbitals. Compare the energies versus r_s to estimate the crystallization r_s.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Homogeneous electron gas in periodic boxes

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Fixed-node diffusion Monte Carlo of a small periodic electron gas
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Run importance-sampled fixed-node DMC with a Slater-Jastrow guiding function for N = 14-38 unpolarized electrons, rejecting node-crossing moves. Compute E(r_s) with time-step extrapolation and compare with VMC to obtain the fixed-node correlation gain.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Homogeneous electron gas in periodic boxes

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: BCC Wigner crystal VMC at low density with Ewald Madelung energy
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Compute the BCC Madelung energy by Ewald summation, then perform VMC with Gaussian orbitals localized on lattice sites times a Jastrow factor for large r_s. Optimize the Gaussian width and compare with the Madelung plus harmonic zero-point energy expansion.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Homogeneous electron gas in periodic boxes

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Quasi-one-dimensional electron gas in a harmonic wire by VMC
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Model electrons in a periodic wire with transverse harmonic confinement through an effective 1D interaction (Ewald-type sum of the projected Coulomb potential). Run Slater-Jastrow VMC to compute the energy and the 2k_F peak in S(k) as functions of r_s and wire width.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Homogeneous electron gas in periodic boxes

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Metropolis sampling of a free-fermion plane-wave determinant: exchange hole and S(k)
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Sample |Slater determinant|^2 for noninteracting spin-polarized fermions in a periodic box by Metropolis with determinant ratio updates. Measure g(r) and S(k) and compare with the exact Fermi-gas exchange hole and the analytic S(k) on the reciprocal lattice.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Homogeneous electron gas in periodic boxes

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Classical one-component plasma internal energy versus coupling via Ewald Monte Carlo
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Run Metropolis simulations of the classical 3D one-component plasma with Ewald-summed interactions over coupling Gamma = 1-170. Compute the excess internal energy and g(r), and compare with fitting formulas and the BCC Madelung limit.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Homogeneous electron gas in periodic boxes

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Backflow-corrected Slater-Jastrow VMC for the 2D electron gas
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Add a Kwon-Ceperley-Martin backflow transformation to the plane-wave determinant coordinates and evaluate the local energy, including the backflow Laplacian terms. Optimize the backflow parameters by variance minimization and quantify the energy gain at r_s = 5-20.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Homogeneous electron gas in periodic boxes

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Hirsch-Fye QMC of a Wilson-chain-discretized Anderson impurity versus NRG ground state
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Logarithmically discretize a flat-band hybridization into a finite Wilson chain. Compute impurity occupancy and double occupancy versus U with discrete Hirsch-Fye QMC, then compare to iterative-diagonalization (NRG) low-temperature values.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Weak-link spin impurity on a Heisenberg chain: SSE impurity susceptibility crossover
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: A spin-1/2 attached by weak coupling J' to the end of a Heisenberg chain mimics Kondo screening. SSE QMC computes the impurity susceptibility T*chi_imp(T) and extracts a crossover scale versus J'.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Hybridization-expansion segment Monte Carlo for a resonant level on a Wilson chain
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: For a spinless resonant-level model with a Wilson-discretized bath, sample hybridization-expansion segment configurations. Compute impurity occupancy and impurity entropy versus temperature, and compare to exact free-fermion diagonalization of the Wilson chain.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Spin-boson localization transition via Monte Carlo of the long-range Ising chain
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Discretize an ohmic bosonic bath logarithmically and map the spin-boson model to a 1D Ising chain with 1/tau^2 interactions. Use Metropolis/cluster Monte Carlo to locate the localization transition in coupling alpha from the magnetization Binder cumulant.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Varma-Yafet Kondo-singlet variational Monte Carlo on a Wilson chain
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Build a Gutzwiller-projected impurity-plus-Wilson-chain Slater determinant (Varma-Yafet ansatz) for the Anderson model. Optimize its energy by VMC and compare the singlet binding energy to iterative NRG ground-state energies.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Minimally entangled typical thermal states for the transverse-field Ising chain
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Implement METTS: imaginary-time TEBD on a finite MPS, collapse to product states by sampling, and a Markov chain over product states. Compute thermal energy and magnetization versus beta, and compare to exact diagonalization.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Matrix product states and canonical forms

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Variational Monte Carlo optimization of MPS amplitudes for a Heisenberg ring
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Parameterize a periodic 10-site Heisenberg ring by an MPS trace ansatz. Evaluate amplitudes by matrix products and optimize by stochastic reconfiguration from Metropolis samples. Report energy versus bond dimension against exact.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Matrix product states and canonical forms

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Truncation bias in sampled correlations of a random-field XXZ ground-state MPS
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Convert an exact random-field XXZ ground state to MPS, truncate to bond dimension chi with discarded-weight bookkeeping, and perfect-sample correlations. Separate truncation bias from sampling noise as functions of chi and sample number.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Matrix product states and canonical forms

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Distribution of transfer-matrix gaps for Haar-random translation-invariant MPS
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Generate random isometric MPS tensors from Haar-random unitaries and compute their transfer-matrix spectra. Sample the distribution of correlation lengths and second-largest eigenvalue moduli versus bond and physical dimension.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Matrix product states and canonical forms

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Rydberg blockade PXP ground state: snapshot density correlations from MPS sampling
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Diagonalize the blockade-constrained Rydberg chain Hamiltonian, convert the ground state to MPS, and perfect-sample occupation snapshots. Compute density-density correlations and the Z2 order parameter versus detuning.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Matrix product states and canonical forms

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: ASEP open-boundary steady state: matrix product ansatz versus Gillespie simulation
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Compute the current and density profile of the open asymmetric simple exclusion process with the DEHP matrix product ansatz, using truncated quadratic algebra matrices. Compare with Gillespie kinetic Monte Carlo across the phase diagram.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Matrix product states and canonical forms

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Directed-loop SSE magnetization curve of the XXZ chain in a field
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Implement Syljuasen-Sandvik directed-loop SSE for the anisotropic XXZ chain with Zeeman field, solving the directed-loop equations for vertex weights. Compute magnetization versus field and compare to Bethe-ansatz saturation field.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Stochastic series expansion for Heisenberg models

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: 2D transverse-field Ising quantum critical point by SSE Binder crossings
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Apply SSE with cluster updates to the square-lattice TFIM. Locate h_c about 3.044 from Binder-cumulant crossings and estimate the correlation-length exponent from slope scaling.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Stochastic series expansion for Heisenberg models

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Bilayer Heisenberg antiferromagnet dimerization transition via SSE
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: SSE loop QMC on square-lattice bilayers with interlayer coupling J_perp. Locate the Neel-to-dimer quantum critical point g_c about 2.52 from Binder ratios and spin stiffness crossings.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Stochastic series expansion for Heisenberg models

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: J-Q model valence-bond-solid correlations by SSE on small square lattices
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Extend SSE operator-loop updates to Sandvik's four-spin Q interaction. Compute Neel and columnar dimer order parameters versus Q/J and identify the crossover region on lattices up to 16x16.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Stochastic series expansion for Heisenberg models

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Specific heat of the square-lattice Heisenberg model from SSE expansion-order fluctuations
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Use SSE expansion-order statistics C = <n^2> - <n>^2 - <n> to compute specific heat versus T on finite square lattices. Locate the specific heat peak and test finite-size convergence.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Stochastic series expansion for Heisenberg models

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Hard-core boson superfluid density and BKT jump on the square lattice
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Use SSE for the 2D XY model (hard-core bosons) to compute superfluid density from winding numbers versus T. Estimate T_BKT from the universal jump criterion with logarithmic finite-size corrections.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Stochastic series expansion for Heisenberg models

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Neel temperature of the cubic Heisenberg antiferromagnet from SSE Binder crossings
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Run SSE on LxLxL simple-cubic Heisenberg lattices and compute the staggered-magnetization Binder ratio versus T. Estimate T_N about 0.946 J from crossings.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Stochastic series expansion for Heisenberg models

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Ferromagnetic Heisenberg chain low-temperature susceptibility by SSE
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Adapt SSE (sign-free ferromagnetic vertices with shifted diagonal constant) to the spin-1/2 ferromagnetic chain. Compute uniform susceptibility versus T and compare to Takahashi's modified spin-wave chi ~ 1/T^2 asymptotics.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Stochastic series expansion for Heisenberg models

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Square-lattice Heisenberg correlation length versus temperature compared with chiral perturbation theory
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Measure the second-moment correlation length from SSE staggered structure factors at q=(pi,pi) and nearby wavevectors. Compare its exponential growth with the Hasenfratz-Niedermayer prediction.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Stochastic series expansion for Heisenberg models

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Lieb-lattice Heisenberg ferrimagnet: total-spin and sublattice magnetization from SSE
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: SSE on the Lieb (decorated square) lattice of unequal sublattices. Compute uniform and staggered moments and verify Lieb's theorem S_tot = |N_A - N_B|/2 via low-T uniform susceptibility.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Stochastic series expansion for Heisenberg models

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Basis-dependent sign problem of the frustrated two-leg ladder in SSE
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Simulate a frustrated two-leg Heisenberg ladder with diagonal couplings in both site and rung-dimer bases. Compute average sign versus temperature in each basis and demonstrate a sign-free basis when the leg and diagonal couplings are equal.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Stochastic series expansion for Heisenberg models

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Sign-free honeycomb Hubbard DQMC: antiferromagnetic structure factor versus U
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Run DQMC for the half-filled honeycomb Hubbard model on small periodic clusters and verify positivity of the sign. Compute the antiferromagnetic structure factor versus U across the semimetal-AF region.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Auxiliary-field QMC and fermion sign problem

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Spin versus charge Hubbard-Stratonovich decoupling and the average sign
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: For a repulsive Hubbard ring away from half filling, compare DQMC average sign under spin (real) and charge (complex) discrete HS transformations. Also check that observables agree with exact diagonalization.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Auxiliary-field QMC and fermion sign problem

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Back-propagated constrained-path AFQMC estimates of double occupancy in Hubbard chains
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Implement CPMC with free-electron trial for a 1D Hubbard chain. Compare mixed and back-propagated estimators of double occupancy and kinetic energy against exact or Bethe-ansatz values.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Auxiliary-field QMC and fermion sign problem

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Constrained-path versus free-projection bias on a 2x2 Hubbard plaquette
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Run ground-state AFQMC on the 2x2 Hubbard plaquette with and without the constrained-path condition at various fillings. Quantify constraint bias and sign-decay variance relative to exact diagonalization.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Auxiliary-field QMC and fermion sign problem

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Average sign of DQMC on frustrated triangular Hubbard clusters
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Compute DQMC average sign versus beta and U for the half-filled triangular-lattice Hubbard model on small clusters. Contrast with bipartite square clusters and relate sign decay to free-energy differences.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Auxiliary-field QMC and fermion sign problem

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Half-filled periodic Anderson model DQMC: local moment screening versus hybridization
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Apply DQMC to a 2D periodic Anderson model, which is sign-free at half filling. Compute f-electron local moment and AF structure factor versus hybridization V to identify the Doniach crossover.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Auxiliary-field QMC and fermion sign problem

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Complex Langevin for a zero-dimensional one-site Hubbard sign-problem integral
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Apply complex Langevin dynamics to a one-site Hubbard partition function written as a Hubbard-Stratonovich integral with complex weight. Compare density and double occupancy to exact results, and diagnose failure via drift-term distributions.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Auxiliary-field QMC and fermion sign problem

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Forward-walking pure estimator of the XXZ structure factor in lattice GFMC
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Add forward walking (descendant-weight tracking) to lattice GFMC of the XXZ chain. Compare mixed and pure estimates of S(q) against exact diagonalization.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Green's function Monte Carlo on lattices

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Lattice GFMC of 2D hard-core bosons: condensate fraction from off-diagonal correlations
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Run GFMC for hard-core bosons on square lattices at various fillings with a Jastrow guiding function. Estimate energy and the condensate fraction from forward-walked one-body density matrix.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Green's function Monte Carlo on lattices

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Lattice GFMC of 1D spinless t-V fermions with open boundaries
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Exploit the absence of fermion signs in 1D open chains to run GFMC for the t-V model. Compute ground-state energy versus V across the Luttinger-liquid-to-CDW transition and compare to Bethe ansatz.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Green's function Monte Carlo on lattices

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Beryllium atom Slater-Jastrow VMC with Sherman-Morrison single-electron moves
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Build Be determinants from Clementi-Roetti STOs with a Pade Jastrow. Use rank-one Sherman-Morrison updates of the inverse Slater matrices for determinant ratios, and compute VMC energy and acceptance.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Drift-diffusion DMC of the lithium atom using inverse-matrix gradients
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Compute quantum force and local kinetic energy from row-wise inverse-matrix contractions of orbital gradients and Laplacians. Run fixed-node DMC for Li and compare to the exact nonrelativistic energy.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Two-configuration beryllium trial function with table-method determinant ratios
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Combine 1s2 2s2 and 1s2 2p2 configurations and compute multideterminant ratios via a table method that shares one reference inverse. Optimize the CI coefficient by VMC and quantify the static correlation energy recovered.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Woodbury rank-k updates for multi-electron moves in trapped-fermion VMC
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Implement Woodbury rank-k inverse updates for simultaneous moves of k electrons in a 3D harmonically trapped Slater-Jastrow VMC. Compare efficiency (autocorrelation per cost) versus k.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Gutzwiller-projected d-wave BCS VMC of the 2D t-J model with rank-one updates
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Sample electron-hop moves of a projected d-wave pairing wavefunction on a square lattice using Sherman-Morrison updates of the pairing matrix inverse. Compute t-J energy and d-wave pair correlations versus doping.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Simple-update PEPS for 4x4 transverse-field Ising, energy by Monte Carlo sampling
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Perform simple-update imaginary-time evolution of a PEPS with bond weights on an open 4x4 lattice. Evaluate energy by Metropolis sampling of exactly contracted amplitudes and compare to ED.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Deformed toric-code PEPS: loop-gas sampling and topological transition
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Map a string-tension-deformed toric code PEPS norm onto a classical Ising/loop model. Sample with Monte Carlo to locate the topological-to-trivial transition via Wilson-loop and plaquette observables.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Nearest-neighbor RVB state on the square lattice via valence-bond Monte Carlo
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Sample nearest-neighbor dimer coverings with overlap loop weights for the RVB wavefunction, which has a simple PEPS representation. Compute spin-spin correlations and energy of the Heisenberg model on small square lattices.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Hard-square lattice gas density via boundary MPS versus grand-canonical Monte Carlo
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Encode the hard-square exclusion model as a 2D tensor network and contract with boundary MPS. Compare density versus activity and the ordering transition near z about 3.796 with Metropolis Monte Carlo.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Entangled-plaquette (correlator product state) VMC for the 4x4 Heisenberg model
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Parameterize amplitudes as products of 2x2 plaquette correlators and sample with Metropolis. Optimize by stochastic reconfiguration and compare energy to Lanczos.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Hydrogen atom pure <r> and <r^2> from reptation with a poor trial function
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Run RQMC for hydrogen with a deliberately poor Gaussian trial wavefunction. Show that pure estimators from the path center converge to exact moments while mixed estimators are biased.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Bounce versus standard reptation algorithm: autocorrelation for a Morse oscillator
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Implement standard and bounce reptation moves for a Morse oscillator. Compare integrated autocorrelation times of energy and pure <r> versus reptile length, and verify against exact Morse moments.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Pure Hellmann-Feynman force on H2+ nuclei from reptation QMC
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Compute the electrostatic Hellmann-Feynman force in H2+ with RQMC pure estimators using an LCAO trial function. Show agreement with the numerical derivative of the energy, unlike the mixed estimator.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Pure density profile of 2D trapped bosons with Gaussian interactions by RQMC
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Use reptation QMC for N bosons in a 2D harmonic trap with repulsive Gaussian pair potential. Compute pure radial density and pair correlation functions versus interaction strength.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Purified iTEBD thermal energy of the XXZ chain versus SSE
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Evolve a purified infinite MPS in imaginary time with iTEBD to get energy and susceptibility versus T. Cross-check against SSE Monte Carlo on long periodic chains.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: iTEBD and infinite MPS correlation lengths

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Quantum-jump trajectories of a dissipative Ising chain with TEBD
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Unravel a Lindblad TFIM chain with local decay into Monte Carlo wavefunction trajectories propagated by TEBD on MPS. Average magnetization dynamics and compare to exact density-matrix evolution for small N.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: iTEBD and infinite MPS correlation lengths

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Six-state clock model correlation length from iMPS transfer matrices versus Wolff
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Compute correlation length versus temperature for the 2D six-state clock model using boundary iMPS transfer matrices at increasing bond dimension. Compare to Wolff Monte Carlo to bracket the two BKT transitions.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: iTEBD and infinite MPS correlation lengths

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: James-Coolidge-type elliptical-coordinate trial function for H2 by VMC
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Build a few-term James-Coolidge expansion in elliptic coordinates including r12. Optimize linear coefficients by VMC energy minimization and compare to Kolos-Wolniewicz at R=1.4 bohr.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Hydrogen molecule and H2+ variational studies

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Optimal ionic admixture in H2: Heitler-London versus Hund-Mulliken by VMC
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Mix covalent and ionic valence-bond configurations with weight lambda and a Jastrow factor. Determine optimal lambda and energy versus R by VMC, showing ionic suppression at dissociation.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Hydrogen molecule and H2+ variational studies

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: HeH+ molecular ion binding curve from Slater-Jastrow VMC
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Build a two-electron HeH+ trial function from optimized Slater orbitals and a Jastrow. Compute the VMC energy curve, equilibrium bond length and dissociation into He + H+.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Hydrogen molecule and H2+ variational studies

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: H2 equilibrium bond length via correlated-sampling energy differences
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Use correlated sampling with space-warp coordinate transformation to compute low-variance VMC energy differences between nearby bond lengths of H2. Locate the minimum and compare noise to independent runs.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Hydrogen molecule and H2+ variational studies

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: H2 vibrational levels from a DMC potential curve fitted to Morse
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Compute DMC energies for H2 at several R and fit a Morse potential with bootstrapped uncertainties. Solve the nuclear Schrodinger equation by Numerov for vibrational spacings versus experiment.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Hydrogen molecule and H2+ variational studies

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Non-Born-Oppenheimer DMC of H2+ with quantum protons
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Treat both protons and the electron as quantum particles in DMC with a correlated three-body trial function. Compute the total nonadiabatic ground-state energy and proton-proton distance distribution, and compare to the BO plus zero-point estimate.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Hydrogen molecule and H2+ variational studies

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: DQMC uniform spin susceptibility of the 2D Hubbard model: Curie-to-Pauli crossover
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Finite-temperature DQMC on a 4x4 half-filled Hubbard lattice measures the uniform magnetic susceptibility versus T for several U. The crossover from Curie-like local-moment behavior to Pauli-like behavior is compared with U=0 exact results.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Determinant quantum Monte Carlo for Hubbard model

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: DQMC momentum distribution n(k) of the half-filled 2D Hubbard model
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Fourier transform of equal-time DQMC Green's functions gives n(k) on a 6x6 lattice. The smearing of the Fermi surface step and the reduction of kinetic energy are tracked as U increases.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Determinant quantum Monte Carlo for Hubbard model

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Ionic Hubbard chain DQMC: staggered charge versus spin structure factors
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Hubbard chain with alternating site potential ±Δ, simulated by DQMC. Staggered charge and spin structure factors are measured across the crossover from band insulator to Mott insulator as U/Δ is varied.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Determinant quantum Monte Carlo for Hubbard model

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Holstein model DQMC with phonon-field updates: CDW structure factor
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Square-lattice Holstein model with continuous phonon displacements integrated in imaginary time. Fermion determinants are combined with the phonon action, and Metropolis updates of the displacements give the (π,π) charge-density-wave structure factor versus temperature.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Determinant quantum Monte Carlo for Hubbard model

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Discrete Ising versus continuous Gaussian Hubbard-Stratonovich fields: estimator variance
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: For a Hubbard dimer, compares DQMC with Hirsch discrete fields and with continuous Gaussian auxiliary fields. Energy and double-occupancy variances, autocorrelation times and Trotter errors are evaluated at fixed computational cost.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Determinant quantum Monte Carlo for Hubbard model

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Zeeman-field magnetization curve of a Hubbard chain from DQMC
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: DQMC of a 1D Hubbard chain in a uniform Zeeman field, using spin-dependent chemical potentials in the B matrices. Magnetization versus field and temperature is measured and the average sign is monitored.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Determinant quantum Monte Carlo for Hubbard model

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Anderson-Hubbard disordered DQMC: averaged double occupancy and local moments
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Hubbard model with box-distributed random site energies on small 2D clusters. Many DQMC runs are averaged over disorder realizations to obtain the double occupancy and the distribution of local moments versus disorder strength.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Determinant quantum Monte Carlo for Hubbard model

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Global HS-field moves at strong coupling: DQMC autocorrelation reduction
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: At large U, local single-flip DQMC freezes HS field patterns. Global spin-flip moves along the imaginary-time line are added, and integrated autocorrelation times of the AF structure factor are compared with and without them.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Determinant quantum Monte Carlo for Hubbard model

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Delayed rank-k Green's function updates in DQMC: equivalence and speedup
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Accumulates k accepted Sherman-Morrison updates and applies them as a single matrix-matrix product. Verifies that the resulting Green's functions match sequential updates to round-off and measures wall-time scaling with k for a 2D Hubbard lattice.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Determinant quantum Monte Carlo for Hubbard model

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: d-wave rung pairing correlations of a doped two-leg Hubbard ladder by DQMC
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Finite-temperature DQMC of a 2xL Hubbard ladder near 1/8 doping. Measures the rung-leg d-wave pair-field correlations, compares them with the U=0 result, and tracks the average sign.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Determinant quantum Monte Carlo for Hubbard model

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Cubic-lattice Hubbard DQMC: antiferromagnetic structure factor and Néel temperature
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: DQMC of the half-filled 3D cubic Hubbard model on 4^3 and 6^3 lattices. The staggered structure factor is measured versus T, and finite-size scaling gives a rough estimate of T_N.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Determinant quantum Monte Carlo for Hubbard model

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Grover's DQMC Green's-function estimator of Renyi-2 entropy for a Hubbard chain
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Uses free-fermion Renyi-2 formulas built from sampled pairs of DQMC Green's-function restrictions, det[G_A G'_A + (1-G_A)(1-G'_A)]. Gives the entanglement of a Hubbard chain segment, which is benchmarked against exact diagonalization for small chains.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Randomized-measurement Renyi-2 entropy of a Heisenberg chain ground state
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Simulates the Brydges protocol: random local Haar unitaries followed by projective sampling of the exact ground state of a 10-site Heisenberg chain. Renyi-2 entropies are estimated from cross-correlations of outcome probabilities and compared with Schmidt values versus the number of measurements.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Random tensor network Renyi-2 entropy via classical Ising Monte Carlo
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Gaussian random tensors on a 2D graph map the Renyi-2 entropy of a boundary region onto the free-energy cost of a domain wall in an Ising-like model. Metropolis sampling with thermodynamic integration gives the entropy versus bond dimension and region size.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Topological entanglement entropy of the Laughlin state by swap Monte Carlo
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Swap-operator Metropolis sampling of the ν=1/3 Laughlin wavefunction on a disk gives Renyi-2 entropies of circular regions. Extrapolating the linear boundary law extracts γ and compares it with ln√3.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Logarithmic negativity of random induced mixed states versus bath dimension
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Samples Haar-random pure states on system plus bath and traces out the bath to get mixed states of two qubit registers. Computes partial-transpose negativity distributions and the entanglement-to-PPT transition as the bath dimension grows.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Symmetry-resolved Page curve for Haar states in fixed magnetization sectors
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Samples random pure states in a fixed S^z sector of N qubits, Schmidt-decomposes them block by block in subsystem charge, and compares the average entanglement and number entropy with the analytic U(1) Page result.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Shannon-Renyi participation entropy of the critical TFIM chain via Monte Carlo
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Samples σz configurations from exact critical transverse-field Ising ground-state amplitudes. Shannon and Renyi-2 participation entropies are estimated from replica collision probabilities and their linear plus subleading-constant scaling with N is extracted.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Doped-Hubbard DMFT with ED solver: compressibility from chemical-potential scans
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Bethe-lattice DMFT away from half filling. A stochastic multi-start bath fit is combined with an ED impurity solver and a chemical-potential search, giving filling versus μ and the compressibility near the Mott insulator.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Dynamical mean-field theory with ED solver

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Hirsch-Fye DMFT of the Bethe-lattice Hubbard model: Mott insulator diagnostic
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: DMFT self-consistency with a Hirsch-Fye QMC impurity solver on an imaginary-time grid. G(β/2) and the double occupancy versus U at fixed T locate the metal-insulator crossover.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Dynamical mean-field theory with ED solver

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Antiferromagnetic DMFT with Hirsch-Fye solver: Néel temperature of Bethe-lattice Hubbard
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Two-sublattice DMFT allowing spin symmetry breaking, solved with Hirsch-Fye QMC. The staggered magnetization versus temperature at several U gives T_N(U).
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Dynamical mean-field theory with ED solver

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Falicov-Kimball model: Metropolis f-electrons with exact conduction diagonalization versus DMFT
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: 2D Falicov-Kimball model in which classical f occupations are sampled by Metropolis and the conduction-electron free energy is obtained by exact diagonalization. Checkerboard order and the density of states are compared with the exact DMFT solution.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Dynamical mean-field theory with ED solver

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: CT-INT DMFT versus ED-bath DMFT: bath-discretization bias in the self-energy
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Solves the same Bethe-lattice Hubbard DMFT with a CT-INT interaction-expansion Monte Carlo solver and with a finite-bath ED solver. Matsubara self-energies and Z are compared versus the number of bath sites.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Dynamical mean-field theory with ED solver

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Swendsen Monte Carlo renormalization group: 2D Ising thermal eigenvalue
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Metropolis or Wolff snapshots of the 2D Ising model are blocked by majority rule. Correlation matrices of block-spin operators give the linearized RG transformation, and its leading eigenvalue gives y_t, which is compared with the exact value 1.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Model-A dynamic exponent z from Langevin dynamics of 2D lattice phi^4
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Overdamped Langevin simulation of the 2D lattice φ^4 model at criticality. Order-parameter autocorrelation times versus L give z, which is compared with the RG prediction z≈2+cη.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Step-scaling beta function of the 2D O(3) sigma model via Wolff Monte Carlo
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Lüscher-Weisz-Wolff finite-volume running coupling from correlation lengths in the 2D O(3) model, computed with Wolff cluster updates. Measures the step-scaling function σ(u) and compares it with two-loop asymptotic freedom.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Parity effect in pairing condensation energy over Poisson versus GOE spectra
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Samples random single-particle spectra from Poisson and GOE ensembles and solves the Richardson equations for even and odd particle numbers. The average and spread of the Matveev-Larkin parity parameter are computed versus coupling.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: VMC with Richardson-Gaudin trial states for a nonintegrable pairing Hamiltonian
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Uses Richardson eigenstates with tunable effective couplings as variational trial functions for pairing with level-dependent G_ij. Metropolis sampling in the pair-occupation basis gives the variational energy, which is compared with exact diagonalization.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Metropolis sampling of Richardson ground-state pair occupations via permanent amplitudes
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Richardson Bethe-state amplitudes in the pair-occupation basis are permanents of 1/(2ε_i-E_α). Metropolis sampling of configurations then gives level occupations and off-diagonal pair correlations, which are checked against exact eigenvectors.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: iTEBD Heisenberg-ladder correlation length versus SSE spin-correlation fits
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Imaginary-time iTEBD for the two-leg spin-1/2 ladder treated as a 2-site-unit chain. The transfer-matrix correlation length versus χ is compared with the low-temperature SSE spin correlation decay.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: iTEBD and infinite MPS correlation lengths

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: iTEBD Bose-Hubbard chain Luttinger parameter versus worm-algorithm winding numbers
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Truncated-boson iTEBD ground states of the 1D Bose-Hubbard model give the decay of single-particle correlations and K. Worm-algorithm QMC at low T gives K from superfluid stiffness and compressibility.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: iTEBD and infinite MPS correlation lengths

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Thermal iTEBD transverse-field Ising chain versus continuous-time path-integral Monte Carlo
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Purified iTEBD gives finite-temperature correlation lengths of the TFIM chain. Continuous-time cluster path-integral Monte Carlo gives the same quantity, and both are compared with exact free-fermion results.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: iTEBD and infinite MPS correlation lengths

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Positronium negative ion Ps- binding energy by Jastrow VMC
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Three equal-mass particles (e-, e-, e+) with Coulomb interactions. A Hylleraas-Jastrow trial function is Metropolis-sampled and optimized, and the binding relative to Ps + e- is computed.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: VMC for helium atom ground state

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: SR optimization of a pair Jastrow for the Calogero-Sutherland model
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Bosons on a ring with 1/sin² interaction, using a Jastrow ansatz with the pair exponent as a free parameter. SR from Metropolis samples should converge to the exact exponent and energy.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: SR regularization study: diagonal shift and SVD cutoff in Bose-Hubbard VMC
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Gutzwiller-Jastrow VMC of a 1D Bose-Hubbard chain optimized by SR. Convergence and noise are compared for diagonal-shift, rescaling and pseudo-inverse regularization of the sampled S matrix.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: SR with orthogonality penalty for the first excited state of a Pöschl-Teller well
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Variational Monte Carlo of the ground state and of a penalized excited state, with overlaps estimated from samples. The SR-optimized excited-state energy is compared with the analytic Pöschl-Teller spectrum.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Ideal bosons in a 3D harmonic trap: PIMC permutations versus canonical recursion
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: PIMC with exact harmonic propagators and permutation sampling for N ideal bosons. Energy and condensate onset versus T are compared with the exact canonical recursion for the partition function.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Bosonic exchange in PIMC and superfluid fraction

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Superfluid fraction of 2D trapped bosons from the PIMC area estimator
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: PIMC of interacting bosons in an isotropic 2D trap with permutation moves. The projected area of the paths gives the nonclassical moment of inertia, from which the superfluid fraction versus temperature is computed.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Bosonic exchange in PIMC and superfluid fraction

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Winding-number superfluid fraction of 2D soft-core bosons in a periodic box
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Gaussian-repulsion bosons in a 2D periodic cell, simulated by PIMC with exchange moves. The winding-number estimator of ρ_s/ρ is used to locate the BKT transition from the universal jump.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Bosonic exchange in PIMC and superfluid fraction

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Permutation-cycle length distribution and condensate in interacting trapped bosons
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: PIMC of weakly interacting trapped bosons records the distribution of exchange-cycle lengths versus T. The long-cycle fraction is related to the condensate fraction and compared with the ideal-gas result.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Bosonic exchange in PIMC and superfluid fraction

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Fermion sign decay in PIMC of few spin-polarized fermions in a harmonic trap
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: PIMC of 2-4 identical fermions in a 2D trap, with permutation signs weighting the samples. The average sign versus β and N is compared with the ratio of the exact fermion and boson partition functions.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Bosonic exchange in PIMC and superfluid fraction

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Open-path PIMC one-body density matrix of trapped bosons
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: A single open worldline in a bosonic PIMC samples the off-diagonal density matrix. Fourier transforming it gives the momentum distribution and the condensate fraction from the largest eigenvalue.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Bosonic exchange in PIMC and superfluid fraction

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Ideal Bose gas in a periodic 3D box: PIMC winding superfluid fraction
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Free bosons in a cubic box, simulated by PIMC with permutation sampling. The winding-number superfluid fraction and specific heat near T_c are compared with exact finite-N canonical results.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Bosonic exchange in PIMC and superfluid fraction

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Diffusion Monte Carlo of the 1D Lieb-Liniger gas versus Bethe ansatz
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Importance-sampled DMC for delta-interacting bosons on a ring with a Bethe-inspired Jastrow guide. Ground-state energy versus coupling γ is compared with the numerically solved Lieb-Liniger integral equation.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Population-control bias in DMC of the harmonic oscillator versus walker number
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Simple branching DMC of the 1D harmonic oscillator with a population feedback trial energy. Measures the systematic energy bias versus target walker number and time step, and checks the 1/N scaling.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Hybrid Monte Carlo of the honeycomb Hubbard model with fermion determinants
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: BRS-type HMC with continuous auxiliary fields and leapfrog molecular dynamics for small honeycomb Hubbard lattices, using exact determinants. The AF structure factor and acceptance rate versus step size are measured.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: PIMC of a few-electron 2D Wigner molecule in a parabolic quantum dot
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Boltzmannon PIMC of 3-6 Coulomb-interacting electrons in a 2D harmonic dot at low density. Radial and angular pair densities are computed to identify the formation of shells in the Wigner molecule.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Path-integral quantum annealing versus simulated annealing for a 2D ±J spin glass
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Trotter-decomposed transverse-field quantum annealing on a classical replica stack, compared with thermal simulated annealing at equal sweep budgets. Residual energy versus annealing time is the observable.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Wang-Landau sampling of SSE expansion orders for Heisenberg-chain thermodynamics
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Quantum Wang-Landau flattens the histogram over SSE expansion order n and estimates g(n). Energy, entropy and specific heat at all temperatures are reconstructed from a single run and compared with ED.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Fixed-node DMC of a p-like excited state of the 3D isotropic oscillator
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: DMC with a nodal plane fixed by an x-odd trial function gives the lowest l=1 energy. The fixed-node result, exact here, is compared with the analytic 5/2 ħω value and its time-step errors are analyzed.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: DMC zero-point energies of Lennard-Jones rare-gas trimers
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Unguided or Jastrow-guided DMC of Ne3 and Ar3 with Lennard-Jones pair potentials. Quantum binding energies are compared with the classical minima, and the ratio of zero-point to classical energy is computed.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Gillespie quantum-jump unraveling of a driven-dissipative Bose-Hubbard dimer
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Waiting-time (Gillespie-type) quantum trajectories for a two-site Bose-Hubbard model with drive and photon loss. Trajectory-averaged occupations and g2 are compared with the Lindblad steady state.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Kinetic Monte Carlo and quantum trajectories

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Worm algorithm for the 3D J-current model: XY-universality critical point
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Prokof'ev-Svistunov worm updates of integer link currents, with the dual classical representation of the 3D Bose system. Winding-number stiffness crossings locate K_c, and the correlation-length exponent is estimated.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Primitive versus pair-product action PIMC for a hydrogen-like Coulomb atom
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: PIMC of a single electron bound to a proton at finite temperature, comparing the primitive approximation with an exact pair action. The time-step convergence of energy and ⟨r⟩ is compared with exact thermal results.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Gutzwiller-approximation hopping renormalization g_t = 2x/(1+x) tested by projected Fermi-sea VMC
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: For the fully projected Fermi sea on a square lattice at hole doping x, estimate the nearest-neighbor hopping expectation by VMC. Divide by the unprojected value and compare the ratio with the Gutzwiller-approximation factor 2x/(1+x), including finite-size effects.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Momentum distribution of the projected Fermi sea in the doped 1D t-J model
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Use VMC to estimate n(k) of a fully projected Fermi sea on a doped t-J ring from off-diagonal single-particle density-matrix estimators with determinant ratios. Characterize the singularity at k_F (smearing of the jump) versus ring length and doping.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Haldane-Shastry chain: projected Fermi sea VMC reproduces the exact ground state
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Sample the half-filled Gutzwiller-projected Fermi sea on a ring and evaluate the energy of the 1/r^2 (chord-distance) Heisenberg Hamiltonian. Compute spin correlations and compare with the exact Haldane-Shastry energy and the closed-form correlation function.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Staggered-flux versus uniform projected states for the 2D Heisenberg antiferromagnet
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Construct mean-field determinants with complex staggered-flux hoppings on L x L square lattices and Gutzwiller-project them. Compute VMC Heisenberg energies as a function of flux and staggered spin correlations, and compare with the projected Fermi sea.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Projected spinon Fermi sea versus 120-degree Néel state on triangular Heisenberg clusters
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Use VMC to compute the Heisenberg energy and spin structure factor of a Gutzwiller-projected spinon Fermi sea on periodic triangular clusters. Compare with the classical 120-degree state and with Lanczos results on the 12-site cluster.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Doublon-holon binding Jastrow in VMC of the half-filled square-lattice Hubbard model
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Augment a Gutzwiller-projected Fermi sea with a nearest-neighbor doublon-holon binding factor. Optimize both parameters by VMC grid scans versus U/t and identify the variational Mott transition from the vanishing Drude-like kinetic response and the double occupancy.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Projected U(1) Dirac spin liquid energy on kagome Heisenberg clusters
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Build the pi-flux mean-field hopping state on periodic kagome clusters, fixing degeneracies with twisted boundaries. Gutzwiller-project and compute the VMC nearest-neighbor Heisenberg energy per site and spin correlations, comparing with the projected uniform Fermi sea.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Single Lanczos-step improvement of projected wavefunctions for the 2D Heisenberg model
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Apply one Lanczos step (1 + alpha H) to a projected Fermi-sea or Néel-Jastrow state. Estimate <H>, <H^2> and <H^3> by VMC, optimize alpha, and use the variance to extrapolate the energy toward the exact 4x4 ground-state value.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Long-range density Jastrow VMC: Bose-Hubbard chain Mott transition from N(q) small-q behavior
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Optimize a Gutzwiller plus long-range density-density Jastrow for the 1D Bose-Hubbard model with a truncated occupation basis. Use the small-q behavior of the Jastrow v(q) and the density structure factor N(q) (q versus q^2) to locate the superfluid-Mott transition.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Wedding-cake density profile of trapped 1D Bose-Hubbard bosons: QMC versus LDA
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Simulate a harmonically trapped Bose-Hubbard chain with SSE or a worm algorithm to obtain the site-resolved density and local compressibility. Compare Mott-plateau widths with a local-density approximation built from homogeneous Gutzwiller mean field.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Bose glass in the disordered 1D Bose-Hubbard chain from worm-algorithm stiffness and compressibility
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Use a continuous-time worm algorithm for the Bose-Hubbard chain with box-distributed random potentials. Compute disorder-averaged winding-number superfluid stiffness and number-fluctuation compressibility, and identify the compressible non-superfluid Bose-glass window.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Supersolid of hard-core bosons on the triangular lattice via SSE
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Simulate hard-core bosons with nearest-neighbor hopping and repulsion on triangular lattices using directed-loop SSE. Compute the sqrt(3) x sqrt(3) density structure factor and the winding-number superfluid density near half filling to establish coexisting orders.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Haldane insulator in the extended Bose-Hubbard chain: SSE string and parity order
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Simulate the 1D Bose-Hubbard model with nearest-neighbor repulsion V using SSE in a truncated occupation basis. Compute density-wave, parity and string correlators from configurations to separate the Mott, Haldane-insulator and density-wave phases.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Truncated Wigner sampling of Bose-Hubbard dimer dynamics versus exact Fock evolution
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Sample Wigner initial conditions for a coherent state in a two- or three-site Bose-Hubbard system and evolve classical Gross-Pitaevskii trajectories. Compare averaged population imbalance and collapse-revival or self-trapping with exact truncated-Fock time evolution as particle number grows.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Sampled Fisher metric versus analytic quantum geometric tensor for product-state TFIM ansatz
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: For a site-factorized spin wavefunction of the transverse-field Ising chain, compare the Monte Carlo SR overlap matrix with its closed-form quantum geometric tensor. Compare convergence and final energy of natural-gradient versus plain-gradient optimization against the exact mean-field optimum.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: SR-optimized Jastrow wavefunction for the Lipkin-Meshkov-Glick model in the Dicke basis
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Parametrize amplitudes over total-spin Dicke states with a polynomial Jastrow in S_z and sample the collective basis by Metropolis. Optimize by SR across the LMG quantum phase transition and compare energies and <S_z^2> with exact diagonalization.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Energy-variance extrapolation of SR-optimized RBMs for the two-leg Heisenberg ladder
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Optimize RBMs with increasing hidden-unit density by SR on Heisenberg ladders. Measure energy and variance by VMC and linearly extrapolate energy to zero variance, comparing with Lanczos energies of small ladders.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Finite-temperature Lanczos two-peak specific heat of a half-filled Hubbard ring
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Build sparse Hubbard Hamiltonians in (N_up, N_down) sectors with Jordan-Wigner signs and run random-vector finite-temperature Lanczos. Compute C(T), resolve the low-T spin and high-T charge peaks versus U/t, and estimate stochastic error bars.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Hubbard model exact diagonalization on clusters

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Fermion sign conventions: exact enumeration versus Metropolis Gutzwiller VMC on Hubbard clusters
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: For a Gutzwiller-projected Slater determinant on 2x2 and 2x3 Hubbard clusters, compute the energy by exact enumeration over occupation configurations with consistent fermion ordering. Check it against Metropolis VMC and against the Lanczos ground state.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Hubbard model exact diagonalization on clusters

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Nagaoka ferromagnetism with one and two holes in the U=infinity Hubbard model
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Compare the fully polarized Nagaoka state with Gutzwiller-projected paramagnetic states on square clusters by VMC with no double occupancy. Validate on small clusters by Lanczos total-spin sectors and estimate the critical hole density for ferromagnetism.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Hubbard model exact diagonalization on clusters

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Ogata-Shiba factorized wavefunction for the U=infinity Hubbard chain: spin-charge separation
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Sample the product of a spinless-fermion determinant and a squeezed-chain Heisenberg amplitude (from Lanczos or projected Fermi sea) by Monte Carlo. Compute the electron momentum distribution and spin correlations, and verify against ED of small infinite-U rings.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Hubbard model exact diagonalization on clusters

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Quantum-gas-microscope snapshots of a doped Hubbard cluster from Born-rule sampling
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Obtain the Lanczos ground state of a doped 3x4 Hubbard cluster and draw Fock-space snapshots from |psi|^2. Compute full counting statistics of local moments, staggered-magnetization histograms and hole-centered spin correlations.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Hubbard model exact diagonalization on clusters

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Hubbard-chain Mott plateau: grand-canonical DQMC density versus chemical potential against Lanczos gaps
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Run finite-temperature DQMC of the 1D Hubbard chain over a chemical-potential grid to obtain n(mu) and the compressibility. Compare the incompressible plateau width with charge gaps E(N+1)+E(N-1)-2E(N) from Lanczos and with the Lieb-Wu thermodynamic value.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Hubbard model exact diagonalization on clusters

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Jackknife bias-corrected Binder cumulant crossings of the 3D Ising model
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: From binned Wolff Monte Carlo data of the simple-cubic Ising model, compute Binder cumulants and susceptibilities as nonlinear estimators with jackknife bias correction and errors. Locate pairwise crossings to estimate T_c with uncertainties.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Optimal Metropolis step size from statistical efficiency in hydrogen-atom VMC
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: For a non-exact hydrogen trial function, scan the Metropolis step size. Measure acceptance, variance and blocked autocorrelation time, and find the step that maximizes efficiency 1/(sigma^2 tau), testing the 50%-acceptance heuristic.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Gamma-method error analysis of derived observables in lattice phi^4 hybrid Monte Carlo
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Generate HMC chains for 2D lattice phi^4 near criticality and apply the Wolff Gamma method with automatic windowing to primary and derived quantities. Compare susceptibility and the Binder ratio with blocking and jackknife errors.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: MSER equilibration detection and blocking errors in DMC of the Morse oscillator
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Run DMC for a Morse potential from a deliberately poor initial walker distribution. Apply the MSER truncation rule to the energy trace, then block the remaining data, and compare the bias and error bars with naive discard rules and the exact energy.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Thermodynamic versus virial energy estimators in quartic-oscillator PIMC: blocking and bootstrap errors
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Run primitive-action PIMC for the quartic oscillator at several Trotter numbers. Compute primitive thermodynamic and virial energy estimators and compare their variances and autocorrelations using blocking and moving-block bootstrap as the number of slices grows.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Multihistogram reweighting of the q=10 Potts first-order transition with jackknife errors
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Simulate the 2D 10-state Potts model at several temperatures near T_c with Metropolis or multicanonical updates. Combine the data by Ferrenberg-Swendsen reweighting to obtain the double-peaked energy histogram and latent heat, with jackknife errors over bins.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Shrinkage-regularized correlated fits of PIMC imaginary-time correlators for a Morse oscillator gap
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: From PIMC estimates of <x(tau)x(0)> on many time slices, build jackknife covariance matrices and apply Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage. Perform correlated exponential fits for the first excitation gap and compare chi-square stability with uncorrelated fits.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Quantum Rabi model by PIMC with retarded spin kernel versus truncated-boson ED
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Integrate out the single bosonic mode to obtain an Ising-like imaginary-time spin action with exponential kernel and sample it with kink-based Metropolis moves. Compute <sigma_x> and the energy versus coupling against truncated-Fock ED.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: PIMC of the Feynman Fröhlich-polaron action versus the Feynman variational bound
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Sample discretized electron paths with the retarded Fröhlich influence functional at low temperature. Extract the polaron free or ground-state energy versus alpha and compare with Feynman's variational result and weak-coupling perturbation theory.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Stochastic Liouville equation for pure-dephasing spin-boson coherence versus exact decay
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Generate Gaussian colored noise with the spectral density of an Ohmic bath at finite temperature and propagate stochastic qubit phases. Average the coherence over realizations and compare with the exact independent-boson decoherence function.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Holstein dimer PIMC in phonon coordinates with exactly traced electron versus Lang-Firsov
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: For one electron on two Holstein sites, sample phonon paths with the electronic weight given by products of 2x2 transfer matrices. Compare ground-state energy and site-displacement correlations with truncated-boson ED and variational Lang-Firsov.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Caldeira-Leggett dissipative double-well: PIMC with influence functional and tunneling suppression
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Sample imaginary-time paths of a particle in a symmetric double well coupled to an Ohmic bath through the nonlocal Caldeira-Leggett kernel. Measure the position autocorrelation and its long-time plateau to show dissipation-induced localization versus damping strength.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Quantum Langevin equation with colored noise: damped-oscillator equilibrium fluctuations
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Integrate a generalized Langevin equation for an oscillator coupled to an Ohmic bath, driven by noise with the quantum fluctuation-dissipation spectrum. Compare stationary <x^2> and <p^2> with exact quantum Brownian-motion results versus temperature.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Dicke superradiant transition: coherent-state VMC versus truncated-boson ED
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Use a variational product of spin-coherent and boson-coherent states with a Jastrow correction, sampled in the total-spin and Fock basis. Compute photon number and energy across the Dicke critical coupling and compare with ED in the symmetric subspace.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Stochastic Lanczos quadrature low-temperature entropy of the 18-site kagome Heisenberg cluster
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Build the sparse kagome Heisenberg Hamiltonian by S_z sectors and estimate Z(T), E(T) and S(T) by stochastic Lanczos quadrature with random vectors. Identify the low-T entropy shoulder and quantify sample-to-sample error bars.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Spin-wave velocity of the Heisenberg chain: momentum-sector Lanczos versus SSE estimates
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Compute low-lying energies in S_z and momentum sectors with Lanczos to extract the velocity from E(k) near k = pi. Compare with c = sqrt(rho_s/chi) from SSE winding numbers and susceptibility, and with the exact pi J/2.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Fast randomized iteration with stochastic vector compression for the 4x4 Heisenberg ground state
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Implement a power method on (1 - epsilon H) with stochastic compression of the iterate to a fixed number of nonzeros. Estimate the ground-state energy via projected estimators and compare its bias and variance with exact Lanczos as the compression budget varies.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Tower of states of the 4x4 Heisenberg antiferromagnet: Lanczos rotor spectrum versus SSE susceptibility
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Compute the lowest energy in each total-spin sector of the 4x4 square lattice by Lanczos and fit E(S) = S(S+1)/(2I). Compare the moment of inertia with chi_perp inferred from SSE uniform susceptibility.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: SSE of the reduced BCS Hamiltonian as an all-to-all XY model versus exact thermodynamics
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Map Richardson pairing on equally spaced levels to Anderson pseudospins and simulate them with SSE, which is sign-free for attractive G. Compute pairing energy and specific heat versus T and compare with exact seniority-sector diagonalization.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Lattice GFMC of the picket-fence pairing model with BCS guiding versus Richardson solution
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Implement importance-sampled lattice GFMC in the pair-occupation basis with a number-projected BCS guide. Compare ground-state energies and occupation numbers with the exact Richardson root-finding solution across weak and strong coupling.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Electron bilayer VMC: interlayer pair correlation and energy versus layer separation
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Simulate two 2D electron-gas layers separated by distance d using a 2D Ewald sum for intra- and interlayer Coulomb terms and Slater-Jastrow trial functions with an interlayer Jastrow. Compute g_12(r) and correlation energy versus d.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Homogeneous electron gas in periodic boxes

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Momentum distribution and renormalization factor Z of the 3D electron gas by VMC
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Use a Slater-Jastrow VMC with Ewald interactions to estimate the off-diagonal one-body density matrix via determinant-ratio displacement moves. Fourier transform it to n(k) and extract the jump Z at k_F versus r_s.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Homogeneous electron gas in periodic boxes

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Charged Bose gas in a periodic box: RPA Jastrow VMC with Ewald energies
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Simulate bosons with Coulomb interactions on a uniform background using a Gaskell-type Jastrow and Ewald summation. Compute energy and S(k) versus r_s and check the plasmon small-k behavior and comparisons with Bogoliubov theory.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Homogeneous electron gas in periodic boxes

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Polarization energy of the 2D electron gas: polarized versus unpolarized Slater-Jastrow VMC
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Compute VMC energies of fully polarized and paramagnetic 2D electron gases at several r_s with Ewald sums and closed-shell occupations. Estimate the Bloch ferromagnetic crossing and compare with Hartree-Fock.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Homogeneous electron gas in periodic boxes

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Laughlin nu=1/3 Coulomb energy on the disk via plasma-analogy Metropolis
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Sample |Psi_Laughlin|^2 as a 2D one-component plasma at Gamma = 2m with Metropolis. Compute the electron-electron, electron-background and background-background energies, and extrapolate the per-particle energy to large N.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Homogeneous electron gas in periodic boxes

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Friedel oscillations around a charged impurity in the 2D electron gas by VMC
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Add a fixed point charge to a periodic 2D electron gas treated by Slater-Jastrow VMC with Ewald interactions. Compute the radial induced density and compare oscillation period and amplitude with Lindhard linear response.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Homogeneous electron gas in periodic boxes

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Population-dynamics cavity method for Anderson localization on the Bethe lattice
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Iterate a stochastic population of cavity Green's functions for the Anderson model on a random regular graph. Compute the typical local DOS (imaginary self-energy) versus disorder W to locate the localization transition near W_c of about 18 for connectivity 3.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Thouless conductance from twist-angle level curvature in random-field Heisenberg chains
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Diagonalize disordered Heisenberg chains with twisted boundary conditions and compute level curvatures or the energy-shift-to-spacing ratio. Disorder-average the logarithm of the Thouless conductance versus chain length and disorder across the ergodic-MBL crossover.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: l-bit localization length from infinite-time averaged local operators in random-field XXZ
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Construct l-bits as infinite-time averages of sigma^z_i using full diagonalization. Decompose them in Pauli strings to measure weight decay with distance, and disorder-average the localization length versus field strength.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Eigenstate thermalization test: local-magnetization fluctuations between neighboring eigenstates
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: For disordered XXZ chains, compute diagonal expectation values of sigma^z in all mid-spectrum eigenstates. Evaluate the standard deviation of differences between adjacent eigenstates and disorder-average its scaling with system size in ergodic and localized regimes.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Efros-Shklovskii Coulomb gap of the 2D electron glass by Metropolis Monte Carlo
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Simulate the classical Coulomb glass of localized electrons with random site energies and long-range interactions using single-particle and pair-exchange Metropolis moves at low T. Compute the single-particle DOS and its linear gap.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Quantum avalanche toy model: GOE dot coupled to a localized l-bit chain
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Couple a small random-matrix ergodic dot to a chain of l-bits with exponentially decaying couplings, sampled over disorder. Track level-spacing ratio statistics versus chain length and coupling decay to locate the avalanche thermalization threshold.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Quantum pendulum libration gap from PIMC imaginary-time angular correlator
