physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Planar rotor H = -B d²/dθ² - V cos θ is sampled by angular path-integral Monte Carlo with winding sectors. The ⟨cos θ(0) cos θ(τ)⟩ and ⟨sin θ(0) sin θ(τ)⟩ correlators are fitted to exponentials to obtain gaps, which are compared with Mathieu-function eigenvalues.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Band effective mass of a particle in a cosine lattice from PIMC
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: A particle in V0 cos(2πx/a) is simulated with path-integral Monte Carlo on unwrapped periodic paths. The band mass m* is extracted from the low-temperature winding/centroid imaginary-time diffusion and compared with the curvature of the Mathieu band minimum.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Triplet gap of the alternating-bond Heisenberg chain from SSE imaginary-time correlators
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: SSE with operator-loop updates measures the staggered S^z(τ) correlator of the chain with bonds J(1±δ). Exponential fits give the triplet gap versus δ, which is compared with the δ^{2/3} scaling law (up to logarithmic corrections).

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Edge versus bulk single-particle gaps in an SSH-Hubbard chain from DQMC
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Determinant QMC of an open Su-Schrieffer-Heeger chain with on-site U computes the local G(τ) on edge and bulk sites. Exponential decays give the edge Hubbard gap and the bulk dimerization gap as functions of U.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Diagrammatic Monte Carlo of the 1D Peierls bond polaron
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Diagrammatic Monte Carlo samples Feynman diagrams of G(k,τ) for one electron with SSH-type momentum-dependent coupling to dispersionless phonons. The polaron energy and quasiparticle weight come from the G(k=0,τ) tail, and the effective mass from small-k energies.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Stochastic optimization method continuation of quasiparticle-plus-continuum fermionic spectra
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Mishchenko's stochastic optimization method represents the spectrum as a sum of rectangles updated by random moves, then averages the good solutions. It is applied to noisy synthetic fermionic G(τ) from a Lorentzian quasiparticle plus a broad continuum to recover Z and the peak position.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Constrained stochastic analytic continuation with δ-peak edge for magnon-plus-continuum spectra
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Shao-Sandvik constrained sampling uses a fixed-weight δ-function edge A0 δ(ω-ω0) plus a continuum of sampled δ-functions at fictitious temperature, with a bosonic kernel. Scanning A0 to optimize χ² recovers the true edge weight from noisy synthetic imaginary-time data.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: 2D dipolar Bose gas in a periodic box: Jastrow VMC equation of state
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Bosons with perpendicular dipoles (1/r³) in a periodic square box use a periodic-image sum with continuum tail correction. A two-body Jastrow VMC gives energy per particle and g(r) versus density, compared with the dilute-gas logarithmic expansion.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Homogeneous electron gas in periodic boxes

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Twist-averaged VMC of 2D spin-polarized dipolar fermions
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Plane-wave Slater determinants with twisted boundary conditions and a Jastrow factor are sampled for dipolar fermions in a periodic box. Averaging over random twists removes shell effects, and the result is compared with periodic boundary conditions and the Hartree-Fock energy.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Homogeneous electron gas in periodic boxes

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Electron-hole bilayer: excitonic pairing VMC versus decoupled Fermi liquids
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Electrons and holes in two layers a distance d apart interact through 2D Ewald-summed Coulomb potentials. VMC energies of a BCS-like excitonic pair-determinant trial and an uncorrelated Slater-Jastrow trial are compared versus d to locate the condensate stability region.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Homogeneous electron gas in periodic boxes

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Pure neutron matter equation of state from Jastrow VMC with Minnesota potential
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Spin-1/2 neutrons in a periodic box use closed-shell plane-wave determinants and a central Jastrow with the spin-dependent Minnesota interaction. VMC gives E/N versus density, compared with the free Fermi gas and Hartree-Fock.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Homogeneous electron gas in periodic boxes

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Spin-polarized atomic hydrogen gas: McMillan VMC with Silvera triplet potential
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Bosonic H↓ atoms interacting via the Silvera triplet potential are treated with a McMillan Jastrow in a periodic box with tail corrections. Energy per atom versus density and g(r) confirm a self-bound-free gas.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Homogeneous electron gas in periodic boxes

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Homogeneous hard-sphere Bose gas DMC equation of state versus Lee-Huang-Yang
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Importance-sampled DMC uses a two-body scattering-solution Jastrow in a periodic box. E/N versus gas parameter na³ is compared with the mean-field and Lee-Huang-Yang expansions to find where beyond-LHY terms matter.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Homogeneous electron gas in periodic boxes

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: 2D hard-disk Bose gas DMC versus Schick logarithmic equation of state
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: DMC of hard-disk bosons in a periodic square box uses a 2D zero-energy scattering Jastrow. The energy versus density is compared with Schick's 4πn/|ln(na²)| law and its higher-order corrections.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Homogeneous electron gas in periodic boxes

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Dilute repulsive two-component Fermi gas: VMC versus Lee-Yang expansion
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Spin-balanced hard-sphere fermions use plane-wave Slater determinants times a Jastrow factor in a periodic box. VMC energies versus k_F a are compared with the Lee-Yang second-order expansion including the 4(11-2ln2)/(35π²) term.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Homogeneous electron gas in periodic boxes

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: 2D Yukawa bosons (vortex-line model): DMC liquid versus crystal freezing
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Bosons interacting via K0(r/λ) in a periodic box (Magro-Ceperley vortex model) are simulated with DMC from a Jastrow liquid trial and a Nosanow triangular-crystal trial. Comparing the energies brackets the freezing density.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Homogeneous electron gas in periodic boxes

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Random spin-1 Heisenberg chain: Hyman-Yang SDRG and Haldane-to-random-singlet crossover
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Strong-disorder decimation with spin-1 and effective spin-1/2 rules is applied to random spin-1 chains. The fraction of decimated singlet bonds and the gap distributions are tracked versus disorder width to locate the Haldane-to-random-singlet crossover.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Random dimerized Heisenberg chain: Griffiths dynamical exponent from SDRG
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Ma-Dasgupta decimation is run on chains with even/odd bonds drawn from distributions of different width. The dynamical exponent z versus dimerization is extracted from the low-energy tail of the last-decimated gap distribution.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Mixed ferro-antiferro random spin chain: Westerberg large-spin SDRG scaling
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: SDRG for random-sign couplings merges spins into large effective spins or singlets. The growth of typical cluster spin with RG scale and the Curie-like susceptibility exponent are compared with the large-spin fixed point.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: 2D random transverse-field Ising SDRG: critical point and cluster fractal dimension
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Kovács-Iglói-style decimation of strongest fields and bonds is applied to square-lattice disorder samples. The critical disorder point and the fractal dimension of magnetized clusters come from finite-size scaling.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Long-range random transverse-field Ising chain: SDRG with power-law couplings
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: SDRG with J_ij ∝ r^-α is implemented using cluster merging that keeps all pairs. Gap-versus-size scaling over many disorder samples shows finite-z critical scaling instead of infinite randomness.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Random two-leg Heisenberg ladder: SDRG with mixed-sign effective couplings
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Strong-disorder decimation of random rung and leg couplings generates ferromagnetic effective bonds and spin clusters. Low-energy gap distributions and rung-singlet fractions characterize the random-ladder phases.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Random quantum Potts chain SDRG: q-dependence of the infinite-randomness fixed point
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Senthil-Majumdar decimation rules with q-dependent prefactors are applied to random q-state Potts chains. Magnetization exponents and log-gap scaling are compared across q = 2, 3, 4 to test universality.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: 3D cubic Bose-Hubbard Mott transition at unit filling from SSE winding numbers
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Directed-loop SSE with truncated occupations samples the cubic-lattice Bose-Hubbard model. Superfluid stiffness from winding numbers gives ρ_s L crossings that locate (t/U)_c at unit filling.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Extended hard-core bosons on the square lattice: checkerboard solid via SSE
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: SSE of half-filled hard-core bosons with nearest-neighbor repulsion V measures the (π,π) structure factor and the winding-number stiffness. Their behavior versus V/t locates the superfluid-to-checkerboard-solid transition.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Josephson-junction array superconductor-insulator transition via (2+1)D Villain XY Monte Carlo
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: The 2D quantum rotor array maps to a 3D classical Villain/XY model, simulated with Wolff cluster Monte Carlo. Helicity-modulus crossings give the critical E_J/E_C of the array.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Rokhsar-Kivelson quantum dimer model on the square lattice by lattice GFMC
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Lattice Green's function Monte Carlo is run in the dimer-covering basis with plaquette flips, a guiding function and walker reconfiguration. Ground-state energy and columnar order versus V/t are computed and checked against E = 0 at the RK point.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Green's function Monte Carlo on lattices

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: 1D Kondo necklace spin gap by lattice GFMC with stochastic reconfiguration
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: GFMC of the XY chain coupled to local spins via J S·τ is run in the S^z_tot = 0 and 1 sectors. Their energy difference gives the spin gap as a function of J/t.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Green's function Monte Carlo on lattices

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Two-orbital density-density Hubbard DMFT with Hirsch-Fye: Hund's coupling and quasiparticle weight
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Bethe-lattice DMFT is solved with a Hirsch-Fye impurity solver using Hubbard-Stratonovich fields for each orbital pair of the density-density interaction. The quasiparticle weight from Matsubara self-energies is computed versus Hund's J at fixed U.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Dynamical mean-field theory with ED solver

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Two-impurity Anderson model by Hirsch-Fye QMC: RKKY versus Kondo screening
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Two Anderson impurities with direct exchange or hybridization coupling are simulated with Hirsch-Fye QMC. The interimpurity spin correlation ⟨S1·S2⟩ and local susceptibility versus coupling show the crossover from Kondo screening to the interimpurity singlet.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Dynamical mean-field theory with ED solver

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Site-diluted square-lattice Heisenberg antiferromagnet: staggered moment versus vacancy concentration
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: SSE loop updates are applied to disorder realizations of randomly diluted square lattices. The disorder-averaged staggered structure factor is extrapolated in size to obtain the ordered moment versus dilution up to the percolation threshold.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Stochastic series expansion for Heisenberg models

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Columnar-dimerized square-lattice Heisenberg model: critical coupling from SSE stiffness crossings
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: SSE of the square lattice with strong columnar dimer bonds measures the spin stiffness and Binder ratio. Size crossings locate the Néel-to-dimer quantum critical ratio.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Stochastic series expansion for Heisenberg models

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Néel transition of the Ising-anisotropic square-lattice XXZ antiferromagnet by SSE
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Finite-temperature SSE of the XXZ model with Δ > 1 measures staggered-magnetization Binder cumulants. Size crossings give T_N(Δ), which vanishes logarithmically as Δ → 1.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Stochastic series expansion for Heisenberg models

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Coupled Heisenberg chains: Néel order onset for weak interchain coupling
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: SSE of the spatially anisotropic square-lattice Heisenberg model with J⊥ ≪ J measures the staggered moment from finite-size structure factors. The ordered moment versus J⊥/J is compared with chain mean-field theory.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Stochastic series expansion for Heisenberg models

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Three-leg Heisenberg ladder: gapless odd-leg susceptibility from SSE
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: SSE computes the uniform susceptibility and correlations of three-leg ladders versus temperature. The gapless behavior of odd-leg ladders is contrasted with the activated decay of even-leg ladders.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Stochastic series expansion for Heisenberg models

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Order by disorder in the triangular-lattice transverse-field Ising antiferromagnet via SSE
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: SSE with cluster updates samples the frustrated but sign-free transverse-field Ising model on the triangular lattice. The three-sublattice clock order parameter ψ = m_A + ω m_B + ω² m_C is measured versus transverse field.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Stochastic series expansion for Heisenberg models

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Unfrustrated long-range Heisenberg chain: ordering versus decay exponent by SSE
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: SSE of the chain with J(r) = (-1)^{r+1}/r^α is run with all-pair bond sampling. Size scaling of the staggered structure factor determines the α below which long-range Néel order appears.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Stochastic series expansion for Heisenberg models

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Plaquette-RVB transition in the 1/5-depleted square-lattice Heisenberg model
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: SSE is applied to the CaV4O9-type depleted lattice with plaquette and dimer couplings. Stiffness crossings locate the quantum transitions from the Néel phase to the plaquette and dimer singlet phases.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Stochastic series expansion for Heisenberg models

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Antiferromagnetic spin-5/2 molecular ring: SSE susceptibility and Landé interval rule
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Split-spin SSE simulates a hexanuclear S = 5/2 Heisenberg ring. Susceptibility versus temperature is compared with exact sector diagonalization and the rotational-band (Landé interval) model.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Stochastic series expansion for Heisenberg models

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Mixed-spin (1, 1/2) ferrimagnetic chain: low-temperature susceptibility by SSE
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: SSE of the alternating spin-1/spin-1/2 Heisenberg chain computes χT versus T, showing the ferrimagnetic minimum and the low-temperature divergence. Results are compared with linear spin-wave theory.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Stochastic series expansion for Heisenberg models

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: SU(N) square-lattice antiferromagnet: loss of Néel order with N via loop QMC
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Loop SSE for the fundamental/conjugate SU(N) model weights each loop by N. Staggered structure factors versus N and size locate where Néel order disappears.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Stochastic series expansion for Heisenberg models

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Hénon-Heiles ground state: DMC with timestep extrapolation versus basis diagonalization
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Branching DMC with reference-energy feedback samples the 2D Hénon-Heiles potential. Energies are extrapolated in timestep and walker number and compared with harmonic-oscillator basis diagonalization.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Diffusion Monte Carlo for anharmonic oscillators

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Zero-point energy of water from DMC on a quartic normal-mode force field
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: DMC in the three normal coordinates of H2O uses a cubic-quartic force field. The anharmonic ZPE is compared with the harmonic estimate and second-order vibrational perturbation theory.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Diffusion Monte Carlo for anharmonic oscillators

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Particle in a box with absorbing walls: DMC timestep bias and boundary correction
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: DMC with walkers killed at hard walls shows an O(√Δτ) bias in 1D and 3D boxes. Image/boundary-crossing probability corrections restore linear convergence to the exact energy.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Diffusion Monte Carlo for anharmonic oscillators

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Ashkin-Teller model: continuously varying thermal exponent from Monte Carlo RG
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Cluster Monte Carlo of the square-lattice Ashkin-Teller model is combined with majority-rule blocking of both Ising species. MCRG thermal eigenvalues along the critical line are compared with the exact varying exponent.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Real-space renormalization group for spin models

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Attractive Gaudin-Yang Fermi gas in 1D: DMC energy versus Bethe ansatz
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Two-component fermions with attractive delta interactions are simulated by DMC with a pair-product trial (nodes of the 1D free-fermion structure). Energies versus coupling are compared with numerically solved Gaudin-Yang Bethe equations.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: McGuire polaron: single impurity in a 1D Fermi sea by DMC
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: One distinguishable impurity interacts via a delta potential with N polarized fermions on a ring. DMC with exact free-fermion nodes gives the polaron energy, compared with McGuire's exact formula.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: 1D hard-rod bosons: DMC energy and structure factor versus excluded-volume mapping
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: DMC of hard-rod bosons on a ring computes the energy and S(k). These are compared with the exact mapping to a Tonks gas of reduced length, testing the Luttinger parameter K = (1 - na)².

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: 1D dipolar bosons DMC: Luttinger parameter from static structure factor
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: DMC with a two-body Jastrow and periodic dipolar sums samples 1D bosons with 1/r³ repulsion. The Luttinger parameter K is extracted from the small-k slope of S(k) versus density.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Trapped Tonks-Girardeau gas: Metropolis one-body density matrix and momentum distribution
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Metropolis sampling of the Bose-Fermi-mapped harmonic-trap wavefunction uses displacement estimators. They give the one-body density matrix, n(k) with its 1/k⁴ tail, and condensate occupation versus N.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Bose polaron energy in a dilute 3D Bose gas by DMC
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: A single impurity with an attractive square-well interaction sits in a hard-sphere Bose gas in a periodic box, with Jastrow trial factors. DMC gives the impurity chemical potential versus impurity-boson scattering length, compared with perturbation theory.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Moore-Read Pfaffian on the sphere: Metropolis pair correlation and Coulomb energy
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Metropolis sampling of the ν=1/2 Pfaffian on the Haldane sphere evaluates the Pfaffian with a stable Parlett-Reid/Householder routine. Pair correlation g(r) and per-particle Coulomb energy are extrapolated in N.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Solid para-hydrogen VMC with Silvera-Goldman potential: equation of state and Lindemann ratio
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: A Nosanow-Jastrow trial on an hcp lattice is sampled with VMC using the Silvera-Goldman interaction. Energy versus density gives the equilibrium density and Lindemann ratio, compared with experiment.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Para-hydrogen clusters by PIMC: superfluid response versus cluster size
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Path-integral Monte Carlo with bosonic exchange permutations samples (pH2)_N clusters. The 3D area-estimator superfluid fraction and permutation statistics are reported versus N and temperature.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Bertsch parameter of few unitary fermions from lattice auxiliary-field projection Monte Carlo
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Two-component fermions with an on-site attraction tuned to unitarity via the Lüscher two-body formula are projected with sign-free auxiliary-field Monte Carlo on small periodic lattices. The energy ratio to the free gas estimates ξ.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Half-filled Kondo lattice model by DQMC: magnetic order versus Kondo coupling
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Sign-free DQMC of the 2D half-filled Kondo lattice uses a Hubbard-Stratonovich decoupling of the Kondo term. The f-spin antiferromagnetic structure factor versus J_K/t locates the transition to the Kondo insulator.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Spinless fermions on the honeycomb lattice: CDW transition by CT-INT Monte Carlo
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Continuous-time interaction-expansion QMC of the half-filled t-V model on small honeycomb clusters (sign-free) measures the CDW structure factor. Finite-size crossings locate V_c/t.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Sawtooth chain flat-band magnetization jump by random-vector finite-temperature Lanczos
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Finite-temperature Lanczos with random starting vectors computes magnetization curves and entropy of the frustrated delta chain. The saturation jump and the large residual entropy from localized magnons are characterized.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Haken-Strobl dephasing on a tight-binding chain: diffusion constant from stochastic unraveling
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Stochastic phase-noise trajectories of a single particle on a lattice are averaged to give the mean-square displacement. The crossover from ballistic to diffusive motion is compared with D = 2J²/γ.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Open quantum systems and stochastic unravelings

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Rydberg facilitation as an absorbing-state transition: kinetic Monte Carlo of rate equations
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Kinetic Monte Carlo of a 1D Rydberg array uses facilitated excitation, de-excitation and decay rates. Stationary density and survival scaling are measured near the directed-percolation-like absorbing transition.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Open quantum systems and stochastic unravelings

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Single-electron transistor Coulomb diamonds by kinetic Monte Carlo of orthodox tunneling
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Gillespie simulation of orthodox-theory tunneling rates through a metallic island gives current versus bias and gate voltage. The Coulomb diamonds and finite-temperature smearing are mapped.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Open quantum systems and stochastic unravelings

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Quantum state diffusion of a damped driven Duffing oscillator: quantum-to-classical bistability
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Quantum state diffusion trajectories in a truncated Fock basis are integrated for a driven Kerr-Duffing oscillator. Trajectory localization and switching between bistable states are compared with the master-equation steady state.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Open quantum systems and stochastic unravelings

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Complex Langevin for the relativistic Bose gas at nonzero chemical potential
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Complex Langevin is applied to a 4D lattice complex scalar field with a complex action at chemical potential μ. Density versus μ shows the Silver Blaze plateau, with adaptive step sizes and checks of the drift distribution.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Open quantum systems and stochastic unravelings

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Dispersion C6 coefficient of quantum Drude oscillators by PIMC
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Two coupled 3D Drude oscillators with dipole-dipole coupling are simulated by PIMC at low temperature. The interaction energy versus separation gives C6, compared with the exact normal-mode result 3ħω α²/4.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Path-integral Monte Carlo for nuclear quantum effects

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Phaseless AFQMC for the linear H8 chain in STO-3G versus full CI
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Phaseless auxiliary-field QMC uses Cholesky-decomposed two-electron integrals and an RHF trial for equally spaced H8. Energies along bond stretching are compared with full CI.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: SU(3) Sutherland chain: Gutzwiller-projected Fermi sea VMC
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Metropolis sampling of the three-color Gutzwiller-projected Fermi sea on a ring uses color-exchange moves. The energy and color-color correlations are compared with the Bethe-ansatz energy of the SU(3) Heisenberg chain.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Fixed-phase DMC of two electrons on a 2D quantum ring with Aharonov-Bohm flux
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Fixed-phase DMC with a phase taken from angular-momentum eigenstates computes ground-state energies versus enclosed flux. Singlet/triplet crossings and the persistent current are compared with exact diagonalization.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: DSMC of a trapped Fermi gas relaxation with Pauli blocking
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Direct-simulation Monte Carlo of a harmonically trapped two-component Fermi gas includes final-state Pauli-blocking factors. The relaxation rate of a momentum-space anisotropy versus T/T_F shows collisional suppression in the degenerate regime.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Open quantum systems and stochastic unravelings

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Binary hard-sphere Bose mixture in a harmonic trap: VMC phase separation
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Two bosonic species in a common spherical trap, with intra- and inter-species hard-sphere Jastrow factors on Gaussian orbitals. Metropolis VMC gives the energy per particle and the species-resolved radial density profiles. The density-overlap integral is computed versus the interspecies scattering length to locate the miscible-to-separated crossover.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Trapped dilute Bose gas variational treatment

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: RBM quantum-state tomography of a TFIM chain from sampled Z-basis snapshots
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Draw Born-rule snapshots from the exact ground state of an 8-site transverse-field Ising chain and train a positive RBM on them by contrastive divergence with block Gibbs sampling. Report the fidelity and the reconstructed energy against exact diagonalization as the number of snapshots grows.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Neural-network quantum states on spin models

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Interaction shift of the BEC transition temperature of dilute hard-sphere bosons via PIMC
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: PIMC of hard-sphere bosons in a periodic 3D box, using a hard-sphere pair action and permutation moves. Winding-number superfluid fractions at several temperatures and densities give Tc(a)/Tc0, and its linear-in-a^(1/3) shift is estimated.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Bosonic exchange in PIMC and superfluid fraction

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Positronium hydride PsH binding energy by explicitly correlated VMC
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Treat the proton, two electrons and one positron with a Hylleraas-type trial function that includes electron-positron and electron-electron Jastrow factors and obeys the cusp conditions. Metropolis VMC with parameter optimization gives the total energy and the binding relative to H plus Ps.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Excess electron in a hard-sphere fluid: PIMC localization and radius of gyration
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: A quantum electron path interacts through a hard-core pseudopotential with mobile classical hard spheres. Joint Metropolis moves of the bisected path and the solvent particles give the electron's imaginary-time radius of gyration versus solvent density, signalling the crossover to cavity localization.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Path integral Monte Carlo at finite temperature

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Restricted PIMC of the ideal Fermi gas in a periodic box versus exact energies
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Fixed-node (restricted) PIMC of spin-polarized free fermions, using the free-particle density-matrix determinant as the nodal constraint, with permutation sampling. Thermodynamic energies versus temperature are compared with the exact canonical-ensemble recursion, and the sign problem of unrestricted PIMC is quantified.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Positive-P stochastic simulation of a lossy Kerr oscillator: g2 dynamics
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Integrate the positive-P Ito stochastic differential equations for a single damped Kerr mode prepared in a coherent state. Trajectory ensembles give the mean photon number and the second-order coherence g2(t), which are compared with an exact Lindblad master-equation solution, and the growth of sampling error is monitored.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Stochastic phase-space methods for open quantum systems

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Neutron drops in a harmonic trap: Jastrow-Slater VMC with Minnesota potential
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Small numbers of neutrons (N=2 to 8) sit in an external oscillator well and interact through the Minnesota potential with spin projectors. Slater determinants of oscillator orbitals with a central Jastrow factor give, by Metropolis VMC, the energies and radii, and the shell-closure energy differences are computed.

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Odd-even staggering of trapped attractive two-component fermions with AGP-Jastrow VMC
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Two-spin fermions in a 3D harmonic trap interact through an attractive Gaussian potential. They are described by an antisymmetrized geminal power (pair-orbital determinant) times a Jastrow factor, with an unpaired orbital for odd N. VMC energies for N=2 to 7 give the pairing gap from the three-point staggering.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Ultracold Fermi gases by quantum Monte Carlo

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Attractive Fermi polaron in 3D: fixed-node DMC energy versus scattering length
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: A single impurity interacts through a square-well attraction with a spin-polarized Fermi sea of plane waves in a periodic box, using a Slater-Jastrow trial function with an impurity-fermion pair Jastrow. Fixed-node DMC gives the polaron energy across 1/(kF a), compared with the Chevy variational result.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Ultracold Fermi gases by quantum Monte Carlo

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Heisenberg antiferromagnet on a Cayley tree: SSE ground-state order and susceptibility
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Loop SSE for the spin-1/2 Heisenberg model on finite bipartite Cayley trees with a few generations. It computes the staggered structure factor, the uniform susceptibility and the low-temperature energy, examining the anomalously low-lying tower of states that comes from the large boundary.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Stochastic series expansion for quantum spin systems

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Bosons in a deep 1D optical lattice: continuum DMC versus Wannier Bose-Hubbard
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Run DMC of bosons with a narrow Gaussian repulsion in a periodic cosine potential at unit filling, with a Jastrow trial function. Ground-state energies are compared with Bose-Hubbard ED, using J and U computed from maximally localized Wannier functions of the band structure, as the lattice depth varies.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Continuum quantum Monte Carlo of trapped and lattice bosons

physics/many_body|stochastic.title: Counterflow superfluidity of two-species hard-core bosons via worm-algorithm winding numbers
physics/many_body|stochastic.gist: Two hard-core boson species live on a periodic chain or square lattice with interspecies on-site repulsion at total unit filling. A two-species worm algorithm samples separate and counterflow winding numbers, which locate the regime where only counterflow stiffness survives.
physics/many_body|stochastic.area: Lattice quantum Monte Carlo of bosons

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Time to MRCA under exponential growth via lineage-count Kolmogorov equations
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the forward Kolmogorov ODEs of the pure-death lineage-count chain of a Kingman coalescent with time-varying rates n(n-1)/(2N(t)) using solve_ivp. Compute the T_MRCA distribution, the expected total branch length and the expected segregating sites, and compare with constant-size formulas.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Two-deme structured coalescent: pairwise coalescence times and F_ST
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Write ODEs for the probability that two lineages are uncoalesced and sit in the same or different demes under symmetric migration. Integrate them to get expected within- and between-deme coalescence times and F_ST, then compare with the analytic island-model result.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Site frequency spectrum under a bottleneck via diffusion moment equations
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the closed linear ODE system for expected SFS entries of the Wright-Fisher diffusion (moments approach) through a piecewise-constant bottleneck history. Compute Tajima's D at sampling time from the expected spectrum.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Heterozygosity loss and recovery after a population bottleneck
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Solve the drift-mutation ODE dH/dt = -H/(2N(t)) + 2μ(1-H) for an arbitrary N(t) history and compute the time for H to recover to 95% of equilibrium. Compare with expected pairwise coalescence times obtained by integrating the coalescence hazard.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Seed-bank coalescent: pairwise coalescence time with dormant compartments
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Model lineages switching between active and dormant states, where coalescence happens only in the active state, as a linear ODE system for state probabilities. Compute the expected pairwise coalescence time and the effective-size inflation factor, and check the result against the matrix-inverse solution.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Diversity reduction near a selective sweep by structured-coalescent ODEs
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate a logistic sweep trajectory together with the ODE for the probability that a linked neutral lineage escapes through recombination. Compute the expected heterozygosity reduction as a function of recombination distance and compare with the Maynard Smith-Haigh approximation.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Aliev-Panfilov single-cell action potential duration restitution by S1-S2 pacing
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the Aliev-Panfilov two-variable ODE under S1 pacing followed by premature S2 stimuli. Measure APD versus diastolic interval, fit the restitution curve and find its slope-one point.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Fenton-Karma three-variable model conduction velocity restitution in a cable
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Simulate a 1D Fenton-Karma cable by method of lines under repeated pacing. Measure the conduction velocity of the last pulse versus diastolic interval to build the CV restitution curve and find the conduction-block interval.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Noble 1962 Purkinje fiber pacemaker period versus potassium conductance
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the stiff Noble 1962 Hodgkin-Huxley-type Purkinje model with a BDF solver. Measure the spontaneous firing period and maximum diastolic potential as a K+ conductance scaling is varied, and locate where oscillations disappear.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Beeler-Reuter ventricular action potential APD90 sensitivity to calcium current
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the eight-variable Beeler-Reuter model with a stiff solver after a single stimulus. Compute APD90 and the plateau potential for scaled slow inward conductance, and estimate their normalized sensitivity coefficients by finite differences.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Source-sink failure: pacemaker cell coupled to quiescent myocytes
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Couple an oscillatory FHN pacemaker cell diffusively to N excitable quiescent FHN cells and integrate the ODE network. Find the critical gap-junction coupling at which pacemaking is suppressed, as a function of N.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Generalized Langevin cell motility with Markovian embedding of memory
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Represent a bi-exponential velocity memory kernel through auxiliary OU variables and integrate the linear moment ODEs. Compute the velocity autocorrelation and MSD, and identify the transient subdiffusive regime.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Cell motility and random walk statistics

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Crow-Kimura parallel quasispecies model: mean fitness from ODE and eigenproblem
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the parallel mutation-selection ODE for a single-peak landscape grouped into Hamming classes. Compare the steady-state mean fitness with the dominant eigenvalue of the class matrix and check the sharpness of the transition as L increases.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Lethal mutagenesis of a within-host virus quasispecies
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Couple target-cell dynamics to a two-class quasispecies (master and mutant virus) ODE whose mutation rate is increased by a mutagenic drug. Compute the critical mutation rate at which the infected steady state disappears, together with viral load versus mutation rate.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Eigen-Schuster hypercycle oscillations for n members
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the elementary hypercycle replicator ODE on the simplex for n = 3 to 8. Determine where the interior fixed point is stable or a limit cycle appears, and measure oscillation period and amplitude versus n.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Continuous-trait mutation-selection balance as Sturm-Liouville eigenproblem
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Solve the stationary replicator-mutator equation μu'' - s(x)u = -λu for a Gaussian and a quartic fitness function by Numerov shooting on the eigenvalue. Compute the equilibrium trait variance and mean-fitness load, and compare with Hermite-function results.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Resistance emergence during antibiotic therapy with PK/PD mutation-selection ODEs
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate a pharmacokinetic dosing ODE coupled to sensitive and resistant bacterial populations with mutation and concentration-dependent kill rates. Compute the time at which resistant cells dominate and map the mutant selection window over dose.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: HKY85 transition probabilities by Kolmogorov ODEs and ML pairwise distance
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the 4x4 forward Kolmogorov equations for the HKY85 rate matrix and verify the result against expm. Compute the maximum-likelihood divergence time between two aligned sequences from their site-pattern counts using scalar optimization.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: CpG depletion: dinucleotide frequency dynamics under context-dependent mutation
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Write mean-field ODEs for the 16 dinucleotide frequencies under uniform substitution plus elevated CpG→TpG mutation, using a pair-closure approximation. Integrate to steady state and compute the CpG observed/expected ratio versus hypermutation rate.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: TKF91 indel model: alignment link probabilities and expected alignment length
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the TKF91 birth-death ODEs for the probabilities of a nucleotide surviving with k descendants and inserting new links. Compute the pairwise alignment homology-structure probabilities and the expected gap length versus divergence time.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Non-homogeneous substitution with drifting GC content: phylogenetic pruning likelihood
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the time-ordered Kolmogorov ODE for a substitution matrix whose equilibrium GC content changes along a branch, then run Felsenstein pruning on a three-taxon tree. Compute the log-likelihood and the bias relative to a homogeneous model.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Kimura-Ohta conditional mean fixation time of a beneficial allele
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Solve the second-order inhomogeneous BVP for the mean absorption time and the conditional fixation time of an allele under genic selection in the Wright-Fisher diffusion. Compare with the neutral 4N result and with transition-matrix calculations for small N.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Method-of-lines forward Kolmogorov equation for neutral drift
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Discretize the forward Wright-Fisher diffusion with a conservative finite-volume scheme and integrate it with a stiff solver. Compute the interior probability mass and heterozygosity decay, and compare with Kimura's leading eigenvalue 1/(2N).

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Underdominant hybrid zone cline width via boundary value problem
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Solve the stationary cline equation D p'' + s p(1-p)(2p-1) = 0 on a long domain with solve_bvp. Compute the cline width from the maximal slope and compare with the analytic tanh solution and with the effect of a dispersal barrier.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Haldane migration-selection cline across an environmental step
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Solve the stationary BVP for allele frequency when selection changes sign at x = 0, with matching conditions. Compute the cline slope at the center as a function of the dispersal-to-selection length scale √(σ²/s).

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Two-locus epistatic selection: linkage disequilibrium at quasi-linkage equilibrium
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate continuous-time haplotype frequency ODEs for two loci with additive and epistatic selection and recombination. Compute the steady LD as a function of recombination rate and compare with the QLE approximation D ≈ ε p_A p_a p_B p_b / r.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Fixation probability in a logistically growing population
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Solve the time-dependent backward Kolmogorov PDE with time-varying N(t) by method of lines, integrating backward in time from the absorbing horizon. Compute the fixation probability of a beneficial mutation versus its arrival time during growth.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Relaxation rate of Wright-Fisher diffusion with mutation via Sturm-Liouville eigenvalues
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Cast the Wright-Fisher diffusion with mutation as a Sturm-Liouville problem in Liouville normal form and find the lowest nonzero eigenvalues by shooting. Compare with the exact Jacobi-polynomial spectrum.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Telegraph gene model: FSP time evolution and Fano factor relaxation
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Build the truncated CME generator for promoter switching with mRNA production and degradation, then integrate it with BDF. Compute the time-dependent mean and Fano factor and compare the stationary distribution with the analytic beta-Poisson result.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Chemical master equation finite state projection

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Linear noise approximation for a negatively autoregulated gene
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the macroscopic rate equation together with the LNA Lyapunov ODE for the covariance of a self-repressing gene. Compare the stationary noise strength with FSP to quantify LNA error versus Hill coefficient.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Chemical master equation finite state projection

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Adaptive FSP truncation with sink-state error control
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Implement FSP with an absorbing sink for a birth-death process with positive feedback, integrating the truncated CME ODE. Expand the state space until the sink probability falls below a tolerance and report the converged distribution at time T.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Chemical master equation finite state projection

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Single-enzyme Michaelis-Menten CME with few enzymes and substrates
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Solve the FSP of enzyme-substrate-complex-product kinetics with small molecule numbers by stiff ODE integration. Compute mean product time courses, compare with deterministic Michaelis-Menten ODEs, and quantify the discrepancy versus copy number.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Chemical master equation finite state projection

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Chemical Fokker-Planck versus CME for an autoregulated gene
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Compute the stationary chemical Fokker-Planck density by integrating its zero-flux ODE and normalizing. Compare it with the exact 1D CME stationary distribution obtained by FSP, using Kullback-Leibler divergence versus system size.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Chemical master equation finite state projection

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Barkai-Leibler receptor methylation model: precision of perfect adaptation
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the two-state receptor methylation-demethylation ODEs with CheB acting only on active receptors. Apply ligand steps and compute adaptation precision and time while perturbing enzyme concentrations, to show robustness.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Fold-change detection in an incoherent feedforward loop
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate an incoherent type-1 feedforward loop ODE under input steps of various absolute sizes but equal fold change. Compute response amplitude and timing, and verify fold-change invariance and where it breaks down.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Traveling chemotactic bacterial band consuming nutrient
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Simulate the 1D Keller-Segel model with logarithmic sensing and nutrient consumption by method of lines with a stiff integrator. Measure the band speed and compare with the analytic traveling-wave speed from the Keller-Segel 1971 solution.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Dictyostelium cAMP relay: Martiel-Goldbeter excitability and oscillation period
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the three-variable Martiel-Goldbeter receptor desensitization model. Locate the Hopf bifurcations as the adenylate cyclase rate varies and compute oscillation period and cAMP peak amplitude across the oscillatory range.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Sperm chemotaxis along helical paths: Friedrich-Jülicher signaling model
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the Frenet-Serret swimming equations coupled to an adaptive signaling ODE that modulates curvature and torsion in response to the concentration sampled along the path. Compute the helix-axis alignment rate with the gradient.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Time-varying reproduction number from SEIR with spline transmission rate
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Parameterize β(t) by a B-spline in an SEIR ODE and fit the coefficients to incidence with a roughness penalty. Compute R_t = β(t)S(t)/(γN) and its timing of crossing one.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Kermack-McKendrick final epidemic size and peak prevalence
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the SIR ODE to completion and compare the final attack fraction with the Lambert-W solution of the final-size equation. Compute peak prevalence analytically from the S-I invariant and confirm numerically.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Age-structured SEIR: next-generation R0 and age-specific attack rates
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Build a next-generation matrix from a contact matrix and age-specific susceptibility to compute R0 as its spectral radius. Integrate the age-structured SEIR ODE to obtain attack rates per age group, and verify them against the multi-group final-size equations.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Optimal vaccination control of SIR via Pontryagin boundary value problem
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Formulate the state-costate system for minimizing infections plus quadratic vaccination cost and solve the two-point BVP with solve_bvp, or forward-backward sweep. Compute the optimal vaccination schedule and averted infections.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Pair approximation SIR on random regular contact network
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the pair-approximation ODEs for singlet and pair densities of SIR on a k-regular network. Compute the epidemic threshold and final size and compare with mean-field SIR at equal per-contact transmission.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Early growth rate to reproduction number via linear-chain SEIR
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Model Erlang-distributed latent and infectious periods with a linear chain trick. Compute the epidemic growth rate as the dominant eigenvalue of the linearized ODE Jacobian, invert it to R for an observed growth rate, and compare with the Wallinga-Lipsitch formula.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Repressilator Hopf threshold and oscillation period
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Linearize the symmetric six-variable repressilator at its unique fixed point to find the Hopf condition in Hill coefficient and protein/mRNA lifetime ratio. Integrate above threshold to measure the period from peak times.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Leloup-Goldbeter PER-TIM clock: period versus degradation rate
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the ten-variable Leloup-Goldbeter Drosophila clock ODEs with a stiff solver. Compute the free-running period as the maximal PER degradation rate varies, and locate the boundaries of the oscillatory domain.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Selkov glycolytic oscillator: Hopf curve and relaxation period
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Derive the Hopf curve of the two-variable Selkov model in the (a, b) parameter plane analytically and check it numerically via Jacobian eigenvalues. Integrate to compute period and amplitude near and far from onset.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Floquet multipliers of the repressilator limit cycle
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Locate the periodic orbit by Newton shooting on a Poincaré section and integrate the variational equations over one period to obtain the monodromy matrix. Compute the Floquet multipliers and the decay rate of amplitude perturbations.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Quorum-sensing coupled repressilators: synchronization threshold
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate a population of heterogeneous repressilators coupled through a diffusing autoinducer (Garcia-Ojalvo model). Compute the Kuramoto order parameter versus coupling strength and identify the synchronization transition.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Kim-Forger stoichiometric repressor clock: period robustness to activator ratio
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the mammalian clock model with protein sequestration-based repression. Compute the oscillation period and amplitude as the activator-to-repressor ratio is varied, and identify the near-1:1 window that supports oscillations.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Chemostat competition for one resource: R* rule and washout
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate Monod chemostat ODEs for two species competing for a single substrate. Compute each species' break-even concentration R*, the washout dilution rate and the time to competitive exclusion.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Adaptive dynamics canonical equation and evolutionary branching in Lotka-Volterra competition
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Compute invasion fitness for a Gaussian-kernel competition model and integrate the canonical equation of adaptive dynamics to the singular strategy. Determine the branching condition from the second derivatives and verify it with multi-morph ODE simulations.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Tyson-Novak cell cycle model: mass threshold for division
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the Cdk1-cyclin B/APC-Cdh1 ODE model with exponential cell mass growth and division reset. Compute the critical mass at the saddle-node of the G1-S switch and the steady cycle period versus growth rate.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Systems biology signaling and cell cycle

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: MacArthur-Wilson island biogeography: equilibrium richness and relaxation time
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the richness ODE dS/dt = I(S) - E(S) with nonlinear immigration and extinction curves for islands of varying area and isolation. Find the equilibrium S* by root finding, compute the e-folding relaxation time from the linearization, and compare both with the integrated trajectories.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Neutral birth-death-immigration community: expected abundance distribution and Fisher's alpha
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Solve the forward Kolmogorov ODE system for a single species' abundance under neutral birth, death, immigration and speciation until stationarity. Convert the result into an expected species abundance distribution, fit Fisher's log-series alpha, and compare with Volkov's analytic form.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Random generalized Lotka-Volterra assembly: survivor fraction and diversity indices
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate gLV communities with Gaussian random interaction matrices to steady state using a stiff solver. Compute the fraction of surviving species, their abundance distribution, and Shannon and Simpson indices as functions of interaction strength.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Tilman competition-colonization hierarchy: equilibrium occupancies and Hill numbers
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the multispecies competition-colonization patch-occupancy ODEs with a trade-off between colonization rate and competitive rank. Compare equilibrium occupancies with the analytic recursion and compute Hill diversity numbers of order 0, 1 and 2.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Extinction debt after habitat destruction in multispecies metapopulations
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Starting from equilibrium of a multispecies Levins-type hierarchy, reduce available habitat and integrate the occupancy ODEs. Compute the time course of species richness, the delayed extinction times, and the size of the extinction debt.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: May-Leonard rock-paper-scissors competition: heteroclinic cycle and time-averaged diversity
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the three-species cyclic competition ODEs and track the growing residence times near saddle equilibria along the heteroclinic cycle. Compute the cycle stability ratio and the time-averaged Shannon diversity versus the competition asymmetry.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Huisman-Weissing plankton competition: chaotic coexistence and time-averaged species richness
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate five phytoplankton species competing for three resources with Liebig-minimum Monod kinetics. Detect oscillatory or chaotic coexistence, then compute the time-averaged richness, the evenness, and the number of species exceeding the competitive exclusion bound.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Gardner-Collins toggle switch: saddle-node curves and cusp by pseudo-arclength continuation
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Continue the steady states of the two-repressor toggle ODEs in the synthesis rate alpha1 using pseudo-arclength continuation. Detect folds from the Jacobian determinant, trace the bistability region in the (alpha1, alpha2) plane, and locate the cusp point.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Toggle switch flipping: strength-duration curve for inducer pulses
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Apply a rectangular inducer pulse that lowers one repressor's effective activity and integrate the toggle ODEs. Bisect for the minimal pulse duration that flips the switch at each amplitude, then fit the resulting rheobase and chronaxie.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Lambda phage CI-Cro switch: bistability window and SOS-induction threshold
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Model CI and Cro with operator-occupancy promoter functions and integrate the resulting ODEs. Find the lysogenic and lytic steady states, then increase the RecA-mediated CI degradation rate to locate the saddle-node at which lysogeny is lost.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: PU.1-GATA1 mutual inhibition with self-activation: tristability and pitchfork
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Analyze the Huang progenitor-fate model in which two genes repress each other and activate themselves. Compute steady states and their stability versus self-activation strength, identify the pitchfork that creates the central progenitor attractor, and estimate the basin fractions.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Kramers escape in a one-dimensional bistable gene switch: MFPT boundary value problem
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Reduce a self-activating gene to a Langevin equation with state-dependent noise. Solve the backward Kolmogorov BVP for the mean first passage time between wells, and compare the result with the Kramers formula built from potential curvatures and barrier height.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Growth-dependent dilution destroys toggle bistability (Tan-Marguet-You)
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Add growth-rate-dependent dilution and a metabolic burden feedback to a self-activating or toggle circuit. Integrate the system and continue its steady states to find the critical growth rate above which bistability disappears.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: LuxI-LuxR quorum sensing positive feedback: bistable cell-density window
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the AHL synthesis, diffusion and LuxR-activation ODEs coupled to the cell density. Find the activation and deactivation density thresholds where saddle-nodes occur, and compute the hysteresis width versus AHL degradation rate.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Kussell-Leibler phenotypic switching in a Markov-switching environment: optimal switching rate
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the two-phenotype linear growth ODEs while the environment flips by a telegraph process, renormalizing the population vector along the trajectory. Estimate the long-run Lyapunov growth rate versus switching rates and locate the optimum near the environmental flip rates.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Environmental stochasticity and stochastic growth rate

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Lande logistic diffusion: mean time to extinction with demographic and environmental noise
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Solve the backward Kolmogorov boundary value problem for the mean extinction time of a logistic diffusion whose variance has demographic and environmental terms. Compare quadrature and ODE solutions, and report how extinction time scales with carrying capacity under each noise type.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Environmental stochasticity and stochastic growth rate

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Red versus white environmental noise in logistic growth: moment ODEs and variance
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Couple the linearized logistic dynamics to an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck environmental variable. Integrate the second-moment ODEs (or solve the Lyapunov equation) to get the stationary abundance variance and autocorrelation versus noise color and return rate.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Environmental stochasticity and stochastic growth rate

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Moran effect: synchrony of two dispersal-coupled populations under correlated noise
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Linearize two coupled populations driven by correlated environmental noise. Solve the stationary Lyapunov equation to obtain the population cross-correlation as a function of dispersal rate and noise correlation, and verify with Euler-Maruyama simulation.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Environmental stochasticity and stochastic growth rate

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Competitor coexistence in a randomly switching environment: invasion growth rate
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate a resident Lotka-Volterra competitor whose parameters switch by a Markov chain, and average the invader's per-capita growth along that trajectory. Compute the invasion growth rate versus switching rate, showing coexistence that neither fixed environment supports.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Environmental stochasticity and stochastic growth rate

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Logistic growth with Poisson catastrophes: mean persistence time
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Model logistic growth interrupted by Poisson catastrophes that remove a fixed fraction of the population, as a piecewise-deterministic process. Solve the backward equation for the mean time to fall below a quasi-extinction threshold numerically, and compare with Monte Carlo sample paths.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Environmental stochasticity and stochastic growth rate

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Murray fox rabies wave: critical width of a vaccination break
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the Källén-Murray rabies reaction-diffusion model, with a vaccinated zone where susceptible density is reduced. Bisect for the minimal break width that halts the advancing epizootic wave.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Catalytic model of age-seroprevalence: piecewise force of infection by maximum likelihood
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the age ODE dP/da = lambda(a)(1 - P) with a piecewise-constant force of infection. Fit lambda by binomial maximum likelihood to serosurvey counts and compute the average age at infection and the implied R0.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Age-targeted vaccine allocation with a contact matrix: minimizing deaths in SEIR
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate an age-structured SEIR with a POLYMOD-like contact matrix and age-specific fatality rates. Optimize a fixed vaccine stock across age groups with constrained optimization, and compare death-minimizing and infection-minimizing allocations.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Cholera on a river network: advection-diffusion of Vibrio and spatial R0
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Couple SIR host dynamics at network nodes to a waterborne pathogen compartment transported by advection and diffusion along the river edges. Compute R0 as the dominant eigenvalue of the next-generation operator and examine how downstream advection lowers it.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Time-since-infection infectivity profiles: peak timing at fixed R0 via linear chains
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Represent Kermack-McKendrick infectivity kernels with different shapes as linear-chain ODEs. With R0 held fixed, compute final size, peak incidence and peak time, demonstrating that final size is invariant while timing depends on kernel shape.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: SIR profile likelihood with reporting fraction: practical identifiability
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Fit beta, gamma and the reporting fraction of an SIR model to case counts with a negative binomial likelihood. Compute profile likelihoods by repeated constrained ODE fitting, and report confidence intervals and non-identifiable parameter combinations.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Gradient matching versus trajectory fitting for SIR parameter estimation
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Smooth noisy prevalence data with splines, regress the derivative estimates on the SIR right-hand side to get initial parameters, and then refine them by full ODE least squares. Compare bias, variance and computational cost of the two estimators.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Boarding school influenza outbreak: Metropolis MCMC posterior for SIR R0
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Use the classic 763-pupil outbreak bed-confinement data, with a Poisson or negative binomial likelihood on the integrated SIR prevalence. Sample beta and gamma by random-walk Metropolis and report posterior means and credible intervals for R0 and the infectious period.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Variant takeover: joint fit of two-strain SEIR to cases and sequencing fractions
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate a two-strain SEIR with cross-immunity. Jointly fit total incidence (Poisson) and variant sequence fractions (binomial) to estimate the transmission advantage and the selection coefficient on the logit scale.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Wastewater-based SEIR inference with a fecal shedding kernel
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Convolve SEIR incidence with a gamma shedding-load kernel to predict wastewater RNA concentration. Fit transmission rate and onset time to log-normal noisy concentration data and compare the estimated R0 with one from case data.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Renewal-equation Rt estimation versus SEIR-implied reproduction number
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Simulate incidence from an Erlang-stage SEIR with a step change in transmission, and derive its generation-interval distribution analytically. Apply the Cori renewal-equation estimator and compare its Rt with the true R0*S(t)/N, including the lag around the intervention.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Multiple-shooting parameter estimation for SEIR with sparse noisy data
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Split the observation window into segments with free initial states and continuity constraints, then solve the resulting nonlinear least squares problem. Compare its convergence basin with single shooting from poor initial guesses.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: D-optimal sampling times for SIR parameter estimation via sensitivity ODEs
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the SIR forward sensitivity equations to build the Fisher information matrix for a set of observation times. Optimize the sampling times to maximize log det FIM, and compare the expected parameter variances with those from uniform sampling.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: SIRS waning immunity: interepidemic period and inference of waning rate
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Find the SIRS endemic equilibrium and the damped oscillation period from its Jacobian eigenvalues, and compare with integrated trajectories. Invert the period to estimate the immunity waning rate from an observed interepidemic interval.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: RNA folding kinetics on an enumerated structure space: master equation
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Enumerate all secondary structures of a short sequence, using a Nussinov-type recursion with a simple stacking energy. Connect structures that differ by single base-pair moves with Metropolis rates, then integrate the master equation to get the MFE population over time and the folding time.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: RNA hairpin melting: partition-function melting curve and T-jump relaxation
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Compute the hairpin's two-state (or zipper) partition function versus temperature to get the melting temperature. Integrate the opening-closing kinetic ODEs after a temperature jump and extract the relaxation rate's temperature dependence.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Cotranscriptional riboswitch: kinetic versus thermodynamic control of ON fraction
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate ODEs for aptamer folding, ligand binding and terminator formation within the time window set by transcription speed. Compute the ON-state fraction versus ligand concentration and transcription rate, and show the shift in EC50 from the thermodynamic value.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Lynch-Lande moving optimum: evolutionary lag and critical rate of change
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate coupled ODEs for the mean trait and log population size under a linearly moving Gaussian optimum. Compute the steady lag and the mean fitness load, then find the critical rate of environmental change beyond which the population declines.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Gomulkiewicz-Holt evolutionary rescue after abrupt environmental shift
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the coupled population size and mean trait ODEs after a sudden shift in the optimum. Compute the minimum population size and the time to recovery, and estimate rescue probability using a quasi-extinction threshold, all versus genetic variance.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Multivariate Lande response: deflection of evolutionary trajectories along g_max
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate dz/dt = G grad ln W for a two- or three-trait Gaussian fitness surface. Compute the G eigenstructure, the angle between the response and the selection gradient over time, and the time to approach the optimum versus the alignment of g_max.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Fisher runaway sexual selection: line of equilibria and its stability
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Analyze Lande's coupled ODEs for male trait and female preference means with a genetic covariance. Find the line of equilibria, determine its stability from the Jacobian eigenvalues, and simulate runaway versus convergence for different G matrices.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Kirkpatrick-Barton range limits from gene-flow swamping: coupled BVP
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Solve the steady-state boundary value problem for population density and mean trait along a linear environmental gradient, with diffusive dispersal. Determine whether a finite range limit exists and how its width depends on gradient steepness.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Eco-evolutionary predator-prey cycles with evolving prey defense
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate a rotifer-algae-type model with a quantitative defense trait that trades off against growth. Compute cycle period and the predator-prey phase lag, showing the shift toward antiphase cycles as additive genetic variance increases.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Character displacement under Gaussian competition kernels: equilibrium trait divergence
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the Lande-type mean-trait ODEs of two competing species whose fitness depends on Gaussian resource utilization overlap. Compute the equilibrium separation of means versus competition width and stabilizing selection strength.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Bulmer effect in continuous time: genetic variance under stabilizing selection
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate ODEs for genic variance and linkage-disequilibrium covariance under Gaussian stabilizing selection with free recombination. Compute the equilibrium reduction of additive variance and the relaxation time after selection is relaxed.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Transient evolution of phenotypic plasticity after an environmental shift
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate Lande's ODEs for the elevation and slope of a linear reaction norm after an abrupt change in mean environment. Compute the transient rise and slow decline of plasticity, and the timescale of genetic assimilation.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Mutation-selection equilibrium G-matrix under correlational selection
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate a matrix ODE for G with mutational input M and Gaussian correlational selection, to equilibrium or via a Riccati-type stationary solution. Compute the eigenvalues and orientation of the equilibrium G and their dependence on selection correlation.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Brusselator Turing-Hopf codimension-two point
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Compute the Turing threshold B_T(eta) and the Hopf threshold B_H = 1 + A^2 from the Brusselator dispersion relation. Locate their intersection in the plane of diffusion ratio and parameter, then simulate on either side to confirm stationary versus oscillatory patterns.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Lengyel-Epstein CIMA reaction: Turing threshold with starch complexation
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Analyze the Lengyel-Epstein model, where a complexing agent rescales the activator timescale. Compute the critical diffusion ratio and critical wavenumber, then confirm Turing stripes by 1D method-of-lines simulation.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: BMP-Sox9-Wnt digit patterning: digit number versus limb bud width
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Linearize the three-species Raspopovic model and compute its dispersion relation and critical wavelength. Simulate the model in 1D for several domain widths to predict digit counts and their response to modulated BMP or Wnt signaling.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Cross-diffusion predator-prey Turing instability
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Add self- and cross-diffusion (prey-taxis) to a Holling type II predator-prey model. Derive the instability criterion and critical cross-diffusion coefficient, then simulate spatially patterned steady states with method of lines.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Hastings-Powell three-species food chain: largest Lyapunov exponent
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the food chain ODEs together with their variational equations, using Benettin renormalization. Estimate the maximal Lyapunov exponent and check convergence in time and step size.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Hastings-Powell teacup attractor: next-maximum map and period-doubling cascade
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Record successive maxima of the top predator while sweeping the half-saturation constant b1. Build a bifurcation diagram, estimate Feigenbaum ratios from the period-doubling points, and plot the unimodal next-maximum return map.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Seasonally forced Rosenzweig-MacArthur: stroboscopic bifurcation diagram and Feigenbaum ratio
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the predator-prey model with seasonally forced prey carrying capacity and sample it stroboscopically once per year. Locate period-doubling points in forcing amplitude by Floquet multiplier crossings, and estimate the Feigenbaum delta.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Nicholson's blowflies delay equation: Hopf onset and period-doubling with delay
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the delay differential equation by the method of steps with RK4 and history interpolation. Find the Hopf delay from the characteristic equation, then build a peak-value bifurcation diagram versus delay and the delay-scaled birth rate.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Two-prey one-predator chemostat chaos: Lyapunov exponent versus dilution rate
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate a Gilpin-Vance-type chemostat in which two prey species compete for a nutrient and share one predator. Compute the largest Lyapunov exponent across dilution rates to map windows of chaos and periodicity.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Bursty negative feedback gene: FSP stationary distribution versus generating-function solution
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Build the truncated CME for protein produced in geometric bursts with a repressing feedback on burst frequency. Solve for the stationary distribution with sparse linear algebra, compare with the analytic solution, and compute the Fano factor versus feedback strength.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Chemical master equation finite state projection

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Stochastic SIR final-size distribution via FSP on the (S, I) lattice
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Build the absorbing-state generator for the stochastic SIR epidemic and solve it with the sparse embedded chain or FSP to get the final-size distribution. Show the bimodality above threshold and compare with the Sellke construction.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Chemical master equation finite state projection

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Birth-death-immigration process: generating function by characteristics versus FSP
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Solve the probability generating function PDE using its characteristic ODEs and recover the time-dependent distribution by FFT on the unit circle. Validate against matrix-exponential FSP and report the error versus truncation size.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Chemical master equation finite state projection

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Lambda phage lysis timing: first-passage time distribution of holin accumulation
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Build an FSP for holin production with an absorbing state at the lysis threshold. Integrate it to get the first-passage time density, its mean and its coefficient of variation, and study how threshold and burstiness affect timing precision.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Chemical master equation finite state projection

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Bimolecular association A + B <=> C: exact CME versus mass-action equilibrium
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Solve the one-dimensional CME implied by conservation laws for small copy numbers, both stationary and time-dependent. Quantify how the mean complex number deviates from the mass-action prediction as volume decreases.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Chemical master equation finite state projection

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Self-activating gene with promoter states: multimodality of stationary protein distribution
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Build the joint promoter-protein CME with protein-dependent activation, then compute the stationary distribution with a sparse solver. Count its modes versus binding and unbinding rates to separate slow-switching bimodality from deterministic bistability.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Chemical master equation finite state projection

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Two-gene transcription cascade: noise propagation by FSP versus linear noise approximation
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Solve the stationary FSP for a cascade in which protein X activates gene Y. Compute the covariance and noise decomposition of Y into intrinsic and transmitted parts, and compare with LNA Lyapunov-equation predictions.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Chemical master equation finite state projection

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Stochastic Brusselator: oscillation coherence from CME generator eigenvalues
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Build the truncated two-species Brusselator CME near and above the Hopf point and compute the leading complex eigenvalues of the sparse generator. Extract the stochastic oscillation period and coherence quality factor, and compare them with the deterministic limit cycle.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Chemical master equation finite state projection

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: May complexity-stability transition in random community matrices
