biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Build random community matrices with self-regulation -d, connectance C and interaction s.d. sigma. Estimate the probability of stability versus sigma*sqrt(SC) from the rightmost eigenvalues, and confirm stable and unstable cases by integrating the linearized ODE dx/dt = Jx.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Random community matrices and May stability

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Reactivity and transient amplification in asymptotically stable random communities
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: For stable random community matrices, compute the numerical abscissa (reactivity) from the Hermitian part. Compute the maximal amplification envelope max ||exp(Jt)|| by integrating the matrix ODE, and relate transient growth to non-normality.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Random community matrices and May stability

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Cascade food web model: leading eigenvalue versus connectance compared to random matrices
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Construct Cohen-Newman cascade-model food webs with predator-prey sign structure. Compute the spectra and the leading real eigenvalue versus connectance, compare with unstructured random and elliptic-law predictions, and verify by integrating the linear dynamics.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Random community matrices and May stability

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Feasibility probability of random generalized Lotka-Volterra equilibria versus species number
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Solve A x* = -r for random interaction matrices and estimate the probability that all x* > 0 as a function of S and interaction strength. Compare with the Gaussian orthant estimate, and verify local stability of feasible points by ODE integration.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Random community matrices and May stability

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Dispersal-stabilized metacommunity: spectrum of block community-plus-Laplacian Jacobian
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Couple identical random local community matrices across patches with diffusive dispersal through a patch-graph Laplacian. Compute the block-Jacobian spectrum and the stability probability versus dispersal rate and spatial heterogeneity, and check results with linear ODE simulations.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Random community matrices and May stability

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Noise-driven linearized community: stationary covariance via Lyapunov equation near May threshold
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Treat a stable random community perturbed by white noise as an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process. Solve the Lyapunov equation J Sigma + Sigma J^T + D = 0 for the stationary covariance, track the total variance as sigma approaches the stability edge, and validate against the moment ODEs.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Random community matrices and May stability

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Abundance scaling of gLV Jacobians: spectra of D times interaction matrix
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: For feasible random gLV equilibria, form the Jacobian diag(x*) A. Compare its spectrum and stability probability with those of A alone, quantify how heterogeneous abundances reshape the circular law (Gibbs-Grilli-Allesina), and check results by integrating the nonlinear gLV.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Random community matrices and May stability

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: MacArthur's minimization principle: Lyapunov function decrease along consumer-resource trajectories
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: For a MacArthur consumer-resource community with time-scale-separated resources, evaluate the weighted distance between supply and depleted resource vectors along ODE trajectories. Verify that it decreases monotonically and converges to the constrained minimum found by scipy.optimize.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Microbial consumer-resource model with cross-feeding leakage: diversity versus leakage fraction
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Implement the Marsland-Mehta microbial consumer-resource model, in which a fraction l of consumed energy is secreted as byproducts via a metabolic matrix. Integrate to steady state and compute the number of surviving species and resource depletion as l varies.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Frequency response of the E. coli chemotaxis pathway to oscillating ligand
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Drive the receptor-methylation-CheY ODE model with small sinusoidal ligand modulations. Compute the amplitude and phase of the CheY-P response versus frequency, identify the band-pass peak, and compare with the linearized transfer function.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Chemotactic advantage in a diffusing nutrient patch: uptake by adaptive run-and-tumble cells
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Model a diffusing nutrient pulse analytically in 3D and integrate the internal adaptation ODEs along run-and-tumble trajectories. Compare the mean nutrient exposure of chemotactic and non-chemotactic cells as a function of patch age.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Mixed Tar-Tsr receptor clusters: extended dynamic range of adaptive sensing
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Use a heterogeneous MWC cluster model of two receptor types with distinct ligand affinities and integral-feedback methylation ODEs. Compute the adapted gain versus background concentration and show the range extension relative to a homogeneous cluster.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: CheY-P fluctuation spectrum and behavioral variability via linear noise approximation
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Linearize a stochastic methylation-demethylation chemotaxis model and solve the Lyapunov equation and spectral density for CheY-P fluctuations. Compute the noise correlation time and the induced variance in tumble bias, and validate against the moment ODEs.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Force-ramp unfolding of an RNA hairpin: rupture force distribution
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Represent hairpin unzipping as a chain of base-pair-opening states with force-dependent Bell-Evans rates. Integrate the time-dependent master equation under a constant loading rate and compute the rupture force distribution and its mean versus loading rate.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Toehold-mediated DNA strand displacement: rate acceleration versus toehold length
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Build a master equation over toehold-binding and branch-migration states using nearest-neighbor toehold free energies. Compute the effective displacement rate from the mean first-passage time via linear solves and ODE integration, and reproduce the exponential-then-saturating dependence on toehold length.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Target-site accessibility: McCaskill unpaired probabilities feeding siRNA binding kinetics
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Compute probabilities that a target window is unpaired using a simplified McCaskill partition function. Use them to set the effective association rate in a binding ODE, and compare knockdown time courses for accessible and structured sites.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: TASEP mean-field translation: ribosome density profile and protein synthesis rate
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate mean-field ODEs for ribosome occupancy along an mRNA codon lattice with extended ribosome footprints and codon-specific elongation rates. Compute steady-state density profiles and protein output versus initiation rate, identifying initiation-limited and elongation-limited phases.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: School closure in an age-structured SIR: peak and attack-rate reduction
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Use a four-age-class contact matrix decomposed into home, school, work and community components. Integrate the age-structured SIR with time-limited removal of school contacts, and compute the peak reduction and final attack rates versus closure timing and duration.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Epidemic spread on a chain of patches: lattice traveling wave speed
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate a 1D chain of SIR patches coupled by nearest-neighbor migration as a lattice differential equation. Measure the discrete front speed and compare it with the linear spreading speed from the discrete dispersion relation as migration decreases.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Seasonal dengue vector-host model: periodic R0 via Floquet theory
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Use a host-mosquito SEIR-SEI model with periodic mosquito recruitment. Compute the basic reproduction number for periodic environments (Bacaër) as the R0 for which the Floquet multiplier of the linearized system equals one, and compare it with the time-averaged R0.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Rubella vaccination paradox: congenital rubella burden versus infant coverage
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate an age-structured SIR with continuous ageing and age-dependent contact rates to endemic equilibrium under infant vaccination. Compute the incidence in women of childbearing age versus coverage and identify the coverage range where congenital rubella increases.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Advection-diffusion SI plant epidemic: upwind and downwind front speeds
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Solve a 1D SI model for wind-dispersed plant pathogen spores with advection and diffusion by the method of lines. Compute the asymmetric upwind and downwind invasion speeds and compare them with the linear spreading predictions c = v ± 2sqrt(D r).

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: ESS virulence under transmission-virulence trade-off in an SIR host-pathogen system
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Compute the invasion fitness of a mutant pathogen strain at the resident endemic equilibrium obtained by ODE integration. Locate the singular virulence where the selection gradient is zero, and classify it from the second derivatives.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Evolutionary suicide in a population with an Allee effect
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Following Gyllenberg-Parvinen, compute the invasion fitness from the resident equilibrium of an Allee-effect population ODE. Integrate the canonical equation for the evolving trait, and show that it drives the population through a fold to extinction.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Generalist-specialist branching in a two-resource chemostat with uptake trade-off
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Consumers allocate uptake between two substitutable resources along a convex or concave trade-off. Compute invasion fitness from the resident chemostat equilibrium, determine the singular strategy and branching condition, and simulate the subsequent dimorphic coexistence.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Dieckmann-Marrow-Law predator-prey coevolution: Red Queen cycles from canonical equations
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Derive selection gradients for prey and predator traits from population-equilibrium invasion fitness. Integrate the coupled canonical equations, and detect the Hopf bifurcation leading to sustained coevolutionary cycles as the mutation-rate ratio varies.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Continuous snowdrift game: evolutionary branching into cooperators and defectors
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: For the continuous snowdrift game with quadratic benefits and costs (Doebeli-Hauert-Killingback), compute the selection gradient and singular investment level. Classify convergence stability and evolutionary stability, and integrate dimorphic canonical equations after branching.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: ESS age at maturity in a stage-structured population via dominant eigenvalue fitness
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Define mutant invasion fitness as the dominant eigenvalue of the linearized juvenile-adult ODE system in the density-dependent resident environment. Find the evolutionarily stable maturation rate under a fecundity-survival trade-off and check its second-order conditions.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Replicator-mutator rock-paper-scissors: Hopf bifurcation in mutation rate
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the replicator-mutator equation for generalized RPS payoffs with uniform mutation. Locate the critical mutation rate where the interior fixed point loses stability from the Jacobian eigenvalues, and measure the limit-cycle amplitude below threshold.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Asymmetric hawk-dove owner-intruder game: bimatrix replicator convergence to Bourgeois
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Set up two-population replicator dynamics for owner and intruder roles in the hawk-dove game. Show that the symmetric mixed ESS becomes a saddle, and compute basins of the Bourgeois and anti-Bourgeois equilibria by ODE integration.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Iterated prisoner's dilemma replicator dynamics with ALLC, ALLD and TFT
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Compute payoffs for m-round iterated games and integrate the three-strategy replicator dynamics on the simplex. Find the rest points and their stability, and compute the basin of attraction of the TFT-ALLC face versus m.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Optional public goods game with loners: rock-paper-scissors cycles of cooperation
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Implement the Hauert et al. replicator dynamics for cooperators, defectors and loners with group-size-dependent payoffs. Compute the interior fixed point, show that closed orbits exist, and compute the time-averaged payoff and orbit period versus the multiplication factor r.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Generalized RPS with tie parameter: time averages converge to interior Nash
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: For RPS payoffs with a win/loss asymmetry epsilon, integrate the replicator orbits. Verify that time averages converge to the interior Nash equilibrium, and classify the cases (stable focus, center, heteroclinic attractor) using a Lyapunov function.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Logit best-response dynamics in rock-paper-scissors: Hopf bifurcation of quantal response equilibrium
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate smoothed best-response (logit) dynamics with noise level eta for a bad-RPS game. Locate the critical eta at which the quantal response equilibrium loses stability, and characterize the emerging limit cycle.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Replicator-diffusion fronts in a bistable coordination game
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Solve a 1D reaction-diffusion replicator equation for a two-strategy coordination game. Compute the front speed and direction by shooting in the co-moving frame, and confirm that the risk-dominant strategy invades.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Ecological public goods game: density feedback and coexistence oscillations
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the Hauert et al. (2006) model coupling cooperator and defector frequencies to population density. Find the interior equilibrium, the Hopf bifurcation in the multiplication factor, and the region where cooperation and the population persist.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Invasion graph of a four-species gLV community predicting permanence
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Enumerate the boundary equilibria of a four-species gLV system by linear solves, and compute invasion growth rates of the missing species at each. Build the Hofbauer-Schreiber invasion graph to predict permanence and the assembled community, and verify by ODE integration.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Allesina-Levine intransitive tournament competition: time-averaged abundances
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: For gLV dynamics derived from a random tournament matrix with an odd number of species, integrate the trajectories. Show that time-averaged abundances match the solution of the skew-symmetric linear system, and identify which species persist.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Higher-order interactions in gLV communities: stability with quadratic interaction tensors
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Add random third-order interaction terms B_ijk x_j x_k to a random gLV system. Compute equilibria by Newton iteration and Jacobian spectra, and compare the stability probability versus diversity with the pairwise-only case (Bairey et al.).

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Microbiome gLV inference by gradient matching from noisy time series
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Simulate a small gut-microbiome gLV with an antibiotic perturbation term and add noise to the time series. Estimate growth rates, interactions and susceptibilities by regularized regression on finite-difference log-derivatives (Stein et al.), and validate by re-integrating the fitted model.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Keystone species removal: secondary extinction cascades in gLV food webs
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Starting from a feasible stable multitrophic gLV equilibrium, remove each species in turn and integrate to the new steady state. Count secondary extinctions, and rank species by their community impact relative to their abundance.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Allometric trophic network persistence versus predator-prey body-mass ratio
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate a Yodzis-Innes/Brose bioenergetic food-web model with niche-model topology and allometrically scaled metabolic rates. Compute the fraction of persisting species versus the predator-prey body-mass ratio.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Nested mutualistic networks: plant-pollinator persistence with saturating benefits
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate a Bastolla-type mutualistic model with Holling-II benefits on networks with tunable nestedness. Compute the number of surviving species and the effective competition, comparing nested and random architectures.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Franks NPZ model with Ivlev grazing: Hopf bifurcation in total nutrient
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate a closed nutrient-phytoplankton-zooplankton model with Ivlev grazing and mass conservation. Find equilibria and their Jacobian stability versus total nutrient, locate the Hopf point, and measure the cycle amplitude.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Seasonally forced NPZ model: Floquet multipliers of the annual cycle
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Force phytoplankton growth with an annual light cycle and converge the periodic solution by shooting. Compute Floquet multipliers from the monodromy matrix by integrating variational equations, and detect period doubling as the forcing amplitude increases.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Evans-Parslow NPZD with mixed-layer deepening: spring bloom timing
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate an NPZD model with seasonal mixed-layer depth and light forcing, including entrainment dilution. Compute the bloom onset and peak dates and peak chlorophyll as functions of winter mixing depth.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Critical turbulence for phytoplankton bloom development in a water column
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Solve a linear reaction-diffusion eigenproblem for phytoplankton in a light-attenuating column with turbulent diffusivity (Huisman et al.) by shooting or finite differences. Find the critical diffusivity and depth for positive growth.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Droop cell-quota model in a chemostat: steady state and nutrient storage
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the Droop model with variable internal quota under constant and pulsed nutrient supply. Compute the steady-state biomass, quota and residual nutrient versus dilution rate, and compare washout with the Monod model.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Phage-bacteria chemostat with latent period: oscillation onset via linear chain delay
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Model infected-cell latency in a Levin-type phage-bacteria chemostat with an Erlang linear chain. Find the coexistence equilibrium and the Hopf onset of oscillations versus latent period and burst size.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Truscott-Brindley excitable plankton model: red tide outbreak threshold
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the two-variable phytoplankton-zooplankton model with Holling-III grazing. Characterize excitability by computing the threshold perturbation in phytoplankton growth that triggers a bloom excursion, together with the excursion amplitude and duration.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Incomplete lineage sorting: three-taxon gene tree discordance via lineage Markov chain
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Model lineages in each branch of a species tree with a continuous-time Markov chain over lineage counts, integrated by ODE or matrix exponential. Compute the probabilities of concordant and discordant gene trees versus internal branch length, and compare with 1 - (2/3)exp(-t).

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Ohta-Kimura two-locus moments: expected sigma_d^2 linkage disequilibrium
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the closed moment ODEs for E[D^2], E[Dz] and E[pi_2] under drift, recombination and mutation. Compute equilibrium sigma_d^2 versus rho = 4Nr, and the relaxation after a size change.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Two-locus coalescent with recombination: correlation of coalescence times
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Build the Markov chain on ancestral configurations for two loci and two samples, with recombination and coalescence. Compute E[T1 T2] and the correlation coefficient versus rho by solving the linear system or integrating the ODE.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Pairwise coalescence time distribution under piecewise population size: PSMC-style inversion
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the hazard ODE for the pairwise coalescence time under a piecewise-constant N(t). Simulate coalescence-time data and recover the epoch sizes by maximum likelihood.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Coalescent with ancient (heterochronous) samples: expected pairwise times and diversity
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Use the lineage-count Kolmogorov ODE with samples added at specified past times, under constant or exponentially changing size. Compute the expected pairwise coalescence times and the number of segregating sites for modern-ancient sample sets.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Within-host influenza target-cell-limited model: fitting viral titers and within-host R0
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Fit the Baccam et al. target-cell/eclipse/infected-cell/virus ODE model to synthetic log-titer data by least squares. Compute the within-host R0, the infected-cell lifetime and the peak timing.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Kuznetsov tumor-immune model: tumor dormancy bistability and escape threshold
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the effector-tumor cell ODE model and find its equilibria and their stability. Compute the separatrix between dormancy and escape and the critical initial tumor size versus immune recruitment.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Two-compartment pharmacokinetics with Michaelis-Menten elimination under repeated dosing
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate a central-peripheral PK model with saturable elimination under periodic bolus dosing. Compute the steady-state trough and peak by shooting for the periodic orbit, and show the nonlinear dose-exposure relation.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Bergman minimal model: insulin sensitivity from intravenous glucose tolerance test
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Fit the glucose-remote insulin ODE minimal model to IVGTT glucose data with a measured insulin input. Estimate S_I and S_G by nonlinear least squares, using forward sensitivities for standard errors.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Goldbeter two-pool calcium-induced calcium release: oscillation window and frequency
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the cytosolic and store calcium ODE model versus stimulus level beta. Locate both Hopf bifurcations bounding the oscillatory window, and compute the period-versus-stimulus curve.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Krishna-Jensen-Sneppen NF-kB oscillator: spike period versus IkB transcription
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the three-variable NF-kB/IkB model and compute the period and spikiness (peak-to-trough ratio). Locate the Hopf bifurcation as the IkB transcription and complex-formation parameters vary.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Ribosome allocation growth laws: growth rate transition after nutrient upshift
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate a coarse-grained proteome-partition ODE model (Scott-Hwa type) with regulated ribosome allocation. Compute the growth-rate trajectory and the time to the new steady state after a nutrient upshift, and compare optimal and constant allocation.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Predator-prey with strong prey Allee effect: Bogdanov-Takens point and heteroclinic collapse
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Analyze a predator-prey ODE with cubic prey growth. Locate the Hopf and saddle-node curves, detect the parameter at which the limit cycle collides with the saddle (heteroclinic) by shooting, and identify the resulting system collapse.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Spruce budworm outbreak model: hysteresis and outbreak threshold
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Find equilibria of the Ludwig-Jones-Holling model with Holling-III predation, and trace the fold points by continuation in carrying capacity. Simulate slow forest-growth forcing to produce outbreak and collapse cycles.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Clark bioeconomic optimal harvesting: singular arc via Pontryagin boundary value problem
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Solve the optimal discounted harvest of a logistic fish stock with bounded effort as a state-costate BVP. Find the singular-arc stock level and compare it with the analytic golden-rule equation.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Anderson-May host-macroparasite model: host regulation versus parasite aggregation
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the host-mean-parasite-burden ODEs with negative binomial aggregation k. Compute the equilibrium host depression and its stability versus k and pathogenicity, including the oscillatory instability for weak aggregation.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Klausmeier semi-arid vegetation bands: uphill migration speed
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Solve the water-plant reaction-advection-diffusion model on a slope by the method of lines. Measure the banded-pattern wavelength and uphill migration speed versus rainfall, and compare with the linear instability band.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Wolbachia cytoplasmic incompatibility: invasion threshold frequency and spatial wave
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Derive the Wolbachia frequency ODE with fecundity cost and incomplete maternal transmission, and find the unstable threshold frequency. Compute the bistable wave speed and critical release size in 1D by shooting.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Bacterial persisters: biphasic antibiotic killing curve from two-state switching
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate a normal/persister switching ODE under antibiotic treatment and fit the switching rates to synthetic time-kill data. Predict regrowth after treatment ends, and choose the treatment duration that minimizes survivors.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Yeast sucrose public goods: cooperator-cheater coexistence with density bistability
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Model a Gore et al.-type cooperator-cheater ODE with glucose privatization and serial dilution. Compute the stable mixed equilibrium frequency, the population collapse threshold, and the bistability region versus dilution factor.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Within-host malaria: red blood cell, merozoite and parasitemia dynamics
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate an Anderson-May-Gupta RBC-infected RBC-merozoite ODE model. Compute the within-host R0, the peak parasitemia and anemia nadir, and the damped oscillations near the chronic equilibrium.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Huang-Ferrell MAPK cascade: tier-by-tier effective Hill coefficients
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the three-tier mass-action MAPKKK-MAPKK-MAPK cascade with dual phosphorylation to steady state over a range of E1 input levels. Compute the effective Hill coefficient n_H = log(81)/log(EC90/EC10) for each tier's dose-response curve and show sensitivity amplification down the cascade.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Distributive multisite phosphorylation: ultrasensitivity versus number of sites
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Build ODEs for a substrate with n phosphosites modified distributively by a kinase and phosphatase with explicit enzyme-substrate complexes. Obtain steady states by integration and a root solver, and compute the Hill coefficient and response coefficient of the fully phosphorylated fraction as functions of n.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Substrate sequestration erodes zero-order ultrasensitivity in covalent modification cycles
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Model a phosphorylation cycle with explicit enzyme-substrate complexes in which the enzyme concentration is comparable to the substrate concentration (Bluthgen et al.). Compute steady-state input-output curves by ODE integration and quantify the loss of the Hill exponent relative to the Goldbeter-Koshland limit.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Heinrich linear kinase cascade: signaling time, duration and amplitude
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate a weakly activated N-step linear kinase cascade driven by a decaying receptor input. Compute the Heinrich-Neel-Rapoport signaling time, signal duration and signal amplitude from temporal moments of the output, and compare them with analytic formulas as kinase and phosphatase rates vary.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Retroactivity in a covalent modification cycle: load-induced response slowdown
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Couple a phosphorylation cycle to downstream promoter binding sites that sequester the active protein (Del Vecchio-Ninfa-Sontag). Integrate the stiff ODEs under a time-varying kinase input, and quantify the amplitude attenuation and phase lag as functions of load and cycle enzyme levels.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Modular response analysis: inferring MAPK cascade connectivity from perturbation steady states
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Simulate steady states of a three-module kinase cascade with hidden feedback under small parameter perturbations of each module. Compute the global response matrix by finite differences of the steady states, then invert it to recover the local response coefficients (Kholodenko MRA) and identify the feedback link.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: EnvZ-OmpR bifunctional two-component system: absolute concentration robustness
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the Shinar-Alon-Feinberg mass-action model of a bifunctional histidine kinase with phosphotransfer and phosphatase activities. Show numerically that the steady-state OmpR-P level is independent of total OmpR and EnvZ, and compute the log-sensitivity of OmpR-P to each total.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Wind-dispersed seeds: settling-diffusion kernel from an ODE and invasion speed
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Obtain the seed dispersal kernel by solving the Fourier-space ODE for an advection-diffusion process with a constant settling rate, giving a skewed kernel and its moment-generating function. Compute the upwind and downwind asymptotic spread rates of an integrodifference model and verify them by FFT simulation.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Stage-structured integrodifference spread with within-season stage-transition ODEs
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Build the annual projection matrix by integrating a linear juvenile-adult ODE through one season (matrix exponential), with stage-specific Gaussian and Laplace kernels. Compute the spread rate as min_s ln(rho(H(s)))/s, where rho(H(s)) is the dominant eigenvalue of the kernel-weighted matrix, and check it against FFT simulation.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Mate-finding Allee effect from within-season ODE: pushed versus pulled IDE fronts
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Derive a Beverton-Holt-type annual map with a mate-limitation Allee effect by integrating within-season mating and survival ODEs. Simulate integrodifference spread via FFT convolution and determine the Allee strength at which the front speed departs from the linear MGF prediction.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Facilitated diffusion of transcription factors: target search time by sliding BVP
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Model 3D excursions alternating with 1D sliding on DNA, where the target site is absorbing. Solve the mean-first-passage boundary value problem for sliding to obtain the capture probability per landing, compute the Berg-von Hippel search time, and find the optimal fraction of time spent sliding.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Motif finding and position weight matrices

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: PWM-scored genomic decoys: transcription factor occupancy kinetics with sequestration
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Score a random genome with a position weight matrix to obtain a distribution of site binding energies. Integrate mass-action binding ODEs for a limited TF pool, and compute the target occupancy time course and steady-state occupancy as functions of TF copy number and decoy competition.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Motif finding and position weight matrices

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: SELEX rounds: PWM recovery from binding-equilibrium selection of random sequences
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Simulate SELEX rounds in which each sequence's bound fraction is obtained by integrating binding kinetics to equilibrium under protein-limited conditions. Build pseudocount PWMs from the enriched pool after each round, and compute their information content and correlation with the true energy matrix.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Motif finding and position weight matrices

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Morrison tight-binding inhibition: estimating Ki when inhibitor depletion matters
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate mass-action kinetics for an enzyme, substrate and competitive inhibitor at comparable enzyme and inhibitor concentrations. Fit Ki using the Morrison quadratic equation and using the naive classical equation, and quantify the error of the classical estimate as E0/Ki increases.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Reversible Michaelis-Menten with product inhibition: Haldane-constrained progress-curve fit
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the reversible E+S<->C<->E+P scheme to obtain progress curves that approach equilibrium. Fit forward and reverse Km and Vmax by least squares subject to the Haldane relation, and compare the constrained and unconstrained fits in parameter identifiability.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Coupled enzyme assay: lag time and required coupling-enzyme excess
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate a two-enzyme sequential assay in which the product of the primary enzyme is converted to the detected species. Compute the lag time to reach a given fraction of the steady-state readout and compare it with the McClure first-order approximation, then find the coupling-enzyme activity needed for a target lag.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Slow-binding inhibition: Morrison-Walsh progress curves and mechanism discrimination
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Simulate one-step and two-step (isomerization) slow-binding inhibition with stiff mass-action ODEs. Fit the progress curves to the vi-vs-kobs integrated equation, and identify the mechanism from the hyperbolic or linear dependence of kobs on inhibitor concentration.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Pre-steady-state burst kinetics: acylation and deacylation rates of a serine protease
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the three-step acyl-enzyme mechanism for chymotrypsin-like hydrolysis. Fit the burst amplitude, burst rate and steady-state rate of product release from simulated stopped-flow traces, and recover k2, k3 and Ks using the analytic burst expressions.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Michaelis-Menten initial layer: matched asymptotics versus stiff numerical solution
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Nondimensionalize the mass-action Michaelis-Menten system with small parameter epsilon = E0/(S0+Km). Construct the inner, outer and composite uniform asymptotic solutions, compare them with a stiff BDF integration, and confirm that the maximum error scales as O(epsilon).

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Volterra's principle: fishing effects on time-averaged predator and prey
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate Lotka-Volterra dynamics with an equal harvesting mortality applied to both species (D'Ancona's fishery problem). Compute time averages over exact periods, and verify numerically that the averages equal the shifted equilibrium values, so that reduced fishing increases the average predator abundance.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Holling-Tanner (Leslie-Gower) predator-prey: Hopf boundary and limit cycle period
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Compute the interior equilibrium and Jacobian of the May-Holling-Tanner model to locate its Hopf curve in the (predator growth rate, half-saturation) parameter plane. Integrate trajectories past the Hopf point to measure the limit cycle period and amplitude.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Generalized Holling exponent: Williams-Martinez stabilization of consumer-resource dynamics
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Use the functional response a*N^(1+q)/(1+a*h*N^(1+q)) in a Rosenzweig-MacArthur-type model. Compute the critical carrying capacity for the Hopf bifurcation as a function of q, and determine the q above which the equilibrium is stable at all enrichment levels.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Canard explosion in a slow-fast Rosenzweig-MacArthur model
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Rescale predator dynamics to be slow by a factor epsilon, then integrate with a stiff solver while varying carrying capacity just past the Hopf point. Locate the narrow parameter interval in which the cycle amplitude jumps from small to relaxation oscillations, and show how its width scales with epsilon.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Hydra effect: harvesting a cycling predator raises its mean density
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Add predator harvest mortality to a Rosenzweig-MacArthur model that is cycling. Compute the time-averaged predator density over limit cycles and at stable equilibria as a function of harvest rate, and identify the range of harvest rates over which mean density increases with mortality (Abrams' hydra effect).

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Predator switching between two prey: emergent sigmoid response and stabilization
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Model a predator whose preference shifts toward the relatively more abundant of two prey, using a switching exponent. Integrate the three-species ODEs, compute the stability of the interior equilibrium versus switching strength, and compare the result with a fixed-preference model.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Maturation delay in random communities: destabilization via linear-chain stage structure
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Embed a gamma-distributed maturation delay into a random linearized community through linear-chain juvenile compartments. Compute the spectral abscissa of the enlarged Jacobian as a function of delay and chain length, and estimate the probability of stability compared with May's undelayed criterion.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Random community matrices and May stability

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Miller-Volz edge-based compartmental SIR on configuration-model networks
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the single-variable edge-based ODE for theta(t) using the probability generating function of a Poisson or negative-binomial degree distribution. Compute the epidemic curve, the final size from the fixed-point equation and the epidemic threshold, and compare them with a homogeneous-mixing SIR model.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Lindquist effective-degree SIR model: epidemic curve and final size
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Build the effective-degree ODE system that tracks susceptible and infected nodes by their numbers of susceptible and infected neighbours on a random regular or truncated-Poisson network. Integrate the system to obtain the peak time and final size, and verify agreement with the edge-based compartmental model.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Adaptive rewiring SIS (Gross et al.): bistability from pair-approximation ODEs
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the pair-approximation ODEs for SIS with susceptible-infected link rewiring, which track node densities and SS, SI and II link densities. Find the coexisting endemic and disease-free attractors and the hysteresis window in infection rate as the rewiring rate varies.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Keeling clustered pair approximation: effect of triangles on SIR growth and size
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Implement the pair-level SIR ODEs with Keeling's clustering-corrected triple closure for a network of degree n and clustering coefficient phi. Compute the early growth rate, peak prevalence and final size as functions of phi.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Dynamic message-passing SIR on sparse graphs versus individual-based mean field
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Implement the Lokhov et al. dynamic message-passing ODEs for continuous-time SIR on a sparse random graph, and compare them with the individual-based mean-field ODEs. Quantify how much each method overestimates node-level infection probabilities and final size, using Monte Carlo Gillespie runs as reference.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Endemic SIR with demography: damped oscillation period approaching equilibrium
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate SIR with births and deaths, and compute the eigenvalues of the Jacobian at the endemic equilibrium. Compare the damping time and oscillation period with the Anderson-May approximation T = 2*pi*sqrt(A*D), where A is the mean age at infection and D is the infectious period, across diseases with different R0.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Prevalence-dependent behaviour change in SIR: peak flattening and plateau dynamics
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Let the contact rate decrease with current prevalence or deaths as beta/(1+(I/I_c)^k). Integrate the model to obtain the peak height and the duration of the near-plateau phase, and compute the final size as a function of the behavioural sensitivity I_c.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Optimal timing of a fixed-duration lockdown to minimize SEIR peak prevalence
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate SEIR with a transmission reduction applied over a window of fixed length. Optimize the start time with a bounded scalar minimizer to minimize peak prevalence, and show that a lockdown imposed too early only delays the peak, using the final-size relation for interpretation.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Two-serotype dengue with antibody-dependent enhancement: onset of sustained oscillations
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the Ferguson-Anderson-Gupta two-strain model, in which secondary infections have enhanced infectiousness. Locate the ADE factor at which the endemic equilibrium loses stability from its Jacobian eigenvalues, and measure the oscillation period of serotype prevalence beyond that threshold.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Tuberculosis with fast and slow progression: R0 and backward bifurcation from reinfection
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Model tuberculosis with latent compartments for fast and slow progression and with exogenous reinfection of latently infected and treated individuals. Compute R0 by the next-generation matrix, solve for endemic equilibria, and detect the backward bifurcation region in which endemic states exist with R0 < 1.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: SEIQR with isolation and contact tracing: controlled reproduction number and outbreak control
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Add quarantine of traced exposed individuals and isolation of symptomatic cases to SEIR. Compute the controlled reproduction number Rc by the next-generation method, find the combinations of tracing and isolation rates that give Rc < 1, and verify the outbreak outcomes by integration.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: ICU occupancy from SEIR with Erlang length-of-stay compartments: capacity exceedance
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Feed SEIR incidence into hospital and ICU pathways in which length of stay is Erlang distributed and represented by linear chains. Compute the peak ICU occupancy and the time spent above capacity, and find the minimal transmission reduction that keeps occupancy below capacity.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: FSP parameter sensitivities and Fisher information for experiment design
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Augment the finite state projection ODEs for a bursty gene expression model with forward sensitivity equations for dp/dtheta. Compute the Fisher information matrix for snapshot data at a set of measurement times, and choose the time set that maximizes its determinant.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Chemical master equation finite state projection

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Paulsson stochastic focusing: noise sharpens a hyperbolically inhibited downstream reaction
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Solve the two-species CME by FSP for a fluctuating inhibitor I that controls the production of a product P with rate k/(1+I/K). Compare the sensitivity of mean P to the inhibitor synthesis rate with the deterministic prediction, and quantify the enhancement as a function of the inhibitor's lifetime.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Chemical master equation finite state projection

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Noise-induced bimodality in an enzymatic futile cycle at low copy number
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Build the truncated CME for the Samoilov-Plyasunov-Arkin futile cycle in which a fluctuating kinase drives substrate modification. Compute the stationary distribution of modified substrate by sparse null-space solve and show that it is bimodal although the deterministic model is monostable.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Chemical master equation finite state projection

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Time-varying propensities in FSP: osmotic-shock-induced transcription bursts
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Model a gene whose activation propensity follows a transient kinase signal after osmotic shock, as in Hog1-driven STL1 expression. Integrate the time-inhomogeneous FSP ODEs to obtain mRNA distributions at the measurement times, and compute the mean, the Fano factor and the fraction of responding cells.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Chemical master equation finite state projection

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Intracellular viral replication CME: probability of abortive infection
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Use FSP with absorbing states to solve the CME for template replication, genome production and degradation that starts from a single viral genome. Compute the probability that the infection aborts before templates reach a threshold and the first-passage time distribution of successful infections.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Chemical master equation finite state projection

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Local accumulation time of a morphogen gradient by method of lines
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the time-dependent synthesis-diffusion-degradation PDE semi-discretized in space with a stiff solver. Compute the position-dependent local accumulation time from the transient and compare it with the Berezhkovskii-Shvartsman analytic formula.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Receptor-mediated morphogen transport: free and bound ligand gradient versus receptor density
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Solve the coupled steady BVP for free ligand diffusion and receptor binding/internalization (Lander-type Dpp model) with a source region. Compute the effective decay length of bound ligand as receptor density and binding rates vary.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Expansion-repression mechanism: morphogen gradient scaling with domain size
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the Ben-Zvi-Barkai morphogen-expander reaction-diffusion system to steady state by method of lines for several domain lengths. Quantify the scaling of the rescaled gradient profile and its threshold position with tissue size.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Opposing morphogen gradients: combined positional error along the axis
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Solve steady BVPs for two exponential-like gradients secreted from opposite ends with noisy readout. Compute positional error from each gradient and from the optimal (Fisher-information) combination along the axis, and locate its minimum.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Morphogen-driven bistable switch: boundary position and memory after gradient removal
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Couple a steady exponential morphogen profile to a cell-autonomous positive-feedback target gene ODE integrated in each cell. Find the induced boundary position, its sharpness and hysteresis, and test whether the pattern persists after the morphogen decays.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Fisher-KPP front speed convergence and Bramson logarithmic delay
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate Fisher-KPP by method of lines with a stiff solver from step initial data and track the level-set position. Fit the front speed approach to 2 sqrt(rD) including the -3/(2 lambda) log t Bramson correction.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Fisher-KPP traveling wave profiles by heteroclinic shooting in the phase plane
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Reduce Fisher-KPP to the traveling-wave ODE system and shoot from the unstable manifold of the unoccupied state to find heteroclinic connections. Determine the minimal speed for nonnegative profiles and compute front steepness versus wave speed.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Gatenby-Gawlinski acid-mediated tumor invasion: front speed and interstitial gap
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the three-field normal tissue, tumor and excess acid reaction-diffusion model by method of lines. Measure the invasion speed and determine when a hypocellular gap forms ahead of the tumor front as the acid destruction parameter varies.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Swanson proliferation-invasion glioma model: radial front speed and survival time
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Solve the radially symmetric Fisher equation for glioma cell density in 3D by method of lines. Compute the time for the detectable radius to grow from diagnostic to fatal size, and compare the asymptotic radial speed with 2 sqrt(rho D).

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Sherratt-Murray epidermal wound healing: healing time from traveling waves
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the cell density and mitosis-regulating chemical reaction-diffusion model for a 1D or radial wound by method of lines. Measure the healing front speed and total healing time, comparing activator and inhibitor regulation.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Thomas substrate-inhibition Turing model: critical diffusion ratio and wavelength
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Derive the Turing instability region of the Thomas uric acid-oxygen kinetics from the dispersion relation. Simulate on a 1D domain by method of lines and compare the selected pattern wavelength with the fastest-growing mode.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Meinhardt activator-substrate model of seashell pigmentation patterns
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate Meinhardt's activator-substrate depletion model on a 1D growing edge by method of lines, giving a space-time pigmentation pattern. Classify oscillatory versus traveling-wave regimes and measure stripe period versus substrate production.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Rietkerk vegetation-water model: spot, gap and labyrinth transitions with rainfall
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Perform Turing analysis of the HilleRisLambers-Rietkerk plant-soil water-surface water model. Simulate in 2D by method-of-lines integration, then classify pattern type and vegetation cover along a decreasing rainfall gradient.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Armstrong-McGehee coexistence: two predators on one prey via cycles
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the Rosenzweig-MacArthur limit cycle of a saturating predator and compute the invasion growth rate of a linear-response predator as the time average over the cycle. Find the enrichment range permitting nonequilibrium coexistence.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Explicit searching-handling predator states versus Holling type II approximation
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the full prey-searching predator-handling predator ODE and the reduced Rosenzweig-MacArthur model obtained under fast handling. Quantify discrepancies in equilibrium, Hopf threshold and cycle period as the handling time scale grows.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Edible and inedible prey: Hopf threshold versus carrying capacity
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Extend Rosenzweig-MacArthur with an inedible competitor sharing the nutrient or carrying capacity. Locate the Hopf bifurcation in total enrichment by Jacobian eigenvalue root finding, and integrate to show cycle damping relative to the edible-only system.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Substrate-bacteria-ciliate chemostat food chain: Hopf bifurcation in dilution rate
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Model a chemostat with Monod bacteria grazed by Holling II ciliates. Compute the equilibria and the Hopf point in dilution rate via eigenvalues, and integrate with a stiff solver to measure oscillation amplitude and period across dilution rates.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Loladze-Kuang-Elser stoichiometric producer-grazer model: paradox of energy enrichment
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the LKE model with phosphorus-limited producer quality along a light (carrying capacity) gradient. Map the equilibria and limit cycles, and show grazer decline at high light from food-quality limitation.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Holling type II versus III discrimination from prey-depletion ODE likelihood
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Numerically integrate prey depletion over feeding trials for type II and type III responses and build binomial likelihoods. Sample both posteriors by Metropolis-Hastings, compare models by maximized likelihood/AIC, and report credible intervals for attack rate and handling time.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Bayesian and MCMC parameter estimation for biological models

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: De Roos stage-structured biomass model: emergent Allee effect of a predator
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the juvenile-adult consumer stage-structured biomass model with maturation and reproduction overcompensation, plus a stage-specific predator. Compute the bistability range and the predator invasion versus persistence thresholds in mortality.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Hutchinson delayed logistic equation: Hopf at r tau = pi/2 and cycle amplitude
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the delayed logistic DDE by the method of steps with an RK solver and dense output. Verify the Hopf onset at r tau = pi/2, and compute cycle period and amplitude versus r tau, including near-extinction troughs.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Stage-structured host-parasitoid model: generation cycles versus consumer-resource cycles
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Use a linear-chain-trick ODE approximation of the Murdoch-Nisbet-Gurney host-parasitoid model with juvenile development and vulnerable stages. Classify cycle periods relative to development time as the parameters vary.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Lande sexual dimorphism evolution with intersex genetic correlation
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the coupled ODEs for male and female trait means under sex-specific stabilizing selection with a B-matrix of cross-sex covariance. Compute the two-phase approach to equilibrium dimorphism and its slow time scale from G-matrix eigenvalues.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Eco-evolutionary density-dependent selection on a quantitative trait (r-K trade-off)
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Couple logistic population dynamics to Lande's trait-mean equation, where growth and competitive ability trade off through the trait. Integrate to the eco-evolutionary equilibrium and compute the selection gradient and the trait trajectory after a perturbation.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Homing gene drive with resistance allele formation: suppression threshold
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate allele-frequency ODEs for wild-type, drive and resistance alleles with homing efficiency, fitness costs and density-dependent population size. Find the critical homing efficiency for population suppression and the time to resistance takeover.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Coexistence game in finite populations: exit time from the interior equilibrium
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Derive the diffusion approximation of the Moran process for a 2x2 coexistence game and solve the backward Kolmogorov BVP for mean fixation time. Show exponential growth with population size and compare with exact Markov chain results.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Stochastic evolutionary games in finite populations

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: N-person stag hunt with threshold: interior equilibria and cooperation basin
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Write replicator dynamics with binomial group payoffs for an N-player public goods game with a cooperation threshold. Find both interior fixed points by root finding and integrate to map the basin of attraction of cooperation versus group size.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Weitz oscillating tragedy of the commons: replicator dynamics with environmental feedback
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the coupled replicator-environment ODE in which strategies degrade or restore a resource that modifies the payoffs. Classify interior fixed point stability and compute heteroclinic orbit behavior and time averages under varying feedback strength.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Ultimatum game replicator dynamics with drift (Gale-Binmore-Samuelson)
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the replicator dynamics of proposer and responder strategy populations with small drift toward uniform mixing. Determine which Nash equilibrium component the trajectories select and how the fair-offer outcome depends on drift ratios.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Imperfect waning vaccine in an SIS model: backward bifurcation and critical coverage
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Analyze the Kribs-Zaleta-Velasco-Hernandez SIS model with leaky vaccination and waning. Compute the endemic equilibria by root finding and integrate the ODEs to show bistability below R0 = 1 and the coverage needed for eradication.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Nonlinear incidence SIRS (Liu-Hethcote-Levin): Hopf bifurcation and periodic epidemics
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: For SIRS with incidence beta I^p S^q, compute the endemic equilibrium and locate Hopf bifurcations in the parameters. Integrate stiffly to obtain the amplitude and period of sustained oscillations.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Two-strain SIR with partial cross-immunity: coexistence and oscillations
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate an Andreasen-Lin-Levin two-strain model with reduced susceptibility after heterologous infection. Compute invasion conditions for each strain, coexistence equilibria, and the onset of sustained oscillations as cross-immunity strengthens.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Pulse vaccination in SIR: critical inter-pulse interval for eradication
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate SIR with demography between periodic vaccination pulses that move a fraction of susceptibles to immune. Compute the disease-free periodic orbit and its Floquet stability to find the maximal pulse interval that guarantees eradication.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Macdonald-Dietz malaria superinfection model: prevalence with superinfection queue
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the human infection-recovery model with superinfection, using a truncated series of infection-count compartments. Compute equilibrium parasite prevalence versus inoculation rate and compare with the exact superinfection recovery formula.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Keeling-Gilligan bubonic plague rat-flea model: human spillover timing
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the rat SIR, flea-on-host and free-flea ODE model. Compute R0 and determine when free infectious fleas peak after the rat epizootic, which sets the human case wave and its delay versus rat resistance.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Hospital antibiotic cycling versus mixing: resistant colonization prevalence
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate ODEs for patients uncolonized or colonized by strains resistant to drug A or drug B under periodic cycling or 50:50 mixing prescription. Compare time-averaged resistant prevalence and the double-resistance risk.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Herpes simplex with lifelong latency and reactivation: R0 and prevalence
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the Blower-type susceptible-infected-latent-recurrent model with reactivation and antiviral treatment. Compute R0 via the next-generation matrix and the equilibrium seroprevalence, and assess the treatment rate needed to reduce shedding prevalence.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Plant epidemic with primary and secondary infection (Gubbins-Gilligan)
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate a susceptible-infected-removed host model with constant primary infection from inoculum plus plant-to-plant secondary infection. Fit monomolecular, logistic and mixed disease progress curves, and compute time to 50% disease incidence.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Xenopus oocyte Mos-MAPK positive feedback: irreversible maturation threshold
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the Mos-MEK-p42 MAPK cascade with Mos stabilization feedback under progesterone stimulus. Compute steady-state branches and the saddle-node points by continuation, and show irreversibility after stimulus withdrawal.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Caspase-8/caspase-3 apoptosis switch with XIAP: bistability and activation delay
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Use the Eissing caspase activation model to find steady states and the bistable range of the initial stimulus by root finding. Integrate stiffly to compute the time delay to caspase-3 activation versus caspase-8 input.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Rb-E2F restriction point: serum-dependent hysteresis of E2F activation
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the Yao et al. Myc-E2F-Rb-CycD network to steady states across serum levels. Compute upward and downward switching thresholds by saddle-node continuation and find the minimal serum pulse duration for commitment.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: miR-200/ZEB double-negative feedback: EMT tristability versus SNAIL input
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Find all steady states of the Lu-Jolly-Levine-Onuchic-Ben-Jacob microRNA-mediated ZEB/miR-200 model across SNAIL levels using root finding and stiff integration. Identify the epithelial, hybrid and mesenchymal branches and their saddle-node thresholds.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: ComK-ComS excitable competence circuit in Bacillus subtilis: excursion duration
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Analyze the Süel excitable ComK-ComS ODE model through its nullclines and fixed-point stability. Integrate from perturbations above threshold to compute the competence excursion duration and how it depends on ComS expression.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Yeast GAL network Gal80 sequestration: bistability and galactose memory
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Model GAL4, GAL80, GAL3 and GAL2 feedback with sequestration as an ODE system. Compute bistability in galactose by continuation and integrate pre-induced versus naive cells to quantify memory duration.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: p53-Mdm2 delayed negative feedback: oscillation onset and pulse period
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate a p53-Mdm2 model with an explicit transcriptional delay, either as a DDE or via a linear chain of intermediates. Find the critical delay/feedback strength for oscillations and the pulse period and amplitude after DNA damage.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Goldbeter minimal mitotic oscillator: cyclin-cdc2-protease limit cycle
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the three-variable Goldbeter cascade with zero-order ultrasensitive covalent modification steps. Compute the period and amplitude versus cyclin synthesis rate and locate the Hopf boundaries of the oscillatory domain.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Clock-and-wavefront somitogenesis: segment length from oscillator and regressing wavefront
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate an array of cellular segmentation-clock oscillators (Lewis Her1/Her7 delay model or a phase oscillator) whose frequency slows along an FGF wavefront moving posteriorly. Compute somite length, compare with speed times period, and quantify its sensitivity to the delay.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Sturis glucose-insulin ultradian oscillations: period and amplitude versus glucose infusion
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the six-variable Sturis-Tolic model with a three-stage delay of hepatic glucose production. Compute the ultradian oscillation period and insulin amplitude across glucose infusion rates, and locate where the oscillation disappears.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Chay-Keizer pancreatic beta-cell bursting: burst period from slow-fast analysis
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the stiff beta-cell model with fast voltage/potassium dynamics and slow calcium. Compute the fast-subsystem bifurcation diagram versus calcium and the burst period/plateau fraction as glucose-dependent parameters vary.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Coherent type-1 feedforward loop: sign-sensitive delay and persistence detection
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the C1-FFL with AND-gate logic under ON and OFF steps of input. Compute the delay asymmetry and the minimal input pulse duration that produces target expression, and compare with simple regulation.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Receptor-ligand binding with internalization and recycling: ligand depletion and steady state
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the Lauffenburger-Linderman trafficking model with surface binding, endocytosis, recycling, degradation and medium ligand depletion. Compute steady surface complexes, ligand half-life in the medium and the effect of cell density.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Amyloid aggregation with secondary nucleation: half-time scaling exponent from moment ODEs
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the Knowles-Cohen moment equations for fibril number and mass with primary nucleation, elongation and monomer-dependent secondary nucleation. Compute half-times versus initial monomer concentration and fit the scaling exponent.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Nye-Tinker-Barber root nutrient uptake: depletion zone and cumulative uptake
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the radial convection-diffusion equation for soil solute toward a root with Michaelis-Menten uptake at the root surface by method of lines. Compute the depletion zone width and the cumulative uptake versus buffer power.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Münch pressure-flow in a phloem sieve tube: sugar and velocity profiles
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Solve the coupled osmotic-flow BVP for sugar concentration and axial velocity along a sieve tube with loading and unloading zones (Jensen-Thompson-Holbrook). Compute total translocation rate and its scaling with tube length and the Münch number.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Pulmonary capillary oxygen loading with Hill hemoglobin saturation: equilibration length
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the ODE for capillary plasma PO2 along transit time with alveolar diffusion and Hill or Kelman hemoglobin binding. Compute the fraction of transit needed to reach equilibrium at rest, during exercise and at altitude.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Loop of Henle countercurrent multiplier: concentrating capacity by boundary value problem
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Solve the steady ODEs for solute concentration in descending limb, ascending limb and interstitium with active NaCl pumping as a two-point BVP. Compute the papillary concentration and its dependence on loop length and pump rate.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Noy-Meir grazing system: catastrophic collapse threshold in herbivore density
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Analyze logistic vegetation growth with a saturating herbivore offtake and find equilibria and saddle-node points in herbivore density by root finding. Integrate to show hysteresis and the slowing of recovery rate near the fold.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Carpenter lake phosphorus recycling: eutrophication hysteresis and reversibility
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the Carpenter-Ludwig-Brock phosphorus model with sigmoid internal recycling. Compute the bistable loading range by saddle-node root finding, and the loading reduction and time needed to restore the oligotrophic state.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Staver-Levin savanna-forest-grassland model: fire-mediated tree cover bistability
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the grass-sapling-tree-forest ODE system with a sigmoidal fire-dependent sapling recruitment. Compute equilibria and bistability versus precipitation proxies, and the basin boundary between savanna and forest.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Mumby coral-macroalgae-turf model: grazing threshold and reef hysteresis
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the coral, macroalgae and algal turf cover ODEs under parrotfish grazing. Locate the saddle-node bifurcations in grazing intensity and compute the hysteresis loop and recovery times after a disturbance.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Obligate-facultative mutualism with saturating benefits: saddle-node and collapse
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Analyze a two-species mutualism ODE with saturating benefit functions in which one partner is obligate. Find coexistence equilibria and the saddle-node in mutualist mortality, and integrate to determine the Allee-like threshold densities.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Bever plant-soil feedback model: coexistence via negative feedback and oscillations
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the two-plant, two-soil-community feedback ODEs. Compute the interaction coefficient I_s, the neutral cycles or stable coexistence it predicts, and the time-averaged plant frequencies.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Eco-epidemiological predator-prey with infected prey: disease-mediated predator persistence
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Analyze the Hadeler-Freedman-type model in which predators preferentially consume infected prey. Compute the boundary equilibria and invasion conditions, and integrate to identify when infection enables predator persistence or induces oscillations.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Khoury honeybee colony model: forager death rate threshold for collapse
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the hive-bee/forager ODE with social inhibition of recruitment. Compute the equilibrium colony size and the critical forager mortality causing collapse, and simulate collapse timing after a mortality increase.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Schaefer surplus production model fit to catch-per-unit-effort data
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate logistic biomass dynamics with an observed catch series to predict CPUE. Fit r, K and catchability by lognormal least squares with an ODE solver in the loop, and derive MSY and B_MSY with profile intervals.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Two-pool soil carbon model with bomb radiocarbon: turnover time estimation
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate a fast/slow soil carbon pool model including the atmospheric 14C bomb spike and radioactive decay. Fit the pool turnover rates to Delta-14C observations and compute the mean age and transit time of soil carbon.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Kooijman dynamic energy budget: von Bertalanffy growth emerging from feeding level
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the standard DEB reserve-structure-maturity ODEs at constant food. Compute ultimate length, the von Bertalanffy growth rate and age at puberty versus feeding level, and verify the predicted von Bertalanffy limit.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Escalator boxcar train for a size-structured Daphnia-algae consumer-resource model
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Implement the escalator boxcar train, which tracks cohort size and number by ODEs with periodic cohort creation, for a size-structured consumer feeding on a logistic resource. Compute equilibrium versus cohort-cycle dynamics and the cycle period.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Integral projection models for size structure

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Geider photoacclimation model: chlorophyll-to-carbon steady state and acclimation time
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the Geider-MacIntyre-Kana ODEs for phytoplankton carbon, nitrogen and chlorophyll under light shifts. Compute steady Chl:C versus irradiance and the acclimation time scale after a step change in light.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Payne-Jansen phage therapy: inundation and proliferation thresholds
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the bacteria-phage ODE with infection, lysis and burst size, using a stiff solver. Compute the proliferation threshold host density and the inundation dose for clearance, and the effect of dosing time on treatment outcome.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Plasmid persistence with conjugation and segregation loss: critical conjugation rate
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the Stewart-Levin plasmid-free/plasmid-bearing ODEs in a chemostat with cost, segregational loss and mass-action conjugation. Compute the critical conjugation rate for plasmid persistence and the equilibrium plasmid frequency.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Antia-Bergstrom-Levin pathogen-immune race: clearance threshold in initial dose
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the pathogen-immune cell expansion model with a lethal pathogen density. Compute the time to clearance and the peak pathogen load versus initial dose and growth rate, and find the critical immune activation threshold for survival.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Norton-Simon chemotherapy under Gompertzian growth: dose-dense scheduling advantage
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate Gompertz tumor growth with kill proportional to growth rate under periodic cycles. Compare dose-dense and conventional schedules by end-of-treatment tumor size and find the cycle spacing that minimizes regrowth.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Mackey-Glass periodic hematopoiesis: oscillation onset and period versus maturation delay
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the Mackey-Glass blood-cell production delay equation by the method of steps. Locate the Hopf onset in delay, compute the period of oscillations relevant to periodic chronic myelogenous leukemia, and identify period-doubling at larger delays.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Komarova osteoclast-osteoblast bone remodeling: remodeling cycle and bone mass change
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the power-law autocrine/paracrine osteoclast-osteoblast ODE model after a remodeling trigger. Compute the cycle duration and the net bone mass change per cycle, and the stability of the steady state.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Topp beta-cell mass-insulin-glucose model: pathways to diabetes
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Analyze the slow beta-cell mass dynamics coupled to fast insulin-glucose regulation. Find steady states and saddle-node bifurcations versus insulin sensitivity, and integrate to compute time to hyperglycemia under declining sensitivity.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Simeoni tumor growth inhibition model: transit-compartment damage and tumor stasis threshold
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the Simeoni exponential-linear growth model with three damage transit compartments driven by drug concentration. Fit growth and potency parameters to xenograft data, and compute the threshold concentration for tumor stasis.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Jusko indirect response models: rebound and time to peak effect
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the four basic indirect response PK/PD models with Emax inhibition or stimulation of production or loss. Compute the time to peak response versus dose and the post-dosing rebound when precursor pools are included.

biology/quant_bio|ode.title: Bayesian estimation of JAK-STAT nucleocytoplasmic cycling with linear-chain delay
biology/quant_bio|ode.gist: Integrate the Swameye-Timmer STAT5 model with the nuclear residence delay represented by a linear chain, driven by an interpolated EpoR input. Sample parameter posteriors by Metropolis-Hastings, report credible intervals and the posterior predictive band.
biology/quant_bio|ode.area: Bayesian and MCMC parameter estimation for biological models

physics/optics|ode.title: Swept-detuning Fabry-Perot cavity ringing and apparent finesse
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the single-mode cavity amplitude ODE da/dt = -(κ/2 + iΔ(t))a + √κ_in s_in while the detuning is swept linearly. Compute the transient transmission ringing, compare it with the steady-state Airy profile, and extract the apparent linewidth and finesse as functions of sweep rate.

physics/optics|ode.title: Kerr-nonlinear Fabry-Perot bistability hysteresis under ramped input
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the mean-field Kerr cavity ODE with a slowly ramped input power up and then down. Obtain the hysteresis loop of transmitted power and the up and down switching thresholds, and compare them with the turning points of the steady-state cubic.

physics/optics|ode.title: Thermal triangle in a microcavity under laser wavelength sweep
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve the coupled stiff ODEs for intracavity energy and mode temperature, with absorption heating that red-shifts the resonance, while the laser wavelength is scanned. Compute the triangular transmission lineshape and its dependence on sweep direction and input power.

physics/optics|ode.title: Optical spring and dynamical backaction in a detuned Fabry-Perot cavity
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the coupled ODEs for cavity field and mirror displacement under radiation pressure. Extract the effective spring constant and damping from the ringdown of the mirror oscillation, and locate the parametric instability threshold versus detuning.

physics/optics|ode.title: Pound-Drever-Hall laser lock acquisition dynamics
physics/optics|ode.gist: Model the laser frequency as an ODE driven by a PI servo acting on the analytic PDH error signal of a Fabry-Perot cavity. Integrate from various initial detunings to find the capture range and the settling time versus loop gain.

physics/optics|ode.title: Fabry-Perot etalon with a thermally graded spacer index
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the 1D Helmholtz ODE through a spacer whose index varies linearly or parabolically, bounded by partially reflecting mirrors. Compute the transmission spectrum, then the peak shifts, the effective finesse and the free spectral range relative to the uniform-spacer Airy formula.

physics/optics|ode.title: Ring-laser gyroscope lock-in via the Adler equation
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the Adler phase equation dψ/dt = Ω_S - Ω_L sin ψ for the counter-propagating beat phase of a Sagnac ring laser. Compute the time-averaged beat frequency versus rotation rate, the lock-in threshold, and how mechanical dither reduces the dead band.

physics/optics|ode.title: Thermo-optic Mach-Zehnder switch transient via method-of-lines heat diffusion
physics/optics|ode.gist: Discretize 1D transverse heat diffusion from a heater into a waveguide arm into a stiff ODE system and integrate it with an implicit solver. Convert the core temperature into an arm phase and compute the MZI output transient, including the 10-90% switching time.

physics/optics|ode.title: Numerov generation of Riccati-Bessel functions for Mie efficiencies
physics/optics|ode.gist: Generate ψ_n(x) and ξ_n(x) by Numerov integration of the Riccati-Bessel ODE, starting from asymptotic or small-x data, and validate them against scipy. Use them to compute the Mie coefficients a_n, b_n, the efficiency Q_ext, and the angular phase function of a water droplet.

physics/optics|ode.title: Radiation-pressure acceleration of a microsphere in viscous fluid
physics/optics|ode.gist: Compute the Mie radiation-pressure efficiency Q_pr = Q_ext - g Q_sca for a polystyrene sphere in water. Integrate Newton's equation with Stokes drag under a focused Gaussian beam to obtain the terminal velocity and the displacement versus time.
