physics/optics|ode.title: Photothermal heating transient of a plasmonic nanoparticle under pulsed light
physics/optics|ode.gist: Compute Q_abs of a gold nanosphere from Mie theory using a Drude-Lorentz permittivity. Integrate a lumped heat-balance ODE with conductive loss to the medium under a pulse train, giving peak and steady-state temperature rises.

physics/optics|ode.title: Mie-resonance time series from an evaporating droplet
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the Maxwell diffusion-limited evaporation ODE for droplet radius. At each radius, compute the Mie scattering cross-section at a fixed angle to produce the resonance-spike time series, then identify the mode numbers from the peak spacings.

physics/optics|ode.title: Electro-optic TE-TM mode converter in periodically poled-electrode LiNbO3
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the coupled-mode ODEs for TE and TM amplitudes with periodic Pockels coupling and birefringent phase mismatch. Compute conversion efficiency versus wavelength and drive voltage, and find the full-conversion voltage and the optical bandwidth.

physics/optics|ode.title: Pockels-cell Q-switched laser giant-pulse rate equations
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the stiff coupled ODEs for population inversion and photon density, with a time-dependent cavity loss from Pockels-cell retardation switching. Compute pulse energy, peak power, build-up delay and width versus initial inversion.

physics/optics|ode.title: Freedericksz transition and voltage-dependent retardation of a nematic cell
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve the nonlinear director-tilt boundary-value problem from Frank elastic theory under applied voltage using shooting or solve_bvp. Integrate the local birefringence across the cell to obtain retardation and crossed-polarizer transmission versus voltage, including the threshold voltage.

physics/optics|ode.title: Apodized collinear acousto-optic tunable filter passband
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the coupled-mode ODEs for collinear AOTF polarization conversion with a z-dependent coupling profile (uniform, Hann or Gaussian). Compute the transmission passband, sidelobe suppression and FWHM versus acoustic power.

physics/optics|ode.title: Variational Gaussian-pulse ODEs for dispersion and self-phase modulation
physics/optics|ode.gist: Derive and integrate the Lagrangian variational ODEs for width, chirp and phase of a chirped Gaussian pulse in fiber with GVD and Kerr SPM. Compute broadening, compare with exact linear chirped-Gaussian results, and find the propagation distance at which an initial chirp gives minimum pulse width.

physics/optics|ode.title: Graded-index fiber group-velocity dispersion from radial shooting
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve the scalar radial wave equation for an α-profile fiber by shooting for β(ω), using Sellmeier silica indices for core and cladding. Differentiate β numerically to obtain group index, GVD and the zero-dispersion wavelength.

physics/optics|ode.title: Chirped fiber Bragg grating reflectivity and group delay for dispersion compensation
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the forward/backward coupled-mode ODEs as a boundary-value problem for a linearly chirped, apodized FBG. Compute the reflection spectrum, group delay and dispersion, and the residual broadening of a pulse after compensating a fiber span.

physics/optics|ode.title: Raman soliton self-frequency shift along a dispersion-varying fiber
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the coupled ODEs for soliton center frequency and duration, using the Gordon Raman shift rate and adiabatic energy conservation in a fiber whose β2(z) varies. Compute frequency shift versus distance.

physics/optics|ode.title: Fiber optical parametric amplifier gain spectrum with pump depletion
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the coupled complex ODEs for pump, signal and idler with Kerr nonlinearity and a phase mismatch from β2 and β4. Compute gain spectra in the undepleted and depleted regimes and verify Manley-Rowe invariants.

physics/optics|ode.title: Ray-equation integration through a synthetic Kolmogorov refractive-index field
physics/optics|ode.gist: Build a random index field from a Kolmogorov spectrum (spectral sum of Fourier modes) and integrate the paraxial ray equation over many realizations. Compute angle-of-arrival variance and beam-centroid wander, and compare with Rytov-theory scaling in C_n² and L.

physics/optics|ode.title: Superior mirage ray tracing over a temperature-inversion layer
physics/optics|ode.gist: Convert a temperature profile T(z) with an inversion into n(z) via the Gladstone-Dale relation. Integrate ray ODEs from an observer to map apparent versus true elevation, identifying multiple images and the looming magnification.

physics/optics|ode.title: Second-moment ODE for long-term Gaussian beam spreading in turbulence
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the moment (Wigner) ODEs for the mean-square beam radius with a Kolmogorov turbulence diffusion term. Compute the long-term beam size versus range, separate the short-term and wander contributions, and compare with diffraction-limited spreading.

physics/optics|ode.title: Thermal blooming of a high-energy beam in crosswind: beam-parameter ODEs
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate coupled ODEs for beam width and centroid deflection, with an absorption-induced thermal lens and prism set by wind-convected heating. Compute peak-irradiance reduction versus power and the critical power.

physics/optics|ode.title: Localization length in a continuous random index profile via phase-amplitude Riccati ODEs
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the Helmholtz equation in amplitude-phase (Prüfer) variables through a random, correlated n(z). Extract the Lyapunov exponent and localization length versus frequency and disorder strength, and compare with the weak-disorder perturbative formula.

physics/optics|ode.title: Off-diagonal disorder waveguide array and the band-center anomaly
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate coupled-mode ODEs for arrays with random coupling constants only. Compute propagation-distance-dependent IPR and spreading, and show the anomalous delocalization of the chiral E=0 state compared with on-site disorder.

physics/optics|ode.title: Rugate graded-index filter reflectance at oblique incidence
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the TE and TM wave equations (including the ε'/ε term for TM) through a sinusoidal index-modulated coating at oblique incidence. Compute reflectance spectra, stopband position and width versus angle and polarization.

physics/optics|ode.title: Graded-index antireflection layer via the reflection-coefficient Riccati equation
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the Riccati ODE for the local reflection coefficient r(z) through linear, cubic and quintic index profiles between air and glass. Compute broadband reflectance versus layer thickness and wavelength, and compare with the WKB limit.

physics/optics|ode.title: Ellipsometric angles of a film with graded interfacial roughness
physics/optics|ode.gist: Model the film/substrate interface as an error-function index transition and integrate the TE and TM field ODEs through the stack. Compute ellipsometric Ψ and Δ versus angle and the error made by an abrupt-interface model fit.

physics/optics|ode.title: Optical absorption profile in a graded-bandgap thin-film solar absorber
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the Helmholtz ODE through a layer with depth-dependent complex index, representing a graded composition, on a metal back reflector. Compute the local absorption density, total absorptance spectrum and AM1.5-weighted photocurrent.

physics/optics|ode.title: Discrete solitons in Kerr waveguide arrays: stationary profiles and stability
physics/optics|ode.gist: Find site-centered and bond-centered stationary DNLS solitons by Newton iteration on the algebraic equations. Integrate the perturbed ODEs to test stability and compute the power versus propagation-constant curve and Peierls-Nabarro barrier.
physics/optics|ode.area: Coupled waveguide arrays and discrete optics

physics/optics|ode.title: Dynamic localization in periodically curved waveguide arrays
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the discrete Schrödinger equation with a sinusoidal transverse gradient representing axis curvature. Compute the beam width after many periods versus modulation amplitude, showing suppression at zeros of J_0.
physics/optics|ode.area: Coupled waveguide arrays and discrete optics

physics/optics|ode.title: Topological edge states in an SSH photonic waveguide lattice
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate coupled-mode ODEs for a dimerized array with alternating couplings and edge excitation. Compute the power retained at the edge versus coupling ratio, and the overlap with the zero-mode eigenvector from diagonalization.
physics/optics|ode.area: Coupled waveguide arrays and discrete optics

physics/optics|ode.title: PT-symmetric gain-loss directional coupler and exceptional point
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the two-waveguide coupled-mode ODEs with balanced gain and loss. Compute power oscillations below threshold, exponential growth above it, the nonreciprocal power evolution, and the exceptional point at γ = κ.
physics/optics|ode.area: Coupled waveguide arrays and discrete optics

physics/optics|ode.title: Adiabatic light transfer in a three-waveguide STIRAP-analog coupler
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the three-mode coupled-mode ODEs with Gaussian z-dependent couplings in counterintuitive order. Compute transfer efficiency from outer to outer guide versus device length and pulse delay, and the robustness compared with intuitive ordering.
physics/optics|ode.area: Coupled waveguide arrays and discrete optics

physics/optics|ode.title: TM modes of an asymmetric multilayer slab via H_y shooting
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the TM equation for H_y with continuity of (1/ε)dH/dx across layer interfaces through a four-layer guide. Root-find the effective indices, compute field profiles and confinement factors, and compare TE/TM birefringence.

physics/optics|ode.title: Leaky modes and loss of an ARROW waveguide by complex shooting
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the TE mode equation across an anti-resonant reflecting multilayer cladding with an outgoing-wave substrate condition. Find complex propagation constants with a complex root finder and compute propagation loss versus cladding thickness.

physics/optics|ode.title: Power-dependent guided waves of a Kerr-nonlinear slab waveguide
physics/optics|ode.gist: Shoot the nonlinear TE wave equation with a Kerr core or cladding, using the analytic sech-type cladding solution as the starting condition. Compute the guided power versus propagation constant and identify the branches of nonlinear dispersion.

physics/optics|ode.title: Effective-index method for a rib waveguide from two slab eigenproblems
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve vertical slab mode equations by shooting in the rib and outer regions, then solve the lateral effective slab eigenproblem. Compute the rib-mode effective index versus rib width and etch depth, together with the single-mode condition.

physics/optics|ode.title: 1D photonic crystal band structure from Hill-equation monodromy matrices
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the Helmholtz ODE over one period of a sinusoidal or stepwise index modulation to build the monodromy matrix. Obtain Bloch wavenumbers from the trace, then band diagrams, gap edges, and gap width versus modulation depth.

physics/optics|ode.title: Omnidirectional reflection bands of a 1D crystal for TE and TM
physics/optics|ode.gist: Compute the monodromy matrix trace via ODE integration at oblique incidence for both polarizations, including the TM Brewster effect. Map projected band structures versus in-plane wavevector and find the omnidirectional gap range.

physics/optics|ode.title: Superprism beam steering from PWE bands and semiclassical ray ODEs
physics/optics|ode.gist: Compute a 2D square-lattice TM band with plane-wave expansion, interpolate ω(k) and its gradient, and integrate the semiclassical Hamiltonian ray equations in the crystal. Obtain refraction angle versus wavelength and its angular sensitivity.

physics/optics|ode.title: Semiconductor laser rate equations: relaxation oscillations and modulation response
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the carrier-photon rate equations with gain compression from below to above threshold. Extract turn-on delay and relaxation oscillation frequency and damping, and compute the small-signal modulation response by driving at varying frequencies.

physics/optics|ode.title: Erbium-doped fiber amplifier gain and optimal length
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the coupled two-level population and pump/signal propagation ODEs with McCumber cross-sections at 980 nm pumping. Compute signal gain versus fiber length and pump power, the optimal length, and pump threshold.

physics/optics|ode.title: Passively Q-switched microchip laser with Cr:YAG saturable absorber
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the stiff coupled rate equations for gain inversion, absorber ground-state population and photon density. Compute pulse energy, width, peak power and repetition rate versus pump rate.

physics/optics|ode.title: Optical injection locking range of a semiconductor laser
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the rate equations for field amplitude, phase and carriers with an injected master field, including linewidth enhancement factor α. Map the stable locking boundaries in detuning-injection plane and compare with the asymmetric Adler range.

physics/optics|ode.title: Bidirectional Raman fiber amplifier with pump depletion as a boundary-value problem
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve the coupled pump/signal power ODEs with counter-propagating pump using solve_bvp. Compute on-off gain, noise-relevant signal power excursion and gain versus pump power for forward and backward pumping.

physics/optics|ode.title: Stimulated Brillouin scattering threshold in single-mode fiber
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve the counter-propagating pump and Stokes intensity ODEs with spontaneous seeding as a two-point BVP. Compute reflected Stokes power versus input power, threshold power and pump clamping, and compare with the 21/(g_B L_eff/A_eff) rule.

physics/optics|ode.title: Second-harmonic generation with pump depletion and phase mismatch
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the coupled fundamental and second-harmonic amplitude ODEs. Verify the tanh² law for phase matching, compute conversion efficiency versus Δk and crystal length, and examine quasi-phase-matching with random duty-cycle errors.

physics/optics|ode.title: Cascaded quasi-phase-matched third-harmonic generation in a single crystal
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate coupled ODEs for fundamental, second- and third-harmonic waves with two QPM processes in a dual-period poling. Compute THG efficiency versus poling period ratio and input intensity.

physics/optics|ode.title: χ(2) optical parametric amplifier with pump depletion and Manley-Rowe check
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the three-wave OPA ODEs in a birefringently phase-matched crystal. Compute signal gain versus length including the back-conversion regime, saturation, and the Manley-Rowe invariants.

physics/optics|ode.title: Polarization instability in a nonlinear birefringent fiber
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the coupled Kerr ODEs for orthogonal polarization amplitudes, including cross-phase modulation and the coherent coupling term. Map the Stokes-vector trajectories on the Poincaré sphere and find the critical power for fast-axis instability.

physics/optics|ode.title: Ray-optics trapping forces and equilibrium of a large dielectric sphere
physics/optics|ode.gist: Sum Ashkin ray-optics forces from Fresnel reflection and refraction over a focused beam's angular spectrum. Integrate the overdamped motion to find the axial equilibrium position, and compute trap stiffness versus relative index and numerical aperture.

physics/optics|ode.title: Optical binding of two dipolar nanoparticles in a plane wave
physics/optics|ode.gist: Compute interparticle forces from coupled-dipole scattered fields and integrate the overdamped equations of motion. Find the stable binding separations near multiples of the wavelength and their dependence on polarization.

physics/optics|ode.title: Optical spanner: rotation of a birefringent particle in circularly polarized light
physics/optics|ode.gist: Compute the spin angular momentum transfer from the particle's Jones-matrix retardance and integrate the rotational ODE with rotational drag. Find the rotation rate versus retardance and the Adler-like locking behavior for elliptical polarization.

physics/optics|ode.title: Dipole trap for cold atoms: classical trajectories and trap frequencies
physics/optics|ode.gist: Compute the optical dipole potential of a focused far-detuned Gaussian beam and integrate classical atom trajectories. Extract radial and axial trap frequencies from the oscillations and show the anharmonic frequency shift with energy.

physics/optics|ode.title: GRIN rod lens ray tracing: pitch and spherical aberration
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the exact ray equation in a parabolic-like sech-profile GRIN rod with RK45. Compute pitch length, imaging of off-axis points, and longitudinal spherical aberration compared with the paraxial solution.

physics/optics|ode.title: Gaussian beam q-parameter evolution through a continuous lens-like medium
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the Riccati ODE dq/dz = 1 + g(z)q²/(...) for the complex beam parameter in a medium with z-dependent quadratic index (thermal lens or tapered GRIN). Compute beam width and waist locations, and compare with piecewise ABCD matrices.

physics/optics|ode.title: Optical black-hole analog: ray capture in an omnidirectional absorber
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate ray trajectories in the Narimanov-Kildishev radial index profile n ∝ 1/r inside a core. Compute the capture cross-section versus impact parameter and the critical spiraling behavior.

physics/optics|ode.title: Dual-beam fiber optical trap: axial equilibrium and stiffness from counter-propagating Gaussians
physics/optics|ode.gist: Two diverging Gaussian beams leave opposed fibers and act on a Rayleigh sphere. Compute the summed gradient and scattering forces, integrate overdamped Stokes dynamics to the axial equilibrium, and get the stiffness from the force slope versus fiber separation.
physics/optics|ode.area: Optical tweezers forces and trap stiffness

physics/optics|ode.title: Escape velocity of a Rayleigh particle from a focused Gaussian trap
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate overdamped equations of motion for a dipolar particle in a focused-beam force field under uniform fluid flow. Bisect on flow speed to find the critical escape velocity and compare it with the maximum transverse restoring force.
physics/optics|ode.area: Optical tweezers forces and trap stiffness

physics/optics|ode.title: Optical conveyor belt: particle transport by a detuned standing-wave trap
physics/optics|ode.gist: Two counter-propagating beams with a small frequency offset form a moving standing-wave potential that drags a damped particle. Integrate the tilted-washboard ODE, compute the mean transport velocity versus detuning, and find the slip threshold.
physics/optics|ode.area: Optical tweezers forces and trap stiffness

physics/optics|ode.title: Parametric feedback cooling of a levitated nanosphere in vacuum
physics/optics|ode.gist: Model an underdamped nanosphere in an anharmonic optical potential with a feedback force proportional to x²·v plus gas damping and Langevin noise. Integrate the SDE ensemble and extract the effective temperature and energy decay rate versus feedback gain.
physics/optics|ode.area: Optical tweezers forces and trap stiffness

physics/optics|ode.title: Anharmonic trap response to sinusoidal stage oscillation
physics/optics|ode.gist: Drive a bead in a Gaussian-profile optical potential (not a parabola) with a sinusoidal fluid flow. Integrate the nonlinear overdamped ODE, extract amplitude and phase lag by Fourier projection, and show the apparent stiffness falling with drive amplitude.
physics/optics|ode.area: Optical tweezers forces and trap stiffness

physics/optics|ode.title: Evanescent-wave trapping near a surface with Faxén-corrected wall drag
physics/optics|ode.gist: A Rayleigh particle sits in a total-internal-reflection evanescent field above a wall, subject to gravity and double-layer repulsion. Integrate the height dynamics with Brenner/Faxén drag corrections and find the equilibrium height and relaxation time versus incidence angle.
physics/optics|ode.area: Optical tweezers forces and trap stiffness

physics/optics|ode.title: Optical guiding of a microparticle along a zeroth-order Bessel beam
physics/optics|ode.gist: Compute dipole gradient and scattering forces in a J0 Bessel beam with finite axicon aperture. Integrate 3D damped trajectories to find the transverse capture range, the radial oscillation frequency, and the axial terminal velocity.
physics/optics|ode.area: Optical tweezers forces and trap stiffness

physics/optics|ode.title: Hydrodynamic coupling of two optically trapped beads via the Oseen tensor
physics/optics|ode.gist: Two beads in separate harmonic traps interact through the Rotne-Prager mobility tensor. Integrate the coupled Langevin equations and compute the cross-correlation function, with its delayed anticorrelation dip, versus bead separation.
physics/optics|ode.area: Optical tweezers forces and trap stiffness

physics/optics|ode.title: Optical fractionation: size-dependent deflection of particles crossing an optical lattice
physics/optics|ode.gist: Particles flowing across a tilted 1D sinusoidal optical potential either lock into channels or drift past them, depending on size-dependent polarizability and drag. Integrate trajectories and compute the deflection angle versus particle radius and lattice tilt.
physics/optics|ode.area: Optical tweezers forces and trap stiffness

physics/optics|ode.title: Spin-to-orbital conversion in a q-plate with depth-dependent director twist
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the 2x2 Jones-matrix ODE through a liquid-crystal q-plate whose local director azimuth twists with depth because of boundary anchoring. Compute the conversion efficiency into the l=±2q OAM mode versus retardance and twist.
physics/optics|ode.area: Optical vortices and orbital angular momentum

physics/optics|ode.title: Vortex soliton radial profiles in a saturable self-focusing medium
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve the radial stationary NLS u'' + u'/r − m²u/r² − βu + u³/(1+su²) = 0 by shooting on the core slope for charges m = 1-3. Compute power-versus-propagation-constant curves and the Vakhitov-Kolokolov slope.
physics/optics|ode.area: Optical vortices and orbital angular momentum

physics/optics|ode.title: Variational ring-width dynamics of a self-focusing vortex beam in Kerr media
physics/optics|ode.gist: Use a Laguerre-Gauss-shaped ansatz in the NLS Lagrangian to derive an ODE for the ring width. Integrate it to find the charge-dependent critical power for collapse and the oscillation period below threshold.
physics/optics|ode.area: Optical vortices and orbital angular momentum

physics/optics|ode.title: Vortex-dipole drift in a defocusing Kerr background via point-vortex ODEs
physics/optics|ode.gist: Model optical vortices in a self-defocusing medium as point vortices advected by each other's phase gradients and by the background intensity gradient of a broad Gaussian beam. Integrate their trajectories and compute the dipole drift speed versus separation.
physics/optics|ode.area: Optical vortices and orbital angular momentum

physics/optics|ode.title: OAM mode effective-index splitting in a ring-core fiber
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve the scalar radial equation for azimuthal orders l in a ring-core index profile by shooting. Add the first-order polarization correction for the spin-orbit-aligned and anti-aligned vector modes, then compute the splitting and the OAM walk-off length.
physics/optics|ode.area: Optical vortices and orbital angular momentum

physics/optics|ode.title: Second-harmonic generation of a Laguerre-Gauss pump: charge doubling with depletion
physics/optics|ode.gist: Project the SHG coupled-wave equations onto a truncated LG basis and integrate the coupled amplitude ODEs through the crystal. Compute conversion efficiency, the OAM spectrum of the harmonic, and the radial-mode content generated by depletion.
physics/optics|ode.area: Optical vortices and orbital angular momentum

physics/optics|ode.title: OAM generation by a helical long-period fiber grating
physics/optics|ode.gist: Write coupled-mode ODEs between the fundamental core mode and l=±1 modes, coupled by a helically twisted index perturbation with a chiral phase-matching condition. Integrate them to get the conversion-efficiency spectrum and its handedness selectivity.
physics/optics|ode.area: Optical vortices and orbital angular momentum

physics/optics|ode.title: Astigmatic GRIN medium as a continuous Hermite-to-Laguerre mode converter
physics/optics|ode.gist: Propagate an HG_{mn} beam through an elliptical lens-like medium using coupled-mode ODEs in the HG basis with differential Gouy phases. Find the length that gives a π/2 converter and the purity of the resulting LG mode.
physics/optics|ode.area: Optical vortices and orbital angular momentum

physics/optics|ode.title: Linearly graded index slab: shooting versus exact Airy-function modes
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve the TE Helmholtz eigenproblem for a slab whose index decreases linearly into the substrate below a step cover, using Numerov shooting. Validate against the Airy-function dispersion equation and WKB effective indices.

physics/optics|ode.title: Inverse WKB reconstruction of an ion-exchanged erfc index profile
physics/optics|ode.gist: From a set of TE effective indices, reconstruct the graded-index depth profile with the inverse WKB (White-Heidrich) method. Validate it by forward Numerov shooting on the reconstructed profile to reproduce the input mode indices.

physics/optics|ode.title: Uniaxial anisotropic slab waveguide: TE/TM modes and modal birefringence
physics/optics|ode.gist: Derive the TE (ordinary) and TM (extraordinary, n_x ≠ n_z) field ODEs for a uniaxial film between isotropic claddings. Solve the dispersion relations by shooting and compute the modal birefringence versus film thickness.

physics/optics|ode.title: LP modes and fundamental-mode cutoff of a W-type depressed-cladding fiber
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the scalar radial wave equation through a three-layer W profile and match to modified Bessel decay in the outer cladding. Find LP_lm effective indices and the finite LP01 cutoff frequency.

physics/optics|ode.title: TE/TM polarizer: lossy modes of a slab with a thin metal overlay
physics/optics|ode.gist: Use complex shooting for TE and TM modes of a dielectric slab topped by a buffer layer and an absorbing metal film. Compute modal attenuation versus buffer thickness and the resulting polarization extinction ratio.

physics/optics|ode.title: Gain-guided semiconductor laser slab with a complex parabolic index profile
physics/optics|ode.gist: Find complex-β eigenmodes of a waveguide with a lateral parabolic gain and antiguiding profile by complex shooting, and check them against complex Hermite-Gauss solutions. Compute modal gain, wavefront curvature, and astigmatism factor.

physics/optics|ode.title: Bright photorefractive screening soliton: existence curve by shooting
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve the stationary normalized ODE u'' = βu + u/(1+u²) for bright screening solitons under an applied field by shooting on the peak amplitude. Compute the FWHM-versus-intensity-ratio existence curve.

physics/optics|ode.title: Nematicon: nonlocal soliton profile in a nematic liquid crystal
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve the coupled ODE system for the optical envelope and the reorientation angle, which obeys a screened Poisson equation, as a boundary-value problem. Compute soliton width versus power for several nonlocality ratios.

physics/optics|ode.title: Group-velocity dispersion and zero-dispersion thickness of an SOI slab waveguide
physics/optics|ode.gist: Shoot TE modes of a silicon-on-insulator slab with Sellmeier dispersion across wavelengths. Differentiate the effective index numerically to obtain group index and GVD, and root-find the thickness that zeros the GVD at 1550 nm.

physics/optics|ode.title: Waveguide side-coupled to a photonic-crystal nanocavity: temporal coupled-mode theory
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the temporal CMT ODE for a cavity with intrinsic and waveguide decay rates under a chirped input pulse. Compute the transmission dip, the loaded Q from ring-down, and the energy stored versus pulse duration.

physics/optics|ode.title: Fano line shapes of a cavity coupled to a waveguide with a partially reflecting element
physics/optics|ode.gist: Combine temporal CMT for a side-coupled cavity with a direct-path partial reflector to produce asymmetric Fano resonances. Integrate the ODEs and extract the Fano parameter q versus reflector position.

physics/optics|ode.title: Self-pulsing in a silicon photonic-crystal cavity with free-carrier and thermal dynamics
physics/optics|ode.gist: Couple the cavity-field CMT ODE to free-carrier density (two-photon generation, recombination) and temperature equations with Kerr, free-carrier-dispersion, and thermo-optic shifts. Map the oscillation regimes and self-pulsing frequency versus input power and detuning.

physics/optics|ode.title: Backscattering-induced resonance doublet in an add-drop microring filter
physics/optics|ode.gist: Write temporal CMT ODEs for clockwise and counterclockwise ring modes coupled by sidewall backscattering, with two bus waveguides. Compute through and drop spectra, the doublet splitting, and the reflected power versus coupling regime.

physics/optics|ode.title: Transmission bistability of a disordered Kerr multilayer via backward Helmholtz integration
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the nonlinear Helmholtz equation backward from a fixed transmitted field through a random-thickness Kerr layered medium to map input versus output intensity. Compute hysteresis widths and how they depend on the disorder-induced localization length.

physics/optics|ode.title: Random fiber Bragg grating: log-normal transmission and localization length
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the contradirectional coupled-mode ODEs for a grating with random coupling-strength and phase fluctuations over many realizations. Show that ln T is normally distributed and extract the localization length versus detuning from the band gap.

physics/optics|ode.title: Random mode coupling in a multimode fiber: power diffusion and modal localization
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate coupled-mode ODEs for N guided modes with random, z-dependent, nearest-neighbor coupling, and track the modal power distribution. Compute the mode-diffusion constant and the regime in which power stays localized in mode space.

physics/optics|ode.title: Disorder-induced backscattering loss in a slow-light photonic-crystal waveguide
physics/optics|ode.gist: Use coupled-mode ODEs between forward and backward Bloch modes with random sidewall-roughness coupling scaled by the group index. Compute the localization length versus n_g and verify the 1/n_g² scaling.

physics/optics|ode.title: Delocalized resonances in a random-dimer multilayer
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the 1D Helmholtz equation through a multilayer that randomly places paired dimer layers, and compute the Lyapunov exponent versus frequency. Identify the dimer resonance where localization vanishes and its scaling with sample length.

physics/optics|ode.title: Lasing thresholds of Anderson-localized modes in a 1D random laser
physics/optics|ode.gist: Add uniform gain to a random multilayer and complex-shoot for frequency and gain values where outgoing-wave boundary conditions hold. Compute the threshold distribution and its correlation with mode localization length.

physics/optics|ode.title: Sidelobe suppression in apodized uniform-period fiber Bragg gratings
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate coupled-mode ODEs with z-dependent coupling for uniform, Gaussian, and raised-cosine apodization profiles. Compute reflection spectra, bandwidth, and sidelobe suppression, and check the uniform case against the analytic result.
physics/optics|ode.area: Distributed Bragg reflectors and photonic bandgaps

physics/optics|ode.title: Gap-soliton transmission bistability in a nonlinear Bragg grating
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the nonlinear coupled-mode equations with self- and cross-phase modulation backward from a fixed output field. Map transmission versus input intensity inside the stop band and locate the switching thresholds to soliton-mediated transmission.
physics/optics|ode.area: Distributed Bragg reflectors and photonic bandgaps

physics/optics|ode.title: Band-edge lasing threshold in a finite active 1D photonic crystal
physics/optics|ode.gist: Complex-shoot for lasing modes of a gain-loaded multilayer with outgoing boundary conditions. Find the threshold gain for modes near the band edge and its N^-3 scaling with period number, linked to the group index.
physics/optics|ode.area: Distributed Bragg reflectors and photonic bandgaps

physics/optics|ode.title: Tamm plasmon at a metal/Bragg-mirror interface
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the field through a Drude-metal film on a DBR and find the Tamm-state resonance as a reflectance dip. Compute resonance wavelength and Q versus metal thickness and the thickness of the DBR's top layer.
physics/optics|ode.area: Distributed Bragg reflectors and photonic bandgaps

physics/optics|ode.title: Cholesteric liquid-crystal selective reflection via Berreman 4x4 ODEs
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the Berreman 4x4 first-order system through a helical cholesteric layer at normal and oblique incidence. Compute circular-polarization-resolved reflectance and the band edges n_o·p and n_e·p.
physics/optics|ode.area: Distributed Bragg reflectors and photonic bandgaps

physics/optics|ode.title: Bloch surface waves on a truncated 1D photonic crystal
physics/optics|ode.gist: Shoot TE fields with evanescent decay in the ambient medium and Bloch decay into a semi-infinite multilayer whose top layer is truncated. Compute the BSW dispersion curve and its sensitivity to the ambient index.
physics/optics|ode.area: Distributed Bragg reflectors and photonic bandgaps

physics/optics|ode.title: Long-period fiber grating core-to-cladding-mode transmission notches
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the co-directional coupled-mode ODEs between the core mode and several cladding modes with their own phase-matching periods. Compute the multi-notch transmission spectrum and the notch-depth dependence on κL.
physics/optics|ode.area: Distributed Bragg reflectors and photonic bandgaps

physics/optics|ode.title: Sommerfeld and Brillouin precursors via Lorentz-medium ADE in 1D FDTD
physics/optics|ode.gist: Couple a Yee 1D FDTD grid to a Lorentz-oscillator auxiliary differential equation for the polarization. Propagate a step-modulated carrier into the medium and extract precursor arrival times and amplitude decay versus depth.

physics/optics|ode.title: Self-phase-modulation broadening with Kerr-Raman ADE in 1D FDTD
physics/optics|ode.gist: Add instantaneous Kerr and Lorentzian Raman-response auxiliary ODEs to a 1D FDTD scheme and propagate a femtosecond pulse. Compute spectral broadening and the Raman-induced red shift, and compare them with NLSE estimates.

physics/optics|ode.title: Temporal boundary: frequency conversion by an abrupt permittivity switch
physics/optics|ode.gist: Switch the permittivity of a 1D FDTD domain abruptly or with a finite ramp while a wave packet propagates. Compute the forward and backward (time-reflected) amplitudes and the frequency shift, and compare them with the temporal Fresnel coefficients.

physics/optics|ode.title: Laser photon statistics through threshold from the Scully-Lamb master equation
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the diagonal Scully-Lamb rate equations for photon-number probabilities p_n with gain, saturation, and loss. Compute the steady-state Mandel Q and g2(0) versus pump parameter across threshold.

physics/optics|ode.title: Fock and coherent states under loss and a thermal bath: Mandel Q evolution
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the damped-oscillator master equation in the Fock basis for an initial Fock or coherent state coupled to a finite-temperature reservoir. Compute the time evolution of mean photon number, Mandel Q, and the crossover to super-Poissonian statistics.

physics/optics|ode.title: Sub-Poissonian light generated by two-photon absorption
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the master equation for a cavity mode with linear driving and a two-photon-absorption Lindblad term. Compute the steady-state photon distribution, its Mandel Q, and the parameter regime of maximal sub-Poissonian character.

physics/optics|ode.title: Quadrature squeezing near the turning point of a Kerr-cavity bistability
physics/optics|ode.gist: Linearize the quantum Langevin equations of a driven Kerr cavity about the classical steady state and integrate the covariance ODE. Compute the optimal squeezing spectrum along the bistability curve, which grows toward the turning points.

physics/optics|ode.title: Total-variation gradient-flow deconvolution of a blurred optical image
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the smoothed-TV-regularized gradient flow for deblurring a 1D or 2D optical image with known PSF using method-of-lines time stepping. Compute the converged reconstruction error and edge-preservation metrics versus the regularization weight.

physics/optics|ode.title: Light scattering by a radially graded-index cylinder via radial ODEs
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the radial cylindrical-wave equation for each angular order through a graded fiber profile at normal incidence, for TE and TM polarizations. Match to Bessel/Hankel exteriors to obtain scattering coefficients and the extinction efficiency.

physics/optics|ode.title: Whispering-gallery mode wavelengths of a microdisk by radial shooting
physics/optics|ode.gist: Using the effective-index slab approximation, shoot the 2D radial Bessel equation for complex WGM frequencies of a microdisk with outgoing Hankel boundary conditions. Compare with Airy-zero asymptotic formulas and compute radiative Q versus azimuthal number.

physics/optics|ode.title: Rainbow angle of a droplet with an internal radial temperature gradient
physics/optics|ode.gist: Trace rays through a sphere with a radially varying refractive index by integrating the ray equation, with Snell refraction at the surface. Find the minimum-deviation rainbow angle for first- and second-order bows versus gradient strength.

physics/optics|ode.title: Ray escape and angle growth in a tapered step-index fiber
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the ray equation, or the reflection map with adiabatic invariant, through a linearly tapered core. Compute where rays exceed the critical angle and the transmitted fraction versus taper ratio and launch NA.

physics/optics|ode.title: Power and spherical aberration of a GRIN crystalline lens model
physics/optics|ode.gist: Trace meridional rays by integrating the ray equation through a Gullstrand/Liou-Brennan-type nested graded-index lens. Compute the paraxial power, the longitudinal spherical aberration, and the contribution of the gradient versus the surfaces.

physics/optics|ode.title: Lorenz-Haken laser second-threshold instability
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the Maxwell-Bloch single-mode laser equations, which are isomorphic to Lorenz. Locate the second laser threshold for chaotic emission in the bad-cavity regime and compare it with the analytic Hopf condition.

physics/optics|ode.title: Primary Kerr comb onset in a microresonator: three-mode coupled ODEs
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate coupled-mode equations for the pump and two symmetric sidebands with Kerr four-wave mixing, dispersion, and detuning. Compute the parametric threshold and the sideband growth, and compare with the Lugiato-Lefever modulational-instability prediction.

physics/optics|ode.title: Singly resonant optical parametric oscillator: threshold and conversion efficiency
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the three-wave coupled amplitude ODEs per pass inside a cavity resonant only for the signal, and iterate to steady state. Compute threshold, pump depletion, and idler output power versus pump power.

physics/optics|ode.title: Purcell-enhanced nanocavity LED: rate equations and modulation bandwidth
physics/optics|ode.gist: Write carrier and photon rate equations with Purcell-enhanced spontaneous emission into a high-Q photonic-crystal cavity mode. Integrate a small-signal current step to extract the 3 dB modulation bandwidth versus Purcell factor and β.

physics/optics|ode.title: Silicon slot waveguide TM mode: field enhancement and confinement in the low-index slot
physics/optics|ode.gist: Shoot the TM H_y equation across a five-layer Si/SiO2/air-slot slab, enforcing the 1/ε jump in E_x. Compute neff, the slot power confinement and the peak-field enhancement as functions of slot width.

physics/optics|ode.title: Optical confinement factor of a GRINSCH quantum-well laser waveguide
physics/optics|ode.gist: Build the AlGaAs index profile from a linearly or parabolically graded Al fraction around a thin quantum well. Solve the finite-difference TE eigenproblem and compute the quantum-well confinement factor versus graded-layer thickness.

physics/optics|ode.title: Exponential graded-index slab: Numerov shooting versus exact Bessel-function dispersion
physics/optics|ode.gist: Find TE eigenvalues of an exponential-profile waveguide by Numerov shooting with decaying boundary conditions. Validate them against roots of the analytic Bessel-function dispersion relation as the profile depth varies.

physics/optics|ode.title: UV-written Gaussian-profile polymer slab: mode count and cutoffs versus index contrast
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve the FD Helmholtz eigenproblem for a Gaussian index perturbation in a polymer film. Track the number of bound modes and their cutoff peak-index values, and compare with the V-number estimate.

physics/optics|ode.title: TM guided modes of a hyperbolic-metamaterial slab with indefinite permittivity
physics/optics|ode.gist: Shoot the anisotropic TM equation (ε_x<0, ε_z>0) for a finite hyperbolic slab in a dielectric. Compute the high-index mode ladder and its dispersion, including modes with negative group velocity.

physics/optics|ode.title: Graphene plasmon dispersion in a dielectric sandwich via a conductive-sheet jump condition
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the TM field ODE through the layers with the Kubo-conductivity discontinuity at the graphene sheet. Root-find the complex propagation constant to get confinement and propagation length versus Fermi energy.

physics/optics|ode.title: Nonreciprocal phase shift of TM modes in a magneto-optic garnet slab isolator
physics/optics|ode.gist: Compute TM mode profiles of a garnet/garnet/substrate slab by shooting. Evaluate the first-order perturbation integral of the gyrotropic off-diagonal term to get the nonreciprocal phase shift and the isolator length.

physics/optics|ode.title: Thermo-optically tuned slab waveguide: heater conduction BVP coupled to mode solving
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve the 1D steady heat-conduction BVP with a surface heater to get the temperature profile. Convert it to an index profile, recompute the TE effective index, and extract tuning efficiency per milliwatt.

physics/optics|ode.title: Substrate leakage loss of an SOI slab versus buried-oxide thickness
physics/optics|ode.gist: Complex shooting finds the leaky TE/TM mode of Si on a finite SiO2 layer over a silicon substrate. The loss in dB/cm is extracted from Im(neff) as a function of BOX thickness.

physics/optics|ode.title: Bulk and surface sensitivity of a four-layer slab-waveguide refractometric sensor
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve TE/TM modes of substrate/film/adlayer/cover stacks by shooting. Compute dneff/dn_cover and dneff/d(adlayer thickness), and the film thickness that maximizes each sensitivity.

physics/optics|ode.title: Bragg reflection waveguide: low-index core guided by transverse DBR claddings
physics/optics|ode.gist: Complex shooting through periodic claddings finds the Bragg-guided core mode. Compute its effective index and confinement loss versus the number of cladding periods, using monodromy matrices for the cladding Bloch condition.

physics/optics|ode.title: Residual linear birefringence of a spun high-birefringence fiber
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the Jones ODE for linear birefringence whose axis rotates at the spin rate. Compute the effective retardance and output polarization state versus spin rate and length, and compare with the rotating-frame analytic result.

physics/optics|ode.title: Fiber-optic current sensor: Faraday rotation quenched by intrinsic linear birefringence
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve the Stokes/Jones ODE that combines a Verdet circular term with linear birefringence along the fiber. Compute the sensor scale factor and its nonlinearity versus beat length and current.

physics/optics|ode.title: Off-axis quartz plate: combined optical activity and birefringence eigenpolarizations
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate coupled ODEs for the field components with both a gyration term and linear birefringence at angle θ to the optic axis. Extract the ellipticity of the eigenmodes and the transmitted polarization versus θ.

physics/optics|ode.title: Thermally induced depolarization loss in an end-pumped Nd:YAG rod
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve the radial heat-conduction BVP with distributed pumping, then compute plane-strain thermal stresses and the photoelastic radial/tangential birefringence. Integrate across the aperture for depolarization loss versus pump power.

physics/optics|ode.title: Internal conical refraction ring in biaxial KGd(WO4)2 from coupled paraxial ODEs
physics/optics|ode.gist: For each transverse wavevector, integrate the 2×2 coupled-polarization paraxial ODE near the optic axis, then inverse-FFT to real space. Extract the ring radius, the Poggendorff dark ring and the dependence on crystal length.

physics/optics|ode.title: Voigt singular axes in an absorbing biaxial crystal
physics/optics|ode.gist: Propagate the field along directions near the optic axis of a weakly absorbing biaxial crystal by integrating the non-Hermitian 2×2 coupled-mode ODE. Locate the singular axes where the eigenpolarizations coalesce, and characterize the anomalous linear-in-z field growth.

physics/optics|ode.title: Jaynes-Cummings collapse and revival with an initial coherent field
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the Schrödinger equation in a truncated Fock⊗atom basis. Compute atomic inversion, its collapse and revival times, and the atomic purity, comparing with the analytic Rabi-frequency sum.

physics/optics|ode.title: Incoherently pumped quantum-dot cavity spectrum: strong-to-weak coupling crossover
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve the Lindblad master equation with incoherent pumping and decay rates for an emitter-cavity system. Use the quantum regression theorem for the cavity emission spectrum, and track when the vacuum Rabi doublet merges as pump and κ vary.

physics/optics|ode.title: Tavis-Cummings collective splitting and cavity protection under inhomogeneous broadening
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve the linear single-excitation ODEs for N detuned emitters coupled to a cavity. Compute the √N vacuum Rabi splitting and the polariton linewidth narrowing as collective coupling exceeds the inhomogeneous width.

physics/optics|ode.title: Vacuum-stimulated Raman adiabatic passage single-photon source in a Λ atom-cavity
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the time-dependent three-level atom plus cavity Schrödinger/master equation with a ramped pump pulse. Compute the output photon wavepacket and the emission efficiency versus pump duration and κ.

physics/optics|ode.title: Non-Markovian atom decay in a structured reservoir via the pseudomode method
physics/optics|ode.gist: Model a band-gap-like reservoir as a difference of two Lorentzians, using one positive- and one negative-weight pseudomode. Integrate the pseudomode master equation to get the fractional population trapping and its oscillations.

physics/optics|ode.title: Atom in front of a mirror: delayed spontaneous emission via delay-differential equations
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve the Wigner-Weisskopf amplitude equation with a round-trip delay term using a method-of-steps DDE integrator. Compute decay-rate modification and population revivals versus atom-mirror distance.

physics/optics|ode.title: Rytov-Vladimirskii geometric polarization rotation in a helically wound fiber
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate parallel-transport (Frenet) ODEs for the polarization vector along a helical fiber. Show the rotation equals the solid angle subtended by the tangent trajectory, and compare with the Berry-phase formula versus pitch.
physics/optics|ode.area: Polarization optics with Jones and Mueller calculus

physics/optics|ode.title: Polarization attraction in counterpropagating Kerr fiber as a two-point BVP
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve the counterpropagating Stokes-vector Kerr equations with boundary conditions at both fiber ends. Show signal polarization pulling toward a pump-determined state, and quantify the degree of attraction versus power.
physics/optics|ode.area: Polarization optics with Jones and Mueller calculus

physics/optics|ode.title: Pancharatnam-Berry phase from a slowly rotating birefringent sequence
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the Jones ODE for a retarder whose axis rotates along z. Compute the geometric phase from the Poincaré-sphere trajectory and compare the solid-angle prediction in adiabatic and nonadiabatic regimes.
physics/optics|ode.area: Polarization optics with Jones and Mueller calculus

physics/optics|ode.title: Fiber-loop (Lefèvre) wave plates from bend-induced birefringence
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the Jones ODE along coiled fiber with bend birefringence ∝ (r/R)². Find loop radii and turn counts giving quarter- and half-wave retardation, and the polarization-controller coverage of the Poincaré sphere.
physics/optics|ode.area: Polarization optics with Jones and Mueller calculus

physics/optics|ode.title: SOA picosecond pulse amplification: gain saturation and self-phase-modulation spectral shift
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve the Agrawal-Olsson integrated-gain ODE in the retarded frame for Gaussian input pulses. Compute output pulse shape, gain compression and the alpha-factor-induced red shift of the spectrum.

physics/optics|ode.title: Cross-gain modulation wavelength converter in a semiconductor optical amplifier
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the carrier rate equation, together with propagation ODEs, for a modulated pump and a CW probe. Compute the converted extinction ratio and pattern effects versus bit rate and the holding beam.

physics/optics|ode.title: Spectrally resolved forward/backward ASE and noise figure of an EDFA
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve the two-level Giles model with tens of spectral ASE bins in both directions as a two-point BVP by shooting and relaxation. Compute gain spectrum and noise figure versus pump power.

physics/optics|ode.title: EDFA power transients on channel add/drop via the reservoir model
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the Saleh/Sun single-ODE reservoir model for the total inversion of an EDFA. Compute surviving-channel overshoot and settling time after dropping channels, with and without gain-clamping feedback.

physics/optics|ode.title: Erbium-doped waveguide amplifier with cooperative upconversion
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve three-level rate equations including a quadratic upconversion term, coupled to pump/signal propagation ODEs. Compute net gain versus Er concentration and length, and find the concentration optimum.

physics/optics|ode.title: Gain narrowing and spectral red shift in a multipass Ti:sapphire CPA amplifier
physics/optics|ode.gist: Apply spectrally resolved saturated gain per pass with a wavelength-dependent cross section, integrating the stored-energy depletion across the chirped pulse. Output: spectral bandwidth and centroid shift versus pass number.

physics/optics|ode.title: Saturation of an inhomogeneously broadened Doppler gas amplifier: hole burning
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the propagation ODE with a gain coefficient obtained from a Voigt integral over velocity classes. Contrast inhomogeneous (1+I/Is)^-1/2 and homogeneous saturation, and compute extracted power versus length.

physics/optics|ode.title: Ultrafast gain recovery of a quantum-dot SOA with wetting-layer reservoir
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate coupled rate equations for the wetting-layer, excited-state and ground-state occupations after a short saturating pulse. Extract the multi-timescale recovery and the patterning-free bit rate.

physics/optics|ode.title: Parabolic (Weber) nondiffracting beams from parabolic cylinder ODEs
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the parabolic-cylinder ODEs in parabolic coordinates for a continuous separation parameter. Construct even/odd Weber beam profiles and their traveling combinations, and verify the transverse Helmholtz residual.

physics/optics|ode.title: Ince-Gaussian mode eigenvalues from the Ince equation
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve the Ince equation eigenproblem by Fourier matrix truncation and confirm with shooting. Construct Ince-Gauss modes, and show the limits interpolating between Hermite- and Laguerre-Gauss modes as ellipticity varies.

physics/optics|ode.title: Airy beam centroid and peak oscillation in a parabolic graded-index medium
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the Ehrenfest moment ODEs and the caustic ray family for an Airy beam in a lens-like medium. Compute the oscillating peak trajectory versus centroid motion and the periodic self-imaging length.

physics/optics|ode.title: Caustic design of self-accelerating beams along arbitrary convex trajectories
physics/optics|ode.gist: Given a target trajectory, solve the tangent-ray/Legendre-transform ODE for the input phase mask. Verify by propagating the resulting field with the Fresnel integral that the intensity peak follows the curve.

physics/optics|ode.title: Nonlinear unbalanced Bessel beams in Kerr media with nonlinear losses
physics/optics|ode.gist: Shoot the radial nonlinear Helmholtz ODE with multiphoton absorption for stationary conical beams. Compute the inward/outward Hankel-component imbalance and the energy-flux balance versus cone angle.

physics/optics|ode.title: Ring-Airy autofocusing beams: focal position from the caustic ray ODE
physics/optics|ode.gist: Trace the ray family of a radially symmetric Airy beam and locate the caustic convergence on axis. Compare the focus distance and contrast with a Hankel-transform propagation check versus ring radius.

physics/optics|ode.title: Differential method for a sinusoidal metallic grating with S-matrix stabilization
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate truncated Fourier-coupled field ODEs through the modulated region of a sinusoidal metal grating, slicing with S-matrix recursion. Compute TE diffraction efficiencies and their convergence with truncation order.

physics/optics|ode.title: Slanted volume hologram with depth-varying modulation: multiwave coupled-wave ODEs
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the rigorous second-order coupled-wave ODEs, including higher orders, for a slanted grating with nonuniform index modulation. Compare diffraction efficiency and angular selectivity with two-wave Kogelnik theory.

physics/optics|ode.title: Moth-eye subwavelength antireflection grating via staircase RCWA
physics/optics|ode.gist: Stair-step a conical/sinusoidal relief into slabs and solve each with coupled-wave eigenproblems. Compute zeroth-order reflectance versus wavelength and angle, and compare with the effective-medium graded-index limit.

physics/optics|ode.title: Chandezon C-method for blazed echelette grating efficiency
physics/optics|ode.gist: Use curvilinear coordinates to convert Maxwell's equations into an ODE eigenproblem with constant coefficients. Compute TE/TM blaze efficiencies of a smooth blazed profile versus wavelength and convergence in truncation.

physics/optics|ode.title: Fox-Li modes of a resonator with an absorption-heated thermally deformed mirror
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve the radial heat BVP in a mirror substrate under Gaussian absorbed power to obtain thermal surface deformation. Use it as phase in Fox-Li iteration to find mode distortion and loss versus power.

physics/optics|ode.title: Wassermann-Wolf aplanatic two-aspheric-surface lens design
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the coupled Wassermann-Wolf ODEs for two aspheric surfaces enforcing zero spherical aberration and the sine condition. Verify by exact ray tracing the residual wavefront error and coma.

physics/optics|ode.title: Gaussian-to-flat-top beam shaper lens from a ray-mapping ODE
physics/optics|ode.gist: Derive the energy-conserving ray map, then integrate the Snell-law surface ODE for a refractive shaper. Trace rays to evaluate output uniformity and edge steepness.

physics/optics|ode.title: Axial-gradient GRIN singlet: correcting spherical aberration with an index gradient
physics/optics|ode.gist: Trace rays through a spherical singlet with an axial gradient n(z) by integrating ray ODEs. Find the gradient coefficient minimizing longitudinal spherical aberration, and compute the RMS spot versus aperture.

physics/optics|ode.title: Generalized Coddington wavefront-curvature transport to locate lens caustics
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the ray ODE and the principal-curvature transport equations after refraction at a thick plano-convex lens. Locate the tangential/sagittal caustic surfaces and the circle of least confusion.

physics/optics|ode.title: Three-mirror coupled cavity: normal-mode splitting and beating ringdown
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate coupled-mode ODEs for two optical cavities sharing a middle mirror. Compute normal-mode frequencies and linewidths versus middle-mirror transmission and the beating ringdown waveform after the drive is switched off.

physics/optics|ode.title: Cavity ring-down spectroscopy: absorption retrieval with detector bandwidth effects
physics/optics|ode.gist: Simulate the ringdown ODE with analyte absorption and convolution with a finite-bandwidth detector response. Fit decay times to retrieve absorption coefficient and quantify bias versus detector bandwidth and noise.

physics/optics|ode.title: MEMS-tunable Fabry-Perot filter: electrostatic pull-in and transmission transient
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the damped mass-spring ODE of a mirror under a nonlinear electrostatic force. Find the pull-in voltage and map the gap transient into a time-dependent Airy transmission at a fixed wavelength.

physics/optics|ode.title: Gain-switched semiconductor laser: pulse width and alpha-factor chirp
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate carrier/photon/phase rate equations under a large current pulse. Compute output pulse width, turn-on delay and instantaneous frequency chirp versus bias and pulse amplitude.

physics/optics|ode.title: Haus master-equation mode-locked pulse via stationary Ginzburg-Landau shooting
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve the stationary complex Ginzburg-Landau ODE with fast saturable absorption, gain filtering and GVD as a BVP in time. Compute pulse width and chirp, and compare with the analytic sech-pulse solution.

physics/optics|ode.title: Q-switched mode-locking instability threshold in a SESAM solid-state laser
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate pulse-energy and gain ODEs with SESAM saturable absorption. Find the intracavity energy threshold for stable CW mode locking, and compare with the Hönninger criterion.

physics/optics|ode.title: Spin-VCSEL polarization dynamics in the spin-flip model
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the SFM equations for circular field components and spin-resolved carriers with birefringence. Compute polarization oscillation frequency and the degree of circular polarization versus spin pumping.

physics/optics|ode.title: Directional bistability in a semiconductor microring laser
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate rate equations for the counterpropagating fields with self/cross saturation and backscattering. Compute regimes of bidirectional, alternate-oscillation and unidirectional bistable operation versus pump.

physics/optics|ode.title: Excitable spiking in a Yamada gain/absorber semiconductor laser
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the Yamada three-variable model for gain, absorber and intensity. Find the excitability threshold, refractory time and spike amplitude for perturbations, relevant to photonic neurons.

physics/optics|ode.title: Phase locking of two evanescently coupled semiconductor lasers
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate coupled rate equations for two lasers with complex field coupling, frequency detuning and alpha factor. Compute the locking boundaries and the in-phase versus out-of-phase supermode stability.

physics/optics|ode.title: Four-wave mixing in silicon waveguides with two-photon and free-carrier absorption
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate coupled pump/signal/idler amplitude ODEs including TPA, free-carrier density and FCA. Compute conversion efficiency versus pump power, and the onset of saturation.

physics/optics|ode.title: Cascaded stimulated Raman scattering in a hydrogen gas cell
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate coupled intensity ODEs for pump and successive Stokes orders with pump depletion. Compute output energy partition into Stokes orders versus pressure and pump intensity.

physics/optics|ode.title: Terahertz difference-frequency generation with strong THz absorption
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate coupled-amplitude ODEs for two pumps and a THz wave in a crystal with large THz absorption and phase mismatch. Find the optimal crystal length and conversion efficiency.

physics/optics|ode.title: Phase-conjugate reflectivity of degenerate four-wave mixing as a BVP
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve the counterpropagating Yariv coupled-mode equations with probe and conjugate boundary conditions at opposite faces. Compute phase-conjugate reflectivity, including the tan² gain regime and oscillation condition.

physics/optics|ode.title: Photorefractive two-beam coupling with pump depletion
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate coupled intensity and phase ODEs for two beams in a photorefractive crystal with an absorbing medium. Compute signal gain versus beam ratio and the energy-transfer saturation.

physics/optics|ode.title: Cascaded Stokes orders in a stimulated Brillouin ring laser
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate coupled-mode ODEs for intracavity Stokes orders with Brillouin gain coupling and loss. Compute successive cascading thresholds and output power clamping.

physics/optics|ode.title: Spatial hole burning and multimode threshold in a standing-wave Nd laser
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve rate equations with z-dependent inversion grating for multiple longitudinal modes. Compute the pump power at which a second mode reaches threshold.

physics/optics|ode.title: Baer green problem: chaotic intracavity-doubled Nd:YAG laser
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate multimode rate equations with sum-frequency coupling between modes. Compute bifurcation from steady state to chaotic intensity fluctuations and the suppression of chaos by mode orientation.

physics/optics|ode.title: Resonant absorption at an epsilon-near-zero point in a graded plasma layer
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the oblique TM wave equation through a linear permittivity profile across ε=0 with small damping. Compute absorbed fraction versus incidence angle and compare with Ginzburg's formula.

physics/optics|ode.title: Two-mode squeezed vacuum from a lossy nondegenerate parametric amplifier
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the Lyapunov ODE for the 4x4 quadrature covariance matrix of signal and idler under parametric gain and linear loss. Compute the EPR variance and logarithmic negativity versus length, and the length that maximizes entanglement.

physics/optics|ode.title: Biexciton-exciton cascade: cross-correlation g2 between XX and X photons
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve the master equation of a four-level quantum-dot cascade with fine-structure splitting under incoherent pumping. Use the quantum-regression theorem to obtain the XX-X cross-correlation g2(τ), the X autocorrelation, and their bunching or antibunching timescales.

physics/optics|ode.title: Kerr quadrature squeezing of a CW beam in a lossy optical fiber
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the linearized Heisenberg (Bogoliubov) ODEs for field fluctuations under self-phase modulation and distributed loss along the fiber. Compute the optimal-angle quadrature variance versus length and nonlinear phase, and compare it with the lossless analytic result.

physics/optics|ode.title: Frequency-filtered resonance fluorescence correlations via the cascaded sensor method
physics/optics|ode.gist: Weakly couple two-level sensor cavities, or cascaded filter modes, to a coherently driven two-level atom and integrate the cascaded master equation. Compute the frequency-resolved g2 between Mollow sidebands versus filter linewidth.

physics/optics|ode.title: Dynamic light scattering autocorrelation from simulated Brownian scatterers
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate overdamped Langevin trajectories for many particles and build the scattered speckle field at a fixed scattering vector. Compute g1(τ) and g2(τ), verify the Siegert relation, and recover the hydrodynamic radius from the fitted decay rate.

physics/optics|ode.title: Laser speckle contrast versus exposure time for Ornstein-Uhlenbeck phase dynamics
physics/optics|ode.gist: Simulate speckle phasors whose phases follow OU stochastic ODEs, which give an exponential field correlation. Integrate the intensity over finite camera exposures to get the speckle contrast K(T), and compare it with the analytic contrast-correlation-time formula.

physics/optics|ode.title: Frequency-domain photon density waves in a turbid slab via the diffusion BVP
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve the complex-valued diffusion-approximation ODE in depth for a modulated source, with extrapolated (Robin) boundary conditions. Compute the amplitude and phase of diffuse transmittance versus modulation frequency, then invert them for the absorption and reduced scattering coefficients.

physics/optics|ode.title: Doppler-free saturated absorption Lamb dip from velocity-resolved Bloch equations
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate two-level Bloch equations for each velocity class driven by counterpropagating pump and probe, using a perturbative probe or a time-averaged standing wave. Doppler-average the probe absorption to obtain the Lamb dip width and depth versus pump saturation.
physics/optics|ode.area: Optical Bloch equations and atom-light interaction

physics/optics|ode.title: Optical pumping into Zeeman sublevels under σ+ light
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate rate equations, built from Clebsch-Gordan branching ratios, for the hyperfine Zeeman populations of an F=1→F'=2 alkali transition with ground-state relaxation. Compute the pumping time and the steady-state orientation versus intensity.
physics/optics|ode.area: Optical Bloch equations and atom-light interaction

physics/optics|ode.title: Sisyphus polarization-gradient cooling force in a lin⊥lin standing wave
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the optical Bloch equations of a Jg=1/2→Je=3/2 atom moving at constant velocity through a lin⊥lin field and average the force over a wavelength. Compute the velocity-dependent force, the capture range and the friction coefficient, and compare them with Doppler cooling.
physics/optics|ode.area: Optical Bloch equations and atom-light interaction

physics/optics|ode.title: Gravity sag of a ring-supported mirror: Zernike decomposition and RMS error
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve the axisymmetric Kirchhoff thin-plate bending ODE for a circular mirror under self-weight with a ring support, using shooting or a BVP solver. Fit the surface to rotationally symmetric Zernike terms, and compute the RMS wavefront error versus support radius to find the optimal ring.

physics/optics|ode.title: Electrostatic membrane deformable mirror: actuation shape and Zernike content
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve the radial Poisson-type BVP for a tensioned membrane under an annular electrostatic pressure, including the gap-dependent nonlinear force. Decompose the deflection into Zernike defocus and spherical terms, and compute the achievable defocus stroke and residual RMS.

physics/optics|ode.title: Transient thermal-lens aberration in an absorbing liquid cell
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the radial heat equation by method of lines for Gaussian-beam heating of a liquid cell, and convert the temperature to optical path difference via dn/dT. Fit the result to Zernike defocus plus spherical terms and track the Strehl ratio over time.

physics/optics|ode.title: Self-pulsing of an erbium fiber laser from clustered ion pairs
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate rate equations with isolated and paired Er³⁺ populations, where the pairs undergo fast upconversion and act as a saturable absorber. Determine the pump range of self-pulsing, the pulse repetition rate, and the onset found from a linear stability (Hopf) analysis.

physics/optics|ode.title: Thulium fiber laser with two-for-one cross-relaxation pumping at 790 nm
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the Tm³⁺ multilevel rate equations with a concentration-dependent cross-relaxation term to steady state, together with the pump and signal power ODEs along the fiber. Compute the slope efficiency and the effective quantum efficiency versus doping.

physics/optics|ode.title: Dye laser pulse termination by triplet-state accumulation
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate singlet, triplet and photon rate equations for a flashlamp-pumped dye laser, with intersystem crossing and triplet-triplet absorption. Compute the lasing duration versus triplet quencher concentration.

physics/optics|ode.title: Locally competitive algorithm for compressive recovery of an optical image
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the Rozell LCA neural ODE with soft thresholding to recover sparse DCT or wavelet coefficients from random-mask single-pixel measurements. Compute the reconstruction PSNR versus sampling ratio and convergence time.

physics/optics|ode.title: Perona-Malik anisotropic-diffusion-regularized deconvolution flow
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the method-of-lines gradient flow of a data-fidelity term plus Perona-Malik edge-preserving diffusion for a blurred, noisy microscope image. Compute the restoration error versus diffusion threshold and stopping time, and compare with Wiener filtering.

physics/optics|ode.title: Hydrodynamic memory (Basset force) in optical-trap power spectra
physics/optics|ode.gist: Approximate the Basset kernel by a sum of exponentials and integrate the resulting Markovian-embedded generalized Langevin equation for a trapped bead. Compute the PSD and its deviation from the Lorentzian, and quantify the resulting bias in corner-frequency calibration.

physics/optics|ode.title: Trapped bead in a Maxwell viscoelastic fluid: PSD and MSD plateau
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate coupled Langevin equations for a bead and an auxiliary polymer-stress variable that represents a Maxwell fluid. Compute the MSD plateau, the PSD, and the fluid relaxation time and modulus recovered by fitting.

physics/optics|ode.title: Force-clamp optical tweezers with PI feedback on trap position
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the overdamped Langevin equation for a bead tethered to a molecule while a PI controller steers the trap position to hold the force constant. Compute the force-noise spectrum, the closed-loop bandwidth and the stability limits on gain.

physics/optics|ode.title: Jarzynski equality for a bead in a dragged optical trap
physics/optics|ode.gist: Simulate overdamped Langevin trajectories under a trap translated at constant speed, and accumulate the work done on each trajectory. Compute the work distribution, check the Jarzynski and Crooks relations, and measure the convergence bias versus sample size.

physics/optics|ode.title: Mirrorless backward-wave OPO threshold as a two-point BVP
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve the coupled-wave equations with a forward signal and a backward idler in a sub-micron-poled crystal, applying boundary conditions at opposite faces. Compute the threshold gain-length product (π/2 in the undepleted limit), the above-threshold conversion, and the narrow idler linewidth.

physics/optics|ode.title: Temperature-tuned PPLN OPO: signal-idler tuning curve and gain bandwidth
physics/optics|ode.gist: Root-find quasi-phase-matching with a temperature-dependent Sellmeier equation to obtain signal and idler wavelengths versus temperature. Integrate the coupled ODEs to obtain the single-pass parametric gain bandwidth at each operating point.

physics/optics|ode.title: Mie scattering from a radially anisotropic (radially uniaxial) sphere
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the radial ODEs for TE and TM Debye potentials inside a sphere with distinct radial and tangential permittivity; the TM case gives fractional-order Bessel solutions. Match these to Riccati-Bessel exterior solutions and compute extinction, scattering and backscatter efficiencies.

physics/optics|ode.title: Quasistatic plasmon resonance of a radially graded metal-dielectric nanoshell
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve the radial Laplace ODE for the l=1 potential in a sphere with a continuously graded Drude-dielectric permittivity profile. Extract the effective polarizability and the absorption and scattering cross sections, and track the dipole resonance shift versus gradient width.

physics/optics|ode.title: Voltage-tunable liquid-crystal-clad slab waveguide
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve the nematic director BVP across the cladding under applied voltage, map the director to an anisotropic index profile, then shoot for the TM modes of the slab. Compute the effective-index tuning versus voltage and the threshold set by the Freedericksz transition.

physics/optics|ode.title: Matched laser guiding in a preformed plasma channel with non-parabolic density
physics/optics|ode.gist: Shoot the radial Helmholtz eigenproblem for the fundamental mode of a hydrodynamically formed plasma channel with a quartic or real-shaped density profile. Compute the matched spot size, the mode leakage, and the deviation from the parabolic-channel prediction.

physics/optics|ode.title: Group delay and dispersion of a biconical fiber taper from local modes
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve the step-index LP01 eigenvalue at each axial position of a taper with a prescribed radius profile r(z). Integrate the local β1(z) and β2(z) along z as an ODE to get the total group delay and accumulated GDD versus waist diameter.

physics/optics|ode.title: XPM-induced probe frequency shift from a walking-off pump pulse
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the moment ODEs for probe center frequency and delay under cross-phase modulation from a Gaussian pump with group-velocity mismatch and GVD. Compute the net spectral shift versus initial delay and walk-off length.

physics/optics|ode.title: Eaton lens: 180-degree retroreflection by ray-equation integration
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate Hamiltonian ray equations in the spherically symmetric Eaton-lens index n(r)=sqrt(2a/r−1). Verify retroreflection for all impact parameters and quantify the angular error versus integrator tolerance near the singular center.

physics/optics|ode.title: Mikaelian sech-profile GRIN slab: isochronous self-focusing of meridional rays
physics/optics|ode.gist: Trace rays in a slab with n(x)=n0 sech(αx). Verify that all rays share the same spatial period, unlike a truncated parabolic profile, and compute the residual focal spread when the profile is perturbed.

physics/optics|ode.title: Laser ray refraction in a linear plasma density ramp and turning point
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate rays obliquely incident on a plasma with density rising linearly toward critical density. Verify the turning density n_c cos²θ, and compute the exit angle and the path-integrated inverse-bremsstrahlung absorption versus incidence angle.

physics/optics|ode.title: Shadowgraph caustics behind a weak spherical blast wave
physics/optics|ode.gist: Trace a collimated bundle of rays through the refractive-index field of a Gaussian-smoothed spherical density shell (Gladstone–Dale). Bin the ray landing positions on a screen to get the shadowgraph intensity and locate the caustic rings.

physics/optics|ode.title: Time-domain plasmon ringing of a gold nanosphere under a femtosecond pulse
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the Drude–Lorentz polarization ODEs of a quasistatic gold sphere driven by a Gaussian pulse. Extract the dipole ringing, the dephasing time, and the Fourier-domain extinction, and compare with the frequency-domain resonance.

physics/optics|ode.title: Photopolymer holographic grating formation: diffusion-driven polymerization model
physics/optics|ode.gist: Expand monomer and polymer concentrations in Fourier harmonics of the recording fringe and integrate the coupled ODEs. Compute the refractive-index modulation and Kogelnik diffraction efficiency versus exposure time and the ratio of diffusion to polymerization rate.

physics/optics|ode.title: Azzam differential Mueller matrix for depth-varying anisotropic media
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate dM/dz = m(z)M for a medium whose linear birefringence axis, circular birefringence and depolarization vary with depth. Compare the result with a discrete Mueller product and compute the output Stokes trajectory on the Poincaré sphere.
physics/optics|ode.area: Polarization optics with Jones and Mueller calculus

physics/optics|ode.title: Surface-stabilized ferroelectric liquid-crystal switching and transmission
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the azimuthal director ODE γφ' = −PsE sinφ for a surface-stabilized FLC cell after a voltage step. Compute the optical transmission between crossed polarizers versus time and the switching time versus field.
physics/optics|ode.area: Polarization optics with Jones and Mueller calculus

physics/optics|ode.title: Single-photon transport through a waveguide-coupled two-level emitter
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the driven-dissipative master equation for a chirally or symmetrically coupled emitter. Compute transmission and reflection versus detuning and the g2(0) of transmitted and reflected light versus β-factor.

physics/optics|ode.title: Two-photon-driven dissipative cavity: steady-state cat states
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the Fock-truncated master equation for a cavity with two-photon drive, two-photon loss and single-photon loss. Compute the steady-state Wigner function, parity and cat size versus drive strength and loss ratio.

physics/optics|ode.title: Single-photon absorption probability by a two-level atom versus pulse shape
