physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the excitation amplitude ODE of an atom driven by a single-photon wavepacket in a 1D or partially coupled mode. Compare rising-exponential, decaying-exponential and Gaussian pulses and optimize bandwidth for maximal absorption.

physics/optics|ode.title: Apodized grating coupler for a Gaussian out-coupled beam via the leakage ODE
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve dP/dz = −2α(z)P inversely to obtain a leakage-rate profile α(z) that produces a Gaussian emitted intensity. Map α to etch depth or fill factor and compute the fiber mode-overlap efficiency.
physics/optics|ode.area: Scalar grating and diffractive element design

physics/optics|ode.title: Raman fiber laser with FBG cavity: output power as a two-point BVP
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve the coupled pump and forward/backward Stokes power ODEs with FBG reflectivities as boundary conditions using shooting. Compute output power and slope efficiency versus output-coupler reflectivity and fiber length.

physics/optics|ode.title: High-gain 1D free-electron laser: exponential growth and saturation
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the Colson–Bonifacio coupled electron-phase and field ODEs in universal scaled units. Extract the exponential gain length, the saturation length and the saturated power relative to the FEL parameter ρ.

physics/optics|ode.title: Ikeda delay-differential equation: period-doubling in a nonlinear ring cavity
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the Ikeda DDE for a ring cavity containing a Kerr medium with finite response time. Build the bifurcation diagram of output intensity versus input power and identify period-2^n and chaotic regimes.

physics/optics|ode.title: Optical refrigeration of Yb:YLF by anti-Stokes fluorescence
physics/optics|ode.gist: Combine the cooling efficiency η = λ/λ_f·η_ext·η_abs − 1 with a temperature ODE that includes the background absorption and the radiative load. Compute the minimum achievable temperature and the cooling transient versus pump wavelength.

physics/optics|ode.title: Photon avalanche in Tm-doped crystals: rate-equation threshold and nonlinearity
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate three-level rate equations with weak ground-state absorption, strong excited-state absorption and cross-relaxation. Locate the avalanche threshold, the slowing-down of rise time and the extreme power-law slope.

physics/optics|ode.title: Yb–Er upconversion nanoparticle: green/red emission power-law slopes
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the coupled Yb–Er energy-transfer rate equations to steady state versus 980 nm intensity. Extract the log-log slopes of green and red emission and their saturation-induced reduction from 2.

physics/optics|ode.title: Variable stripe length method: optical gain from ASE growth
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate dI/dz = (g−α)I + βN_sp along a pumped stripe with gain saturation to get ASE intensity versus stripe length. Fit the small-signal regime to recover net gain and quantify the bias that saturation introduces.

physics/optics|ode.title: Reverse saturable absorption optical limiter: five-level rate model
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the singlet–triplet five-level population ODEs coupled to fluence propagation through a thick sample for nanosecond pulses. Compute nonlinear transmission versus input fluence and the limiting threshold.

physics/optics|ode.title: Femtosecond laser damage threshold from multiphoton and avalanche ionization
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the Stuart-type rate equation for conduction-band electron density in fused silica during a Gaussian pulse. Find the fluence at which the critical plasma density is reached versus pulse duration.

physics/optics|ode.title: Orientation dynamics of an elongated Rayleigh particle in a linearly polarized trap
physics/optics|ode.gist: Use the anisotropic polarizability of a prolate spheroid to compute the optical torque. Integrate the overdamped rotational Langevin or deterministic ODE to get the alignment time and the angular distribution versus power.

physics/optics|ode.title: Relativistic laser-driven light sail acceleration with Doppler-reduced thrust
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the relativistic equations of motion of a reflective sail pushed by a ground laser, including Doppler redshift, finite beam size and wavelength-dependent reflectivity. Compute the final velocity and acceleration distance versus sail areal density.

physics/optics|ode.title: Evanescent-wave atom mirror with van der Waals attraction
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate classical atom trajectories in the blue-detuned evanescent dipole potential plus the −C3/z³ surface attraction. Compute the minimum laser intensity for reflection versus incidence velocity and the turning-point distance.

physics/optics|ode.title: Freeform reflector for uniform illuminance from a Lambertian LED
physics/optics|ode.gist: Derive and integrate the ray-mapping ODE for a rotationally symmetric reflector profile that maps a Lambertian source to uniform target irradiance. Verify the result by Monte Carlo ray tracing.

physics/optics|ode.title: Electrowetting liquid lens: Young–Laplace meniscus shape and focal length
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the axisymmetric Young–Laplace ODE with gravity for the oil–water meniscus at voltage-dependent contact angles. Compute paraxial focal power and spherical aberration of the meniscus by ray tracing.

physics/optics|ode.title: SPP nanofocusing along a tapered gold wire via WKB
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve the local TM0 wire-plasmon dispersion at each radius. Integrate the WKB phase and amplitude ODEs along a conical taper to get field enhancement at the tip versus taper angle, including absorption.

physics/optics|ode.title: SNAP bottle microresonator axial modes via Numerov
physics/optics|ode.gist: Map a nanoscale fiber-radius variation Δr(z) to an effective 1D Schrödinger equation for the axial whispering-gallery field. Compute the axial eigenmodes and resonance spacing by Numerov shooting for parabolic and box profiles.

physics/optics|ode.title: Lasing without inversion in a V-type three-level system
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate density-matrix ODEs of a V atom with incoherent pumping and a coherent drive to steady state. Compute probe gain versus detuning and show gain without population inversion in the bare basis.

physics/optics|ode.title: Optical Ramsey fringes with finite pulses and decoherence
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate optical Bloch equations for two separated π/2 pulses on a two-level atom with dephasing. Compute fringe contrast and central-fringe linewidth versus free-evolution time and pulse duration.

physics/optics|ode.title: Rydberg blockade of two atoms: collective √2 Rabi enhancement
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the four-level Schrödinger equation for two atoms laser-driven to a Rydberg state with van der Waals interaction V. Compute the double-excitation probability and the effective Rabi frequency versus V/Ω.

physics/optics|ode.title: Nonlinear 1D laser wakefield amplitude versus pulse length
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the 1D quasistatic cold-fluid ODE for the wake potential driven by a laser pulse envelope. Compute the peak wake electric field versus pulse length and a0, and show wave steepening at high intensity.

physics/optics|ode.title: Fluorescence correlation spectroscopy with triplet blinking
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the three-state singlet–triplet rate equations to obtain the blinking correlation. Combine it with 3D Gaussian diffusion to compute G(τ) and the triplet fraction versus excitation intensity.

physics/optics|ode.title: Vegetation canopy two-stream reflectance versus leaf area index
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve the two-stream (Kubelka–Munk–type) BVP for upward and downward fluxes in a leaf canopy over soil. Compute canopy reflectance in red and NIR and the NDVI saturation with leaf area index.

physics/optics|ode.title: Klett elastic lidar inversion of aerosol extinction
physics/optics|ode.gist: Simulate a range-corrected lidar signal from a known extinction profile. Invert it by solving the Bernoulli ODE backward from a far-range boundary, and assess sensitivity to the lidar ratio and the boundary value.

physics/optics|ode.title: Photobleaching front propagation in a thick absorbing dye film
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the coupled Beer–Lambert intensity ODE and the photobleaching concentration ODE over depth and time. Compute the bleaching front velocity and the transmission transient versus quantum yield.

physics/optics|ode.title: Varactor-loaded split-ring resonator: nonlinear response and bistability
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the nonlinear circuit ODE of an SRR with a voltage-dependent capacitance under plane-wave drive. Compute the frequency-response hysteresis, the bistable window and the effective nonlinear permeability.

physics/optics|ode.title: Magnetoinductive wave pulses along a split-ring resonator chain
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the coupled LC circuit ODEs for a chain of mutually coupled SRRs excited at one end. Extract the dispersion relation, group velocity and attenuation, and compare with analytic magnetoinductive theory.

physics/optics|ode.title: CO2–N2 TEA laser vibrational kinetics and pulse output
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate rate equations for the CO2 asymmetric-stretch, lower-laser and N2 vibrational populations coupled to the cavity photon number. Compute the gain-switched spike and the nitrogen-tail pulse shape versus gas mix.

physics/optics|ode.title: Aero-optical aberration from a heated air jet: ray OPD and Zernike content
physics/optics|ode.gist: Trace rays through the Gladstone–Dale index field of an axisymmetric Gaussian temperature jet. Fit the resulting optical path difference over a circular aperture to Zernike modes and estimate the Strehl ratio.

physics/optics|ode.title: Invariant-imbedding T-matrix of a dielectric spheroid
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the matrix Riccati ODE in radial coordinate for the T-matrix of a nonspherical dielectric particle, truncated at small multipole order. Compute orientation-averaged extinction and check the sphere limit against Mie theory.

physics/optics|ode.title: Controlled reversible inhomogeneous broadening echo memory efficiency
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the Maxwell–Bloch equations for an ensemble with a reversible frequency gradient absorbing and later re-emitting a probe pulse. Compute retrieval efficiency versus optical depth and compare forward and backward recall.

physics/optics|ode.title: Heat-and-pull fiber taper profile from volume conservation ODE
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the Birks–Li ODE relating waist radius to elongation for a hot zone that varies during pulling. Compute the taper profile and check the adiabaticity criterion against the LP01–LP02 beat length.

physics/optics|ode.title: Ion-exchanged waveguide fabrication: concentration-dependent diffusion and mode count
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve the Boltzmann-transformed nonlinear diffusion ODE for Ag+/Na+ exchange with an interdiffusion coefficient depending on concentration. Map concentration to index and solve slab modes to count guided modes versus diffusion time.

physics/optics|ode.title: Evaporative cooling in a dipole trap by power ramping: scaling-law ODEs
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate coupled ODEs for atom number and temperature under a prescribed trap-power ramp, with truncation parameter η and background losses. Compute phase-space density versus final power and the onset of runaway evaporation.

physics/optics|ode.title: Laser-focused atomic deposition: standing-wave atom lens nanostructures
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate classical Cr atom trajectories through a Gaussian-envelope standing-wave dipole potential. Histogram the deposition positions to get feature linewidth and contrast versus laser power and atomic beam divergence.

physics/optics|ode.title: Temporal photonic crystal: momentum band gap from the Mathieu equation
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the field ODE for a medium whose permittivity is periodically modulated in time. Compute the Floquet exponents and momentum gaps versus modulation depth, and the parametric amplification inside the gap.

physics/optics|ode.title: Supersymmetric waveguide partner: removing the fundamental mode
physics/optics|ode.gist: Compute the fundamental mode of a slab index profile by shooting and construct the SUSY partner profile via the superpotential. Verify by shooting that the remaining propagation constants are identical.

physics/optics|ode.title: Unidirectional invisibility of a PT-symmetric Bragg grating
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the coupled-mode ODEs for a grating with balanced index and gain/loss modulation. Compute left and right reflectance and transmission phase, and show unidirectional reflectionlessness at the PT-breaking point.

physics/optics|ode.title: Bad-cavity superradiant laser linewidth from second-order cumulant ODEs
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate cumulant-expansion ODEs for N incoherently pumped atoms in a bad cavity. Compute output photon number versus repumping rate, the lasing window, and the sub-natural linewidth.

physics/optics|ode.title: Exciton-polariton condensation threshold from reservoir rate equations
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the coupled reservoir density and condensate occupation ODEs with stimulated scattering under CW and pulsed pumping. Compute the condensation threshold, the output nonlinearity and the blueshift.

physics/optics|ode.title: Diode-pumped alkali laser: three-level rate equations with collisional mixing
physics/optics|ode.gist: Solve the steady-state rate equations for a Cs or Rb DPAL, with pump D2 absorption, fine-structure mixing and cavity extraction, along the cell length. Compute output power versus pump power and buffer-gas mixing rate.

physics/optics|ode.title: Plasmon-induced transparency: coupled bright–dark oscillator model
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate two coupled damped Lorentz oscillators, with only the bright one driven, to obtain extinction spectra. Map the transparency window width and depth versus coupling and dark-mode damping.

physics/optics|ode.title: Nonlinear optical loop mirror: power-dependent switching of pulses
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the counterpropagating SPM and GVD propagation in the loop using an asymmetric coupler. Compute the switching transfer function for CW and sech pulses and the pulse-shaping effect.

physics/optics|ode.title: Interband photonic transition isolator in a spatiotemporally modulated waveguide
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the coupled-mode ODEs for even and odd modes under travelling index modulation. Show complete forward conversion with no backward conversion, and compute the isolation bandwidth.

physics/optics|ode.title: Adiabatic wavelength conversion of light trapped in a dynamically tuned microring
physics/optics|ode.gist: Integrate the temporal coupled-mode equation for a ring whose resonance is tuned during the photon lifetime. Compute the output spectrum and conversion efficiency versus tuning speed and Q.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Generalized Brillouin zone of the non-reciprocal SSH chain
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: For the non-reciprocal SSH model, solve the characteristic polynomial det[H(β)-E]=0 for β on an energy grid. Build the non-Bloch GBZ from the condition |β_M|=|β_{M+1}| and verify that the resulting continuum bands and the non-Bloch topological transition match finite OBC diagonalization.
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Non-Hermitian band theory and skin effect

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Skin-mode localization length and directional IPR in non-reciprocal chains
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize OBC Hatano-Nelson and non-reciprocal SSH chains. Compute the summed eigenstate density profile, inverse participation ratios, and skin depth from least-squares fits of log|ψ|, and compare the fitted depth with the analytic value 1/ln|β|.
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Non-Hermitian band theory and skin effect

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Hatano-Nelson delocalization transition with on-site Anderson disorder
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize disordered Hatano-Nelson rings over many realizations. Track the fraction of complex eigenvalues and the mobility edge versus non-reciprocity g, and compare with the Lyapunov exponent computed from transfer-matrix products with QR re-orthogonalization.
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Non-Hermitian band theory and skin effect

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Biorthogonal polarization and edge states of non-Hermitian SSH
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Compute the biorthogonal polarization P = 1 − lim (1/N) ⟨ψ_L|Σ n Π_n|ψ_R⟩ from left and right zero-mode eigenvectors of the OBC non-reciprocal SSH chain. Map its jump against the transition predicted by the non-Bloch winding number.
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Non-Hermitian band theory and skin effect

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Corner skin effect in a 2D non-reciprocal square lattice
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Build a 2D lattice with non-reciprocal hoppings along x and y under full OBC, cylinder, and torus boundaries. Diagonalize each, compute corner-weight densities and the 2D spectral area versus boundary conditions, and show eigenstates accumulate at one corner.
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Non-Hermitian band theory and skin effect

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Mode Grüneisen parameters of fcc Lennard-Jones crystal across the Brillouin zone
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Build the dynamical matrix of an fcc Lennard-Jones solid with all neighbors within a cutoff at two nearby volumes. Diagonalize along high-symmetry paths and compute γ_qs = −dlnω/dlnV by finite differences, plus the heat-capacity-weighted average Grüneisen parameter versus T.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: QHA lattice constant and bulk modulus of solid argon versus temperature
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Compute the quasi-harmonic free energy F(V,T) of fcc Lennard-Jones argon with Monkhorst-Pack phonon sums, then fit F(V) at each T to a Birch-Murnaghan form. Extract a(T), B_T(T), and α(T), and compare zero-point expansion with the classical limit.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Negative thermal expansion from tension-softened transverse modes in a chain
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Model a chain of masses with longitudinal springs whose transverse modes are restored by tension. Compute the dynamical matrix at varying length, show that transverse mode Grüneisen parameters are negative, and obtain the crossover temperature where the QHA thermal expansion changes sign.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Flexural phonons and negative thermal expansion of a honeycomb membrane
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Use a valence-force-field honeycomb lattice with bond-stretching and out-of-plane bending terms. Diagonalize the dynamical matrix at strained lattice constants to get mode Grüneisen parameters (negative for ZA), and integrate them over the BZ to obtain the in-plane α(T).

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Grüneisen relation check: α = γC_V/(B_T V) in a diatomic crystal
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: For a 3D NaCl-type spring model with volume-dependent force constants, compute phonon spectra on a k-grid. Evaluate mode heat capacities and Grüneisen parameters, and verify the thermodynamic Grüneisen relation against α obtained from direct free-energy minimization.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Isotope effect on zero-point lattice volume via quasi-harmonic free energy
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Compute T=0 quasi-harmonic lattice constants for a Lennard-Jones or Morse fcc crystal with different isotope masses (e.g., ²⁰Ne vs ²²Ne). The method minimizes static energy plus zero-point phonon energy from BZ-sampled dynamical-matrix eigenvalues, giving the isotope-induced volume difference.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Quasi-harmonic temperature shift of zone-center optical phonon frequency
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Combine QHA-minimized V(T) of a diatomic 3D spring crystal with Γ-point dynamical-matrix diagonalization to predict the temperature-dependent optical (Raman) frequency shift. Compare the shift with the linear estimate Δω/ω = −γ ΔV/V.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Synthetic antiferromagnet acoustic and optical resonance modes
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Model two macrospins coupled by interlayer exchange under an in-plane field. Find the canted equilibrium by energy minimization, linearize the coupled LLG equations into a 4×4 matrix, and compute acoustic and optical mode frequencies versus field, including the spin-flop transition.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Linear spin-wave theory of a Heisenberg antiferromagnet by Colpa diagonalization
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Build the Holstein-Primakoff bosonic Hamiltonian for a 1D or square-lattice Néel antiferromagnet with easy-axis anisotropy. Perform paraunitary Bogoliubov diagonalization via Cholesky (Colpa's method), and obtain magnon dispersions, anisotropy gap, and the zero-point sublattice magnetization reduction.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: FMR linewidth extraction from damped LLG time integration
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Integrate the full nonlinear LLG for a thin-film macrospin with RK4 after a small field kick. Fit the transverse magnetization ringdown to a damped sinusoid by least squares, and verify the Gilbert linewidth relation ΔH = 2αω/γ over several α.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Chiral helimagnet period from exchange-DMI energy minimization
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Minimize the discretized energy of a classical spin chain with exchange, bulk DMI, and Zeeman field using gradient-based relaxation. Extract the helix wavevector q = D/(2A) at zero field and the critical field for unwinding into the ferromagnetic state.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: SSH Zak phase via discretized Wilson loop of overlap matrices
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the 2×2 SSH Bloch Hamiltonian on a k-grid and form the gauge-invariant product of overlaps ⟨u_k|u_{k+δk}⟩. Compute the Zak phase in both dimerization phases, and show its dependence on unit-cell choice and inversion center.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Real-space winding number and topological Anderson insulator in disordered SSH
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Compute the disorder-averaged real-space winding number ν = Tr'(Γ Q [Q,X]) from the flat-band projector of chiral-disordered SSH chains. Map ν versus hopping disorder strength, showing a disorder-induced topological phase.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Extended SSH with long-range hopping: higher winding numbers
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Add third-neighbor intercell hopping to SSH and compute the winding number of the off-diagonal h(k) via a discretized argument integral. Verify the count of zero-energy edge modes in finite open chains for phases with winding 0, 1, and 2.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Resta many-body polarization of a disordered ionic Rice-Mele ring
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Compute the Resta polarization P = (1/2π) Im ln det(U) from the occupied-orbital matrix of exp(i2πx/L) for finite Rice-Mele rings with on-site disorder. Compare with the Zak-phase result for the clean system, and study the convergence with L.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Maximally localized Wannier function of an SSH band and spread
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Construct the Wannier function of the lower SSH band by fixing a smooth gauge via parallel transport plus Wilson-loop phase correction. Compute its center, spread Ω, and the gauge-invariant spread Ω_I from overlap matrices, showing how the spread grows near the gap closing.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Creutz ladder flat bands, Aharonov-Bohm caging, and edge states
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the Creutz ladder Hamiltonian with flux-threaded diagonal hoppings. Obtain the flat bands at π flux and the compact localized states, compute the winding number from the chiral off-diagonal block, and verify zero-energy end states in open ladders.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Wolff cluster Monte Carlo of 3D Heisenberg model with Rodrigues reflections
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Implement Wolff single-cluster updates for the classical O(3) Heisenberg model on a simple-cubic lattice, using random-plane reflection matrices. Compute magnetization, Binder cumulant crossings near T_c ≈ 1.443J, and integrated autocorrelation times versus Metropolis.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Classical Heisenberg chain: exact transfer-integral spectrum versus Monte Carlo
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the transfer-integral operator of the classical Heisenberg chain in a spherical-harmonic basis, including a field, to get the free energy and correlation function. Compare with Metropolis estimates and Fisher's exact result u = coth K − 1/K.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Harper equation and Hofstadter butterfly at rational flux p/q
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Build the q×q magnetic Bloch Hamiltonian of the square-lattice Harper model in Landau gauge for all coprime p/q with q≤Q. Diagonalize on a magnetic-BZ grid to assemble the butterfly and compute the bandwidths and gap widths versus flux.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Hofstadter band Chern numbers and the TKNN Diophantine equation
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Compute the Chern number of each Hofstadter subband at flux p/q using Fukui-Hatsugai link variables on the magnetic BZ, with care for degeneracies. Verify that the cumulative Hall conductance in each gap satisfies r = q·s_r + p·t_r.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Landau fan of a finite square lattice with Peierls phases
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize finite open square lattices with Peierls-substituted hoppings over a field sweep to build the Landau fan. Compare low-energy levels with E_n = −4t + ħω_c(n+½) using effective mass, and identify where lattice effects break the fan.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Kubo-formula Hall conductance of the Hofstadter model versus filling
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Evaluate the TKNN/Kubo Hall conductivity from velocity-operator matrix elements between magnetic Bloch eigenstates, summed over occupied states on a k-grid. Plot σ_xy versus Fermi energy, showing quantized plateaus inside gaps at flux 1/q.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Bott index of a disordered finite Hofstadter flake
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Compute the Bott index from the projector onto states below the Fermi energy and the unitary position matrices exp(2πiX/L), exp(2πiY/L) via matrix logarithms of the eigenvalues. Track the index's breakdown as Anderson disorder closes the mobility gap.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Kane-Mele helical edge states and spin Chern number
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Build the Kane-Mele model with intrinsic spin-orbit and Rashba coupling. Compute the spin Chern number from spin-resolved projectors when Rashba is weak, and diagonalize zigzag ribbons to show helical edge crossings and the Rashba-driven transition.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Electron-hole asymmetry from next-nearest-neighbor hopping in graphene
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Include NNN hopping t' in the honeycomb Hamiltonian and compute the shifted Dirac point energy, the band asymmetry along Γ-K-M, and the DOS asymmetry. Fit t and t' to synthetic band-energy data at high-symmetry points by linear least squares.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Infrared intensities of a polyatomic molecule from Born charges and normal modes
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the mass-weighted Hessian of a small molecule (e.g., H₂O or CO₂ with a given force field) to obtain normal modes. Compute IR intensities from Born-charge tensors contracted with eigenvectors, and assemble a Lorentzian-broadened absorption spectrum.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Multi-oscillator dielectric function, reststrahlen band and reflectivity
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Compute TO mode frequencies and oscillator strengths from dynamical-matrix eigenvectors and Born charges of a two-mode polar crystal. Build ε(ω) = ε∞ + Σ S_m ω_m²/(ω_m²−ω²−iγω), find LO frequencies from its zeros, verify the generalized LST product, and compute normal-incidence reflectivity.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Orientationally averaged Raman activities from polarizability derivative tensors
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Project given Cartesian polarizability derivatives onto mass-weighted normal-mode eigenvectors of a molecule. Compute isotropic and anisotropic invariants a² and γ², Raman activities 45a²+7γ², and depolarization ratios, then simulate the Lorentzian Raman spectrum.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Phonon-polariton dispersion of a polar crystal as eigenvalue problem
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Couple a TO phonon oscillator to transverse photons and cast the coupled Maxwell–lattice equations as a polynomial eigenproblem in ω for each k via a companion-matrix linearization. Obtain the upper and lower polariton branches, the gap between ω_TO and ω_LO, and the photon-phonon mixing fractions.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Symmetry classification of molecular vibrations by projection operators
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Build the 3N-dimensional representation matrices of a point group (e.g., C₂v for H₂O or D₃h for BF₃) acting on Cartesian displacements. Compute characters, decompose into irreps, remove translations and rotations, and apply projection operators to identify IR- and Raman-active normal modes.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Raman line broadening in isotopically disordered diatomic chains
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize large diatomic chains with random isotope mass substitution. Compute the q≈0 projected vibrational spectral function as an optical-phonon Raman line shape, and quantify frequency shift and width versus isotope concentration against the virtual-crystal approximation.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Two-phonon density of states and second-order Raman spectrum
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the dynamical matrix of a 2D or 3D spring crystal on a fine k-grid. Compute the overtone (ω_s(q)+ω_s(−q)) and combination two-phonon densities of states with Gaussian broadening, and identify van Hove features of the second-order Raman spectrum.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Group velocity and power-flow angle in hexagonal crystals
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Solve the Christoffel equation for a transversely isotropic crystal (e.g., Zn or Ti) versus angle from the c-axis. Compute group velocity vectors from eigenvector derivatives v_g,j = C_ijkl p_i p_k n_l/(ρv), the power-flow deviation angle, and cusps in the quasi-transverse wavefront.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Born mechanical stability under pressure from Voigt matrix eigenvalues
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Construct the 6×6 Voigt stiffness matrix including pressure-corrected (Wallace/Birch) coefficients for cubic or tetragonal crystals. Compute its eigenvalues versus pressure to find the critical pressure where generalized Born stability fails, and identify the soft eigen-strain mode.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Directional Young's modulus via Bond-matrix rotation of stiffness tensors
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Rotate a cubic or orthorhombic stiffness tensor with 6×6 Bond transformation matrices, and invert it to compliances. Compute directional Young's modulus and Poisson ratio surfaces, the Zener anisotropy ratio, and the universal anisotropy index.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Metal-insulator coexistence region Uc1 and Uc2 from hysteretic IPT-DMFT sweeps
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Sweep U upward from a metallic seed and downward from an insulating seed in Bethe-lattice IPT at several temperatures. Detect the jump in -ImG(iω_0) to map the spinodal lines Uc1(T) and Uc2(T) of the first-order Mott transition.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Two-site DMFT (Potthoff): minimal ED estimate of the critical Uc
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Use a single impurity site coupled to one bath site and fix the bath hopping by the low-energy self-consistency V² = Z t². Diagonalize the two-site Anderson model to get Z(U) and the linearized estimate of Uc ≈ 6t. Compare with the IPT result.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Hubbard-I approximation Mott gap on the Bethe lattice
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Combine the atomic-limit self-energy of the Hubbard model with the semicircular lattice Green's function to obtain the real-frequency spectral function. Compute the Hubbard subband edges and the Mott gap as functions of U.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Double occupancy and Galitskii-Migdal energy from converged IPT Matsubara functions
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: From the converged Bethe-lattice G and Σ, evaluate the kinetic energy via t²ΣG² and the potential energy via the Galitskii-Migdal formula with tail subtraction. Obtain the double occupancy ⟨n↑n↓⟩ across the Mott transition.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Falicov-Kimball model DMFT on the Bethe lattice: exact Mott transition
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Iterate the exactly solvable impurity problem G = w1/(G0^-1 - U) + (1 - w1)G0 with the Bethe self-consistency. Compute the real-frequency DOS and the critical U at which the gap opens.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Rashba-Dresselhaus 2DEG band splitting and Fermi-contour spin texture
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the 2×2 Hamiltonian H = ħ²k²/2m + α(σx ky - σy kx) + β(σx kx - σy ky) on polar k-grids. Compute the anisotropic splitting, the Fermi contours, and the spin expectation angle versus k direction for varying α/β.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Persistent spin helix at α=β: shifted Fermi contours and precession length
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Verify numerically that for α=β the two spin-split contours are rigid translations by Q = 4mα/ħ². Propagate the spin of electrons along different directions to show that the precession is direction-independent, with helix wavelength 2π/Q.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Rashba Landau levels with Zeeman coupling by truncated oscillator-basis diagonalization
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Write the Rashba Hamiltonian in a magnetic field with ladder operators and diagonalize in a truncated Landau-level ⊗ spin basis. Compare with the analytic Bychkov-Rashba levels and find the level-crossing fields.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Anomalous Hall conductivity of a magnetized Rashba square-lattice model
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize a tight-binding Rashba model with exchange field M σz on a BZ grid. Compute the Berry curvature from Kubo eigenvector sums and integrate the occupied-band curvature to get σ_xy versus Fermi energy and M.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Cubic Dresselhaus terms breaking the persistent spin helix in quantum wells
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Add the cubic Dresselhaus term to the linear Rashba-Dresselhaus Hamiltonian. Compute the residual spin splitting along the helix direction and the renormalized optimal ratio α/β₁ that minimizes the spread of precession wavevectors on the Fermi contour.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Datta-Das spin transistor conductance via recursive Green's functions
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Model a quasi-1D Rashba wire between ferromagnetic leads with spin-polarized lead self-energies. Compute the Landauer conductance versus Rashba strength using recursive Green's functions and compare with the spin-rotation angle 2mαL/ħ².

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Shubnikov-de Haas beating in a Rashba 2DEG and frequency extraction
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Simulate the oscillatory conductivity from the two spin-split Fermi areas using a Lifshitz-Kosevich sum with Dingle damping. Fourier transform in 1/B to recover the two frequencies, then infer α and the density from them.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Extremal Fermi-surface areas of a cubic tight-binding metal versus field angle
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: For E(k) = -2t Σcos k_i at fixed filling, slice the Fermi surface perpendicular to rotating field directions and compute cross-sectional areas by polygon contour integration. Locate the extremal orbits and convert them to dHvA frequencies via the Onsager relation.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Warped quasi-2D Fermi cylinder: neck-belly beats and Yamaji angles
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Compute the k_z-dependent cross-sections of a warped cylinder E = k∥²/2m - 2t_c cos(k_z c) for tilted fields. Find the belly and neck frequencies and the angles where the warping-induced splitting vanishes (Bessel zeros), then simulate the resulting oscillations.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Onsager quantization versus exact Landau levels for a nonparabolic 2D band
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Represent E(k) = k²/2m + λk⁴ in a magnetic field using ladder operators and diagonalize in a truncated Landau basis. Compare the levels with semiclassical Onsager areas, extract the Maslov phase offset, and quantify corrections at low n.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Magnetic breakdown network: combination frequencies in coupled-orbit oscillations
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Model two Fermi-surface orbits coupled at breakdown junctions with tunneling probability exp(-B0/B). Sum all closed-orbit paths with their phases and amplitudes, Fourier analyze the resulting oscillation, and identify combination frequencies such as α+β and 2β-α.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Wigner crystal Madelung energies of sc, bcc and fcc in uniform background
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Apply Ewald summation to a one-component plasma, removing the G=0 term and adding the neutralizing-background correction. Compare Madelung energies per electron to confirm that bcc is the lowest and to reproduce the Fuchs constant.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: 2D Ewald energies of triangular and square Wigner crystals
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Use the 2D Ewald formula with a 1/G reciprocal kernel and erfc real-space terms for point charges in a plane with a neutralizing sheet. Compute the Bonsall-Maradudin energies for triangular versus square lattices.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Dipolar Ewald sums and Lorentz local-field tensors of dipole lattices
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Evaluate the Ewald-split dipole-dipole interaction tensor at lattice sites for cubic and tetragonal Bravais lattices of point dipoles. Diagonalize the local-field tensor, check the 4π/3 cubic result, and verify the trace sum rule with shape-dependent terms.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Born-Mayer lattice energies of alkali halides from Ewald plus repulsion
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Combine Ewald Madelung energies with nearest-neighbor Born-Mayer repulsion. Minimize with respect to the lattice constant, fit the repulsive parameters to experimental a₀ and bulk modulus, and compare lattice energies with Born-Haber values.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Site Madelung potentials and ionic site energies in layered perovskites
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Use Ewald summation to compute electrostatic potentials at inequivalent sites of an ABO3 perovskite and a Ruddlesden-Popper A2BO4 structure. Compare the apical and planar oxygen potentials and their dependence on formal charges.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Demagnetizing tensor of a rectangular prism from Newell-Aharoni formulas
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Evaluate the analytic demagnetizing-factor expressions for rectangular prisms of varying aspect ratios. Verify that the trace equals 1, compare with ellipsoid limits, and compute the shape anisotropy energy.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Collective spin-wave modes of a dipole-coupled nanomagnet array
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Linearize LLG for a finite 1D or 2D array of macrospins coupled by point-dipole interactions about the ground state. Diagonalize the resulting non-Hermitian linear-response matrix to obtain mode frequencies and profiles versus lattice spacing and field.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Néel-Brown thermal switching times from stochastic LLG of a macrospin
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Integrate stochastic LLG with Heun's method and a fluctuation-dissipation-consistent thermal field. Measure mean switching times versus barrier KV/kT and fit the Arrhenius law to compare with the Brown prefactor.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Exchange-spring hard/soft bilayer hysteresis by discretized energy minimization
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Discretize a 1D hard/soft magnetic bilayer with layer-dependent anisotropy and exchange. Minimize the energy versus field using a quasi-Newton or Hessian method to trace the reversible exchange-spring regime and the irreversible switching field.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Magnetocrystalline anisotropy energy from spin-orbit tight-binding band energies
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Build a d-orbital tight-binding model with on-site ξL·S spin-orbit coupling for magnetization along different axes. Diagonalize on k-grids and sum the occupied band energies to obtain the anisotropy energy, then compare with second-order perturbation theory.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Ammann-Beenker tiling tight-binding spectrum via cut-and-project
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Generate an octagonal Ammann-Beenker patch by projecting Z⁴ points through an acceptance window, then build the vertex hopping Hamiltonian. Compute the DOS and the fraction of degenerate E=0 confined states.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Anomalous wave-packet diffusion exponent on the Fibonacci chain
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Propagate an initially localized state on a Fibonacci hopping chain by exact diagonalization. Fit the mean-square displacement ⟨x²⟩ ~ t^{2β} and relate β to the spectral and wavefunction fractal dimensions.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Transmission spectra of Fibonacci versus Thue-Morse chains by transfer matrices
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Embed finite substitution-sequence chains between periodic leads and compute the transmission T(E) from 2×2 transfer matrices. Compare the self-similar Fibonacci spectrum with the perfect-transmission states of Thue-Morse chains.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Phonon spectrum of a Fibonacci mass chain and vibrational localization
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the dynamical matrix of a harmonic chain with two masses arranged in Fibonacci order. Compute the integrated phonon DOS, its gap structure, and the mode participation ratios versus frequency.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Non-Hermitian Chern insulator: biorthogonal Chern number and anomalous edge spectra
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Add non-reciprocal or imaginary terms to a two-band Qi-Wu-Zhang model. Compute the biorthogonal Chern number from left and right eigenvectors with Fukui link variables, and compare it with open-boundary edge spectra that show the breakdown of conventional bulk-edge correspondence.
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Non-Hermitian band theory and skin effect

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Liouvillian damping matrix and skin effect of a dissipative fermion chain
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: For a tight-binding chain with Lindblad gain/loss jump operators, build the single-particle damping matrix X governing correlation dynamics. Diagonalize it under periodic and open boundaries to reveal the Liouvillian skin effect and size-dependent relaxation gaps.
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Non-Hermitian band theory and skin effect

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Non-Hermitian Aubry-André: coincident PT breaking, localization and winding
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the quasiperiodic chain with complex phase potential V cos(2πβn + ih). Track the fraction of complex eigenvalues, the IPR, and the spectral winding number versus V, and confirm the transition at V = 2t e^{-h}.
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Non-Hermitian band theory and skin effect

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Critical skin effect in coupled opposite-asymmetry Hatano-Nelson chains
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Weakly couple two Hatano-Nelson chains with opposite non-reciprocity. Diagonalize open systems of increasing size to show the size-dependent spectral transition, and extract the crossover length from the GBZ and the eigenstate localization.
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Non-Hermitian band theory and skin effect

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Z2 skin effect in a reciprocal spinful chain with symplectic symmetry
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Construct a non-Hermitian spinful chain obeying transpose time-reversal symmetry, so that the net winding vanishes. Show by open-boundary diagonalization that Kramers-paired skin modes localize at opposite ends, and compute the Z2 invariant.
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Non-Hermitian band theory and skin effect

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Quantum point contact conductance steps from recursive Green's functions
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Model a 2D square-lattice saddle or hard-wall constriction between semi-infinite leads with decimated surface Green's functions. Compute the Landauer conductance by RGF slices and the Caroli formula, showing quantized plateaus and their smoothing with constriction length.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Fano resonances in a T-shaped side-coupled quantum dot
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Attach a single level or a short chain side-coupled to a 1D tight-binding wire. Compute the transmission by Dyson equation with lead self-energies, and fit the asymmetric Fano lineshape parameter q versus dot energy.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Localization length of disordered quasi-1D wires from RGF transmission
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Compute the transmission of Anderson-disordered strips of width W and length L by recursive Green's functions. Extract the localization length from ⟨ln T⟩ ~ -2L/ξ and check the Thouless-type scaling ξ ∝ W ℓ.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Quantum interference in para- versus meta-benzene molecular junctions
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Connect a Hückel benzene ring to wide-band-limit leads at different sites and compute the transmission with the Caroli formula. Show the destructive-interference zero of the meta configuration and how it depends on site energies.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Seebeck coefficient and figure of merit from Landauer transmission integrals
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Compute the transmission of a resonant-level or double-barrier tight-binding junction. Evaluate the Landauer moment integrals L0, L1, L2 with Fermi derivatives to obtain G, S, electronic thermal conductance, and ZT versus level position.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Atomistic Green's function phonon transmission across a mass interface
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Join two semi-infinite harmonic chains or lattices with different masses and spring constants, with lead self-energies from decimation. Compute the phonon transmission spectrum and the Landauer thermal boundary conductance versus temperature, and compare with acoustic mismatch theory.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Quantum Hall edge transport in a disordered multi-terminal Hall bar
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Compute the transmission matrix among six leads of a lattice Hall bar in a magnetic field using Green's functions. Solve the Landauer-Büttiker linear equations for longitudinal and Hall resistances, showing plateaus robust to disorder.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Anomalous-velocity Hall drift of a wave packet in a gapped honeycomb band
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Integrate the semiclassical equations ṙ = ∂E/∂k - k̇ × Ω with Berry curvature computed numerically for massive graphene. Compare the transverse drift with full quantum time evolution of a Gaussian wave packet on a finite lattice.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: 2D Bloch oscillations and Lissajous trajectories on a square lattice
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Apply a field at angle θ to a 2D tight-binding lattice and propagate a wave packet exactly with sparse expm_multiply. Show closed Lissajous orbits for rational tan θ and open drifting orbits otherwise, and compare with semiclassical trajectories.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Zitterbewegung of wave packets in the SSH chain
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Prepare a Gaussian packet that superposes both SSH bands and evolve it exactly. Extract the trembling-motion frequency and amplitude of ⟨x(t)⟩ and its decay, and compare with the interband gap and the projector analysis.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Anderson localization dynamics: mean-square displacement saturation in 1D disorder
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Evolve initially localized states in disordered chains and average over realizations. Show the saturation of ⟨x²(t)⟩, and relate the plateau to the localization length obtained from transfer-matrix Lyapunov exponents.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Thomas-Reiche-Kuhn sum rule for anharmonic oscillator dipole spectra
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize a quartic or Morse oscillator in a truncated harmonic-oscillator basis. Compute oscillator strengths f_0n = 2m ω_n0 |x_0n|²/ħ and check that they sum to 1, studying convergence with basis size.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Lindhard response of a 2D tight-binding lattice and KK consistency
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Compute Im χ₀(q,ω) and Re χ₀(q,ω) of a square-lattice electron gas from band-sum Lindhard formulas with small broadening. Verify the Kramers-Kronig relation between them numerically and the static limit against the compressibility.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: RPA plasmon dispersion and loss-function sum rules in 2D lattice metals
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Build ε(q,ω) = 1 - V(q)χ₀(q,ω) for a 2D lattice with Coulomb interaction. Locate plasmon peaks in -Im 1/ε, and verify the f-sum rule and the perfect-screening sum rule for the inverse dielectric function.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Period-doubling chain spectrum and integrated density-of-states devil's staircase
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Build tight-binding Hamiltonians for successive approximants of the period-doubling substitution chain with two on-site energies. Diagonalize them to get the integrated density of states, locate the plateaus and compare with Fibonacci-chain gap structure.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Separable two-dimensional Fibonacci grid: spectrum as sum of one-dimensional spectra
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Construct the square Fibonacci product lattice Hamiltonian H = H_x⊗1 + 1⊗H_y. Verify by direct sparse diagonalization that its eigenvalues are pairwise sums of 1D Fibonacci eigenvalues, and compute how the DOS gaps close as hopping contrast varies.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Zero-energy confined states of the Penrose rhombus tiling vertex model
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Generate a Penrose patch with the de Bruijn pentagrid method and build its hopping-only vertex Hamiltonian. Count the E=0 degeneracy through the matrix null space, and compare the fraction of confined states with the Kohmoto-Sutherland value of about 81/(1+τ)^... using finite-patch extrapolation.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Localization transition of the quasiperiodic p-wave Kitaev-Aubry-André chain
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the BdG Hamiltonian of a Kitaev chain with an incommensurate cosine potential. Compute the IPR of quasiparticle states and the Majorana edge-mode gap, and locate the critical potential λ_c = 2(t+Δ).

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Level-spacing ratio statistics across the Aubry-André transition
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize Aubry-André chains under periodic boundaries with rational approximants of the golden ratio, averaging over phase offsets. Compute the mean adjacent-gap ratio ⟨r⟩ versus λ and compare with Poisson and GOE values.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Fractal dimension D2 of critical Aubry-André eigenstates by IPR scaling
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: At λ=2, diagonalize Aubry-André chains on Fibonacci-number sizes and fit IPR ~ L^{-D2} for states at band center and band edge. Show that D2 depends on energy, unlike extended (D2=1) and localized (D2=0) phases.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Aubry duality: Fourier-transform mapping between localized and extended eigenstates
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the Aubry-André Hamiltonian at λ and at its dual 4/λ on the same rational approximant. Apply the discrete Fourier transform to the eigenvectors and verify the duality numerically through overlaps and IPR exchange.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Exact mobility edges of the mosaic quasiperiodic lattice
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize a chain whose quasiperiodic potential acts only on every κ-th site (mosaic model), compute fractal dimensions of all eigenstates, and compare the numerically located mobility edges with the analytic condition |E| = 2|t|/λ.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Bichromatic optical lattice in continuum versus effective Aubry-André model
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the 1D Schrödinger equation with a primary plus incommensurate secondary cosine potential in a plane-wave basis. Extract Wannier-derived t and Δ for the effective Aubry-André model, and compare the localization threshold from first-band IPRs with the λ = 2 prediction.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Phason-driven edge-state crossings in finite Fibonacci chains
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Generate Fibonacci chains via a characteristic function with a phason offset φ, and diagonalize the open chains as φ sweeps a full cycle. Track in-gap edge states localized at the left and right ends, and count their gap crossings to obtain winding labels.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Fibonacci-modulated SSH chain: topological gaps and fractal edge-state hierarchy
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize an SSH-type chain whose strong and weak bonds follow a Fibonacci sequence. Identify gaps that host zero-energy and finite-energy edge states, and compute their localization lengths for different terminations.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Superconducting Tc from linearized Eliashberg equation as a Matsubara eigenvalue problem
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Discretize the isotropic linearized Eliashberg gap equation on fermionic Matsubara frequencies for a model α²F(ω) (Einstein plus Lorentzian peaks) with μ*. Find the T at which the largest kernel eigenvalue equals 1, and compare with the McMillan and Allen-Dynes formulas using λ and ω_log.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Holstein polaron effective mass on a ring from momentum-sector diagonalization
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the one-electron Holstein model on an N-site ring in each total-momentum sector, using a truncated multi-phonon basis. Extract the polaron band E(K) and the effective mass, and show the crossover to exponential mass enhancement at strong coupling.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Kohn anomaly and Peierls phonon softening from RPA in a 1D metal
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Compute the static electronic susceptibility χ0(q) of a 1D tight-binding chain at temperature T, then the renormalized phonon frequencies ω²(q) = ω0²(q) − 2g²ω0χ0(q). Locate the 2k_F softening and the mean-field Peierls temperature at which ω(2k_F) → 0.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Franck-Condon vibronic progression from displaced oscillators in a truncated basis
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize displaced harmonic-oscillator Hamiltonians in a finite number basis to obtain vibronic overlaps. Compute the absorption line intensities and compare with the Poisson distribution set by the Huang-Rhys factor S, including frequency-changed excited states.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Self-consistent Migdal self-energy of the Holstein model on Matsubara axis
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Iterate the Migdal-Eliashberg electron self-energy with a dressed Green's function for a Holstein coupling to an Einstein mode, using a semicircular band. Extract the mass enhancement 1+λ from the slope at low Matsubara frequency, and compare with λ = 2g²N(0)/ω0.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Zero-point band-gap renormalization of a diatomic chain via Allen-Heine-Cardona
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: For a 1D diatomic tight-binding chain with bond-length-dependent hopping, compute the phonon modes from the dynamical matrix and the second-order Fan and Debye-Waller corrections to the band-edge energies. Compare the result with frozen-phonon supercell averaging over thermal displacements.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Triangular-lattice 120° antiferromagnet spin waves and ordered-moment reduction
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Perform LSWT in the locally rotated frame for the 120° state. Bogoliubov-diagonalize to get the magnon dispersion with Goldstone modes at Γ and ±K, then integrate over the Brillouin zone to obtain the quantum reduction of the sublattice magnetization (about 0.26 for S=1/2).
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Spin waves and linear spin-wave theory

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Dynamic structure factor of a helical magnet via rotating-frame LSWT
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: For a J1-J2 chain or cubic helimagnet with an incommensurate spiral, find the ordering wavevector by minimizing J(q). Perform LSWT in the rotating frame, and compute the neutron intensities S^{αα}(q,ω) including the ω(q±Q) satellite branches.
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Spin waves and linear spin-wave theory

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Spin-flop transition and field-dependent magnon gaps of an easy-axis antiferromagnet
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Determine the classical ground state of a two-sublattice antiferromagnet with uniaxial anisotropy in a parallel field, by energy minimization. Perform LSWT in the collinear and spin-flop phases, and show the magnon gap closing at H_sf = √(2H_E H_A + H_A²).
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Spin waves and linear spin-wave theory

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Surface spin waves of a ferromagnetic Heisenberg slab with modified surface exchange
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the layer-resolved LSWT matrix of an N-layer simple-cubic ferromagnetic film for each in-plane wavevector. Identify surface magnon modes split off below the bulk continuum when the surface exchange is reduced, and find their decay lengths.
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Spin waves and linear spin-wave theory

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Zigzag-ordered Heisenberg-Kitaev honeycomb magnet: four-sublattice spin-wave spectrum
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Build the 8×8 bosonic Bogoliubov-de Gennes Hamiltonian for the zigzag state of the J-K honeycomb model. Colpa-diagonalize it to obtain the anisotropy-induced magnon gap and the dispersion along high-symmetry paths.
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Spin waves and linear spin-wave theory

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Two-magnon bound states of the ferromagnetic Heisenberg XXZ chain
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the two-magnon sector at fixed total momentum K of an anisotropic ferromagnetic chain. Separate the scattering continuum from bound-state energies, and compare these with the Bethe-ansatz result E_b(K) = J(Δ − cos²(K/2)/Δ).
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Spin waves and linear spin-wave theory

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Triplon dispersion of a two-leg spin ladder from bond-operator Bogoliubov theory
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Represent rung dimers with singlet and triplet bond operators, then solve the harmonic bond-operator mean-field equations self-consistently. Bogoliubov-diagonalize to obtain the triplon gap versus leg/rung coupling, and compare with exact diagonalization of small ladders.
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Spin waves and linear spin-wave theory

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Zener pair production in a gapped Dirac material from k-resolved two-level dynamics
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Under a uniform electric field, integrate the two-band Bloch equations for each initial k of a massive 2D Dirac model. Sum the interband excitation probabilities over k, and compare the pair-creation rate with the Landau-Zener/Schwinger formula exp(−πΔ²/ħv eE).
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Landau-Zener and Zener tunneling between bands

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Majorana spin-S Landau-Zener transitions from SU(2) representation matrices
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Propagate a spin-S system in a linearly swept field with transverse coupling, using the (2S+1)-dimensional spin matrices. Compare the final level populations with the Majorana formula built from Wigner d-matrix elements in terms of the spin-1/2 LZ probability.
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Landau-Zener and Zener tunneling between bands

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Landau-Zener transitions for nonlinear power-law sweeps and adiabaticity scaling
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Numerically integrate the two-level problem for detuning ∝ sign(t)|t|^n. Compute the final transition probability versus coupling, and compare with the Vitanov-Garraway asymptotic scaling and with the linear-sweep case.
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Landau-Zener and Zener tunneling between bands

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Z2 invariant of the BHZ model with Rashba coupling by Wilson-loop Wannier flow
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Compute the hybrid Wannier-center flow from Wilson loops along k_x as a function of k_y for the four-band BHZ model with Rashba coupling that breaks S_z conservation. Determine the Z2 index by counting the crossings of a reference line.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Fu-Kane parity Z2 indices of a 3D Wilson-Dirac topological insulator model
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Build the four-band cubic-lattice Wilson-Dirac Hamiltonian with inversion symmetry. Compute the occupied-band parity eigenvalues at the 8 TRIM, and obtain the strong and weak Z2 indices (ν0; ν1ν2ν3) versus mass parameter.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Nearly flat Chern bands of the kagome lattice with spin-orbit and NNN hopping
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize a three-band kagome model with complex NN and NNN hoppings, and compute the band Chern numbers with link variables. Evaluate the flatness ratio of the gap to the bandwidth, and optimize it over the hopping parameters.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Orbital magnetization of the Haldane model from the modern theory
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Compute the k-space orbital magnetization M = Σ_k Im⟨∂u|×(H+E−2μ)|∂u⟩ using derivatives of the Bloch eigenvectors expressed through sums over states. Show that dM/dμ = C/(2π) within the gap.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Friedel oscillations around a point impurity in a 2D tight-binding metal
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize a finite square lattice with a single impurity potential, compute the induced local density change δn(r) at fixed filling, and fit the long-range oscillation period and r^{-2} decay to the Lindhard 2k_F prediction.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Real-space RPA screening of a charged impurity in a tight-binding cluster
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Build the static real-space bare susceptibility matrix χ0_ij from cluster eigenstates and a Coulomb matrix V_ij. Solve ε = 1 − Vχ0 by linear algebra for the screened impurity potential, and compare with Thomas-Fermi screening length estimates.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Static polarization function of doped graphene and Thomas-Fermi wavevector
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Compute the static polarization Π(q) of a two-band Dirac model numerically from band eigenvectors with chirality overlap factors. Compare with the Hwang-Das Sarma analytic form, including the flat plateau for q<2k_F, and obtain q_TF = 4αk_F.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Local-field effects: Adler-Wiser dielectric matrix of a 1D periodic potential
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Compute the Bloch states of a 1D cosine potential in a plane-wave basis, then build the static microscopic χ0_{GG'}(q) and the RPA dielectric matrix ε_{GG'}. Obtain the macroscopic dielectric constant 1/[ε^{-1}]_{00}, and compare it with the diagonal approximation.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Plasmon eigenmodes of a tight-binding nanoring from real-space RPA
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Compute the dynamic real-space χ0_ij(ω) of a ring of N sites with long-range Coulomb interaction. Find the plasmon resonances as eigenvalues of Vχ0(ω) crossing 1 and as peaks in the loss function −Im tr ε^{-1}, and plot the mode frequency versus angular number.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Long-range-pairing Kitaev chain: fractional topological numbers and massive edge states
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the BdG Hamiltonian of a Kitaev chain with pairing decaying as r^{-α}. Compute the winding number from the k-space pairing function, which becomes half-integer for α<1, and the edge-mode energies in open chains.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Trimer SSH chain: Zak phases, edge states and inversion symmetry breaking
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the three-site-unit-cell SSH3 chain with hoppings t1, t2, t3. Compute band Zak phases by discrete Wilson loops, which need not be quantized without inversion symmetry, and relate them to edge states in open chains of different terminations.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Fractional e/2 charge bound to an SSH domain-wall soliton
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Build an SSH chain with a smooth tanh dimerization domain wall, diagonalize it, and sum the local charge density relative to the uniform background in a window around the wall. Show that the result is ±e/2, and compare the zero-mode profile with the Jackiw-Rebbi solution.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Floquet SSH chain: 0 and π edge modes from two-step driving
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Form the one-period Floquet operator of a chain that alternates intra- and intercell hopping. Diagonalize it in open geometry to find quasienergy-0 and quasienergy-π edge modes, and compute the two winding numbers (W0, Wπ) from symmetric time frames.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Thouless pump in a continuum sliding double-well optical superlattice
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize a bichromatic superlattice V1cos²(kx)+V2cos²(kx/2+φ) in a plane-wave basis. Compute the Berry-phase polarization of the lowest band versus φ by Wilson loops, and obtain the pumped charge per cycle as a Chern number.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Chern-insulator ribbon edge-state decay length versus complex-wavevector prediction
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize a QWZ ribbon, extract the edge-state amplitude decay into the bulk at each k_x, and compare with the decay rate obtained by solving the bulk Hamiltonian for complex k_y at the edge-state energy.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Kagome ribbon flat band and termination-dependent edge states
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize kagome nanoribbons with different edge terminations, and identify the persistent bulk flat band at E = 2t. Find the dispersive edge modes in the gaps, and compute their weights at each edge.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Valley kink states at a gated bilayer-graphene domain wall
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Build a Bernal bilayer graphene ribbon whose interlayer bias changes sign across the middle. Diagonalize it to obtain the valley-chiral kink states within the bias gap, check that there are two modes per valley, and compute their localization at the wall.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Two-dimensional SSH lattice ribbons: edge states and 2D Zak phase
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize ribbons of the Liu-Wakabayashi 2D SSH square lattice with alternating hoppings. Compute the vectorial bulk Zak phase from Wilson loops, and connect it to edge-band existence for different ribbon orientations.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Generating the D4h point group and its character table from 3×3 matrices
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Generate the group by closure from rotation and reflection generators, compute conjugacy classes, and construct characters of the irreducible representations by Burnside class-algebra diagonalization. Verify the orthogonality relations.
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Symmetry analysis and group theory of bands

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Little-group irreps of square-lattice s-p bands at Γ, X and M
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize a square-lattice tight-binding model with s, p_x and p_y orbitals. Compute the representation matrices of the little-group operations on the degenerate eigenspaces at Γ, X and M, and assign irreps from characters and degeneracies.
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Symmetry analysis and group theory of bands

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Γ-point phonon irreducible representations of cubic perovskite ABO3
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Build the 15-dimensional displacement representation of O_h from atom permutations and vector matrices. Reduce it into irreps (4T1u + T2u), and check by projecting eigenvectors of a model force-constant dynamical matrix.
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Symmetry analysis and group theory of bands

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Double group C4v: spin-orbit splitting of p-bands at Γ
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Construct SU(2) spinor matrices for the C4v operations, generate the double group, and compute its characters. Diagonalize a p-orbital Hamiltonian with λL·S to confirm the decomposition into Γ6 and Γ7 doublets.
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Symmetry analysis and group theory of bands

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Block diagonalization of tight-binding Hamiltonians with symmetry-adapted Bloch functions
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Build projection operators from the character table of the little group at Γ, form an orthonormal symmetry-adapted basis by QR, and block-diagonalize a multi-orbital (e.g., kagome or graphene) Hamiltonian. Verify that the block eigenvalues reproduce the full spectrum.
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Symmetry analysis and group theory of bands

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Point-charge crystal-field splitting of d orbitals in octahedral and tetrahedral sites
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Evaluate crystal-field matrix elements of a point-charge potential on real d orbitals by numerical angular integration, then diagonalize. Verify the e_g/t_2g splitting ratio, and the inversion of this ordering, with Δ_tet = −4/9 Δ_oct.
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Symmetry analysis and group theory of bands

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: C3 rotation eigenvalues at K and symmetry-protected Dirac points in honeycomb lattices
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Compute the C3 representation matrices on the honeycomb Bloch states at K. Show that the two-dimensional E representation protects the Dirac point, and verify numerically which perturbations (sublattice mass versus Kekulé versus strain) open a gap.
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Symmetry analysis and group theory of bands

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Graphene phonon irreps at Γ and K from a force-constant dynamical matrix
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize a fourth-neighbor force-constant dynamical matrix of graphene at Γ and K. Compute the characters of the D6h and D3h little-group operations on the eigenvector subspaces, and label the modes (E2g, A1', etc.).
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Symmetry analysis and group theory of bands

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: IPT-DMFT on the hypercubic lattice with Gaussian density of states
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Iterate the half-filled IPT DMFT loop on the Matsubara axis using a numerical Hilbert transform of the Gaussian DOS instead of the Bethe-lattice semicircle. Compare the quasiparticle weight Z(U) and the crossover to the insulator with the Bethe-lattice results.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Doped Hubbard model DMFT with Kajueter-Kotliar modified IPT
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Implement the interpolative self-energy ansatz away from half filling, with chemical-potential adjustment to fix the density n. Compute the quasiparticle weight and the effective mass versus doping near the Mott insulator on the Bethe lattice.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Kondo-insulator hybridization gap in the periodic Anderson model via IPT-DMFT
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Solve DMFT self-consistency on the Bethe lattice for a periodic Anderson model, with an IPT solver for the f-electron self-energy. Track the renormalized hybridization gap and f-quasiparticle weight versus U and V.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Millis-Mueller-Shraiman DMFT of the Holstein model with classical phonons
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Solve DMFT for electrons coupled to a static classical displacement on the Bethe lattice, integrating over the displacement distribution P(x) self-consistently. Find the polaron crossover at which P(x) becomes bimodal, and the resulting spectral pseudogap.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Real-frequency IPT-DMFT and optical conductivity across the Mott transition
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Iterate IPT on the real-frequency axis at finite temperature using FFT-based convolutions for the second-order self-energy. Compute the DMFT optical conductivity σ(ω) from the spectral functions and show the transfer of Drude weight to the Hubbard band.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Field-induced metamagnetism near the Mott transition in spin-polarized IPT-DMFT
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Add a Zeeman field to the half-filled paramagnetic Bethe-lattice IPT loop with separate spin channels. Compute the magnetization curve m(h) and the enhanced susceptibility near U_c, and look for a metamagnetic jump at a critical field.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Logarithmic van Hove singularity shift with next-nearest hopping on the square lattice
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Compute the DOS of the t-t' square-lattice band with Lorentzian broadening and with histograms at several k-mesh sizes. Track the saddle-point energy E = 4t' and fit the coefficient of the log divergence against the saddle-point curvature prediction.
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Density of states and van Hove singularities

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Kagome lattice DOS: flat-band delta, saddle points and sublattice interference
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the three-band kagome Bloch Hamiltonian on dense meshes to build total and sublattice-projected DOS. Identify the flat-band weight and the two M-point log singularities, and show that the eigenvectors at the van Hove points live on a single sublattice.
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Density of states and van Hove singularities

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Kernel polynomial method DOS of the 3D Anderson model with Jackson kernel
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Build a sparse 3D Anderson Hamiltonian, rescale it to [-1,1], and compute Chebyshev moments by stochastic trace estimation. Reconstruct the Jackson-damped DOS, then quantify how disorder smears the van Hove kinks and compare with exact diagonalization on small lattices.
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Density of states and van Hove singularities

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Berg-Lüscher topological charge of a relaxed skyrmion lattice under field
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Relax a classical Heisenberg-DMI square-lattice spin model with Zeeman field by projected gradient descent from a triangular-skyrmion initial guess. Compute the integer topological charge from signed solid angles of spin triangles, and the charge density per magnetic unit cell.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Bloch, Néel and antiskyrmion textures from bulk, interfacial and D2d DMI
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Relax spin textures on a square lattice with three DMI vector patterns (bulk, interfacial, D2d anisotropic). Compute the helicity, vorticity and topological charge (+1 versus −1) of each relaxed texture from discrete solid angles and azimuthal winding.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Real-space Berry phase: Chern bands of electrons strongly coupled to a skyrmion crystal
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Couple tight-binding electrons through Hund's exchange to a fixed skyrmion-crystal texture in a magnetic supercell. Diagonalize the 2N×2N Bloch Hamiltonian and compute the Chern numbers of the split-off bands with Fukui link variables, comparing with the emergent flux of one quantum per cell.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Breathing and gyrotropic eigenmodes of an isolated skyrmion from linearized LLG
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Linearize the LLG equation around a relaxed lattice skyrmion in local rotated frames to build the dynamical matrix. Solve the generalized eigenproblem for the low-lying internal modes and classify the breathing, CCW and CW modes by their azimuthal number.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Chemical potential by bisection and Luttinger-area Fermi contours of t-t' metals
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Find μ at fixed electron density for a t-t' square lattice by bisection on the Fermi-Dirac-occupied k-mesh. Extract the Fermi contour by Brent root finding along radial rays and verify Luttinger's theorem from the enclosed area.
