physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Lifshitz transitions of the anisotropic triangular lattice: Fermi-contour topology versus filling
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Sweep the filling of a triangular tight-binding band with anisotropic hopping and solve for μ at each filling. Count Fermi-surface pockets and their electron or hole character by contour tracing, and locate the Lifshitz fillings as van Hove crossings.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Polarized Raman selection rules and angular intensity patterns from Raman tensors
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Rotate tabulated Raman tensors of a tetragonal (D4h) crystal's A1g, B1g, B2g and Eg modes into lab frames for backscattering geometries. Compute |e_s·R·e_i|² as a function of in-plane polarization angle in parallel and crossed configurations, recovering the symmetry-specific polar patterns.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Ionic static dielectric tensor from Born charges and force-constant pseudo-inverse
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Obtain the ionic contribution to ε0 of an anisotropic polar crystal from Born effective charges and the Γ-point force-constant matrix, using a pseudo-inverse that removes the acoustic translations. Decompose it into mode oscillator strengths and check the generalized Lyddane-Sachs-Teller product.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Berreman mode in thin polar films from oblique p-polarized transfer matrices
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Compute oblique-incidence transmittance of a thin polar film on a substrate with a 2×2 characteristic-matrix method and a Lorentz-oscillator dielectric function. Show the s-polarized dip at ωTO and the extra p-polarized absorption at ωLO, and how it scales with film thickness and angle.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Inverting elastic constants from directional sound velocities by Gauss-Newton least squares
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Generate noisy quasi-longitudinal and quasi-transverse velocities in many directions for an orthorhombic crystal from the Christoffel equation. Recover the nine Cij by Gauss-Newton fitting with eigenvalue-derivative Jacobians (Hellmann-Feynman), and report parameter covariances.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Voigt-Reuss-Hill polycrystalline moduli and universal anisotropy index from stiffness matrices
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Fit the stiffness matrix of a low-symmetry crystal from stress-strain data by linear least squares and invert it to the compliance. Compute Voigt, Reuss and Hill bulk and shear moduli, isotropic sound velocities and the universal anisotropy index.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Shiba chain of magnetic adatoms on an s-wave superconductor: Pfaffian phase diagram
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Build a real-space BdG Hamiltonian of a 2D s-wave superconductor with Rashba coupling and a line of classical magnetic impurities. Find the Yu-Shiba-Rusinov bands, compute the Z2 Pfaffian invariant of the effective chain, and locate the Majorana end states in finite strips.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Spinless p+ip square-lattice superconductor: BdG Chern numbers and chiral edge Majoranas
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Compute the BdG Chern number of a lattice p+ip superconductor versus μ/t with Fukui link variables, giving the phases C = 0, ±1. Diagonalize ribbon BdG Hamiltonians to show the chiral Majorana edge dispersion and check bulk-edge correspondence.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Coupled Kitaev chains in class BDI: integer winding numbers and Majorana multiplicity
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Model two or three Kitaev chains coupled by interchain hopping while chiral symmetry is preserved. Compute the BDI winding number from the off-diagonal block of the chiral-basis Hamiltonian, and count zero modes under open boundaries across the phase diagram.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Time-reversal-invariant class DIII superconducting chain: Kramers Majorana pairs
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize a spinful Rashba chain with s± (or p-wave) pairing that preserves time reversal. Compute the DIII Z2 invariant from Pfaffian ratios at k = 0, π, and show twofold-degenerate Majorana Kramers pairs at the ends of open chains.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Self-consistent Schrödinger-Poisson 2DEG in a modulation-doped GaAs/AlGaAs heterojunction
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Iterate finite-difference Schrödinger and Poisson solutions with ionized remote donors and position-dependent conduction-band offset, using linear mixing until convergence. Return the subband energies, sheet density, Fermi level and band-bending profile.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Intersubband absorption and quantum-confined Stark shift in asymmetric coupled double wells
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Solve the subbands of a coupled double quantum well under a static electric field by finite differences. Compute dipole matrix elements and oscillator strengths (checking the TRK sum), and produce Lorentzian intersubband absorption spectra with their anticrossings versus field.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Hartree-Fock para/ferro/antiferro phase diagram of the square-lattice Hubbard model
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Iterate self-consistent mean-field equations at fixed density, solving for μ each step, for uniform and Néel orders. Compare free energies over (U, n) to map the phase diagram, and check the ferromagnetic boundary against the Stoner criterion.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Real-space unrestricted Hartree-Fock stripes in the hole-doped Hubbard model
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Run collinear unrestricted HF on a periodic cluster with stripe-seeded initial densities near 1/8 doping. Compare converged energies of stripe periods and site- versus bond-centred configurations, extracting the charge and spin modulation profiles by Fourier analysis.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Spiral magnetic order in the Hubbard model: mean-field energy versus spiral wavevector
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Use the generalized-translation ansatz so each k couples to k+Q in a 2×2 mean-field Hamiltonian, and solve the gap equation for each Q. Minimize the grand potential over Q to find where Néel order gives way to incommensurate spirals under doping.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Intrinsic spin Hall conductivity of a Rashba tight-binding lattice via Kubo formula
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Compute the spin-current Berry-curvature-like Kubo spin Hall conductivity of a square-lattice Rashba model with a conserved-current definition. Recover the universal e/8π plateau in the continuum limit and its deviations near the band edges and van Hove fillings.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Surface Rashba splitting from p-orbital tight binding with atomic SOC and surface field
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Build a Petersen-Hedegård slab or monolayer p-orbital model with atomic spin-orbit coupling λL·S and an inversion-breaking surface hopping term. Extract the effective Rashba parameter from the band splitting near Γ and study how it scales with λ and the surface potential gradient.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Ideal-Chern-band trace condition in the lowest Harper-Hofstadter band versus flux
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the q×q Harper magnetic Bloch Hamiltonian, compute the quantum geometric tensor of the lowest band with gauge-invariant projectors, and evaluate the violation of tr g ≥ |Ω| as flux 1/q → 0 (Landau-level limit).
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Quantum geometry and the quantum metric

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Four Weyl nodes of an inversion-broken lattice model: root finding and chirality
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Time-reversal-symmetric, inversion-broken two-band cubic-lattice model: locate the gap-closing points by Newton/least-squares root finding on the d-vector. Assign each node's chirality from the Berry flux through a small discretized sphere (link-variable plaquettes).

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Burkov-Balents TI/ferromagnet multilayer: Weyl node separation and pair annihilation
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Four-band Burkov-Balents heterostructure Hamiltonian: find the kz node positions versus exchange splitting and tunneling amplitudes. Verify opposite chiralities by sphere Berry flux and locate the field where the nodes annihilate at the zone boundary.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: C4-protected double-Weyl semimetal: monopole charge 2 and anisotropic quadratic dispersion
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Lattice model with d = (k_x²−k_y², 2k_xk_y, m(k_z)): locate the nodes, integrate the Berry flux over an enclosing sphere to get charge ±2, and fit the in-plane quadratic and out-of-plane linear dispersions near each node.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Type-II Weyl node: tilt-driven Lifshitz transition and finite DOS at node
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Tilted two-band Weyl lattice model: compute the DOS at the node energy by tetrahedron or Gaussian-smeared BZ sampling as the tilt crosses the type-I/type-II boundary, showing the onset of electron and hole pockets.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Γ-point phonon irreps of wurtzite and their Raman/IR activity
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Build the 12×12 displacement representation of the 4-atom wurtzite cell under C6v and reduce it with characters into A1+E1+2B1+2E2. Assign Raman and IR activity from the symmetry of polarizability and dipole components.
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Symmetry analysis and group theory of bands

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Antiferromagnetic skyrmion on a square lattice: sublattice charges and relaxation
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Relax a Néel-texture skyrmion in a square-lattice antiferromagnet with interfacial DMI and anisotropy by projected gradient descent. Compute Berg-Lüscher topological charges of each sublattice and of the staggered field, showing net cancellation.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Caroli-de Gennes-Matricon vortex core states in a 2D s-wave BdG disk
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Discretize the angular-momentum-resolved radial BdG equations for a vortex with a tanh gap profile and diagonalize per channel. Extract the subgap level spacing and compare it with Δ²/E_F.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: 4π-periodic fractional Josephson effect in a Kitaev-chain junction
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Two topological Kitaev chains joined by a weak link with phase φ: diagonalize the BdG Hamiltonian versus φ. Identify the fermion-parity-protected level crossing at φ=π and compare with the trivial-phase 2π-periodic Andreev spectrum.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Planar Josephson junction with Rashba and Zeeman: topological phase diagram versus phase
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Discretized Pientka-type S-N-S strip with Rashba SOC and in-plane field: compute the k_x=0 BdG Pfaffian sign and gap. Map the topological region in the (Zeeman, phase-difference) plane, showing its widening at φ=π.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Quantized 2e²/h Majorana zero-bias conductance from a BdG scattering matrix
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Attach a normal tight-binding lead to a Kitaev chain and compute electron and hole reflection amplitudes from the BdG scattering matrix via surface Green's functions. Evaluate G = (2e²/h)(N − R_ee + R_he) versus bias and chemical potential.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Commensurate Aubry-André-Harper charge pump: Chern numbers of gaps and pumped charge
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Off-diagonal and diagonal Harper chain with phason φ as pump parameter: compute (k,φ)-torus Chern numbers of each band by link variables. Check the pumped charge per cycle from Wannier-center flow against the Diophantine gap labels.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Ionic Hubbard chain: many-body Berry phase across band-insulator–Mott transition
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Exact diagonalization of a small ionic Hubbard ring with twisted boundary conditions. Compute the Berry phase of the ground state over the twist and find the U where it jumps by π (Resta-Ortiz polarization).

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Kane-Lubensky rotor chain: topological floppy modes from the rigidity matrix
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Linkage chain of rotors and springs: build the compatibility (rigidity) matrix, compute its winding number in k-space, and find by SVD which end hosts the zero-energy floppy mode on finite chains.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Two-orbital Anderson impurity in Hartree-Fock: Hund's coupling and moment formation
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Degenerate two-orbital Anderson impurity with U, U' and J_H in a Lorentzian bath: solve the self-consistent spin- and orbital-resolved occupations. Map the local-moment phase boundary and show that J_H lowers the critical U.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Wilson-chain mapping: logarithmic discretization and Lanczos tridiagonalization of a flat band
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Discretize a flat conduction band logarithmically with parameter Λ and tridiagonalize the star bath by Lanczos. Verify the hopping decay t_n ∝ Λ^{-n/2} against the Wilson analytic formula.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Kondo screening cloud: impurity–bath spin correlations from Lanczos Anderson-chain ED
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Single-impurity Anderson model coupled to a finite tight-binding chain: find the ground state by sparse Lanczos in the S_z=0 sector. Compute ⟨S_imp·S_j⟩ versus distance and the total compensation sum.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Square-lattice elementary band representations: 1a versus 1b orbitals and obstructed limits
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Induce band representations from s orbitals at Wyckoff positions 1a and 1b of p4mm. Compute irreps at Γ, X and M from tight-binding eigenvectors, and show that the 1b set is distinguishable (obstructed atomic limit).
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Symmetry analysis and group theory of bands

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Point-group Clebsch-Gordan coefficients from the null space of intertwiner equations
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Build Oh (or Td) irrep matrices and form direct products. Obtain Clebsch-Gordan coefficients by solving the linear intertwiner equations via the null space, and verify unitarity and multiplicity counts.
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Symmetry analysis and group theory of bands

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Hückel spectrum of C60 and icosahedral degeneracies of its levels
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Build the truncated-icosahedron adjacency matrix with distinct single and double bond hoppings and diagonalize it. Classify the level degeneracies (1,3,5,4) and the HOMO-LUMO gap versus bond alternation.
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Symmetry analysis and group theory of bands

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Dunlap-Kenkre dynamic localization of a wave packet under an AC field
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Time-evolve a localized state on a tight-binding chain with a sinusoidal field. Compute the long-time mean-square displacement versus field amplitude, showing suppression at zeros of J0(eE_0a/ħω).

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Tamura isotope scattering rates from eigenvectors of an fcc force-constant model
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize an fcc Born-von Kármán dynamical matrix on a k-mesh and evaluate the Tamura mass-variance scattering rate, which includes eigenvector overlaps, with Gaussian-broadened delta functions. Compare with the Rayleigh ω⁴ law.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: FFLO modulated pairing in a Zeeman-split 1D attractive Hubbard chain
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Self-consistent real-space BdG for a spin-imbalanced attractive Hubbard chain: show that the gap develops sign-changing oscillations with wavevector set by k_F↑ − k_F↓. Compare the free energy with the uniform BCS state.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Clogston-Chandrasekhar limit: first-order Zeeman-driven breakdown of BCS
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Solve the BCS gap equation with Zeeman splitting and compare normal and superconducting grand potentials. Locate the first-order transition at h = Δ0/√2 and the T-dependent paramagnetic phase boundary.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: McMillan proximity minigap in a normal layer on a superconductor via BdG slab
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Tight-binding S/N bilayer slab with pairing only in S: diagonalize the k-resolved BdG Hamiltonian, optionally self-consistently. Extract the induced minigap and the pair-amplitude leakage versus N-layer thickness and interface hopping.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Near-zero-energy resonance of a unitary impurity in a d-wave superconductor
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Compute the momentum-summed BdG Green's function of a d-wave lattice superconductor and solve the T-matrix pole condition for a point scatterer. Find the resonance energy versus scattering strength and the resulting LDOS.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Slater-Koster d bands of fcc copper: Γ12/Γ25′ splitting and bandwidth
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Build the 5×5 fcc d-orbital Slater-Koster Hamiltonian with ddσ, ddπ, ddδ and diagonalize along high-symmetry lines. Extract the Γ12–Γ25′ crystal-field splitting, X-point bandwidth and d-DOS.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: SrVO3 t2g three-orbital bands: quasi-2D cylinders and Fermi-surface volume
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Cubic perovskite t2g tight-binding with nearest and next-nearest hoppings: diagonalize, set the d¹ filling by bisection, and compute the per-orbital DOS and cubic Fermi-surface cross sections.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Löwdin downfolding of the Emery CuO2 model to a one-band t-t′ model
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Starting from the three-band p-d Hamiltonian, project out the oxygen orbitals by energy-dependent Löwdin partitioning. Fit the effective antibonding band to extract t, t′ and t″ versus Δ_pd.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Lattice Bethe-Salpeter excitons of a 1D two-band semiconductor
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Build the electron-hole BSE matrix in the k basis of a two-band chain with a screened Coulomb kernel and Bloch overlaps. Diagonalize to get exciton binding energies and the oscillator-strength-weighted absorption.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Magnon-phonon hybridization: magnetoelastic anticrossing gaps in a ferromagnet
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Couple linearized LLG magnons to transverse acoustic phonons through a magnetoelastic constant and diagonalize the coupled linear-mode matrix. Extract anticrossing positions and gap versus coupling and field.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Fourier interpolation of bands from a coarse mesh: recovering real-space hoppings
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Sample tight-binding eigenvalues on a coarse k-grid, inverse-FFT to real-space hopping coefficients, interpolate onto a fine path, and measure the error versus mesh size near band crossings.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Euler class of PT-symmetric bands from real Wilson-loop windings
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Real two-band subspace of a PT-symmetric three-band kagome or square model: compute Wilson-loop eigenphase winding over a BZ patch and identify Euler class 2 associated with braided band nodes.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Chiral hinge modes of a C4T-symmetric 3D second-order topological insulator
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Four-band Wilson-Dirac model with a C4T-symmetric mass: diagonalize a k_z-resolved square-column geometry and identify gapless hinge-localized states by weight in the column corners.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Bogoliubov spectrum of a BEC in a 1D optical lattice: dynamical instability
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Build Bogoliubov-de Gennes matrices of a condensate moving at quasimomentum p in a tight-binding lattice. Find the onset of complex eigenvalues (dynamical instability) at p = π/2 and Landau instability.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Tanabe-Sugano diagram of d² and d³ ions from crystal-field multiplet ED
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Build Coulomb matrix elements via Racah parameters in the d^n Slater-determinant basis, add the octahedral crystal field, diagonalize, and plot term energies versus Dq/B.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Orbital magnetic susceptibility of square-lattice electrons from weak-flux energy curvature
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the Harper Hamiltonian at small rational fluxes, compute the grand potential versus field, and fit its curvature to get χ_orb versus filling, including the paramagnetic van Hove singularity.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Chalker-Coddington network model: localization length at the quantum Hall transition
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Multiply random U(1) network transfer matrices on strips with QR reorthogonalization to obtain Lyapunov exponents. Extract the critical scaling of Λ = ξ/M near the critical saddle-point parameter.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Pair binding energy of the 2×2 Hubbard plaquette
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the 2×2 Hubbard cluster in fixed particle-number and spin sectors at fillings 2, 3 and 4 electrons. Compute Δ_b = 2E(3) − E(2) − E(4) versus U and its d-wave symmetry.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Carbon nanotube zone folding: metallicity rule and Kataura E_ii versus diameter
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Cut graphene tight-binding bands along quantized k lines for chiral (n,m) tubes. Classify metallicity by (n−m) mod 3 and compute van Hove transition energies E11, E22 versus diameter.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Graphene antidot lattice band gap scaling with hole and cell size
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize large hexagonal supercells of graphene with removed hole atoms at Γ and on k paths. Fit the gap to the N_removed^{1/2}/N_total scaling law.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Maxwell-Calladine counting of zero modes in a kagome spring network
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Build the rigidity matrix of periodic and finite kagome or twisted-kagome spring networks. Count floppy modes and states of self-stress by SVD and verify the index theorem.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Barrett quantum paraelectric: soft TO mode and LST-diverging dielectric constant
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Use the Barrett formula for the temperature-dependent soft mode in SrTiO3-like crystals and apply the Lyddane-Sachs-Teller relation to obtain ε(0,T), with quantum saturation at low T.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Coupled-dipole plasmon bands of a 1D metal-nanoparticle chain
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Quasistatic dipole-dipole interaction matrix of Drude spheres in a chain: solve the eigenproblem for longitudinal and transverse collective plasmon bands with Bloch sums, and locate the light-line features.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Allen-Feldman diffusivity of vibrational modes in a disordered harmonic network
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize a mass- or spring-disordered harmonic lattice, compute heat-current matrix elements between modes, and evaluate Allen-Feldman diffusivities and the diffuson thermal conductivity.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: J_eff=1/2 states of t2g⁵ iridates from spin-orbit projection
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize atomic spin-orbit coupling in the t2g⊗spin basis with an effective l=1 representation, identify the J_eff=1/2 doublet and J_eff=3/2 quartet, and add trigonal distortion to track mixing.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Honeycomb Heisenberg antiferromagnet: LSWT ordered-moment reduction and energy
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Two-sublattice Holstein-Primakoff Bogoliubov diagonalization on a k-mesh: compute the magnon dispersion, zero-point energy correction and reduced sublattice moment for coordination z=3.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Weak ferromagnet with DM interaction: canting angle and two magnon modes
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Two-sublattice antiferromagnet with a Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya vector and anisotropy: minimize the energy for the canting angle, then linearize the LLG to get quasi-FM and quasi-AFM resonance frequencies versus field.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Time-reversal-invariant Hofstadter model: Z2 index of each gap versus filling
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Build two copies of the square-lattice Harper Hamiltonian with opposite flux p/q for the two spins, add a Rashba-type spin-mixing hopping, and compute Wilson-loop Wannier-center flow on the magnetic Brillouin zone. Show that the Z2 index of each gap equals the parity of the spin-up TKNN Chern number.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Guo-Franz pyrochlore-lattice topological insulator: strong and weak indices from parities
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the spinful s-orbital pyrochlore tight-binding model with nearest-neighbor spin-orbit hopping at the eight fcc TRIM. Combine inversion-eigenvalue products into the (ν0; ν1ν2ν3) Fu-Kane indices and map them against a trigonal bond distortion.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Davydov factor-group splitting of a molecular vibration in a two-molecule cell
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Couple identical intramolecular oscillators on two inequivalent molecules through a Bloch-summed intermolecular force-constant matrix and diagonalize it at q=0. Form the IR transition dipoles of the in-phase and out-of-phase combinations, then invert the polarized intensity ratio to obtain the angle between the molecules.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: ABA trilayer graphene: mirror-symmetry decomposition into monolayer and bilayer bands
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Build the six-band π Hamiltonian of Bernal trilayer graphene and block-diagonalize it with the mirror-symmetric and antisymmetric layer combinations. Verify that the result is one monolayer-like and one bilayer-like spectrum with √2-enhanced coupling. Show how a perpendicular bias hybridizes the two blocks.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Ando model: symplectic-class Anderson transition from quasi-1D localization lengths
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Apply the MacKinnon-Kramer QR-stabilized transfer-matrix method to 2D square-lattice strips with random on-site disorder and SU(2) spin-orbit hopping. Find where the normalized localization length Λ_M/M for different widths crosses, which gives the critical disorder of the 2D symplectic metal-insulator transition.
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Disorder, Anderson localization and transfer matrices

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Hofstadter butterfly and Chern numbers of the triangular lattice
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the q×q Peierls-substituted triangular-lattice Hamiltonian at rational flux p/q to build the butterfly spectrum. Compute the Chern number of each gap with Fukui-Hatsugai link variables and check the gap-labeling Diophantine relation on the triangular lattice.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Hatsugai-Kohmoto model: diagonal hopping rearranges Hofstadter gap Chern numbers
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Add next-nearest-neighbor diagonal hopping t′ to the square-lattice Harper model at flux p/q and track gap closings as t′ increases. Compute the Hall conductance of each gap from Berry curvature to show that Chern numbers jump at these closings while staying consistent with the Diophantine constraint.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Landau-level splitting by a weak 2D superlattice: continuum Hofstadter subbands
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Project a weak square cosine potential onto the n-th Landau level of a 2DEG at flux p/q per superlattice cell, using Laguerre form factors and magnetic-translation bases. Diagonalize to obtain p subbands per Landau level and verify the Rauh duality that inverts the tight-binding q↔p structure.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Kagome q=0 Heisenberg antiferromagnet: zero-energy flat magnon band lifted by DM
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Perform Holstein-Primakoff expansion around the coplanar q=0 120° state of the kagome antiferromagnet and diagonalize the bosonic BdG Hamiltonian with Colpa's method. Show the dispersionless zero mode, and compute the gap a Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction opens together with the ordered-moment reduction.
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Spin waves and linear spin-wave theory

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Type-II fcc antiferromagnet (MnO-like): J1-J2 magnon dispersion and stability
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Set up linear spin-wave theory for type-II order on the fcc lattice using the two-sublattice rhombohedral magnetic cell, with frustrated J1 and dominant J2. Compute magnon branches along high-symmetry paths and find the J1/J2 range where all frequencies stay real.
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Spin waves and linear spin-wave theory

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Floquet topological insulator: circularly driven trivial BHZ quantum well
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Drive a lattice BHZ model in its trivial phase with circularly polarized light through Peierls phases, and build the Floquet operator by time-ordered products or Sambe-space truncation. Compute quasienergy spectra of a ribbon, count the induced edge states, and find the band-inversion condition on drive amplitude and frequency.
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Floquet engineering of periodically driven lattices

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Circularly polarized light on a 3D Dirac semimetal lattice: Floquet Weyl node splitting
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Periodically drive a cubic-lattice four-band Dirac semimetal with circular light and compute the Floquet Hamiltonian from the exact one-period propagator. Locate the split Weyl nodes, compare their separation with the high-frequency A²/ω prediction, and assign chiralities by Berry flux through small spheres.
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Floquet engineering of periodically driven lattices

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Disordered Kitaev chain: critical disorder from the Majorana zero-mode Lyapunov exponent
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: For a Kitaev chain with random chemical potential, iterate the zero-energy Majorana transfer matrix to obtain the inverse localization length of the end mode. Locate the topological transition where it changes sign, and compare with the Brouwer-Akhmerov analytic phase boundary and with finite-chain BdG spectra.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Sau heterostructure: Chern number of a 2D Rashba-Zeeman s-wave superconductor
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Discretize the 2D Rashba electron gas with Zeeman field and s-wave pairing on a square lattice, then diagonalize the 4×4 BdG Bloch Hamiltonian. Compute the BdG Chern number on a k-mesh and verify the topological criterion Vz > √(Δ²+μ²).

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Plasmon eigenmodes of a 2D electron ribbon from a discretized Coulomb kernel
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Discretize the electrostatic integral equation linking charge density and potential across a 2DEG strip in the Drude limit to obtain a symmetric eigenproblem. Compute frequencies and charge profiles of the transverse plasmon modes versus longitudinal wavevector and compare them with the bulk √q dispersion.

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Magnetoplasmons and Bernstein-mode anticrossings in a 2DEG
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Build the magnetized RPA polarizability of a 2D electron gas as a sum over Landau-level transitions with Laguerre form factors. Find the zeros of the dielectric function versus q to trace the magnetoplasmon branch and its anticrossings near harmonics nω_c, and compare with ω² = ω_c² + ω_p²(q).

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Scale-free localization in a Hatano-Nelson chain with weak boundary coupling
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize a Hatano-Nelson chain whose end-to-end hopping interpolates between open and periodic boundaries. Show that the localization length of the skin modes grows in proportion to system length in the intermediate regime, and track the crossover through spectral winding and eigenvector profiles.
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.area: Non-Hermitian band theory and skin effect

physics/condensed_matter|linalg.title: Neutron-weighted generalized phonon DOS versus true DOS in a CsCl-type crystal
physics/condensed_matter|linalg.gist: Diagonalize a nearest- and next-nearest-neighbor force-constant model of a B2 diatomic crystal on a Monkhorst-Pack grid. Compute the partial phonon DOS and the σ/M-weighted generalized DOS with Debye-Waller factors, and quantify the spectral distortion this introduces for different cross-section ratios.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Self-consistent Fermi level with multiple charged defects in n-type GaN
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Given formation energies and charge states of V_N, V_Ga, O_N and C_N, plus Fermi-Dirac carrier statistics with a parabolic DOS, solve the charge-neutrality equation for E_F. Use Newton iteration with an analytic derivative to obtain E_F, carrier densities and defect concentrations as functions of growth temperature and quench temperature.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Anisotropic Ewald point-charge correction for defects in wurtzite ZnO
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Compute the Madelung energy of a periodic point charge in a medium with a full dielectric tensor ε. The anisotropic Ewald sum uses ε^-1 and det ε in real and reciprocal space, and the result gives the image-charge correction for a charged defect in supercells of various shapes.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Brouwer diagram of a nonstoichiometric oxide from log-linear mass action
materials/structure|linalg.gist: For an oxide MO with V_O, V_M, electrons and holes, write each Brouwer regime as a linear system in log concentrations from mass-action laws plus the dominant neutrality condition. Solve each system to obtain slopes versus log pO2, then solve the full nonlinear system numerically to construct the complete diagram.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Elastic dipole tensor and relaxation volume of a self-interstitial
materials/structure|linalg.gist: From the atomic forces around a relaxed <100> dumbbell interstitial in a pair-potential fcc supercell, compute the elastic dipole tensor P_ij = Σ f_i r_j. Diagonalize it to obtain the principal components and anisotropy, and obtain the relaxation volume through the compliance tensor.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Indexing cubic powder patterns by sin^2θ ratios and extinction rules
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Given peak 2θ values, search for the integer sequence h^2+k^2+l^2 consistent with the observed sin^2θ ratios and identify P, I or F centering. Refine a by linear least squares on Q = (h^2+k^2+l^2)/a^2, then compute the de Wolff M20.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Hexagonal and tetragonal indexing by two-parameter Q-space least squares
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Assign (hk,l) indices so that Q = A·(h^2+hk+k^2) or A·(h^2+k^2) plus C·l^2. Enumerate candidate assignments of the lowest lines, solve the 2x2 linear system for (A, C), and rank the trial cells by the number of indexed lines and M20.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Reciprocal metric tensor refinement with zero-shift and esd from covariance
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Refine the six components of the reciprocal metric tensor G* plus a 2θ zero offset from indexed peaks using linearized weighted least squares. Convert to direct-cell parameters and propagate uncertainties through the Jacobian of the G* to (a, b, c, α, β, γ) transformation.

materials/structure|linalg.title: TREOR-style trial-and-error monoclinic indexing from four base lines
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Choose four low-angle lines, enumerate small-hkl assignments, and solve the 4x4 linear system for the monoclinic Q-form coefficients. Reject non-positive-definite metrics, index the remaining lines within a tolerance, and return the best cells ranked by M20 and F_N.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Dichotomy indexing of orthorhombic powder patterns by interval bisection
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Implement DICVOL-style successive halving of the (a, b, c) parameter boxes, computing interval bounds on Q(hkl) for each box and keeping boxes in which every observed line lies within some hkl interval. Finish with least-squares refinement of the surviving cells and M20 ranking.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Lattice basis recovery from 3D electron diffraction spot vectors via LLL
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Given noisy reciprocal-space spot positions from a rotation series, form difference vectors and apply LLL basis reduction to find a short basis. Solve for integer indices by least squares, refine the UB matrix, and report the fraction of spots indexed.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Nelson-Riley extrapolation for precise cubic lattice parameters
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Compute the apparent a from each indexed reflection of a cubic powder pattern. Fit a linear least-squares regression of a against the Nelson-Riley function (cos^2θ/sinθ + cos^2θ/θ) to extrapolate a at θ = 90°, and compare with a Cohen-method simultaneous fit that includes a drift term.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Two-beam Bloch-wave rocking curve and pendellösung in Si 220
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Construct the 2x2 Bloch-wave structure matrix from the extinction distance and deviation parameter, and diagonalize it to obtain the Bloch wavevectors and excitation coefficients. Compute the transmitted and diffracted intensities versus thickness and tilt, and check the pendellösung period against ξ_g.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Zone-axis CBED intensities for Al [001] with complex absorptive potential
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Assemble the non-Hermitian Bloch matrix for all beams inside a g-cutoff at the [001] zone axis, including imaginary absorptive Fourier components. Solve the general eigenproblem and form the scattering amplitude through C diag(exp(iγt)) C^-1 ψ0 to obtain disk intensities across the illumination cone.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Dispersion surface branches and anticrossings in three-beam diffraction
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Compute the eigenvalues of a three-beam (0, g, 2g) structure matrix as a function of tilt to trace the dispersion surface branches. Locate the anticrossing gaps, relate their widths to effective Bethe-coupled potentials, and verify the result against second-order perturbation theory.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Critical voltage determination in Ni from systematic-row eigenvalue degeneracy
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Include the relativistic mass correction in the systematic-row Bloch matrix and scan the accelerating voltage to find where two Bloch-wave eigenvalues become degenerate at the second-order Bragg condition. Determine the critical voltage by root finding on the eigenvalue gap.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Kinematically forbidden GaAs 002 via scattering-matrix exponential
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Compute the scattering matrix S = exp(iAt) both by eigendecomposition and with scipy.linalg.expm for a many-beam GaAs [110] systematic row. Check unitarity in the non-absorbing case and obtain the dynamically excited, kinematically weak 002 intensity versus thickness.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Borrmann anomalous absorption from Bloch-state imaginary eigenvalue shifts
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Treat the absorptive potential by first-order perturbation, using the expectation of iV' over the Bloch eigenvectors of the Hermitian two-beam matrix, and compare with exact non-Hermitian diagonalization. Compute the branch-dependent absorption lengths and the transmitted intensity enhancement at the Bragg condition.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Bethe potentials: accuracy of weak-beam perturbative reduction versus full diagonalization
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Reduce an N-beam Bloch matrix to strong beams by adding weak-beam contributions as Bethe potentials, and compare the reduced eigenvalues and diffracted intensities with full diagonalization. Quantify the error as a function of the strong/weak cutoff in excitation error.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Bunge Euler angles, quaternions and rotation matrices: consistent conversions
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Implement conversions among Bunge ZXZ Euler angles, unit quaternions, axis-angle and rotation matrices under a passive convention, including the gimbal-lock cases at Φ = 0 and π. Verify round-trip errors and orthogonality on random orientations sampled uniformly from SO(3).

materials/structure|linalg.title: Detecting {10-12} twin boundaries in hcp titanium from EBSD orientations
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Apply the 12 hexagonal symmetry operators to compute disorientations between neighboring hcp grains. Identify extension twins by matching to the 85.2°<11-20> relation within a tolerance, converting Miller-Bravais axes to Cartesian coordinates using the c/a ratio.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Mean grain orientation by quaternion eigen-averaging with symmetry
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Compute the mean orientation of a noisy cubic grain as the principal eigenvector of Σ q q^T, after first moving each quaternion to the symmetry variant closest to a reference. Report the mean orientation and the orientation spread from the eigenvalue ratios.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Kernel ODF estimation and texture index from discrete orientations
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Estimate an orientation distribution function on an SO(3) grid by summing de la Vallée Poussin kernels over symmetry-equivalent orientations. Compute the texture index ∫f^2 dg and the (111) pole figure through rotation matrix actions on crystal directions.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Kernel average misorientation map on a square EBSD grid
materials/structure|linalg.gist: For a 2D grid of cubic orientations containing a simulated bent grain, compute the symmetry-reduced misorientation to nearest and second-nearest neighbors below a threshold. Average these into a KAM map and estimate the geometrically necessary dislocation density through ρ ≈ 2θ/(u b).

materials/structure|linalg.title: Voigt-Reuss-Hill elastic moduli of textured cubic polycrystal via tensor rotation
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Rotate the 4th-rank stiffness tensor of copper into the sample frame for each orientation in a fiber texture, then average the stiffness (Voigt) and the compliance (Reuss, via matrix inversion of the 6x6 Voigt matrix). Compute the directional Young's moduli and the Hill averages.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Periodic Voronoi cell volumes and face counts in bcc, fcc and A15
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Replicate atoms with periodic images and run scipy.spatial.Voronoi, keeping the cells of central atoms. Compute cell volumes by tetrahedral decomposition and face areas by polygon triangulation, verify that the volumes sum to the cell volume, and recover the 14-face bcc and 12-face fcc polyhedra.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Bond-valence sums and global instability index for perovskite oxides
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Use a periodic neighbor list to compute bond valences s = exp((R0 − R)/b) and the cation and anion bond-valence sums in SrTiO3, CaTiO3 and a distorted BaTiO3 cell. Compute the global instability index and its variation under a strain applied through the cell matrix.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Least-squares fitting of bond-valence parameters R0 from reference structures
materials/structure|linalg.gist: From a set of cation coordination environments with known oxidation states, fit R0 (and optionally b) by nonlinear least squares, using Gauss-Newton with the Jacobian of the bond-valence sums. Report the parameter covariance and the resulting BVS residuals.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Hoppe effective coordination number by self-consistent weighted mean bond length
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Iteratively compute the weighted mean bond length and the effective coordination number ECoN = Σ exp[1 − (l_i/l_av)^6] for cations in distorted polyhedra, such as Jahn-Teller Cu2+ and V5+ in vanadates. Compare the results with cutoff-based coordination numbers.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Octahedral distortion via Kabsch alignment to an ideal octahedron
materials/structure|linalg.gist: For each BO6 octahedron in a tilted perovskite, find the best-fit ideal octahedron by scaling plus SVD-based rotation (Kabsch). Compute the continuous shape measure, the bond-angle variance and the quadratic elongation, and extract the octahedral tilt angles from the rotation matrix.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Radical Voronoi (power) tessellation of a binary ionic crystal via lifted hull
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Lift points with weights r_i^2 to 4D (x, |x|^2 − r_i^2) and compute the lower convex hull to obtain the power diagram dual. Compute ion-specific radical Voronoi volumes for NaCl and CsCl structures with ionic radii and compare them with ordinary Voronoi volumes.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Delaunay interstitial voids and largest-insertable-sphere in zeolite frameworks
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Compute the periodic Delaunay tetrahedralization of framework atoms and the circumsphere of each tetrahedron by solving a 3x3 linear system. Subtract atomic radii to obtain void radii, then find the largest included sphere and the void size distribution.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Schmid factors of fcc slip systems and primary system over the stereographic triangle
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Enumerate the 12 {111}<110> slip systems and compute Schmid factors m = (n·l)(b·l) for loading directions over the standard triangle. Identify the primary system, map the maximum m, and locate orientations where duplex slip occurs.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Non-Schmid tension-compression asymmetry for bcc {112}<111> twinning/antitwinning
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Enumerate the 48 bcc slip systems and compute resolved shear stresses for an arbitrary stress tensor. Apply an effective non-Schmid criterion with a twinning/antitwinning sense factor and additional non-glide stress components, and map the tension-versus-compression yield asymmetry across orientations.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Slip mode activation in hcp Mg with CRSS-weighted Schmid analysis
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Convert basal, prismatic and pyramidal <c+a> systems from Miller-Bravais to Cartesian coordinates. For given CRSS ratios, determine the yield stress τ_c/m for each loading orientation and map which mode activates first across the hcp stereographic triangle.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Taylor factor of fcc crystals by linear programming minimum shear
materials/structure|linalg.gist: For an imposed deviatoric strain, solve min Σ|γ_s| subject to Σ γ_s P_s = ε using scipy linprog with split positive/negative shears. Compute the Taylor factor M for orientations and its random-texture average (~3.06), and report the active slip set.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Bishop-Hill maximum-work stress states and Taylor yield locus of textured sheet
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Use the 56 Bishop-Hill stress vertices to compute the maximum work per crystal. Average over a rolling texture to construct the plane-stress yield locus and compute the Lankford r-values versus tensile direction.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Tensile-axis lattice rotation and overshoot in single-slip fcc crystal
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Integrate the rate-independent single-crystal kinematics: the plastic velocity gradient from the active systems, followed by the lattice spin needed to keep the tensile axis fixed. Track the axis toward [101]-[112] and quantify overshoot with latent hardening.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Viscoplastic Taylor stress solve with Newton iteration on power-law slip
materials/structure|linalg.gist: For each grain, solve Σ_s P_s γ0 |τ_s/τ_c|^n sgn(τ_s) = D for the deviatoric stress by Newton's method with the analytic 5x5 Jacobian. Average to obtain the polycrystal stress and compare with the rate-independent limit as n increases.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Luster-Morris slip transfer factor m' across grain boundaries
materials/structure|linalg.gist: For neighboring grain orientations, rotate the slip plane normals and directions to the sample frame and compute m' = cosψ cosκ for all incoming/outgoing system pairs. Weight the pairs by Schmid factors to predict slip transmission, and compute the distribution for random boundaries versus Σ3 boundaries.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Hessian vibrational spectrum and boson peak of jammed soft-sphere packings
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Minimize a bidisperse harmonic soft-sphere packing near jamming with conjugate gradients and assemble its sparse Hessian. Diagonalize it to obtain the density of states, the reduced D(ω)/ω^2 boson peak and the participation ratios, all as functions of compression above φ_J.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Non-affine shear modulus of amorphous solids via Hessian pseudoinverse
materials/structure|linalg.gist: For an energy-minimized 2D Lennard-Jones glass, compute the affine Born modulus and the force-response vectors Ξ. Subtract Ξ^T H^+ Ξ using a pseudoinverse that excludes zero modes, compare against finite-strain shear simulations, and quantify the non-affine fraction.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Keating-model vibrational density of states of amorphous silicon
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Build the analytic Keating Hessian (bond-stretch α and bond-bend β terms) for a 4-coordinated periodic CRN and diagonalize it. Compute the VDOS, mode localization via the inverse participation ratio, and the TA/TO peak positions compared with crystalline Si.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Ring counting in silica networks via non-backtracking adjacency matrices
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Count simple cycles of length up to 10 in a periodic SiO2 CRN using traces of powers of the non-backtracking (Hashimoto) matrix, corrected for composite cycles, and compare with explicit shortest-path primitive rings. Report the ring-size distribution.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Tikhonov-regularized inversion of truncated S(q) to pair distribution function
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Discretize the sine-Fourier relation between g(r) and S(q) as a linear operator. Recover g(r) from noisy, truncated S(q) of amorphous carbon by Tikhonov-regularized least squares with an L-curve choice of λ, and compare termination ripples with direct Fourier inversion.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Random close packing by force-biased overlap removal with Voronoi analysis
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Generate monodisperse hard-sphere packings by the Jodrey-Tory/force-biased algorithm with progressive diameter shrinkage until no overlaps remain, approaching φ ≈ 0.64. Analyze the contact numbers and the distribution of Voronoi indices ⟨n3, n4, n5, n6⟩.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Unrelaxed and z-relaxed {111}<112> gamma line of fcc Cu with EAM
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Rigidly shift the upper half of an fcc slab along <112> using a Johnson-type analytic EAM, with optional relaxation of z coordinates only. Extract the unstable and intrinsic stacking-fault energies and compare the two branches.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Full {111} gamma surface and least-squares Fourier fit
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Compute the generalized stacking fault energy on a 2D grid of shifts over the fcc {111} plane cell. Fit a symmetry-adapted Fourier series by linear least squares, then use the fit to locate the stable and unstable points and the minimum-energy path between them.

materials/structure|linalg.title: bcc W {110}<111> and {112}<111> gamma lines with Finnis-Sinclair potential
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Build bcc slabs oriented for {110} and {112} planes using rotation matrices, apply rigid shifts along <111>, and evaluate Finnis-Sinclair energies. Compare the gamma-line shapes and maxima, and show the absence of a stable intrinsic fault in bcc.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Basal plane I2 stacking fault and gamma surface of hcp Mg
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Construct hcp basal slabs and compute the gamma surface for shifts along <10-10> and <11-20> with an EAM potential. Extract the I2 intrinsic fault energy and the unstable fault energy, and compare with ANNNI estimates obtained from polytype energies.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Atomic reconstruction in twisted bilayer graphene from GSFE plus elasticity
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Minimize the continuum energy of a small-angle twisted bilayer, consisting of in-plane linear elasticity plus a Fourier-fitted GSFE of local registry. Use a plane-wave basis for the displacement field and Newton/linear solves, then compute the AB domain fraction and domain-wall width versus twist angle.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Interstitial site radii in fcc, hcp and bcc via circumsphere linear solves
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Identify the tetrahedral and octahedral interstitial sites as Delaunay simplex circumcenters by solving the linear system for equidistant points. Compute the maximum interstitial radii relative to the host radius, the packing fractions, and the site multiplicities per atom.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Transfer-matrix free energy of stacking disorder in ANNNI close-packed crystals
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Build the transfer matrix for the ANNNI stacking Hamiltonian with J1, J2 interactions over pairs of consecutive hexagonality spins. Compute the free energy from the largest eigenvalue and the correlation length of stacking order from the eigenvalue ratio, both versus temperature.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Zhdanov, Jagodzinski and stacking-fault classification of ABC sequences
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Convert between ABC stacking, h/c (Jagodzinski) and Zhdanov notations, compute the hexagonality, and generate atomic coordinates for each polytype. Identify the intrinsic, extrinsic and twin faults inserted in fcc stacking by comparing local h/c patterns.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Ewald Madelung energies of ZnS and SiC tetrahedral polytypes
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Generate the cells and point charges of zincblende, wurtzite, 4H and 6H, and compute their Madelung energies with a full Ewald sum using the reciprocal lattice from the cell matrix inverse. Rank the polytypes and relate the differences to the hexagonality.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Stacking-layer correlation decay from transition-matrix powers in disordered hcp
materials/structure|linalg.gist: For a stacking Markov chain with finite fault probability, compute the probability that layers n apart share the same position using powers of the transition matrix. Fit the exponential decay rate from its subleading eigenvalue and relate it to the diffraction peak width.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Layer stacking polytypes of MoS2 (1T, 2H, 3R) and registry geometry
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Construct the 1T, 2H and 3R MoS2 cells from layer-shift and rotation operations applied to fractional coordinates. Compute the interlayer S-S registry distances, the c-axis periodicity and the stacking-dependent coordination of Mo, and verify the results by symmetry checks.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Debye scattering of Au cuboctahedral clusters versus Bragg positions
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Generate magic-number fcc cuboctahedra and compute I(q) by the Debye pair sum with Au atomic form factors. Compare the peak positions and widths with bulk Bragg peaks and the Scherrer prediction as a function of size.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Histogram-accelerated Debye equation and bin-width error analysis
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Replace the O(N^2) Debye sum with a weighted pair-distance histogram computed using scipy.spatial.distance or a KD-tree. Quantify the intensity error versus bin width and q range, and verify that the speedup is consistent with the q·Δr < 1 criterion.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Icosahedral, decahedral and cuboctahedral nanoparticle powder pattern discrimination
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Construct Mackay icosahedra, Ino decahedra and cuboctahedra of equal atom count, and compute their Debye patterns and pair distribution functions. Identify the morphology-specific features, such as peak splitting and shifts near 111/200, using difference metrics.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Multi-element Debye scattering of CdSe/CdS core-shell quantum dots
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Build wurtzite core-shell nanocrystals with element-specific form factors and compute the partial Debye sums for each element pair. Separate the core and shell contributions and the cross-term interference as a function of shell thickness.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Guinier radius of gyration and inertia-tensor shape from Debye intensity
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Compute the small-q Debye intensity of nanorods and platelets and fit the Guinier law ln I = ln I0 − q^2 R_g^2/3. Compare R_g with the value from the eigenvalues of the atomic inertia tensor, and infer the aspect ratio from those eigenvalues.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Nanoparticle size distribution from powder pattern by non-negative least squares
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Build a basis of Debye patterns for spherical Pd nanoparticles of several diameters and fit a noisy measured pattern with scipy NNLS. Add Tikhonov smoothing, recover the size distribution, and compare its mean with the Scherrer estimate.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Nanoparticle PDF with spherical shape envelope versus bulk
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Compute the reduced PDF G(r) of a spherical Ni nanoparticle from its pair distances and compare it with the bulk G(r) multiplied by the analytic spherical characteristic function. Fit the particle diameter by least squares on the envelope.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Thermal damping of Debye intensity from Einstein-model displacement ensembles
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Average the Debye intensity over configurations with Gaussian atomic displacements, with variance taken from the eigenvalues of the cluster's harmonic Hessian. Compare the result with applying an exp(−q^2⟨u^2⟩) Debye-Waller factor, and show the size dependence of surface-enhanced vibrations.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Graphene fourth-nearest-neighbour force-constant phonon dispersion and flexural ZA branch
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Assemble the 6x6 graphene dynamical matrix from radial, in-plane and out-of-plane force constants out to fourth neighbours, and diagonalize along Γ-M-K-Γ. Fit the quadratic curvature of the ZA branch near Γ and the TA/LA sound velocities.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Phonon group velocities in diamond Si from Hellmann-Feynman derivatives of D(k)
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Use an analytic Keating-model dynamical matrix of crystalline Si and compute v = <e|∂D/∂k|e>/(2ω). Degenerate branches are handled by diagonalizing ∂D/∂k within each degenerate subspace, and the results are checked against finite differences along Γ-X and Γ-L.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Finite-displacement supercell force constants with acoustic sum-rule projection
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Displace atoms in an LJ fcc supercell and build real-space force constants from finite-difference forces. Symmetrize them and enforce the acoustic sum rule by orthogonal projection, then Fourier-interpolate D(k) and compare with the analytic dispersion.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Localized vibrational mode of a light substitutional impurity via phonon Green's function
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Compute the host fcc lattice Green's function G(ω) by Brillouin-zone summation of eigenmodes, and solve the Lifshitz condition 1 - ε ω² G(ω) = 0 for the local mode above the band edge. Project the impurity-site spectral density.

materials/structure|linalg.title: First-order thermal diffuse scattering around Bragg peaks of fcc Al
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Evaluate the one-phonon TDS intensity Σ_j |Q·e_j|²(2n+1)/ω_j on a grid around the (200) and (220) reciprocal points, using diagonalization of a Born-von Karman dynamical matrix. Report the anisotropic diffuse intensity maps.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Anisotropic displacement parameters of an hcp metal from phonon eigenvectors
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Diagonalize a Born-von Karman hcp dynamical matrix on a k-mesh and accumulate the mean-square displacement tensor U = Σ e e† (2n+1)ħ/(2Nmω). Report U11 and U33 versus temperature and the resulting anisotropic Debye-Waller factors.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Shell-model phonons of NaI with adiabatic elimination of shell coordinates
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Build core-core, core-shell and shell-shell force-constant blocks for a rocksalt Dick-Overhauser shell model. Eliminate the massless shells by a Schur complement at each k, then diagonalize along Γ-X-L and compare with the rigid-ion model.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Rayleigh surface phonons of an fcc(100) Lennard-Jones slab
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Construct the 2D-periodic dynamical matrix of an N-layer fcc(100) slab with free surfaces, diagonalize along Γ̄-X̄, and identify surface-localized modes by their layer-resolved eigenvector weight. Overlay the bulk bands projected onto the surface Brillouin zone.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Zone-centre modes of monolayer 2H-MoS2 and irreducible representation labels
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Build the Γ-point dynamical matrix of an MoS2 monolayer using Mo-S and S-S spring constants. Diagonalize it, then apply D3h projection operators to assign each mode to A1', E', E'' or A2'' and identify the Raman- and IR-active modes.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Phonon band unfolding in a mass-disordered simple-cubic supercell
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the dynamical matrix of a supercell with random binary masses, and unfold the eigenvectors onto the primitive Brillouin zone through plane-wave projection weights. This gives a configuration-averaged spectral function A(k,ω) along Γ-X with disorder broadening.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Kurdjumov-Sachs variants and inter-variant misorientations in lath martensite
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Generate the 24 KS orientation matrices of bcc martensite inside an fcc parent from the plane and direction parallelism conditions. Compute cubic-symmetry-reduced misorientations between all variant pairs and group them into the standard V1-V24 classes.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Phenomenological martensite crystallography: habit plane from invariant plane strain
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Combine the Bain strain with a lattice-invariant shear, find the shear magnitude for which the total deformation has a unit middle eigenvalue (Wechsler-Lieberman-Read), and solve for the habit plane normal, the shape strain and the orientation relationship of Fe-30Ni.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Burgers orientation relationship and parent-β reconstruction in titanium
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Generate the 12 α variants of the Burgers OR from a β orientation. Given a set of measured α orientations, recover the parent β orientation by testing candidate parents for minimal summed disorientation to the variants.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Hexagonal disorientation reduction into the Rodrigues fundamental zone
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Apply the 12 proper hcp symmetry operators as quaternions on both sides of a misorientation together with the switching symmetry. Select the minimum-angle representation that satisfies the fundamental-zone inequalities, and tabulate the axis distribution for random pairs.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Pole figures and inverse pole figure coloring from orientation sets
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Rotate the symmetry-equivalent {hkl} poles by each orientation matrix and bin them on an equal-area Lambert projection normalized to multiples of random density. Map the sample axes into the cubic standard triangle to produce IPF coordinates.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Nye tensor and geometrically necessary dislocation density from EBSD gradients
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Compute lattice curvature from finite-difference misorientations between neighbouring EBSD pixels and form the Nye tensor. Decompose it into fcc edge and screw dislocation densities by minimum-norm least squares with a pseudoinverse.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Rolling texture component volume fractions from discrete orientations
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Represent the ideal Copper, Brass, S, Goss and Cube components as rotation matrices and compute the cubic-symmetry-reduced misorientation of every grain to each one. Assign volume fractions within a 15° tolerance and compare with a random reference.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Fiber texture ODF from pole figures by Legendre least squares
materials/structure|linalg.gist: For an axially symmetric fiber texture, expand the axis distribution in even Legendre polynomials and set up the linear projection relations to measured pole figures of several {hkl}. Solve for the coefficients by regularized least squares and report the texture index.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Frank-Bilby dislocation content of low-angle grain boundaries
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Apply the Frank-Bilby equation B = (I - R⁻¹)v for an arbitrary low-angle misorientation and boundary plane. Decompose B into fcc Burgers vectors by least squares, and compute the dislocation line directions and spacings for tilt, twist and mixed boundaries.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Bollmann O-lattice of a general cubic boundary
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Solve (I - A⁻¹)X = b for every lattice vector b to obtain O-lattice points for a twist misorientation, using the pseudoinverse when the problem is degenerate. Compute the O-cell volume and compare the cell sizes with CSL periodicity and dislocation spacing.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Triple-junction dihedral angles from boundary energies via Young force balance
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Solve the vector force balance of three boundary tensions in 2D (law of sines) for the dihedral angles, extend to torque terms with a linearized Herring equation, and invert measured angles back to relative boundary energies by least squares.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Grain boundary stiffness from capillary fluctuation spectrum
materials/structure|linalg.gist: From a time series of boundary height profiles, compute Fourier amplitudes |h(k)|² and fit kT/(A Γ k²) by linear regression in 1/k² to obtain the stiffness. Error bars come from block averaging, and the procedure is validated on synthetic Langevin-generated profiles.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Anisotropic Potts grain growth with inertia-tensor grain shape analysis
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Run Q-state Potts Monte Carlo on a square lattice with misorientation-dependent boundary energy. Label grains, compute each grain's second-moment inertia tensor and its eigenvalues, and track the mean aspect ratio and the grain-area growth exponent.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Five-parameter boundary plane normal from serial-section trace analysis
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Given boundary trace directions on two or more sections and the orientations of both grains, compute the boundary normal as the least-squares null vector of the stacked trace constraints. Transform it into both crystal frames and identify the low-index plane it lies near.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Niggli reduced cell by the Křivý-Gruber algorithm
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Implement the Křivý-Gruber reduction steps on the metric parameters (A,B,C,ξ,η,ζ) with tolerances, while tracking the accumulated integer transformation matrix. Test it on skewed supercells of known lattices and recover the unique Niggli cell and its Bravais type.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Miller-Bravais four-index conversions and angles in hcp crystals
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Convert hcp directions and planes between [uvtw] and [UVW] notation, form the hexagonal metric tensor for a given c/a, and compute angles between directions, between plane normals and between slip directions. Results are verified against Cartesian cross products for Mg and Ti.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Hermite normal form enumeration of symmetry-distinct supercells
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Enumerate all integer HNF matrices of a given determinant for fcc (Hart-Forcade). Remove matrices equivalent under the 48 point operations by comparing reduced HNFs of rotated lattices, and report the number of inequivalent supercells for each size.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Principal thermal expansion tensor of a monoclinic crystal
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Fit temperature-dependent a,b,c,β data with polynomials, and construct the strain tensor relative to a reference cell from the lattice vector matrices. Diagonalize the derivative tensor at each T to obtain principal expansion coefficients and their axis orientations relative to the crystal axes.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Lattice point group from integer metric-preserving matrices
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Enumerate integer matrices W with entries in {-1,0,1} that satisfy WᵀGW = G within a tolerance, using the reduced metric G. Identify the holohedry and crystal system from the group order and determinant and trace statistics, including for pseudosymmetric cells.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Space-group orbits and Wyckoff multiplicities from Seitz generators
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Generate the full set of 4x4 affine Seitz matrices of a space group (such as Pnma or Fd-3m) by closure under multiplication modulo lattice translations. Apply them to fractional positions to obtain orbits, multiplicities and site-symmetry group orders.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Carbon nanotube atomic structure generation from chiral indices (n,m)
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Compute the chiral and translation vectors, the number of hexagons per unit cell and the diameter. Map graphene coordinates onto the cylinder by a rolling transformation, then check the bond lengths and number of atoms for armchair, zigzag and chiral tubes.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Pseudomorphic film strain on an arbitrary (hkl) substrate
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Rotate the cubic stiffness tensor into a frame with z along (hkl), impose the in-plane lattice-matching strain, and solve the 3x3 linear system σ_i3 = 0 for the out-of-plane strain components. Report the tetragonal distortion and the shear strains, for example for SiGe on Si(001), (110) and (111).

materials/structure|linalg.title: Lennard-Jones argon equation of state and bulk modulus from lattice sums
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Compute the Lennard-Jones-Ingham lattice constants A12 and A6 for fcc by direct summation with tail correction. From these, obtain the equilibrium nearest-neighbour distance, the cohesive energy and the pressure-volume curve, and get the bulk modulus by fitting a Birch-Murnaghan EOS with linear least squares.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Pair potentials for metals and noble gases

materials/structure|linalg.title: Buckingham rigid-ion MgO lattice energy, lattice constant and elastic constants
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Combine the Ewald Coulomb sum with Buckingham short-range terms for rocksalt MgO. Minimize over the lattice constant, compute the strain Hessian for C11, C12 and C44, and compare the lattice energy with a Born-Haber estimate.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Pair potentials for metals and noble gases

materials/structure|linalg.title: Virial stress tensor of a strained pair-potential crystal
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Implement the atomic virial stress σ = -(1/V)Σ r⊗f for a Morse crystal under general homogeneous strain applied through the cell matrix. Validate it against numerical derivatives of the energy with respect to strain, and extract second- and third-order elastic constants.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Pair potentials for metals and noble gases

materials/structure|linalg.title: Johnson analytic EAM with Rose-equation embedding: cubic elastic constants
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Use exponential density and pair functions with an embedding function obtained by inverting the Rose universal EOS along the fcc dilation path. Compute C11, C12 and C44 from analytic second strain derivatives, and check the bulk modulus consistency for Ni.

materials/structure|linalg.title: EAM vacancy formation and divacancy binding energies in Ni
materials/structure|linalg.gist: With a Johnson-type EAM, remove one or two atoms from a periodic supercell and relax with L-BFGS. Compute the unrelaxed and relaxed monovacancy formation energies, the binding energies of first- and second-neighbour divacancies, and the convergence with supercell size.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Climbing-image nudged elastic band for vacancy migration in EAM Al
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Interpolate images between the initial and final vacancy-hop configurations. Apply spring forces with tangent-projected true forces and climbing-image removal of the parallel component, and relax with FIRE to obtain the migration barrier and the saddle geometry.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Finnis-Sinclair bcc Fe elastic constants and Cauchy pressure
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Implement the Finnis-Sinclair square-root embedding with polynomial cutoff functions for bcc Fe. Compute the lattice constant, cohesive energy and C11, C12 and C44 from homogeneous strain energy fits, and evaluate the Cauchy pressure C12 - C44 and the bcc Born stability criteria.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Multilayer surface relaxation of Ni(110) with EAM
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Relax a periodic Ni(110) slab with an EAM potential using conjugate gradient while holding the bottom layers fixed. Report the oscillatory interlayer relaxations Δd12 and Δd23 and the surface energy, and decompose the forces into embedding and pair contributions.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Dilute heat of solution of Ag in Cu with Johnson alloy EAM
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Construct the cross pair potential using the Johnson geometric-mean mixing rule. Relax a Cu supercell containing one Ag atom and compute the substitutional solution energy and the local lattice expansion, then compare with the size-mismatch elastic estimate.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Analytic EAM force constants and phonon dispersion of Ni
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Derive the second-derivative force-constant tensors of the EAM energy, including the many-body embedding cross terms through ρ', ρ'' and F''. Assemble D(k), diagonalize it along Γ-X-K-Γ-L, and check the result against finite-difference phonons.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Linear least-squares fitting of cubic-spline EAM pair and embedding coefficients
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Fix the density function and expand the pair and embedding functions in cubic-spline bases, so that energies and elastic constants become linear in the coefficients. Fit to target EOS points and C_ij by weighted least squares, and analyse the conditioning via SVD.

materials/structure|linalg.title: hcp Brillouin zone by halfspace intersection and high-symmetry k-path
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Form the Bragg bisector half-spaces for nearby reciprocal vectors of an hcp lattice with arbitrary c/a. Intersect them with scipy HalfspaceIntersection, identify the Γ, M, K, A, L and H points, and generate an evenly spaced Cartesian path with cumulative lengths.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Reciprocal lattice and Brillouin zone construction

materials/structure|linalg.title: Monkhorst-Pack irreducible k-points and weights by point-group reduction
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Generate shifted and unshifted MP meshes in fractional coordinates. Apply the reciprocal-space point-group operations (transposed inverses of the real-space rotations) to fold the mesh to the irreducible wedge, and return the weights and the reduction ratio for fcc and hexagonal cells.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Reciprocal lattice and Brillouin zone construction

materials/structure|linalg.title: Nearly-free-electron bands of fcc Al by plane-wave pseudopotential diagonalization
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Build the plane-wave Hamiltonian with kinetic terms |k+G|² and two local pseudopotential Fourier components V_111 and V_200, then diagonalize along W-L-Γ-X-W. Measure the band gaps at the zone boundaries and compare them with 2|V_G|.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Reciprocal lattice and Brillouin zone construction

materials/structure|linalg.title: Higher Brillouin zones of 2D square and hexagonal lattices
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Assign each k on a fine grid to its zone index by counting the Bragg bisector lines crossed from Γ, which is equivalent to ranking the distances to reciprocal lattice points. Verify that every zone has equal area and fold the higher zones back into the first.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Reciprocal lattice and Brillouin zone construction

materials/structure|linalg.title: FIRE versus conjugate gradient for a 2D Lennard-Jones crystal with interstitial
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Implement FIRE with adaptive time step and velocity mixing, and Polak-Ribière conjugate gradient with line search, on a periodic triangular LJ crystal containing a split interstitial. Compare the force-call counts needed to reach a given force tolerance and the final formation energies.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Dimer-method saddle search for adatom hopping on an LJ fcc(100) surface
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Find the lowest Hessian eigenmode by rotating a dimer with finite-difference forces (Rayleigh-Ritz). Translate along the inverted-force direction to converge on the hop and exchange saddle points, then verify each saddle by full Hessian diagonalization with one negative eigenvalue.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Exponential-preconditioned L-BFGS relaxation of large defective supercells
