materials/structure|linalg.gist: Build the sparse Packwood exponential preconditioner P_ij from neighbour distances and solve P s = -g by sparse Cholesky within L-BFGS. Benchmark the iteration counts against unpreconditioned L-BFGS for Morse-potential vacancy clusters as the supercell size grows.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Edge dislocation core in a 2D triangular LJ crystal by sparse Newton relaxation
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Seed an edge dislocation with the isotropic Volterra displacement field, fix the boundary atoms, and relax the core with Newton steps using a sparse Hessian and conjugate-gradient linear solves. Measure the core width and the core energy from the energy versus ln R.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Deviatoric strain from Laue microdiffraction spot positions
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Starting from an indexed Laue pattern, refine a deformed reciprocal basis (nine components minus scale) by nonlinear least squares on the unit plane-normal directions. Extract the deviatoric strain tensor and its sensitivity, then validate on synthetic strained patterns.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Coordination numbers from Gaussian-shell least-squares fit of bcc Fe RDF
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Model the first two neighbour shells of a thermally broadened bcc Fe radial distribution function as Gaussians and fit by nonlinear least squares with a Jacobian. Integrate to obtain coordination numbers 8 and 6, and report the shell-overlap-induced errors versus temperature.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Correlated-motion PDF peak sharpening from phonon eigenvectors
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Compute the pair-displacement variance <(u_i - u_j)·r̂_ij²> from a Born-von Karman phonon model summed over the Brillouin zone. Show the reduced PDF peak widths at low r relative to the uncorrelated 2U limit, and fit the Jeong δ/r correction.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Real-space Gauss-Newton refinement of lattice constant and ADP from PDF
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Fit a calculated fcc G(r) to target data by refining the lattice constant, the isotropic Uiso, the scale and Qdamp with Gauss-Newton or Levenberg-Marquardt using analytic Jacobians. Report the parameter correlation matrix and the Rw.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Box-car PDF refinement: local versus average structure in distorted perovskite
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Generate a cubic perovskite supercell with correlated local octahedral tilts that average to zero. Refine the cubic and tilted models by least squares over successive r-windows, and show that the tilt amplitude decays with fitting range.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Number density and normalization from the low-r slope of G(r)
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Fit the -4πρ0 r baseline below the first peak of an experimentally scaled G(r) by linear least squares, jointly with an S(Q) scale factor and a background polynomial. Recover the number density and normalization error of an amorphous model.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Internal-strain relaxation of graphene elastic constants via Hessian Schur complement
materials/structure|linalg.gist: For a valence-force-field graphene model, compute the full Hessian in strain and sublattice-shift coordinates. Eliminate the internal shift by a Schur complement to obtain the relaxed 2D C11 and C12, the Poisson ratio and the Kleinman-like internal strain parameter.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Atomistic Nye tensor from Hartley-Mishin lattice correspondence tensors
materials/structure|linalg.gist: For each atom, match neighbours to ideal fcc bond vectors and solve the least-squares lattice correspondence tensor G. Take finite-difference curls of G to obtain the per-atom Nye tensor, then integrate it over the core of a simulated dislocation to recover the Burgers vector.

materials/structure|linalg.title: X-ray sin²ψ residual stress tensor in ferrite by least squares
materials/structure|linalg.gist: From d-spacings measured at many (φ, ψ) tilts, set up the linear relation between lattice strain and the six strain tensor components. Solve by least squares, convert to stress with X-ray elastic constants, and report the uncertainties from the covariance.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Morse-potential structure map: sc, bcc, fcc, hcp stability versus range parameter
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Evaluate Morse lattice sums with a cutoff for sc, bcc, fcc and ideal hcp, minimize each energy with respect to lattice constant, and find the range parameter ρ at which the ground-state structure switches.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Pair potentials for metals and noble gases

materials/structure|linalg.title: CsCl, NaCl and zincblende stability of binary Lennard-Jones crystals
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Use Lorentz-Berthelot mixed LJ parameters and real-space lattice sums over sublattices to compute the minimized lattice energy of the B1, B2 and B3 structures. Map the stable structure as a function of the size ratio σB/σA.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Pair potentials for metals and noble gases

materials/structure|linalg.title: Kr monolayer on graphite: Steele corrugation and √3×√3 commensurate registry
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Build the Steele Fourier-expanded Kr-graphite potential on the hexagonal reciprocal lattice and add Kr-Kr LJ lattice sums. Compare commensurate √3 and relaxed incommensurate triangular monolayer energies per atom and find the misfit of the incommensurate phase.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Pair potentials for metals and noble gases

materials/structure|linalg.title: Morse 38-atom clusters: truncated octahedron versus icosahedron across range ρ
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Generate fcc truncated-octahedral, icosahedral and decahedral 38-atom Morse clusters and relax them with analytic gradients. Confirm true minima from Hessian eigenvalues (six zero modes) and locate the crossover value of ρ.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Pair potentials for metals and noble gases

materials/structure|linalg.title: Dynamical instability of bcc Lennard-Jones crystal from imaginary phonon branches
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Assemble the pair-potential dynamical matrix of the bcc LJ crystal at its equilibrium volume and diagonalize it along Γ-H-N-Γ-P. Identify the wavevectors and polarizations of imaginary modes and compare with the stable fcc spectrum.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Pair potentials for metals and noble gases

materials/structure|linalg.title: Vineyard harmonic TST prefactor for tetrahedral-site hydrogen hopping in bcc
materials/structure|linalg.gist: With a pair-potential model of an H interstitial in a relaxed bcc metal cluster, locate the tetrahedral minimum and the tet-tet saddle. Compute the Vineyard prefactor from the ratio of Hessian eigenvalue products and derive the Arrhenius diffusivity.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Diffusion pathways and nudged elastic band

materials/structure|linalg.title: H, D, T isotope effect from zero-point-corrected barriers and Wigner tunnelling
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Mass-weight the Hessians at the interstitial minimum and saddle and diagonalize them for each isotope to obtain zero-point-corrected barriers and quantum-corrected harmonic TST rates. Report Wigner tunnelling factors and the isotope ratios of the diffusion coefficients versus temperature.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Diffusion pathways and nudged elastic band

materials/structure|linalg.title: Snoek relaxation time of carbon in bcc Fe from master-equation eigenvalues
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Set up the three-state rate matrix for C occupying x, y and z octahedral sublattices, with stress-biased jump rates. Diagonalize it to obtain the relaxation time and the anelastic relaxation strength, and relate these to the diffusion coefficient.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Diffusion pathways and nudged elastic band

materials/structure|linalg.title: Anisotropic oxygen diffusivity in hcp Ti from a multi-site rate network
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Build the periodic network of octahedral, hexahedral and crystallographic interstitial sites with given barriers. Solve the stationary master equation and the Laplacian pseudoinverse (linear-response) problem to get the D_parallel and D_perp tensors versus temperature.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Diffusion pathways and nudged elastic band

materials/structure|linalg.title: Frenkel-pair recombination barrier in a 2D triangular LJ crystal via NEB
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Create vacancy-interstitial pairs at several separations in a 2D LJ crystal, relax the endpoints, and run climbing-image NEB with spring forces and tangent projections. Report the recombination barrier as a function of pair separation and the recombination radius below which no barrier exists.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Diffusion pathways and nudged elastic band

materials/structure|linalg.title: Generalized solid-state NEB for the B1-to-B2 transition in KCl
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Use a Born-Mayer rigid-ion potential with Ewald electrostatics and run a G-SSNEB that combines atomic and cell degrees of freedom through a Jacobian-scaled metric. Find the minimum energy path and barrier of the Buerger-type pathway at the equilibrium transition pressure.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Diffusion pathways and nudged elastic band

materials/structure|linalg.title: Rhombohedral Brillouin zones of α-dependent topology for bismuth-like lattices
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Construct the reciprocal basis of a rhombohedral lattice and build the Wigner-Seitz cell of the reciprocal lattice by Voronoi construction for α below and above 90°. Classify its faces and vertices and locate the T, L, F and X high-symmetry points.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Reciprocal lattice and Brillouin zone construction

materials/structure|linalg.title: Hume-Rothery electron concentrations from Fermi-sphere contact with Brillouin-zone faces
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Compute the inscribed-sphere radii of the fcc, bcc and hcp Brillouin zones from their nearest zone-boundary planes. Convert them to the critical electrons-per-atom at which a free-electron Fermi sphere first touches each zone face.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Reciprocal lattice and Brillouin zone construction

materials/structure|linalg.title: Moiré wavelength and mini-Brillouin zone under heterostrain in twisted bilayers
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Apply a twist plus uniaxial heterostrain to one hexagonal layer and form the moiré reciprocal vectors as differences of the layer reciprocal vectors. Derive the moiré lattice vectors, wavelengths, angles and mini-BZ by inverting the 2×2 reciprocal basis.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Reciprocal lattice and Brillouin zone construction

materials/structure|linalg.title: Surface Brillouin zones of fcc(111) and (110) and projected bulk points
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Build the 2D surface lattice and its reciprocal for a given (hkl) termination using an integer in-plane basis. Project the bulk fcc BZ high-symmetry points onto the surface BZ along the surface normal, modulo surface reciprocal vectors.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Reciprocal lattice and Brillouin zone construction

materials/structure|linalg.title: Face-centred orthorhombic Brillouin zone and automatic k-path labelling
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Build the FCO reciprocal lattice for the three axis-ratio cases, compute the BZ vertices by halfspace intersection, and assign Setyawan-Curtarolo labels using symmetry-distinct vertex and face-centre positions. Output a connected high-symmetry path with segment lengths.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Reciprocal lattice and Brillouin zone construction

materials/structure|linalg.title: bcc nearest-neighbour s-band tight binding along H-N-P and van Hove points
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Evaluate the s-band dispersion of the bcc lattice along a high-symmetry path and classify its critical points by the Hessian eigenvalue signatures of E(k). Compute the density of states by k-mesh histogramming to show the logarithmic van Hove features.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Reciprocal lattice and Brillouin zone construction

materials/structure|linalg.title: Satellite reflection positions of an incommensurately modulated crystal in (3+1)D
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Index main and satellite reflections H = ha* + kb* + lc* + mq for an incommensurate modulation vector q. Compute their d-spacings and 2θ, then refine q and the cell from observed satellite positions by linear least squares.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Reciprocal lattice and Brillouin zone construction

materials/structure|linalg.title: Pawley whole-pattern refinement of Si lattice parameter with linear intensities
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Fit a simulated Si powder pattern by treating the peak intensities and Chebyshev background as linear parameters inside a Gauss-Newton loop over the lattice parameter, zero shift and Caglioti widths. Report parameter esds from the normal-matrix inverse.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Le Bail iterative intensity partitioning for an overlapped tetragonal pattern
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Implement Le Bail extraction: partition observed counts among overlapping pseudo-Voigt reflections in proportion to their current model intensities, iterate to convergence, and refine the cell parameters a and c by nonlinear least squares. Compare extracted intensities with the true structure-factor values for rutile.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Hill-Howard quantitative phase analysis of rutile-anatase mixtures by Rietveld scales
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Fit a two-phase pattern with one scale factor per phase as linear parameters in a weighted least-squares model. Convert the scales to weight fractions using the ZMV products and propagate the scale-factor covariance to the fraction esds.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Caglioti U, V, W instrument resolution from fitted single-peak widths
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Fit isolated pseudo-Voigt peaks of a standard to obtain FWHMs, then solve for U, V and W by weighted linear least squares in tanθ subject to positivity of FWHM². Analyse parameter correlation through the condition number of the design matrix.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Variable-projection separable least squares for powder profile fitting
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Use the Golub-Pereyra variable-projection method to eliminate the linear background and intensity parameters through QR. Optimize only the nonlinear peak positions and widths, and compare convergence and minima with a full Levenberg-Marquardt fit.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Rietveld refinement of spinel oxygen parameter u and isotropic displacements
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Compute structure factors for MgAl2O4 in Fd-3m as a function of the oxygen u parameter and B factors, and build the full calculated pattern with Lorentz-polarization and profile functions. Refine scale, u, B and cell by Gauss-Newton with an analytic Jacobian.

materials/structure|linalg.title: March-Dollase preferred orientation refinement for platy calcite
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Multiply reflection intensities by the March-Dollase correction, which depends on the angle between each reflection and the preferred-orientation axis computed with the hexagonal metric tensor. Refine the March parameter r together with the scale by nonlinear least squares.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Bérar-Lelann correction of Rietveld esds for serially correlated residuals
materials/structure|linalg.gist: After a profile fit, compute the Durbin-Watson statistic and residual autocorrelation and apply the Bérar-Lelann scaling to the covariance-matrix esds. Use Monte Carlo resampling with correlated noise to show that the corrected esds match the empirical scatter.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Stephens anisotropic microstrain broadening in an orthorhombic powder pattern
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Implement the Stephens quartic-form strain broadening with S_HKL parameters allowed by orthorhombic symmetry. Fit hkl-dependent peak widths by linear least squares and plot the resulting directional microstrain surface.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Bond-length restrained Rietveld refinement via augmented least squares
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Add weighted bond-distance restraints, computed through the metric tensor, as extra rows of the least-squares system for a refinement of a molecular-crystal fragment. Study how the restraint weight trades off profile fit against geometry and affects parameter esds.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Rhombohedral-hexagonal setting transformations of metric tensors and Miller indices
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Apply obverse and reverse transformation matrices P to convert cell, metric tensor G' = PᵀGP, fractional coordinates and hkl between rhombohedral and hexagonal settings. Verify that volume ratios and d-spacings are invariant, and identify obverse/reverse settings by the -h+k+l=3n condition.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Bond lengths, angles and torsions with esds from cell and coordinate covariance
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Compute geometric quantities in triclinic fractional coordinates with the metric tensor. Propagate esds of cell parameters and atomic coordinates through analytic Jacobians to obtain uncertainties of distances, angles, torsions and cell volume.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Converting anisotropic displacement parameters between β, U, U_cart and U_eq
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Build orthogonalization matrices and reciprocal-length scalings to transform ADPs among the βij, Uij (crystal), U_cart and B conventions for a monoclinic crystal. Compute U_eq and thermal-ellipsoid principal axes by eigen-decomposition of U_cart.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Planar atomic density and 2D mesh of arbitrary (hkl) planes
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Find an integer basis of lattice vectors lying in the (hkl) plane with the extended Euclidean algorithm and Smith normal form, and compute the 2D mesh area and planar density for fcc, bcc and hcp. Rank planes by atomic density and interplanar spacing.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Wulff shape of a tetragonal crystal by halfspace intersection
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Convert facet Miller indices into Cartesian normals with the reciprocal metric and place facet planes at distances proportional to the surface energies. Build the Wulff polyhedron by halfspace intersection and report the facet area fractions and the shape-volume ratio.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Fincke-Pohst enumeration of lattice vectors and coordination shells in skewed cells
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Cholesky-factor the metric tensor of a highly oblique triclinic cell and enumerate all lattice vectors within a radius by Fincke-Pohst recursion. Group the vectors into coordination shells and validate against a brute-force search on the reduced cell.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Twin-law detection via near-metric-preserving matrices and obliquity
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Search integer matrices with small entries that nearly preserve the metric tensor of a pseudo-merohedral cell. Compute each candidate's obliquity and twin index, and identify the twin operation and its twin element.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Point group of molecules and clusters from inertia tensor and axis tests
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the inertia tensor to classify a structure as spherical, symmetric or asymmetric top, generate candidate rotation axes and mirror planes from atom positions, and test each operation by permutation matching within tolerance. Assign the point group for C60, SF6, CH4, ferrocene and a distorted cluster.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Space-group operation search for rutile TiO2 including fractional translations
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Combine lattice point-group candidate rotations with fractional translations generated by atom-pair differences, and keep operations that map the structure onto itself modulo lattice translations. Reconstruct the 16 operations of P4₂/mnm and identify the nonsymmorphic elements.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Symmetrizing noisy atomic coordinates by group averaging
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Given detected symmetry operations and the atom permutations they induce, project noisy positions onto the symmetric subspace by averaging the transformed coordinates (Reynolds operator). Quantify the residual displacement and verify that the symmetrized structure is exactly invariant.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Continuous symmetry measures of CuCl4 tetrahedra along the Td-to-D4h path
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Compute Pinsky-Avnir continuous symmetry measures by optimal SVD rotation over vertex permutations relative to ideal Td and D4h shapes. Trace the minimal distortion path of flattened CuCl4²⁻ tetrahedra and the deviation of real geometries from it.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Primitive cell recovery from a scrambled supercell by translation search
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Find all pure lattice translations mapping a supercell structure onto itself, form the translation lattice from these vectors and the supercell basis, and reduce it to a primitive basis by integer lattice reduction. Extract the primitive cell's atoms and verify the number of formula units.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Plane-group identification of 2D periodic structures
materials/structure|linalg.gist: For 2D lattices with basis atoms (honeycomb, kagome, Lieb, and distorted variants), detect the 2D lattice point group from integer metric-preserving matrices and search rotations, mirrors and glides with fractional translations. Assign one of the 17 plane groups within a tolerance.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Full Cu Kα powder XRD pattern of rutile with Cromer-Mann form factors
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Enumerate reflections and multiplicities by Laue-group orbits, compute structure factors with Cromer-Mann form factors and isotropic Debye-Waller factors, and apply Lorentz-polarization. Convolve with pseudo-Voigt Kα1/Kα2 doublets on a 2θ grid.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Neutron powder pattern of antiferromagnetic MnO with magnetic reflections
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Compute nuclear structure factors with neutron scattering lengths and magnetic structure factors for the type-II AFM doubled cell, using the Mn²⁺ magnetic form factor and the orientation factor 1-(ê·m̂)². Simulate the combined pattern and assign the half-integer magnetic peaks.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Finger-Cox-Jephcoat axial-divergence peak asymmetry in low-angle powder peaks
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Implement the FCJ asymmetric profile by numerically integrating over the divergence weighting and convolving with pseudo-Voigt profiles. Quantify the apparent peak shifts and asymmetry versus 2θ and the slit parameters S/L and H/L.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Superlattice reflection intensities of L12 Cu3Au versus long-range order
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Compute fundamental and superlattice structure factors for partially ordered Cu3Au as a function of the order parameter S. Simulate powder patterns and invert measured superlattice-to-fundamental intensity ratios for S by least squares.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Debye temperature from Wilson-plot fitting of temperature-dependent powder intensities
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Simulate intensities of an fcc metal at several temperatures with the Debye-model B(T), then recover B by linear least squares of ln(I_obs/I_calc) against sin²θ/λ². Invert B(T) to obtain the Debye temperature, separating static and thermal contributions.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Resonant powder contrast of B2 FeCo ordering near the Co K edge
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Include anomalous dispersion f' and f'' in the B2 structure factors to show how the weak superlattice contrast between Fe and Co is enhanced near an absorption edge. Find the energy that maximizes the superlattice-to-fundamental intensity ratio.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Energy-dispersive XRD pattern of a cubic material at fixed angle
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Compute reflection energies E = hc/(2d sinθ) at a fixed detector angle with a model white-beam spectrum, absorption and an energy-dependent detector resolution. Recover the lattice parameter under pressure by least squares on the peak energies.

materials/structure|linalg.title: 2D elastic constants of monolayer MoS2 with a Stillinger-Weber potential
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Apply in-plane strains to a monolayer MoS2 cell, relax the internal S/Mo coordinates, and fit the energy-strain data to obtain C11, C12, the 2D Young's modulus and the Poisson ratio. Compare with the unrelaxed (clamped-ion) values.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Thermal ripple height correlations from discrete plate normal modes
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Discretize a periodic tensionless elastic plate with bending rigidity κ and diagonalize its stiffness matrix. Use equipartition to compute the height-height correlation spectrum, the mean-square ripple amplitude, and its scaling with membrane size.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Tension-induced wrinkling of a clamped stretched sheet by eigen-buckling analysis
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Compute the in-plane prestress of a stretched rectangular sheet clamped at both ends, then solve the linear buckling eigenproblem for out-of-plane wrinkles. Compare the predicted wrinkle wavelength with the Cerda-Mahadevan scaling.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Interlayer shear and breathing modes of N-layer graphene
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Build the tridiagonal force-constant matrix of a linear chain of rigid graphene layers coupled by interlayer shear and compressive force constants. Diagonalize it to obtain Raman-active low-frequency mode frequencies versus N, and fit force constants to measured values.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Anisotropic directional Young's modulus and Poisson ratio of black phosphorene
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Starting from orthorhombic 2D elastic constants, invert the in-plane stiffness to compliance, rotate it, and compute E(θ) and ν(θ). Fit C11, C22, C12 and C66 from strain-energy data and identify the armchair and zigzag extremes.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Seung-Nelson buckling of a disclination in a triangulated elastic membrane
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Create a fivefold disclination in a triangular spring network with discrete bending energy and minimize it with and without out-of-plane displacement. Find the critical Föppl-von Kármán number for buckling into a cone and the energy scaling with radius.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Third-order Birch-Murnaghan fit by linear least squares in Eulerian strain
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Fit E-V data to a polynomial in Eulerian finite strain f = ((V0/V)^(2/3)-1)/2 by linear least squares. Convert the coefficients to E0, V0, B0 and B0' and propagate the covariance analytically.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Equations of state and bulk modulus

materials/structure|linalg.title: Weighted Vinet fit to P-V compression data with normalized-pressure diagnostics
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Fit the Vinet EOS to P-V data with uncertainties in both P and V using effective-variance weighted nonlinear least squares. Report the parameter covariance and V0-B0-B0' correlations and build the F-f normalized-pressure plot as a consistency check.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Equations of state and bulk modulus

materials/structure|linalg.title: EOS model selection among BM2, BM3 and BM4 by F-tests and AIC
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Fit nested Birch-Murnaghan orders to compression data by least squares. Compare them with F-statistics, AIC and parameter significance, and show how truncation bias in B0' depends on the maximum compression.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Equations of state and bulk modulus

materials/structure|linalg.title: Shock Hugoniot of copper from Vinet cold curve and Mie-Grüneisen
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Solve the Rankine-Hugoniot energy equation together with a Mie-Grüneisen EOS for pressure along the Hugoniot at each compression, using a Vinet reference curve. Convert the result to shock velocity versus particle velocity and fit the linear Us-up relation.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Equations of state and bulk modulus

materials/structure|linalg.title: <100> versus <111> self-interstitial dumbbell energies in EAM copper
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Insert split dumbbells of different orientations and an octahedral interstitial into an EAM Cu supercell and relax them with analytic forces. Compare formation energies, relaxation volumes and the stability of each configuration from Hessian eigenvalues.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Sutton-Chen fcc-bcc-hcp structural energy differences across exponents n and m
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Evaluate Sutton-Chen lattice sums for fcc, bcc and hcp, with energies minimized over lattice constant (and c/a for hcp). Map the stable structure and the fcc-hcp difference over the (n, m) exponent grid.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Antiphase boundary energy on {111} and {100} in Ni3Al with EAM
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Build L12 Ni3Al slabs, apply a ½<110> shift on {111} and {100}, and relax the atoms perpendicular to the fault plane with an alloy EAM. Compute APB energies and their anisotropy, which is relevant to Kear-Wilsdorf locking.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Size-dependent cohesive energy of Pt nanoparticles with second-moment tight binding
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Compute relaxed Rosato-Guillopé-Legrand energies of cuboctahedral and truncated-octahedral Pt clusters of increasing size. Decompose the excess energy into surface, edge and vertex contributions by linear least squares on coordination counts.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Octahedral versus tetrahedral hydrogen in Pd with EAM and zero-point energy
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Relax H at the octahedral and tetrahedral sites of an EAM Pd-H supercell, compute the local H vibrational modes from a mass-weighted Hessian, and add zero-point energies. Determine the preferred site and the isotope dependence of the site preference.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Effective-pair gauge transformation of EAM and normalization to the embedding curvature
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Apply the gauge transformations F(ρ) → F(ρ) + kρ, φ → φ - 2kf and ρ → sρ to an EAM potential and verify numerically that energies, forces and elastic constants are unchanged. Construct the 'effective pair' normalized form with F'(ρ_eq) = 0.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Stillinger-Weber germanium phonon dispersion along Γ-X-L from dynamical matrix
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Build real-space force constants for diamond Ge with a reparametrized SW potential by finite displacements. Diagonalize the 6×6 dynamical matrix along Γ-X-W-L-Γ and extract the optical-mode frequency at Γ and the TA(X) zone-boundary frequency.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Quasi-harmonic thermal expansion of Stillinger-Weber silicon
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Compute phonon frequencies on a Monkhorst-Pack grid at several volumes by diagonalizing SW dynamical matrices. Minimize the static energy plus vibrational free energy to get a(T) and α(T), and identify the sign of α at low temperature.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Tersoff hexagonal boron nitride lattice constant and 2D elastic constants
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Use a two-component Tersoff B-N potential to optimize the h-BN lattice constant. Compute C11 and C12 from homogeneous strains with sublattice internal relaxation eliminated through a Hessian Schur complement, then report Young's modulus and Poisson ratio.

materials/structure|linalg.title: C60 vibrational spectrum and mode degeneracies from a Brenner-type potential
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Relax the icosahedral C60 cage with a Brenner/Tersoff carbon potential and build the 180×180 mass-weighted Hessian. Diagonalize it to obtain the frequencies, verify the six zero modes and group frequencies into degenerate multiplets matching Ih irrep dimensions.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Goodwin-Skinner-Pettifor tight-binding silicon energy-volume curves for diamond and β-Sn
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Build sp3 Slater-Koster Hamiltonians with GSP distance scaling and diagonalize them on k-point grids for the band energy. Add the repulsive embedding term, then compare the equilibrium volumes and the diamond/β-Sn energy difference.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Coulson bond orders and bond-length alternation in graphene nanoflakes
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the Hückel π Hamiltonian of hexagonal and triangular graphene flakes with zigzag and armchair edges. Compute Coulson π bond orders from occupied eigenvectors and map them to bond lengths with a linear bond-order/length relation.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Kelvin eigenstiffnesses and eigenstrains of trigonal α-quartz
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Write the quartz stiffness tensor as a 6×6 Mandel matrix and diagonalize it to obtain the six Kelvin moduli and eigenstrain modes. Verify positive definiteness and invariance under the crystal's 3-fold rotation.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Browaeys-Chevrot symmetry decomposition of the olivine stiffness tensor
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Represent the orthorhombic olivine stiffness as a 21-component vector. Project it successively onto isotropic, hexagonal, tetragonal and orthorhombic subspaces using the closest-symmetry projectors, and report the percentage of anisotropy in each class after aligning to the symmetry coordinate frame.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Directional linear compressibility and negative linear compressibility in a monoclinic crystal
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Invert a monoclinic 6×6 stiffness matrix and evaluate β(l) = S_iikl l_k l_l over the unit sphere. Find the minimum and maximum directions by eigen-decomposition of the second-rank compressibility tensor and test for negative linear compressibility.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Piezoelectrically stiffened acoustic velocities in lithium niobate
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Build the piezoelectrically stiffened Christoffel tensor with c_ijkl, e_ijk and ε_ij for LiNbO3. Solve for the three acoustic speeds over directions and compute the electromechanical coupling coefficient K² as the difference between stiffened and unstiffened velocities.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Anisotropic elastic Green's function of copper by Barnett's line integral
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Compute the point-force displacement Green's tensor G_ij(r) for cubic Cu by integrating the inverse Christoffel matrix over the unit circle normal to r with Gauss quadrature. Compare with the isotropic Kelvin solution and quantify the directional anisotropy.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Stroh sextic eigenproblem for the displacement field of an hcp zirconium edge dislocation
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Set up the 6×6 Stroh eigenvalue problem for a ⟨a⟩ prismatic edge dislocation in hcp Zr. Build the A and B matrices, normalize the eigenvectors and evaluate the anisotropic displacement and stress fields and the energy prefactor K.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Le Claire five-frequency solute correlation factor in fcc dilute alloys
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Use Lidiard's five-frequency model of vacancy-solute exchange in fcc to build the linear escape-probability equations and solve them for the solute correlation factor f2. Plot f2 and the solute/solvent diffusion ratio versus the frequency ratios w2/w1 and w4/w0.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Kinetic Monte Carlo of defect diffusion

materials/structure|linalg.title: Mean first-passage time of a vacancy to a planar sink via absorbing Markov chain
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Build the transition matrix of a vacancy hopping on a finite bcc slab with absorbing boundary planes. Solve the fundamental-matrix linear system for mean absorption times as a function of starting depth and validate against residence-time KMC trajectories.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Kinetic Monte Carlo of defect diffusion

materials/structure|linalg.title: Effective diffusivity of a random-barrier lattice from conductance-matrix solve
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Assign Arrhenius hop rates with random barriers to the bonds of a simple-cubic lattice. Compute the effective diffusivity by solving a sparse Laplacian (resistor-network) system with an imposed concentration gradient, and compare with mean-squared displacement from KMC.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Kinetic Monte Carlo of defect diffusion

materials/structure|linalg.title: Crowdion one-dimensional glide with rotations in bcc tungsten: mixed 1D-3D diffusion
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Model a self-interstitial crowdion gliding along four ⟨111⟩ directions with occasional reorientation rates. Run residence-time KMC and compare the diffusion coefficient and sink-capture times with an analytic rate-matrix result.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Kinetic Monte Carlo of defect diffusion

materials/structure|linalg.title: Anisotropic lithium diffusion tensor in rutile TiO2 channels via KMC
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Simulate Li hopping between octahedral interstitials of rutile with distinct c-axis and ab-plane barriers using the residence-time algorithm. Build the displacement covariance tensor, diagonalize it for the principal diffusivities, and verify them against the analytic rate expressions.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Kinetic Monte Carlo of defect diffusion

materials/structure|linalg.title: Time-of-flight neutron diffractometer calibration of DIFC, DIFA and ZERO
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Fit the quadratic TOF-d relation to measured peak positions of a Si or CeO2 standard by weighted linear least squares. Propagate the covariance to lattice-parameter uncertainty and analyze correlations between DIFA and ZERO.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Schomaker-Trueblood TLS rigid-body analysis of anisotropic displacement parameters
materials/structure|linalg.gist: From refined U_ij of a rigid molecule or polyhedron in a crystal, set up the linear equations U = T + LS terms and solve for the T, L and S tensors by least squares. Diagonalize L for libration axes and amplitudes, and apply the libration correction to bond lengths.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Constrained Fe/Mg site-occupancy refinement in olivine via null-space parameterization
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Refine M1/M2 Fe-Mg occupancies against simulated structure-factor data under linear constraints on full occupancy and bulk composition. Enforce the constraints by projecting onto the constraint null space and compare the result with Lagrange-multiplier least squares.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Parametric sequential refinement of thermal expansion coefficients from multi-temperature patterns
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Fit lattice parameters of an orthorhombic phase at many temperatures simultaneously, parameterized as polynomials in T. Compare standard errors with sequential independent refinement using the joint Jacobian and its covariance.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Single-crystal Gauss-Newton refinement of the wurtzite u parameter
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Compute wurtzite ZnO structure factors with free internal parameter u, overall scale and isotropic B. Refine them against noisy |F|² data by weighted Gauss-Newton, reporting esds and the u-B correlation.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Rietveld scale-displacement parameter correlation versus Q-range from the covariance matrix
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Simulate powder patterns of fcc Ni with truncated Q_max and refine the scale and isotropic B. Analyze how their correlation coefficient and esds from the normal-matrix inverse depend on Q coverage.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Generalized planar fault energy and Tadmor-Bernstein twinnability in Morse nickel
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Shift successive {111} layers to compute the stacking fault, unstable twin fault and two-layer twin energies with a Morse potential, including normal relaxation by linear solves. Evaluate the Tadmor-Bernstein twinnability parameter.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Bilayer hexagonal boron nitride sliding energy landscape AA′, AB and AB′
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Combine a registry-dependent interlayer potential (Kolmogorov-Crespi-type) with Coulomb point charges via 2D Ewald. Compute the full sliding energy surface over the unit cell, fit Fourier components by least squares, and extract barriers between stackings.

materials/structure|linalg.title: B2 binary Lennard-Jones {110} gamma surface and antiphase boundary metastability
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Compute the {110} gamma surface of a CsCl-ordered binary LJ crystal by rigid shifts with normal relaxation. Locate the ½⟨111⟩ APB minimum by Hessian eigen-analysis to decide whether superdislocation dissociation is possible.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Prismatic {10-10}⟨11-20⟩ gamma line of hcp Morse crystal versus c/a
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Build hcp slabs for prismatic slip at several c/a ratios and compute relaxed GSFE curves for wide and narrow prism plane cuts. Determine how the unstable fault energy ratio to the basal value varies with c/a.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Supercell k-point folding and commensurate wavevectors via Smith normal form
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Compute the Smith normal form of an integer supercell matrix and enumerate the primitive-cell k-points that fold to the supercell Γ point. Verify the count equals |det M| and map phonon unfolding weights.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Cluster expansion of fcc binary formation energies by regularized least squares
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Generate ordered fcc A-B structures, compute their formation energies with a pair potential plus many-body term, and fit effective cluster interactions by ridge/LASSO least squares with leave-one-out cross-validation. Identify the ground-state convex hull.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Coincidence site lattices in hexagonal crystals with rational c/a
materials/structure|linalg.gist: For hcp with c²/a² rational, enumerate rotations about [0001] and general axes that produce coincidence lattices. Compute Σ from integer matrix denominators and build CSL bases via HNF reduction.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Commensurate magnetic supercell from a propagation vector
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Given a rational propagation vector k in a cubic or hexagonal lattice, find the minimal integer supercell for which all lattice translations satisfy exp(2πik·t) = 1, using Smith normal form. Generate the corresponding collinear spin arrangement.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Optimal lattice correspondence search for the hcp-to-bcc transformation
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Enumerate integer correspondence matrices mapping hcp Ti supercells onto bcc cells. Compute the stretch tensor via polar decomposition and select correspondences minimizing the principal-strain cost, recovering the Burgers correspondence.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Peach-Koehler forces between non-parallel dislocations on intersecting fcc slip systems
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Evaluate the isotropic stress field of a straight dislocation on one {111} plane at the position of another. Compute the Peach-Koehler force and its glide and climb components for all Thompson tetrahedron pairings to classify attractive junction configurations.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Non-singular segment energy of a prismatic dislocation loop
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Discretize hexagonal and circular prismatic loops into straight segments and sum Cai-Arsenlis non-singular self- and interaction energies. Study convergence with segment number and core width, and compare with the analytic loop energy.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Kanzaki-force lattice statics of a vacancy via the lattice Green's function
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Compute the fcc nearest-neighbour harmonic lattice Green's function by Brillouin-zone integration of the inverse dynamical matrix. Apply Kanzaki forces at vacancy neighbours to get displacement fields and the relaxation volume, and compare with direct supercell relaxation.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Lomer lock zipping length from line-tension energy minimization
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Model two attracting dislocations on intersecting {111} planes forming a Lomer junction, discretized as line segments with orientation-dependent line tension. Minimize the total energy versus junction length by linear-constrained optimization and find the unzipping stress.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Little group and star of k for high-symmetry points of Fm-3m
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Apply the 48 point operations of Oh to the X, L, W and K points and, for each, find the operations leaving k invariant modulo reciprocal lattice vectors. Enumerate the star arms and verify that little-group order times star size equals 48.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Isotropy subgroups and fixed-point subspaces of the polar T1u irrep of Oh
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Represent order-parameter directions in the 3D T1u space and find, for trial directions, the subgroup of Oh leaving them invariant. Compute fixed-point subspace dimensions via projector traces to enumerate the tetragonal, orthorhombic and rhombohedral ferroelectric subgroups.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Symmetry-allowed magnetic moment directions on a Wyckoff site
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Apply site-symmetry rotations acting on axial vectors, with optional time reversal, to a magnetic moment. Construct the averaging projector and its eigenspace with eigenvalue 1 to obtain allowed moment directions for sites in hexagonal and tetragonal magnetic groups.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Ferroelastic domain variants and spontaneous strains for the cubic-to-tetragonal transition
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Perform coset decomposition of Oh with respect to D4h to enumerate orientational domain variants. Rotate the spontaneous strain tensor to each variant and compute the compatibility of domain walls via eigenvalues of strain differences.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Phonon dispersion of hcp Lennard-Jones crystal with a two-atom basis
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Build the 6×6 dynamical matrix for ideal hcp LJ with lattice sums to a cutoff. Diagonalize it along Γ-M-K-Γ-A, compare optical modes at Γ with fcc, and check dynamic stability versus c/a.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Pair potentials for metals and noble gases

materials/structure|linalg.title: Chen-Möbius lattice inversion of an fcc cohesive-energy curve into a pair potential
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Given E(a) for fcc, from a Rose universal binding curve, write it as shell sums of an unknown pair potential. Recover φ(r) on a discretized grid by solving the triangular shell-coordination linear system, and test transferability to bcc.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Pair potentials for metals and noble gases

materials/structure|linalg.title: Charge equilibration (QEq) of a periodic oxide via linear solve
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Set up the Rappé-Goddard QEq electronegativity equalization for a ZnO or SiO2 crystal with shielded Coulomb interactions under a total-charge constraint. Solve the bordered linear system for atomic charges and study their dependence on lattice strain.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Pair potentials for metals and noble gases

materials/structure|linalg.title: LO-TO splitting in a rigid-ion zincblende crystal from the nonanalytic dynamical matrix
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Combine short-range force constants with the Ewald dipole-dipole dynamical matrix and add the nonanalytic term with Born charges and ε∞. Diagonalize to get the LO-TO splitting and its directional dependence near Γ.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Pair potentials for metals and noble gases

materials/structure|linalg.title: Point-polarizable dipole model of the optical dielectric constant of alkali halides
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Place ion polarizabilities on rocksalt sites, build the Ewald dipole interaction tensor and solve the self-consistent induced-dipole linear system under a uniform field. Compute ε∞ and compare it with the Clausius-Mossotti relation.
materials/structure|linalg.area: Pair potentials for metals and noble gases

materials/structure|linalg.title: Strain-dependent band gap of monolayer MoS2 in a three-band tight-binding model
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Implement the Liu et al. three-band d-orbital TB model with bond-length-dependent hoppings under biaxial and uniaxial strain. Diagonalize along Γ-K-M and track the direct-to-indirect gap transition and K-valley shifts.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Trigonal warping and Lifshitz transition in uniaxially strained bilayer graphene
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Build the four-band Bernal bilayer TB Hamiltonian with γ0, γ1 and γ3 and strain-modified hoppings. Locate the Dirac point positions near K by root finding on eigenvalues and determine the strain at which the mini-cones merge.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Anisotropic strain tuning of the phosphorene band gap with a four-band tight-binding model
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Implement the Rudenko-Katsnelson phosphorene TB Hamiltonian with distance-dependent hoppings and apply armchair and zigzag strains. Compute the Γ-point gap and effective masses from eigenvalue curvature.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Barycentric equilibrium placement of periodic nets from quotient graphs
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Given a labelled quotient graph (dia, srs, pcu), solve the Laplacian linear system for barycentric vertex positions with fixed cell vectors. Detect vertex collisions and compute the resulting maximal-symmetry embedding.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Point symbols and vertex symbols of 3-periodic nets dia, srs and nbo
materials/structure|linalg.gist: For each vertex angle in a periodic net, enumerate shortest cycles through the two edges using BFS in the lifted graph. Assemble Schläfli point symbols and vertex symbols, and verify them against RCSR data.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Dimensionality and interpenetration of periodic nets via cycle-space Smith normal form
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Compute net voltages of cycle bases of the labelled quotient graph per connected component. Take the Smith normal form of the resulting integer vectors to get each component's periodicity rank and the index of interpenetration.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Rigid unit modes of a corner-sharing octahedral perovskite framework
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Build the rigidity (compatibility) matrix for rigid octahedra joined at shared corners in a perovskite cell with Bloch phases. Count null-space dimension across the Brillouin zone to locate the rigid unit modes along the M-R line.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Rigidity percolation threshold of a diluted triangular central-force network
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Randomly remove bonds from a periodic triangular spring network and compute the effective shear modulus by sparse linear solves with an affine strain. Locate the rigidity onset near Maxwell counting z = 4.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Auxetic Poisson ratio of a re-entrant honeycomb beam lattice
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Model a re-entrant honeycomb as an Euler-Bernoulli frame network, assemble the global stiffness matrix with periodic boundary conditions and solve under imposed macroscopic strain. Compute the effective Poisson ratio and Young's modulus versus re-entrant angle.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Elastic strain and lattice rotation from HR-EBSD cross-correlation shifts
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Given pattern-center geometry and region-of-interest shifts between reference and test Kikuchi patterns, solve the Wilkinson overdetermined linear system for the deviatoric displacement gradient tensor. Separate it into strain and rotation and add a traction-free constraint.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Penrose tiling by cut-and-project from a 5D lattice and its diffraction pattern
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Project the 5D hypercubic lattice with orthonormal parallel/perpendicular projection matrices and accept points inside a decagonal window. Compute diffraction intensities from window Fourier transforms and verify tenfold symmetry and τ-scaling.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Selling reduction and Voronoi type of a 3D lattice
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Implement Selling's reduction on the superbase scalar products until all are non-positive. Identify the Delaunay/Voronoi combinatorial type from zero-valued conorms and compute the Voronoi relevant vectors.

materials/structure|linalg.title: Haydock recursion local density of states at surface versus bulk bcc d-band sites
materials/structure|linalg.gist: Build a nearest-neighbour s- or d-band tight-binding Hamiltonian for a bcc slab and run Lanczos recursion from surface and bulk sites. Compute continued-fraction local DOS with terminators, compare second moments, and relate the band narrowing to coordination.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Semigrand identity-swap MC of a lattice polymer blend and critical χ
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Simulate a symmetric binary blend of short lattice chains with A/B identity-swap moves at fixed exchange chemical potential. Locate the critical χ from Binder cumulant crossings and compare it with the Flory-Huggins value χc=2/N.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Configurational-bias MC of a lattice polymer brush density profile
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Simulate end-grafted chains on a cubic lattice at several grafting densities using configurational-bias regrowth moves. Compute the monomer density profile and brush height scaling, and compare them with the parabolic self-consistent-field profile.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Kawasaki MC binodal of a lattice binary mixture versus Flory-Huggins
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Use composition-conserving Kawasaki exchange MC in a slab geometry for a lattice monomer mixture with interaction χ. Extract coexisting compositions from density profiles and compare them with the mean-field binodal and spinodal.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Umbrella sampling of largest-cluster size in 2D Ising nucleation
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Apply harmonic bias on the largest down-spin cluster in a supersaturated 2D Ising model, combining Metropolis sampling with cluster identification. Reconstruct ΔG(n) by WHAM and compare the barrier height and critical size with 2D classical nucleation theory.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Forward flux sampling of the nucleation rate in a 3D lattice gas
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Define interfaces in largest-cluster size and compute the flux through the first interface from brute-force kinetic MC. Estimate the conditional crossing probabilities by forward flux sampling and obtain the nucleation rate versus supersaturation.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Heterogeneous nucleation at a wall in the Ising model
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Use biased cluster-size sampling with a surface field on one boundary of a 3D Ising lattice. Compare barrier reduction with the CNT spherical-cap factor f(θ), where θ comes from the field-dependent contact angle.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Cluster-size distribution free energies in small Lennard-Jones vapor systems
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Run NVT MC of supersaturated LJ vapor and identify clusters with the Stillinger distance criterion. Compute ΔG(n) = -kT ln(N_n/N₁) and fit surface and bulk terms to extract an effective surface tension.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Brownian dynamics over a CNT barrier: Kramers versus Zeldovich rate
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Integrate overdamped Langevin dynamics along cluster size n on the CNT free-energy profile with size-dependent attachment diffusivity. Compute mean first-passage times and compare the rate with the Kramers/Zeldovich expression.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Committor analysis to identify the critical nucleus in 2D Ising
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Shoot many short Metropolis trajectories from configurations of varying largest-cluster size and estimate the committor p_B. Locate the critical size at p_B=1/2, build the committor histogram, and assess cluster size as a reaction coordinate.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Seeded nucleation: critical cluster size versus supersaturation and CNT surface tension
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Insert a spherical seed of the stable phase into a metastable 3D Ising lattice and run MC to see whether it grows or shrinks. Bracket the critical radius for several fields and infer interfacial tension through the CNT relation r* = 2γ/Δμ.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Configurational-bias Rosenbluth Henry coefficients of n-alkanes in a channel
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Grow united-atom n-alkanes (C1-C6) with fixed bonds, harmonic bends and torsions inside a cylindrical LJ channel using CBMC. Compute Henry coefficients from the Rosenbluth weight ratio and the linear dependence of adsorption enthalpy on chain length.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Adsorption in zeolites and porous frameworks

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Pore blocking of inaccessible pockets by energy-grid flood fill
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Threshold a framework energy grid and identify connected accessible regions by periodic flood-fill percolation analysis. Block inaccessible pockets and compare Widom Henry coefficients and heats with and without blocking.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Adsorption in zeolites and porous frameworks

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Feynman-Hibbs quantum corrections to H2 Henry coefficients at 77 K
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Construct the quadratic Feynman-Hibbs effective host-guest potential for H2 in a model framework. Compute Henry coefficients by Widom insertion at 77-300 K and quantify the quantum reduction relative to the classical potential.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Adsorption in zeolites and porous frameworks

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Xe/Kr cage selectivity at infinite dilution versus temperature
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Compute Henry coefficients of Xe and Kr in a model cage-type framework by Widom insertion on energy grids. Calculate zero-loading selectivity and its van't Hoff temperature dependence, and decompose it into energetic and entropic contributions.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Adsorption in zeolites and porous frameworks

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Lattice KMC of cage-to-cage hopping and loading-dependent diffusivities
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Model a zeolite as a cubic lattice of cages with capacity limits and run rejection-free KMC of hops. Compute self-diffusivity from MSD and collective diffusivity from center-of-mass fluctuations versus loading, compared with Reed-Ehrlich mean-field theory.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Adsorption in zeolites and porous frameworks

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Rejection-free BKL KMC of CO oxidation with desorption and diffusion
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Implement an n-fold-way KMC for CO oxidation with physical Arrhenius rate constants for adsorption, desorption, hopping and reaction. Compute the turnover frequency versus CO partial pressure and temperature, and extract the apparent activation energy.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Kinetic Monte Carlo of surface reactions

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Random sequential adsorption of dimers: jamming coverage on lattices
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Simulate irreversible random sequential adsorption of dimers on a 1D chain and a 2D square lattice. Compute jamming coverage and the coverage approach kinetics, comparing with Flory's exact 1-e⁻² in 1D and ≈0.9068 in 2D.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Kinetic Monte Carlo of surface reactions

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Degree of rate control from KMC turnover frequencies
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Build a lattice KMC model of an A+B2 Langmuir-Hinshelwood reaction with several elementary steps. Compute Campbell's degree of rate control by finite-difference perturbation of each step's rate constant with common random numbers, and check the sum rule.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Kinetic Monte Carlo of surface reactions

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Adsorption-desorption KMC with lateral interactions versus quasi-chemical isotherm
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Run KMC with detailed-balance adsorption and desorption rates including nearest-neighbor interaction energy. Compute the equilibrium coverage isotherm and compare it with Langmuir, Bragg-Williams and quasi-chemical approximations.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Kinetic Monte Carlo of surface reactions

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Bistability in the NO+CO reaction on a square lattice
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Simulate the Yaldram-Khan-type NO+CO lattice model with N2 and CO2 formation by KMC. Map steady-state reactive windows and poisoning transitions versus CO fraction, with hysteresis from forward and backward parameter sweeps.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Kinetic Monte Carlo of surface reactions

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Equilibrium capillary transition by grand-potential thermodynamic integration
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Integrate GCMC adsorption and desorption branches of a slit-pore lattice gas via dΩ = -N dμ from reference states. Locate the equilibrium condensation point where the branch grand potentials cross, and compare it with the Kelvin equation.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Ink-bottle pore desorption: pore blocking versus cavitation
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Run GCMC of a lattice gas in an ink-bottle geometry (wide cavity, narrow neck) for several neck widths. Determine whether desorption occurs by neck-controlled pore blocking or cavitation from the desorption-branch chemical potentials.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Hysteresis of lattice gas in a quenched random porous matrix
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Generate a site-diluted random matrix of a given porosity and run low-temperature GCMC sweeps of the confined lattice gas. Compute disorder-averaged hysteresis loops versus porosity and temperature and the loop-closure temperature.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Pore-size distribution by NNLS inversion of a simulated GCMC kernel
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Build a kernel of lattice-gas slit-pore isotherms for a range of widths by GCMC. Generate a synthetic polydisperse isotherm, recover the pore-size distribution by regularized NNLS, and compare with a Kelvin/BJH-based estimate.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Confinement shift of the capillary critical point via Binder cumulants
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Use GCMC with histogram reweighting at the coexistence chemical potential for slit-pore lattice gases of various widths. Locate the pore critical temperature from cumulant analysis and fit its shift versus width to 2D-3D crossover scaling.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Membrane permeability from umbrella PMF and position-dependent diffusion
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Simulate a solute crossing a model z-dependent membrane potential in Langevin umbrella windows. Obtain the PMF by WHAM, local diffusivity D(z) by Hummer's harmonic-window autocorrelation method, and permeability from the inhomogeneous solubility-diffusion integral.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Hamiltonian replica-exchange umbrella sampling on a rugged 1D landscape
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Run umbrella windows with periodic neighbor exchanges accepted by the Metropolis criterion on a rough sinusoid-modulated potential. Compare PMF convergence with and without exchanges, using exchange acceptance rates and replica round-trip times.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Adaptive biasing force estimate of a torsional free-energy profile
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Apply adaptive biasing force Langevin dynamics on a 1D periodic torsion with a rough potential, accumulating the mean force per bin. Integrate the mean force to a free-energy profile and compare its convergence with static umbrella sampling plus WHAM.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Variational TST: optimizing the dividing surface by MC free energies
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: For a 2D model potential with curved reaction path, compute the TST rate for a family of rotated dividing planes using MC estimates of the dividing-surface and reactant configurational integrals. Find the variational minimum rate and compare it with the saddle-plane result.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Anharmonic corrections to harmonic TST by MC configurational integrals
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: For a Morse-like well and anharmonic saddle, compute exact classical partition functions of reactant and transition state by MC integration. Compare the anharmonic TST rate with harmonic TST versus temperature, with an Arrhenius fit of each.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Path-integral MC centroid quantum TST for an Eckart barrier
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Use path-integral MC with staging moves to compute the centroid potential of mean force along an Eckart barrier coordinate. Obtain the quantum rate correction factor and compare it with Wigner and Bell tunneling corrections and the exact Eckart transmission.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Arrhenius and Eyring analysis of Langevin escape rates with bootstrap errors
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Estimate escape rates at several temperatures from first-passage times in Langevin simulations of a 2D well. Fit Arrhenius and Eyring forms to extract activation energy, ΔH‡ and ΔS‡ with bootstrap confidence intervals, compared with harmonic TST.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Brownian dynamics mean first-passage time in a tilted periodic potential
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Simulate overdamped Brownian motion in a tilted cosine potential and measure mean first-passage times over one period and drift velocity. Compare the barrier-hopping rate with Kramers' high-friction formula and the exact Stratonovich drift expression.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Spatial Gillespie reaction-diffusion master equation for A+B→0 annihilation
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Simulate diffusion hops between 1D compartments and on-site annihilation with the spatial SSA. Compute the anomalous density decay ρ ~ t^(-1/4) and segregation into domains, contrasting with mean-field ρ ~ 1/t.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Multilayer lattice GCMC and BET fitting of monolayer capacity
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Simulate a layered lattice gas above a substrate whose attraction decays with layer index using GCMC. Fit the BET equation in the 0.05-0.3 relative-pressure range to extract C and monolayer capacity, and compare with the true monolayer.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Langmuir, BET, and multicomponent adsorption theory

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Dimer adsorption on a square lattice: GCMC versus Nitta multisite isotherm
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Perform GCMC of flexible dimers occupying two adjacent sites. Compare isotherms with the Nitta/Flory-Huggins multisite isotherm and with Langmuir, and quantify the entropic coverage penalty near saturation.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Langmuir, BET, and multicomponent adsorption theory

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Recovering a Gaussian site-energy distribution from heterogeneous-surface isotherms
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Simulate adsorption by GCMC on a lattice with Gaussian-distributed site energies. Invert the isotherm by regularized nonnegative least squares over a Langmuir local-isotherm kernel and compare with the input distribution and a Sips fit.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Langmuir, BET, and multicomponent adsorption theory

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Zwanzig FEP bias and forward/reverse asymmetry for harmonic oscillators
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Sample Boltzmann configurations of harmonic oscillators of differing force constants and compute exponential-averaging free-energy differences in both directions. Characterize bias and variance versus sample size against the exact ΔF = (kT/2) ln(k₁/k₀).

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Bennett acceptance ratio versus exponential averaging on Gaussian work distributions
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Generate synthetic and MC-derived forward/reverse energy-difference distributions with tunable overlap. Compare Zwanzig, BAR and overlap-histogram estimators, along with error estimates, as overlap decreases.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Thermodynamic integration versus FEP for charging a model ion
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Compute the free energy of charging an ion in a lattice of point-dipole solvent molecules by MC at several λ. Compare TI with quadrature against staged FEP and the Born continuum estimate, including λ-dependence of ⟨∂U/∂λ⟩.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Gibbs ensemble MC coexistence curve and critical point of LJ fluid
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Run Gibbs ensemble MC with displacement, volume exchange and particle transfer for the truncated LJ fluid. Compute coexisting densities over temperatures and fit the critical point using the rectilinear diameter rule and Ising scaling.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Reaction ensemble MC for 2NO2 ⇌ N2O4 dimerization equilibrium
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Implement reaction ensemble MC with forward/reverse reaction moves weighted by ideal-gas partition function ratios in an LJ-interacting gas. Compute equilibrium conversion versus pressure and compare it with the ideal-gas equilibrium constant prediction.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Binary vapor nucleation free-energy surface in a two-species lattice gas
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Umbrella-sampled MC of a 2D Blume-Capel-like A/B lattice gas, biased on the composition (nA, nB) of the largest cluster. A 2D free-energy surface is reconstructed and the saddle point gives the critical nucleus composition and barrier height.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Cavitation bubble nucleation barrier in a stretched 3D lattice liquid
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Metropolis GCMC of a lattice-gas liquid held at chemical potential below coexistence, with umbrella sampling on the largest connected vapor bubble. The barrier versus undersaturation is compared with CNT using the planar lattice surface tension.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Vacancy-mediated KMC precipitation in a binary alloy: cluster-size distributions
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Rejection-free KMC of vacancy exchanges in a supersaturated 2D A-B lattice alloy with nearest-neighbor bonds. The time-dependent precipitate size distribution, incubation time and nucleation rate are compared with Becker-Döring/CNT estimates.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Metastable zone width from stochastic nucleation during linear cooling ramps
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Nucleation is a nonhomogeneous Poisson process with a CNT rate J(T(t)), simulated by time-rescaled Gillespie sampling under cooling ramps. The distribution of nucleation temperatures is computed and compared with the analytic survival integral for several cooling rates.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Ostwald ripening of 2D lattice-gas clusters and the LSW t^1/3 law
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Kawasaki KMC of a quenched low-density 2D lattice gas tracks the mean cluster radius and cluster count during coarsening. The fitted growth exponent and the scaled size distribution are compared with Lifshitz-Slyozov-Wagner theory.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Dual-site Langmuir fits to GCMC isotherms of a two-site model framework
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: GCMC of a gas in a model framework with strong cation-like sites and weak channel sites on interpolated grids. Isotherms at several temperatures are fitted with dual-site Langmuir parameters, and site occupancies are checked against binned histograms.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Adsorption in zeolites and porous frameworks

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Methane deliverable capacity versus slit width in Steele 10-4-3 carbon pores
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: GCMC of LJ methane in graphitic slit pores with an analytic Steele wall potential at 65 and 5.8 bar. The pore width that maximizes deliverable capacity is found and compared across temperatures.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Adsorption in zeolites and porous frameworks

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Osmotic-ensemble MC of a breathing two-state framework and gate-opening pressure
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Combined GCMC of guests and MC switching between narrow-pore and large-pore host cells with a free-energy offset. Stepped isotherms and the gate-opening pressure are compared with the osmotic grand-potential prediction.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Adsorption in zeolites and porous frameworks

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: LJ fluid in an attractive slit: FMT plus mean-field DFT versus GCMC
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: DFT with FMT repulsion and mean-field WCA attraction gives slit-pore density profiles and adsorption at fixed μ. These are benchmarked against GCMC profiles of the same LJ fluid and Steele wall.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Classical density functional theory of fluids

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Lattice-gas mean-field DFT near a wall versus lattice GCMC profiles
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Layer-by-layer mean-field lattice DFT is solved iteratively for a nearest-neighbor lattice gas against an attractive wall. Profiles, adsorption and the onset of prewetting are compared with exact GCMC on the same lattice.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Classical density functional theory of fluids

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Asakura-Oosawa depletion potential between big spheres from MC force sampling
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: MC of ideal or hard-sphere depletants around two fixed colloids measures the mean force versus separation. Integration gives the depletion potential, compared with the analytic Asakura-Oosawa overlap-volume formula.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Classical density functional theory of fluids

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Hard-disk sedimentation equilibrium: MC profiles versus local-density approximation
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: NVT MC of hard disks under gravity in a tall box. The barometric density profile is compared with the LDA prediction from integrating a hard-disk equation of state (Henderson) via hydrostatic balance.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Classical density functional theory of fluids

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Morphogen gradient noise from a localized source with diffusion and degradation
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: RDME of morphogen produced at one boundary, diffusing and degrading. The mean profile is compared with the exponential PDE steady state, and the Fano factor of copy numbers sets positional-information error versus distance.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: RDME compartment-size breakdown of bimolecular kinetics and Erban-Chapman corrections
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: A+B→C RDME simulations with shrinking voxel size h show the loss of bimolecular reactions as h→0. The effective rate is compared with the corrected mesoscopic rate formula derived from the microscopic reaction radius.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Schlögl bistable front propagation in RDME and the stochastic Maxwell point
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Spatial Gillespie simulation of a 1D Schlögl system seeded with a high/low state interface. Front velocity versus the control parameter locates the stall point, compared with the deterministic Maxwell condition of the reaction-diffusion PDE.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Isotropic-nematic order of hard spherocylinders with quaternion rotation MC
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: NVT/NPT MC of hard spherocylinders using segment-distance overlap tests and small random rotations about uniformly sampled axes. The nematic order parameter is computed from the Q-tensor's largest eigenvalue versus packing fraction and compared with Onsager theory.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Stockmayer fluid dielectric constant from dipole fluctuations with reaction field
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: NVT MC of LJ particles with point dipoles uses translation and orientation moves (uniform sphere sampling) and reaction-field electrostatics. The static dielectric constant is computed from total-dipole fluctuations and compared with Onsager and Wertheim MSA predictions.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Second virial coefficient of rigid SPC-like water by orientational MC
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: The Mayer function of two rigid three-site water molecules is averaged over uniformly sampled quaternion orientations and radial quadrature to give B2(T). The temperature dependence is compared with experimental values.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Rotational Metropolis sampling of dipoles in a field versus the Langevin function
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Metropolis MC of noninteracting classical dipoles uses small-angle rotation moves and checks uniform sampling via the sinθ measure. Mean polarization versus μE/kT is compared with the Langevin function, contrasting naive Euler-angle moves with correct ones.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Lebwohl-Lasher lattice nematic transition by rotational MC
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Metropolis MC of unit vectors on a cubic lattice with -P2(cosθij) coupling. The order parameter, heat capacity and the weakly first-order transition temperature are computed, with finite-size comparison to mean-field Maier-Saupe theory.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: NPT MC Lennard-Jones isotherms versus Peng-Robinson with LJ-mapped critical constants
