chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: NPT MC gives LJ fluid densities along supercritical and subcritical isotherms. These are compared with Peng-Robinson predictions using LJ critical constants and acentric factor, quantifying EOS errors in compressibility factor.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Equations of state and fluid thermodynamics

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Mayer-sampling MC of LJ third virial coefficient with overlap sampling
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Importance-sampled Mayer-sampling MC of B3(T) for the LJ potential, using a hard-sphere reference and Bennett overlap sampling. Results are compared with numerically integrated B2 and literature B3, with the Boyle temperature estimated.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Equations of state and fluid thermodynamics

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Barker-Henderson perturbation theory for square-well fluids using MC reference g(r)
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: The hard-sphere reference g(r) from MC feeds first- and second-order (compressibility approximation) Barker-Henderson terms. The resulting square-well free energy and pressure are compared with direct NVT MC.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Equations of state and fluid thermodynamics

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Bonding fraction of a one-site associating fluid: MC versus Wertheim theory
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: NVT MC of hard spheres with an off-center attractive patch (Kern-Frenkel-like) gives the fraction of unbonded monomers. This is compared with Wertheim's TPT1 mass-action result X_A and the SAFT association free energy.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Equations of state and fluid thermodynamics

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Hard-sphere hydration via TI over cavity radius versus scaled-particle theory
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: MC of an LJ solvent around a growing hard cavity, with the cavity contact density giving dF/dR. Integration gives the cavity solvation free energy versus radius, compared with scaled-particle theory and Widom insertion at small radii.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Absolute LJ fluid free energy by density integration from the ideal gas
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: NVT MC pressures along an isotherm from low to liquid density are integrated as (Z-1)/ρ with quadrature to obtain excess Helmholtz free energy. Results are compared with the Johnson-Zollweg-Gubbins equation of state.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Quadrature and λ-schedule errors in TI from harmonic to quartic oscillator
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: MC averages of dU/dλ along a harmonic-to-anharmonic switch are integrated using trapezoid, Simpson and Gauss-Legendre schemes with nonlinear λ maps. Errors are compared against the exactly computable classical free energy.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Free energy of mixing in a lattice alloy via TI over interaction strength
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Kawasaki MC of an A-B lattice alloy gives the average interaction energy as the exchange parameter is switched on. TI yields the mixing free energy versus composition, compared with regular-solution and quasi-chemical approximations.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Kinesin stepping kinetic scheme: velocity and randomness versus ATP
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Gillespie simulation of a multistate mechanochemical cycle with ATP-dependent binding. Mean velocity, effective diffusion and randomness parameter are computed versus [ATP] and compared with the Derrida formulas for periodic kinetic chains.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Michaelis-Menten kinetics in crowded lattices and fractal rate coefficients
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Lattice KMC of diffusing substrates, enzymes and immobile obstacles at varying crowding fractions. Time-dependent effective rate coefficients k(t)∝t^-h are fitted and apparent Km and Vmax are extracted.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Well-tempered metadynamics on a 2D Fourier torsional (φ,ψ) surface
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Langevin dynamics on an alanine-dipeptide-like periodic 2D torsional potential uses well-tempered Gaussian deposition on both angles. The FES from the rescaled bias is compared with the exact Boltzmann inversion, and basin free-energy differences are tracked versus time.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Tiwary-Parrinello c(t) reweighting of metadynamics for an unbiased CV
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Well-tempered metadynamics on one coordinate of a 2D potential. Time-dependent c(t) reweighting reconstructs the free-energy profile along the orthogonal unbiased coordinate, compared with the exact marginal.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Metadynamics with a poor collective variable: hysteresis from a hidden barrier
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Metadynamics biasing only x on a 2D potential with a significant barrier along y. Forward and backward FES estimates and their hysteresis are quantified versus deposition rate and compared with a run that uses an optimal linear-combination CV.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: OPES on-the-fly probability enhanced sampling on a 1D multiwell potential
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Langevin dynamics biased by the OPES kernel-density estimate of the probability converges to a target well-tempered distribution. The reconstructed FES and convergence speed are compared with well-tempered metadynamics.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Binary LJ mixture Gibbs-ensemble VLE and Peng-Robinson k_ij fitting
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Gibbs-ensemble MC of a binary LJ mixture with particle transfers gives coexisting compositions and pressure. The Peng-Robinson binary interaction parameter is fitted to the Pxy data by minimizing fugacity-equality residuals.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Monte Carlo uncertainty propagation through multicomponent Rachford-Rice flash
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Critical constants and acentric factors of a hydrocarbon mixture are sampled from uncertainty distributions, and Wilson-K plus Peng-Robinson flash is solved for each draw. The output distributions of vapor fraction and phase compositions, and their sensitivity indices, are computed.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Multicanonical GCMC of square-well fluid coexistence and interfacial free energy
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Grand-canonical MC with multicanonical N-weights gives bimodal density distributions. Equal-area histogram reweighting locates coexistence, and the barrier between peaks gives the interfacial tension via Binder's formula.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Infinite-dilution activity coefficients by identity-swap MC and azeotrope prediction
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Semigrand identity-change MC in a binary off-lattice LJ liquid gives infinite-dilution activity coefficients. A two-parameter Margules model is fitted, combined with Antoine pressures, and solved for the azeotropic composition and temperature.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Simulated-annealing tangent-plane stability test for multiphase flash
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Simulated annealing minimizes the Michelsen tangent-plane distance of a Peng-Robinson ternary mixture to detect phase instability. The subsequent two- or three-phase flash results are compared with a Newton-based stability analysis.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Primitive versus virial PIMC kinetic-energy estimators for neon in a cage
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Path-integral MC of a neon-like particle in an anharmonic cage potential, varying the number of beads. Primitive and centroid-virial kinetic-energy estimators are compared for variance and convergence to the quantum limit.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Reaction-ensemble MC of high-pressure ammonia synthesis equilibrium
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: RxMC of N2+3H2⇌2NH3 with LJ site models at high pressure uses reactive insertion/deletion moves. The equilibrium conversion is compared with ideal-gas and Peng-Robinson fugacity-corrected equilibrium-constant predictions.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Lattice GCMC voltage profile of Li intercalation versus regular-solution model
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Lattice GCMC of Li on an interstitial host lattice with nearest-neighbor repulsion, mapping μ to cell voltage. Voltage plateaus and order-disorder steps are compared with the mean-field regular-solution Nernst expression.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Hybrid Monte Carlo of an LJ cluster: acceptance versus time step and energy errors
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: HMC with leapfrog trajectories samples a small LJ cluster canonically. Acceptance rate versus step size is compared with the erfc(√⟨ΔH⟩/2) prediction, and potential-energy averages are checked against Metropolis MC.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Cyclic voltammetry of a surface-bound redox couple by Butler-Volmer KMC
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: KMC of adsorbed redox sites with potential-dependent Butler-Volmer oxidation and reduction rates under a triangular sweep. Current-potential curves, peak separation versus scan rate and Laviron analysis are computed, with optional lateral interactions.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Frank-model autocatalytic chiral symmetry breaking: enantiomeric excess distributions by SSA
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Gillespie simulation of achiral-to-chiral autocatalysis with mutual inhibition. The stationary distribution of enantiomeric excess and its transition from unimodal to bimodal with volume are compared with a chemical Fokker-Planck analysis.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Stochastic A2+B3 step-growth polymerization and the Flory-Stockmayer gel point
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Gillespie/KMC of functional-group reactions with union-find tracking of molecular clusters. Weight-average molecular weight divergence and the largest-cluster fraction locate the gel conversion, compared with Flory-Stockmayer theory.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Marcus-Lushnikov stochastic coagulation versus Smoluchowski constant and additive kernels
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Direct stochastic simulation of cluster coagulation with constant and additive kernels. Cluster-size distributions versus time are compared with the analytic Smoluchowski solutions, along with finite-N deviations.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Photon antibunching and blinking of a three-level emitter by SSA
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Gillespie simulation of a ground-excited-triplet photophysical scheme generates photon arrival times. The second-order correlation g2(τ), showing antibunching and triplet bunching, is compared with the analytic rate-equation solution.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Binary hard-sphere mixture: MC partial contact values versus BMCSL equation of state
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: NVT Metropolis MC of a size-asymmetric binary hard-sphere mixture. Partial radial distribution contact values g_ij(σ_ij) are extrapolated from histograms and combined into the virial pressure, which is compared with the Boublík-Mansoori-Carnahan-Starling-Leland EOS and its contact-value expressions.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Equations of state and fluid thermodynamics

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Inverse-power soft-sphere fluids: MC compressibility factor and Hoover density scaling
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: NVT MC of r^-n soft spheres for several exponents n. The virial pressure is computed and the curves are shown to collapse onto a single function of ρσ³(ε/kT)^(3/n). The fluid EOS is compared with Carnahan-Starling using an effective hard-sphere diameter.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Equations of state and fluid thermodynamics

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Gaussian-core model fluid: MC pressure and energy versus mean-field equation of state
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: NVT MC of penetrable Gaussian-core particles across densities to obtain the excess energy and virial pressure. The results are compared with the mean-field (RPA) EOS, quantifying how the mean-field theory becomes asymptotically exact at high density.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Equations of state and fluid thermodynamics

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Second virial coefficients of Mie λ-6 fluids by MC integration and Boyle temperatures
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Importance-sampled MC integration of the Mayer function for Mie λ-6 potentials gives B2(T) with error bars, checked against quadrature. Boyle temperatures are then located by root-finding and plotted versus the repulsive exponent λ.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Equations of state and fluid thermodynamics

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Van der Waals loops in canonical LJ MC isotherms and equal-area construction
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Subcritical NVT MC of a small Lennard-Jones system yields pressure and Widom chemical-potential isotherms that show finite-size loops. Coexistence pressure and densities are estimated by Maxwell equal-area and equal-μ conditions and compared with a fitted van der Waals EOS.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Equations of state and fluid thermodynamics

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Speed of sound of the LJ fluid from NVT fluctuations versus Johnson MBWR
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: NVT MC of a Lennard-Jones fluid. Cv, the thermal pressure coefficient and the isothermal compressibility are computed from energy-virial fluctuation formulas and combined into the adiabatic speed of sound. The result is compared with the Johnson-Zollweg-Gubbins MBWR EOS derivatives.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Equations of state and fluid thermodynamics

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Hard-core Yukawa fluid MC energies and pressure versus analytic MSA
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: NVT MC of hard-core attractive Yukawa fluids at several screening lengths κ gives the excess internal energy and virial pressure (contact term plus Yukawa term). These are compared with the closed-form mean spherical approximation thermodynamics.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Equations of state and fluid thermodynamics

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: MWC hemoglobin oxygen binding by Metropolis sampling of conformation and occupancy
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Metropolis sampling of the joint quaternary T/R state and four-site O2 occupancy of the Monod-Wyman-Changeux tetramer at varying pO2. Fractional saturation and the Hill coefficient are computed and checked against the exact binding polynomial, and n_H is mapped versus L and c.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: KNF sequential binding on a square tetramer: MC versus exact binding polynomial
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Koshland-Némethy-Filmer model in which liganded subunits change conformation and interact with their square-lattice neighbors. Metropolis sampling of subunit states gives saturation curves, Adair constants and Hill slopes, all validated against exact enumeration of the 2^4 states.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Wyman linkage between two ligands on a multisite allosteric protein
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: MC sampling of a multisite protein that binds ligands X and Y with heterotropic coupling through an MWC conformational equilibrium. The work numerically verifies the linkage relation ∂ν_X/∂ln a_Y = ∂ν_Y/∂ln a_X and computes the free energy of coupling from the sampled binding polynomial.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Duke-Bray conformational spread in a ring of allosteric protomers
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Kinetic MC (Glauber dynamics) of a ring of two-state protomers that bind ligand and couple to their neighbors, modeling the bacterial flagellar switch. The simulation computes the CW bias versus ligand concentration, switching-interval distributions, and mean domain sizes as functions of coupling strength.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Hard disks adsorbed on a smooth surface: 2D GCMC versus scaled-particle isotherm
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Continuous 2D grand-canonical MC of hard disks with an adsorption energy on a structureless surface. The coverage versus gas pressure is compared with the Langmuir, Volmer and 2D scaled-particle-theory isotherms, and the spreading pressure is checked by Gibbs integration.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Langmuir, BET, and multicomponent adsorption theory

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Krypton on a triangular graphite-like lattice: √3 commensurate phase by GCMC
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: GCMC of a lattice gas on a triangular lattice with nearest-neighbor exclusion (hard-hexagon-like) and weak further-neighbor attraction. The simulation produces adsorption isotherms that step to the 1/3 √3×√3 phase, the sublattice order parameter, and isosteric heats via Clausius-Clapeyron.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Langmuir, BET, and multicomponent adsorption theory

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Real adsorbed solution theory with Wilson activities fitted to interacting binary GCMC
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Binary lattice GCMC with unlike adsorbate-adsorbate interactions generates mixture adsorption data. IAST is compared with RAST, in which Wilson activity coefficients for the adsorbed phase are fitted by least squares, and the resulting selectivity errors are reported.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Langmuir, BET, and multicomponent adsorption theory

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Ternary IAST with bootstrap uncertainty propagated from noisy single-component isotherms
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Dual-site Langmuir fits to noisy synthetic pure-component isotherms are resampled by bootstrap. Each resample is propagated through ternary IAST, with spreading-pressure equality solved by nested root-finding, to give confidence intervals on mixture loadings and selectivities.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Langmuir, BET, and multicomponent adsorption theory

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Type-V water adsorption from cooperative lattice GCMC with hydrogen-bonding sites
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Lattice GCMC of water-like particles on a weakly adsorbing surface with a few strong primary sites and strong adsorbate-adsorbate attraction. The simulated S-shaped type-V isotherm is fitted with the Do-Do cluster isotherm and compared with the BET and Langmuir models.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Langmuir, BET, and multicomponent adsorption theory

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Square-well fluid Gibbs-ensemble coexistence versus well range and scaling-law critical points
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Two-box GEMC with displacement, volume and particle-exchange moves for square-well fluids at λ = 1.25-2.0. Coexistence densities are fitted with the rectilinear diameter and the Ising β scaling law to estimate Tc and ρc as functions of λ.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Two-dimensional Lennard-Jones Gibbs-ensemble coexistence and the β = 1/8 exponent
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: GEMC of 2D Lennard-Jones disks to obtain the coexistence curve. Density differences are fitted with free and fixed 2D Ising exponents, Tc is compared with literature values, and the finite-size rounding near criticality is assessed.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Lattice Gibbs ensemble of a simple-cubic lattice gas versus 3D Ising Tc
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Two-box lattice GEMC in which particle transfers and box-size exchanges are implemented on cubic lattices with nearest-neighbor attraction. The coexistence curve is fitted to obtain Tc, which is compared with the exact mapping to the 3D Ising critical temperature 4.5115 J/4.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Two-center Lennard-Jones fluids: Gibbs-ensemble coexistence versus bond elongation
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: GEMC of rigid 2CLJ dumbbells with translational, rotational, volume and transfer moves. Coexistence densities and vapor pressures are computed at several reduced elongations L/σ, and critical points are extracted from scaling fits.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Configurational-bias Gibbs ensemble of lattice chains and Shultz-Flory critical scaling
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: GEMC on a cubic lattice in which chain transfers use Rosenbluth configurational-bias insertion. Critical temperatures and volume fractions are computed for chain lengths 4-32 and extrapolated to infinite length via the Shultz-Flory 1/Tc ∝ 1/√N + 1/2N plot.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Cutoff and tail-correction dependence of the LJ critical point in Gibbs-ensemble MC
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: GEMC of the Lennard-Jones fluid with truncated, truncated-shifted and tail-corrected potentials at several cutoffs. The study quantifies the shifts in coexistence densities and fitted Tc, and checks consistency of the tail corrections with the full-potential curve.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Feynman-Hibbs quantum-corrected neon vapor-liquid coexistence by Gibbs-ensemble MC
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: GEMC of neon using a Lennard-Jones potential augmented with the temperature-dependent quadratic Feynman-Hibbs correction. Coexistence densities and critical temperature are compared with classical GEMC and experimental values to quantify the quantum shift.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Gaussian-core particles at a hard wall: mean-field DFT versus MC profiles
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Picard-iterated mean-field (RPA) functional for penetrable Gaussian-core particles near a planar hard wall, using an FFT convolution of the pair potential. Density profiles are compared with grand-canonical or canonical MC profiles at low and high bulk density.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Classical density functional theory of fluids

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Primitive-model electric double layer: MC ion profiles versus Gouy-Chapman and modified PB
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Canonical MC of charged hard-sphere counterions and coions near a uniformly charged planar wall in a slab geometry, with a 2D-corrected Ewald or charged-sheet electrostatics. Ion density profiles and the potential drop are compared with Gouy-Chapman and a modified Poisson-Boltzmann theory that includes excluded volume.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Classical density functional theory of fluids

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Percus test-particle route: Rosenfeld FMT g(r) versus MC for bulk hard spheres
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: A hard sphere is fixed at the origin and the Rosenfeld FMT density profile around it is solved in spherical geometry by Picard iteration with radial convolutions. The resulting g(r) is compared with bulk NVT MC histograms at several packing fractions.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Classical density functional theory of fluids

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Hard disks at a hard wall: 2D Roth FMT versus Monte Carlo
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Picard solution of the 2D fundamental-measure functional for hard disks in a slit between hard lines, with weighted densities obtained by numerical line integrals. Wall density profiles are compared with canonical MC, and the 2D contact theorem is checked.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Classical density functional theory of fluids

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Ideal freely-jointed chains near a hard wall: propagator DFT versus chain MC
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: The segment density profile of non-interacting freely-jointed chains near a hard wall is computed from the single-chain propagator recursion of polymer DFT. It is compared with direct MC sampling of chain conformations to quantify the depletion layer versus chain length.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Classical density functional theory of fluids

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: n-Butane gauche/trans populations and van't Hoff conformational enthalpy by Metropolis
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Metropolis MC over the central dihedral of butane with a Ryckaert-Bellemans torsion potential gives trans/gauche populations versus temperature. These are checked against 1D quadrature and analyzed by van't Hoff to extract ΔH and ΔS of the gauche state.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: 1,2-Dichloroethane conformer populations versus solvent dielectric with reaction field
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Torsional MC of 1,2-dichloroethane combining a torsion potential with an Onsager reaction-field solvation term for the conformation-dependent dipole moment. The run computes trans/gauche ratios and the mean-square dipole as functions of the solvent dielectric constant.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Polyethylene characteristic ratio: dihedral MC versus Flory RIS matrix method
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Metropolis sampling of backbone dihedrals of polymethylene chains with fixed bonds and angles, including pentane-type second-order interactions. The characteristic ratio C_n is computed versus n and compared with the rotational-isomeric-state generator-matrix result.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Ethylene glycol conformers and intramolecular hydrogen bonding by multi-dihedral MC
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: MC over the HO-CC, OCCO and CC-OH dihedrals of ethylene glycol with torsion potentials plus a distance-angle hydrogen-bond term. The run gives conformer populations, the OCCO gauche fraction, and the fraction of internally H-bonded conformers versus temperature.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Fixman metric correction for dihedral sampling with rigid versus flexible bond angles
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Butane-like chain conformer populations are compared between full flexible-angle MC and constrained dihedral-only MC with and without the Fixman/Jacobian metric determinant. The study quantifies the population bias introduced by hard constraints.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: High-barrier amide cis/trans sampling: local Metropolis versus jump-between-minima moves
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: A dihedral potential with a ~20 kT cis/trans barrier is sampled by small-step Metropolis and by a mixed scheme with detailed-balance-satisfying jump moves. The comparison covers population convergence, autocorrelation times and the accuracy of the cis fraction.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Wang-Landau density of states of the 2D Ising model versus Beale exact
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Flat-histogram Wang-Landau sampling of L×L periodic Ising lattices with modification-factor refinement. The estimated ln g(E) is compared with Beale's exact density of states, and the canonical energy, heat capacity and free energy are derived.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: 1/t Wang-Landau versus standard Wang-Landau: error saturation in ln g(E)
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Standard Wang-Landau and the Belardinelli-Pereyra 1/t algorithm are compared on a small Ising lattice with exactly known g(E). The error of ln g is tracked versus MC time to show saturation of standard WL and the t^-1/2 convergence of the 1/t variant.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Wang-Landau in particle number for lattice-gas grand-canonical isotherms
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Wang-Landau random walk in N at fixed temperature for a 2D lattice gas with attractions estimates the canonical partition functions Q(N). From these, adsorption isotherms at all chemical potentials, coexistence via equal-area of ln P(N), and the condensation step are reconstructed.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: 2D XY model heat capacity from continuous-energy Wang-Landau sampling
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Wang-Landau on binned continuous energies for the classical planar XY model is used to derive specific heat curves versus L. The non-divergent heat capacity peak above the BKT temperature is compared with canonical Metropolis results.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Lifson-Roig per-residue helicity of a heteropeptide: Metropolis versus transfer matrix
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Sequence-dependent Lifson-Roig model with residue-specific w and v parameters. Per-residue helicity profiles and mean helix length are computed by Metropolis sampling of h/c states and by the exact 3×3 transfer-matrix product with derivatives.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Poland-Scheraga DNA melting with loop entropy exponent by Monte Carlo
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: MC of a long DNA duplex model with base-pair stacking energies and loop weights s^(-c), compared with transfer-matrix results at c = 0. The melting-curve sharpness and Tm are computed as the loop exponent c varies from 0 to 2.1.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Kinetic Ising helix-coil relaxation after a temperature jump
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Kinetic MC (Glauber dynamics) of a Zimm-Bragg chain with nucleation and propagation rates satisfying detailed balance. Relaxation of fractional helicity after T-jumps is simulated, and relaxation times are compared with Schwarz's linearized kinetic theory versus s and σ.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Force-induced helix-coil unfolding: Zimm-Bragg coupled to freely-jointed chain elasticity
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Metropolis sampling of helix/coil residue states combined with a force-dependent coil free energy from the FJC model. The run gives the force-extension curve, helicity versus force and the plateau force, all checked against a force-dependent transfer matrix.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Skolnick-Holtzer coiled-coil dimer: helix-coil MC with interhelix contact interactions
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: MC sampling of two coupled Zimm-Bragg chains with an interhelical attraction for paired helical residues and a dimer association equilibrium. The run computes melting curves versus concentration and the enhancement of helicity relative to an isolated chain.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Bayesian MCMC inference of Zimm-Bragg σ and s(T) from noisy melting curves
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Synthetic CD melting curves are generated from the exact Zimm-Bragg transfer matrix for several chain lengths. Metropolis MCMC over σ, ΔH and Tm then yields posterior distributions, correlations and credible intervals, showing σ identifiability from length dependence.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: MSM implied timescales of a 1D double-well Langevin particle versus Fokker-Planck
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Overdamped Langevin trajectories on a double well are discretized into grid states, and transition matrices are built at multiple lag times. Implied timescales and stationary distributions are compared with eigenvalues of the discretized Fokker-Planck operator.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: PCCA+ metastable sets of a 2D three-well Langevin MSM
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: A fine-grid MSM is built from 2D Langevin dynamics on a three-well potential. The spectral gap is identified, and PCCA+ fuzzy memberships give three macrostates with populations and coarse-grained rates compared with direct trajectory transition counts.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Reversible maximum-likelihood transition matrices versus naive row-normalized counts
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Short Langevin trajectories that start out of equilibrium yield count matrices. These are estimated by naive normalization, by symmetrized counts, and by the self-consistent reversible MLE fixed-point iteration, and the resulting stationary distributions and timescale biases are compared.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: TICA slow coordinates from 2D Langevin trajectories and MSM on TICA space
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Time-lagged independent component analysis solves the generalized eigenproblem of instantaneous and lagged covariance matrices from anisotropic 2D Langevin data. The analysis identifies the slow reaction coordinate, and timescales from an MSM on TICA bins are compared with one on naive Cartesian bins.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Chapman-Kolmogorov test of a torsional (φ,ψ) Langevin MSM
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Langevin dynamics on a Fourier-series Ramachandran-like surface is discretized on a 2D dihedral grid to build an MSM. Chapman-Kolmogorov predictions of macrostate survival probabilities are compared with direct estimates at multiple lags to select a Markovian lag time.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Markovian milestoning on a rugged 1D landscape: MFPT versus direct Langevin
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Short Langevin trajectories are launched from milestones, and their milestone-to-milestone transition kernel and lifetimes are recorded. Milestoning MFPTs across a rugged barrier are then compared with brute-force first-passage simulation and the exact 1D MFPT integral.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Flyvbjerg-Petersen blocking of AR(1) and Metropolis harmonic-oscillator chains
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Correlated series are generated from an AR(1) process and from Metropolis sampling of a harmonic oscillator. The blocking-transformation error plateau is detected and compared with the exact standard error from the known autocorrelation time.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Block averaging and statistical error analysis

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Metropolis step-size tuning: integrated autocorrelation time versus acceptance rate
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Random-walk Metropolis is run on 1D and multivariate Gaussian targets with varying step sizes. τ_int is estimated with Sokal automatic windowing, efficiency is plotted versus acceptance, and the optimal acceptance rate is compared with the 0.44 and 0.234 results.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Block averaging and statistical error analysis

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Critical slowing down in 2D Ising: Metropolis versus Wolff dynamic exponents
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Single-spin Metropolis and Wolff cluster MC are run at Tc for several L. The integrated autocorrelation times of energy and |M| are estimated with automatic windowing and fitted as τ ∝ L^z to extract the dynamic exponents.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Block averaging and statistical error analysis

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Gelman-Rubin R-hat and multi-chain effective sample size on a bimodal target
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Multiple Metropolis chains sample a bimodal 1D distribution from dispersed starting points. Split-R-hat and multi-chain ESS are computed versus chain length, showing how they detect unmixed modes that single-chain blocking misses.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Block averaging and statistical error analysis

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Jackknife errors of heat capacity and Binder cumulant from correlated Ising MC
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Blocked jackknife resampling of 2D Ising energy and magnetization series gives errors on the nonlinear observables Cv and the Binder cumulant U4. These are compared with naive error propagation and with bootstrap over independent runs.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Block averaging and statistical error analysis

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Moving-block bootstrap versus blocking for correlated MC error bars
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Moving-block and stationary bootstrap are applied to correlated MC series of known autocorrelation and compared with Flyvbjerg-Petersen blocking. The comparison covers estimated standard errors and confidence-interval coverage as functions of block length and series length.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Block averaging and statistical error analysis

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Stochastic Oregonator oscillations: period dispersion and coherence versus volume
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: SSA and explicit tau-leaping of the three-variable Oregonator model of the BZ reaction. Measure the mean oscillation period, period coefficient of variation and autocorrelation decay as functions of volume, and compare with the deterministic limit cycle from a stiff ODE solve.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Sel'kov glycolytic model: noise-induced quasi-cycles below the Hopf bifurcation
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: SSA of the Sel'kov glycolysis oscillator at parameters just below the deterministic Hopf point. Compute the power spectrum of fluctuations and compare it with the analytic linear-noise-approximation spectrum from the Jacobian and diffusion matrix.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Togashi-Kaneko discreteness-induced transitions in a four-species autocatalytic loop
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: SSA of the cyclic autocatalytic network X_i+X_{i+1}→2X_{i+1} with in/outflow in a small volume. Compute the distribution of the composition variable and show the emergence of bimodality (switching states) as total molecule number drops, in contrast to the unimodal deterministic and LNA predictions.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Cubic autocatalysis in a CSTR: stochastic hysteresis width versus reactor volume
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Model the well-mixed Gray-Scott-type CSTR A+2B→3B, B→C with feed. Run SSA under slow residence-time ramps up and down to measure the hysteresis loop width versus volume, and compare with the deterministic saddle-node bifurcation points from continuation.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Negative autoregulation noise suppression from truncated CME stationary distributions
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Compute stationary protein distributions for constitutive versus self-repressing genes with a Hill-type production propensity by solving the truncated generator. Report Fano factors and coefficients of variation at matched means, cross-checked by SSA.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Slow-scale SSA for fast reversible isomerization coupled to slow conversion
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Apply the Cao-Gillespie-Petzold slow-scale SSA to S1⇌S2 (fast) with S2→S3 (slow). Use the exact virtual fast-subsystem moments to compare S3 production statistics and CPU cost against the full SSA as the timescale separation varies.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Polymorph selection from competing CNT nucleation rates in droplet ensembles
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Stochastically simulate first-nucleation events of two polymorphs with different interfacial energies and bulk driving forces in microdroplets. Compute the fraction of droplets yielding each polymorph versus supersaturation, illustrating Ostwald's rule of stages.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Swendsen-Wang dynamics of the 3D Ising model and the Li-Sokal bound
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Implement Swendsen-Wang FK-cluster updates for the simple-cubic Ising model at T_c. Measure integrated autocorrelation times of the energy and magnetization versus L to extract z and compare with the Li-Sokal bound from specific-heat scaling.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Liu-Luijten geometric cluster algorithm for size-asymmetric soft-sphere mixtures
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Implement point-reflection geometric cluster moves for a binary mixture of large and small particles with a size ratio of about 5. Compare decorrelation of large-particle structure and pair distributions against local Metropolis at equal CPU cost.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Widom-Rowlinson mixture demixing with geometric cluster moves
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Simulate the continuum Widom-Rowlinson model (AB hard overlap, AA/BB ideal) using a Johnson-Gould-Machta reflection cluster algorithm in the semigrand ensemble. Locate the critical total density from Binder cumulants of the composition order parameter.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Star polymer exponents γ_f from PERM growth of f-arm lattice stars
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Grow f-arm self-avoiding stars on the cubic lattice simultaneously with PERM. Estimate the star partition functions to extract γ_f for f=3,4,6, and compare with ε-expansion and literature estimates.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Interpenetration ratio Ψ* of two lattice SAWs from Rosenbluth overlap sampling
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Sample pairs of independent SAWs with Rosenbluth/PERM weights and compute the probability of mutual overlap versus center-of-mass separation. Integrate to get the second virial coefficient and the universal ratio Ψ* versus chain length.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Semiflexible lattice chains with bending energy: PERM persistence length
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Grow SAWs on the cubic lattice with a penalty for bends using PERM. Compute bond-bond orientation correlations, persistence length and ⟨R²⟩ versus stiffness, and compare with the worm-like chain crossover formula.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Self-avoiding walks confined in a square lattice tube: confinement free energy
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Use PERM to compute partition functions of 3D SAWs confined in tubes of width D. Extract the confinement free energy per monomer and test the de Gennes blob scaling D^(-1/ν) versus the ideal-chain D^(-2).

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Lifted nonreversible Metropolis on a ring: spectral gap versus reversible sampling
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Construct exact transition matrices for reversible Metropolis and the lifted (Diaconis-Holmes-Neal) chain targeting a distribution on an N-site ring. Compute spectral gaps and mixing times versus N to show the N² to N speedup, and verify with simulated autocorrelations.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Detailed balance and Markov chain move design

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Hastings correction for multiplicative log-normal proposals on a positive variable
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Sample a gamma-distributed molecular quantity, such as a radius, using multiplicative log-normal steps with and without the Hastings ratio x'/x. Quantify the bias in moments and KS distance when the correction is omitted, and verify that the corrected chain satisfies detailed balance numerically.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Detailed balance and Markov chain move design

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Peskun ordering: Metropolis versus Barker asymptotic variance on discrete targets
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: For small discrete Boltzmann distributions, build Metropolis and Barker (heat-bath) transition matrices. Compute exact asymptotic variances of observables from the fundamental matrix, demonstrating Peskun ordering, and confirm by simulation.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Detailed balance and Markov chain move design

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Suwa-Todo rejection-free balance for spin-1 Blume-Capel single-site updates
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Implement Suwa-Todo irreversible transition probabilities via weight allocation for the three-state Blume-Capel spin. Compare rejection rates, exact local transition-matrix spectra and lattice-level integrated autocorrelation times with Metropolis and heat-bath updates.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Detailed balance and Markov chain move design

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Random-scan versus systematic-scan Gibbs sampling of correlated Gaussian conformational modes
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Derive the exact linear autoregressive operators of random and systematic-scan Gibbs samplers for a correlated multivariate Gaussian (harmonic normal modes). Compute spectral radii and integrated autocorrelation times versus correlation strength, and validate with simulation.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Detailed balance and Markov chain move design

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Hydrogen evolution KMC with Volmer-Heyrovsky-Tafel steps: Tafel slopes and coverage
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Lattice KMC of H adsorption and desorption on an electrode with potential-dependent Butler-Volmer rate constants for the Volmer, Heyrovsky and Tafel steps. Compute steady current and H coverage versus overpotential, and extract Tafel slopes for different rate-determining steps.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Bjerrum ion pairing in a 2:2 restricted primitive electrolyte
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: MC of divalent charged hard spheres in a low-dielectric solvent. Compute the fraction of contact and Bjerrum-distance ion pairs and the association constant versus concentration, and compare with Bjerrum and Fuoss theories.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Br/Ag(100) c(2×2) electrosorption: lattice GCMC equilibrium voltammogram
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Lattice-gas GCMC of bromide on a square lattice with nearest-neighbor exclusion and longer-range repulsions, with chemical potential linear in electrode potential. Compute coverage isotherms and the equilibrium current from dθ/dE, locating the order-disorder c(2×2) transition peak.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Marcus reorganization energy from energy-gap sampling in a dipolar lattice solvent
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Metropolis sampling of point dipoles around a donor-acceptor pair in two charge states. Compute energy-gap distributions and free-energy parabolas via histogram reweighting, and extract the reorganization energy and test linear-response (Gaussian) behavior.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Polyampholyte isoelectric point from constant-pH Monte Carlo
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Constant-pH MC of a chain with acidic and basic sites with screened Coulomb interactions. Compute the net charge versus pH, isoelectric point and apparent pKa shifts relative to the ideal Henderson-Hasselbalch sum, for random and blocky sequences.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Shell-wise protonation of a poly(propylene imine) dendrimer by constant-pH MC
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Model a generation-4 dendrimer as a fixed graph of amine sites with screened Coulomb interactions. Sample protonation states with constant-pH MC to obtain the two-step titration curve and per-shell protonation degrees versus pH.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Redox Bohr effect: constant-pH constant-potential MC of a two-heme protein
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Jointly sample protonation of titratable sites and oxidation states of two hemes, with pH and electrode potential as fields. Compute pH-dependent midpoint potentials and redox-linked pKa shifts, and validate against exact enumeration of the microstate partition function.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Fatty-acid Langmuir monolayer titration: 2D lattice MC versus mean-field approximations
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Constant-pH MC of a square lattice of carboxylic sites with nearest-neighbor charge repulsion. Compute the degree of dissociation versus pH and compare with Bragg-Williams and quasi-chemical (Bethe) approximations, including the broadening of the titration curve.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Penetrable-sphere model fluid: MC structure versus HNC and PY closures
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: MC of particles with a finite step repulsion ε inside diameter σ at various densities and kT/ε. Compare g(r) and S(k) with PY and HNC solutions, highlighting cluster formation and the closures' failure at high density.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Narrow square-well fluid approaching Baxter adhesive spheres: MC versus PY
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: MC of square-well fluids with shrinking well width at fixed second virial coefficient. Compute contact values, coordination numbers and compressibility factor, and compare with Baxter's analytic PY sticky-hard-sphere solution as a function of stickiness τ.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Hard-sphere fourth virial coefficient by Mayer-sampling Monte Carlo
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Use Mayer sampling with a ring reference integral to compute B4 for hard spheres. Compare with the exact value (≈0.2869 b^3 in units of B2^3) and with the Carnahan-Starling prediction, and report statistical errors versus sample size.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Hard spheres in a spherical cavity: density profiles and contact theorem
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Canonical MC of N hard spheres confined in a hard spherical pore. Compute radial density profiles and the wall contact density, verify the curved-wall contact theorem with surface-tension corrections, and examine how layering changes with pore radius.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Nitric oxide dimerization 2NO⇌(NO)2 enhanced by confinement in carbon slit pores
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Reactive (reaction-ensemble) GCMC of NO and its dimer in graphitic slit pores modeled by a Steele wall potential, coupled to a bulk reservoir. Compute dimer mole fraction in the pore versus pore width, and compare with bulk-phase conversion.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Living (equilibrium) polymerization: scission-recombination MC chain-length distribution
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Lattice MC of self-assembling chains with bond-formation energy E and scission/recombination moves satisfying detailed balance. Compute the exponential length distribution and the mean length scaling φ^(1/2) exp(E/2kT), and compare with mean-field theory.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Van der Waals-Platteeuw Langmuir constants for methane in sI hydrate cages
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Compute cage Langmuir constants by MC integration of the Boltzmann factor of a methane guest interacting with water molecules of the small and large sI cages. Then derive cage occupancies and hydrate dissociation pressure using the vdWP model.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Single-file adsorption in a 1D nanochannel: GCMC versus the exact Takahashi isotherm
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: GCMC of LJ particles confined to a line inside a channel with external well depth. Compare loading versus pressure with the exact Takahashi isobaric partition function for nearest-neighbor interactions, computed by Laplace-transform quadrature.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Free-radical polymerization SSA: dispersity for combination versus disproportionation
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Gillespie simulation of initiation, propagation, and termination by combination or disproportionation in a small volume, tracking individual chain lengths. Compute molecular-weight distributions and dispersity, approaching 1.5 versus 2.0, and compare with method-of-moments solutions.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Unimolecular falloff via stochastic collisional master equation with Kassel k(E)
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Simulate energy-grained random walks of reactant molecules with exponential-down collisional energy transfer and RRK microcanonical decay. Compute k_uni versus bath pressure, the falloff curve, and compare with Lindemann-Hinshelwood and the strong-collision limit.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Larson lattice surfactant model: critical micelle concentration by MC
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Lattice MC of H_mT_n amphiphilic chains in solvent with reptation and configurational moves. Compute free-surfactant concentration versus total concentration to locate the CMC, and obtain the micelle aggregation-number distribution.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Mercedes-Benz 2D water model: density anomaly by NPT Monte Carlo
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: NPT MC of the Ben-Naim Mercedes-Benz model with LJ cores and directional hydrogen-bond arms. Compute density, heat capacity and hydrogen-bond fraction versus temperature, and locate the temperature of maximum density.

chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.title: Aggregation-volume-bias MC for sticky-sphere dimer association equilibrium
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.gist: Implement Chen-Siepmann AVBMC moves that swap particles into and out of bonding volumes for a dilute fluid with a short strong attractive well. Compute the dimer fraction and association constant, and compare efficiency and results with plain Metropolis and the exact two-body integral.
chemistry/mc_thermo|stochastic.area: Detailed balance and Markov chain move design

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Tikhonov least-squares sinc reconstruction from jittered nonuniform samples
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Build the sinc Gram/synthesis matrix linking Nyquist-grid coefficients to randomly jittered sample times. Solve a regularized least-squares problem and report reconstruction RMSE and matrix condition number against jitter level.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Papoulis generalized sampling with signal and derivative at half rate
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Reconstruct a bandlimited signal from samples of f and f′ taken at half the Nyquist rate. At each frequency, invert the 2×2 aliasing filterbank matrix to obtain the synthesis filters, then compute the reconstruction error.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Cubic B-spline interpolation prefilter via tridiagonal solve versus ideal sinc
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Compute cubic B-spline coefficients by solving the tridiagonal (Toeplitz) interpolation system. Derive the equivalent cardinal-spline frequency response and quantify passband attenuation and aliased energy relative to ideal sinc interpolation.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Least-squares calibration of gain and timing mismatch in time-interleaved ADCs
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Model a 4-channel time-interleaved ADC with per-channel gain and skew errors, linearized as a design matrix acting on a known sinusoid and its derivative. Estimate the mismatches by least squares and report the spurious-free dynamic range before and after correction.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Weighted least-squares Farrow fractional-delay filter design
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Fit FIR coefficients as polynomials in the fractional delay μ by solving one weighted least-squares problem over a grid of frequency and delay. Evaluate the worst-case group-delay and magnitude error over the band.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Eigenfilter design of an anti-aliasing decimation filter
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Form the quadratic stopband-energy and passband-deviation matrices for a linear-phase FIR used in decimation by M. Take the minimizing Rayleigh-quotient eigenvector as the filter and compute the residual aliased-energy fraction after decimation.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Bandlimited graph signal reconstruction from a vertex subset
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: On a random geometric sensor graph, define bandlimited signals through the first K Laplacian eigenvectors. Reconstruct them from samples on a chosen vertex subset by least squares, and compare a greedy E-optimal sampling set with random sets via reconstruction error.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Maximum entropy density on [0,1] from power or Chebyshev moments
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Reconstruct a Beta(2,5) density from its first K moments by Newton optimization of the dual. Hessians are Gram matrices assembled by Gauss-Legendre quadrature. Compare Hessian conditioning in the monomial and Chebyshev bases and the L1 reconstruction error as K grows.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Dempster covariance selection: maximum-determinant Gaussian completion
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Given covariance entries specified only on the edges of a chordal or cycle graph, compute the maximum-entropy Gaussian completion with Newton or iterative proportional updates. Verify that the precision matrix vanishes off the graph and report the entropy.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Pairwise Ising maximum entropy model of a five-neuron spike pattern
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Fit fields and couplings that reproduce given firing rates and pairwise correlations by Newton's method, enumerating all 2^5 states and using the Fisher information matrix. Compute the multi-information captured by the pairwise model relative to the independent model.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Maximal-entropy random walk and Parry measure on a network
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Build the maximal-entropy random walk on a small graph from the Perron eigenpair of its adjacency matrix, P_ij = A_ij ψ_j/(λψ_i). Verify that the entropy rate equals log λ and compare its stationary distribution and entropy rate with those of the generic random walk.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Sinkhorn matrix scaling for entropy-regularized optimal transport
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Compute the maximum-entropy coupling between two discrete histograms under a quadratic cost by alternating Sinkhorn scaling of the Gibbs kernel matrix. Track the transport cost and entropic gap as ε→0 and compare with the exact linear-program transport cost.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Mean-field direct coupling analysis of a synthetic Potts sequence alignment
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Generate sequences from a known Potts model by Gibbs sampling and compute pseudocount-regularized one- and two-site frequency matrices. Infer couplings as J = −C⁻¹ and rank contacts by the average-product-corrected Frobenius norm, scoring precision against the true contacts.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Phillips MaxEnt species distribution from presence points on a grid
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Fit a Gibbs distribution over landscape cells whose expected environmental features match presence-sample averages, using Newton's method on the L2-regularized dual. Report the fitted coefficients, the habitat suitability map entropy, and test-set log-likelihood.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Levinson-Durbin recursion for an AR(4) process with reflection coefficients
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Starting from the theoretical autocorrelation of a known AR(4) model, run Levinson-Durbin to recover the coefficients, reflection coefficients and prediction-error sequence. Validate against a direct Toeplitz solve and check the stability criterion |k|<1.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: AR model order selection by AIC, BIC and FPE
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Simulate an AR(3) series, compute the biased sample autocorrelation, and run Levinson-Durbin up to order 15. Collect the order-wise prediction error variances and select the order by AIC, BIC and FPE, comparing selection frequencies across realizations.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Line spectral frequencies of an LPC polynomial via companion eigenvalues
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Form the symmetric and antisymmetric polynomials P(z), Q(z) from a 10th-order LPC model and find their unit-circle roots as companion-matrix eigenvalues. Verify interlacing of the LSFs and the round-trip conversion back to LPC coefficients.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Vocal tract area function from reflection coefficients (Wakita)
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Compute PARCOR coefficients of a synthetic vowel via the step-down recursion. Map them to the cross-sectional areas of a lossless acoustic tube and to log-area ratios, and compare the formant frequencies with tube resonances.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Whittle multichannel Levinson recursion for VAR(2) estimation
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Estimate a bivariate VAR(2) by solving the block-Toeplitz Yule-Walker equations with the Whittle-Wiggins-Robinson forward/backward recursion. Validate against a direct block solve and report the innovation covariance and spectral matrix.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Conditional Granger causality in a three-variable linear network
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Fit full and reduced VAR models by least squares to data from a chain X→Y→Z. Compute conditional Granger causality as log ratios of residual variances, showing that the indirect X→Z influence vanishes once Y is conditioned on.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Modified covariance versus Yule-Walker AR estimation for short records
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Estimate AR(2) coefficients of a narrowband process from 32-sample records using forward-backward least squares and the autocorrelation method. Compare bias, variance and spectral-peak location accuracy over Monte Carlo trials.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Exact Gaussian AR(p) likelihood via Toeplitz Cholesky and Levinson determinant
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Compute the exact log-likelihood of an AR(p) sample using a Cholesky factorization of the Toeplitz covariance. Compare it with the Levinson-based log-det and quadratic form (product of prediction errors), then maximize over the coefficients.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Wiener FIR channel equalizer from Toeplitz normal equations
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: For a known dispersive channel plus noise, form the input autocorrelation matrix and cross-correlation vector and solve the Wiener-Hopf equations for equalizers of increasing length and decision delay. Report the MMSE and the optimal delay.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Discrete Hilbert transform matrix and AM envelope recovery
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Build the circulant discrete Hilbert transform matrix as F⁻¹ diag(−i·sgn) F and verify its eigenvalues ±i and its anti-self-adjointness. Form the analytic signal of an AM tone and measure envelope recovery error versus carrier-to-modulation frequency ratio.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Least-squares design of a type-III FIR Hilbert transformer
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Design an odd-length antisymmetric FIR approximating −i·sgn(ω) over a transition-excluded band by solving the normal equations of a sine-basis least-squares problem. Report passband ripple versus filter length and band edge.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Phase-locking value matrix and synchronization clusters in Kuramoto oscillators
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Simulate two weakly coupled clusters of Kuramoto oscillators and extract phases via analytic signals. Build the N×N phase-locking-value matrix and identify clusters from its leading eigenvectors and eigenvalue gap.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Finite Hilbert transform on an interval by Chebyshev collocation
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Solve the airfoil equation (1/π) PV∫ f(t)/(x−t) dt = g(x) on [−1,1] using the Chebyshev-U/T spectral relation and a collocation matrix. Compare with the analytic inversion and report the circulation-type constant fixed by the Kutta condition.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Minimum-phase reconstruction via cepstral Hilbert folding versus spectral factorization
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Compute the minimum-phase filter with a given magnitude response by folding the real cepstrum with DFT matrices. Check the result against reflecting the outside-unit-circle zeros, found as companion-matrix eigenvalues, back inside.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Kalman-filter FM demodulation from IQ samples
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Track the phase and instantaneous frequency of a noisy FM signal with a linear state-space model (phase, frequency, frequency rate) driven by phase measurements, using Kalman updates. Compare output SNR with the Hilbert-phase differentiator across carrier-to-noise ratios.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: CAVI for Bayesian linear regression with Gamma-distributed precisions
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Implement coordinate-ascent mean-field updates for q(w)q(α)q(β) in Bayesian linear regression, with matrix inverses for the Gaussian factor. Track the ELBO to convergence and compare the posterior mean and covariance with the exact fixed-hyperparameter posterior.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Mean-field VB for a Gaussian with unknown mean and precision
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Run the factorized q(μ)q(τ) updates for i.i.d. Gaussian data under a Normal-Gamma prior. Compute the ELBO and its gap to the exact log evidence, and quantify the KL from the exact Normal-Gamma posterior together with variance underestimation versus sample size.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Variational Bayesian Gaussian mixture with Gaussian-Wishart priors
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Fit a VB-GMM (Bishop §10.2) to 2D data from three clusters, starting from ten components. Update the responsibilities, Wishart parameters and Dirichlet weights, check that the ELBO increases monotonically, and count the effective components remaining.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Naive mean-field and TAP free energies versus exact enumeration for a small Ising model
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: For a 4×4 Ising model with random couplings, solve the naive mean-field and TAP self-consistency equations. Compare the variational free-energy bound and the magnetizations with exact results from 2^16-state enumeration, and get linear-response correlations by inverting the Hessian.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Variational Bayesian PCA with ARD determining latent dimensionality
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Apply Bishop's VBPCA with per-column ARD precisions to data with three true latent directions in 10D. Iterate the q(W), q(Z), q(α) updates and identify the effective dimension from the α values, comparing it with Minka's Laplace evidence.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Titsias inducing-point ELBO for sparse Gaussian process regression
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Compute the collapsed variational lower bound using Cholesky factorizations of the inducing-point and Nyström matrices. Compare it with the exact GP log marginal likelihood as the number of inducing points grows, and optimize the inducing locations.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Jaakkola-Jordan variational bound for Bayesian logistic regression
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Iterate the local-variational ξ updates and Gaussian posterior updates for 2D logistic regression. Compare the lower bound on the evidence with the Laplace approximation and with brute-force 2D quadrature of the exact evidence.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Mean-field variance underestimation for a correlated multivariate Gaussian target
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: For a Gaussian target with precision Λ, derive the fully factorized solution q_i with variance 1/Λ_ii by CAVI. Compare it with the true marginals Σ_ii, and compute KL(q‖p) and KL(p‖q) as functions of the correlation structure.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: MacKay evidence framework for polynomial regression order selection
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: For each polynomial order, iterate α and β using the effective number of parameters γ = Σλ_i/(λ_i+α), computed from the eigenvalues of the data Hessian. Evaluate the log evidence and choose the order, comparing the result with cross-validation.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: KSG mutual information estimator for multivariate Gaussian blocks
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Estimate I(X;Y) between Gaussian vector blocks with the Kraskov-Stögbauer-Grassberger estimator. Compare with the closed form ½ log(det Σ_X det Σ_Y / det Σ) over a range of canonical correlations.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Entropy bounds for Gaussian mixtures: pairwise KL and Bhattacharyya
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: For a mixture of 2D Gaussians with full covariances, compute the Kolchinsky-Tracey upper and lower entropy bounds from pairwise KL and Bhattacharyya distances. Compare them with tensor-product quadrature and Monte Carlo entropy as the component separation varies.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Closed-form Gaussian transfer entropy via discrete Lyapunov equations
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: For a bivariate linear VAR(1), solve the discrete Lyapunov equation for the stationary covariance. Compute transfer entropy in both directions from conditional covariance log-determinants, verify it equals half the Granger causality, and check against a KSG estimate.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Von Neumann entropy of Gaussian bosonic states via symplectic eigenvalues
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: For two-mode squeezed thermal states passed through a beam splitter, compute symplectic eigenvalues from the eigenvalues of iΩσ. Evaluate the von Neumann entropies, the mutual information and the logarithmic negativity versus squeezing.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Gaussian information bottleneck curve from generalized eigenvalues
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: For jointly Gaussian X,Y, compute the eigenvalues of Σ_{x|y}Σ_x⁻¹ (Chechik et al.) and the critical β values at which new dimensions activate. Trace the piecewise I(T;X) versus I(T;Y) information curve.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Entropy change under linear mixing of Laplace sources: kNN test of log|det A|
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Mix independent Laplace sources with random matrices and compare kNN entropy estimates of the mixtures with h(X) + log|det A|, using the analytic Laplace entropy. Assess how estimator bias depends on the mixing condition number.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: TLS-ESPRIT frequency estimation compared with the Cramér-Rao bound
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Estimate the frequencies of three sinusoids with total-least-squares ESPRIT using the shift invariance of the signal subspace. Compute the CRB from the Fisher information matrix and compare it with Monte Carlo MSE across SNR.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Burg maximum entropy spectrum and spectral line splitting
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Implement Burg's harmonic-mean reflection-coefficient recursion for a short record of two sinusoids in noise. Compare peak resolution with the periodogram and Yule-Walker, and show line splitting dependent on initial phase at high order.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Matrix pencil identification of power-system electromechanical oscillation modes
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Apply the Hua-Sarkar matrix pencil to ringdown data containing three damped modes. Use an SVD-truncated Hankel matrix pencil and generalized eigenvalues to estimate frequencies, damping ratios and amplitudes.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Capon MVDR spectral estimator versus periodogram resolution
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Compute the Capon spectrum 1/(aᴴR⁻¹a) with diagonal loading for closely spaced tones in colored noise. Compare the Rayleigh resolution limit and the bias of power estimates with the Bartlett periodogram and the AR spectrum of matching order.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Spatial smoothing MUSIC for coherent sources on a uniform linear array
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Simulate coherent multipath arrivals on a ULA. Apply forward-backward spatial smoothing over subarrays to restore covariance rank, then estimate directions of arrival with MUSIC and record success rate versus subarray size.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Thomson multitaper spectrum and harmonic F-test
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Compute DPSS tapers from the symmetric tridiagonal eigenproblem and form adaptively weighted multitaper estimates. Apply Thomson's F-test, a least-squares regression across tapers, to detect and estimate a weak line component in colored noise.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Wax-Kailath MDL and AIC estimation of the number of sinusoids
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: From the eigenvalues of a sample covariance of snapshots, compute the geometric-to-arithmetic mean likelihood statistics and the MDL and AIC criteria. Estimate the number of signals and map detection probability versus SNR and snapshot count.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Filter diagonalization harmonic inversion of a synthetic NMR FID
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Build Krylov-type matrices U0 and U1 from a short FID in a frequency window and solve the generalized eigenproblem U1B = uU0B for complex frequencies. Use small-singular-value regularization and compare line positions and widths with the truth.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Finite-time Landauer erasure in a discretized double-well Fokker-Planck model
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Discretize overdamped Fokker-Planck dynamics in a time-dependent double well as a master-equation generator and propagate it with matrix exponentials. Compute the work and heat of a tilt-and-lower erasure protocol versus duration, approaching kT ln 2.
math/info_stats|linalg.area: Thermodynamics of information and Landauer bounds

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Information flow and learning rate in a bipartite sensor-signal Markov system
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Build the four-state generator of a binary receptor tracking a binary telegraph signal and compute its stationary distribution. Split the entropy production into subsystem contributions and evaluate the Horowitz-Esposito information flow (learning rate) versus sensor speed.
math/info_stats|linalg.area: Thermodynamics of information and Landauer bounds

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Mandal-Jarzynski information ratchet: work extraction from a bit tape
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Model the demon-plus-bit system as a Markov chain evolving for interaction time τ per bit, propagated by matrix exponentials. Compute the outgoing bit statistics, the work per bit and the tape Shannon entropy change, and map the engine, eraser and dud regimes.
math/info_stats|linalg.area: Thermodynamics of information and Landauer bounds

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Qubit erasure by thermalization: von Neumann entropy and Landauer heat
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Erase a qubit by coupling it to a thermal bath through a Lindblad generator assembled as a superoperator matrix while ramping the Hamiltonian. Compute the heat released and the von Neumann entropy change with matrix logarithms, and check the bound Q ≥ kT ΔS.
math/info_stats|linalg.area: Thermodynamics of information and Landauer bounds

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Polynomial-approximation entropy estimator via Chebyshev least squares
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Fit the best polynomial approximation to −p log p on [0, c·log n/n] by least squares, using a Chebyshev design matrix. Build the Wu-Yang / Jiao-Venkat-Han estimator and compare its bias and RMSE with plug-in and Miller-Madow estimates for Zipf distributions with large support.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Entropy rate estimation of a Markov chain from a sampled sequence
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Estimate the transition matrix of a 4-state chain from symbol counts, compute its stationary distribution by eigendecomposition, and evaluate the plug-in entropy rate. Characterize bias versus sequence length, and add a Miller-Madow-type correction per row.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: KL and Jensen-Shannon divergences between multivariate Gaussians
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Evaluate the closed-form Gaussian KL divergence using log-determinants and traces via Cholesky factors. Estimate the Jensen-Shannon divergence, which has no closed form, by Monte Carlo with the mixture density, and compare with the Bhattacharyya and Hellinger distances.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Delta-method variance of plug-in entropy from the multinomial covariance
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Compute the asymptotic variance of the plug-in entropy from the gradient and the multinomial covariance diag(p) − ppᵀ. Compare it with bootstrap and Monte Carlo variances and with Miller-Madow bias corrections for small and large alphabets.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Histogram mutual information of a bivariate Gaussian with Panzeri-Treves correction
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Bin samples from a correlated bivariate Gaussian, compute plug-in MI from the joint histogram matrix, and apply the Panzeri-Treves bias correction. Compare with −½ log(1−ρ²), including the discretization limit, across bin counts.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: KL divergence rate between two Markov chains and hypothesis testing
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Compute the divergence rate Σ π_i P_ij log(P_ij/Q_ij) using the stationary eigenvector of P. Verify it as the Chernoff-Stein error exponent by simulating likelihood-ratio tests on finite sequences.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: MIMO Gaussian channel capacity by water-filling over eigenmodes
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: For a random 4×4 Rayleigh MIMO channel with colored noise, whiten the noise and take the SVD of the effective channel. Water-fill power over the eigenmodes, then compute capacity versus SNR and the ergodic capacity over channel draws.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Two-state rate model of stochastic resonance via Floquet monodromy
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Model hopping between two wells with Kramers rates modulated periodically. Solve the periodic master equation via the monodromy matrix, then compute the spectral amplification and output SNR versus noise intensity and locate the resonance peak.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Kramers escape rate from the Fokker-Planck spectral gap
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Discretize the Fokker-Planck operator of a bistable potential and symmetrize it to a Schrödinger-like Hermitian matrix. Take the smallest nonzero eigenvalue as twice the hopping rate, and compare it with the Kramers formula versus barrier height over noise.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Suprathreshold stochastic resonance in an array of noisy threshold devices
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: For N identical thresholds with independent Gaussian noise and a Gaussian input, construct the binomial channel matrix P(n|x) on a quadrature grid. Compute the input-output mutual information versus noise-to-signal ratio for several N and locate the optimum.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Linear-response susceptibility of a bistable oscillator by Risken matrix continued fractions
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Expand the Fokker-Planck density of an overdamped double well in Hermite functions and set up the tridiagonal block recursion. Solve it by matrix continued fractions to obtain the complex susceptibility χ(ω) and spectral amplification versus noise.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Residence-time statistics of a noisy Schmitt trigger via absorbing Markov chains
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Discretize a periodically driven Schmitt trigger with noise as a Markov chain with absorbing switching states. Use the fundamental matrix (I−Q)⁻¹ to compute residence-time distributions and the synchronization peak at half the driving period versus noise strength.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: DPSS tapers: tridiagonal commuting matrix versus sinc-kernel Toeplitz eigenproblem
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Compute Slepian sequences for given N and NW by eigendecomposing the symmetric tridiagonal commuting matrix and the dense sinc-kernel Toeplitz matrix. Compare the eigenvectors and recover the concentration eigenvalues λ_k by Rayleigh quotients.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Thomson adaptive weighting for a high-dynamic-range AR(4) spectrum
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Generate an AR(4) process with a deep spectral trough and form DPSS eigenspectra. Iterate Thomson's adaptive weights and compare broadband leakage bias and the effective degrees of freedom against uniform-weight multitaper estimates.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Multitaper magnitude-squared coherence with jackknife confidence intervals
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Two channels share a common AR component plus independent noise. Compute the multitaper cross- and auto-spectra from DPSS eigencoefficients, estimate coherence, and form delete-one-taper jackknife variances of the Fisher-transformed coherence. Compare the result with the theoretical coherence.
