math/info_stats|linalg.title: Minimum-bias tapers from a quadratic-form eigenproblem versus sine tapers
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Build the matrix whose quadratic form gives the local spectral bias, i.e. the second moment of the spectral window. Take its smallest eigenvectors as tapers and compare them with Riedel-Sidorenko sine tapers in bias and variance for a smooth spectrum.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Thomson quadratic-inverse estimate of the spectrum derivative
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Construct the quadratic-inverse basis matrices from DPSS products and their eigenstructure. Apply them to eigencoefficient outer products to estimate the local spectral slope of an AR(2) process, and compare with the analytic dS/df.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Bronez generalized prolate tapers for irregularly sampled time series
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: For nonuniform sample times, solve the generalized eigenproblem between the in-band and full-band sinc Gram matrices to obtain concentrated tapers. Form a multitaper spectrum of a sinusoid in noise and compare its leakage with a Lomb-Scargle periodogram.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Axisymmetric spherical Slepian functions concentrated on a polar cap
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Assemble the Gram matrix of m=0 normalized Legendre functions integrated over a polar cap of half-angle Θ, up to degree L. Eigendecompose it to obtain the concentration eigenvalues and the spherical Shannon number, then compare with (L+1)(1-cosΘ)/2.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Two-dimensional separable DPSS multitaper spectrum of an anisotropic random field
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Synthesize a 2D Gaussian random field with an anisotropic Matérn-like spectrum using FFT filtering. Estimate its spectrum with outer-product DPSS tapers, then quantify the variance reduction and leakage relative to a 2D periodogram.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Multitaper local-fractional-variance SVD for coherent signals in a sensor array
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: For M sensors carrying a common narrowband oscillation plus noise, form the M×K matrix of weighted eigencoefficients at each frequency. Its leading singular value fraction (Mann-Park LFV) detects the coherent signal, and the spatial pattern of the mode is recovered from it.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Iterated EKF as Gauss-Newton for GNSS pseudorange positioning
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Estimate receiver position and clock bias from satellite pseudoranges by iterating the EKF measurement update. Show that it is equivalent to Gauss-Newton on the MAP cost, and compare the converged covariance and the GDOP with a single-step EKF.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Square-root UKF on Lorenz-63 with QR and Cholesky rank-one updates
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Implement the square-root unscented filter, propagating Cholesky factors via QR of weighted sigma-point deviations and cholupdate/downdate. Compare it with the standard UKF on the chaotic Lorenz-63 system in RMSE and in preservation of positive definiteness.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: EKF-SLAM in 2D with point landmarks: covariance correlation and convergence
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: A robot with a unicycle model observes range-bearing to a few landmarks. Run EKF-SLAM with an augmented state and analytic Jacobians, then track the determinant of the landmark covariance submatrix and the correlation coefficients as the map converges.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Cubature Kalman filter for ballistic reentry tracking with altitude-dependent drag
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Use third-degree spherical-radial cubature points, generated with a Cholesky factor, to propagate a reentry state with exponential atmosphere drag and an unknown ballistic coefficient. Compare RMSE with EKF and UKF from radar range measurements.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Ensemble Kalman filter on Lorenz-96 with Gaspari-Cohn covariance localization
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Run a stochastic EnKF with perturbed observations on 40-variable Lorenz-96 using a small ensemble. Apply Schur-product localization with the Gaspari-Cohn function and multiplicative inflation, and report analysis RMSE versus localization radius.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: EKF state-of-charge estimation for a lithium-ion cell equivalent circuit
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Model the cell as an OCV(SOC) polynomial with a series resistance and an RC branch, discretized exactly. Use the EKF to estimate SOC and polarization voltage from terminal voltage under a current profile, using the Jacobian of the OCV curve.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Unscented Rauch-Tung-Striebel smoother for a pendulum observed through sine
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Track a noisy pendulum angle from y=sin(θ)+noise with a UKF forward pass and an unscented RTS backward pass. The backward pass uses sigma-point cross-covariances, and smoother RMSE is compared with filter RMSE.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Brook-Evans Markov chain approximation of CUSUM average run length
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Discretize the one-sided CUSUM statistic for Gaussian data into transient states and build the transition matrix R. Compute in-control and out-of-control ARLs as (I-R)^{-1}1, and compare with Siegmund's approximation.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: EWMA control chart ARL by Nyström solution of the integral equation
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Discretize the EWMA run-length integral equation with Gauss-Legendre nodes and solve the linear system for ARL as a function of the starting value. Calibrate the control limit for a target in-control ARL of 370 and tabulate the shift-detection ARLs.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Bayesian online change-point detection with a Normal-Gamma model for variance shifts
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Implement Adams-MacKay run-length recursions with constant hazard and Student-t predictive probabilities from conjugate updates. Apply them to a sequence with piecewise variance changes and report the MAP run lengths and the detection delays.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Shiryaev-Roberts procedure: ARL to false alarm and stationary delay
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Discretize the Shiryaev-Roberts statistic for Gaussian mean change on a grid to obtain a Markov transition matrix. Compute the ARL to false alarm by a linear solve and the stationary average detection delay from the quasi-stationary eigenvector.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Crosier multivariate CUSUM versus Hotelling T² chart for correlated process means
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Monitor a 3D Gaussian process with known covariance, using Cholesky whitening and Mahalanobis norms. Calibrate both charts to equal in-control ARL by simulation and compare their out-of-control ARLs for shifts along different eigen-directions.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: SPRT for a Poisson count-rate increase in radiation portal monitoring
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Model the integer-valued log-likelihood-ratio random walk of Poisson counts as an absorbing Markov chain. Obtain exact detection probability and expected sample number from the fundamental matrix, and compare with Wald's approximations.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Structural break in regression coefficients: Chow test and Andrews sup-F
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: For a linear regression with an unknown break date, compute the least-squares residual sums for all candidate splits via QR. Form the sup-F statistic and the break-date estimate, and calibrate the critical values by simulation.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Hamilton filter and Kim smoother for a two-regime Markov-switching AR(1)
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Recursively compute filtered regime probabilities with the transition matrix and the Gaussian regime likelihoods, then run Kim's backward smoother. Maximize the likelihood over the parameters and locate the regime change points.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Narrowband ambiguity function of an LFM chirp and range-Doppler coupling
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Compute the discrete ambiguity surface |χ(τ,ν)| of a linear FM pulse by FFT over Doppler-shifted lag products. Measure the slope of the coupling ridge and the 3 dB range and Doppler resolutions, and compare with the analytic values.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Least-squares mismatched filter for Barker-13 sidelobe suppression
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Design a longer FIR receive filter minimizing integrated sidelobe energy subject to unit mainlobe gain by solving the Toeplitz normal equations. Report peak sidelobe level, integrated sidelobe level and SNR mismatch loss versus filter length.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Frank and P4 polyphase codes: periodic and aperiodic autocorrelation and Doppler tolerance
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Generate Frank and P4 codes of length 64 and compute their aperiodic and periodic autocorrelations. Compute the ambiguity cuts, then compare peak sidelobe levels and the mainlobe loss under Doppler shift.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Costas frequency-hopping waveform: thumbtack ambiguity and sidelobe statistics
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Construct Welch Costas arrays from a primitive root modulo p and build the stepped-frequency waveform. Compute its ambiguity function and verify the at-most-one coincidence property of the hit array, measuring peak sidelobes against a random hop sequence.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Whitened matched filter in AR(1) clutter: output SNR gain over the white filter
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Build the Toeplitz noise covariance R of AR(1) clutter and compute the optimal filter R^{-1}s via Cholesky. Compare the output SNR s^H R^{-1} s with the conventional matched filter as a function of the correlation coefficient.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Space-time adaptive processing: clutter covariance rank and SINR loss
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Form the space-time clutter covariance of an airborne ULA radar from clutter patches over azimuth. Verify Brennan's rule for its rank by eigendecomposition and compute the optimal-STAP SINR loss versus Doppler.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Gravitational-wave chirp matched-filter SNR and Fisher matrix for chirp mass
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Using a Newtonian stationary-phase inspiral template and an analytic detector PSD, compute the noise-weighted inner products. Obtain the optimal SNR, the template match versus chirp-mass offset, and the inverted Fisher matrix errors on (t_c, φ_c, M_c).

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Transmit waveform optimization for SINR in signal-dependent clutter
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: With clutter that is a convolution of the waveform, iterate between the optimal receive filter and a transmit waveform given by a generalized eigenvector under an energy constraint. Report monotone SINR improvement over an LFM baseline.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Taylor-weighted LFM pulse compression: sidelobe level versus SNR loss
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Apply Taylor amplitude weighting with parameters (n̄, SLL) on receive to an LFM pulse. Compute the compressed pulse, peak sidelobe level, mainlobe broadening and mismatch SNR loss, and compare with Hamming weighting.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Golay complementary pairs: zero-sidelobe sum and Doppler degradation
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Recursively construct binary Golay pairs and verify that the summed aperiodic autocorrelations have zero sidelobes. Quantify the growth of range sidelobes when the two pulses experience different Doppler phase progressions.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Lloyd-Max versus μ-law companded quantization of a Laplacian speech-like source
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Design an optimal non-uniform quantizer for a unit-variance Laplacian source and a μ-law companded uniform quantizer. Compare SQNR versus input level, showing the robustness to variance mismatch of the companding approach.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: LBG vector quantization of 2D Gauss-Markov vectors versus reverse water-filling
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Train k-means codebooks with splitting on pairs from an AR(1) source. Compare the distortion at rates of 1 to 4 bits per sample with the Shannon rate-distortion function, computed by reverse water-filling on the covariance eigenvalues.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Transform coding gain of KLT versus DCT for an AR(1) block source
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Eigendecompose the Toeplitz covariance for block size N and compute the coding gain (arithmetic over geometric mean of variances) for the KLT and the DCT-II. Perform greedy integer bit allocation and simulate quantized reconstruction MSE.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Normalized second moment of hexagonal and D4 lattice quantizers
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Implement Conway-Sloane closest-point algorithms for the A2 and D4 lattices using their generator matrices. Estimate the normalized second moment G by Monte Carlo over the Voronoi region and compare with the cubic lattice value 1/12.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Closed-loop DPCM of an AR(2) source with optimal linear prediction
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Solve the Yule-Walker normal equations for the optimal predictor and quantize the prediction residual with a Lloyd-Max quantizer inside the loop. Compare the measured SNR gain with the theoretical prediction gain σ_x²/σ_e².

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Quantized overcomplete frame expansions: linear versus consistent reconstruction
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Quantize the coefficients of a vector in a harmonic tight frame of redundancy r. Reconstruct by the canonical dual (pseudo-inverse) and by consistent reconstruction via linear programming, and fit the MSE decay rates 1/r and 1/r².

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Discrete Wigner-Ville distribution of a two-chirp signal and cross-term geometry
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Form the analytic signal, compute the discrete WVD from the instantaneous autocorrelation by FFT over lag, and locate the oscillating cross-terms midway between the two chirps. Check the time and frequency marginals against |x|² and |X|².

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Choi-Williams distribution: kernel parameter tradeoff between cross-terms and resolution
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Apply the exponential kernel exp(-θ²τ²/σ) in the ambiguity domain to a two-component signal. Quantify cross-term energy and auto-term width as functions of σ, and compare them with the WVD and the spectrogram.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Reassigned spectrogram of a chirp using derivative and time-weighted windows
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Compute STFTs with windows h, t·h and dh/dt to obtain the reassignment operators. Relocate spectrogram energy accordingly and measure the concentration improvement (Rényi entropy) for a chirp plus noise.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Gabor frame operator and canonical dual window by matrix inversion
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: For a Gaussian window on a periodic lattice with time shift a and M channels, build the frame operator matrix. Compute its frame bounds from the eigenvalues and the canonical dual window S^{-1}g, and verify perfect reconstruction as a·M approaches N.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Discrete fractional Fourier transform from DFT-commuting matrix eigenvectors
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Eigendecompose the Grünbaum/Candan tridiagonal-like matrix that commutes with the DFT to obtain Hermite-Gaussian-like eigenvectors. Build the DFrFT, and find the rotation angle that maximally compacts a chirp.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Smoothed pseudo-Wigner-Ville instantaneous frequency of a sinusoidal FM signal
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Compute the SPWVD with separate time and lag smoothing windows for a sinusoidally frequency-modulated tone in noise. Estimate the instantaneous frequency from the peaks of each time slice, and report bias and variance against the true IF law.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Hermite-function multitaper spectrogram from a discrete harmonic oscillator eigenproblem
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Obtain discrete Hermite functions as eigenvectors of a tridiagonal discretized harmonic-oscillator matrix. Average spectrograms over the first K tapers, then compare the time-frequency concentration and variance for a chirp in noise with a single-Gaussian spectrogram.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Gaussian KDE mutual information estimator: bandwidth bias on correlated Gaussians
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Estimate I(X;Y) by resubstitution and leave-one-out with Gaussian product kernels whose bandwidth matrices come from the sample covariance (Scott rule). Compare with -½log(1-ρ²) over ρ and sample size.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: KSG estimators 1 and 2 for nonlinear dependence y = x² + noise
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Implement both Kraskov estimators with max-norm kNN via cKDTree. Compute the true MI by numerical quadrature of the joint density, and compare bias and variance versus k and N for this non-Gaussian dependence.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Gaussian-copula mutual information via rank transform and log-determinants
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Rank-transform marginals to standard normal scores and estimate MI from the log-determinants of the copula correlation matrices with an analytic bias correction. Evaluate invariance under monotone marginal transforms of correlated Gaussians.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Frenzel-Pompe kNN conditional mutual information on a Gaussian Markov chain
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: For X→Y→Z with linear Gaussian links, estimate I(X;Z|Y) and I(X;Y|Z) with the conditional KSG estimator. Compare them with the closed-form log-det values computed from the joint covariance.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Total correlation of a Gaussian factor model: kNN estimate versus closed form
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Sample a 5D one-factor Gaussian model and compute the total correlation Σh(X_i) − h(X) analytically from log-determinants. Estimate it with a KSG-type multivariate estimator, reporting the bias as a function of factor loading strength.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: HSIC kernel independence test with centered Gram matrices
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Compute HSIC = tr(KHLH)/n² with Gaussian kernels for dependent but uncorrelated data, e.g. a ring or x with |x|-scaled noise. Obtain p-values by permutation and by the Gamma approximation from the Gram-matrix moments.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Gaussian partial information decomposition with minimum mutual information redundancy
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: For a jointly Gaussian target and two predictors, compute I(T;X1), I(T;X2) and I(T;X1,X2) from log-det covariance expressions. Decompose them into redundancy, unique and synergy terms, and compare with plug-in estimates from samples.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Fisher information and ML decoding of a von Mises tuning population
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: For N Poisson neurons with von Mises tuning curves, compute J(θ) = Σ f_i'²/f_i. Compare the Cramér-Rao bound with the empirical error of a grid-search maximum-likelihood decoder versus N and observation window.
math/info_stats|linalg.area: Fisher information in neural population coding

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Information-limiting differential correlations and saturating linear Fisher information
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Add the rank-one covariance ε f'f'^T to independent Poisson-like covariance, then compute J = f'^T Σ^{-1} f' via Sherman-Morrison and direct solves. Show saturation at 1/ε as N grows.
math/info_stats|linalg.area: Fisher information in neural population coding

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Full Gaussian Fisher information with stimulus-dependent covariance
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: For a population with Gaussian noise whose covariance depends on θ through tuning curves, compute J = f'^TΣ^{-1}f' + ½tr(Σ^{-1}Σ'Σ^{-1}Σ'). Compare the mean and covariance contributions as correlation strength varies.
math/info_stats|linalg.area: Fisher information in neural population coding

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Population vector versus ML decoding of 2D reach direction with cosine tuning
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Neurons with cosine tuning and Poisson spikes encode movement direction. Compute the 2×2 Fisher matrix and compare the variance of population-vector and maximum-likelihood estimates with the CRB, including for nonuniform preferred-direction distributions.
math/info_stats|linalg.area: Fisher information in neural population coding

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Brunel-Nadal Fisher bound versus exact mutual information for a Poisson population
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Compute the exact stimulus-response MI of a small Poisson population by Monte Carlo over spike counts with a discretized posterior. Compare it with the asymptotic approximation H(θ) − ½E[log(2πe/J(θ))] as N increases.
math/info_stats|linalg.area: Fisher information in neural population coding

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Optimal tuning width in D-dimensional stimulus spaces via the Fisher matrix
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: For radial Gaussian tuning curves on a D-dimensional lattice of preferred stimuli, compute the full Fisher information matrix. Verify the Zhang-Sejnowski scaling J ∝ σ^{D-2}, then find the optimal width under a fixed spike budget.
math/info_stats|linalg.area: Fisher information in neural population coding

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Bias-corrected linear Fisher information estimator from finite trials
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Estimate f'^TΣ^{-1}f' from sampled trials using the empirical covariance and finite-difference tuning derivatives. Apply the Kanitscheider bias correction for the inverse-Wishart mean and finite trials, and validate against ground truth versus trial count.
math/info_stats|linalg.area: Fisher information in neural population coding

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Fisher information matrix and confidence intervals for a Poisson GLM neuron
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Fit a Poisson GLM with exponential link to a white-noise stimulus by Newton-IRLS using Cholesky solves. Compute the observed Fisher information X^TWX and the asymptotic standard errors of the receptive-field weights, then check coverage by simulation.
math/info_stats|linalg.area: Fisher information in neural population coding

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Fisher information transmission through a recurrent linear network
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Inputs with tuning f(θ) and noise pass through r = (I−W)^{-1}(f+ξ) with additional private noise. Compute the input and output linear Fisher information, and show the data-processing loss as a function of the spectral radius of W.
math/info_stats|linalg.area: Fisher information in neural population coding

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Bootstrap particle filter on the Kitagawa nonstationary growth model
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Run a bootstrap particle filter with systematic resampling on x_t = x/2 + 25x/(1+x²) + 8cos(1.2t) + noise, with y = x²/20 + noise. Report ESS traces, the log-likelihood estimate and posterior bimodality.
math/info_stats|linalg.area: Particle filters and sequential Monte Carlo

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Particle filter log-likelihood variance versus exact Kalman likelihood
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: For a linear Gaussian AR(1)-plus-noise model, compute the exact log-likelihood by the Kalman prediction-error decomposition. Measure the bias and variance of the bootstrap particle filter estimate versus N, checking that the variance scales roughly as 1/N.
math/info_stats|linalg.area: Particle filters and sequential Monte Carlo

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Auxiliary particle filter for a stochastic volatility model
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Implement Pitt-Shephard auxiliary weights using the predictive mean of log-volatility for the SV model. Compare ESS and log-likelihood variance with the bootstrap filter on returns that contain volatility jumps.
math/info_stats|linalg.area: Particle filters and sequential Monte Carlo

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Rao-Blackwellized particle filter for a conditionally linear Gaussian model
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Sample the nonlinear substate with particles while each particle carries a Kalman filter for the linear substate. Compare estimation variance with a full particle filter at equal cost on a mixed linear/nonlinear benchmark.
math/info_stats|linalg.area: Particle filters and sequential Monte Carlo

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Particle marginal Metropolis-Hastings for the process-noise variance of the growth model
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Embed the bootstrap particle filter likelihood estimate in a random-walk Metropolis-Hastings sampler over log σ_v². Tune N so the log-likelihood standard deviation is near 1.2, and report posterior mean and acceptance rate.
math/info_stats|linalg.area: Particle filters and sequential Monte Carlo

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Comparing multinomial, stratified, systematic and residual resampling variance
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: For fixed skewed weight vectors, compute the empirical variance of offspring counts and the induced error of a test-function estimate under each resampling scheme. Compare with the analytic multinomial variance.
math/info_stats|linalg.area: Particle filters and sequential Monte Carlo

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Forward-filtering backward-smoothing particle smoother for stochastic volatility
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Store filtered particles and reweight them backward using transition densities, an O(N²T) computation. Obtain smoothed log-volatility means, then compare them with the filter output and with a long-run reference.
math/info_stats|linalg.area: Particle filters and sequential Monte Carlo

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Range-only robot localization with beacons: multimodal particle filter posterior
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Use a particle filter to localize a 2D robot from noisy ranges to two or three known beacons. Track the posterior modes, ESS and RMSE as geometry resolves the mirror ambiguity, and compare against an EKF failure case.
math/info_stats|linalg.area: Particle filters and sequential Monte Carlo

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Locally optimal proposal particle filter with linear Gaussian observations
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: For nonlinear Gaussian dynamics and a linear observation y = Hx + v, derive the optimal importance density p(x_t|x_{t-1},y_t) via Gaussian conditioning, using matrix inverses and Cholesky factors. Compare the weight degeneracy with the bootstrap filter.
math/info_stats|linalg.area: Particle filters and sequential Monte Carlo

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Kalman filter and RTS smoother for constant-velocity tracking with NEES/NIS tests
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Simulate a 2D constant-velocity target, then run the Kalman filter and the Rauch-Tung-Striebel smoother. Compute Monte Carlo-averaged NEES and NIS and check them against chi-square confidence bounds under correct and mistuned process noise.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: EM learning of a linear dynamical system with lag-one smoothed covariances
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Implement the Shumway-Stoffer EM algorithm. The E-step is an RTS smoother with lag-one cross-covariances, and the M-step gives closed-form updates of A, C, Q and R. Monitor likelihood monotonicity and the recovered spectrum of A.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Information filter for decentralized multi-sensor fusion
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Run the Kalman filter in information form (Y = P^{-1}, y = P^{-1}x) with several sensors contributing additive information H_i^T R_i^{-1} H_i terms. Verify numerical equivalence with the centralized covariance-form filter.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Dynamic linear regression with time-varying coefficients via Kalman smoothing
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Model regression coefficients as random walks and observations as y_t = x_t^T β_t + ε. Estimate the β_t trajectories with filtering and RTS smoothing, and choose the drift variance by maximizing the marginal likelihood.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Covariance intersection fusion of estimates with unknown cross-correlation
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Fuse two Gaussian estimates using P^{-1} = ωP_a^{-1} + (1−ω)P_b^{-1}, with ω minimizing the determinant or trace. Compare consistency with naive independent fusion when the true correlation is nonzero.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Kalman filtering of an irregularly sampled Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process via Van Loan
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Discretize a 2D linear SDE exactly for arbitrary time gaps using the Van Loan block matrix exponential to obtain Φ and Q_d. Run the Kalman filter on irregular samples and compare with naive Euler discretization.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Orthogonal matching pursuit on a spike-plus-DCT dictionary and mutual coherence guarantees
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Build the union of identity and orthonormal DCT bases, compute its mutual coherence from the Gram matrix, and run OMP with least-squares updates via QR. Compare the empirical exact-recovery rate against the coherence bound k < (1 + 1/mu)/2.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Approximate message passing for LASSO and its state-evolution MSE prediction
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Implement AMP with soft thresholding and the Onsager correction term for i.i.d. Gaussian sensing of a Bernoulli-Gaussian signal. Compare the per-iteration empirical MSE with the scalar state-evolution recursion, evaluated by numerical quadrature.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Restricted isometry constants of small random matrices by exhaustive submatrix eigenvalues
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: For small Gaussian and Bernoulli matrices, enumerate every k-column submatrix and compute the extreme eigenvalues of its Gram matrix to get the exact RIP constant delta_k. Study how delta_k grows with k and with the aspect ratio, and compare it with Marchenko-Pastur edge estimates.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: NLMS acoustic echo canceller: echo return loss enhancement versus step size
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Simulate a far-end AR speech-like signal passed through an exponentially decaying synthetic room impulse response with near-end noise, and adapt a normalized LMS FIR filter to cancel the echo. Compute ERLE curves, the steady-state misalignment and the convergence time as functions of the step size and filter length.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: LMS misadjustment and eigenvalue-spread convergence for AR(1)-correlated input
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Identify an unknown FIR system with LMS driven by AR(1) input. Build the input Toeplitz autocorrelation matrix and use its eigenvalues to predict mode time constants and the misadjustment M ≈ mu·tr(R)/2. Check these predictions against ensemble-averaged learning curves.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Exponentially weighted RLS tracking a random-walk FIR channel
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Run RLS with a Riccati inverse-correlation update to track channel taps that evolve as a Gaussian random walk. Measure the excess MSE as the sum of a lag term and a noise term versus the forgetting factor lambda, and find the optimal lambda against the theoretical tracking formula.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: LMS adaptive line enhancer for a sinusoid buried in white noise
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Use an LMS predictor with a decorrelation delay to separate a narrowband sinusoid from broadband noise. Compute the converged weights' frequency response by FFT and compare it with the Wiener solution R^{-1}p from the Toeplitz normal equations. Report the output SNR gain.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Rate-distortion of a Gauss-Markov process by reverse water-filling on Toeplitz eigenvalues
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: For an AR(1) Gaussian process, compute the n-block R(D) by reverse water-filling over the eigenvalues of the n×n Toeplitz covariance. Show convergence to the spectral (Kolmogorov) reverse water-filling formula as n grows, using the Szegő limit.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Iterative information bottleneck on a discrete joint distribution
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Implement Tishby's self-consistent IB updates for p(t|x), p(t) and p(y|t) on a small discrete p(x,y). Sweep beta to trace the I(T;Y) versus I(X;T) curve, and detect the cluster-splitting phase transitions through the critical beta values.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Least-squares spectral analysis with iterative prewhitening of multiple frequencies
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Apply Vaníček-style successive least-squares spectral analysis to an unevenly sampled multiperiodic signal. Pick the highest peak, refit all frequencies jointly by nonlinear least squares with a Gauss-Newton Jacobian, subtract the fit and repeat. Compute the spectral window and the final amplitude and frequency uncertainties from the covariance matrix.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Total-variation denoising of a piecewise-constant signal by ADMM
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Minimize 0.5||x-y||^2 + lambda·||Dx||_1 using ADMM, with a banded (D^T D + I) linear solve in each iteration and soft thresholding. Track primal and dual residuals, and measure jump-location accuracy and MSE versus lambda.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: LARS homotopy algorithm for the full LASSO regularization path
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Implement least-angle regression with the LASSO modification, which drops a variable when its coefficient crosses zero, using equiangular directions from active-set Gram inverses. Compute the piecewise-linear path for a correlated design, verify it against coordinate descent at sampled lambdas, and select lambda by K-fold CV.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Asymmetric least-squares baseline correction of a synthetic Raman spectrum
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Estimate a smooth fluorescence baseline under sharp Raman peaks with the Eilers-Boelens penalized least squares method. Iteratively solve the sparse banded system (W + lambda·D2^T D2)z = Wy and update the weights asymmetrically. Report the baseline error and the recovered peak areas versus lambda and the asymmetry p.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Fraser-Potter two-filter smoother versus RTS for a damped-oscillator state-space model
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: For a discretized damped harmonic oscillator observed in noise, run a forward Kalman filter and a backward information filter. Fuse them into two-filter smoothed estimates and verify numerical equality with Rauch-Tung-Striebel means and covariances, including over intervals with missing observations.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Lee-Seung Frobenius NMF unmixing of overlapping Raman component spectra
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Generate mixture spectra from three nonnegative Lorentzian-band pure components with random concentrations. Factorize them with multiplicative updates under the Frobenius loss, verify monotone objective decrease, and match the recovered endmembers to the true ones by correlation after permutation and scaling.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: KL-divergence NMF extraction of mutational signatures from 96-channel counts
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Simulate Poisson tumor mutation counts from known 96-trinucleotide signatures and exposures. Factorize with KL multiplicative updates over multiple restarts, choose the rank by reconstruction error and solution stability, and measure cosine similarity of the recovered signatures to the ground truth.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Itakura-Saito NMF of a magnitude spectrogram for two-note source separation
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Compute the power spectrogram of a synthetic two-note harmonic mixture by STFT and factorize it with Itakura-Saito multiplicative updates. Reconstruct each source with Wiener soft masks and the inverse STFT, then report source-to-distortion ratios and compare with Euclidean NMF.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Constant-Q transform kernel matrix and least-squares inversion for harmonic tones
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Build the constant-Q transform (CQT) as a dense complex kernel matrix of windowed geometric-frequency atoms. Apply it to a synthetic two-note harmonic signal, measure how resolution changes across octaves, and reconstruct the signal with the pseudo-inverse. Report the reconstruction SNR versus the number of bins per octave.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Time-varying AR(2) spectrum with Legendre-basis coefficients tracking a linear chirp
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Expand the coefficients of a TVAR(2) model on a Legendre polynomial basis and fit them by least squares to a noisy linear chirp. Read the instantaneous frequency off the time-varying pole angle and compare its tracking error with spectrogram peak tracking.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Eigen-decomposition of the Zhao-Atlas-Marks kernel into weighted spectrograms
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Write the Zhao-Atlas-Marks (cone-kernel) Cohen-class distribution as a Hermitian local kernel matrix. Diagonalize it so the distribution becomes a weighted sum of spectrograms with eigenvector windows. Measure truncation error versus the number of retained eigen-windows on a two-chirp signal.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Classical MDS of great-circle distances on a sphere: negative eigenvalues and stress
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Double-centre the squared geodesic distance matrix of points on a sphere and eigendecompose it. Quantify non-Euclidean structure through the negative-eigenvalue mass, and compute Kruskal stress versus embedding dimension, contrasting with chordal distances.
math/info_stats|linalg.area: Manifold learning and nonlinear dimensionality reduction

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Locally linear embedding of the S-curve with regularized local Gram matrices
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Implement LLE: solve regularized local Gram systems for the reconstruction weights, then take the bottom eigenvectors of (I-W)^T(I-W). Evaluate recovery of the S-curve's 2D intrinsic coordinates as a function of the regularization strength and the neighbourhood size.
math/info_stats|linalg.area: Manifold learning and nonlinear dimensionality reduction

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Local tangent space alignment unfolding a noisy helicoid surface
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Compute local tangent coordinates by SVD of centred neighbourhoods and assemble the LTSA alignment matrix. Extract the 2D global parametrization of a helicoid from its null-space eigenvectors, and report the Procrustes error against the true parameters under added noise.
math/info_stats|linalg.area: Manifold learning and nonlinear dimensionality reduction

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Spectral clustering of a stochastic block model near the Kesten-Stigum threshold
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Generate two-community stochastic block model graphs and cluster them using the eigenvectors of the adjacency matrix, the normalized Laplacian and the Bethe-Hessian. Compute overlap with the planted partition as a function of (c_in - c_out), relative to the detectability threshold.
math/info_stats|linalg.area: Manifold learning and nonlinear dimensionality reduction

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Brown-Durbin-Evans recursive-residual CUSUM test for regression parameter instability
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Compute recursive residuals of a linear regression by recursive least squares with rank-one updates, and form the CUSUM and CUSUM-of-squares paths with their significance boundaries. Determine the detection time of a mid-sample slope break.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Singular spectrum transformation change-point score for an abrupt frequency change
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Build past and future Hankel trajectory matrices in a sliding window and take their dominant left singular subspaces. Compute the SST score as 1 minus the largest subspace cosine. Locate a frequency jump in a noisy sinusoid and study the score's sensitivity to window length and subspace rank.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: MEWMA chart average run length by the Runger-Prabhu Markov chain approximation
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Discretize the multivariate EWMA statistic into an on-axis/off-axis two-dimensional Markov chain and solve (I-Q) ARL = 1 for in-control and shifted average run lengths. Compare the results with Monte Carlo ARLs for a bivariate correlated process.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Probabilistic PCA by EM versus the Tipping-Bishop closed-form ML solution
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Fit probabilistic PCA to synthetic low-rank-plus-isotropic-noise data in two ways: by EM iterations on W and σ², and by the closed-form eigendecomposition solution. Compare the convergence rate, the recovered subspace angles and the noise variance estimates.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Gavish-Donoho optimal hard threshold for singular values in low-rank denoising
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Denoise noisy low-rank matrices of different aspect ratios by truncating singular values at the optimal threshold ω(β)·median(σ). Compare the Frobenius error with truncation at the true rank and with the Marchenko-Pastur bulk edge.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Factor analysis by EM versus PCA under heteroscedastic noise
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Fit a factor analysis model with diagonal noise Ψ by EM, using the Woodbury identity for posterior moments, to data whose noise variances differ widely across channels. Compare the loading-subspace recovery with PCA, which absorbs the high-variance noise channels.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Finite-rate-of-innovation recovery of a periodic Dirac stream via annihilating filter
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Sample a K-Dirac periodic stream through a sinc kernel and form the Toeplitz system for the annihilating filter. Solve it by total least squares (SVD), take roots to get the locations, then find the amplitudes by Vandermonde least squares. Report location error versus SNR.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Phase retrieval by spectral initialization and Wirtinger flow from Gaussian measurements
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Recover a complex vector from intensity measurements |a_i^H x|². Initialize with the leading eigenvector of the weighted measurement matrix, then refine by Wirtinger gradient descent. Map the success rate versus the oversampling ratio m/n.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Geweke spectral Granger causality for a bivariate VAR(2) with unidirectional coupling
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Fit a VAR(2) model by least squares, then compute the transfer function H(f) and the spectral matrix. Apply Geweke's normalization transform to decompose the spectral power into intrinsic and causal parts. Check that integrating the frequency-domain causality reproduces the time-domain Granger causality.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Partial directed coherence of a five-channel VAR network
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Estimate a five-variable VAR model with sparse directed coupling by multivariate least squares. Compute the column-normalized partial directed coherence from the Fourier transform of the coefficient matrices, and recover the directed connectivity graph with surrogate thresholds.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Gradient-enhanced Gaussian process regression of a Morse potential curve
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Build the joint covariance of function values and derivatives for a squared-exponential kernel. Condition on sparse energy-plus-force data from a Morse potential using a Cholesky factorization, and compare the posterior error and variance with those from energy-only GP regression.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Matérn-3/2 Gaussian process: state-space Kalman inference versus dense Cholesky
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Express the Matérn-3/2 GP as a two-dimensional linear SDE and discretize it at irregular inputs using matrix exponentials. Run a Kalman filter and RTS smoother, and verify that the posterior mean, variance and log marginal likelihood match the dense Cholesky solution, comparing the scaling with n.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Residual and wild bootstrap versus HC3 sandwich covariance for heteroscedastic regression
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: For a linear regression with variance growing in x, compute the HC0 and HC3 sandwich standard errors from the hat-matrix leverages. Compare them with standard errors from the residual and wild (Rademacher) bootstrap, and report confidence-interval coverage by Monte Carlo.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Mantel permutation test between geographic and genetic distance matrices
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Simulate populations under isolation by distance and compute the Mantel statistic between the geographic and genetic distance matrices. Obtain its p-value by joint row-column permutation, and compute the partial Mantel test that controls for an environmental distance matrix through matrix residualization.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: PRESS leave-one-out cross-validation via the hat matrix versus AIC and BIC for polynomial order
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Fit polynomials of increasing degree by QR least squares and compute the leave-one-out error in closed form as Σ(e_i/(1-h_ii))². Compare the polynomial orders selected by PRESS, AIC, BIC and GCV over repeated noisy samples of a known smooth function.

math/info_stats|linalg.title: Slow feature analysis extracting a slowly varying driving force from a chaotic map
math/info_stats|linalg.gist: Expand time series of a logistic map with a slowly drifting parameter in a quadratic feature space. Solve the generalized eigenproblem between the covariance of temporal differences and the feature covariance, and correlate the slowest feature with the true hidden driving force.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Linear method optimization of hydrogen atom exponent with stabilization shift scan
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Trial wavefunction exp(-a r) for hydrogen: estimate the overlap and Hamiltonian matrices in the {psi, d psi/da} basis from VMC samples. Solve the 2x2 generalized eigenproblem with a diagonal shift and iterate until a converges to 1 and the energy to -0.5 Ha.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Linear method for VMC energy minimization

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Zero-variance principle of nonsymmetric linear-method Hamiltonian estimator for harmonic oscillator
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: For a Gaussian-times-polynomial trial function of the 1D harmonic oscillator, build symmetric and nonsymmetric sample estimates of H in the parameter-derivative basis. Compare the statistical variance of the resulting eigenvalue and parameter update as sample size grows.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Linear method for VMC energy minimization

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Semi-orthogonalized derivative normalization in linear method for Morse oscillator
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Optimize the nonlinear parameters of a Morse-oscillator trial wavefunction with the linear method. Rescale parameter updates using the xi-dependent semi-orthogonalization of derivatives against psi, and compare convergence stability for xi = 0, 0.5 and 1 against the exact ground-state energy.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Linear method for VMC energy minimization

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Correlated-sampling selection of linear-method shift for H2 molecule Jastrow-Slater wavefunction
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: For H2 at fixed bond length with a Jastrow-Slater trial function, solve the linear-method eigenproblem for several stabilization shifts. Estimate each candidate's energy by reweighted correlated sampling on the same samples, and select the shift that minimizes energy without instability.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Linear method for VMC energy minimization

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Linear method in CI-coefficient space for Gutzwiller-projected four-site Hubbard ring
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Linear-parameter trial state for the 4-site Hubbard ring: a combination of a few determinants times a Gutzwiller factor. Estimate H and S in the determinant basis from VMC samples and show the eigenvector reproduces the exact projected diagonalization in the large-sample limit.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Linear method for VMC energy minimization

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Orbital rotation parameters in linear method for two fermions in harmonic trap
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Two same-spin fermions in a 1D harmonic trap with soft Gaussian repulsion. Parameterize the orbitals by Givens rotations within a small oscillator basis, compute log-derivatives of the Slater determinant, and optimize the orbitals with the linear method. Compare against basis-set exact diagonalization.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Linear method for VMC energy minimization

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Linear method versus Newton optimization for anharmonic quartic oscillator variational ansatz
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Quartic oscillator x^4 with trial function exp(-a x^2 - b x^4). Compare iterations to convergence and stability under noise for two optimizers: the linear-method generalized eigenproblem and Newton steps using a stochastic Hessian built from the same derivative samples.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Linear method for VMC energy minimization

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Stochastic reconfiguration as projected imaginary-time evolution on small Hilbert space
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Use a complete-enough variational ansatz on a few-spin Heisenberg cluster with exact expectation values. Show that small-step SR updates reproduce exact imaginary-time evolution exp(-τH)|ψ>, tracking fidelity and energy versus τ.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Time-dependent variational Monte Carlo quench dynamics with Jastrow ansatz
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Integrate the McLachlan equations S θdot = -i F with RK4 for a complex Jastrow ansatz after a transverse-field quench in a 10-site Ising chain. Use regularized linear solves at each step, and compare <σx(t)> and the Loschmidt echo with exact time evolution.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Minimum-step stochastic reconfiguration in sample space for overparameterized ansatz
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Implement MinSR for a variational state with more parameters than samples. Solve the natural-gradient step through the sample-space Gram matrix T T† instead of the parameter-space S matrix, and verify it equals the pseudo-inverse SR update on a small Heisenberg ring.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Stochastic reconfiguration of Gaussian Jastrow for trapped bosons with contact-like interaction
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: N bosons in a 1D harmonic trap with a narrow Gaussian repulsion. Use a trial function with a variational trap width and pair Jastrow parameters, optimize it by SR from Metropolis samples, and report the energy per particle versus interaction strength.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Stochastic reconfiguration of Gutzwiller-Jastrow wavefunction for Bose-Hubbard ring
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Bose-Hubbard ring of 8 sites at unit filling with a truncated occupation basis. Optimize an on-site Gutzwiller plus density-density Jastrow ansatz by SR and compare energy and density fluctuations with exact diagonalization across U/t.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Stochastic reconfiguration for spin-1 bilinear-biquadratic chain variational ansatz
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Two-body Jastrow ansatz over local spin-1 states for an 8-site bilinear-biquadratic chain near the AKLT point. Optimize it with SR via a regularized linear solve, and compare energies and spin correlations with exact diagonalization.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: RBM for Heisenberg antiferromagnet with Marshall sign and zero-magnetization exchange moves
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Heisenberg ring of 12 sites using an RBM amplitude times the Marshall sign. Use Metropolis moves that exchange antiparallel neighbors to stay in the Sz=0 sector, optimize by SR, and report the relative energy error.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Neural-network quantum states on spin models

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Translation-symmetric RBM with weight sharing for J1-J2 Heisenberg chain
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Build a translation-invariant RBM whose hidden filters are shifted copies, cutting the parameter count to α(N+1). Train it on the J1-J2 chain at J2=0 and J2=0.5 (Majumdar-Ghosh point) and compare with exact ground energies.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Neural-network quantum states on spin models

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Complex RBM learning ground-state sign structure of frustrated J1-J2 chain
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Use complex RBM weights without a sign rule on the J1-J2 chain at J2=0.4. Optimize with complex SR and measure both the energy and the fraction of configurations whose amplitude sign matches the exact ground state.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Neural-network quantum states on spin models

physics/many_body|linalg.title: RBM for two-dimensional transverse-field Ising model on 4x4 torus
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Train an RBM on the 4x4 periodic TFIM at several fields around h≈3.04. Estimate the energy and squared magnetization with Metropolis sampling and compare with sparse Lanczos exact diagonalization in the 65536-dimensional space.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Neural-network quantum states on spin models

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Jastrow versus RBM ansatz comparison on two-leg Heisenberg ladder
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Two-leg spin-1/2 Heisenberg ladder of 2x6 sites. Optimize a two-body Jastrow and an RBM with comparable parameter counts by SR, then compare variational energies, rung and leg correlations, and the energy variance against exact diagonalization.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Neural-network quantum states on spin models

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Single Lanczos step improvement of a trained RBM state
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Starting from an SR-optimized RBM for the Heisenberg chain, compute <H>, <H^2> and <H^3> by sampling. Solve the 2x2 Lanczos-step problem for the optimal α in (1+αH)|ψ>, and report the energy gain and the variance-extrapolated energy.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Neural-network quantum states on spin models

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Feedforward neural-network quantum state for Bose-Hubbard chain occupation configurations
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: One-hidden-layer network with one-hot occupation inputs as the amplitude for an 8-site Bose-Hubbard chain at unit filling. Train by SR with particle-conserving hopping moves, and compute the energy and the one-body density matrix compared with ED.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Neural-network quantum states on spin models

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Gap times system size crossings for transverse-field Ising chain criticality
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Compute the lowest gap of periodic TFIM chains with L=6-16 by sparse Lanczos in the parity sectors. Locate the crossings of L·Δ(h) between successive sizes and extrapolate them to h_c=1 with dynamical exponent z=1.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Finite-size scaling of quantum critical points

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Level crossing method for J1-J2 Heisenberg chain dimerization transition
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Okamoto-Nomura approach: find where the lowest singlet and triplet excitations cross versus J2 in periodic J1-J2 chains of L=8-24, using momentum- and spin-resolved Lanczos. Extrapolate in 1/L^2 to J2c≈0.2411.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Finite-size scaling of quantum critical points

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Three-state quantum Potts chain data collapse of energy gap
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Build the sparse 3-state Potts chain Hamiltonian for L up to 12 and compute gaps near the self-dual point. Perform data collapse of L·Δ versus (g-1)L^{1/ν}, fitting ν≈5/6 by minimizing a collapse cost function.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Finite-size scaling of quantum critical points

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Central charge from entanglement entropy scaling in periodic XXZ chains
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Compute ground-state subsystem entanglement entropies of periodic XXZ chains from ED reduced density matrices. Fit to the Calabrese-Cardy chord-length formula to extract c=1 across the critical regime -1<Δ≤1.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Finite-size scaling of quantum critical points

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Free-fermion finite-size scaling of anisotropic XY chain gap and susceptibility
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Map the XY chain in a transverse field to free fermions and diagonalize the 2L x 2L Bogoliubov-de Gennes matrix for L up to 1000. Perform finite-size scaling of the gap and the ground-state energy second derivative to confirm Ising universality.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Finite-size scaling of quantum critical points

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Critical exponent of ANNNI chain transition from gap scaling
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Transverse-field ANNNI chain with next-nearest-neighbor frustration κ. Use Lanczos gaps of chains up to L=16 and scaled-gap crossings to locate the ferromagnetic-paramagnetic transition line for several κ, comparing with the κ=0 Ising point.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Finite-size scaling of quantum critical points

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Infinite TEBD imaginary-time ground state of transverse-field Ising chain
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Two-site unit-cell iTEBD with second-order Trotter gates in imaginary time and SVD truncation to bond dimension χ. Converge the energy per site and compare with the exact free-fermion result versus χ and time step.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Domain-wall melting magnetization profile in XXZ chain by TEBD
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Start a finite open XXZ chain from the |↑↑↑↓↓↓> domain-wall product state and real-time evolve it with TEBD. Compute the magnetization profile and transported spin versus time for Δ=0 (ballistic, compare exact) and Δ=0.5.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Lieb-Robinson light cone of connected correlations after Ising quench
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Quench a fully polarized state with the TFIM and evolve it with TEBD. Compute connected σz-σz correlations versus distance and time, extract the light-cone velocity, and compare with free-fermion exact correlators.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Entanglement entropy growth after Néel quench in Heisenberg chain
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Evolve the Néel state under the XXZ Hamiltonian with TEBD at several bond dimensions. Record half-chain von Neumann entropy versus time, identify the linear growth rate, and show the χ-dependent saturation and truncation error.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Trotter error scaling of second- and fourth-order Suzuki decompositions
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: On a 10-site Heisenberg chain, compare TEBD states from first-, second-order and Forest-Ruth fourth-order gate sequences against exact expm evolution with no truncation. Fit the global error exponent versus time step.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Mott-state quench in Bose-Hubbard chain with truncated boson TEBD
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Quench from the unit-filling Mott product state to a finite U/J Bose-Hubbard chain with local dimension 4. Use TEBD to compute on-site occupation variance and the spread of density-density correlations.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: String order parameter of spin-1 Heisenberg chain via imaginary-time TEBD
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Obtain the Haldane-phase ground state of the spin-1 Heisenberg chain by imaginary-time TEBD with spin-1 gates. Compute the den Nijs-Rommelse string correlator and its long-distance value of about 0.374, and contrast it with the AKLT value 4/9.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Helium-4 trimer ground state with correlated Gaussian basis
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Expand the He3 relative-motion wavefunction in explicitly correlated Gaussians with analytic overlaps and kinetic matrix elements. Evaluate potential matrix elements of the Aziz potential, which is fit to Gaussians by least squares, and solve the generalized eigenproblem for the trimer binding energy.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Static structure factor and Feynman phonon-roton spectrum of liquid helium-4
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: From McMillan-VMC configurations in a cubic box, compute S(k) on reciprocal-lattice vectors with shell averaging. Evaluate the Feynman excitation energy ħ²k²/(2m S(k)) and locate the roton minimum.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Pair distribution function and potential-energy tail correction for liquid helium-4
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Histogram g(r) from VMC samples with the minimum-image convention and normalize it by ideal-gas shells. Compute the potential energy per atom from g(r), including an analytic tail correction beyond L/2, and compare it with the direct estimator.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Liquid-drop extrapolation of helium-4 cluster energies to bulk
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Compute VMC energies per atom of He-4 droplets with N=20-112 using a McMillan Jastrow plus one-body confining term. Fit E/N = e_v + e_s N^{-1/3} + e_c N^{-2/3} by least squares to obtain the bulk and surface energies.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Finite-size extrapolation of Hartree-Fock exchange energy of homogeneous electron gas
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: For closed-shell electron numbers in a periodic box, compute the HF exchange energy by k-point sums with the Ewald Madelung term. Least-squares fit to E∞ + a/N and compare E∞ with the analytic -0.916/r_s Ry.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Natoli-Ceperley optimized breakup of Coulomb potential by least squares
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Split 1/r into a short-range part in a local finite-element basis and a long-range part in k-space. Choose the coefficients by weighted least-squares minimization of the k-space error with constraints, and compare errors against standard Ewald splitting.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Ewald energies and forces for random neutral charge configurations
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Implement Ewald energies and analytic forces for N random point charges in a triclinic cell using reciprocal lattice vectors from the cell matrix inverse. Validate the forces by finite differences and the energy against spherical-shell direct sums with a dipole correction.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Importance-sampled DMC of 3D harmonic oscillator with time-step extrapolation
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Drift-diffusion DMC with Metropolis-corrected moves and branching for a 3D oscillator using a deliberately off-width Gaussian trial function. Compute mixed-estimator energies at several time steps and extrapolate to τ→0 by least squares.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Fixed-node DMC for first excited state of anharmonic oscillator
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Use an odd trial function with a node at x=0 for the 1D oscillator V=x²/2+λx⁴. Run fixed-node importance-sampled DMC and compare the excited-state energy with a finite-difference sparse eigensolver reference.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: DMC energy of Hooke's atom two electrons in parabolic trap
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Two electrons in a 3D harmonic confinement with Coulomb repulsion at ω=1/2, where the exact energy is 2 Ha. Run DMC with a Gaussian times Pade-Jastrow trial function and verify the mixed energy and its time-step error.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Extrapolated estimator for mean-square radius in quartic oscillator DMC
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Compute <x²> from VMC and mixed DMC estimates with a Gaussian trial function for a quartic oscillator, then form the extrapolated estimator 2<x²>_mix - <x²>_VMC. Compare with exact grid diagonalization.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: DMC of trapped bosons with soft-core repulsion versus Gross-Pitaevskii
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: N bosons in a 3D harmonic trap with Gaussian repulsion, using a Gaussian-Jastrow trial function. Compute the DMC energy per particle versus N and compare with a Gross-Pitaevskii mean-field estimate from a radial finite-difference solve.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Mid-spectrum eigenstate entanglement entropy volume-to-area law transition
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: For the random-field Heisenberg chain, compute half-chain entanglement entropies of eigenstates near the energy density center via SVD of reshaped eigenvectors. Compare with the Page value, and analyze the disorder dependence of the mean and its variance peak.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Participation entropy scaling of eigenstates in disordered spin chains
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Compute the inverse participation ratio and participation entropies S_q of mid-spectrum eigenstates in the computational basis. Fit their scaling with Hilbert-space dimension to extract fractal dimensions versus disorder.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Quasiperiodic Aubry-André field Heisenberg chain level statistics
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Replace random fields with h cos(2πβi+φ) using β the inverse golden ratio. Average over phases φ and compute gap-ratio statistics and entanglement versus h, then compare the crossover location with the random-field case.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Néel-state imbalance dynamics in disordered XXZ chain from full spectrum
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Evolve the Néel state using the full eigendecomposition of the random-field XXZ chain. Compute the disorder-averaged spin imbalance versus time and its long-time value as a function of W, the diagnostic used in cold-atom experiments.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Logarithmic entanglement growth in many-body localized chain
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: From exact eigendecompositions, compute half-chain entanglement after a product-state quench in the strongly disordered XXZ chain. Contrast the log(t) growth at finite Jz with saturation at Jz=0 and fit the growth coefficient.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Eigenstate thermalization test in tilted-field Ising chain
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: For the nonintegrable Ising chain with transverse and longitudinal fields, using momentum blocks, compute diagonal matrix elements of local σx in eigenstates. Show the eigenstate-to-eigenstate fluctuations shrink exponentially with L, and examine the off-diagonal element distribution.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Spectral form factor of kicked Ising Floquet chain
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Build the Floquet unitary of a kicked Ising chain with disorder, diagonalize it, and compute the spectral form factor K(t) of quasienergies averaged over realizations. Compare the ramp with the circular orthogonal ensemble and identify the Thouless time.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Truncation error versus fidelity for compressed Heisenberg ground-state MPS
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Convert an ED ground state of a 16-site Heisenberg chain into a mixed-canonical MPS and truncate to bond dimension χ. Compare the discarded-weight sum with the actual infidelity and the energy error.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Matrix product states and canonical forms

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Variational MPS compression of sum of two MPS by sweeping
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Compress the sum of two random MPS into a single MPS of bond dimension χ by alternating local least-squares updates in canonical form. Compare the resulting error with naive SVD truncation of the direct-sum MPS.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Matrix product states and canonical forms

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Entanglement spectrum degeneracy diagnosing Haldane phase symmetry protection
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Obtain MPS ground states of the spin-1 chain with a D(Sz)² anisotropy using DMRG or iTEBD. Compute the Schmidt spectrum at a central bond, and show the twofold degeneracy is present in the Haldane phase and lifted in the large-D phase.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Matrix product states and canonical forms

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Fidelity per site from MPS transfer matrix across Ising transition
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: For infinite TFIM ground-state MPS at fields h and h', compute the leading eigenvalue of the mixed transfer matrix to get the fidelity per site. Map d(h,h') and show the pinch point at h_c=1.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Matrix product states and canonical forms

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Rényi entropy parity oscillations in open XX chain
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Compute Rényi-n block entropies of the open XX chain from correlation-matrix eigenvalues. Fit the subleading oscillating term (-1)^l l^{-2/n} to extract its amplitude and test the predicted exponent.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Srednicki area law for a sphere in a three-dimensional harmonic lattice
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Discretize a free massless scalar field radially with a partial-wave decomposition. Compute each partial wave's entropy from symplectic eigenvalues of the reduced covariance matrices, then sum over angular momenta to show S proportional to R^2.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Logarithmic negativity between blocks of a harmonic chain
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Build position and momentum covariance matrices of a coupled-oscillator chain and apply the partial transpose as a momentum sign flip. Compute the logarithmic negativity of adjacent and disjoint blocks from symplectic eigenvalues as a function of separation.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Mutual information of disjoint intervals in critical Ising chain
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Map the critical transverse-field Ising chain to Majorana fermions and build the Majorana correlation matrix for two separated intervals. Compute the mutual information I(A:B) from the eigenvalues and study its decay with the cross-ratio.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Symmetry-resolved entanglement in the Bose-Hubbard chain
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Exactly diagonalize a small Bose-Hubbard chain and block the reduced density matrix by subsystem particle number. Compute the number and configurational entanglement contributions and their sum across the superfluid-Mott crossover.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Exact enumeration of Hubbard-Stratonovich fields for tiny Hubbard cluster
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: For a two-site Hubbard model with few time slices, sum det(1+B↑)det(1+B↓) over all auxiliary-field configurations. Verify that the result equals the exactly Trotterized partition function and the thermal energy.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Determinant quantum Monte Carlo for Hubbard model

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Checkerboard breakup of the DQMC kinetic propagator and its error
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Decompose exp(-ΔτK) for a square lattice into commuting bond-pair exponentials. Measure the operator-norm error against the exact matrix exponential and its effect on DQMC energies.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Determinant quantum Monte Carlo for Hubbard model

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Sherman-Morrison fast updates and wrapping drift in DQMC
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Implement rank-one Green's function updates for single auxiliary-spin flips and wrapping between time slices. Quantify the accumulated deviation from freshly recomputed Green's functions as a function of the recomputation interval.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Determinant quantum Monte Carlo for Hubbard model

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Richardson-Gaudin integrals of motion and simultaneous diagonalization
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Build the commuting Gaudin-magnet conserved operators R_i for a small pairing system and verify that they commute. Check their joint eigenvalues against the closed-form expressions in terms of the Richardson pair energies.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Degenerate-shell nuclear pairing with Richardson equations
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Solve the Richardson equations with level degeneracies Ω_j for a model valence shell of a semi-magic nucleus. Compute the odd-even mass staggering including blocked levels and compare with BCS.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Gaudin-matrix norms and Slavnov overlaps of Richardson eigenstates
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Compute normalizations of Richardson Bethe states from the Gaudin-matrix determinant and overlaps between states at different couplings from Slavnov determinants. Verify both by explicit construction in the Fock basis.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: p+ip hyperbolic Richardson-Gaudin model and Moore-Read line
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Solve the Bethe equations of the integrable p+ip pairing Hamiltonian for a small set of 2D momenta. Locate the Moore-Read and Read-Green points from the behaviour of the pair energies and the ground-state energy derivative.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Pair-breaking excitation spectrum of picket-fence Richardson model
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Solve the Richardson equations in every seniority sector by blocking unpaired levels. Assemble the low-lying excitation spectrum and the spectroscopic gap versus pairing strength, and verify it by exact diagonalization.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Hartree-Fock energy of closed-shell two-dimensional electron gas
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Fill closed shells of plane waves in a square periodic box and compute the kinetic energy and the exchange energy with 2D Ewald-summed Coulomb interactions. Include the Madelung term and compare with the infinite-system 2D HF formula versus N.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Homogeneous electron gas in periodic boxes

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Bloch ferromagnetism in finite-box Hartree-Fock jellium
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Compute HF energies of fully polarized and unpolarized closed-shell plane-wave determinants in a cubic box with Ewald interactions. Locate the polarization crossing r_s and compare it with the thermodynamic-limit value 5.45.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Homogeneous electron gas in periodic boxes

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Two-electron plane-wave full CI in a periodic jellium box
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Build the CI Hamiltonian for two opposite-spin electrons in a cubic box in a plane-wave pair basis with fixed total momentum and an Ewald Coulomb kernel. Diagonalize it and study convergence of the energy with the cutoff.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Homogeneous electron gas in periodic boxes

physics/many_body|linalg.title: MP2 correlation energy of 14-electron electron gas versus plane-wave cutoff
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Evaluate the MP2 correlation energy of the closed-shell 14-electron 3D electron gas by summing over momentum-conserving double excitations. Extrapolate in basis size following Shepherd et al.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Homogeneous electron gas in periodic boxes

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Ring-diagram RPA correlation energy of a finite electron gas
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: For each momentum transfer q, build the particle-hole RPA matrices of a closed-shell finite electron gas. Obtain the correlation energy from the plasmon formula, (1/2)Σ(ω_RPA - ω_TDA)-type eigenvalue sums, and compare with MP2.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Homogeneous electron gas in periodic boxes

physics/many_body|linalg.title: H2 STO-3G integrals from scratch and full CI dissociation curve
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Evaluate s-type Gaussian overlap, kinetic, nuclear-attraction and two-electron integrals with the Boys function. Run RHF and the 2x2 full CI to compare RHF and FCI potential curves and correlation energy.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: HeH+ STO-3G self-consistent field and full CI correlation energy
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Compute minimal-basis integrals for HeH+ and converge RHF SCF with symmetric orthogonalization. Transform to the MO basis and build the full determinant CI to obtain the correlation energy at the equilibrium bond length.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Full CI of rectangular-to-square H4 with Slater-Condon rules
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Build the full determinant-basis CI matrix of H4 in STO-3G using bit-string determinants and Slater-Condon rules. Track RHF versus FCI energies and the multireference weight along the rectangle-to-square distortion.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Davidson diagonalization of full CI for the H6 ring
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Implement σ = Hc products directly from Slater-Condon rules and the Davidson algorithm with a diagonal preconditioner. Compute the ground state of H6 in a minimal basis and compare iterations and accuracy with dense diagonalization.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: CISD size-inconsistency for two noninteracting H2 molecules
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Compare the CISD and FCI energies of a single H2 molecule with those of two H2 molecules far apart. Quantify the size-consistency error of CISD and test the Davidson correction.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Pariser-Parr-Pople full CI excitation energies of benzene
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Build the PPP π-electron Hamiltonian of benzene with Ohno interactions and construct the full CI in the six-orbital, six-electron determinant space. Obtain the singlet and triplet excitation energies and compare them with the Hückel and CIS results.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: UHF spin contamination versus full CI along H2 dissociation
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Solve UHF for H2 beyond the Coulson-Fischer point and compute ⟨S²⟩ from the determinant. Compare the UHF energy and spin expectation with FCI and locate the instability point from the RHF stability matrix.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Selected CI with Epstein-Nesbet PT2 for a Hubbard ring
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Implement CIPSI-style iterative determinant selection with Epstein-Nesbet second-order corrections for a 10-site Hubbard ring in the Hartree-Fock momentum-orbital basis. Extrapolate the variational energy to zero PT2 and compare with exact diagonalization.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Spin-adapted configuration state functions for linear H3 doublet
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Build determinant and spin-adapted CSF bases for three electrons in three orbitals and construct the CI Hamiltonian in each. Show that the CSF basis block-diagonalizes by total spin and reproduces the FCI doublet and quartet energies.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Analytic RBM representation of toric-code ground state verified by enumeration
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Construct the exact RBM with one hidden unit per plaquette and star (Deng et al.) for the toric code on a small torus. Verify by full enumeration that the amplitudes are stabilizer eigenstates and that the variational energy equals the exact ground-state energy.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Neural-network quantum states on spin models

physics/many_body|linalg.title: RBM excited state via orthogonality penalty for transverse-field Ising chain
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Train a second RBM with stochastic reconfiguration on an energy plus penalty-overlap functional, with the overlap with the first trained state estimated by Monte Carlo. Obtain the first excited-state energy and gap and compare with exact values.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Neural-network quantum states on spin models

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Rényi-2 entropy of RBM state via replica swap estimator
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Estimate S_2 of half-chain blocks of an RBM wavefunction by Metropolis sampling of two replicas and the swap operator expectation. Benchmark against SVD of the exactly enumerated RBM state.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Neural-network quantum states on spin models
