physics/many_body|linalg.title: Autoregressive neural quantum state with exact sampling for Heisenberg chain
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Implement a small autoregressive conditional-probability network with a Marshall sign rule so that configurations can be sampled directly without Markov chains. Optimize the variational energy and compare its statistical efficiency with Metropolis sampling.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Neural-network quantum states on spin models

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Autocorrelation time of Metropolis chains for RBM local energies
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Sample a trained Heisenberg RBM with single-flip and exchange moves. Compute integrated autocorrelation times and binning-analysis error bars of the local energy, comparing efficiency per CPU step.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Neural-network quantum states on spin models

physics/many_body|linalg.title: V-score of RBM ansatz across transverse-field Ising couplings
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Compute the variance-based V-score N·Var(E)/E² of trained RBMs for a range of transverse fields. Correlate it with the exact relative energy error to assess it as an accuracy diagnostic near criticality.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Neural-network quantum states on spin models

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Hubbard dimer single-particle G(τ) from Lehmann representation
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the two-site Hubbard model in all particle sectors and build G_k(τ) from the Lehmann sum. Extract the charge gap from the log-derivative and verify the G(0⁺)+G(β⁻) = -1 and density sum rules.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: f-sum rule from imaginary-time density correlator slope in Bose-Hubbard chain
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Compute the density-density correlator S(q,τ) by exact diagonalization. Verify that -dS/dτ at τ=0 equals the double commutator ⟨[[H,ρ_q],ρ_{-q}]⟩/2 expressed through the kinetic energy.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Legendre polynomial representation of imaginary-time Green's functions
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Expand G(τ) of an Anderson impurity in the atomic limit in Legendre polynomials by least squares. Show the rapid decay of the coefficients and the noise filtering, and transform the coefficients to Matsubara frequencies analytically.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Matsubara Green's function tails from commutator moments
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Compute the first three high-frequency moments of an Anderson atom Green's function from nested anticommutators. Use them to Fourier-transform G(τ) to G(iω_n) accurately and check the result against the exact Lehmann form.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Superfluid stiffness of hard-core bosons from imaginary-time current correlator
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Compute the current-current correlator Λ(τ) on a hard-core boson ring by exact diagonalization. Obtain the superfluid stiffness as kinetic term minus ∫dτΛ(τ) and verify it against the curvature of the energy under a flux twist.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Vidal Γ-Λ canonical form from left-canonical MPS
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Convert a random MPS to left-canonical form by QR and then sweep with SVDs to Vidal's Γ-Λ form. Verify the left and right orthonormality identities and the Schmidt values on every bond.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Matrix product states and canonical forms

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Mixed canonical form and local reduced density matrices of MPS
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Move the orthogonality center along an MPS with QR and LQ steps. Compute one- and two-site reduced density matrices locally and check them against contraction of the full state vector for a Heisenberg ground state.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Matrix product states and canonical forms

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Motzkin chain ground-state MPS and square-root-log entanglement
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Construct the exact MPS for the uniform superposition of Motzkin paths with height-tracking bond dimension. Compute the half-chain entanglement by canonicalization and verify the sqrt(log n) violation of the area law.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Matrix product states and canonical forms

physics/many_body|linalg.title: U(1) charge-conserving block-sparse MPS for XXZ chain
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Represent MPS tensors in magnetization quantum-number blocks and perform blockwise QR and SVD canonicalization and truncation. Verify the Sz-resolved entanglement spectrum and compare the cost with dense tensors.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Matrix product states and canonical forms

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Rényi-2 entropy of infinite MPS block from doubled transfer matrix
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Compute S_2 of a block of l sites in a translation-invariant MPS by contracting the replica (doubled) transfer matrices. Show saturation at large l, verify against Schmidt values in canonical form, and test the result on the AKLT state.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Matrix product states and canonical forms

physics/many_body|linalg.title: MBPT2 and MBPT3 versus CCD for the pairing Hamiltonian
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Compute second- and third-order many-body perturbation energies from the explicit diagram sums for the pairing model. Compare them with CCD and the exact solution over attractive and repulsive coupling ranges.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Coupled cluster doubles for pairing models

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Pair coupled-cluster doubles versus exact Richardson energies for picket fence
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Solve the pCCD (AP1roG) equations for half-filled picket-fence systems with up to 20 levels. Benchmark against exact Richardson solutions to show near-exactness at weak coupling and failure past the BCS transition.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Coupled cluster doubles for pairing models

physics/many_body|linalg.title: DIIS acceleration of CCD amplitude iterations for pairing
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Implement Pulay DIIS extrapolation on the pairing CCD residual vectors by solving the augmented B-matrix linear system. Compare iteration counts and convergence radius with damped Jacobi iteration as g varies.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Coupled cluster doubles for pairing models

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Ladder-only and ring-only approximations to pairing CCD
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Partition the pairing CCD equations into particle-particle ladder, hole-hole ladder and ring terms. Solve each truncated variant and assess which diagrams control accuracy against the exact energies.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Coupled cluster doubles for pairing models

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Equation-of-motion pair-addition CCD for neighboring-nucleus pairing energies
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Build the non-Hermitian EOM matrix for two-particle addition on top of the CCD similarity-transformed pairing Hamiltonian and diagonalize it. Compare the resulting ground and excited energies of the A+2 system with exact diagonalization.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Coupled cluster doubles for pairing models

physics/many_body|linalg.title: CCD Lambda equations and one-body occupation numbers for pairing
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Solve the linear CCD Λ equations for the pairing model and build the response one-body density matrix. Compare the level occupations with exact diagonalization and the Hellmann-Feynman derivative of the CCD energy.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Coupled cluster doubles for pairing models

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Branching random-walk GFMC for the one-dimensional Heisenberg antiferromagnet
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Perform stochastic GFMC with walkers moving according to the guided Green's function, using the Marshall sign rule so that weights stay positive. Apply branching population control and compare the energy with exact diagonalization or the Bethe ansatz.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Green's function Monte Carlo on lattices

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Fixed-node lattice GFMC for frustrated J1-J2 Heisenberg ring
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Construct the van Bemmel-ten Haaf effective fixed-node Hamiltonian with a sign-flip potential from a guiding wavefunction. Solve it by exact power iteration and stochastic walkers, and verify the variational upper bound against exact diagonalization.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Green's function Monte Carlo on lattices

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Forward-walking pure estimators of staggered magnetization in lattice GFMC
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Accumulate products of future walker weights to convert mixed estimates of the squared staggered magnetization into pure estimates on a 4x4 Heisenberg lattice. Study the convergence with forward-walking length.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Green's function Monte Carlo on lattices

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Correcting population-control bias with reweighting factor products
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Run branching lattice GFMC with population-controlled weights and store the history of normalization factors. Correct the energy by products of these factors over a history window and show that the bias is removed as a function of window length.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Green's function Monte Carlo on lattices

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Dynamical structure factor of the dimerized Heisenberg chain via Lanczos continued fraction
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Build the bond-alternating spin-1/2 Heisenberg ring (N=20) in momentum sectors and run Lanczos from S^z_q|0>. Evaluate S(q,ω) as a continued fraction and extract the one-triplon dispersion and the two-triplon continuum edge as functions of dimerization.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Single hole in the t-Jz model: string-state spectral function
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Use Lanczos and a continued fraction to compute the spectral function of one hole in an Ising antiferromagnet on a 4x4 cluster. Compare the ladder of peaks with the retraceable-path (Bethe-lattice) prediction, whose level spacings scale as (Jz/t)^(2/3).

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Fleury-Loudon two-magnon Raman spectrum of the honeycomb Heisenberg antiferromagnet
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Construct the Raman operator for A1g and Eg polarizations on an 18-site honeycomb cluster. Compute the Raman intensity from a Lanczos continued fraction and locate the two-magnon peak in units of J.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Krylov complexity and Lanczos coefficients of operator growth in SYK
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Represent the q=4 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev Hamiltonian with Majorana matrices (N=10-14). Run the Liouvillian Lanczos recursion on a single Majorana operator at infinite temperature, check the linear growth and saturation of b_n, and compute the Krylov complexity K(t).

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Scaling dimensions of the 3-state Potts model from TRG fixed-point tensors
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Coarse-grain the critical q=3 Potts tensor network with TRG. Diagonalize the transfer matrix built from the fixed-point tensor on a small cylinder to obtain the central charge c≈4/5 and the lowest scaling dimensions (Gu-Wen method).
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Tensor renormalization group for classical models

physics/many_body|linalg.title: HOTRG free energy and critical temperature of the 3D Ising model
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Implement higher-order TRG with HOSVD truncation for the cubic-lattice Ising tensor at small bond dimension. Compute the free energy and the internal energy versus T, and locate Tc from the energy inflection, comparing with 4.5115.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Tensor renormalization group for classical models

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Ashkin-Teller model free energy along the self-dual line via TRG
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Construct the four-state local tensor of the square-lattice Ashkin-Teller model and compute its free energy with TRG. Locate the critical line from the specific-heat peak at several four-spin couplings and check consistency with the self-dual curve.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Tensor renormalization group for classical models

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Krylov imaginary-time projection for the 4x4 J1-J2 square Heisenberg model
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Propagate random states as exp(-τH)|ψ> using Lanczos-based Krylov exponentiation. Measure the energy convergence rate against the exactly computed singlet-triplet gap for J2/J1 from 0 to 0.6, highlighting slowdown near the frustrated regime.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Chebyshev versus Krylov imaginary-time propagators for the 2D quantum compass model
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Project the 4x4 quantum compass model toward its ground manifold with both Chebyshev-series and Krylov propagators. Compare accuracy versus matrix-vector cost, and analyze slow convergence caused by the near-degenerate subsystem-symmetry states.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Momentum-sector Krylov projection for the frustrated sawtooth chain
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Build the spin-1/2 delta (sawtooth) chain in translation sectors. Imaginary-time project the lowest state in each momentum sector with Krylov exponentiation, then extract the dispersion of low-lying excitations and verify degeneracies at J2/J1 = 1/2.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Liouvillian gap of a dephasing tight-binding chain by Arnoldi iteration
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Vectorize the Lindblad superoperator for a single particle hopping on a chain with on-site dephasing. Compute the slowest relaxation modes with Arnoldi and check the diffusive gap scaling ~ (4J²/γ) sin²(π/L).

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Lattice Fermi polaron: Chevy one-particle-hole ansatz versus exact diagonalization
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Place a single down-spin impurity in an up-spin Fermi sea on a 2D Hubbard lattice with attractive U. Solve the Chevy variational ansatz as a small eigenproblem and compare the polaron energy and residue Z with full diagonalization of the N_up+1 sector.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Jaynes-Cummings-Hubbard dimer: polariton localization-delocalization crossover
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Diagonalize two coupled cavities, each containing a two-level atom, with truncated photon numbers at fixed excitation number. Compute the photon-number variance and the imbalance versus photon hopping-to-coupling ratio.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: RBM ground state of the transverse-field Sherrington-Kirkpatrick model
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Optimize a restricted Boltzmann machine wavefunction for a random all-to-all ±J Ising model in a transverse field (N≤16) by stochastic reconfiguration with Metropolis sampling. Compare the energy and Edwards-Anderson order with exact diagonalization across the field.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Neural-network quantum states on spin models

physics/many_body|linalg.title: RBM variational energy of the 16-site pyrochlore Heisenberg cluster
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Optimize a complex RBM with zero-magnetization exchange moves for the cubic 16-site pyrochlore antiferromagnet. Use stochastic reconfiguration and compare the energy and spin correlations with exact Lanczos.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Neural-network quantum states on spin models

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Nitrogen atom quartet Slater-Jastrow VMC with Sherman-Morrison updates
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Build spin-up (5) and spin-down (2) determinants from STO-type orbitals for the N atom in its 4S state. Implement rank-one inverse updates for single-electron moves, and compute gradients and Laplacians via the inverse to obtain the VMC energy with a Padé-Jastrow factor.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: LiH molecule Slater-Jastrow VMC: energy and dipole moment
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Use minimal STO molecular orbitals for LiH, including a bonding orbital from a small LCAO solve. Sample with single-electron Sherman-Morrison updates and estimate the energy and electric dipole moment at the equilibrium bond length.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: AGP geminal determinant VMC for spin-balanced trapped 2D fermions
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Represent a paired trial state as det[φ(r_i↑ - r_j↓)] for fermions in a 2D harmonic trap with attractive Gaussian interaction. Implement row and column rank-one updates for single-electron moves and compute the energy and pair correlation.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Maximum-density-droplet quantum dot in a magnetic field: complex-orbital determinant VMC
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Fill the lowest Fock-Darwin m-orbitals with N spin-polarized electrons and use complex Sherman-Morrison updates. Compute the Coulomb and kinetic energies versus magnetic field to locate where the maximum density droplet is stable.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Orbital-selective Mott transition in two-band DMFT with ED solver
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Solve two-orbital Kanamori DMFT on the Bethe lattice with different bandwidths, using an ED impurity solver with discretized baths. Bath parameters are fit by least squares on the Matsubara axis. Compute each orbital's quasiparticle weight versus U to find the orbital-selective regime.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Dynamical mean-field theory with ED solver

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Kanamori three-orbital atom: multiplets and Hund's rules by exact diagonalization
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Construct the rotationally invariant Kanamori interaction for a t2g shell in Fock space. Diagonalize it at each filling, identify the multiplet energies, and verify Hund's-rule ground states and the U-3J and U+2J charge gaps.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Dynamical mean-field theory with ED solver

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Stark many-body localization in a tilted interacting fermion chain
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Fully diagonalize spinless fermions with nearest-neighbor interaction in a linear potential (with a small curvature to break degeneracies). Compute the mean level-spacing ratio and half-chain eigenstate entanglement versus field gradient.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: SU(2) disordered Hubbard chain: charge localization with spin delocalization
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Diagonalize a Hubbard chain with spin-independent random potentials in the S, Sz sectors. Compare level statistics, charge imbalance and spin-correlation decay to show that spin does not localize.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: SYK level statistics: GOE, GUE and GSE classes by N mod 8
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Build the Majorana SYK Hamiltonian, split it into fermion-parity blocks and fully diagonalize. Compute the level-spacing-ratio distributions for N=10-16 and check the random-matrix class predicted by N mod 8.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Bosonic Richardson-Gaudin solution of the U(5)-O(6) interacting boson model
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Solve the bosonic Richardson equations for the s-d boson Hamiltonian along the U(5)-O(6) path by root finding and continuation. Compare the ground-state energies and the E(4+)/E(2+) ratios with exact diagonalization in the seniority basis.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Russian doll BCS model: cyclic RG spectrum from Bethe ansatz versus ED
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Solve the generalized Richardson equations of the time-reversal-breaking Russian doll pairing model. Compare the ladder of condensate energies with exact diagonalization in the pair (hard-core boson) basis and check the cyclic scaling ratio.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: 1D Kondo lattice spin gap from MPO-based two-site DMRG
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Write the finite-state-automaton MPO for the half-filled spin-1/2 Kondo lattice chain. Run two-site DMRG in the S_z=0 and S_z=1 sectors and extrapolate the spin gap versus J_K/t.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Matrix product operators for lattice Hamiltonians

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Interacting SSH chain: DMRG edge states and entanglement-spectrum degeneracy
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Construct the MPO for spinless fermions with alternating hopping and nearest-neighbor repulsion. Use DMRG to compute the edge-charge localization and the twofold entanglement-spectrum degeneracy, and track the topological-to-CDW transition.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Matrix product operators for lattice Hamiltonians

physics/many_body|linalg.title: SU(3) Uimin-Lai-Sutherland chain: DMRG central charge c=2
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Build an MPO with permutation-operator terms for the spin-1 SU(3)-symmetric chain. Optimize the ground state with two-site DMRG on open chains and fit the Calabrese-Cardy entanglement profile to extract c≈2.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Matrix product operators for lattice Hamiltonians

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Hund's-coupling sign problem in a two-orbital Hubbard dimer by field enumeration
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Decouple density-density and Hund's exchange terms with discrete Hubbard-Stratonovich fields for a small two-orbital dimer. Exactly enumerate all auxiliary-field configurations to compute the average sign versus β and J/U.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Auxiliary-field QMC and fermion sign problem

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Magnon Bloch oscillations in a ferromagnetic Heisenberg chain with field gradient
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Prepare a localized spin flip on a polarized chain and evolve it with TEBD in a linearly varying field. Measure the oscillation period and amplitude of the magnon wavepacket and the two-magnon bound-state contribution.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Interacting resonant level model: TEBD steady-state current versus bias
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Model a spinless dot coupled to two tight-binding leads with dot-lead interaction U' and apply a bias quench. Use TEBD to compute the transient and quasi-steady current versus bias, and compare with the U'=0 Landauer result.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Quantized Thouless pump in an interacting Rice-Mele chain via TEBD
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Adiabatically drive the hopping dimerization and staggered potential of an interacting Rice-Mele chain around a cycle with TEBD. Integrate the bond current to obtain the pumped charge per cycle and its deviation from 1 versus pumping speed.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Slow relaxation in the quantum East model: TEBD autocorrelation
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Evolve the kinetically constrained quantum East chain from random product states with TEBD. Compute the occupation autocorrelation decay and the entanglement growth on either side of the active-inactive crossover.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Icosahedron Heisenberg antiferromagnet: magnetization jumps by sector diagonalization
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the 12-site spin-1/2 icosahedral Heisenberg cluster in total-Sz sectors. Construct the zero-temperature magnetization curve and identify the frustration-induced discontinuity.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Cr8 molecular ring: Landé rotational band of a spin-3/2 antiferromagnet
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Lanczos-diagonalize the 8-site spin-3/2 Heisenberg ring in total-S_z sectors and identify the lowest energy per total spin S. Fit E(S) to the Landé band ΔS(S+1)/2 and compare with the rotational-band model.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Z2 lattice gauge theory on a 3x3 torus: confinement from Wilson loops
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the transverse-field Z2 gauge model restricted to the gauge-invariant sector. Compute Wilson-loop area-versus-perimeter behavior and the topological ground-state degeneracy splitting across the confinement transition.
physics/many_body|linalg.area: Exact diagonalization of lattice gauge theories

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Yrast spectrum of rotating bosons in the lowest Landau level
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Diagonalize contact-interacting bosons in a harmonic trap within the LLL at fixed total angular momentum L. Construct the yrast line E(L) for N=4-8, and check the single-vortex state at L=N and the zero-energy Laughlin state at L=N(N-1).

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Blume-Capel tricritical point by strip transfer matrices and phenomenological RG
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Build column transfer matrices for the spin-1 Blume-Capel model on strips of width L. Obtain correlation lengths from the two largest eigenvalues and locate the tricritical point by Nightingale scaling of three widths.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Kugel-Khomskii spin-orbital chain at the SU(4) point by exact diagonalization
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Construct the spin-orbital chain H = Σ (2S_i·S_j + 1/2)(2T_i·T_j + 1/2) on periodic rings. Diagonalize in symmetry sectors to obtain the ground-state energy, the low-lying spectrum and the period-4 structure factor.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Fractional Chern insulator of hard-core bosons: many-body Chern number from twists
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Diagonalize hard-core bosons at ν=1/2 in a Harper-Hofstadter lattice on a small torus over a grid of twist angles. Compute the many-body Chern number of the twofold quasi-degenerate ground manifold by the Fukui link method.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Eigenvector continuation emulator for the kagome transverse-field Ising antiferromagnet
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Collect exact ground states of a 12-site kagome TFIM at a few training fields. Solve the generalized eigenproblem in their span to predict energies and magnetizations at other fields, and quantify the error versus the number of training points.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: f7/2 shell with surface-delta interaction: seniority multiplets by m-scheme ED
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Construct j=7/2 two-body matrix elements of a surface-delta interaction via Wigner-3j algebra and build the m-scheme many-body basis for n=2-4 nucleons. Diagonalize and classify the levels by seniority and J.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: 1D trapped 2+1 fermions with contact interaction: ED approach to fermionization
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Diagonalize two up and one down fermions in a 1D harmonic trap with delta interaction in a truncated oscillator basis with an energy cutoff. Extrapolate the energy versus cutoff and compare with the infinite-repulsion fermionized limit.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Tasaki flat-band ferromagnetism of the Hubbard model on a sawtooth chain
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Lanczos-diagonalize the sawtooth Hubbard chain with flat-band-tuned hoppings at flat-band filling in all S_z sectors. Verify the maximal-spin ground state and compute the spin-wave stiffness versus U and detuning.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Hubbard [3]triangulene: Lieb's-theorem spin-one ground state via Lanczos
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Lanczos-diagonalize the 13-site triangulene Hubbard model at half filling in fixed (N↑,N↓) sectors. Confirm the S=1 ground state predicted from the sublattice imbalance and compute the singlet-triplet gap versus U.

physics/many_body|linalg.title: Magnetization plateaus of the square-kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet
physics/many_body|linalg.gist: Diagonalize an 18-site square-kagome spin-1/2 cluster in all magnetization sectors. Construct the ground-state magnetization curve, identify plateaus (e.g., 1/3), and compute their widths in units of J.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Gillespie simulation of individual-based NPZ model with demographic noise
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Write the nutrient-phytoplankton-zooplankton model as a stochastic reaction network for nutrient uptake, grazing, mortality and remineralization in a small closed volume. Simulate it with the Gillespie SSA and compute the distribution of bloom peak times and peak heights, then compare them with the deterministic ODE trajectory.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: NPZ model with stochastic nutrient supply via Euler-Maruyama
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Add multiplicative white noise to the nutrient upwelling rate of an NPZ model and integrate the resulting SDE with Euler-Maruyama. Compute the phytoplankton power spectrum and the frequency of bloom events above a chlorophyll threshold as a function of noise intensity.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Metropolis MCMC inference of zooplankton grazing parameters from chlorophyll data
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Generate synthetic noisy phytoplankton time series from an NPZ model with Ivlev grazing. Run random-walk Metropolis-Hastings over the maximum grazing rate and the half-saturation constant, and report posterior means, credible intervals and the parameter correlation.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Zooplankton extinction times in stochastic NPZ under nutrient enrichment
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Use Gillespie simulation of a finite-volume NPZ network in the paradox-of-enrichment regime, where predator-prey oscillations grow with total nutrient. Compute the mean zooplankton extinction time as a function of total nutrient and system size.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Coherence resonance of plankton blooms in an excitable NPZ model
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Use an excitable NPZ parameter regime driven by additive Langevin noise and integrate it stochastically. Compute the coefficient of variation of inter-bloom intervals versus noise amplitude and identify the noise level that minimizes it.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Exact OU-velocity simulation and Fürth formula fitting of cell tracks
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Generate 2D cell tracks from an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck velocity process using the exact discrete update. Compute the time-averaged MSD and the velocity autocorrelation, and recover the persistence time and speed by nonlinear least squares on the Fürth formula.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Cell motility and random walk statistics

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Chemotactic drift velocity of run-and-tumble bacteria in a linear gradient
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate run-and-tumble cells whose tumble rate is reduced when they move up a linear attractant gradient. Measure the chemotactic drift velocity and the chemotactic index by Monte Carlo and compare them with the linear-response prediction.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Cell motility and random walk statistics

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Lévy walk versus Brownian search times for T cells
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate 2D Lévy walks with power-law flight lengths and Brownian walkers in a periodic domain containing a sparse absorbing target. Compare the mean first-passage times and find the Lévy exponent that minimizes search time.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Cell motility and random walk statistics

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Berg-Purcell receptor capture rate by Brownian Monte Carlo
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Release Brownian ligands around a sphere covered by N small absorbing disks, with the rest of the surface reflecting and an outer escape radius. Estimate the capture probability and flux by random walks, and compare them with the Berg-Purcell formula Nа/(Nа+πR).
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Cell motility and random walk statistics

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Bayesian inference of persistence and speed from noisy cell tracks
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate OU-velocity tracks corrupted by Gaussian localization noise. Write the exact Gaussian likelihood of the position increments, sample the persistence time, speed and noise level by Metropolis-Hastings, and assess the posterior coverage.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Cell motility and random walk statistics

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Two-stage mRNA-protein noise: FSP generator and Gillespie validation
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Construct the two-dimensional truncated CME for transcription, translation and degradation, and compute the protein marginal with time-dependent expm_multiply. Check the protein mean, variance and noise strength against SSA ensembles and against the analytic two-stage formula.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Chemical master equation finite state projection

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Negative autoregulation noise: SSA, tau-leaping and FSP comparison
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Model a self-repressing gene with a Hill-type production propensity. Compare the stationary protein distributions from exact SSA, fixed-step Poisson tau-leaping and FSP, and quantify the tau-leaping error with the total-variation distance as a function of step size.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Chemical master equation finite state projection

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: FSP likelihood MCMC inference of bursting kinetics from smFISH counts
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Generate synthetic single-cell mRNA counts from the telegraph model and use the FSP stationary distribution as the exact likelihood. Run Metropolis-Hastings over log rates and report posterior burst size and burst frequency together with their identifiability.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Chemical master equation finite state projection

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Dimerization 2A⇌B: exact CME versus linear noise approximation
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Solve the one-dimensional CME of reversible dimerization at fixed total molecule number. Compare the exact mean and variance with SSA and with the LNA from the Lyapunov equation, and show how the LNA error grows as the system size decreases.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Chemical master equation finite state projection

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Kingman coalescent: segregating sites and Watterson estimator variance
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate Kingman coalescent trees for n samples and place Poisson mutations on the branches. Compute the distribution of segregating sites S, and verify E[S]=θa_n and the Tajima/Watterson variance formula, including the bias and variance of θ_W.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Null distribution and critical values of Tajima's D
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate neutral coalescent samples under the infinite-sites model for given n and θ, and compute Tajima's D for each replicate. Estimate the empirical 2.5% and 97.5% quantiles and compare them with Tajima's beta-distribution approximation.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Site frequency spectrum under exponential population growth
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate coalescent times under exponential growth by time-rescaling the Kingman intervals through the inverse cumulative hazard. Compute the expected SFS and the mean Tajima's D as a function of growth rate.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Coalescent through a population bottleneck: SFS distortion
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate genealogies with piecewise-constant population size representing a bottleneck of given depth and timing. Compute the normalized SFS and Tajima's D, and identify which bottleneck timings produce positive versus negative D.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Beta-coalescent SFS under sweepstakes reproduction
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate Λ-coalescent genealogies with Beta(2-α,α) multiple-merger rates. Compute the normalized SFS and show its U-shape and excess of singletons relative to Kingman as α decreases.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: ABC rejection inference of θ and growth rate from the SFS
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Draw parameters from priors, simulate coalescent samples under exponential growth, and summarize each by S, π and singleton counts. Perform rejection ABC with a tolerance quantile and report the posterior means and credible intervals for synthetic observed data.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Dinucleotide-preserving sequence shuffling via random Eulerian paths
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Implement the Altschul-Erickson/Kandel shuffle by building the dinucleotide multigraph and sampling uniform random arborescences to produce Eulerian paths. Use the shuffles to compute empirical p-values of k-mer overrepresentation in a test sequence.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Gibbs sampler motif discovery of a planted PWM
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Plant noisy instances of a transcription-factor motif in random background sequences. Run the Lawrence site-sampling Gibbs sampler with pseudocounts, and report recovery of the motif positions, the information content of the inferred PWM, and convergence across restarts.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Waiting time for DNA words: Monte Carlo versus Conway autocorrelation
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate i.i.d. and first-order Markov DNA sequences and record the first occurrence of given k-mers. Compare the mean waiting times with the Conway leading-number / autocorrelation formula, and evaluate Penney-game win probabilities between word pairs.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Metropolis sampling of RNA secondary structures with base-pair probabilities
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Define a simple nearest-pair energy for non-crossing secondary structures and run Metropolis moves that add or remove base pairs. Estimate base-pair probabilities and compare them with the exact McCaskill-style partition function computed for a short sequence.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Stochastic traceback of CpG-island HMM state paths
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Build a two-state CpG-island HMM, run the forward algorithm, and sample posterior state paths by stochastic backward traceback. Compute the posterior island probability per base and the distribution of island counts, and compare them with Viterbi.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: MinHash estimation of genome Jaccard similarity and Mash distance
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Generate a reference genome and mutated copies at known divergence and extract their k-mer sets. Estimate Jaccard similarity with random hash bottom-s sketches, compute the Mash distance, and quantify the estimator variance against the true mutation rate.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Error-prone reads and de Bruijn graph tip and bubble statistics
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate reads with substitution errors from a random genome and build a k-mer de Bruijn graph with a coverage threshold. Count error-induced tips and bubbles as functions of k, error rate and coverage, and check whether the threshold-filtered graph has an Eulerian path that recovers the genome.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Quasi-stationary distribution by Fleming-Viot resampling simulation
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Estimate the quasi-stationary distribution of a logistic birth-death process with the 'return to a random past state' Monte Carlo method. Compare the result with the normalized left eigenvector of the truncated generator restricted to the transient states.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Endemic SIS extinction time: Gillespie versus WKB asymptotics
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate the stochastic SIS epidemic in a population of size N with Gillespie. Compute the mean time to disease extinction from the endemic state, and compare it with the exact birth-death formula and the WKB exponent N(ln R0 - 1 + 1/R0).

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Quasi-extinction probabilities under environmental stochasticity
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Model a population with lognormally fluctuating growth rates using Monte Carlo of the stochastic Ricker map. Estimate the probability of hitting a quasi-extinction threshold within T years, and compare it with the diffusion (inverse Gaussian) approximation.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Stochastic Levins metapopulation: extinction time versus patch number
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate the stochastic patch-occupancy model with colonization c·k(H-k)/H and extinction e·k using Gillespie. Compute the metapopulation mean extinction time as a function of the number of patches H.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Wright-Fisher diffusion with selection: Euler-Maruyama fixation probability
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Integrate the SDE dx = s x(1-x)dt + sqrt(x(1-x)/N)dW with Euler-Maruyama and absorbing-boundary handling. Estimate fixation probabilities over a range of selection strengths and compare them with Kimura's formula.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Fixation probability of partially recessive beneficial alleles
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Compute the fixation probability with dominance coefficient h from the backward Kolmogorov integral by quadrature. Validate it with Wright-Fisher binomial simulations and quantify Haldane's sieve as h varies.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Fixation under fluctuating selection in a random environment
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate Wright-Fisher dynamics with a temporally autocorrelated selection coefficient drawn from an AR(1) process. Estimate the fixation probability and time of a new mutant as a function of selection variance, and compare them with the diffusion approximation with effective drift.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Sojourn time density of a neutral allele by Monte Carlo
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate the neutral Wright-Fisher diffusion from initial frequency p and accumulate the occupation-time histogram. Compare it with the Green's function of the backward equation, and compute the expected age of an allele observed at frequency x.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Lambda phage CI-Cro switch stability with bursty production
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Model CI and Cro with translational bursting and cross-repression and simulate them with Gillespie. Estimate the spontaneous lysogen-to-lytic switching rate and its dependence on burst size and repressor cooperativity.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Non-adiabatic toggle switching with slow promoter dynamics
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Include explicit promoter binding and unbinding states in a stochastic toggle and simulate them with SSA. Compute how the mean switching time varies with the promoter switching rate, contrasting the adiabatic and slow-promoter regimes.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Bulmer effect under truncation selection in infinitesimal model simulation
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate individual-based truncation selection with an infinitesimal-model offspring distribution (midparent plus segregation variance). Compute the response per generation, the realized heritability, and the decline of additive variance to the Bulmer equilibrium, compared with the breeder's equation prediction.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Sampling error in G-matrix eigenstructure via Wishart Monte Carlo
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Draw sample G matrices from a Wishart distribution around a true G matrix for a given number of families. Quantify bias in the eigenvalues, the angle error of g_max, and the distribution of evolvability along random selection gradients under Lande's Δz = Gβ.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Gibbs sampling of heritability from a half-sib design
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate phenotypes from a sire half-sib model and implement a Gibbs sampler with conjugate inverse-gamma priors on the variance components. Report the posterior of h² = 4σ_s²/(σ_s²+σ_e²) and compare it with the ANOVA estimator.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Genetic variance of a polygenic trait under stabilizing selection and mutation
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate a Wright-Fisher population with L additive loci, Gaussian stabilizing selection and mutation. Compute the equilibrium additive variance, and compare it with Gaussian and house-of-cards approximations across mutation rates.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Ornstein-Uhlenbeck trait evolution on a phylogeny: MLE of selection strength
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate trait values at the tips of a random Yule tree under an OU process using exact branch transitions. Compute the multivariate-normal likelihood, maximize it over α, σ and θ, and assess the bias of α̂ by parametric bootstrap.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Bootstrap uncertainty of Lande-Arnold selection gradients
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate correlated traits and fitness under a known quadratic fitness surface. Estimate the linear and quadratic selection gradients by regression on relative fitness, and compute bootstrap confidence intervals and the canonical analysis of the γ matrix.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Moran process on star versus complete graphs: amplification of selection
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate birth-death Moran dynamics on star and complete graphs. Estimate the fixation probability of a single mutant with fitness r and verify that the star amplifies selection according to the effective fitness r² approximation.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Stepping-stone Wright-Fisher on a ring: differentiation versus migration
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate neutral Wright-Fisher demes on a ring with nearest-neighbor migration. Compute pairwise F_ST as a function of deme distance and the time to global fixation, and compare them with isolation-by-distance predictions.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Clonal interference and saturation of adaptation rate
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate asexual Wright-Fisher evolution with beneficial mutations of fixed effect. Compute the speed of fitness increase versus population size and mutation rate, and show the transition from successional-mutation to clonal-interference scaling.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Frequency-dependent Moran fixation and the one-third rule
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Compute fixation probabilities in a Moran process with payoff-dependent fitness from a 2x2 game, using both the exact product formula and Monte Carlo. Check the one-third rule for weak selection in coordination games.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Effective population size under fluctuating census size
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate neutral Wright-Fisher drift with cyclically varying population size. Measure the rate of heterozygosity decay and verify that the effective size equals the harmonic mean of the census sizes, with the transition matrix as an exact check.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: ABC inference of R0 and recovery rate from outbreak incidence
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate stochastic SIR epidemics with tau-leaping and summarize each by weekly case counts. Infer β and γ by ABC rejection or ABC-SMC, and report the posterior of R0 for a synthetic outbreak.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Phase diffusion of a stochastic circadian oscillator
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate a Goodwin-type negative-feedback oscillator with Gillespie at several system sizes. Extract peak times to compute the phase diffusion constant and the coherence time, and show the 1/Ω scaling.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Kinetic proofreading discrimination in T-cell receptor signaling
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate ligand-receptor binding with an N-step proofreading chain by Gillespie. Compute the signaling output and specificity ratio between ligands differing in off-rate, and compare them with the analytic (k_p/(k_p+k_off))^N.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Microtubule dynamic instability via kinetic Monte Carlo
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Model a microtubule with a GTP-cap, stochastic addition, hydrolysis and catastrophe/rescue events, and simulate it with kinetic Monte Carlo. Compute the length distribution, the catastrophe frequency, and the transition between bounded and unbounded growth.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Channel noise in stochastic Hodgkin-Huxley neurons
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate a membrane patch with finite numbers of Na and K channels as Markov gating schemes using hybrid Gillespie. Compute the spontaneous spike rate and the interspike interval CV as functions of patch area.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Metropolis Ising model of chemoreceptor array cooperativity
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Model a lattice of MWC-like chemoreceptors with nearest-neighbor coupling and a ligand-dependent field, and sample it with the Metropolis algorithm. Compute the activity dose-response curve and fit the Hill coefficient versus coupling strength.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Path-integral Monte Carlo of proton tunneling kinetic isotope effects
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Use path-integral Monte Carlo with Metropolis bead moves for H and D in an enzymatic double-well potential. Compute quantum free-energy barrier corrections and estimate the H/D kinetic isotope effect relative to the classical value.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Jarzynski free energy from Langevin pulling of an RNA hairpin
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate the overdamped extension of a hairpin model in a moving harmonic trap with Langevin dynamics. Estimate the folding free energy with the Jarzynski equality and Crooks crossing, and analyze the bias versus pulling speed.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Gillespie repressilator: period variability versus system size
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate the Elowitz-Leibler repressilator (mRNA and protein for three genes) with the Gillespie SSA at several volume scales Ω. Extract periods from peak-to-peak intervals and report the period coefficient of variation scaling with Ω.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Stochastic Goodwin oscillator: quality factor across the Hopf threshold
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Integrate the chemical Langevin equation of the Goodwin negative-feedback loop for Hill exponents below and above the deterministic Hopf threshold (n≈8). Compute the autocorrelation function and the spectral peak quality factor to show noise-sustained quasi-oscillations.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Noise-induced circadian oscillations in the Vilar-Barkai activator-repressor model
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Run Gillespie simulations of the Vilar-Barkai-Leibler circadian model in the parameter regime where the deterministic system has a stable fixed point. Quantify the coherence of the stochastic oscillations from the power-spectrum peak and the period distribution.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Phase response curve of a noisy Goodwin oscillator by ensemble perturbation
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Apply brief pulses of repressor degradation at different phases to an ensemble of chemical Langevin Goodwin trajectories. Estimate the mean phase shift and its standard error versus stimulus phase, and compare with the deterministic adjoint PRC.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: KaiABC phosphorylation cycle: timing precision versus hexamer number
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Model each KaiC hexamer as a multi-state phosphorylation cycle with KaiA sequestration feedback and simulate it with the Gillespie SSA for varying hexamer counts. Report how the period and the phase-diffusion coefficient scale with the hexamer number.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Thermodynamic cost of precision in a biochemical ring oscillator
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate a driven unicyclic Markov ring of N states with the Gillespie algorithm. Compute the number of coherent oscillations from the decaying correlation function and the entropy production per cycle, then compare them with the Barato-Seifert bound.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Metropolis inference of Goodwin clock parameters from luminescence traces
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Generate a noisy synthetic bioluminescence time series from the Goodwin ODE. Sample the posterior of the transcription rate, degradation rates and Hill coefficient with random-walk Metropolis, and report credible intervals for the period.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Bayesian and MCMC parameter estimation for biological models

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Stochastic growth rate of i.i.d. random Leslie matrices versus Tuljapurkar
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Draw random Leslie matrices with variable fecundity and survival each year. Estimate log λ_s from long products with renormalization and confidence intervals, and compare it with Tuljapurkar's small-noise approximation built from the mean-matrix sensitivities.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Environmental stochasticity and stochastic growth rate

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Autocorrelated Markov environments and the stochastic growth rate
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Let good and bad environment matrices alternate according to a two-state Markov chain with tunable autocorrelation. Compute log λ_s by simulation and compare it with Tuljapurkar's approximation including the autocorrelation correction term.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Environmental stochasticity and stochastic growth rate

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Stochastic elasticities of λ_s for a stage-structured plant
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate the environment sequence of a stage-classified population and obtain the forward population vectors and backward reproductive-value vectors. Compute Tuljapurkar-Haridas stochastic elasticities of log λ_s to the mean and the variance of the matrix entries.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Environmental stochasticity and stochastic growth rate

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Cohen bet-hedging: optimal germination fraction in random environments
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate annual-plant seed-bank dynamics with random good and bad years. Estimate the geometric-mean growth rate as a function of germination fraction and compare the Monte Carlo optimum with Cohen's analytic result.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Environmental stochasticity and stochastic growth rate

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Kesten recurrence: heavy-tailed population abundances from multiplicative noise
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate N_{t+1} = A_t N_t + B_t with lognormal A_t (E[log A] < 0) and positive immigration B_t. Estimate the stationary tail exponent from Hill estimators and compare it with the root κ of E[A^κ] = 1.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Environmental stochasticity and stochastic growth rate

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Branching process in a random environment: survival probability regimes
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate Galton-Watson processes whose Poisson offspring mean is redrawn each generation. Estimate survival probabilities in the supercritical, intermediate subcritical and strongly subcritical regimes and relate them to E[log m] and E[m].
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Environmental stochasticity and stochastic growth rate

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Inflationary effect: dispersal-driven persistence in autocorrelated sink habitats
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate a two-patch population in which each patch is a sink on average but fluctuates with autocorrelated noise. Compute the metapopulation stochastic growth rate versus dispersal rate and noise autocorrelation to detect when λ_s exceeds 1.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Environmental stochasticity and stochastic growth rate

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Storage effect in the Chesson lottery model: invasion growth rate
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate two species competing for space with fluctuating, partially correlated recruitment. Estimate each species' low-density invasion growth rate by Monte Carlo as a function of adult survival and environmental correlation.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Environmental stochasticity and stochastic growth rate

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Integral projection model with random year effects: kernel-sampled λ_s
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Build size-structured IPM kernels whose growth and survival intercepts are drawn each year from a random-effects distribution. Discretize with the midpoint rule and estimate log λ_s by simulation, comparing it with log λ of the mean kernel.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Environmental stochasticity and stochastic growth rate

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Individual stochasticity in lifetime reproductive success of a stage-structured population
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate individual life histories as absorbing Markov chains with Poisson reproduction. Compute the mean, variance and skewness of lifetime reproductive success and validate them against Caswell's Markov-chain-with-rewards formulas.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Environmental stochasticity and stochastic growth rate

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Correlated random walk with wrapped-Cauchy turns: MSD versus Kareiva-Shigesada
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate 2D animal paths with gamma step lengths and wrapped-Cauchy turning angles. Compute the ensemble mean squared displacement against step number and compare it with the Kareiva-Shigesada analytic formula.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Movement ecology and home range estimation

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: OU home-range tracks: kernel density 95% utilization area and bandwidth bias
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate a range-resident animal as a 2D Ornstein-Uhlenbeck position process. Estimate 95% KDE home-range areas with reference and least-squares cross-validation bandwidths and compare them with the true Gaussian stationary area.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Movement ecology and home range estimation

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Brownian bridge movement model utilization distribution from GPS fixes
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate a CRW and record sparse noisy fixes. Estimate the Brownian motion variance by leave-one-out likelihood, then build the Brownian bridge UD on a grid and compare its 95% contour area with that of the true path occupancy.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Movement ecology and home range estimation

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Bayesian two-state movement HMM: encamped versus exploratory behavior
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate tracks that switch between two step-length and turning-angle regimes through a Markov chain. Compute the HMM likelihood with the forward algorithm and sample the transition probabilities and step parameters with Metropolis-Hastings.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Movement ecology and home range estimation

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Home-range area accumulation curves: MCP versus KDE estimators
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: From simulated central-place-biased random walks, compute minimum convex polygon and KDE home-range areas as functions of the number of fixes. Average over replicates to determine how many fixes each estimator needs to reach its asymptote.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Movement ecology and home range estimation

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Homing by a biased correlated random walk: return probability to nest
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate a forager performing a CRW with a turning bias toward a central nest under a finite energy budget. Estimate the probability and mean time of returning to within a capture radius as functions of the bias strength and persistence.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Movement ecology and home range estimation

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Territory formation from mutually avoiding scent-marking lattice walkers
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate N random walkers on a periodic lattice that deposit scent marks lasting a finite time and cannot enter cells freshly marked by others. Compute the mean territory size and territory-border MSD as functions of scent lifetime.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Movement ecology and home range estimation

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Dispersal across fragmented percolation landscapes: crossing time versus habitat cover
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Generate random binary habitat maps at varying habitat fraction p. Simulate random walkers whose step and mortality rates depend on habitat type, and compute the probability and mean time of crossing the landscape around the percolation threshold.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Movement ecology and home range estimation

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Goldbeter-Koshland cycle with few enzymes: stochastic loss of ultrasensitivity
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate a covalent modification cycle with the full Michaelis-Menten mass-action mechanism using the Gillespie SSA for small enzyme and substrate copy numbers. Fit apparent Hill exponents to the mean input-output curve and report the bimodality of the output distribution.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Noise propagation through a three-tier MAPK cascade
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate a simplified Huang-Ferrell MAPK cascade with the SSA. Compute Fano factors and coefficients of variation at each tier, and compare the per-tier noise decomposition with the linear noise approximation.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Stochastic switching in distributive dual phosphorylation bistability
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Use the Gillespie SSA on the Markevich-Hoek-Kholodenko dual phosphorylation network in its bistable regime. Compute mean residence times in the low and high states versus total kinase number and compare them with the deterministic bistable range.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Enzyme rebinding in dual phosphorylation: processivity from Brownian dynamics
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate a kinase and a substrate as diffusing spheres with reactive collisions after the first phosphorylation, using Brownian dynamics. Estimate the probability of rapid rebinding and the resulting effective processivity, and show how it erodes ultrasensitivity.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: IP3 receptor cluster puffs: stochastic gating and puff-size distribution
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate a cluster of De Young-Keizer IP3 receptor subunits with calcium-dependent coupling using the Gillespie algorithm. Compute the distributions of puff amplitude and duration and the interpuff intervals versus IP3 concentration.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Molecular titration ultrasensitivity with sRNA-mRNA sequestration noise
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate mutual stoichiometric annihilation of mRNA and sRNA with the SSA. Compute the threshold-linear mean response and the noise peak near the equivalence point, and compare effective Hill exponents with the deterministic prediction.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Stochastic SEIR: distribution of epidemic peak time versus deterministic
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Run Gillespie SEIR epidemics in a closed population and condition on major outbreaks. Compute the distributions of peak time and peak prevalence and compare them with the ODE peak and the analytic R0.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Measles critical community size from seasonally forced stochastic SEIR
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate term-time-forced SEIR dynamics with births using tau-leaping across population sizes. Estimate the frequency of fade-outs and the critical community size above which the disease persists.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Household epidemic model: threshold parameter R* and final size
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate a two-level-mixing SIR epidemic with households of mixed sizes. Estimate R* from Monte Carlo within-household final size distributions, and compare the overall attack rate with the two-level final-size equation.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Metropolis MCMC of SEIR ODE parameters with negative binomial case counts
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Fit a deterministic SEIR model to synthetic daily cases using a negative binomial likelihood. Sample the transmission rate, latent period and dispersion with adaptive Metropolis, and report posterior distributions of R0 and the final size.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Bayesian and MCMC parameter estimation for biological models

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Data-augmented MCMC for unobserved SIR infection times
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Given only removal times from a simulated Markovian SIR outbreak, run the O'Neill-Roberts sampler. Combine Gibbs updates of β and γ with Metropolis moves on the latent infection times, and assess coverage of the true parameters.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Bayesian and MCMC parameter estimation for biological models

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Stochastic Ross-Macdonald malaria model: probability of major outbreak
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate host-vector malaria transmission with the Gillespie SSA starting from a single infected human or mosquito. Compare the empirical extinction probabilities with roots of the two-type branching process generating functions.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Contact process on a 2D lattice: critical infection rate
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate the SIS contact process on a square lattice with continuous-time kinetic Monte Carlo. Estimate the critical infection rate from survival-probability scaling of spreading experiments started from a single infected site.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Gamma-distributed infectious periods: linear chain trick and outbreak statistics
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate SIR epidemics whose infectious periods are Erlang(k) through k sequential stages with the SSA. Compute the minor-outbreak probability and the variance of the epidemic growth rate as k varies at fixed R0 and mean period.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Gillespie SIR on Watts-Strogatz small-world networks: peak timing
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Run event-driven SIR epidemics on Watts-Strogatz networks with varying rewiring probability. Compute the mean peak time and final size versus rewiring and compare them with a homogeneous-mixing ODE.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Asynchronous Boolean cell-cycle network: Monte Carlo attractor basin probabilities
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Enumerate the synchronous attractors of a mammalian cell-cycle Boolean network (Fauré et al.). Under random asynchronous updating, estimate by Monte Carlo the probability of reaching each attractor from random initial states.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Kauffman random Boolean networks: Derrida damage spreading and criticality
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Generate random Boolean networks with in-degree K and bias p. Compute the Derrida map of one-step Hamming-distance propagation by Monte Carlo and locate the order-chaos transition at 2Kp(1-p) = 1.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Probabilistic Boolean network steady state: Monte Carlo versus exact Markov chain
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Define a small probabilistic Boolean network with context-switching predictor functions and random gene perturbations. Compute the exact stationary distribution from the 2^n transition matrix and compare it with long-run simulation estimates and their convergence rate.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Inferring linear gene networks from stationary fluctuations via Lyapunov equations
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate a multivariate OU process dX = AX dt + B dW for a sparse interaction matrix A. Estimate A from sample covariance and lagged covariance of the simulated data, and assess recovery error versus sample length.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Dual-reporter decomposition of intrinsic and extrinsic expression noise
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate two identical reporter genes sharing a fluctuating upstream regulator with the Gillespie SSA. Compute the Elowitz-Swain intrinsic and extrinsic noise estimators and compare them with analytic values as extrinsic fluctuation timescales vary.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Stochastic traceback sampling of alignments from a pair HMM
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Implement the pair-HMM forward algorithm for two DNA sequences and sample alignments by stochastic traceback. Estimate posterior match probabilities per residue pair and compare them with the Viterbi alignment.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: MCMC posterior of evolutionary distance under K80 from aligned pairs
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate pairwise sequence divergence under the Kimura two-parameter model. Sample the posterior of the distance d and the transition/transversion ratio κ with Metropolis-Hastings, and compare with the analytic K80 distance estimate.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Alignment accuracy versus affine gap penalties under simulated indel evolution
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Evolve sequence pairs with substitutions and geometric-length indels while recording the true alignment. Align them with Needleman-Wunsch using affine gaps, and map the fraction of correctly aligned columns over a grid of gap-open and gap-extend penalties.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Chvátal-Sankoff constant: expected LCS length of random sequences
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Compute longest common subsequence lengths of random sequence pairs by dynamic programming over increasing lengths and alphabet sizes. Extrapolate the ratio LCS/n by Monte Carlo and finite-size fits, and compare with the known bounds for binary and DNA alphabets.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Linear-logarithmic phase transition of local alignment scores
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: For random sequences, compute Smith-Waterman scores against length over a grid of mismatch and gap penalties. Identify the Arratia-Waterman phase boundary where score growth changes from logarithmic to linear by Monte Carlo slope estimation.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Crowded cell migration: tracer diffusion in a lattice exclusion process
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate cells as random walkers with excluded volume on a 2D lattice using kinetic Monte Carlo. Compute the tracer MSD and the self-diffusion coefficient versus occupancy, and compare them with the Nakazato-Kitahara approximation.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Cell motility and random walk statistics

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Hop diffusion in a membrane picket-fence corral lattice
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Brownian-dynamics simulate a membrane protein in a square corral lattice with partially permeable boundaries. Compute the MSD crossover from microscopic to macroscopic diffusion and relate the long-time diffusion coefficient to the hop probability.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Cell motility and random walk statistics

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Active Brownian cells in circular confinement: wall accumulation
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate 2D active Brownian particles inside a hard circular well. Compute the radial density profile and the fraction of time spent at the boundary as functions of the Péclet number and confinement radius.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Cell motility and random walk statistics

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Keizer's paradox: deterministic stability versus stochastic extinction
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate an autocatalytic network (e.g., A+X→2X, X→0, 2X→X) whose deterministic model has a stable positive state but whose CME has an absorbing zero state. Compute the mean absorption time versus volume and compare it with an exact birth-death formula.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Conservation laws and multinomial stationary states of closed enzyme networks
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Compute conservation laws of a closed first-order conversion network from the left null space of its stoichiometric matrix. Verify with SSA that the stationary distribution in each conservation class is multinomial, using χ² tests.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Stochastic signatures of multistationarity flagged by deficiency analysis
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Compute the deficiency of the Edelstein network and its deterministic multiple steady states. Simulate the CME with the Gillespie SSA to find the bimodal stationary distribution and the mean interstate switching times versus volume.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Parallel tempering for multimodal posteriors of a bistable gene circuit
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Infer the parameters of a self-activating Hill ODE from time courses whose likelihood has separated modes. Compare the mixing of single-chain Metropolis with replica-exchange MCMC through mode-occupation fractions and the Gelman-Rubin R-hat.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Bayesian and MCMC parameter estimation for biological models

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Hamiltonian Monte Carlo for logistic growth parameters from microbial counts
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Use the analytic logistic solution with Poisson-distributed colony counts. Implement HMC with leapfrog integration and analytic gradients to sample growth rate, carrying capacity and initial size, and compare its ESS per gradient with random-walk Metropolis.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Bayesian and MCMC parameter estimation for biological models

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Practical identifiability of a two-compartment pharmacokinetic model via MCMC
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Fit a two-compartment IV-bolus PK model to sparse plasma concentrations with Metropolis sampling. Diagnose non-identifiability through posterior ridges and correlations, and compare the credible intervals with profile-likelihood intervals.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Bayesian and MCMC parameter estimation for biological models

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Metropolis-within-Gibbs for Michaelis-Menten progress-curve data
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Integrate the substrate depletion ODE and fit Vmax and Km by Metropolis steps, with a conjugate inverse-gamma Gibbs update for the noise variance. Report credible intervals and the Km-Vmax posterior correlation.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Bayesian and MCMC parameter estimation for biological models

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Stochastic Gompertz state-space model: Kalman likelihood MCMC
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate log-abundance under a Gompertz model with process noise and observe it with sampling error. Compute the exact likelihood with a Kalman filter and sample density dependence, process variance and observation variance by Metropolis.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Bayesian and MCMC parameter estimation for biological models

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Stochastic chemostat washout: consumer extinction near the critical dilution rate
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Simulate a Monod consumer-resource chemostat with demographic noise using the Gillespie SSA. Estimate the mean washout time and the quasi-stationary consumer abundance versus dilution rate near the deterministic washout threshold.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Environmental stochasticity and stochastic growth rate

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Stochastic resonance of outbreaks in a bistable spruce budworm model
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Integrate the Ludwig spruce-budworm model with periodic forcing of carrying capacity and additive Langevin noise. Compute the signal-to-noise ratio at the forcing frequency versus noise intensity to identify the resonance peak.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Environmental stochasticity and stochastic growth rate

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Time to competitive exclusion of two Monod competitors in a stochastic chemostat
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Gillespie simulation of individual cell birth and washout for two Monod species sharing a substrate (continuous ODE substrate, hybrid scheme). Computes the distribution and mean of exclusion times and the probability that the R*-inferior species wins, as functions of vessel volume.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Segregational plasmid loss in a chemostat with stochastic copy-number partitioning
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Individual-based Monte Carlo of plasmid replication and binomial partitioning at division, with plasmid-free cells carrying a growth advantage under chemostat dilution. Computes the plasmid-free fraction over time and the time to 50% plasmid loss versus mean copy number.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Bayesian Metropolis inference of Monod parameters from batch substrate and biomass data
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Metropolis-Hastings sampling of mu_max, K_s and yield, using the Monod batch ODE solution as the likelihood mean for noisy substrate and biomass observations. Reports posterior means, credible intervals and the mu_max-K_s posterior correlation.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Bayesian integral projection model: MCMC vital-rate posteriors propagated to lambda
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Random-walk Metropolis fits of logistic survival, Gaussian growth and Poisson fecundity regressions to individual size data. Each posterior draw builds a midpoint-rule IPM kernel, giving a credible interval for the dominant eigenvalue lambda.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Integral projection models for size structure

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Probability of outbreak control under isolation and contact tracing by branching simulation
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Hellewell-style individual branching process with negative binomial offspring, incubation delays, presymptomatic transmission and a probability of tracing contacts. Monte Carlo estimates the probability of outbreak control versus tracing fraction and isolation delay.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Outbreak size at first detection under random case ascertainment
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Gillespie SIR started from one infection, with each recovery or symptom onset detected with a small probability. Computes the distribution of cumulative and current infections at the first detected case, compared with geometric-type branching approximations.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Hospital ward MRSA colonization with patient turnover by Gillespie simulation
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Stochastic SIS-type ward model (Cooper et al.) with admissions of colonized patients, discharge, decolonization and healthcare-worker-mediated transmission. Computes the quasi-stationary prevalence, the ward reproduction number R_A and the effect of screening.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Particle marginal Metropolis-Hastings for a stochastic SIR with binomial reporting
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: A bootstrap particle filter over tau-leaped SIR states gives an unbiased likelihood estimate for weekly case counts. Particle MCMC then samples transmission and recovery rates and the reporting probability, with a check of log-likelihood estimator variance against particle number.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Probability of pre-existing drug-resistant HIV variants at therapy initiation
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Stochastic birth-death-mutation simulation of wild-type and resistant infected-cell lineages during within-host expansion to set point.
