Estimates the probability that resistant mutants exist when treatment starts and the probability that they survive therapy, compared with branching-process formulas.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Evolutionary escape of a pathogen introduced into a host with subcritical R0
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Multitype branching process (Iwasa-Michor-Nowak) in which a strain with R0 < 1 may mutate to an escape strain with R0 > 1. Gillespie Monte Carlo of escape probability is compared with the generating-function fixed-point solution across mutation rates.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Coexistence of many consumers under metabolic trade-offs by random strategy sampling
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Posfai-Taillefumier-Wingreen model in which uptake strategies lie on a fixed-budget simplex. Monte Carlo samples random consumer pools, integrates each to steady state, and estimates the number of survivors and the probability of exceeding the competitive-exclusion bound versus supply position.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Probabilistic niche model fit to a food web by Metropolis MCMC
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Williams-Purves probabilistic niche model in which each species has a niche position, centre and Gaussian feeding width. Metropolis sampling of these parameters given an observed adjacency matrix reports the posterior predictive fraction of correctly predicted links.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Food web structure and network ecology

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Food web three-node motif z-scores under curveball degree-preserving randomization
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Counts the 13 directed three-node motifs in a food web. Curveball-algorithm Markov chain sampling of degree-preserving null webs then gives null distributions, z-scores and empirical p-values for each motif.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Food web structure and network ecology

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Morphogen gradient robustness to source dosage: linear versus self-enhanced degradation
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Monte Carlo sampling of production-rate fluctuations between embryos, solving the steady synthesis-diffusion-degradation BVP for each sample. Compares the spread of threshold-boundary positions under linear and quadratic (Eldar) degradation.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Hunchback boundary precision from stochastic Bicoid promoter readout with time averaging
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Gillespie simulation of cooperative Bicoid binding to the hunchback promoter and bursty transcription along the anterior-posterior axis. Computes boundary positional error versus integration time and Hill coefficient.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Stochastic patch occupancy model: extinction time scaling with metapopulation capacity
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Discrete-time stochastic incidence-function simulation on random patch landscapes with exponential dispersal kernels. Estimates the mean time to metapopulation extinction and relates its logarithm to the leading eigenvalue lambda_M of the landscape matrix.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Dynamic occupancy colonization and extinction rates with imperfect detection by Gibbs sampling
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: MacKenzie multi-season occupancy model with latent true occupancy states. A data-augmentation Gibbs sampler with Metropolis steps samples colonization, extinction and detection probabilities from repeat-visit survey data.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Spatial habitat destruction threshold by lattice kinetic Monte Carlo
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Contact-process patch occupancy on a 2D lattice with a fraction of sites made permanently unsuitable (Bascompte-Solé). Locates the extinction threshold in destroyed fraction and compares it with the mean-field Levins prediction 1 - e/c.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Optimal fire return interval maximizing the stochastic growth rate of a plant
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Stage-structured matrix model whose post-fire and inter-fire matrices are chosen by a random fire process with a given mean interval. Long random matrix products estimate lambda_s versus mean interval and give the optimal interval.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Environmental stochasticity and stochastic growth rate

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Large deviations of population growth in random environments via tilted matrix products
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Computes the scaled cumulant generating function of log population size for an i.i.d. random Leslie environment as the growth rate of tilted matrix products. Legendre transform gives the rate function, used to predict decline probabilities that are checked by importance-sampled Monte Carlo.
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.area: Environmental stochasticity and stochastic growth rate

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Voltage fluctuations in a passive dendrite under Poisson synaptic shot noise
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Stochastic cable equation solved by Crank-Nicolson with spatially distributed Poisson synaptic currents. Computes voltage variance and autocorrelation versus distance from the soma and compares them with the cable Green's function prediction.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Action potential propagation failure and timing jitter in thin axons from channel noise
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Compartmental Hodgkin-Huxley axon with Markov-chain Na and K channel gating simulated by Gillespie or Langevin steps. Estimates spike propagation failure probability and arrival-time jitter versus axon diameter.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Bayesian quantal analysis of synaptic release parameters from EPSC amplitudes
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Binomial quantal model with release sites n, release probability p and quantal size q plus Gaussian noise. Metropolis-within-Gibbs samples p and q while enumerating n, giving marginal posteriors from EPSC amplitudes recorded at several calcium levels.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Mutational meltdown: extinction time of small asexual populations
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Individual-based simulation of asexual reproduction with Poisson deleterious mutations, multiplicative fitness and density regulation, so that ratchet clicks feed back on population size. Computes the mean time to extinction versus carrying capacity and mutation rate.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Stochastic tunneling across a fitness valley in a Moran population
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Moran simulation of wild type, deleterious single mutant and advantageous double mutant. Estimates the rate at which double mutants appear and fix, compared with the Iwasa-Michor-Nowak tunneling approximation across population sizes.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Luria-Delbrück fluctuation test: mutant count distribution and mutation rate MLE
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Monte Carlo of exponentially growing cultures with stochastic mutation events, giving mutant count distributions per culture. Compares them with the Ma-Sandri-Sarkar recursion and estimates the mutation rate by maximum likelihood.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Stamping machine versus geometric replication: intracellular viral mutation distributions
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Branching simulation of intracellular RNA virus replication in which progeny copy either the founding template or successive copies. Compares mutation-count distributions and mean mutation frequency per burst between the two modes.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Amyloid aggregation lag-time distribution in microdroplets by kinetic Monte Carlo
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Gillespie simulation of primary nucleation, elongation and fragmentation in small volumes. Computes the lag-time distribution across droplet volumes and the crossover from stochastic to deterministic aggregation kinetics.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Enhancer-promoter first encounter time in a Rouse chromatin polymer
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Brownian dynamics of a bead-spring Rouse chain. Computes the mean first-passage time and steady looping probability for two beads to come within a capture radius versus genomic separation, with scaling exponents.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Bayesian phylogenetic MCMC over five-taxon topologies and branch lengths
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Metropolis-Hastings sampling of tree topologies via NNI proposals and branch lengths via multiplier proposals, under the Jukes-Cantor pruning likelihood. Reports posterior split probabilities and the maximum a posteriori topology.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Empirical Gumbel lambda and K for gapped local alignment by shuffling
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Smith-Waterman scores of many random or shuffled sequence pairs with affine gaps are fitted to a Gumbel distribution with finite-length correction. Gives empirical lambda and K and resulting E-values for a query.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Lattice predator-prey kinetic Monte Carlo: spatial correlations and damped oscillations
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Stochastic lattice Lotka-Volterra with nearest-neighbor predation, reproduction and death. Computes stationary densities, the decay of oscillations and the spatial correlation length, compared with mean-field rate equations.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Propagule establishment probability under a mate-finding Allee effect
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Gillespie birth-death simulation with mate-limited birth rate for introductions of varying founder size. Estimates the establishment probability curve and the founder number giving 50% success.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Spatial prisoner's dilemma with Fermi imitation updating on a lattice
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Monte Carlo of the Szabó-Tőke spatial game with random sequential pairwise imitation at noise K. Computes the stationary cooperator fraction versus temptation payoff and the critical temptation for cooperator extinction.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Species-area relationship of a spatial neutral voter model by coalescence simulation
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Spatially explicit neutral community with point speciation, sampled backward in time by coalescing random walks (Rosindell-style). Computes species richness versus sample area and the local slope z of the species-area curve.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Waiting time to cancer from sequential driver mutations in a Moran model
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Stochastic simulation of driver accumulation with selective advantage in a growing or fixed-size tissue (Beerenwinkel et al.). Computes the waiting time to k drivers and compares it with the analytic approximation.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Neutral clonal drift of stem-cell lineages: clone size scaling
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Gillespie simulation of critical birth-death progenitor dynamics in a tissue. Computes clone survival probability and the scaling collapse of clone size distributions over time, as in the Klein-Simons lineage-tracing analysis.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Hit-and-run uniform sampling of a metabolic flux polytope
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Artificial-centering hit-and-run sampling of the steady-state flux space S v = 0 with flux bounds, for a small metabolic network. Computes flux marginal distributions and correlations, with convergence checked by sampler diagnostics.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Marxan-style reserve design by simulated annealing with boundary-length penalty
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Selects planning units on a grid so that each species reaches its representation target while minimizing cost plus boundary length. Uses Metropolis simulated annealing with a cooling schedule and reports the best objective and selection frequencies over runs.

biology/quant_bio|stochastic.title: Closed-population capture-recapture abundance by data-augmentation Gibbs sampling
biology/quant_bio|stochastic.gist: Model M0 (or Mh) for capture histories, augmented with all-zero histories and latent inclusion indicators. A Gibbs sampler gives the posterior distribution of abundance N and detection probability.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: FEAST trapezoidal contour filter for discretized quantum harmonic oscillator levels
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Discretize -u''/2 + x^2 u/2 with finite differences and run FEAST subspace iteration. The spectral projector is built by trapezoidal quadrature of the resolvent on a circle enclosing an energy window. Report the eigenvalues found in the window and compare them with n+1/2.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Eigenvalue counting via resolvent trace on ellipse for impurity tight-binding chain
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Count the eigenvalues of a tight-binding chain with an impurity site inside an elliptic contour. The count is the contour integral of tr((zI-H)^{-1}) evaluated by Gauss-Legendre in the parameter angle. Verify the integer count, the impurity bound-state energy and its closed-form value.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Rational filter design for FEAST: Gauss-Legendre versus trapezoidal contour nodes
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the scalar rational filter rho(x) induced by N-point quadrature rules on a circle along the real axis. Measure the leakage ratio outside the target interval. Check that the subspace-iteration convergence rate of FEAST on a random symmetric matrix matches the predicted filter ratio.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Contour-integral Fermi-operator density matrix for SSH polyacetylene chain
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Build the finite-temperature density matrix of an SSH tight-binding chain from a pole/contour quadrature of the Fermi function times the resolvent. Compute the electron count and the alternating bond orders, and compare against full diagonalization.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Sakurai-Sugiura generalized eigensolver for vibrating string with variable density
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Assemble P1 finite-element stiffness and mass matrices for a string with density rho(x) = 1 + alpha x. Apply Sakurai-Sugiura moments of (zM-K)^{-1} on a circle to extract the eigenfrequencies in a band. Validate against dense generalized eigenvalues.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: GMRES with Givens rotations for convection-diffusion versus Peclet number
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Implement Arnoldi-GMRES with Givens QR updates for the upwind 1D/2D convection-diffusion operator. Record residual histories as the Peclet number grows and relate the convergence plateaus to the departure from normality and the numerical range.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: GMRES on Nystrom-discretized Love's equation for circular capacitor
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Discretize the second-kind Love integral equation of a parallel-disk capacitor with Gauss-Legendre Nystrom and solve it by GMRES. Show that the iteration count is independent of the mesh, and compute the capacitance versus plate separation.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Restart stagnation of GMRES(m) on a cyclic-shift-type nonnormal matrix
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Construct matrices on which restarted GMRES(m) stalls completely while full GMRES converges. Compute the residual norms for several restart lengths and explain the stagnation through the minimal residual polynomial over each cycle.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: GMRES for 1D Lippmann-Schwinger scattering off a rectangular barrier
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Discretize the 1D Lippmann-Schwinger equation with the outgoing free Green's function by quadrature and solve it with GMRES. Extract the transmission coefficient and compare it with the closed-form rectangular barrier formula, along with the iteration count versus wavenumber.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Arnoldi approximation of transient distribution of truncated M/M/1 queue
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Use Krylov-Arnoldi to approximate exp(tQ)p0 for the generator Q of a finite-buffer M/M/1 queue. Compare the mean queue length with expm and with the closed-form stationary limit, and study the error versus Krylov dimension.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Pseudospectra of Grcar matrix and GMRES residual bounds
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Compute epsilon-pseudospectra of the Grcar Toeplitz matrix on a complex grid via smallest singular values. Use contour lengths to evaluate the pseudospectral GMRES bound and compare it with the observed GMRES convergence.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Leslie matrix growth rate and stable age distribution via power iteration
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Assemble a Leslie matrix from age-specific fecundity and survival and compute the dominant eigenpair by power iteration. Compare lambda with the Euler-Lotka root and relate the convergence to the damping ratio |lambda2/lambda1|.
math/nla_approx|quad_models.area: Power, inverse and Rayleigh quotient iteration

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Transfer-matrix power iteration for 2D Ising strips versus Onsager free energy
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Build the row-to-row transfer matrix of 2D Ising strips of width L and compute its largest eigenvalue by power iteration. Extrapolate the free energy per site in 1/L and compare with Onsager's double integral evaluated by quadrature.
math/nla_approx|quad_models.area: Power, inverse and Rayleigh quotient iteration

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Karhunen-Loeve modes of exponential covariance via Nystrom and deflated power iteration
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Discretize the kernel exp(-|x-y|/l) on [-1,1] with Gauss-Legendre Nystrom and extract the leading eigenpairs by power iteration with Hotelling deflation. Compare with the analytic eigenvalues obtained from the transcendental tan equations.
math/nla_approx|quad_models.area: Power, inverse and Rayleigh quotient iteration

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Inverse iteration for circular drum membrane modes versus Bessel zeros
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Discretize the radial Bessel operator for the axisymmetric and m-th angular membrane modes and apply shifted inverse iteration. Compare the frequencies with scipy.special.jn_zeros and the eigenvectors with J_m(k r).
math/nla_approx|quad_models.area: Power, inverse and Rayleigh quotient iteration

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Gaussian deblurring with Tikhonov regularization and L-curve corner
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Discretize a Gaussian blurring Fredholm first-kind kernel by midpoint quadrature and add noise to synthetic data. Solve Tikhonov via SVD filter factors and locate the L-curve corner by maximum curvature, reporting the reconstruction error versus lambda.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Distribution of relaxation times from impedance spectra with GCV
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Model an impedance spectrum as a Fredholm integral of a relaxation-time distribution with the Debye kernel 1/(1+i omega tau), discretized on a log-tau grid. Recover a two-peak distribution with Tikhonov regularization, choosing lambda by generalized cross-validation.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Backward heat equation initial-condition recovery by truncated SVD
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Form the forward heat propagator from its sine-series closed form and recover the initial temperature from noisy final data. Use TSVD with the truncation index set by the discrepancy principle and examine the Picard plot.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Abel inversion of cylindrically symmetric plasma emissivity with smoothness regularization
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Discretize the Abel line-of-sight projection with exact annulus chord lengths and recover the radial emissivity from noisy chord data. Use second-derivative Tikhonov regularization and compare with an analytic emissivity profile.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Dynamic light scattering particle-size distribution by nonnegative Tikhonov
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Build the field-autocorrelation Laplace kernel exp(-Gamma t), with Gamma tied to particle radius through the Stokes-Einstein relation. Recover a bimodal size distribution by NNLS-constrained Tikhonov (CONTIN-like) with lambda chosen by the discrepancy principle.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Gravity surveying inverse problem: subsurface density from surface anomaly
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Discretize the vertical gravity kernel d/(d^2+(s-t)^2)^{3/2} for a buried density line and study Picard coefficient decay. Compare TSVD and Tikhonov reconstructions as burial depth increases ill-conditioning.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: NMR T2 relaxation spectrum from multiexponential decay data
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Invert CPMG echo decays through the exponential kernel on a log-T2 grid using regularized NNLS. Choose the regularization by the L-curve and by the discrepancy principle, comparing the recovered pore-size modes and their robustness to noise.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Indirect Fourier transform of SAXS intensity to pair-distance distribution
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Discretize I(q) = 4 pi integral p(r) sin(qr)/(qr) dr up to Dmax for a sphere. Recover p(r) with smoothness-regularized least squares and compare with the closed-form sphere p(r) and its radius of gyration.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Phonon density of states from heat capacity by Einstein-kernel inversion
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Write C_V(T) as an integral of g(omega) against the Einstein function, discretized by quadrature, and generate data from a Debye solid. Recover g(omega) with Tikhonov regularization and test recovery of the Debye cutoff and the omega^2 law.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Neumann-Neumann preconditioned Schur complement for 2D Poisson strips
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Assemble the interface Schur complement for strip subdomains of a 2D Poisson problem and precondition it with Neumann-Neumann local inverses. Compute condition numbers versus mesh size and compare with the (1+log(H/h))^2 bound.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Multiplicative Schwarz for high-contrast layered diffusion in porous media
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Apply multiplicative Schwarz (block Gauss-Seidel over overlapping subdomains) to 2D diffusion with layered permeability contrasts. Report convergence factors versus contrast, and test coefficient-aligned subdomains and an effective-harmonic-mean coarse correction.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Discrete Steklov-Poincare operator of a disk versus Dirichlet-to-Neumann spectrum
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Discretize Laplace on a polar grid and form the Schur complement onto the boundary circle. Compare its eigenvalues with the analytic Dirichlet-to-Neumann eigenvalues |k| for Fourier modes, including the discretization error per mode.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Schwarz waveform relaxation for the 1D heat equation
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Implement overlapping Schwarz waveform relaxation with Dirichlet transmission for u_t = u_xx over time windows. Measure the superlinear convergence versus window length and compare with the erfc-based theoretical contraction.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Guyan static condensation of cantilever beam finite-element model
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Assemble Hermite-cubic Euler-Bernoulli beam stiffness and mass matrices and condense out rotational and interior DOFs by Schur complement. Compare the reduced-model natural frequencies with the full model and the analytic cantilever roots of cos(x)cosh(x) = -1.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Spectral relaxation versus exact ratio cut and normalized cut on small graphs
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: For barbell, ring-of-cliques and random small graphs, compute spectral bisections from unnormalized and normalized Laplacians. Compare their ratio-cut and Ncut values with the brute-force optimum over all bipartitions.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Spectral bisection of L-shaped finite-element mesh for load balancing
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Triangulate an L-shaped domain, build the mesh dual graph Laplacian, and partition by sign of the Fiedler vector. Compare edge cut and balance with coordinate bisection, and apply recursive bisection into 4 and 8 parts.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Effective resistance in square-lattice resistor networks via Laplacian pseudoinverse
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Compute two-point resistances on finite square lattices from the Laplacian pseudoinverse. Compare with the infinite-lattice Green's function double integral evaluated by quadrature (e.g. 2/pi for diagonal neighbors) and examine boundary effects.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Diffusion maps on noisy circle and Swiss roll point clouds
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Build Gaussian-kernel graphs with density normalization and compute the leading Markov eigenvectors. Show that they recover the intrinsic angle or arclength coordinate, measuring correlation versus kernel bandwidth and noise.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Matrix-tree theorem spanning-tree counts versus closed forms
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Count spanning trees from a Laplacian cofactor determinant via Cholesky log-determinants for complete, complete bipartite, wheel and grid graphs. Compare with closed forms (n^{n-2}, m^{n-1}n^{m-1}) and with the grid product formula over cosines.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Consensus dynamics rate set by algebraic connectivity on networks
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Simulate linear consensus x' = -Lx on ring, small-world and random geometric graphs. Verify that the disagreement decays as exp(-lambda2 t), and compute lambda2 against rewiring probability.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: BiCG, BiCGSTAB and GMRES compared on convection-dominated diffusion
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Implement BiCG and BiCGSTAB and compare them with GMRES on 2D central-difference convection-diffusion. Report the residual oscillation amplitude, the number of matrix-vector products to tolerance and the memory cost across Peclet numbers.
math/nla_approx|quad_models.area: BiCGSTAB, QMR and short-recurrence nonsymmetric solvers

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Constructing and detecting Lanczos breakdowns in BiCG and QMR
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Build nonsymmetric systems and shadow vectors that cause serious and near-breakdowns, such as permutation matrices and specially chosen r0-hat. Detect them through vanishing <r-hat,r>, compare with GMRES behavior, and measure recovery via random shadow restarts.
math/nla_approx|quad_models.area: BiCGSTAB, QMR and short-recurrence nonsymmetric solvers

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: CGS versus BiCGSTAB on Scharfetter-Gummel drift-diffusion discretization
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Discretize a 1D semiconductor electron continuity equation with the Scharfetter-Gummel scheme, using a carefully evaluated Bernoulli function B(x) = x/(e^x - 1). Compare CGS and BiCGSTAB residual irregularity and accuracy for strong built-in fields.
math/nla_approx|quad_models.area: BiCGSTAB, QMR and short-recurrence nonsymmetric solvers

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: COCG versus BiCGSTAB for complex symmetric Helmholtz with absorbing layer
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Discretize 1D/2D Helmholtz with a complex-stretched absorbing layer, giving a complex symmetric matrix. Compare COCG and BiCGSTAB iteration counts and residual smoothness versus wavenumber, and check the computed field against the outgoing plane-wave solution.
math/nla_approx|quad_models.area: BiCGSTAB, QMR and short-recurrence nonsymmetric solvers

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: TFQMR for discrete-ordinates slab neutron transport with Gauss-Legendre angles
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Discretize 1D slab transport using Gauss-Legendre angular quadrature and diamond differencing, and write the scattering source iteration as a linear system. Solve with TFQMR and compare with source iteration as the scattering ratio approaches 1.
math/nla_approx|quad_models.area: BiCGSTAB, QMR and short-recurrence nonsymmetric solvers

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Adaptive Gauss-Kronrod G7-K15 for the Debye heat capacity function
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Implement globally adaptive G7-K15 with a priority queue to evaluate the Debye function D3(x) and C_V(T)/(3Nk). Verify the Dulong-Petit and T^3 limits and compare the error estimates with the true errors.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Tanh-sinh quadrature for elliptic integrals near logarithmic singularity
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Use double-exponential tanh-sinh quadrature for K(m) and E(m) as m approaches 1, where the integrand has an endpoint singularity. Compare with scipy.special.ellipk and the asymptotic ln(4/sqrt(1-m)), and apply the result to large-amplitude pendulum periods.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Filon-type quadrature for Fresnel integrals and knife-edge diffraction
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Implement Filon quadrature for highly oscillatory cos/sin integrands to compute Fresnel integrals C(x) and S(x). Compare with scipy.special.fresnel, then evaluate the knife-edge diffraction intensity profile.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Gauss-Jacobi quadrature for weakly singular Abel-type kernels
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Build Gauss-Jacobi rules from Golub-Welsch to integrate f(t)(x-t)^{-1/2}. Evaluate forward Abel transforms of test profiles with known closed forms, and compare their convergence with Gauss-Legendre and adaptive Simpson.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Voigt line profile via Gauss-Hermite and Clenshaw-Curtis versus Faddeeva function
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Voigt profile as a Gaussian-Lorentzian convolution integral using Gauss-Hermite and adaptive Clenshaw-Curtis rules with error estimates. Compare with Re w(z) from scipy.special.wofz across the Doppler-to-pressure-broadening regimes.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Bose-Einstein condensate fraction and critical temperature from polylog integrals
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Compute g_{3/2}(z) and the thermal particle number in a harmonic trap and in a box by adaptive quadrature handling the integrable x^{1/2}/(e^x - 1) endpoint behavior. Solve for the fugacity and the condensate fraction versus T/Tc.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Gaussian process regression log marginal likelihood via jittered Cholesky
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Factor squared-exponential covariance matrices, which are nearly singular for dense inputs, adding minimal jitter until Cholesky succeeds. Compute the posterior mean, variance and log marginal likelihood, and track the jitter required versus length scale.
math/nla_approx|quad_models.area: Cholesky and LDL^T for symmetric systems

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Sampling Matern Gaussian random fields by Cholesky with variogram check
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Build Matern covariance matrices using scipy.special.kv for several smoothness values and sample fields on 1D/2D grids via Cholesky. Verify the empirical variogram against the analytic model.
math/nla_approx|quad_models.area: Cholesky and LDL^T for symmetric systems

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Sylvester inertia counts for diatomic-chain phonon integrated density of states
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Use LDL^T of (K - omega^2 M) for a finite diatomic spring chain to count the modes below each omega by Sylvester's law. Compare the resulting integrated density of states with the closed-form acoustic and optical dispersion relations.
math/nla_approx|quad_models.area: Cholesky and LDL^T for symmetric systems

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Modified Cholesky Newton steps for Lennard-Jones cluster relaxation
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Compute analytic gradients and Hessians of the Lennard-Jones energy for small clusters and apply Gill-Murray-type modified Cholesky to obtain descent directions. Relax to minima and verify the known LJ7/LJ13 energies and positive-definite final Hessians.
math/nla_approx|quad_models.area: Cholesky and LDL^T for symmetric systems

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Cholesky normal equations versus QR for monomial and Chebyshev polynomial fits
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Fit high-degree polynomials to data with normal equations solved by Cholesky and with Householder QR, in monomial and Chebyshev bases. Show the coefficient and residual error growth scaling with kappa^2 versus kappa.
math/nla_approx|quad_models.area: Cholesky and LDL^T for symmetric systems

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Banded Cholesky for natural and clamped cubic spline interpolation
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Assemble the SPD tridiagonal moment system for cubic splines and solve it with an O(n) banded Cholesky. Verify the O(h^4) interpolation error for Runge and smooth functions, and the clamped versus natural end effects.
math/nla_approx|quad_models.area: Cholesky and LDL^T for symmetric systems

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Exact two-grid convergence factor for 1D Poisson via Fourier harmonics
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Form the 2x2 harmonic-pair symbol of the two-grid operator with full weighting, linear interpolation and Jacobi smoothing. Compute its spectral radius versus smoothing steps and compare with the spectral radius of the explicit two-grid iteration matrix.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Geometric V-cycle for 2D Poisson with manufactured solution
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Implement a recursive V(nu1,nu2) cycle with full weighting and bilinear prolongation. Measure the asymptotic convergence factor across grid levels to show h-independence, and verify second-order discretization error.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Full multigrid reaching discretization accuracy in one cycle
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Implement FMG with cubic or bilinear solution interpolation for 1D/2D Poisson. Show that the algebraic error after one FMG cycle per level is below the truncation error, and report total work units.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: LFA of damped Jacobi for Helmholtz showing smoother amplification
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Compute the Fourier symbol of damped Jacobi for the shifted operator -Delta - k^2. Identify frequencies amplified as kh grows and determine the coarsest grid on which smoothing still works, validated with two-grid experiments.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: FAS multigrid for nonlinear Poisson-Boltzmann double layer
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Solve the 1D nonlinear Poisson-Boltzmann equation phi'' = kappa^2 sinh(phi) near a charged wall with the full approximation scheme and nonlinear Gauss-Seidel. Compare the potential profile with the Gouy-Chapman closed form tanh(phi/4) = tanh(phi0/4) e^{-kappa x}.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Least-squares B-spline fit of Shomate heat capacity and thermodynamic integration
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Fit noisy Cp(T) data generated from the Shomate equation with a cubic least-squares B-spline. Integrate the spline exactly for enthalpy H(T) and for entropy via Cp/T with Gauss quadrature, then compare with the closed-form Shomate H and S.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Boehm knot insertion and Gauss-Legendre arc length of a B-spline curve
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Insert knots into a planar cubic B-spline curve with Boehm's algorithm and verify that the curve is unchanged at sample points. Compute arc length with composite Gauss-Legendre on knot spans, and test convergence against a curve that reproduces a circle-like reference.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: P-spline smoothing of a noisy Planck spectrum and Wien peak location
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Smooth noisy blackbody spectral radiance with a penalized B-spline whose curvature penalty matrix comes from Gauss quadrature of products of second derivatives. Choose the penalty by GCV, then locate the spectral peak and recover the temperature through Wien's displacement law.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: B-spline representation of Lennard-Jones potential and second virial coefficient
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Interpolate a Lennard-Jones pair potential on a nonuniform knot grid with cubic B-splines. Evaluate the second virial coefficient B2(T) by Gauss-Legendre quadrature of the Mayer function, and compare with the closed-form series in reduced temperature built from gamma functions.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Spline interpolation of tabulated Debye function and derived heat capacity
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Tabulate the Debye function D3(x) by quadrature and interpolate it with a not-a-knot cubic B-spline after checking the Schoenberg-Whitney conditions. Differentiate the spline to get the Debye heat capacity and compare it with the direct quadrature formula across temperatures.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Exact B-spline integrals as quadrature weights for spline quasi-interpolants
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Use the closed-form integral (t_{i+k}-t_i)/k of each B-spline to build quadrature weights from a quasi-interpolant on uniform and graded knots. Apply them to Fermi-Dirac-type integrands and measure the convergence order against Gauss-Legendre.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Lanczos Gauss quadrature for heat-kernel diagonal on a path graph
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Approximate u^T exp(-tL) u for a path-graph Laplacian with k-step Lanczos Gauss and Gauss-Radau quadrature, which give lower and upper bounds. Compare with the closed-form cosine spectrum and track how the bounds tighten with k.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Classical, modified and twice-iterated Gram-Schmidt on Hilbert matrix columns
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Orthogonalize the columns of Hilbert matrices of increasing size with CGS, MGS and CGS2. Plot ||I-Q^TQ|| against kappa(A) and compare with the theoretical O(u kappa^2), O(u kappa) and O(u) scalings.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Gram-Schmidt on monomials under Gauss-Legendre inner product recovering Legendre polynomials
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Orthogonalize the monomials 1, x, ..., x^n in the Gauss-Legendre-discretized L2 inner product using CGS and MGS. Compare the resulting coefficients and orthogonality with the closed-form Legendre polynomials as degree grows and the Gram matrix becomes ill-conditioned.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Orthogonalizing even-tempered Gaussian orbital bases with analytic overlap integrals
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Build s-type Gaussian basis sets with exponents alpha*beta^k and form their analytic overlap matrix. Orthogonalize with MGS, iterated GS and Löwdin, then measure orthogonality loss and the hydrogen ground-state energy error as beta approaches 1 and the overlap condition number explodes.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Gram-Schmidt of Slater functions r^n e^{-r} reproducing Laguerre radial functions
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Use gamma-function closed forms for overlap integrals of r^n e^{-zeta r} and orthogonalize the set with CGS, MGS and CGS2. Compare with generalized Laguerre functions and measure orthogonality loss against basis size.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Roundoff accumulation in very fine trapezoidal quadrature with pairwise summation
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Gaussian integral over [-L, L] with the trapezoidal rule on up to 10^8 nodes in float32, using recursive, pairwise and compensated sums. Separate truncation error from roundoff by comparison with the erf closed form, and locate the optimal n.
math/nla_approx|quad_models.area: Floating-point error analysis and compensated summation

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Ogita-Rump-Oishi Dot2 with TwoSum and TwoProduct on ill-conditioned dot products
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Generate dot products with prescribed condition numbers using the Ogita-Rump-Oishi generator. Compute them naively and with error-free-transformation Dot2, and compare the relative errors with the bounds gamma_n*cond and u + gamma_n^2*cond.
math/nla_approx|quad_models.area: Floating-point error analysis and compensated summation

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Naive, two-pass and Welford variance on large-mean data with error bounds
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Compute sample variances of data with mean much larger than the spread, using textbook, two-pass, corrected two-pass and Welford updating. Compare the measured errors with the Chan-Golub-LeVeque condition-number-based bounds.
math/nla_approx|quad_models.area: Floating-point error analysis and compensated summation

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Evjen expanding-cube summation of the NaCl Madelung constant with compensation
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Sum the conditionally convergent NaCl lattice sum over Evjen-weighted cubes of growing size in float32 and float64, with and without Kahan summation. Compare with the reference Madelung constant 1.747565 and separate the truncation error from accumulated rounding error.
math/nla_approx|quad_models.area: Floating-point error analysis and compensated summation

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Wilkinson polynomial roots from companion eigenvalues: conditioning and backward error
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Find the roots of Wilkinson's degree-20 polynomial from companion-matrix eigenvalues. Compute per-root condition numbers and normwise backward errors in the coefficients, and compare the observed root errors with condition number times backward error.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Colleague-matrix zeros of Chebyshev interpolant of Bessel J0
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Interpolate J0 on subintervals of [0, 50] at Chebyshev points and find the zeros of each piece as eigenvalues of the colleague matrix. Compare with the tabulated jn_zeros, and assess accuracy against degree and subinterval length.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Peng-Robinson cubic compressibility roots via companion matrix and fugacity
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Solve the Peng-Robinson cubic in Z for a pure fluid both with companion eigenvalues and with Cardano's formula. Select the vapor and liquid roots, evaluate the closed-form fugacity coefficients, and locate the saturation pressure by equal fugacity.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Balancing effect on companion eigenvalues for truncated exponential Taylor polynomials
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Compute the roots of degree-n Taylor polynomials of exp from companion matrices with and without Parlett-Reinsch balancing. Compare accuracy against high-precision sympy roots, and check that the scaled zeros approach the Szegő curve.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Kac random polynomial roots versus Edelman-Kostlan density
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Sample many random Gaussian-coefficient polynomials and find their roots from companion matrices. Compare the expected number of real roots with the Edelman-Kostlan integral evaluated by quadrature and with its 2/pi log n asymptote.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: BDF stability boundaries and A(alpha) angles via companion root loci
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: For each BDF order k, scan the boundary locus z(theta) and check root conditions with companion-matrix eigenvalues of the characteristic polynomial. Compute the A(alpha) stability angles and compare with the known values, such as 73.35 degrees for BDF4.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Randomized SVD of Gauss-Legendre Nystrom Poisson Green's function
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Discretize the 1D Dirichlet Green's function operator with Gauss-Legendre Nystrom weights. Apply a randomized range finder with q power iterations, and compare the errors and singular values with the closed-form 1/(k pi)^2 and the Halko-Martinsson-Tropp bounds.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Randomized eigenvalues of Gaussian kernel operator versus Mercer closed form
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Form the weighted Gaussian-kernel matrix under a Gaussian measure by Gauss-Hermite quadrature. Compute its leading eigenvalues by randomized SVD, and compare with the closed-form geometric Mercer eigenvalues in terms of Hermite functions.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Randomized Nystrom approximation of Brownian-motion covariance and KL eigenvalues
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Apply randomized Nystrom to the min(s,t) covariance discretized by quadrature. Compare the approximate KL eigenvalues and eigenfunctions with the closed-form 1/((k-1/2)^2 pi^2) and sine modes, and measure the trace-norm error against the optimal tail.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Ng-Jordan-Weiss spectral clustering of concentric rings with eigengap bandwidth selection
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Cluster noisy concentric-circle data using a Gaussian affinity, the normalized Laplacian and k-means on row-normalized eigenvectors. Choose the kernel width by maximizing the eigengap, and report the adjusted accuracy against noise level.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Random geometric graph Laplacian convergence to Neumann Laplacian eigenvalues
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Build epsilon-ball graph Laplacians on uniform samples of [0,1] and rescale them with the kernel second moment, computed by quadrature. Compare the low eigenvalues and eigenvectors with the Neumann (k pi)^2 and cosine modes as n grows.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Shi-Malik normalized cut segmentation of a synthetic two-region image
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Build a pixel graph with intensity- and distance-based weights for a noisy synthetic image. Solve the generalized eigenproblem (D-W)y = lambda D y with Lanczos and threshold y to minimize Ncut, then measure segmentation error against noise.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Weighted path Laplacian Fiedler vector of heterogeneous rod versus Sturm-Liouville
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Discretize a rod with variable conductivity k(x) as a weighted path graph and compute its Fiedler vector and value. Compare with the lowest nontrivial Neumann Sturm-Liouville eigenpair obtained by shooting with quadrature.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Multiway spectral clustering of Gaussian mixtures versus separation threshold
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Cluster k-component Gaussian mixtures with k Laplacian eigenvectors and k-means while varying the component separation. Compare the misclassification rate with the Bayes error, computed by quadrature of overlapping normal densities.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Kirchhoff index of cycles, wheels and fullerene-like graphs from Laplacian spectra
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Compute the Kirchhoff index n*sum(1/lambda_i) from Laplacian eigenvalues of cycle, prism and wheel graphs. Verify the closed forms (n^3-n)/12 for cycles and the trigonometric-sum formulas for prisms, then compare against an integral asymptotic for large n.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Rational Remez for exp(-x) on [0,inf) and Halphen's constant
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Map [0,inf) to a finite interval and compute best uniform (n,n) rational approximations to exp(-x) with rational Remez. Check equioscillation, and compare the error ratios with the Cody-Meinardus-Varga/Halphen constant 1/9.2890.
math/nla_approx|quad_models.area: Minimax approximation and the Remez algorithm

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Minimax relative-error seed for Newton square root on [1/4,1]
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Compute low-degree polynomial approximations to sqrt(x) with minimum relative error by weighted Remez. Predict the number of correct bits after k Newton steps from the quadratic convergence formula, and verify in floating point.
math/nla_approx|quad_models.area: Minimax approximation and the Remez algorithm

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Zolotarev rational approximation of the sign function via elliptic functions
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Construct Zolotarev's optimal rational approximation to sign(x) on [-1,-delta] U [delta,1] from Jacobi elliptic functions and complete elliptic integrals. Verify equioscillation numerically and compare the error with the closed-form decay rate.
math/nla_approx|quad_models.area: Minimax approximation and the Remez algorithm

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Parks-McClellan Remez exchange for a linear-phase lowpass FIR filter
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Design a type-I equiripple lowpass FIR filter by Remez exchange on a cosine basis over the passband and stopband, with weights. Verify the alternation count and ripple levels, and compare the required length with Kaiser's empirical formula.
math/nla_approx|quad_models.area: Minimax approximation and the Remez algorithm

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Euclidean distance matrix completion for sensor network localization
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Complete a partially observed squared-distance matrix of planar sensors using its rank-(d+2) structure with alternating minimization. Recover coordinates by classical MDS and Procrustes alignment, and measure localization error against the fraction of missing distances.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Low-rank density matrix tomography from random Pauli expectations
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Reconstruct a low-rank multi-qubit density matrix from a subset of Pauli expectation values using projected SVT onto trace-one PSD matrices. Report fidelity against the number of Pauli measurements and the rank.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Soft-impute completion of sampled smooth kernel f(x,y)=1/(1+x+y)
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Sample a smooth bivariate kernel on a grid with missing entries and complete it with soft-impute. Compare the recovered singular values and the error with the exponential singular-value decay of the Cauchy-like kernel computed from the full matrix.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Noisy alternating least squares completion with regularization path and oracle bound
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Complete noisy rank-r matrices by regularized ALS over a lambda grid selected on held-out entries. Compare the test RMSE with the oracle error sigma*sqrt(r(2n-r)/m) as the noise level varies.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Line SOR versus point SOR for Laplace with sinh-series boundary solution
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Solve Laplace's equation on a square with one nonzero Dirichlet edge using point SOR and line SOR (with Thomas solves) at their optimal omegas. Compare iteration counts with the theoretical ratio of approximately sqrt(2), and compare the solution with the Fourier sinh series.
math/nla_approx|quad_models.area: Stationary iterative methods: Jacobi, Gauss-Seidel, SOR

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Romberg versus Bulirsch step sequences with polynomial and rational extrapolation for erf
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Integrate the Gaussian to obtain erf(x) using trapezoidal sums on the Romberg (h/2^k) and Bulirsch (h/2, h/3, h/4, h/6, ...) step sequences. Apply Neville polynomial and Bulirsch-Stoer rational extrapolation, then compare error versus function evaluations against the scipy erf reference.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Plane-parallel slab emissivity via exponential integrals with composite Boole and Richardson
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the emissivity 1-2E3(τ) of an isothermal gray slab by integrating the angular intensity with composite Boole's rule, and check the observed order. Richardson extrapolation removes leading error terms; results are validated against E_n(τ) from recurrences and scipy.special.expn.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Ellipse perimeter from inscribed polygons with repeated Richardson extrapolation
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Compute perimeters of inscribed polygons with n=2^k vertices for an ellipse and establish their error expansion in even powers of 1/n. Repeated Richardson extrapolation then approaches the exact perimeter 4aE(e), which is checked against the complete elliptic integral and Ramanujan's approximation.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Rigid-rotor rotational partition function: direct sum versus Euler-Maclaurin high-temperature expansion
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Evaluate q_rot=Σ(2J+1)exp(-J(J+1)θ/T) by direct summation and by the Euler-Maclaurin (Mulholland) expansion T/θ+1/3+θ/(15T)+.... Compute the relative error versus T/θ and find the temperature at which each truncation order is accurate to 1e-8.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Bloch-Grüneisen electrical resistivity of metals via Romberg integration
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Bloch-Grüneisen integral J5(θ_D/T)=∫x^5/((e^x-1)(1-e^-x))dx with Romberg quadrature after treating the removable singularity at x=0. Verify the T^5 low-temperature and linear high-temperature limits, and fit θ_D to synthetic resistivity data.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Kepler equation Fourier-Bessel series versus trapezoidal quadrature for orbit averages
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Solve Kepler's equation via its Fourier-Bessel series E=M+Σ(2/n)J_n(ne)sin(nM) and by Newton iteration. Compute orbit-averaged quantities such as <r^-2> and <r^-3> with the periodic trapezoidal rule in mean anomaly, and check their geometric convergence against closed forms as a function of eccentricity.
math/nla_approx|quad_models.area: Special functions and closed-form physical models

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Quadratic tetrahedral P2 element matrices: Keast cubature versus barycentric closed form
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Assemble 10-node tetrahedral mass and stiffness matrices with Keast/Grundmann-Möller cubature of increasing degree, and compare them with the exact barycentric integration formula a!b!c!d!3!/(a+b+c+d+3)!. Find the minimal exact cubature degree and the eigenvalue range of the element matrices.
math/nla_approx|quad_models.area: Finite element basis functions and assembly

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Axisymmetric linear finite elements for radial heat conduction with r-weighted quadrature
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Assemble 1D P1 elements in r for steady conduction with uniform heat generation in a cylinder and in a cylindrical shell. Evaluate the r-weighted stiffness and load integrals by Gauss quadrature, and compare the solution with the closed-form logarithmic and quadratic temperature profiles, including the convergence rate near r=0.
math/nla_approx|quad_models.area: Finite element basis functions and assembly

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Rank deficiency of underintegrated P2 triangle mass matrices and spurious modes
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Assemble P2 triangle mass matrices with vertex, edge-midpoint and degree-2/4 cubature rules, then compute rank and eigenvalues. Show that vertex-only quadrature produces a singular mass matrix and that edge-midpoint lumping produces spurious modes in the Laplace eigenproblem on the unit square.
math/nla_approx|quad_models.area: Finite element basis functions and assembly

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Discrete dispersion of p-version FEM for 1D Helmholtz versus Ainsworth's estimate
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Assemble integrated-Legendre hierarchical element matrices by Gauss-Legendre quadrature and compute the discrete wavenumber from the Bloch-wave transfer relation of one element. Verify the phase-error decay versus polynomial degree p and kh against Ainsworth's Padé-based closed form.
math/nla_approx|quad_models.area: Finite element basis functions and assembly

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Legendre fits of nuclear angular distributions: Householder QR versus normal equations
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Fit dσ/dΩ=Σa_lP_l(cosθ) to synthetic noisy angular-distribution data with Householder QR, normal equations, and Gauss-Legendre projection. Compare coefficient errors and conditioning versus maximum order L and angular coverage.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Randomized SVD of the discretized Laplace transform operator with Gauss-Laguerre weights
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Discretize the real Laplace transform from decay rates to times using weighted quadrature nodes, then compute its rapidly decaying singular values. Compare a randomized range finder with q power iterations against the optimal truncated SVD, and relate the numerical rank to resolvable relaxation components.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Separable exponential-sum CP approximation of the Coulomb potential via sinc quadrature
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Discretize 1/r=(2/√π)∫exp(-r²t²)dt with a sinc (trapezoidal after exp substitution) quadrature, which yields a sum of Gaussians and hence a CP-format tensor on a 3D grid. Measure relative accuracy versus number of terms and compare the resulting CP rank with CP-ALS compression of the full tensor.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Pseudospectra of the Chebyshev differentiation matrix and explicit time-step stability
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Build the Chebyshev collocation first-derivative matrix with an inflow boundary condition, and compute its ε-pseudospectra on a grid via minimum singular values. Relate the O(N²) eigenvalue/pseudospectral extent to stability of explicit Runge-Kutta time steps, and compare ||exp(tD)|| transient growth with eigenvalue predictions.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Reactivity and transient amplification of perturbations in a food-chain Jacobian
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Linearize a three-level Lotka-Volterra food chain around its stable equilibrium. Compute the reactivity (largest eigenvalue of the symmetric part), the maximal amplification max_t ||e^{tA}||, and ε-pseudospectra, showing transient growth despite asymptotic stability.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: NMF separation of multi-temperature blackbody emission mixtures and temperature recovery
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Generate spectra as nonnegative mixtures of Planck curves at several source temperatures with Poisson noise. Factor them with multiplicative-update and HALS NMF, then fit Planck temperatures to the recovered spectral factors and track reconstruction error and identifiability versus temperature spacing.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Dynamic polarizability of a soft-Coulomb 1D atom via MINRES Sternheimer solves
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Discretize a 1D soft-Coulomb Hamiltonian, compute its ground state, and solve the indefinite shifted Sternheimer equations (H-E0∓ω)ψ1=-xψ0 with MINRES. Compare α(ω) with a sum-over-states using oscillator strengths, and monitor convergence near resonances.
math/nla_approx|quad_models.area: MINRES and SYMMLQ for symmetric indefinite systems

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Momentum-space Lippmann-Schwinger phase shifts for Yukawa potentials with principal-value subtraction
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Discretize the partial-wave K-matrix equation with Gauss-Legendre momentum quadrature mapped to [0,∞), handling the principal value by subtraction. Solve with GMRES, extract s-wave phase shifts, and verify against Born approximation and coordinate-space Numerov results.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Mie extinction efficiency via downward recurrence of logarithmic derivatives
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Compute Mie coefficients a_n and b_n from Riccati-Bessel functions using Wiscombe's truncation and downward recurrence of D_n(mx). Show the instability of upward recurrence for absorbing spheres, then compute Q_ext and Q_sca and check the extinction-paradox limit.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Miller's backward recurrence for Bessel functions J_n with normalization sums
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Evaluate J_n(x) for many orders by backward recurrence from a large starting order, normalized with J_0+2ΣJ_{2k}=1. Quantify the error growth of forward recurrence past n≈x, choose the starting order by error criteria, and compare with scipy.special.jv.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Regularized incomplete gamma by series and Lentz continued fraction for chi-square tails
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Implement P(a,x) by power series and Q(a,x) by modified Lentz continued fraction, switching at x≈a+1. Compute chi-square p-values far into the tails without cancellation, and compare accuracy and iteration counts with scipy.special.gammaincc.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Fully normalized associated Legendre functions to high degree for geopotential synthesis
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Implement standard forward-column recursion for fully normalized P̄_nm(cosθ) to degree 2000 and show underflow near the poles. Fix it with Holmes-Featherstone scaled recursion (extended-range arithmetic), and verify normalization via Gauss-Legendre quadrature.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Airy function via trapezoidal quadrature on steepest-descent contours versus power series
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Evaluate Ai(x) for large positive and negative x by trapezoidal integration of the Airy integral along steepest-descent paths through the saddle points. Compare with the cancellation-prone Maclaurin series and with asymptotic expansions, showing geometric convergence of the contour rule.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Baffled circular piston radiation impedance via Struve functions by quadrature
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Compute radiation resistance 1-2J1(2ka)/(2ka) and reactance 2H1(2ka)/(2ka), evaluating the Struve function H1 through Gauss-Legendre quadrature of its integral representation. Validate against series and scipy.special.struve, and find where the reactance peaks.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Spherical harmonic transforms on Gauss-Legendre versus Driscoll-Healy equiangular grids
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Implement forward spherical harmonic transforms using Gauss-Legendre-in-cosθ times trapezoidal-in-φ quadrature, and Driscoll-Healy weighted equiangular quadrature. Measure aliasing error for band-limited and non-band-limited test fields as a function of grid size.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Two-center Slater orbital overlap in prolate spheroidal coordinates versus Mulliken formulas
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Compute 1s-1s and 1s-2p_σ Slater overlap integrals by Gauss-Legendre quadrature in prolate spheroidal coordinates (λ, μ). Compare with closed-form A_n and B_n auxiliary-function expressions, which suffer B_n cancellation at small arguments.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Henyey-Greenstein phase function Legendre moments and delta-M truncation
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Compute Legendre moments of the Henyey-Greenstein phase function by Gauss-Legendre quadrature and verify the exact result χ_l=g^l. Apply delta-M truncation and evaluate the phase-function reconstruction error versus truncation order for strongly forward-peaked scattering.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Mean first-passage time in a double well: nested quadrature versus Kramers rate
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the exact overdamped MFPT nested double integral for a quartic double-well potential with cumulative Gauss-Legendre quadrature. Compare with the Kramers saddle-point formula and its finite-barrier correction across barrier heights.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Zernike wavefront coefficients: polar Gauss quadrature versus discrete least squares
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Compute Zernike coefficients of a synthetic aberrated wavefront by Gauss-Legendre-in-r times trapezoid-in-θ quadrature on the unit disk, and by least squares on a pixelated pupil. Compare orthogonality loss, coefficient errors and Strehl ratio estimates.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Griffith crack stress intensity factors via Gauss-Chebyshev collocation of singular equations
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Solve the Cauchy singular integral equation for crack-opening dislocation density using Gauss-Chebyshev quadrature (Erdogan-Gupta) for a crack under polynomial loading. Extract stress intensity factors and verify exponential convergence against closed forms.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Thin-airfoil Glauert coefficients for NACA four-digit camber lines by quadrature
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Compute Glauert Fourier coefficients A_0, A_1 and A_2 for piecewise-parabolic NACA camber lines by Gauss-Legendre quadrature in θ, splitting at the maximum-camber kink. Obtain the zero-lift angle, lift slope and quarter-chord moment, and check convergence as the kink is or is not aligned with a panel boundary.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Gamma function via Lanczos approximation versus Stirling series with Bernoulli corrections
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Implement the Lanczos approximation with given coefficients and the Stirling asymptotic series with optimal truncation, using reflection for negative arguments. Map relative error across the complex plane and choose a recurrence shift so that Stirling reaches 1e-15.

math/nla_approx|quad_models.title: Orientational powder averaging: Fibonacci lattice versus Gauss product rules on the sphere
math/nla_approx|quad_models.gist: Compute powder-averaged NMR chemical-shift-anisotropy lineshape moments and dipolar second moments using Fibonacci spherical lattices and Gauss-Legendre-times-trapezoid product rules. Compare error versus number of orientations for smooth and tensor-rank-limited integrands.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Fitting diatomic chain force constants to measured phonon dispersion
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Use a 1D diatomic linear chain with nearest- and next-nearest-neighbor springs. Fit the force constants to measured acoustic and optical branch frequencies by nonlinear least squares, and report the zone-boundary gap and sound velocity.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: SiGe alloy composition and strain from three Raman modes
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Use empirical linear relations for the Si-Si, Si-Ge and Ge-Ge mode positions versus Ge fraction and strain. Fit Voigt peaks to a synthetic spectrum, then solve the overdetermined nonlinear system for composition and strain by least squares.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Raman thermometry via Balkanski anharmonic decay model inversion
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Fit the three- and four-phonon decay coefficients of the Balkanski model to the temperature-dependent shift and linewidth. Invert a measured peak position for local temperature with a bracketing root finder.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Maximum-rate Forster transfer pathways in polydisperse quantum-dot solids
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Build a graph of Forster transfer rates between QDs placed on a disordered lattice with size-dependent spectra. Find the dominant donor-to-acceptor pathway with Dijkstra on minus log branching ratios and report the bottleneck step.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Percolation threshold of energy-transfer networks in nanocrystal films
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Connect nanocrystals whose pairwise Forster rate exceeds the radiative rate and find clusters with union-find. Bisect on the dot packing fraction to locate the threshold where a spanning cluster first appears.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Optimal acceptor loading in host-guest emissive films
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Model donor-to-acceptor Forster harvesting against acceptor self-quenching from concentration-dependent aggregation. Maximize the net acceptor emission yield over acceptor concentration with bounded scalar optimization.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Steady-state energy funneling in graded QD films by master-equation iteration
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Set up a Pauli master equation for exciton populations on a 1D chain of QD layers with graded bandgaps and Forster rates. Solve for the steady state by fixed-point power iteration, then compute the fraction of excitons reaching the low-gap sink.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Combinatorial design of a three-dye FRET cascade
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Choose an ordered triple of dyes from a library of Gaussian absorption and emission spectra. Enumerate all ordered triples, computing overlap integrals and Forster radii for each, to maximize end-to-end transfer efficiency at fixed spacings.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Mean first-passage time for excitons in an energetically disordered chain
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Use Miller-Abrahams hopping rates on a 1D chain with Gaussian site energies. Solve the linear first-passage equations by sparse tridiagonal solve to obtain the effective diffusion coefficient versus disorder and temperature.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Dexter attenuation factor from bridge-length-dependent triplet transfer
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Fit triplet energy transfer rates measured across oligomer bridges of increasing length to k = k0 exp(-beta R) by weighted least squares in log space. Find the bridge length where Dexter transfer equals the phosphorescence rate.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Two-diode dark I-V fitting with Levenberg-Marquardt in log space
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Fit the diffusion (n=1) and recombination (n=2) saturation currents together with series and shunt resistance to a dark I-V curve. Minimize log-current residuals with Levenberg-Marquardt, the model being evaluated by a Newton inner solve.
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.area: Solar cell equivalent circuits and parameter extraction

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Global maximum power point of a partially shaded module with bypass diodes
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Combine cell-string I-V curves under nonuniform irradiance, with reverse-bias breakdown and bypass diodes, at fixed current. Find all local P-V maxima by scanning plus Brent refinement and identify the global maximum.
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.area: Solar cell equivalent circuits and parameter extraction

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Perturb-and-observe versus incremental conductance MPPT convergence
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Implement both discrete MPPT algorithms on a single-diode PV model under an irradiance ramp. Compare tracking efficiency and steady-state oscillation as functions of step size.
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.area: Solar cell equivalent circuits and parameter extraction

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Shockley-Queisser optimal bandgap under blackbody illumination
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Compute detailed-balance J(V) from photon flux integrals for a 5778 K sun. Maximize power over voltage with Brent's method, then maximize efficiency over bandgap.
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.area: Solar cell equivalent circuits and parameter extraction

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Current-matched two-terminal tandem bandgap optimization
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Model each subcell by detailed balance. Find the operating current of the series stack by root finding on the voltage sum, then maximize tandem efficiency over the top and bottom bandgaps with Nelder-Mead.
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.area: Solar cell equivalent circuits and parameter extraction

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Global single-diode parameter extraction with differential evolution
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Fit the five single-diode parameters to a noisy illuminated I-V curve using the explicit Lambert-W current. Compare differential evolution with local least squares to show the problem of multiple minima.
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.area: Solar cell equivalent circuits and parameter extraction

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Fully coupled Newton drift-diffusion for an illuminated p-i-n solar cell
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Assemble the coupled Jacobian for (psi, n, p) with Scharfetter-Gummel fluxes and Beer-Lambert generation, and solve with Newton. Use voltage continuation, then find Voc and fill factor by root finding on J(V).

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Space-charge-limited current in single-carrier organic diodes
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Solve drift-diffusion with injecting ohmic contacts and a field-dependent Poole-Frenkel mobility by Gummel iteration. Find the crossover from ohmic to Mott-Gurney J proportional to V^2 behavior.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Quasi-static mobile-ion redistribution in perovskite solar cells
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Find the steady-state anion vacancy distribution at a given preconditioning bias by Newton solution of Poisson plus a zero-flux ion continuity equation. Freeze the ions and solve electron/hole drift-diffusion to get the hysteretic J-V curve.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: External cavity modes of the Lang-Kobayashi equations
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Solve the transcendental phase condition for the steady-state frequencies at a given feedback strength C and linewidth enhancement factor. Bracket every root with Brent's method, then classify the roots as modes or antimodes and count them versus C.
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.area: Laser dynamics with feedback and injection

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Hopf bifurcation boundary of injection-locked lasers
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Follow the stable locked branch and find the detuning where the leading Jacobian eigenvalue's real part crosses zero, using Brent's method. Map the Hopf curve in the injection-strength versus detuning plane.
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.area: Laser dynamics with feedback and injection

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Feedback strengths of saddle-node creation of external cavity mode pairs
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Find the critical C values at which new mode-antimode pairs appear in the Lang-Kobayashi equations. Locate the double roots of the phase equation using combined root finding and minimization.
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.area: Laser dynamics with feedback and injection

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: L-I curve with gain compression and threshold extraction
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Solve the steady-state carrier and photon rate equations with gain compression by Newton at each current. Fit threshold, slope efficiency and compression factor to measured L-I data by least squares.
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.area: Laser dynamics with feedback and injection

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Phase-locked states of two mutually delay-coupled semiconductor lasers
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Find symmetric and antisymmetric compound-cavity steady states of mutually coupled Lang-Kobayashi lasers by solving the nonlinear algebraic system with fsolve from multiple starting points. Count the distinct solutions.
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.area: Laser dynamics with feedback and injection

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Period-doubling route detection in optically injected lasers
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Integrate the injection rate equations and count distinct Poincare-section intensity maxima to classify each orbit as period-1, period-2, period-4 or chaotic. Bisect on injection strength to locate the period-doubling points.
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.area: Laser dynamics with feedback and injection

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Spin lifetime and g-factor from Hanle depolarization fitting
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Fit the Lorentzian Hanle curve of optically oriented electron spin polarization versus transverse field by nonlinear least squares. Combine the half-width with the PL lifetime to separate the spin lifetime from the g-factor product.
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.area: Spin relaxation and spintronics in semiconductors

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Nonlocal spin-valve Hanle fitting with diffusion and precession
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Evaluate the nonlocal Hanle signal as a numerical time integral of the drift-diffusion-precession Green's function. Fit the spin lifetime and diffusion constant to parallel and antiparallel data with least squares.
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.area: Spin relaxation and spintronics in semiconductors

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Electric-field-enhanced spin injection lengths in semiconductor channels
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Solve the spin drift-diffusion characteristic equation for the upstream and downstream spin decay lengths. Root-find the field needed for a target downstream polarization at a detector distance.
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.area: Spin relaxation and spintronics in semiconductors

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Gate voltage for the persistent spin helix in a gated quantum well
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Model the Rashba coefficient as linear in gate voltage and the Dresselhaus coefficient as density dependent through the gate. Find the voltage where alpha equals beta by Brent's method and report the spin-helix wavelength.
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.area: Spin relaxation and spintronics in semiconductors

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Optimal tunnel barrier resistance for ferromagnet-semiconductor spin valves
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Use the Fert-Jaffres two-terminal magnetoresistance model with spin-dependent interface resistances. Maximize the MR over the interface resistance-area product by bounded scalar optimization to overcome conductivity mismatch.
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.area: Spin relaxation and spintronics in semiconductors

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Optimal reduced Fermi level for power factor in a single parabolic band
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Compute Seebeck coefficient and conductivity from Fermi-Dirac integrals with an energy-dependent scattering exponent. Maximize the power factor over reduced Fermi level and convert the optimum to carrier density by root finding.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Segmented thermoelectric leg material ordering and interface temperatures
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Enumerate segment orderings from a material library with temperature-dependent properties. For each ordering, find the interface temperatures and the optimal current density by nested root finding and optimization to maximize leg efficiency.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Peltier cooler optimum current for maximum COP and maximum temperature difference
