materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Use constant-property thermoelectric cooler energy balances. Find the current maximizing COP at given temperatures and the current maximizing temperature difference at zero load, comparing the numerical optima with analytic zT expressions.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Band convergence offset optimizing zT in two-valley semiconductors
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Model a light and a heavy valence band separated by Delta E with Boltzmann transport including intervalley scattering. Jointly optimize doping and Delta E for maximum zT with Nelder-Mead.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Intersubband transitions in a finite square quantum well
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Find even and odd bound states from the transcendental matching equations with BenDaniel-Duke mass discontinuity using bracketing root finding. Compute the 1-2 transition energy, dipole matrix element and oscillator strength.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: QWIP well width and Al fraction for a target bound-to-quasibound peak
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Solve two coupled conditions in GaAs/AlGaAs by 2D root finding: the first excited state sits at the barrier edge, and the transition matches a 9 micron peak. Report the resulting oscillator strength.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Asymmetric coupled quantum well design maximizing second-harmonic susceptibility
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Use a shooting eigensolver for a step or coupled-well structure. Maximize the product |z12 z23 z31| with resonance-detuning weighting over barrier and well widths via bounded optimization.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Anticrossing field of coupled levels in a quantum cascade injector
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Compute two-well level energies under a tilted potential with a finite-difference Hamiltonian. Minimize the energy gap over electric field to find the anticrossing field and the tunnel coupling 2 hbar Omega.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Optimal avalanche photodiode gain with McIntyre excess noise
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Combine signal shot noise, dark-current shot noise with McIntyre excess noise F(M, k), and amplifier thermal noise. Maximize SNR over gain with bounded scalar optimization and compare against the analytic optimum.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: HgCdTe cutoff wavelength optimizing specific detectivity for a target scene
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Combine composition-dependent bandgap, diffusion-limited dark current and the in-band background flux from a blackbody target. Maximize D* or signal-to-noise over Cd fraction at fixed operating temperature.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Transimpedance feedback resistor and capacitor selection from E-series values
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Enumerate standard E24 resistor and capacitor combinations for a photodiode TIA. Evaluate bandwidth, stability margin and input-referred noise, then select the lowest-NEP pair meeting the bandwidth specification.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Decomposing measured noise spectra into 1/f, G-R and white components
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Fit a noise PSD model of 1/f, Lorentzian generation-recombination and white floor terms to log-spaced spectral data by weighted nonlinear least squares. Extract the 1/f corner frequency and trap time constant.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: R0A component extraction from temperature-dependent infrared photodiode data
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Fit R0A(T) as parallel diffusion, G-R and trap-assisted tunneling contributions by least squares in log space. Find the crossover temperatures between mechanisms by root finding and compute the thermal-noise-limited D*.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: SPAD excess bias optimization balancing detection efficiency and dark counts
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Model photon detection efficiency, dark count rate and afterpulsing as functions of excess bias. Maximize the photon-counting SNR at a given photon flux and dead time by scalar optimization.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Exciton binding energy from the Wannier equation by shooting
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Solve the radial Wannier equation for 3D and strictly 2D Coulomb excitons by Numerov shooting with bisection on energy. Compare the computed 1s and 2s energies with the hydrogenic series.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Excitation-induced dephasing parameter from density-dependent four-wave mixing decays
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Fit time-integrated FWM decays at multiple excitation densities with a homogeneous-plus-EID dephasing model by global least squares. Extract the zero-density T2 and the EID coefficient.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Two-pulse coherent control delay maximizing exciton population
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Integrate the Bloch equations for two phase-locked pulses with dephasing. Find the delays maximizing and minimizing the final population by bracketed optimization, and compute the coherent-control fringe visibility versus T2.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Elliott formula fit of the band-edge absorption spectrum
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Fit measured near-edge absorption with the broadened Elliott formula, including discrete exciton lines and the Sommerfeld-enhanced continuum, by nonlinear least squares. Extract bandgap, binding energy and broadening (e.g. for MAPbI3).

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Variational Stark shifts of electron and hole subbands in tilted GaAs wells
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: For a finite GaAs/AlGaAs quantum well under a uniform field, minimize the energy of a shifted, field-polarized trial envelope over its variational parameters for the electron and the heavy hole. Report the subband Stark shifts and the electron-hole overlap versus field, and benchmark them against a finite-difference eigen-solution.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Operating wavelength maximizing contrast-to-insertion-loss ratio of a QCSE modulator
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Build field-dependent excitonic absorption spectra using Stark-shifted exciton energies, overlap-scaled oscillator strengths and Gaussian broadening. Golden-section search over operating wavelength maximizes the ratio of absorption change to on-state absorption for a given bias swing.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Direct-to-indirect exciton crossover field in asymmetric coupled quantum wells
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Diagonalize the electron and hole Hamiltonians of an asymmetric double GaAs well under field, and estimate the direct and indirect exciton energies including Coulomb binding corrections. Root-find the field at which the spatially indirect exciton becomes the lowest optical state.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Field-dependent exciton binding in a tilted well by two-parameter variational minimization
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Use a separable trial function with an in-plane Bohr radius and a field-polarization parameter for the exciton in a biased finite well. Minimize the total exciton energy with Nelder-Mead or L-BFGS to obtain the binding energy and net Stark shift versus field.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Reverse bias flattening the polarization field in an InGaN/GaN quantum well
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Model the built-in piezoelectric and spontaneous polarization field in an InGaN well embedded in a p-i-n junction. Solve the well subband states at each bias, then root-find the applied bias that maximizes the electron-hole overlap, which corresponds to flat-band compensation.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Ambegaokar-Halperin-Langer critical conductance by union-find percolation bisection
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Generate random sites with random energies, assign Miller-Abrahams pair conductances, and bisect on a conductance threshold using union-find to detect a spanning cluster. Extract the critical-path conductance versus temperature and fit it to the Mott T^-1/4 law.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Finite-density steady-state master equation with Pauli blocking
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Solve the nonlinear steady-state hopping master equation, with rates multiplied by (1-p_j), on a disordered lattice at finite carrier concentration under bias by damped fixed-point iteration. Compute current and mobility versus density to show the extended-GDM density enhancement.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Extracting Bässler disorder parameters from temperature- and field-dependent mobility
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Fit the Gaussian disorder model parametrization mu(T,F) to synthetic or measured data sets by nonlinear least squares. Recover the energetic disorder sigma, the positional disorder Sigma, the prefactor and the field coefficient, with parameter uncertainties.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Time-of-flight transit time from KMC photocurrent transients
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Generate a time-of-flight current transient from kinetic Monte Carlo of an ensemble of carriers in a Gaussian-disordered slab. Fit two power-law asymptotes on a log-log plot and locate their intersection to obtain the transit time and the dispersion parameters.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Threshold density and differential gain of a quantum-well laser
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Combine the quantum-well peak modal gain with the confinement factor and the internal and mirror losses. Bisect on carrier density for the modal-gain-equals-loss threshold, then evaluate the differential gain at threshold by finite differences.
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.area: Optical gain in bulk and quantum wells

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Thermal tuning of the gain-peak wavelength by golden-section maximization
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Compute temperature-dependent gain spectra using a Varshni bandgap and Fermi functions at a fixed injection. Locate the gain peak by golden-section search at each temperature and fit the dλ/dT tuning coefficient.
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.area: Optical gain in bulk and quantum wells

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Ground-to-excited-state lasing switch current in quantum-dot lasers
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Model inhomogeneously broadened ground- and excited-state quantum-dot gain with Fermi occupation and a carrier-density-to-current relation. Root-find the current at which excited-state modal gain first reaches the cavity loss before ground-state lasing saturates, as a function of cavity length.
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.area: Optical gain in bulk and quantum wells

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Quasi-Fermi level separation from the transparency crossing of measured gain spectra
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Fit smooth models to Hakki-Paoli-style net gain spectra measured at several currents. Root-find the photon energy where material gain crosses zero, giving the quasi-Fermi level separation, and check it against a gain model.
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.area: Optical gain in bulk and quantum wells

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Gärtner analysis of bias-dependent EQE in CdTe solar cells
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Model collection with the Gärtner formula, using a voltage-dependent depletion width from the depletion approximation. Fit EQE spectra measured at several reverse biases simultaneously for doping and diffusion length by least squares.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Base thickness maximizing efficiency of a back-surface-field silicon cell
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Compute Jsc and the base saturation current density as functions of base thickness with an effective back-surface recombination velocity and an AM1.5-like spectrum. Solve for Voc and the maximum power at each thickness, then maximize efficiency with bounded scalar optimization.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Emitter thickness and doping co-optimization with Auger lifetime and sheet resistance
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Model emitter collection with doping-dependent Auger lifetime and mobility, together with an emitter saturation current and a sheet-resistance power loss. Optimize emitter depth and doping jointly with a 2D bounded optimizer for maximum efficiency.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Optimal drift field from graded doping in a solar cell base
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Solve the drift-diffusion minority-carrier equation for an exponentially graded base, where the doping-dependent lifetime trades off against field-assisted collection. Maximize Jsc or efficiency over the grading strength with bounded scalar optimization.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Monte Carlo mismatch loss in series strings of nonidentical cells
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Sample cell parameters (photocurrent, saturation current, resistances) from distributions and build the string I-V by inverting each cell's voltage at a common current via Newton. Locate the string maximum power and compute mismatch-loss statistics over many trials.
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.area: Solar cell equivalent circuits and parameter extraction

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Hot-spot operating point of a shaded cell with Bishop reverse breakdown
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Model a series string without bypass diodes in which one shaded cell follows the Bishop avalanche-breakdown extension of the single-diode model. Solve current continuity by root finding at the string operating point and compute the power dissipated in the reverse-biased cell.
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.area: Solar cell equivalent circuits and parameter extraction

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: S-shaped I-V from a reverse back-contact Schottky diode in series
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Model the cell as a main diode in series with an opposing Schottky barrier diode, and solve for the common voltage split at each current by Newton or bracketing root finding. Fit the back barrier height to an S-shaped I-V curve and compute the fill-factor loss.
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.area: Solar cell equivalent circuits and parameter extraction

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Number of QWIP wells maximizing detectivity with capture-limited gain
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Model absorption quantum efficiency, photoconductive gain via capture probability and well number, and generation-recombination dark-current noise. Enumerate the integer number of wells and pick the one that maximizes the specific detectivity D*.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: QWIP activation energy from Arrhenius fitting of thermionic dark current
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Model QWIP dark current as thermionic emission over the barrier with field-assisted lowering and a 2D electron density from Fermi statistics. Fit the activation energy and Fermi level to temperature-dependent dark-current data by nonlinear least squares.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Model-solid offsets of strained InGaAs on GaAs and type-I/II crossover
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Combine Van de Walle model-solid average valence energies with hydrostatic and shear deformation potentials for a pseudomorphically strained layer. Compute the heavy-hole and light-hole offsets, and root-find the composition at which the light-hole alignment changes type.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Lattice-matched InGaAsP on InP composition for target bandgap
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Use Vegard interpolation with bowing for the lattice constant and bandgap of In(1-x)Ga(x)As(y)P(1-y). Solve the two simultaneous conditions, lattice match to InP and the target gap, by 2D Newton iteration, and tabulate compositions for 1.3 and 1.55 um.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Enumerating buffer and window layers for spike-type alignment with CIGS
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Given affinities, gaps and doping for candidate buffer and window materials, compute the conduction-band offsets for every buffer/window stack on a CIGS absorber of chosen composition. Enumerate the combinations to find those with a small positive spike and no cliff, ranked by a recombination-barrier criterion.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Arora/Caughey-Thomas mobility fit with temperature exponents for silicon
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Fit the temperature-dependent Caughey-Thomas (Arora) expression for mu(N,T) jointly to tabulated electron mobility data at several temperatures by nonlinear least squares. Report the fitted exponents and the reference doping density.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Temperature of maximum mobility with Brooks-Herring and phonon scattering
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the free-carrier density versus temperature from charge neutrality with donor freeze-out, which sets the Brooks-Herring screening. Combine lattice and impurity-limited mobilities through Matthiessen's rule and find the peak-mobility temperature with bounded optimization.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Multicarrier extraction from magnetic-field-dependent Hall data
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Model the conductivity tensor components sigma_xx(B) and sigma_xy(B) as sums over electron and hole species. Fit densities and mobilities of two or three carriers to field-swept Hall and resistivity data by constrained least squares.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Hot-electron temperature versus field from energy balance in GaAs
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Balance Joule heating against polar-optical-phonon energy loss with an electron-temperature-dependent mobility. Solve for the electron temperature at each field by Brent root finding and compute the resulting velocity-field curve.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Quantum-well linear absorption from SBEs with k-grid convergence of the exciton peak
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Solve the linear SBE in the frequency domain on a radial k-grid with an angle-averaged 2D Coulomb matrix. Locate the 1s exciton peak by Brent maximization, and study binding energy convergence versus grid size against the 4 Ry 2D value.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Self-consistent bandgap renormalization with plasmon-pole screening
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Compute exchange and Coulomb-hole self-energies in the single-plasmon-pole approximation, with screening depending on density and temperature. Iterate the renormalized gap to a fixed point versus plasma density and compare it with the n^(1/3) scaling.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Exciton absorption saturation density from phase-space filling in SBEs
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the linear absorption with quasi-equilibrium Fermi occupations entering phase-space filling and the renormalized Coulomb terms. Root-find the density at which the exciton peak absorption falls to half, and compare it with an a_B^-2 estimate.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Turn-on delay by event-detected threshold crossing in rate equations
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Integrate the carrier-photon rate equations for current steps from below threshold using solve_ivp, with an event detecting when carrier density reaches threshold. Fit the delay versus bias to tau ln(I/(I-Ith)) to extract the carrier lifetime.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Self-pulsation onset in a saturable-absorber laser (Yamada model)
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Find the steady states of the gain, absorber and photon rate equations by root finding. Compute Jacobian eigenvalues versus current and bisect for the Hopf current bounding the self-pulsation range.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Vernier supermode selection in a sampled-grating DBR tunable laser
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Model the two comb reflectivity spectra and the cavity phase condition of a sampled-grating DBR laser. Enumerate the comb alignments and the corresponding mirror-current pairs to map the lasing wavelength and the side-mode suppression over the tuning range.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: RGB LED mixing weights for target chromaticity with maximum efficacy
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Given LED spectra modelled with Gaussian or asymmetric lineshapes, compute their tristimulus values and luminous efficacies. Solve the linear program, or the constrained optimization if wavelengths are free, for the optical power fractions that hit a target white point at maximum luminous efficacy.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Core radius of a CdSe/ZnS dot for a target emission wavelength
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Compute electron and hole confinement energies in a finite spherical core/shell potential by BenDaniel-Duke root finding, and add the Brus Coulomb correction. Bisect on core radius so that the predicted emission matches a target wavelength.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Dominant wavelength and color purity of a narrowband LED
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Computes CIE xy chromaticity of a Gaussian or asymmetric LED spectrum using analytic multi-Gaussian color-matching functions. Finds the dominant wavelength by root-finding the intersection of the white-point ray with the spectral locus, then reports excitation purity.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Direct versus indirect radiative emission of germanium from van Roosbroeck–Shockley
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Builds direct (Γ) and phonon-assisted indirect (L) absorption spectra of Ge, applies van Roosbroeck–Shockley to get each emission spectrum, and includes the thermal Γ/L electron population. Bisects for the temperature or n-doping at which direct-gap emission reaches a target fraction of total PL.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Tersoff charge-neutrality level from a model band-structure Green's function zero
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Builds a model density of states for several semiconductors (parabolic or Penn-gap two-band with cutoffs). Root-finds the energy where the Green's function real part ∫DOS(E')/(E−E')dE' vanishes, then predicts valence-band offsets by aligning these branch points.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Interface-gap-limited open-circuit voltage of a cliff-type Cu2O/ZnO heterojunction
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Combines bulk diode recombination with interface recombination across the interface gap E_g,IF = E_g,abs − ΔE_c of a cliff alignment. Solves the total recombination current = Jsc for Voc by Newton iteration and maps Voc against the conduction-band offset.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: In0.53Ga0.47As/InP quantum-well width for 1.55 µm emission at 300 K
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Uses a Varshni gap for lattice-matched InGaAs and InP band offsets, and solves finite-well electron and heavy-hole levels from the BenDaniel–Duke transcendental equations. Bisects the well width that gives 1550 nm at a chosen operating temperature.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: ZnTe1−xOx band anticrossing composition for an optimal intermediate band
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Computes the E− and E+ subbands of a highly mismatched ZnTeO alloy from the two-level band anticrossing model. Root-finds the oxygen fraction that places E− at the position that maximizes detailed-balance intermediate-band efficiency.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Band-gap minimum of CdSexTe1−x with large bowing for graded absorbers
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Uses the quadratic bowing law with temperature shifts to locate the composition and value of the minimum gap. Inverts for the Se fractions that give a target front and back gap in a graded CdTe absorber.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Equilibrium partial strain relaxation of a SiGe layer beyond critical thickness
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Minimizes the total energy (elastic strain energy plus 60° misfit-dislocation line energy) with respect to the residual strain in a SiGe film on Si. Gives the relaxed fraction and the resulting strain-dependent band gap as functions of thickness.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Binodal and spinodal of the InGaN miscibility gap
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Uses a regular-solution free energy of mixing with an interaction parameter, optionally plus a coherency-strain term. Solves the common-tangent conditions for binodal compositions with Newton's method and finds spinodal points from the zeros of the second derivative versus temperature.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Digital-alloy layer sequence approximating a linear AlGaAs composition grade
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Chooses a sequence of monolayer-scale AlAs/GaAs (or two-alloy) layers so that the running average composition, smoothed by a diffusion kernel, best matches a target grade. Solved by dynamic programming or greedy error diffusion, with the result checked by the resulting band-edge profile.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Rose sublinear photocurrent exponent from an exponential trap distribution
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Solves charge neutrality between free electrons and trapped charge in an exponential tail for the electron quasi-Fermi level under each generation rate. Extracts the photocurrent power-law exponent γ = T_c/(T+T_c) numerically and compares it with Rose's analytic result.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Superlinear photoconductivity from two-center sensitization in CdS
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Writes steady-state rate equations for fast recombination centers and slow sensitizing centers with different capture cross sections. Solves the coupled nonlinear system by Newton's method versus intensity and locates the superlinear region where d ln I_ph/d ln G > 1.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Maximum photoconductive gain at the dielectric-relaxation limit
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Models photoconductor gain τ/t_tr with field-dependent drift velocity and space-charge-limited injection. Root-finds the bias where the transit time equals the dielectric relaxation time and evaluates the Rose maximum-gain bound for given trap and material parameters.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Finger spacing maximizing bandwidth of an interdigitated MSM photodetector
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Combines a carrier transit-time roll-off (with saturated velocities and a field-dependent effective path) with RC limitation from the conformal-mapping interdigitated capacitance. Maximizes the 3 dB bandwidth over finger spacing and width by bounded scalar optimization.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Breakdown voltage of a linearly graded silicon junction versus impurity gradient
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Builds the parabolic field profile of a linearly graded junction and evaluates the ionization integral with Chynoweth electron and hole coefficients. Root-finds the bias where the integral reaches unity across several gradients and fits a power-law scaling.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Punch-through 4H-SiC drift layer minimizing specific on-resistance
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: For a target blocking voltage, computes avalanche breakdown of a punch-through p+n−n+ structure from anisotropic 4H-SiC ionization coefficients. Then optimizes drift doping and thickness to minimize specific on-resistance, subject to the breakdown constraint.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Bifacial detailed-balance efficiency limit versus albedo
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Adds rear-side albedo illumination to the AM1.5 or blackbody photon flux in a Shockley–Queisser calculation. Solves for the maximum power point at each gap and optimizes the band gap as a function of albedo.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Optimal band gap of a semitransparent photovoltaic window under a visibility constraint
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Computes detailed-balance efficiency of an absorber with an absorption-onset gap and partial above-gap transmission. Finds the maximum efficiency subject to a minimum photopic-weighted average visible transmittance by constrained optimization.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Detailed-balance limit of a solar cell with a front quantum-cutting down-converter
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Implements the Trupke 2002 model in which photons above 2E_g are split into two below the converter's gap, including the converter's own detailed balance and radiative coupling to the cell. Optimizes the cell gap for maximum efficiency.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Cell width optimizing monolithic interconnection of a thin-film PV module
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Combines TCO sheet-resistance power loss in a stripe cell with dead-area loss from P1–P3 scribes, using a single-diode cell with distributed resistance. Maximizes module efficiency with respect to cell width by golden-section search.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Doping density maximizing QWIP detectivity
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Balances bound-to-continuum absorption, which grows with sheet density, against thermionic dark current, which grows with the Fermi level. Optimizes doping for maximum D* and checks the Levine rule E_F ≈ 2kT.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Absorber thickness maximizing D* of a photovoltaic infrared detector
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Treats quantum efficiency with a back reflector and thickness-proportional diffusion and generation dark current in an n-on-p HgCdTe or InAsSb diode. Optimizes the absorber thickness and checks the classic t ≈ 1.26/α result.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Weak-confinement edge length of CsPbBr3 nanocubes from PL energy
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Uses center-of-mass exciton quantization in a cube, E = E_g + E_X + 3ħ²π²/(2M L²) with corrections, together with the intermediate-regime Efros formula. Inverts the PL peak for edge length by root finding and compares the two regimes.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Temperature maximizing electron spin lifetime in n-GaAs
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Combines Dyakonov–Perel (cubic Dresselhaus with momentum time from mobility), Elliott–Yafet, and Bir–Aronov–Pikus relaxation rates. Locates the temperature of maximum spin lifetime for given doping by bounded optimization.
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.area: Spin relaxation and spintronics in semiconductors

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Mean-field Curie temperature of (Ga,Mn)As from p–d exchange
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Solves the self-consistent Brillouin-function equation for the Mn magnetization coupled to spin-split hole bands (parabolic heavy and light holes) by fixed-point iteration. Root-finds the temperature at which magnetization vanishes versus hole density and Mn content.
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.area: Spin relaxation and spintronics in semiconductors

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Giant Zeeman splitting of Cd1−xMnxTe from a modified Brillouin fit
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Fits magneto-optical exciton splittings to N0(α−β)x_eff⟨S_z⟩ with a modified Brillouin function. Uses nonlinear least squares to extract the effective Mn fraction and the effective temperature T+T0.
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.area: Spin relaxation and spintronics in semiconductors

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Bistability of dynamic nuclear polarization in a quantum dot
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Writes the nuclear polarization steady state in which the pumping rate depends on the Overhauser-shifted electron Zeeman detuning. Finds all fixed points versus applied field by root bracketing, determines their stability, and maps the hysteresis window.
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.area: Spin relaxation and spintronics in semiconductors

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Optical constants of InP from normal-incidence reflectance via Kramers–Kronig phase retrieval
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Computes the reflectance phase by Kramers–Kronig integration of ln√R with power-law high-energy extrapolation. Tunes the extrapolation exponent by root finding so that n matches a known transparent-region anchor, then inverts the Fresnel relation for n and k.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Facet reflectivity maximizing wall-plug efficiency of a high-power diode laser
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Builds the L–I–V characteristic from threshold, slope efficiency with mirror loss, series resistance and turn-on voltage. Optimizes front-facet reflectivity for maximum wall-plug efficiency at a fixed operating current.
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.area: Optical gain in bulk and quantum wells

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: W-quantum-well layer thicknesses for a 3.5 µm interband cascade laser
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Solves envelope-function levels of an InAs/GaInSb/InAs W-well by transfer matrix. Searches layer thicknesses for a target transition wavelength while maximizing electron–hole overlap as a constrained optimization.
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.area: Optical gain in bulk and quantum wells

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Selecting quantum-well widths for a flat broadband superluminescent diode
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Computes broadened spontaneous emission spectra for wells of different widths. Combinatorially selects a set of widths, with carrier-filling weights, that minimizes spectral ripple over a target bandwidth.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Surface photovoltage of n-GaN from self-consistent surface band bending
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Solves charge neutrality between depletion charge and an acceptor-like surface-state distribution for the surface potential, adding photogenerated minority-carrier flux to the surface. Root-finds band bending versus illumination to get the surface photovoltage.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Ground-state energy of a cylindrical GaAs/AlGaAs quantum wire
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Matches Bessel-J inside and modified-Bessel-K outside solutions with BenDaniel–Duke boundary conditions for each angular momentum. Root-finds the subband energies versus radius and compares them with the infinite-wall and square-wire approximations.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Special quasirandom structure search for a zincblende alloy supercell
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Searches cation-sublattice occupations of an InGaAs supercell at fixed composition by Monte Carlo or simulated annealing. Minimizes the deviation of pair and triplet correlation functions from random-alloy values over several neighbor shells.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Disentangling crossing bands by eigenvector-overlap assignment along a k-path
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Computes sp3 tight-binding bands of a zincblende crystal along Γ–X–L. Connects eigenstates between neighboring k-points by maximum-overlap Hungarian assignment so that symmetry-allowed crossings are not treated as anticrossings, then reports band continuity.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Singlet–triplet gap of a TADF emitter from temperature-dependent delayed fluorescence
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Models prompt and delayed decay rates from three-state kinetics with Arrhenius reverse intersystem crossing. Fits ΔE_ST and the rate prefactors to lifetime-versus-temperature data by nonlinear least squares, solving the kinetic eigenvalues at each temperature.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Fermi-edge PL lineshape of a modulation-doped quantum well
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Models 2DEG recombination with localized holes as a step-like density of states times Fermi occupation, with broadening and an optional Mahan edge enhancement. Fits the spectrum for E_F, temperature and broadening, then converts E_F to sheet density.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Band-offset tuning by a doping interface dipole at GaAs/AlGaAs
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Places p and n delta-doped sheets symmetrically around the interface (the Capasso dipole). Solves Poisson's equation with Fermi-level self-consistency for the effective conduction-band discontinuity, then root-finds the sheet density needed for a target offset change.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Coulomb-blockade threshold of a quantum-dot array by optimal-path search
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Uses Middleton–Wingreen theory for a 2D semiconductor nanocrystal array with random offset charges. Computes the conduction threshold voltage by searching minimal-cost paths (Dijkstra) across the array and studies its scaling with array length.

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: Spin injection efficiency from spin-LED circular polarization
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Solves steady-state spin-resolved rate equations in the quantum-well active region with recombination and spin relaxation under a Faraday field. Inverts the measured electroluminescence circular polarization for injected spin polarization by root finding.
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.area: Spin relaxation and spintronics in semiconductors

materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.title: GaAs absorption-edge fiber-optic thermometer by transmission inversion
materials/semiconductors|opt_discrete.gist: Models transmitted LED light through a thin GaAs chip using a Varshni-shifted Urbach-tailed absorption edge. Root-finds the temperature from a two-wavelength transmission ratio and estimates temperature sensitivity and resolution.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Hard-sphere mode-coupling glass transition from Percus-Yevick structure factor
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Build S(k) on a wavevector grid from the Percus-Yevick solution and iterate the full wavevector-dependent MCT memory kernel to find nonergodicity parameters f(k). Bisect on packing fraction to locate φ_c≈0.516.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Soft glassy rheology model flow curve under steady shear
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the SGR evolution equation for the trap-energy and local-strain distribution P(E,l,t) with upwind strain advection and activated yielding. Compute the steady flow curve σ(γ̇) and extract the power-law exponent x-1 for 1<x<2.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Self-intermediate scattering function in a random-periodic potential via Smoluchowski
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the 1D Smoluchowski equation with a quenched rugged periodic potential by finite volumes. Compute F_s(k,t) from Fourier transforms of the evolving propagator, showing two-step relaxation, and extract the α-relaxation time versus roughness.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Hébraud-Lequeux model: yield stress and glass transition of stress distribution
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Evolve the Hébraud-Lequeux PDE for the local stress distribution, which combines shear advection, mechanical-noise diffusion and yielding beyond σc, under imposed shear rate. Compute the dynamic yield stress versus coupling α and show it vanishes as α→1/2.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Nonlocal granular fluidity model in planar shear near jamming
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the steady Kamrin-Koval nonlocal fluidity BVP ξ²g''=g-g_loc(μ) with finite differences and Newton iteration in a channel with wall boundary conditions. Compute velocity profiles, the creep below the local yield stress, and the cooperativity length.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Diffusing-diffusivity Fokker-Planck model: non-Gaussian parameter and dynamic heterogeneity
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the joint Fokker-Planck equation for position and a fluctuating Ornstein-Uhlenbeck diffusivity on a 2D grid, or in Fourier space in x. Compute the mean-square displacement, the van Hove function and the non-Gaussian parameter α2(t) with its peak time.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Split-step wavepacket localization in a 1D optical speckle potential
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Propagate an expanding matter-wave packet in a correlated speckle potential with split-step Fourier evolution and average over disorder. Fit exponential tails to get localization length versus momentum and compare with the perturbative prediction, which has an effective mobility edge at kσ_R=1.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Subdiffusive spreading in disordered discrete nonlinear Schrödinger lattice
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Integrate the disordered DNLS chain with a symplectic split-step scheme from a single-site excitation. Compute the second moment and participation number versus time, and fit the spreading exponent (≈1/3) against the linear Anderson case.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Thouless conductance from boundary-twist sensitivity of disordered lattice levels
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Compute eigenvalue shifts of 1D and 2D Anderson Hamiltonians between periodic and antiperiodic boundary conditions, normalized by mean level spacing. Obtain the Thouless number g(L) and the scaling function β(g) versus disorder.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Lloyd model Cauchy disorder: numerical versus exact Lyapunov exponent
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Compute the Lyapunov exponent of a tight-binding chain with Lorentzian on-site disorder from transfer-matrix products and Riccati recursions. Compare with the exact Thouless formula cosh γ=(√((2+E)²+W²)+√((2-E)²+W²))/4.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Dyson gas hydrodynamics: complex Burgers equation relaxing to Wigner semicircle
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the inviscid complex Burgers equation for the eigenvalue resolvent of Dyson Brownian motion by numerical characteristics or finite differences. Compute the evolving density from arbitrary initial spectra and show convergence to the semicircle with the correct radius.
physics/stat_phys|pde.area: Random matrix spectra in disordered systems

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Spectral rigidity Δ3 and number variance in Sinai billiard
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Compute Dirichlet eigenvalues of a square with a circular obstacle using finite elements or finite differences. Unfold the spectrum and evaluate the number variance Σ²(L) and Dyson-Mehta Δ3(L), comparing with GOE and Poisson and identifying the saturation scale.
physics/stat_phys|pde.area: Random matrix spectra in disordered systems

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: GOE-to-GUE crossover from magnetic flux in disordered 2D lattice
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Add Peierls phases for a uniform magnetic flux to a 2D Anderson Hamiltonian in the metallic regime. Compute the mean adjacent-gap ratio ⟨r⟩ versus flux, showing the crossover from ≈0.531 (GOE) to ≈0.600 (GUE).
physics/stat_phys|pde.area: Random matrix spectra in disordered systems

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: 3D Anderson metal-insulator transition from spacing ratio statistics
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Compute eigenvalues near E=0 of sparse 3D Anderson Hamiltonians by shift-invert Lanczos. Evaluate ⟨r⟩ versus disorder W for several L and locate the size-independent crossing between Poisson and GOE values.
physics/stat_phys|pde.area: Random matrix spectra in disordered systems

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Marchenko-Pastur bulk versus slow modes in Edwards-Wilkinson snapshot covariance
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Simulate the stochastic Edwards-Wilkinson equation with finite differences, form sample covariance matrices from T snapshots of N sites, and compare their eigenvalue density with Marchenko-Pastur. Identify outlier eigenvalues tied to long-wavelength diffusive modes.
physics/stat_phys|pde.area: Random matrix spectra in disordered systems

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Lifshitz tails in density of states of random Schrödinger operator
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Discretize -Δ+V with random Bernoulli or Gaussian potential in 1D/2D and compute low-lying eigenvalues by sparse solvers. Extract the band-edge integrated density of states and fit ln N(E) ∝ -E^{-d/2}.
physics/stat_phys|pde.area: Random matrix spectra in disordered systems

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Tracy-Widom distribution from Painlevé II Hastings-McLeod boundary value problem
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the Hastings-McLeod solution of Painlevé II as a finite-domain BVP with asymptotic Airy boundary conditions using collocation. Build F2(s), its mean and variance, and compare with the largest-eigenvalue statistics of sampled GUE matrices.
physics/stat_phys|pde.area: Random matrix spectra in disordered systems

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Spectral decimation of Sierpinski gasket Laplacian and walk dimension
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Use the decimation map λ→λ(5-λ) for the graph Laplacian of the Sierpinski gasket to generate eigenvalues and spectral dimension 2ln3/ln5. Verify the walk dimension ln5/ln2 by explicit heat-equation time stepping on generation-n gaskets.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Wilson-Polchinski local potential approximation fixed point and exponent ν
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the dimensionless LPA Polchinski flow ODE for the 3D Ising fixed-point potential by shooting with large-field asymptotics. Linearize the finite-difference operator around it and obtain ν from the leading relevant eigenvalue.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Wetterich LPA flow with Litim regulator via method of lines
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Integrate the LPA functional RG flow PDE for the effective potential u(ρ,t) in d=3 on a field grid. Bisect the initial mass to find the critical surface, and extract ν from the divergence of the flow time spent near the fixed point.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Random resistor network conductivity exponent at percolation threshold
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve Kirchhoff's discrete Laplace equation with random bond conductances on 2D lattices using sparse linear solves. Compute effective conductance versus bond occupation and system size, and extract the conductivity exponent t/ν by finite-size scaling at p_c=1/2.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Narrow escape mean first-passage time from disk through small window
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the Poisson equation DΔT=-1 in a disk with mixed Dirichlet window and reflecting boundary using finite elements or polar finite differences. Compare the mean escape time versus window size with the asymptotic formula (R²/D)[ln(1/ε)+O(1)].

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Optimal stochastic resetting rate minimizing diffusive search time
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the backward Fokker-Planck equation with resetting, D T'' - rT + rT(x0) = -1, on a finite-difference grid with an absorbing target. Compute the MFPT versus resetting rate and locate the optimum r* (γ*≈1.594 in units √(r/D)·x0).

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Sinai diffusion in Brownian random potential: logarithmic spreading
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the Smoluchowski equation in a quenched random-walk potential using Scharfetter-Gummel finite volumes over many disorder realizations. Compute disorder-averaged mean-square displacement and verify ⟨x²⟩∝ln⁴t.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Majumdar-Sire persistence exponent of diffusion from random initial conditions
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Evolve the 1D heat equation from white-noise initial data spectrally on large periodic grids. Measure the probability that the field at a site has not changed sign up to time t, and extract the persistence exponent θ≈0.1207.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Fick-Jacobs reduction versus full 2D escape through corrugated channel
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Compute mean first-passage times through a periodically corrugated 2D channel by solving the full Poisson problem on a mapped grid. Compare with the 1D Fick-Jacobs and Reguera-Rubí entropic-barrier approximations as a function of corrugation amplitude.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: One-step RSB free energy of SK model via Parisi PDE
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the backward Parisi PDE ∂_q f = -½(∂²f + x(q)(∂f)²) on a field grid for step-function x(q), using Cole-Hopf transforms within steps. Optimize the 1RSB parameters (q0,q1,m) to obtain the free energy and compare with the replica-symmetric value below Tc.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Cugliandolo-Kurchan aging dynamics of spherical p=3 spin glass
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Integrate the two-time integro-differential equations for C(t,t') and R(t,t') of the spherical 3-spin model on a triangular time grid. Compute aging correlation curves below T_d=√(3/8) and the effective fluctuation-dissipation temperature.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Derrida-Spohn directed polymer on tree: FKPP traveling wave glass transition
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the FKPP-type equation for the generating function of the directed polymer partition function on a tree by finite differences. Compute front velocity versus β, giving the free energy, and show freezing of the velocity at β_c.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Ising p-spin glass 1RSB transition temperature via Parisi PDE
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Adapt the Parisi PDE with covariance ξ(q)=q^p/2 for p=3 Ising spins. Compute the 1RSB free energy with optimization over (q1,m) and locate the static transition temperature, comparing with the random energy model limit for large p.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Brusselator Turing threshold and supercritical amplitude scaling
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Derive and evaluate the Brusselator dispersion relation giving B_c=(1+A√(Du/Dv))² and the critical wavenumber. Simulate the 1D system with zero-flux boundaries slightly above threshold and verify the pattern amplitude ∝√(B-B_c).

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Lengyel-Epstein CIMA model: Turing versus Hopf instability competition
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Compute Turing and Hopf thresholds of the Lengyel-Epstein model from linear stability. Simulate 2D patterns with pseudo-spectral IMEX near the codimension-two point, classifying outcomes as stationary, oscillatory or mixed through spatial and temporal spectra.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Stochastic Turing quasi-patterns from linear noise approximation of Brusselator
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Simulate the linearized Brusselator SPDE with intrinsic noise below the deterministic Turing threshold on a spectral grid. Compute the spatial power spectrum peak and compare with the analytic linear-noise-approximation spectrum.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Phase-field crystal one-mode hexagonal amplitude versus undercooling
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Relax the 2D phase-field crystal equation with semi-implicit spectral stepping at fixed mean density. Compute the hexagonal-phase amplitude and free energy versus ε, and compare with the one-mode approximation, including the stripe-hexagon coexistence.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Keller-Segel chemotactic aggregation instability and coarsening in 1D
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Derive the linear instability criterion for uniform states of the Keller-Segel model with logistic or volume-filling sensitivity. Simulate with a positivity-preserving finite-volume scheme, measuring initial wavelength and aggregate-merging coarsening.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Lifshitz-Slyozov-Wagner Ostwald ripening by population-balance PDE
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the LSW continuity equation for the droplet-size distribution with a conservative upwind finite-volume scheme and a mass-conservation-determined supersaturation. Verify mean-radius growth ∝t^{1/3} and convergence to the LSW scaled distribution.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Zero-temperature hysteresis in random-field φ⁴ Ginzburg-Landau model
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Evolve overdamped TDGL dynamics of a lattice φ⁴ field with quenched Gaussian random fields, relaxing to stationarity at each step of a slowly ramped external field. Compute hysteresis loops, coercive field and the disorder strength where macroscopic jumps disappear.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Avalanche size distribution of quenched Edwards-Wilkinson interface at depinning
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Drive a 1D elastic line in a random pinning force field quasi-statically with finite-difference elasticity and relaxation to rest. Record avalanche sizes between successive stable configurations, and compute the size-distribution exponent and roughness exponent.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: ABBM Barkhausen model: Fokker-Planck velocity distribution and avalanche durations
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the Fokker-Planck equation for the domain-wall velocity in the ABBM model with finite volumes. Compute the stationary distribution P(v)∝v^{c-1}e^{-v}, then use an absorbing boundary at v=0 to obtain the avalanche-duration distribution.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Fukuyama-Lee-Rice charge-density-wave sliding: threshold field and narrow-band noise
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Integrate the overdamped phase equation of a 1D charge-density wave with random impurity phases under applied field. Compute the threshold field, the velocity-field curve and the narrow-band noise frequency from the current power spectrum.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Crack-front depinning with long-range elasticity: roughness exponent
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Model a planar crack front as a line with the nonlocal |k| elastic kernel evaluated by FFT, in quenched toughness disorder. Drive it to depinning, and compute the threshold, the roughness exponent ζ≈0.39 from the structure factor, and avalanche statistics.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Epidemic invasion with long-range dispersal: accelerating versus constant fronts
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Simulate an integro-differential SI/SIR model with nonlocal dispersal kernels using FFT convolution. Compare front position versus time for exponential kernels, which give constant speed, and fat-tailed power-law kernels, which give accelerating fronts.
physics/stat_phys|pde.area: Epidemic spreading on lattices and networks

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Brunet-Derrida cutoff correction to Fisher-KPP front velocity
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Integrate the FKPP equation with a cutoff on growth below density 1/N using finite differences on a co-moving grid. Compute the front velocity versus N and verify v_N≈2-π²/(ln N)².
physics/stat_phys|pde.area: Epidemic spreading on lattices and networks

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Metapopulation SIR on mobility network: arrival times versus effective distance
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Integrate an SIR model coupled by a graph-Laplacian mobility operator on a weighted random network using method of lines. Compute arrival times at each node and show their linear relation to the Brockmann-Helbing effective distance.
physics/stat_phys|pde.area: Epidemic spreading on lattices and networks

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Rabies traveling wave in Källén-Murray-Shaw fox model
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Simulate the 1D susceptible-infected-rabid fox reaction-diffusion model with diffusing rabid foxes. Compute invasion wave speed versus diffusion and carrying capacity, compare with the linearized minimum speed, and measure post-wave oscillation wavelength.
physics/stat_phys|pde.area: Epidemic spreading on lattices and networks

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Stochastic resonance with colored noise: 2D Fokker-Planck SNR
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the joint Fokker-Planck equation for position and Ornstein-Uhlenbeck noise in a periodically forced double well. Compute the SNR from the power spectrum of the periodic response and its noise background versus correlation time, comparing with the white-noise limit.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Array-enhanced stochastic resonance in noisy coupled φ⁴ chain
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Simulate the stochastic φ⁴ field equation (a coupled bistable chain) with periodic forcing using Euler-Maruyama finite differences. Compute the SNR of local and global response versus noise and coupling, showing enhancement at intermediate coupling.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Leaky integrate-and-fire neuron stochastic resonance from Fokker-Planck with reset
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the Fokker-Planck equation for membrane potential with an absorbing threshold and reinjection at reset, under weak periodic input. Compute the firing-rate modulation amplitude versus noise, showing a stochastic-resonance maximum, and check the static rate against the Siegert formula.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Barkley model planar pulse speed versus excitability threshold
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the 1D Barkley reaction-diffusion model with explicit finite differences. Track the pulse front by level crossing to get the wave speed as a function of the threshold parameter b, and locate the propagation-failure value of b.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: FitzHugh-Nagumo pulse-train dispersion relation on a periodic ring
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Simulate stable pulse trains of the FitzHugh-Nagumo equations on rings of varying length L using method-of-lines finite differences. Extract the speed c(L) to get the dispersion curve and the minimal wavelength that supports propagation.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Barkley spiral tip trajectory: rigid rotation to meandering transition
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Integrate the 2D Barkley model with a nine-point Laplacian and track the spiral tip from the intersection of u and v isolines. Classify the tip path as circular or meandering versus parameter a, and find the secondary Hopf frequency.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Electric-field-induced spiral drift in Barkley excitable medium
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Add an advective field term to the activator equation of the 2D Barkley model and integrate with an upwinded finite-difference scheme. Measure the drift velocity components of the spiral core versus field strength.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Strength-duration curve of FitzHugh-Nagumo cable: rheobase and chronaxie
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Apply rectangular current pulses to a 1D FHN cable solved by Crank-Nicolson plus reaction splitting. Bisect for the threshold amplitude versus pulse duration and fit Lapicque's law to obtain rheobase and chronaxie.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Propagation failure of fronts in discrete Nagumo chain
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Integrate the spatially discrete bistable Nagumo lattice equation. Measure front velocity versus coupling strength and detuning, and determine the critical coupling below which fronts are pinned by the lattice.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Oregonator Belousov-Zhabotinsky trigger wave speed and refractory tail
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the two-variable Oregonator reaction-diffusion model in 1D with finite differences. Compute trigger wave speed versus the stoichiometric parameter f and the length of the refractory zone behind the front.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Spiral breakup onset in the Bär-Eiswirth delayed-recovery model
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Integrate the 2D Bär-Eiswirth model with an explicit scheme. Count phase singularities over time versus ε to locate the transition from a stable spiral to spiral-breakup turbulence.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Head-on pulse collisions in FitzHugh-Nagumo: annihilation versus reflection
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Collide two counter-propagating FHN pulses in 1D using a fine finite-difference grid. Map the parameter region where the pulses annihilate versus pass through or reflect soliton-like, as a function of recovery time scale.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Horsthemke-Lefever genetic model: noise-induced bimodality threshold
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Compute the stationary density of the genetic selection model with multiplicative noise by time-stepping its Fokker-Planck equation to steady state. Verify the transition to bimodality at σ² = 4 and its extrema.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Itô, Stratonovich and anti-Itô diffusion with position-dependent diffusivity
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the Fokker-Planck equation in a reflecting box with spatially varying D(x) for the three stochastic interpretations using flux-form finite volumes. Compare the resulting stationary densities with the predicted D(x)^{-α} laws.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Stochastic P-bifurcation of Duffing-van der Pol oscillator under parametric noise
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the 2D stationary Fokker-Planck equation in phase space with an upwind finite-volume discretization and sparse linear algebra. Identify the noise intensity at which the density changes from a single peak to a crater shape.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: On-off intermittency: power-law stationary density near threshold
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the Fokker-Planck equation for x' = (a + ξ(t))x − x³ with a reflecting lower cutoff. Extract the exponent of p(x) ~ x^{-1+2a/σ²} and its dependence on distance from the instability.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Van den Broeck-Parrondo-Toral noise-induced ordering transition in mean field
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the self-consistent nonlinear Fokker-Planck equation of the mean-field coupled multiplicative-noise model on a grid with fixed-point iteration on the order parameter. Map the reentrant ordered phase versus noise strength.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Bistable system with correlated additive and multiplicative noises
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Compute stationary densities of a quartic double-well system driven by cross-correlated additive and multiplicative noise from its Fokker-Planck equation. Determine how the correlation λ shifts peak positions and relative well populations.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Limaçon billiard finite-difference spectrum: Brody parameter versus deformation
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Discretize the Dirichlet Laplacian on Robnik's limaçon billiard with a masked five-point stencil and sparse eigensolver. Unfold the levels with Weyl's law and fit the Brody parameter of the spacing distribution versus deformation λ.
physics/stat_phys|pde.area: Random matrix spectra in disordered systems

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Bunimovich mushroom billiard: Berry-Robnik level spacing in mixed phase space
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Compute several hundred Dirichlet eigenvalues of a mushroom billiard by finite differences in one symmetry class. Fit the Berry-Robnik spacing distribution and compare the fitted regular fraction with the classical phase-space volume.
physics/stat_phys|pde.area: Random matrix spectra in disordered systems

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Šeba billiard intermediate spacing statistics from a point scatterer
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Add a strong localized potential to the finite-difference Laplacian of a rectangular billiard. Compute the spacing distribution and show level repulsion with an exponential tail, unlike both Poisson and GOE.
physics/stat_phys|pde.area: Random matrix spectra in disordered systems

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Symplectic level statistics from Rashba spin-orbit disordered 2D lattice
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Build the Ando model, a tight-binding discretization of a 2D Rashba Hamiltonian with Anderson disorder, and diagonalize it. Show the spacing distribution follows the GSE Wigner surmise with Kramers degeneracy removed.
physics/stat_phys|pde.area: Random matrix spectra in disordered systems

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Localized eigenstates of 2D continuum random-potential Schrödinger operator
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Discretize −∇² + V(x,y) with a smoothed Gaussian random potential and compute eigenpairs across energy. Report the inverse participation ratio versus energy and the size scaling that distinguishes localized from extended states.
physics/stat_phys|pde.area: Random matrix spectra in disordered systems

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Weyl law perimeter and corner corrections for polygonal drum spectra
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Compute finite-difference Dirichlet eigenvalues of triangular billiards and fit the counting function N(E) to area, perimeter and corner-angle terms. Use the fitted Weyl law to unfold the spacings and compare integrable versus pseudo-integrable triangles.
physics/stat_phys|pde.area: Random matrix spectra in disordered systems

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Kottos-Smilansky quantum graph spectra: GOE spacings from finite-difference edges
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Discretize the Laplacian on each edge of a fully connected graph with incommensurate lengths, imposing Kirchhoff vertex conditions. Compute many eigenvalues and compare the spacing distribution and spectral form factor with GOE.
physics/stat_phys|pde.area: Random matrix spectra in disordered systems

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: SCGF of time-integrated Ornstein-Uhlenbeck position via tilted Fokker-Planck operator
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Discretize the tilted generator L + s·x of the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process on a grid. Compute its largest eigenvalue to get the scaled cumulant generating function, compare with the exact quadratic result, and Legendre transform to the rate function.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Current large deviations and Gallavotti-Cohen symmetry in tilted periodic potential
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Build the tilted Fokker-Planck operator for an overdamped particle on a ring with force F and periodic potential using Fourier spectral discretization. Compute the current SCGF and verify the Gallavotti-Cohen symmetry λ(s) = λ(−s − F/T).

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Airy distribution of Brownian excursion area via Feynman-Kac PDE
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the Laplace-transformed Feynman-Kac equation with an absorbing wall for the area under a Brownian excursion using finite differences. Recover the moments and compare with the Airy-distribution predictions.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Dynamical phase transition in occupation time of a double-well diffusion
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Compute the largest eigenvalue of the tilted Smoluchowski operator weighting time spent in the right well of a double-well potential. Show the SCGF develops a kink as the noise decreases and relate it to the Kramers rate.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: KPZ weak-noise theory: optimal path and short-time height distribution tails
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the coupled forward-backward Chernykh-Stepanov optimal-fluctuation PDEs for the KPZ equation by pseudo-spectral back-and-forth iteration. Compute the action versus height and check the λH^{5/2} and H^{3/2} tails.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Run-and-tumble particle entropy production large deviations from tilted two-state generator
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Discretize the two-component tilted Fokker-Planck operator of a run-and-tumble particle in a confining potential. Compute the SCGF of entropy production from its largest eigenvalue and verify the fluctuation symmetry.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Dyson hierarchical model Wilson recursion via FFT convolution of single-spin measure
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Iterate the exact block-spin recursion of the hierarchical model on a discretized field grid using FFT convolutions and rescaling. Locate the critical temperature by bisection and extract ν from the growth rate of deviations near the fixed point.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Functional RG fixed point with cusp for elastic interface in random field
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Integrate the one-loop functional renormalization group PDE for the disorder correlator Δ(u) by method of lines until it reaches a fixed point. Show the linear cusp appears at a finite Larkin scale and extract the roughness exponent.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Multicritical scaling solutions of 2D local potential approximation by shooting
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the 2D LPA fixed-point ODE for the scalar potential by shooting on the initial curvature. Count the nontrivial global solutions as multicritical universality classes and compute the leading exponents from the linearized problem.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Gauss map transfer operator: Gauss-Kuzmin-Wirsing constant by Chebyshev collocation
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Discretize the Gauss-Kuzmin-Wirsing operator with Chebyshev collocation on [0,1]. Compute the leading eigenvalues and verify the Wirsing constant −0.30366, which sets the correlation decay of continued fractions.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Feigenbaum constants from spectral solution of the doubling functional equation
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the Cvitanović-Feigenbaum equation g(x) = −αg(g(−x/α)) with an even Chebyshev expansion and Newton's method to get α. Compute δ as the leading eigenvalue of the linearized doubling operator.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Allee-effect population extinction time: diffusion approximation versus master equation
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Compute the mean extinction time of a birth-death population with a strong Allee effect two ways: exactly from the master equation, and by solving the backward Fokker-Planck BVP of the diffusion approximation. Quantify the exponential error of the diffusion approximation.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: WKB extinction action for endemic SI epidemic with demography via optimal path
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve Hamilton's equations from the eikonal approximation of a two-dimensional SI master equation by shooting along the heteroclinic optimal path. Obtain the extinction action and compare it with exact quasi-stationary mean extinction times.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Branching Brownian motion survival against a moving absorbing wall
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the FKPP-type equation for the survival probability of branching Brownian motion killed at a wall moving at speed v. Locate the critical velocity √2 and measure how the survival probability vanishes near it.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Drift paradox: critical patch size of logistic population in advective river
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve a reaction-advection-diffusion equation on a finite reach with hostile boundaries. Find the critical length for persistence from the principal eigenvalue versus flow speed, and the washout speed 2√(rD).

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Quasi-stationary distribution of logistic population under environmental noise
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Compute the Yaglom quasi-stationary density and decay rate of a logistic diffusion with environmental noise and an absorbing low-density boundary. Obtain both from the principal eigenpair of the discretized Fokker-Planck operator and compare with the mean time to extinction.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Shear instability of granular homogeneous cooling state: critical system size
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Linearize the inelastic Navier-Stokes hydrodynamics around Haff's cooling state to obtain the critical wavelength for shear-mode instability. Simulate 2D granular hydrodynamics pseudo-spectrally in Haff-rescaled time to confirm vortex growth beyond it.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Inelastic Maxwell model: Bobylev Fourier-space Boltzmann solution and power-law tails
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Integrate the Fourier-transformed homogeneous Boltzmann equation of inelastic Maxwell molecules on a k-grid in scaled variables. Extract the fourth cumulant a2 and the exponent of the algebraic velocity tail versus restitution coefficient.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: White-noise driven 1D granular gas: stationary velocity distribution tail
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve a 1D inelastic hard-rod Boltzmann equation with a velocity-diffusion forcing term on a velocity grid, discretizing the collision integral by quadrature. Iterate to steady state and fit the high-energy tail to exp(−v^{3/2}).

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Granular Couette flow: temperature and density profiles from inelastic hydrodynamics
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the steady granular Navier-Stokes boundary value problem between moving walls with collisional cooling, using finite differences and Newton iteration. Obtain temperature and density profiles and the effective shear viscosity versus inelasticity.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Vertically vibrated granular bed: density inversion Leidenfrost threshold
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve steady granular hydrostatic and heat-flux equations for a gas energized from a hot bottom wall as a two-point BVP. Determine where the density profile develops a maximum above the floor versus particle number and inelasticity.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Lattice hard rods DDFT: wall layering and relaxation with exact Lafuente-Cuesta functional
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Implement the exact lattice fundamental-measure free energy for 1D hard rods and evolve dynamical density functional theory in a slit. Obtain equilibrium wall density oscillations and verify the bulk equation of state.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Open TASEP phase diagram from hydrodynamic Burgers equation with Godunov scheme
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the inviscid Burgers equation with flux ρ(1−ρ) and reservoir boundary densities α and 1−β using a Godunov finite-volume method. Map the low-density, high-density and maximal-current phases and the coexistence-line domain wall.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Katz-Lebowitz-Spohn driven lattice gas: nonconvex flux and double shocks
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Use the exact stationary current-density relation of the KLS model with nearest-neighbor interactions as the flux in a conservation law. Solve Riemann problems with a Godunov scheme to show contact discontinuities and shock-rarefaction composites.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Two-species hard-core lattice gas cross-diffusion and uphill diffusion
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the coupled cross-diffusion hydrodynamic equations of a two-species exclusion process with unequal hopping rates by implicit finite volumes. Show transient uphill diffusion of the slow species and verify the total-density diffusion.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Exact 4×4 Ising magnetization free energy driving Smoluchowski relaxation
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Enumerate all 2^16 configurations of the periodic 4×4 Ising model to get the exact free energy F(m). Solve the Smoluchowski equation on m to obtain magnetization-reversal times below Tc and compare with the exact Glauber master-equation gap.
physics/stat_phys|pde.area: Exact enumeration of small lattice partition functions

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Gálfi-Rácz A+B→C reaction front: width and production-rate scaling
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve mean-field reaction-diffusion equations for initially separated reactants with finite differences. Verify the front position x_f ~ t^{1/2}, width w ~ t^{1/6} and local production rate ~ t^{-2/3}.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Active Model B: binodal shift in motility-induced phase separation
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Simulate Active Model B with pseudo-spectral semi-implicit time stepping until phase separation is steady, and measure the coexisting densities. Compare them with the pseudo-variable common-tangent construction versus activity λ.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Liesegang band spacing law in supersaturation precipitation model
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Simulate the 1D Ostwald-Prager supersaturation model with a diffusing reaction front and threshold-triggered precipitation. Verify the Jablczynski spacing law x_{n+1}/x_n → 1 + p and the time law x_n ~ √t_n.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Active Brownian particle in harmonic trap: edge accumulation transition
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the 2D stationary Fokker-Planck equation in position and orientation for a 1D-confined active Brownian particle with a Fourier-in-angle, finite-difference-in-space discretization. Find the Péclet number where the marginal density turns from unimodal to bimodal.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Onsager-Maier-Saupe isotropic-nematic transition from the rod orientational Smoluchowski equation
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the Doi-Onsager Smoluchowski equation on the sphere for rods with a Maier-Saupe mean-field potential. Use a finite-volume discretization in cosθ and relax to the stationary state. Compute the order parameter S versus coupling strength, and locate the first-order jump and the hysteresis bounds.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Mean first-passage time of Lévy flights from an interval via fractional Laplacian
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Discretize the fractional Laplacian on an interval with absorbing exterior using a quadrature-based finite-difference matrix. Solve the backward equation for the mean exit time of a symmetric α-stable flight. Compare with Getoor's exact formula (L²−x²)^{α/2}/Γ(1+α).

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Non-gradient escape in the Maier-Stein model: rate versus nongradient parameter
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the 2D Fokker-Planck operator of the Maier-Stein drift field by finite differences and extract the slowest relaxation eigenvalue. Repeat for several noise strengths and nongradient parameters α. Estimate the activation barrier from Arrhenius fits and locate the onset of the non-gradient regime.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Polymer translocation through a nanopore: Fokker-Planck in the translocation coordinate
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Model translocation as 1D drift-diffusion over the entropic free energy F(s) of the two chain halves plus a chemical-potential bias. Solve for mean translocation times with a finite-difference backward equation and absorbing ends. Determine the scaling with chain length N in the unbiased and driven regimes.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Vibrational resonance in an overdamped bistable system with biharmonic forcing
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the time-periodic Fokker-Planck equation of a quartic double well driven by a weak low-frequency force plus a strong high-frequency force. Use Crank-Nicolson time stepping. Compute the response amplitude at the low frequency versus the high-frequency amplitude and locate the resonance maximum.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Survival exponent of three vicious walkers from diffusion in a wedge
