physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Map three annihilating 1D Brownian walkers onto 2D diffusion in a wedge of opening angle π/3. Solve the heat equation with absorbing walls on a polar grid. Extract the long-time survival exponent and compare with π/(2θ) for other wedge angles.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Taylor-Aris dispersion of a solute in Poiseuille pipe flow
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Integrate the 2D axisymmetric advection-diffusion equation for a tracer pulse in laminar pipe flow with finite volumes. Compute the long-time growth of the axial variance. Compare the effective diffusivity with D(1+Pe²/48).

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Comb-model anomalous diffusion: t^{1/2} backbone spreading from 2D diffusion
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the comb-model diffusion equation, with x-motion allowed only on the backbone y=0, using finite differences on a 2D grid. Compute the backbone mean-square displacement. Compare with the exact subdiffusive scaling and its prefactor.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Diffusion on the incipient percolation cluster: walk and spectral dimensions
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Generate square-lattice site-percolation clusters at p_c with union-find labeling. Integrate the discrete heat equation on the largest cluster with explicit time stepping. Extract the walk dimension from the mean-square displacement and the spectral dimension from return probabilities.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Mean-field hydrodynamics of two-lane TASEP with lane switching
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve coupled conservation laws for densities on two TASEP lanes exchanging particles at asymmetric rates. Use a Godunov finite-volume scheme with open-boundary reservoirs. Compute steady density profiles, shock localization and total current across the boundary phase diagram.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Kerner-Konhäuser traffic model: phantom jam formation threshold on a ring road
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Integrate the second-order Kerner-Konhäuser macroscopic traffic PDE for density and velocity on a periodic road with a finite-volume scheme. Compute the linear instability window in mean density. Measure the amplitude and speed of the emergent stop-and-go jams.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Shan-Chen lattice Boltzmann droplets: Laplace law and surface tension
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Implement a D2Q9 lattice Boltzmann model with Shan-Chen pseudopotential interactions. Equilibrate liquid droplets of several radii in vapor. Extract the surface tension from the Laplace pressure jump and check coexistence densities against the Maxwell construction.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Diffusive Johnson-Segalman model: shear banding and stress-plateau selection
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the 1D planar Couette diffusive Johnson-Segalman equations with finite differences and implicit time stepping. Start from a nonmonotonic constitutive curve. Compute the banded steady state, the selected plateau stress and the band fractions versus applied shear rate.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Surface-directed spinodal decomposition in a Cahn-Hilliard film with a wetting wall
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the Cahn-Hilliard equation in 2D with a surface field and no-flux wall boundary conditions using finite differences. Compute the laterally averaged composition profile and its damped oscillations normal to the wall. Track the growth of the wetting-layer thickness.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Zabusky-Kruskal KdV soliton fission: soliton count and amplitudes from a cosine initial state
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Integrate the KdV equation pseudospectrally with integrating-factor RK4. Count the emergent solitons and measure their amplitudes and speeds. Compare with the eigenvalues of the associated Schrödinger scattering problem, computed by finite differences.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: φ⁴ kink-antikink collisions: critical velocity and two-bounce resonance windows
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Collide φ⁴ kinks and antikinks over a range of initial velocities by solving the 1+1D field equation with finite differences and leapfrog stepping. Classify outcomes as capture, bounce or reflection. Locate the critical velocity and the two-bounce windows.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: One-phase Stefan melting problem: enthalpy method versus Neumann similarity solution
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve a 1D melting problem with the enthalpy finite-difference method. Track the liquid-solid interface position. Compare with the Neumann solution s(t)=2λ√(αt), with λ from the transcendental Stefan-number equation.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Capillary condensation in a slit pore from square-gradient density functional theory
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve the Euler-Lagrange equation of a square-gradient (van der Waals) density functional between two attractive walls by finite-difference Newton iteration. Locate the condensation chemical potential versus pore width. Compare with the Kelvin equation.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Villain-Lai-Das Sarma conserved growth equation: roughness and growth exponents
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Integrate the stochastic VLDS equation in 1D with a pseudospectral semi-implicit scheme. Measure the interface width versus time and system size. Extract β and α and compare with the one-loop conserved-KPZ values.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Dean-Kawasaki fluctuating hydrodynamics of an ideal gas: equal-time structure factor
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Integrate the linearized Dean-Kawasaki stochastic diffusion equation for colloid density with a conservative finite-volume scheme using fluctuating fluxes. Verify the flat static structure factor S(k)=ρ̄. Measure the diffusive intermediate scattering function decay.

physics/stat_phys|pde.title: Giant nonequilibrium concentration fluctuations in a diffusive mixture under a gradient
physics/stat_phys|pde.gist: Solve linearized fluctuating hydrodynamics for concentration coupled to a velocity mode in an imposed concentration gradient. Use a spectral/finite-volume stochastic integrator. Compute the static structure factor and verify the k⁻⁴ enhancement and its gravity or confinement cutoff.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Schwarzschild critical impact parameter and photon sphere via orbit-equation shooting
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the photon orbit equation u''(φ) = 3Mu² − u for a range of impact parameters. Bisect on capture versus escape to recover b_c = 3√3 M and the photon-sphere radius, then compute the shadow angular size seen by a distant observer.
physics/fields_astro|ode.area: Black hole shadows and ray tracing

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Kerr black hole shadow outline from backward-integrated Carter geodesic equations
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Backward-trace null geodesics in Boyer–Lindquist coordinates using the Mino-time first-order Carter equations over an image-plane grid. Classify each ray as captured or escaped to extract the shadow boundary versus spin and inclination, and compare with the analytic spherical-photon-orbit curve.
physics/fields_astro|ode.area: Black hole shadows and ray tracing

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Lensed image and redshift map of thin Keplerian disk around Schwarzschild
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Ray-trace photons from an inclined observer's image plane to a geometrically thin equatorial disk with inner edge at the ISCO. Compute primary and secondary image positions and the redshift factor g from the photon momentum and the circular-orbit emitter four-velocity.
physics/fields_astro|ode.area: Black hole shadows and ray tracing

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Strong-deflection lensing coefficients from numerically integrated Schwarzschild light bending
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Compute the deflection angle α(b) by integrating null geodesics from infinity to infinity, and check the weak-field limit 4M/b. Fit the logarithmic divergence α ≈ −ā ln(b/b_c − 1) + b̄ near the photon sphere and compare with Bozza's analytic coefficients.
physics/fields_astro|ode.area: Black hole shadows and ray tracing

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Reissner–Nordström shadow radius versus charge from null geodesic integration
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate null geodesics in the charged Reissner–Nordström metric to find the photon-sphere radius and critical impact parameter as functions of Q/M up to extremality. Verify the results against the roots of the effective potential.
physics/fields_astro|ode.area: Black hole shadows and ray tracing

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Photon-ring Lyapunov exponent and subring brightness ratios in Schwarzschild
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate geodesics with impact parameters slightly offset from b_c and measure the exponential divergence per half-orbit, giving the Lyapunov exponent γ = π. Use it to predict and numerically verify the demagnification ratio between successive n-th order photon subrings.
physics/fields_astro|ode.area: Black hole shadows and ray tracing

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Shadow size seen by finite-distance observer in Schwarzschild–de Sitter spacetime
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate null geodesics in the Kottler metric for a static observer at finite radius. Compute the shadow angular radius from the local tetrad as a function of the cosmological constant and observer position, and compare with Perlick's closed-form result.
physics/fields_astro|ode.area: Black hole shadows and ray tracing

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Hot-spot light curve at ISCO via emitter-to-observer null-geodesic shooting
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: For a point emitter orbiting at the Schwarzschild ISCO, root-find the impact parameters of the primary and secondary rays that reach a distant inclined observer by integrating the orbit equation. Compute time delays, magnifications and redshifts, and assemble the periodic flux light curve.
physics/fields_astro|ode.area: Black hole shadows and ray tracing

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Quadrupole Kozai–Lidov cycles from vector-averaged equations: maximum eccentricity
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the double-averaged quadrupole equations for the eccentricity and angular-momentum vectors of an inner orbit perturbed by a distant companion. Map e_max and cycle period versus initial inclination, and verify e_max = √(1 − (5/3)cos² i₀).

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Eccentric Kozai–Lidov octupole orbit flips and flip-time in hierarchical triples
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the octupole-order secular equations for a hierarchical triple with an eccentric outer orbit. Detect orbit flips through 90° inclination and the accompanying extreme eccentricity spikes, and map the flip time versus the octupole parameter ε_oct.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: GR apsidal precession quenching of Kozai cycles in planetary companions
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Add the 1PN periastron precession term to the quadrupole Kozai–Lidov equations. Find the critical inner semimajor axis at which relativistic precession suppresses eccentricity excitation, and compare with the timescale-ratio estimate.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Resonance capture probability in convergent migration with Henrard's model
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the second fundamental model of resonance with a slowly drifting resonance parameter that represents migration. Sample initial phases to estimate capture probability into 2:1 resonance versus initial eccentricity and migration rate, and compare with the adiabatic-invariant prediction.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Chaotic diffusion near Jupiter: MEGNO in planar restricted three-body problem
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate test-particle orbits together with their variational equations in the planar circular restricted three-body problem. Compute the MEGNO indicator to map the chaotic zone around the planet's orbit, and compare its width with Wisdom's μ^(2/7) resonance-overlap law.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Cassini states of a precessing spin axis: obliquity equilibria and separatrix
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the Colombo top equations for a spin axis that precesses about an orbit normal which itself precesses uniformly. Locate the Cassini-state fixed points and the separatrix area versus the ratio of precession frequencies, and check the oscillation periods around each state.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Blast-wave deceleration Γ(R) for adiabatic and radiative GRB fireballs
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate energy-conservation ODEs for a relativistic shell that sweeps up a constant-density or wind medium, with a tunable radiative efficiency. Compute Γ(R), the deceleration radius, and the asymptotic Γ ∝ R^(−3/2) versus R^(−3) power-law slopes.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Synchrotron afterglow light curve from integrated blast-wave dynamics and observer time
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate Γ(R) and the observer time t_obs = ∫dR/(2Γ²c), then compute the synchrotron break frequencies ν_m and ν_c and the peak flux. Assemble the slow-cooling spectral segments into an on-axis light curve at fixed frequency and fit the temporal decay indices.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Jet lateral spreading and jet-break time from coupled Γ–θ ODEs
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate coupled ODEs for the Lorentz factor and half-opening angle of a uniform jet that expands sideways at the comoving sound speed. Determine when Γθ ≈ 1 and compute the steepening of the afterglow light curve at the jet break.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Fireball thermal acceleration and baryon-loading saturation Lorentz factor
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the relativistic radial energy and momentum equations for a hot e±-photon-baryon fireball. Recover the Γ ∝ r acceleration phase and saturation at Γ ≈ η, compute the photospheric radius, and find where it crosses the saturation radius.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Compton drag terminal Lorentz factor of a jet above accretion disk
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the equation of motion of a cold electron-positron blob along the jet axis under radiation forces from an extended Shakura–Sunyaev disk. The radiation moments are computed by quadrature over the disk surface, giving the equilibrium and terminal Lorentz factors versus disk luminosity.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Blandford–McKee self-similar profiles behind ultrarelativistic shock in stratified medium
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Derive and integrate the similarity ODEs for Lorentz factor, pressure and density behind an ultrarelativistic shock in an ambient medium with ρ ∝ r^−k. Compare with the analytic profiles and compute the energy normalization integral.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Core shift of a conical synchrotron jet via line-of-sight radiative transfer
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the synchrotron radiative-transfer ODE along lines of sight through a Doppler-boosted Blandford–Königl conical jet with power-law B(r) and N(r). Locate the τ = 1 surface brightness peak versus frequency and fit the core-shift index r_core ∝ ν^(−1/k_r).

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Electron cooling break from synchrotron and adiabatic losses in expanding blob
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate individual electron Lorentz-factor ODEs that include synchrotron and adiabatic losses in a relativistically expanding blob with continuous power-law injection. Reconstruct the evolving electron spectrum and identify the cooling break.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Apparent superluminal speed and Doppler factor of a decelerating jet knot
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the deceleration of a relativistic knot sweeping up external medium to get β(t). Map emission time to observer time including light-travel effects, and compute apparent transverse speed, Doppler factor and boosted flux versus viewing angle.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Stiff pp-chain network at solar core: D and He-3 equilibrium
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the pp-I/II abundance ODEs for H, D, ³He, ⁴He and ⁷Be at solar-core conditions with an implicit BDF solver. Determine the D/H equilibrium time, the ³He equilibrium abundance and timescale, and the energy generation rate.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: CNO cycle approach to equilibrium and 12C/13C ratio
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the CN-cycle network ¹²C, ¹³C, ¹⁴N and ¹⁵N with temperature-dependent rate fits at T₉ of about 0.02–0.05. Compute the equilibrium ¹²C/¹³C and ¹⁴N dominance, and the timescale for the cycle to reach steady state.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Helium burning triple-alpha plus 12C(α,γ): final C/O ratio
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the ⁴He, ¹²C, ¹⁶O and ²⁰Ne abundance ODEs, including the triple-alpha rate, in a one-zone model at constant T and ρ until helium exhaustion. Compute the final C/O mass ratio as a function of temperature and of a scaling factor on the ¹²C(α,γ) rate.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Carbon ignition runaway in one-zone white dwarf core: ignition delay
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Couple the ¹²C+¹²C reaction rate with a temperature ODE whose heat capacity comes from a degenerate electron plus ion gas. Integrate the stiff thermal runaway to compute ignition delay times versus initial temperature and density.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Alpha-chain network in exponentially expanding explosive burning trajectory
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate a 7–13 isotope alpha chain from ⁴He to ⁵⁶Ni along a thermodynamic trajectory T(t) and ρ(t) that decays exponentially. Track the freeze-out yields of ⁵⁶Ni and intermediate-mass elements versus the expansion timescale.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Classical s-process chain with local approximation: σN distribution
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the linear chain of neutron-capture ODEs dN_A/dτ = σ_{A−1}N_{A−1} − σ_A N_A under an exponential exposure distribution. Compare the resulting σN curve with the local-approximation plateau and the analytic Clayton solution.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Hot CNO cycle in nova envelope: beta-limited energy generation
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the CNO network including ¹³N(p,γ)¹⁴O and the β⁺ decays of ¹⁴O and ¹⁵O at nova temperatures. Show the transition to a β-decay-limited energy generation rate that is independent of temperature, and compute its value.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Arnett radioactive Ni-56 supernova light curve from diffusion ODE
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Solve Arnett's one-zone photon-diffusion ODE with ⁵⁶Ni→⁵⁶Co→⁵⁶Fe decay heating for a homologously expanding ejecta. Compute bolometric light curves, peak time and peak luminosity versus ejecta mass, and verify Arnett's rule.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Deuterium burning in contracting protostars and brown dwarfs: minimum mass
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Couple a one-zone polytropic contraction model, including partial electron degeneracy, with deuterium-burning luminosity. Integrate in time to find whether deuterium burning stalls contraction and estimate the minimum mass for significant deuterium burning.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Cold two-stream instability with Dawson sheet N-body model: growth rate
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate a 1D electrostatic sheet model of two counter-streaming cold electron beams in a periodic box. Track the Fourier mode amplitude of the electric field, measure the linear growth rate and saturation level, and compare with cold-fluid theory.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Bounce and drift periods of trapped particles in dipole magnetic field
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate full Lorentz-force orbits of protons in Earth's dipole field with a high-accuracy integrator. Extract bounce and azimuthal drift periods versus energy and equatorial pitch angle, and compare with guiding-center adiabatic-invariant formulas.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Ion-acoustic soliton profiles from Sagdeev pseudopotential: Mach-number bounds
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: For Boltzmann electrons and cold fluid ions, construct the Sagdeev pseudopotential and integrate the energy-like ODE for φ(ξ) to obtain soliton profiles. Determine the allowed Mach-number range 1 < M < 1.585 and the amplitude–width relation.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Whistler ray tracing in dipole magnetosphere: Eckersley dispersion of group delay
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate Hamiltonian ray equations for whistler-mode waves using the cold-plasma refractive index in a dipole field with a diffusive-equilibrium density model. Compute the field-aligned group delay versus frequency and fit the Eckersley dispersion constant.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Bohm criterion and plasma sheath structure from Poisson–Boltzmann ODE
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the planar collisionless sheath equation with cold ions entering at Mach number M and Boltzmann electrons. Show that monotonic solutions require M ≥ 1, and compute the potential profile and the sheath thickness to the floating-wall potential.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Particle trapping in large-amplitude electrostatic wave: bounce frequency and phase mixing
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate test-electron orbits in a fixed sinusoidal wave potential in the wave frame and classify them as trapped or passing. Measure the amplitude-dependent bounce frequency against the elliptic-integral result and show phase mixing of the distribution.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Charged particle with Landau–Lifshitz radiation reaction in uniform magnetic field
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the relativistic equation of motion of an electron with the Landau–Lifshitz radiation-reaction force in a strong uniform B field. Compute the Lorentz-factor decay and compare it with the analytic synchrotron-cooling solution.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: General-relativistic and neutronization limits on maximum white dwarf mass
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the TOV equations with the Chandrasekhar EOS and an inverse-β-decay threshold density for C/O and Fe composition. Locate the maximum of M(ρ_c) and compare it with the Newtonian limiting mass.
physics/fields_astro|ode.area: White dwarf structure and degenerate matter

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Salpeter Coulomb corrections to WD mass-radius for C, O, Fe composition
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Add the lattice electrostatic correction to the degenerate electron pressure and integrate hydrostatic equilibrium. Compute the composition-dependent reduction in radius and mass–radius curves for He, C, O and Fe white dwarfs.
physics/fields_astro|ode.area: White dwarf structure and degenerate matter

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Radiative envelope integration: WD core temperature–luminosity relation
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the radiative-diffusion and hydrostatic envelope equations inward from the photosphere with Kramers opacity until electron degeneracy sets in. Obtain the core temperature versus luminosity relation and compare with Mestel's L ∝ T_c^(7/2) scaling.
physics/fields_astro|ode.area: White dwarf structure and degenerate matter

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Mestel cooling with crystallization latent heat: cooling age vs luminosity
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the core-temperature cooling ODE using ion and electron heat capacities and the envelope L(T_c) relation. Include latent heat release once the Coulomb parameter reaches Γ ≈ 175, and compute the cooling age versus luminosity.
physics/fields_astro|ode.area: White dwarf structure and degenerate matter

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Radial pulsation eigenmodes of WDs and dynamical instability near M_Ch
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Solve the linear adiabatic radial pulsation Sturm–Liouville problem on Chandrasekhar white dwarf models by shooting. Obtain fundamental-mode frequencies versus mass and show ω² → 0 as Γ₁ approaches 4/3 near the limiting mass.
physics/fields_astro|ode.area: White dwarf structure and degenerate matter

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Finite-temperature radius inflation of low-mass helium WDs
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Use finite-temperature Fermi–Dirac integrals for the electron pressure plus ideal ions in isothermal-core hydrostatic models. Compute the mass–radius relation versus core temperature and the radius inflation of low-mass helium white dwarfs.
physics/fields_astro|ode.area: White dwarf structure and degenerate matter

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Maximum radius of cold planets and brown dwarfs with Coulomb-plus-degeneracy EOS
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate hydrostatic equilibrium with a zero-temperature EOS that combines electron degeneracy pressure and Coulomb binding, in the Zapolsky–Salpeter spirit. Locate the maximum radius of cold hydrogen spheres near a Jupiter mass.
physics/fields_astro|ode.area: White dwarf structure and degenerate matter

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Lambert problem by single shooting on two-body ODE vs universal variables
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Solve for the departure velocity linking two position vectors in a given time of flight by Newton shooting on the integrated Kepler ODE. Use the state transition matrix for the Jacobian and validate against a universal-variable Lambert solver.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Hohmann vs bi-elliptic transfers by impulsive burns on propagated orbits
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Propagate the transfer arcs numerically between impulsive burns and verify that the target orbit is achieved. Compare total Δv and time of flight, and locate the radius ratio of about 11.94 above which a bi-elliptic transfer beats a Hohmann transfer.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Orbital decay lifetime of LEO satellite in exponential atmosphere
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate orbital motion with quadratic drag in an exponential-density atmosphere for a given ballistic coefficient. Compute the decay lifetime from various initial altitudes and compare with the orbit-averaged King-Hele decay rate.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Solar sail spiral transfer time to Mars orbit vs lightness number
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate heliocentric planar motion with a flat solar-sail force at a fixed cone angle. Optimize the cone angle for the fastest outward spiral and compute the transfer time from 1 to 1.524 AU versus the lightness number β.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Ballistic atmospheric entry: peak deceleration altitude vs Allen–Eggers
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate planar entry equations with drag, gravity and curvature terms in an exponential atmosphere. Find the peak deceleration and its altitude versus entry angle and ballistic coefficient, and compare with the Allen–Eggers analytic solution.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Peebles three-level hydrogen recombination and residual ionization fraction
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the stiff Peebles ODE for x_e(z) with case-B recombination, Lyman-α escape and two-photon decay in a ΛCDM background. Compare with the Saha solution and compute the freeze-out residual ionization at z ≈ 200.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Neutron-to-proton freeze-out from weak rates and neutron decay
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the n↔p rate equation using numerically integrated weak rates, including the Fermi–Dirac phase-space integrals, in a radiation-dominated background. Obtain the freeze-out n/p ≈ 1/6 and its decay to about 1/7 by the start of nucleosynthesis.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Reduced BBN network: helium-4 and deuterium yields versus baryon-to-photon ratio
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate a stiff network of n, p, D, T, ³He, ⁴He and ⁷Li with tabulated forward rates and detailed-balance reverse rates through the deuterium bottleneck. Compute Y_p and D/H as functions of η.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: WIMP relic abundance from Boltzmann freeze-out equation
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the stiff Riccati-type Boltzmann equation dY/dx = −λ(Y² − Y_eq²)/x² for a thermal relic. Find the freeze-out temperature x_f and the relic density Ωh² versus ⟨σv⟩ and mass, and compare with the approximate analytic solution.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Neutrino decoupling: T_ν/T_γ via entropy transfer during e+e− annihilation
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the photon–electron plasma entropy equation through e⁺e⁻ annihilation, using numerically computed thermodynamic integrals, with neutrinos assumed instantaneously decoupled. Recover T_ν/T_γ → (4/11)^(1/3) and the effective degrees-of-freedom evolution.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Dark-ages gas temperature and 21-cm spin temperature evolution
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate coupled ODEs for the ionization fraction and gas kinetic temperature, including Compton heating and adiabatic cooling. Compute the spin temperature from collisional coupling and the 21-cm brightness temperature δT_b(z) during the dark ages.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: CMB visibility function and last-scattering redshift from ionization history
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the Thomson optical-depth ODE dτ/dz using an x_e(z) obtained from a recombination solver. Compute the visibility function g(z), its peak redshift and width, and the sound horizon at last scattering.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Reionization history Q(z) with clumping and Thomson optical depth
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the Madau-style ionized-volume ODE dQ/dt = ṅ_ion/n̄_H − Q/t_rec with a parametric ionizing emissivity and clumping factor. Compute the end-of-reionization redshift and the CMB Thomson optical depth τ_e.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Helium recombination: HeII and HeI histories with Saha and Peebles-like correction
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the He²⁺→He⁺ and He⁺→He⁰ recombination using Saha equilibrium for the first and a Peebles-like rate equation for the second. Compute their impact on the free-electron fraction at z of about 1500–3000.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Sedov–Taylor blast wave similarity ODEs and energy constant
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the self-similar ODEs for velocity, density and pressure behind a strong spherical blast wave from the Rankine–Hugoniot shock conditions. Compute the energy-normalization constant ξ₀(γ) and the radial profiles.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Guderley converging shock similarity exponent by shooting through sonic point
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the self-similar ODEs for a converging spherical shock and shoot on the similarity exponent α so that the solution passes smoothly through the singular sonic point. Recover α ≈ 0.7172 for γ = 5/3.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Larson–Penston collapse self-similar solution via sonic-point shooting
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the self-similar isothermal collapse ODEs and match regular solutions through the sonic critical point by shooting. Recover the Larson–Penston values of central density amplification and the asymptotic infall velocity of −3.3 c_s.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Radiatively cooling post-shock layer structure and cooling length
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the steady 1D conservation equations behind a strong shock with an optically thin cooling function Λ(T) ∝ T^α. Compute temperature and density profiles, the compression ratio and the cooling length versus shock velocity.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Rayleigh–Taylor growth rate eigenvalue for smooth density transition layer
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Solve the linear incompressible perturbation eigenvalue ODE (ρw')' − k²ρw = −(gk²/σ²)ρ'w for a tanh density profile by shooting. Compute the growth rate σ(k) and compare with the sharp-interface Atwood result in the long-wavelength limit.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Slow-rotation moment of inertia and I–Love universal relation
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Solve Hartle's frame-dragging ODE for ω̄(r) on TOV backgrounds and compute the moment of inertia. Combine with the tidal deformability for several EOS to show the near-universal Ī–Λ relation.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: MIT bag model strange quark star mass–radius and scaling
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate TOV with the self-bound EOS p = (ε − 4B)/3, using a finite surface density as the stopping condition. Compute M(R), the maximum mass, and verify the M_max ∝ B^(−1/2) scaling.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Twin stars from first-order phase transition: Seidov criterion and third family
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Build a hybrid EOS with a hadronic polytrope, a Maxwell-construction density jump and a constant-sound-speed quark phase, then integrate TOV. Identify the stable third family and test the Seidov criterion Δε/ε_t > 1/2 + 3p_t/(2ε_t).

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Spontaneous scalarization of neutron stars in Damour–Esposito-Farèse theory
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the modified TOV plus scalar-field ODEs in the Einstein frame and shoot on the central scalar value so the field vanishes at infinity. Find scalarized branches, their onset coupling β ≲ −4.35 and the scalar charge versus mass.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Kerr ISCO versus spin from marginal radial stability of perturbed equatorial geodesics
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate linearized radial perturbations of equatorial Kerr circular geodesics and extract the radial epicyclic frequency. Root-find where it vanishes to get ISCO radius, energy and angular momentum versus spin, and compare with the Bardeen–Press–Teukolsky formula.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Gyroscope precession per orbit along circular Kerr orbits via Fermi–Walker transport
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the parallel-transport ODE for a spin four-vector carried by a circular equatorial geodesic in Kerr. Extract the net precession angle per orbit and separate the geodetic and frame-dragging contributions versus radius and spin.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Spherical photon orbits in Kerr: latitudinal oscillation and nodal precession per period
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Find the constant-r photon orbits from the Carter-constant conditions. Integrate the θ and φ equations in Mino time to get the latitudinal period and the nodal precession angle versus orbit radius and spin.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Penrose process energy extraction efficiency from particle breakup in Kerr ergosphere
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate an infalling timelike geodesic into the ergosphere and split it into fragments that conserve four-momentum, one with negative Killing energy. Integrate the escaping fragment outward and compute the extraction efficiency versus breakup radius and spin.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Zoom-whirl orbits and periapsis precession of eccentric equatorial Kerr geodesics
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate bound eccentric equatorial Kerr geodesics specified by semi-latus rectum and eccentricity. Compute the periapsis advance per radial period and the number of whirls near the separatrix, for prograde and retrograde spin.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Lense–Thirring nodal precession of tilted Kerr orbits and relativistic precession QPOs
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate slightly inclined near-circular Kerr geodesics and extract the orbital, periastron and nodal precession frequencies from the time series. Compare with the analytic epicyclic formulas of the relativistic precession model.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Smarr embedding of the Kerr horizon and the a = √3/2 M limit
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the ODE for the profile of a surface in flat 3-space that is isometric to the Kerr horizon 2-geometry. Detect the spin above which a polar cap cannot be embedded because the Gaussian curvature turns negative.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Charged particle orbits around Kerr black hole in Wald uniform magnetic field
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the Lorentz-force geodesic equations in the Wald test-field solution. Compute the shift of the charged-particle ISCO and the escape conditions versus field strength, charge sign and spin.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Superradiant amplification of massless scalar waves scattered by Kerr black holes
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the s=0 radial Teukolsky equation in tortoise coordinate from an ingoing horizon condition out to large radius. Extract the reflection coefficient and the amplification factor versus frequency, azimuthal number m and spin.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Black hole spin-up by thin-disk accretion and the Thorne spin limit
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate da/dlnM using the ISCO specific energy and angular momentum of an accreting Kerr hole. Find the mass growth needed to reach a=1, then add a photon-capture torque term and recover an equilibrium spin near 0.998.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Prograde versus retrograde equatorial light deflection angle in Kerr spacetime
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate equatorial null geodesics in Kerr for a range of impact parameters. Compute the total deflection angle and its divergence at the prograde and retrograde photon-orbit impact parameters, and compare with weak-field spin corrections.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Photon escape fraction from emitters in Kerr equatorial disk versus radius
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Backward-integrate null geodesics over the local emitter sky of a circularly orbiting source in Kerr. Classify each ray as escaping, horizon-captured or disk-intersecting and compute the escape fraction versus radius and spin.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: NFW halo deflection angle from weak-field ray integration and Einstein radius
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate photon trajectories through the Newtonian potential of an NFW halo in the weak-field metric. Compare the numerical deflection with the analytic projected-mass result and solve for the Einstein radius versus concentration.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Shapiro and geometric time delays between SIS images via ray integration
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the gravitational time delay along straight and deflected rays through a singular isothermal sphere. Compute the image-pair delay and compare it with the Fermat-potential result for a range of source offsets.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Chromatic light deflection by Schwarzschild black hole in power-law plasma
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate Synge's Hamiltonian ray equations in a Schwarzschild metric surrounded by plasma with a radially varying density. Compute the frequency-dependent deflection angle and the photon-sphere radius shift.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Image finding for singular isothermal ellipsoid by Fermat-potential gradient flow
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Locate the lensed images of an SIE lens by integrating gradient-flow ODEs of the Fermat potential, descending to minima and using saddle-seeking flows. Compute image positions, magnifications and the total magnification versus source position.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Dyer–Roeder angular diameter distance in partially clumpy Friedmann universes
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the Sachs focusing equation with smoothness parameter α in a flat ΛCDM background. Compute the angular diameter distance versus redshift and α, and the resulting bias on the inferred lens Einstein radius.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Finite-source point-lens magnification by image-contour integration with Green's theorem
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Trace the image boundaries of a uniform circular source by integrating the mapped source-limb contour through the point-lens equation. Compute the enclosed image areas with Green's theorem to get magnification for transit and non-transit geometries.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Steady-state SSC blob electron spectrum via Chang–Cooper cooling-injection equation
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the electron continuity equation with power-law injection, escape, and synchrotron plus Thomson SSC losses until steady state, using a Chang–Cooper upwind scheme. Compute the cooling break and the synchrotron-to-SSC luminosity ratio.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Synchrotron self-absorption turnover from radiative transfer through power-law slab
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate dI/ds = j − αI for power-law electrons in a homogeneous slab over a frequency grid. Recover the ν^{5/2} optically thick slope and find the peak frequency versus column and electron index.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Klein–Nishina inverse Compton cooling of TeV electrons on CMB photons
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate dγ/dt with the exact Klein–Nishina loss rate on a blackbody photon field and with the Thomson approximation. Compare the electron energy histories and the cooling times versus initial energy.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Faraday depolarization from polarized synchrotron transfer through magnetized slab
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the Stokes I, Q, U transfer equations with synchrotron emissivity and internal Faraday rotation through a uniform or turbulent slab. Compute the polarization fraction versus wavelength squared and compare with Burn's formula.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Curvature-radiation-limited Lorentz factor of particles in pulsar polar-cap gap
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the energy equation dγ/ds for a particle accelerated by a gap electric field and losing energy to curvature radiation along a dipole field line. Find the radiation-reaction-limited γ and the photon cutoff energy.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Nonradial g-mode periods of a stratified white dwarf by shooting
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Solve the adiabatic nonradial pulsation equations in the Cowling approximation for a WD model with a composition-gradient Brunt–Väisälä profile. Find the ℓ=1,2 g-mode periods and the asymptotic period spacing.
physics/fields_astro|ode.area: White dwarf structure and degenerate matter

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: AM CVn double white dwarf orbital evolution with GW-driven mass transfer
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the coupled orbital-separation and donor-mass ODEs with gravitational-wave losses and Roche-lobe overflow, using a zero-temperature WD mass–radius relation. Find the period minimum and the stability boundary in the mass-ratio plane.
physics/fields_astro|ode.area: White dwarf structure and degenerate matter

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Primordial lithium-7 from beryllium-7 production and late electron capture
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate a small stiff BBN subnetwork for 3He, 4He, 7Be and 7Li through freeze-out. Follow the conversion of 7Be to 7Li after recombination and compute the Li/H ratio versus baryon-to-photon ratio.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Primordial H2 formation via the H⁻ channel in the post-recombination universe
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate a stiff chemistry network for e⁻, H⁺, H⁻, H₂⁺ and H₂ with CMB photodetachment along the cosmic expansion. Compute the frozen-out H₂ fraction and identify the dominant formation channel at each epoch.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Strömgren sphere formation: ionization front ODE and recombination equilibration time
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the ionization-front radius equation with on-the-spot case-B recombination for a switched-on ionizing source. Recover R_S(1−e^{−t/t_rec})^{1/3} and compute the time to reach 90% of the Strömgren radius.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: μ-distortion thermalization by double Compton and bremsstrahlung: blackbody visibility function
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the evolution equation for the chemical potential μ at early times with the double Compton and bremsstrahlung thermalization rates. Compute the fraction of injected energy that survives as μ versus injection redshift.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Grey atmosphere hydrostatic structure and emergent B−V color versus effective temperature
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate dP/dτ = g/κ(P,T) with Eddington T(τ) for a grey atmosphere and a simple power-law opacity. Compute the emergent flux by integrating the source function over depth and obtain the B−V color index versus T_eff.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Transient temperature spike and cooling curve of a UV-heated very small grain
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the grain energy ODE with a Debye-like heat capacity and infrared emission computed from Planck-weighted absorption efficiency. Compute the peak temperature and cooling time after a single UV photon absorption versus grain size.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Isolated neutron star cooling curve with neutrino and blackbody photon losses
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the core thermal-energy ODE with modified Urca neutrino emission and surface photon emission, using an envelope relation for T_s(T_core). Compute the surface temperature and luminosity versus age and find the neutrino-to-photon transition time.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Diurnal surface temperature of a rotating airless body with thermal inertia
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Solve the 1D heat-conduction equation in regolith by method of lines, with a radiative surface boundary condition under periodic insolation. Compute the diurnal temperature curve, the peak-temperature lag and the night-side temperature versus thermal parameter.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Giant planet cooling luminosity versus age from polytropic interior energy ODE
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the energy equation for a degenerate, polytrope-structured giant planet radiating through an atmosphere with a T_eff–T_int relation. Compute the luminosity and effective temperature versus age, with and without stellar irradiation.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Freeze-in dark matter relic abundance from decays of a bath particle
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the Boltzmann equation for a feebly coupled particle produced by in-equilibrium decays of a heavier bath particle. Compute the yield versus coupling and mass, and the temperature at which production peaks.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Asymmetric dark matter freeze-out: coupled particle–antiparticle Boltzmann equations
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the stiff coupled yield equations with a conserved primordial asymmetry. Compute the final symmetric-component fraction versus annihilation cross section and the cross section needed to deplete it.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Supernova neutrino MSW resonance crossing probability versus Landau–Zener prediction
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the flavor evolution of neutrinos through a power-law supernova envelope density. Extract the level-crossing (jump) probability at the H resonance and compare it with the Landau–Zener formula for a range of θ13.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Day–night asymmetry of solar neutrinos from propagation through layered Earth
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate two-flavor evolution through a piecewise-constant mantle and core density model along chords set by nadir angle. Compute the Earth regeneration of ν_e and the day–night asymmetry versus energy.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: WIMP capture–annihilation equilibrium in the Sun and annihilation rate today
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Compute the WIMP capture rate on hydrogen with a Gould-type integral, then integrate dN/dt = C − C_A N² − C_E N. Determine the equilibration time and present-day annihilation rate versus cross section and mass.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Dodelson–Widrow sterile neutrino production and relic abundance from Boltzmann ODE
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the sterile neutrino production equation with the thermal-potential-suppressed effective mixing angle across the QCD era. Compute the momentum-averaged abundance Ω_s h² versus mixing angle and mass.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Bipolar collective neutrino oscillations: flavor pendulum period and inverted-hierarchy instability
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the polarization-vector equations for a monochromatic neutrino–antineutrino gas with self-interaction. Compute the pendulum oscillation period and the onset of bipolar flavor conversion for normal and inverted hierarchy.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: WIMP kinetic decoupling temperature from the second-moment Boltzmann equation
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the ODE for the dark-matter velocity dispersion (temperature) coupled to the bath through elastic scattering. Find the kinetic decoupling temperature and the resulting smallest protohalo mass scale.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: QCD axion misalignment relic density with temperature-dependent mass
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate θ'' + 3Hθ' + m_a(T)² sin θ = 0 through the onset of oscillations using a power-law topological susceptibility. Compute the conserved axion number and Ω_a h² versus initial angle and decay constant, including anharmonic effects.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Weaver stellar-wind bubble: thin-shell expansion and interior energy evolution
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the coupled shell-radius and bubble-pressure equations for a constant mechanical-luminosity wind in a uniform medium. Recover R ∝ t^{3/5} and compute the interior thermal energy fraction.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Chevalier self-similar ejecta–circumstellar interaction region by shooting
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Solve the similarity ODEs between the forward and reverse shocks for power-law ejecta expanding into a power-law wind. Shoot from both shocks to the contact discontinuity to find the shock radius ratios and density profiles.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: C-type MHD shock structure with ion–neutral drift in molecular clouds
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the steady two-fluid shock ODEs with ion–neutral drag and radiative cooling. Compute the shock width, peak neutral temperature and drift velocity versus shock speed and ionization fraction.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Kompaneets blast wave in an exponential atmosphere: shock shape and blowout time
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the Kompaneets shock-surface PDE along characteristics in an isothermal exponential atmosphere. Compute the evolving shock shape and the blowout time, when the top of the shock reaches infinity, versus energy and scale height.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Spitzer D-type expansion of an HII region and stagnation radius
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the shell equation of motion driven by the pressure of ionized gas, with the Strömgren-radius dependence on shell radius. Compare with the Spitzer and Hosokawa–Inutsuka solutions and find the stagnation radius in a turbulent medium.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Cosmic-ray-modified shock compression ratio from Drury–Völk two-fluid precursor
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the two-fluid precursor ODEs with cosmic-ray diffusion and pressure. Solve for the total and subshock compression ratios versus Mach number and injection, including the multiple-solution regime.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Boron-to-carbon ratio from leaky-box propagation with ionization losses
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the steady-state energy-space ODEs for C, O and B, including spallation production, rigidity-dependent escape and ionization energy losses. Compute B/C versus kinetic energy per nucleon and fit the diffusion index.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Positron flux from a nearby pulsar via diffusion-loss Green's function
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the inverse-Compton/synchrotron loss characteristic E(t) and use the Syrovatskii solution with energy-dependent diffusion for burst-like injection. Compute the positron spectrum at Earth, the high-energy cutoff and the dependence on source age.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Maximum proton energy from diffusive shock acceleration in an evolving SNR
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the Lagage–Cesarsky acceleration-rate ODE dE/dt with shock velocity and radius following the ejecta-to-Sedov evolution and Bohm diffusion. Compute E_max(t), the time of peak energy, and the escape-limited value.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Second-order Fermi acceleration steady spectrum from momentum-diffusion Fokker–Planck BVP
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Solve the steady momentum-space Fokker–Planck ODE with hard-sphere momentum diffusion, escape and synchrotron losses as a boundary-value problem. Compute the power-law index versus acceleration-to-escape ratio and the pile-up bump.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Force-field solar modulation of Galactic cosmic-ray protons
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the characteristic ODE of the force-field approximation to the Parker transport equation through the heliosphere. Compute the modulated proton spectrum at 1 AU versus modulation potential and compare with the closed-form shift.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: GZK horizon of ultra-high-energy protons from photopion and pair losses
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate dE/dz for protons with CMB photopion production, Bethe–Heitler pair losses and adiabatic losses in ΛCDM. Compute the observed energy versus source distance and the attenuation horizon.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Parabolic graded-index optical fiber radial modes via Numerov eigenvalue shooting
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Solve the scalar radial Helmholtz equation in a truncated parabolic-index fiber with a cladding, using Numerov integration and bisection on the propagation constant. Compute the mode spacing and the modal dispersion.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Coaxial waveguide TE11 cutoff wavenumber versus radius ratio by radial shooting
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Shoot the radial Bessel ODE between inner and outer conductors with Neumann boundary conditions. Compute TE11 and TM01 cutoff wavenumbers versus radius ratio and compare with the approximation k_c ≈ 2/(a+b).

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Cylindrical cavity TM010 and TE011 quality factors from wall losses
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Obtain the cavity mode fields by integrating the radial ODE, then compute stored energy and wall dissipation with the surface resistance by quadrature. Compute Q versus aspect ratio and conductivity.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Whispering-gallery modes of a dielectric sphere: resonances and radiative Q
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the radial Helmholtz equation inside the sphere and match to outgoing spherical Hankel functions to locate complex resonance frequencies. Compute the mode positions and the radiation-limited Q versus angular number ℓ and refractive index.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Classical hydrogen atom collapse time with Landau–Lifshitz radiation reaction in Coulomb field
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate electron motion in a Coulomb potential with the Landau–Lifshitz reaction force from several initial eccentricities. Compute the infall time, the eccentricity evolution, and how they compare with the circular-orbit Larmor estimate of about 1.6e-11 s.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Pulsar spin-down with exponential field decay: braking index and age discrepancy
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate Ω̇ = -K B(t)^2 Ω^3 with an exponentially decaying dipole field. Compute the evolving braking index n(t) and the ratio of characteristic age P/2Ṗ to true age.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Magnetic inclination alignment of pulsars under force-free spin-down torque
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate coupled ODEs for spin frequency and magnetic obliquity α using the Spitkovsky force-free torque (1+sin²α). Compute the alignment timescale, the time-dependent braking index, and the P–Ṗ track.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Two-component crust–superfluid model of pulsar glitch recovery
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Solve linear coupled ODEs for crust and superfluid angular velocities with a mutual-friction coupling time, driven by external spin-down, after an impulsive glitch. Compute the exponential recovery timescale, the healing parameter Q, and the residual frequency step.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Pulsar wind nebula thin-shell expansion inside freely expanding supernova ejecta
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the thin-shell momentum and nebular energy ODEs for a PWN powered by a magnetic-dipole spin-down luminosity sweeping up uniform-density ejecta. Compute R_pwn(t) and compare it with the self-similar t^{6/5} law.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Gravitational-radiation-driven r-mode instability spin-down of a young neutron star
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the Owen et al. (1998) coupled ODEs for r-mode amplitude and spin frequency, including gravitational-radiation growth and viscous damping, up to amplitude saturation. Compute the final spin frequency and the duration of the spin-down phase.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Inflaton background evolution in Starobinsky and quadratic potentials: n_s and r
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the Klein–Gordon plus Friedmann equations in e-fold time, locate the end of inflation where ε_H = 1, and find the field value 55 e-folds earlier. Compute n_s and r there from the Hubble-flow parameters and compare with slow-roll formulas.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Perturbative reheating: inflaton decay into radiation and reheating temperature
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the coupled ODEs for an oscillating inflaton with decay rate Γ, the radiation density and the Hubble rate after inflation. Compute the maximum temperature, the reheating temperature at H = Γ, and compare with T_rh ∝ sqrt(Γ M_Pl).

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Preheating instability bands in conformal λφ⁴ inflation via Lamé-equation Floquet exponents
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the oscillating background and the linear χ-field mode equation over one period to build monodromy matrices. Map the Floquet exponent as a function of momentum and coupling ratio g²/λ, and find the resonance band with maximal growth.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Axial trapped and w-mode quasinormal frequencies of ultracompact uniform-density stars
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the axial perturbation equation inside a constant-density relativistic star and match it to the exterior Regge–Wheeler equation. Shoot in the complex frequency plane for slowly damped trapped modes, and compute how their frequency and damping vary with compactness.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Mini-boson star mass-radius curve from Einstein–Klein–Gordon eigenvalue shooting
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Shoot on the field frequency ω to find nodeless solutions of the coupled metric and scalar ODEs for a spherically symmetric boson star. Compute the ADM mass and radius versus central field amplitude, and find the maximum mass, near 0.633 M_Pl²/m.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Transonic slim accretion disk in Paczyński–Wiita potential: angular momentum eigenvalue
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the radial ODEs of a viscous, advective slim disk through a sonic point by shooting on the angular momentum accreted per unit mass. Compute the sonic-point radius, the inner-edge location, and the departure from a Keplerian profile versus accretion rate.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Sakurai self-similar shock acceleration at a stellar surface: similarity exponent
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Solve the planar self-similar ODEs for a strong shock running into a power-law density profile ρ ∝ x^n. Shoot through the sonic singular point to find the acceleration exponent of the shock velocity, and tabulate it versus n and γ.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Ejecta–circumstellar shell collision light curve in a one-zone diffusion model
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Couple thin-shell momentum conservation for ejecta sweeping a wind-like CSM to an Arnett-type diffusion ODE heated by shock luminosity. Compute the peak luminosity, the rise time, and the efficiency of converting kinetic energy to radiation.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Kustaanheimo–Stiefel regularized propagation of a sungrazing comet orbit
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate a highly eccentric two-body orbit in both Cartesian and KS-regularized coordinates with fixed-step RK4. Compare energy and positional errors per perihelion passage versus eccentricity and step count.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Yarkovsky semi-major-axis drift from Gauss planetary equations with transverse thrust
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the Gauss variational equations for an asteroid under a small transverse thermal recoil acceleration that scales with heliocentric distance. Compute da/dt and the drift accumulated over 100 Myr, and compare with the averaged analytic formula.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Solar radiation pressure eccentricity cycles of high area-to-mass geosynchronous debris
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the orbit-averaged eccentricity-vector equations, or the full Cartesian orbit, for GEO debris under solar radiation pressure with a yearly rotating Sun direction. Compute the maximum eccentricity versus area-to-mass ratio and the period of the cycle.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Transit timing variations of two near-resonant planets via N-body integration
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate a star plus two planets near a 2:1 resonance and find transit mid-times by root-finding on the sky-projected separation. Fit a linear ephemeris, and compute the TTV amplitude and super-period, then compare with Lithwick et al. formulas.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Ledoux rotational splitting coefficients of p and g modes of an n=3 polytrope
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Solve the nonradial adiabatic oscillation eigenproblem in the Cowling approximation for a polytrope by shooting. Compute the eigenfunctions and the Ledoux constant C_nl for several ℓ and n, then verify the asymptotic g-mode limit 1/[ℓ(ℓ+1)].

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Nonlinear one-zone Baker model of stellar pulsation: limit-cycle amplitude
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Integrate the one-zone ODEs for shell radius, velocity and temperature with a κ-mechanism opacity law until a limit cycle forms. Compute the growth rate, the saturated amplitude and the period, and compare the period with the linear-theory value.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Geomagnetic cutoff rigidity by backtracing cosmic-ray protons in a dipole field
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Backward-integrate relativistic proton trajectories from a site on Earth in a centered dipole field and classify each as allowed or forbidden by escape. Compute the vertical cutoff rigidity versus geomagnetic latitude and compare with the Störmer formula.

physics/fields_astro|ode.title: Two-stream irradiated planetary atmosphere temperature–pressure profile as a BVP
physics/fields_astro|ode.gist: Solve the coupled shortwave and longwave two-stream moment ODEs with an Eddington closure for a hot-Jupiter atmosphere. Compute T(τ) versus the visible-to-infrared opacity ratio, and compare the deep and upper limits with the Guillot (2010) solution.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Gaussian-pulse excitation of a harmonic oscillator: first-order theory vs Crank-Nicolson
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: A 1D harmonic oscillator is driven by a Gaussian dipole pulse. Compute the first-order transition probability to n=1 analytically and by quadrature, and compare it with Crank-Nicolson finite-difference propagation of the TDSE as pulse width and strength vary.
physics/quantum_mech|pde.area: Time-dependent perturbation theory and Fermi golden rule

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Photoionization rate of 1D soft-Coulomb atom: golden rule vs split-step yield
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Box-normalized finite-difference continuum states and the density of states give the Fermi golden rule ionization rate for a weak monochromatic field. Compare it with the ionization yield from split-step Fourier propagation with a complex absorbing boundary.
physics/quantum_mech|pde.area: Time-dependent perturbation theory and Fermi golden rule

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Two-photon off-resonant transition in an infinite square well
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Compute the second-order perturbative amplitude for the 1→3 two-photon transition in a driven infinite well by summing over intermediate FD eigenstates. Compare it with exact Crank-Nicolson propagation near the two-photon resonance.
physics/quantum_mech|pde.area: Time-dependent perturbation theory and Fermi golden rule

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Resonant Rabi oscillations between tunnel-split doublet of a 1D double well
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Compute the ground-state tunneling doublet of a quartic double well by finite differences. Drive it resonantly with a dipole field and compare split-step populations with rotating-wave two-level predictions and the first-order perturbative short-time limit.
physics/quantum_mech|pde.area: Time-dependent perturbation theory and Fermi golden rule

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Multiphoton ionization order from intensity scaling in 1D soft-Coulomb atom
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Run split-step TDSE simulations with absorbing boundaries at several low intensities of a fixed-frequency flat-top pulse. Extract the effective photon order from the log-log slope of yield versus intensity and compare it with the minimal number of photons needed to reach threshold.
physics/quantum_mech|pde.area: Time-dependent perturbation theory and Fermi golden rule

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Landau-Zener transition in a linearly tilted 1D double well
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Sweep the bias of a double-well potential linearly in time with split-step propagation and compute the diabatic transition probability. Compare it with the Landau-Zener formula, using the gap from FD diagonalization at zero bias.
physics/quantum_mech|pde.area: Time-dependent perturbation theory and Fermi golden rule

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Oscillator strengths from delta-kick dipole response and TRK sum rule
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Kick the ground state of a 1D soft-Coulomb atom impulsively and propagate it with Crank-Nicolson. Fourier-transform the dipole signal to obtain the linear-response spectrum, compare peak strengths with FD dipole matrix elements, and verify the Thomas-Reiche-Kuhn sum rule.
physics/quantum_mech|pde.area: Time-dependent perturbation theory and Fermi golden rule

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Electric quadrupole matrix elements of hydrogen and Wigner-Eckart check
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Compute radial integrals <r^2> between FD hydrogen radial functions and 3j symbols from the Racah formula. Assemble the full m-resolved quadrupole matrix and verify that all m-dependence is captured by a single reduced matrix element.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Linear Stark effect of hydrogen n=2 from grid radial functions and Gaunt coefficients
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Build the n=2 Stark Hamiltonian from finite-difference radial wavefunctions and Gaunt angular integrals. Diagonalize it to recover the ±3eFa0 splitting, then extend to n=3 and compare with the parabolic-quantum-number formula.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Partial-wave decomposition of a displaced Gaussian wavepacket
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Project a 3D Gaussian displaced from the origin onto spherical harmonics on a radial grid with Gauss-Legendre angular quadrature. Compare the partial-wave radial amplitudes with the analytic modified-spherical-Bessel expansion and check norm convergence in l.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Slater integrals and p² term energies from radial Poisson solves
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Obtain the 2p radial orbital of a model atom by finite differences and compute the Slater F^0 and F^2 integrals by solving the radial multipole Poisson equations. Combine them with 3j coefficients to get the 3P, 1D and 1S term energies and the ratio (E_1S−E_1D)/(E_1D−E_3P).

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Single-particle levels in an axially deformed Woods-Saxon well via coupled channels
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Expand a quadrupole-deformed Woods-Saxon potential in Legendre multipoles and build the l-coupling matrix with 3j symbols. Solve the coupled radial finite-difference eigenproblem to trace Nilsson-like level splitting versus deformation.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Sodium-like E1 oscillator strengths and lifetimes with 3j angular factors
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Compute radial wavefunctions of a valence electron in a parametric core potential by Numerov integration. Combine dipole radial integrals with 3j/6j angular factors to obtain line strengths, Einstein A coefficients and the 3p lifetime.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Zeeman to Paschen-Back crossover for hydrogen 2p with fine structure
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Use FD radial wavefunctions to compute <r^-3> for the spin-orbit constant. Build the coupled |l s j mj> basis with Clebsch-Gordan coefficients, then diagonalize spin-orbit plus Zeeman terms versus B and compare with Landé g-factor and Paschen-Back limits.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Inverse participation ratio scaling in the 1D Anderson chain
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Diagonalize disordered tight-binding chains with box-distributed on-site energies. Compute the disorder-averaged IPR versus disorder strength and system size to distinguish system-size-limited from localized behavior.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Recursive Green's function transmission decay through disordered segments
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Compute the Landauer transmission through a disordered tight-binding segment between clean leads with the recursive Green's function method. Show that the typical transmission exp<ln T> decays as exp(−2L/ξ), while the average transmission is dominated by rare events.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Level-spacing statistics crossover in the 2D Anderson model
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Use sparse shift-invert diagonalization of 2D square-lattice Anderson Hamiltonians. Compute the unfolded spacing ratio <r> versus disorder and show the crossover from Wigner-Dyson (≈0.53) to Poisson (≈0.386) statistics.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Shell structure of a 2D parabolic quantum dot on a finite-difference grid
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Diagonalize the 2D Cartesian finite-difference Hamiltonian of an isotropic harmonic dot with sparse methods. Verify the ħω(2n+|m|+1) levels and degeneracies, and identify magic shell-filling numbers 2, 6, 12, 20.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Hard-wall circular dot: staircase FD errors and Richardson extrapolation
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Solve the Dirichlet Laplacian on a disk embedded in a Cartesian grid and compare eigenvalues with Bessel-function zeros. Quantify first-order boundary errors and apply Richardson extrapolation.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Self-consistent Hartree addition energies of a circular quantum dot
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Iterate 2D FD Kohn-Sham-like Hartree equations with an FFT Poisson solver for N electrons in a parabolic dot. Compute the chemical potentials and addition energies μ(N+1)−μ(N) to reveal shell-filling peaks at N=2, 6, 12.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Anisotropic elliptical parabolic dot spectrum and level crossings
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Diagonalize an anisotropic 2D harmonic dot on a finite-difference grid while varying ωx/ωy. Track level crossings and new shell closures at rational frequency ratios, and compare with nx ħωx + ny ħωy.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Hydrogenic impurity binding energy in a square hard-wall quantum dot
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Solve a 2D Dirichlet FD problem with a softened Coulomb impurity at varying positions inside a square dot. Compute the impurity binding energy relative to the empty dot as a function of position and dot size.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Wigner molecule formation for two electrons in a 1D harmonic trap
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Diagonalize two soft-Coulomb-interacting electrons on a 2D (x1,x2) grid. Compute the pair correlation function and density as interaction strength grows, showing the development of a two-peak Wigner-molecule structure.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Even-tempered Gaussian basis Rayleigh-Ritz for hydrogen with convergence study
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Build overlap and Hamiltonian matrices for s-type Gaussians with geometric exponents and solve the generalized eigenproblem. Show monotonic upper-bound convergence of the 1s and 2s energies versus basis size, compared with radial FD results.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Gross-Pitaevskii ground state: Gaussian variational vs imaginary-time split-step
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Minimize the GP energy functional with a Gaussian ansatz in a 1D or radially symmetric trap. Compare it with imaginary-time split-step Fourier solutions and the Thomas-Fermi limit as the interaction strength increases.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: B-spline Galerkin eigenvalues for the Yukawa potential
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Solve the radial Schrödinger equation for a Yukawa potential with a B-spline finite-element basis on exponential knots and a generalized eigenproblem. Show upper-bound convergence with knot number and Hylleraas-Undheim interlacing of excited states, and locate the critical screening length for binding.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Canonical orthogonalization for overcomplete Gaussian bases
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Apply Löwdin canonical orthogonalization with overlap-eigenvalue thresholds to a near-linearly-dependent Gaussian basis for a Coulomb-plus-harmonic potential. Study eigenvalue stability versus threshold against an FD reference.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Rubidium quantum defects from parametric model potential and Numerov
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Integrate the radial equation with an l-dependent core-penetrating model potential on a square-root or log grid. Extract quantum defects δ_l(n) for s, p, d series and fit Ritz expansion coefficients.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Scaling of Rydberg radial expectation values and dipole moments with n
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Use Numerov radial wavefunctions for n=10–80 to compute <r>, <r²> and nearest-neighbor dipole matrix elements. Verify n², n⁴ and n² scaling laws and compare them with hydrogenic analytic formulas corrected by n*.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Rydberg-Rydberg van der Waals C6 coefficients from radial matrix elements
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Compute dipole radial integrals between nearby Rydberg states with Numerov and model potential quantum defects. Sum second-order pair-state contributions with Förster energy defects to obtain C6 for nS+nS pairs and its n^11 scaling.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Radiative lifetimes of alkali Rydberg states and n³ scaling
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Sum Einstein A coefficients to all lower states using Numerov dipole matrix elements and model-potential energies. Compute nS and nP lifetimes and fit the effective n*^3 scaling.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Core-polarization quantum defects for nonpenetrating high-l Rydberg states
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Add a cutoff polarization potential −α_d/(2r⁴) to a hydrogenic core and compute quantum defects for l=4–8 via Numerov. Compare them with the perturbative <r^{-4}> polarization formula to extract α_d.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Alkali Rydberg Stark map with quantum-defect-induced avoided crossings
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Diagonalize the Stark Hamiltonian in an nlm basis around n=20 using Numerov radial matrix elements and angular factors. Map energy versus field, showing linear manifolds, quadratic low-l shifts and avoided crossings.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Rydberg excitons in Cu2O with central-cell-corrected Coulomb potential
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Solve the radial effective-mass exciton problem with dielectric screening and a short-range central-cell correction by finite differences. Extract quantum defects of the nP series and the deviation from hydrogen-like scaling.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Chirped infrared laser dissociation of a Morse oscillator
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Drive a Morse oscillator with a linearly chirped IR dipole pulse using split-step propagation with absorbing boundaries. Compute dissociation probability versus chirp rate and compare it with fixed-frequency pulses.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Isotope effects on zero-point energy and dissociation energy for H2, HD, D2
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Use one Born-Oppenheimer Morse curve with three reduced masses and compute vibrational levels by finite differences. Obtain D0 values, zero-point energies, and the deviation of their ratios from harmonic √μ scaling.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Overtone intensities from a dipole moment function on Morse eigenstates
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Evaluate matrix elements of a model dipole moment function μ(r) between FD Morse eigenstates. Compute fundamental and overtone (Δv=1–5) intensities, separating mechanical and electrical anharmonicity contributions.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Edge-state dispersion in a hard-wall Landau-gauge strip
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: For each ky, solve the 1D FD eigenproblem of a strip with hard walls and the shifted harmonic potential. Obtain dispersive edge branches and count crossings at the Fermi level to give quantized Hall conductance plateaus.
physics/quantum_mech|pde.area: Landau levels and charged particles in fields

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Cyclotron motion of a wavepacket via 2D Crank-Nicolson in a magnetic field
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Propagate a Gaussian wavepacket in a uniform B field with an ADI Crank-Nicolson scheme including the vector potential. Measure the orbit period and radius, and verify the period 2π/ωc and norm conservation.
physics/quantum_mech|pde.area: Landau levels and charged particles in fields

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Crossed electric and magnetic fields: Landau-level drift velocity
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Add a uniform electric field to the Landau-gauge strip Hamiltonian and diagonalize per ky by finite differences. Extract the group velocity dE/dky and confirm the E/B drift and field-induced level tilting.
physics/quantum_mech|pde.area: Landau levels and charged particles in fields

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Yukawa scattering: Born cross section vs Numerov partial-wave sums
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Compare the analytic first-Born differential cross section for a Yukawa potential with exact phase shifts from Numerov integration summed over l. Map the validity region in strength and energy.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Electron scattering from a Thomas-Fermi screened atom
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Obtain the Thomas-Fermi screening function by solving the TF ODE numerically. Compute the Born form factor by radial Fourier transform and compare it with Molière and Yukawa approximations and with exact partial waves.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Scattering length and effective range of Yukawa potential near bound-state threshold
