physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Extract scattering length and effective range from low-energy Numerov phase shifts. Compare them with the Born scattering length, showing divergence when a bound state appears at the critical coupling.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Eikonal vs Born vs partial waves for high-energy Gaussian scattering
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Compute the Glauber eikonal amplitude by impact-parameter integration and compare it with first Born and exact Numerov partial-wave amplitudes at increasing ka. Show eikonal accuracy at small angles beyond the Born regime.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Inelastic 1s→2s electron-impact excitation of hydrogen in Born approximation
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Compute the transition form factor <2s|e^{iq·r}|1s> from radial FD wavefunctions by spherical Bessel quadrature. Integrate over momentum transfer to obtain the Born excitation cross section versus impact energy.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Aharonov-Anandan phase for nonadiabatic cyclic spin evolution
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Integrate the Schrödinger equation of a spin in a precessing field at arbitrary rate and find cyclic initial states as Floquet eigenvectors. Compute the total, dynamical and AA geometric phases, and compare the latter with half the solid angle traced on the Bloch sphere.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Berry phase of a trapped charge transported around a flux tube
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Discretize a 2D harmonic trap on a Peierls-phase grid with a localized flux tube. Transport the trap center around a loop and compute the discretized Berry phase of the ground state, recovering the Aharonov-Bohm phase.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Valley Berry curvature of a gapped honeycomb continuum potential
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Solve Bloch states of a 2D periodic honeycomb potential with sublattice asymmetry in a plane-wave spectral basis. Compute Berry curvature near K and K' by plaquette overlaps, and integrate to obtain valley Chern numbers.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Noise-induced destruction of dynamical localization in the kicked rotor
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Add random kick-amplitude or kick-timing noise to the split-step Floquet propagation and average over realizations. Compute the momentum second moment versus time and extract the restored diffusion constant as a function of noise strength.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Nonlinear kicked rotor: Gross-Pitaevskii interaction destroys localization
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Propagate a mean-field kicked rotor with a cubic nonlinearity g|ψ|² using a split-step method. Measure the subdiffusive growth exponent of ⟨p²⟩ versus g, and compare with the localized linear case.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Quantum accelerator modes of gravity-kicked atoms near kick-period resonance
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Simulate the kicked rotor with an added linear gravitational potential using split-step propagation with quasimomentum decomposition near T = 2π. Identify the accelerated momentum peak and compare its velocity with ε-classical fixed-point predictions.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Stochastic web diffusion in the delta-kicked harmonic oscillator
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Propagate a wavepacket under a harmonic oscillator kicked at resonant periods (q = 4 or 6) using exact harmonic evolution plus kicks on a position grid. Compute the energy growth and the phase-space web structure from the Husimi distribution.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Spatial adiabatic passage of a particle through a triple-well potential
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Model a 1D triple well with Gaussian barriers whose heights are modulated in counterintuitive order. Propagate the wavefunction with Crank-Nicolson on a grid and compute the transfer probability from left to right well and the middle-well occupation.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Shortcut to adiabatic harmonic trap expansion via Ermakov invariants
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Design the trap frequency ω(t) from a polynomial scaling factor b(t) satisfying the Ermakov equation. Verify with split-step propagation that the final state is the ground state of the expanded trap, and compare with a linear ramp.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Residual excitation after transporting a wavepacket in a moving harmonic trap
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Move a harmonic trap a distance d in time T, using a sudden profile, a smooth polynomial profile, and an inverse-engineered profile. Propagate with split-step and compute the final excitation energy versus T, comparing with the classical Fourier-transform formula.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Nonadiabatic excitation in an infinite well with a moving wall
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Map the expanding-box Schrödinger equation onto a fixed domain via dilation, propagate with Crank-Nicolson, and compute ground-state survival versus expansion speed. Check the result against the adiabatic theorem's scaling and the exact Doescher-Rice solution.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Anderson localization of an optical beam in a disordered waveguide array
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Solve the continuous paraxial equation i∂_zψ = -∂²_xψ/2k - k δn(x)ψ with a random refractive-index lattice using split-step FFT. Average output intensity profiles over disorder and extract exponential tails and the IPR versus disorder.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Aharonov-Bohm caging and compact localized states in the diamond chain
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Build the rhombic (diamond) tight-binding chain with Peierls phases. Compute the band structure versus flux, the collapse to flat bands at Φ = π, and the absence of wavepacket spreading in real-time Crank-Nicolson evolution.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Exponential and post-exponential power-law decay of survival probability
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Prepare a state localized inside a 1D well bounded by a thin barrier and propagate it with Crank-Nicolson and absorbing boundaries. Compute the survival probability over many lifetimes, and identify the exponential regime, the decay rate, and the late-time t^{-3} tail.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Gurvitz two-potential approach for quasi-bound decay width
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Split a 1D barrier-confined potential into inner and outer parts, compute the inner bound state on a grid, and evaluate the two-potential width formula. Validate against the decay rate from time-dependent propagation.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: First ionization energies from ΔSCF LDA versus Koopmans eigenvalues
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Run spherical KS-LDA for neutral and singly ionized atoms H through Ar. Compare the ΔSCF ionization energy and the negative highest-occupied eigenvalue with experiment, quantifying self-interaction error.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Spin-polarized LSDA for open-shell atoms and Hund's-rule polarization energy
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Extend the radial KS solver to separate spin densities with von Barth-Hedin spin interpolation. Compute energies of the high-spin and spin-unpolarized nitrogen and oxygen atoms and their spin-polarization energies.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Sternheimer linear-response LDA static dipole polarizability of helium
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: From the self-consistent He LDA ground state, solve the l = 1 radial Sternheimer equation for the first-order orbital. Include self-consistent induced Hartree-xc response and compare the polarizability with finite-field estimates.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Moiseyev 1D shape resonance: complex-scaled FD Hamiltonian θ-trajectories
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Discretize H(θ) = -e^{-2iθ}∂²/2 + V(xe^{iθ}) for V = (x²/2 - J)e^{-λx²} on a grid. Track eigenvalues versus θ to identify θ-stationary resonance energies and widths, separated from the rotated continuum.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Stark ionization width of a 1D soft-Coulomb atom via complex scaling
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Complex-rotate a soft-Coulomb atom in a static field F. Compute the ground-state resonance energy shift and width versus F, and compare with the norm-decay rate from split-step propagation and the tunneling (ADK-like) formula.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Stabilization method: resonance energies from box-size avoided crossings
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Diagonalize a resonance-supporting potential in hard-wall boxes of increasing length L. Locate avoided crossings in the stabilization graph E(L), and extract energy and width from the density-of-states peak, comparing with complex scaling.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Quantum carpets and fractional revivals in the infinite square well
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Expand a Gaussian wavepacket in box eigenstates, compute |ψ(x,t)|² over the revival time T_rev = 4mL²/πħ, and identify Talbot-type fractional revivals via autocorrelation peaks.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Herman-Kluk frozen-Gaussian propagator for anharmonic autocorrelation
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Sample initial phase-space points, propagate classical trajectories with stability matrices, and assemble the Herman-Kluk prefactor and wavefunction. Compare the autocorrelation in a quartic potential with split-step FFT results.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Levinson's theorem check for an attractive square well of varying depth
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Compute the s- and p-wave phase shifts versus energy for an attractive square well by numerical radial integration with continuous unwrapping. Verify δ_l(0) - δ_l(∞) = N_b π, including the l = 0 half-bound state subtlety.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Calogero variable-phase method for phase shifts of exponential potentials
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Integrate the variable-phase ODE δ_l'(r) = -(2mV/ħ²k)[ĵ_l cosδ - n̂_l sinδ]² for exponential and Yukawa potentials. Compare with Numerov-matched phase shifts and test the low-energy effective-range expansion.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Excited states of the 2D coupled quartic oscillator by Gram-Schmidt ITP
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Use imaginary-time propagation with successive Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization to obtain the lowest eight states of V = x⁴ + y⁴ + λx²y². Report energies, symmetry classes and degeneracy splitting versus λ.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Hahn echo and CPMG coherence under Ornstein-Uhlenbeck frequency noise
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Generate stochastic OU detuning trajectories, integrate spin precession with π-pulse sequences, and average coherence over realizations. Compare with filter-function predictions versus the number of pulses and correlation time.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Bloch-Torrey diffusion-weighted spin-echo signal in a restricted slab
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Solve the Bloch-Torrey PDE ∂m/∂t = D∂²m - iγGx m with reflecting walls using Crank-Nicolson under a pulsed-gradient spin-echo sequence. Compute signal attenuation versus b-value and the crossover from free to restricted diffusion.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Two-slit matter-wave diffraction: 2D split-step near-to-far field versus Fraunhofer pattern
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Propagate a Gaussian packet through a double-slit hard-wall mask with 2D FFT split-step and complex absorbers. Compare the screen intensity at increasing distances with the Fresnel and Fraunhofer two-slit formulas.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Quantum reflection of slow atoms from an attractive −C4/x⁴ surface tail
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Split-step propagation of slow 1D wavepackets toward a regularized −C4/x⁴ potential, with a complex absorbing potential that mimics sticking. Reflection probability versus incident momentum is compared with the threshold law R≈1−2k·b.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Vortex lattice in a rotating 2D condensate and Feynman's vortex-density rule
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Imaginary-time split-step (or Crank–Nicolson ADI) minimization of the rotating-frame 2D GPE with an L_z term. Vortex number is counted from phase winding versus rotation frequency and compared with n_v = 2mΩ/h.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Precession of an off-center vortex in a trapped 2D condensate
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Imprint a single vortex at radius r0 in a Thomas–Fermi 2D condensate and track its core by real-time split-step propagation. The precession frequency versus r0 is compared with Fetter's formula.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Gap solitons of a repulsive condensate in a 1D optical lattice by Newton continuation
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Compute the Bloch bands of a cosine lattice, then find localized stationary GPE solutions inside the first gap with finite-difference Newton iteration. Atom number versus chemical potential is traced across the gap.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Critical superflow velocity past a delta obstacle in a 1D condensate
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Solve the stationary 1D GPE in the comoving frame with a delta obstacle by FD Newton continuation in flow velocity. Find the velocity at which stationary solutions disappear (saddle-node) and check against Hakim's analytic result.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Quasi-1D dipolar condensate ground state with FFT-evaluated effective dipolar kernel
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Imaginary-time split-step for a cigar-shaped dipolar BEC. The reduced 1D dipolar interaction is applied in momentum space through the analytic quasi-1D Fourier kernel. Peak density and chemical potential versus dipolar-to-contact ratio, including the approach to instability.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: P1 finite elements for a hexagonal hard-wall quantum dot spectrum
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Triangulate a regular hexagon and assemble sparse P1 stiffness and mass matrices. Compute the lowest levels and degeneracies (C6v symmetry) and compare with a circular dot of equal area.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Metal–insulator–metal tunnel junction current: Simmons formula versus exact FD transmission
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Compute transmission through a biased trapezoidal barrier with image-force rounding by FD transfer/QTBM. Integrate the Tsu–Esaki current and compare J(V) with Simmons' WKB formula across the low-bias and Fowler–Nordheim regimes.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Muonic lead 2p→1s transition energy with a Fermi nuclear charge distribution
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Obtain the nuclear electrostatic potential from a radial Poisson solve and compute the muonic 1s and 2p levels by Numerov or FD with reduced mass. Compare the finite-size shift and the transition energy with the point-nucleus result.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Photodetachment of a model short-range negative ion and the Wigner threshold law
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Bind an electron in a short-range Yukawa/Gaussian well (H⁻-like model) and compute p-wave continuum states by FD with energy normalization. Evaluate dipole matrix elements and verify the k³ threshold law of the photodetachment cross section.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Quantum backflow in superpositions of positive-momentum Gaussian packets
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Propagate superpositions of positive-momentum packets with FFT and compute the probability current at x=0 on the grid. Find the maximal negative probability flux over time and compare with the Bracken–Melloy bound.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Truncated Airy wavepackets: free acceleration and decay of the Berry–Balazs solution
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Propagate exponentially apodized Airy packets with FFT split-step. Measure the parabolic peak trajectory, the onset of spreading versus apodization, and the free-fall equivalence in a linear potential.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Fractional quantum oscillator |p|^α + x² on an FFT grid versus WKB
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Represent the Lévy kinetic term |p|^α spectrally on a Fourier grid and diagonalize with a harmonic potential for α in (1,2]. Compare the energies with Bohr–Sommerfeld quantization and the α=2 limit.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: 2D square lattice of Gaussian wells: plane-wave band structure and tight-binding fit
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Plane-wave (spectral) expansion of a non-separable 2D periodic Gaussian-well potential, giving bands along Γ–X–M. Fit nearest- and next-nearest-neighbor tight-binding hoppings to the lowest band.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Impurity-induced gap states in a 1D Mathieu lattice via supercell finite differences
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Add a localized Gaussian defect to a cosine lattice and diagonalize large periodic supercells with FD. Identify in-gap bound states, their energies versus defect strength, and exponential decay lengths compared with complex-band analysis.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Harmonic oscillator confined in a hard-wall box: energies versus box size
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Chebyshev collocation or FD eigenvalues of x²/2 inside Dirichlet walls at ±L. Show the crossover from particle-in-a-box to oscillator levels and compare with the exact parabolic-cylinder (Kummer) root conditions.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Two-particle 1D wavepacket collision on a 2D grid versus reduced one-body scattering
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Propagate two distinguishable particles with a Gaussian interaction using 2D split-step. Extract the transmission probability and compare with one-body relative-coordinate scattering at the reduced mass, testing center-of-mass separation.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Collinear H + H₂ reaction probability by 2D wavepacket propagation on a LEPS surface
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Split-operator propagation in skewed Jacobi coordinates on a LEPS surface with complex absorbing potentials. The energy-resolved reaction probability comes from time-to-energy flux analysis, and the threshold behavior shows tunneling.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Equilibrium radius of the electron bubble in liquid helium
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Compute the ground state of an electron in a finite spherical barrier of about 1 eV by radial FD as a function of bubble radius. Add surface-tension and pressure energies and minimize the total energy to get the equilibrium radius versus pressure.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Quantum monodromy in the 2D champagne-bottle potential
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Radial FD eigenvalues for each angular momentum m of V = a r⁴ − b r² in 2D. Arrange the joint (E,m) spectrum into a lattice and show the defect around E=0 that signals monodromy.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Fermi resonance in a 2:1 coupled 2D oscillator (CO₂-like model)
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: 2D Fourier-grid or FD diagonalization of two oscillators with ω₁≈2ω₂ and cubic coupling k x y². Track the mixing and level repulsion of the polyad states versus detuning and compare with an effective 2×2 model.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Tully dual-avoided-crossing model: exact two-state wavepacket Stückelberg oscillations
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Propagate a nuclear wavepacket on two diabatically coupled surfaces with a two-component split-operator. Compute the upper-state transmission probability versus incident momentum and its Stückelberg oscillations.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Commutator-free Magnus integrators for a 1D atom in a chirped laser pulse
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Compare second- and fourth-order Magnus-type exponential integrators with Strang splitting for a soft-core atom driven by a chirped field. Measure global error versus time step to confirm the orders.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Visscher staggered-time explicit scheme: stability limit and norm conservation
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Implement Visscher's leapfrog for the real and imaginary parts of ψ on an FD grid. Verify the stability bound Δt < ħ/E_max empirically and test conservation of the modified norm against Crank–Nicolson.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Two-center 2D scattering from a double-Gaussian target: grid solution versus Born interference
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Solve the driven equation (E−H)ψ_sc = Vψ₀ on a 2D grid with an absorbing layer for two Gaussian scatterers. Extract the far-field amplitude and compare the angular interference fringes with the Born two-center structure factor.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Superfluid fraction of a condensate in a 1D optical lattice by phase twisting
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Compute GPE ground states with twisted boundary conditions and obtain the superfluid fraction from the energy curvature. Compare with Leggett's upper bound from the density profile versus lattice depth.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Sound propagation in a uniform 1D condensate: pulse speed versus Bogoliubov theory
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Create a small density bump with a transient potential and track the two counter-propagating pulses with split-step. Compare the measured speed with c=√(gn/m), including nonlinear amplitude corrections.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Bohmian trajectories from a two-Gaussian-slit wavefunction
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Evolve a superposition of two Gaussian packets on an FFT grid and integrate guidance-equation trajectories from the numerical phase gradient. Show the non-crossing rule and that trajectory endpoint statistics reproduce |ψ|².

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Kramers–Henneberger dressed potential and high-frequency stabilization of a 1D atom
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Compute the time-averaged KH-frame potential of a soft-core atom by numerical cycle averaging and diagonalize it on a grid. Show the ground-state dichotomy and compare stabilized ionization yields with split-step TDSE versus intensity.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Complex absorbing potential η-trajectories for an l=2 radial shape resonance
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Add −iηW(r) to an FD radial Hamiltonian with a centrifugal barrier and track complex eigenvalues versus η. Locate the resonance at the stationary point of the η-trajectory (Riss–Meyer) and check it against phase-shift Breit–Wigner fits.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Spin-1 condensate ground-state phases with quadratic Zeeman shift
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Imaginary-time propagation of three coupled 1D GPEs with spin-dependent interaction, fixed magnetization via Lagrange multipliers, and quadratic Zeeman energy q. Map the ferromagnetic, polar and antiferromagnetic phases for rubidium-87- and sodium-23-like interactions.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Scissors mode of a condensate in an anisotropic 2D trap
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Suddenly rotate an elliptical trap and propagate the 2D GPE with split-step. Extract the ⟨xy⟩ oscillation frequency and compare with √(ωx²+ωy²) in the Thomas–Fermi limit and |ωx±ωy| in the ideal-gas limit.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Endohedral hydrogen in C₆₀: confinement-induced level rearrangement in a shell potential
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Radial FD eigenvalues of hydrogen inside a square or Gaussian spherical-shell attractive potential versus shell depth. Show the 'mirror collapse' of levels into the shell and the change in 1s energy and radial density.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Constructing a norm-conserving pseudopotential and testing logarithmic-derivative transferability
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Compute all-electron radial valence orbitals for a model atom by FD, pseudize inside r_c with norm conservation, and invert for a smooth l-dependent potential. Compare logarithmic derivatives versus energy with the all-electron result.

physics/quantum_mech|pde.title: Hydrogen atom in D dimensions: radial FD energies and large-D scaling
physics/quantum_mech|pde.gist: Solve the D-dimensional radial Coulomb equation with effective centrifugal term (l+(D−3)/2)(l+(D−1)/2)/r² by FD. Verify E = −1/(2(n+(D−3)/2)²) and examine the 1/D-expansion limit of the ground state.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: ISTA versus FISTA convergence for LASSO recovery of sparse spike trains
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Recover a k-sparse spike train from Gaussian random measurements by minimizing the LASSO objective with ISTA and FISTA, using a Lipschitz step from the largest singular value. Compare the objective suboptimality against the O(1/k) and O(1/k^2) rates and report the final support recovery error.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Donoho-Tanner phase transition map for orthogonal matching pursuit
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Run OMP (greedy atom selection with a least-squares refit) on Gaussian sensing matrices over a grid of undersampling delta=m/n and sparsity rho=k/m. Estimate the empirical success probability surface and locate the 50% transition curve.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Basis pursuit by linear programming and the l1 weak phase transition
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Cast min ||x||_1 subject to Ax=y as a linear program with split variables and solve it with scipy linprog over a sparsity sweep. Compare the empirical exact-recovery boundary with the Donoho-Tanner polytope curve at a fixed delta.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: CoSaMP sparse recovery robustness to measurement noise
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Implement CoSaMP: identify 2k proxy atoms, merge supports, least-squares estimate, then prune to k. Measure the recovery error versus measurement SNR and compare it with the oracle least-squares error on the true support.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Iteratively reweighted least squares for nonconvex lp sparse recovery
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Recover sparse vectors by minimizing the lp quasi-norm (p<1) subject to Ax=y using IRLS with closed-form weighted minimum-norm updates and epsilon annealing. Compare the success-rate curves for p=1, 0.5 and 0.1 against basis pursuit.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Binary iterative hard thresholding for one-bit compressed sensing
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Recover the direction of a sparse unit vector from sign measurements sign(Ax) using BIHT, which takes subgradient steps on the one-sided l1 sign-consistency loss followed by hard thresholding and normalization. Report the angular error and the Hamming consistency versus the number of measurements.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Sample entropy of the logistic map across the period-doubling route
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Compute SampEn(m=2, r=0.2 sd) for logistic-map orbits over a range of the parameter r, counting template matches with the Chebyshev distance and excluding self-matches. Relate the entropy to the bifurcation structure and to periodic windows.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Approximate entropy bias for the Henon map with additive noise
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Compute ApEn and SampEn of the Henon x-series contaminated by Gaussian noise at several levels and record lengths. Quantify the self-match bias of ApEn and its dependence on the tolerance r.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Permutation entropy versus Lyapunov exponent for the logistic map
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Enumerate ordinal patterns of order d using Lehmer-code indexing to compute normalized Bandt-Pompe permutation entropy. Compare the result with the numerically computed Lyapunov exponent (mean log|f'|) across the parameter r.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Multiscale entropy distinguishing 1/f noise from white noise
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Generate white and 1/f noise by spectral shaping, coarse-grain each series at scales 1-20, and compute the sample entropy at each scale. Reproduce the Costa et al. signature, in which white-noise entropy decays with scale while 1/f entropy stays flat.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Forbidden ordinal patterns as a test of determinism
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Count the ordinal patterns of length d that never occur in tent-map, logistic-map and surrogate noise series, as a function of series length. Compare the decay of the missing-pattern count for noise with its persistence for deterministic chaos.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Fuzzy entropy of the Lorenz attractor x-coordinate
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Integrate the Lorenz system with solve_ivp, sample the x-component, and compute fuzzy entropy using exponential membership functions of baseline-removed templates. Compare its smoothness in r with the sample entropy.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Complexity-entropy causality plane for chaotic maps and fractional noise
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the normalized permutation entropy and the Jensen-Shannon statistical complexity of ordinal distributions. Locate tent, logistic and Henon maps and fractional Gaussian noises of varying Hurst exponent relative to the maximum and minimum complexity boundary curves.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Recurrence quantification determinism from diagonal line lengths
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Build delay-embedded recurrence matrices and compute the recurrence rate, the determinism (fraction of points on diagonal lines of length >= l_min) and the entropy of the line-length histogram via run-length scanning. Compare periodic, chaotic and stochastic signals.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Poisson NMF topic extraction from document-word count matrices
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Generate counts from a latent topic model and fit KL-NMF, which is equivalent to Poisson maximum likelihood. Report the log-likelihood trajectory and the topic recovery error after column normalization.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Sparse NMF learning part-based representations of swimmer images
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Construct the swimmer dataset of stick-figure limb configurations and factorize it with L1-penalized multiplicative updates. Measure how many of the true limb parts are recovered as the sparsity weight varies.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Itakura-Saito NMF of power spectrograms with scale invariance
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Implement IS-divergence multiplicative updates on the power spectrogram of a synthetic signal with a wide dynamic range. Compare how well low-energy components are recovered with Frobenius and KL factorizations.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Lawson-Hanson nonnegative least squares fluorescence spectral unmixing
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Given known fluorophore emission spectra, solve the per-pixel NNLS problem with the active-set Lawson-Hanson algorithm. Compare the estimated abundances with unconstrained least squares under Poisson noise.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Schnakenberg entropy production of a driven three-state Markov ring
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Find the stationary distribution of a 3-state continuous-time Markov ring with nonequilibrium rates from the generator null space. Compute the probability current, the cycle affinity and the entropy production rate, and verify that they vanish at detailed balance.
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.area: Thermodynamics of information and Landauer bounds

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Optimal finite-time bit erasure protocol in a two-state system
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Discretize the time-dependent energy gap of a two-level Markov bit coupled to a bath and minimize the total work for erasure to a target error over protocol parameters with scipy.optimize. Show that the minimal work approaches kT ln2 - kT H(error) as the protocol duration grows.
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.area: Thermodynamics of information and Landauer bounds

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Sagawa-Ueda bound check for feedback-controlled two-level system
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Model a two-level system measured with error, followed by feedback switching of the energy levels. Compute the average work and the fluctuation-theorem average <exp(-beta W - I)> exactly by enumerating trajectories, and confirm W_ext <= kT I.
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.area: Thermodynamics of information and Landauer bounds

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Lower bound on hidden entropy production from coarse-grained transitions
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: For a 4-state network observed only through two states, estimate the entropy production from the KL divergence between forward and time-reversed sequence statistics. Compare this lower bound with the true value by enumerating short sequence blocks of increasing length.
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.area: Thermodynamics of information and Landauer bounds

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Energy-speed-accuracy tradeoff in sensory adaptation networks
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Solve the steady state of the Lan et al. methylation-activity Markov network and compute the adaptation error and the dissipated free energy rate. Root-find the energy cost required to reach a target accuracy and test the logarithmic tradeoff.
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.area: Thermodynamics of information and Landauer bounds

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Discretized Blahut-Arimoto for a Gaussian source with squared error
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Discretize a Gaussian source and the reproduction alphabet on fine grids, run Blahut-Arimoto, and compare the resulting curve with R(D)=0.5 log(sigma^2/D). Analyze the convergence of the curve with grid resolution.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Lloyd-Max quantizer for a Gaussian source versus Shannon bound
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Design optimal N-level scalar quantizers by Lloyd fixed-point iteration of centroid and midpoint conditions, using truncated-Gaussian moments. Compare the MSE at log2 N bits with D(R)=sigma^2 2^{-2R}.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Entropy-constrained scalar quantization of a Laplacian source
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Iterate a Lagrangian generalized Lloyd algorithm that minimizes D + lambda H over the quantizer thresholds and reconstruction points. Show that the high-rate gap to the Laplacian R(D) approaches 0.254 bits.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Deterministic annealing clustering and rate-distortion phase transitions
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Apply Rose's deterministic annealing of Gibbs assignments and centroid updates to 2D Gaussian-mixture data. Detect the critical temperatures at which codevectors split and compare the first with 2 times the largest covariance eigenvalue.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Laplacian source rate-distortion with absolute error and Shannon lower bound
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Compute R(D) for a Laplacian source under absolute-error distortion via discretized Blahut-Arimoto. Compare it with the exact result R(D)=log(1/(lambda D)) for D<=1/lambda and with the Shannon lower bound.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Kozachenko-Leonenko entropy estimator bias for multivariate Gaussians
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Implement the kNN Kozachenko-Leonenko estimator with scipy cKDTree and digamma corrections. Compare its estimates with the analytic Gaussian differential entropy in dimensions 1-10 and determine how the bias and variance scale with sample size.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: kNN differential entropy of Laplace and heavy-tailed distributions
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Apply the Kozachenko-Leonenko estimator for several k to Laplace and Student-t samples. Compare the estimates with the closed forms 1+ln(2b) and the digamma-beta expression for Student-t, which are checked against quadrature.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Generalized Gaussian differential entropy by quadrature versus closed form
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Evaluate the differential entropy of generalized Gaussian distributions with shape parameter beta by numerical quadrature and compare it with the gamma-function closed form. Root-find the shape whose entropy equals that of a given variance-matched Gaussian minus delta.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Numerical entropy power inequality check for sums of uniforms
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the densities of sums of i.i.d. uniform variables by repeated numerical convolution and their differential entropies by quadrature. Verify the entropy power inequality and the monotone approach of the sum's entropy to the Gaussian value.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Vasicek m-spacing entropy estimator for Beta distributions
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Implement the Vasicek spacing estimator with boundary handling and choose the window m by minimizing the bias over a grid. Compare the estimates with the analytic Beta entropy, which involves digamma functions.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Jaynes dice problem: maximum entropy distribution under mean constraint
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Find the maximum-entropy distribution on the faces 1-6 with a prescribed mean by root finding for the Lagrange multiplier with brentq. Extend to a mean plus variance constraint solved with 2D Newton iterations.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Pisarenko harmonic decomposition from estimated autocorrelation
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Build a (p+1)x(p+1) autocorrelation matrix, take the minimum-eigenvalue eigenvector, and root its polynomial to obtain sinusoid frequencies. Recover the powers from a linear system and quantify the method's sensitivity to autocorrelation estimation error.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Single-tone frequency MLE threshold effect against the Cramer-Rao bound
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Estimate the frequency of a noisy complex sinusoid by periodogram maximization with Newton refinement, using Monte Carlo trials over SNR. Compare the MSE with the CRB 6/(SNR N(N^2-1)) and locate the SNR threshold where outliers appear.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Numerical Fisher information for damped exponential decay parameters
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the Fisher information matrix for the amplitude, decay rate and frequency of a damped sinusoid in white noise from finite-difference Jacobians. Compare the inverse FIM with the Monte Carlo covariance of Levenberg-Marquardt fits.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Cauchy location MLE via Newton iterations and efficiency
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Find the Cauchy location MLE by Newton-Raphson on the score, started from the median, with safeguards against multiple roots. Compare the Monte Carlo variance with the CRB 2/n and with the asymptotic variance of the sample median.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Time-delay estimation of a Gaussian pulse and its Cramer-Rao bound
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Estimate the arrival time of a known pulse in noise by cross-correlation peak search with parabolic interpolation. Compare the RMSE with the CRB derived from the pulse's RMS bandwidth.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Single-molecule localization precision from pixelated Poisson images
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Model photon counts on a pixel grid from an integrated Gaussian PSF with background. Compute the Fisher information for position, intensity and background, and compare Newton-Raphson MLE localization variance with the CRB.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Gamma shape parameter MLE via Newton with digamma and trigamma
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Solve the gamma shape likelihood equation ln(k) - psi(k) = ln(mean) - mean(ln x) by Newton iterations. Compare the Monte Carlo variance of the joint shape-scale MLE with the inverse Fisher information matrix.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: EM estimation of Gaussian mixture weight versus Fisher information
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Estimate the mixing weight of a two-component Gaussian mixture with known components using the EM fixed-point iteration. Compute the Fisher information by quadrature and compare the estimator variance and the EM convergence rate as the component separation varies.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Phase estimation from one-bit quantized measurements
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Derive the Fisher information for the phase of a sinusoid observed through sign quantization with dithering noise, evaluated numerically. Compute the MLE by Newton or bounded search and quantify the information loss relative to unquantized data.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Weibull reliability parameters from right-censored lifetime data
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Maximize the censored Weibull likelihood by Newton iteration on the profile equation for the shape parameter. Compute the observed Fisher information and compare the Wald intervals with Monte Carlo coverage.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Neyman-Pearson detector and ROC for Gaussian mean shift
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Derive the likelihood ratio test for a known mean shift in i.i.d. Gaussian noise, find the threshold for a target false-alarm probability by inverting the normal survival function or by root finding, and compute the ROC curve and its area. Verify both by Monte Carlo.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Matched-filter detection of a known chirp in white noise
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Correlate the received data with a linear FM chirp template and set the threshold from the target false-alarm probability. Compute the detection probability versus SNR from the deflection coefficient and verify it by Monte Carlo, including time-of-arrival search.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Cell-averaging and ordered-statistic CFAR threshold multipliers
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Find the CA-CFAR multiplier from Pfa=(1+T/N)^{-N} and the OS-CFAR multiplier by root finding on its product formula for exponential clutter. Compare the detection losses and the robustness of the two detectors to interfering targets.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Energy detector threshold for cognitive-radio spectrum sensing
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Set the energy-detector threshold from the chi-square quantile for a target false-alarm probability and compute the detection probability for a Gaussian primary signal. Root-find the number of samples required to reach Pd=0.9 at a given low SNR.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Wald sequential probability ratio test operating characteristic and ASN
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Implement Wald's SPRT for Bernoulli or Gaussian hypotheses. Compute the operating characteristic and the average sample number curves by solving for the nonzero root h(theta) of E[exp(h z)]=1, and verify both by simulation.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Chernoff information and Bayes error exponent between two distributions
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the Chernoff information between two Gaussians, or between two Poissons, by minimizing log of the integral of p^lambda q^(1-lambda) over lambda using bounded optimization and quadrature. Compare the decay of the simulated Bayes error with sample size against the exponent.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Swerling target detection with noncoherent pulse integration
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the threshold for N integrated square-law pulses by inverting the regularized incomplete gamma function. Evaluate the detection probability for nonfluctuating (Marcum Q) and Swerling I targets and the SNR required for Pd=0.9.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Exact-size randomized Neyman-Pearson test for photon-counting detection
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: For Poisson counts with known background rate, construct the uniformly most powerful randomized test of exact size alpha by searching for the integer threshold and the randomization probability. Compute its power curve versus signal rate.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Minimax detection threshold under unknown prior probabilities
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: For binary Gaussian hypotheses with asymmetric costs, root-find the threshold that equalizes the conditional risks. Compare the minimax Bayes risk curve with the Bayes envelope over the prior.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Likelihood cross-validation versus Silverman bandwidth for bimodal mixtures
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Fit Gaussian kernel density estimates to samples from a bimodal Gaussian mixture, selecting the bandwidth by Silverman's rule and by maximizing the leave-one-out log-likelihood. Evaluate the integrated squared error of each against the true density by quadrature.
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.area: Kernel density estimation and bandwidth selection

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Sheather-Jones solve-the-equation plug-in bandwidth
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Implement the Sheather-Jones bandwidth, estimating the density functionals psi_4 and psi_6 with pilot kernels and solving the fixed-point equation h = [R(K)/(n mu2^2 psi4(g(h)))]^{1/5} by brentq. Compare its variability with that of LSCV.
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.area: Kernel density estimation and bandwidth selection

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Botev diffusion kernel density estimator via DCT fixed point
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Bin the data, take a discrete cosine transform, and solve Botev's improved Sheather-Jones fixed-point equation t = xi gamma^[l](t) by root finding. Evaluate the resulting density and its ISE on multimodal test densities.
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.area: Kernel density estimation and bandwidth selection

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Abramson adaptive variable-bandwidth KDE for heavy-tailed data
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Compute a pilot density estimate, set local bandwidths proportional to pilot^{-1/2}, and iterate the pilot update. Compare the tail and peak errors with fixed-bandwidth KDE for Student-t and lognormal samples.
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.area: Kernel density estimation and bandwidth selection

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Bivariate KDE bandwidth matrix selection by LSCV
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Minimize the closed-form Gaussian LSCV criterion over a full 2x2 bandwidth matrix, parametrized by its Cholesky factor, with Nelder-Mead. Compare the selected matrices and their ISE with diagonal and Scott-rule selectors for correlated data.
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.area: Kernel density estimation and bandwidth selection

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Mean-shift mode finding and cluster count versus bandwidth
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Run the Gaussian mean-shift fixed-point iteration from every data point, merge the converged modes, and count the clusters as a function of bandwidth. Identify the stable plateaus of the count for mixture data.
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.area: Kernel density estimation and bandwidth selection

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Reflection boundary-corrected KDE for exponential lifetimes
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Estimate densities on [0, infinity) with reflection-corrected Gaussian KDE and select the bandwidth by likelihood cross-validation. Compare the boundary bias and the ISE with the uncorrected estimator for exponential and gamma data.
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.area: Kernel density estimation and bandwidth selection

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Von Mises kernel density estimation for circular wind-direction data
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Build a circular KDE with von Mises kernels and select the concentration kappa by maximizing the leave-one-out likelihood with bounded optimization. Compare the selected kappa with a plug-in rule on samples from a mixture of von Mises distributions.
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.area: Kernel density estimation and bandwidth selection

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Von Mises concentration MLE via Bessel-ratio root finding and circular entropy
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Fit the von Mises concentration κ to circular data by solving A1(κ)=I1(κ)/I0(κ)=R̄ with Newton's method safeguarded by bracketing. Then evaluate the closed-form differential entropy and check it against quadrature, with an observed-information confidence interval for κ.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Berrett-Samworth weighted Kozachenko-Leonenko estimator via constrained weight optimization
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Build weighted kNN entropy estimators by solving the linear constraints that cancel leading bias terms, choosing minimum-norm weights by constrained least squares. Compare their bias and MSE with the unweighted KL estimator on 5-10 dimensional Gaussians.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Capacity of (d,k) run-length-limited constrained codes from characteristic roots
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Build the constraint graph of a (d,k)-RLL magnetic-recording code and compute its Shannon capacity log2 λ_max. Obtain λ_max both as the largest adjacency eigenvalue and by bracketing the characteristic polynomial root, then enumerate allowed words to show convergence of log N(n)/n.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Block entropies and excess entropy of the even process epsilon-machine
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Enumerate all words up to length L for the even process (and the golden-mean process for comparison) and compute block entropies H(L) exactly by summing over hidden-state paths. Extract the entropy-rate convergence h(L), the excess entropy, and the statistical complexity of the causal states.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Shannon's telegraph channel: cost-constrained noiseless capacity by bracketing
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: For Morse-like symbols with unequal durations, solve Σ_i 2^{-C t_i}=1 for the capacity C by Brent's method. Derive the optimal symbol probabilities, then verify the result by counting sequences of total duration T with dynamic programming.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Context-tree weighting universal coding of variable-order Markov sources
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Implement Krichevsky-Trofimov estimators and the recursive context-tree weighting mixture over binary context trees of depth D. Compute the code length per symbol for sequences from order-1 to order-3 Markov sources and compare it with the true entropy rate and the theoretical redundancy bound.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Negative binomial dispersion MLE for overdispersed RNA-seq counts by Newton
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Profile out the mean and maximize the negative binomial log-likelihood in the dispersion using Newton iterations with digamma and trigamma derivatives, guarding the Poisson boundary. Report the observed-information standard error and a likelihood-ratio test against the Poisson model.
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.area: Maximum likelihood estimation and Newton methods

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Probit and logit dose-response fitting by Fisher scoring with LD50 intervals
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Fit binomial dose-mortality data with iteratively reweighted least squares (Fisher scoring) for logit and probit links. Compute LD50 with delta-method and Fieller confidence intervals, and compare the deviances of the two links.
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.area: Maximum likelihood estimation and Newton methods

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Dirichlet concentration MLE: Minka fixed-point versus Newton iterations
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Estimate Dirichlet parameters from compositional data, such as microbiome proportions, using Minka's fixed-point iteration with an inverse digamma solved by Newton. Compare it with the full Newton method that exploits the diagonal-plus-rank-one Hessian, reporting convergence rates and Fisher-information standard errors.
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.area: Maximum likelihood estimation and Newton methods

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Michaelis-Menten kinetics: profile-likelihood confidence intervals by bracketing
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Fit Vmax and Km to noisy initial-rate data by Gauss-Newton nonlinear least squares. Find the endpoints of the profile-likelihood interval for Km by Brent root finding on the likelihood-ratio statistic, and compare them with Wald intervals from the observed information.
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.area: Maximum likelihood estimation and Newton methods

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Generalized extreme value fit of annual maxima and return-level profile likelihood
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Maximize the GEV log-likelihood for location, scale and shape using Newton steps with a numerical Hessian, starting from probability-weighted moments. Compute the 100-year return level and its asymmetric profile-likelihood confidence interval by reparametrizing the model and bracketing.
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.area: Maximum likelihood estimation and Newton methods

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Empirical mode decomposition separability of two tones versus frequency ratio
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Implement EMD sifting with cubic-spline extremal envelopes and an SD stopping criterion. Map the region in amplitude-ratio and frequency-ratio space where two summed tones are correctly separated into distinct IMFs, reproducing the Rilling-Flandrin separation boundary.
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.area: Empirical mode decomposition and singular spectrum analysis

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Singular spectrum analysis trend and seasonal extraction with w-correlation grouping
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Embed a synthetic tide-gauge series (trend, annual and semiannual cycles, AR noise) into a trajectory matrix and take its SVD. Group the eigentriples by the w-correlation matrix and reconstruct the components by diagonal averaging, reporting the reconstruction error of each component.
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.area: Empirical mode decomposition and singular spectrum analysis

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Iterative SSA gap filling of missing data by fixed-point reconstruction
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Fill gaps in an oscillatory climate-like series with the Kondrashov-Ghil iterative SSA: initialize the missing values, then alternate rank-r SSA reconstruction with resetting the observed values until convergence. Choose the rank and window length by cross-validation on artificially removed points.
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.area: Empirical mode decomposition and singular spectrum analysis

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Steiglitz-McBride iterative identification of ARMA(2,2) spectra
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Estimate the numerator and denominator coefficients of a rational transfer function from input-output data, or of an ARMA spectrum from an impulse response, by Steiglitz-McBride prefiltered least-squares iterations. Compare the fitted pole and zero locations and the spectral error with those of a one-shot Prony fit.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Quinn-Fernandes iterative single-frequency estimator by repeated AR filtering
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Implement the Quinn-Fernandes fixed-point frequency estimator, which repeatedly filters with a second-order notch and updates by least squares. Compare its variance with the periodogram-maximum estimator and the Cramér-Rao bound across SNRs.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Lomb-Scargle periodogram of an unevenly sampled variable star with peak refinement
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the generalized Lomb-Scargle periodogram with its τ offset for irregularly sampled RR-Lyrae-like light curves. Refine the best period by Brent maximization around the grid peak and compute the false-alarm probability using a Baluev-type bound.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Fundamental-frequency estimation of harmonic signals by nonlinear least squares
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Estimate the pitch of a voiced harmonic signal with unknown amplitudes and phases by maximizing the harmonic-summation NLS cost over a coarse f0 grid followed by golden-section refinement. Handle octave errors and compare the estimates with the harmonic Cramér-Rao bound.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: BCH code weight enumerator by codeword enumeration and MacWilliams identity
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Construct the (15,7) BCH code from its generator polynomial over GF(2) and enumerate all codewords to obtain the weight distribution. Verify the weight distribution of the dual code via the MacWilliams transform, then compute the union-bound block error probability on the BSC.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Extended Hamming (8,4) SECDED decoding and BER on the AWGN channel
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Construct the extended Hamming code in systematic form, build the syndrome table that corrects single errors and detects double errors, and simulate hard-decision BPSK over AWGN. Compare the simulated bit and detected-failure rates with analytic binomial predictions.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Viterbi decoding of the rate-1/2 (7,5) convolutional code
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Implement the trellis and Viterbi algorithm with hard and soft metrics for the constraint-length-3 code, and compute the free distance by searching the state diagram. Compare the simulated AWGN BER with the transfer-function union bound.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Gallager bit-flipping decoding of LDPC codes on the binary symmetric channel
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Construct a Gallager (3,6) parity-check matrix and implement iterative bit-flipping decoding based on unsatisfied-check counts. Measure the frame error rate versus crossover probability and the distribution of iterations to convergence.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: First-order Reed-Muller decoding via the fast Hadamard transform
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Encode messages with RM(1,m) codes and implement maximum-likelihood soft decoding using the fast Walsh-Hadamard transform of the received correlations. Simulate the AWGN BER for m=4 to 6 and verify the minimum distance 2^{m-1}.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Polar code construction by Bhattacharyya recursion with successive cancellation decoding
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Compute synthetic-channel Bhattacharyya parameters by the BEC recursion z→(2z−z², z²), select the information set, and implement recursive successive-cancellation decoding. Compare the frame error rate with the predicted sum of Bhattacharyya parameters.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Minimum distance of random binary linear codes versus Gilbert-Varshamov bound
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Generate random generator matrices and reduce them to systematic form by GF(2) Gaussian elimination. Compute exact minimum distances by enumerating codewords for k≤16 and compare their distribution with the Gilbert-Varshamov and Hamming bounds.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Berlekamp-Massey linear complexity profile of binary sequences
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Implement the Berlekamp-Massey algorithm over GF(2) to find the shortest LFSR generating m-sequences, Legendre sequences and random sequences. Compute linear complexity profiles and compare them with the expected n/2 behavior of random sequences.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Optimal STFT window width for a linear chirp by Rényi entropy minimization
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Compute Gaussian-window spectrograms of a linear chirp and minimize the Rényi-3 time-frequency concentration measure over the window width by golden-section search. Compare the optimum with the analytic σ² ∝ 1/|chirp rate| prediction.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Dynamic-programming ridge extraction of crossing chirps from spectrograms
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Extract instantaneous-frequency curves from noisy spectrograms with a Viterbi-style dynamic program whose cost combines energy and a frequency-jump penalty. Measure tracking error through component crossings as a function of SNR.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Chirp rate and start frequency estimation by dechirped periodogram maximization
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Estimate the parameters of a linear FM pulse by a 2D grid search over the dechirped FFT peak followed by Newton refinement of the joint likelihood. Compare the resulting variances with the chirp Cramér-Rao bounds.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Griffin-Lim phase retrieval from STFT magnitude by alternating projections
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Reconstruct a signal from its STFT magnitude by alternating between consistent STFTs and magnitude replacement. Compare classic Griffin-Lim with its fast momentum variant using spectral convergence and the signal error up to sign.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Gallager random-coding exponent of the BSC by alternating maximization
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Compute Gallager's E0(ρ,Q) for binary symmetric and asymmetric channels and obtain the random-coding exponent Er(R)=max_ρ[E0−ρR] by bracketed maximization over ρ and Arimoto-type updates of Q. Identify the critical rate and the cutoff rate.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Sum-rate of the binary adder multiple-access channel by alternating optimization
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: For the two-user channel Y=X1+X2, maximize I(X1,X2;Y) over product input distributions by coordinate-wise alternating maximization. Compute the corner points of the pentagonal capacity region and compare with the known 1.5-bit sum capacity.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Zero-error capacity of the pentagon via independence numbers of strong graph powers
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the independence numbers of the strong powers of C5 by branch-and-bound clique search on the complement graph to show that α(C5⊠C5)=5. Compare the resulting lower bound √5 with the bounds from confusability graphs of other small channels.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: EKF bearings-only target tracking and NEES filter consistency
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Track a constant-velocity target from a maneuvering observer that measures only bearings, using an extended Kalman filter with an analytic Jacobian. Evaluate the normalized estimation error squared and RMSE over Monte Carlo runs against the posterior Cramér-Rao bound.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: UKF joint state and parameter estimation for the Van der Pol oscillator
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Augment the Van der Pol state with the nonlinearity parameter μ and run an unscented Kalman filter with scaled sigma points on noisy position measurements. Report the convergence of the μ estimate and compare the state RMSE with that of an EKF.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Iterated extended Kalman filter as Gauss-Newton for range-only localization
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Implement the IEKF measurement update as Gauss-Newton iterations on the MAP cost for range measurements to multiple beacons. Compare the bias and consistency of the IEKF with those of the single-step EKF when the initial uncertainty is large.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Extended Kalman filter tracking of SIR epidemic states from case counts
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Discretize the SIR ODEs with the transmission rate as a random-walk state and linearize them via Jacobians. Filter noisy daily incidence data to estimate the effective reproduction number R_t with credible bands.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Steady-state Kalman gain via discrete algebraic Riccati fixed-point iteration
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Iterate the Riccati recursion to convergence for a tracking model with constant-acceleration (Singer-type) dynamics, and verify the result against the doubling algorithm and scipy's solver. Report the steady-state gain, error covariance and convergence rate as functions of the process-to-measurement noise ratio.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Whittle likelihood estimation of ARMA(1,1) parameters by quasi-Newton optimization
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Form the periodogram of a simulated ARMA(1,1) series and minimize the Whittle negative log-likelihood under a stationarity and invertibility reparametrization. Compare the estimates and their asymptotic covariance with exact Gaussian MLE.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Valiant unseen estimator: entropy and support size by linear programming
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: From the fingerprint of samples of a large-alphabet distribution (uniform or Zipf), solve an LP for a histogram of probability masses whose expected fingerprint matches the observed one. Read the entropy and support-size estimates off the LP solution and compare their bias with the plug-in estimator.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Jensen-Shannon centroid of word-frequency histograms via concave-convex fixed point
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the distribution that minimizes the average Jensen-Shannon divergence to a set of categorical histograms. Use the CCCP fixed-point iteration, verify that the objective decreases monotonically, and compare the result with the arithmetic and normalized geometric means.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Generalized dimensions of a two-scale Cantor measure from the Moran equation
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: For a self-similar measure with unequal contraction ratios and weights, solve sum_i p_i^q l_i^{-tau} = 1 for tau(q) by bracketing root finding. Obtain the Rényi dimensions D_q and the multifractal spectrum f(alpha) by Legendre transform, and check them against box-counting on the generated measure.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Tsallis q-maximum-entropy distribution under an escort energy constraint
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Maximize the Tsallis entropy on a discrete energy spectrum subject to a fixed escort-averaged energy. Solve the self-consistent q-exponential form by fixed-point iteration plus root finding for the Lagrange multiplier, and study convergence and the q→1 Boltzmann limit.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Bayes-optimal sequential test by backward induction versus Wald's SPRT
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: For Bernoulli observations with a per-sample cost and losses for wrong decisions, compute the optimal stopping boundaries on the posterior probability by dynamic programming over a truncated horizon. Compare the Bayes risk and average sample number with an SPRT whose thresholds are tuned by grid search.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: GLR CUSUM for an unknown post-change Gaussian mean with threshold calibration
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Implement the windowed generalized likelihood ratio change detector, which maximizes over both the change time and the post-change mean. Calibrate the threshold by bisection to a target false-alarm ARL estimated by Monte Carlo, and compare detection delays with CUSUMs tuned to fixed mean shifts.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Bayesian blocks optimal segmentation of photon arrival times
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Apply Scargle's Bayesian blocks O(N^2) dynamic program, with the Cash fitness and a false-positive-calibrated prior, to piecewise-constant Poisson event data from a flaring source. Return the change points and block rates and their accuracy against the injected light curve.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Recursive Jensen-Shannon segmentation of compositionally heterogeneous DNA
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Segment a synthetic DNA sequence made of domains with different base composition. At each step pick the cut that maximizes the Jensen-Shannon divergence, recursing while the significance threshold is met (Bernaola-Galván method), and report the recovered domain boundaries.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Alignment mutual information with APC and Nussinov selection of RNA base pairs
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Compute column-pair mutual information with the average product correction for a simulated alignment of a covarying RNA hairpin family. Choose a nested set of base pairs that maximizes the total corrected MI with a Nussinov dynamic program, and score precision against the true structure.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Schneider small-sample correction e(n) for sequence logos by composition enumeration
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the exact expected entropy of n nucleotides drawn from a given background by enumerating all base-count compositions with multinomial weights. Compare the result with the Miller-Madow approximation and use it to correct the information content of a logo built from a few binding sites.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: t-SNE input bandwidths by perplexity-matching bisection
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: For each point in a Gaussian-cluster dataset, find the Gaussian kernel bandwidth whose conditional distribution has a prescribed perplexity 2^H by bisection on the entropy. Report the resulting symmetric affinity matrix and how the bandwidths vary with local density.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Exact two-sample permutation test by full enumeration versus Monte Carlo
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: For small samples, enumerate all group relabelings to get the exact permutation distribution of the difference in means and its p-value. Compare the result with Monte Carlo permutation p-values and their binomial error, and with the Welch t-test.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Politis-White automatic block length for the stationary bootstrap of AR(1) data
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Estimate the MSE-optimal expected block length from flat-top lag-window spectral estimates, with the adaptive bandwidth chosen by the autocorrelation-significance rule. Check the resulting stationary-bootstrap variance of the sample mean against the exact long-run variance.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Empirical likelihood confidence interval for a mean via Lagrange multiplier root finding
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Compute Owen's empirical likelihood ratio for a candidate mean by solving the Lagrange-multiplier equation with safeguarded Newton. Bracket the chi-square-calibrated interval endpoints, and compare coverage with the t and percentile-bootstrap intervals for skewed exponential data.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Iterative adaptive approach spectral estimation of closely spaced sinusoids
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Apply the IAA weighted least-squares fixed-point iteration on a fine frequency grid to a short noisy multi-tone record. Compare its resolution and leakage suppression with the periodogram, and track convergence of the power estimates.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Darbellay-Vajda adaptive partitioning mutual information estimator
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Estimate mutual information by recursive equiprobable quadrisection of the rank-transformed plane, stopping when a chi-square uniformity test passes. Compare the estimates with the Gaussian closed form on correlated Gaussians and with fixed-bin histograms.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Maximal information coefficient by dynamic programming over grid partitions
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Compute MIC for noisy functional relationships (linear, parabolic, sinusoidal) by optimizing the y-axis partition with a DP over x-axis partitions under the grid-size bound B(n). Compare the scores with the mutual information on the same data.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Chow-Liu maximum-likelihood tree from pairwise mutual information
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Estimate all pairwise mutual informations from samples of a binary tree-structured graphical model and build the maximum-weight spanning tree with Kruskal's algorithm. Report the edge-recovery rate as a function of sample size and the log-likelihood of the fitted tree.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Kapur maximum-entropy and Rényi-entropy thresholding of a bimodal histogram
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Choose an image intensity threshold by exhaustive search for the maximum of the summed class entropies (Shannon and Rényi order alpha). Compare the thresholds with Otsu's and their misclassification rates on a synthetic two-Gaussian histogram.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: BCJR MAP decoding of a recursive systematic convolutional code
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Encode with the rate-1/2 (1, 5/7) RSC code, transmit over BPSK-AWGN, and decode with the log-domain forward-backward BCJR algorithm. Produce LLR histograms and BER curves compared with hard and soft Viterbi decoding.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Deterministic information bottleneck hard clustering of a discrete joint distribution
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Run the Strouse-Schwab deterministic IB iteration, which assigns hard clusters with an entropy cost, on a structured p(x,y). Trace the H(T) versus I(T;Y) tradeoff over beta and compare it with the curve from the standard soft IB.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Huffman coding redundancy for geometric and Zipf sources versus entropy
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Build Huffman codes with a heap-based merge, compute the expected length and the redundancy relative to the entropy for geometric and Zipf sources, and check the result against Gallager's p_max redundancy bound. Repeat for block extensions of the source.

math/info_stats|opt_discrete.title: Wiggins minimum entropy deconvolution of a blurred seismic reflectivity series
math/info_stats|opt_discrete.gist: Design an FIR filter that maximizes the varimax (kurtosis) norm of the output by fixed-point iteration of Toeplitz normal equations, recovering a sparse reflectivity from a trace convolved with a wavelet. Report convergence and the correlation of the recovered spikes with the true reflectivity.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: 2D Yee FDTD of an oscillating line current: radiated power
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the 2D TM Maxwell equations on a staggered Yee grid with an absorbing boundary and a harmonic line-current source. Compute the time-averaged Poynting flux through a closed contour and compare it with the analytic Hankel-function line-source power.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: 3D FDTD Hertzian dipole: angular pattern and Larmor power
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve 3D Maxwell equations with a Yee scheme and first-order Mur absorbing boundaries for a small oscillating dipole current. Extract the far-field sin^2(theta) angular distribution and the total radiated power, and compare them with the Larmor/dipole formula.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Lorenz-gauge grid potentials of a circulating charge: harmonic power spectrum
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the inhomogeneous wave equations for phi and A, with a smoothed charge moving on a circular orbit at moderate beta, using leapfrog finite differences on a 3D grid. Decompose the far-zone radiated power into harmonics of the orbital frequency and compare with the Schott/Liénard-Wiechert result.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: FDTD Cherenkov cone from a superluminal charge in a dielectric
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Drive 2D/3D FDTD Maxwell equations in a uniform dielectric of index n with a Gaussian charge moving at v > c/n. Measure the shock-cone half-angle from the field pattern and compare it with cos(theta) = 1/(n*beta).

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Axisymmetric r-z FDTD of transition radiation at a conductor
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Use a cylindrical (r,z) Yee scheme to evolve the fields of a relativistic charge that strikes a perfectly conducting plane. Extract the backward angular spectrum of the emitted pulse and compare it with the Ginzburg-Frank transition radiation formula.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Steady WNM-CNM conduction front and saturation pressure
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the steady 1D energy equation with thermal conduction and net cooling as a boundary-value problem by finite-difference Newton relaxation. Find the pressure at which the front between the two stable phases is stationary, and the corresponding Field length.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Spherical cloud evaporation by saturated Spitzer conduction
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the nonlinear spherical heat-conduction equation with kappa proportional to T^{5/2} and a saturation flux limiter, using implicit finite differences around a cold cloud in hot gas. Compute the evaporative mass-loss rate and compare it with the Cowie-McKee classical result.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: H/H2 transition depth in a photodissociation region slab
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the steady 1D depth-dependent H2 formation/photodissociation balance with dust attenuation and Draine-Bertoldi self-shielding by relaxation on a column-density grid. Compute the transition column versus G0/n and compare it with the Sternberg analytic estimate.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Cosmic-ray penetration and ionization profile in a molecular cloud
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the steady diffusion-energy-loss transport equation for low-energy cosmic-ray protons entering a 1D cloud, using finite differences in column and energy. Compute the ionization rate profile versus column density.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Thermal free-free radio spectrum of a spherical HII region
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Compute the free-free emission and absorption coefficients with Gaunt factor for a model density profile. Solve the transfer equation along impact-parameter rays on a grid and integrate the total flux density, giving the turnover frequency and the nu^2 to nu^{-0.1} transition.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Supernova remnant from Sedov-Taylor to snowplow terminal momentum
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve 1D spherical finite-volume hydrodynamics with radiative cooling for a point explosion in a uniform ISM. Verify R proportional to t^{2/5} in the adiabatic stage, find the shell-formation time, and measure the asymptotic radial momentum.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Semi-Lagrangian Liouville evolution of a resonance pendulum: phase mixing
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve the phase-space density of a pendulum (resonance) Hamiltonian with a split-step semi-Lagrangian scheme. Compute the coarse-grained entropy growth and the filamentation rate inside and near the separatrix.
physics/fields_astro|pde.area: Chaos and Lyapunov exponents in celestial mechanics

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Finite-time Lyapunov exponent field of a spectral Kelvin-Helmholtz flow
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve 2D incompressible vorticity with a pseudo-spectral solver for a shear layer. Advect tracer grids and compute the finite-time Lyapunov exponent field from the flow-map Cauchy-Green tensor, identifying Lagrangian coherent structures and the mean stretching rate.
physics/fields_astro|pde.area: Chaos and Lyapunov exponents in celestial mechanics

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Self-similar disk evolution with power-law viscosity: accretion rate decay
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve a disk with nu proportional to R^gamma from a similarity-profile initial condition using implicit finite differences. Measure the late-time decay exponent of the accretion rate and the outer-radius growth, and compare them with the Lynden-Bell-Pringle similarity solution.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Dwarf nova thermal-viscous limit cycle with an S-curve
