physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve a 1D disk with a bistable alpha-viscosity S-curve (hot/cold branches with critical surface densities) and mass input at the outer edge. Compute the outburst recurrence time, duration and heating/cooling front propagation speed.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Planet-induced gap depth in a viscous disk
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Add a parameterized planetary tidal torque density to the 1D viscous disk equation and evolve it with finite volumes to steady state. Measure the gap depth versus planet mass, aspect ratio and alpha, and compare with the Kanagawa et al. scaling.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Photoevaporative disk dispersal: viscous evolution plus EUV wind
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the viscous diffusion equation with a radially dependent EUV photoevaporation sink term. Determine when the inner gap opens near the gravitational radius and the subsequent inner-hole clearing time.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Time-dependent multicolor blackbody SED of a spreading ring
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve Sigma(R,t) for a spreading ring and compute the local effective temperature from the viscous dissipation rate. Integrate annular Planck spectra to obtain the evolving SED, peak frequency and bolometric light curve.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Fed accretion disk: approach to steady state and inner torque condition
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve a disk with constant mass injection at an outer ring, comparing zero-torque and finite-torque inner boundary conditions. Compute the time to reach steady accretion and the final T_eff(R) against the Shakura-Sunyaev profile.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Dust radial drift and diffusion in a protoplanetary gas disk
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the advection-diffusion equation for dust surface density with Stokes-number-dependent drift velocity, using a conservative upwind finite-volume scheme on a background gas disk. Compute the pebble mass flux and the dust-to-gas ratio evolution.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Bardeen-Petterson alignment of a warped disk
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve Pringle's warped-disk equation for the angular-momentum tilt vector with Lense-Thirring precession, using implicit finite differences to reach steady state. Compute the alignment (transition) radius versus spin and viscosity ratio.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Vertical structure of an alpha disk with radiative diffusion
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the coupled vertical hydrostatic, radiative diffusion and local viscous heating equations as a two-point BVP by finite-difference relaxation with Kramers opacity. Compute the midplane temperature, density and photospheric height versus radius.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Radial transport of large-scale magnetic flux in accretion disks
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the advection-diffusion equation for the poloidal flux function in a thin disk with inward accretion velocity and turbulent resistivity, using finite volumes. Compute the steady flux distribution and how flux retention depends on the magnetic Prandtl number.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Double-null characteristic evolution on Reissner-Nordström: QNMs versus charge
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Use the Gundlach-Price-Pullin diamond-cell integration scheme in (u,v) null coordinates for scalar perturbations of a charged black hole. Extract the ringdown frequency as a function of Q/M.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Choptuik critical scalar-field collapse mass scaling
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve the spherically symmetric Einstein-Klein-Gordon system in polar-areal coordinates with method-of-lines finite differences. Bisect the initial amplitude to the collapse threshold and fit the black-hole mass scaling exponent (about 0.37).

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Bona-Masso gauge shocks in 1+1 vacuum slicing
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve the 1+1 ADM lapse and extrinsic-curvature system with Bona-Masso slicing f(alpha) in flat spacetime using a high-resolution finite-volume scheme. Detect the gauge-shock formation time and compare it with the characteristic-crossing prediction.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Bowen-York puncture initial data: Hamiltonian constraint and ADM mass
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the elliptic puncture equation for the conformal-factor correction u in axisymmetry for a spinning or boosted Bowen-York hole, using finite differences with Newton iteration and SOR or multigrid. Compute the ADM mass versus momentum or spin.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Schwarzschild-de Sitter ringdown and exponential late-time decay
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve scalar or Regge-Wheeler perturbations on a Schwarzschild-de Sitter background between the horizons with finite differences. Extract the QNM frequency versus Lambda M^2 and show that the late-time signal decays exponentially rather than as a power law.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Massive scalar field on Schwarzschild: oscillatory t^{-5/6} tail
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve the Klein-Gordon field with mass mu on a Schwarzschild tortoise grid. Identify the intermediate t^{-(l+3/2)} and asymptotic oscillatory t^{-5/6} tails, and the oscillation frequency approaching mu.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Parker wind via time-dependent relaxation of an isothermal corona
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve 1D spherical isothermal hydrodynamics from a hydrostatic corona with open outer boundaries. Show that it relaxes to the transonic Parker solution, and compute the sonic point and mass-loss rate against the Lambert-W analytic wind.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: CAK line-driven wind from time-dependent radial hydrodynamics
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve 1D spherical hydrodynamics with Sobolev CAK line acceleration (k, alpha) and a finite-disk correction. Relax to steady state and compute the mass-loss rate, terminal velocity and beta-law fit.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Hydrodynamic atmospheric escape from an irradiated hot Jupiter
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve a 1D spherical atmosphere with XUV photoionization heating (attenuated by column), Lyman-alpha cooling and hydrogen ionization balance to a steady transonic outflow. Compute the mass-loss rate and its efficiency relative to the energy-limited estimate.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Neutron-star radial pulsation modes and onset of instability
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Build TOV polytropic backgrounds and discretize the Chandrasekhar radial-pulsation Sturm-Liouville problem with finite differences. Compute omega^2 of the fundamental mode along the sequence and show that it vanishes at the maximum mass.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Cowling-approximation f-mode frequency of neutron stars
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Discretize the nonradial l=2 relativistic Cowling perturbation equations on a TOV background as a finite-difference generalized eigenproblem. Compute the f-mode frequency versus mean density and fit the sqrt(M/R^3) universal relation.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Neutron-star crust thermal relaxation after an accretion outburst
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the 1D heat equation with GR redshift factors, a density-dependent conductivity and deep-crustal heating in the crust of a TOV star using implicit finite differences. Compute the post-outburst surface temperature cooling curve.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Ohmic decay of crustal magnetic fields in neutron stars
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the radial induction-diffusion equation for an l=1 poloidal field with a depth-dependent electrical conductivity in the crust, using Crank-Nicolson. Compute the dipole decay timescale and how it depends on impurity parameter and temperature.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Hachisu self-consistent-field rotating polytropes and mass shedding
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Iterate the Hachisu SCF method with a 2D (r, mu) Legendre/finite-difference Poisson solver for uniformly rotating polytropes. Compute the sequences of angular velocity versus axis ratio up to the mass-shedding limit.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Tidal Love number k2 from a finite-difference static perturbation BVP
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Discretize the static l=2 metric-perturbation equation on a TOV polytropic background as a linear system instead of shooting. Compute k2 and the dimensionless tidal deformability Lambda versus compactness.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Henyey relaxation for a zero-age main-sequence star
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the four stellar-structure equations with power-law opacity and nuclear energy generation by Henyey Newton-Raphson relaxation on a mass grid. Compute the luminosity and radius versus mass, and the main-sequence scaling exponents.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Gaussian random density field and sigma8 by Fourier-grid filtering
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Generate a 3D Gaussian random field on an FFT grid from a power spectrum with the BBKS or Eisenstein-Hu transfer function. Compute sigma(R) by top-hat filtering, normalize to sigma8, and compare with direct quadrature including box-size effects.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Excursion-set first-crossing via diffusion with an absorbing barrier
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the Fokker-Planck diffusion equation in variance S for the smoothed overdensity with an absorbing barrier at delta_c, using finite differences. Compute the first-crossing distribution and the Press-Schechter halo mass function, including the factor of two.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Fuzzy dark matter growth suppression via split-step Schrödinger-Poisson
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve the 1D comoving Schrödinger-Poisson system with a pseudo-spectral split-step method in an expanding background. Measure the linear growth of perturbation modes and the suppression below the quantum Jeans scale.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Zel'dovich pancake collapse with comoving 1D hydrodynamics
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve a single sine-wave perturbation of baryons with comoving finite-volume hydrodynamics and a Poisson solve. Verify the Zel'dovich solution before caustic formation, then locate the accretion shocks and the temperature profile after shell crossing.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: 2D particle-mesh simulation: power spectrum growth versus linear theory
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Run a 2D cosmological particle-mesh code with CIC deposition and an FFT Poisson solver from Zel'dovich initial conditions. Measure the power spectrum growth versus the linear growth factor D(a) and the onset of nonlinearity.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Massive neutrino free-streaming via 1D comoving Vlasov-Poisson
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve a hot neutrino phase-space distribution together with a cold dark matter fluid using a semi-Lagrangian Vlasov solver and an FFT Poisson solver. Compute the scale-dependent growth suppression and the free-streaming scale.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Excursion-set reionization bubbles on a 3D density grid
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Apply 21cmFAST-style real-space top-hat filtering on an FFT grid to a Gaussian density field with an ionizing efficiency zeta. Compute the ionized fraction versus redshift and the bubble size distribution.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Kaiser-Squires mass reconstruction from weak-lensing shear
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Compute convergence and shear for an NFW cluster lens through the 2D lensing Poisson equation solved by FFT. Invert noisy shear back to convergence with Kaiser-Squires and quantify the reconstruction error and the mass-sheet degeneracy.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Hockney zero-padded FFT potential of a homogeneous triaxial ellipsoid
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Compute the isolated-boundary potential of a uniform triaxial ellipsoid by FFT convolution with a doubled-domain Green's function. Compare it with the analytic interior quadratic potential from Chandrasekhar's index integrals.
physics/fields_astro|pde.area: Gravitational potential theory and Poisson solvers

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Multigrid V-cycle Poisson solver for a Hernquist sphere
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Implement a 3D geometric multigrid solver with a Gauss-Seidel smoother and multipole boundary values for a Hernquist density. Measure the convergence factor per cycle and the error against the analytic potential.
physics/fields_astro|pde.area: Gravitational potential theory and Poisson solvers

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Spherical-harmonic multipole Poisson solver for a Miyamoto-Nagai disk
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Expand the density on a spherical (r, theta) grid into Legendre multipoles and solve the radial Green's-function integrals. Compute the potential and vertical force errors versus l_max against the analytic Miyamoto-Nagai potential.
physics/fields_astro|pde.area: Gravitational potential theory and Poisson solvers

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Particle-mesh force accuracy with CIC and TSC assignment
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Measure the two-particle force from a periodic 3D PM solver with NGP, CIC and TSC mass assignment and Green's-function deconvolution. Compare with direct summation and characterize the force error and anisotropy versus separation in grid cells.
physics/fields_astro|pde.area: Gravitational potential theory and Poisson solvers

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Gravitational Jeans instability in 1D Vlasov-Poisson
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve a self-gravitating Maxwellian phase-space distribution with a split-step semi-Lagrangian Vlasov solver and an FFT Poisson solver. Measure growth rates above the kinetic Jeans length and gravitational Landau damping rates below it.
physics/fields_astro|pde.area: Gravitational potential theory and Poisson solvers

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Isothermal Jeans instability in 2D self-gravitating hydrodynamics
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Combine 2D finite-volume isothermal hydrodynamics with periodic FFT gravity for a perturbed uniform medium. Measure the linear growth rate versus wavenumber and compare it with the Jeans dispersion relation.
physics/fields_astro|pde.area: Gravitational potential theory and Poisson solvers

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Potential of a thick torus by SOR in cylindrical coordinates
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the axisymmetric Poisson equation for a uniform-density torus on an (R,z) grid using successive over-relaxation and multipole boundary conditions. Compare with the ring-integrated elliptic-integral potential.
physics/fields_astro|pde.area: Gravitational potential theory and Poisson solvers

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Ferrers bar potential by 3D FFT: corotation Lagrange points
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Compute the potential of a Ferrers n=2 bar plus a spherical bulge with a zero-padded FFT Poisson solver. Locate the L1 to L5 equilibrium points in the rotating frame and their stability from the effective-potential Hessian.
physics/fields_astro|pde.area: Gravitational potential theory and Poisson solvers

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Oort cloud comet energy diffusion through planetary kicks
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve a Fokker-Planck equation in Keplerian binding energy x = 1/a, with a planetary-perturbation diffusion coefficient and ejection and capture boundaries. Compute the steady flux of long-period comets and the fraction ejected versus captured.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Cohn-Kulsrud loss-cone flux and tidal disruption rate
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the orbit-averaged angular-momentum diffusion equation near the loss cone of a supermassive black hole with finite differences. Compute the empty- to full-loss-cone transition and the tidal disruption rate per energy.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Bahcall-Wolf cusp from the energy-space Fokker-Planck equation
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve the isotropic Fokker-Planck equation in Keplerian orbital energy for stars around a massive black hole with a Chang-Cooper scheme. Recover the f proportional to E^{1/4} (n proportional to r^{-7/4}) steady cusp and its relaxation time.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: 1D mean-field alpha-Omega dynamo: critical dynamo number and wave period
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the coupled mean-field induction equations for A and B in a slab with finite differences and vacuum boundaries. Determine the critical dynamo number from growth rates and the dynamo-wave period and migration direction.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Solar surface flux transport and polar field reversal
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve the radial field on the sphere with differential rotation, meridional flow and supergranular diffusion, using finite volumes in latitude with Joy's-law bipole sources. Compute the polar field reversal time over a cycle.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Ambipolar diffusion of magnetic flux from a molecular cloud slab
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the nonlinear diffusion equation for B in a 1D partially ionized slab with ion density proportional to the square root of the neutral density, using an implicit scheme. Compute the flux-loss timescale versus ionization fraction.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Resistive tearing-mode growth rate by finite-difference eigenproblem
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Discretize the linearized incompressible resistive MHD equations about a Harris current sheet as a generalized eigenvalue problem. Compute the growth rate versus wavenumber and verify the eta^{3/5} scaling.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: 1D FDTD of an EM pulse in a Drude plasma slab
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve Maxwell equations coupled to a cold-plasma current ODE with a Yee scheme for a broadband pulse incident on an ionized slab. Compute the reflection and transmission spectra and the cutoff at the plasma frequency.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Grad-Shafranov magnetostatic coronal arcade equilibrium
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the nonlinear Grad-Shafranov equation for a 2D sheared force-free arcade by Newton-SOR iteration. Compute the field-line apex height and magnetic energy versus shear, and detect loss of equilibrium.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Alfvén wave transmission through a stratified solar atmosphere
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve the linear Alfvén wave equations through an exponentially stratified chromosphere-corona with a transition region using finite differences. Compute the energy transmission coefficient versus frequency.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Marshak radiation wave with flux-limited diffusion
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the coupled nonlinear radiation and matter energy equations with Levermore-Pomraning flux limiting using implicit finite differences. Compute the propagation of the radiation front into a cold slab and compare it with the Su-Olson benchmark.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Bonnor-Ebert sphere collapse with Lagrangian hydrodynamics
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve 1D spherical isothermal Lagrangian hydrodynamics with self-gravity from a perturbed supercritical Bonnor-Ebert sphere. Measure the r^{-2} density profile and the infall velocity, and compare them with the Larson-Penston solution.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Lightman-Eardley radiation-pressure instability limit cycle in inner alpha disks
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve the coupled 1D surface-density and thermal-energy equations of an alpha disk with gas plus radiation pressure using an implicit finite-difference scheme. Compute the limit-cycle period and the luminosity burst amplitude when the inner disk becomes radiation-pressure dominated.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Be-star viscous decretion disk build-up and dissipation
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the viscous diffusion equation for an outflowing disk with mass injected near the stellar surface and a zero-torque outer boundary. Compute the time evolution of the density slope and the disk mass during the build-up and dissipation phases.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Infall-fed protostellar disk growth and Toomre Q evolution
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve a viscous disk that receives mass from a collapsing rotating Shu-Ulrich cloud as a radial source term, using a finite-volume diffusion solver. Compute the disk mass, accretion rate and minimum Toomre Q as functions of time.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Layered dead-zone disk with gravo-magneto FU Orionis outbursts
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Use a 1D two-layer disk model with an MRI-active surface layer and a dead zone that switches on above a critical temperature. Evolve it with implicit diffusion and compute the outburst recurrence time, peak accretion rate and mass accreted per outburst.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Propagating fluctuations in a stochastic-alpha disk: rms-flux relation
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve a viscous disk in which alpha is driven by independent radius-dependent stochastic processes. Compute the power spectrum of the inner accretion rate and the linear rms-flux relation.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Water snow line vapor diffusion and ice condensation enhancement
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve coupled advection-diffusion equations for water vapor and icy pebbles in a protoplanetary disk, with sublimation and condensation source terms at the snow line. Compute the steady ice-to-gas enhancement factor just outside the snow line.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Fallback-fed viscous disk light curve of a tidal disruption event
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve a viscous ring and disk fed at the circularization radius with a t^-5/3 fallback rate and an inner zero-torque boundary. Compute the bolometric and band light curves and find when the late-time decay departs from t^-5/3.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Thin-wire 3D FDTD half-wave dipole input impedance versus frequency
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Model a center-fed thin-wire dipole on a 3D Yee grid with a delta-gap voltage source and absorbing boundaries. Compute the input impedance from Fourier-transformed gap voltage and current, then find the resonant length and radiation resistance (about 73 ohms).

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Beam steering of a phased line-source array in 2D FDTD
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Drive an N-element array of line currents with progressive phase delays on a 2D TMz Yee grid with PML. Extract the far-field pattern by near-to-far transformation, then compare the main-lobe angle and sidelobe levels with the analytic array factor.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Two-element driven-reflector Yagi in 2D FDTD: front-to-back ratio
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Simulate a driven line current next to a parasitic conducting strip on a 2D Yee grid. Compute the radiation pattern and the front-to-back ratio as a function of element spacing and reflector length.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Dipole radiation over a lossy ground half-space via 2D FDTD
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Model a vertical line-current source above a finite-conductivity ground, using conductive Yee updates and PML. Compute how the elevation pattern and the ground-wave attenuation with distance depend on the ground conductivity.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Radial l=2 wave equation from a rotating bar: strain versus quadrupole formula
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the sourced linearized Einstein equation for the l=2 multipole of h on a 1D radial grid with outgoing boundaries, for a rotating Newtonian bar. Compute the far-zone strain amplitude and radiated power and compare them with the quadrupole formula.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Spectral 3D linearized-gravity evolution with transverse-traceless projection
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve a Gaussian metric perturbation pulse on a periodic 3D grid with a Fourier pseudospectral wave solver. Apply the TT projector in k-space and compute the energy flux and how well the gauge and trace constraints are preserved.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Wave-optics gravitational lensing of GWs by a point mass
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Propagate a monochromatic scalar wave through an effective refractive index 1-2Φ on a 2D grid, using a split-step paraxial solver. Compute the amplification factor as a function of frequency and compare it with the analytic point-lens hypergeometric result.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Zerilli radiation from a particle plunging radially into Schwarzschild
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the sourced Zerilli equation in tortoise coordinates by finite differences, with a regularized point-particle source. Compute the l=2 waveform and the radiated energy, then compare it with the Davis-Ruffini-Press value.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Gravitomagnetic field of a rotating shell and Lense-Thirring precession
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the vector Poisson equation for the gravitomagnetic potential of a slowly rotating massive shell on a grid using SOR or FFT. Compute the frame-dragging angular velocity inside and outside the shell and compare it with the analytic result.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Helium gravitational settling in the Sun over 4.6 Gyr
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the diffusion-advection equation for the helium mass fraction on a fixed solar structure grid, using Burgers-type settling velocities and an implicit scheme. Compute the surface helium depletion and the interior gradient beneath the convection zone.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Lithium depletion by convective-envelope mixing and burning
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve a reaction-diffusion equation for lithium in a low-mass main-sequence star, with fast mixing in the convective envelope, exponential overshoot diffusion and temperature-dependent proton capture. Compute surface lithium as a function of age and overshoot parameter.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Kappa-mechanism instability of a Cepheid envelope radial mode
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the linear nonadiabatic radial pulsation equations of a model envelope with Kramers-type opacity bumps as a complex finite-difference eigenproblem. Compute the growth rate of the fundamental mode as a function of effective temperature to locate the instability strip edge.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Thermally unstable two-phase gas from converging flows
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Use 1D hydrodynamics of colliding warm neutral medium flows with Koyama-Inutsuka heating and cooling and thermal conduction, solved with a finite-volume solver and implicit source terms. Compute the cold-gas mass fraction and the cold-cloud size distribution as functions of time.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Lyman-alpha escape from a static slab via frequency-space diffusion
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the Neufeld diffusion equation for resonant Lyα photons in coupled space and frequency on a 2D grid. Compute the emergent double-peaked spectrum and the peak separation, and compare them with the analytic Neufeld solution.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Turbulent mixing layer between hot and cold gas: cooling flux
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve a 1D steady diffusion-cooling equation for a turbulent mixing layer between 10^6 K and 10^4 K gas as a relaxation eigenvalue problem for the mass inflow velocity. Compute how the inflow velocity and the column-integrated cooling scale with turbulent diffusivity.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Steady cooling flow onto a galaxy-cluster center
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Relax time-dependent spherical hydrodynamics with optically thin bremsstrahlung and line cooling in an NFW potential toward a steady state. Compute the mass deposition rate and the temperature and density profiles.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Laminar carbon deflagration speed in degenerate C/O matter
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the 1D reaction-diffusion equations for temperature and carbon fraction, with degenerate electron conduction and a 12C+12C rate. Compute the steady flame speed and flame width as functions of density.
physics/fields_astro|pde.area: White dwarf structure and degenerate matter

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Nova ignition mass from accreted hydrogen envelope heat diffusion
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve the thermal structure of a hydrogen envelope accreting onto a white dwarf, with compressional heating, CNO burning and implicit heat diffusion in column-depth coordinates. Compute the ignition mass as a function of accretion rate and white dwarf mass.
physics/fields_astro|pde.area: White dwarf structure and degenerate matter

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Relativistic Michel accretion via time-dependent GR hydrodynamics
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve spherical relativistic hydrodynamics on a Schwarzschild background with an HLL finite-volume scheme in horizon-penetrating coordinates. Compute the steady accretion rate and sonic radius and compare them with the analytic Michel solution.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Dust-driven AGB wind from coupled gas-dust radial hydrodynamics
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Use two-fluid spherical hydrodynamics with radiation pressure on dust and gas-dust drag coupling, solved with a finite-volume scheme. Compute the terminal velocity, the mass-loss rate and the gas-dust drift velocity.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Gravothermal catastrophe of a globular cluster: conducting-gas model
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the Lynden-Bell-Eggleton gravothermal fluid equations for a Plummer sphere using a Lagrangian implicit scheme. Compute the core-collapse time and the self-similar core density-radius slope (about -2.2).

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Self-interacting dark matter halo gravothermal core formation and collapse
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve the gravothermal conduction equations for an NFW halo with combined short- and long-mean-free-path SIDM conductivity. Compute the core formation time, the maximum core size and the onset of core collapse versus cross-section.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Vertical phase-space spiral in a perturbed galactic disk via 1D Vlasov
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the 1D vertical Vlasov equation with a semi-Lagrangian scheme in an isothermal-sheet potential after an impulsive satellite kick. Compute the winding of the z-vz spiral and estimate the time since perturbation from the spiral pitch.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: 2D TMz FDTD with convolutional PML: reflection versus grading
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Implement CPML with polynomial grading on a 2D Yee grid and launch a pulse at the boundary. Compute the reflection error as a function of PML thickness, grading order and maximum conductivity.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: 3D FDTD rectangular metal cavity resonances
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Excite a PEC-walled box on a 3D Yee grid with a broadband pulse and Fourier-analyze the probe fields. Compute the TE/TM resonant frequencies and compare their discretization error with the analytic modes.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Bragg-stack photonic band gap from 1D FDTD transmission
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Propagate a broadband pulse through a periodic dielectric multilayer with absorbing boundaries. Compute the transmission spectrum, band-gap edges and gap depth versus number of periods, and compare them with the transfer-matrix result.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Schumann resonances of the Earth-ionosphere cavity via spherical-shell FDTD
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve Maxwell's equations in a 2D axisymmetric spherical shell between a conducting Earth and a lossy ionosphere, excited by a lightning source. Compute the lowest resonance frequencies and Q factors.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Finite-difference frequency-domain modes of a dielectric-loaded waveguide
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Assemble the FDFD sparse eigenproblem on a Yee cross-section grid for a partially dielectric-filled rectangular waveguide. Compute the cutoff frequencies and the propagation constants of the lowest modes.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Shu inside-out collapse of a singular isothermal sphere
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve a slightly overdense singular isothermal sphere with 1D Lagrangian hydrodynamics and self-gravity. Compute the central accretion rate in units of c_s^3/G and compare it with the Shu value 0.975 and the Larson-Penston limit.
physics/fields_astro|pde.area: Self-gravitating gas spheres and star formation

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Radial stability eigenmodes of pressure-bounded Bonnor-Ebert spheres
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the isothermal Lane-Emden equation, then discretize the linearized radial perturbation equations as a finite-difference eigenproblem. Compute the squared oscillation frequency versus dimensionless radius, which crosses zero at ξ = 6.45.
physics/fields_astro|pde.area: Self-gravitating gas spheres and star formation

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Fragmentation of an isothermal Ostriker filament: fastest-growing wavelength
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Linearize self-gravitating hydrodynamics about an Ostriker cylinder and solve the radial eigenproblem by finite differences for each axial wavenumber. Compute the dispersion relation and the fastest-growing fragmentation wavelength.
physics/fields_astro|pde.area: Self-gravitating gas spheres and star formation

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: First hydrostatic core formation in barotropic protostellar collapse
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Use 1D spherical Lagrangian hydrodynamics of a collapsing cloud core with a barotropic EOS that stiffens above 10^-13 g/cm^3. Compute the first-core mass, radius and accretion shock location versus time.
physics/fields_astro|pde.area: Self-gravitating gas spheres and star formation

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Toomre instability of a self-gravitating shearing sheet in 2D hydro
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve 2D isothermal hydrodynamics in a shearing box with FFT thin-disk self-gravity. Compute the growth rate of axisymmetric perturbations versus Q and check the marginal-stability threshold Q = 1.
physics/fields_astro|pde.area: Self-gravitating gas spheres and star formation

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Hydrogen profile at a receding convective core with diffusive exponential overshoot
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve the hydrogen mass fraction X(m,t) in a 1D mass grid of a massive main-sequence star. Nuclear burning is a sink term, and mixing is a diffusion coefficient that is large inside the convective core and decays exponentially beyond the Schwarzschild boundary. Use implicit Crank–Nicolson stepping and report the width and slope of the chemical gradient left behind.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Spiegel–Zahn radiative spreading of the solar tachocline
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the fourth-order hyperdiffusion equation for differential rotation below the solar convection zone on a 1D radial grid, using implicit finite differences. Measure the tachocline thickness growth and verify the t^{1/4} similarity law and its dependence on the buoyancy frequency.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Proto-neutron-star deleptonization by equilibrium neutrino diffusion
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve the lepton fraction Y_L(r,t) of a hot proto-neutron star with a nonlinear spherical diffusion equation. The energy-averaged opacity scales as T² and the outer boundary is a flux-limited emission condition. Compute the neutrino number-luminosity curve and the deleptonization timescale with an implicit finite-volume scheme.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Dark-matter annihilation antiproton flux in a two-zone cylindrical diffusion halo
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the steady 2D (r,z) diffusion–convection equation for antiprotons injected by WIMP annihilation in an NFW profile. Include a thin-disk spallation sink and use SOR or sparse finite differences with free-escape boundaries. Report the local antiproton flux versus halo height L and compare it with the Bessel-series solution.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: 10Be/9Be radioactive clock ratio in a disk–halo cosmic-ray diffusion model
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the steady 1D vertical diffusion equation with a thin-disk source and decay term for stable 9Be and radioactive 10Be using finite differences. Compute the surviving fraction and the ratio as a function of halo height and diffusion coefficient. Invert a target ratio for the halo size.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Spectral ageing downstream of a radio-relic shock from advection–loss PDE
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve the electron spectrum N(p,x) advected away from an intracluster merger shock under synchrotron and inverse-Compton losses, using an upwind finite-volume scheme in momentum. Integrate the synchrotron emissivity over the downstream region to obtain the spectral index profile. Verify the 0.5 steepening of the volume-integrated spectrum.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Fringing capacitance of a finite parallel-plate capacitor via SOR
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the 2D Laplace equation around two finite conducting plates in a large grounded box using over-relaxation. Compute the charge from Gauss's law around a plate to obtain capacitance per unit length versus gap/width. Compare with the Kirchhoff/Palmer fringing-field corrections and extrapolate the box size.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Dielectric sphere in a uniform field: axisymmetric finite differences and induced dipole
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve ∇·(ε∇φ)=0 on an (r,θ) grid for a dielectric sphere in an applied uniform field. Project the exterior solution onto Legendre polynomials to extract the dipole and higher multipole coefficients. Check them against the Clausius–Mossotti result and quantify discretization error in the spurious l=3 moment.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Massless scalar ringdown on Kerr via 2+1D finite-difference evolution
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve the azimuthal-mode-decomposed scalar wave equation in Boyer–Lindquist (tortoise r*, θ) coordinates with second-order finite differences and method-of-lines RK4. Extract the l=m=2 quasinormal frequency from the ringdown with a damped-sinusoid fit and track its spin dependence.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Gravitational-wave packet propagation in matter-dominated FRW via finite differences
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the tensor-perturbation equation h'' + 2(a'/a)h' − ∇²h = 0 in conformal time on a 1D comoving grid with leapfrog stepping. Measure the amplitude decay ∝ 1/a deep inside the horizon and the freezing of super-horizon modes. Compare the late-time transfer with the analytic 3j1(kη)/(kη) solution.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Galactic double-white-dwarf frequency distribution from a GW-driven continuity equation
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the advection PDE ∂N/∂t + ∂(ḟN)/∂f = S(f,t) for a population of binaries chirping under the quadrupole ḟ law. Use a conservative upwind finite-volume scheme on a logarithmic frequency grid with a time-dependent birth rate. Verify the steady-state dN/df ∝ f^{−11/3} and count binaries per LISA frequency bin.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Loss-cone pitch-angle Fokker–Planck decay in a magnetic mirror
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the bounce-averaged pitch-angle diffusion equation in μ=cosα with absorbing loss-cone boundaries set by the mirror ratio, using implicit finite volumes. Extract the lowest eigenmode decay time and the trapped-fraction evolution versus mirror ratio and diffusion rate.
physics/fields_astro|pde.area: Charged particle motion in EM fields

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Radial diffusion of radiation-belt electrons with D_LL ∝ L^10
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the Schulz–Lanzerotti radial diffusion equation in L-shell at fixed first and second adiabatic invariants. Include a loss lifetime term and a time-varying outer-boundary source, using Crank–Nicolson stepping. Compute the steady phase-space-density profile and the inward penetration time of a storm injection.
physics/fields_astro|pde.area: Charged particle motion in EM fields

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Slow eccentric modes of a softened self-gravitating disk via grid eigenproblem
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Discretize the Laplace–Lagrange-type secular equation for complex eccentricity E(r) of a self-gravitating disk on a radial grid. Use softened Laplace coefficients plus an external planet or pressure precession term. Solve the resulting matrix eigenproblem for the mode precession rates and shapes, testing convergence with resolution and softening.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Lindblad torque from the forced linear density-wave response to a planet
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the linearized 2D isothermal disk equations for each azimuthal mode m as a forced radial BVP on a finite-difference grid. Apply outgoing-wave radiation boundary conditions. Sum the angular-momentum fluxes over m to obtain the one-sided Lindblad torques and compare with the Goldreich–Tremaine formula.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Matsuno–Gill shallow-water response of a tidally locked hot Jupiter
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the linear damped shallow-water equations on an equatorial beta-plane with a day–night Newtonian heating term, using spectral-in-x and finite-difference-in-y methods. Compute the steady geopotential pattern, the equatorial superrotation structure, and the eastward hot-spot offset versus radiative and drag timescales.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Hydrostatic coronal loop energy balance and the RTV scaling law
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the steady 1D coronal loop equations along a semicircular field line by finite-difference relaxation. Balance Spitzer conduction, optically thin radiative losses and uniform heating with hydrostatic pressure. Compute the apex temperature versus pressure and loop length, and verify T_max ≈ 1400(pL)^{1/3}.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Vertical MRI channel modes in a bounded shearing box via finite-difference eigenproblem
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Discretize the linearized incompressible ideal-MHD equations in z for a Keplerian shearing box threaded by a vertical field, with conducting-wall boundaries. Solve the generalized eigenproblem for growth rates versus field strength. Recover the 3Ω/4 maximum and the stabilization when the box is shorter than the critical wavelength.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Vertical dust settling–diffusion in a protoplanetary disk and Dubrulle scale height
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Evolve the dust density ρ_d(z,t) under Epstein-drag settling velocity and turbulent diffusion in an isothermal Gaussian gas disk, using an implicit finite-volume scheme. Compute the settling timescale and the equilibrium dust scale height versus Stokes number and α. Compare with the Dubrulle formula.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Thermal evolution of a 26Al-heated planetesimal and onset of melting
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Solve the spherical heat-conduction equation with exponentially decaying radiogenic heating and a radiative surface boundary, using Crank–Nicolson in radius. Compute the peak central temperature and melted volume fraction versus formation time and radius, and find the critical delay for differentiation.

physics/fields_astro|pde.title: Langmuir wave collapse in the 1D Zakharov equations by split-step Fourier
physics/fields_astro|pde.gist: Integrate the coupled Zakharov equations for the Langmuir envelope and ion density perturbation with a pseudo-spectral split-step scheme, checking conservation of plasmon number and Hamiltonian. Compute the modulational-instability growth rate and compare with linear theory. Track the formation of Langmuir solitons.

materials/structure|particles.title: Lennard-Jones fcc low-index surface energies and Wulff shape
materials/structure|particles.gist: Cut (100), (110) and (111) slabs of an LJ fcc crystal, relax them with FIRE using a cell-list neighbor search, and compute γ = (E_slab − N·e_bulk)/2A. Build the Wulff shape from the ratios and report its facet fractions.

materials/structure|particles.title: Sutton-Chen copper surface energy anisotropy and Wulff half-space polyhedron
materials/structure|particles.gist: Compute relaxed surface energies for all (hkl) with index ≤3 using the Sutton-Chen many-body potential. Intersect the half-spaces n·x ≤ γ(n) to get the Wulff polyhedron, then report facet area fractions and the sphericity.

materials/structure|particles.title: Anisotropic surface stress tensor of relaxed LJ fcc(110) slab
materials/structure|particles.gist: Relax an LJ (110) slab and compute the layer-resolved virial stress. Integrate the in-plane excess stress to obtain the two principal surface stress components and compare them with the surface energy.

materials/structure|particles.title: Missing-row (1×2) reconstruction stability on fcc(110) with RGL potential
materials/structure|particles.gist: Use Rosato-Guillopé-Legrand (Gupta) tight-binding second-moment potentials for Au and Ag. Compare relaxed unreconstructed and missing-row (110) surface energies to predict which metal reconstructs.

materials/structure|particles.title: Step formation energy from vicinal LJ (111) slab energies
materials/structure|particles.gist: Construct vicinal fcc slabs with increasing terrace width and relax them with an LJ potential. Separate the terrace and step contributions by fitting the surface energy versus step density to obtain the step energy per length.

materials/structure|particles.title: Size crossover between icosahedral, decahedral and truncated-octahedral LJ clusters
materials/structure|particles.gist: Generate Mackay icosahedra, Marks decahedra and Wulff truncated octahedra at magic sizes and relax each with LJ. Fit the excess energy versus N^(2/3) and locate the structural crossover sizes.

materials/structure|particles.title: Graphene armchair versus zigzag edge energies and 2D Wulff flake
materials/structure|particles.gist: Relax armchair and zigzag nanoribbons with the Tersoff carbon potential to extract the edge energies per length. Build the 2D Wulff shape of a graphene flake from the orientation-interpolated edge energy.

materials/structure|particles.title: Surface premelting of LJ fcc(110) by layer-resolved order parameter
materials/structure|particles.gist: Run thermostatted MD of an LJ (110) slab at temperatures approaching T_m. Compute the layer-resolved structure-factor order parameter and density profiles, and extract the quasi-liquid layer thickness versus T.

materials/structure|particles.title: NaCl (100) versus (110) surface energies with Born-Mayer and Wolf summation
materials/structure|particles.gist: Model rocksalt NaCl with a Born-Mayer-Huggins plus Coulomb potential, using damped shifted-force (Wolf) summation. Relax both slabs and compute the surface energies, confirming the cubic Wulff shape.

materials/structure|particles.title: Integer-matrix supercells with periodic duplicate removal and energy invariance
materials/structure|particles.gist: Apply integer transformation matrices to an fcc primitive cell and wrap fractional coordinates. Remove duplicate atoms under the minimum image, then verify that the cell-list LJ energy per atom is invariant across supercells.

materials/structure|particles.title: bcc Fe slab cutting and Finnis-Sinclair multilayer relaxation profile
materials/structure|particles.gist: Find in-plane lattice vectors for Miller indices (100), (110) and (111) of bcc Fe and build slabs of N layers. Relax with the Finnis-Sinclair potential and report the oscillatory interlayer spacing changes Δd_ij.

materials/structure|particles.title: Minimal-strain coherent Cu/Ni interface supercell search with EAM
materials/structure|particles.gist: Search integer 2D supercell matrices of Cu(111) and Ni(111) for minimal mismatch strain within an area cutoff. Build the interface and relax it with an analytic EAM potential to report the interface misfit energy.

materials/structure|particles.title: Carbon nanotube rolling from chiral vector and Tersoff strain energy
materials/structure|particles.gist: Generate (n,m) nanotubes by mapping graphene lattice points along the chiral and translation vectors. Relax them with the Tersoff potential and fit the strain energy per atom to C/D² to extract the bending modulus.

materials/structure|particles.title: Orthohexagonal hcp cell construction and LJ c/a optimization
materials/structure|particles.gist: Transform the hcp primitive cell into an orthorhombic supercell with an integer matrix. Relax the cell shape under an LJ potential and compare the optimal c/a with the ideal √(8/3).

materials/structure|particles.title: MoS2 sulfur vacancy formation energy convergence with supercell size
materials/structure|particles.gist: Build n×n MoS2 monolayer supercells and model them with a Stillinger-Weber MoS2 parametrization. Compute the relaxed S-vacancy formation energy and extrapolate the elastic finite-size error in 1/N.

materials/structure|particles.title: Close-packed polytype stacking energies and ANNNI parameter fit
materials/structure|particles.gist: Generate ABC, AB, ABCB (4H) and 6H stacking sequences and relax each with a long-range LJ potential. Fit the ANNNI interaction constants to the small energy differences.

materials/structure|particles.title: Frozen-phonon multislice CBED of Si[110] from Stillinger-Weber MD
materials/structure|particles.gist: Sample atomic configurations from a thermostatted Stillinger-Weber MD run of silicon. Average multislice CBED patterns over snapshots using an FFT Fresnel propagator, and quantify the thermal diffuse background.

materials/structure|particles.title: HRTEM image of melt-quenched amorphous carbon film
materials/structure|particles.gist: Quench liquid carbon with the Tersoff potential to make a thin amorphous film. Run multislice with an objective lens transfer function, and relate the diffractogram ring radii to peaks in the structure factor.

materials/structure|particles.title: Thermal ripple effect on graphene electron diffraction spot intensities
materials/structure|particles.gist: Generate 300 K ripple configurations of suspended graphene from Tersoff MD. Simulate multislice diffraction at several tilts and compute the ripple-induced attenuation of the first- and second-order spots.

materials/structure|particles.title: Debye-Waller attenuation of Bragg beams in frozen-phonon multislice of argon
materials/structure|particles.gist: Run velocity-Verlet MD of LJ argon at several temperatures to obtain snapshots and the MSD. Compare the frozen-phonon multislice Bragg-beam attenuation with the exp(−B s²) prediction from the MD MSD.

materials/structure|particles.title: STEM probe multislice across an EAM-relaxed vacancy in a Cu column
materials/structure|particles.gist: Relax a Cu supercell containing a vacancy with EAM. Propagate a focused aberration-free probe through it by multislice, and compute the integrated annular dark-field signal change relative to a perfect column.

materials/structure|particles.title: End-on HRTEM of EAM-relaxed edge dislocation core in aluminum
materials/structure|particles.gist: Insert an edge dislocation using the anisotropy-free displacement field and relax it with EAM. Simulate an HRTEM image along the line direction and extract the Burgers vector from a circuit drawn on the fitted image peak positions.

materials/structure|particles.title: Surface lattice contraction fringes in Gupta-relaxed gold nanoparticle HRTEM
materials/structure|particles.gist: Relax a truncated-octahedral Au nanoparticle with the Gupta potential and simulate its multislice HRTEM image. Measure the local fringe spacing from radial to surface regions to quantify the contraction.

materials/structure|particles.title: Multislice exit waves of 2H versus 3R bilayer MoS2 stacking
materials/structure|particles.gist: Relax both bilayer stackings using an intralayer Stillinger-Weber potential plus interlayer LJ. Compute the multislice exit waves and diffraction intensities that discriminate the two stackings.

materials/structure|particles.title: Debye scattering equation powder pattern of LJ nanoparticles and Scherrer size
materials/structure|particles.gist: Average the Debye scattering equation over MD snapshots of LJ fcc nanoparticles to obtain I(2θ). Fit peak widths and compare the Scherrer-derived size with the true size.

materials/structure|particles.title: MD-derived Debye-Waller factor in simulated copper powder patterns
materials/structure|particles.gist: Compute ⟨u²⟩(T) from EAM MD of Cu to obtain the B factor. Build full simulated XRD patterns with Lorentz-polarization and multiplicity factors, and report the high-angle intensity ratios versus T.

materials/structure|particles.title: Morse copper equation of state and pressure-dependent diffraction peaks
materials/structure|particles.gist: Compute P(V) for Morse-potential Cu from virial MD at 300 K and fit a Birch-Murnaghan equation of state. Predict the powder peak positions as a function of applied pressure.

materials/structure|particles.title: Neutron pair distribution function of NaCl from Born-Mayer MD
materials/structure|particles.gist: Run MD of rocksalt NaCl with a Born-Mayer plus Wolf-Coulomb potential. Compute the partial g(r), weight them by neutron scattering lengths into G(r), and Fourier transform to S(Q).

materials/structure|particles.title: Stacking-fault signatures in powder patterns of faulted fcc clusters
materials/structure|particles.gist: Insert intrinsic stacking faults at controlled densities into LJ-relaxed fcc clusters. Compute Debye-equation patterns and the (111)/(200) peak shift and broadening versus fault probability.

materials/structure|particles.title: Melting detection by Bragg peak decay during LJ heating ramp
materials/structure|particles.gist: Heat an LJ fcc crystal with a Langevin thermostat ramp and compute the static structure factor S(k) at reciprocal lattice vectors. Locate the superheating melting point from the collapse of the Bragg peaks.

materials/structure|particles.title: Size-dependent apparent lattice parameter of gold clusters from Debye patterns
materials/structure|particles.gist: Relax Au clusters of increasing size with the Gupta potential and compute their Debye scattering patterns. Fit the apparent lattice parameter from peak positions versus 1/D and compare it with the mean bond length.

materials/structure|particles.title: Lattice swelling from Frenkel pairs and XRD peak shift
materials/structure|particles.gist: Introduce Frenkel pairs at increasing concentrations into an LJ crystal and relax it at zero pressure. Compute the relaxation volume per defect and the resulting powder peak shifts.

materials/structure|particles.title: Kob-Andersen binary LJ glass partial structure factors after quench
materials/structure|particles.gist: Melt and quench the 80:20 Kob-Andersen mixture with a velocity-Verlet integrator and a thermostat. Compute the partial g_ab(r) and the Bhatia-Thornton or Faber-Ziman partial S(q).

materials/structure|particles.title: Random close packing fraction by soft-sphere jamming with FIRE
materials/structure|particles.gist: Compress polydisperse harmonic soft spheres and minimize with FIRE until the jamming point. Extrapolate φ_J to about 0.64 and verify the isostatic contact number Z = 6.

materials/structure|particles.title: Icosahedral Voronoi fraction in Wahnström glass versus cooling rate
materials/structure|particles.gist: Quench the Wahnström binary LJ glass at several cooling rates. Perform Voronoi tessellation with scipy and compute the fraction of ⟨0,0,12,0⟩ icosahedral cells around small atoms.

materials/structure|particles.title: Cooling-rate dependence of glass transition temperature from NPT volume curves
materials/structure|particles.gist: Cool a binary LJ liquid in NPT MD at several rates. Fit the liquid and glass branches of V(T) to locate T_g and fit its logarithmic dependence on cooling rate.

materials/structure|particles.title: Steinhardt bond-orientational order distinguishing crystallized and glassy quench products
materials/structure|particles.gist: Compute local q4, q6 and w6 from neighbor spherical harmonics for monatomic LJ quenched at different rates. Classify atoms as fcc, hcp, icosahedral or disordered, and report the crystalline fraction.

materials/structure|particles.title: Vitreous silica with BKS potential and Wolf summation
materials/structure|particles.gist: Melt-quench SiO2 with the BKS potential using Wolf-damped Coulomb interactions. Compute the Si–O–Si angle distribution, the ring statistics and the first sharp diffraction peak position.

materials/structure|particles.title: Boson peak from Hessian vibrational density of states of LJ glass
materials/structure|particles.gist: Minimize a quenched binary LJ glass and build its analytic Hessian, then diagonalize it. Compute g(ω)/ω² and compare the boson peak with the Debye level from the elastic moduli.

materials/structure|particles.title: Athermal quasistatic shear of 2D LJ glass: plastic avalanches
materials/structure|particles.gist: Apply small affine shear increments to a 2D binary LJ glass with Lees-Edwards cells and minimize with FIRE after each step. Record stress drops and fit the avalanche size distribution.

materials/structure|particles.title: Velocity autocorrelation phonon density of states of LJ argon crystal
materials/structure|particles.gist: Integrate an NVE LJ fcc crystal with velocity Verlet and check the energy drift versus dt. Compute the VACF and FFT it to obtain the vibrational density of states and the heat capacity.

materials/structure|particles.title: LJ melting temperature by solid-liquid two-phase coexistence
materials/structure|particles.gist: Build a half-crystal, half-liquid LJ box and run NPH or NVE MD. Track the interface motion and the plateau temperature to determine T_m at fixed pressure.

materials/structure|particles.title: Lindemann melting criterion for Morse-potential copper
materials/structure|particles.gist: Run thermostatted MD of fcc Morse Cu at increasing temperatures and compute the rms displacement relative to the nearest-neighbor distance. Estimate T_m where the Lindemann ratio reaches about 0.1.

materials/structure|particles.title: Green-Kubo lattice thermal conductivity of LJ fcc crystal
materials/structure|particles.gist: Compute the microscopic heat current with pair-force virial terms in equilibrium NVE MD. Integrate its autocorrelation function to obtain κ(T) and verify the high-temperature 1/T trend.

materials/structure|particles.title: Piston-driven shock Hugoniot of LJ fcc crystal
materials/structure|particles.gist: Drive a shock with a moving wall in a long LJ crystal using non-equilibrium MD. Measure the shock velocity versus particle velocity and the Rankine-Hugoniot pressure and temperature.

materials/structure|particles.title: Graphene uniaxial tension: Young's modulus and fracture strain with Tersoff
materials/structure|particles.gist: Strain a graphene sheet incrementally along armchair and zigzag directions with relaxation or MD at each step. Compute the stress-strain curve, the 2D Young's modulus and the failure strain.

materials/structure|particles.title: Grain orientation mapping in MD polycrystal by Kabsch neighbor fitting
materials/structure|particles.gist: Fit a rotation per atom matching its fcc neighbor vectors to the template using the Kabsch SVD. Cluster the results into grains and compute pairwise misorientation angles under cubic symmetry.

materials/structure|particles.title: Twin detection via quaternion disorientation in deformed fcc nanowire
materials/structure|particles.gist: Compress an LJ fcc nanowire with MD and compute per-atom orientations from neighbors. Find the 60°⟨111⟩ Σ3 twin domains by quaternion disorientation under cubic symmetry.

materials/structure|particles.title: Indexing the orientation of an MD-nucleated crystal from structure factor peaks
materials/structure|particles.gist: Crystallize a supercooled LJ liquid in MD and compute S(k) on a 3D grid. Locate the Bragg peaks, index them as fcc, and solve for the orientation matrix by least squares.

materials/structure|particles.title: Laue spot streaking and Nye tensor in an MD-bent crystal
materials/structure|particles.gist: Bend an LJ crystal beam and relax it, then compute local lattice orientations along its length. Simulate the streaked Laue spots and obtain the geometrically necessary dislocation density from the curvature (Nye) tensor.

materials/structure|particles.title: Dimer method saddle search for ⟨110⟩ dumbbell migration in bcc Fe
materials/structure|particles.gist: Apply the dimer method with Finnis-Sinclair forces to find saddles starting from a self-interstitial dumbbell. Compute the translation-rotation barrier and the lowest curvature mode.
materials/structure|particles.area: Diffusion pathways and nudged elastic band

materials/structure|particles.title: Ehrlich-Schwoebel barrier at a step on LJ fcc(111)
materials/structure|particles.gist: Compute NEB barriers for adatom hopping on a terrace and for descending a step by hop and by exchange. Report the additional step-edge barrier.
materials/structure|particles.area: Diffusion pathways and nudged elastic band

materials/structure|particles.title: Stone-Wales transformation barrier in graphene with Tersoff NEB
materials/structure|particles.gist: Rotate a C–C bond by 90° to form the 5-7-7-5 defect and relax the endpoints. Compute the formation energy and the NEB barrier for the transformation and its reverse.
materials/structure|particles.area: Diffusion pathways and nudged elastic band

materials/structure|particles.title: Kinetic Monte Carlo vacancy diffusion with NEB-computed LJ rates
materials/structure|particles.gist: Tabulate hop rates from NEB plus harmonic TST for a vacancy in LJ fcc. Run a residence-time KMC on the lattice and compute the diffusion coefficient D(T) and the Arrhenius parameters.
materials/structure|particles.area: Diffusion pathways and nudged elastic band

materials/structure|particles.title: Sulfur vacancy migration barrier in monolayer MoS2
materials/structure|particles.gist: Compute the minimum energy path for S-vacancy hopping within the same sulfur layer using NEB with a Stillinger-Weber MoS2 potential. Report the barrier and the room-temperature hop rate.
materials/structure|particles.area: Diffusion pathways and nudged elastic band

materials/structure|particles.title: Harmonic TST versus direct MD hop rate for adatom on LJ(100)
materials/structure|particles.gist: Count adatom hops in long Langevin MD runs at several temperatures and fit an Arrhenius law. Compare with the NEB barrier plus the Vineyard prefactor to assess the validity of harmonic TST.
materials/structure|particles.area: Diffusion pathways and nudged elastic band

materials/structure|particles.title: String method vacancy migration path in Stillinger-Weber silicon
materials/structure|particles.gist: Find the vacancy migration minimum energy path in diamond Si with the zero-temperature string method and spline reparametrization. Compare the barrier with CI-NEB.
materials/structure|particles.area: Diffusion pathways and nudged elastic band

materials/structure|particles.title: Strain dependence of vacancy migration barrier and activation volume
materials/structure|particles.gist: Apply hydrostatic and uniaxial strains to an LJ fcc cell and recompute the NEB vacancy barriers. Extract the migration activation volume tensor and the strain-induced diffusion anisotropy.
materials/structure|particles.area: Diffusion pathways and nudged elastic band

materials/structure|particles.title: Shockley partial separation of MD-relaxed edge dislocation in LJ fcc
materials/structure|particles.gist: Insert a perfect edge dislocation into an LJ fcc slab and relax it with FIRE, during which it dissociates. Measure the partial spacing with common neighbor analysis and compare it with the elastic prediction from the stacking-fault energy.

materials/structure|particles.title: 2D discrete dislocation dynamics of edge dipole annihilation
materials/structure|particles.gist: Evolve two opposite edge dislocations on parallel slip planes under their mutual Peach-Koehler forces with overdamped dynamics. Map the capture region and the stable dipole configurations versus slip-plane spacing.

materials/structure|particles.title: Frenkel-Kontorova kink width and Peierls-Nabarro barrier
materials/structure|particles.gist: Relax a Frenkel-Kontorova chain containing a kink in a sinusoidal substrate. Constrain the kink center to compute the Peierls-Nabarro energy barrier versus the ratio of substrate strength to spring constant.

materials/structure|particles.title: Nanoindentation pop-in and dislocation nucleation in 2D LJ crystal
materials/structure|particles.gist: Indent a 2D triangular LJ crystal with a repulsive cylindrical indenter under quasistatic relaxation. Record the load-depth curve, identify the first pop-in load, and compare the critical shear stress with Hertz theory.

materials/structure|particles.title: Temperature-dependent pendellösung extinction distance in copper
materials/structure|particles.gist: Obtain the Debye-Waller factor B(T) and the lattice parameter from EAM NPT MD of Cu. Compute the two-beam extinction distance ξ_g(T) and the shift of the pendellösung fringes for the (111) and (200) reflections.

materials/structure|particles.title: Many-beam Bloch-wave intensities with Einstein-model thermal absorption
materials/structure|particles.gist: Extract the Einstein frequency and MSD of LJ argon from MD and build complex absorptive potentials. Construct and diagonalize the many-beam structure matrix to get thickness-dependent beam intensities.

materials/structure|particles.title: Howie-Whelan dislocation contrast from MD-relaxed displacement field
materials/structure|particles.gist: Relax a screw dislocation in EAM fcc and interpolate the displacement field along columns. Integrate the two-beam Howie-Whelan equations for bright-field and dark-field images, and verify g·b = 0 invisibility.

materials/structure|particles.title: Morse bcc sodium phonon dispersion along Γ-H-P-Γ-N from dynamical matrix
materials/structure|particles.gist: Build the bcc reciprocal lattice and its high-symmetry path. Diagonalize the analytic Morse-potential dynamical matrix along the path to get phonon branches and sound velocities, then check them against the Christoffel-equation elastic limit.
materials/structure|particles.area: Reciprocal lattice and Brillouin zone construction

materials/structure|particles.title: Thermal diffuse scattering map in hk0 plane from LJ crystal MD
materials/structure|particles.gist: Run NVT MD of an LJ fcc crystal and compute diffuse intensity on a fine grid of reciprocal-space points within the Brillouin zones. Compare it with the first-order harmonic TDS prediction from the LJ dynamical matrix.
materials/structure|particles.area: Reciprocal lattice and Brillouin zone construction

materials/structure|particles.title: Wigner-Seitz occupancy analysis of Frenkel pairs after LJ-ZBL displacement cascade
materials/structure|particles.gist: Launch a primary knock-on atom in an fcc crystal described by an LJ potential splined to ZBL, using adaptive-timestep velocity Verlet. Count vacancies and interstitials by Wigner-Seitz cell occupancy of reference lattice sites, versus PKA energy and against the NRT estimate.
materials/structure|particles.area: Reciprocal lattice and Brillouin zone construction

materials/structure|particles.title: [001] symmetric tilt grain boundary energy versus misorientation in LJ copper
materials/structure|particles.gist: Generate Σ5, Σ13, Σ17, Σ25, Σ29 and Σ37 [001] tilt bicrystals from CSL rotations and minimize energy over rigid-body translations with FIRE. Fit the low-angle energies to the Read-Shockley form.
materials/structure|particles.area: Coincidence site lattices and grain boundaries

materials/structure|particles.title: Coherent versus incoherent Σ3 twin boundary energies in EAM copper
materials/structure|particles.gist: Construct Σ3(111) and Σ3(112) [1-10] tilt bicrystals and relax them with an analytic EAM potential. Compute the boundary energies and excess volumes and compare them with the intrinsic stacking-fault energy, checking the γ_twin ≈ γ_SF/2 relation.
materials/structure|particles.area: Coincidence site lattices and grain boundaries

materials/structure|particles.title: DSC-lattice rigid-body translation scan of Σ13 [001] twist boundary
materials/structure|particles.gist: Build the CSL and DSC lattices for the Σ13 [001] twist rotation and construct the LJ bicrystal. Map the relaxed boundary energy over translations spanning the DSC cell and identify the minimum-energy translation state.
materials/structure|particles.area: Coincidence site lattices and grain boundaries

materials/structure|particles.title: Shear-coupled migration factor of Σ17 [001] tilt boundary in LJ bicrystal
materials/structure|particles.gist: Drive an LJ Σ17(530) bicrystal by imposed shear displacement in MD and track the GB position with a centrosymmetry or order parameter. Extract the coupling factor β and compare it with the geometric Cahn-Taylor prediction.
materials/structure|particles.area: Coincidence site lattices and grain boundaries

materials/structure|particles.title: Graphene grain boundary energy with 5-7 dislocations versus tilt angle
materials/structure|particles.gist: Construct periodic graphene bicrystals whose boundaries are made of pentagon-heptagon pairs at several misorientations and relax them with Tersoff carbon. Compute boundary energy per length and out-of-plane buckling, and compare with a dislocation-array model.
materials/structure|particles.area: Coincidence site lattices and grain boundaries

materials/structure|particles.title: Curvature-driven shrinkage of a cylindrical grain in 2D LJ crystal
materials/structure|particles.gist: Embed a rotated circular grain in a 2D triangular LJ crystal and run thermostatted MD. Track the grain area through local orientation analysis, verify the linear dA/dt law and extract the reduced boundary mobility.
materials/structure|particles.area: Coincidence site lattices and grain boundaries

materials/structure|particles.title: Dichotomy indexing of Debye-simulated powder pattern of NPT-equilibrated LJ hcp
materials/structure|particles.gist: Equilibrate an LJ hcp crystal with NPT MD and compute its powder pattern by the Debye equation. Pick peak positions, recover the hexagonal cell by successive dichotomy on (a, c), and report the de Wolff M20.

materials/structure|particles.title: Trial-and-error indexing of Bain-strained body-centered tetragonal Morse crystal
materials/structure|particles.gist: Generate peak lists from a relaxed tetragonally strained Morse crystal and index them by trial-and-error assignment of low hkl triples. Refine a and c by least squares and rank candidate solutions with M20 and F_N.

materials/structure|particles.title: Ito zone-method indexing of monoclinic cell from Parrinello-Rahman sheared LJ crystal
materials/structure|particles.gist: Apply shear stress in Parrinello-Rahman MD to produce a monoclinic cell and compute its d-spacings. Recover the reciprocal metric tensor with Ito's zone method, then Niggli-reduce the result and compare it with the MD cell matrix.

materials/structure|particles.title: Zero-shift-corrected lattice refinement of random binary LJ alloys and Vegard deviation
materials/structure|particles.gist: Relax random substitutional LJ A-B alloys across composition with variable cell. Simulate peak positions with an instrumental zero shift, index them, and refine a and the zero offset by least squares to quantify the deviation from Vegard's law.

materials/structure|particles.title: Histogram-accelerated Debye pattern of Stillinger-Weber relaxed silicon nanocrystals
materials/structure|particles.gist: Relax spherical Si nanocrystals with Stillinger-Weber and compute their Debye powder patterns both exactly and with pair-distance histograms. Quantify error versus bin width and speedup, and show surface-relaxation peak shifts against Bragg positions.

materials/structure|particles.title: Ag-core/Cu-shell Gupta nanoparticle Debye pattern and misfit strain peaks
materials/structure|particles.gist: Build core-shell Ag@Cu clusters, relax them with Gupta (RGL) potentials, and compute radial strain profiles. Compute Debye patterns and attribute the peak splitting and shifts to core compression and shell tension.

materials/structure|particles.title: Debye scattering of Tersoff-relaxed multiwall carbon nanotubes and asymmetric hk bands
materials/structure|particles.gist: Build multiwall nanotubes from chiral vectors with interwall spacing and relax each wall with Tersoff. Compute Debye patterns, and analyze the 002 peak and the sawtooth hk0 band asymmetry against Warren's 2D-lattice line-shape formula.

materials/structure|particles.title: Anisotropic shape broadening in Debye patterns of silicon nanowires
materials/structure|particles.gist: Cut [110] and [111] Si nanowires and relax them with Stillinger-Weber. Compute Debye patterns and extract direction-dependent peak widths, comparing them with Scherrer estimates using shape-specific constants.

materials/structure|particles.title: Guinier radius versus gyration radius for thermally equilibrated LJ cluster ensembles
materials/structure|particles.gist: Sample LJ clusters of several sizes by MD at a fixed temperature. Compute small- and wide-angle scattering via Debye sums, fit the Guinier region, and compare with the ensemble-averaged radius of gyration and with Bragg-like peak positions.

materials/structure|particles.title: Capillary fluctuation method for LJ solid-liquid interface stiffness
materials/structure|particles.gist: Simulate a coexisting LJ crystal-melt slab with MD and locate the interface height field using a local order parameter. Fit the Fourier-mode fluctuation spectrum ⟨|h_k|²⟩ = kT/(A γ̃ k²) to obtain the interfacial stiffness for (100) and (110) orientations.

materials/structure|particles.title: Spinodal decomposition of quenched binary LJ mixture and domain coarsening exponent
materials/structure|particles.gist: Quench a symmetric immiscible binary LJ fluid into the spinodal region with thermostatted MD. Compute the concentration structure factor over time, track the peak wavenumber, and compare the coarsening exponent with Cahn-Hilliard (Lifshitz-Slyozov) and hydrodynamic predictions.

materials/structure|particles.title: Diamond elastic constants and Kleinman internal-strain parameter with Tersoff carbon
materials/structure|particles.gist: Apply small homogeneous strains to diamond and relax the two-sublattice internal displacement. Compute C11, C12 and C44 with and without relaxation, and extract the Kleinman parameter ζ.

materials/structure|particles.title: Stillinger-Weber silicon Γ-point optical phonon and mode Grüneisen parameter
materials/structure|particles.gist: Evaluate the Raman-active zone-center optical frequency of diamond Si with Stillinger-Weber by frozen-phonon sublattice displacement at several volumes. Obtain its mode Grüneisen parameter from the logarithmic volume derivative.

materials/structure|particles.title: Multicomponent Tersoff SiC zincblende lattice constant, bulk modulus and cohesive energy
materials/structure|particles.gist: Implement Tersoff's multicomponent potential with χ mixing and cross parameters for Si-C. Compute the zincblende SiC equation of state, the formation energy relative to diamond Si and diamond C, and the energy of an antisite pair.

materials/structure|particles.title: Brenner-type bond-order carbon: Pauling bond-length/energy versus coordination
materials/structure|particles.gist: Implement a simplified Brenner bond-order potential without conjugation corrections and relax carbon structures with coordination 2, 3, 4 and higher (chain, graphene, diamond, sc, fcc). Verify the monotone bond-energy versus bond-length relation and the binding-energy ordering.

materials/structure|particles.title: Strain-fluctuation elastic compliances from Parrinello-Rahman NPT MD of LJ crystal
materials/structure|particles.gist: Run Parrinello-Rahman MD with full cell flexibility and record the cell matrix h(t). Compute the Lagrangian strain from the metric tensor h^T h and obtain the compliance tensor from strain fluctuations S = V⟨δε δε⟩/kT, then invert it to elastic constants.

materials/structure|particles.title: Ideal shear strength of Morse fcc metal along {111}⟨112⟩ in triclinic cell
materials/structure|particles.gist: Incrementally apply simple shear to a triclinic cell built from a (111)-oriented basis, relaxing atoms and the remaining strain components at each step. Locate the maximum resolved shear stress and the strain at instability, and compare unrelaxed with relaxed paths.

materials/structure|particles.title: Girifalco-Weizer Morse fits for cubic metals and Cauchy relation violation
materials/structure|particles.gist: Fit Morse parameters to the experimental cohesive energy, lattice constant and bulk modulus of fcc metals using lattice sums. Compute C11, C12 and C44 analytically and quantify the mismatch with experiment imposed by the Cauchy relation C12 = C44.
materials/structure|particles.area: Pair potentials for metals and noble gases

materials/structure|particles.title: Cutoff and shift scheme bias in LJ lattice constants and bulk moduli
materials/structure|particles.gist: Compare plain-truncated, energy-shifted, force-shifted and tail-corrected LJ potentials for fcc, bcc and sc lattices. Measure the errors in equilibrium lattice constant, cohesive energy and bulk modulus against exact Jones-Ingham-type lattice sums as a function of cutoff.
materials/structure|particles.area: Pair potentials for metals and noble gases

materials/structure|particles.title: Vacancy formation energy, relaxation volume and elastic dipole in Morse aluminum
materials/structure|particles.gist: Relax a vacancy in Morse-Al supercells of increasing size at fixed volume and at zero pressure. Compute the unrelaxed and relaxed formation energies, the relaxation volume from residual stress, and the elastic dipole tensor with finite-size extrapolation.
materials/structure|particles.area: Pair potentials for metals and noble gases

materials/structure|particles.title: Ring-polymer path-integral MD of solid neon: zero-point lattice expansion
materials/structure|particles.gist: Implement path-integral MD with normal-mode propagation and PILE thermostats for LJ neon. Compute the quantum kinetic energy (centroid-virial estimator) and the equilibrium lattice constant versus bead number, and compare with classical MD.
materials/structure|particles.area: Pair potentials for metals and noble gases

materials/structure|particles.title: Born-Mayer-Huggins KCl B1 to B2 transition pressure with Ewald electrostatics
materials/structure|particles.gist: Compute rocksalt and CsCl energy-volume curves for KCl using Ewald Coulomb sums plus Born-Mayer repulsion and dispersion. Fit equations of state and find the transition pressure and volume collapse from the enthalpy crossing.
materials/structure|particles.area: Pair potentials for metals and noble gases
