materials/structure|particles.title: Interstitial site preference and tetrahedral-network diffusion in bcc pair-potential host
materials/structure|particles.gist: Compute relaxed octahedral and tetrahedral interstitial energies and the hop saddle for a small solute in a bcc pair-potential lattice. Run kinetic Monte Carlo on the tetrahedral site network and compare the diffusion coefficient with the Arrhenius prediction.
materials/structure|particles.area: Hydrogen and solute trapping in metals

materials/structure|particles.title: Cottrell atmosphere: misfit-solute binding map around LJ edge dislocation
materials/structure|particles.gist: Compute atomistic binding energies of an oversized substitutional solute at sites around a relaxed LJ edge dislocation and compare them with the elastic pΔV formula. Obtain Fermi-Dirac/Oriani equilibrium occupancy profiles versus temperature and bulk concentration.
materials/structure|particles.area: Hydrogen and solute trapping in metals

materials/structure|particles.title: Vacancy-hydrogen trap binding from atomistics and McNabb-Foster thermal desorption peaks
materials/structure|particles.gist: Compute the binding energy of a light interstitial to a vacancy in a pair-potential metal from relaxed energies. Use it in McNabb-Foster diffusion-trapping equations solved by method of lines to simulate TDS spectra at several heating rates, then recover the trap energy from a Kissinger analysis.
materials/structure|particles.area: Hydrogen and solute trapping in metals

materials/structure|particles.title: Dynamic crack propagation speed in strained 2D LJ strip versus Rayleigh speed
materials/structure|particles.gist: Pre-strain a 2D LJ strip, seed an edge crack and run NVE MD while tracking the crack tip. Relate the steady crack speed to the energy release rate from strip strain energy, and compare it with the Rayleigh wave speed computed from the elastic constants.

materials/structure|particles.title: Atomistic J-integral from virial stresses around crack in Morse lattice
materials/structure|particles.gist: Compute per-atom virial stresses and displacement gradients in a K-loaded 2D Morse crystal. Evaluate the J-integral on several contours, verify path independence, and compare with K²/E'.

materials/structure|particles.title: Ductile versus brittle crack tip: dislocation emission with tunable Morse softness
materials/structure|particles.gist: Load cracks in 2D hexagonal Morse lattices with different range parameters α under K_I/K_II mixity. Detect dislocation emission versus cleavage, and compare the critical K with Rice's γ_us-based emission criterion.

materials/structure|particles.title: Goodwin-Skinner-Pettifor tight-binding molecular dynamics of small silicon clusters
materials/structure|particles.gist: Build orthogonal sp3 GSP Slater-Koster Hamiltonians for Si4-Si6 clusters and compute band-structure energies and Hellmann-Feynman forces from eigenvectors. Add the repulsive pair term, relax the clusters, then run velocity-Verlet tight-binding MD and verify energy conservation.

materials/structure|particles.title: Prandtl-Tomlinson stick-slip friction of an AFM tip on NaCl(001)
materials/structure|particles.gist: Simulate an AFM tip on a spring dragged across a 2D sinusoidal NaCl(001) corrugation using Langevin dynamics. Compute the lateral-force traces, the mean friction force versus velocity and temperature, and its logarithmic thermal-activation dependence.
materials/structure|particles.area: Pair potentials for metals and noble gases

materials/structure|particles.title: Axilrod-Teller three-body correction to fcc versus hcp stability of rare-gas crystals
materials/structure|particles.gist: Compute LJ two-body and Axilrod-Teller-Muto triple-dipole lattice sums for fcc and hcp Ar, Kr and Xe with convergence in the cutoff. Determine whether the three-body term shifts the fcc-hcp energy difference and how it changes the lattice constants.
materials/structure|particles.area: Pair potentials for metals and noble gases

materials/structure|particles.title: Room-temperature isotherm of solid xenon from exp-6 NVT MD and Vinet fit
materials/structure|particles.gist: Run NVT MD of fcc xenon with a Buckingham exp-6 potential at several densities and compute pressures from the virial with tail corrections. Fit the P-V data to Vinet and third-order Birch-Murnaghan forms and compare V0, K0 and K0'.
materials/structure|particles.area: Equations of state and bulk modulus

materials/structure|particles.title: Thermal expansion of Sutton-Chen rhodium: NPT MD versus quasiharmonic theory
materials/structure|particles.gist: Obtain the lattice constant of Sutton-Chen fcc Rh versus temperature from NPT MD, and separately from minimizing the quasiharmonic free energy built on dynamical-matrix phonons. Compare the two thermal-expansion coefficients and identify where anharmonicity breaks the quasiharmonic result.
materials/structure|particles.area: Equations of state and bulk modulus

materials/structure|particles.title: Dynamics of the supercooled Dzugutov liquid: self-intermediate scattering and non-Gaussian parameter
materials/structure|particles.gist: Quench a one-component Dzugutov-potential liquid by MD to several supercooled temperatures. Compute the MSD, the self-intermediate scattering function F_s(q,t) with stretched-exponential α-relaxation times, and the peak of the non-Gaussian parameter α2(t).

materials/structure|particles.title: Phonon linewidths of Stillinger-Weber germanium from spectral energy density
materials/structure|particles.gist: Run NVE MD of diamond-structure Ge with the Stillinger-Weber Ge parametrization. Project atomic velocities onto Bloch waves along Γ-X to compute the spectral energy density, then fit Lorentzians to get temperature-dependent frequencies and lifetimes.
materials/structure|particles.area: Reciprocal lattice and Brillouin zone construction

materials/structure|particles.title: Finnis-Sinclair molybdenum 1/2<111> screw dislocation core and differential displacement map
materials/structure|particles.gist: Insert a screw dislocation into a cylindrical bcc Mo cell using the anisotropic or isotropic elastic field, then relax it with the Finnis-Sinclair potential using fixed outer boundary atoms. Compute the Vitek differential-displacement map and the core polarity to classify the core as compact or degenerate.

materials/structure|particles.title: Phonon drag coefficient of a gliding edge dislocation in Sutton-Chen aluminium
materials/structure|particles.gist: Apply shear tractions via surface forces to a periodic slab containing an edge dislocation, with Langevin control of temperature. Measure the steady glide velocity versus stress at several temperatures and extract the linear drag coefficient B(T).

materials/structure|particles.title: Critical nucleus size in supercooled Lennard-Jones liquid by the seeding method
materials/structure|particles.gist: Embed fcc seeds of varying size, identified with ten Wolde-Frenkel q6 solid-bond criteria, in a supercooled LJ liquid and run NPT MD replicas. Locate the size with 50% growth probability and fit classical nucleation theory for the interfacial free energy and the barrier.

materials/structure|particles.title: Superionic transition of CaF2 with rigid-ion Born-Mayer-Huggins MD
materials/structure|particles.gist: Run MD of fluorite CaF2 with Born-Mayer-Huggins plus Coulomb interactions (Wolf or Ewald summation) across temperature. Compute fluoride MSD and diffusivity, the anion-sublattice Lindemann ratio and the Ca-F coordination change that mark the Faraday transition.

materials/structure|particles.title: Force-matching an effective pair potential to Sutton-Chen many-body forces
materials/structure|particles.gist: Generate MD snapshots of a Sutton-Chen metal at several temperatures and densities. Fit cubic-spline pair-potential coefficients to the reference forces by linear least squares, and assess transferability and parameter sensitivity through the Jacobian and errors in the lattice constant and vacancy energy.

materials/structure|particles.title: Rigid-unit-mode negative thermal expansion of a corner-sharing square framework
materials/structure|particles.gist: Simulate a 2D network of corner-linked rigid squares (stiff bonds plus soft hinge angles) with NPT MD. Compute the area thermal-expansion coefficient and the rocking-angle distribution, and show the negative expansion arising from rigid-unit-mode tilting.

materials/structure|particles.title: Axial channeling critical angle of MeV He ions along Si<110> from ZBL trajectories
materials/structure|particles.gist: Integrate ion trajectories through a rigid diamond-Si lattice with thermal vibrations, using ZBL pair forces and neighbor lists. Compute transmitted fractions versus incidence angle and compare the channeling half-width with the Lindhard critical angle.
materials/structure|particles.area: Pair potentials for metals and noble gases

materials/structure|particles.title: Size-dependent melting of Sutton-Chen gold clusters and Pawlow fit
materials/structure|particles.gist: Heat truncated-octahedral Au clusters of 100-2000 atoms with stepwise Langevin MD. Detect melting from caloric-curve jumps and the Lindemann index, then fit the melting-point depression to the Pawlow 1/R law.
materials/structure|particles.area: Pair potentials for metals and noble gases

materials/structure|particles.title: Sintering neck growth between two Sutton-Chen silver nanoparticles
materials/structure|particles.gist: Place two equilibrated Ag spheres in contact and run NVT MD at several temperatures. Track neck radius, shrinkage and the gyration tensor over time, and fit the neck-growth power-law exponent to identify the dominant transport mechanism.
materials/structure|particles.area: Pair potentials for metals and noble gases

materials/structure|particles.title: Nanovoid growth under hydrostatic tension in Finnis-Sinclair tantalum
materials/structure|particles.gist: Apply incremental triaxial strain to a periodic bcc Ta cell containing a spherical void, with MD at fixed temperature. Record the pressure-strain curve, the cavitation (spall) stress versus void radius and the onset of dislocation emission from the void surface.

materials/structure|particles.title: Two-temperature-model Langevin MD of a laser-heated Morse nickel film
materials/structure|particles.gist: Couple a finite-difference electron heat equation to atomistic MD through local Langevin electron-phonon friction. Compute lattice temperature evolution, the equilibration time and the absorbed-fluence threshold for melting of a thin film.
materials/structure|particles.area: Pair potentials for metals and noble gases

materials/structure|particles.title: Critical size for misfit dislocation in a mismatched LJ island on rigid substrate
materials/structure|particles.gist: Relax finite 2D LJ islands of varying size and misfit on a rigid sinusoidal substrate potential. Compute the edge strain relaxation profile and the island size at which inserting a misfit dislocation lowers the total energy.

materials/structure|particles.title: Sputtering yield of Pt(111) under Ar bombardment with Sutton-Chen plus ZBL
materials/structure|particles.gist: Launch Ar projectiles at random impact points on a Pt(111) slab, using a ZBL-splined Sutton-Chen potential and adaptive time steps. Count ejected atoms to obtain the sputtering yield versus incident energy and compare with Sigmund/Yamamura estimates.
materials/structure|particles.area: Pair potentials for metals and noble gases

materials/structure|particles.title: One-dimensional crowdion migration in Finnis-Sinclair vanadium
materials/structure|particles.gist: Insert a <111> crowdion self-interstitial into bcc V, relax it, then run MD at several temperatures. Project the defect trajectory onto the crowdion axis to obtain 1D diffusivities and an effective migration barrier from Arrhenius fits.

materials/structure|particles.title: Methane self-diffusion in a rigid LJ silicalite-like zeolite framework
materials/structure|particles.gist: Model methane as united-atom LJ spheres moving through a rigid periodic oxygen framework with a precomputed grid potential and loading-dependent MD. Compute self-diffusivities from the MSD along each channel direction and the diffusion anisotropy.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Howie-Whelan two-beam intensities with anomalous absorption and thickness averaging
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Solve the analytic two-beam Howie-Whelan equations with complex extinction distances to give bright- and dark-field intensities versus thickness and deviation parameter. Then average numerically over a thickness wedge to get bend-contour profiles.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Many-beam Bloch-wave systematic row calculation for Al 111 reflections
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Build the Bloch-wave structure matrix for an Al (111) systematic row of 2N+1 beams, with U_g from parametrized form factors and excitation errors. Diagonalize it, apply boundary conditions, and compute beam intensities versus thickness, comparing against the two-beam limit.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Zachariasen secondary extinction correction for a mosaic HOPG monochromator
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the integrated reflectivity of a mosaic graphite 002 crystal using the Zachariasen extinction factor with a Gaussian mosaic distribution, integrating numerically over angle. Find the thickness that maximizes the reflected neutron flux at a given wavelength.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Gaussian-shell model of vitreous SiO2 transformed to S(Q) with Lorch window
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Build partial pair distributions of a-SiO2 from Gaussian Si-O, O-O and Si-Si shells with given coordinations. Transform them to the neutron-weighted S(Q) by sine-transform quadrature, and quantify the first sharp diffraction peak and the effect of the Lorch modification function.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Debye-equation scattering from a random sequential addition sphere packing
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Generate a random packing of hard spheres in a box by random sequential addition. Compute the scattered intensity with the Debye scattering equation multiplied by the sphere form factor, and compare its structure-factor peak with Percus-Yevick at the same density.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Tool-Narayanaswamy-Moynihan fictive temperature under cooling-rate history
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Integrate the TNM structural relaxation model with a stretched-exponential relaxation function as a discretized Boltzmann superposition over a cooling-reheating schedule. Compute the fictive temperature, the apparent glass transition and the normalized heat-capacity overshoot.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Kauzmann temperature and Adam-Gibbs relaxation from heat-capacity data
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Integrate the excess heat capacity ΔCp/T of a glass-former from the melting point downward to get the configurational entropy and the Kauzmann temperature. Evaluate Adam-Gibbs relaxation times and compare them with a Vogel-Fulcher fit.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Amorphous silicon coordination and bond-angle disorder from shell widths
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Model a-Si g(r) with first and second Gaussian shells, where the second-shell width follows from a Gaussian bond-angle distribution around 109.47°. Integrate 4πρr²g(r) to obtain coordination numbers and invert the second-shell width for the angle spread.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Debye-Bueche SAXS of nanoporous amorphous carbon and Porod invariant
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Debye-Bueche exponential correlation-function scattering law for a random two-phase porous carbon. Compute the Porod invariant by quadrature and use it, with the Porod constant, to extract porosity and specific surface area.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Hyperuniformity of a jammed harmonic soft-disk packing
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Generate a jammed bidisperse soft-disk packing by FIRE energy minimization at fixed density. Compute S(k) by direct summation over wavevectors and extrapolate S(k→0) to assess hyperuniformity near the jamming point.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: FIRE relaxation of Lennard-Jones clusters and icosahedral magic numbers
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Implement the FIRE minimizer with analytic LJ forces and relax 13- and 55-atom clusters from perturbed icosahedral and cuboctahedral seeds. Compare the relaxed energies to identify the stable motif.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Variable-cell enthalpy relaxation of a 2D Morse triangular lattice under pressure
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Compute the virial stress tensor of a periodic 2D Morse crystal and relax both atomic positions and cell vectors to minimize H = E + PA. Report the equilibrium area and the 2D bulk modulus versus applied pressure.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Surface interlayer relaxation of Lennard-Jones fcc(100) and (111) slabs
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Use planar lattice sums of the LJ potential to write the energy of a slab as a function of its interlayer spacings. Minimize with conjugate gradient to find the first- and second-layer relaxations and the surface energies.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Relaxed vacancy formation energy in Morse copper by conjugate gradient
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Build an fcc Cu supercell with a Morse potential, remove one atom, and relax the neighbors with nonlinear conjugate gradient. Compute the unrelaxed and relaxed vacancy formation energies, the relaxation volume, and their convergence with supercell size.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Tetragonal relaxation of a biaxially strained Morse fcc thin film
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Impose an in-plane epitaxial strain on a Morse fcc crystal and relax the out-of-plane lattice parameter by energy minimization. Compare the resulting strain ratio with the linear-elastic -2c12/c11 prediction at increasing misfit.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Athermal recombination-corrected arc-dpa efficiency versus NRT for metals
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Implement the Nordlund arc-dpa efficiency function with material parameters for Fe, Cu and W. Compute the surviving Frenkel pairs versus damage energy and integrate over a PKA spectrum to compare arc-dpa and NRT dpa.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: ZBL scattering angle from Gauss-Chebyshev quadrature of the classical integral
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Find the distance of closest approach with the ZBL universal screened potential by root finding. Compute the center-of-mass scattering angle by Gauss-Chebyshev quadrature of the deflection integral, and benchmark it against the Biersack-Haggmark magic formula.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Nuclear stopping cross-section from ZBL energy-transfer integration
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Integrate the ZBL energy transfer T(p) = γE sin²(θ/2) over impact parameter to get the nuclear stopping cross-section for Ar in Si. Compare the result with the ZBL universal reduced nuclear stopping fit.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Spectrum-averaged dpa cross-section of iron in a Watt fission spectrum
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Combine isotropic elastic neutron scattering kinematics, the recoil-energy distribution, and the NRT damage function with Robinson partition to compute σ_d(E_n). Fold σ_d(E_n) with a Watt fission spectrum by nested quadrature to get the dpa per unit fluence.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Binary-collision Monte Carlo ion range distribution in amorphous silicon
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Implement a TRIM-like BCA with random free-flight paths, magic-formula scattering angles and Lindhard-Scharff electronic stopping for B ions in a-Si. Compute the projected range, straggling and the Kinchin-Pease vacancy count per ion.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Projected ion range by integrating combined nuclear and electronic stopping
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Combine ZBL nuclear stopping with Lindhard-Scharff electronic stopping at low energy and Bethe-Bloch stopping at high energy. Integrate dE/S(E) to get the path length, then apply a projected-range correction for He and Xe ions in Fe.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Waite diffusion-limited recombination kinetics of correlated Frenkel pairs
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Use the Waite time-dependent rate constant with an initial distribution of vacancy-interstitial separations. Integrate the surviving-pair fraction over time to obtain the correlated and uncorrelated recombination fractions.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Seitz thermal spike temperature profile and molten volume
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the closed-form solution for an instantaneous point and line heat source in copper deposited by a cascade. Compute T(r,t), the maximum molten radius, and the number of atoms that exceed the melting temperature.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Isotropic mode-I K-field displacements imposed on a triangular lattice
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Compute Williams mode-I crack-tip displacement fields under plane strain and plane stress and apply them to a 2D triangular lattice. Verify G = K²/E' by evaluating the strain energy in an annulus at two load levels.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Anisotropic Sih-Paris-Irwin crack-tip field for cleavage in silicon
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Solve the characteristic sextic or quartic for the complex roots μ_k of cubic Si on a (111)[1-10] crack system. Build the anisotropic near-tip displacement field and compute the energy release rate prefactor relating G to K_I.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Griffith fracture stress of graphene from bond-cutting surface energy
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Compute the edge energy of armchair and zigzag graphene from a pair-bond energy model. Combine it with the 2D Young's modulus in the Griffith relation to obtain critical stress versus crack length.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Numerical J-integral on contours around an analytic mode-I crack tip
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the J-integral by quadrature of the strain energy density and the traction-displacement-gradient term along circular and rectangular contours, using the analytic K-field. Verify path independence and J = K²/E'.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Dugdale cohesive zone length and crack-tip opening displacement
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Compute the Dugdale strip-yield zone length and the CTOD from closed-form expressions for a center crack in an infinite plate. Cross-check them by numerically integrating the cohesive closure weight-function equation.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Weight-function stress intensity factor for an edge crack in residual stress
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Integrate a residual stress profile, such as a quench or shot-peening profile, against the Bueckner/Glinka weight function for an edge crack. Compute K versus crack depth and identify crack-arrest depths.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Lattice trapping of a crack in a 2D harmonic spring lattice
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Apply K-field boundary displacements to a triangular lattice of breakable linear springs and relax it with conjugate gradient. Find the upper and lower K values for crack advance and healing, and compare them with the Griffith K_G.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Rice criterion for ductile versus brittle crack tips in fcc metals
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Compute K_Ie for dislocation emission from the unstable stacking fault energy, including the slip-plane orientation factors of the Rice 1992 model. Compute K_Ic from the surface energy and classify Cu, Al, Ni and Ir.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Mixed-mode crack kinking angle by maximum tangential stress criterion
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the near-tip hoop stress for combined K_I and K_II and solve for the kink angle that maximizes it. Map the effective toughness and kink angle against mode mixity.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Termination ripples and Lorch modification in nickel G(r)
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Compute S(Q) of an fcc Ni cluster with the Debye equation and Fourier-sine transform it to G(r) for several Q_max values. Quantify the ripple amplitude and the peak broadening with and without the Lorch window.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: X-ray weighted partial PDFs of zincblende GaAs
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Compute Ga-Ga, As-As and Ga-As partial PDFs of GaAs. Combine them with Q-dependent Waasmaier-Kirfel form-factor weights through S(Q) and back-transform to compare true and approximate X-ray total G(r).

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Warren-Cowley short-range order from partial PDFs of an fcc alloy
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Generate a Cu3Au-like fcc configuration with tunable chemical order and compute partial PDFs. Integrate the first-shell peaks to obtain Warren-Cowley α1 and compare it with the imposed ordering.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: PDF of finite graphene flakes via Debye equation and finite Q_max
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Build hexagonal graphene flakes of several sizes and compute their PDF, including a finite-Q_max transform of the Debye-equation S(Q). Extract C-C bond lengths and the size-induced damping of higher shells.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Debye temperature of fcc Lennard-Jones argon from Brillouin-zone phonon DOS
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Build the dynamical matrix of fcc LJ argon with first- and second-neighbor force constants and sample the Brillouin zone. Compute the heat capacity by integrating over the phonon DOS and extract the effective Debye temperature θ_D(T).
materials/structure|quad_models.area: Pair potentials for metals and noble gases

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Steele 10-4-3 physisorption potential of argon on graphite
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Integrate the LJ interaction over the graphite basal planes to obtain the Steele 10-4-3 potential. Compute the adsorption well depth, the equilibrium height and the vibrational frequency normal to the surface.
materials/structure|quad_models.area: Pair potentials for metals and noble gases

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Zone-axis spot pattern of fcc aluminum with Ewald excitation errors
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Compute the relativistic 200 kV wavelength and the excitation errors of all reciprocal-lattice points near the [001] Ewald sphere. Weight the spots by kinematic Doyle-Turner intensities times a sinc² shape factor and convert positions to detector millimeters via the camera length.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Indexing a selected-area diffraction pattern of bcc iron by ratios
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Take measured spot distances and inter-spot angles, compare d-spacing ratios and angles against all bcc reflection pairs, and assign indices. Determine the zone axis by a cross product and the camera constant by least squares.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: HOLZ ring radii for silicon [111] zone axis
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Compute the spacing of higher-order Laue zones along [111] and the radii of the FOLZ and SOLZ rings from Ewald-sphere geometry. Evaluate the radii versus accelerating voltage and their sensitivity to lattice-parameter strain.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Kikuchi line positions and band widths in a tilted copper crystal
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Compute the Bragg angles and the projected Kikuchi line pairs for low-index Cu planes on the detector at a given crystal tilt. Report band widths and line shifts that can be used for precise orientation determination.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Electron scattering factors via Mott-Bethe formula from X-ray form factors
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Convert Waasmaier-Kirfel X-ray form factors to electron scattering amplitudes with the Mott-Bethe relation, treating the small-s limit carefully. Compare the result with Doyle-Turner fits for Si, Cu and Au.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Precession electron diffraction intensity integration over precession circle
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Integrate the two-beam dynamical intensity numerically over the azimuthal precession angle for each reflection to get integrated PED intensities. Show how increasing the precession angle drives the intensities toward kinematic ratios.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: RHEED streak geometry for reconstructed Si(001) 2x1 surface
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Intersect the reciprocal lattice rods of a 2×1-reconstructed Si(001) surface with the Ewald sphere at grazing incidence. Compute streak positions on a screen for [110] and [100] azimuths, including Laue zone circles.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Double diffraction of forbidden Si 002 spots in [110] zone axis
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Enumerate the pairs of allowed diamond-structure reflections whose vector sums give kinematically forbidden reflections in the [110] pattern. Estimate the double-diffraction intensities as products of kinematic amplitudes and check whether the paths survive a tilt off the zone axis.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Relrod shape-factor intensity and integrated reflectivity of thin foils
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the kinematic sinc² shape function versus excitation error for foils of different thicknesses. Integrate the intensity over s by quadrature to verify the thickness dependence of the integrated intensity and compute the relrod FWHM.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Eshelby tensor and misfit strain energy of a spherical inclusion
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the closed-form Eshelby tensor for a spherical inclusion in an isotropic matrix and compute the constrained strain and elastic energy for a dilatational misfit. Compare inclusions with different elastic constants (Eshelby inhomogeneity).

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Anisotropic energy factor of screw and edge dislocations in cubic metals
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Compute the anisotropic dislocation energy prefactor K for <110>{111} dislocations from the Stroh or integral formalism, using a numerical angular integral of the Christoffel-type matrix. Compare K with isotropic Voigt-averaged values for Cu and Fe.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Brenner REBO bond length and cohesive energy of graphene
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Implement a simplified first-generation Brenner hydrocarbon potential, without conjugation terms, for pure carbon in graphene. Minimize the energy with respect to bond length and compute the cohesive energy and the in-plane area modulus.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Parry 2D Ewald summation for a charged honeycomb point-charge monolayer
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the electrostatic energy of an hBN-like ±q honeycomb monolayer with the 2D-periodic Ewald method of Parry and Heyes. The reciprocal term uses erfc-weighted in-plane lattice sums. Compare with the 3D Ewald sum over slab images as the vacuum gap grows.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Probe-accessible surface area of zeolite-like frameworks by Shrake-Rupley sampling
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Place quasi-random points on spheres of radius r_atom + r_probe around each framework atom and discard points that overlap neighbouring spheres under periodic boundaries. Convert the accessible fraction to m²/g. Check the method against the analytic cap-overlap area for a simple cubic sphere packing.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Calibrating the Scherrer constant from Debye scattering of spherical and cubic Si nanocrystals
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Carve spherical and cubic silicon crystallites of several sizes and compute their powder patterns from the Debye equation. Extract the integral breadths of the 111 and 220 peaks. Fit the shape-dependent Scherrer constant K and compare it with the analytic values.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Oliver-Pharr hardness and reduced modulus of fused silica from Berkovich unloading
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Generate a Berkovich load-displacement curve with power-law unloading P = α(h - h_f)^m and fit the unloading branch. Obtain the contact stiffness and the contact depth with ε = 0.75. Apply a polynomial area function to compute the hardness and the reduced and sample Young's moduli.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Hertzian pop-in load from Huber subsurface stresses under spherical tungsten indenter
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the closed-form Huber stress field beneath a spherical Hertz contact on a W(100) surface. Locate the depth and magnitude of the maximum shear stress. Solve for the pop-in load at which this stress reaches the theoretical shear strength, roughly G/2π.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Maugis-Dugdale adhesive contact and pull-off force of an AFM tip on graphite
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Solve the Maugis-Dugdale transcendental equations for the contact radius versus load across the transition parameter λ. Integrate the cohesive-zone relations to recover the JKR and DMT limits. Compute the pull-off force of a silicon tip on HOPG as a function of tip radius.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Cubic CSL Σ values and misorientations about [100], [110], [111] axes
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Enumerate coincidence site lattices with Ranganathan's formula Σ = x² + N y² (odd part) and θ = 2 arctan(y√N/x). Build the corresponding rotation matrices and confirm that Σ equals the denominator of the rational matrix. Tabulate the Brandon-criterion tolerances for all Σ ≤ 49.
materials/structure|quad_models.area: Coincidence site lattices and grain boundaries

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Stress field screening of a finite low-angle tilt boundary dislocation wall
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Sum the closed-form isotropic edge-dislocation stresses for a finite wall of N dislocations in aluminum with spacing b/θ. Show that the stress decays exponentially away from an infinite wall, following Li's analytic expression, and that a finite wall leaves a long-range residual field. Compare with the Read-Shockley energy per unit area.
materials/structure|quad_models.area: Coincidence site lattices and grain boundaries

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Williamson-Hall size-strain analysis using Voigt integral breadths of ball-milled ferrite
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Simulate bcc Fe peaks as Voigt profiles evaluated with the Faddeeva function, using Lorentzian size broadening and Gaussian microstrain broadening. Compute the integral breadths numerically and separate them into Cauchy and Gauss parts. Recover the crystallite size and strain with Williamson-Hall and Halder-Wagner plots.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Zur-McGill coincident supercell search for MoS2 on graphene versus twist angle
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Enumerate integer supercell matrices for both hexagonal lattices and reduce each candidate pair with the Zur-McGill area-matching and reduction conditions. Compute the residual biaxial strain, shear strain and total atom count for each twist angle. Report the Pareto front of strain versus supercell size.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Matthews-Blakeslee critical thickness of In_xGa_{1-x}As on GaAs(001)
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Combine the Vegard-law lattice mismatch with the Matthews-Blakeslee force-balance equation, including the logarithmic core term and the 60° dislocation geometry. Solve the transcendental equation for h_c(x) with a root finder. Compare the results with the People-Bean energy-balance model.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Hill 1948 anisotropic yield locus of rolled sheet from Lankford r-values
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Derive the Hill48 coefficients F, G, H, N from r0, r45 and r90. Trace the plane-stress yield locus and compute the directional yield stress and r(θ) to predict earing tendency.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Sachs factor of random fcc and bcc polycrystals by orientation-space quadrature
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Integrate the maximum Schmid factor over SO(3) with Haar measure using Euler-angle Gauss quadrature. Compares the Sachs lower-bound factor (~2.24) with the Taylor value for uniaxial tension.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Kocks-Mecking dislocation density evolution and Voce hardening of aluminium
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Integrate dρ/dγ = k1√ρ - k2ρ with Taylor stress σ = MαGb√ρ to get stress-strain curves. Extract the stage-III hardening rate θ(σ) and the saturation stress versus the recovery coefficient.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Varvenne-Curtin solute strengthening of fcc high-entropy alloys from misfit volumes
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Compute the average-alloy lattice constant, elastic moduli and concentration-weighted misfit-volume variance. Evaluate the closed-form zero-temperature yield stress and its thermal activation for CoCrFeMnNi-family alloys.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Precipitate shearing versus Orowan bypass crossover radius in Al-Cu alloys
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Combine closed-form coherency/modulus shearing stress, which grows with radius, and Orowan looping stress with line-tension logarithms, which falls with radius. Find the peak-strength radius and strength versus volume fraction.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Westergaard full stress field of a central crack and K-dominance zone
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the complex Westergaard function for a Griffith crack under remote tension and compare it with the singular K-field. Map the region where the K-term error stays below a set tolerance.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Irwin plastic zone shapes under plane stress and plane strain
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Insert mode-I, II and mixed-mode K-field stresses into von Mises and Tresca criteria. Gives polar plastic-zone boundaries r_p(θ), zone areas and Irwin's effective crack-length correction.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Sneddon penny-shaped crack: opening profile and K under arbitrary pressure
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Compute the stress intensity factor and crack-face opening of an embedded circular crack from Sneddon's Abel-type integrals for nonuniform pressure. Validate against the uniform and parabolic loading closed forms.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Paris-law fatigue life of a center-cracked plate with finite-width correction
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Integrate da/(C ΔK^m) using the Feddersen secant geometry factor from the initial crack to the critical crack length set by K_IC. Gives cycles to failure versus stress range and plate width.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Weibull effective volume and strength scaling of ceramics in three- and four-point bending
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Integrate (σ/σ_max)^m over the beam volume for each loading geometry to get effective volumes. Predicts the strength ratios between test geometries and tensile specimens.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Rose universal binding energy relation: traction-separation law and work of separation
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Build the UBER cohesive law from surface energy and the screening length. Integrate it to verify the work of separation equals 2γ, then derive the peak cohesive stress and a Griffith-consistent cohesive-zone length.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Suzuki segregation and solute reduction of stacking-fault energy in Cu-Al
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Model the intrinsic stacking fault as a thin hcp layer with Fermi-Dirac solute enrichment from a segregation energy. Compute the composition- and temperature-dependent SFE and the resulting Shockley partial splitting width.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Coordination sequences and topological density of the sodalite (SOD) net
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Generate the SOD tetrahedral-node bond graph, compute shell counts N_k by periodic BFS and fit the closed-form quadratic. Compute topological density TD10 and compare with tabulated values.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Simmons-Balluffi equilibrium vacancy concentration from dilatometry and X-ray lattice data
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Use 3(ΔL/L - Δa/a) to extract vacancy site fractions from synthetic aluminium data. Fit Arrhenius formation enthalpy and entropy, including the divacancy contribution.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Sneddon load-depth relations for blunted conical and arbitrary axisymmetric indenters
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Evaluate Sneddon's integral formulation for a spherically tipped cone by quadrature to get P(h) and the contact radius. Compare with the pure cone and paraboloid closed forms and estimate the Oliver-Pharr area-function bias.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Nix-Gao indentation size effect from geometrically necessary dislocations
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Compute GND density under a conical indenter and the resulting hardness H(h) = H0√(1+h*/h). Fit H0 and h* to depth-dependent hardness data and convert to a characteristic length.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Gao weighting-function substrate correction for indentation modulus of thin films
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Use Gao's closed-form moduli-perturbation weight functions in contact radius over film thickness to predict the apparent modulus. Invert synthetic measurements on hard-on-soft and soft-on-hard stacks for the true film modulus.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Johnson expanding-cavity model of hardness-to-yield ratio for conical indentation
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Compute H/Y versus the indentation strain E·tanβ/Y from the spherical cavity solution. Locate the elastic, elastoplastic and fully plastic (Tabor) regimes for metals and ceramics.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Vlassak-Nix indentation modulus of anisotropic cubic crystals
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Compute the surface Green's function factor by Barnett-Lothe angular integrals of the Christoffel matrix inverse, then average over in-plane directions. Gives the indentation modulus on (100), (110) and (111) of Cu and W.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Small-angle scattering of Schulz-polydisperse spherical nanoparticles
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Average the sphere form factor over a Schulz size distribution by Gauss-Laguerre quadrature and verify against the analytic closed form. Extract the apparent Guinier radius and Porod constant versus polydispersity.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Cylindrical-sample absorption correction for Debye-Scherrer capillary geometry
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Integrate the incident and diffracted path lengths over the cylinder cross-section on a 2D quadrature grid to obtain A(θ, μR). Compare with tabulated corrections and the resulting intensity bias.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Bragg-Brentano Lorentz-polarization and finite-thickness absorption intensity factors
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Compute the LP factor with monochromator polarization and the thickness-dependent absorption factor (1 - exp(-2μt/sinθ)). Quantify relative intensity errors for thin films and low-absorbing powders.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Thermal renormalization of graphene bending rigidity and Young's modulus
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Solve the self-consistent screening equations for κ_R(q) and Y_R(q) of a thermally fluctuating membrane by quadrature over wavevectors. Gives the Ginzburg length and length-dependent effective moduli at 300 K.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Hencky blister test of pressurized circular graphene membranes
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Solve the Hencky power-series solution for deflection and stress of a clamped pressurized membrane. Combine it with the blister free energy to extract adhesion energy from pressure-deflection data.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Graphene-substrate adhesion energy from integrated Lennard-Jones sheet potentials
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Integrate the 12-6 interaction between a graphene sheet and a semi-infinite SiO2-like substrate to get the 9-3 or 10-4 continuum form. Compute equilibrium separation, adhesion energy and the peel-off stress.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Resonance frequencies of pretensioned circular graphene and MoS2 drums
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Solve the plate-membrane characteristic equation with Bessel functions J and I for clamped circular resonators under tension. Map the crossover from membrane to plate behaviour versus radius and prestrain.

materials/structure|quad_models.title: Hashin-Shtrikman bounds versus Voigt-Reuss for two-phase WC-Co cermets
materials/structure|quad_models.gist: Compute closed-form HS upper and lower bounds on bulk and shear moduli of an isotropic two-phase composite as functions of volume fraction. Compare them with Voigt-Reuss bounds and synthetic data for WC-Co.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Impedance-contrast reflection in a 1D staggered velocity-stress elastic rod
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Assemble the sparse staggered-grid velocity-stress update operator for a two-layer elastic rod. Propagate a Ricker pulse across the interface and measure the reflected and transmitted amplitude ratios. Compare them with the analytic coefficients (Z2-Z1)/(Z2+Z1) and 2Z2/(Z1+Z2).

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Spectral-radius CFL limit of the staggered elastic leapfrog propagator
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Build the one-step amplification matrix of the 1D staggered velocity-stress scheme in a heterogeneous medium. Compute its eigenvalues to find the largest stable Courant number. Compare it with the homogeneous estimate c_max dt/dx ≤ 1 for 2nd- and 4th-order spatial stencils.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: P and S arrival times from a point source in 2D P-SV Virieux scheme
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Construct 2D staggered difference operators with Kronecker products. Time-step the P-SV velocity-stress system from an explosive or force point source. Pick P and S arrivals at receivers and compare them with r/vp and r/vs.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Love-wave dispersion curves via finite-difference depth eigenproblem
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Discretize the SH-wave operator in depth for a layer over a half-space as a generalized eigenproblem. Solve it at each frequency to obtain fundamental and higher-mode phase and group velocities. Verify the results against the analytic Love-wave secular equation.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Rayleigh-wave phase velocity in a depth-graded medium by FE eigenanalysis
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Assemble 1D finite-element stiffness and mass matrices for coupled P-SV motion in depth for a vertically heterogeneous medium. Solve the quadratic eigenvalue problem in wavenumber to get Rayleigh-mode dispersion. Check the homogeneous limit c_R ≈ 0.9194 vs for a Poisson solid.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: SH resonance frequencies of a layered soil column for site amplification
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Build a finite-difference generalized eigenproblem for SH waves in a multilayer soil column over rigid or elastic bedrock. Compute the modal resonance frequencies. Compare the fundamental mode with the quarter-wavelength rule Vs/(4H).

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Newmark implicit FE time stepping of impact waves in an elastic bar
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Assemble consistent and lumped mass matrices plus a stiffness matrix for a 1D bar under end impact. Integrate with average-acceleration Newmark using sparse factorizations. Measure wave-front speed, spurious oscillations and energy conservation.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: PML reflection coefficient versus layer thickness in 1D velocity-stress scheme
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Augment the 1D staggered elastic operator with a graded perfectly matched layer. Measure the amplitude reflected back into the interior from a pulse. Map the reflection coefficient against PML thickness and damping profile order.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Crank-Nicolson oscillations and Rannacher startup for discontinuous heat data
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Solve the heat equation with step initial data using Crank-Nicolson at large dt/dx^2. Quantify the slowly decaying oscillations, which follow from the amplification factor tending to -1. Show that a few backward Euler startup steps restore smooth second-order convergence.
math/pde_numerics|linalg.area: Explicit and implicit heat equation solvers

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Peaceman-Rachford ADI for 2D heat equation with tridiagonal line solves
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Implement ADI half-steps as batched tridiagonal solves along x and y lines on a rectangle. Verify second-order convergence against a separable exact solution. Compare runtime with a sparse direct Crank-Nicolson solve.
math/pde_numerics|linalg.area: Explicit and implicit heat equation solvers

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: FTCS time-step limit from discrete Laplacian eigenvalues with Robin boundaries
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Construct the discrete Laplacian matrix with Dirichlet, Neumann and Robin conditions and compute its extreme eigenvalues. Derive the maximal stable FTCS time step for each case. Confirm the stability threshold by direct simulation.
math/pde_numerics|linalg.area: Explicit and implicit heat equation solvers

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Cooling of a sphere with convective boundary: radial finite volumes vs series
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Solve spherically symmetric conduction with a Biot-number Robin condition using implicit finite volumes. Compute the center-temperature history. Compare with the transcendental-eigenvalue series solution for several Biot numbers.
math/pde_numerics|linalg.area: Explicit and implicit heat equation solvers

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Matrix-exponential time stepping to separate spatial and temporal heat errors
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Compute exp(dt*A) of the discrete Laplacian by eigendecomposition to obtain time-exact semidiscrete solutions. Use these to isolate the purely temporal errors of backward Euler and Crank-Nicolson. Report spatial and temporal convergence rates separately.
math/pde_numerics|linalg.area: Explicit and implicit heat equation solvers

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Yoshida fourth-order composition splitting for NLS and observed order
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Compose Strang steps with Yoshida triple-jump coefficients for the cubic NLS. Verify fourth-order temporal convergence on a soliton. Compare accuracy per FFT cost against Strang and Lie splitting.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Vakhitov-Kolokolov stability of generalized NLS solitons from linearized spectrum
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Build the linearized operator about solitons of NLS with power-law nonlinearity using Fourier differentiation matrices. Compute its eigenvalues to find real unstable eigenvalues. Correlate them with the sign of dP/domega across nonlinearity exponents.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Mass-conserving Crank-Nicolson finite-difference NLS with fixed-point iteration
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Implement the Delfour-Fortin-Payre scheme with sparse complex tridiagonal solves inside a fixed-point loop. Verify exact discrete mass and energy conservation. Compare soliton accuracy and cost with split-step Fourier.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Scharfetter-Gummel versus central flux at high cell Peclet number
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Discretize steady drift-diffusion of carriers in a strong field with central and with exponentially fitted fluxes. Check the M-matrix property of each resulting matrix. Measure spurious oscillations and errors against the exact exponential solution.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Fully coupled Newton versus Gummel at high injection in a pin diode
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Assemble the block Jacobian of the coupled Poisson and continuity system and solve it with sparse LU. Compare nonlinear iteration counts and convergence failure with Gummel decoupling as forward bias increases.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Illuminated silicon solar cell J-V with Beer-Lambert generation
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Add an optical generation profile and SRH recombination to the drift-diffusion equations. Solve for the illuminated J-V curve. Report the short-circuit current, open-circuit voltage, fill factor and efficiency.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Poisson-Nernst-Planck double layer and differential capacitance at an electrode
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Solve the steady PNP equations for a binary electrolyte near a charged electrode with Newton and Slotboom-type fluxes. Compute the diffuse-layer profile and differential capacitance versus potential. Compare with Gouy-Chapman theory.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Preissman box multisymplectic scheme for the linear wave equation
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Implement the Preissman box scheme as a sparse implicit space-time system for the wave equation in first-order multisymplectic form. Compute its numerical dispersion relation. Verify that local energy-flux conservation and global energy hold over long times.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: 2D Yee TE scheme energy boundedness and discrete Gauss law preservation
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Write Yee FDTD as a symplectic splitting using sparse curl matrices, and verify div(curl) = 0 algebraically. Check that the discrete Gauss law is preserved to roundoff. Show that a modified electromagnetic energy is exactly conserved in a PEC cavity.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Furihata discrete-variational scheme for Cahn-Hilliard energy dissipation
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Discretize Cahn-Hilliard with a discrete-gradient scheme solved by Newton with a sparse Jacobian. Verify monotone decay of the discrete free energy and exact mass conservation for large time steps. Track the evolution of the coarsening length scale.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Gautschi trigonometric integrator for cubic nonlinear Klein-Gordon
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Apply a Gautschi-type exponential integrator using matrix functions cos(dt Omega) and sinc(dt Omega) of the discrete Laplacian, computed by eigendecomposition. Measure energy errors and numerical resonances at step sizes near multiples of 2pi/omega_k.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Symplecticity test of one-step propagator matrices for discrete wave equations
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Form the one-step matrices M of leapfrog, implicit midpoint and RK4 applied to a semi-discrete wave equation. Check M^T J M = J and that all eigenvalues lie on the unit circle. Quantify RK4's departure from symplecticity versus dt.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Upwind, Lax-Friedrichs, Lax-Wendroff and Beam-Warming on smooth and square waves
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Advect a Gaussian and a square pulse periodically with four schemes written as sparse update matrices. Compute L1 and L2 error orders for each. Contrast numerical smearing with Gibbs-type oscillations.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Instability of central advection schemes on stretched non-uniform grids
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Build advection operators on geometrically stretched meshes and compute the eigenvalues of the semidiscrete and fully discrete matrices. Locate eigenvalues with positive real parts that cause growth. Compare upwind and central behavior versus the stretching ratio.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Transient growth of Lax-Wendroff with inflow boundaries despite spectral stability
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Assemble non-periodic advection matrices with inflow and outflow boundary closures. Compare their spectral radius with the norms ||M^n|| and with pseudospectra. Demonstrate non-normal transient amplification consistent with GKS theory.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Implicit upwind advection at large Courant numbers: phase lag and damping
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Solve backward-Euler upwind and box schemes with sparse solves at CFL much greater than 1. Measure amplitude decay and phase speed error of a sine wave. Compare the measurements with the exact amplification factors.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Dimensional splitting vs corner transport upwind for solid-body rotation
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Advect a slotted cylinder and a cone in a rotating 2D flow using Strang-split 1D upwind and Lax-Wendroff sweeps, and separately with unsplit CTU. Report error norms, the maximum stable CFL and shape distortion after one revolution.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Wave-packet group velocity errors of Lax-Wendroff advection
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Advect modulated wave packets at several wavenumbers with Lax-Wendroff and track the speed of the envelope centroid. Compare measured speeds with the numerical group velocity d(omega_num)/dk derived from the amplification factor.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Absolute stability regions of SSPRK(2,2), SSPRK(3,3) and SSPRK(5,4)
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Form the stability polynomials from Butcher tableaux by computing det(I - zA + z e b^T). Trace the |R(z)| = 1 boundaries. Compute the real-axis stability intervals and imaginary-axis inclusion for each scheme.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: SSP coefficient of explicit RK schemes via Shu-Osher form and linear programming
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Convert Butcher tableaux to the canonical Shu-Osher form using the matrix K formulation. Compute the SSP coefficient as the largest r with nonnegative coefficients by bisection with LP feasibility. Verify the known values for classical SSP and non-SSP schemes.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Total variation growth of MUSCL-minmod advection under SSP and non-SSP RK2
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Advect a square wave with a minmod-limited MUSCL scheme. Integrate with SSPRK2, SSPRK3 and a non-SSP RK2 of the same order. Measure total-variation increase as a function of CFL relative to the forward-Euler limit.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Maximal CFL of RK schemes for third-order upwind-biased advection spectra
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Compute eigenvalues of the semidiscrete third-order upwind-biased operator. Find the largest dt for which the scaled spectrum fits inside each RK stability region, using bisection on polynomial magnitude. Compare predictions with simulations.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Threshold factor for linear problems from absolute monotonicity of stability polynomials
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Compute the radius of absolute monotonicity R(psi) by checking nonnegativity of polynomial derivatives at -r. Compare the linear threshold with the nonlinear SSP coefficient for several RK families.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Boundary locus stability regions of SSP linear multistep methods
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Construct the characteristic polynomials of explicit SSP linear multistep schemes and plot their boundary-locus stability regions. Compute SSP coefficients from the nonnegativity conditions. Compare these with stage-normalized SSP-RK regions.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Runge-Kutta-Chebyshev stabilized schemes for diffusion: stability length vs stages
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Build damped Chebyshev stability polynomials and the three-term RKC recursion. Verify that the real stability interval grows as about 2s^2 with stage count. Apply the scheme to 1D diffusion at time steps far beyond the forward-Euler limit.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Two-stream instability growth rate from Vlasov-Poisson simulation
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Simulate counter-streaming Maxwellian beams with a semi-Lagrangian Vlasov solver and measure the exponential growth of the field mode. Compare the rate with the root of the kinetic dispersion relation computed from the plasma dispersion function.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Fourier-Fourier spectral Vlasov-Ampere solver with energy conservation
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Discretize the distribution function in Fourier modes in both x and v, using filtered spectral derivatives. Advance the Vlasov-Ampere system with a split scheme. Monitor total energy, L2 norm and current-field consistency compared with Poisson closure.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: 1D electrostatic particle-in-cell plasma oscillations and finite-grid instability
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Implement cloud-in-cell deposition, a tridiagonal periodic Poisson solve and leapfrog pushes. Verify the plasma frequency against theory. Show heating due to finite-grid instability when the Debye length is much smaller than the grid spacing.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Chang-Cooper implicit Fokker-Planck relaxation to Maxwellian
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Discretize the Lenard-Bernstein or Dougherty collision operator in velocity using Chang-Cooper weights and solve it implicitly with tridiagonal systems. Verify positivity, density and energy conservation, and relaxation to a Maxwellian.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Positive flux-conservative semi-Lagrangian Vlasov scheme vs splines
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Implement a PFC conservative semi-Lagrangian advection with slope limiters. Compare it with cubic-spline interpolation on two-stream instability. Measure positivity violations, L1 norm and entropy conservation.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Modified equations of upwind and Lax-Wendroff by symbolic Taylor elimination
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Expand the stencils in Taylor series with sympy and eliminate higher time derivatives using the PDE recursively. Obtain the numerical diffusion and dispersion coefficients. Verify them numerically by fitting Gaussian variance growth and phase shift.
math/pde_numerics|linalg.area: Von Neumann stability and modified equations

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Fornberg finite-difference weights and leading truncation-error terms
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Compute arbitrary-order finite-difference weights on non-uniform stencils via Vandermonde solves and Fornberg's recursion. Extract the leading truncation-error coefficient symbolically. Verify the predicted errors numerically.
math/pde_numerics|linalg.area: Von Neumann stability and modified equations

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Stability region in Courant-diffusion number plane for explicit advection-diffusion
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Numerically maximize |G(theta)| for FTCS, upwind-diffusion and Lax-Wendroff-diffusion schemes over a grid of (C, r) values. Map the stable regions. Compare the boundaries with analytic conditions such as C^2 ≤ 2r ≤ 1.
math/pde_numerics|linalg.area: Von Neumann stability and modified equations

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Tanner's spreading law for a 1D thin-film droplet with precursor film
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Solve h_t = -(h^3 h_xxx)_x implicitly with Newton iterations and banded pentadiagonal Jacobian solves. Track the droplet radius over time. Fit the spreading exponent and compare with the Tanner prediction R ~ t^(1/7) for planar drops.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Linearized thin-film operator spectrum and dispersion relation
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Build the discrete linearization of the thin-film equation with disjoining pressure about a flat film, as a pentadiagonal periodic matrix. Compute its eigenvalues. Verify the growth rate sigma(k) = -h0^3 (k^4 - A k^2 / h0^4).

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Capillary ridge of gravity-driven film down an incline via Newton BVP
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Solve the traveling-wave thin-film ODE for a film flowing down an inclined plane onto a precursor, using Newton on a sparse banded system. Compute the capillary ridge height versus precursor thickness and inclination.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Axisymmetric droplet spreading in finite-volume radial coordinates
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Discretize the axisymmetric thin-film equation conservatively in r with implicit Newton time stepping. Verify volume conservation. Fit the contact-line radius growth to Tanner's law R ~ t^(1/10).

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Thermocapillary Marangoni thin-film deformation under imposed temperature gradient
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Solve the steady thin-film equation with a Marangoni shear stress from a localized heater using Newton with a banded Jacobian. Compute the film thickness bump and depression. Report how they scale with the Marangoni number.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Gravity current self-similar spreading h_t = (h^3 h_x)_x
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Solve the degenerate nonlinear diffusion equation for a released viscous gravity current with implicit Picard or Newton iterations and tridiagonal solves. Measure the front position. Compare with the self-similar solution x_f ~ t^(1/5).

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Brennan-Schwartz direct LCP solver versus PSOR for Crank-Nicolson American put
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Price an American put on a log-price grid with Crank-Nicolson. At each step solve the linear complementarity problem in two ways: the Brennan-Schwartz modified tridiagonal elimination and projected SOR. Compare the prices, PSOR iteration counts versus relaxation parameter, and the extracted early-exercise boundary.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: American call with continuous dividend yield: early-exercise boundary near expiry
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Solve the Black-Scholes LCP for an American call on a dividend-paying asset with PSOR or penalty iteration. Locate the exercise boundary S*(tau) from the grid and verify that it tends to max(K, rK/q) as tau goes to 0.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Perpetual American put on a truncated domain versus closed-form threshold
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Discretize the time-independent Black-Scholes obstacle problem on a truncated stock interval and solve the stationary LCP by projected SOR. Compare the optimal exercise level and the value function with S* = 2rK/(2r+sigma^2) as the domain and grid are refined.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Elastic membrane over a spherical obstacle: contact radius via projected SOR
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Solve the 2D obstacle problem -Laplace u >= f, u >= psi with a five-point finite-difference discretization and projected Gauss-Seidel/SOR. Extract the coincidence set and compare its radius with the radially symmetric exact free-boundary solution.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Dupire local-volatility calibration by Tikhonov-regularized least squares
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Generate synthetic call prices from a known local-volatility surface with a forward Dupire PDE solver. Recover a piecewise-linear local volatility by Gauss-Newton least squares with smoothness regularization, using finite-difference sensitivity matrices. Report the reconstruction error versus the regularization weight (L-curve).
math/pde_numerics|linalg.area: Inverse problems and calibration in finance

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Hyperthermia of a spherical tumor: CEM43 thermal dose from radial Pennes model
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Solve the radially symmetric Pennes bioheat equation with different perfusion in tumor and healthy tissue and a uniform RF power deposition, using implicit finite volumes with tridiagonal solves. Compute the temperature histories and the cumulative equivalent minutes at 43 C (CEM43) at the tumor center and margin.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Three-layer skin contact burn: Henriques Arrhenius damage integral and burn depth
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Solve the 1D Pennes equation through epidermis, dermis and subcutis with a hot-contact boundary condition, using Crank-Nicolson and harmonic interface conductivities. Integrate the Henriques Arrhenius damage function and report the depth at which Omega = 1 versus contact duration.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: CFS-CPML versus standard PML for grazing and evanescent waves in 2D acoustics
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Implement a recursive-convolution complex-frequency-shifted PML and a classical PML for the 2D velocity-pressure acoustic system on a staggered grid. Measure the reflected energy against a large-domain reference for a near-field source close to the boundary, as a function of the alpha shift parameter.
math/pde_numerics|linalg.area: Absorbing boundaries and perfectly matched layers

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Paine-de Hoog-Anderssen asymptotic correction for higher Sturm-Liouville eigenvalues
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Compute Dirichlet eigenvalues of -u'' + q(x)u = lambda u with a three-point finite-difference matrix. Add the correction obtained from the q = 0 discrete-versus-exact eigenvalue difference, and show that the eigenvalue error becomes uniform in mode index rather than growing like k^4 h^2.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Sloshing frequencies in a rectangular tank with a bottom-mounted baffle
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Formulate potential-flow sloshing as a Laplace eigenproblem with the free-surface condition phi_z = (omega^2/g) phi, using P1 finite elements and a generalized eigenproblem posed on the surface degrees of freedom. Verify against omega^2 = g k tanh(kh) without the baffle, then quantify the frequency shift versus baffle height.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Chafee-Infante problem: Allen-Cahn steady-state bifurcations and Morse indices
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Compute nontrivial steady states of u_t = u_xx + lambda(u - u^3) with Dirichlet boundary conditions by Newton continuation in lambda. Count the positive eigenvalues of each linearization (the Morse index) and verify that the branches bifurcate at lambda = (n pi / L)^2.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Heat method for geodesic distance on a triangulated sphere
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Build the cotangent Laplacian and lumped mass matrix on an icosphere mesh. Solve one backward-Euler heat step from a point source, normalize the gradient field and solve a Poisson problem to recover distance. Compare with the great-circle distance as functions of mesh size and time step.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Lambda modes and dominance ratio of a 2D two-group core via Arnoldi iteration
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Assemble the finite-difference two-group diffusion operators for a large square core and compute several leading k-eigenvalues and their flux harmonics with Arnoldi iteration. Relate the dominance ratio k2/k1 to core size and to the slow convergence of plain power iteration.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Doppler feedback in a slab reactor: nonlinear k-eigenvalue with fuel temperature coupling
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Couple a one-group diffusion eigenproblem to a 1D fuel heat-conduction model through a square-root-of-temperature Doppler absorption cross section. Iterate power iteration and heat solves at fixed total power until consistent, and report k-effective and flux flattening versus power level.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Kansa RBF collocation for Poisson: shape-parameter accuracy-conditioning trade-off
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Solve a 2D Poisson problem on a disk with multiquadric radial-basis-function collocation. Sweep the shape parameter and node count, recording the error and the condition number of the collocation matrix, and locate the optimal shape parameter predicted by the uncertainty principle.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Inverse heat conduction: surface heat flux from interior thermocouple data via Tikhonov
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Build the sensitivity matrix linking a piecewise-constant boundary heat flux to temperatures at an interior sensor in a 1D slab, using an implicit finite-difference solver. Reconstruct the flux from noisy data with Tikhonov regularization chosen by the L-curve or the discrepancy principle.

math/pde_numerics|linalg.title: Seepage under a sheet-pile cutoff: discharge and exit gradient versus conformal solution
math/pde_numerics|linalg.gist: Solve steady confined groundwater flow beneath a cutoff wall with a five-point Laplace discretization that includes an internal impermeable barrier. Compute the seepage discharge and the exit hydraulic gradient, then compare with Harr's conformal-mapping results as functions of embedment depth.

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Exact decimation of the 1D Ising chain in a magnetic field
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Derive the b=2 decimation recursions for (K, h, constant g). Iterate them and sum the accumulated constants to get the free energy per spin, then compare with the transfer-matrix closed form over a range of fields and temperatures.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Real-space renormalization group for spin models

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Niemeijer-van Leeuwen cumulant RG for the triangular-lattice Ising model
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Use sqrt(3) x sqrt(3) three-spin majority blocks and a first-order cumulant expansion to get K'(K) in closed form. Solve for the fixed point and y_T, and compare K_c and nu with the exact triangular-lattice values.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Real-space renormalization group for spin models

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Migdal-Kadanoff RG for q-state Potts models versus q and dimension
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Build the bond-moving plus decimation recursion for the Potts coupling in general dimension d. Locate the fixed points as functions of q and d, and compute nu(q) from the linearized flow.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Real-space renormalization group for spin models

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Ising model on the diamond hierarchical lattice: exact free energy and specific heat
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Use the exact recursion for the diamond hierarchical lattice and sum the free-energy contributions over generations to obtain f(K). Numerically differentiate to get the specific heat, and extract alpha from the fixed-point eigenvalue through hyperscaling.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Real-space renormalization group for spin models

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Two-site block RG for the quantum transverse-field Ising chain
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Diagonalize two-spin blocks and project onto the lowest doublet to get renormalized J' and h' (Fernandez-Pacheco/Jullien-Pfeuty scheme). Find the fixed-point ratio h/J and the exponent nu, and compare with the exact critical point h=J and nu=1.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Real-space renormalization group for spin models

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Migdal-Kadanoff RG for the 2D XY model via Bessel character expansion
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Expand the bond weight exp(K cos theta) in Fourier characters I_n(K)/I_0(K). Implement bond moving as a convolution of character coefficients and decimation as their product. Track the flow of the truncated character set and its approach to the high-temperature fixed point.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Real-space renormalization group for spin models

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Exact decimation RG for the Ising model on the Sierpinski gasket
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Derive the exact recursion for the nearest-neighbor coupling under decimation of the gasket's internal sites. Show there is no finite-temperature fixed point, and compute the low-temperature divergence of the correlation length from the flow.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Real-space renormalization group for spin models

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Kosterlitz RG flow equations and the BKT correlation-length singularity
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Integrate the Kosterlitz flow equations for the stiffness K and fugacity y numerically. Locate the separatrix that defines T_BKT, and fit the correlation length from the flow-stopping scale to xi ~ exp(b/sqrt(t)).
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Real-space renormalization group for spin models

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Three-coupling square-lattice Ising decimation with nearest, next-nearest and quartic terms
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Decimate every other site on the square lattice exactly to get the generated couplings K1', K2', K3'. Truncate (Wilson's scheme), find the critical fixed point, and get y_T from the eigenvalues of the 3x3 linearized matrix.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Real-space renormalization group for spin models

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Primitive versus Takahashi-Imada action for the harmonic oscillator via ring normal modes
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Diagonalize the discretized ring polymer to get closed-form P-bead partition functions for the primitive and fourth-order Takahashi-Imada actions. Compute the thermodynamic energy as a function of P, and verify the 1/P^2 and 1/P^4 Trotter error scaling against the exact (hbar omega/2)coth(beta hbar omega/2).
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Path integral Monte Carlo at finite temperature

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Winding-number superfluid fraction of a free particle on a ring
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Write the free-particle ring density matrix as a sum over winding numbers (a Jacobi theta function). Compute the winding-number distribution and the superfluid-fraction estimator <W^2>L^2/(2 lambda beta N) versus temperature, and check against the Poisson-resummed form.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Path integral Monte Carlo at finite temperature

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Levy staging construction for free-particle path segments
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Implement Levy/staging generation of Brownian-bridge path segments between fixed endpoints. Verify that the bead mean and variance match the closed-form bridge result, and compute acceptance ratios of staging moves in a harmonic external potential.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Path integral Monte Carlo at finite temperature

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Suzuki-Trotter mapping of the transverse-field Ising chain to a 2D classical model
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Map the 1D quantum TFIM at inverse temperature beta and Trotter number P to an anisotropic 2D Ising model with K_tau = -(1/2) ln tanh(beta Gamma/P). Compute its free energy by exact transfer matrix for small N, and show convergence to the free-fermion thermal energy as P grows.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Path integral Monte Carlo at finite temperature

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Automaton MPO and two-site DMRG for the TFIM versus elliptic-integral energy
