physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Build the bond-dimension-3 finite-state-automaton MPO for the transverse-field Ising chain and run two-site DMRG on open chains. Extrapolate the energy per site and compare with the exact -(1/pi) int sqrt(1+h^2+2h cos k) dk, evaluated as a complete elliptic integral.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Matrix product operators for lattice Hamiltonians

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Hubbard chain MPO with Jordan-Wigner strings versus Lieb-Wu Bessel integral
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Build the fermionic Hubbard MPO with Jordan-Wigner parity strings and compute half-filled ground states with two-site DMRG. Compare the energy with the Lieb-Wu result -4 int J0 J1 / (w(1+e^{wU/2})) dw over a range of U.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Matrix product operators for lattice Hamiltonians

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Sum-of-exponentials MPO for power-law interacting spin chains
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Fit J/r^alpha by a sum of K exponentials using least squares or a Prony-type method. Build the corresponding automaton MPO and quantify the energy error of a long-range Ising chain against exact diagonalization versus K and alpha.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Matrix product operators for lattice Hamiltonians

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Bilinear-biquadratic spin-1 MPO and the exact AKLT matrix product state
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Build the MPO for the spin-1 bilinear-biquadratic chain and evaluate the AKLT MPS energy through its transfer matrix. Verify E = -2/3 per bond and the correlation length 1/ln 3, then run DMRG away from the AKLT point to track the energy.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Matrix product operators for lattice Hamiltonians

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Energy variance from an MPO for H squared in Heisenberg DMRG
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Construct the MPO for H^2 by stacking MPO tensors, contract <psi|H^2|psi> with zipper environments, and use the variance as a DMRG convergence diagnostic. Check against exact diagonalization for small Heisenberg chains as the bond dimension is varied.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Matrix product operators for lattice Hamiltonians

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: t-V spinless fermion chain: DMRG compressibility versus Bethe-ansatz Luttinger parameter
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Build the Jordan-Wigner MPO for the t-V chain and obtain the charge compressibility and velocity from DMRG energies at neighboring fillings. Compare K with the closed form pi/(2(pi - arccos Delta)).
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Matrix product operators for lattice Hamiltonians

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Stochastic reconfiguration for a Gaussian wavepacket in an anharmonic well
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Parametrize a Gaussian trial state by width, center and phase, and evaluate the overlap matrix S and forces with Gauss-Hermite quadrature. Integrate the imaginary-time SR (TDVP) equations to the variational ground state of a quartic oscillator, and compare with grid diagonalization.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Wavefunction optimization by stochastic reconfiguration

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Natural-gradient optimization of a Gaussian trial wavefunction for the harmonic oscillator
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Derive the closed-form S matrix, forces and energy for exp(-a x^2) in a harmonic potential. Compare the convergence rate of plain gradient descent and SR with diagonal shift, and verify that SR reproduces imaginary-time evolution in the variational manifold.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Wavefunction optimization by stochastic reconfiguration

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Long-range Jastrow optimization for the Heisenberg chain by exact enumeration
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: For a 12-16 site Heisenberg ring, use a Marshall-signed Jastrow state with distance-dependent couplings v(r). Compute the S matrix and forces exactly by enumerating the Sz=0 sector, then optimize with SR and compare the energy and structure factor with Lanczos.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Wavefunction optimization by stochastic reconfiguration

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Gutzwiller-projected Fermi sea for a small Hubbard ring optimized by SR
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Combine a Slater determinant of plane waves with a Gutzwiller factor g^{D} and a density-density Jastrow, and sample configurations with Metropolis. Optimize by SR and compare the energy and double occupancy with exact diagonalization versus U.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Wavefunction optimization by stochastic reconfiguration

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Restricted Boltzmann machine wavefunction for the transverse-field Ising chain via SR
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Implement an RBM ansatz and its analytic log-derivatives. Build S and forces by exact summation for N <= 12, optimize with SR and a diagonal shift, and compare the ground-state energy with the free-fermion result across h.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Wavefunction optimization by stochastic reconfiguration

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: GFMC energy of the 4x4 square-lattice Heisenberg antiferromagnet versus spin-wave theory
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Run importance-sampled lattice GFMC on the 4x4 Heisenberg model. Compare with exact diagonalization and with the linear spin-wave energy -2J S^2[1 + (1/(2S))(1 - 2/N sum_k sqrt(1-gamma_k^2))], evaluated by Brillouin-zone quadrature.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Green's function Monte Carlo on lattices

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: GFMC for the 1D Bose-Hubbard model in the Mott regime
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Project the ground state of a 1D Bose-Hubbard chain at unit filling with a Gutzwiller guiding function and truncated occupation. Compare the energy and double occupancy with exact diagonalization and with the strong-coupling expansion E/N = -4t^2/U + O(t^4/U^3).
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Green's function Monte Carlo on lattices

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Spectral analysis of power-method projection with shift Lambda
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: For a small spin Hamiltonian, compute how the convergence ratio (Lambda - E1)/(Lambda - E0) and the positivity condition on G = Lambda - H depend on Lambda. Compare deterministic iteration counts with exp(-tau H) projection, and identify the optimal shift.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Green's function Monte Carlo on lattices

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Exact diagonalization of a small Kitaev cluster resolved by flux sector
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Build the Kitaev Hamiltonian on a periodic 12- or 16-site honeycomb cluster and construct the plaquette operators W_p. Block-diagonalize by flux sector, and compare sector energies with the free-Majorana prediction on the matching finite k-mesh, including gauge and boundary-condition subtleties.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Kitaev and frustrated spin models

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Specific heat of the Kitaev model from zero-flux Majorana fermions
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Compute the free energy of the zero-flux-sector Majorana gas by Brillouin-zone quadrature with Fermi factors. Differentiate to get C(T), and identify the high-temperature peak alongside the missing low-T flux peak, as a function of anisotropy.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Kitaev and frustrated spin models

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Exact diagonalization of the 12-site kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Build the sparse Sz=0 Hamiltonian on a periodic 12-site kagome cluster and compute the ground-state energy per bond, the singlet-triplet gap, and the number of singlets below the first triplet with Lanczos. Also compute the static spin structure factor.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Kitaev and frustrated spin models

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Vison-pair excitation energy in the Kitaev honeycomb model by Majorana BdG diagonalization
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Place two adjacent flipped bonds (a flux pair) on a large periodic honeycomb lattice and diagonalize the Majorana hopping matrix in real space. Extract the flux-pair energy (about 0.26 J at the isotropic point) and its convergence with lattice size.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Kitaev and frustrated spin models

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Twist-averaged boundary conditions for the free-electron kinetic energy
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Compute the kinetic energy of N free electrons in a periodic box under twisted boundary conditions. Average over twists with a Gauss-Legendre grid in the grand-canonical and canonical schemes, and quantify the residual shell-filling error versus N.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Homogeneous electron gas in periodic boxes

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Zero-point phonon energy of the bcc Wigner crystal from Ewald dynamical matrices
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Build the Coulomb dynamical matrix by Ewald summation of the second derivatives of 1/r. Diagonalize it on a Brillouin-zone mesh, and integrate the zero-point energy (1.33/r_s^{3/2}) and the Kohn sum rule.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Homogeneous electron gas in periodic boxes

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Finite-temperature Hartree-Fock exchange energy of the uniform electron gas
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Find the chemical potential from Fermi-Dirac integrals at given r_s and reduced temperature theta. Compute the exchange energy as a double momentum integral of Fermi occupations, and compare with the Perrot-Dharma-wardana parametrization in warm-dense-matter conditions.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Homogeneous electron gas in periodic boxes

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Gygi-Baldereschi correction of the Coulomb singularity in exact exchange
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the HF exchange energy of the electron gas on finite k-point meshes. Correct the q=0 divergence with an auxiliary function whose BZ integral is known analytically, and show the accelerated convergence relative to the uncorrected sum.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Homogeneous electron gas in periodic boxes

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Three-state Potts model critical point from CTMRG
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Build the Boltzmann tensor of the square-lattice q=3 Potts model and run CTMRG. Locate the critical coupling from the peaks of the correlation length and order parameter, and compare with the exact K_c = ln(1 + sqrt 3).
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Corner transfer matrix methods

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Ising corner transfer matrix spectrum from elliptic integrals
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Compute the CTM spectrum of the ordered Ising model with CTMRG. Compare its level spacing with Baxter's exact result epsilon_j proportional to j pi K(k')/K(k), evaluated with complete elliptic integrals, and verify the degeneracy pattern.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Corner transfer matrix methods

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Hard-hexagon lattice gas critical activity and density by CTMRG
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Encode the hard-hexagon exclusion model as a square-lattice tensor network with diagonal constraints. Locate the transition from the sublattice order parameter, and compare with Baxter's exact z_c = (11 + 5 sqrt 5)/2 and rho_c = (5 - sqrt 5)/10.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Corner transfer matrix methods

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: High-temperature Ising correlation length from CTMRG transfer matrices
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Build the row-to-row transfer matrix from converged CTMRG edge tensors, and get the correlation length from the ratio of its two leading eigenvalues. Compare with the exact 1/xi = -ln tanh K - 2K for T > T_c.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Corner transfer matrix methods

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Hubbard atom with discrete Hubbard-Stratonovich: exact auxiliary-field enumeration
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: For a single site, enumerate all 2^L Ising auxiliary-field configurations, compute the fermion determinants exactly, and obtain the double occupancy and energy. Show the Delta tau^2 Trotter error against the exact atomic-limit closed forms.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Determinant quantum Monte Carlo for Hubbard model

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: DQMC for the Hubbard dimer versus exact diagonalization
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Implement single-spin-flip DQMC with Sherman-Morrison Green's function updates for a two-site Hubbard model. Compare the energy, double occupancy and spin correlation with the exact finite-temperature grand-canonical results.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Determinant quantum Monte Carlo for Hubbard model

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: UDT-stabilized equal-time Green's function tested at U = 0
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Form long products of B matrices for a free tight-binding lattice and compute G = (1 + B_L...B_1)^{-1} with and without QR (UDT) stabilization. Compare with the exact Fermi-Dirac Green's function, and show the loss of precision at low temperature without stabilization.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Determinant quantum Monte Carlo for Hubbard model

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Double occupancy and local moment of the half-filled 4x4 Hubbard model
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Run stabilized DQMC on a periodic 4x4 lattice at half filling for several U at fixed beta. Measure <n_up n_dn> and the local moment <m_z^2> versus U, and compare small-U values with second-order perturbation theory.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Determinant quantum Monte Carlo for Hubbard model

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Antiferromagnetic structure factor of a half-filled Hubbard ring by DQMC
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Compute S(q) from equal-time spin correlations with Wick's theorem on DQMC Green's functions for a 1D ring. Compare S(pi) growth with temperature and U against exact diagonalization for 8 sites.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Determinant quantum Monte Carlo for Hubbard model

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Exact contraction of a toric-code PEPS on small tori
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Build the bond-dimension-2 PEPS of the toric code ground state, and contract the norm and Wilson-loop expectation values exactly on 2x2 and 3x3 tori. Verify the stabilizer expectations and the four-fold topological degeneracy from inserted loop operators.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Projected entangled pair states basics

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: AKLT state on the honeycomb lattice as a PEPS: norm and spin correlations
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Build the spin-3/2 AKLT PEPS from virtual singlets and the symmetric projector. Contract finite cylinders or strips by transfer matrix to get the correlation length and nearest-neighbor energy, and verify that the AKLT Hamiltonian annihilates it.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Projected entangled pair states basics

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Ising-PEPS with tunable entanglement mapped to classical Ising correlations
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Construct the Verstraete-Wolf-Perez-Garcia-Cirac PEPS whose squared amplitudes are classical Ising Boltzmann weights. Compute <sz sz> by boundary-MPS contraction, and compare with exact Onsager-based correlations and magnetization.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Projected entangled pair states basics

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Ma–Towler–Needs cusp correction of a Gaussian-contracted hydrogenic 1s orbital
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Inside a cutoff radius, replace an STO-3G-type Gaussian 1s orbital for nuclear charge Z with exp(polynomial). The polynomial coefficients are fixed by value, slope, curvature and Kato-cusp matching conditions. Compute the local-energy profile E_L(r), verify the 1/r divergence is cancelled at r=0, and quantify the reduction in local-energy variance by radial quadrature.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Jastrow factor cusp conditions

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Dimension-dependent electron-electron cusp coefficients for Padé-Jastrow factors in 2D and 3D
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Use sympy series expansions of the local energy near coalescence to derive the cusp coefficients in d dimensions: 1/(d-1) for antiparallel spins and 1/(d+1) for parallel spins. Verify numerically that Padé-Jastrow pairs u(r)=a r/(1+b r) with these values give finite local energies. Show the residual divergence when the coefficients are wrong.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Jastrow factor cusp conditions

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Quantum bouncer: reptation pure versus mixed estimators against exact Airy-function moments
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: For a particle in V=x (x>0) with a hard wall, sample reptile paths of fixed imaginary-time length under a poor trial function x·exp(-a x²). Compare the pure estimates of <x> and <x²> with mixed estimates. The exact values come from Airy-function zeros and quadrature of Ai²(x - x0).
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Reptation quantum Monte Carlo

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Yukawa-crystal Madelung energies: bcc versus fcc stability as a function of screening
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Derive the Ewald-type splitting for the screened potential exp(-κr)/r, using erfc-exponential real-space kernels and a Gaussian-screened reciprocal space. Compute lattice energies of bcc, fcc and hcp Yukawa crystals versus κa. Locate the bcc-fcc crossover near κa≈1.07, which is relevant to dusty plasmas.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Ewald summation and finite-size corrections

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Beth–Uhlenbeck quantum second virial coefficient of Lennard-Jones para-hydrogen gas
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Obtain s-, p-, d-wave and higher phase shifts δ_l(k) by Numerov integration in a Lennard-Jones potential, then Boltzmann-weight them with even-l bosonic symmetry. Integrate over k to get B2(T) from 15 to 300 K. Compare with the classical and Wigner-Kirkwood ħ² results.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Path integral Monte Carlo at finite temperature

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Quantum pendulum thermodynamics: Feynman–Kleinert free energy versus exact Mathieu spectrum
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Compute the variational effective classical potential of a rotor in a cosine potential, using Gaussian smearing and optimized trial frequency at each angle. Integrate it to get the free energy versus temperature. Benchmark against the exact partition function from Mathieu characteristic values.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Path integral Monte Carlo at finite temperature

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Migdal–Kadanoff renormalization of the 2D Blume–Capel model and its tricritical point
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Derive bond-moving plus decimation recursions for (K, Δ) of the spin-1 Blume-Capel model on the square lattice. Find the critical fixed point and the tricritical fixed point by Newton's method. Linearize the flows to get the thermal and crossover eigenvalues.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Real-space renormalization group for spin models

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Majority-rule real-space RG for site percolation on the triangular lattice
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Write the 3-site triangular-block majority-rule recursion p' = p³ + 3p²(1-p). Find the nontrivial fixed point p*=1/2 and estimate ν from the linearized flow. Extend to larger 7- and 19-site hexagonal blocks by exact enumeration to show convergence of ν toward 4/3.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Real-space renormalization group for spin models

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Three fermions at unitarity in a trap: Werner–Castin exponents and spectrum
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Solve the transcendental equation for the hyperangular exponents s of the (2+1)-fermion unitary problem in each angular-momentum channel. Build the trap spectrum E = (s + 1 + 2q)ħω for a ladder of excitations. Compute the three-body contribution to the high-temperature virial coefficient by summing the spectrum.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Few-body quantum systems

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Anderson orthogonality catastrophe: free-fermion overlaps after a local potential quench
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Compute the ground-state overlap of N spinless fermions on a chain, with and without a local impurity potential, as a Slater determinant of single-particle overlaps. Extract the power-law exponent and compare with δ_F²/π², where the Fermi-level phase shift δ_F comes from the T-matrix closed form.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Exactly solvable impurity models

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Haldane pseudopotentials of Coulomb interactions in the lowest two Landau levels
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Compute V_m for the 1/r interaction in LLL and n=1 Landau levels by Fourier integrals with Laguerre form factors. Add the Fang-Howard finite-thickness form factor. Check the closed-form Γ-function values and quantify the softening of V1 with well width.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Quantum Hall interaction models

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Kaufman exact partition function of finite periodic 2D Ising lattices
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Implement Kaufman's four-product formula for the Ising partition function on an m×n torus. Compute the specific heat versus temperature for several sizes. Extract the finite-size shift of the specific-heat peak and the logarithmic growth of its height, and compare with the Onsager infinite-lattice limit.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Exactly solvable lattice models

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: BCS–BEC crossover: Eagles–Leggett mean-field gap and chemical potential at T=0
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Solve the coupled regularized gap and number equations for a 3D two-component Fermi gas versus 1/(k_F a), with momentum quadrature checked against Marini's elliptic-integral closed forms. Report Δ/E_F and μ/E_F through unitarity, and the contact from the adiabatic relation.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Mean-field theory of strongly interacting Fermi gases

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Average sign of the spin-imbalanced attractive Hubbard dimer under Hubbard-Stratonovich decoupling
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: For the attractive Hubbard dimer in a Zeeman field, enumerate discrete HS fields over L time slices. Compute the determinant products, which are sign-free at zero field but not otherwise. Map the average sign versus field and temperature, and check the reweighted energy against exact diagonalization.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Auxiliary-field QMC and fermion sign problem

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Charge-channel Hubbard-Stratonovich sign problem for a spinless t-V ring
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Decouple the nearest-neighbor interaction of a 4- or 6-site spinless-fermion ring with bond HS fields. Exactly enumerate field configurations at small L to get single-determinant weights. Compute the average sign versus V and β, and compare the reweighted energy with exact diagonalization.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Auxiliary-field QMC and fermion sign problem

physics/many_body|quad_models.title: Goedecker–Teter–Hutter pseudopotential: analytic form factors versus numerical Hankel transforms
physics/many_body|quad_models.gist: Implement the GTH local and separable nonlocal pseudopotentials for a light element. Compute the reciprocal-space local form factor and projector Fourier transforms by spherical Bessel quadrature, and compare with the closed-form Gaussian-polynomial expressions. Evaluate the 1s/2s eigenvalues on a radial grid.
physics/many_body|quad_models.area: Pseudopotentials and locality approximation in QMC

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Binary CH4/CO2 GCMC selectivity in carbon slit pore versus IAST
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Two-component GCMC uses single-site LJ models of CH4 and CO2 in a 9-3 wall slit pore and computes component loadings and adsorption selectivity versus total pressure. The results are compared with IAST predictions built from simulated pure-component isotherms.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Configurational-bias GCMC of flexible bead-spring alkanes in slit pores
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Chains of 2-6 united-atom beads with harmonic bonds are inserted and deleted by Rosenbluth-weighted configurational-bias moves in an LJ slit pore. The adsorption isotherm is computed, and the chain-length dependence of the Henry regime is obtained.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Transition-matrix GCMC macrostate distribution for LJ fluid in slit pore
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Grand-canonical transition-matrix MC accumulates the collection matrix over particle-number macrostates for an LJ fluid in a slit pore. The free energy ln Π(N) is built, then histogram reweighting gives the full isotherm and the pore-condensation chemical potential from equal-area peaks.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Kremer-Grest chain radius of gyration and Flory exponent in good solvent
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Langevin MD of single FENE+WCA bead-spring chains of length N=10-80 in implicit good solvent. Radius of gyration and end-to-end distance are measured, and a log-log fit extracts the Flory exponent, which is compared with 0.588.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Pivot-algorithm self-avoiding walks: swelling exponent and universal ratio
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Self-avoiding walks on the simple cubic lattice are sampled by the pivot algorithm, with symmetry-operation moves and hashed overlap checking. The swelling exponent ν and the ratio <R_e^2>/<R_g^2> are estimated with error bars.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Osmotic pressure of semidilute bead-spring solution from the virial
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Multi-chain FENE+WCA MD in a periodic box uses cell lists. Osmotic pressure is computed from the molecular virial at several monomer concentrations and compared with the van 't Hoff limit and with des Cloizeaux c^{9/4} scaling.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Flory-Huggins binodal, spinodal and critical point of asymmetric blends
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Starting from the Flory-Huggins free energy of mixing for chain lengths N_A and N_B, compute the spinodal analytically and the binodal by common-tangent root solving. Report the critical χ and composition as functions of N_A/N_B.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Effective chi parameter from MD of binary LJ bead-spring blend
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: MD of A and B bead-spring chains in which the A-B LJ well depth is reduced relative to A-A and B-B. The intermolecular contact numbers and mixing energy are computed and mapped onto an effective Flory-Huggins χ, which is compared with the mean-field coordination estimate.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Constant-pH MC titration of a Debye-Hückel weak polyacid chain
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Linear chain of ionizable sites interacting via screened Coulomb potential at fixed conformation; Metropolis protonation flips with pH-pKa term give degree of ionization versus pH and apparent pKa shift versus salt.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Coupled conformation-protonation MC of a weak polyelectrolyte: swelling versus pH
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Bead-spring weak polyacid with harmonic bonds and screened Coulomb interactions. The simulation alternates displacement moves and protonation moves, giving R_g and ionization degree versus pH, which are compared against a rigid-chain titration.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Reaction-ensemble titration of weak polyacid with explicit counterions
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Restricted primitive model with HA ⇌ A⁻ + H⁺ reaction moves that insert or delete a counterion. Coulomb interactions are summed by Ewald in a small periodic box, and the titration curve is compared with ideal Henderson-Hasselbalch behavior.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Microscopic versus macroscopic pKa of two interacting ionizable sites
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Two titrating sites are coupled by an interaction energy. Exact enumeration of the four microstates gives the microscopic and macroscopic pKa values and the Hill coefficient, and constant-pH MC is then validated against the exact titration curve.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Grand-reaction method Donnan partitioning of salt and protons into polyelectrolyte
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Weak polyacid chains in a simulation box exchange H+, Na+ and Cl- with a reservoir of fixed pH and salt via grand-reaction moves; compute ionization and ion partition coefficients versus pH, compare to ideal Donnan theory.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Charge regulation between two titrating colloids versus separation
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Two spheres carry surface ionizable sites, and constant-pH MC is run at fixed center-to-center separations with screened Coulomb interactions. The average charges and the mean force are computed as functions of distance and compared with the constant-charge limit.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Particle-based Doi-model Michaelis-Menten kinetics in a periodic box
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Brownian enzyme and substrate particles react with a Doi reaction radius and propensity. Effective association rate constants are extracted from the simulated progress and compared with mass-action ODEs and the Erban-Chapman Doi-rate formula.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Dynamic disorder: Ornstein-Uhlenbeck modulated catalytic rate and waiting times
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: The catalytic rate k2 depends on a conformational coordinate that evolves under Langevin OU dynamics. Simulating single-enzyme turnovers gives non-exponential waiting-time distributions and turnover-time correlation functions, which are compared with the fast- and slow-modulation limits.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Crowding reduction of diffusion-limited association among hard-sphere obstacles
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Tracer substrate undergoes Brownian dynamics among frozen random hard-sphere obstacles at varying volume fraction. The simulation measures the reduced long-time diffusion coefficient and the resulting diffusion-limited rate to an absorbing target, and compares them with the 4πDR estimate.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Isomerization rate of a double-well dimer in explicit WCA solvent
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: NVT MD with velocity Verlet and a thermostat for a bistable bonded dimer immersed in a WCA solvent with cell lists. The method obtains the potential of mean force along the bond length and the rate constant via reactive flux at several solvent densities.
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.area: Kramers escape and Langevin barrier crossing

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Forward flux sampling of a rare escape rate in a high-barrier double well
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Interfaces are placed along x for Langevin dynamics. The method computes the flux through the first interface and the conditional crossing probabilities between successive interfaces, then validates the product rate against brute force and Kramers at moderate barriers.
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.area: Kramers escape and Langevin barrier crossing

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Isomerization rates of the 2D LJ7 cluster under Langevin dynamics
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Seven Lennard-Jones particles in 2D are integrated with a Langevin thermostat. Configurations are classified into the four known minima by energy quenching, and transition rates between isomers are estimated from dwell times versus temperature, with Arrhenius fits.
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.area: Kramers escape and Langevin barrier crossing

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Green-Kubo shear viscosity of LJ fluid with block-averaged uncertainties
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: NVE velocity-Verlet MD of an LJ fluid near the triple point stores off-diagonal pressure-tensor components. The stress autocorrelation is integrated, the Green-Kubo plateau is chosen, and the viscosity error bar comes from independent blocks.
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.area: Block averaging and statistical error analysis

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Optimizing MC displacement size by statistical inefficiency in LJ fluid
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Metropolis MC of a 3D LJ liquid is run over a range of maximum displacements. For each displacement, acceptance ratio and energy autocorrelation time are measured, and the displacement minimizing CPU cost per independent sample is identified instead of fixing 50% acceptance.
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.area: Block averaging and statistical error analysis

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Automated equilibration detection for LJ MD melting from fcc lattice
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: NVT MD of an LJ system is started from a perfect fcc lattice above melting. For each candidate cutoff t0, the statistical inefficiency of the remaining series is computed, and t0 is chosen to maximize the effective sample size (Chodera's method). Results are compared with block-average errors.
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.area: Block averaging and statistical error analysis

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Jackknife errors for heat capacity from energy fluctuations in LJ cluster
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Canonical MC of an LJ13 cluster is run at several temperatures to obtain the heat capacity from energy-variance fluctuations. Uncertainties come from blocked jackknife resampling and are contrasted with naive error propagation.
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.area: Block averaging and statistical error analysis

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: IAST binary mixture prediction from dual-site Langmuir pure isotherms
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: The reduced spreading pressure integrals are evaluated analytically for dual-site Langmuir pure-component isotherms. The IAST equations are solved for adsorbed-phase composition and total loading by nested root finding, and the result is compared with extended Langmuir.
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.area: Langmuir, BET, and multicomponent adsorption theory

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Isosteric heat: fluctuation formula versus Clausius-Clapeyron from GCMC isotherms
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: GCMC of an LJ adsorbate on a 9-3 wall surface is run at three temperatures. The isosteric heat versus loading is computed both from the ⟨UN⟩−⟨U⟩⟨N⟩ fluctuation formula and from Clausius-Clapeyron differentiation of interpolated isotherms.
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.area: Langmuir, BET, and multicomponent adsorption theory

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: BET analysis of simulated multilayer adsorption on a 9-3 LJ wall
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: GCMC of nitrogen-like LJ particles above a single attractive 9-3 wall is run up to near saturation. The BET equation is fitted using a Rouquerol-criterion pressure window to extract the monolayer capacity and C constant, and these are compared with the integrated first-layer density.
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.area: Langmuir, BET, and multicomponent adsorption theory

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Model selection among Langmuir, Sips and Toth isotherms by AIC
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Noisy synthetic isotherm data are fitted by nonlinear least squares to the Langmuir, Freundlich, Sips and Toth forms. AIC/BIC scores and bootstrap parameter confidence intervals are reported, along with the Henry constants extrapolated from each model.
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.area: Langmuir, BET, and multicomponent adsorption theory

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Solvation pressure oscillations versus slit width from GCMC
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: GCMC of an LJ fluid in a 10-4-3 slit pore at fixed chemical potential is run over a range of wall separations. The normal pressure on the walls and the solvation (disjoining) pressure are computed and show oscillations with a period near the molecular diameter.
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.area: Langmuir, BET, and multicomponent adsorption theory

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Hard-sphere contact value of g(r) and Carnahan-Starling pressure
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: NVT overlap-rejection MC of hard spheres with cell lists is run at several packing fractions. g(r) is histogrammed and extrapolated to contact to obtain the pressure via Z = 1+4ηg(σ⁺), which is compared with Carnahan-Starling.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Event-driven MD of hard spheres: collision-rate pressure
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Event-driven molecular dynamics uses a binary collision-time priority queue for hard spheres in a periodic box. The pressure comes from the collision virial and the collision frequency comes from Enskog-style rate counting, and both are compared with Carnahan-Starling.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Tonks gas of hard rods: exact equation of state and g(x)
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: MC of hard rods on a periodic line is used to compute the pressure and pair distribution. These are compared with the exact Tonks equation of state and the analytic piecewise g(x), with the finite-N corrections quantified.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Quasi-harmonic versus full anharmonic free energy of LJ fcc crystal
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: The LJ fcc dynamical matrix is built over a k-point grid to compute the harmonic phonon free energy. This is compared with the Frenkel-Ladd anharmonic free energy from MC, giving the anharmonic contribution versus temperature.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Einstein molecule method for LJ crystal free energy
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: One reference particle is fixed and the remaining particles are tethered by springs (the Vega-Noya Einstein molecule) for an LJ fcc crystal. The free energy is computed by thermodynamic integration and checked for agreement with conventional Frenkel-Ladd results, including the corrections.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Free energy of the triangular hard-disk solid via Einstein reference
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Frenkel-Ladd integration for hard disks on a triangular lattice in 2D with a center-of-mass constraint. The solid free energy is computed at several densities and compared with the free-volume cell theory approximation.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Vacancy formation free energy in LJ fcc crystal
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Thermodynamic integration decouples one particle in a fcc LJ crystal, combined with perfect-crystal Frenkel-Ladd references, to compute the vacancy formation free energy. The equilibrium vacancy concentration is then obtained versus temperature.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Metadynamics free-energy surface of the Müller-Brown potential
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Overdamped Langevin dynamics on the 2D Müller-Brown surface uses 2D Gaussian hills on a grid. The reconstructed free-energy surface is compared with the exact surface, and the minimum free-energy barriers between basins are extracted.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Adaptive biasing force mean-force estimation in a 2D potential
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Langevin dynamics of a particle in a 2D potential uses the CV x. The adaptive biasing force method accumulates the binned instantaneous force with ramped application, and the mean force is integrated to the PMF, which is compared with exact marginalization over y.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Quantum heat capacity of a harmonic chain by path-integral MD
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Sample a 1D harmonic lattice with staging path-integral MD and a Langevin normal-mode thermostat. Compute the heat capacity with the double-virial estimator as a function of bead number and compare with the exact phonon-mode Einstein sum.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Quantum delocalization and kinetic energy of liquid para-hydrogen by PIMD
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Run path-integral MD of para-H2 with the Silvera-Goldman pair potential near 25 K. Compute the centroid-virial kinetic energy, the radius of gyration of the ring polymers and g(r) broadening relative to classical MD, and extrapolate in bead number.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Markov state model of β-hairpin folding in an off-lattice Gō model
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Simulate a Cα Gō-model hairpin with Langevin dynamics and discretize trajectories by fraction of native contacts and end distance. Build count matrices to obtain implied timescales, the stationary folded population and the folding rate, and compare with direct transition counts.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Knock-on ion permeation in a three-site channel via MSM
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Run Langevin MD of two or three repulsive ions in a 1D multi-site channel potential under an applied bias. Discretize channel occupancy states, estimate the transition matrix and stationary flux, and compare the MSM current with direct crossing counts.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Microcanonical heat capacity of the LJ fluid from kinetic-energy fluctuations
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Run NVE velocity-Verlet MD of the Lennard-Jones fluid and apply the Lebowitz-Percus-Verlet formula, which relates ⟨δK²⟩ to Cv. Compare with canonical energy fluctuations from thermostatted MD and with a finite difference of E(T).

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Thermal expansion and Grüneisen parameter of an LJ fcc crystal from fluctuations
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Run NPT and NVT MD of a Lennard-Jones fcc solid. Obtain α_P from enthalpy-volume cross-fluctuations and the thermal pressure coefficient from energy-pressure correlations, combine them into the Grüneisen parameter, and compare with quasi-harmonic lattice dynamics.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Supercritical Widom line of the LJ fluid from Cp maxima
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Run NPT MD along supercritical isobars of the Lennard-Jones fluid and compute isobaric heat capacity from enthalpy fluctuations. Trace the locus of Cp maxima versus pressure and compare with the slope of the coexistence line near Tc.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Double-decoupling absolute binding free energy of an LJ guest in a rigid host
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Decouple an LJ guest both inside a rigid spherical-shell host and in bulk solvent, using a harmonic restraint and MD at multiple λ states. Solve the MBAR equations by Newton iteration and add the analytic restraint standard-state correction to obtain the binding free energy.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Green-Kubo conductivity of the restricted primitive model with Ewald forces
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Run MD of soft-core charged spheres with Ewald-summed Coulomb forces and compute the charge-current autocorrelation integral. Compare the conductivity with the Nernst-Einstein estimate from self-diffusion and with Debye-Hückel-Onsager limiting behaviour.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Image-charge depletion of ions near an air-water interface
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Simulate a primitive-model electrolyte near a planar dielectric discontinuity with Langevin MD, including image-charge forces. Compute ion density profiles and the Gibbs surface excess, and compare the surface tension increment with the Onsager-Samaras limiting law.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Temperature-accelerated MD on an extended collective variable
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Couple a hot auxiliary variable through a stiff spring to a particle on a 2D three-well potential, following the TAMD/d-AFED scheme. Recover the free energy along x from the auxiliary-variable histogram and compare the sampling speedup with plain Langevin dynamics.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Diffusing particle among random static traps: survival decay
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Run Brownian dynamics of tracers in 1D and 2D media with randomly placed absorbing traps. Measure the survival probability, which crosses over from a Smoluchowski mean-field exponential to a Donsker-Varadhan stretched exponential, and fit the decay exponents.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Statistical temperature MD caloric curve of a 2D Morse cluster
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Implement statistical-temperature MD (Kim-Straub), the MD analogue of Wang-Landau sampling, by iteratively updating T_S(E) and scaling forces. Integrate the statistical temperature to ln g(E) and obtain the heat-capacity peak of solid-liquid-like melting of a 2D Morse cluster.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Crooks crossing and Jarzynski free energy for stretching a FENE chain
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Perform forward and reverse steered Langevin MD on a FENE bead-spring chain's end-to-end distance. Collect work distributions, locate the Crooks crossing, and compare the Jarzynski, BAR and analytic free energies of the stretched chain.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Langevin splitting schemes: configurational temperature error versus timestep
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Integrate the LJ fluid with BAOAB, ABOBA and OBABO splittings at increasing timesteps. Measure the configurational temperature, potential energy and g(r) bias against small-step references, and identify the superconvergence of BAOAB.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Blue-moon constrained MD with Fixman/Z correction for a curvilinear CV
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Constrain a 2D particle (or diatomic) to level sets of a nonlinear collective variable using SHAKE/RATTLE, and average the Lagrange-multiplier force. Apply the mass-metric Z^{-1/2} correction and compare the resulting PMF with direct Boltzmann integration.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Axilrod-Teller triple-dipole contribution to liquid argon pressure
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Run MD of liquid argon with an accurate pair potential plus Axilrod-Teller three-body forces, using a neighbor list for triplets. Quantify the three-body contributions to energy and pressure along an isotherm and compare with experimental-like reference data.

chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.title: Density maximum of monatomic mW water by NPT MD
chemistry/mc_thermo|particles.gist: Implement Stillinger-Weber three-body forces with mW parameters (λ=23.15) and run NPT MD across supercooled temperatures. Locate the density maximum near 250 K and compute the isobaric thermal expansion from fluctuations.

chemistry/md|stochastic.title: MSM of Brownian dynamics on a periodic phi/psi torsion surface
chemistry/md|stochastic.gist: Integrate overdamped Langevin dynamics on a toroidal alanine-dipeptide-like dihedral potential with periodic wrapping, and grid-discretise into an MSM. Compare the MSM stationary distribution with the Boltzmann weights and report the conformer-exchange timescales.

chemistry/md|stochastic.title: Bayesian MSM uncertainty via reversible transition-matrix Gibbs sampling
chemistry/md|stochastic.gist: From finite trajectories of a three-state Langevin system, sample reversible transition matrices from the posterior using Noé's Gibbs sampler. Report posterior means and credible intervals of implied timescales and stationary probabilities.

chemistry/md|stochastic.title: Rate-matrix estimation from Gillespie trajectories of a folding network
chemistry/md|stochastic.gist: Simulate continuous-time trajectories of a known six-state protein-folding kinetic network with the Gillespie algorithm, then recover the generator by maximum likelihood from dwell times and jump counts. Compare mean first-passage times to folding with the exact values.

chemistry/md|stochastic.title: Chapman-Kolmogorov validation of a three-well potential MSM
chemistry/md|stochastic.gist: Estimate MSMs at a base lag from Brownian trajectories in a three-well 1D potential. Compare P(τ)^k with directly estimated P(kτ) for set-to-set probabilities, using bootstrap error bars to assess Markovianity.

chemistry/md|stochastic.title: Hard-sphere fluid S(k) from Metropolis MC versus Percus-Yevick
chemistry/md|stochastic.gist: Run NVT Metropolis MC of hard spheres in a cubic periodic box and compute S(k) as a direct sum over allowed reciprocal-lattice vectors, shell-averaged. Compare with the analytic Percus-Yevick structure factor at several packing fractions.

chemistry/md|stochastic.title: Lennard-Jones liquid S(k) via g(r) transform with Lorch window
chemistry/md|stochastic.gist: From MC configurations of an LJ liquid, compute g(r) and Fourier-transform it to S(k) with and without Lorch modification and long-range tail extension. Compare with direct k-space S(k) and assess truncation ripples at small k.

chemistry/md|stochastic.title: Hansen-Verlet freezing criterion for 2D hard-disk Monte Carlo
chemistry/md|stochastic.gist: Sample hard-disk configurations at increasing area fraction with Metropolis MC and compute the 2D structure factor from k-vectors. Track the height of the first peak of S(k) and locate where it reaches the empirical freezing value.

chemistry/md|stochastic.title: Finite-size extrapolation of S(k→0) by subvolume number fluctuations
chemistry/md|stochastic.gist: From grand-like subvolume sampling of an MC hard-sphere or LJ fluid, compute number-fluctuation ratios as a function of subvolume size. Extrapolate with the Román/Krüger finite-size Kirkwood-Buff correction to obtain S(0) and the isothermal compressibility, and compare with the Carnahan-Starling value.

chemistry/md|stochastic.title: Polymer form factor from pivot-algorithm MC of self-avoiding chains
chemistry/md|stochastic.gist: Sample off-lattice self-avoiding bead chains with pivot moves and compute the single-chain form factor P(q) by orientational averaging. Compare with the Gaussian Debye function and extract the Flory exponent from the Kratky-plot regime.

chemistry/md|stochastic.title: Perfect-screening small-k structure factor of one-component plasma
chemistry/md|stochastic.gist: Perform Metropolis MC of a 3D one-component plasma with Ewald-summed Coulomb energy at several coupling constants Γ. Compute S(k) and verify the Stillinger-Lovett k²/k_D² limit at small k.

chemistry/md|stochastic.title: BAR free energy between harmonic oscillators of different stiffness
chemistry/md|stochastic.gist: Draw Metropolis samples from two multidimensional harmonic wells and solve the self-consistent Bennett equation iteratively for ΔF. Compute the asymptotic variance and compare with the exact (d/2)ln(k1/k0) result.

chemistry/md|stochastic.title: Feedback-optimised temperature ladder for LJ7 cluster parallel tempering
chemistry/md|stochastic.gist: Run parallel tempering MC on a 2D LJ7 cluster and measure the replica-flow fraction f(T) from up/down labels. Iteratively redistribute temperatures with the Katzgraber feedback scheme to maximise round trips.

chemistry/md|stochastic.title: Neighbour swaps versus all-pairs Gibbs-sampling replica exchange mixing
chemistry/md|stochastic.gist: On a double-well test system, compare nearest-neighbour exchange with infinite-swap/Gibbs-sampling permutation updates among replicas. Measure the temperature-index autocorrelation time and round-trip rate.

chemistry/md|stochastic.title: Configurational sampling bias of BAOAB, ABOBA and OBABO Langevin splittings
chemistry/md|stochastic.gist: Integrate underdamped Langevin dynamics on harmonic and quartic potentials with three operator splittings. Measure the time-step dependence of the ⟨x²⟩ and kinetic-temperature bias and compare with known analytic results for the harmonic case.

chemistry/md|stochastic.title: Generalised HMC with partial momentum refresh and Forest-Ruth integrator
chemistry/md|stochastic.gist: Implement Horowitz GHMC with a Forest-Ruth fourth-order integrator for a 2D LJ fluid, using momentum flips on rejection. Measure the global error order, acceptance and the diffusion rate as a function of the momentum-mixing angle.

chemistry/md|stochastic.title: Weak and strong order of Euler-Maruyama versus stochastic Heun integrators
chemistry/md|stochastic.gist: Integrate overdamped Langevin dynamics in a nonlinear potential with both schemes, using shared Brownian increments for strong-error estimates. Fit the strong and weak convergence orders against a fine-step reference.

chemistry/md|stochastic.title: Metropolis-adjusted Langevin (smart Monte Carlo) for a Lennard-Jones liquid
chemistry/md|stochastic.gist: Implement Rossky-Doll force-biased smart MC with the asymmetric proposal correction for an LJ liquid. Compare acceptance and the mean-squared displacement per CPU step with plain Metropolis as a function of step size.

chemistry/md|stochastic.title: Shadow work and Metropolised Langevin correction of discretisation error
chemistry/md|stochastic.gist: Accumulate the shadow work during BAOAB Langevin steps on an anharmonic oscillator. Use it to estimate the KL divergence of the sampled distribution and implement a Metropolised variant that removes the time-step bias.

chemistry/md|stochastic.title: Exact CSVR kinetic-energy propagator via chi-squared noise sums
chemistry/md|stochastic.gist: Implement the exact Bussi update for the kinetic energy using gamma/chi-squared draws for many degrees of freedom. Verify that the canonical distribution is stationary and that the autocorrelation decays at the coupling rate 1/τ.

chemistry/md|stochastic.title: Maxwell-Boltzmann velocity initialisation with exact temperature on cubic lattices
chemistry/md|stochastic.gist: Generate fcc, bcc and hcp positions and draw Gaussian velocities, then remove centre-of-mass momentum and rescale to the target temperature with 3N−3 degrees of freedom. Verify the speed distribution and the momentum and temperature constraints.

chemistry/md|stochastic.title: Frenkel-Ladd Einstein-crystal free energy of fcc hard spheres
chemistry/md|stochastic.gist: Run MC of fcc hard spheres tethered by harmonic springs to lattice sites with a fixed centre of mass at several coupling strengths. Integrate ⟨Δr²⟩ by Gauss-Legendre quadrature to obtain the absolute solid free energy.

chemistry/md|stochastic.title: Lindemann melting of a Langevin-heated LJ fcc nanocluster
chemistry/md|stochastic.gist: Cut a spherical cluster from an fcc lattice and heat it stepwise under Langevin dynamics. Compute the Lindemann index from interparticle distance fluctuations and the caloric curve to locate melting.

chemistry/md|stochastic.title: MC thermal expansion and harmonic comparison for diamond-lattice crystal
chemistry/md|stochastic.gist: Generate a diamond lattice with a Keating-type bond-stretch/bend potential and sample it by NPT Metropolis MC. Extract the lattice parameter and mean-squared displacement versus T and compare with the low-T harmonic expectation.

chemistry/md|stochastic.title: FFT autocorrelation with zero-padding validated on Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process
chemistry/md|stochastic.gist: Generate an OU time series with the exact discrete update and compute its ACF by Wiener-Khinchin FFT with and without zero-padding, and by direct summation. Quantify the circular-wrap error and the agreement with exp(−t/τ).

chemistry/md|stochastic.title: VACF of an underdamped Brownian particle in a harmonic trap
chemistry/md|stochastic.gist: Integrate Langevin dynamics in a harmonic well and compute the VACF by FFT. Compare with the analytic damped-oscillator correlation in all damping regimes and check that its Green-Kubo integral is zero.

chemistry/md|stochastic.title: Memory kernel extraction from GLE simulations via Volterra inversion
chemistry/md|stochastic.gist: Simulate a generalised Langevin equation with an exponential memory kernel embedded through an auxiliary OU variable. Compute the VACF by FFT and invert the discretised Volterra equation to recover the kernel.

chemistry/md|stochastic.title: Power spectrum of Langevin oscillator via Wiener-Khinchin and windowed periodograms
chemistry/md|stochastic.gist: Compute position power spectra of an underdamped Langevin oscillator via FFT of the ACF and via Welch-averaged periodograms. Fit the Lorentzian-type analytic spectrum to recover the friction and frequency.

chemistry/md|stochastic.title: Integrated autocorrelation time with Sokal automatic windowing for MC series
chemistry/md|stochastic.gist: Compute FFT autocorrelations of energy time series from Metropolis MC of an LJ fluid and of AR(1) test data. Estimate the integrated autocorrelation time with Sokal's self-consistent window and compare with block-averaging error estimates.

chemistry/md|stochastic.title: Test-volume perturbation pressure versus virial for truncated LJ
chemistry/md|stochastic.gist: Compute the pressure of a cut LJ fluid from MC both by the virial route and by the volume-perturbation free-energy estimator using small compressions and expansions. Show that the two agree for the cut-shifted potential.

chemistry/md|stochastic.title: Two-dimensional LJ fluid MC with 2D tail corrections
chemistry/md|stochastic.gist: Run MC of a 2D LJ fluid and derive the 2D energy and pressure tail corrections analytically. Evaluate how the corrected EOS converges with cutoff radius.

chemistry/md|stochastic.title: FFT-based MSD of unwrapped Brownian dynamics in a periodic box
chemistry/md|stochastic.gist: Simulate Brownian particles in a periodic box, unwrap the trajectories from minimum-image jumps, and compute the MSD with the Calandrini FFT algorithm. Validate it against the direct O(N²) sum and extract D.

chemistry/md|stochastic.title: Yeh-Hummer finite-size correction of DPD fluid diffusion coefficient
chemistry/md|stochastic.gist: Simulate a dissipative particle dynamics fluid with Groot-Warren pairwise stochastic forces in several box sizes and compute D(L) from the MSD. Extrapolate to infinite size with the Yeh-Hummer 1/L correction using the measured viscosity.

chemistry/md|stochastic.title: Anomalous diffusion of a blind-ant random walk on percolation clusters
chemistry/md|stochastic.gist: Generate 2D site-percolation lattices near p_c and perform random walks restricted to occupied sites. Compute MSD exponents and the crossover from anomalous to normal diffusion above p_c.

chemistry/md|stochastic.title: Wang-Landau density of states for a square-well homopolymer coil-globule transition
chemistry/md|stochastic.gist: Flat-histogram Wang-Landau sampling with crankshaft and pivot moves of an off-lattice square-well bead chain to estimate the density of states g(E). Canonical averages then give the heat capacity and radius of gyration versus temperature and locate the collapse transition.

chemistry/md|stochastic.title: Transition path sampling with Langevin shooting moves on the Müller-Brown surface
chemistry/md|stochastic.gist: Shooting-move TPS between two Müller-Brown minima, using Langevin dynamics and Metropolis acceptance of reactive paths. Computes the acceptance rate, path decorrelation and committor histograms of configurations on the path-ensemble dividing surface.
chemistry/md|stochastic.area: Transition state theory and rare-event rates

chemistry/md|stochastic.title: Metropolis Monte Carlo in equivalent triclinic and orthorhombic cells: g(r) invariance test
chemistry/md|stochastic.gist: Implements triclinic wrapping and minimum-image distances through fractional coordinates, then runs Metropolis MC of an LJ fluid in a cubic cell and in a skewed triclinic representation of the same lattice. Verifies that energy, pressure and g(r) agree within error.
chemistry/md|stochastic.area: Minimum image convention and periodic boundaries

chemistry/md|stochastic.title: Wolf damped-shifted summation versus Ewald along MC trajectories of a primitive molten salt
chemistry/md|stochastic.gist: Metropolis MC of a soft-core ±1 molten salt. Compares Wolf and damped-shifted-force energies and forces with Ewald references for configurations sampled over a scan of damping α and cutoff, then reports the optimal parameters.

materials/semiconductors|linalg.title: FD Helmholtz eigenproblem for TE modes of GaAs/AlGaAs SCH laser slab
materials/semiconductors|linalg.gist: Discretize d²E/dx² + k0²n²(x)E = β²E on a separate-confinement heterostructure index profile. The tridiagonal matrix is diagonalized with scipy.linalg.eigh_tridiagonal to give guided-mode effective indices, normalized profiles and the quantum-well confinement factor versus wavelength.

materials/semiconductors|linalg.title: Supermodes and coupling length of a semiconductor rib directional coupler
materials/semiconductors|linalg.gist: Compute the even and odd supermodes of two parallel rib waveguides with a sparse 2D FD eigen-solve. Derive the coupling length L_c = λ/(2Δn_eff) versus gap and check it against coupled-mode theory from overlap integrals.

materials/semiconductors|linalg.title: Complex-index surface-plasmon waveguide losses in mid-IR quantum cascade laser
materials/semiconductors|linalg.gist: Discretize the TM slab operator with complex Drude permittivities of doped layers and metal. Solve the complex non-Hermitian eigenproblem for the modal effective index, then report waveguide loss α_w and active-region confinement factor.

materials/semiconductors|linalg.title: Resonant-cavity-enhanced photodiode quantum efficiency with DBR mirrors
materials/semiconductors|linalg.gist: Use transfer matrices for a thin InGaAs absorber placed between GaAs/AlAs DBRs to compute the position-resolved absorbed power. Integrate it into the QE spectrum and optimize absorber position relative to the standing-wave antinode.

materials/semiconductors|linalg.title: Photodiode receiver bandwidth via modified nodal analysis of parasitic network
materials/semiconductors|linalg.gist: Assemble the complex MNA admittance matrix for a photodiode current source with junction capacitance, series resistance, bond-wire inductance, pad capacitance and load. Solve it versus frequency to obtain the RC-limited response and combine it with the transit-time response for total bandwidth.

materials/semiconductors|linalg.title: Position-resolved absorption and Jsc in a perovskite solar cell stack
materials/semiconductors|linalg.gist: Compute the forward and backward field amplitudes in each layer of glass/ITO/HTL/perovskite/ETL/Ag with transfer matrices. Evaluate the local absorption |E|²·n·α profile and integrate against AM1.5 for the maximum short-circuit current versus absorber thickness.

materials/semiconductors|linalg.title: VCSEL cold-cavity resonance and longitudinal confinement factor via transfer matrices
materials/semiconductors|linalg.gist: Locate the resonance wavelength of a DBR/λ-cavity/DBR VCSEL from the phase condition of the round-trip transfer matrix. Compute the standing-wave field to get the longitudinal confinement factor of the QWs and the mirror-limited photon lifetime.

materials/semiconductors|linalg.title: Mode partition noise in multimode Fabry-Perot laser via Lyapunov equation
materials/semiconductors|linalg.gist: Linearize the N-mode rate equations with cross-gain saturation and solve the continuous Lyapunov equation for the steady-state fluctuation covariance. Compare individual-mode and total intensity variances to show anticorrelation-driven mode partition noise.

materials/semiconductors|linalg.title: Quantum-dot laser modulation response and RIN with wetting-layer reservoir
materials/semiconductors|linalg.gist: Linearize the coupled wetting-layer, excited-state, ground-state and photon rate equations with Pauli blocking. Compute the modulation transfer function and Langevin RIN through the 4×4 matrix resolvent, showing capture-limited damping.

materials/semiconductors|linalg.title: Effective rear recombination of point-contact PERC cell via 2D sparse diffusion
materials/semiconductors|linalg.gist: Solve the 2D steady minority-carrier diffusion in a symmetry cell with passivated and contacted rear regions using a sparse FD system and scipy.sparse.linalg.spsolve. Extract the effective rear surface recombination velocity versus contact fraction and compare with the Fischer model.

materials/semiconductors|linalg.title: Effective lifetime from lowest eigenmode of diffusion operator with surface recombination
materials/semiconductors|linalg.gist: Discretize the transient excess-carrier diffusion operator with Robin boundaries on a wafer and compute its eigenvalues to get τ_eff and higher decay modes. Reproduce the 1/τ_eff = 1/τ_b + 2S/W limit and its breakdown at high S.

materials/semiconductors|linalg.title: Quasi-Fermi level splitting from PL spectrum via generalized Planck tail fit
materials/semiconductors|linalg.gist: Generate PL spectra from an absorptance with an Urbach tail using the van Roosbroeck-Shockley and generalized Planck relations. Recover temperature and Δμ by linear least squares on ln(PL/E²) in the high-energy tail, and assess bias from absorption saturation.

materials/semiconductors|linalg.title: Self-consistent Schrödinger-Poisson QCSE and screening in InGaN quantum well
materials/semiconductors|linalg.gist: Iterate FD Schrödinger eigen-solves for electrons and holes with Poisson including polarization sheet charges and photo-carrier screening. Compute the emission blue-shift and overlap-integral increase versus carrier density.

materials/semiconductors|linalg.title: Deconvolution of overlapping PL bands with non-negative least squares
materials/semiconductors|linalg.gist: Represent a measured multi-peak PL spectrum, such as a near-band-edge band with donor-acceptor pair and defect bands, on a dictionary of Gaussian or Voigt basis functions. Solve for non-negative amplitudes with scipy.optimize.nnls and report integrated intensities and peak positions.

materials/semiconductors|linalg.title: Hot-electron energy relaxation via LO-phonon master equation and matrix exponential
materials/semiconductors|linalg.gist: Build the rate matrix for electron populations on an energy grid coupled by Fröhlich LO-phonon emission and absorption that satisfies detailed balance. Propagate with scipy.linalg.expm and extract the cooling time from the eigenvalue spectrum.

materials/semiconductors|linalg.title: Global target analysis of pump-probe ΔT spectra via SVD and variable projection
materials/semiconductors|linalg.gist: Decompose a simulated time- and wavelength-resolved ΔT/T matrix with SVD to identify the number of components. Fit a sequential kinetic model, with rate constants nonlinear and species spectra linear, by variable projection to extract evolution-associated spectra.

materials/semiconductors|linalg.title: Carrier capture and relaxation in InAs quantum dots from multilevel rate matrix
materials/semiconductors|linalg.gist: Model barrier, wetting-layer, excited-state and ground-state populations with phonon and Auger-assisted rates linearized around a pump level. Use eigenvalues of the rate matrix to obtain rise times and fit a synthetic ground-state TRPL rise.

materials/semiconductors|linalg.title: Heterojunction drift-diffusion with band offsets for AlGaAs/GaAs graded junction
materials/semiconductors|linalg.gist: Include position-dependent electron affinity, bandgap and effective densities of states as effective fields in the SG flux discretization. Solve the coupled system to obtain band diagrams and I-V curves for abrupt and graded heterointerfaces.

materials/semiconductors|linalg.title: Four-point probe correction factors for finite samples via 2D sparse Laplace solve
materials/semiconductors|linalg.gist: Solve the 2D Laplace equation for current injected at collinear probes in rectangular or circular samples with insulating edges using sparse FD. Derive geometric correction factors for sheet resistance versus probe position and compare with the method of images.

materials/semiconductors|linalg.title: Donor ionization energy and compensation from temperature-dependent Hall concentration
materials/semiconductors|linalg.gist: Solve charge neutrality with donor, acceptor and intrinsic terms at each temperature by root-finding. Fit N_D, N_A and E_D to n(T) data with nonlinear least squares and parameter covariance, identifying freeze-out, extrinsic and intrinsic regimes.

materials/semiconductors|linalg.title: 8-band Kane k·p bulk band structure and conduction-band nonparabolicity
materials/semiconductors|linalg.gist: Assemble the 8×8 Kane Hamiltonian for InSb or GaAs including spin-orbit coupling and diagonalize it along high-symmetry directions. Extract the energy-dependent effective mass and nonparabolicity parameter and compare with the two-band model.

materials/semiconductors|linalg.title: Distributed-diode network model of a solar cell with a localized shunt
materials/semiconductors|linalg.gist: Discretize the cell into a 2D grid of local diodes connected by emitter sheet resistance, and place one low-resistance shunt. Solve the nonlinear Kirchhoff equations by Newton with a sparse nodal Jacobian to obtain the voltage map and the FF and Voc loss versus shunt position.
materials/semiconductors|linalg.area: Solar cell equivalent circuits and parameter extraction

materials/semiconductors|linalg.title: Gummel-iterated drift-diffusion I–V of an n+–n–n+ silicon diode
materials/semiconductors|linalg.gist: Couple the Poisson equation with an electron continuity equation using Scharfetter–Gummel fluxes and Caughey–Thomas field-dependent mobility, solved by Gummel iteration with tridiagonal solves. Compute the I–V curve, the space-charge regions at the n+/n interfaces, and the onset of velocity saturation.

materials/semiconductors|linalg.title: Capacitance transients of a double-acceptor defect from charge-state master equations
materials/semiconductors|linalg.gist: Model a three-charge-state trap with emission and capture rates between adjacent states, written as a linear master equation. Solve it by matrix exponential after a filling pulse, then compute the capacitance transient, the DLTS rate-window spectrum, and the extracted versus true activation energies of both levels.

materials/semiconductors|linalg.title: Born–von Kármán phonon dispersion and lattice specific heat of silicon
materials/semiconductors|linalg.gist: Construct the 6×6 dynamical matrix of diamond-structure Si with first- and second-neighbor force constants and diagonalize it along high-symmetry lines. Sample the Brillouin zone for the phonon DOS and compare the resulting heat capacity with the Debye model.

materials/semiconductors|linalg.title: Polarized Raman intensity versus rotation angle for (001), (110) and (111) silicon
materials/semiconductors|linalg.gist: Rotate the three zincblende/diamond Raman tensors into the lab frame for each wafer orientation. Compute the backscattering intensity |e_s·R·e_i|² versus in-plane rotation angle for parallel and crossed polarizers, and identify the orientations and angles where the optical phonon is forbidden.

materials/semiconductors|linalg.title: Semi-vectorial finite-difference modes and birefringence of an InP ridge waveguide
materials/semiconductors|linalg.gist: Discretize the quasi-TE and quasi-TM semi-vectorial Helmholtz operators with correct interface conditions on a 2D grid. Find the effective indices with sparse eigensolvers, and compute modal birefringence and confinement factor versus ridge width and etch depth.

materials/semiconductors|linalg.title: Supermodes and far-field of an evanescently coupled diode-laser array
materials/semiconductors|linalg.gist: Build the N×N coupled-mode matrix of an array of identical ridge waveguides with nearest-neighbor coupling and edge effects. Diagonalize it for supermode propagation constants and amplitudes, add modal gain overlap, and compute the in-phase and out-of-phase far-field patterns.

materials/semiconductors|linalg.title: Kramers–Kronig-consistent dielectric function by linear least-squares B-spline fit
materials/semiconductors|linalg.gist: Represent ε2(E) with B-splines and compute each basis function's KK transform numerically to form a matched ε1 basis. Fit both parts to synthetic n,k data by regularized linear least squares, and assess how well the fit recovers a Tauc–Lorentz reference.

materials/semiconductors|linalg.title: Transitive band-offset scale from pairwise heterojunction data by least squares
materials/semiconductors|linalg.gist: Set up an overdetermined incidence-matrix system ΔEv(A/B) = Ev(A) − Ev(B) for a set of measured III–V and II–VI valence-band offsets, with one reference fixed. Solve by weighted least squares, and use residuals to quantify violations of transitivity and identify inconsistent interfaces.

materials/semiconductors|linalg.title: Chemical-potential stability polygon of kesterite Cu2ZnSnS4
materials/semiconductors|linalg.gist: Write the formation-enthalpy equality for CZTS and the competing-phase inequalities (CuS, ZnS, SnS, Cu2SnS3, etc.) as a linear system in (μCu, μZn, μSn, μS). Find the vertices of the stable polygon at fixed μS by solving pairs of active constraints, and report the region area and its endpoints.
materials/semiconductors|linalg.area: Defect formation energies and charge transitions

materials/semiconductors|linalg.title: Cubic Dresselhaus spin-splitting coefficient of bulk GaAs from 14-band k·p
materials/semiconductors|linalg.gist: Build the 14×14 k·p Hamiltonian including Γ15 upper conduction bands and the inversion-asymmetry P' coupling. Diagonalize along [110] and fit the conduction-band spin splitting to γ k³ to extract the Dresselhaus coefficient, and compare with third-order perturbation theory.

materials/semiconductors|linalg.title: Quantization and density-of-states masses of silicon valleys for (001), (110), (111) inversion layers
materials/semiconductors|linalg.gist: Rotate the ellipsoidal effective-mass tensors of the six Si Δ-valleys into each surface frame. Compute the quantization mass m_z = 1/(M⁻¹)_zz and the 2D in-plane DOS and conductivity masses for each valley set, then find the resulting triangular-well subband ordering.

materials/semiconductors|linalg.title: J-aggregate absorption from a disordered Frenkel exciton Hamiltonian
materials/semiconductors|linalg.gist: Diagonalize a chain Hamiltonian of dipole-coupled molecular transition energies with Gaussian site disorder. Compute oscillator strengths, the exchange-narrowed absorption line and the redshift of the J-band, plus the scaling of linewidth with coherence number.

materials/semiconductors|linalg.title: Biexciton binding energy of a parabolic quantum dot by configuration interaction
materials/semiconductors|linalg.gist: Expand the two-electron, two-hole states in 2D harmonic-oscillator orbitals and compute Coulomb matrix elements numerically. Build and diagonalize the CI Hamiltonians of exciton and biexciton, and obtain biexciton binding energy versus confinement length and basis-size convergence.

materials/semiconductors|linalg.title: Field-tuned exciton anticrossings in a vertically coupled InAs quantum-dot molecule
materials/semiconductors|linalg.gist: Build a four-configuration Hamiltonian (direct and indirect electron/hole placements) with hole tunneling coupling and field-dependent Stark terms, and diagonalize it versus axial field. Extract anticrossing gaps and oscillator-strength transfer of the PL lines.

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Young's fringe visibility for broadband Gaussian and Lorentzian spectra
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the complex degree of temporal coherence as the normalized Fourier integral of a source power spectrum (Wiener-Khinchin) by quadrature. Compute fringe visibility versus path difference and the rms coherence time, and compare with analytic results.
physics/optics|quad_models.area: Coherence theory and partially coherent light

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Wolf effect: correlation-induced spectral shift on axis
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Model a planar secondary source whose spectral degree of coherence scales with frequency. Compute the far-field on-axis spectrum by integrating the cross-spectral density, and quantify the redshift or blueshift of a Gaussian line versus correlation length.
physics/optics|quad_models.area: Coherence theory and partially coherent light

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Slant-path Fried parameter and Rytov variance with Hufnagel-Valley profile
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Integrate the HV5/7 Cn2(h) profile along a zenith-angle-dependent path to obtain r0, the plane-wave and spherical-wave Rytov variances and the scintillation index. Use adaptive quadrature with the correct path-weighting kernels.

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Long-exposure turbulent OTF and Strehl of a circular telescope
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Multiply the diffraction-limited circular-pupil OTF by the Kolmogorov long-exposure atmospheric MTF. Integrate the product over spatial frequency to get the Strehl ratio and long-exposure FWHM versus D/r0.

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Noll residual phase variance after Zernike mode correction
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Compute the Kolmogorov-spectrum variance of each Zernike mode by radial quadrature of the spectrum times the squared Bessel-function Zernike filters J_{n+1}(2pi k R)/k. Sum these to get the Noll residuals Delta_J for J corrected modes.

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Beam wander of a collimated Gaussian beam in von Karman turbulence
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Andrews-Phillips double integral over path position and spatial frequency for the rms beam-centroid displacement, with a von Karman spectrum having finite outer scale. Compare with the Kolmogorov closed-form approximation versus propagation distance.

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Aperture-averaging factor for scintillation of a plane wave
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Compute the irradiance variance collected by a circular aperture by integrating the weak-fluctuation Kolmogorov spectrum times the Airy aperture filter [2J1(x)/x]^2 and the propagation filter. Report the aperture-averaging factor versus D/sqrt(lambda L).

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Greenwood and Tyler frequencies from Bufton wind and Cn2 profiles
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Combine a Bufton wind-speed profile with an HV Cn2 profile and integrate the appropriate moments. Obtain the Greenwood frequency, Tyler G-tilt tracking frequency and the closed-loop servo-lag phase variance for a given adaptive-optics bandwidth.

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Phase-diversity estimation of spherical aberration from defocused PSFs
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Compute radially symmetric PSFs of a pupil with Zernike defocus and spherical aberration using Hankel-type quadrature at two known defocus values. Estimate the unknown spherical coefficient by nonlinear least-squares matching.

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Gerchberg-Saxton design of a Gaussian-to-flattop beam shaper
