physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Iterate between pupil and focal planes with FFTs, enforcing Gaussian input amplitude and super-Gaussian target amplitude, to obtain a phase-only element. Report the convergence of rms error, uniformity and diffraction efficiency.

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Error-reduction versus hybrid input-output for a 1D support-constrained object
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Recover a real non-negative 1D object from oversampled Fourier modulus data using ER and HIO with a known support. Compare the convergence of the Fourier-domain error and the reconstruction error up to trivial ambiguities.

physics/optics|quad_models.title: TE band gap of triangular-lattice air holes with Ho inverse rule
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Build the TE plane-wave Hermitian matrix for a triangular lattice of air holes by inverting the Fourier-space permittivity matrix (Ho-Chan-Soukoulis). Trace bands along Gamma-M-K-Gamma and study gap convergence versus number of plane waves.

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Group velocity of photonic-crystal bands via Hellmann-Feynman theorem
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: From PWE eigenvectors of a square-lattice rod crystal, compute band group velocities as eigenvector expectation values of dH/dk. Validate against finite differences and locate slow-light regions near the band edge.

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Walk-off and lateral displacement in a calcite beam displacer
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Use Sellmeier dispersion for calcite ordinary and extraordinary indices with the uniaxial index-ellipse formula to compute the extraordinary index and Poynting walk-off angle versus propagation angle. Compute the beam separation of a plate versus wavelength.

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Fresnel equation of wave normals in biaxial KTP
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Solve the Fresnel quadratic for the two refractive indices along arbitrary directions in biaxial KTP from Sellmeier principal indices. Compute the optic-axis angle Vz versus wavelength and the birefringence over a polar-angle grid.

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Traveling-wave electro-optic modulator bandwidth with velocity mismatch
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Integrate the accumulated optical phase along the electrode including RF-optical velocity mismatch and frequency-dependent microwave loss proportional to sqrt(f). Compute the normalized EO response versus frequency and the 3-dB bandwidth.

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Bragg acousto-optic diffraction efficiency with momentum mismatch
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Use Kogelnik coupled-wave solutions to compute first-order diffraction efficiency versus acoustic power, via figure of merit M2 for TeO2 and fused silica, and versus Bragg-angle detuning. Determine the acoustic power for 100% efficiency and the angular bandwidth.

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Electro-optic phase-modulator sidebands for Pound-Drever-Hall locking
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Compute carrier and sideband powers from Bessel functions of the modulation depth. Combine them with the Fabry-Perot reflection coefficient to evaluate the PDH error signal and its slope versus modulation depth, and find the optimal depth.

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Long-range and short-range SPPs of a thin metal film
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Solve the complex transcendental insulator-metal-insulator dispersion relations for symmetric and antisymmetric modes by complex root-finding. Track effective index and propagation length versus film thickness for gold.
physics/optics|quad_models.area: Surface plasmon polaritons and Drude metals

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Hermite-Gauss to Laguerre-Gauss conversion by cylindrical-lens converter
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Compute the expansion coefficients of rotated HG_{n,m} modes into LG modes using the closed-form Wigner-d sums or Gouy-phase relations of an astigmatic pi/2 converter. Verify by numerical overlap integrals and compute the output OAM.
physics/optics|quad_models.area: Optical vortices and orbital angular momentum

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Doppler-broadened saturated two-level absorption as Voigt profile
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Combine the power-broadened steady-state Bloch absorption with a Maxwell-Boltzmann velocity distribution by quadrature or the Faddeeva function. Compute absorption coefficient versus detuning and intensity for the rubidium D2 line.
physics/optics|quad_models.area: Optical Bloch equations and atom-light interaction

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Damped Rabi oscillations: optical Bloch integration versus Torrey solution
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Integrate the two-level optical Bloch equations with T1 and T2 decay and detuning using an ODE solver. Compare excited-state population dynamics with Torrey's analytic solution in the resonant strong-damping limit, and extract the steady state.
physics/optics|quad_models.area: Optical Bloch equations and atom-light interaction

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Poisson–Arago bright spot behind an opaque disk via Lommel functions
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Compute the Fresnel-diffraction intensity behind an opaque circular disk using two-variable Lommel functions and direct Hankel-type quadrature. Verify the on-axis spot intensity and its width as functions of Fresnel number and observation distance.

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Three-dimensional focal-region intensity from Lommel U and V functions
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Compute the intensity near the focus of an aberration-free circular lens from Lommel-function series, cross-checked against direct pupil quadrature. Extract the isophote map, the axial and transverse half-widths, and the dark rings on the focal plane.

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Single-mode fiber splice loss: Marcuse Gaussian approximation versus exact LP01 overlap
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Compute the exact LP01 field of a step-index fiber from Bessel functions and its Petermann mode-field diameter. Evaluate splice loss for lateral offset, tilt and mode-size mismatch using overlap integrals, and compare with Marcuse's Gaussian formulas.

physics/optics|quad_models.title: OTDR Rayleigh backscatter trace: capture fraction and dynamic range
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Compute the Rayleigh backscatter capture coefficient of a single-mode fiber from its mode field and NA. Build the OTDR power trace versus distance for a given pulse width and attenuation, including splices and Fresnel reflections, and derive the dynamic range.

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Lummer–Gehrcke plate multiple-beam interference near grazing emergence
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Sum the multiply reflected beams emerging near the critical angle from a plane-parallel plate, using Fresnel coefficients. Compute the fringe profile, resolving power and free spectral range, and compare them with an equivalent Fabry–Pérot.

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Scanning Fabry–Pérot spectroscopy of a Doppler-broadened line: Airy–Gaussian convolution
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Convolve the Airy instrument function of a scanning etalon with a Doppler-broadened two-component spectrum by numerical quadrature. Determine the resolvability criterion and fit the recorded trace to recover the gas temperature and component splitting.

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Intracavity etalon selection of a single longitudinal laser mode
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Combine a Lorentzian or Gaussian gain profile, the cavity mode comb and the Airy transmission of a tilted intracavity etalon. Compute the net round-trip gain discrimination between adjacent modes versus etalon thickness and reflectivity, including walk-off loss.

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Relative illumination of a wide-angle lens: cos⁴ law versus exact solid-angle integral
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Integrate the radiance accepted by an exit pupil of finite size, including pupil distortion, to obtain image-plane irradiance versus field angle. Compare the result with the cos⁴ law and quantify how pupil enlargement in retrofocus lenses reduces the falloff.
physics/optics|quad_models.area: Paraxial ray tracing and lens design

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Sparrow flatness condition for irradiance uniformity of a square LED array
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Model each LED as a generalized Lambertian source with a cosⁿ intensity distribution and sum the irradiance on a target plane. Solve for the maximum spacing-to-height ratio that keeps the center irradiance flat (Sparrow criterion), and evaluate uniformity versus n.

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Van de Hulst anomalous diffraction versus Mie extinction and the extinction paradox
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Compute Mie extinction efficiency for large, weakly refracting spheres and compare it with the closed-form anomalous-diffraction approximation as a function of phase shift and absorption. Show the ripple structure and the convergence of Q_ext toward 2.

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Ka-band radar reflectivity of raindrops: Mie versus Rayleigh with Marshall–Palmer spectrum
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Use a Debye-model permittivity for water and Mie backscatter efficiencies to integrate radar reflectivity over an exponential raindrop size distribution. Compare the result with the Rayleigh Z = ΣD⁶ law and quantify the non-Rayleigh attenuation and reflectivity deficits.

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Ångström exponent of lognormal aerosol optical depth from Mie extinction
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Integrate Mie extinction cross sections over lognormal size distributions of ammonium sulfate aerosol to obtain spectral optical depth. Compute the Ångström exponent and its curvature versus mode radius and width.

physics/optics|quad_models.title: 22° and 46° ice-crystal halos: minimum deviation and intensity distribution
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Trace rays through randomly oriented hexagonal ice prisms with 60° and 90° wedges, using Fresnel transmission and dispersive ice index. Obtain the halo angular intensity profiles, the sharp inner edges and the red-inside color sequence.

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Metal optical constants from principal angle and principal azimuth
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Use Fresnel coefficients for an absorbing medium to compute the s–p phase difference and amplitude ratio versus incidence angle. Find the principal angle where the retardance is 90°, and invert the principal angle and azimuth to recover n and k.

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Risk mode-overlap threshold of an end-pumped four-level laser
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Evaluate overlap integrals of Gaussian pump and TEM00 laser mode distributions, including pump divergence and absorption along the crystal. Compute threshold pump power and slope efficiency versus mode-to-pump size ratio.

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Er³⁺ emission cross sections: McCumber reciprocity versus Füchtbauer–Ladenburg
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Construct a model Er:glass absorption band and derive the emission cross section from McCumber reciprocity with the Stark-manifold partition functions. Check it against Füchtbauer–Ladenburg integration of the fluorescence spectrum and radiative lifetime.

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Judd–Ofelt intensity parameters of Er³⁺ from absorption band oscillator strengths
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Integrate absorption bands to obtain measured oscillator strengths, then solve a least-squares problem for Ω2, Ω4 and Ω6 using reduced matrix elements. Compute the radiative rates, branching ratios and radiative lifetime of the ⁴I13/2 level.

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Elliott excitonic absorption of GaAs with Lorentzian broadening
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Combine the bound-exciton Rydberg series with the Sommerfeld-enhanced continuum in the Elliott formula. Convolve with a broadening function to compute the absorption spectrum near the band edge, and compare it with the free-carrier square-root law.

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Open-aperture z-scan for two-photon absorption: Sheik-Bahae series and Gaussian pulses
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Compute the normalized transmittance versus sample position for a two-photon absorber using the ln(1+q)/q radial result, with time integration over Gaussian pulses. Fit synthetic data to extract the TPA coefficient β.

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Third-harmonic generation by focused Gaussian beams in gases: Bjorklund phase-matching integral
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the complex phase-matching integral for THG of a focused beam as a function of Δk·b and of focal position relative to a finite gas cell. Demonstrate the Gouy-phase cancellation for tight focusing and find the optimal negative mismatch.

physics/optics|quad_models.title: Pointing-jitter fading in a free-space optical link with Gaussian beam reception
physics/optics|quad_models.gist: Integrate a Gaussian beam footprint over a finite receiver aperture to obtain the collected fraction versus radial offset. Derive the beta-type distribution of received power under Rayleigh-distributed pointing jitter, and compute the outage probability and optimal transmit divergence.

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Schematic mode-coupling F2 model: nonergodicity parameter and alpha-relaxation divergence
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Integrate the F2 MCT integro-differential equation phi'' + Omega^2[phi + ∫ m(t-s) phi'(s) ds] = 0 with m = λ phi^2, using a Volterra time-stepping scheme. Compute the long-time plateau f(λ) and the relaxation time τ(λ) as λ → 4⁻, then fit the power-law exponent.

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: F12 schematic MCT model: glass transition line and exponent parameter
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: For memory m = v1 phi + v2 phi^2, locate the ergodic-glass transition line in the (v1, v2) plane from the fixed-point bifurcation of phi(t→∞). Compute the exponent parameter λ, and validate the critical decay exponent a against the Gamma-function relation using ODE-integrated correlators.

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Aging in the spherical p=2 Sherrington-Kirkpatrick model after a quench
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Integrate the Langevin mode equations over the Wigner semicircle eigenvalue density, with a self-consistent ODE for the spherical Lagrange multiplier. Compute the two-time correlation C(t,tw) and show that it collapses as a function of t/tw below Tc.

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Bouchaud trap model master equation: energy distribution aging and correlation
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Discretize trap depths with an exponential density of states and integrate the stiff master equation for the occupation P(E,t). Compute the mean escape time growth and the two-time persistence correlation Π(tw+t,tw), and verify the t/tw scaling for T < Tg.

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Overdamped quench of bidisperse soft disks to locate jamming packing fraction
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Minimize the harmonic soft-disk energy of a small periodic 50:50 bidisperse packing by integrating the gradient-flow ODE with a stiff solver at increasing φ. Extract the residual energy and pressure versus φ, and fit E ∝ (φ - φJ)^2 to estimate φJ.

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Generalized Langevin cage model: mean-squared displacement and self-intermediate scattering function
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Embed a tagged particle's exponential-plus-long-memory kernel in a Markovian set of linear ODEs and integrate the velocity autocorrelation and MSD. Compute the Gaussian F_s(k,t) = exp(-k^2 MSD/6) and its plateau and α-relaxation time versus cage stiffness.

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Kuramoto oscillators on a nearest-neighbour ring: frequency-cluster synchronization transition
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Integrate N phase oscillators with random natural frequencies coupled only to ring neighbours using RK4. Compute time-averaged effective frequencies and the size of the largest frequency-locked cluster versus coupling K, and identify the full-locking threshold.
physics/stat_phys|ode.area: Coupled map lattices and spatiotemporal chaos

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Chimera states in nonlocally coupled phase oscillators on a ring
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Simulate the Abrams-Strogatz model with an exponential or cosine coupling kernel and phase lag α. Compute the local order parameter profile and mean-phase velocity profile, and classify coherent versus incoherent domains as α varies.
physics/stat_phys|ode.area: Coupled map lattices and spatiotemporal chaos

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Master stability function for diffusively coupled Rössler oscillators
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Integrate the Rössler attractor together with the variational equation for transverse perturbations, ξ' = [DF - σ DH]ξ. Compute the largest transverse Lyapunov exponent Λ(σ) by renormalized integration, and use it to predict synchronization windows for ring and all-to-all networks from their Laplacian eigenvalues.
physics/stat_phys|ode.area: Coupled map lattices and spatiotemporal chaos

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Benjamin-Feir phase turbulence in the 1D complex Ginzburg-Landau equation
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Integrate the CGLE pseudo-spectrally with an ETDRK4 Runge-Kutta scheme across the Benjamin-Feir line 1 + c1 c3 = 0. Compute the spatial autocorrelation of A(x,t), its correlation length, and the onset of phase turbulence.
physics/stat_phys|ode.area: Coupled map lattices and spatiotemporal chaos

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Ott-Antonsen reduction for Kuramoto oscillators with bimodal frequency distribution
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Derive and integrate the low-dimensional Ott-Antonsen ODEs for two Lorentzian frequency subpopulations. Map the incoherent, partially synchronized and standing-wave states, and compare with direct N-oscillator simulation.
physics/stat_phys|ode.area: Coupled map lattices and spatiotemporal chaos

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Brownian particle in time-dependent trap: variance ODE and optimal-protocol work
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: For overdamped motion with stiffness k(t), integrate the variance ODE w' = -2k w/γ + 2D. Compute the mean work for linear and Schmiedl-Seifert optimal protocols over finite time, and verify the work-difference result for the optimal protocol.

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Stochastic resonance in a periodically forced double well Fokker-Planck equation
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Discretize the Fokker-Planck equation by finite volumes and integrate the resulting ODE system to its time-periodic asymptotic state. Compute the spectral amplification of the mean position versus noise strength and locate its resonance maximum.

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Underdamped Kramers escape in energy-diffusion regime via action ODE
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Compute the action I(E) of a cubic metastable well by orbit integration. Solve the 1D energy-diffusion backward equation for the mean first-passage time, and compare the low-friction rate with the Kramers γ I(Eb)/kT formula.

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Pair approximation Glauber dynamics for Ising model on random regular graphs
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Integrate closed ODEs for magnetization and nearest-neighbour bond correlation under a pair (Bethe) closure. Compute equilibrium m(T), recover the Bethe critical temperature 2/ln[z/(z-2)], and measure critical slowing down.

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Voter model consensus time on heterogeneous networks via backward Fokker-Planck
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Reduce the voter model on uncorrelated networks to a diffusion in the degree-weighted density. Solve the backward boundary-value ODE for the mean consensus time T(ρ), and compare its scaling N⟨k⟩²/⟨k²⟩ for different degree distributions.

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Kuramoto synchronization on scale-free networks: heterogeneous mean-field critical coupling
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Integrate degree-weighted phase oscillator equations on a configuration-model graph. Compare the onset of the order parameter with the predicted Kc = 2⟨k⟩/(πg(0)⟨k²⟩), and extract the order parameter exponent versus γ.

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: One-loop Wilson-Fisher flow for O(n) φ⁴ theory in 4-ε dimensions
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Integrate the coupled one-loop flow equations for (r, u), locate the Gaussian and Wilson-Fisher fixed points, and linearize to get ν(n, ε). Trace crossover trajectories to compute effective exponents.

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Random-bond φ⁴ one-loop RG: Harris criterion and random fixed point
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Integrate the replica one-loop flow equations for couplings (u, Δ) of the dilute n-component model. Locate the random fixed point for n < 4, compute its stability eigenvalues and ν, and verify the Harris criterion.

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Poor-man's scaling of anisotropic Kondo model and Kondo temperature
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Integrate the Anderson-Yuval-Hamann flow for (J_z, J_⊥) with solve_ivp. Map the ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic basins, and extract T_K from the scale at which the couplings diverge, comparing with the analytic hyperbolic invariant.

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: SIS heterogeneous mean-field on scale-free networks: threshold and prevalence scaling
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Integrate the degree-class SIS ODEs ρk' = -ρk + λk(1 - ρk)Θ. Compute the endemic prevalence versus λ, verify λc = ⟨k⟩/⟨k²⟩, and extract the prevalence exponent for 2 < γ < 4.
physics/stat_phys|ode.area: Epidemic spreading on lattices and networks

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Pair approximation SIS on random regular networks: improved epidemic threshold
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Integrate the closed ODEs for node and SI/SS pair densities on a z-regular graph. Compute the endemic density and the threshold λc = 1/(z-1), contrasting it with homogeneous mean field.
physics/stat_phys|ode.area: Epidemic spreading on lattices and networks

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Spatial SIR traveling wave: minimal front speed by phase-plane shooting
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Reduce the diffusive SIR model to traveling-wave ODEs and find the minimal speed c* = 2√(D(R0-1)γ) by shooting for a nonnegative connecting orbit. Validate against a method-of-lines PDE simulation.
physics/stat_phys|ode.area: Epidemic spreading on lattices and networks

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Homoclinic snaking of localized states in quadratic-cubic Swift-Hohenberg
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Solve the steady 1D Swift-Hohenberg fourth-order ODE for symmetric localized states with solve_bvp. Use natural-parameter continuation in r to trace the snaking branch and the width of the pinning region.

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Eckhaus stability boundary of Swift-Hohenberg roll solutions
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Compute periodic roll solutions with wavenumber q by Galerkin/Newton. Solve the Bloch-Floquet linear eigenvalue problem to obtain the Eckhaus band, and compare it with the amplitude-equation prediction r = 12(q-1)²·3.

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Rolls versus hexagons in Swift-Hohenberg with quadratic nonlinearity: amplitude equations
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Integrate the three coupled hexagon amplitude ODEs and compute the stability ranges of hexagons, rolls and mixed states versus r. Verify the predicted pattern by a short pseudo-spectral 2D simulation.

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Pulled front speed and selected wavenumber in Swift-Hohenberg invasion
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Apply linear marginal stability (saddle-point) analysis to obtain the front speed and the wavenumber left behind (Dee-Langer). Measure both in a 1D ETDRK4 simulation of a pattern invading the unstable state.

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Coarsening kinetics in the 1D Cahn-Hilliard equation
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Integrate the 1D Cahn-Hilliard equation pseudo-spectrally with a semi-implicit scheme from a noisy symmetric quench. Track the number of domains and the mean domain size, and show logarithmic coarsening.

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: FitzHugh-Nagumo traveling pulse speed via homoclinic shooting
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Write the traveling-wave ODEs for the FitzHugh-Nagumo excitable medium and find the pulse speed c by shooting or bisection for a homoclinic orbit. Compare with the direct PDE pulse speed and the bistable front-speed limit.

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: φ⁴ kink fluctuation spectrum via Numerov shooting
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Linearize around the Allen-Cahn/φ⁴ kink to get a Pöschl-Teller Schrödinger operator, and find its bound states by Numerov shooting. Verify the zero mode and the internal mode at ω² = 3/2, and compute the one-loop kink mass correction.

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Smoluchowski coagulation: gelation time and cluster size distribution
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Integrate the truncated Smoluchowski ODEs for constant, additive and multiplicative kernels. Compare with exact solutions, and detect the gelation time from the divergence of the second moment and the loss of mass.

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Becker-Döring nucleation kinetics: steady-state rate versus classical nucleation theory
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Integrate the stiff Becker-Döring cluster ODEs with capillary free energies at fixed supersaturation. Extract the time lag and the steady nucleation flux, and compare with the Zeldovich-CNT formula.

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Sinai diffusion: mean first-passage time in a random Brownian potential
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: For overdamped diffusion in a quenched random-walk potential, evaluate the backward-equation solution for the mean first-passage time by numerical quadrature of the ODE. Average over disorder to show ln²t-type scaling of the typical displacement.

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Rotating spiral wave of the complex Ginzburg-Landau equation via Hagan's radial BVP
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Seek the one-armed spiral A=F(r)exp[i(ψ(r)-ωt)] of the 2D CGLE. Reduce it to a nonlinear radial boundary-value problem for amplitude and local wavenumber, and solve with scipy solve_bvp plus a shooting continuation in the dispersion parameters. Find the selected asymptotic wavenumber and rotation frequency, and compare them with Hagan's small-dispersion asymptotics.

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Stationary pulses of the 1D Gray-Scott model: BVP continuation and fold point
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Solve the steady Gray-Scott equations on a large interval as a two-component boundary-value problem for a single localized pulse. Use natural-parameter continuation in the feed rate. Locate the saddle-node where the pulse branch disappears, which marks the onset of self-replication, and check it by stiff method-of-lines time integration.

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Solitary flocking bands in Bertin-Droz-Grégoire hydrodynamics via traveling-wave ODE
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Insert a traveling-wave ansatz into the Boltzmann-derived density/polarization hydrodynamic equations of Vicsek-like flocks. This reduces them to a 2D ODE system. Find homoclinic band solutions by shooting along unstable manifolds, and compute the band speed and the gas-density selection as functions of the band velocity, following Caussin et al.

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Melting of the Lennard-Jones 13-atom cluster from microcanonical velocity-Verlet MD
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Start from the icosahedral LJ13 minimum and integrate Newton's equations with velocity Verlet at a range of total energies. Record kinetic temperature and Lindemann bond-length fluctuations. Build the caloric curve and locate the solid-liquid coexistence region where the Lindemann index jumps.

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Sine-kernel gap probability from the Jimbo-Miwa-Mori-Sato Painlevé V ODE
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Integrate the σ-form Painlevé V equation from small-s series initial data. This gives the bulk GUE gap probability E(0;s) and the nearest-neighbor spacing density p(s) = d²E/ds². Compare with the Wigner surmise and with spacings of numerically diagonalized GUE matrices.
physics/stat_phys|ode.area: Random matrix spectra in disordered systems

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Burton-Cabrera-Frank step flow: adatom concentration BVP and step velocity
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Solve the 1D steady diffusion-desorption-deposition equation for adatoms on terraces between steps on a vicinal surface, under kinetic boundary conditions that include Ehrlich-Schwoebel asymmetry. Compute the step velocity versus terrace width and supersaturation, and identify the linear stability of equal step spacing (step bunching versus pairing).

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Kapitza pendulum: inverted-state stability from averaging versus direct integration
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Integrate a pendulum with a rapidly vibrating pivot. Find the critical drive amplitude at which the inverted position becomes stable, both by Floquet analysis of the linearized equation and by long nonlinear RK runs. Compare with the Kapitza effective-potential criterion a²ω² > 2gl.

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Normal Fourier heat conduction in the φ⁴ lattice with Nosé-Hoover end baths
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Couple the ends of a 1D φ⁴ anharmonic chain to Nosé-Hoover thermostats at different temperatures and integrate the deterministic equations of motion. Extract the steady temperature profile and heat flux, and from them the size-independent conductivity versus mean temperature (normal Fourier law).

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Van der Pol relaxation oscillations: period versus μ with a stiff solver
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Integrate the van der Pol oscillator for μ from 0.1 to 1000 using an implicit stiff solver (Radau/BDF). Extract the limit-cycle period and amplitude. Compare with the small-μ Poincaré-Lindstedt expansion and with the large-μ Dorodnitsyn asymptotic series, including its μ^(-1/3) correction.

physics/stat_phys|ode.title: Exact moment hierarchy of a 3D active Brownian particle: MSD and non-Gaussian parameter
physics/stat_phys|ode.gist: Derive and integrate the closed linear ODEs for orientation-position moments of a free 3D active Brownian particle with translational noise. This gives the exact time-dependent MSD, effective diffusivity and fourth moment. Compute the non-Gaussian parameter crossover, and check against Langevin simulations on the sphere.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Entanglement sudden death of two qubits under independent amplitude damping
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Integrate the two-qubit Lindblad master equation with local spontaneous emission starting from an X-state. Compute the Wootters concurrence versus time and locate the sudden-death time by root-finding, then compare it to the analytic expression.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Steady-state optomechanical entanglement from linearized quantum Langevin equations
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Integrate the moment ODEs of the linearized cavity-mirror fluctuations up to the stationary state and verify against the algebraic Lyapunov solution. Compute the log-negativity versus detuning and temperature, including a Routh-Hurwitz stability check.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Dissipative steady-state entanglement of two qubits via a shared reservoir
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Integrate a Lindblad equation with collective decay, local driving and qubit-qubit detuning to its steady state. Compute the concurrence and the overlap with the subradiant singlet state, and scan parameters to find the maximal stationary entanglement.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Negativity dynamics of two qutrits under collective and local dephasing
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Evolve a two-qutrit maximally entangled state under a 9x9 Lindblad equation with collective and independent dephasing using a stiff solver. Compute the negativity and log-negativity and identify bound-entangled regimes where the PPT criterion fails.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: DRAG-corrected Gaussian pi pulses on a three-level transmon
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Integrate the rotating-frame Schrödinger equation of a weakly anharmonic transmon truncated to three levels under Gaussian and DRAG pulses. Compute the leakage to the second excited state and the average gate fidelity of the qubit subspace versus pulse duration.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Cross-resonance ZX interaction rate between two fixed-frequency transmons
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Integrate the driven two-transmon Hamiltonian with multilevel truncation. Extract the effective ZX, IX and ZI rates by fitting the conditional target Bloch-vector trajectories, then compute the fidelity of an echoed CNOT built from these dynamics.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Hahn-echo coherence decay under random telegraph noise
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Integrate the qubit Bloch equations for an ensemble of random telegraph-noise realizations with and without a refocusing pi pulse. Average the coherence and compare with the analytic echo decay across the motional-narrowing and static-noise regimes.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Floquet quasienergies of a strongly driven qubit via one-period propagator
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Integrate the Schrödinger equation over one drive period for a set of basis initial states to build the Floquet operator. Diagonalize it to obtain the quasienergies versus drive amplitude and locate the avoided crossings that mark multiphoton resonances.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Ballistic spreading of a continuous-time quantum walk on a line
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Integrate i dψ/dt = -γLψ on a finite path graph starting from a localized site. Compute the position variance and fit its t^2 scaling, and compare the site amplitudes with the Bessel-function solution of the infinite chain.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Quantum-walk search on two-dimensional periodic lattices
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Integrate the oracle-plus-Laplacian walk on L x L tori for several marked-vertex positions. Optimize γ and compute the first-peak success probability and time to examine the logarithmic-correction scaling in two dimensions.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Exponentially fast traversal of glued binary trees by quantum walk
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Reduce the continuous-time walk on two randomly glued binary trees to the column-space line and integrate the resulting ODE. Compute the arrival probability at the exit root versus time and depth, and compare with classical random-walk hitting times.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Perfect state transfer in an XX spin chain with engineered couplings
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Integrate the single-excitation dynamics of chains with uniform couplings and with Christandl couplings J_n ∝ sqrt(n(N-n)). Compute the end-to-end transfer fidelity versus time and its sensitivity to random coupling disorder.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Quantum stochastic walk interpolating coherent and classical diffusion on a line
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Integrate a Lindblad equation that combines the coherent graph Hamiltonian with classical hopping jump operators weighted by ω. Compute the variance growth exponent and the crossover time from ballistic to diffusive spreading as ω varies.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Environment-assisted quantum transport in the FMO light-harvesting complex
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Integrate the seven-site FMO Haken-Strobl Lindblad equation with dephasing, recombination loss and a reaction-center sink. Compute the transfer efficiency versus dephasing rate and identify the optimal noise level.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Anderson localization of continuous-time quantum walks on disordered rings
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Integrate walks on rings with random on-site energies for many disorder realizations. Compute the disorder-averaged long-time inverse participation ratio and return probability versus disorder strength, and extract the localization length.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: SIC-POVM tomography of a qubit undergoing damped Rabi dynamics
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Integrate the Lindblad evolution of a driven damped qubit and compute the tetrahedral SIC-POVM outcome probabilities at each time. Reconstruct the Bloch trajectory by linear inversion from finite-shot multinomial samples and quantify the reconstruction error.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Quantum Zeno freezing of Rabi oscillations by repeated and continuous measurement
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Interleave ODE integration of a driven qubit with projective measurements at interval τ, and separately integrate a continuous-dephasing Lindblad equation. Compute the survival probability versus measurement rate and compare the effective decay rates of the two models.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Dense coding with entanglement distributed by XY spin-chain dynamics
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Integrate the evolution of an XY chain that distributes entanglement between its end spins, from a singlet initially placed on one end. Compute the end-to-end reduced state and its dense-coding capacity versus time and chain length.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Steady-state coherence of a driven dissipative qubit versus detuning
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Integrate the optical Bloch equations to the steady state over a grid of drive strengths and detunings. Compute the l1-norm and relative-entropy coherence in the energy basis and locate the maximal-coherence ridge.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Site-basis coherence dynamics of an excitonic dimer under Redfield theory
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Build and integrate the Redfield tensor equation for a two-site exciton coupled to an Ohmic bath at finite temperature. Compute the l1-norm coherence in the site basis and in the exciton basis, together with the decoherence time.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Stabilizer Rényi entropy growth after a mixed-field Ising quench
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Integrate the Schrödinger equation of a small mixed-field Ising chain from a stabilizer product state. Compute the second stabilizer Rényi entropy from the full Pauli spectrum versus time and its saturation value relative to Haar-random states.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: MPS compression error of an exactly time-evolved Heisenberg chain
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Integrate a Heisenberg chain quench exactly, then convert the state to an MPS by successive SVDs at each time. Compute the truncation error and the bond dimension needed for fixed accuracy versus time, linked to the half-chain entropy.
physics/quantum_info|ode.area: Matrix product states and tensor networks

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Imaginary-time ODE ground state of the transverse Ising chain and its entanglement spectrum
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Integrate the normalized imaginary-time Schrödinger ODE to the ground state across the critical field. Decompose the result into an MPS by SVDs and compute the entanglement spectrum, the entropy, and the bond dimension needed for a given energy error.
physics/quantum_info|ode.area: Matrix product states and tensor networks

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Bond-dimension-one TDVP mean-field dynamics versus exact Ising dynamics
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Derive and integrate the TDVP ODEs for product-state spin angles in a transverse-field Ising chain, and integrate the exact dynamics in parallel. Compute the magnetization trajectories and the fidelity between the two states versus time.
physics/quantum_info|ode.area: Matrix product states and tensor networks

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Out-of-time-order correlators and butterfly velocity in the mixed-field Ising chain
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Compute W(t) = e^{iHt} Z_1 e^{-iHt} by integrating the Heisenberg-picture ODE (or forward and backward state evolutions on random states). Evaluate the OTOC C(r,t) with distant operators and extract the butterfly velocity from the wavefront.
physics/quantum_info|ode.area: Matrix product states and tensor networks

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Exponential bit-flip suppression in a dissipative two-photon cat qubit
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Integrate the Lindblad equation with two-photon dissipation, single-photon loss and thermal noise in a truncated Fock space. Extract the bit-flip time from the decay of the logical Z expectation versus mean photon number, and compare with the phase-flip rate.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Adiabatic Kerr-cat preparation by ramping a two-photon squeeze drive
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Integrate the Kerr-parametric oscillator Schrödinger equation from vacuum under a ramped squeeze drive. Compute the fidelity with the even cat state versus ramp time, and the gap of the instantaneous spectrum that controls nonadiabatic errors.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Binomial kitten code versus Fock encoding under photon loss
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Integrate the cavity amplitude-damping Lindblad equation for the binomial code words. Apply the ideal parity-based recovery channel and compute the entanglement fidelity versus time, compared with the 0/1 Fock-state encoding and the break-even condition.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Adiabatic ground-state preparation of the transverse Ising chain versus total time
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Integrate the interpolating Hamiltonian H(s) = (1-s)H_x + sH_Ising for several schedules and total times. Compute the final ground-state fidelity and energy error, relate the required time to the minimal spectral gap, and benchmark against a VQE solution.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Rényi-2 entropy growth after a quench from randomized measurements
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Integrate a long-range XY quench like those in trapped-ion experiments. Simulate local Haar-random unitaries and finite-shot measurements, and estimate subsystem purities with the Brydges cross-correlation formula, comparing them with the exact second Rényi entropies.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Shadow-based tracking of local energy and correlations along Heisenberg dynamics
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: At successive times of an exactly integrated Heisenberg chain evolution, estimate all two-local Pauli observables from one shared set of random Pauli shadows. Compute the energy-density and correlator errors versus snapshot number, using median-of-means.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Tavis-Cummings vacuum Rabi splitting scaling as sqrt(N) from weak-drive transmission
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Integrate the Lindblad master equation of N two-level atoms coupled to a lossy driven cavity to steady state over a sweep of probe frequencies. Extract the transmission doublet splitting and show it grows as 2g*sqrt(N), compared with the linearized single-excitation eigenvalues.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Dual-rail cavity qubit under photon loss: erasure conversion versus residual Pauli errors
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Integrate the Lindblad equation of two lossy cavities encoding |01>,|10> with unequal decay and dephasing. Compute leakage into |00> (detectable erasure) and the conditional logical channel within the code space, giving its residual Pauli error rates versus time.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Wigner negativity generated by Kerr evolution of a coherent state with photon loss
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Integrate the Kerr-oscillator master equation for a coherent state in truncated Fock space, then build the Wigner function on a phase-space grid from displaced-parity expectations. Track Wigner-negativity volume versus time and loss rate, including the cat-like states that appear at fractional revival times.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Dolinar receiver: feedback displacement ODE attaining the Helstrom bound for coherent states
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Solve the optimal-feedback ODE for the displacement amplitude in a photon-counting receiver that discriminates the binary coherent states |alpha> and |-alpha>. Evaluate the resulting error probability by integrating the posterior dynamics and compare it with the Kennedy receiver and the Helstrom limit.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Entanglement growth after a Néel quench in the XX chain via correlation-matrix ODE
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Integrate the Heisenberg equation dC/dt = i[h,C] for the free-fermion correlation matrix of an XX chain prepared in the Néel state. Compute block entanglement entropy from eigenvalues of the restricted correlation matrix and compare its linear growth and saturation with the quasiparticle-picture prediction.
physics/quantum_info|ode.area: Matrix product states and tensor networks

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: rf-SQUID flux qubit: Numerov shooting for tunnel splitting versus flux bias
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Solve the 1D Schrödinger equation for the double-well rf-SQUID potential in phase variable by Numerov shooting with node counting. Compute the qubit splitting and persistent-current matrix elements versus flux bias and beta_L, and fit the effective two-level Hamiltonian.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Monte Carlo wave-function photon counting from a decaying Fock state
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Unravel cavity decay of an initial Fock state |n> into jump trajectories by integrating the non-Hermitian no-jump ODE and drawing jump times from the norm decay. Compare averaged photon-number distributions and jump-time histograms with the binomial master-equation solution.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Mølmer-Sørensen gate: residual spin-motion entanglement under detuning errors
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Integrate the two-ion bichromatic interaction Hamiltonian in a truncated phonon Fock space starting from a thermal motional state. Compute Bell-state fidelity, the residual phonon-displacement loop closure and reduced-spin purity versus detuning error, compared with the Magnus-expansion result.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Two-axis versus one-axis twisting: spin squeezing dynamics in the Dicke basis
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Integrate collective-spin dynamics under the two-axis-twisting Hamiltonian in the spin-N/2 symmetric subspace from a coherent spin state. Compute the Wineland squeezing parameter versus time and N, and verify the Heisenberg-like 1/N scaling of TAT against the N^(-2/3) scaling of OAT.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Cirac-Zoller-Kimble-Mabuchi state transfer between cavities with time-symmetric photon wavepackets
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Integrate the cascaded-system equations for emitter and receiver cavity-atom amplitudes in the single-excitation sector, with the receiver coupling chosen to time-reverse the emission. Compute transfer fidelity versus coupling-shape and timing mismatch and versus intrinsic loss.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: Rotary echo suppression of driven-qubit decay under quasi-static amplitude noise
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Integrate the Bloch equations of a qubit driven with periodically sign-reversed Rabi amplitude, averaged by quadrature over Gaussian amplitude and detuning noise. Compare echo amplitude decay with plain Rabi decay versus echo period, and contrast with the analytic second-order estimate.

physics/quantum_info|ode.title: HEOM dynamics of the biased spin-boson qubit with a Drude-Lorentz bath
physics/quantum_info|ode.gist: Build and integrate the truncated hierarchical equations of motion for a qubit with sigma_x tunneling coupled through sigma_z to a Drude-Lorentz bath with Matsubara terms. Compute population relaxation and coherence versus reorganization energy and temperature, benchmarked against Redfield theory.

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: Weinberg eigenvalues and bound-state poles of an attractive Yukawa potential
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: Discretize the kernel V G0(E) for negative energies and compute its eigenvalues versus E. Root-find where an eigenvalue equals one to locate bound states, and track how the Weinberg eigenvalues control Born-series convergence.

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: Born series convergence versus exact T-matrix for exponential potential
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: Compute successive Born approximations to the on-shell K-matrix for an attractive exponential potential by repeated quadrature-discretized kernel application. Compare them with the exact LS solution and identify the potential strength at which the series diverges.

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: Levinson's theorem check for separable potentials with multiple bound states
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: Use a rank-two separable potential supporting zero, one or two bound states. Compute the phase shift from the LS T-matrix over all energies with continuous unwrapping, then verify that delta(0) - delta(inf) = N_b * pi using bound states found from the determinant condition.

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: Stückelberg oscillations in double passage with adiabatic-impulse model and Stokes phase
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: Model two successive Landau-Zener crossings using the adiabatic-impulse transfer matrices with the Stokes phase from the gamma function. The dynamical phase is a quadrature of the adiabatic energy gap; compare the predicted interference fringes with direct ODE integration.

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: Dykhne-Davis-Pechukas formula versus exact Rosen-Zener and Allen-Eberly probabilities
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: Locate the complex-time zeros of the adiabatic energy for Rosen-Zener and Allen-Eberly pulses. Evaluate the DDP exponent by contour quadrature and compare with the closed-form exact transition probabilities and direct ODE integration.

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: Fock-state Wigner functions: FFT transform versus Laguerre closed form
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: Numerically Wigner-transform harmonic-oscillator eigenstates built from Hermite functions. Compare with the analytic (-1)^n L_n(4H) e^{-2H} form, and compute the origin value, the purity integral and the marginals.

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: Quantum versus classical phase-space flow of a Gaussian in a quartic oscillator
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: Evolve a Gaussian wavepacket in an anharmonic potential with split-operator FFT and compute its Wigner function at selected times. Compare the moments <x^2>(t) and <p^2>(t) with an ensemble of classical trajectories sampled from the initial Wigner distribution, revealing quantum revivals.

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: Rb-87 ground-state Breit-Rabi diagram and second-order Zeeman clock shift
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Breit-Rabi formula for all 87Rb 5S1/2 hyperfine sublevels versus magnetic field, including the nuclear g-factor. Compute the clock-transition frequency and its quadratic Zeeman coefficient, and check them against direct diagonalization of the I·J plus Zeeman Hamiltonian.

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: Magic field of the Rb-87 two-photon |1,-1>-|2,1> transition
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: Using exact Breit-Rabi energies, compute the |F=1,m=-1> to |F=2,m=1> transition frequency versus B. Root-find the field (~3.23 G) where the first derivative vanishes and report the residual curvature at that sweet spot.

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: Fermi-contact hyperfine splittings of hydrogen, deuterium and muonium
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: Compute the ground-state hyperfine splitting from the Fermi contact formula with |psi(0)|^2 for hydrogenic atoms with reduced-mass correction, nuclear moments and spins. Compare with the 21 cm line and the measured muonium value.

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: Excited-state hyperfine with dipole and quadrupole constants into Paschen-Back regime
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: Build the Cs 6P3/2 hyperfine Hamiltonian with A and B constants via the Casimir formula, then add a Zeeman term in the |m_J m_I> basis. Diagonalize versus field to locate level crossings and the onset of the hyperfine Paschen-Back regime.

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: Li-6 ground-state Breit-Rabi states: electron-spin character at Feshbach fields
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: Compute 6Li 2S1/2 Breit-Rabi energies and eigenvector mixing coefficients versus field. Report the magnetic moments of the lowest three states and the field above which their electron spin polarization exceeds 99%.

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: Finite square well: transcendental roots, state counting and normalized eigenfunctions
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: Solve the even and odd matching conditions z tan z = sqrt(z0^2 - z^2) by bracketed root finding. Count the bound states versus well strength, and construct normalized piecewise eigenfunctions with quadrature-checked normalization.

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: Symmetric double square well tunnel splitting versus barrier width
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: Derive and solve the even and odd transcendental equations for two finite wells separated by a barrier. Compute the ground-doublet splitting versus barrier width and compare with the exponential WKB-style asymptotic estimate.

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: Spherical square well bound states with spherical Bessel matching
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: Match spherical Bessel j_l inside to modified spherical Bessel k_l outside for l = 0, 1, 2 to find bound-state energies. Determine the critical depths for the appearance of each l state and the deuteron-like well depth for 2.22 MeV binding.

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: Quantum-confined Stark effect in a finite well via Airy-function matching
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: In a finite square well under a uniform electric field, write the solutions in all regions as Airy Ai and Bi combinations. Solve the 4x4 determinant condition for quasi-bound levels and compute the ground-state Stark shift versus field, compared with second-order perturbation theory.

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: Dirac comb lattice: band-bottom effective mass and density of states
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: For the delta-function Kronig-Penney limit, compute E(k) by root finding and the effective mass from curvature at band extrema. Compute the 1D density of states as the integral of delta(E - E(k)) through dk/dE, including its van Hove singularities.

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: Optical-lattice bands from plane waves versus Mathieu characteristic values
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: Diagonalize the plane-wave Hamiltonian for V0 sin^2(kx) at each quasimomentum. Validate band edges against scipy's Mathieu characteristic values a_r and b_r, and extract band widths and gaps versus lattice depth in recoil units.

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: Bloch oscillations in a tilted lattice: semiclassical trajectory from band structure
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: Compute the lowest Bloch band of a cosine lattice and evolve the quasimomentum linearly under a constant force. Integrate the group velocity to obtain the real-space oscillation amplitude and period, and compare with the bandwidth/F estimate and wavepacket propagation.

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: Thomas-Fermi total energy Z^{7/3} scaling via virial integrals
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: Using the numerical screening function, evaluate kinetic, electron-nuclear and electron-electron energy integrals by quadrature. Verify the virial theorem and the coefficient -0.7687 Z^{7/3} Hartree, and compare with Hartree-Fock totals for neutral atoms.

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: Compressed Thomas-Fermi atom in Wigner-Seitz cell: pressure-volume relation
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: Impose the neutral-cell boundary condition phi(x0) = x0 phi'(x0) for the Feynman-Metropolis-Teller compressed atom and solve by shooting for several cell radii. Compute the electron pressure from the boundary density and the equation of state P(V).

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: HCl Morse levels: DVR numerics versus analytic eigenvalues and anharmonicity
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: Compute vibrational levels of the HCl Morse potential with a sinc-DVR Hamiltonian and compare with the analytic Morse eigenvalues. Extract omega_e and omega_e x_e from a fit, and report the number of bound levels.

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: Morse oscillator thermodynamics: partition function and heat capacity versus harmonic
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: Sum the finite set of analytic Morse levels to obtain the vibrational partition function, internal energy and heat capacity versus temperature. Contrast them with harmonic and first-order anharmonic-correction formulas.

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: Rectangular barrier transmission: transfer matrix versus analytic formula
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: Implement 2x2 transfer matrices for piecewise-constant potentials and compute T(E) below and above a rectangular barrier. Compare with the closed-form transmission including over-barrier resonances, and verify R + T = 1.

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: Finite superlattice transmission minibands converging to Kronig-Penney bands
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: Compute T(E) through N identical barrier-well periods with transfer matrices and identify the N - 1 resonances in each miniband. Show that the miniband edges converge to the infinite Kronig-Penney band edges as N grows.

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: Anderson localization length from transfer matrices of disordered delta-barrier arrays
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: Compute the transmission through long chains of delta barriers with random strengths or positions using transfer-matrix products. Extract the localization length from the Lyapunov exponent of ln T versus length, and compare with the weak-disorder perturbative formula versus energy.

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: Helium 1s2s singlet–triplet splitting from hydrogenic Coulomb and exchange integrals
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: Use screened hydrogenic 1s and 2s orbitals to evaluate the direct integral J and exchange integral K by radial multipole quadrature. Report the first-order 2¹S/2³S energies and splitting 2K, and compare with experiment.

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: Lithium 2s–2p penetration splitting in the Hartree field of a frozen 1s² core
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: Build the analytic Hartree potential of a hydrogenic 1s² core with an optimized exponent. Solve for valence 2s, 2p and 3d by Numerov, and extract the term energies, quantum defects and penetration splitting.

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: NV-center ground-state level anticrossing near 1024 G with ¹⁴N hyperfine coupling
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: Diagonalize the spin-1 NV ground-state Hamiltonian (zero-field splitting, Zeeman term, ¹⁴N hyperfine and quadrupole terms) as a function of axial field. Locate the anticrossing gaps and the electron–nuclear mixing that enables polarization transfer.

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: Tycko geometric phase of a spin-3/2 nucleus in a rotating quadrupole field
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: Rotate the axial electric-field-gradient Hamiltonian of a spin-3/2 nucleus around a cone. Compute the Berry phases of the ±3/2 and ±1/2 doublets from discretized overlap products, and compare the resulting NQR line splitting with the solid-angle formula.

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: Geometric phase of a coherent state carried around a phase-space loop
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: Displace a harmonic-oscillator coherent state along closed polygonal and elliptical loops in phase space. Evaluate the discretized Pancharatnam overlap product in a truncated Fock basis, and verify that the phase equals the enclosed area divided by ħ as the truncation converges.

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: Electric-field quenching of metastable hydrogen 2s via Lamb-shift Stark mixing
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: Build the 2s1/2–2p1/2–2p3/2 Stark Hamiltonian with Lamb shift, fine structure and 2p decay widths as a non-Hermitian matrix. Compute the 2s quench lifetime versus field, and compare with the Bethe–Lamb perturbative formula.

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: Complex rotation of the V=7.5r²e^{-r} shape resonance in a Laguerre basis
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: Complex-scale the s-wave Hamiltonian for the benchmark potential 7.5 r² e^{-r} in a Laguerre basis, evaluating the scaled potential matrix elements by Gauss–Laguerre quadrature. Trace the θ-trajectories of the eigenvalues to locate the stationary resonance energy E≈3.426−0.0128i.

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: Wigner function of the non-spreading Berry–Balazs Airy wavepacket
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: Compute the Wigner function of a truncated (exponentially apodized) Airy wavepacket by FFT. Check it against the closed-form Airy Wigner function, and show the free-evolution shear and accelerating peak, including how apodization breaks exact shape invariance.

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: Least-squares STO-nG fits to a Slater 1s orbital and hydrogen energy errors
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: Determine the Gaussian exponents and contraction coefficients that maximize the overlap with a Slater 1s function for n=1–6 using analytic Gaussian–Slater overlap integrals. Report the variational hydrogen energy and cusp/tail errors of each contraction.

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: Hydrogen Balmer-α Einstein A coefficients and n=3 lifetimes via Gordon formula
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the n=3→2 radial dipole integrals with Gordon's hypergeometric closed form and cross-check by quadrature. Combine them with angular factors to obtain A coefficients, branching ratios and lifetimes of 3s, 3p and 3d.
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.area: Dipole transition rates and oscillator strengths

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: Two-photon decay rate of metastable hydrogen 2s
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: Compute the 2s→1s two-photon emission spectrum from second-order sums over intermediate np states, including continuum contributions via a large Sturmian or Laguerre pseudostate basis. Integrate over photon frequency to recover the total rate of ≈8.23 s⁻¹.
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.area: Dipole transition rates and oscillator strengths

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: Franck–Condon factors for H₂ → H₂⁺ photoionization from Morse eigenfunctions
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: Build analytic Morse vibrational eigenfunctions for H₂(X) and H₂⁺(X) using Laguerre polynomials. Compute the overlap integrals by quadrature to obtain Franck–Condon factors for the v′ progression, and compare with the reflection approximation and the harmonic Ansbacher formula.

physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.title: ADK tunneling ionization of argon and saturation intensity in a Gaussian pulse
physics/quantum_mech|quad_models.gist: Evaluate cycle-averaged ADK ionization rates for argon with Coulomb-corrected exponents. Integrate the ground-state depletion over a Gaussian pulse envelope by quadrature, and determine the saturation intensity versus pulse duration and Keldysh parameter.

physics/condensed_matter|waves.title: Second-order Fröhlich polaron energy and mass in two dimensions
physics/condensed_matter|waves.gist: Evaluate the weak-coupling Fröhlich self-energy for a 2D electron with a 1/q coupling, using Bessel-function angular integrals and finite-thickness form factors. Obtain the energy shift and effective-mass renormalization, and compare the strictly-2D results (−πα/2 ħω, πα/8) with quasi-2D slabs.

physics/condensed_matter|waves.title: Transfer-integral thermal expansion of a classical Morse chain
physics/condensed_matter|waves.gist: Evaluate the classical partition function of a 1D Morse-bonded chain with the transfer-integral operator, discretized on a bond-length grid, and use its dominant eigenpair to get the mean bond length versus temperature and pressure. Compare the resulting linear thermal expansion with the quasi-harmonic Grüneisen estimate.

physics/condensed_matter|waves.title: Ewald-summed rigid-ion phonons of rock-salt NaCl and LO-TO Grüneisen parameters
physics/condensed_matter|waves.gist: Assemble the Coulomb dynamical matrix of a rigid-ion NaCl model by Ewald summation in real and reciprocal space, add a Born-Mayer short-range term, and diagonalize along high-symmetry lines. Report the LO-TO splitting, check the Lyddane-Sachs-Teller relation, and compute volume-derivative mode Grüneisen parameters.

physics/condensed_matter|waves.title: FFT-based Hilbert-transform Kramers-Kronig for a Drude-Lorentz dielectric function
physics/condensed_matter|waves.gist: Reconstruct ε₁(ω) from a sampled ε₂(ω) of a multi-oscillator Drude-Lorentz model with an FFT discrete Hilbert transform, using zero-padding and odd extension. Quantify truncation errors against the analytic result and verify the f-sum rule for the plasma frequency.

physics/condensed_matter|waves.title: Reflectance phase retrieval and optical constants with Hagen-Rubens extrapolation
physics/condensed_matter|waves.gist: From a simulated normal-incidence reflectivity spectrum of a metal, apply low-frequency Hagen-Rubens and high-frequency ω^{-4} extrapolations and compute the reflectivity phase by principal-value KK quadrature. Invert to n, κ and σ₁(ω), then compare with the input model.

physics/condensed_matter|waves.title: EELS loss-function Kramers-Kronig analysis with Bethe and perfect-screening sum rules
physics/condensed_matter|waves.gist: From a model loss function −Im[1/ε(ω)] with plasmon and interband features, normalize it using the perfect-screening sum rule and recover Re[1/ε] by Kramers-Kronig. Invert to ε(ω) and verify the Bethe f-sum for the valence electron count.

physics/condensed_matter|waves.title: Momentum-space Hartree-Fock of the extended Hubbard chain with FFT exchange
physics/condensed_matter|waves.gist: Solve self-consistent Hartree-Fock for a 1D Hubbard chain with longer-range V(r), evaluating the Fock self-energy Σ(k)=−Σ_q V(q)n(k−q) by FFT convolution in a doubled unit cell. Map the SDW-versus-CDW boundary in the (U,V) plane.

physics/condensed_matter|waves.title: Spin Hall conductivity of the Kane-Mele model with Rashba coupling
physics/condensed_matter|waves.gist: Compute the spin Berry curvature with the s_z-conjugate current operator for the Kane-Mele model on an FFT-generated k-mesh and integrate σ^s_xy(μ). Show the deviation from 2e/4π quantization as Rashba coupling breaks S_z conservation.

physics/condensed_matter|waves.title: Luttinger-Kohn hole-band warping via spherical-harmonic expansion of energy surfaces
physics/condensed_matter|waves.gist: Diagonalize the 4×4 Luttinger Hamiltonian for GaAs/Ge parameters over a sphere of k-directions and project the heavy- and light-hole E(k̂) onto cubic harmonics. Extract warping coefficients and direction-averaged density-of-states masses.

physics/condensed_matter|waves.title: Kohn-Luttinger shallow donor levels in silicon via Legendre-expanded anisotropic hydrogen
physics/condensed_matter|waves.gist: Solve the anisotropic-mass hydrogenic donor Hamiltonian (m_l, m_t of Si) by expanding the wavefunction in Legendre/spherical harmonics with a radial basis and diagonalizing the coupled channels. Obtain 1s, 2p₀ and 2p± binding energies and compare with experiment.

physics/condensed_matter|waves.title: Time-resolved ARPES Floquet sidebands of a driven two-band model
physics/condensed_matter|waves.gist: Compute the tr-ARPES intensity of a driven 1D two-band model using a double-time integral over a Gaussian probe envelope, evaluated by FFT of the two-time lesser Green's function. Show sideband replicas spaced by ħω and the avoided crossings that open gaps.
physics/condensed_matter|waves.area: Floquet engineering of periodically driven lattices

physics/condensed_matter|waves.title: Cohen-Bergstresser empirical pseudopotential band structure of silicon with cutoff convergence
physics/condensed_matter|waves.gist: Build the plane-wave EPM Hamiltonian for diamond Si using symmetric form factors at |G|²=3,8,11 and compute bands along L-Γ-X-K-Γ. Converge the indirect gap and the conduction minimum location with respect to the kinetic-energy cutoff.

physics/condensed_matter|waves.title: Zincblende GaAs empirical pseudopotential bands and conduction-band effective mass
physics/condensed_matter|waves.gist: Include symmetric and antisymmetric form factors to construct the GaAs EPM Hamiltonian and compute bands and the direct gap. Extract the Γ₆ conduction effective mass by finite-difference curvature and compare it with the k·p estimate.

physics/condensed_matter|waves.title: FFT-based valence charge density and bond charge in pseudopotential silicon
physics/condensed_matter|waves.gist: Solve the Si EPM at special k-points, transform the occupied plane-wave eigenvectors to a real-space FFT grid, and accumulate the valence density. Plot the (110) density map and integrate the bond charge between nearest neighbors.

physics/condensed_matter|waves.title: Kronig-Penney bands: transfer matrix versus plane-wave expansion convergence
physics/condensed_matter|waves.gist: Compute 1D square-well superlattice bands exactly from the transfer-matrix condition cos(ka)=½Tr M(E). Compare with plane-wave Hamiltonian diagonalization using Fourier coefficients of the potential, and quantify Gibbs-related convergence of the band edges with the number of G vectors.

physics/condensed_matter|waves.title: Molecular-graphene artificial lattice bands from Bessel form factors of disk potentials
physics/condensed_matter|waves.gist: Model a 2D electron gas with a triangular array of repulsive disks (CO on Cu(111)) whose Fourier form factors are ∝J₁(GR)/G. Diagonalize the plane-wave Hamiltonian to obtain emergent Dirac cones, their velocity, and their dependence on disk radius.

physics/condensed_matter|waves.title: Quasi-2D electron gas plasmons with finite-thickness Coulomb form factor
physics/condensed_matter|waves.gist: Compute the 2D Lindhard response (Stern) and a Coulomb form factor F(q) obtained by Fourier transforming the subband density of an infinite well. Find plasmon dispersions from 1−v_qF(q)χ₀=0 and quantify the deviation from √q with well width.

physics/condensed_matter|waves.title: Aloof-beam EELS of a Drude nanosphere via multipolar surface-plasmon expansion
physics/condensed_matter|waves.gist: Sum the quasistatic multipole series (modified Bessel functions K_m of the impact parameter and Legendre coefficients) for an electron passing outside a Drude sphere. Compute the loss probability spectrum, showing the l-dependent modes at ω_p√(l/(2l+1)) and their weights.

physics/condensed_matter|waves.title: Fibonacci chain spectrum via transfer-matrix trace map and fractal dimension
physics/condensed_matter|waves.gist: Use the trace-map recursion of Fibonacci transfer matrices to locate allowed energies of off-diagonal or on-site Fibonacci chains. Measure the scaling of total bandwidth with generation and estimate the box-counting dimension of the spectrum.

physics/condensed_matter|waves.title: Diffraction pattern of a cut-and-project Fibonacci quasilattice
physics/condensed_matter|waves.gist: Generate a Fibonacci quasilattice by projection from a 2D square lattice and compute its structure factor by direct Fourier sums on a fine q-grid. Index the Bragg peaks with two integers and compare intensities with the analytic sinc form of the window function.

physics/condensed_matter|waves.title: Landauer phonon thermal conductance of a mass-disordered chain by transfer matrices
physics/condensed_matter|waves.gist: Compute frequency-resolved phonon transmission through a harmonic chain segment with random or isotopic mass disorder between ordered leads, using lattice transfer matrices with lead self-energy boundary conditions. Integrate to get the thermal conductance versus T and length, and show Anderson localization of high-frequency modes.

physics/condensed_matter|waves.title: Chebyshev filter diagonalization of band-centre eigenstates in the 3D Anderson model
physics/condensed_matter|waves.gist: Build a Chebyshev polynomial window filter for a narrow interior energy interval of a sparse 3D Anderson Hamiltonian and apply it to random blocks. Use Rayleigh-Ritz to extract the eigenpairs, then compute their inverse participation ratios and compare the counts with the KPM DOS.

physics/condensed_matter|waves.title: Spin filtering by tunneling through a Dresselhaus barrier (Perel' effect)
physics/condensed_matter|waves.gist: Use 2x2 spinor transfer matrices at a semiconductor tunnel barrier with k-linear Dresselhaus coupling to compute spin-dependent transmission versus in-plane wavevector. Integrate over incident angles to obtain the transmitted current's spin polarization versus barrier thickness.

physics/condensed_matter|waves.title: Surface plasmon modes of a Drude metallic nanowire from modified Bessel functions
physics/condensed_matter|waves.gist: Solve the quasi-static (and retarded) matching conditions for a Drude cylinder with I_m and K_m Bessel functions. Obtain the m=0,1,2 surface plasmon dispersions ω(k) and their limits ω_p/√2 and ω_p at small and large ka.

physics/condensed_matter|waves.title: Mean-field semimetal-antiferromagnet transition of the honeycomb Hubbard model
physics/condensed_matter|waves.gist: Self-consistently solve the Néel Hartree-Fock gap equation on the half-filled honeycomb lattice using Brillouin-zone sums over Dirac bands. Find the critical U_c≈2.23t and the gap and staggered magnetization versus U.

physics/condensed_matter|waves.title: Pair distribution function from S(Q) by sine Fourier transform
physics/condensed_matter|waves.gist: Generate S(Q) for a model fcc crystal with Debye-Waller damping and transform it to G(r) by a sine Fourier transform. Quantify the termination ripples versus Q_max, and how Lorch window functions trade them off against peak broadening.

physics/condensed_matter|waves.title: Wannier functions and Hubbard J, U in a 1D optical lattice
physics/condensed_matter|waves.gist: Solve the cos² lattice bands by plane-wave expansion and build gauge-fixed Wannier functions via FFT over quasimomentum. Compute the tunneling J and the on-site U versus lattice depth and compare with the Mathieu-based asymptotic formulas.

physics/condensed_matter|waves.title: Transverse magnetic focusing in a 2DEG by classical ray tracing
physics/condensed_matter|waves.gist: Trace cyclotron trajectories injected from a point contact with specular or diffuse edge reflections. Histogram the arrivals at a collector to obtain focusing peaks at B = n·2ħk_F/(eL), with peak amplitudes versus edge specularity.

physics/condensed_matter|waves.title: Multislice electron diffraction: thickness oscillations of Bragg beams in silicon
physics/condensed_matter|waves.gist: Build a projected crystal potential from Gaussian atomic form factors and alternate phase-grating transmission with an FFT Fresnel propagator through [110] Si. Track the Pendellösung oscillations of the beam intensities versus thickness.

physics/condensed_matter|waves.title: Mie extinction and Fröhlich mode of a SiC nanosphere in the reststrahlen band
physics/condensed_matter|waves.gist: Evaluate Mie coefficients with spherical Bessel and Hankel functions for a Lorentz-oscillator SiC sphere. Locate the Fröhlich condition ε=-2 and follow the higher multipole resonances and their size-dependent redshift.
physics/condensed_matter|waves.area: Photonic and phononic crystal band structures

physics/condensed_matter|waves.title: Real-time delta-kick absorption spectrum of a graphene quantum dot
physics/condensed_matter|waves.gist: Apply an impulsive vector-potential kick to a tight-binding hexagonal graphene flake and propagate the density matrix. Fourier transform the induced dipole with exponential damping to obtain the absorption spectrum, then check it against the Lehmann sum and the TRK sum rule.

physics/condensed_matter|waves.title: Time-domain thermoreflectance signal from layered heat diffusion via Hankel transform
physics/condensed_matter|waves.gist: Propagate heat through a transducer/interface/substrate stack using thermal-quadrupole transfer matrices in Hankel and frequency space. Assemble the Cahill TDTR in-phase and out-of-phase signals to fit the substrate conductivity and the interface conductance.

physics/condensed_matter|waves.title: Hyperbolic phonon polaritons in an hBN slab from transfer-matrix poles
physics/condensed_matter|waves.gist: Use uniaxial Lorentz permittivities for hBN's two reststrahlen bands and compute the p-polarized reflection coefficient of a thin slab with an anisotropic transfer matrix. Map Im r_p(q,ω) to obtain the multibranch hyperbolic polariton dispersion.
physics/condensed_matter|waves.area: Photonic and phononic crystal band structures

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Saha-Boltzmann peak of Balmer line strength versus temperature
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Combine Saha ionization with Boltzmann excitation, using truncated hydrogen partition functions and electron pressure. Compute the n=2 population fraction versus temperature and locate its maximum, near 10^4 K.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Holtsmark quasistatic Stark broadening distribution by Fourier quadrature
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Holtsmark microfield distribution as an oscillatory Fourier integral. Convolve it with the linear Stark shifts of a hydrogen line, then compare the far wings with the asymptotic beta^(-5/2) law and with a Lorentzian impact profile.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Doublet-ratio column densities and b-values for interstellar absorbers
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Tabulate Doppler-dominated curves of growth for a doublet with known f-values. Invert observed equivalent widths of two lines for column density and Doppler parameter by 2D root finding.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: 21-cm absorption-emission spin temperature of a cold HI cloud
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Compute the 21-cm optical depth profile from column density, spin temperature and Gaussian velocity dispersion. Form the on/off-source brightness temperature spectra and recover T_spin from the combined profiles.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Plummer sphere: virial quantities, Jeans dispersion and sampled equilibrium
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Plummer potential energy and isotropic velocity dispersion by quadrature of the Jeans equation. Sample positions and velocities from the distribution function, then verify 2T/|W|≈1 and the analytic W=-3πGM²/(32a).

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Dynamical friction inspiral of a globular cluster in isothermal halo
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Apply the Chandrasekhar friction formula with erf-based velocity factors and a Coulomb logarithm to a satellite in a singular isothermal sphere. Integrate the radial decay and compare the sinking time with the analytic estimate.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Eddington inversion distribution function for the Hernquist profile
