physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Compute f(E) for the Hernquist model by numerical Abel/Eddington inversion quadrature with careful endpoint handling. Compare with Hernquist's closed form and compute the differential energy distribution N(E).

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Softened leapfrog Kepler binary: energy error versus timestep and eccentricity
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Integrate a two-body orbit with kick-drift-kick leapfrog and Plummer softening. Measure the energy error amplitude and its scaling with dt across eccentricities, and quantify the precession of periapsis induced by softening.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: King model star clusters: concentration, tidal radius and relaxation time
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Integrate Poisson's equation for the lowered-isothermal King distribution function, using erf-based density closures, for a range of W0. Compute the concentration log(rt/r0), the half-mass radius and the half-mass two-body relaxation time.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Two-phase neutral ISM pressure curve and Field stability
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Model photoelectric heating plus C II 158 μm, O I and Lyα cooling as functions of n and T. Solve thermal equilibrium to get the P(n) curve, find P_min and P_max, and classify the phases with the isobaric Field criterion.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Strömgren sphere ionization structure around an O star blackbody
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Integrate the Planck photon rate above 13.6 eV and use the frequency-averaged photoionization cross section. Solve local ionization balance with attenuation outward to obtain the ionized fraction profile and compare its edge with the Strömgren radius.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Collisional ionization equilibrium of hydrogen and helium versus temperature
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Use Voronov collisional ionization fits and radiative plus dielectronic recombination fits. Solve the coronal-equilibrium ion fractions of H, He, He+ and He++ over 10^4 to 10^6 K.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Equilibrium dust grain temperature from Planck-mean absorption and emission
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Balance absorbed interstellar or stellar radiation against modified-blackbody emission with Q_abs ∝ ν^β. Use Planck-mean quadratures and root finding to obtain grain temperature versus distance from a star.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Eddington standard model: radiation pressure fraction and central conditions
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Solve Eddington's quartic for the gas-pressure fraction β as a function of stellar mass and μ. Combine it with n=3 polytrope constants to compute the central density and temperature of massive stars.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Apsidal motion constant and tidal Love number of polytropes
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Integrate the Radau equation for η2 alongside the Lane-Emden structure, then compute the apsidal constant k2 and the Love number versus n. Apply the result to the apsidal precession of an eclipsing binary.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Exact Hopf function for the grey atmosphere versus Eddington approximation
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Hopf function q(τ) from its exact integral representation by quadrature. Construct T(τ), and compute the emergent intensity and limb-darkening law compared with the Eddington 1+3μ/2 law.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Feautrier solution of two-level atom line source function
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Solve the second-order transfer equation with complete redistribution and a Doppler profile, using Gauss angle and frequency quadrature and block tridiagonal elimination. Compute the non-LTE line source function and the emergent line profile.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Milne-Eddington absorption line profiles with Voigt opacity
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Use a linear source function in τ and a constant line-to-continuum opacity ratio with a Voigt profile. Compute the emergent intensity and flux profiles analytically, plus the equivalent width versus line strength.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Wavelength-dependent limb darkening coefficients from a grey temperature structure
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Integrate the Planck function over the Eddington T(τ) to get I_λ(μ) at several wavelengths. Fit quadratic limb-darkening coefficients and compute the disk-integrated flux and transit depth profiles.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: ΛCDM distances with radiation: angular diameter distance turnover
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Integrate the comoving distance for a flat ΛCDM model with radiation, then compute luminosity and angular diameter distances and the comoving volume element. Locate the redshift where D_A peaks.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Age, lookback time and acceleration onset in CPL dark energy
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Evaluate H(z) for w0-wa dark energy using the closed-form density evolution. Compute the age and lookback time by quadrature, and find the deceleration-acceleration transition redshift by root finding.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Supernova Hubble diagram fit for curved cosmologies
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Compute distance moduli with the sinn curvature mapping for (Ωm, ΩΛ) grids. Evaluate χ² against synthetic SN Ia data with marginalized absolute magnitude, and locate best-fit confidence contours.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Linear growth factor and fσ8 via the Heath integral
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Compute D(a) for ΛCDM from Heath's integral solution and the growth rate f=dlnD/dlna. Compare with Ωm(z)^0.55, then predict fσ8(z).

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Sound horizon at drag epoch and BAO angular scale
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Integrate the baryon-photon sound speed over time to obtain r_s at the drag redshift. Compute the BAO angular scale θ = r_s / D_M(z) and the radial scale r_s H(z)/c for survey redshifts.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: TT-gauge strain from a rotating triaxial neutron star
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Build the time-dependent mass quadrupole of a spinning ellipsoid and project it to TT gauge along arbitrary directions. Compute h+ and h× versus inclination and the radiated luminosity in closed form.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Angular quadrature of TT-projected flux to verify quadrupole formula
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: For a generic time-dependent quadrupole, integrate dP/dΩ over the sphere with Lebedev or Gauss-product quadrature of the TT-projected third derivatives. Confirm the result equals (G/5c^5) times the traceless quadrupole term.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Interferometer antenna patterns and sky-averaged gravitational wave response
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Compute the F+ and F× antenna patterns of an L-shaped detector versus sky position and polarization angle. Integrate over the sky to obtain the 2/5 average and the network sensitivity of two detectors.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Ni-56 mass from late-time tail with gamma-ray leakage
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Model the cobalt-tail luminosity with deposition 1-exp(-T0²/t²) plus positron energy deposition. Fit a synthetic bolometric tail to infer M_Ni and the gamma-ray escape timescale T0.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Magnetar spin-down powered superluminous supernova light curve
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Insert the magnetar spin-down luminosity into the Arnett diffusion integral. Scan the magnetic field and initial period to compute peak luminosity and rise time, and compare with a pure Ni-powered case.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Kilonova light curve with r-process heating and thermalization efficiency
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Use the power-law r-process heating rate with Barnes-like time-dependent thermalization inside an Arnett-type diffusion integral for low-mass ejecta. Compute bolometric luminosity, peak time and photospheric blackbody temperature.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Type IIP plateau duration and luminosity from Popov recombination model
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Evaluate Popov's analytic recombination-wave model for plateau length and luminosity versus explosion energy, ejecta mass and progenitor radius. Invert observed plateau properties for the explosion parameters.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Fresnel reflectance of Drude metals and pseudo-Brewster angle
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Compute the complex permittivity of a Drude metal versus frequency and the s/p Fresnel reflection coefficients for absorbing media. Locate the pseudo-Brewster minimum of R_p and the plasma-edge reflectance drop.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Bragg mirror transfer matrix reflectance and stopband width
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Build 2x2 characteristic matrices for quarter-wave multilayer stacks at oblique incidence. Compute reflectance spectra, then compare the peak reflectance and stopband width with the analytic expressions.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Hulse-Taylor orbital period decay prediction from quadrupole emission
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Compute dP_b/dt from the masses, period and eccentricity with the Peters-Mathews enhancement f(e). Accumulate the periastron-time shift over decades and compare with the observed value.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Matched-filter SNR and horizon distance for Newtonian chirp
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Use the stationary-phase amplitude |h(f)| ∝ f^(-7/6) and an analytic Advanced LIGO noise PSD fit. Integrate the optimal SNR up to f_ISCO, then compute the horizon and sky-averaged range versus total mass.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Stochastic background from binary black hole population via Phinney formula
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Integrate the source-frame energy spectrum over a redshift-dependent merger rate following the star formation history. Obtain Ω_gw(f) ∝ f^(2/3) and its amplitude at 25 Hz.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Case A and B hydrogen recombination coefficients via Milne relation quadrature
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Compute level-resolved radiative recombination coefficients of hydrogen. Apply the Milne relation to Kramers photoionization cross sections with Gaunt factors and integrate over a Maxwellian, then sum over n to get α_A(T) and α_B(T) and the recombination cooling rate.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Novikov-Thorne relativistic thin-disk flux profile and spectrum versus Kerr spin
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Page-Thorne flux integral using the Kerr circular-orbit energy, angular momentum and angular velocity, with the zero-torque condition at the ISCO. Then integrate local blackbody emission over radius to obtain the disk luminosity, the spectral peak and the efficiency as functions of spin.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Toroidal field ripple of a discrete-coil tokamak by Biot-Savart quadrature
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Model N planar circular toroidal-field coils arranged around a torus. Numerically integrate Biot-Savart over each coil to map B_φ(R,φ) and the ripple amplitude δ=(Bmax−Bmin)/(Bmax+Bmin) versus coil number and major radius, and compare with the ideal 1/R field.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Off-axis magnetic field of a finite solenoid via generalized complete elliptic integrals
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Compute B_r and B_z of a finite-length current sheet solenoid everywhere using the Derby-Olbert closed form with the Bulirsch generalized elliptic integral. Verify it against direct quadrature over stacked loops, and quantify field homogeneity within the bore.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Oblique MHD Rankine-Hugoniot jumps: fast, slow and intermediate shock roots
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Write the shock adiabatic as a polynomial in the downstream normal velocity for given upstream β, Mach number and field obliquity, then find its physical roots. From these, compute the compression ratio, field rotation and entropy jump for fast and slow shocks.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Taub adiabat: relativistic shock jump conditions with Synge gas equation of state
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Solve the relativistic Rankine-Hugoniot conditions for a Synge-Jüttner ideal gas, with enthalpy given by modified Bessel functions K3/K2. Obtain the downstream temperature, compression ratio and shock speed versus upstream Lorentz factor, bridging the Newtonian factor-4 and ultrarelativistic limits.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Ionospheric virtual height of radio echoes from Appleton-Hartree group refractive index
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Use a Chapman-layer electron density with a dipole geomagnetic field and vertical incidence. Integrate the Appleton-Hartree group index for the O and X modes up to the reflection level to obtain ionogram virtual height h'(f) and the critical frequencies.
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.area: Wave propagation in plasmas and dielectrics

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Electron Weibel instability growth rate from bi-Maxwellian kinetic dispersion relation
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Solve the transverse kinetic dispersion relation for an electron bi-Maxwellian plasma using the Faddeeva-based plasma dispersion function. Root-find purely growing modes to get growth rate versus wavenumber, the maximum growth and the cutoff wavenumber as functions of temperature anisotropy.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Interstellar extinction curve from Mie theory and MRN grain size distribution
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Compute extinction efficiencies of silicate and graphite spheres with the Riccati-Bessel Mie series using a model complex refractive index. Integrate over an MRN a^{-3.5} size distribution to get A_λ/A_V, R_V and the albedo versus wavelength.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Rosseland and Planck mean opacities of hydrogen from free-free and bound-free absorption
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Build the monochromatic hydrogenic opacity from Kramers bound-free edges with Saha-Boltzmann level populations and from free-free absorption with stimulated emission correction. Evaluate Rosseland and Planck means by quadrature over frequency and compare their T,ρ scaling with Kramers' law.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Partially degenerate electron gas EOS via generalized Fermi-Dirac integrals
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Evaluate relativistic generalized Fermi-Dirac integrals by quadrature to obtain electron number density, pressure and energy at finite temperature. Invert for the degeneracy parameter at given ρ,T, and map the transition between ideal and degenerate regimes along stellar core tracks.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Maclaurin spheroid and Jacobi ellipsoid sequences via gravitational index-symbol integrals
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Compute the potential index symbols A_i of homogeneous ellipsoids by one-dimensional quadrature. Use them to evaluate Ω²/(πGρ) and angular momentum along the Maclaurin sequence and to solve for the Jacobi branch, locating the bifurcation at eccentricity ≈0.8127.

physics/fields_astro|quad_models.title: Milankovitch daily-mean insolation versus latitude, obliquity and eccentricity
physics/fields_astro|quad_models.gist: Derive orbital solar distance and declination from Kepler's equation, then integrate top-of-atmosphere flux over the hour angle with polar-day and polar-night limits. Map daily insolation by latitude and season, and compute annual means and caloric half-year sums as functions of orbital elements.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Bayesian MCMC phase estimation with dephased GHZ probes
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Simulate parity-measurement outcomes of N-qubit GHZ states under local dephasing, sample the phase posterior with Metropolis-Hastings, and compare the posterior variance with the quantum Cramér-Rao bound from the noisy-GHZ QFI.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Empirical Fisher information of lossy NOON-state interferometry from Monte Carlo counts
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Sample photon-number detection events for NOON states through a beam splitter with photon loss, estimate the classical Fisher information from finite-difference likelihoods of the histograms, and compare with the analytic QFI as loss varies.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Sequential Monte Carlo adaptive Ramsey frequency estimation with T2 decay
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Track a qubit detuning posterior with a particle filter (resampling, Liu-West moves) using adaptively chosen Ramsey evolution times, then compute the error-scaling exponent against the number of experiments and the standard quantum limit.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Ramsey QFI loss under Ornstein-Uhlenbeck field noise via Langevin sampling
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Integrate Ornstein-Uhlenbeck frequency noise trajectories with the exact discretization, average the qubit coherence over realizations, and compute the QFI for frequency estimation and the optimal interrogation time. Compare against the Gaussian decoherence functional.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Fisher information of a continuous homodyne record via stochastic master equation
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Integrate the Itô stochastic master equation for a driven qubit under continuous homodyne monitoring, propagate the likelihood derivative along trajectories, and Monte Carlo average to obtain the classical Fisher information of the record for estimating the Rabi frequency.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Measurement-induced entanglement transition in monitored random qubit circuits
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Interleave random two-qubit unitaries with projective Z measurements sampled by Born-rule Monte Carlo at rate p, average the steady-state half-chain von Neumann entropy over trajectories, and locate the transition from crossings of entropy versus system size.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Continuously monitored free-fermion chain via Gaussian stochastic trajectories
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Evolve the correlation matrix of a hopping chain under continuous monitoring of site occupations with Wiener increments and QR re-orthonormalization, then compute the trajectory-averaged entanglement entropy versus subsystem size and fit area-law versus logarithmic scaling.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Quantum-jump trajectories of a dephasing XXZ chain after a Néel quench
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Unravel the Lindblad equation with local dephasing into Monte Carlo wavefunction trajectories, compute the trajectory-averaged half-chain entanglement entropy and the staggered magnetization, and check the averaged observables against exact density-matrix evolution.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Randomized-measurement estimation of Rényi-2 entropy after an Ising quench
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Simulate the Brydges et al. protocol: apply random local unitaries to the quenched transverse-field Ising state, sample finite-shot bitstrings, and estimate subsystem purities from Hamming-distance-weighted cross-correlations. Compare with the exact Rényi-2 entropies and their statistical errors.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Discord and geometric discord statistics of Hilbert-Schmidt random two-qubit states
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Sample two-qubit density matrices from the Hilbert-Schmidt measure via Ginibre matrices, compute the measurement-optimized discord and the closed-form geometric discord, and estimate their distributions, means and joint correlation with negativity.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Frozen discord of Bell-diagonal states under Brownian phase noise
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Generate local Gaussian random-walk phase noise by Langevin sampling and average the two-qubit Bell-diagonal state over realizations. Compute the classical correlation and discord, and locate the sudden-change time and the discord-freezing interval.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Shot-noise scaling of qubit SIC-POVM tomography
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Sample finite-shot outcomes of the tetrahedral SIC-POVM on random qubit states, reconstruct by linear inversion with projection onto physical states, and fit the average Hilbert-Schmidt and infidelity error scaling with the number of shots.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Metropolis-Hastings Bayesian tomography of a two-qubit state
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Parametrize density matrices through Ginibre/Cholesky factors, sample the posterior given simulated Pauli-measurement counts with Metropolis-Hastings, and compute the posterior-mean state, the fidelity credible interval, and comparison to the maximum-likelihood estimate.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Markov chain of repeated Hesse SIC-POVM measurements on a qutrit
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Construct the qutrit Hesse SIC-POVM with Lüders post-measurement states, simulate long sequences of repeated measurements interleaved with a fixed unitary, and compute the outcome transition matrix, stationary distribution and outcome-entropy rate from Monte Carlo and exact calculations.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Quantum Zeno survival with Poisson-random measurement times
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Simulate a Rabi-driven qubit interrupted by projective measurements at exponentially distributed waiting times, Monte Carlo average the survival probability, and compare the effective decay rate with regularly spaced measurements and the analytic stochastic-Zeno formula.
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.area: Quantum Zeno effect and weak measurement

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Weak-value amplification with Monte Carlo Gaussian pointer sampling
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Simulate a von Neumann qubit-pointer weak interaction with pre- and postselection, sample pointer readings from the exact postselected distribution, and estimate the weak value and its signal-to-noise and Fisher information. Compare with standard measurement as the postselection angle varies.
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.area: Quantum Zeno effect and weak measurement

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Monte Carlo teleportation fidelity through an amplitude-damped Bell resource
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Teleport Haar-random qubit states using a Bell pair with one qubit amplitude-damped, sampling Bell-measurement outcomes and Kraus branches. Estimate the average fidelity versus damping and compare with the analytic singlet-fraction formula and the classical 2/3 limit.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Repeater chain swapping with stochastic link generation and memory decoherence
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Kinetic Monte Carlo of elementary links generated by geometric trials, with qubits decohering in depolarizing memories while waiting, followed by nested entanglement swapping. Compute the end-to-end delivery-time distribution and the mean Werner fidelity versus link success probability.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Monte Carlo volume of PPT states for two qubits and qubit-qutrit
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Sample Hilbert-Schmidt-distributed density matrices, test the Peres-Horodecki criterion via partial-transpose eigenvalues, and estimate the separable-state probability with error bars. Reproduce 8/33 for two qubits and obtain the qubit-qutrit value.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: SSE quantum Monte Carlo thermal concurrence in a Heisenberg ring
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Implement stochastic series expansion QMC with operator-loop updates for the spin-1/2 Heisenberg ring, measure nearest-neighbor ⟨S_i·S_j⟩, and convert it to concurrence through the SU(2)-symmetric two-qubit formula. Find the entanglement temperature and benchmark with exact diagonalization.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Path-integral Monte Carlo two-site concurrence in the transverse-field Ising chain
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Sample the Trotterized imaginary-time world-line representation of the TFIM with Metropolis cluster updates, measure ⟨σz⟩, ⟨σx⟩ and nearest/next-nearest correlators, assemble two-site reduced density matrices, and compute their concurrence across the critical point.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Finite-shot quantum natural gradient VQE for the transverse Ising model
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Estimate energy gradients and the Fubini-Study metric of a hardware-efficient ansatz from sampled measurement outcomes with parameter-shift rules, regularize the metric, and compare convergence of QNG and plain gradient descent under shot noise.
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.area: Quantum natural gradient and Fubini-Study metric

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Simulated-annealing Holevo capacity of the amplitude-damping channel
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Optimize the Holevo quantity over finite ensembles of qubit input states and probabilities using Metropolis simulated annealing, and compare the resulting single-shot classical capacity versus the damping parameter with known two-state-ensemble optima.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Parallel-tempering search for superadditive coherent information of the dephrasure channel
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Use replica-exchange Monte Carlo over two-use input density matrices to maximize the coherent information of the dephrasure channel. Identify the parameter region where the two-letter value exceeds twice the single-letter value.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Stochastic optimization of accessible information for the trine ensemble
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Maximize the mutual information between trine-state labels and outcomes over rank-one POVMs parametrized via Naimark isometries using stochastic hill climbing with restarts. Recover the known accessible information and compare with the Holevo bound.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Fidelity and trace-distance statistics of Bures-random mixed states
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Sample qubit and qutrit density matrices from the Bures measure via Ginibre and Haar unitary constructions, compute Uhlmann fidelity, Bures angle and trace distance between pairs, and estimate their distributions and moments. Check the Fuchs-van de Graaf inequalities.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Randomized benchmarking under depolarizing and coherent over-rotation errors
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Generate random single-qubit Clifford sequences with an inverting gate, simulate survival probabilities with depolarizing and coherent noise, and fit the exponential decay to extract the average gate fidelity. Compare with the process fidelity and diamond distance of the noise channel.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Gillespie simulation of logical failure in a periodically corrected repetition code
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Generate continuous-time bit-flip errors on a three- or five-qubit repetition code with the Gillespie algorithm, apply majority-vote correction at fixed intervals, and compute the logical failure-time distribution and effective logical error rate. Compare with the analytic binomial result.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Quantum state diffusion versus jump unraveling: convergence to the Lindblad steady state
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Simulate a detuned, driven, damped qubit with both Gisin-Percival quantum state diffusion (Euler-Maruyama) and quantum-jump trajectories. Measure how the ensemble-averaged Bloch vector error versus the exact Lindblad solution scales with trajectory number and time step.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Random-bond Ising model on the Nishimori line and the toric-code threshold
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Map toric-code bit-flip decoding to the 2D ±J random-bond Ising model at the Nishimori temperature. Run disorder-averaged Metropolis Monte Carlo with periodic boundaries and locate the ferro-paramagnetic transition near p≈0.109 from Binder-cumulant or domain-wall free-energy crossings.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Clifford data regression error mitigation with sampled near-Clifford training circuits
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: For a noisy small TFIM Trotter circuit, randomly replace most non-Clifford rotations with Clifford angles to build training circuits. Simulate their noisy and ideal expectation values, fit a linear map, and apply it to mitigate the target observable, including shot-noise sampling.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Szegedy quantization of a Metropolis chain: quantum phase gap versus classical spectral gap
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Build the Metropolis-Hastings transition matrix for Gibbs sampling of a small Ising ring at several temperatures and construct the Szegedy walk unitary. Compare its phase gap with the square root of the classical spectral gap, the source of quadratic amplitude-amplification speedups in mixing.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Thermal-light boson sampling via positive P-function Monte Carlo
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Represent thermal inputs to a Haar-random linear-optical interferometer by Gaussian-distributed coherent amplitudes. Sample output photon-number patterns via Poisson statistics and validate the pattern probabilities against exact permanents of positive semidefinite matrices for small modes.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Truncated Wigner approximation for collapse and revival in a Kerr oscillator
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Sample Gaussian Wigner initial conditions of a coherent state, evolve them under classical Kerr dynamics, and compute ⟨a(t)⟩ and quadrature variances. Compare with exact Fock-basis results to show where TWA captures collapse and squeezing but misses the quantum revival.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Thermodynamic uncertainty relation in a three-level maser from jump-counting trajectories
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Simulate quantum-jump trajectories of a three-level maser coupled to hot and cold baths and a coherent drive. Count net photon exchanges to estimate the current and its variance, then evaluate the TUR ratio against entropy production, checking it with full-counting-statistics tilted generators.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Locally biased classical shadows for estimating a Heisenberg-chain energy
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Estimate ⟨H⟩ of a six-qubit Heisenberg-chain state from random Pauli-basis snapshots drawn with non-uniform, site-dependent basis probabilities that minimize the Hamiltonian's shadow variance. Compare the empirical estimator variance with uniform shadows at a fixed shot budget.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Pauli-frame Monte Carlo pseudo-threshold of the concatenated Steane code
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Propagate randomly sampled depolarizing Pauli errors through level-1 and level-2 concatenated [[7,1,3]] codes with ideal syndrome lookup decoding at each level. Estimate the logical error rates and the pseudo-threshold where the two concatenation levels cross.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Variational Monte Carlo Rényi-2 entropy of a Jastrow spin state via the swap trick
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Use Metropolis sampling of two replicas of a Jastrow-correlated wavefunction for a Heisenberg chain. Estimate the swap-operator expectation to obtain the Rényi-2 entanglement entropy versus subsystem size, validated against exact amplitudes for small chains.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: OTOC growth in a Brownian spin cluster with white-noise couplings
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Evolve an all-to-all spin cluster under a Hamiltonian with independent white-noise two-body couplings using stochastic Schrödinger steps. Average out-of-time-order correlators over noise realizations and compare their growth with the noise-averaged Lindbladian prediction.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Markov simulation of leakage accumulation and leakage reduction in a repetition-code memory
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Model data and ancilla qubits of a distance-d repetition code as stochastic three-state (0, 1, leaked) processes with per-round leakage, seepage and leakage-induced syndrome randomization. Monte Carlo the logical failure rate with and without periodic leakage-reduction units.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Wiseman-Milburn homodyne feedback stabilization of a qubit via stochastic master equation
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Integrate the homodyne stochastic master equation for a fluorescent qubit with a feedback Hamiltonian proportional to the measured photocurrent. Compare the trajectory-averaged steady-state purity and Bloch vector with the analytic feedback-modified master equation as the gain varies.

physics/quantum_info|stochastic.title: Gillespie simulation of NV-center optical spin readout photon statistics
physics/quantum_info|stochastic.gist: Model the NV center's ground, excited and metastable singlet levels as a classical rate network and Gillespie-sample photon counts in a readout window for initial ms=0 and ms=±1. Compute the resulting count histograms, the optimal threshold, the readout fidelity and the spin-shot-noise-limited sensitivity.

math/nla_approx|pde.title: Generalized finite-difference Poisson solver on scattered nodes using MLS derivative weights
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Solve -Δu=f on the unit disk with Dirichlet data, using scattered quasi-uniform nodes. Laplacian weights come from moving-least-squares quadratic fits with Gaussian weights over k nearest neighbours. Compute the sparse system, its solution and the observed max-norm convergence order against a manufactured exact solution.
math/nla_approx|pde.area: Moving least squares and scattered data fitting

math/nla_approx|pde.title: Element-free Galerkin elastic bar with MLS shape functions and penalty boundary conditions
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Solve the 1D bar equation -(EA u')'=q using element-free Galerkin with MLS shape functions (linear basis, cubic-spline weight) and Gauss background-cell quadrature. Enforce the essential boundary condition by penalty. Report displacement and stress errors versus nodal spacing and support radius.
math/nla_approx|pde.area: Moving least squares and scattered data fitting

math/nla_approx|pde.title: Semi-Lagrangian solid-body rotation on scattered nodes: MLS versus Shepard interpolation
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Advect a Gaussian hill by solid-body rotation on randomly scattered 2D nodes, tracing departure points with RK4 and interpolating them by quadratic MLS or by inverse-distance Shepard. Measure L2 error, peak loss and total-mass drift after one revolution.
math/nla_approx|pde.area: Moving least squares and scattered data fitting

math/nla_approx|pde.title: Weighted least-squares versus Green-Gauss gradient reconstruction on perturbed finite-volume grids
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: On a randomly perturbed 2D quadrilateral grid, reconstruct cell gradients of a smooth field by weighted least-squares fits to neighbour centroids and by Green-Gauss. Use both in a cell-centred finite-volume diffusion solver and compare gradient error orders and solution accuracy.
math/nla_approx|pde.area: Moving least squares and scattered data fitting

math/nla_approx|pde.title: Stationary density of Scharfetter-Gummel Fokker-Planck generator via power iteration and GMRES
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Discretize 1D Smoluchowski dynamics in a double-well potential with the Scharfetter-Gummel finite-volume flux, giving a Markov generator Q. Compute the null vector of Q^T by power iteration on the uniformized chain and by GMRES on a rank-one bordered system. Compare with the Boltzmann density.
math/nla_approx|pde.area: Markov chain stationary distributions and PageRank

math/nla_approx|pde.title: Kushner Markov-chain approximation of 2D Ornstein-Uhlenbeck stationary Gaussian distribution
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Build Kushner's upwind finite-difference transition matrix for a 2D anisotropic OU diffusion on a truncated grid. Compute its stationary vector with a sparse singular solve. Compare the stationary mean and covariance against the exact Lyapunov-equation solution as the grid is refined.
math/nla_approx|pde.area: Markov chain stationary distributions and PageRank

math/nla_approx|pde.title: PageRank on a 2D lattice as a screened Poisson problem: damping sensitivity
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Interpret PageRank with teleportation on an N×N grid graph with reflecting edges as a discrete screened-Poisson equation. Solve (I-αP^T)x=(1-α)v with GMRES and power iteration. Compute dπ/dα by differentiating the linear system and relate the localization length to α.
math/nla_approx|pde.area: Markov chain stationary distributions and PageRank

math/nla_approx|pde.title: Field-of-values bound versus observed GMRES convergence for non-normal convection operators
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: For centred finite-difference 1D convection-diffusion matrices, compute the numerical range by rotating Hermitian-part eigenvalues. Evaluate the Elman/Crouzeix-type field-of-values GMRES bound and the eigenvalue-based bound. Compare both with actual GMRES residual histories as non-normality grows.

math/nla_approx|pde.title: Haar versus Daubechies-4 compression of a viscous Burgers shock profile
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Compute the viscous Burgers solution with a conservative finite-difference scheme until a steep front forms. Apply periodic Haar and D4 discrete wavelet transforms to the result. Report the number of coefficients needed to reach given L2 reconstruction errors, and how coefficient decay concentrates near the shock across levels.

math/nla_approx|pde.title: Daubechies wavelet-Galerkin solution of periodic 1D Poisson via connection coefficients
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Compute the Daubechies D6 scaling-function connection coefficients ∫φ''(x)φ(x-k)dx from the refinement-equation eigenproblem with moment normalization. Assemble the circulant wavelet-Galerkin stiffness matrix for -u''=f on a periodic interval and solve it by FFT. Verify the convergence order against an exact solution.

math/nla_approx|pde.title: Harten interpolating multiresolution adaptive grid for advecting a steep pulse
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Represent a 1D advected profile with a periodic square pulse using a Harten point-value multiresolution based on 4-point interpolatory prediction. Threshold the details to select an adaptive grid and advance it with an upwind finite-volume scheme. Report the active-point count and error versus the uniform fine-grid solution.

math/nla_approx|pde.title: Condition numbers of finite-difference Laplacians in diagonally scaled wavelet bases
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Transform the 1D and 2D Dirichlet Laplacian matrices into the hierarchical Haar and D4 bases (explicit DWT matrices) and apply level-dependent diagonal scaling. Compute the condition numbers versus N. Show near-uniform boundedness compared with the O(h⁻²) growth in the nodal basis.

math/nla_approx|pde.title: Kress product-quadrature Nyström method for the interior Helmholtz Dirichlet problem
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Solve the interior Dirichlet Helmholtz problem on an ellipse with a combined-field boundary integral equation. Split off the logarithmic kernel singularity and integrate it with Kress trigonometric product weights. Evaluate the interior solution against a plane-wave exact solution and show spectral convergence.

math/nla_approx|pde.title: Singular-integral quadrature discretization of the 1D fractional Laplacian Dirichlet problem
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Discretize the hypersingular integral definition of (-Δ)^s on (-1,1) with a Huang-Oberman-type quadrature that treats the singular near-field analytically. Solve (-Δ)^s u=1 with exterior zero data and compare with the exact solution c_s(1-x²)^s. Report the error order versus s.

math/nla_approx|pde.title: Filon quadrature for Born scattering amplitudes of a finite-difference screened-Poisson potential
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Obtain a radial potential V(r) by solving the screened Poisson equation for a smooth charge density with finite differences. Evaluate the Born amplitude f(q)∝∫V(r) r sin(qr)dr at large q with Filon-Simpson quadrature. Compare it with ordinary Simpson quadrature and the analytic Yukawa-type result.

math/nla_approx|pde.title: Bernstein-Bézier Galerkin FEM for 1D Poisson with p- and k-refinement
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Assemble a Galerkin finite element method in a C⁰ Bernstein polynomial basis for -u''=f, and raise the polynomial degree with Bézier degree elevation. Compare energy-norm errors and stiffness-matrix condition numbers under h-, p- and smooth k-refinement via a B-spline extraction operator.

math/nla_approx|pde.title: Bound-preserving discontinuous Galerkin advection in a Bernstein polynomial basis
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Implement a 1D DG method for linear advection using Bernstein (Bézier) local bases, upwind fluxes and SSP-RK3 time stepping. Enforce bounds with a limiter that clips Bernstein control coefficients using the convex-hull property. Report the error and the minimum and maximum values for a square-wave plus Gaussian test.

math/nla_approx|pde.title: Spectral instability of the Davies complex harmonic oscillator finite-difference discretization
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Discretize H=-d²/dx²+i x² on a truncated interval with finite differences. Compute eigenvalues and ε-pseudospectra, showing that the pseudospectral contours extend far from the spectrum along the rotated ray. Quantify eigenvalue condition numbers from left and right eigenvectors as the eigenvalue index increases.

math/nla_approx|pde.title: Pseudospectral abscissa and transient growth of the linearized Brusselator reaction-diffusion operator
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Linearize the 1D Brusselator about its homogeneous steady state and discretize with finite differences into a stable non-normal block Jacobian. Compute the ε-pseudospectral abscissa by grid search of σ_min. Compare its lower bound on sup||e^{tJ}|| with the computed matrix-exponential growth curve.

math/nla_approx|pde.title: Reverse Cuthill-McKee bandwidth and Cholesky fill for P1 FEM Laplacians on Delaunay meshes
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Generate a Delaunay triangulation of a disk with scipy and assemble the P1 stiffness matrix. Implement reverse Cuthill-McKee from a pseudo-peripheral node. Compare bandwidth, profile and Cholesky fill (nonzeros of the factor) with the natural and random orderings as the mesh is refined.

math/nla_approx|pde.title: Minimum-degree versus nested dissection fill on the 2D five-point Laplacian
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Implement symbolic Gaussian elimination via the elimination graph, a minimum-degree ordering, and a geometric nested-dissection ordering for k×k grid Laplacians. Count fill nonzeros and flops for each ordering. Verify the O(n log n) fill scaling of nested dissection.

math/nla_approx|pde.title: Elimination-tree column counts for 3D seven-point Laplacian Cholesky factors
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Compute the elimination tree and row/column counts of the Cholesky factor of the 3D seven-point Laplacian by symbolic factorization under natural and RCM orderings. Validate the predicted nnz(L) against a numerical sparse Cholesky. Report the factor-memory scaling with grid size.

math/nla_approx|pde.title: ILU(k) level-of-fill under natural versus RCM ordering for convection-diffusion GMRES
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Implement level-based ILU(k) symbolic and numeric factorization for an upwind 2D convection-diffusion matrix. Apply it under natural and RCM orderings and record fill per level and the resulting preconditioned GMRES iteration counts. Show how ordering interacts with flow direction.

math/nla_approx|pde.title: Red-black ordering and Young's optimal SOR parameter for the 2D Poisson equation
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Reorder the five-point Laplacian in red-black form and verify that the result is consistently ordered. Compute the Jacobi spectral radius and Young's optimal ω, then compare the measured SOR convergence factors for natural and red-black orderings across a range of ω.

math/nla_approx|pde.title: Conjugate gradient iteration counts versus Chebyshev bound for 2D Poisson
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Implement CG for the five-point Dirichlet Laplacian and compute the exact condition number from the analytic eigenvalues. Compare the observed A-norm error decay with the bound 2((√κ-1)/(√κ+1))^k. Confirm iteration counts scale as O(h⁻¹).

math/nla_approx|pde.title: CG superlinear convergence and deflation for high-contrast inclusion diffusion
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Discretize -∇·(a∇u)=f with a few high-conductivity inclusions, which produce isolated small eigenvalues. Show CG's delayed superlinear convergence and compare it with an outlier-adjusted Chebyshev bound. Implement deflated CG using approximate eigenvectors that are piecewise constant on the inclusions.

math/nla_approx|pde.title: Lanczos approximation of exp(tA)v for 2D heat equation with a posteriori estimates
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Approximate exp(tA)v for the five-point Laplacian with Lanczos and an exponential of the small tridiagonal matrix. Implement the Saad a posteriori error estimate based on the last Krylov coefficient. Compare true and estimated errors versus Krylov dimension and t against scipy expm_multiply.

math/nla_approx|pde.title: Exponential Rosenbrock-Euler for Fisher-KPP via augmented-Arnoldi φ₁ evaluation
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Integrate the 1D Fisher-KPP equation using the exponential Rosenbrock-Euler method. Evaluate φ₁(hJ)F through an augmented-matrix exponential computed in the Arnoldi basis. Measure the travelling-front speed against 2√(Dr) and verify second-order temporal convergence.

math/nla_approx|pde.title: Short-iterative Lanczos propagation of a finite-difference quantum harmonic oscillator wavepacket
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Propagate a displaced Gaussian under H=-½∂²+½x² discretized with fourth-order finite differences. Apply exp(-iHΔt) with the short-iterative Lanczos method and an adaptive step-size error control. Check norm conservation and the coherent-state centre trajectory x(t)=x₀cos t.

math/nla_approx|pde.title: Smoothed aggregation AMG with rigid-body near-nullspace for 2D plane-strain elasticity
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Assemble a P1 or Q1 plane-strain elasticity stiffness matrix on a cantilever plate. Build smoothed-aggregation AMG with a strength-of-connection graph, greedy aggregates and a damped-Jacobi prolongator smoother. Compare V-cycle convergence factors when the tentative prolongator spans only constants versus all three rigid-body modes.

math/nla_approx|pde.title: Notay pairwise aggregation AMG preconditioning GMRES for upwind convection-diffusion
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Discretize 2D convection-diffusion with first-order upwind finite differences on a recirculating wind. Build unsmoothed pairwise-aggregation multigrid with a nonsymmetric strength measure and Gauss-Seidel smoothing. Report GMRES iteration counts and grid/operator complexities versus Péclet number and mesh size.

math/nla_approx|pde.title: Kahan-compensated explicit finite-volume diffusion: float32 total-heat drift over long runs
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Run an explicit conservative finite-volume heat equation with insulated boundaries for 10^5-10^6 steps in float32. Accumulate cell updates naively, with Kahan compensation and with pairwise flux summation. Measure drift of total heat against the float64 reference and against a priori rounding bounds.
math/nla_approx|pde.area: Floating-point error analysis and compensated summation

math/nla_approx|pde.title: Truncation-roundoff error plateau of finite-difference Poisson in single and double precision
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Solve the 2D five-point Poisson problem with a manufactured solution by direct sparse solves in float32 and float64 over a sequence of grids. Locate the grid size where O(h^2) truncation error meets the roundoff error growing like eps·h^-2. Compare the observed optimal h with the model prediction.
math/nla_approx|pde.area: Floating-point error analysis and compensated summation

math/nla_approx|pde.title: Total least squares identification of reaction-diffusion coefficients from noisy snapshots
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Generate noisy snapshots of a 1D linear reaction-diffusion equation with a Crank-Nicolson solver. Form finite-difference estimates of u_t, u_xx and u, all of which are noisy. Recover D and the reaction rate by ordinary least squares and by SVD-based total least squares, and compare bias versus noise level.
math/nla_approx|pde.area: Total least squares and constrained fitting

math/nla_approx|pde.title: Mean-preserving constrained least-squares k-exact reconstruction for finite-volume advection
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Reconstruct quadratic polynomials in each cell of a 1D nonuniform finite-volume grid from neighbor cell averages. Impose exact conservation of the cell's own mean through the null-space method for equality-constrained least squares. Use the reconstruction in a linear advection scheme and measure order of accuracy and mass conservation.
math/nla_approx|pde.area: Total least squares and constrained fitting

math/nla_approx|pde.title: Fraction of accurate eigenvalues of Chebyshev collocation second-derivative matrices
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Build the Dirichlet Chebyshev collocation matrix for u'' on [-1,1] for increasing N. Compute its eigenvalues with a shifted Hessenberg QR implementation, counting iterations and deflations. Compare with the exact -(kπ/2)^2 values to verify the Weideman-Trefethen 2/π fraction of accurate modes and the O(N^4) outliers.
math/nla_approx|pde.area: QR algorithm with shifts and deflation

math/nla_approx|pde.title: Daubechies wavelet sparsity of heat-equation solutions from discontinuous initial data
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Evolve a 1D periodic heat equation from a piecewise-smooth initial profile with a spectral or Crank-Nicolson solver. At each output time, apply Haar and Daubechies-4 DWTs. Track how many coefficients are needed to reach a fixed L2 compression error as diffusion smooths the jumps.

math/nla_approx|pde.title: HODLR compression of the 2D heat semigroup matrix exp(tΔ_h) versus time
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Form the finite-difference heat propagator on a 1D-ordered or 2D grid via expm or eigendecomposition. Compress it with ACA into HODLR form at fixed tolerance. Measure off-diagonal ranks, storage and matvec cost as functions of t and grid size, and verify the propagated-solution error.

math/nla_approx|pde.title: Woodbury low-rank update of a prefactored Cholesky for implicit heat with local conductivity change
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Prefactor the backward-Euler matrix for 2D heat conduction. Represent a conductivity change in a small inclusion as a low-rank symmetric correction. Solve subsequent steps through the Sherman-Morrison-Woodbury formula, then compare accuracy and cost with refactorization as the inclusion size and the rank grow.
math/nla_approx|pde.area: Cholesky and LDL^T for symmetric systems

math/nla_approx|pde.title: Clenshaw-Curtis weights for the nonlocal term in Chebyshev-collocation nonlocal Fisher-KPP
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Solve u_t = D u_xx + u(1 - ∫K(x-y)u(y)dy) on a bounded interval with Chebyshev collocation and an IMEX time stepper. Evaluate the convolution with Clenshaw-Curtis weights computed via DCT. Study spatial convergence and how the steady-state pattern wavenumber depends on the kernel width.

math/nla_approx|pde.title: GMRES iteration counts for implicit-Euler upwind advection steps versus CFL number
math/nla_approx|pde.gist: Form the nonsymmetric, non-normal backward-Euler matrices of 1D and 2D upwind advection with inflow boundaries. Solve them with a hand-written Givens-based GMRES(m). Relate iteration counts at increasing CFL numbers to the matrix's departure from normality and to a Jordan-block-like analysis of the 1D case.

physics/quantum_mech|waves.title: Compton profiles of noble-gas atoms from Hartree-Fock-Slater orbitals
physics/quantum_mech|waves.gist: Solve self-consistent Xα (Slater exchange) radial equations for Ne, Ar and Kr. Transform the orbitals to momentum space with spherical Bessel (Hankel) transforms, then compute the isotropic Compton profile J(q) and check the normalization and <p²> virial relations.
physics/quantum_mech|waves.area: Hartree-Fock-Slater and shell structure of atoms

physics/quantum_mech|waves.title: X-ray atomic form factors from self-consistent Xα densities
physics/quantum_mech|waves.gist: Compute Hartree-Fock-Slater ground-state densities for Z=1-36. Obtain f(q) by spherical Bessel transform of the radial density, then compare the large-q behavior and shell oscillations across the periodic table.
physics/quantum_mech|waves.area: Hartree-Fock-Slater and shell structure of atoms

physics/quantum_mech|waves.title: Multipole Hartree potential for open-p-shell atoms beyond the spherical approximation
physics/quantum_mech|waves.gist: For B, C and O in a fixed m-configuration, build the non-spherical density and expand it in Legendre multipoles up to l=2 using Gaunt coefficients. Solve the radial Poisson equations by Green's-function integrals, then compute the quadrupole moment and first-order orbital-energy splittings.
physics/quantum_mech|waves.area: Hartree-Fock-Slater and shell structure of atoms

physics/quantum_mech|waves.title: Shell filling of 1D soft-Coulomb model atoms with FFT Hartree-Slater SCF
physics/quantum_mech|waves.gist: Run self-consistent Kohn-Sham-Slater calculations for 1D soft-Coulomb atoms with N=1-10 electrons on a periodic grid. Use the FFT kinetic operator and an FFT convolution for the Hartree term, then compute ionization energies and shell-closure trends.
physics/quantum_mech|waves.area: Hartree-Fock-Slater and shell structure of atoms

physics/quantum_mech|waves.title: Wave-packet time delay from split-operator propagation versus phase derivative
physics/quantum_mech|waves.gist: Propagate a Gaussian packet through a 1D resonant well-barrier potential with the FFT split-operator method. Measure the arrival-time shift of the transmitted packet and compare it with the energy-averaged Wigner time delay computed from transfer matrices.

physics/quantum_mech|waves.title: Quasi-bound state widths from Fourier transform of autocorrelation function
physics/quantum_mech|waves.gist: Prepare a state inside a cubic metastable well and propagate it with split-operator FFT, using a complex absorbing potential at the edges. Fourier-transform the windowed autocorrelation function and fit the Lorentzian peaks to extract resonance energies and widths, then compare with the exponential survival-probability decay.

physics/quantum_mech|waves.title: Siegert resonance poles of a rectangular barrier via complex-energy transfer matrices
physics/quantum_mech|waves.gist: Analytically continue the transfer-matrix transmission amplitude of a symmetric well between barriers to complex energy. Root-find the outgoing-wave (Siegert) poles, then check that Re E and −2 Im E agree with the Breit-Wigner fits to the real-energy time delay.

physics/quantum_mech|waves.title: Wigner-Smith time-delay matrix for an asymmetric 1D scatterer
physics/quantum_mech|waves.gist: Build the 2×2 S-matrix of an asymmetric multi-step potential from transfer matrices and form Q = −iħ S† dS/dE by finite differences. Compute the proper delay times and verify that Tr Q equals the derivative of the total scattering phase.

physics/quantum_mech|waves.title: Kemble WKB transmission through an Eckart barrier versus exact transfer matrices
physics/quantum_mech|waves.gist: Compute the WKB barrier integral by quadrature, with turning points from root finding, and apply the Kemble formula. Compare it with the exact Eckart hypergeometric transmission and a fine-slab transfer-matrix result across sub- and above-barrier energies.

physics/quantum_mech|waves.title: Stark-tilted barrier transmission with Airy-function transfer matrices and Fowler-Nordheim WKB
physics/quantum_mech|waves.gist: Build exact transfer matrices from Ai/Bi solutions for a rectangular barrier under a uniform field. Compute the field-emission current density and compare it with the WKB Fowler-Nordheim triangular-barrier approximation.

physics/quantum_mech|waves.title: SUSY hierarchy of the Pöschl-Teller well on a Fourier grid
physics/quantum_mech|waves.gist: Construct the superpotential of the sech² well from its ground state and generate the partner hierarchy. Diagonalize each partner with a Fourier-grid Hamiltonian, then verify isospectrality and shape invariance with the predicted parameter shift.
physics/quantum_mech|waves.area: Supersymmetric quantum mechanics and partner potentials

physics/quantum_mech|waves.title: Reflectionless sech² potentials as SUSY partners of the free particle
physics/quantum_mech|waves.gist: Generate multi-soliton reflectionless potentials by iterated Darboux transformations. Compute their transmission with fine transfer matrices to verify |T|=1 and the predicted transmission phase, and contrast them with a non-integer-strength sech² well.
physics/quantum_mech|waves.area: Supersymmetric quantum mechanics and partner potentials

physics/quantum_mech|waves.title: Abraham-Moses isospectral deformations of the harmonic oscillator
physics/quantum_mech|waves.gist: Build the one-parameter isospectral family of the oscillator from the SUSY double-Darboux construction. Confirm equal spectra by Fourier-grid diagonalization, and compare coherent-like wave-packet dynamics and revivals between the family members.
physics/quantum_mech|waves.area: Supersymmetric quantum mechanics and partner potentials

physics/quantum_mech|waves.title: Thermal density matrix of a double well by FFT matrix squaring
physics/quantum_mech|waves.gist: Build the high-temperature density matrix with the Trotter factorization, using FFT kinetic propagators on a grid, and repeatedly square it down to low temperature. Compute the partition function, the diagonal density and the energy, and benchmark against eigenvalue sums.
physics/quantum_mech|waves.area: Path-integral Monte Carlo at finite temperature

physics/quantum_mech|waves.title: Fermion doubling and spurious states in a Fourier-grid 1D Dirac Hamiltonian
physics/quantum_mech|waves.gist: Discretize the 1D Dirac equation with a soft-Coulomb potential using finite differences and Fourier pseudospectral derivatives. Identify spurious doubled states by their momentum content, and compare bound energies with the Klein-Gordon and Schrödinger results.

physics/quantum_mech|waves.title: Klein tunneling through a 1D electrostatic barrier: Dirac versus Klein-Gordon
physics/quantum_mech|waves.gist: Build spinor transfer matrices for Dirac scattering on a rectangular barrier and scalar transfer matrices for Klein-Gordon scattering. Compute transmission versus barrier height through the Klein regime V > E + mc² and check flux conservation.

physics/quantum_mech|waves.title: Dirac-Coulomb radial wavefunctions from confluent hypergeometric functions
physics/quantum_mech|waves.gist: Construct hydrogenic large and small radial components with scipy.special.hyp1f1 for given n and κ. Verify normalization, compute fine-structure energies and <r^k> expectation values, and compare with Schrödinger and Klein-Gordon energies across Z.

physics/quantum_mech|waves.title: Dirac partial-wave phase shifts and Sherman function for a spherical square well
physics/quantum_mech|waves.gist: Match interior Dirac spinor solutions to free Riccati-Bessel spinors for each κ to obtain the spin-up and spin-down phase shifts. Sum the partial-wave amplitudes f and g, then compute the differential cross section and the Mott spin asymmetry.

physics/quantum_mech|waves.title: Zitterbewegung of a free 1D Dirac wave packet via FFT propagation
physics/quantum_mech|waves.gist: Propagate a Gaussian spinor packet exactly in momentum space by diagonalizing the 2×2 Dirac Hamiltonian at each k. Extract the position expectation value, then measure the trembling frequency and its decay and compare with the analytic 2mc²/ħ prediction.

physics/quantum_mech|waves.title: Wigner function of squeezed oscillator states via FFT on a phase-space grid
physics/quantum_mech|waves.gist: Evolve a squeezed Gaussian in the harmonic oscillator with a split-operator FFT scheme. Compute the Wigner function by FFT of ψ(x+y/2)ψ*(x−y/2), and track the rotating squeezing ellipse and the uncertainty product ΔxΔp over time.
physics/quantum_mech|waves.area: Coherent and squeezed states of oscillators

physics/quantum_mech|waves.title: Parametric squeezing from the Mathieu monodromy (ABCD) matrix
physics/quantum_mech|waves.gist: Integrate the classical equation for a frequency-modulated oscillator over one period to obtain its 2×2 symplectic monodromy matrix. Use it to propagate a Gaussian state's covariance, and compute the squeezing gain inside and outside the parametric instability tongue.
physics/quantum_mech|waves.area: Coherent and squeezed states of oscillators

physics/quantum_mech|waves.title: Periodic Fourier DVR for the methyl torsional rotor
physics/quantum_mech|waves.gist: Set up an exponential DVR on φ ∈ [0, 2π) for H = −B d²/dφ² + (V3/2)(1−cos 3φ). Compute torsional levels and A/E tunneling splittings versus barrier height, and check against Mathieu characteristic values.

physics/quantum_mech|waves.title: Bessel-zero DVR for a hydrogen atom confined in a spherical cavity
physics/quantum_mech|waves.gist: Build a radial DVR from spherical Bessel functions vanishing at the cavity wall (zeros of j_l). Compute 1s, 2s and 2p energies versus cavity radius, and find the radius at which the ground-state energy crosses zero.

physics/quantum_mech|waves.title: Effective-range expansion of the square well from Riccati-Bessel phase shifts
physics/quantum_mech|waves.gist: Compute s- and p-wave phase shifts of a square well analytically. Fit k^{2l+1} cot δ_l to extract the scattering length (volume), the effective range and the shape parameter, and compare with closed-form expressions near the zero-energy resonance.
physics/quantum_mech|waves.area: Low-energy scattering length and effective range

physics/quantum_mech|waves.title: van der Waals scattering length: numerical versus Gribakin-Flambaum formula
physics/quantum_mech|waves.gist: Compute the s-wave scattering length for a Lennard-Jones-like 6-12 potential by zero-energy integration. Compare with the Gribakin-Flambaum semiclassical formula, built from the WKB phase integral and the Gamma-function mean scattering length, as the well depth is varied.
physics/quantum_mech|waves.area: Low-energy scattering length and effective range

physics/quantum_mech|waves.title: Confinement-induced resonance of 1D scattering in a harmonic waveguide
physics/quantum_mech|waves.gist: Evaluate the Olshanii 1D coupling constant g_1D(a_3D, a_⊥) using the Hurwitz zeta function. Locate the confinement-induced resonance, and verify the zeta-function constant by summing the transverse-mode Green's function numerically.
physics/quantum_mech|waves.area: Low-energy scattering length and effective range

physics/quantum_mech|waves.title: Levinson's theorem in 1D for Gaussian wells via transfer matrices
physics/quantum_mech|waves.gist: Compute even- and odd-parity phase shifts of a Gaussian well from fine-slab transfer matrices. Unwrap them continuously from k=0 to large k, and verify the 1D Levinson relation including the half-bound-state correction at threshold.
physics/quantum_mech|waves.area: Low-energy scattering length and effective range

physics/quantum_mech|waves.title: Quasi-exactly solvable sextic oscillator: algebraic levels versus Fourier-grid numerics
physics/quantum_mech|waves.gist: Build the finite tridiagonal matrix that yields the algebraic eigenvalues of the QES potential x⁶ − (4J+3)x² (with suitable coefficients). Compare them with full Fourier-grid diagonalization, and identify which numerical levels belong to the algebraic sector.

physics/quantum_mech|waves.title: Mode-dependent tunneling splittings of a 2D coupled double well by split-operator autocorrelation
physics/quantum_mech|waves.gist: For V = (x²−1)² + ½ω²(y + c x²)², propagate localized Gaussian packets with the split-operator FFT method. Extract the ground and transverse-excited doublet splittings from FFT peaks of the autocorrelation function, and check them against Fourier-grid diagonalization while varying the coupling c.

physics/quantum_mech|waves.title: Shaped-pulse excitation profiles: small-tip Fourier approximation versus exact Bloch rotation
physics/quantum_mech|waves.gist: For Gaussian and windowed-sinc RF pulses, compare the transverse magnetization versus offset frequency predicted by the Fourier transform of the pulse envelope with exact piecewise SU(2) Bloch-sphere propagation. Quantify how the agreement breaks down as the flip angle increases toward 90° and 180°.

physics/quantum_mech|waves.title: Periodic-image error in supercell FFT Hartree energies of an ionized atom
physics/quantum_mech|waves.gist: Solve Poisson's equation by 3D FFT for a charged atomic-like (Gaussian or Slater) density in cubic boxes with a neutralizing background. Fit the 1/L Madelung and 1/L³ quadrupole Makov–Payne terms, and extrapolate to the isolated-ion Hartree energy, which is known analytically.

physics/quantum_mech|waves.title: Reflection from complex absorbing potentials: polynomial versus Manolopoulos transmission-free forms
physics/quantum_mech|waves.gist: Compute the energy-dependent reflection and transmission of monomial and Manolopoulos-type CAPs by integrating the complex-potential Schrödinger equation. Validate the results with split-operator wavepackets whose residual norm is measured, and find the CAP strength and length that minimize reflection over a target energy band.
physics/quantum_mech|waves.area: Complex absorbing potentials and absorbing boundaries

physics/quantum_mech|waves.title: Matter-wave Talbot self-imaging and fractional Talbot images behind a grating
physics/quantum_mech|waves.gist: Propagate a wave transmitted by a periodic slit grating using the Fresnel free-particle kernel, implemented by FFT. Locate the full and fractional Talbot planes, compute the fringe visibility as a function of the grating opening fraction, and compare with Gauss-sum predictions.

physics/many_body|quantum_ops.title: Coupled anharmonic oscillators: DMC energy and Fock-space entanglement entropy
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.gist: For two quartic oscillators with bilinear coupling g x1 x2, obtain the ground-state energy from DMC and from exact diagonalization of the Kronecker-product Fock Hamiltonian. Partially trace one oscillator to get the von Neumann and Rényi-2 entropies as functions of g.
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.area: Diffusion Monte Carlo for anharmonic oscillators

physics/many_body|quantum_ops.title: Pöschl–Teller well: DMC versus split-operator imaginary-time projection fidelity
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.gist: Compare branching DMC for the Pöschl–Teller potential with grid-based split-operator imaginary-time propagation of the state vector. Track the fidelity with the analytic ground state versus projection time and timestep, and extrapolate both energies to zero timestep.
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.area: Diffusion Monte Carlo for anharmonic oscillators

physics/many_body|quantum_ops.title: Hydrogen atom DMC: trial-state overlap and mixed-estimator bias of r²
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.gist: Run importance-sampled DMC for hydrogen with a deliberately wrong-exponent Slater trial function. Compute the analytic trial–exact fidelity, the mixed and extrapolated (2·mixed − variational) estimators of ⟨r²⟩, and show how the bias scales with the infidelity.

physics/many_body|quantum_ops.title: Green's-function Monte Carlo for the transverse-field Ising chain with ED guiding state
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.gist: Build the TFIM Hamiltonian from tensor products of Pauli matrices for N ≤ 10. Run discrete-basis Green's-function Monte Carlo with a guiding wavefunction of tunable fidelity to the exact ground state. Report the mixed-estimator energy and population-control bias versus the guiding-state fidelity.

physics/many_body|quantum_ops.title: Fixed-node DMC for two polarized fermions in a 2D trap
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.gist: Run importance-sampled fixed-node DMC for two spin-polarized fermions with Gaussian repulsion in a 2D harmonic trap, using a Slater-Jastrow trial function. Compare the energy with exact diagonalization in an antisymmetrized two-particle basis, and compute the trial–exact overlap that controls the node quality.

physics/many_body|quantum_ops.title: Truncation error versus bond dimension for critical and gapped TFIM ground states
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.gist: Convert exact TFIM ground states (N ≤ 16) to MPS by sequential SVD with bond-dimension truncation. Measure the discarded weight, the fidelity loss and the energy error versus χ at criticality and off criticality, and contrast the results with Haar-random states.
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.area: Matrix product states and canonical forms

physics/many_body|quantum_ops.title: Canonical MPS for GHZ, W and cluster states: correlators by transfer contraction
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.gist: Write exact MPS tensors for GHZ, W and 1D cluster states and bring them into mixed canonical form. Evaluate two-point and stabilizer correlators by transfer-matrix contraction, check them against dense tensor-product calculations, and report the Schmidt ranks across every cut.
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.area: Matrix product states and canonical forms

physics/many_body|quantum_ops.title: Measurement-based gate teleportation on a cluster-state MPS
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.gist: Represent a 1D cluster state as an MPS and perform sequential single-qubit projective measurements in rotated bases with outcome-dependent byproduct corrections. Verify that an arbitrary single-qubit rotation is implemented by computing the output-state fidelity and the outcome probabilities.
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.area: Matrix product states and canonical forms

physics/many_body|quantum_ops.title: Deuteron VMC with Minnesota potential and spin-isospin projectors
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.gist: Build the two-nucleon spin-isospin space as tensor products and construct the projectors P_σ, P_τ and the exchange operators. Evaluate the Minnesota central potential on the spin-isospin states, run Metropolis VMC for a Jastrow radial function, and minimize the deuteron binding energy.

physics/many_body|quantum_ops.title: Triton VMC with Malfliet–Tjon potential in the 64-dimensional spin-isospin space
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.gist: Represent three-nucleon spin-isospin states as 2^6 vectors with permutation-based exchange operators. Construct an antisymmetric spin-isospin component times a symmetric Jastrow factor, then compute the triton energy expectation by Metropolis VMC with a local-energy estimator.

physics/many_body|quantum_ops.title: Alpha particle VMC with spin-isospin operator correlations
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.gist: For ⁴He, act with pair correlation operators (1 + u_σ σi·σj + u_τ τi·τj) on 256-dimensional spin-isospin vectors built from Kronecker products. Sample positions by Metropolis and compute the energy with the Minnesota potential, comparing it with a purely central Jastrow wavefunction.

physics/many_body|quantum_ops.title: Richardson pairing model: exact versus number-projected BCS fidelity
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.gist: Diagonalize the reduced-BCS pairing Hamiltonian for equally spaced doubly degenerate levels in the pair (hard-core boson) basis. Compute the overlap of the exact ground state with the BCS and number-projected BCS states, plus the single-level pair entanglement entropy, versus the coupling G.

physics/many_body|quantum_ops.title: Excitation gap from reptation imaginary-time correlation functions
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.gist: Use reptation QMC to estimate ⟨x(0)x(τ)⟩ for a double-well anharmonic oscillator and fit its exponential decay to extract E1 − E0. Compare the gap and the dipole matrix element |⟨0|x|1⟩|² with exact diagonalization.

physics/many_body|quantum_ops.title: Reptation QMC covariance matrix and Gaussian entanglement of coupled oscillators
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.gist: Obtain pure RQMC estimators of ⟨x1²⟩, ⟨x1x2⟩ and the momentum second moments (via virial/imaginary-time differences) for two coupled harmonic oscillators. Build the reduced covariance matrix, compute its symplectic eigenvalue and the resulting entanglement entropy, and compare with the exact result.

physics/many_body|quantum_ops.title: Ma–Dasgupta entanglement scaling in the random XX chain
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.gist: Decimate random-coupling XX chains with the SDRG rule J' = J_L J_R / Ω, counting ln2 per singlet crossing a block boundary. Fit the effective central charge c_eff = ln 2 and compare with exact free-fermion correlation-matrix entropies on the same disorder samples.

physics/many_body|quantum_ops.title: SDRG singlet product state versus exact ground state of random Heisenberg chains
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.gist: For short random-bond Heisenberg chains, build the SDRG valence-bond product state as a tensor product of singlets. Compute its fidelity with the ED ground state and the concurrence of decimated pairs from two-site reduced density matrices, as functions of disorder strength.

physics/many_body|quantum_ops.title: RSRG-X excited eigenstates of the random XXZ chain
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.gist: Apply the excited-state SDRG, choosing singlet or triplet branches at each decimation, to construct approximate highly excited eigenstates. Compare their energies and area-law entanglement with exact eigenstates of small chains obtained by full diagonalization.

physics/many_body|quantum_ops.title: Singlet length distribution and average correlations in the random-singlet phase
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.gist: Run Ma–Dasgupta decimation on long random Heisenberg chains to histogram the singlet bond lengths, P(l) ~ l^-2. Derive the disorder-averaged spin correlation C(r) ~ r^-2 from singlet statistics and check it against ED on small chains.

physics/many_body|quantum_ops.title: Bosonic Josephson junction: two-site Bose–Hubbard entanglement and number squeezing
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.gist: Diagonalize the two-site Bose–Hubbard model for N bosons in the Fock basis. Compute the inter-site entanglement entropy, the number-squeezing parameter and the coherence ⟨b1†b2⟩ versus U/J, and identify the Rabi, Josephson and Fock regimes.

physics/many_body|quantum_ops.title: Collapse and revival of matter-wave coherence after a lattice quench
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.gist: Evolve a coherent (or Gutzwiller superfluid) on-site state under H = U n(n−1)/2 after a sudden quench to the deep lattice. Compute ⟨b⟩(t), the revival time h/U, and the purity and fidelity of the single-site state, including the effect of a finite tunneling J via two-site ED.

physics/many_body|quantum_ops.title: Fidelity susceptibility locating the superfluid–Mott transition in 1D
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.gist: Compute ground-state overlaps |⟨ψ(J)|ψ(J+δJ)⟩| for unit-filling Bose–Hubbard chains from truncated-Fock ED. Extract the fidelity susceptibility per site and its peak, and analyze the drift of the peak with L toward the BKT critical point.

physics/many_body|quantum_ops.title: Two-body atom loss in a Bose–Hubbard double well via Kraus channel
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.gist: Model on-site two-body loss with Kraus operators ∝ b_i² applied together with coherent two-site Bose–Hubbard evolution over each timestep, acting on the full density matrix across particle-number sectors. Compute the decay of atom number, purity and inter-well coherence, and the effective quantum-Zeno suppression at strong loss.

physics/many_body|quantum_ops.title: Quantum-gas-microscope parity measurements on Bose–Hubbard ground states
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.gist: Apply projective on-site parity measurements (n mod 2), as a quantum gas microscope does, to ED ground states of Bose–Hubbard chains. Compute outcome distributions, parity–parity correlations and the nonlocal string parity order across the superfluid–Mott crossover.

physics/many_body|quantum_ops.title: Single-site entropy and two-site mutual information in a half-filled Hubbard ring
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.gist: Exactly diagonalize a 6-site Hubbard ring in the fixed-N, Sz=0 occupation basis using Jordan-Wigner sign conventions. Build the fermionic one- and two-site reduced density matrices with sign-correct partial traces, then compute the single-orbital entropies and the pairwise mutual information as functions of U/t.
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.area: Hubbard model exact diagonalization on clusters

physics/many_body|quantum_ops.title: Exchange-pulse SWAP gate fidelity in a Hund-Mulliken double quantum dot
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.gist: Diagonalize a two-electron double-dot Hamiltonian in a Hund-Mulliken singlet/triplet basis with Coulomb, tunneling and detuning terms to obtain the exchange J(ε). Then simulate a timed exchange pulse in the 4-dim spin space and compute the average SWAP gate fidelity and the two-spin concurrence versus detuning and charge-noise amplitude.

physics/many_body|quantum_ops.title: Central charge along the Ashkin-Teller critical line from CTM entanglement entropy
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.gist: Run Baxter/Nishino CTMRG for the square-lattice Ashkin-Teller model with 4-state local tensors. Form the reduced density matrix ρ ∝ C^4 from the corner matrices and extract the von Neumann entropy and correlation length at several bond dimensions. Fit S = (c/6) ln ξ to obtain c ≈ 1 at several points on the critical line.

physics/many_body|quantum_ops.title: Bond concurrence and dimer-state fidelity in the frustrated sawtooth (delta) chain
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.gist: Exactly diagonalize a periodic sawtooth Heisenberg chain of 12-16 spins versus the basal/apical coupling ratio. Compute the two-spin reduced density matrices and their Wootters concurrence on every bond type, and the fidelity of the ground state with the exact dimer product state at the Majumdar-Ghosh-like point.

physics/many_body|quantum_ops.title: Out-of-time-order correlator logarithmic light cone in the random-field XXZ chain
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.gist: Use full diagonalization of 10-12 site disordered XXZ chains to compute the infinite-temperature OTOC F(x,t) = Tr[σz_0(t) σz_x σz_0(t) σz_x]/2^L, averaged over disorder.
