Extract the butterfly front, showing a ballistic front in the ergodic regime and a logarithmic light cone in the MBL regime.

physics/many_body|quantum_ops.title: Dephasing-induced decay of localization: Kraus-map dynamics of a disordered XXZ chain
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.gist: Evolve the density matrix of an 8-site random-field XXZ chain under unitary steps alternated with local dephasing Kraus channels. Compute the disorder-averaged Néel imbalance and the purity, and fit the stretched-exponential decay exponent as a function of dephasing rate and disorder strength.

physics/many_body|quantum_ops.title: Fidelity susceptibility of the Haldane to large-D transition in spin-1 chains
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.gist: Use sparse Lanczos ED of periodic spin-1 Heisenberg chains with single-ion anisotropy D (L = 6-12). Compute the ground-state overlap fidelity F(D, D+δD) and the fidelity susceptibility, and locate D_c from finite-size peak positions and scaling.
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.area: Hubbard model exact diagonalization on clusters

physics/many_body|quantum_ops.title: Quantum Fisher information of staggered magnetization in a finite-temperature Heisenberg chain
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.gist: Fully diagonalize a 12-site Heisenberg ring and compute the thermal quantum Fisher information for the staggered magnetization with the spectral (Braunstein-Caves) formula. Compare it with the variance bound and report the temperature below which F_Q/N certifies multipartite entanglement depth.

physics/many_body|quantum_ops.title: Bisognano-Wichmann entanglement Hamiltonian test for the XXZ chain ground state
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.gist: Obtain the reduced density matrix of a half block of an open XXZ chain ground state from ED by partial trace. Fit a Bisognano-Wichmann ansatz with linearly position-weighted local energy densities, and compute the fidelity and entanglement-spectrum agreement between exp(-H_BW)/Z and the exact ρ_A versus Δ.
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.area: Hubbard model exact diagonalization on clusters

physics/many_body|quantum_ops.title: Classical-shadow estimation of energy and correlations for an XXZ ring ground state
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.gist: Prepare the exact ground state of an 8-qubit XXZ ring and simulate random single-qubit Pauli-basis measurements with Born-rule sampling. Build classical-shadow snapshots and use median-of-means estimators to reconstruct the energy, two-point correlators and the fidelity with the ED state, and study the estimator variance versus number of snapshots.

physics/many_body|quantum_ops.title: Noisy Trotter circuit for a Jordan-Wigner Hubbard chain: fidelity under depolarizing gates
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.gist: Compile Trotterized time evolution of a 3-site Hubbard chain (6 qubits) into two-qubit gates using Jordan-Wigner strings and a fermionic-swap network. Apply depolarizing Kraus channels after every gate, then compute the state fidelity, doublon dynamics and the optimal Trotter step balancing Trotter error against noise.
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.area: Hubbard model exact diagonalization on clusters

physics/many_body|quantum_ops.title: Quantum imaginary-time evolution (QITE) for the 6-site Heisenberg chain ground state
physics/many_body|quantum_ops.gist: Implement Motta-style QITE: at each imaginary-time step, solve the linear system S a = b built from Pauli-string expectation values on local domains to find the unitary that mimics e^{-Δτ H}, and apply it to the statevector. Track energy and ground-state fidelity versus domain size and Δτ, compared with exact ED.

physics/fields_astro|waves.title: Asteroseismic mass and radius from a solar-like oscillator light curve
physics/fields_astro|waves.gist: Simulate a stochastically excited p-mode light curve with granulation noise. Compute its power spectrum by FFT, find nu_max from the smoothed power excess and the large separation from the power-spectrum autocorrelation, then apply scaling relations to get stellar mass and radius.

physics/fields_astro|waves.title: Helium second-ionization glitch from oscillatory p-mode frequency differences
physics/fields_astro|waves.gist: Generate asymptotic p-mode frequencies that carry a sinusoidal glitch term. Form second differences and recover the acoustic depth of the He II zone by Fourier analysis and nonlinear least-squares sinusoid fitting.

physics/fields_astro|waves.title: Red-giant mixed-mode period spacing via Fourier transform of stretched periods
physics/fields_astro|waves.gist: Build mixed dipole-mode frequencies from the asymptotic coupling relation and compute the stretched periods. Fourier-transform the stretched power spectrum to extract the asymptotic g-mode period spacing Delta Pi_1 and the coupling factor q.

physics/fields_astro|waves.title: Disk-integrated mode visibilities from spherical-harmonic surface patterns and limb darkening
physics/fields_astro|waves.gist: Integrate Y_lm patterns over the visible stellar disk with quadratic limb darkening, using Legendre-polynomial expansions and quadrature. The outputs are mode visibility ratios V_l and the relative heights of the rotationally split m-components as functions of inclination angle.

physics/fields_astro|waves.title: Cepheid light-curve Fourier parameters and period-luminosity relation
physics/fields_astro|waves.gist: Fit truncated Fourier series to phased Cepheid light curves to compute the amplitude ratio R21 and phase difference phi21, then separate fundamental-mode from first-overtone pulsators. Finally fit a Leavitt period-luminosity relation by weighted least squares.

physics/fields_astro|waves.title: Acoustic cutoff and wave transmission through a stratified stellar atmosphere
physics/fields_astro|waves.gist: Model a photosphere-chromosphere temperature profile as piecewise isothermal layers. Propagate vertical acoustic waves with 2x2 transfer matrices to compute the frequency-dependent transmission coefficient and the effective acoustic cutoff frequency.

physics/fields_astro|waves.title: Solar k-omega diagnostic diagram from 3D FFT of synthetic Dopplergrams
physics/fields_astro|waves.gist: Synthesize a Doppler-velocity data cube as a superposition of p-mode ridges from the dispersion relation, with added noise. Apply apodization, take a 3D FFT, azimuthally average in k, and locate the ridge frequencies to fit the ridge dispersion relation.

physics/fields_astro|waves.title: Undulator on-axis spectrum from FFT of time-domain Lienard-Wiechert fields
physics/fields_astro|waves.gist: Integrate the trajectory of a relativistic electron through a planar sinusoidal undulator and evaluate the retarded far-field Lienard-Wiechert field versus observer time. FFT the field to obtain harmonic photon energies and intensities, and compare them with the Bessel-function formula as a function of K.

physics/fields_astro|waves.title: Classical bremsstrahlung spectrum of a hyperbolic Coulomb encounter
physics/fields_astro|waves.gist: Integrate the Rutherford hyperbolic orbit and Fourier-transform the dipole acceleration numerically to get the radiated energy per unit frequency. Validate against the exact Hankel-function result, then average over impact parameter to estimate a classical Gaunt factor.

physics/fields_astro|waves.title: Relativistic iron-line profile from a Schwarzschild thin disk by ray tracing
physics/fields_astro|waves.gist: Backward-trace null geodesics from an observer image plane to a Keplerian disk extending from the ISCO outward. Compute the redshift g of each pixel and its emissivity weighting, then histogram the flux into a broadened, skewed Fe K-alpha line profile versus inclination.

physics/fields_astro|waves.title: Interferometric visibility of a black-hole photon ring via Hankel transform
physics/fields_astro|waves.gist: Build a thin-ring and thick-ring image model of radius near sqrt(27)M and compute its complex visibility by a numerical Hankel transform, yielding J_0-type nulls. Recover the ring diameter and width by fitting the positions of the visibility nulls.

physics/fields_astro|waves.title: Epsilon-mechanism frequency response of a linearized CNO burning network
physics/fields_astro|waves.gist: Linearize the CN-cycle abundance equations about equilibrium at a given temperature and density. Compute the complex transfer function of energy generation to sinusoidal temperature perturbations from the Jacobian, (i omega I - J)^-1, giving gain and phase lag versus pulsation period.

physics/fields_astro|waves.title: Gradient-coil design by cancelling higher zonal harmonics of coaxial loops
physics/fields_astro|waves.gist: Expand the on-axis field of a coaxial current loop in Legendre/zonal harmonics and reconstruct the off-axis field from the series. Optimize the loop positions and currents to null higher-order terms, as in Maxwell or anti-Helmholtz coils, then evaluate the gradient uniformity volume.

physics/fields_astro|waves.title: Spectral Biot-Savart: magnetic field of a periodic current distribution by FFT
physics/fields_astro|waves.gist: On a periodic 3D grid, project the current density onto its divergence-free part. Solve k^2 A = mu0 J in Fourier space and compute B = i k x A, then check the result against direct Biot-Savart summation for a toroidal winding and compute the magnetic energy.

physics/fields_astro|waves.title: Potential-field source-surface model of the solar coronal magnetic field
physics/fields_astro|waves.gist: Expand a photospheric radial-field magnetogram in spherical harmonics and apply the PFSS radial functions with a source surface at 2.5 R_sun. Compute the open magnetic flux and the coronal-hole area fraction, then trace field lines to locate the heliospheric current sheet.

physics/fields_astro|waves.title: Induced surface charge in a grounded box via discrete sine transform Poisson solver
physics/fields_astro|waves.gist: Solve Poisson's equation for an off-center point-like charge in a grounded rectangular box with a fast DST-I solver. Compute the induced charge density on each wall and check that the total induced charge equals minus the enclosed charge.

physics/fields_astro|waves.title: Isolated-boundary FFT Poisson solver for galactic disk gravitational potential
physics/fields_astro|waves.gist: Use Hockney's zero-padding method to convolve the surface density of an exponential disk with the free-space Green's function via FFT. Compare the resulting midplane rotation curve with the Freeman Bessel-function I0K0 - I1K1 formula.

physics/fields_astro|waves.title: Hellings-Downs overlap reduction function for pulsar timing arrays
physics/fields_astro|waves.gist: Compute the angular correlation of pulsar timing residuals induced by an isotropic stochastic gravitational-wave background. Integrate the TT-projected antenna responses over the sky numerically, compare with the closed-form Hellings-Downs curve, and give its Legendre-polynomial coefficients.

physics/fields_astro|waves.title: Harmonic gravitational-wave power of eccentric binaries via Peters-Mathews Bessel series
physics/fields_astro|waves.gist: Evaluate g(n,e) built from Bessel functions J_n to get the power radiated at each orbital harmonic. Check that summing over harmonics reproduces the Peters-Mathews enhancement function f(e), and find the peak harmonic as a function of eccentricity.

physics/fields_astro|waves.title: Spin-weighted spherical-harmonic mode decomposition of binary GW radiation
physics/fields_astro|waves.gist: Compute the TT quadrupole (and mass-octupole) strain of a circular binary on a sky grid. Project the strain onto spin-weight -2 harmonics by quadrature to extract the h_lm mode amplitudes, and verify the inclination dependence of the (2,2) and (2,1) modes.

physics/fields_astro|waves.title: Coherent dedispersion of pulsar signals through cold interstellar plasma
physics/fields_astro|waves.gist: Model ISM propagation as a quadratic-phase transfer function in the Fourier domain and disperse a simulated baseband pulse. Recover the dispersion measure by maximizing the dedispersed peak signal-to-noise over trial DMs.

physics/fields_astro|waves.title: Interstellar scintillation from a Kolmogorov thin phase screen
physics/fields_astro|waves.gist: Generate a 2D Kolmogorov phase screen by FFT filtering of white noise and propagate it to the observer with the Fresnel kernel via FFT. Compute the scintillation index and the diffractive decorrelation scale across weak and strong scattering regimes.

physics/fields_astro|waves.title: X-ray reverberation lag-frequency spectrum of a lamp-post illuminated disk
physics/fields_astro|waves.gist: Compute the impulse response of a thin disk to a flare from an on-axis point source, using light-travel delays with Newtonian geometry and optional Shapiro corrections. FFT the response to obtain the phase lag and time lag versus Fourier frequency, including the phase-wrapping features.

physics/fields_astro|waves.title: Hot-Jupiter optical phase curve: Fourier decomposition into reflection, ellipsoidal and beaming
physics/fields_astro|waves.gist: Synthesize an orbital phase curve containing Lambertian reflection, ellipsoidal variation and Doppler beaming terms. Fit a low-order Fourier series by linear least squares and map the harmonic coefficients to the planetary albedo and the mass ratio.

physics/fields_astro|waves.title: Limb-darkened transit light curves via Hankel-transform occultation convolution
physics/fields_astro|waves.gist: Express the occulted flux as an overlap of a limb-darkened stellar disk and a planetary disk, computed in Hankel space where the overlap is a product of J_1-weighted transforms. Validate the result against direct 2D quadrature and fit the planet radius and impact parameter.

physics/fields_astro|waves.title: Kepler's equation solved by Bessel-function Fourier series of the anomaly
physics/fields_astro|waves.gist: Expand the eccentric anomaly and the equation of the center in Fourier-Bessel series in the mean anomaly. Study the truncation error and convergence up to the Laplace limit e = 0.6627, and benchmark against Newton iteration for orbit ephemerides.

physics/fields_astro|waves.title: Gaussian-beam propagation through a Cassegrain radio telescope with ABCD matrices
physics/fields_astro|waves.gist: Represent the feed horn beam as a complex beam parameter q and propagate it through the subreflector, primary mirror and free-space sections using ABCD matrices. Compute the beam waist, the edge taper, and the aperture-illumination efficiency of the telescope.

physics/fields_astro|waves.title: Toomre Hankel-transform inversion of a flat-disk rotation curve to surface density
physics/fields_astro|waves.gist: Take a razor-thin axisymmetric disk with a prescribed rotation curve (e.g. Brandt or exponential-disk form). Recover its surface density Σ(R) using Toomre's Bessel-function (Hankel) transform pair, computed by numerical Hankel quadrature. Check the result against the analytic Freeman I0K0/I1K1 solution and verify mass conservation.

physics/fields_astro|waves.title: NAFF frequency analysis of box and loop orbits in a logarithmic potential
physics/fields_astro|waves.gist: Integrate orbits in a 2D cored logarithmic potential. Extract the fundamental frequencies Ωx and Ωy with windowed-FFT refinement (NAFF-style Hann-windowed peak fitting). Map the frequency ratio across initial conditions to classify box, loop and resonant boxlet orbits and to measure frequency diffusion.

physics/fields_astro|waves.title: Terrell rotation: ray-traced apparent shape of a relativistically moving cube
physics/fields_astro|waves.gist: Trace light rays backward from a pinhole camera, solving each ray's emission-time intersection with a cube moving at speed β along x. Render the photographed image, including relativistic aberration and the Doppler/searchlight intensity factor. Quantify the apparent rotation angle, which should equal arcsin β, versus β and viewing angle.

physics/fields_astro|waves.title: Transfer-matrix microwave tunneling through an Epstein-profile plasma slab
physics/fields_astro|waves.gist: Discretize a smooth cold-plasma density profile (Epstein/sech²-type) into thin layers. Multiply 2×2 characteristic transfer matrices to get complex transmission and reflection coefficients versus frequency, including the overdense tunneling regime. Compare with the exact hypergeometric Epstein result and the WKB phase-integral estimate.
physics/fields_astro|waves.area: Wave propagation in plasmas and dielectrics

physics/fields_astro|waves.title: Zonal gravity harmonics J2n of a Maclaurin spheroid by Legendre multipole quadrature
physics/fields_astro|waves.gist: For a homogeneous oblate spheroid, compute the exterior multipole moments J2n by numerically integrating the density times r^{2n} P_{2n}(cos θ) over the body. Compare with the exact closed form J2n = (−1)^{n+1} 3e^{2n}/((2n+1)(2n+3)). Assess how truncating the multipole series affects the convergence of the potential near the surface.
physics/fields_astro|waves.area: Gravitational potential theory and Poisson solvers

physics/fields_astro|waves.title: Stellar v sin i from Fourier-transform zeros of rotationally broadened lines
physics/fields_astro|waves.gist: Build the limb-darkened rotational broadening kernel and convolve it with a thermal Gaussian intrinsic profile by FFT. Locate the first zeros of the line profile's Fourier transform. Recover v sin i and the limb-darkening coefficient, following Gray's method, with and without added noise.

physics/fields_astro|waves.title: Geomagnetic field downward continuation to the core–mantle boundary and Lowes spectrum
physics/fields_astro|waves.gist: Start from a set of Schmidt-normalized Gauss coefficients g_n^m, h_n^m. Evaluate B on the Earth's surface and at the core–mantle boundary via spherical-harmonic synthesis. Compute the Lowes–Mauersberger power spectrum R_n at both radii, the dipole tilt, and the locations of flux patches at the boundary.

physics/fields_astro|waves.title: Near-field to far-field transition of a circular radio aperture by angular-spectrum propagation
physics/fields_astro|waves.gist: Propagate the field of a uniformly or taper-illuminated circular aperture using FFT angular-spectrum propagation kernels. Track on-axis intensity oscillations (Fresnel zones) and the beam pattern versus distance. Show convergence to the Airy/Hankel-transform far-field pattern beyond the Rayleigh distance 2D²/λ.

physics/optics|linalg.title: Azimuthal modulational instability growth rates of vortex ring beams
physics/optics|linalg.gist: Linearize the 2D cubic NLSE about stationary vortex solitons of charge m and build the Bogoliubov-de Gennes operator for each azimuthal perturbation index on a radial grid. Compute the unstable eigenvalues with a sparse eigensolver to predict how many filaments the ring breaks into.

physics/optics|linalg.title: Foldy-Lax multiple scattering by a cluster of parallel dielectric cylinders
physics/optics|linalg.gist: Combine Bessel-Hankel single-cylinder T-matrices with Graf's addition theorem into a dense linear system for the coupled multipole coefficients of N rods under TM illumination. Solve it and compute the total and bistatic scattering widths, checking the optical theorem.

physics/optics|linalg.title: Core-shell cylinder scattering cancellation cloak via boundary-matching linear systems
physics/optics|linalg.gist: For each angular order, assemble and solve the 4x4 boundary-condition system of a coated dielectric/plasmonic cylinder to get its scattering coefficients. Find the shell permittivity and thickness that minimize the total scattering width of the dominant order.

physics/optics|linalg.title: Method-of-moments EFIE scattering from arbitrary-shaped PEC cylinders
physics/optics|linalg.gist: Discretize the 2D TM electric-field integral equation with a Hankel-function kernel and pulse basis on the contour of an elliptical or square PEC cylinder, then solve the dense system for the surface current. Compute the bistatic scattering width and validate against the circular-cylinder series solution.

physics/optics|linalg.title: High-k mode density of Ag/TiO2 hyperbolic multilayer: exact versus effective medium
physics/optics|linalg.gist: Compute the p-polarized reflection coefficient of a finite metal-dielectric stack as a function of evanescent in-plane wavevector using transfer matrices. Map Im(r_p) to locate high-k modes and compare with the hyperbolic isofrequency contour from effective-medium theory, including the nonlocal cutoff.
physics/optics|linalg.area: Hyperbolic media and evanescent wave optics

physics/optics|linalg.title: Dyakonov surface waves at a uniaxial-isotropic interface
physics/optics|linalg.gist: Write the boundary-condition determinant that couples the ordinary and extraordinary evanescent fields in a uniaxial crystal to TE/TM evanescent fields in an isotropic medium. Solve for the surface-wave effective index and find the narrow angular existence window relative to the optic axis.
physics/optics|linalg.area: Hyperbolic media and evanescent wave optics

physics/optics|linalg.title: Floquet SSH waveguide array with periodically modulated couplings
physics/optics|linalg.gist: Form the one-period Floquet operator of a periodically driven SSH lattice as a time-ordered product of matrix exponentials and diagonalize it to get quasi-energies. Identify the 0 and π edge modes in a finite chain and compute their localization lengths versus drive frequency.

physics/optics|linalg.title: PT-symmetric gain-loss coupled waveguide chain and exceptional points
physics/optics|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the non-Hermitian coupled-mode matrix of a waveguide chain with alternating gain and loss. Locate the PT-symmetry-breaking threshold from the onset of complex eigenvalues and characterize eigenvector coalescence at the exceptional point through the eigenvector condition number.

physics/optics|linalg.title: Orthonormal aberration polynomials over a hexagonal pupil and Strehl ratio
physics/optics|linalg.gist: Gram-Schmidt-orthonormalize sampled Zernike polynomials over a hexagonal segmented-mirror pupil with QR decomposition, and least-squares fit a measured wavefront onto this basis. Compute the PSF by FFT and the Strehl ratio, comparing it with the Maréchal approximation.

physics/optics|linalg.title: Hopkins TCC eigen-decomposition for partially coherent lithographic imaging
physics/optics|linalg.gist: Build the transmission cross-coefficient matrix for annular illumination and a circular pupil with defocus, then eigen-decompose it into coherent kernels (sum of coherent systems). Compute the aerial image and contrast of a line-space mask versus the number of retained kernels.

physics/optics|linalg.title: Prolate spheroidal modes and degrees of freedom of a band-limited imaging system
physics/optics|linalg.gist: Discretize the space-bandwidth-limited sinc kernel operator for a 1D slit aperture and compute its eigenvalues and eigenfunctions. Find the step-like eigenvalue falloff that defines the Shannon number and how it scales with the space-bandwidth product.

physics/optics|linalg.title: Matrix Fourier transform PSF of an apodized coronagraph pupil
physics/optics|linalg.gist: Compute the focal-plane field of an apodized, obstructed telescope pupil with Soummer's semi-analytic matrix Fourier transform, using explicit DFT matrices at arbitrary focal sampling. Propagate it through a Lyot coronagraph and evaluate the raw contrast in a given dark-hole region.

physics/optics|linalg.title: Levenberg-Marquardt design of broadband oblique-incidence antireflection coating
physics/optics|linalg.gist: Parametrize a multilayer AR coating on glass by its layer thicknesses and compute s- and p-reflectance at oblique incidence with characteristic matrices. Minimize the band-averaged reflectance using damped least squares with a finite-difference Jacobian.

physics/optics|linalg.title: Finite-difference mode solver for step-index fiber total dispersion
physics/optics|linalg.gist: Discretize the scalar radial Helmholtz equation of a step-index fiber and solve the sparse eigenproblem for the LP01 propagation constant across wavelengths, using Sellmeier core and cladding indices. Compute waveguide plus material dispersion and the shifted zero-dispersion wavelength versus core radius.

physics/optics|linalg.title: Supermodes and differential group delay of a coupled seven-core fiber
physics/optics|linalg.gist: Build the coupled-mode matrix of a hexagonal seven-core fiber with wavelength-dependent coupling coefficients and diagonalize it into supermodes. Compute the supermode group delays from the frequency derivatives of the eigenvalues and the resulting impulse-response spread.

physics/optics|linalg.title: ABCD matrix analysis of GRIN rod lens fiber coupling
physics/optics|linalg.gist: Build ray-transfer matrices for a parabolic GRIN rod of arbitrary length and compose them with free-space and interface matrices. Compute pitch, effective focal length, principal planes and the Gaussian-beam waist transformation for coupling a laser diode into a single-mode fiber.

physics/optics|linalg.title: Twisted Gaussian beam eigenmode of a nonorthogonal astigmatic cavity via 4x4 ray matrices
physics/optics|linalg.gist: Build 4x4 symplectic ray-transfer matrices for a resonator containing rotated cylindrical lenses. Eigendecompose the round-trip matrix to get the complex inverse-curvature matrix Q of the twisted Gaussian eigenmode, then compute its beam ellipse rotation and twist parameter, and check stability from the eigenvalue moduli.
physics/optics|linalg.area: Paraxial ray tracing and lens design

physics/optics|linalg.title: Bimodal transmission eigenvalue distribution of a disordered multimode waveguide
physics/optics|linalg.gist: Model a quasi-1D disordered waveguide as a cascade of random scattering matrices combined with the Redheffer star product. SVD of the total transmission matrix gives eigenvalue histograms, which are compared with the DMPK bimodal density and with the Ohmic conductance g = N l/L.

physics/optics|linalg.title: Wavefront-shaping focus enhancement through a scattering medium from its transmission matrix
physics/optics|linalg.gist: Draw a random complex Gaussian transmission matrix and form optimal input wavefronts by full phase conjugation, phase-only conjugation and binary-amplitude modulation. Compute the focal intensity enhancement versus the number of controlled modes and compare it with the theoretical π/4·N and 1/(2π)·N scalings.

physics/optics|linalg.title: Karhunen-Loève turbulence modes from diagonalizing the Noll Zernike covariance matrix
physics/optics|linalg.gist: Assemble the Kolmogorov Zernike covariance matrix from Noll's analytic formula for the first few hundred modes. Diagonalize it to obtain Karhunen-Loève modes and variances, then compare the residual phase variance after correcting J modes in the KL basis with that in the Zernike basis.

physics/optics|linalg.title: Multi-conjugate AO tomography: two-layer least-squares reconstruction from three guide stars
physics/optics|linalg.gist: Build ray-projection matrices that map two turbulent phase layers at different altitudes onto the pupil slopes measured by Shack-Hartmann sensors for several off-axis guide stars. Solve the regularized least-squares tomography problem, then compute the reconstruction error and the residual phase variance across the field of view.

physics/optics|linalg.title: Complex Bloch wavevectors of a Drude-metal rod square lattice at fixed frequency
physics/optics|linalg.gist: Fix the frequency so the dispersive permittivity is constant, and recast the TM plane-wave-expansion Maxwell problem as a quadratic eigenproblem for the Bloch wavevector k along ΓX. Linearize it and solve, giving real bands and evanescent decay rates inside the gap below the effective plasma cutoff.

physics/optics|linalg.title: Three-core photonic lantern supermode evolution and adiabaticity along the taper
physics/optics|linalg.gist: Use a coupled-mode matrix for three cores whose propagation constants and couplings vary along a taper toward a common multimode section. Track the supermode eigenvalues and eigenvectors along z, then evaluate the adiabaticity criterion |⟨i|∂z j⟩|/Δβ and the resulting mode-selective power transfer.

physics/optics|linalg.title: Mode-matching eigenmode expansion at an abrupt slab-waveguide width step
physics/optics|linalg.gist: Solve the slab TE eigenmodes, including discretized radiation modes in a PEC-bounded box, on both sides of a core-width discontinuity. Build overlap matrices and solve the mode-matching linear system for the reflection and transmission matrices, giving fundamental-mode transmission, reflection and radiated power versus width ratio.

physics/optics|linalg.title: Er/Yb codoped fiber amplifier: level populations from the rate-matrix null space
physics/optics|linalg.gist: Write the linear rate matrix of the coupled Yb2F and Er4I manifolds with pump and signal transitions, iterating self-consistently on the nonlinear Yb→Er energy-transfer terms. Obtain steady-state populations from its null space at each position and integrate the pump and signal powers to get gain versus fiber length.

physics/optics|linalg.title: Bloch–Messiah decomposition of a multimode Gaussian optical circuit
physics/optics|linalg.gist: Assemble the symplectic matrix of a network of single-mode squeezers and beam splitters. Decompose it by SVD into passive-squeezing-passive form, extract the effective squeezing spectrum and supermodes, and verify symplecticity and photon-number consistency.

physics/optics|linalg.title: Damped least-squares optimization of a cemented doublet with real-ray-trace Jacobian
physics/optics|linalg.gist: Define merit-function residuals from exact real-ray intercepts at several pupil heights and wavelengths, plus an effective-focal-length constraint. Iterate the Levenberg damped least-squares update on the curvatures using finite-difference Jacobians, and report the RMS spot reduction and the final prescription.
physics/optics|linalg.area: Paraxial ray tracing and lens design

physics/optics|linalg.title: Extended-boundary-condition T-matrix of an elliptical dielectric cylinder
physics/optics|linalg.gist: Compute the EBCM Q and Rg-Q matrices for an elliptical dielectric cylinder from surface integrals of cylindrical wave functions, then obtain T = −RgQ·Q⁻¹. Use T to compute TM scattering widths versus incidence angle and orientation-averaged extinction, and check reciprocity and energy conservation.

physics/optics|linalg.title: Many-body near-field radiative heat transfer in a chain of SiC nanoparticles
physics/optics|linalg.gist: Model SiC nanospheres as fluctuating electric dipoles with Lorentz-oscillator polarizability. Invert the many-body dipole interaction matrix to get the spectral transmission coefficients between particles, then compute the thermal conductance between chain ends and compare it with pairwise-additive predictions.
physics/optics|linalg.area: Thermal radiation and emissivity of structures

physics/optics|linalg.title: Linear stability spectrum of cubic-quintic Kerr solitons via finite-difference Bogoliubov eigenproblem
physics/optics|linalg.gist: Find stationary 1D solitons of the cubic-quintic NLSE using the analytic or Petviashvili profile. Discretize the linearized L+/L− operators into a non-Hermitian block matrix and compute its eigenvalues versus propagation constant, checking the internal modes and the Vakhitov–Kolokolov criterion.
physics/optics|linalg.area: Optical solitons in photorefractive and Kerr media

math/pde_numerics|quad_models.title: Mitchell-Schaeffer APD restitution curve and conduction-velocity dispersion
math/pde_numerics|quad_models.gist: Derive the closed-form action-potential duration as a function of diastolic interval for the Mitchell-Schaeffer two-variable model, using logarithmic gate-recovery formulas. Combine it with numerically measured cable conduction velocities to predict when alternans onsets, where the restitution slope exceeds 1.

math/pde_numerics|quad_models.title: Critical ignition radius of circular fronts from eikonal curvature relation
math/pde_numerics|quad_models.gist: Use the eikonal relation c(kappa) = c0 - D*kappa for a 2D bistable medium to predict the critical radius below which a circular excitation collapses. Verify the prediction by integrating the radially symmetric reaction-diffusion PDE with the method of lines and bisecting on the initial radius.

math/pde_numerics|quad_models.title: Anisotropic bidomain-to-monodomain conduction velocity ratio in cardiac tissue
math/pde_numerics|quad_models.gist: Compute effective monodomain conductivities from intracellular and extracellular conductivity tensors using the harmonic-mean formula sigma_i*sigma_e/(sigma_i+sigma_e). Predict the longitudinal/transverse conduction-velocity ratio as a square root of the conductivity ratio and compare it with 2D FitzHugh-Nagumo front speeds along the fiber axes.

math/pde_numerics|quad_models.title: KdV two-soliton Hirota solution and invariant drift under discrete gradients
math/pde_numerics|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the exact Hirota two-soliton solution of KdV, and compute its mass, momentum and energy by spectral quadrature. Measure how these invariants drift over long times under an average-vector-field discrete-gradient scheme versus a Runge-Kutta scheme.

math/pde_numerics|quad_models.title: Goodman heat-balance integral method versus exact Neumann Stefan solution
math/pde_numerics|quad_models.gist: Apply Goodman's heat-balance integral method with quadratic and cubic profile approximations to obtain closed-form front laws for one-phase melting. Quantify their error relative to the exact Neumann lambda as a function of Stefan number.

math/pde_numerics|quad_models.title: Taylor-Green vortex energy decay under Chorin projection on staggered grid
math/pde_numerics|quad_models.gist: Simulate the 2D Taylor-Green vortex with a Chorin projection method on a MAC grid. Compute kinetic energy and enstrophy by midpoint quadrature, and compare them with the exact exp(-4*nu*k^2*t) decay, also reporting the maximum discrete divergence.

math/pde_numerics|quad_models.title: Kovasznay flow exact solution as steady Navier-Stokes verification benchmark
math/pde_numerics|quad_models.gist: Evaluate Kovasznay's exact solution with lambda = Re/2 - sqrt(Re^2/4 + 4*pi^2) and check that it satisfies the steady incompressible Navier-Stokes equations. Use it as a boundary condition and reference for a pseudo-time projection solver, reporting velocity and pressure L2 errors versus grid size.

math/pde_numerics|quad_models.title: Womersley pulsatile pipe flow from complex Bessel functions versus radial solver
math/pde_numerics|quad_models.gist: Compute the Womersley velocity profile, flow rate and wall shear stress from J0 and J1 Bessel functions of complex argument for an oscillatory pressure gradient. Compare these with a Crank-Nicolson finite-difference solution of the axisymmetric unsteady Stokes equation.

math/pde_numerics|quad_models.title: Manufactured solutions for nonlinear diffusion u_t = (u^m u_x)_x in multiple norms
math/pde_numerics|quad_models.gist: Use sympy to build manufactured source terms for a degenerate nonlinear diffusion equation. Solve it with a Crank-Nicolson finite-volume scheme, and estimate observed orders of accuracy in L1, L2 and Linf norms computed with Gauss quadrature.

math/pde_numerics|quad_models.title: Scharfetter-Gummel drift-diffusion current in a pn-junction diode
math/pde_numerics|quad_models.gist: Discretize the electron continuity equation using the Scharfetter-Gummel flux with the Bernoulli function B(x) = x/(e^x - 1), on a prescribed potential profile. Compare the computed current density with the Shockley diode equation and with a naive central-difference flux.

math/pde_numerics|quad_models.title: Shishkin mesh uniform convergence for convection-diffusion boundary layers
math/pde_numerics|quad_models.gist: Construct piecewise-uniform Shishkin meshes with transition point sigma = min(1/2, 2*eps*ln(N)/beta) for a variable-coefficient singularly perturbed problem. Verify parameter-uniform N^-1*ln(N) convergence of upwind differences using double-mesh error estimates.

math/pde_numerics|quad_models.title: Discrete Mur boundary reflection including FDTD grid dispersion
math/pde_numerics|quad_models.gist: Derive the reflection coefficient of the first-order Mur boundary condition from the discrete Yee dispersion relation, as a function of Courant number, angle and points per wavelength. Verify it with 2D FDTD Gaussian-pulse experiments.
math/pde_numerics|quad_models.area: Absorbing boundaries and perfectly matched layers

math/pde_numerics|quad_models.title: Semi-Lagrangian cubic Lagrange interpolation amplification factor and damping
math/pde_numerics|quad_models.gist: Derive the closed-form amplification factor of 1D semi-Lagrangian advection with linear and cubic Lagrange interpolation as a function of wavenumber and fractional Courant number. Compare the predicted damping and phase error with large-Courant simulations of a periodic sine wave.

math/pde_numerics|quad_models.title: Radial Buckley-Leverett waterflood front around an injection well
math/pde_numerics|quad_models.gist: Derive the radial similarity solution r_f^2 = Q*t*f'(S_f)/(pi*h*phi) from the Welge shock saturation. Compare the predicted saturation profiles with a finite-volume solver in radial coordinates using upwind fluxes on a logarithmic grid.

math/pde_numerics|quad_models.title: Down-and-out barrier option: Crank-Nicolson with Rannacher smoothing versus closed form
math/pde_numerics|quad_models.gist: Price a down-and-out European call by solving the Black-Scholes PDE with Crank-Nicolson and Rannacher start-up steps. Compare price, delta and gamma with the closed-form Merton/Reiner-Rubinstein formula, which uses normal CDFs.
math/pde_numerics|quad_models.area: Method of lines and stiff ODE integration

math/pde_numerics|quad_models.title: Extremum clipping of TVD limiters on smooth sine data with Gauss-averaged cells
math/pde_numerics|quad_models.gist: MUSCL reconstructions with minmod, van Leer, MC and superbee limiters advect a sine wave whose exact cell averages come from Gauss-Legendre quadrature. Measured L1 and L-infinity errors and observed orders show the order loss caused by clipping at extrema, checked against the Sweby second-order TVD region of each limiter function.

math/pde_numerics|quad_models.title: Lagrange-Galerkin advection: instability from inexact quadrature versus area-weighting
math/pde_numerics|quad_models.gist: A P1 Lagrange-Galerkin (Galerkin-characteristics) scheme for 1D periodic advection-diffusion computes the inner products of basis functions with the foot of the characteristic either exactly or by Gauss quadrature. The amplification of the resulting one-step operator and long-time mass and L2 errors show that Gauss quadrature can destabilize the scheme while exact integration or area-weighting does not.

math/pde_numerics|quad_models.title: Hamilton's force of selection from Euler-Lotka with Siler mortality and Hadwiger fertility
math/pde_numerics|quad_models.gist: Survivorship comes from Siler competing-hazard mortality and fertility from a Hadwiger schedule, and quadrature plus root-finding solves the continuous Euler-Lotka equation for r. From the same model the code computes the stable age distribution, Fisher reproductive value, generation time, and Hamilton's sensitivities dr/dmu(a) and dr/dm(a).

math/pde_numerics|quad_models.title: IMEX-RK Fisher-KPP fronts versus Ablowitz-Zeppetella exact traveling wave
math/pde_numerics|quad_models.gist: Fisher-KPP is integrated with implicit diffusion and explicit logistic reaction using IMEX pairs (IMEX Euler, ARS(2,2,2), ARS(4,4,3)), starting from the closed-form Ablowitz-Zeppetella wave with speed 5/sqrt(6). Front-speed and profile errors are reported against the exact solution as functions of time step and grid spacing.

math/pde_numerics|quad_models.title: Reflectionless Pöschl-Teller well: Crank-Nicolson residual wavepacket reflection
math/pde_numerics|quad_models.gist: A Gaussian wavepacket is propagated with the Crank-Nicolson scheme through a sech^2 potential of integer strength, which the analytic hypergeometric scattering solution makes exactly reflectionless. The code measures the reflected probability, norm drift and transit phase delay, and compares them with the exact momentum-averaged transmission and phase shift.

math/pde_numerics|quad_models.title: Startup of plane Poiseuille flow: Chorin projection versus Fourier series solution
math/pde_numerics|quad_models.gist: An impulsively applied pressure gradient drives a channel flow that Chorin's projection method on a staggered grid solves. The transient centerline velocity and wall shear stress are compared with the exact eigenfunction series, alongside the divergence norm and the first-order splitting error in time.

math/pde_numerics|quad_models.title: Semi-discrete central advection of a delta: Bessel J_n solution and group velocity
math/pde_numerics|quad_models.gist: The method-of-lines central-difference advection equation with Kronecker-delta initial data has the exact solution J_{j}(ct/h), whose wavefront travels at the group velocity. The code evaluates this solution with special functions, checks it against RK4 time integration, and quantifies the dispersive wake, the Airy-type front decay and the spurious -c group-velocity mode.
math/pde_numerics|quad_models.area: Von Neumann stability and modified equations

math/pde_numerics|quad_models.title: Free drainage of a vertical liquid film versus Jeffreys similarity solution
math/pde_numerics|quad_models.gist: The lubrication equation for a film draining under gravity on a vertical wall, h_t + (g h^3/3nu)_x = 0, is solved with upwind finite volumes, with optional weak capillarity. Film thickness profiles and drained volume are compared with the Jeffreys kinematic-wave solution h = sqrt(nu x/(g t)).

math/pde_numerics|quad_models.title: Duhamel superposition for slab conduction with ramped surface temperature
math/pde_numerics|quad_models.gist: A plane wall with time-varying surface temperature (linear ramp, then hold) is solved by Crank-Nicolson finite differences. The interior temperature and surface heat flux are compared with Duhamel's convolution of the step-response eigenfunction series, evaluated by product quadrature.

math/pde_numerics|quad_models.title: 2D wave equation afterglow: Poisson's formula with singular quadrature versus leapfrog
math/pde_numerics|quad_models.gist: The 2D wave equation with a compactly supported radial initial displacement is evaluated from Poisson's formula, handling its inverse-square-root kernel singularity by a change of variables plus Gauss quadrature. The code checks the result against a second-order leapfrog finite-difference simulation and quantifies the trailing afterglow that breaks Huygens' principle in 2D.
math/pde_numerics|quad_models.area: Von Neumann stability and modified equations

math/pde_numerics|quad_models.title: Rosenthal moving heat source in a thin plate: K0 solution versus moving-frame FD
math/pde_numerics|quad_models.gist: The quasi-steady temperature field of a line heat source moving through a thin plate with surface losses is computed from Rosenthal's modified-Bessel K0 closed form. A 2D upwinded advection-diffusion finite-difference solution in the moving frame is compared against it, along with the predicted melt-isotherm width and length.

math/pde_numerics|quad_models.title: Crank-Nicolson paraxial beam propagation: Gaussian beam width and Gouy phase
math/pde_numerics|quad_models.gist: The paraxial Helmholtz (Schrödinger-type) equation for an axisymmetric Gaussian beam is marched in z with Crank-Nicolson in radial coordinates. The numerical beam radius, on-axis intensity and accumulated Gouy phase are compared with the closed-form Gaussian-beam solution, including the effect of the step size on phase error.

physics/quantum_info|linalg.title: Two-qubit quantum discord of X-states via measurement-angle optimization
physics/quantum_info|linalg.gist: For two-qubit X-state density matrices, compute classical correlation and quantum discord by building projective measurement operators on qubit B, constructing post-measurement conditional states, and minimizing conditional entropy over Bloch-sphere angles with eigenvalue-based von Neumann entropies.

physics/quantum_info|linalg.title: Geometric discord of two-qubit states from correlation-matrix eigenvalues
physics/quantum_info|linalg.gist: Compute the Dakic-Vedral-Brukner geometric discord by extracting the local Bloch vector and the 3x3 correlation matrix T from the Pauli expansion, then using the closed form with the largest eigenvalue of xx^T + TT^T. Check it against brute-force minimization over classical-quantum states.

physics/quantum_info|linalg.title: Measurement-induced disturbance and discord in Heisenberg dimer thermal states
physics/quantum_info|linalg.gist: Build thermal states of a two-spin XXZ Heisenberg Hamiltonian in a magnetic field by diagonalization. Compute discord, concurrence and measurement-induced disturbance as functions of temperature, showing that discord persists where entanglement vanishes.

physics/quantum_info|linalg.title: ZYZ Euler-angle decomposition of arbitrary single-qubit unitaries
physics/quantum_info|linalg.gist: Given a U(2) matrix, extract the global phase and the ZYZ Euler angles from its entries, reconstruct the unitary, and verify it to machine precision, handling the degenerate cases where the Y rotation angle is 0 or pi.

physics/quantum_info|linalg.title: Makhlin local invariants and minimum CNOT count of two-qubit gates
physics/quantum_info|linalg.gist: Compute the Makhlin invariants G1 and G2 from the magic-basis matrix m = U_B^T U_B. Use them together with the Weyl coordinates to classify gates (CNOT, sqrt(SWAP), B-gate, SWAP) by the number of CNOTs required, and test the classification on random unitaries.

physics/quantum_info|linalg.title: Quantum Shannon decomposition of three-qubit unitaries via cosine-sine decomposition
physics/quantum_info|linalg.gist: Recursively decompose an 8x8 unitary using the cosine-sine decomposition (scipy.linalg.cossin) and the demultiplexing of block-diagonal unitaries via eigendecomposition. Count the resulting CNOTs and single-qubit rotations and verify the reconstruction error.

physics/quantum_info|linalg.title: Haar-random unitaries via QR with phase correction and spectral statistics
physics/quantum_info|linalg.gist: Sample CUE matrices from QR decompositions of Ginibre matrices, including the diagonal phase fix. Verify Haar invariance by comparing the eigenphase nearest-neighbor spacing distribution with the Wigner surmise and computing the spectral form factor.

physics/quantum_info|linalg.title: Approach to unitary designs in random local brickwork circuits
physics/quantum_info|linalg.gist: Build brickwork circuits of Haar-random two-qubit gates on n qubits as dense unitaries. Estimate the second frame potential as a function of depth and extract the convergence rate toward the 2-design value.

physics/quantum_info|linalg.title: Bell-diagonal coefficient transfer matrices for noisy entanglement swapping
physics/quantum_info|linalg.gist: Represent swapping of Bell-diagonal pairs as a bilinear map on the 4-vector of Bell coefficients, including gate depolarization and measurement errors. Propagate it through N segments and find the maximum distance at which the final state remains distillable.

physics/quantum_info|linalg.title: Maximum-likelihood amplitude estimation from Grover-power measurement schedules
physics/quantum_info|linalg.gist: Simulate measurement outcomes of Q^m A|0> for exponentially spaced m using exact amplitudes from matrix powers. Estimate the amplitude by maximizing the combined likelihood and compare the error scaling with the Heisenberg limit and classical Monte Carlo.

physics/quantum_info|linalg.title: Spectral analysis of the Grover operator for quantum phase estimation counting
physics/quantum_info|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the Grover operator for n-qubit searches with k marked items, identify the eigenphases ±2θ, and simulate quantum counting via phase estimation with a register of t qubits. This yields the distribution of the estimated number of solutions.

physics/quantum_info|linalg.title: Transmon charge-basis diagonalization: spectrum, anharmonicity and charge dispersion
physics/quantum_info|linalg.gist: Build the Cooper-pair-number-basis Hamiltonian 4E_C(n-n_g)^2 - E_J cos φ as a tridiagonal matrix and diagonalize it. Compute the transition frequencies, the anharmonicity, and the charge dispersion versus E_J/E_C, and compare with Mathieu-function asymptotics.

physics/quantum_info|linalg.title: Dispersive shift of a transmon coupled to a resonator via exact diagonalization
physics/quantum_info|linalg.gist: Construct the transmon-resonator Hamiltonian in a truncated product basis using charge matrix elements and diagonalize it. Extract the dressed energies, identify states by overlap, and compute the dispersive shift χ versus detuning, comparing with the perturbative straddling-regime formula.

physics/quantum_info|linalg.title: Fluxonium spectrum in the phase basis and flux-sweep transition matrix elements
physics/quantum_info|linalg.gist: Discretize the fluxonium Hamiltonian 4E_C n^2 + E_L φ^2/2 - E_J cos(φ - φ_ext) on a phase grid, or in the harmonic-oscillator basis. Compute the lowest levels and the charge and flux matrix elements across the flux sweep, including at the half-flux sweet spot.

physics/quantum_info|linalg.title: Tunable-coupler ZZ interaction between two transmons from dressed energies
physics/quantum_info|linalg.gist: Build a three-transmon (qubit-coupler-qubit) Duffing-oscillator Hamiltonian in a truncated Fock basis and diagonalize it. Compute the residual ZZ coupling ζ = E11 - E10 - E01 + E00 versus coupler frequency to locate the zero-ZZ point.

physics/quantum_info|linalg.title: BBPSSW recurrence purification of Werner states: fidelity flow and yield
physics/quantum_info|linalg.gist: Iterate the BBPSSW fidelity map with twirling, find its fixed points and threshold F > 1/2, and track the yield after successive rounds. Validate one round against explicit CNOT-plus-measurement density-matrix calculations on two copies of the pair.

physics/quantum_info|linalg.title: Hardware-efficient VQE for the transverse-field Ising chain ground state
physics/quantum_info|linalg.gist: Build the Pauli-sum Hamiltonian of a 6-qubit transverse-field Ising chain from Kronecker products, construct a layered RY-CZ ansatz by statevector simulation, and minimize the energy with BFGS. Compare with exact diagonalization across the field strength.

physics/quantum_info|linalg.title: Variational quantum deflation for excited states of a Heisenberg ring
physics/quantum_info|linalg.gist: Find the lowest three eigenstates of a 4-site XXZ ring by sequentially minimizing the energy plus overlap penalties with previously found states using a hardware-efficient ansatz. Verify the energies and fidelities against exact diagonalization.

physics/quantum_info|linalg.title: Toric code stabilizer construction and logical operators via GF(2) linear algebra
physics/quantum_info|linalg.gist: Build the X and Z parity-check matrices of the L×L toric code, compute their ranks over GF(2), and verify that the code encodes k = 2 logical qubits. Extract representatives of the logical operators as kernel elements not in the row space of the parity checks.

physics/quantum_info|linalg.title: Fidelity susceptibility of the transverse-field Ising chain as a critical metrology resource
physics/quantum_info|linalg.gist: Build the open-chain TFIM Hamiltonian for N≤12 spins and compute the ground-state QFI for the field, 4χ_F, from the spectral sum Σ|⟨n|∂_hH|0⟩|²/(E_n−E_0)². Check the result against finite-difference overlaps and extract the scaling exponent of the susceptibility peak with N.

physics/quantum_info|linalg.title: Entanglement spectrum of the Bose-Hubbard trimer across the superfluid–Mott crossover
physics/quantum_info|linalg.gist: Exactly diagonalize the three-site Bose-Hubbard Hamiltonian at fixed filling in the number basis. Reshape the ground state across the site-1 | sites-2,3 bipartition and use SVD to get Schmidt coefficients, the entanglement spectrum and the von Neumann entropy versus U/J.

physics/quantum_info|linalg.title: Knill-Laflamme verification and distance of the nine-qubit permutation-invariant gnu code
physics/quantum_info|linalg.gist: Construct Ouyang's (g,n,u)=(3,3,1) permutation-invariant code words from Dicke states. Assemble the Knill-Laflamme matrices ⟨i|E_a†E_b|j⟩ over all Paulis of weight ≤2 and determine the code distance by enumerating low-weight Paulis until a logical-acting one is found.

physics/quantum_info|linalg.title: Simon's algorithm: hidden XOR period recovery by GF(2) linear algebra
physics/quantum_info|linalg.gist: Build the oracle unitary for a random 2-to-1 function with hidden mask s on n≤6 qubits and simulate the Hadamard–oracle–Hadamard circuit to get the distribution of outcomes y with y·s=0. Recover s by Gaussian elimination over GF(2) on sampled equations, and compute the expected number of queries needed for full rank.

physics/quantum_info|linalg.title: Horodecki 2×4 bound-entangled family: PPT, realignment and reduction tests versus b
physics/quantum_info|linalg.gist: Construct the Horodecki one-parameter qubit–ququart state family ρ_b. Check positivity of the partial transpose via eigenvalues, compute the CCNR realignment trace norm by SVD, and test the reduction criterion across b∈[0,1], mapping which criteria detect entanglement.

physics/quantum_info|linalg.title: Area law in a harmonic chain ground state via symplectic eigenvalues
physics/quantum_info|linalg.gist: For a coupled harmonic-oscillator chain with potential matrix V, obtain the ground-state position and momentum covariances from V^{±1/2}. Compute the symplectic eigenvalues of block reduced covariances and from them the block entanglement entropy versus block size, comparing gapped scaling with the logarithmic scaling near the massless limit.

physics/optics|pde.title: Defect-mode frequency and Q factor of a DBR microcavity by FDTD ring-down
physics/optics|pde.gist: Excite a half-wave defect layer between two quarter-wave mirrors with a short pulse in 1D FDTD. Record the field after the source has decayed, then fit the ring-down (damped sinusoid or Prony/harmonic inversion) to get the resonance frequency and Q, and study how Q scales with the number of mirror pairs.
physics/optics|pde.area: Distributed Bragg reflectors and photonic bandgaps

physics/optics|pde.title: Finite-difference quasistatic plasmon resonance of a silver elliptical nanowire
physics/optics|pde.gist: Solve ∇·(ε(ω)∇φ) = 0 on a 2D grid with a uniform applied field and complex Drude-Lorentz permittivity inside an ellipse. Compute the dipole polarizability and absorption spectrum versus wavelength, then compare the resonance positions for both polarizations with the analytic depolarization-factor formula.

physics/optics|pde.title: Electrostatic plasmon eigenmodes and gap-dependent hybridization of a nanocylinder dimer
physics/optics|pde.gist: Formulate the quasistatic plasmon problem for two metal cylinders as a sparse generalized eigenproblem from the finite-difference operator ∇·(ε∇φ), with the inner permittivity as the eigenvalue. Map the eigenpermittivities to Drude frequencies to obtain bonding/antibonding mode splitting and gap field enhancement as functions of separation.

physics/optics|pde.title: FDFD scattering width of a dielectric cylinder with PML versus analytic Bessel series
physics/optics|pde.gist: Assemble a sparse 2D finite-difference frequency-domain Helmholtz operator with stretched-coordinate PML for TM plane-wave scattering by a circular dielectric cylinder, using a scattered-field formulation. Compute the near-to-far-field scattering width and total scattering cross section, then compare with the cylindrical Mie series built from Bessel/Hankel coefficients.

physics/optics|pde.title: Chebyshev spectral Mie coefficients for a radially graded-index (Luneburg) sphere
physics/optics|pde.gist: Solve the radial Riccati-Bessel-type ODEs for TE and TM partial waves inside a sphere with continuous n(r) using Chebyshev collocation. Match logarithmic derivatives to exterior Riccati-Bessel functions to get a_n and b_n, and compute extinction and backscatter efficiencies; validate the homogeneous-sphere limit against standard Mie.

physics/optics|pde.title: Azimuthal modulational instability of ring vortex solitons in saturable Kerr media
physics/optics|pde.gist: Integrate the 2D nonlinear Schrödinger equation with saturable nonlinearity by split-step Fourier, starting from a noisy charge-m ring vortex beam. Measure the number of filaments and the growth rates of azimuthal perturbation modes, then compare with linear stability predictions.
physics/optics|pde.area: Optical vortices and orbital angular momentum

physics/optics|pde.title: Nondiffracting range and on-axis intensity of an axicon-generated Bessel beam
physics/optics|pde.gist: Apply a conical phase to a Gaussian beam and propagate it with an FFT-based angular-spectrum method over many z-planes. Extract the on-axis intensity versus z, the central-lobe width, and the maximum Bessel zone, and compare with stationary-phase predictions; include a higher-order Bessel beam with a vortex phase.
physics/optics|pde.area: Optical vortices and orbital angular momentum

physics/optics|pde.title: OAM crosstalk of Laguerre-Gauss beams through Kolmogorov turbulence phase screens
physics/optics|pde.gist: Generate FFT-based Kolmogorov phase screens with a given Fried parameter and propagate an LG beam through them by split-step angular-spectrum propagation. Decompose the received field into OAM harmonics, average over realizations, and report detection probability and crosstalk matrices versus D/r0.
physics/optics|pde.area: Optical vortices and orbital angular momentum

physics/optics|pde.title: Travelling-wave model of a Fabry-Perot laser diode: L-I curve and threshold
physics/optics|pde.gist: Discretize counter-propagating field PDEs with gain, loss and spontaneous emission along the cavity, coupled to a local carrier rate equation with gain compression. Use facet reflectivity boundary conditions and step to steady state for a range of currents to obtain the L-I curve, threshold current, slope efficiency and longitudinal spatial hole burning.

physics/optics|pde.title: Lateral carrier diffusion and gain guiding in a ridge-waveguide laser
physics/optics|pde.gist: Solve the steady 1D lateral carrier diffusion equation with injection, recombination and stimulated emission by finite differences. Self-consistently couple it to a finite-difference effective-index Helmholtz eigenproblem with carrier-induced index change (α-factor) to compute the lateral mode profile, modal gain and the onset of lateral hole burning versus current.

physics/optics|pde.title: Supercell plane-wave expansion of a point-defect cavity mode in a rod lattice
physics/optics|pde.gist: Use an N×N supercell of a square rod photonic crystal with one rod removed or resized, and compute FFT-based Fourier coefficients of the dielectric map. Solve the TM eigenproblem at Γ to find defect-mode frequencies inside the gap, their localization length, and convergence with supercell size.

physics/optics|pde.title: Dispersion and slow-light group index of a W1 photonic-crystal waveguide
physics/optics|pde.gist: Compute the guided-mode dispersion of a line-defect waveguide in a triangular hole lattice using supercell plane-wave expansion along the waveguide direction. Extract group velocity from Hellmann-Feynman expectation values or finite differences, and map the group-index bandwidth product versus first-row hole shift.

physics/optics|pde.title: Transverse modes of an oxide-confined VCSEL from cylindrical finite-difference Helmholtz
physics/optics|pde.gist: Model the VCSEL with an effective-index step set by the oxide aperture and discretize the radial scalar Helmholtz equation for each azimuthal order. Solve for LP-mode effective-index shifts, transverse mode wavelength splittings and confinement factors versus aperture diameter, and determine the single-mode cutoff.

physics/optics|pde.title: Second-harmonic generation with pump depletion and walk-off by split-step
physics/optics|pde.gist: Integrate the coupled χ(2) envelope equations for fundamental and second-harmonic pulses or beams, including group-velocity mismatch, diffraction and spatial walk-off, using a split-step Fourier scheme. Compute conversion efficiency versus crystal length and focusing, and verify the plane-wave tanh² depletion limit.

physics/optics|pde.title: Transmission spectrum of a 90° bend in a photonic-crystal rod waveguide by FDTD
physics/optics|pde.gist: Model a square lattice of dielectric rods with a line defect containing a sharp bend. Use 2D TM FDTD with PML and a Gaussian pulse source, and compute bend transmission versus frequency by normalizing Poynting flux to a straight-waveguide run.

physics/optics|pde.title: Resonance cones of a point dipole in an anisotropic Drude hyperbolic medium
physics/optics|pde.gist: Simulate a time-harmonic line dipole in a uniaxial medium with opposite-sign permittivity components, using FDTD with anisotropic ADE. Measure the angle of the field-concentration cones and compare with the hyperbolic dispersion prediction arctan√(−ε⊥/ε∥).
physics/optics|pde.area: Hyperbolic media and evanescent wave optics

physics/optics|pde.title: Ionization-induced spectral blueshift of a femtosecond pulse in a gas cell
physics/optics|pde.gist: Propagate a pulse in (z,t) with a Kerr term and a plasma term, computing free-electron density from a multiphoton ionization rate equation at each step. Compute the spectral centroid shift and plasma defocusing phase versus peak intensity using a split-step solver.

physics/optics|pde.title: Spatial coherence radius of a beam after multi-screen Kolmogorov turbulence propagation
physics/optics|pde.gist: Propagate a plane wave through a series of FFT Kolmogorov phase screens with split-step angular-spectrum propagation. Estimate the wave-structure function and mutual coherence function from many realizations, and extract ρ0 for comparison with the analytic plane-wave coherence radius.

physics/optics|pde.title: Valley-Hall kink states at a domain wall of a continuum honeycomb photonic lattice
physics/optics|pde.gist: Discretize the scalar paraxial or Helmholtz operator for a honeycomb potential with broken sublattice symmetry on a finite-difference supercell containing a domain wall. Compute the Bloch supercell spectrum versus k_x and identify the in-gap kink states.

physics/optics|pde.title: Helical waveguide honeycomb Floquet topological insulator: unidirectional edge transport
physics/optics|pde.gist: Propagate a beam with the paraxial equation through a honeycomb waveguide lattice whose waveguides follow helical paths, using split-step Fourier in the co-moving frame. Show chiral edge-state circulation around a corner defect and compute the fraction of power that remains on the edge.

physics/optics|pde.title: Continuous-facesheet deformable mirror influence functions from the biharmonic plate equation
physics/optics|pde.gist: Solve the Kirchhoff plate equation ∇⁴w = F/D on a grid with point actuator loads and edge boundary conditions using finite differences. Compute actuator coupling, then the least-squares fitting residual of low-order Zernike modes.

physics/optics|pde.title: Two-temperature model of femtosecond laser heating of a gold film
physics/optics|pde.gist: Solve the coupled 1D electron and lattice heat equations with temperature-dependent electron heat capacity and an exponentially absorbed Gaussian pulse source, using Crank–Nicolson. Compute the electron–phonon equilibration time and the peak surface lattice temperature versus fluence.

physics/optics|pde.title: Pulsed Gaussian-beam surface heating of an absorber in axisymmetric coordinates
physics/optics|pde.gist: Solve the transient heat equation in (r,z) with a finite-difference ADI scheme for a Gaussian laser pulse absorbed at the surface. Validate against the analytic center temperature and compute the melting-threshold fluence versus pulse duration.

physics/optics|pde.title: Kukhtarev band-transport build-up of a photorefractive space-charge grating
physics/optics|pde.gist: Integrate the 1D Kukhtarev equations for ionized donor density, electron density and electric field under sinusoidal illumination with method-of-lines finite differences. Compute the space-charge field amplitude and the grating formation time versus grating period and applied field.

physics/optics|pde.title: Photonic crystal fiber fundamental mode and endlessly single-mode V parameter
physics/optics|pde.gist: Solve the scalar Helmholtz eigenproblem for a hexagonal air-hole silica PCF cross-section on a finite-difference grid with sparse eigensolvers. Compute the fundamental-mode and first-cladding-mode effective indices versus wavelength, and the effective V parameter versus d/Λ.

physics/optics|pde.title: EIT light storage and retrieval in a Λ medium via Maxwell–Bloch propagation
physics/optics|pde.gist: Solve the coupled probe-field propagation equation and three-level Bloch equations on a (z,t) grid while the control field is switched off and back on. Compute storage–retrieval efficiency versus optical depth and storage time with ground-state decoherence.
physics/optics|pde.area: Optical Bloch equations and atom-light interaction

physics/optics|pde.title: Hexagonal Turing patterns in a 2D transverse Kerr cavity Lugiato–Lefever model
physics/optics|pde.gist: Integrate the driven, damped 2D transverse LLE with diffraction using a pseudo-spectral split-step scheme. Compare the onset pump threshold and selected pattern wavenumber with linear stability analysis, and classify roll versus hexagon states.

physics/stat_phys|linalg.title: Vortex-pair interaction energies from the square-lattice Laplacian Green's function
physics/stat_phys|linalg.gist: Construct the periodic lattice Laplacian, invert it on the zero-mode-free subspace with a pseudoinverse or FFT diagonalization, and compute Coulomb-gas vortex-antivortex energies versus separation. From the logarithmic slope, estimate the Kosterlitz-Thouless vortex-unbinding temperature.

physics/stat_phys|linalg.title: Schnakenberg cycle decomposition of entropy production in a driven four-state network
physics/stat_phys|linalg.gist: Obtain the steady state of a non-equilibrium four-state Markov generator as its null vector. Build a spanning tree and its fundamental cycles, compute cycle currents and affinities, and verify that entropy production equals the sum of cycle currents times affinities.

physics/stat_phys|linalg.title: Gallavotti-Cohen symmetry of entropy-production large deviations on a driven ring
physics/stat_phys|linalg.gist: Tilt the generator of a biased N-state ring by an entropy-production counting field and compute the scaled cumulant generating function as the leading eigenvalue. Verify the symmetry λ(s) = λ(-1-s), and obtain the rate function by numerical Legendre transform.

physics/stat_phys|linalg.title: Spinodal avalanches in finite-temperature mean-field random-field Ising lattice
physics/stat_phys|linalg.gist: Solve the site-dependent mean-field equations m_i = tanh(β(JΣm_j + h_i + H)) by Newton iteration while sweeping H. Build the susceptibility matrix χ = (D⁻¹ − βJA)⁻¹ and track its smallest eigenvalue to detect avalanche-triggering instabilities. Characterize the soft-mode localization by its participation ratio.

physics/stat_phys|linalg.title: Critical temperature and ν from Binder-cumulant data collapse by polynomial least squares
physics/stat_phys|linalg.gist: Given Binder cumulant data U_L(T) for several L, rescale the abscissa as (T−Tc)L^{1/ν} and fit a global polynomial master curve by linear least squares. Minimize the collapse residual over (Tc, ν), and estimate the parameter errors from the curvature of the residual.

physics/stat_phys|linalg.title: Central charge of the critical three-state Potts model from strip free energies
physics/stat_phys|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the transfer matrix of q=3 Potts strips at criticality with periodic width L. Fit f(L) = f∞ − πc/(6L²) + a/L⁴ by least squares to extract the central charge c ≈ 4/5.

physics/stat_phys|linalg.title: Garden-of-Eden counts and cycle structure of additive CA over GF(2)
physics/stat_phys|linalg.gist: Represent rules 90 and 150 on rings of N cells as circulant matrices over GF(2) and implement Gaussian elimination mod 2. From the rank and kernel dimension, count unreachable configurations, and use matrix powers or order computations to obtain the maximal cycle lengths.

physics/stat_phys|linalg.title: Absorption times of the Domany-Kinzel probabilistic cellular automaton on small rings
physics/stat_phys|linalg.gist: Construct the full 2^N Markov transition matrix of the Domany-Kinzel CA with parameters (p1, p2). Compute the mean time to the absorbing state through the fundamental matrix (I−Q)⁻¹, and map how it scales with N to indicate the active-phase boundary.

physics/stat_phys|linalg.title: Maximal Lyapunov exponent of elementary cellular automata via Boolean Jacobians
physics/stat_phys|linalg.gist: Along a CA trajectory, build Bagnoli's Boolean-derivative Jacobian matrices for an elementary rule. Propagate a damage vector through the product of Jacobians and measure its exponential growth rate to classify damage spreading across all 256 rules.

physics/stat_phys|linalg.title: Spatial entropy of elementary-CA fixed points from de Bruijn transfer matrices
physics/stat_phys|linalg.gist: Construct the de Bruijn-graph adjacency matrix restricted to neighborhood transitions consistent with a rule's fixed-point (or period-p) condition. The spatial entropy of invariant configurations is the log of the largest eigenvalue, computed for all elementary rules.

physics/stat_phys|linalg.title: Quasi-stationary distribution and lifetime of the contact process on rings
physics/stat_phys|linalg.gist: Build the master-equation generator of the contact process on a ring of N sites and restrict it to the non-absorbing subspace. Obtain the quasi-stationary distribution and lifetime from the leading eigenpair, and estimate λ_c from crossings of the moment ratio ⟨ρ²⟩/⟨ρ⟩² with N.

physics/stat_phys|linalg.title: Pair-approximation fixed points and stability of the contact process
physics/stat_phys|linalg.gist: Write the pair mean-field equations for the densities of occupied sites and occupied pairs in the contact process on a coordination-z lattice. Locate fixed points with Newton's method and determine the transcritical threshold λ_c from Jacobian eigenvalues, comparing with the simple mean-field value.

physics/stat_phys|linalg.title: Epidemic thresholds and eigenvector localization of the contact process on networks
physics/stat_phys|linalg.gist: Compute the quenched mean-field threshold of the contact or SIS process as 1/Λ_max of the adjacency matrix on random-regular, Erdős–Rényi and power-law graphs. Measure localization of the principal eigenvector through the inverse participation ratio as network size grows.

physics/stat_phys|linalg.title: Zero-range process condensation: factorized measure versus exact generator null space
physics/stat_phys|linalg.gist: For a ZRP on a small ring with hop rates u(n) = 1 + b/n, verify the factorized steady state against the null vector of the full generator. Compute the partition function by recursive convolution, then find the critical density and the condensate occupation as functions of b.

physics/stat_phys|linalg.title: Spectral gap of the symmetric exclusion process via Heisenberg-chain mapping
physics/stat_phys|linalg.gist: Map the SSEP generator on a graph to the ferromagnetic Heisenberg Hamiltonian and diagonalize it in each particle-number sector. Verify that the spectral gap equals the single-particle random-walk gap (Aldous' property) on rings and on random graphs.

physics/stat_phys|linalg.title: Long-range two-point correlations in boundary-driven symmetric exclusion
physics/stat_phys|linalg.gist: Derive and solve the closed linear system for the connected correlations ⟨τ_iτ_j⟩_c in the open-boundary SSEP coupled to two reservoirs. Compare the numerical solution with the exact −(ρ_a−ρ_b)² x(1−y)/L scaling form.

physics/stat_phys|linalg.title: Hard-square lattice gas pressure and density from row transfer matrices
physics/stat_phys|linalg.gist: Enumerate the independent-set row configurations (a Fibonacci count) of width-L cylinders and build the fugacity-weighted transfer matrix. Compute pressure and density versus z from the largest eigenvalue and its derivative, and extrapolate the hard-square entropy constant at z = 1.

physics/stat_phys|linalg.title: Lee-Yang zeros of hard-core lattice gas from transfer-matrix partition polynomials
physics/stat_phys|linalg.gist: For hard-core particles on finite triangular or square tori, compute the partition-function polynomial in fugacity via traces of transfer-matrix powers. Locate its complex roots with companion-matrix eigenvalues, and track how the zero closest to the real axis approaches it with size.

physics/stat_phys|linalg.title: One-dimensional lattice gas with nearest- and next-nearest-neighbor interactions
physics/stat_phys|linalg.gist: Build the 4×4 pair-state transfer matrix of a 1D lattice gas with couplings J1 and J2 and chemical potential μ. Compute density isotherms, compressibility and correlation length from the eigenvalues, including the frustrated J2 < 0 regime.

physics/stat_phys|linalg.title: Pseudo-arclength continuation of exothermic CSTR steady states with fold and Hopf detection
physics/stat_phys|linalg.gist: Continue the steady-state branch of the nondimensional Uppal-Ray-Poore exothermic CSTR in Damköhler number using bordered Newton linear solves. Detect saddle-node points from sign changes of the Jacobian determinant and Hopf points from complex eigenvalue pairs crossing the imaginary axis.

physics/stat_phys|linalg.title: First Lyapunov coefficient at the Brusselator Hopf bifurcation via Kuznetsov's formula
physics/stat_phys|linalg.gist: At the Hopf point of the Brusselator, compute the right and left critical eigenvectors and the multilinear forms B and C. Evaluate the first Lyapunov coefficient using linear solves with (A) and (2iω−A), and confirm supercriticality against direct numerical limit-cycle amplitudes.

physics/stat_phys|linalg.title: Linear stability spectrum of the FitzHugh-Nagumo pulse and its Goldstone mode
physics/stat_phys|linalg.gist: Linearize the FitzHugh-Nagumo equations about a computed traveling pulse and discretize the resulting operator on a large domain. Compute its spectrum with sparse shift-invert eigensolvers, verify the zero translational eigenvalue, and distinguish fast-stable from slow-unstable pulse branches.

physics/stat_phys|linalg.title: Infinite-randomness scaling of gaps in the random transverse-field Ising chain
physics/stat_phys|linalg.gist: Sample random couplings J_i and fields h_i for the critical disordered transverse-field Ising chain. Diagonalize the 2L×2L Bogoliubov-de Gennes (free-fermion) matrix for each sample, collect lowest excitation energies over chain lengths, and verify Fisher's activated scaling ln(gap) ~ L^{1/2} by collapsing the log-gap distributions.
physics/stat_phys|linalg.area: Quantum Ising chain and quantum criticality

physics/stat_phys|linalg.title: Zamolodchikov E8 golden-ratio mass ratio in the critical Ising chain with longitudinal field
physics/stat_phys|linalg.gist: Build the sparse Hamiltonian of a periodic transverse-field Ising chain at h=J with a weak longitudinal field. Use Lanczos (eigsh) in the zero-momentum sector to get the lowest excitation gaps for several system sizes, and extrapolate the ratio m2/m1 toward the E8 prediction 2cos(π/5).
physics/stat_phys|linalg.area: Quantum Ising chain and quantum criticality

physics/stat_phys|linalg.title: Relaxation spectral gap and dynamical transition of the open partially asymmetric exclusion process
physics/stat_phys|linalg.gist: Construct the 2^L Markov generator of the open-boundary ASEP with forward/backward hopping and injection/extraction rates. Compute its first nonzero eigenvalue with sparse eigensolvers, extrapolate in L, and locate the de Gier-Essler dynamical transition line inside the low-density phase.

physics/stat_phys|linalg.title: Wavelength-selective instability of the synchronized period-2 orbit in a coupled logistic ring
physics/stat_phys|linalg.gist: For diffusively coupled logistic maps on a ring, find the spatially uniform period-2 orbit. Block-diagonalize the two-step Jacobian into Fourier modes and compute mode-resolved Floquet multipliers. Map the (r, ε) region where spatially modulated modes destabilize synchrony, then confirm by direct iteration.
physics/stat_phys|linalg.area: Coupled map lattices and spatiotemporal chaos

physics/stat_phys|linalg.title: Hatano-Sasa relation for a driven Markov ring with time-dependent rates
physics/stat_phys|linalg.gist: For a three- or four-state ring whose biased rates vary with a protocol λ(t), obtain steady states from generator null spaces to define φ = -ln p_ss. Propagate the tilted master equation with matrix exponentials to get the generating function of the excess entropy production, and verify ⟨exp(-Y)⟩=1 alongside a Gillespie check.

physics/stat_phys|linalg.title: Mean convergence times of fully asynchronous elementary cellular automata on small rings
physics/stat_phys|linalg.gist: Under fully asynchronous updating (one random cell per step), each elementary CA rule on an N-cell ring defines an absorbing Markov chain over 2^N configurations. Build its transition matrix, solve for expected absorption times into fixed points with the fundamental matrix, and classify rules by how the times scale with N (Fatès-style classes).

physics/stat_phys|linalg.title: Multifractal harmonic measure of lattice DLA clusters via sparse Laplace solves
physics/stat_phys|linalg.gist: Grow a lattice DLA cluster with random walkers, then solve the discrete Laplace equation with an absorbing cluster and a distant circular boundary using a sparse direct solver. Take growth probabilities from the perimeter fluxes and compute the multifractal spectrum D_q, checking Makarov's information-dimension result D_1 = 1.

physics/stat_phys|linalg.title: Dynamic critical exponent of 2D Glauber Ising from master-equation spectral gaps
physics/stat_phys|linalg.gist: Build the sparse 2^(L²) heat-bath Glauber generator for periodic L×L Ising lattices (L up to 4-5) at the exact critical temperature, with symmetry reduction where helpful. Extract the slowest relaxation rate with Lanczos and fit gap ~ L^{-z} with corrections to estimate z ≈ 2.17.
physics/stat_phys|linalg.area: Lattice spin models and critical dynamics

math/info_stats|quad_models.title: Gaussian-approximation density evolution threshold for irregular LDPC on BI-AWGN
