math/info_stats|quad_models.gist: Track the mean of Gaussian LLR messages through variable and check node degree distributions. The Chung phi-function is evaluated by adaptive quadrature and its inverse by root finding, and bisection on noise sigma gives the decoding threshold.

math/info_stats|quad_models.title: Binary erasure channel thresholds and EXIT curves for irregular LDPC ensembles
math/info_stats|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the closed-form density evolution recursion x = eps*lambda(1-rho(1-x)) for given degree polynomials. The threshold comes from the fixed-point condition by root finding, and is compared with the area theorem and the capacity gap.

math/info_stats|quad_models.title: BI-AWGN capacity via Gauss-Hermite quadrature versus sum-product decoding thresholds
math/info_stats|quad_models.gist: Compute binary-input AWGN capacity as 1 - E[log2(1+e^{-L})] with Gauss-Hermite quadrature to obtain the Shannon limit Eb/N0 for a code rate. Compare it with a Monte Carlo sum-product decoding threshold on a small regular Tanner graph.

math/info_stats|quad_models.title: Coded-modulation capacity of PAM and QAM constellations via Gauss-Hermite quadrature
math/info_stats|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the constellation-constrained mutual information of M-PAM and square QAM in AWGN using product Gauss-Hermite quadrature of the log-sum-exp likelihood ratio. Report the gap to Shannon capacity versus SNR.

math/info_stats|quad_models.title: I-MMSE relation for BPSK and Gaussian inputs in AWGN
math/info_stats|quad_models.gist: Compute the MMSE of a BPSK input, 1 - E[tanh(snr + sqrt(snr) Z)], by Gauss-Hermite quadrature and integrate it over snr. Verify the Guo-Shamai-Verdu identity I(snr) = 0.5 * integral of mmse against directly computed mutual information.

math/info_stats|quad_models.title: Ergodic and outage capacity of Rayleigh and Nakagami-m fading channels
math/info_stats|quad_models.gist: Evaluate ergodic capacity in closed form using the exponential integral, e^{1/snr} E1(1/snr), and for Nakagami-m by numerical quadrature against the gamma density. Compute outage capacity from the incomplete gamma inverse and compare both with Monte Carlo.

math/info_stats|quad_models.title: Differential entropy and Fisher information of the Rician distribution for MRI magnitude
math/info_stats|quad_models.gist: Compute the differential entropy and Fisher information of the Rician amplitude pdf by adaptive quadrature with scaled Bessel I0 and I1. Use them to quantify noise-floor bias and the Cramer-Rao bound for SNR estimation from MRI magnitude data.

math/info_stats|quad_models.title: Entropy rate of a binary Markov source observed through a BSC
math/info_stats|quad_models.gist: Bound the entropy rate of the hidden Markov output using conditional block entropies H(Y_n|Y^{n-1}) computed by forward recursion. Estimate it accurately by integrating the binary entropy over a numerically approximated Blackwell measure, and compare with the Ordentlich-Weissman high-SNR expansion.

math/info_stats|quad_models.title: Lempel-Ziv complexity of the logistic map versus Pesin entropy
math/info_stats|quad_models.gist: Compute the Lyapunov exponent of the logistic map at r=4 by quadrature over the invariant density 1/(pi sqrt(x(1-x))) and at other r by orbit averaging. Compare it with the Kolmogorov-Sinai entropy estimated from LZ76 complexity and block entropies of the binary symbolic sequence.

math/info_stats|quad_models.title: Expected periodogram bias as Fejer-kernel convolution for AR(2) spectra
math/info_stats|quad_models.gist: Compute the exact expected periodogram of a narrowband AR(2) process by quadrature of the true PSD convolved with the Fejer kernel, or with a tapered-window spectral kernel. Quantify peak bias and leakage versus record length and compare with Monte Carlo averages.

math/info_stats|quad_models.title: Kaiser window figures of merit via Bessel functions and quadrature
math/info_stats|quad_models.gist: Build the continuous Kaiser window from I0 and evaluate its spectrum by numerical Fourier quadrature. From it compute equivalent noise bandwidth, scalloping loss, the highest sidelobe level and the processing loss as functions of beta, then compare with Hann and Blackman windows.

math/info_stats|quad_models.title: Equivalent degrees of freedom and variance of Welch estimates with overlap
math/info_stats|quad_models.gist: Compute the variance of Welch PSD estimates using Welch's formula built from squared window autocorrelation sums at the segment offsets. Derive the chi-square equivalent degrees of freedom and confidence intervals versus overlap fraction, then validate on simulated white and colored noise.

math/info_stats|quad_models.title: Aliasing error for sampled Gaussian and Lorentzian pulses with sinc reconstruction
math/info_stats|quad_models.gist: Compute the out-of-band energy fraction of Gaussian (via erfc) and Lorentzian (via exponential) pulses, and the resulting aliasing error bound. Compare it with the actual L2 error of truncated sinc-series reconstruction, evaluated by quadrature, as a function of sampling rate.

math/info_stats|quad_models.title: Kaiser-windowed sinc polyphase filter design for rational sample-rate conversion
math/info_stats|quad_models.gist: Design a lowpass prototype for L/M resampling using Kaiser's empirical beta and length formulas, then split it into polyphase branches. Compute passband ripple and stopband attenuation by evaluating the frequency response on a dense grid, and verify the resampling error on test tones.

math/info_stats|quad_models.title: Clock-jitter-limited SNR of ADC sampling for band-limited inputs
math/info_stats|quad_models.gist: Derive the jitter-induced noise power for a Gaussian-jittered sampler as an integral of the signal PSD times 2(1 - exp(-omega^2 sigma^2 / 2)), evaluated by quadrature for flat and Lorentzian input spectra. Compare with the sinusoid formula -20 log10(2 pi f sigma) and with simulation.

math/info_stats|quad_models.title: Daubechies filters by spectral factorization and scaling-function values at dyadic points
math/info_stats|quad_models.gist: Obtain Daubechies-N filter coefficients by rooting the Bezout polynomial and selecting the minimum-phase factorization, then check perfect-reconstruction and vanishing-moment conditions. Compute the scaling function at integers via the eigenvector of the refinement matrix and refine to dyadic points.

math/info_stats|quad_models.title: Morlet wavelet admissibility constant and CWT ridge frequency of a chirp
math/info_stats|quad_models.gist: Compute the admissibility constant and the true center frequency of a corrected Morlet wavelet by quadrature. Then build the CWT scalogram of a linear chirp by direct numerical convolution and extract the ridge, comparing the recovered instantaneous frequency with the analytic chirp law.

math/info_stats|quad_models.title: Minimax and SURE thresholds for wavelet soft-thresholding under Gaussian noise
math/info_stats|quad_models.gist: Compute the exact risk of soft thresholding for a single Gaussian coefficient in closed form using Phi and phi, and find the Donoho-Johnstone minimax threshold by optimization. Apply SURE and universal thresholds to Haar or Daubechies denoising of test signals and compare MSE.

math/info_stats|quad_models.title: Uniform circular array beampattern and directivity index via spherical quadrature
math/info_stats|quad_models.gist: Compute the far-field response of a uniform circular array, including its Bessel-J phase-mode expansion. Integrate the power pattern over the sphere with Gauss-Legendre in elevation and the trapezoid rule in azimuth to get the directivity index, then study grating lobes versus radius-to-wavelength ratio.

math/info_stats|quad_models.title: Superdirective MVDR beamforming in spherically diffuse noise with diagonal loading
math/info_stats|quad_models.gist: Build the diffuse-noise coherence matrix sinc(k d_ij) for a linear microphone array and compute MVDR weights with diagonal loading. Trace the trade-off between directivity factor and white-noise gain over frequency and loading level.

math/info_stats|quad_models.title: Cramer-Rao bound versus MUSIC and Capon DOA errors for ULA
math/info_stats|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the closed-form stochastic CRB for direction of arrival of one or two uncorrelated sources on a uniform linear array. Compare it with the Monte Carlo RMSE of MUSIC and Capon spectral peak estimates, located by refined grid search, across SNR to expose the threshold region.

math/info_stats|quad_models.title: Fisher LDA error rate versus Bayes error for heteroscedastic Gaussian classes
math/info_stats|quad_models.gist: Compute the Fisher discriminant direction from the between-class and within-class scatter generalized eigenproblem, with its error given in closed form via Phi. Compute the Bayes quadratic-boundary error by 2D quadrature and the Bhattacharyya and Chernoff bounds by 1D optimization.

math/info_stats|quad_models.title: AMUSE separation of AR sources using analytic lagged covariances
math/info_stats|quad_models.gist: Compute the exact lagged covariances of AR(1)/AR(2) sources by quadrature of their PSDs (Wiener-Khinchin), mix them, and solve the AMUSE generalized eigenproblem. Evaluate the Amari performance index for the analytic and sample-based estimates, including near-degenerate lag spectra.

math/info_stats|quad_models.title: EM for von Mises mixtures with Bessel-ratio concentration updates
math/info_stats|quad_models.gist: Fit a mixture of von Mises distributions to circular data, such as wind directions or dihedral angles, by EM. The M-step inverts A(kappa) = I1(kappa)/I0(kappa) with scaled Bessel functions and Newton root finding, and the log-likelihood is monitored for monotonicity, with BIC used to choose the number of components.

physics/quantum_mech|linalg.title: Hulthén potential s- and l>0 levels: Sturmian diagonalization versus analytic
physics/quantum_mech|linalg.gist: Expand the Hulthén potential V = -V0 e^{-r/a}/(1-e^{-r/a}) in a Laguerre basis and compute matrix elements by quadrature. Compare the s-wave eigenvalues with the exact Hulthén formula, then report l = 1, 2 levels and the convergence rate versus basis size and Sturmian exponent.
physics/quantum_mech|linalg.area: Bound states in central potentials via Laguerre bases

physics/quantum_mech|linalg.title: Wigner functions of double-well eigenstates and tunneling dynamics
physics/quantum_mech|linalg.gist: Obtain the lowest eigenstates of a symmetric quartic double well by sparse diagonalization. Compute their Wigner functions and negativity, then track the Wigner function of a localized superposition through one tunneling period set by the ground-state splitting.

physics/quantum_mech|linalg.title: Two atoms in a 3D harmonic trap: Busch spectrum versus scattering length
physics/quantum_mech|linalg.gist: Separate center-of-mass and relative coordinates and diagonalize the s-wave relative Hamiltonian with a narrow Gaussian interaction on a radial grid. Tune its depth to set the scattering length a, then compare the spectrum E(a) with the roots of the Busch transcendental equation over the full range a/aho from -∞ to +∞.

physics/quantum_mech|linalg.title: 1D trapped atom pair with delta interaction in a Hermite basis
physics/quantum_mech|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the relative Hamiltonian of two atoms in a 1D harmonic trap with contact coupling g using an even-parity Hermite-function basis with analytic matrix elements. Study the slow convergence with basis size, extrapolate to the 1D Busch result, and recover the Tonks-Girardeau limit as g → ∞.

physics/quantum_mech|linalg.title: Landau-Zener transitions by numerical propagation versus the LZ formula
physics/quantum_mech|linalg.gist: Integrate a linearly swept two-level Hamiltonian over a large finite time window using short-step matrix exponentials. Compare the final diabatic transition probability with exp(-2πΔ²/ħα), and analyze finite-window oscillations and the multilevel bow-tie generalization.

physics/quantum_mech|linalg.title: Helium Hartree-Fock via Roothaan equations in an even-tempered Gaussian basis
physics/quantum_mech|linalg.gist: Build the overlap, kinetic, nuclear-attraction and two-electron s-Gaussian integrals analytically for an even-tempered basis. Iterate the closed-shell Roothaan generalized eigenproblem FC = SCε with damping, and converge E toward -2.86168 Eh and ε1s toward -0.918 Eh as the basis grows.
physics/quantum_mech|linalg.area: Hartree-Fock for helium and light atoms

physics/quantum_mech|linalg.title: Quantum kicked rotor quasienergy spacing statistics across the chaos transition
physics/quantum_mech|linalg.gist: Build the Floquet matrix of the kicked rotor on a torus (truncated or resonant momentum basis) and diagonalize it within parity sectors. Compute the mean adjacent-gap ratio ⟨r⟩ of the quasienergies as a function of kick strength K and compare with the Poisson and COE values.

physics/quantum_mech|linalg.title: Reflectionless Bargmann potentials from prescribed bound states via Gel'fand-Levitan-Marchenko
physics/quantum_mech|linalg.gist: For chosen bound-state energies and norming constants, solve the finite linear Marchenko system at each x to build the reflectionless potential. Verify by grid diagonalization that it reproduces the target spectrum, and check the result against the Pöschl-Teller sech² family.

physics/quantum_mech|linalg.title: Fitting model potential parameters to s-wave phase shifts with Lagrange-mesh R-matrix
physics/quantum_mech|linalg.gist: Compute s-wave phase shifts of a parameterized short-range potential with the R-matrix method on a Lagrange-Legendre mesh, which reduces to one linear solve per energy. Recover the potential parameters from noisy synthetic phase shifts by nonlinear least squares, and report parameter covariances and the scattering length.

physics/quantum_mech|linalg.title: Deuteron from central-plus-tensor Yukawa potential via coupled momentum-space equations
physics/quantum_mech|linalg.gist: Discretize the coupled 3S1–3D1 momentum-space Schrödinger and Lippmann–Schwinger equations for a Yukawa central plus tensor interaction, using numerical partial-wave projections and Gauss–Legendre quadrature. Compute the deuteron binding energy, D-state probability, asymptotic D/S ratio and the mixing parameter ε1 from the 2×2 S-matrix.

physics/quantum_mech|linalg.title: Hydrogen spectrum in momentum space with Landé subtraction of the Coulomb singularity
physics/quantum_mech|linalg.gist: Build a Nyström matrix for the l-projected momentum-space Coulomb kernel, which contains Legendre-Q logarithmic singularities. Apply the Landé subtraction, then diagonalize to obtain the −1/2n² levels and compare against the unsubtracted quadrature convergence.

physics/quantum_mech|linalg.title: Spinless Salpeter Coulomb problem in momentum space and the Herbst critical coupling
physics/quantum_mech|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the semirelativistic Hamiltonian sqrt(p²+m²) − α/r in a momentum-space quadrature basis for s and p waves. Track the ground-state energy versus α and its collapse as α approaches 2/π, and compare with the nonrelativistic Bohr levels.

physics/quantum_mech|linalg.title: p-wave scattering volume and effective range of a Gaussian well via Lagrange-mesh R-matrix
physics/quantum_mech|linalg.gist: Solve the l=1 internal problem on a Legendre Lagrange mesh, form the R-matrix at the channel radius and match to Riccati-Bessel functions to get δ1(k). Extract the scattering volume and p-wave effective range near the threshold where a p-wave bound state appears.
physics/quantum_mech|linalg.area: Low-energy scattering length and effective range

physics/quantum_mech|linalg.title: Cumulative reaction probability of a 2D Eckart-plus-oscillator model by Seideman–Miller trace
physics/quantum_mech|linalg.gist: Build a 2D DVR Hamiltonian for an Eckart barrier coupled to a transverse harmonic mode, with reactant and product absorbing potentials. Compute N(E) = 4 Tr[Γr G Γp G†] from the CAP Green's function and resolve the quantized steps from transverse-mode thresholds.
physics/quantum_mech|linalg.area: Complex absorbing potentials and absorbing boundaries

physics/quantum_mech|linalg.title: One-electron H3²⁺ equilateral ion: Gaussian-basis energy curve and metastability
physics/quantum_mech|linalg.gist: Assemble analytic s-Gaussian overlap, kinetic and three-center nuclear-attraction integrals using the Boys function, then solve the generalized eigenproblem as a function of triangle side length. Locate the local minimum and compare its energy with the H2+ + H+ dissociation asymptote.

physics/quantum_mech|linalg.title: HeH⁺ restricted Hartree–Fock curve in an STO-3G basis
physics/quantum_mech|linalg.gist: Least-squares fit STO-3G contractions to Slater 1s orbitals, then compute all analytic one- and two-electron Gaussian integrals for HeH+. Iterate the Roothaan SCF over bond lengths to obtain the equilibrium distance, total energy and orbital energies.

physics/quantum_mech|linalg.title: HCN–HNC isomerization bending levels on a Legendre DVR
physics/quantum_mech|linalg.gist: Build a Gauss–Legendre DVR Hamiltonian for the bending angle of a model one-dimensional HCN/HNC isomerization potential with a fixed-geometry effective moment of inertia. Compute localized and delocalized bending levels, their probability on each side of the barrier, and the convergence with grid size.

physics/quantum_mech|linalg.title: Asymmetric-top rotational levels of H2O from Wang-symmetrized matrices
physics/quantum_mech|linalg.gist: Construct the rigid asymmetric-rotor Hamiltonian in the symmetric-top |J K⟩ basis using A, B, C constants, block it by Wang symmetry and diagonalize. Assign J_{KaKc} labels and compare with prolate and oblate limits as a function of Ray's asymmetry parameter κ.

physics/quantum_mech|linalg.title: Hydrogen atom in a strong magnetic field: diamagnetic spectrum via Sturmian basis
physics/quantum_mech|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the hydrogen Hamiltonian with paramagnetic and diamagnetic terms in a Coulomb-Sturmian times spherical-harmonic basis at fixed m and parity. Track the low-lying levels from weak field through γ ≈ 1 and compare the ground-state energy with high-field Landau-level asymptotics.
physics/quantum_mech|linalg.area: Landau levels and charged particles in fields

physics/quantum_mech|linalg.title: Critical dipole moment for electron binding by a point dipole
physics/quantum_mech|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the angular operator L² − 2D cosθ in a Legendre basis and find the dipole strength where its lowest eigenvalue reaches −1/4 (D_c ≈ 0.639 a.u.). Then compute bound-state energies of a finite dipole with short-range cutoff above threshold, showing the Efimov-like geometric spectrum.

materials/structure|opt_discrete.title: Equilibrium positions of an edge-dislocation pile-up against a barrier
materials/structure|opt_discrete.gist: Solve the coupled force-balance equations for N edge dislocations pushed against a locked obstacle under applied shear, using Newton's method with an analytic Jacobian. Compare the positions with the zeros of Laguerre polynomials (Eshelby) and compute the stress concentration at the leading dislocation.

materials/structure|opt_discrete.title: Critical resolved shear stress of a dislocation through random point obstacles
materials/structure|opt_discrete.gist: Move a flexible dislocation through a 2D random array of point obstacles of finite strength using a quasistatic Foreman-Makin-style unpinning algorithm. Each pinned arc's breaking angle is checked and the weakest obstacle is released iteratively. Extract the depinning CRSS and compare it with Friedel statistics.

materials/structure|opt_discrete.title: Passing stress of an edge-dislocation dipole on neighboring slip planes
materials/structure|opt_discrete.gist: Use the isotropic elastic interaction force between two parallel edge dislocations on slip planes separated by h. Find the stable equilibrium angle by root finding and the maximum glide force by bracketing optimization. This gives the dipole passing (flip) stress as a function of h.

materials/structure|opt_discrete.title: Fitting Born-von Karman force constants of fcc nickel to neutron dispersion
materials/structure|opt_discrete.gist: Build the fcc dynamical matrix with first- and second-neighbor axially symmetric force constants and diagonalize it along Γ-X-K-Γ-L. Fit the constants to tabulated phonon frequencies by nonlinear least squares, then report the fitted constants and the elastic constants they imply.

materials/structure|opt_discrete.title: Locating van Hove critical points in honeycomb-lattice phonon bands
materials/structure|opt_discrete.gist: For a graphene-like honeycomb force-constant model, compute branch frequencies and analytic group velocities. Find the k-points where the gradient of ω(k) vanishes using multi-start Newton iteration in the Brillouin zone, then classify each as a minimum, maximum or saddle and report the singular frequencies of the DOS.

materials/structure|opt_discrete.title: Most compact supercell by Hermite normal form enumeration
materials/structure|opt_discrete.gist: Enumerate all integer supercell matrices of a given determinant N as Hermite normal forms. Rank each resulting cell by its shortest periodic-image distance or by its deviation from a cube, and return the optimal transformation matrix for a defect calculation in a hexagonal or fcc primitive cell.

materials/structure|opt_discrete.title: Surface slab basis for arbitrary Miller indices via extended Euclid and reduction
materials/structure|opt_discrete.gist: For a given (hkl) in a cubic or hexagonal lattice, construct two integer in-plane vectors with the extended Euclidean algorithm and reduce them with 2D Gauss/LLL reduction. Choose the out-of-plane vector, and compute the interplanar spacing and the number of layers needed to reach a target slab thickness.

materials/structure|opt_discrete.title: Periodic duplicate-atom removal using union-find clustering
materials/structure|opt_discrete.gist: After merging or replicating structures, detect atom pairs closer than a tolerance under the minimum-image convention with a cell-list neighbor search. Cluster them with union-find, then replace each cluster with a single species-consistent averaged site, and report the cleaned composition.

materials/structure|opt_discrete.title: Optimal Scherzer-type defocus by maximizing HRTEM contrast transfer pass band
materials/structure|opt_discrete.gist: Use the phase contrast transfer function with spherical aberration and defocus. Root-find its first zero crossing and maximize the width of the band free of zeros over defocus. Then use the chosen defocus in a weak-phase multislice image of a thin crystal.

materials/structure|opt_discrete.title: Gerchberg-Saxton exit-wave phase retrieval from multislice-simulated intensities
materials/structure|opt_discrete.gist: Simulate the exit wave of a thin crystal by FFT multislice, then record its image-plane and diffraction-plane intensities. Recover the phase by alternating Fourier-modulus projections (Gerchberg-Saxton / error reduction) and track how the error decreases with iteration.

materials/structure|opt_discrete.title: Specimen thickness from PACBED pattern matching with multislice
materials/structure|opt_discrete.gist: Compute position-averaged CBED patterns of a crystal versus thickness with a STEM multislice code. Find the thickness that minimizes the chi-squared mismatch to a reference pattern, using a coarse grid followed by golden-section refinement.

materials/structure|opt_discrete.title: Carbon phase stability and transition pressure with Tersoff potential
materials/structure|opt_discrete.gist: Compute E(V) curves for graphite-like layered, diamond and simple-cubic carbon with the Tersoff carbon potential, optimizing internal parameters at each volume. Locate the graphite-diamond transition pressure by root finding of the common-tangent condition.

materials/structure|opt_discrete.title: Pore-limiting diameter of a periodic framework via bottleneck path search
materials/structure|opt_discrete.gist: Voxelize a periodic framework and compute the periodic distance-to-nearest-atom-surface field. Bisect on probe radius and test for a percolating connected path along each axis with BFS/union-find, which gives the pore-limiting diameter.

materials/structure|opt_discrete.title: Steady-state vacancy and interstitial concentrations under irradiation with sinks
materials/structure|opt_discrete.gist: Write rate-theory balance equations with Frenkel-pair production, mutual recombination and sink absorption at dislocations. Solve for the steady-state point-defect concentrations versus temperature and dose rate by Newton's method, identifying the recombination- and sink-dominated regimes.

materials/structure|opt_discrete.title: Threshold displacement energy by bisection in a Morse-lattice recoil simulation
materials/structure|opt_discrete.gist: Give an atom in a 2D Morse-potential triangular lattice a recoil kick and integrate the motion with velocity-Verlet. Classify the final state as a stable Frenkel pair or a recovered lattice, and bisect on recoil energy to find the direction-dependent threshold displacement energy.

materials/structure|opt_discrete.title: Enumerating close-packed polytypes up to equivalence via Zhdanov symbols
materials/structure|opt_discrete.gist: Enumerate all ABC stacking sequences of period N, excluding sequences with repeated adjacent layers. Reduce them to distinct polytypes under cyclic shift, reversal and relabeling using canonical necklace forms, and report the count, Zhdanov symbol and hexagonality of each.

materials/structure|opt_discrete.title: ANNNI-model ground-state polytypes and stacking fault energies in SiC
materials/structure|opt_discrete.gist: Use an axial next-nearest-neighbor Ising model with interactions J1, J2 and J3 between layer spins. Find the minimum-energy stacking among all sequences up to period N by exhaustive enumeration, map the phase diagram in J-space, and compute intrinsic and extrinsic stacking fault energies of 3C.

materials/structure|opt_discrete.title: Generalized stacking fault curve of Lennard-Jones fcc along <112>
materials/structure|opt_discrete.gist: Shear a slab of fcc LJ atoms rigidly across a (111) plane along <112>, relaxing atom positions normal to the plane at each displacement. Locate the intrinsic stacking fault minimum and the unstable stacking fault maximum by Brent optimization.

materials/structure|opt_discrete.title: Oriani equilibrium partitioning of hydrogen among multiple trap types
materials/structure|opt_discrete.gist: Given total hydrogen content, trap densities and binding energies, solve the Fermi-Dirac-like local equilibrium together with mass balance for the lattice occupancy using bracketed root finding. Output trap occupancies and the effective diffusivity versus temperature.
materials/structure|opt_discrete.area: Hydrogen and solute trapping in metals

materials/structure|opt_discrete.title: Grain-boundary solute segregation spectrum with bulk depletion in finite grains
materials/structure|opt_discrete.gist: Model segregation as a spectrum of grain-boundary sites with a distribution of segregation energies, each following a McLean/Fermi-Dirac isotherm. Solve the self-consistent mass balance for bulk concentration in grains of finite size by root finding, and compute boundary excess versus grain size and temperature.
materials/structure|opt_discrete.area: Hydrogen and solute trapping in metals

materials/structure|opt_discrete.title: Lennard-Jones fcc, hcp and bcc lattice sums and equilibrium lattice constants
materials/structure|opt_discrete.gist: Compute converged LJ lattice sums for fcc, hcp (ideal c/a) and bcc, with a tail correction beyond the cutoff. Solve dE/da = 0 by Newton's method for each structure, and compare the cohesive energies, including the small fcc-hcp difference.
materials/structure|opt_discrete.area: Pair potentials for metals and noble gases

materials/structure|opt_discrete.title: Ideal tensile strength of Lennard-Jones fcc under [100] uniaxial loading
materials/structure|opt_discrete.gist: Apply uniaxial strain along [100] to an LJ fcc crystal using Cauchy-Born lattice sums, minimizing over lateral strains at each step. Find the peak tensile stress and the corresponding critical strain by bracketed maximization.
materials/structure|opt_discrete.area: Pair potentials for metals and noble gases

math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.title: Greedy P-greedy center selection for Gaussian RBF interpolation
math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.gist: From a dense candidate set in the unit square, greedily add the center that maximizes the power function, using an incrementally updated Newton basis (pivoted Cholesky). Record the power-function decay and the interpolation error for a peaks test function versus the number of centers.
math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.area: Moving least squares and scattered data fitting

math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.title: Hankel-type integral via Bessel zeros and Wynn epsilon acceleration
math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.gist: Compute ∫_0^∞ x J0(ax)/(x^2+b^2)^{1/2} dx. Find the zeros of J0 with Newton-bracketed iterations, integrate between consecutive zeros with Gauss-Legendre, and accelerate the alternating partial sums with Wynn's epsilon algorithm. Compare with the closed form e^{-ab}/a.

math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.title: Spectrum slicing of beam vibration modes via LDL^T inertia and bisection
math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.gist: For the generalized eigenproblem K - σM of a finite-element Euler-Bernoulli beam, count the eigenvalues below a shift σ using Sylvester inertia from a symmetric indefinite (Bunch-Kaufman) LDL^T factorization. Bisect on σ to isolate the k-th natural frequency, and compare with the analytic frequencies.
math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.area: Cholesky and LDL^T for symmetric systems

math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.title: Moré-Sorensen trust-region subproblem solver including the hard case
math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.gist: Solve min g^T p + ½p^T B p subject to ||p||≤Δ for indefinite B. Apply Newton's method to the secular equation 1/||p(λ)|| - 1/Δ, using a Cholesky factorization of B+λI at each step. Detect the hard case and handle it with an eigenvector step. Embed the solver in a trust-region method for the extended Rosenbrock function.
math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.area: Cholesky and LDL^T for symmetric systems

math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.title: Polynomial Remez algorithm for |x| and the Bernstein constant
math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.gist: Compute minimax polynomial approximations of |x| on [-1,1] by the Remez exchange algorithm. Locate the error extrema with Brent's method on Chebyshev-basis evaluations. Extrapolate n·E_n toward the Bernstein constant ≈0.2802, and compare with the error of Chebyshev interpolation.

math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.title: Approximate Fekete points on the triangle via QR column pivoting
math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.gist: Extract approximate Fekete points for total-degree-n interpolation on the reference triangle. Apply greedy column-pivoted QR to the transposed Vandermonde matrix of a Dubiner orthogonal basis on a fine admissible mesh. Report the Lebesgue constants and compare them with equispaced triangular lattices.

math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.title: Locating the Runge convergence boundary with logarithmic potential theory
math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.gist: For equispaced interpolation of 1/(1+(x/ε)^2), use root finding on the logarithmic potential of the uniform node density to compute the real interval where interpolation converges. Do this as a function of ε, then verify the boundary numerically with high-precision barycentric interpolation (e.g., 0.7266 for the classic case).

math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.title: CG on grounded spring networks: Chebyshev versus outlier-deflated bounds
math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.gist: Solve stiffness systems from grounded random geometric spring networks with conjugate gradients. Compare the observed A-norm error decay with the classical Chebyshev bound and with a bound that assigns polynomial roots to the few largest outlying eigenvalues. Quantify how clustering affects the iteration count.

math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.title: Polak-Ribière nonlinear CG for the Thomson problem on the sphere
math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.gist: Minimize the Coulomb energy of N point charges on the unit sphere with nonlinear conjugate gradients (PR+ restarts and a strong-Wolfe line search), using a spherical-coordinate or projected-gradient parametrization. Compare the final energies with known minima (e.g., N=12: 49.165) and with steepest descent.

math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.title: TT-cross with maxvol pivoting for high-dimensional Genz integrals
math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.gist: Approximate a d-dimensional Genz oscillatory or product-peak function on a tensor Gauss-Legendre grid with TT-cross interpolation. Choose the index sets with the greedy maxvol algorithm. Contract with the quadrature weights to compute the integral, and compare it with the analytic value and with Monte Carlo.
math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.area: Tensor trains and low-rank tensor arithmetic

math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.title: CP-ALS discovery of rank-7 decompositions of the 2×2 matrix multiplication tensor
math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.gist: Fit rank-R CP decompositions of the 4×4×4 matrix-multiplication tensor using regularized alternating least squares with random restarts. Show that R=7 reaches near-zero residual (a Strassen-type algorithm) while R=6 stalls, and report the residuals across the restarts.
math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.area: Tensor trains and low-rank tensor arithmetic

math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.title: Newton iteration near multiple roots with compensated Horner evaluation
math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.gist: Apply Newton's method to the expanded form of (x-0.75)^5(x-1)^m. Evaluate the polynomial and its derivative with standard Horner and with error-free-transformation compensated Horner (TwoSum/TwoProd). Compare the attainable root accuracy with the a priori bounds that involve cond(p,x).
math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.area: Floating-point error analysis and compensated summation

math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.title: Coifman-Wickerhauser best-basis selection for wavelet packet compression
math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the full Daubechies-4 wavelet packet tree of a chirp-plus-transient signal. Select the best basis by bottom-up dynamic programming on an additive Shannon entropy cost. Compare the N-term compression error curves of the best basis, the DWT and the DCT.

math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.title: Palser-Manolopoulos canonical purification for the density matrix of a Hückel graphene flake
math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.gist: Build the Hückel Hamiltonian of a hydrogen-terminated graphene flake and obtain the half-filled density matrix by trace-conserving canonical (McWeeny-type) purification. Report idempotency error per iteration, the iteration count versus HOMO-LUMO gap, and the band energy compared with diagonalization.
math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.area: Matrix functions: exponential, logarithm, square root

math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.title: Denman-Beavers versus Newton-Schulz inverse square roots for Löwdin orthogonalization
math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.gist: Compute S^{-1/2} for overlap matrices of even-tempered s-type Gaussian bases with growing near-linear dependence. Use the coupled Denman-Beavers iteration and the inverse-free Newton-Schulz iteration, and compare convergence, orthonormality error and stability against an eigendecomposition reference as the condition number of S grows.
math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.area: Matrix functions: exponential, logarithm, square root

math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.title: Newton pth root of an annual credit-rating transition matrix for monthly transitions
math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the principal 12th root of a rating-migration stochastic matrix with a stable Newton iteration for matrix pth roots (Iannazzo) started inside the convergence region. Check row sums and the negativity of entries, then regularize to the nearest stochastic matrix and report the resulting error in the annual matrix.
math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.area: Matrix functions: exponential, logarithm, square root

math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.title: Golden-section search for the optimal SOR parameter of the 13-point biharmonic plate
math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.gist: Discretize the clamped-plate biharmonic equation with the 13-point stencil, which lacks property A, so Young's formula does not apply. Minimize the spectral radius of the SOR iteration matrix over ω by golden-section search and compare the optimum and iteration counts with Gauss-Seidel.
math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.area: Stationary iterative methods: Jacobi, Gauss-Seidel, SOR

math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.title: Boyd's trigonometric companion matrix for all roots of periodic functions
math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.gist: Interpolate a smooth periodic function, such as the equilibrium condition of a bead on a rotating hoop, by an FFT trigonometric interpolant. Map it to a polynomial in z = e^{iθ} and find all real roots from companion eigenvalues on the unit circle, refining them with Newton. Report root accuracy versus interpolation degree.
math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.area: Trigonometric interpolation and periodic trapezoidal rule

math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.title: Kabsch SVD superposition and minimal RMSD between molecular conformers
math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.gist: Solve the orthogonal Procrustes problem for two conformations of a small molecule via SVD of the cross-covariance matrix, with the determinant correction that excludes reflections. Verify optimality against a quaternion eigenvalue formulation and random rotations, and report the minimal RMSD.

math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.title: Fiedler sweep cuts and Cheeger inequality verification on dumbbell and lattice graphs
math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.gist: Compute Fiedler vectors with Lanczos, sort the vertices and sweep all prefix cuts to minimize conductance. Compare against the exact Cheeger constant from exhaustive enumeration on small graphs, and check that λ2/2 ≤ h ≤ sqrt(2λ2) holds.

math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.title: Closest-point projection onto a Bézier curve via subdivision and Newton refinement
math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.gist: Find the global minimum distance from query points to a high-degree planar Bézier curve. Prune candidate parameter intervals by de Casteljau subdivision with convex-hull distance bounds, then refine with Newton on (C(t)-p)·C'(t) = 0. Compare robustness with naive Newton from uniform starting guesses.

math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.title: Minimal bending-energy cubic Bézier interpolation of G1 Hermite data
math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.gist: For given endpoints and unit tangents, optimize the two tangent-length parameters of a cubic Bézier curve to minimize ∫κ² ds, with the energy evaluated by Gauss-Legendre quadrature and minimized with scipy. Compare the result with the exact Euler elastica arc and with standard length heuristics.

math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.title: QDWH dynamically weighted Halley polar decomposition and spectral divide-and-conquer
math/nla_approx|opt_discrete.gist: Implement the QR-based dynamically weighted Halley iteration for the polar factor, choosing weights from condition-number estimates. Use it to split a symmetric matrix spectrum at a shift via the invariant-subspace projector (I+U)/2, recursing to full eigendecomposition. Verify the bound of about six iterations and compare backward errors with eigh.

physics/many_body|ode.title: One-loop O(N) plus cubic anisotropy flows and fixed-point stability
physics/many_body|ode.gist: Integrate the ε-expansion beta functions for the isotropic u and cubic v quartic couplings in d = 4−ε. Find the Gaussian, Ising, Heisenberg and cubic fixed points and their stability-matrix eigenvalues. Determine the crossover N_c and the leading-order exponents ν and η.

physics/many_body|ode.title: Zero-dimensional φ^4 functional RG versus the exact partition function
physics/many_body|ode.gist: Solve the Wetterich PDE for the effective potential of a 0D φ^4 'field theory' by the method of lines on a φ grid with a stiff ODE solver. Compare the resulting ⟨φ^2⟩ and 1PI vertices with numerical quadrature of the exact one-dimensional integral over a range of couplings.

physics/many_body|ode.title: g-ology one-loop RG of the 1D electron gas and spin-gap formation
physics/many_body|ode.gist: Integrate the one-loop flow equations for the backscattering g_1, forward g_2 and umklapp g_3 couplings of the half-filled 1D Hubbard-like model. Classify the regimes (Luttinger liquid, spin gap, charge gap) and estimate gap scales from the divergence length.

physics/many_body|ode.title: Wegner flow equation diagonalization of the reduced BCS pairing Hamiltonian
physics/many_body|ode.gist: Integrate the Wegner flow dH/dl = [[H_d, H], H] as a matrix ODE for the picket-fence pairing model in a small seniority-zero many-body basis. Track the decay of the off-diagonal norm and the convergence of the flowing diagonal to the exact ground-state and pair-excitation energies from ED.

physics/many_body|ode.title: Fixed-node energies of a 1D anharmonic first excited state with misplaced node
physics/many_body|ode.gist: For the quartic-plus-harmonic oscillator, impose a trial node at x0 and solve the Schrödinger equation in each nodal pocket with Dirichlet conditions by Numerov shooting. The fixed-node energy is the lower pocket ground energy. Map E_FN(x0) against the exact E_1 and verify that it is quadratic in the node error.

physics/many_body|ode.title: Fixed-node DMC for two spin-polarized electrons in a 2D parabolic quantum dot
physics/many_body|ode.gist: Obtain the exact |m| = 1 relative-motion energy of two Coulomb-interacting electrons in a 2D harmonic trap by radial shooting. Run importance-sampled fixed-node DMC with the noninteracting Slater-determinant node, rejecting node-crossing moves, and compare E_FN with the exact energy as a function of timestep.

physics/many_body|ode.title: Majorana edge correlations after a quench in the open Kitaev chain
physics/many_body|ode.gist: Integrate the time-dependent Bogoliubov-de Gennes equations for an open Kitaev wire quenched from the trivial to the topological regime. Compute the end-to-end Majorana correlation and the bulk-edge spectral weight, and compare with exact matrix exponentiation of the single-particle BdG Hamiltonian.

physics/many_body|ode.title: He-He Aziz potential: dimer binding energy and s-wave scattering length
physics/many_body|ode.gist: Solve the radial Schrödinger equation for the HFDHE2 or HFD-B Aziz potential using Numerov with a short-range hard-core start. Find the extremely weakly bound He_2 state (~mK) by shooting and the zero-energy scattering length from the asymptotic phase, then check convergence in grid spacing and matching radius.

physics/many_body|ode.title: Lowest-order constrained variational equation of state for liquid helium-4
physics/many_body|ode.gist: Solve the LOCV Euler-Lagrange equation for the Jastrow correlation f(r) as an ODE eigenvalue problem with healing conditions f(d) = 1, f'(d) = 0 and the normalization constraint fixing d. Use the Aziz potential, compute E/N versus density, and locate the saturation density.

physics/many_body|ode.title: Adiabatic ramp fidelity in a 12-site Kitaev honeycomb cluster
physics/many_body|ode.gist: Integrate the time-dependent Schrödinger equation while ramping K_z from the decoupled-dimer limit into the gapless phase in a fixed flux sector of a small honeycomb cluster. Compute the final ground-state fidelity and plaquette flux expectations versus ramp time, and identify Landau-Zener scaling near small gaps.

physics/many_body|ode.title: Classical Landau-Lifshitz spin dynamics on a kagome Heisenberg cluster
physics/many_body|ode.gist: Sample low-temperature classical states of the kagome antiferromagnet by Monte Carlo, then integrate dS_i/dt = S_i × h_i with an energy- and norm-conserving RK scheme. Compute the spin autocorrelation and the dynamical structure factor S(q, ω), showing the weathervane zero-mode signature.

physics/many_body|ode.title: Hybrid Monte Carlo for a lattice anharmonic oscillator with blocking error analysis
physics/many_body|ode.gist: Sample the Euclidean path integral of the quartic oscillator by HMC with leapfrog integration and a Metropolis accept/reject step. Measure ⟨x^2⟩ and the ground-state energy via the virial estimator. Apply Flyvbjerg-Petersen blocking and integrated autocorrelation time estimates as functions of trajectory length and step size.

physics/many_body|ode.title: Real-time TDVP Gaussian wavepacket in an anharmonic potential
physics/many_body|ode.gist: Derive and integrate the McLachlan/TDVP equations S θ̇ = −iF for a complex Gaussian ansatz (width, center, momentum, phase) in a quartic potential, with S and F computed by quadrature. Compare ⟨x(t)⟩ and the fidelity with a split-operator FFT reference solution.

physics/many_body|ode.title: Lipkin-Meshkov-Glick model: semiclassical dynamical transition and gap scaling
physics/many_body|ode.gist: Integrate the classical mean-field spin equations of the LMG model after field quenches to locate the dynamical critical quench via the time-averaged magnetization. Compute the ED gap versus N at the ground-state critical point and fit the finite-size exponent Δ ∝ N^{−1/3}.
physics/many_body|ode.area: Finite-size scaling of quantum critical points

physics/many_body|ode.title: Richardson equations solved by ODE continuation in the pairing coupling
physics/many_body|ode.gist: For the picket-fence reduced BCS model, convert the Richardson equations into ODEs for the pair rapidities as functions of g, starting from the g → 0 limit. Integrate through the singular points using a change of variables, and compare the ground-state energy with ED and with BCS theory.

physics/many_body|ode.title: Halperin-Lubensky-Ma flows: charged fixed points need n > 365.9
physics/many_body|ode.gist: Integrate the one-loop epsilon-expansion flows of the quartic coupling and gauge charge for an n-component Ginzburg-Landau superconductor. Locate the critical n_c where real charged fixed points appear, and show runaway (fluctuation-induced first-order) trajectories below it.

physics/many_body|ode.title: Stiff-ODE versus Krylov imaginary-time projection for a sawtooth Heisenberg ring
physics/many_body|ode.gist: Project a random state toward the ground state of a 12-site spin-1/2 sawtooth (delta) chain by integrating the normalized imaginary-time Schrödinger ODE three ways: explicit RK45, implicit BDF and expm_multiply Krylov propagation. Compare energy convergence rates with the exact singlet-triplet gap.

physics/many_body|ode.title: Overhauser screened-pair model: on-top pair density g(0) of the electron gas
physics/many_body|ode.gist: Solve the zero-energy radial Schrödinger equation (Numerov, l = 0, 1, 2) for two electrons interacting via the Overhauser potential of a uniformly charged sphere of radius r_s. Build the spin-resolved g(0) for several r_s and compare with the Kimball cusp relation and QMC-parametrized values.
physics/many_body|ode.area: Homogeneous electron gas in periodic boxes

physics/many_body|ode.title: Unitary Fermi gas pair Jastrow from the square-well two-body equation
physics/many_body|ode.gist: Tune a square-well depth to infinite scattering length. Then solve the finite-energy radial boundary-value problem with healing condition f'(R)=0 at half the box length by shooting. Tabulate the resulting BCS-pair/Jastrow function and its effective-range dependence for use in QMC trial states.

physics/many_body|ode.title: SRG evolution of the Malfliet-Tjon s-wave potential in momentum space
physics/many_body|ode.gist: Discretize the 3S1 Malfliet-Tjon potential on a Gauss-Legendre momentum mesh. Integrate the similarity-renormalization-group flow dH/ds = [[T,H],H] with a stiff ODE solver. Check that the deuteron energy stays invariant while off-diagonal matrix elements decouple, and quantify the speedup of convergence in a truncated basis.

physics/condensed_matter|ode.title: Quantum Hall edge-state dispersion in graphene near a zigzag boundary
physics/condensed_matter|ode.gist: Solve the continuum Dirac-Landau-level ODE (parabolic-cylinder type) with zigzag boundary conditions by shooting in the guiding-center coordinate. Compute how the n=0 and n=±1 levels disperse as the guiding center approaches the edge, and count the edge channels at a given Fermi energy.

physics/condensed_matter|ode.title: Amplitude-mode dynamics of a Peierls chain after a hopping quench
physics/condensed_matter|ode.gist: Integrate the coupled Ehrenfest equations for the SSH single-particle density matrix and the classical lattice dimerization with an RK solver after a sudden change of electron-phonon coupling. Extract the amplitude-mode oscillation frequency and its damping, and compare them with 2Δ.
physics/condensed_matter|ode.area: Charge density waves and Peierls instability

physics/condensed_matter|ode.title: McMillan discommensuration lattice in a nearly commensurate CDW
physics/condensed_matter|ode.gist: Solve the sine-Gordon BVP for the CDW phase with an incommensurability term on a periodic cell, using shooting or solve_bvp. Compute the soliton-lattice profile, its energy per length versus soliton density, and the commensurate-incommensurate critical mismatch.
physics/condensed_matter|ode.area: Charge density waves and Peierls instability

physics/condensed_matter|ode.title: Anharmonic soft-mode spectrum of a quartic double-well phonon via Numerov
physics/condensed_matter|ode.gist: Solve the 1D Schrödinger equation for a frozen-phonon double-well potential with Numerov shooting to obtain the low-lying levels. Compute temperature-dependent thermal averages ⟨u²⟩, transition-frequency spectra and the effective renormalized mode frequency.

physics/condensed_matter|ode.title: Volume-dependent zone-boundary phonon and mode Grüneisen from frozen-phonon ODE
physics/condensed_matter|ode.gist: For a 1D Lennard-Jones chain, numerically integrate the classical equation of motion of the zone-boundary frozen-phonon coordinate at several lattice constants to obtain amplitude-dependent frequencies. Derive the harmonic limit, the mode Grüneisen parameter and the quasi-harmonic equilibrium spacing versus T.

physics/condensed_matter|ode.title: Quasi-1D exciton in a carbon nanotube with regularized Coulomb potential
physics/condensed_matter|ode.gist: Solve the 1D Schrödinger equation with V=-e²/(ε√(x²+R²)) for even and odd states by parity-resolved shooting. Compute the ground-state binding energy versus tube radius, showing the logarithmic divergence as R→0 (Loudon problem).

physics/condensed_matter|ode.title: Sommerfeld enhancement of 2D band-edge absorption from continuum exciton states
physics/condensed_matter|ode.gist: Integrate the radial 2D Schrödinger equation at positive energies, normalize the scattering states by asymptotic matching, and evaluate |ψ(0)|² to obtain the Elliott absorption spectrum. Compare the Coulomb and Keldysh potentials against the analytic 2D Sommerfeld factor.

physics/condensed_matter|ode.title: Mathieu-potential band structure from Floquet monodromy integration
physics/condensed_matter|ode.gist: Integrate two fundamental solutions of ψ''+(E-2V0 cos 2x)ψ=0 over one period to get the Floquet discriminant. Find band edges and gaps by root finding, and compare them with nearly-free-electron and tight-binding limits.

physics/condensed_matter|ode.title: Magnon dispersion from Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert dynamics of a Heisenberg chain
physics/condensed_matter|ode.gist: Integrate the LLG equations for a classical anisotropic Heisenberg ferromagnetic chain from small random tilts. Fourier-transform m(x,t) to extract ω(k) and linewidths, and compare them with linear spin-wave theory and Gilbert damping.

physics/condensed_matter|ode.title: Localization length of elastic waves in a randomly layered rod
physics/condensed_matter|ode.gist: Integrate the 1D wave equation (ρu_tt=(Eu_x)_x) at fixed frequency through a medium with random layer densities by RK propagation of displacement and stress. Compute the frequency-dependent Lyapunov exponent and verify the ω^{-2} low-frequency scaling of the localization length.
physics/condensed_matter|ode.area: Disorder, Anderson localization and transfer matrices

physics/condensed_matter|ode.title: Rashba quantum wire subbands, spin texture and anticrossings
physics/condensed_matter|ode.gist: Solve the transverse ODE eigenproblem for a parabolically confined Rashba wire by finite differences for each k_x. Compute the subband dispersion, the spin-orbit-induced anticrossing gaps between adjacent subbands, and the k-dependent spin expectation values.

physics/condensed_matter|ode.title: Nonlinear FMR foldover and bistability of a driven macrospin
physics/condensed_matter|ode.gist: Integrate the LLG equation for a thin-film macrospin with uniaxial and shape anisotropy under a strong rf field (RK45, lab or rotating frame). Sweep the static field up and down, extract the steady-state precession cone angle, and locate the hysteretic foldover jump fields as a function of rf amplitude.

physics/condensed_matter|ode.title: Current-driven domain wall: q-φ model intrinsic pinning and nonadiabatic β
physics/condensed_matter|ode.gist: Integrate the collective-coordinate (wall position q, tilt angle φ) ODEs for a transverse wall under adiabatic and nonadiabatic spin-transfer torque. Compute the time-averaged wall velocity versus current density, the intrinsic-pinning threshold current at β=0, and the Walker-like oscillatory regime at β≠α.

physics/condensed_matter|ode.title: Toda lattice solitons: velocity–amplitude relation and two-soliton phase shift
physics/condensed_matter|ode.gist: Integrate the Toda chain equations of motion with a symplectic or high-order RK scheme, launching exact one- and two-soliton initial conditions. Measure the soliton speed versus amplitude against sinh(κ)/κ and the collision-induced position shift. Monitor energy conservation and the long-wavelength sound-speed limit.

physics/condensed_matter|ode.title: Shear-horizontal guided modes of a functionally graded elastic plate by shooting
physics/condensed_matter|ode.gist: For a plate whose shear modulus and density vary with depth (e.g. exponential grading), solve the SH displacement ODE with traction-free faces. Use a shooting method plus root finding in frequency at fixed wavenumber to obtain the dispersion branches, cutoff frequencies, and mode shapes. Compare with the homogeneous-plate limit.
physics/condensed_matter|ode.area: Photonic and phononic crystal band structures

physics/condensed_matter|ode.title: Nonlinear phononics: rectified Raman displacement from a resonantly pumped IR mode
physics/condensed_matter|ode.gist: Integrate coupled damped anharmonic oscillator ODEs for an infrared-active mode driven by a Gaussian mid-IR pulse and a Raman mode coupled through a cubic Q_IR²Q_R term. Compute the transient lattice distortion and its quasi-static rectified shift versus pump field and detuning. Compare with the analytic impulsive and displacive limits.

physics/condensed_matter|ode.title: Ultrafast laser demagnetization from the Koopmans microscopic three-temperature model
physics/condensed_matter|ode.gist: Integrate stiff coupled ODEs for electron temperature, lattice temperature and magnetization (M3TM, Elliott-Yafet spin-flip rate) driven by a femtosecond pulse. Extract the demagnetization time, the maximum quench and the recovery dynamics versus fluence. Reproduce the distinction between type I and type II demagnetization behavior.

physics/condensed_matter|ode.title: Shapiro steps of an RCSJ Josephson junction under microwave drive
physics/condensed_matter|ode.gist: Integrate the resistively and capacitively shunted junction phase ODE with dc plus ac current bias over a range of Stewart-McCumber parameters. Compute the time-averaged voltage versus dc current to reveal quantized Shapiro steps at V = nħω/2e. Compare the step widths with the Bessel-function |J_n| prediction in the voltage-biased limit.

physics/quantum_info|quad_models.title: Finite-width pulse XY-8 versus CPMG filter functions under Ornstein-Uhlenbeck noise
physics/quantum_info|quad_models.gist: Derive time-domain modulation functions for XY-8 and CPMG with finite π-pulse duration. Fourier transform them numerically to get filter functions, then integrate against a Lorentzian (OU) spectrum to compare coherence versus pulse duty cycle.

physics/quantum_info|quad_models.title: Uhrig dynamical decoupling suppression order for ohmic exponential-cutoff baths
physics/quantum_info|quad_models.gist: Place UDD pulses at sin² timings and compute the filter function and its low-frequency power-law suppression order. Integrate χ(t) against an ohmic spectrum with exponential cutoff and identify the crossover where UDD beats CPMG as a function of cutoff and pulse number.

physics/quantum_info|quad_models.title: Noise spectroscopy by inverting CPMG decays in the delta-filter approximation
physics/quantum_info|quad_models.gist: Generate synthetic CPMG decays for a spectrum with a Gaussian peak (e.g. a nuclear Larmor line) on a 1/f background using full filter-function quadrature. Reconstruct S(ω) with the Álvarez-Suter delta-function approximation and quantify the reconstruction bias against the true spectrum.

physics/quantum_info|quad_models.title: BLP non-Markovianity of spin-boson pure dephasing for Ohmic-family spectral densities
physics/quantum_info|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the decoherence function Γ(t)=∫J(ω)coth(βω/2)(1-cos ωt)/ω² dω for J∝ω^s e^{-ω/ωc} by quadrature, or via the closed-form gamma-function result at T=0. Compute the BLP measure as the integrated positive trace-distance derivative and locate the s>2 non-Markovian threshold at finite temperature.

physics/quantum_info|quad_models.title: Random telegraph noise dephasing: closed-form coherence and memory measure
physics/quantum_info|quad_models.gist: Use the exact coherence of a qubit coupled to symmetric random telegraph noise, which crosses over from overdamped to oscillatory at strong coupling. Compute trace distance dynamics and the BLP measure versus coupling-to-switching ratio, and identify the Markovian–non-Markovian boundary.

physics/quantum_info|quad_models.title: Fiber-loss entanglement swapping chain: end-to-end fidelity versus distance
physics/quantum_info|quad_models.gist: Model each elementary link with photon transmission e^{-L/L_att}, detector efficiency and depolarization, which together give a Werner parameter and a heralding probability. Compose Bell-measurement swaps over n segments and compute end-to-end fidelity and entanglement-distribution rate. Find the optimal number of nodes for a given total distance.

physics/quantum_info|quad_models.title: Two-mode squeezed vacuum entanglement spectrum from truncated Fock SVD
physics/quantum_info|quad_models.gist: Build the TMSV state in a truncated Fock basis, with optional loss applied to one mode via Kraus operators. Obtain the entanglement spectrum by SVD or reduced-state diagonalization and compare it with the closed-form thermal distribution and entropy, quantifying truncation error versus squeezing r.

physics/quantum_info|quad_models.title: Kitaev chain via Jordan-Wigner: finite qubit spectrum versus elliptic-integral energy
physics/quantum_info|quad_models.gist: Map the Kitaev p-wave chain to a transverse-field XY spin chain by Jordan-Wigner. Diagonalize finite open chains to observe the Majorana zero-mode degeneracy, and compare ground energy density with the momentum integral ∫√((μ+2t cos k)²+4Δ² sin² k)dk, which is evaluated with complete elliptic integrals.

physics/quantum_info|quad_models.title: Single-qubit randomized benchmarking under T1/T2 device decoherence model
physics/quantum_info|quad_models.gist: Model each Clifford gate as ideal unitary followed by combined amplitude damping and dephasing derived from T1, T2 and gate time. Sample random Clifford sequences, average survival probabilities, fit A p^m + B, and compare the extracted average gate error with the closed-form T1/T2 average-fidelity formula.

physics/quantum_info|quad_models.title: Randomized benchmarking with quasi-static Gaussian detuning noise via Gauss-Hermite averaging
physics/quantum_info|quad_models.gist: Model gates with a coherent over-rotation from a static detuning drawn from a Gaussian distribution. Average the per-sequence survival over detuning with Gauss-Hermite quadrature. Quantify deviation from single-exponential decay and the bias of the fitted error rate relative to the averaged gate infidelity.

physics/quantum_info|quad_models.title: Interleaved RB of a two-qubit CZ gate with coherent phase error
physics/quantum_info|quad_models.gist: Simulate two-qubit Clifford RB and interleaved RB, with the CZ gate carrying a conditional-phase error plus depolarizing noise. Extract the CZ gate fidelity from the ratio of decay constants and compare it to the exact process fidelity, including the interleaved-RB systematic bounds.

physics/quantum_info|quad_models.title: Truncated-Fock bosonic thermal loss channel: Choi matrix and truncation error
physics/quantum_info|quad_models.gist: Build Kraus operators of the pure-loss channel in a truncated Fock space using binomial matrix elements, and compose with thermal amplification to get thermal loss. Form the Choi matrix, quantify the trace-preservation defect from truncation, and compute the output mean photon number versus the closed form ηn+(1-η)N_th.

physics/quantum_info|quad_models.title: Shor period finding with Gaussian phase noise in controlled rotations
physics/quantum_info|quad_models.gist: Add independent Gaussian phase errors to the QFT controlled-phase gates. Average the outcome distribution over noise with Gauss-Hermite quadrature or Monte Carlo, then compute period-recovery success probability via continued fractions versus phase-noise standard deviation and number of QFT qubits.

physics/quantum_info|quad_models.title: CV cluster-state gate teleportation with finite squeezing: Gaussian-kernel fidelity
physics/quantum_info|quad_models.gist: Model one-mode MBQC on a continuous-variable cluster as Gaussian displacement noise with variance e^{-2r} per measurement step. Compute the fidelity of teleported coherent and cat-state inputs by numerical integration of Wigner-function convolutions, and find the squeezing needed for a target fidelity after n steps.

physics/quantum_info|quad_models.title: Flux-tunable transmon dephasing versus flux bias from 1/f flux noise
physics/quantum_info|quad_models.gist: Model a symmetric or asymmetric SQUID transmon with E_J(Φ) = E_JΣ·sqrt(cos²(πΦ/Φ0) + d² sin²(πΦ/Φ0)) and the closed-form frequency ω01 ≈ sqrt(8E_J E_C) − E_C. Compute the flux sensitivity ∂ω/∂Φ analytically. Obtain the Ramsey and echo dephasing times from the Gaussian-decay formulas for 1/f noise, which use log-cutoff integrals evaluated by quadrature. Return T_φ versus flux, including the sweet-spot second-order limit.

physics/quantum_info|quad_models.title: Transmon T1 budget from Purcell, dielectric-loss and quasiparticle models
physics/quantum_info|quad_models.gist: Combine three device formulas for a fixed-frequency transmon: Purcell decay through a readout resonator κ(g/Δ)², dielectric loss with loss tangent and thermal factor coth(ħω/2kT), and quasiparticle tunneling with the Catelani spectral density, which involves a modified Bessel function K0. Sum the rates to get the total T1 versus qubit frequency and identify the dominant loss channel.

physics/quantum_info|quad_models.title: Surface-code resource estimate for a target algorithm from logical-error scaling
physics/quantum_info|quad_models.gist: Use the phenomenological model p_L(d) = A(p/p_th)^((d+1)/2) per round to choose the minimum code distance that reaches a total failure budget for a given logical-qubit count and T-count. Add 15-to-1 distillation output error 35p³ and factory footprints. Return the physical qubit count and runtime versus physical error rate.

physics/quantum_info|quad_models.title: Gaussian quantum discord of two-mode squeezed thermal states
physics/quantum_info|quad_models.gist: From the covariance matrix of a two-mode squeezed thermal state (squeezing r, thermal occupations n1 and n2), compute the symplectic invariants and symplectic eigenvalues. Evaluate the Adesso-Datta closed-form Gaussian discord using the entropy function g(x) = (x+½)log(x+½) − (x−½)log(x−½). Compare it with log-negativity and Gaussian mutual information versus temperature.

physics/quantum_info|quad_models.title: Thermal-loss bosonic channel: PLOB bound, coherent information and heterodyne rate
physics/quantum_info|quad_models.gist: For a thermal-loss channel with transmissivity η and thermal noise n̄, evaluate three closed-form quantities: the PLOB repeaterless upper bound, the reverse coherent information lower bound computed from symplectic eigenvalues and g(x), and the Shannon rate of Gaussian-modulated heterodyne detection. Return the bounds versus distance for fiber loss of 0.2 dB/km and the distance at which they cross zero.

physics/quantum_info|quad_models.title: Schmidt number of SPDC biphotons: sinc phase matching versus double-Gaussian approximation
physics/quantum_info|quad_models.gist: Discretize the transverse-momentum biphoton amplitude ψ(q_s, q_i) = exp(−|q_s + q_i|²w²/4)·sinc(L|q_s − q_i|²/4k_p) on a Gauss-Legendre grid, including quadrature weights. Compute the Schmidt coefficients by weighted SVD. Compare the Schmidt number K and entanglement entropy with the closed-form double-Gaussian result K = ¼(b/σ + σ/b)² as functions of crystal length and pump waist.

physics/quantum_info|quad_models.title: Mølmer-Sørensen gate infidelity from thermal motion via Laguerre-polynomial Debye-Waller factors
physics/quantum_info|quad_models.gist: For a two-ion MS gate, use the closed-form effective Rabi frequencies Ω_{n,n'} ∝ η^{|Δn|} e^{−η²/2} sqrt(n<!/n>!) L_{n<}^{|Δn|}(η²) that come from associated Laguerre polynomials. Average the Bell-state fidelity over a thermal phonon distribution, including off-resonant carrier excitation. Return the gate infidelity versus Lamb-Dicke parameter and mean phonon number n̄.

physics/quantum_info|quad_models.title: Singlet-triplet double-dot qubit: exchange J(ε) and charge-noise dephasing
physics/quantum_info|quad_models.gist: Diagonalize the two-electron double-quantum-dot Hubbard Hamiltonian in the (1,1)/(0,2) singlet basis, with tunnel coupling t_c, detuning ε and charging U, to obtain the exchange J(ε). Compare it with the closed-form expression. Using quasi-static Gaussian charge noise in ε, compute the free-induction decay and T2* ∝ 1/|dJ/dε| at each detuning, and find the coherence-optimal operating point.

physics/quantum_info|quad_models.title: Quantum Stirling cycle with a harmonic-oscillator working medium and regeneration
physics/quantum_info|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the four strokes of a Stirling cycle between frequencies ω1 and ω2 and temperatures T_h and T_c using closed-form oscillator partition functions, internal energies and entropies, with isothermal work computed by quadrature of the force over ω. Compute the efficiency with perfect, partial and no regeneration. Compare it with the Carnot efficiency and the Otto efficiency for the same parameters.

physics/stat_phys|quad_models.title: Extinction-time distribution of linear birth-death process from generating function
physics/stat_phys|quad_models.gist: Use the closed-form probability generating function of the linear birth-death process with rates λ and μ to obtain P0(t) for n0 initial individuals. Compute the extinction-time density, its mean and variance by quadrature in the subcritical case, and the ultimate extinction probability (μ/λ)^n0 in the supercritical case.

physics/stat_phys|quad_models.title: Ornstein-Uhlenbeck spectral density and integrated OU position statistics
physics/stat_phys|quad_models.gist: Implement the exact OU update, then obtain the Lorentzian power spectral density by Wiener-Khinchin quadrature of the exponential autocorrelation and check it against the closed form. Derive the mean-square displacement of a particle whose velocity is an OU process, recovering the ballistic and diffusive limits.

physics/stat_phys|quad_models.title: Kuramoto self-consistency for Gaussian frequency distribution: partial-locking branch
physics/stat_phys|quad_models.gist: Solve the Kuramoto self-consistency equation r = Kr∫cos²θ g(Kr sinθ)dθ for a Gaussian g by quadrature and root finding to obtain r(K). Verify the onset Kc = 2/(πg(0)) and the square-root exponent near Kc, and compare with the closed-form Lorentzian result.

physics/stat_phys|quad_models.title: Bimodal Kuramoto model: critical coupling and bifurcation type versus peak separation
physics/stat_phys|quad_models.gist: For a frequency distribution made of two Lorentzians or two Gaussians separated by 2ω0, solve the self-consistency integral for the stationary partially locked state. Determine Kc and classify the bifurcation as supercritical or subcritical from the sign of g''(0) as ω0 varies.

physics/stat_phys|quad_models.title: Sakaguchi-Kuramoto phase-lag model: complex self-consistency with drifting oscillators
physics/stat_phys|quad_models.gist: Solve the complex self-consistency equation of the Kuramoto-Sakaguchi model with phase lag α. Include the drifting-oscillator contribution through principal-value quadrature, and obtain the order parameter r(K) together with the collective frequency Ω(K) for a Lorentzian or Gaussian frequency distribution.

physics/stat_phys|quad_models.title: Noisy Kuramoto model critical coupling from linearized Fokker-Planck dispersion
physics/stat_phys|quad_models.gist: For Kuramoto oscillators with phase diffusion D, compute the incoherence-instability threshold Kc from 1 = (K/2)∫g(ω)D/(D²+ω²)dω by quadrature. Map Kc(D) for Gaussian and uniform frequency distributions and check the limits D→0 and identical oscillators (Kc = 2D).

physics/stat_phys|quad_models.title: Linear Cahn-Hilliard-Cook theory of early spinodal decomposition structure factor
physics/stat_phys|quad_models.gist: Compute the time-dependent structure factor S(k,t) of a quenched binary mixture from the closed-form solution of the linearized Cahn-Hilliard-Cook equation with thermal noise. Extract the fastest-growing wavevector, the stationary crossover point, and the circularly averaged peak position as functions of quench depth and noise strength.

physics/stat_phys|quad_models.title: Transverse-field Ising chain ground-state energy and critical singularities via free fermions
physics/stat_phys|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the ground-state energy density of the 1D transverse-field Ising model, e0(h) = -(1/π)∫ε_k dk, by quadrature and as complete elliptic integrals. Compute the transverse magnetization and its derivative, showing the logarithmic divergence at h = 1, and compare with finite-N momentum sums.
physics/stat_phys|quad_models.area: Quantum Ising chain and quantum criticality

physics/stat_phys|quad_models.title: Block entanglement entropy of transverse-field Ising chain from Toeplitz correlation matrices
physics/stat_phys|quad_models.gist: Build the Majorana correlation matrix of a block of ℓ spins from Fourier coefficients of the Bogoliubov symbol, computed by quadrature. Diagonalize it to obtain the von Neumann entropy S(ℓ), then fit the Calabrese-Cardy log law to extract c = 1/2 at criticality and saturation off criticality.
physics/stat_phys|quad_models.area: Quantum Ising chain and quantum criticality

physics/stat_phys|quad_models.title: Loschmidt echo rate function and dynamical quantum phase transitions in Ising chain
physics/stat_phys|quad_models.gist: Compute the Loschmidt rate function -(1/2π)∫ln|cos²φ_k + sin²φ_k e^{-2iε_k t}|dk for quenches across h = 1 by quadrature. Locate its cusps and verify them against the closed-form critical times t*_n = (n+1/2)π/ε_{k*}.
physics/stat_phys|quad_models.area: Quantum Ising chain and quantum criticality

physics/stat_phys|quad_models.title: Mean-field directed percolation survival probability from Galton-Watson generating functions
physics/stat_phys|quad_models.gist: Model mean-field DP spreading as a branching process with binomial offspring on a tree of branching number z. Iterate the probability generating function to obtain the survival probability P(t) and the ultimate survival P∞(p), and extract the mean-field exponents β = 1 and δ = 1 by fitting near pc.

physics/stat_phys|quad_models.title: Integrated current statistics of independent random walkers: Skellam and annealed averages
physics/stat_phys|quad_models.gist: For noninteracting continuous-time random walkers on a 1D lattice with step initial condition, compute the distribution of net particles crossing the origin. Express single-particle crossing probabilities through modified Bessel functions, and obtain the current cumulants for annealed and quenched initial conditions, showing their t^{1/2} growth.

physics/stat_phys|quad_models.title: Analytic replica-exchange acceptance and temperature ladder for constant-heat-capacity systems
physics/stat_phys|quad_models.gist: Model each replica's energy distribution as a Gamma distribution, corresponding to constant heat capacity C. Compute the swap acceptance ∫∫min(1, e^{ΔβΔE})P_i P_j dE dE' by quadrature, and construct a temperature ladder with uniform target acceptance, verifying the geometric spacing and the √C scaling of the number of replicas.

physics/stat_phys|quad_models.title: Pulled-to-pushed transition of fronts with reaction u(1-u)(1+αu)
physics/stat_phys|quad_models.gist: For the reaction-diffusion equation with reaction u(1-u)(1+αu), compute the selected front speed by shooting on the traveling-wave ODE. Compare it with the linear speed 2 for α ≤ 2 and the exact pushed speed (α+2)/√(2α) with its closed-form tanh-type profile for α > 2.

physics/stat_phys|quad_models.title: Kohlrausch stretched-exponential relaxation: mean time, susceptibility spectrum and distribution
physics/stat_phys|quad_models.gist: For KWW relaxation exp[-(t/τ)^β], compute the mean relaxation time τΓ(1/β)/β and the dielectric loss χ''(ω) by oscillatory Fourier quadrature. Extract the loss-peak frequency and high-frequency slope, and compare with a fitted Havriliak-Negami form.

physics/stat_phys|quad_models.title: Spherical model critical temperature from Watson lattice Green's function integrals
physics/stat_phys|quad_models.gist: Compute the d-dimensional lattice Green's function W_d(z) by reducing the Brillouin-zone integral to a 1D integral over modified Bessel functions e^{-zt}I_0(t)^d. Solve the spherical constraint for the critical temperature of the Berlin-Kac model on simple cubic and hypercubic lattices, and show that no transition exists for d ≤ 2.
physics/stat_phys|quad_models.area: Lattice spin models and phase transitions

physics/stat_phys|quad_models.title: Multiple-histogram reweighting recovering the exact density of states of a periodic Ising chain
physics/stat_phys|quad_models.gist: Draw energy histograms from the exact canonical distribution of an N-spin periodic Ising ring (g(E)=2·C(N,k), k even) at several temperatures. Solve the Ferrenberg-Swendsen/WHAM self-consistent free-energy equations by iteration and compare the reconstructed ln g(E) and reweighted ⟨E⟩(β) with the exact transfer-matrix result, including the reweighting-window error.

physics/stat_phys|quad_models.title: q-state Potts model on scale-free networks: degree-exponent-controlled transition order
physics/stat_phys|quad_models.gist: Use heterogeneous mean-field theory for the ferromagnetic Potts model on uncorrelated power-law networks P(k)∝k^{-γ}, with degree sums evaluated through Hurwitz zeta functions and truncated sums. Solve the self-consistency for the order parameter versus temperature to find T_c and the latent jump, showing the first-order transition turns continuous as γ decreases below 3.

physics/stat_phys|quad_models.title: McKean piecewise-linear FitzHugh-Nagumo caricature: exact front and pulse speeds
physics/stat_phys|quad_models.gist: Build the traveling front and pulse of the McKean caricature from piecewise exponential solutions in each region. Impose continuity and threshold conditions to get transcendental speed equations, solve them with brentq for the fast and slow pulse branches, and locate the saddle-node where propagation fails as recovery strength increases.

physics/stat_phys|quad_models.title: Mullins-Sekerka instability of a diffusion-limited growing disk: critical radii per mode
physics/stat_phys|quad_models.gist: Use the quasistatic Laplacian growth of a circular cluster with Gibbs-Thomson surface tension to derive the closed-form growth rate of each angular harmonic n versus radius. Compute the critical radius R_c(n) for each mode, the fastest-growing mode at given radius and supersaturation, and the planar-limit Mullins-Sekerka wavelength 2π√(3 d0 ℓ) that sets the tip-splitting scale in DLA-like growth.

physics/stat_phys|quad_models.title: Griffiths phase of the disordered contact process: rare-region power-law decay
physics/stat_phys|quad_models.gist: Model a diluted contact process in which locally supercritical rare regions of size L occur with probability p^L and have lifetimes τ(L)=τ0 e^{aL}. Evaluate ρ(t)=∫dL L p^L e^{-t/τ(L)} by quadrature, extract the nonuniversal exponent d/z' = ln(1/p)/a from log-log fits, and compare with the saddle-point asymptotics.

physics/stat_phys|quad_models.title: Feynman ratchet and pawl: velocity, heat flux and efficiency at maximum power
physics/stat_phys|quad_models.gist: Build the Arrhenius-rate model of a ratchet between hot and cold reservoirs lifting a load, with forward and backward step rates set by the barrier ε and load torque. Compute the angular velocity, heat fluxes and efficiency, maximize power over load and barrier numerically, and compare η* with the Carnot and Curzon-Ahlborn efficiencies.

physics/stat_phys|quad_models.title: Open partially asymmetric exclusion process: finite-size current from the Askey-Wilson integral
physics/stat_phys|quad_models.gist: Write the normalization Z_N of the open ASEP with asymmetry q and boundary rates as the Uchiyama-Sasamoto-Wadati integral over the Askey-Wilson weight, evaluated by quadrature with q-Pochhammer products. Compute J_N = Z_{N-1}/Z_N versus N, check the q=0 TASEP Derrida formula, and extrapolate the low-density, high-density and maximal-current bulk currents.

physics/stat_phys|quad_models.title: Sonine-corrected homogeneous cooling of inelastic hard spheres and Haff's law
physics/stat_phys|quad_models.gist: Compute the second Sonine coefficient a2(α) of the homogeneous cooling state in d dimensions from the van Noije-Ernst closed form. Evaluate the corrected cooling rate ζ(α) including the (1+3a2/16) factor, integrate Haff's law T(t)=T0/(1+ζ0 t/2)^2, and quantify the deviation from the Maxwellian-approximation cooling and the velocity-distribution kurtosis versus restitution coefficient.

physics/many_body|waves.title: T-move transition kernel from Legendre-expanded nonlocal pseudopotential
