physics/many_body|waves.gist: Build the T-move (Casula) off-diagonal matrix elements from Legendre-expanded semilocal pseudopotential channels evaluated on a randomly rotated spherical quadrature. Split them into sign-violating and sign-preserving parts. Compute the locality-approximation energy, the T-move effective potential and their difference for a Jastrow-Slater trial function of a one-electron pseudo-atom.
physics/many_body|waves.area: Pseudopotentials and locality approximation in QMC

physics/many_body|waves.title: RPA Gaskell Jastrow factor and static structure factor of the electron gas
physics/many_body|waves.gist: Construct the Gaskell RPA Jastrow u(k) for the 3D homogeneous electron gas at density r_s. Fourier transform it to real space with the cusp condition imposed. Compute the corresponding Slater-Jastrow approximation to the static structure factor S(k) and the long-wavelength plasmon behavior.

physics/many_body|waves.title: Binder cumulant crossings for the XY-anisotropic quantum chain from free fermions
physics/many_body|waves.gist: For the anisotropic XY chain in a transverse field, compute the ground-state order-parameter moments ⟨M²⟩ and ⟨M⁴⟩ using Pfaffian/Toeplitz determinants of Fourier-built fermionic correlation matrices. Form the Binder cumulant versus field for several L. Locate the Ising critical line from the crossings.
physics/many_body|waves.area: Finite-size scaling of quantum critical points

physics/many_body|waves.title: One-loop patch RG for 2D Hubbard with FFT-computed Brillouin-zone bubbles
physics/many_body|waves.gist: Compute particle-particle and particle-hole bubbles at nesting vectors for the square-lattice dispersion at a running cutoff, using FFT convolutions over a k-grid. Integrate simplified g-ology flows for the two-patch model at the van Hove filling. Identify the leading instability (d-wave vs antiferromagnetic) from the divergence scale.

physics/many_body|waves.title: Average sign in determinant QMC for the Hubbard model with FFT kinetic propagator
physics/many_body|waves.gist: For a small 2D Hubbard lattice away from half filling, apply exp(−Δτ K) by FFT to momentum space. Build B-matrix products for discrete HS fields with stabilized QR products. Sample the fields with Metropolis and compute the average sign ⟨sgn det M↑ det M↓⟩ versus β and U.
physics/many_body|waves.area: Auxiliary-field QMC and fermion sign problem

physics/many_body|waves.title: Constrained-path AFQMC for the 1D Hubbard ring with split-operator propagation
physics/many_body|waves.gist: Propagate an ensemble of Slater-determinant walkers with alternating FFT-diagonal kinetic factors and HS-decoupled interaction factors. Apply the constrained-path condition against a free-electron trial determinant and use importance-sampled weights. Extract the mixed-estimator ground-state energy and compare with exact diagonalization.
physics/many_body|waves.area: Auxiliary-field QMC and fermion sign problem

physics/many_body|waves.title: Fermion sign of path integrals on a ring via antisymmetrized free propagator
physics/many_body|waves.gist: For 2–3 spinless fermions on a 1D ring, build the free-particle imaginary-time propagator as a winding-number (theta-function) sum and Poisson-dual Fourier series. Form the antisymmetrized permutation sum. Compute the exact average permutation sign versus temperature and density, showing its exponential decay with β·N.
physics/many_body|waves.area: Auxiliary-field QMC and fermion sign problem

physics/many_body|waves.title: MPS transfer-matrix correlation length for the gapped spin-1 chain
physics/many_body|waves.gist: From an iDMRG ground-state MPS of the spin-1 Heisenberg (Haldane) chain, build the MPS transfer matrix. Compute the correlation length from the ratio of the leading eigenvalues. Find the Haldane gap's magnon minimum at q=π from the Fourier-transformed correlation function.

physics/many_body|waves.title: Imaginary-time spin correlations and Matsubara susceptibility from SSE
physics/many_body|waves.gist: Run SSE with diagonal and loop updates for the Heisenberg chain. Map the operator-string expansion to imaginary time via binomial weights to obtain C(q,τ). Fourier transform to Matsubara frequencies χ(q, iω_n) and compare χ(π, 0) with ED.
physics/many_body|waves.area: Stochastic series expansion for Heisenberg models

physics/many_body|waves.title: Dynamic structure factor by kernel polynomial Chebyshev expansion
physics/many_body|waves.gist: Compute S(q,ω) for an XXZ chain by expanding the spectral function in Chebyshev polynomials using sparse Hamiltonian recursion with Jackson kernel damping. Evaluate the series with a DCT. Check the sum rules against ⟨S_{-q}S_q⟩.

physics/many_body|waves.title: Two-electron 2D quantum dot by split-operator FFT imaginary-time evolution
physics/many_body|waves.gist: Separate center-of-mass and relative motion of two electrons in a 2D parabolic trap. Evolve the relative wavefunction on a grid with split-operator FFT imaginary-time propagation for several angular-momentum channels. Compute singlet-triplet energies versus Coulomb strength and compare with Taut's exact solutions.

physics/many_body|waves.title: Classical bilayer Wigner crystal structural phases from 2D Ewald lattice sums
physics/many_body|waves.gist: Computes Madelung energies of the five staggered bilayer lattices (hexagonal to square to rectangular) versus layer separation. Uses 2D Ewald sums for intra- and interlayer 1/r interactions with erfc real-space and erfc-type reciprocal kernels, then minimizes over the lattice aspect parameters to locate the structural transitions.

physics/many_body|waves.title: Model periodic Coulomb interaction versus Ewald energies for electron-gas configurations
physics/many_body|waves.gist: For sampled electron-gas configurations in cubic supercells, computes the Ewald electron-electron energy and the MPC energy (bare 1/r minimum-image Hartree term plus FFT-density mean-field correction). Analyzes their difference and its 1/N scaling as a finite-size error versus N and r_s.

physics/many_body|waves.title: Kohn-mode dipole oscillation of 1D trapped fermions by split-operator time-dependent Hartree-Fock
physics/many_body|waves.gist: Obtains Hartree-Fock orbitals of N spin-polarized fermions with Gaussian interaction in a harmonic trap by FFT imaginary-time evolution. A sudden trap displacement is followed by real-time split-operator TDHF; FFT of the center-of-mass signal verifies the Kohn frequency ω₀ independent of interaction, and the breathing mode is extracted.

physics/many_body|waves.title: Second-order self-energy of the 2D Hubbard model via FFT convolutions
physics/many_body|waves.gist: Computes the momentum- and Matsubara-dependent second-order self-energy of the square-lattice Hubbard model by FFT convolutions in (k,τ) space. Extracts quasiparticle weights at nodal and antinodal Fermi points versus U and temperature, with convergence in grid size checked.

physics/many_body|waves.title: Quantum transfer matrix free energy of the XXZ chain at finite Trotter number
physics/many_body|waves.gist: Builds the column-to-column quantum transfer matrix of the XXZ chain from a Trotter-Suzuki checkerboard decomposition. Its leading eigenvalue gives the thermodynamic-limit free energy, specific heat and susceptibility; results are extrapolated in Trotter number and compared with the free-fermion XX limit.

physics/many_body|waves.title: Partial-wave convergence of helium full CI and Schwartz L⁻⁴ extrapolation
physics/many_body|waves.gist: Performs two-electron full CI for helium in a Laguerre-type radial basis, with 1/r₁₂ expanded in Legendre multipoles up to angular momentum L_max. The partial-wave energy increments are fitted to the Schwartz (L+1/2)⁻⁴ law and extrapolated to the complete-basis limit near −2.9037 Hartree.

physics/many_body|waves.title: RBM ground state of the XXZ chain: Luttinger parameter from FFT S(q)
physics/many_body|waves.gist: Trains a restricted Boltzmann machine for the critical XXZ chain with stochastic reconfiguration and Metropolis sampling. The static structure factor S^zz(q) is computed by FFT of sampled configurations, and the Luttinger parameter K, from the small-q slope, is compared with the Bethe-ansatz value as a function of Δ.
physics/many_body|waves.area: Neural-network quantum states on spin models

physics/many_body|waves.title: Local-potential-approximation Wetterich flow for 3D Ising criticality via Chebyshev collocation
physics/many_body|waves.gist: Represents the dimensionless LPA effective potential with the Litim regulator in a Chebyshev expansion. The Wilson-Fisher fixed point is found by Newton iteration, and linearizing the flow around it gives the eigenvalue ν ≈ 0.65, compared with the ε-expansion value.

physics/many_body|waves.title: Dipolar Bose-Einstein condensate stability via FFT-evaluated dipolar mean field
physics/many_body|waves.gist: Solves the 3D Gross-Pitaevskii equation with a dipole-dipole term by imaginary-time split-step propagation. The dipolar potential is evaluated in Fourier space with the cutoff-regularized kernel (4π/3)(3cos²θ_k−1); the critical dipolar strength for collapse is mapped versus trap aspect ratio.

physics/condensed_matter|stochastic.title: Diffusion Monte Carlo ground state of a finite GaAs/AlGaAs quantum well
physics/condensed_matter|stochastic.gist: Use importance-free diffusion Monte Carlo with walker branching to estimate the ground-subband energy of an electron in a 1D finite square well with position-dependent effective mass. Compare the growth-energy estimator against a finite-difference or shooting eigenvalue as a function of well width.

physics/condensed_matter|stochastic.title: Variational Monte Carlo binding energy of a hydrogenic donor in a quantum well
physics/condensed_matter|stochastic.gist: Metropolis-sample a trial wavefunction that is the product of the well's ground subband and a 3D hydrogenic envelope, for a donor at the well center. Minimize the variational energy over the Bohr-radius parameter to get the donor binding energy versus well width, from the 3D limit to the quasi-2D limit.

physics/condensed_matter|stochastic.title: Gillespie simulation of carrier capture and subband relaxation in a quantum-well laser
physics/condensed_matter|stochastic.gist: Model barrier, excited-subband and ground-subband populations with stochastic capture, escape, LO-phonon intersubband scattering and radiative recombination events. Simulate them with the Gillespie algorithm and compare the mean populations and transient rise times with the deterministic rate equations.

physics/condensed_matter|stochastic.title: Metropolis Monte Carlo of the adiabatic Holstein model with classical phonons
physics/condensed_matter|stochastic.gist: Sample classical lattice displacements on a 1D Holstein chain with Metropolis moves, using a weight from the exact electronic free energy obtained by diagonalizing the single-particle Hamiltonian in each configuration. Compute the mean lattice distortion, the polaron localization (IPR) and the crossover to small-polaron formation versus coupling and temperature.

physics/condensed_matter|stochastic.title: Diagrammatic Monte Carlo of the Fröhlich polaron Green's function
physics/condensed_matter|stochastic.gist: Implement Prokof'ev-Svistunov diagrammatic Monte Carlo with add/remove phonon-line updates to sample the imaginary-time Green's function of a zero-momentum Fröhlich polaron. Extract the ground-state energy from the exponential decay and compare with second-order perturbation theory, -α ħω.

physics/condensed_matter|stochastic.title: Monte Carlo Fermi-surface integration of α²F(ω) and McMillan Tc
physics/condensed_matter|stochastic.gist: Use random k and q sampling with Gaussian-smeared delta functions to evaluate the Eliashberg function of a 2D square-lattice tight-binding metal coupled to a model optical/acoustic phonon branch. Compute λ, ω_log and the Allen-Dynes/McMillan Tc, with statistical error bars.

physics/condensed_matter|stochastic.title: Stochastic-trace kernel polynomial DOS of vacancy-disordered graphene
physics/condensed_matter|stochastic.gist: Combine Chebyshev expansion of the density of states with random-phase vector trace estimation and Jackson kernel damping on a large honeycomb lattice with random vacancies. Resolve the zero-mode peak and quantify the statistical error versus the number of random vectors.

physics/condensed_matter|stochastic.title: Constrained Monte Carlo of temperature-dependent anisotropy and Callen-Callen scaling
physics/condensed_matter|stochastic.gist: Use Asselin-type constrained Metropolis Monte Carlo on a classical Heisenberg ferromagnet with uniaxial single-ion anisotropy to compute the restoring torque versus magnetization angle. Extract K(T) and verify the Callen-Callen K ∝ m^3 power law.

physics/condensed_matter|stochastic.title: Kinetic Monte Carlo of ZFC/FC magnetization in a superparamagnetic nanoparticle ensemble
physics/condensed_matter|stochastic.gist: Simulate a log-normal size ensemble of Stoner-Wohlfarth particles with Arrhenius-Néel two-state switching rates under a temperature sweep using kinetic Monte Carlo. Compute the zero-field-cooled and field-cooled magnetization curves and the blocking temperature versus sweep rate.

physics/condensed_matter|stochastic.title: Path-integral Monte Carlo of zero-point energy in an anharmonic quantum chain
physics/condensed_matter|stochastic.gist: Sample Trotter-discretized imaginary-time paths of a 1D chain with nearest-neighbor quartic (FPU-β) interactions using staging or normal-mode moves. Compute the internal energy and heat capacity versus temperature with the virial estimator, and compare with the quantum harmonic phonon (Debye-like) result.

physics/condensed_matter|stochastic.title: Langevin dynamics phonon DOS of an anharmonic FPU chain from velocity autocorrelation
physics/condensed_matter|stochastic.gist: Thermalize an FPU-α/β chain with a Langevin thermostat and then compute the vibrational density of states from the Fourier transform of the velocity autocorrelation. Use that DOS in quantum harmonic formulas for C_V and vibrational entropy, and track phonon frequency renormalization with temperature.

physics/condensed_matter|stochastic.title: Spin-fermion Monte Carlo Néel temperature for the 2D Hubbard model
physics/condensed_matter|stochastic.gist: Treat the Hubbard interaction through classical auxiliary magnetization fields and Metropolis-sample them, using fermionic free energies obtained by exact diagonalization of the quadratic Hamiltonian for each configuration. Extract the antiferromagnetic structure factor and the finite-size Néel crossover temperature versus U, and contrast with the mean-field T_N.

physics/condensed_matter|stochastic.title: Landau-Zener transitions with classical noise via stochastic trajectory averaging
physics/condensed_matter|stochastic.gist: Integrate the two-level Landau-Zener Schrödinger equation with random telegraph or Ornstein-Uhlenbeck noise added to the diagonal bias, averaging over many noise realizations. Compare the averaged transition probability with the noiseless formula and with Kayanuma's fast-noise limit.
physics/condensed_matter|stochastic.area: Landau-Zener and Zener tunneling between bands

physics/condensed_matter|stochastic.title: Displacive φ⁴ lattice model: soft-mode frequency from Monte Carlo fluctuations
physics/condensed_matter|stochastic.gist: Use Metropolis sampling of a 2D lattice of double-well on-site potentials with harmonic intersite coupling. Extract the order parameter and the temperature-dependent effective frequency ω²(q) = k_BT/(m⟨|u_q|²⟩), showing zone-center mode softening near T_c, and compare with the self-consistent harmonic approximation.

physics/condensed_matter|stochastic.title: Exciton diffusion and exciton-exciton annihilation in a 2D semiconductor by kinetic Monte Carlo
physics/condensed_matter|stochastic.gist: Simulate excitons hopping on a square lattice with radiative decay and on-contact annihilation using the Gillespie algorithm. Compute the time-resolved photoluminescence decay for several initial densities and extract the effective annihilation rate γ by comparing with the mean-field rate equation dn/dt = -n/τ - γn².

physics/condensed_matter|stochastic.title: Gaussian and dynamic Kubo-Toyabe muon spin relaxation by Monte Carlo field sampling
physics/condensed_matter|stochastic.gist: Sample random dipolar fields from a nuclear-moment distribution, or from a Gaussian, and average the muon spin precession to reconstruct the static Kubo-Toyabe function with its 1/3 tail. Add strong-collision field jumps at rate ν to obtain the dynamic function, and compare with the motional-narrowing limit exp(-2Δ²t/ν).

physics/condensed_matter|stochastic.title: Kubo-Anderson stochastic line shape: motional narrowing of a two-state jumping frequency
physics/condensed_matter|stochastic.gist: Simulate random telegraph modulation of a spectral line frequency (±Δ) with jump rate k by Monte Carlo trajectories and average the dipole phase factor. Fourier transform to obtain spectra that cross over from a doublet to a narrowed Lorentzian, and verify the result against the exact stochastic Liouville solution.

physics/optics|stochastic.title: Turn-on delay jitter of gain-switched lasers from spontaneous emission noise
physics/optics|stochastic.gist: Apply a step current to stochastic rate equations whose photon number starts from spontaneous-emission noise. Build the distribution of first-pulse turn-on delay over many trajectories and compare its mean and standard deviation with the deterministic delay and an analytic jitter estimate.

physics/optics|stochastic.title: Optical amplifier noise figure from stochastic birth-death photon kinetics
physics/optics|stochastic.gist: Treat the photon number along a linear optical amplifier as a birth-death process with stimulated emission, absorption and spontaneous emission, and simulate it with Gillespie sampling for a coherent input. Compute the output mean and variance and the noise figure, and compare with the Shimoda result NF approx 2 n_sp.

physics/optics|stochastic.title: Simulated annealing inverse design of a multilayer narrowband defect filter
physics/optics|stochastic.gist: Use Metropolis simulated annealing over the layer thicknesses of a dielectric stack, with a cost given by the transfer-matrix mismatch to a target reflectance with a single defect-mode transmission peak. Report the optimized structure, its defect-mode Q factor and the cost convergence history.
physics/optics|stochastic.area: Distributed Bragg reflectors and photonic bandgaps

physics/optics|stochastic.title: Metropolis sampling of 2D optical matter arrays with coupled-dipole energies
physics/optics|stochastic.gist: Evaluate the many-body energy of N dipolar particles in a normally incident plane wave from the self-consistent coupled-dipole solution. Sample configurations at finite temperature with Metropolis Monte Carlo, and report the pair correlation function and the lowest-energy lattice found by annealing.

physics/optics|stochastic.title: Optical tweezer stiffness calibration from simulated Brownian power spectra
physics/optics|stochastic.gist: Integrate the overdamped Langevin equation of a bead in a harmonic optical trap, including a finite sampling rate. Recover the trap stiffness from a Lorentzian corner-frequency fit to the power spectral density, from equipartition and from the position autocorrelation, and compare the three estimates and their statistical errors.

physics/optics|stochastic.title: Anomalous diffusion of a colloid in a random optical speckle potential
physics/optics|stochastic.gist: Generate 2D speckle intensity fields by FFT of random phasors to serve as an optical potential, and run Brownian dynamics of particles moving in it. Compute the mean-square displacement, the long-time effective diffusion coefficient and the subdiffusive regime as a function of speckle strength over kT.

physics/optics|stochastic.title: Gaussian pulse broadening in fibers with random group-velocity-dispersion maps
physics/optics|stochastic.gist: Propagate chirped Gaussian pulses through fiber sections whose beta2 values are drawn randomly from a Sellmeier-derived nominal value plus fluctuations, using the analytic ABCD-like q-parameter or spectral phase propagation. Compute the ensemble statistics of the output RMS width and the residual broadening after nominal dispersion compensation.

physics/optics|stochastic.title: Shack-Hartmann least-squares reconstruction residuals on Kolmogorov phase screens
physics/optics|stochastic.gist: Generate random Kolmogorov turbulence phase screens with an FFT method that includes subharmonics, compute Shack-Hartmann subaperture slopes, and reconstruct the wavefront by least squares with a slope-influence matrix. Report the Monte Carlo residual wavefront variance and Strehl versus D/r0, and compare with Noll residuals.

physics/optics|stochastic.title: Laser-phase-noise degradation of EIT transparency in three-level atoms
physics/optics|stochastic.gist: Integrate the Lambda-system Bloch equations with stochastic Wiener phase noise on the coupling and probe lasers, sampled over many trajectories. Compute the averaged probe absorption spectrum and EIT dip depth versus relative laser linewidth, and compare with the dephasing-rate model.
physics/optics|stochastic.area: Optical Bloch equations and atom-light interaction

physics/optics|stochastic.title: Monte Carlo ray tracing of apparent emissivity in blackbody cavities
physics/optics|stochastic.gist: Trace random rays launched into an isothermal conical or cylindrical cavity with diffuse gray walls, absorbing at each bounce with probability epsilon. Compute the effective cavity emissivity versus wall emissivity and aspect ratio, and compare with Gouffé's approximation. Integrate with Planck spectra to obtain the radiance.
physics/optics|stochastic.area: Thermal radiation and emissivity of structures

physics/optics|stochastic.title: Monte Carlo photon transport for solar reflectance of radiative-cooling paints
physics/optics|stochastic.gist: Use Mie-derived scattering and absorption coefficients for a particulate coating with a Henyey-Greenstein phase function, and run random-walk photon transport through a slab of finite thickness. Compute the spectral solar reflectance and thermal emissivity, and from them the net radiative cooling power under the AM1.5 and atmospheric-window spectra.
physics/optics|stochastic.area: Thermal radiation and emissivity of structures

physics/optics|stochastic.title: Disorder-induced group-delay statistics in coupled-resonator optical waveguides
physics/optics|stochastic.gist: Model a CROW of N coupled ring resonators with transfer matrices or coupled-mode equations, and draw resonance-frequency detunings at random. Compute the transmission and group-delay spectra over Monte Carlo ensembles, and quantify how the slow-light group index and bandwidth degrade with disorder strength.

physics/optics|stochastic.title: Monte Carlo tolerance analysis of a cemented achromatic doublet's focal length and back focus
physics/optics|stochastic.gist: Randomly perturb the radii, thicknesses and glass indices of a cemented achromat within manufacturing tolerances and propagate each sample through a paraxial y-nu marginal ray trace. Report the distributions of effective focal length and back focal distance, sensitivity coefficients, and the yield fraction inside a focus specification.
physics/optics|stochastic.area: Paraxial ray tracing and lens design

physics/optics|stochastic.title: Abbe source-point Monte Carlo sampling for partially coherent imaging of a periodic grating
physics/optics|stochastic.gist: Model Köhler illumination as an incoherent sum over randomly sampled source points inside a disk of radius σ·NA. Each point contributes a coherent image of a line grating through a circular pupil. Compute image contrast versus the coherence factor σ and grating period, check convergence against Hopkins' integral, and locate the Abbe cutoff period.

physics/optics|stochastic.title: Total internal reflection microscopy: Brownian colloid height and Boltzmann-inverted potential
physics/optics|stochastic.gist: Use overdamped Langevin dynamics with height-dependent hindered diffusion for a sphere above a glass wall under gravity plus a screened electrostatic repulsion. Convert the trajectory to scattered intensity using the evanescent decay length set by the TIR angle and index. Recover the height histogram and potential-energy profile by Boltzmann inversion of the intensity statistics.
physics/optics|stochastic.area: Hyperbolic media and evanescent wave optics

physics/optics|stochastic.title: Lévy glass: superdiffusive light transport from heavy-tailed random-walk step lengths
physics/optics|stochastic.gist: Simulate photon random walks in a slab where step lengths are drawn from a power-law (Lévy) distribution with exponent α, using absorbing slab boundaries. Compute total transmission versus slab thickness and compare the anomalous scaling exponent with the diffusive Ohm's-law 1/L behavior.

physics/optics|stochastic.title: Polarized Monte Carlo with Mie scattering matrices: circular versus linear polarization memory
physics/optics|stochastic.gist: Track Stokes vectors through multiple scattering in a slab of polystyrene microspheres, rotating reference frames and applying Mie Mueller matrices computed from Riccati–Bessel coefficients. Compute the degree of linear and circular polarization of transmitted and backscattered light versus optical depth and size parameter to demonstrate circular polarization memory.

physics/optics|stochastic.title: Diffusion Monte Carlo for the fundamental mode of a graded-index fiber
physics/optics|stochastic.gist: Map the scalar paraxial Helmholtz equation for a parabolic or α-profile fiber onto an imaginary-time Schrödinger problem. Run walker-based diffusion Monte Carlo with branching to estimate the fundamental-mode propagation constant from the growth estimator and the mode profile from walker histograms. Compare with the analytic or finite-difference solution.

physics/optics|stochastic.title: Monte Carlo ray tracing of a compound parabolic concentrator's angular transmission
physics/optics|stochastic.gist: Launch uniformly sampled random rays over the entrance aperture and incidence angles into a 2D CPC with specular, partially absorbing walls, tracing each ray with exact reflections. Compute transmission versus incidence angle, the sharpness of the acceptance-angle cutoff, the mean number of reflections, and the concentration relative to the étendue limit 1/sinθ.

physics/quantum_info|waves.title: Quantum Otto engine with a particle in an infinite square well
physics/quantum_info|waves.gist: Model the working medium as a box whose width changes between L1 and L2, expanding states in the sine eigenbasis. Compute heat, work and efficiency for quasi-static strokes and for a sudden width-change stroke, using overlap integrals of sine modes between the two boxes.

physics/quantum_info|waves.title: Ergotropy of displaced thermal states of a cavity mode
physics/quantum_info|waves.gist: Build the displaced thermal state in a truncated Fock basis using matrix elements given by associated Laguerre polynomials. Compute the ergotropy from the eigenvalues sorted against energy levels (passive state), and compare with the coherent contribution ħω|α|².

physics/quantum_info|waves.title: Filter-function dephasing of a qubit under CPMG and UDD pulse sequences
physics/quantum_info|waves.gist: Compute filter functions F(ωt) for Ramsey, Hahn, CPMG-n and Uhrig sequences by Fourier transforming the switching function. Integrate them against 1/f and Lorentzian noise spectra to obtain the coherence decay χ(t) and extract T2 scaling with the number of pulses.

physics/quantum_info|waves.title: Quantum discord of two qubits under Ohmic spin-boson pure dephasing
physics/quantum_info|waves.gist: Compute the exact dephasing function Γ(t) = ∫ J(ω) coth(βω/2)(1-cos ωt)/ω² dω for an Ohmic bath with exponential cutoff, and apply it to an initial Bell-diagonal state. Optimize projective measurements over the Bloch sphere to obtain the classical correlation and the discord versus time.

physics/quantum_info|waves.title: Homodyne photocurrent power spectrum of a driven qubit from stochastic master equation
physics/quantum_info|waves.gist: Integrate the diffusive stochastic master equation (Euler-Maruyama) under continuous homodyne detection of a Rabi-driven qubit. FFT the measurement current to obtain the averaged power spectrum, and compare the Rabi peak position and height with the analytic result.

physics/quantum_info|waves.title: Continuous position measurement of a particle: split-step stochastic Schrödinger equation
physics/quantum_info|waves.gist: Propagate a wavepacket in a harmonic or double-well potential using a split-step Fourier method with a stochastic measurement term for weak continuous position monitoring. Show that the ensemble-averaged density matrix reproduces the Lindblad decoherence of position coherences, ρ(x,x') ∝ e^{-κ(x-x')²t}.

physics/quantum_info|waves.title: Thermal density matrix by imaginary-time split-operator propagation vs Mehler kernel
physics/quantum_info|waves.gist: Build the Gibbs state ρ(x,x') of a 1D particle in an anharmonic potential by imaginary-time split-operator FFT propagation. Validate it against the exact Mehler kernel for the harmonic case, then compute purity, ⟨x²⟩ and the trace normalization versus temperature.

physics/quantum_info|waves.title: Symplectic ABCD propagation of two-mode squeezed states through lossy beamsplitters
physics/quantum_info|waves.gist: Represent Gaussian operations (squeezers, beamsplitters, loss) as symplectic ABCD-type matrices acting on covariance matrices. Propagate a two-mode squeezed vacuum through a lossy network and compute the logarithmic negativity from the partially transposed symplectic eigenvalues.

physics/quantum_info|waves.title: Quantum Fourier transform circuit and phase estimation versus numpy FFT
physics/quantum_info|waves.gist: Build the n-qubit QFT unitary from Hadamard, controlled-phase and swap gates, and verify it equals the normalized DFT matrix. Use it in quantum phase estimation of a single-qubit phase gate to compute the outcome probability distribution and its sinc²-like spectral leakage for non-dyadic phases.

physics/quantum_info|waves.title: Split-operator Trotter-Suzuki order scaling for a 1D anharmonic oscillator
physics/quantum_info|waves.gist: Evolve a wavepacket with first-order, Strang and fourth-order Suzuki split-operator FFT schemes. Compare against a reference fine-grid or eigenbasis exact evolution, and extract the error exponents versus time step and the cost-accuracy trade-off.

physics/quantum_info|waves.title: Trotterized tight-binding chain: Fourier analysis of effective dispersion errors
physics/quantum_info|waves.gist: Trotterize nearest-neighbor hopping into even and odd bond layers and diagonalize the resulting Floquet operator in momentum space. Compare the effective quasi-energy dispersion with the exact 2J cos k, and quantify the wavepacket group-velocity error and Loschmidt fidelity versus step size.

physics/quantum_info|waves.title: Fourier-parametrized QAOA angle schedules for depth extrapolation on random regular graphs
physics/quantum_info|waves.gist: Parametrize the QAOA γ_i and β_i schedules by a few sine and cosine Fourier coefficients (the FOURIER heuristic), optimize the coefficients at depth p, and extrapolate them to initialize depth p+1. Compare the approximation ratios and optimizer call counts with random initialization on 3-regular graphs.

physics/quantum_info|waves.title: Classical shadows of magnetization full counting statistics via Fourier inversion
physics/quantum_info|waves.gist: Use random Pauli snapshots of a spin-chain ground state to estimate the generating function ⟨e^{iθM_A}⟩ on a θ-grid with median-of-means. Discrete-Fourier invert it to obtain the subsystem magnetization distribution P(M_A), and compare with the exact distribution.

physics/quantum_info|waves.title: Suppression laws for multiphoton interference in discrete Fourier transform multiports
physics/quantum_info|waves.gist: Build the N-mode DFT unitary and compute output-pattern probabilities for periodic multiphoton inputs using matrix permanents (Ryser formula). Verify the Tichy zero-transmission law, which predicts suppressed outputs from a mode-index sum rule. Compare the suppressed fraction against the distinguishable-particle case.

physics/quantum_info|waves.title: Jacobi-Anger Chebyshev expansion for qubitized Hamiltonian simulation: truncation degree
physics/quantum_info|waves.gist: Expand e^{-ixt} in Chebyshev polynomials with Bessel-function coefficients and find the truncation degree that meets a target error, compared with the asymptotic t+log(1/ε) scaling. Apply the truncated series to a block-encoded small Heisenberg Hamiltonian through Chebyshev polynomials of its qubitization walk operator. Check the result against exact expm.

physics/quantum_info|waves.title: Shor discrete logarithm via two-register Fourier sampling over Z_r × Z_r
physics/quantum_info|waves.gist: Prepare the state Σ_{a,b}|a,b⟩|g^a h^{-b} mod p⟩ for a small prime p and measure the function register. Apply a 2D FFT over the exponent registers to obtain the outcome distribution. Recover the discrete logarithm from the sampled (c,d) pairs by modular linear algebra and estimate the success probability per run.

physics/quantum_info|waves.title: Spectral form factor of random-phase Floquet circuits versus the CUE ramp
physics/quantum_info|waves.gist: Construct Floquet operators of a brickwork random-phase circuit (Chan-De Luca-Chalker model) for a qudit chain and diagonalize them to obtain quasienergies. Compute the disorder-averaged spectral form factor |Tr U^t|^2 by Fourier sums over eigenphases. Extract the Thouless time at which it joins the circular-unitary-ensemble linear ramp.

physics/quantum_info|waves.title: Agarwal spin Wigner functions of Dicke and GHZ states via spherical-harmonic multipoles
physics/quantum_info|waves.gist: Expand the density matrix of N spin-1/2s in the symmetric subspace into spherical tensor (multipole) operators using Clebsch-Gordan coefficients. Reconstruct the Agarwal Wigner function on the sphere from spherical harmonics. Compute its negative volume as a nonclassicality and multipartite-entanglement indicator for Dicke, GHZ and spin-coherent states.

physics/quantum_mech|stochastic.title: Importance-sampled Monte Carlo electron-repulsion integrals versus analytic Boys-function formula
physics/quantum_mech|stochastic.gist: Estimate the six-dimensional (ss|ss) Coulomb integral over normalized s-type Gaussians by Monte Carlo, sampling the product Gaussian densities directly. Compare the estimate with the closed-form Boys-function result across exponents and centre separations, and quantify how the statistical error scales with sample size.

physics/quantum_mech|stochastic.title: Importance-sampled diffusion Monte Carlo potential curve of H2+
physics/quantum_mech|stochastic.gist: Run drift-diffusion-branching DMC for the single electron of H2+ at fixed nuclei, using an LCAO 1s guiding function with optimized exponent. Compute the ground-state energy versus internuclear distance, then fit the equilibrium bond length and dissociation energy and compare them with exact values.

physics/quantum_mech|stochastic.title: Path-integral Monte Carlo tunneling splitting in a symmetric double well
physics/quantum_mech|stochastic.gist: Sample discretized imaginary-time paths for a particle in a quartic double well using Metropolis single-bead and bisection moves. Extract the tunneling splitting from the exponential decay of the imaginary-time correlation <x(0)x(τ)>, and compare it with exact diagonalization on a grid.

physics/quantum_mech|stochastic.title: Linearized semiclassical Wigner-trajectory transmission through an Eckart barrier
physics/quantum_mech|stochastic.gist: Monte Carlo sample the Wigner phase-space distribution of an incident Gaussian wavepacket and propagate the samples classically across an Eckart barrier. Compute the transmitted probability versus mean energy, and compare it with exact split-operator propagation and the analytic Eckart transmission to expose the missing deep tunneling.

physics/quantum_mech|stochastic.title: Tully fewest-switches surface hopping across a Landau-Zener avoided crossing
physics/quantum_mech|stochastic.gist: Implement fewest-switches surface hopping for Tully's single avoided-crossing model, with stochastic hops, momentum rescaling and frustrated hops. Compute the branching probabilities versus incident momentum and compare them with exact wavepacket results and the Landau-Zener formula evaluated at the crossing velocity.

physics/quantum_mech|stochastic.title: Phase-noise washout of Landau-Zener-Stückelberg interference fringes
physics/quantum_mech|stochastic.gist: Simulate a periodically driven two-level system that makes repeated avoided-crossing passages, adding random Gaussian jitter to the drive amplitude or phase. Compute the noise-averaged excited-state population map versus amplitude and detuning, and extract how the fringe visibility decays with jitter variance.

physics/quantum_mech|stochastic.title: Gillespie simulation of hydrogen Rydberg radiative cascades
physics/quantum_mech|stochastic.gist: Compute hydrogen E1 Einstein A coefficients from numerically integrated radial dipole matrix elements for n up to about 10. Then run a Gillespie kinetic Monte Carlo of cascades starting from a chosen (n,l) state, and report the mean time to reach 1s, the 2s metastable branching fraction and the photon-number statistics.

physics/quantum_mech|stochastic.title: Variational Monte Carlo static polarizability of hydrogen with Dalgarno-Lewis trial
physics/quantum_mech|stochastic.gist: Use Metropolis sampling of the field-perturbed trial function (1+βz+γzr)e^{-r} to estimate the energy as a function of field strength. Use correlated sampling to obtain the quadratic Stark coefficient, and compare the resulting polarizability with the exact value of 9/2 a.u.

physics/quantum_mech|stochastic.title: Classical trajectory Monte Carlo field ionization of hydrogen Rydberg atoms
physics/quantum_mech|stochastic.gist: Sample a microcanonical classical ensemble for principal quantum number n, slowly ramp a static electric field, and integrate the Kepler-plus-field trajectories to detect over-barrier escape. Compute the ionization probability versus field and compare the threshold with the saddle-point estimate F = 1/(16n⁴).

physics/quantum_mech|stochastic.title: Stochastic projected Gross-Pitaevskii equation for finite-temperature 1D trapped Bose gas
physics/quantum_mech|stochastic.gist: Integrate the SPGPE in a harmonic-oscillator mode basis with damping and complex Langevin noise until it reaches thermal equilibrium. Compute the condensate fraction versus temperature from the Penrose-Onsager largest eigenvalue of the sampled one-body density matrix, and compare it with the ideal-gas prediction.

physics/quantum_mech|stochastic.title: Simulated-annealing minimization of a parametrized Thomas-Fermi screening function
physics/quantum_mech|stochastic.gist: Parametrize the TF screening function with a three-parameter trial form φ(x)=(1+(x/a)^b)^{-c} and minimize the TF energy functional over the parameters by Metropolis simulated annealing. Compare the optimized φ and the coefficient of the -Z^{7/3} total energy with a shooting solution of the TF equation (0.7687).

physics/quantum_mech|stochastic.title: Disorder-broadened resonant tunneling peaks in double-barrier heterostructures
physics/quantum_mech|stochastic.gist: Compute the transmission of a GaAs/AlGaAs double barrier with effective mass by the transfer-matrix method. Monte Carlo average over monolayer-scale fluctuations of the well and barrier widths, and quantify how the peak height, position shift and inhomogeneous broadening of the resonance compare with the intrinsic Breit-Wigner width.

physics/quantum_mech|stochastic.title: Nelson stochastic mechanics simulation of a harmonic-oscillator superposition
physics/quantum_mech|stochastic.gist: Propagate an ensemble of diffusing particles with the time-dependent osmotic-plus-current drift derived from an exact two-level harmonic-oscillator superposition state, using Euler-Maruyama Langevin steps. Compare histograms of the ensemble with |ψ(x,t)|² and the computed <x(t)> with the quantum expectation value.

physics/quantum_mech|stochastic.title: Gillespie simulation of optical pumping into a dark Zeeman sublevel
physics/quantum_mech|stochastic.gist: Kinetic Monte Carlo of σ⁺ optical pumping on a J=1/2→J'=1/2 (or F=1→F'=1) transition. Excitation rates and decay branching ratios come from Clebsch–Gordan coefficients. The distribution and mean number of scattered photons before the atom reaches the dark state are compared with the Markov-chain absorption-time result.

physics/quantum_mech|stochastic.title: Feynman–Kac Brownian survival estimate of the L-shaped hard-wall ground-state energy
physics/quantum_mech|stochastic.gist: Brownian walkers are absorbed on the boundary of an L-shaped quantum billiard. The exponential decay rate of the survival probability gives the lowest Dirichlet eigenvalue, with time-step bias controlled by a boundary-crossing correction. The result is compared with a sparse finite-difference eigenvalue and Richardson extrapolation.

physics/quantum_mech|stochastic.title: Classical trajectory Monte Carlo charge-exchange cross section for p + H(1s)
physics/quantum_mech|stochastic.gist: Initial H(1s) electron states are drawn from the microcanonical ensemble, and three-body Coulomb trajectories are integrated for random impact parameters. Final electron capture is classified by two-body energies. The charge-transfer and ionization cross sections versus impact energy are reported with statistical errors.

physics/quantum_mech|stochastic.title: PIMC winding-number sampling of the thermal persistent current in a flux-threaded ring
physics/quantum_mech|stochastic.gist: Path-integral Monte Carlo is performed for a particle on a 1D ring with discrete-angle paths and winding-number moves. The Aharonov–Bohm phase enters as a winding-weighted factor. The thermal current versus flux and temperature is compared with the exact spectral sum over angular-momentum levels.

physics/quantum_mech|stochastic.title: Forward-walking DMC pure estimators for the 3D isotropic quartic oscillator
physics/quantum_mech|stochastic.gist: Importance-sampled DMC is run for a particle in V=r⁴ with a Gaussian guide. The mixed, extrapolated (2·mixed − VMC) and forward-walking pure estimates of ⟨r²⟩ are compared against a Numerov radial ground-state reference. Bias is studied as a function of forward-walking projection time.

physics/stat_phys|waves.title: Quasi-cycle power spectra in stochastic Brusselator: Gillespie FFT versus linear noise approximation
physics/stat_phys|waves.gist: Simulate the Brusselator reaction network with the Gillespie algorithm below the Hopf bifurcation. Resample the trajectories on a uniform grid and estimate the power spectrum with windowed FFT periodograms (Welch averaging). Compare the resonant peak frequency and height with the analytic LNA spectrum obtained from the Jacobian and diffusion matrices.

physics/stat_phys|waves.title: Jarzynski check via spectral split-step tilted Fokker-Planck in moving quartic trap
physics/stat_phys|waves.gist: Solve the work-tilted Fokker-Planck equation for an overdamped particle in a translated anharmonic trap, using Fourier split-step propagation on a periodic grid. This gives the work generating function <exp(-lambda W)>. Verify the Jarzynski equality at lambda = beta and compare the moments with Langevin-simulated work histograms.

physics/stat_phys|waves.title: Kramers turnover from Klein-Kramers operator in Hermite-Fourier basis
physics/stat_phys|waves.gist: Represent the Klein-Kramers operator for a particle in a cosine potential in a basis of Hermite functions in velocity and Fourier modes in position, then compute its smallest nonzero eigenvalue with sparse eigensolvers. Map the escape rate across friction and compare with the energy-diffusion, Kramers and Mel'nikov-Meshkov interpolation formulas.

physics/stat_phys|waves.title: Ruelle-Pollicott resonances of a noisy circle map in Fourier basis
physics/stat_phys|waves.gist: Represent the Perron-Frobenius operator of the sine circle map with additive Gaussian noise as a matrix in Fourier modes; the noise is diagonal in this basis and the map matrix elements are Bessel functions. Compute the leading eigenvalues and compare the implied correlation decay rates with autocorrelations from simulated trajectories.

physics/stat_phys|waves.title: Subharmonic power-spectrum cascade of the logistic map at period doubling
physics/stat_phys|waves.gist: Iterate the logistic map at parameters just past successive period-doubling bifurcations and at the accumulation point. Compute FFT power spectra of the orbits and measure the attenuation between successive subharmonic families, comparing it with Feigenbaum's universal spectral prediction and with the Lyapunov exponent at each parameter.

physics/stat_phys|waves.title: Wavepacket spreading in the random dimer model via Chebyshev propagation
physics/stat_phys|waves.gist: Evolve an initially localized state in the 1D random dimer tight-binding chain using a Chebyshev-Bessel expansion of exp(-iHt). Measure the mean-squared displacement exponent, demonstrate superdiffusive spreading at the resonant energy, and contrast it with localization in the uncorrelated Anderson chain.

physics/stat_phys|waves.title: Belief propagation for XY model on random regular graphs with Bessel-Fourier messages
physics/stat_phys|waves.gist: Represent cavity messages for planar spins on a random regular graph as Fourier series in angle, so that the coupling convolution becomes multiplication by ratios of modified Bessel functions I_n(beta J)/I_0(beta J). Iterate to the fixed point, compute the Bethe free energy and magnetization, and locate the transition from the stability of the paramagnetic messages.

physics/stat_phys|waves.title: Ising strip transfer matrix with momentum-sector block diagonalization
physics/stat_phys|waves.gist: Build the row-to-row transfer matrix of the 2D Ising model on width-L cylinders and block-diagonalize it in translation-momentum sectors using discrete Fourier combinations of spin configurations. Obtain the correlation length from the gap, then estimate T_c and nu by phenomenological renormalization L*xi_L crossings.
physics/stat_phys|waves.area: Transfer matrix methods for 1D and strip lattices

physics/stat_phys|waves.title: Second-moment correlation length from FFT structure factor: xi/L crossings
physics/stat_phys|waves.gist: Run Wolff cluster Monte Carlo for the 2D Ising model and compute the structure factor S(k) of each configuration by 2D FFT. Form the second-moment correlation length from S(0) and S(k_min), locate T_c from xi/L and Binder cumulant crossings, and fit nu by data collapse.

physics/stat_phys|waves.title: Pseudospectral KPZ and Edwards-Wilkinson interfaces: structure factor and growth exponents
physics/stat_phys|waves.gist: Integrate the 1D EW equation exactly mode-by-mode as Ornstein-Uhlenbeck processes in Fourier space, and the 1D KPZ equation with a dealiased pseudospectral stochastic integrator. Measure the width growth exponent beta, the saturated structure factor S(k) ~ k^-2, and the dynamic exponent z from mode relaxation times.

physics/stat_phys|waves.title: Aubry-André quasiperiodic chain: localization transition and Fourier duality of eigenstates
physics/stat_phys|waves.gist: Diagonalize the incommensurate Harper/Aubry-André Hamiltonian at golden-mean frequency. Compute real-space and momentum-space (FFT) inverse participation ratios across λ=2, and confirm the transfer-matrix Lyapunov exponent ln(λ/2) in the localized phase.
physics/stat_phys|waves.area: Random matrix spectra in disordered systems

physics/stat_phys|waves.title: Faraday-wave onset: Floquet-Hill determinant for parametrically driven surface modes
physics/stat_phys|waves.gist: Model each surface wavenumber of a vertically vibrated inviscid fluid layer as a Mathieu equation with an optional phenomenological damping. Expand its Floquet solutions in Fourier harmonics (Hill's method) to locate the subharmonic and harmonic instability tongues. Report the critical drive amplitude and the selected wavelength.

physics/stat_phys|waves.title: Mean-field ANNNI model: modulated-phase wavevector from Fourier couplings and the Lifshitz point
physics/stat_phys|waves.gist: Fourier transform the competing nearest- and next-nearest-neighbor axial couplings to J(q). Maximize J(q) to obtain the mean-field critical temperature and ordering wavevector versus κ, locate the Lifshitz point κ=1/4, and solve real-space mean-field equations to confirm the modulated order.

physics/stat_phys|waves.title: Totally asymmetric zero-range process: kinematic-wave velocity from space-time FFT of density fluctuations
physics/stat_phys|waves.gist: Simulate a ring TAZRP with constant or bounded hop rates. Compute the dynamic structure factor S(k,t) by FFT of site occupations, and compare the drift of the correlation peak with the collective velocity dJ/dρ predicted from the factorized steady-state measure.

physics/stat_phys|waves.title: Spectral synthesis of fractional Brownian landscapes and box-counting dimension D=3−H
physics/stat_phys|waves.gist: Generate 2D fractional Brownian surfaces by filtering white noise with a power-law Fourier amplitude k^{-(H+1)} and inverse FFT. Measure the Hurst exponent from height-difference scaling and the fractal dimension of the surface and its coastlines by box counting, and compare with D=3−H.

physics/stat_phys|waves.title: Branched flow: first-caustic distance of rays in a Gaussian-correlated random potential
physics/stat_phys|waves.gist: Generate a smooth weak random potential by FFT filtering of white noise, then trace a parallel bundle of classical rays with an ODE integrator while also following the stability (ABCD-type) matrix. Record where it first becomes singular, and verify the ε^{-2/3} scaling of the mean first-caustic distance with potential strength.
physics/stat_phys|waves.area: Stochastic and wave propagation in disordered media

physics/stat_phys|waves.title: Continuous-time random walk propagator via Montroll-Weiss Fourier-Laplace inversion
physics/stat_phys|waves.gist: For a CTRW with Gaussian jumps and Pareto (power-law) waiting times, evaluate the Montroll-Weiss propagator in Fourier-Laplace space. Invert it numerically with FFT in space and Talbot or Stehfest in time, and compare P(x,t) and the subdiffusive MSD ~ t^α with Monte Carlo walkers.

physics/fields_astro|stochastic.title: Metropolis sampling of equilibrium of 1D self-gravitating sheet system
physics/fields_astro|stochastic.gist: Sample the canonical ensemble of N gravitating sheets, whose pair potential is |x_i - x_j|, with Metropolis moves in position at fixed temperature. Compare the sampled density profile with the isothermal sech^2 solution of Spitzer and estimate the finite-N corrections.

physics/fields_astro|stochastic.title: Self-inductance of a thick rectangular-section toroid by Monte Carlo energy integration
physics/fields_astro|stochastic.gist: Compute the field of a finite-thickness toroidal winding with Biot-Savart quadrature. Integrate the magnetic energy density B^2/(2 mu0) over the volume by Monte Carlo to obtain L = 2W/I^2, and compare with the analytic (mu0 N^2 h / 2 pi) ln(b/a) result, including leakage contributions.

physics/fields_astro|stochastic.title: Brownian dynamics of charged particles in a uniform magnetic field
physics/fields_astro|stochastic.gist: Integrate the Langevin equation with friction, thermal noise and the Lorentz force for a charged particle in a uniform B field. Extract the parallel and perpendicular diffusion coefficients from mean-square displacements and verify D_perp = D/(1 + omega_c^2 tau^2).

physics/fields_astro|stochastic.title: Monte Carlo dispersion analysis of Hohmann transfer with burn execution errors
physics/fields_astro|stochastic.gist: Perturb the magnitude and pointing of both Hohmann burns using Gaussian errors, propagate each sample with two-body Kepler propagation, and collect the resulting final-orbit semi-major axis and eccentricity. Report the statistics of these quantities and the 99th-percentile correction delta-v.

physics/fields_astro|stochastic.title: Satellite conjunction collision probability by Monte Carlo versus Foster 2D integral
physics/fields_astro|stochastic.gist: Sample relative position and velocity at closest approach from combined Gaussian covariances and count samples whose miss distance falls below the hard-body radius. Compare this collision probability with the short-encounter 2D Gaussian integral computed in the B-plane.

physics/fields_astro|stochastic.title: Delta-v distribution for Earth-Mars Lambert transfers under ephemeris uncertainty
physics/fields_astro|stochastic.gist: Solve the Lambert problem with a universal-variable solver for an Earth-Mars launch window. Propagate Gaussian uncertainties in the departure and arrival states by Monte Carlo to obtain the distributions of C3 and arrival v_inf, and identify the most robust departure date.

physics/fields_astro|stochastic.title: Cometary energy random walk and ejection times via the Kepler map
physics/fields_astro|stochastic.gist: Iterate the stochastic Kepler map for the orbital energy kick that a comet receives at each perihelion passage near Jupiter, using random phases. Compute the distribution of dynamical lifetimes before ejection or capture and compare it with the diffusion-theory prediction.

physics/fields_astro|stochastic.title: Photon random-walk escape time from an n=3 polytropic Sun
physics/fields_astro|stochastic.gist: Integrate the Lane-Emden n=3 equation to get the solar density profile, and assign an electron-scattering plus Kramers opacity. Run Monte Carlo photon random walks with position-dependent mean free paths to estimate the radiative diffusion time, and compare it with the analytic estimate R^2/(lambda c).

physics/fields_astro|stochastic.title: Wave localization length in random layered dielectric via ensemble 1D FDTD
physics/fields_astro|stochastic.gist: Propagate pulses with a 1D Yee FDTD scheme with PML boundaries through slabs of randomly drawn permittivity layers. Average the transmission over disorder realizations to extract the localization length versus frequency, and compare it with transfer-matrix results.

physics/fields_astro|stochastic.title: Escape fraction of isotropically emitted photons near a Schwarzschild black hole
physics/fields_astro|stochastic.gist: Sample emission directions isotropically in the static observer's frame and classify each null geodesic by its impact parameter relative to 3√3 M. Compute the escape fraction versus emission radius and compare it with the analytic escape-cone formula.

physics/fields_astro|stochastic.title: Synchrotron spectrum and polarization from Monte Carlo power-law electron ensemble
physics/fields_astro|stochastic.gist: Sample electron Lorentz factors from a power law and pitch angles from an isotropic distribution, then evaluate the single-particle synchrotron functions F(x) and G(x) for each electron. Assemble the total spectrum and linear polarization fraction, and verify the slope (p-1)/2 and the polarization (p+1)/(p+7/3).

physics/fields_astro|stochastic.title: Production-averaged MSW solar neutrino survival probability for 8B neutrinos
physics/fields_astro|stochastic.gist: Sample neutrino production radii from the 8B source profile and energies from the 8B spectrum. Evolve each neutrino through an exponential solar electron density with the two-flavor MSW equation, and compute the energy-binned average survival probability.

physics/fields_astro|stochastic.title: Capacitance of a unit cube by walk-on-spheres random walks
physics/fields_astro|stochastic.gist: Use the walk-on-spheres algorithm, with a first-passage sampling step for returning from infinity, to estimate the harmonic measure and capacitance of a conducting cube. Converge the result toward C ≈ 0.6607·4πε0 a and analyze how the bias and variance depend on the shell thickness epsilon.

physics/fields_astro|stochastic.title: Pitch-angle diffusion of cosmic rays in synthetic slab magnetic turbulence
physics/fields_astro|stochastic.gist: Generate random-phase slab Kolmogorov turbulence superposed on a mean field, integrate test-particle Lorentz-force orbits, and compute the parallel running diffusion coefficient. Extract the mean free path and compare it with quasilinear theory as a function of particle rigidity.

physics/fields_astro|stochastic.title: Diffusive shock acceleration spectrum by Monte Carlo scattering across a shock
physics/fields_astro|stochastic.gist: Simulate particles that scatter isotropically in the upstream and downstream fluid frames of a planar shock with compression ratio r, applying Lorentz-transformed energy gains at each crossing and a probabilistic escape downstream. Recover the momentum spectral index 3r/(r-1).

physics/fields_astro|stochastic.title: Variational Monte Carlo binding energy of hydrogen in neutron-star magnetic fields
physics/fields_astro|stochastic.gist: Use Metropolis sampling with an anisotropic Gaussian-times-exponential trial wavefunction to minimize the energy of hydrogen at B = 10^9 to 10^13 G. Compute the binding energy and compare it with the logarithmic adiabatic approximation ln^2(B) scaling.

chemistry/md|quad_models.title: Impulsive cutoff correction to virial pressure for truncated-unshifted LJ
chemistry/md|quad_models.gist: A truncated but unshifted LJ potential has a step at r_c, which produces a delta-function force. Compute the resulting pressure correction (2π/3)ρ²r_c³g(r_c)u(r_c) using a low-density model g(r)=exp(-βu), and compare it with the ordinary tail correction across cutoffs and temperatures using quadrature.

chemistry/md|quad_models.title: Debye scattering function of icosahedral Lennard-Jones nanoclusters
chemistry/md|quad_models.gist: Build Mackay icosahedral clusters (13 to 309 atoms) and compute the orientationally averaged I(q) with the Debye sinc sum. Validate it against explicit spherical averaging of |Σexp(iq·r)|² using Gauss-Legendre × trapezoid quadrature over directions.

chemistry/md|quad_models.title: Direct k-space S(k) for a periodic box versus continuous transform
chemistry/md|quad_models.gist: For a perturbed fcc configuration in a cubic box, compute S(k) on the allowed k-vectors 2πn/L and shell-average it. Compare with the transform of the box's g(r), and analyse the finite-size bias at the smallest k using the Debye-Waller form exp(-k²⟨u²⟩).

chemistry/md|quad_models.title: Heavy symmetric top nutation period from elliptic integral and quaternion dynamics
chemistry/md|quad_models.gist: For a Lagrange top, compute the nutation turning points from the cubic effective potential and the nutation period by quadrature (an elliptic integral). Compare these with a quaternion-based symplectic splitting simulation, and check conservation of the angular momentum components about the symmetry and vertical axes.

chemistry/md|quad_models.title: Classical rotational partition function of rigid water by Euler-angle quadrature
chemistry/md|quad_models.gist: Build the inertia tensor of a rigid SPC/E water molecule and diagonalise it. Evaluate the classical rotational partition function by numerical quadrature over Euler angles and conjugate momenta, compare with the closed form √(π I_A I_B I_C)(8π²kT/h²)^{3/2}/σ, and obtain the rotational heat capacity.

chemistry/md|quad_models.title: Sutton-Chen EAM copper: equation of state and Birch-Murnaghan bulk modulus
chemistry/md|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Sutton–Chen pair and density lattice sums for fcc Cu to obtain the cohesive energy versus lattice constant curve. Fit it to the third-order Birch–Murnaghan form, and compare the extracted a0, E_coh and B0 with the analytic minimum condition.

chemistry/md|quad_models.title: Unrelaxed vacancy formation and (100) surface energies in Finnis-Sinclair bcc iron
chemistry/md|quad_models.gist: Use the Finnis–Sinclair square-root embedding with polynomial pair and density functions to compute energies for a perfect bcc supercell, a single-vacancy cell and a (100) slab. From these, extract the unrelaxed vacancy formation energy and surface energy, and check the many-body forces by finite differences.

chemistry/md|quad_models.title: Mean first-passage times in triple-well potential: MSM versus exact double integral
chemistry/md|quad_models.gist: Build an MSM from Langevin trajectories in a 1D triple-well potential, then compute the stationary distribution and the MFPTs between wells by solving the linear system on the transition matrix. Validate both against the analytic 1D MFPT double integral ∫e^{βU}∫e^{−βU} evaluated by quadrature.

chemistry/md|quad_models.title: Yoshida and Forest-Ruth composition orders on pendulum with elliptic-integral period
chemistry/md|quad_models.gist: Integrate a large-amplitude pendulum with velocity Verlet and with 4th- and 6th-order Yoshida/Forest–Ruth compositions. Measure the global phase error against the exact period 4K(sin(θ0/2))/ω0, fit the convergence orders, and record the energy error scaling.

chemistry/md|quad_models.title: First-order density correction to g(r) of a dilute Lennard-Jones gas
chemistry/md|quad_models.gist: Compute g(r) = exp(-βu)[1 + ρ y1(r)], with y1 the convolution of two Mayer functions. Evaluate y1 by Fourier-Bessel (spherical sine) transforms with quadrature. Derive first-shell coordination numbers and the potential of mean force, and quantify the departure from exp(-βu) versus density and temperature.

chemistry/md|quad_models.title: Exact pair correlation of a 1D Takahashi Lennard-Jones gas via Laplace transforms
chemistry/md|quad_models.gist: For a 1D fluid with nearest-neighbour LJ interactions in the isobaric ensemble, compute the nearest-neighbour distribution by quadrature. Build g(x) as a sum of n-fold convolutions using FFT. Obtain the exact equation of state ρ(P,T), and check the compressibility sum rule from the integral of g(x)-1.

chemistry/md|quad_models.title: Lebowitz-Percus-Verlet microcanonical heat capacity tested on an exact harmonic crystal
chemistry/md|quad_models.gist: For N classical harmonic oscillators at fixed total energy, the kinetic energy follows a Beta distribution. Evaluate its moments analytically with special functions. Apply the LPV formula linking NVE kinetic-energy fluctuations to Cv, and compare finite-N predictions with sampled microcanonical states and the canonical result.

chemistry/md|quad_models.title: Hydrodynamic finite-size correction of self-diffusion in orthorhombic and slab boxes
chemistry/md|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the periodic Oseen-tensor lattice sum for non-cubic boxes by Ewald-Hasimoto summation using erfc and Gaussian terms. Obtain direction-dependent correction coefficients for D_xx and D_zz. Apply them to MSD diffusion coefficients from boxes of varying aspect ratio, and recover the cubic Yeh-Hummer constant 2.837297 as a check.

chemistry/md|quad_models.title: MSM discretisation error for an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process with analytic bin transitions
chemistry/md|quad_models.gist: Compute exact bin-to-bin transition probabilities of an OU process from its Gaussian propagator using double erf integrals over bins. Form the MSM transition matrix at several lag times and extract implied timescales and the stationary distribution. Compare against the exact relaxation time 1/k as a function of bin number and lag time.

chemistry/md|quad_models.title: Bjerrum ion-pair association constant from a distance PMF
chemistry/md|quad_models.gist: Build an ion-pair PMF from a Born-Mayer-plus-screened-Coulomb model, or from an umbrella/WHAM reconstruction. Integrate 4πr² exp(-βW) up to a cutoff to get the association constant and standard free energy. Compare with Bjerrum's Q(b) special-function result and analyse dependence on the cutoff choice.

chemistry/md|quad_models.title: Inertial free-rotor orientational correlations of linear molecules versus quaternion MD
chemistry/md|quad_models.gist: Derive the classical free-rotor C1(t) and C2(t) by quadrature over the Maxwell distribution of angular velocities, giving Dawson-function closed forms. Compare with orientational correlations from quaternion integration of non-interacting rigid linear rotors. Verify angular momentum conservation and the short-time Gaussian decay.

biology/quant_bio|linalg.title: Seed-bank plus continuous-size IPM megamatrix and seed-dormancy elasticity
biology/quant_bio|linalg.gist: Build a block megamatrix that couples a discrete seed-bank stage to a midpoint-discretized size kernel. Compute lambda by power iteration and sparse eigensolvers, and compute the summed elasticities of seed-bank transitions versus growth and survival.
biology/quant_bio|linalg.area: Integral projection models for size structure

biology/quant_bio|linalg.title: Moran model fixation probabilities and absorption times via fundamental matrix
biology/quant_bio|linalg.gist: Construct the transition matrix of a Moran process with selection coefficient s and population size N. Compute fixation probabilities and conditional mean fixation times from the fundamental matrix (I-Q)^{-1}, and validate them against closed-form results.

biology/quant_bio|linalg.title: Similarity-sensitive Hill diversity and maximum-diversity weighting of Leinster-Cobbold
biology/quant_bio|linalg.gist: Build a species similarity matrix Z from phylogenetic or functional distances, then compute similarity-sensitive Hill numbers across orders q. Find the maximum-diversity abundance vector by solving Z w = 1 on principal submatrices and selecting the feasible nonnegative weighting.

biology/quant_bio|linalg.title: GTR substitution model likelihood on a quartet via eigendecomposed rate matrix
biology/quant_bio|linalg.gist: Build a GTR rate matrix from exchangeabilities and base frequencies, symmetrize it, and compute P(t)=exp(Qt) by eigendecomposition. Evaluate site likelihoods on a four-taxon tree with Felsenstein pruning and pick the maximum-likelihood topology among the three quartets.

biology/quant_bio|linalg.title: Principal coordinates analysis of Kimura two-parameter distances among sequences
biology/quant_bio|linalg.gist: Compute Kimura two-parameter distances among sequences from several clades, then double-center the squared distance matrix. Embed the sequences by its eigendecomposition and report the variance explained per axis, negative eigenvalues, and the Cailliez correction constant for non-Euclidean distances.

biology/quant_bio|linalg.title: Schnakenberg Turing dispersion relation and unstable Neumann modes on finite domain
biology/quant_bio|linalg.gist: Linearize the Schnakenberg reaction-diffusion system and compute the eigenvalues of J - k^2 D as a function of wavenumber. Identify the critical diffusion ratio and the band of unstable cosine modes n*pi/L that are admissible on a finite one-dimensional domain with no-flux boundaries.

biology/quant_bio|linalg.title: Turing instability of Brusselator on random networks via graph Laplacian spectrum
biology/quant_bio|linalg.gist: Diagonalize the graph Laplacian of an Erdos-Renyi or scale-free network and evaluate the Brusselator growth rates for each Laplacian eigenvalue. Predict the critical mobility ratio and the localized unstable eigenvectors, then confirm the predictions by integrating the network ODEs.

biology/quant_bio|linalg.title: Linear gene network inference from steady-state perturbations by ridge regression
biology/quant_bio|linalg.gist: Simulate steady-state responses X of a sparse linear network dx/dt = A x + p to known perturbations P with measurement noise. Infer A by ridge-regularized least squares, choose the penalty by generalized cross-validation, and score edge recovery by AUROC.

biology/quant_bio|linalg.title: Steady-state rate law of ordered bi-bi mechanism via enzyme-species linear system
biology/quant_bio|linalg.gist: Assemble the pseudo-first-order rate matrix among enzyme forms of an ordered bi-bi mechanism and solve for steady-state enzyme fractions from its null space under the total-enzyme constraint. Compute the initial velocity surfaces, then extract the apparent Km and Vmax and verify them against the King-Altman symbolic expression from sympy.

biology/quant_bio|linalg.title: Inferring age-specific susceptibility from early-outbreak case age distribution by NNLS
biology/quant_bio|linalg.gist: Take a survey contact matrix, correct it for reciprocity using age-class population sizes, and build the next-generation matrix as diag(susceptibility) times contacts. Recover the susceptibility profile whose dominant eigenvector best matches an observed early-epidemic case age distribution, using alternating eigenvector computation and nonnegative least squares, then report the implied R0.

biology/quant_bio|linalg.title: Resilience and reactivity of the Rosenzweig-MacArthur equilibrium versus carrying capacity
biology/quant_bio|linalg.gist: For a Holling type II predator-prey model, compute the coexistence equilibrium and its Jacobian across a range of carrying capacities. Derive the asymptotic return time from the leading eigenvalue and the reactivity from the largest eigenvalue of the Jacobian's symmetric part. Map the enrichment interval where the equilibrium is stable but transiently amplifies perturbations.

biology/quant_bio|linalg.title: Directional spread speeds of a 2D integrodifference invasion with anisotropic Gaussian kernel
biology/quant_bio|linalg.gist: For an IDE with a bivariate Gaussian dispersal kernel that has drift and a general covariance matrix, write the moment-generating function as a quadratic form and compute the spread speed in each direction by minimizing ln(R0 M(s e))/s over s. Construct the asymptotic front shape by the Wulff envelope, and compare it with a 2D FFT simulation of the front.

biology/quant_bio|linalg.title: Sloppy Fisher information spectrum of a three-enzyme pathway model
biology/quant_bio|linalg.gist: Compute output sensitivities of a linear Michaelis-Menten enzyme cascade ODE with respect to log-parameters, using forward sensitivity equations. Assemble the Fisher information matrix and eigendecompose it to obtain the eigenvalue spread across decades and the stiff and sloppy parameter combinations. Compare the eigenvalue-based marginal uncertainties with the Cramér-Rao bounds.
biology/quant_bio|linalg.area: Bayesian and MCMC parameter estimation for biological models

biology/quant_bio|linalg.title: Eigenreactions and eigenconnectivities of a red blood cell stoichiometric matrix by SVD
biology/quant_bio|linalg.gist: Build the stoichiometric matrix of glycolysis plus the pentose phosphate pathway in the erythrocyte, then compute its singular value decomposition. Identify the dominant left singular vectors (eigenconnectivities) and right singular vectors (eigenreactions), the rank, and the null and left-null space dimensions. Interpret the leading modes as cofactor and redox exchange patterns, following Famili and Palsson.

biology/quant_bio|linalg.title: Cumomer linear systems for steady-state 13C labeling in a small metabolic network
biology/quant_bio|linalg.gist: For a small branched network with atom transitions, given fluxes and a labeled substrate, solve the cascade of cumomer balance equations level by level as sparse linear systems. Convert the cumomers into mass isotopomer distributions, then estimate the split ratio between the two branches by least-squares fitting to measured mass isotopomer distributions.

biology/quant_bio|linalg.title: Anisotropic 2D Aliev-Panfilov monodomain: longitudinal-to-transverse conduction velocity ratio
biology/quant_bio|linalg.gist: Discretize the monodomain diffusion operator with a rotated fiber conductivity tensor as a sparse matrix. Integrate Aliev-Panfilov kinetics with an IMEX scheme, factorizing the implicit diffusion matrix once with sparse LU. Measure the conduction velocities along and across the fibers from activation-time maps and compare their ratio with the square root of the conductivity ratio.

biology/quant_bio|linalg.title: Keyfitz population momentum after an instantaneous drop to replacement fertility
biology/quant_bio|linalg.gist: Build a human female Leslie matrix from age-specific survival and fertility schedules. Rescale fertility so that the net reproductive rate R0 equals 1, then compute the ultimate population size relative to its current size using the reproductive-value-weighted initial vector of the new matrix. Compare this result with direct matrix projection and with Keyfitz's approximation formula.

biology/quant_bio|linalg.title: Sequential versus combination therapy: time to multidrug resistance in a linear clone model
biology/quant_bio|linalg.gist: Model sensitive cells, single-resistant clones and doubly-resistant clones as a linear ODE x' = (G_d + μM)x under each drug regimen, where G_d holds the drug-specific growth rates and M the mutation transitions. Compute the time at which resistant cells exceed a detection threshold using eigendecompositions or matrix exponentials over piecewise-constant schedules, and compare sequential, alternating and combination regimens.

biology/quant_bio|linalg.title: Mean and variance of population size in random environments via Kronecker second moments
biology/quant_bio|linalg.gist: For i.i.d. random stage matrices, compute the growth rate of expected population size from the spectral radius of E[A]. Compute the growth of the second moment from the spectral radius of E[A⊗A]. Compare both rates with the stochastic growth rate λ_s estimated by simulation, and quantify how the coefficient of variation of population size grows over time.
biology/quant_bio|linalg.area: Environmental stochasticity and stochastic growth rate

physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.title: Thermal Fock-space density matrices of Einstein phonons: entropy and free energy
physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.gist: Build truncated Fock-space Gibbs states rho = exp(-beta H)/Z for a set of Einstein or Debye-sampled phonon modes. Compute the von Neumann entropy, vibrational free energy and heat capacity, check their convergence with Fock cutoff against the analytic Bose formulas, and sum over modes weighted by a Debye DOS.

physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.title: Mutual information between atoms in a thermal harmonic chain from Gaussian covariances
physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.gist: For a monatomic or diatomic harmonic chain, build the thermal position-momentum covariance matrix from the phonon normal modes and reduce it to a subset of atoms (Gaussian partial trace). Compute the symplectic eigenvalues, the reduced von Neumann entropies, and the two-site mutual information as functions of temperature and separation.

physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.title: Phonon-induced pure dephasing of a quantum-dot qubit as a Kraus channel
physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.gist: Integrate a super-ohmic Debye-cutoff phonon spectral density J(w) ~ w^3 exp(-w^2/wc^2) with coth(beta w/2) weighting to get the independent-boson decoherence function. Build the resulting dephasing Kraus channel and compute coherence decay, the residual coherence plateau, and the fidelity of the evolved qubit state versus temperature.

physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.title: Fukui-Hatsugai-Suzuki link-variable Berry curvature and Hall conductivity of the Qi-Wu-Zhang model
physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.gist: Discretize the Brillouin zone and form U(1) link variables from overlaps of neighboring Bloch eigenvectors. Obtain the gauge-invariant plaquette Berry curvature, the Chern number, and the occupation-weighted intrinsic sigma_xy versus chemical potential, including the quantized plateau in the gap.

physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.title: Anomalous Hall conductivity of a two-node magnetic Weyl semimetal from kz-resolved Chern numbers
physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.gist: For a four-band or two-band lattice Weyl model, compute the Chern number of each kz slice from Wilson-loop and overlap link products. Integrate over kz to obtain sigma_xy proportional to the Weyl-node separation, and track how it changes as the nodes move.

physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.title: Lehmann spectral function of a 6-site Hubbard ring via Jordan-Wigner operators
physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.gist: Build fermion creation operators on the full Fock space with Jordan-Wigner tensor products and diagonalize the Hubbard ring at half filling. Evaluate the momentum-resolved A(k,w) from the Lehmann sum, apply Lorentzian lifetime and Gaussian instrumental broadening, and extract the quasiparticle weight Z_k and the Hubbard-band weights.

physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.title: Spin-resolved ARPES of Rashba bands as a POVM with Mott-detector Sherman function
physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the photoelectron spin density matrices of the Rashba-split surface bands from the 2x2 Bloch eigenstates. Model a Mott or VLEED detector as a two-outcome POVM with Sherman function S_eff and finite efficiency, then compute the measured spin-resolved intensities, the reconstructed polarization vector, and its statistical error per count.

physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.title: Electron-phonon kink from exact diagonalization of the two-site Holstein model
physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.gist: Represent one electron on two sites coupled to a truncated phonon Fock space using tensor-product operators, and diagonalize the full Hamiltonian. Compute the electron spectral function from the Lehmann sum, the quasiparticle residue and effective mass, and compare them with Lang-Firsov polaron and second-order self-energy predictions.

physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.title: Wilson-loop Wannier charge centers and polarization of the Rice-Mele chain
physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the discrete Berry phase of the Rice-Mele model as the phase of an ordered product of Bloch-state overlaps (a gauge-invariant Wilson loop). Obtain the Wannier center and electronic polarization, and the pumped charge over an adiabatic cycle in (k,t).

physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.title: Hubbard dimer: exact single-site entanglement versus Hartree-Fock product state
physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.gist: Diagonalize the two-site Hubbard model at half filling in the 16-dimensional Fock space with Jordan-Wigner operators. Obtain the single-site reduced density matrix by partial trace, compute the entanglement entropy and double occupancy versus U/t, and compare energies and fidelity with the unrestricted Hartree-Fock antiferromagnetic Slater determinant.

physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.title: Ground-state fidelity susceptibility across mean-field Néel and Stoner transitions
physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.gist: Iterate self-consistent Hartree-Fock for the square-lattice Hubbard model at chosen fillings.
