Compute the overlap of Slater determinants at U and U+dU as the determinant of the occupied-orbital overlap matrix, and locate the ordering transitions from peaks in the fidelity susceptibility.

physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.title: Two-mode squeezing entanglement of antiferromagnetic magnons from Bogoliubov coefficients
physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.gist: Perform Holstein-Primakoff and Bogoliubov diagonalization of the square-lattice Heisenberg antiferromagnet. Treat each (a_k, b_-k) pair as a two-mode squeezed vacuum, compute the reduced-mode entanglement entropy per k, and compute the BZ-integrated sublattice magnetization reduction.
physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.area: Spin waves and linear spin-wave theory

physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.title: Exact one-magnon spectrum and dynamical structure factor of small Heisenberg rings versus LSWT
physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.gist: Build spin-1/2 Heisenberg ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic rings (N <= 12) from Kronecker products of Pauli matrices. Compute S(q,w) from Lehmann sums of S_q^- matrix elements, and compare the ferromagnetic one-magnon branch and the antiferromagnetic des Cloizeaux-Pearson dispersion with linear spin-wave theory.
physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.area: Spin waves and linear spin-wave theory

physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.title: Stochastic trace estimation of 2D DOS with random-phase states and kernel polynomials
physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.gist: Estimate the DOS of square and anisotropic rectangular tight-binding lattices with the kernel polynomial method, using random-phase vectors for stochastic traces and the Jackson kernel. Locate the logarithmic van Hove peak, fit its log divergence coefficient, and quantify the statistical error versus the number of random vectors.
physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.area: Density of states and van Hove singularities

physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.title: Entanglement-entropy Fermi-surface coefficient of square-lattice fermions near van Hove filling
physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the ground-state entanglement entropy of L x L blocks of 2D free fermions from correlation-matrix eigenvalues at several fillings. Fit the L log L coefficient and compare it with the Widom-conjecture Fermi-surface integral, analyzing the behavior as the filling approaches the van Hove saddle point.
physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.area: Density of states and van Hove singularities

physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.title: Subsystem particle-number fluctuations of 1D free fermions and Lindhard static structure factor
physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.gist: From the free-fermion correlation matrix, compute the particle-number variance of an interval and its log growth. Compare it with the static structure factor S(q) obtained by frequency-integrating the dynamic Lindhard response, and verify the f-sum rule numerically.

physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.title: Charge-qubit dephasing by RPA-screened 2DEG density fluctuations
physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the dynamic 2D Lindhard function and the RPA dielectric function, and obtain the qubit's density-fluctuation noise spectrum from the fluctuation-dissipation theorem. Build the pure-dephasing Kraus channel and compute the coherence decay, the dephasing rate, and its dependence on screening and qubit-gate distance.

physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.title: Entanglement spectrum of a Qi-Wu-Zhang cylinder: chiral entanglement edge modes
physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.gist: For a half-filled Chern-insulator cylinder at each momentum k_y, cut it into two halves and diagonalize the restricted correlation matrix. Plot entanglement energies versus k_y, count the spectral-flow crossings to read off the Chern number, and compare them with the physical edge-state dispersion and localization length.

physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.title: Majorana edge-mode splitting in a many-body Kitaev chain via Jordan-Wigner ED
physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.gist: Build the interacting Kitaev chain in the full Fock space with Jordan-Wigner tensor products and resolve the even and odd fermion-parity sectors. Compute the ground-state splitting versus chain length, extract the localization length from its exponential decay, and compute the edge-to-edge Majorana correlation.

physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.title: Lieb's theorem and flat-band ferromagnetism: total spin of small Lieb-lattice Hubbard clusters
physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.gist: Diagonalize the half-filled Hubbard model on small bipartite Lieb-type clusters (for example a 5-site star or a Lieb plaquette) using Jordan-Wigner Fock operators. Compute <S^2> of the ground state to verify S = |N_A - N_B|/2, and compare the result with the flat-band compact-localized-state count.
physics/condensed_matter|quantum_ops.area: Flat bands in kagome and Lieb lattices

physics/optics|quantum_ops.title: Two-photon correlations in a disordered coupled-waveguide lattice
physics/optics|quantum_ops.gist: Propagate two indistinguishable photons through a 1D tight-binding waveguide array with random on-site detuning. Compute the disorder-averaged two-photon correlation matrix Gamma_qr for symmetric and antisymmetric input states using the single-particle unitary exp(-iHz) and tensor-product two-photon amplitudes. Report the localization length extracted from the decay of the correlations.

physics/optics|quantum_ops.title: Static disorder versus Haken-Strobl dephasing in photonic quantum walks
physics/optics|quantum_ops.gist: Evolve a single-photon density matrix in a disordered waveguide lattice under a Lindblad master equation with site-dephasing Kraus operators. Compute the mean-squared displacement exponent and the inverse participation ratio. These show the crossover from Anderson localization to dephasing-induced diffusion.

physics/optics|quantum_ops.title: BPM-designed directional coupler as beam splitter for Hong-Ou-Mandel interference
physics/optics|quantum_ops.gist: Use split-step paraxial BPM to propagate the supermodes of two coupled slab waveguides and extract the coupling length. Build the 2x2 coupler unitary from these results. Apply it to the |1,1> Fock state to compute the HOM coincidence probability and visibility as a function of device length.

physics/optics|quantum_ops.title: Multimode interference coupler unitary and three-photon output statistics
physics/optics|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate an N x N MMI coupler with Crank-Nicolson BPM and extract its transfer matrix from the overlaps of input and output modes. Check its unitarity fidelity. Compute multiphoton output probabilities via matrix permanents for bosonic inputs and compare them with distinguishable-particle predictions.

physics/optics|quantum_ops.title: Coherent-mode decomposition and coherence entropy in Hopkins partially coherent imaging
physics/optics|quantum_ops.gist: Discretize the Hopkins transmission cross-coefficient for an annular source and a circular pupil as a positive Hermitian operator. Diagonalize it to obtain the coherent modes (SOCS kernels). Compute the von Neumann entropy and effective mode number versus the partial coherence factor sigma.

physics/optics|quantum_ops.title: Quantum Fisher information for resolving two incoherent point sources
physics/optics|quantum_ops.gist: Represent a photon from two equal incoherent sources through a Gaussian PSF as a mixed density matrix in a truncated Hermite-Gauss basis. Compute the quantum Fisher information for the separation via the symmetric logarithmic derivative. Compare it with the classical Fisher information of direct imaging and of HG-mode (SPADE) measurements.

physics/optics|quantum_ops.title: Helstrom bound for discriminating one versus two sub-Rayleigh point sources
physics/optics|quantum_ops.gist: Construct density operators for a single source and for a symmetric source pair in a Hermite-Gauss mode basis. Take their M-photon tensor powers. Compute the Helstrom minimum error probability from the trace distance and compare it with a direct-intensity hypothesis test.

physics/optics|quantum_ops.title: Ghost imaging with SPDC biphotons: reduced states and image visibility
physics/optics|quantum_ops.gist: Model a transverse-entangled SPDC biphoton with a double-Gaussian amplitude on a discretized grid. Show via partial trace that each arm alone is incoherent. Compute the ghost image of a slit object from coincidence correlations, along with the visibility and resolution versus the Schmidt number.

physics/optics|quantum_ops.title: Recoil decoherence of an optically levitated dielectric nanosphere
physics/optics|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the photon scattering rate of a trapped silica nanosphere from its Clausius-Mossotti polarizability and the dipole cross section. Use it to set the position-localization decoherence rate in a Lindblad equation for a Fock-truncated motional density matrix. Report the phonon heating rate and the purity decay.

physics/optics|quantum_ops.title: Polarization entanglement of photon pairs after Mie scattering of one photon
physics/optics|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the Mie amplitudes S1 and S2 from Riccati-Bessel coefficients for a dielectric sphere. Apply the scattering Jones matrix as a local non-unitary Kraus filter to one photon of a polarization Bell state. Compute the concurrence and fidelity of the postselected pair versus scattering angle and size parameter.

physics/optics|quantum_ops.title: Cloude coherency-matrix entropy of light scattered by polydisperse spheres
physics/optics|quantum_ops.gist: Build the Mueller matrix for a log-normal size distribution of spheres from Mie amplitudes. Convert it to the 4x4 Cloude coherency (Choi-type) matrix. Compute its eigenvalues, the polarimetric entropy and the physical realizability versus scattering angle.

physics/optics|quantum_ops.title: Broadband zeroth-order grating waveplate as a polarization qubit channel
physics/optics|quantum_ops.gist: Use 1D RCWA for TE and TM to compute the complex zeroth-order transmission of a subwavelength dielectric lamellar grating. Form the frequency-dependent Jones matrix and average it over a photon's spectrum to build the polarization channel. Compute the process fidelity to an ideal half-wave plate.

physics/optics|quantum_ops.title: Littrow-mounted dielectric grating as a two-photon beam splitter
physics/optics|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the 0 and -1 order reflection amplitudes of a binary grating in Littrow mount with RCWA, then assemble the two-port scattering matrix including loss to other orders. Evaluate the HOM coincidence probability and two-photon interference visibility versus groove depth.

physics/optics|quantum_ops.title: Nonlocal dispersion cancellation for SPDC photons in Sellmeier-modeled fibers
physics/optics|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the GVD of fused silica from a Sellmeier fit. Apply quadratic spectral phases to a time-frequency entangled joint spectral amplitude. Use SVD for the Schmidt number and compute the arrival-time correlation width for equal and opposite dispersion in the two arms.

physics/optics|quantum_ops.title: Polarization-mode-dispersion dephasing of a broadband polarization qubit
physics/optics|quantum_ops.gist: Model fiber PMD as a frequency-dependent birefringent unitary with a differential group delay. Average it over the photon spectrum and Maxwellian-distributed DGD to obtain a dephasing channel with Kraus representation. Compute the entanglement fidelity and the Bloch-vector shrinkage versus fiber length.

physics/optics|quantum_ops.title: Time-bin qubit error rate from chirped-pulse broadening in dispersive fiber
physics/optics|quantum_ops.gist: Propagate early and late Gaussian time-bin pulses through fiber with second- and third-order dispersion. Compute the inter-bin overlap and construct the effective POVM for arrival-time measurement. Evaluate the BB84 quantum bit error rate with and without a dispersion-compensating fiber segment.

physics/optics|quantum_ops.title: Two-mode squeezed state degradation through a lossy negative-index slab
physics/optics|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the Fresnel transmission of a Drude-Lorentz negative-index slab to obtain the frequency-dependent loss eta. Apply the pure-loss Kraus channel to one arm of a Fock-truncated two-mode squeezed vacuum. Compute the logarithmic negativity and fidelity versus frequency.

physics/optics|quantum_ops.title: Purcell-modified emitter decay near a cylinder cluster as amplitude damping
physics/optics|quantum_ops.gist: Solve the 2D multiple-scattering T-matrix system for a cluster of dielectric cylinders using Graf's addition theorem. Obtain the local density of states and the Purcell factor at an emitter position. Model the emitter as an amplitude-damping qubit channel and compute its fidelity and coherence lifetime.

physics/optics|quantum_ops.title: Von Neumann entropy flux of thermal emission from a multilayer selective emitter
physics/optics|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the spectral emissivity of a multilayer radiative-cooling stack with the transfer-matrix method. Assign each mode a thermal Gaussian state with occupancy epsilon * n_BE(T). Integrate the radiated power and the von Neumann entropy flux, and compare them with blackbody values.
physics/optics|quantum_ops.area: Thermal radiation and emissivity of structures

physics/optics|quantum_ops.title: OAM entanglement decay through a Kolmogorov turbulence phase screen
physics/optics|quantum_ops.gist: Generate Kolmogorov phase screens by FFT and project Laguerre-Gauss OAM modes through them to obtain an ensemble of qudit Kraus operators. Apply the ensemble to an OAM-entangled photon pair. Compute the crosstalk matrix, fidelity and negativity versus the Fried parameter.

chemistry/mc_thermo|quad_models.title: Adair binding polynomial with proton linkage: Bohr effect in tetrameric binding
chemistry/mc_thermo|quad_models.gist: Construct a four-site Adair binding polynomial whose stepwise constants depend on pH through linked proton-binding sites. Compute saturation curves at several pH values, and get the number of protons released per bound ligand from Wyman linkage derivatives of ln P with respect to ln[O2] and pH.

chemistry/mc_thermo|quad_models.title: Multiple-histogram WHAM free energies for harmonic oscillator ensembles
chemistry/mc_thermo|quad_models.gist: Generate analytic Boltzmann histograms of the energy for a d-dimensional harmonic system at several temperatures, then solve the self-consistent Ferrenberg-Swendsen equations for the relative free energies. Reconstruct the density of states and the mean energy at intermediate T, and compare both to the exact Gamma-distribution results.

chemistry/mc_thermo|quad_models.title: Brusselator Hopf bifurcation and limit-cycle period near onset
chemistry/mc_thermo|quad_models.gist: Compute the Brusselator fixed point and Jacobian eigenvalues, and locate the Hopf point B_c=1+A^2. Integrate the stiff ODEs with an implicit solver beyond onset, measure the oscillation period from successive peaks, and compare it to 2π/ω_c and to the amplitude scaling sqrt(B-B_c).

chemistry/mc_thermo|quad_models.title: Rachford-Rice isothermal flash of a natural-gas mixture with Wilson K-values
chemistry/mc_thermo|quad_models.gist: Estimate K-values for a C1–nC7 mixture from the Wilson correlation using critical constants and acentric factors. Solve the Rachford-Rice equation for the vapor fraction with a bracketed Newton/Brent method between the asymptotes, and return the phase compositions together with the bubble and dew pressures.

chemistry/mc_thermo|quad_models.title: Peng-Robinson fugacity-equality flash for methane/n-butane at high pressure
chemistry/mc_thermo|quad_models.gist: Implement Peng-Robinson cubic roots, mixing rules and component fugacity coefficients, then iterate successive substitution on K-values coupled to Rachford-Rice until the liquid and vapor fugacities are equal. Report the phase split and compositions, and the shrinking two-phase region as pressure approaches the mixture critical point.

chemistry/mc_thermo|quad_models.title: Ethanol-water azeotrope from Wilson activity model and Antoine vapor pressures
chemistry/mc_thermo|quad_models.gist: Combine Antoine vapor pressures with Wilson activity coefficients in modified Raoult's law. Compute the isobaric bubble-temperature curve and the vapor compositions by root-finding, then locate the azeotropic composition and temperature where the relative volatility equals one.

chemistry/mc_thermo|quad_models.title: Frenkel-Ladd integration for a harmonic crystal with analytic Einstein reference
chemistry/mc_thermo|quad_models.gist: For a 1D or 3D nearest-neighbor harmonic lattice, compute the Einstein-crystal free energy analytically, including the center-of-mass constraint correction. Integrate the coupling-parameter average ⟨U_latt − U_Ein⟩_λ, known in closed form via normal modes, with Gauss-Legendre quadrature, and check the total against the exact phonon free energy.

chemistry/mc_thermo|quad_models.title: Hard-sphere melting point from Carnahan-Starling fluid and Hall solid equations
chemistry/mc_thermo|quad_models.gist: Integrate the Carnahan-Starling fluid equation of state and the Hall/Speedy fcc solid equation of state to get free energies, anchoring the solid with the Frenkel-Ladd reference value at a known density. Solve equal pressure and chemical potential for the coexisting packing fractions and the melting pressure.

chemistry/mc_thermo|quad_models.title: Lennard-Jones fcc crystal free energy via lattice sums and Einstein frequency
chemistry/mc_thermo|quad_models.gist: Compute the static fcc lattice energy from Lennard-Jones lattice sums (truncated plus tail correction) and the Einstein frequency from the summed curvature of the pair potential. Assemble the quantum-corrected Einstein free energy and the zero-temperature equilibrium lattice constant for argon.

chemistry/mc_thermo|quad_models.title: Osmotic pressure and theta temperature of polystyrene-cyclohexane solutions
chemistry/mc_thermo|quad_models.gist: Compute the osmotic pressure from Flory-Huggins with χ(T)=A+B/T, extract the second virial coefficient and the theta temperature, and evaluate the reduced osmotic pressure Π/(cRT) versus concentration. Compare it with the virial expansion and determine the chain-length dependence of the critical temperature.

chemistry/mc_thermo|quad_models.title: Equilibrium constant K(T) for H2 + I2 ⇌ 2HI from spectroscopic constants
chemistry/mc_thermo|quad_models.gist: Compute translational, rigid-rotor (with symmetry numbers), harmonic vibrational and electronic partition functions from tabulated spectroscopic constants and dissociation energies. Combine them into K_p(T) over 300–1500 K and extract the reaction ΔH° and ΔS° by van 't Hoff analysis.
chemistry/mc_thermo|quad_models.area: Ideal-gas partition functions and equilibrium constants

chemistry/mc_thermo|quad_models.title: Ortho/para hydrogen rotational partition functions and heat capacity anomaly
chemistry/mc_thermo|quad_models.gist: Sum the rotational levels of H2 and D2 with nuclear-spin statistical weights to obtain partition functions for the equilibrium and frozen (3:1) mixtures. Compute the rotational heat capacity versus temperature by analytic derivatives of the level sums, and find the equilibrium ortho fraction as a function of T.
chemistry/mc_thermo|quad_models.area: Ideal-gas partition functions and equilibrium constants

chemistry/mc_thermo|quad_models.title: Isotope exchange equilibrium H2 + D2 ⇌ 2HD including zero-point energies
chemistry/mc_thermo|quad_models.gist: Use isotopically scaled reduced masses to compute the vibrational frequencies, rotational constants and zero-point energies of H2, D2 and HD, with symmetry numbers included. Evaluate K(T) from full partition functions and show its approach to the classical symmetry-number limit of 4 at high temperature.
chemistry/mc_thermo|quad_models.area: Ideal-gas partition functions and equilibrium constants

chemistry/mc_thermo|quad_models.title: Methane Henry coefficient in graphitic slit pore via Steele 10-4-3 potential
chemistry/mc_thermo|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the Steele 10-4-3 wall potential from both graphite walls of a slit pore. Integrate the Boltzmann factor across the pore width with adaptive quadrature to obtain the Henry constant per unit area and the isosteric heat of adsorption from the Boltzmann-weighted mean energy, both as a function of pore width.

chemistry/mc_thermo|quad_models.title: Argon Henry coefficient inside carbon nanotubes using Tjatjopoulos hypergeometric potential
chemistry/mc_thermo|quad_models.gist: Implement the Tjatjopoulos-Feke-Mann continuum potential for an atom inside a cylindrical carbon shell using Gauss hypergeometric functions. Integrate exp(-βU) over the radial coordinate to get Henry coefficients and low-coverage isosteric heats as functions of tube radius and temperature.

math/nla_approx|ode.title: Levin collocation for oscillatory integrals via a Chebyshev ODE boundary problem
math/nla_approx|ode.gist: Evaluate ∫f(x)e^{iωg(x)}dx by solving the Levin ODE p'+iωg'p=f with Chebyshev collocation. Measure how the error behaves as ω grows, compare with Gauss-Legendre quadrature, and include a nonlinear phase g(x)=x+x^3.

math/nla_approx|ode.title: Filon-type variation-of-constants integrator for a highly oscillatory forced oscillator
math/nla_approx|ode.gist: Integrate y''+ω²y=f(t,y) with large ω by evaluating the variation-of-constants integrals with Filon quadrature, using moments of sin and cos. Compare the global error and step-size independence from ω against RK4 and the Störmer-Verlet method.

math/nla_approx|ode.title: Tanh-sinh quadrature of Morse oscillator period versus RK event detection
math/nla_approx|ode.gist: Compute the classical period T(E)=√(2m)∫dx/√(E-V(x)) of a Morse oscillator, which has inverse-square-root endpoint singularities, using double-exponential quadrature. Validate against the analytic period and against turning-point detection in an RK45 trajectory.

math/nla_approx|ode.title: HODLR compression of Sturm-Liouville Green's function built from shooting solutions
math/nla_approx|ode.gist: Construct the Green's function matrix of -(p u')'+q u=f from two RK-integrated homogeneous solutions and the Wronskian, and compress it into HODLR form with ACA. Verify that the off-diagonal ranks equal 1, measure storage and matvec scaling, and compare the resulting solution with a finite-difference solve.

math/nla_approx|ode.title: ACA-compressed fractional Laplacian semi-discretization with explicit Runge-Kutta stepping
math/nla_approx|ode.gist: Assemble the dense 1D fractional Laplacian matrix (singular kernel |x-y|^{-1-2s}), approximate its well-separated blocks by ACA in a hierarchical partition, and time-step fractional diffusion with RK4 using H-matrix matvecs. Report storage versus N and the solution error relative to the dense computation.

math/nla_approx|ode.title: Van der Pol limit-cycle period via Newton-Krylov multiple shooting
math/nla_approx|ode.gist: Formulate a periodic orbit as a multiple-shooting nonlinear system with a phase condition and solve it by Newton-GMRES, using Jacobian-vector products of the RK flow map. Return the period versus μ and the Floquet multipliers, and check quadratic convergence.

math/nla_approx|ode.title: Tensor-train Runge-Kutta for the four-dimensional heat equation with rounding
math/nla_approx|ode.gist: Represent the d=4 Kronecker-sum Laplacian and a non-separable initial condition in TT format via TT-SVD, then time-step with explicit RK, applying TT rounding after each stage. Track TT ranks and the error against the full-grid solution computed by matrix exponentials.
math/nla_approx|ode.area: Tensor trains and low-rank tensor arithmetic

math/nla_approx|ode.title: Projector-splitting dynamical low-rank integrator for a differential Lyapunov equation
math/nla_approx|ode.gist: Integrate X'=AX+XA^T+BB^T with the Lubich-Oseledets KSL splitting at a fixed rank r. Compare the error against the full RK45 solution as a function of r and step size, and show that the integrator is robust to small singular values.
math/nla_approx|ode.area: Tensor trains and low-rank tensor arithmetic

math/nla_approx|ode.title: Tikhonov recovery of forcing on a damped oscillator with GCV
math/nla_approx|ode.gist: Build the forward operator from the oscillator's impulse response (obtained by ODE integration) mapping force f(t) to noisy displacement data, then reconstruct f by Tikhonov regularization. Choose the parameter by GCV and the L-curve and compare the reconstruction errors.

math/nla_approx|ode.title: Ruge-Stueben AMG for implicit Euler anisotropic diffusion on Delaunay meshes
math/nla_approx|ode.gist: Assemble P1 FEM stiffness and lumped mass matrices on a random Delaunay mesh, then solve each implicit Euler step with classical strength-of-connection C/F coarsening and a direct-interpolation V-cycle. Measure the asymptotic convergence factor versus time step and anisotropy.

math/nla_approx|ode.title: HOSVD compression of Lotka-Volterra trajectories over a parameter grid
math/nla_approx|ode.gist: Integrate predator-prey ODEs over a grid of (α, β) parameters to form a time×α×β tensor, then compute its truncated HOSVD/Tucker decomposition. Report the compression ratio versus relative error and the decay of the mode-n singular values.

math/nla_approx|ode.title: CP-ALS recovers eigenmodes of a linear first-order reaction network
math/nla_approx|ode.gist: Simulate a linear kinetic network from many initial conditions to build an initial-condition×species×time tensor, whose exact CP rank equals the number of eigenmodes. Fit CP-ALS and compare the recovered temporal factors and decay rates with the eigenvalues of the rate matrix.

math/nla_approx|ode.title: Orr-Sommerfeld critical Reynolds number by Chebyshev collocation
math/nla_approx|ode.gist: Discretize the Orr-Sommerfeld equation for plane Poiseuille flow with Chebyshev collocation, including clamped boundary conditions, and solve the generalized eigenproblem. Locate the neutral curve minimum near Re≈5772, α≈1.02, and verify spectral convergence of the leading eigenvalue.

math/nla_approx|stochastic.title: Talay-Tubaro Richardson extrapolation of Euler-Maruyama weak error for Ornstein-Uhlenbeck
math/nla_approx|stochastic.gist: Estimate E[f(X_T)] for an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck or geometric Brownian motion SDE by Euler-Maruyama Monte Carlo at step sizes h and h/2, with coupled Brownian increments. Apply Richardson extrapolation and verify that the weak order improves from O(h) to O(h^2) against the exact expectation.

math/nla_approx|stochastic.title: Richardson-extrapolated tau-leaping for a stochastic dimerization network
math/nla_approx|stochastic.gist: Simulate the reaction network 2A <-> B with Poisson tau-leaping at several leap sizes and estimate the mean and variance of species counts at a fixed time. Romberg-style extrapolation is checked against long Gillespie SSA reference runs to confirm the improved weak order.

math/nla_approx|stochastic.title: Stochastic Lanczos quadrature for Gaussian-process log-determinants
math/nla_approx|stochastic.gist: Estimate log det(K + sigma^2 I) for a Matérn covariance matrix with Hutchinson Rademacher probes combined with Lanczos-based Gauss quadrature of the logarithm. The marginal likelihood of a GP length-scale is profiled and compared with dense Cholesky results, along with the estimator variance.

math/nla_approx|stochastic.title: Kernel polynomial method density of states for a random-graph Laplacian
math/nla_approx|stochastic.gist: Compute the spectral density of the normalized Laplacian of an Erdős-Rényi graph. Chebyshev moments are estimated stochastically with random probe vectors and Jackson damping, and the resulting histogram is compared with exact eigenvalues as a function of moment count and number of probes.

math/nla_approx|stochastic.title: Generalized cross-validation with randomized trace estimation for Tikhonov deblurring
math/nla_approx|stochastic.gist: Regularize a 1D Gaussian-blur deconvolution with Tikhonov. The GCV denominator trace(I - A(lambda)) is evaluated with Hutchinson probes and CG solves, and the selected lambda is compared with exact SVD-based GCV and the discrepancy principle.

math/nla_approx|stochastic.title: Hierarchical Gibbs sampler for regularization parameter in Bayesian deconvolution
math/nla_approx|stochastic.gist: Sample the posterior of the image, the noise precision and the prior precision for a linear blurring inverse problem, using Gamma-conditional updates and Gaussian conditional draws by perturbation optimization. The posterior distribution of the effective Tikhonov parameter is compared with L-curve and GCV choices.

math/nla_approx|stochastic.title: Randomized multiplicative Schwarz with overlapping subdomains for 2D Poisson
math/nla_approx|stochastic.gist: Solve a finite-difference Poisson problem by multiplicative Schwarz, choosing the subdomain to update at random at each step. The expected error-contraction factor is measured by Monte Carlo over orderings and compared with deterministic sweeps and additive Schwarz as the overlap width varies.

math/nla_approx|stochastic.title: Walk-on-spheres interface values for probabilistic domain decomposition of Laplace
math/nla_approx|stochastic.gist: Estimate the solution of the Dirichlet Laplace problem at interface nodes with walk-on-spheres Brownian simulation. Subdomain problems are then solved independently with finite differences, and the final error is tracked against walk count, interface resolution and an exact harmonic solution.

math/nla_approx|stochastic.title: Average sign decay in Monte Carlo of oscillatory quartic integrals versus Filon quadrature
math/nla_approx|stochastic.gist: Evaluate Z(lambda) = integral of exp(-x^2/2 + i*lambda*x^4) by Gaussian Monte Carlo with phase reweighting. The exponential decay of the average sign and the relative error is quantified and compared with high-accuracy Filon and tanh-sinh quadrature references.

math/nla_approx|stochastic.title: Brownian first-passage density through curved boundary via Abel-kernel product integration
math/nla_approx|stochastic.gist: Solve the weakly singular Volterra integral equation for the first-passage time density of Brownian motion through a square-root or linear boundary, using product-integration rules for the t^{-1/2} kernel. The result is validated against histograms from Monte Carlo Brownian path simulation with Brownian-bridge crossing correction.

math/nla_approx|stochastic.title: Aggregation-based multigrid Monte Carlo for Gaussian Markov random fields
math/nla_approx|stochastic.gist: Sample a GMRF defined by a graph Laplacian on an unstructured Delaunay mesh. Single-site Gibbs sampling is compared with multigrid Monte Carlo, which uses pairwise-aggregation coarsening for coarse-level moves, by measuring integrated autocorrelation times of a mean observable.

math/nla_approx|stochastic.title: FEAST contour filtering of slow Fokker-Planck eigenvalues for double-well Brownian dynamics
math/nla_approx|stochastic.gist: Discretize the Fokker-Planck generator of an overdamped particle in a 1D double well. FEAST with Gauss-Legendre contour quadrature extracts the eigenvalues near zero, and the slowest relaxation rate is compared with transition rates estimated from Brownian dynamics trajectories and with Kramers theory.

math/nla_approx|stochastic.title: Variational Monte Carlo with B-spline trial wavefunction for an anharmonic oscillator
math/nla_approx|stochastic.gist: Represent the trial wavefunction of a 1D quartic oscillator in a clamped B-spline basis and sample |psi|^2 with Metropolis. Spline coefficients are optimized with the stochastic linear method, and the variational energy is compared with exact diagonalization.

math/nla_approx|stochastic.title: Gaussian random field sampling with HODLR-compressed exponential covariance via ACA
math/nla_approx|stochastic.gist: Compress the exponential covariance matrix of a 2D point cloud into a HODLR format, using adaptive cross approximation for the off-diagonal blocks. Correlated samples are drawn through a low-rank-updated factorization, and the study reports storage and matvec scaling plus the error of the empirical covariance against the dense result.

math/nla_approx|stochastic.title: Ulam-von Neumann random-walk estimator for diagonally dominant linear systems
math/nla_approx|stochastic.gist: Solve (I - H) x = b by Monte Carlo random walks on the Neumann series, using transition probabilities proportional to |H_ij|, applied to a discretized 1D Poisson-type matrix. The study measures variance versus spectral radius and compares the estimated solution components with direct solves.

math/nla_approx|waves.title: Global-matrix LU versus transfer-matrix products for evanescent multilayer optical stacks
math/nla_approx|waves.gist: For a 1D dielectric multilayer with thick evanescent (tunneling) layers, compute reflectance two ways: by multiplying 2x2 interface/propagation transfer matrices, and by solving the banded global boundary-condition system with partial-pivoting LU. Report the exponential error growth of the transfer-matrix product, the LU growth factor and the backward error.

math/nla_approx|waves.title: Pivoting growth factors for Vandermonde systems on perturbed roots of unity
math/nla_approx|waves.gist: Build Vandermonde (nonuniform DFT) matrices on nodes jittered off the unit-circle roots of unity. Factor them with partial, rook and complete pivoting LU and compare growth factors, condition numbers and componentwise backward errors against the exactly unitary FFT case as the jitter increases.

math/nla_approx|waves.title: Plane-wave-enriched moving least squares for scattered Helmholtz field samples
math/nla_approx|waves.gist: Reconstruct a 2D superposition of Helmholtz plane waves from scattered sensor samples using MLS with Gaussian weights. Compare a local polynomial basis, a local plane-wave (Trefftz) basis and Shepard interpolation through RMS error and the FFT-measured spectral leakage of each reconstruction on a grid.
math/nla_approx|waves.area: Moving least squares and scattered data fitting

math/nla_approx|waves.title: Trigonometric polynomial fitting of irregular samples via Toeplitz-FFT conjugate gradients
math/nla_approx|waves.gist: Recover a band-limited periodic signal from nonuniformly spaced samples using the adaptive-weights (ACT) method. Solve the weighted normal equations, which have Toeplitz structure, by CG with FFT-based Toeplitz matvecs, and compare reconstruction error and iteration counts with Shepard interpolation as the maximum sampling gap varies.
math/nla_approx|waves.area: Moving least squares and scattered data fitting

math/nla_approx|waves.title: Ray tracing through spline-interpolated Munk sound-speed profile: travel-time error
math/nla_approx|waves.gist: Trace acoustic rays through the canonical Munk ocean sound-speed profile with an RK4 integration of the ray equations, using either the analytic profile or cubic-spline and piecewise-linear interpolants built from N depth samples. Report the convergence of turning depths, ray-cycle range and travel time as N grows.

math/nla_approx|waves.title: Roundoff error growth in radix-2 FFT versus naive and compensated DFT
math/nla_approx|waves.gist: Implement a recursive radix-2 FFT, a naive DFT and a Kahan-compensated DFT, using either accurate or recursively generated twiddle factors. Measure relative errors against a high-precision reference as n grows and compare them with the a priori O(u log n) and O(u n) bounds.
math/nla_approx|waves.area: Floating-point error analysis and compensated summation

math/nla_approx|waves.title: Compensated Clenshaw recurrence for Chebyshev and Legendre series evaluation
math/nla_approx|waves.gist: Implement the Clenshaw recurrence and an error-free-transformation (TwoSum/TwoProd) compensated version for Chebyshev and Legendre expansions with slowly decaying coefficients. Compare the measured errors near x = ±1 with the running error bounds and the series condition number.
math/nla_approx|waves.area: Floating-point error analysis and compensated summation

math/nla_approx|waves.title: Lanczos approximation of cos(t√A)u0 for heterogeneous 2D acoustic waves
math/nla_approx|waves.gist: Solve the 2D wave equation with a layered sound speed by applying cos(t√A) and sinc-type matrix functions to the initial data via Lanczos on the sparse finite-difference Laplacian. Compare with leapfrog time stepping and study Krylov dimension versus t·||A||^(1/2) and the a posteriori error estimate.

math/nla_approx|waves.title: Tucker compression of the 3D Helmholtz Green's function for FFT convolution
math/nla_approx|waves.gist: Sample the kernel exp(ikr)/r, regularized at r = 0, on a 3D grid and compress it with HOSVD/Tucker and with CP-ALS. Measure ranks versus tolerance and wavenumber, and report the error of the resulting FFT-based volume convolution against the full-kernel convolution.

math/nla_approx|waves.title: CP-ALS recovery of DFT diagonalization of the cyclic convolution tensor
math/nla_approx|waves.gist: Form the 3-way bilinear tensor of length-n cyclic convolution and compute rank-n CP decompositions by alternating least squares from random starts. Check convergence, compare the factors with the DFT matrices up to scaling and permutation, and test whether rank n-1 fits fail.

math/nla_approx|waves.title: Circulant-preconditioned GMRES for nonsymmetric Toeplitz convection-diffusion systems
math/nla_approx|waves.gist: Solve nonsymmetric Toeplitz systems from 1D upwinded convection-diffusion with GMRES, using FFT matvecs and Strang or T. Chan circulant preconditioners. Relate the observed convergence to eigenvalue clustering and to the departure from normality and pseudospectra as the Péclet number grows.

math/nla_approx|waves.title: Restart stagnation of GMRES for 2D Lippmann–Schwinger scattering
math/nla_approx|waves.gist: Solve the 2D acoustic Lippmann–Schwinger equation for a penetrable cylinder, discretized on a grid with an FFT-convolution matvec using the H0^(1) Hankel kernel. Compare full GMRES with GMRES(m) for several restart lengths, show stagnation as contrast and size increase, and validate the far field against the Mie-series solution.

math/nla_approx|waves.title: Nonlinear N-term approximation: Daubechies wavelets versus Fourier for piecewise-smooth signals
math/nla_approx|waves.gist: Implement periodized Haar and Daubechies-4 and -8 DWTs and their inverses with filter banks, then keep the N largest coefficients of a piecewise-polynomial signal with jumps. Fit the L2 error decay rates in N and compare them with Fourier N-term truncation, which suffers from the Gibbs phenomenon.

math/nla_approx|waves.title: Beylkin–Coifman–Rokhlin wavelet compression of the Hilbert transform kernel matrix
math/nla_approx|waves.gist: Discretize the periodic Hilbert transform (cotangent kernel) as a dense matrix, apply a 2D Daubechies wavelet transform in standard form, and threshold the result. Measure the number of retained entries versus tolerance and n, and the matvec error against the exact FFT-based Hilbert transform.

math/nla_approx|waves.title: Circulant embedding Gaussian random field sampling and Cholesky definiteness failure
math/nla_approx|waves.gist: Sample stationary Gaussian fields with Matérn and squared-exponential covariances on a 1D or 2D grid by FFT circulant embedding. Detect negative embedding eigenvalues and find the minimal padding that removes them, and compare with dense Cholesky, where the squared-exponential covariance loses numerical definiteness and needs added jitter.
math/nla_approx|waves.area: Cholesky and LDL^T for symmetric systems

math/nla_approx|waves.title: Counting waveguide modes via LDL^T inertia of the shifted stiffness matrix
math/nla_approx|waves.gist: Assemble the 1D FEM stiffness and mass matrices for a step-index slab waveguide, form K - λM, and compute its inertia by symmetric indefinite LDL^T (Bunch–Kaufman) using Sylvester's law. Count guided modes below a cutoff and bisect on λ to locate the propagation constants, checking them against the transcendental dispersion relation.
math/nla_approx|waves.area: Cholesky and LDL^T for symmetric systems

math/pde_numerics|ode.title: Lid-driven cavity at Re=100 via vorticity-streamfunction method of lines
math/pde_numerics|ode.gist: Semi-discretize 2D vorticity transport on a uniform grid with Thom wall vorticity. March to steady state with RK4, solving a sparse Poisson problem for the streamfunction at each stage. Report the primary vortex center location, its streamfunction minimum, and circulation, and compare against the Ghia benchmark values.

math/pde_numerics|ode.title: Double shear layer roll-up with pseudo-spectral vorticity and RK4
math/pde_numerics|ode.gist: Evolve a doubly periodic perturbed double shear layer using Fourier pseudo-spectral vorticity-streamfunction RHS with 2/3 dealiasing and classical RK4 time stepping. Compute the time histories of energy, enstrophy and palinstrophy, and the enstrophy decay rate at a given viscosity.

math/pde_numerics|ode.title: Albedo and transmission of isotropically scattering slab with S_N source iteration
math/pde_numerics|ode.gist: Solve the monoenergetic slab transport equation using Gauss-Legendre S_N quadrature. Each direction's streaming ODE is integrated across cells with the step-characteristic (exponential) scheme inside a source iteration. Compute albedo, transmission and the scalar flux profile, and measure the spectral radius of the iteration versus the scattering ratio c.

math/pde_numerics|ode.title: Milne problem extrapolation distance from S_N discrete eigenmodes
math/pde_numerics|ode.gist: Write the half-space S_N transport equations as a linear constant-coefficient ODE system. Compute its eigenvalues (discrete decay constants) and eigenvectors, and impose the vacuum boundary condition to construct the Milne solution. Extract the linear extrapolation distance and its convergence with N toward 0.7104 for c=1.

math/pde_numerics|ode.title: FTCS, backward Euler and Crank-Nicolson for a rod with Robin cooling
math/pde_numerics|ode.gist: Semi-discretize 1D heat conduction with a convective Robin boundary condition and integrate with FTCS, backward Euler (Thomas tridiagonal solves) and Crank-Nicolson. Benchmark against the eigenfunction-series solution with transcendental eigenvalues. Report L2/Linf errors, observed temporal and spatial convergence rates, and the FTCS stability threshold.
math/pde_numerics|ode.area: Explicit and implicit heat equation solvers

math/pde_numerics|ode.title: Annular drum eigenfrequencies via radial Bessel ODE shooting
math/pde_numerics|ode.gist: Separate the Dirichlet Laplacian on an annulus into angular modes and solve each radial Bessel-type ODE by RK shooting with bracketed root finding on the outer-boundary mismatch. Compute the lowest eigenvalues across azimuthal orders and verify them against roots of the Bessel cross-product J_m(ka)Y_m(kb) - J_m(kb)Y_m(ka).

math/pde_numerics|ode.title: Critical Rayleigh number for rigid-rigid Rayleigh-Bénard onset by shooting
math/pde_numerics|ode.gist: Solve the sixth-order linear stability ODE (D²-a²)³W = -Ra a²W on a layer with no-slip, fixed-temperature walls. Use multi-solution shooting with determinant matching, or orthonormalization, to find the neutral Ra(a). Minimize over wavenumber to obtain Ra_c ≈ 1707.76 and a_c ≈ 3.117.

math/pde_numerics|ode.title: Graetz problem eigenvalues and Nusselt number for laminar pipe flow
math/pde_numerics|ode.gist: Reduce thermally developing Poiseuille pipe flow with constant wall temperature to the Graetz Sturm-Liouville problem. Compute its eigenvalues and eigenfunction coefficients by shooting with an RK integrator. Assemble the local and mean Nusselt numbers versus Graetz coordinate and verify the fully developed limit Nu = 3.657.

math/pde_numerics|ode.title: Stability regions of IMEX-RK pairs for advection-diffusion in Fourier space
math/pde_numerics|ode.gist: For advection-diffusion, with advection treated explicitly and diffusion implicitly, compute the amplification factor of several IMEX-RK tableaux (IMEX-Euler, ARS(2,2,2), ARS(4,4,3)) over all Fourier modes. Determine the maximum stable time step as a function of the cell Péclet number and verify each pair's order conditions numerically.

math/pde_numerics|ode.title: Blow-up time of u_t = u_xx + u^p via scale-invariant moving mesh
math/pde_numerics|ode.gist: Solve the semilinear heat equation with power nonlinearity on a moving mesh, where the monitor function is chosen to preserve the blow-up scaling invariance, and integrate the mesh-PDE system with a stiff ODE solver. Estimate the blow-up time and verify the self-similar rate max u ~ (T-t)^{-1/(p-1)}.

math/pde_numerics|ode.title: Sorbing, decaying contaminant breakthrough with finite-volume method of lines
math/pde_numerics|ode.gist: Discretize 1D advection-dispersion with linear retardation and first-order decay using upwind/central finite volumes, and integrate with BDF. Compute breakthrough curves at an observation well and their temporal moments. Compare against the Ogata-Banks / van Genuchten analytic solutions to quantify numerical dispersion.

math/pde_numerics|stochastic.title: Travel-time statistics in lognormal random slowness fields via fast marching
math/pde_numerics|stochastic.gist: Generate Gaussian-correlated lognormal slowness fields by FFT spectral synthesis and solve the 2D eikonal equation for each with a first-order fast marching method. Monte Carlo estimates the mean and variance of first-arrival times at a receiver line, compared with Rytov/ray-perturbation predictions.

math/pde_numerics|stochastic.title: Varadhan's formula: eikonal distance from Brownian hitting probabilities
math/pde_numerics|stochastic.gist: Simulate small-noise Brownian particles with absorption at a target in an obstacle-laden 2D domain and estimate the distance as -sqrt(2 eps log P) as eps goes to 0. Compare the result with fast-sweeping eikonal distances and quantify bias versus eps.

math/pde_numerics|stochastic.title: Quasipotential of the Maier-Stein nongradient SDE versus Monte Carlo escape times
math/pde_numerics|stochastic.gist: Compute the quasipotential of the 2D Maier-Stein system with an upwind fast-marching-type solver for its Hamilton-Jacobi equation. Estimate exit times by Euler-Maruyama Langevin simulation at decreasing noise and verify the Arrhenius slope against the barrier height.

math/pde_numerics|stochastic.title: HJB stochastic control via Cole-Hopf Feynman-Kac Monte Carlo versus monotone FD
math/pde_numerics|stochastic.gist: Linearize a quadratic-cost stochastic control HJB equation with the log transform and evaluate its value function at chosen points by Feynman-Kac Brownian path averages. Compare with a monotone upwind finite-difference HJB solution and recover the optimal feedback control.

math/pde_numerics|stochastic.title: Harmonic measure on an L-shaped polygon: random walks versus double-layer Nyström
math/pde_numerics|stochastic.gist: Compute the harmonic measure of each boundary edge seen from an interior point of an L-shaped domain from walk-on-spheres exit-location histograms. Cross-check against a graded-mesh Nyström double-layer potential solution, resolving the reentrant-corner singularity.
math/pde_numerics|stochastic.area: Boundary integral and boundary element methods

math/pde_numerics|stochastic.title: Metropolis optimization of PML absorption grading profile for 1D wave equation
math/pde_numerics|stochastic.gist: Parameterize the PML damping profile of a staggered-grid 1D acoustic FDTD solver by a few polynomial coefficients. Minimize the measured spurious reflection of a Ricker pulse by simulated-annealing Metropolis moves, and compare with the optimal polynomial order and amplitude.
math/pde_numerics|stochastic.area: Absorbing boundaries and perfectly matched layers

math/pde_numerics|stochastic.title: Partially absorbing Robin boundary: Brownian particle reflection rule versus FD
math/pde_numerics|stochastic.gist: Simulate Brownian particles near a reactive wall, absorbing each crossing with probability proportional to sqrt(dt) (Erban-Chapman rule). Compare the survival fraction and concentration profile with a Crank-Nicolson solution of the diffusion equation under a Robin boundary condition.
math/pde_numerics|stochastic.area: Absorbing boundaries and perfectly matched layers

math/pde_numerics|stochastic.title: Transparent boundary for truncated heat-equation domain checked by particle simulation
math/pde_numerics|stochastic.gist: Implement a discrete transparent (convolution-kernel) boundary condition for the 1D heat equation on a truncated interval. Validate interior density histories and boundary flux against a Brownian particle ensemble simulated on the full line.
math/pde_numerics|stochastic.area: Absorbing boundaries and perfectly matched layers

math/pde_numerics|stochastic.title: Numerical diffusion of random-walk advection-diffusion schemes via modified equation
math/pde_numerics|stochastic.gist: Treat a biased lattice random walk as a stochastic upwind discretization of advection-diffusion and derive its modified equation symbolically with sympy. Compare the predicted effective diffusivity and skewness with Monte Carlo particle displacement moments.
math/pde_numerics|stochastic.area: Von Neumann stability and modified equations

math/pde_numerics|stochastic.title: Mean-square stability and stationary spectrum of explicit stochastic heat equation
math/pde_numerics|stochastic.gist: Discretize the 1D stochastic heat equation with space-time white noise by the explicit Euler-Maruyama finite-difference scheme and derive per-mode amplification factors and their mean-square stability limit. Verify the predicted discrete stationary Fourier spectrum by long Monte Carlo runs.
math/pde_numerics|stochastic.area: Von Neumann stability and modified equations

math/pde_numerics|stochastic.title: Coherent field and effective wavenumber in random 2D Helmholtz media
math/pde_numerics|stochastic.gist: Solve the 2D Helmholtz equation with a sparse finite-difference scheme and an absorbing layer for many realizations of a weakly fluctuating medium. Monte Carlo average the field to extract the effective complex wavenumber and compare it with second-order Born (Bourret) theory.

math/pde_numerics|stochastic.title: Hybrid Monte Carlo for lattice phi^4 with leapfrog energy-error scaling
math/pde_numerics|stochastic.gist: Sample 2D lattice phi^4 field theory with Hybrid Monte Carlo using a symplectic leapfrog integrator. Measure the scaling of <dH^2> with step size, verify <exp(-dH)> = 1, and compute the acceptance rate and magnetization susceptibility.

math/pde_numerics|stochastic.title: Gibbs-measure invariance of discrete NLS under symplectic splitting integrator
math/pde_numerics|stochastic.gist: Draw initial data from the discrete Gibbs measure of the 1D lattice nonlinear Schrödinger equation using Metropolis sampling. Evolve the ensemble with a symplectic Strang splitting scheme and monitor drift of mass, energy and the mode-occupation spectrum.

math/pde_numerics|stochastic.title: Bayesian conductivity inversion with Metropolis-Hastings and 2D triangle FEM
math/pde_numerics|stochastic.gist: Infer piecewise-constant conductivities of a 2D triangulated domain from noisy point temperature data. Use random-walk Metropolis-Hastings with a P1 FEM forward solver, and report posterior means, credible intervals and the chain autocorrelation time.

math/pde_numerics|stochastic.title: SUPG versus Feynman-Kac Monte Carlo for boundary layers at high Péclet
math/pde_numerics|stochastic.gist: Solve steady 2D convection-diffusion with an outflow boundary layer using SUPG-stabilized P1 elements. Estimate point values by Euler-Maruyama exit-path Feynman-Kac Monte Carlo, comparing SUPG crosswind smearing and oscillation against the unbiased stochastic estimates.

math/pde_numerics|stochastic.title: Effective conductivity of random two-phase checkerboards with harmonic-averaged finite volumes
math/pde_numerics|stochastic.gist: Generate random binary pixel composites at varying volume fraction and compute the effective conductivity by finite volumes with harmonic-mean face conductivities under an imposed temperature drop. Monte Carlo over realizations checks Keller's duality sqrt(s1*s2) at 50% fraction and percolation behavior.
math/pde_numerics|stochastic.area: Heat conduction in composite and anisotropic media

math/pde_numerics|stochastic.title: Kinetic Monte Carlo random walk for diffusion across conductivity interfaces
math/pde_numerics|stochastic.gist: Simulate a continuous-time lattice random walk with harmonic-mean hopping rates in a layered or anisotropic composite using Gillespie event selection. Extract the effective conductivity tensor from mean-squared displacement and verify it against a finite-volume steady-state solution and the series/parallel bounds.
math/pde_numerics|stochastic.area: Heat conduction in composite and anisotropic media

math/pde_numerics|waves.title: Two-soliton collision phase shift in NLS via split-step Fourier
math/pde_numerics|waves.gist: Collide two counter-propagating NLS solitons of unequal amplitude using fourth-order Yoshida-composed split-step Fourier. Fit post-collision soliton positions and phases, then compare the measured shifts with the inverse-scattering formula.

math/pde_numerics|waves.title: Modulation instability gain spectrum from split-step NLS simulation
math/pde_numerics|waves.gist: Seed a plane-wave solution of focusing NLS with small random noise and propagate it with split-step Fourier. Extract the exponential growth rate of each Fourier sideband and compare it with the Benjamin-Feir linear gain curve and its peak wavenumber.

math/pde_numerics|waves.title: ETDRK4 Kuramoto-Sivashinsky with contour-integral phi-function evaluation
math/pde_numerics|waves.gist: Solve periodic KS with Fourier pseudospectral ETDRK4, evaluating the phi-function coefficients by complex contour integrals as in Kassam-Trefethen. Verify fourth-order temporal convergence on a short run, then compute the time-averaged energy spectrum on the chaotic attractor.
math/pde_numerics|waves.area: Exponential time differencing for stiff PDEs

math/pde_numerics|waves.title: Allen-Cahn coarsening exponent with 2D Fourier ETDRK4
math/pde_numerics|waves.gist: Evolve the 2D periodic Allen-Cahn equation from random initial data using pseudospectral ETDRK4. Measure total interface length (or a structure-factor length scale) over time and fit the t^{1/2} coarsening law.
math/pde_numerics|waves.area: Exponential time differencing for stiff PDEs

math/pde_numerics|waves.title: Pollution error of 1D linear FEM Helmholtz at high wavenumber
math/pde_numerics|waves.gist: Solve the 1D Helmholtz equation u''+k^2u=f with P1 finite elements and an impedance boundary condition. Derive the discrete dispersion relation from the stencil symbol, and verify that the relative phase error scales as k^3h^2 at fixed kh, unlike the interpolation error.

math/pde_numerics|waves.title: Numerical dispersion anisotropy of 5-point versus 9-point Helmholtz stencils
math/pde_numerics|waves.gist: Use plane-wave Fourier symbol analysis to compute the numerical phase velocity as a function of propagation angle and points per wavelength for the standard 5-point and optimized 9-point FD Helmholtz stencils. Validate the predicted phase error by solving a 2D plane-wave problem with absorbing boundaries.

math/pde_numerics|waves.title: Bragg mirror reflectance: FD Helmholtz with PML versus transfer matrices
math/pde_numerics|waves.gist: Compute the reflectance spectrum of a 1D quarter-wave dielectric stack by solving the variable-coefficient Helmholtz equation with second-order FD and a PML. Compare against the exact 2x2 transfer-matrix result and quantify the error versus grid resolution near the band edge.

math/pde_numerics|waves.title: Sound-soft scattering via combined-field integral equation with Kress quadrature
math/pde_numerics|waves.gist: Solve exterior Helmholtz scattering by a smooth star-shaped obstacle using the Brakhage-Werner combined-field BIE. Discretize with Nyström and Kress log-singular trigonometric quadrature, compute the far-field pattern, and check exponential convergence on the circle against the Hankel-series solution.
math/pde_numerics|waves.area: Boundary integral and boundary element methods

math/pde_numerics|waves.title: Exterior Laplace Dirichlet problem via double-layer Nyström and multipole check
math/pde_numerics|waves.gist: Represent the exterior harmonic field around an ellipse as a double-layer potential plus a log charge, discretized with the periodic trapezoidal rule. Verify spectral convergence of the density and compare the far-field multipole coefficients with the exact conformal-map solution.
math/pde_numerics|waves.area: Boundary integral and boundary element methods

math/pde_numerics|waves.title: Averaged vector field Fourier scheme for sine-Gordon breather energy conservation
math/pde_numerics|waves.gist: Discretize the periodic sine-Gordon equation pseudospectrally and integrate with the energy-preserving averaged-vector-field discrete gradient method using fixed-point iteration. Over long times, compare Hamiltonian error and breather phase drift with implicit midpoint and RK4.

math/pde_numerics|waves.title: Störmer-Verlet Fourier scheme for nonlinear Klein-Gordon: modified energy behavior
math/pde_numerics|waves.gist: Integrate the cubic nonlinear Klein-Gordon equation with Fourier pseudospectral space and Störmer-Verlet time stepping. Show the bounded oscillatory energy error scaling as dt^2 and the absence of secular drift, and compute the numerical dispersion relation of the linearized scheme including its CFL limit.

math/pde_numerics|waves.title: Fourier space time-stepping for American puts under Merton jump-diffusion
math/pde_numerics|waves.gist: Price Bermudan and American puts under Merton's jump-diffusion PIDE by FFT-based Fourier space time-stepping, applying the early-exercise projection between steps. Extrapolate in exercise frequency, then compare with a finite-difference PIDE solution and the European closed-form series.
math/pde_numerics|waves.area: Multi-factor and stochastic volatility pricing PDEs

math/pde_numerics|waves.title: Spectral level-set advection of Zalesak disk with exponential filtering
math/pde_numerics|waves.gist: Rotate the Zalesak slotted-disk level set for one revolution using Fourier pseudospectral advection with RK4 and exponential spectral filters of varying order. Reinitialize toward a signed distance function, then measure area loss and interface error versus filter strength.

math/pde_numerics|waves.title: Bloch-wave dispersion analysis of P1 triangular finite elements
math/pde_numerics|waves.gist: Assemble P1 stiffness and mass matrices on periodic structured triangle meshes with right, criss-cross and equilateral patterns. Derive the Bloch-wave generalized eigenproblem for the numerical wavenumber of the wave equation, compute phase-velocity error versus angle, and compare consistent and lumped mass.

math/pde_numerics|waves.title: Spectral vanishing viscosity Fourier method for inviscid Burgers shocks
math/pde_numerics|waves.gist: Solve the periodic inviscid Burgers equation with a Fourier Galerkin method stabilized by Tadmor spectral vanishing viscosity. Post-process with exponential filtering, then measure L1 error away from the shock and the Gibbs overshoot amplitude as resolution increases.

math/pde_numerics|opt_discrete.title: Malthus growth rate of size-structured cell division by eigenvalue bracketing
math/pde_numerics|opt_discrete.gist: Discretize the growth-fragmentation equation for equal-mitosis cell division with a finite-volume scheme. Find the dominant eigenvalue (Malthus parameter) and the stable size distribution by shifted inverse power iteration. Cross-check with a bisection root find on the characteristic equation for the constant-rate case.

math/pde_numerics|opt_discrete.title: Newton inverse isoparametric mapping for point location in curved quadratic quadrilaterals
math/pde_numerics|opt_discrete.gist: Build 9-node biquadratic Lagrange shape functions and the map for a curved quadrilateral element. Solve for the reference coordinates of physical points by Newton iteration with the element Jacobian, and use them to interpolate a P2 field at those points. Report iteration counts and interpolation errors as the element distortion grows.

math/pde_numerics|opt_discrete.title: Cubic Lagrange FEM for Bratu problem with Newton and fold-point location
math/pde_numerics|opt_discrete.gist: Discretize the 1D Bratu equation -u'' = λ e^u with cubic Lagrange elements, using Gauss-Legendre nodes generated by Newton iteration on Legendre polynomials. Solve each λ by Newton's method and follow the solution branch with pseudo-arclength continuation to locate λ_crit ≈ 3.5138. Verify O(h^4) convergence of the solution in L2.

math/pde_numerics|opt_discrete.title: Moffatt corner eddy intensity ratios in Stokes cavity flow by root bracketing
math/pde_numerics|opt_discrete.gist: Solve the biharmonic Stokes streamfunction problem in a deep or square cavity with a finite-difference coupled vorticity-streamfunction iteration. Locate successive sign changes of ψ along the corner bisector by bracketing and Brent root finding. Compare the computed eddy size and intensity ratios with Moffatt's analytic values (about 1/16.4 and 1/350).

math/pde_numerics|opt_discrete.title: Inverse estimation of longitudinal dispersivity from column breakthrough curves
math/pde_numerics|opt_discrete.gist: Use an upwind or TVD finite-volume advection-dispersion solver as the forward model for a tracer column experiment. Fit dispersivity and retardation factor to a synthetic noisy breakthrough curve by Levenberg-Marquardt with a finite-difference Jacobian. Compare the fitted values with the Ogata-Banks analytic solution.

math/pde_numerics|opt_discrete.title: Reduced convergence order for L-shaped membrane eigenvalue via extrapolation
math/pde_numerics|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the first Dirichlet eigenvalue of the L-shaped domain on a sequence of finite-difference grids using shifted inverse iteration with sparse LU. Estimate the singularity-limited observed order (about 4/3) by nonlinear least-squares fitting. Richardson-extrapolate the eigenvalue toward 9.6397238 and quantify the remaining error.

math/pde_numerics|opt_discrete.title: Optimal SUPG stabilization parameter by golden-section error minimization
math/pde_numerics|opt_discrete.gist: Solve 1D steady convection-diffusion with linear SUPG finite elements across a range of mesh Péclet numbers. For each Péclet number, find the stabilization parameter τ that minimizes the nodal error against the exact boundary-layer solution by golden-section search. Compare the result with the analytic optimum τ = (h/2|a|)(coth Pe − 1/Pe).

math/pde_numerics|opt_discrete.title: FDTD-driven optimization of single-layer antireflection coating on glass
math/pde_numerics|opt_discrete.gist: Simulate a broadband Gaussian pulse normally incident on a coated dielectric with a 1D Yee FDTD solver using a total-field/scattered-field source and Mur boundaries. Extract the spectral reflectance by DFT. Minimize the reflectance at the design wavelength over coating index and thickness with Nelder-Mead, and compare with the quarter-wave optimum n = √n_s.

math/pde_numerics|opt_discrete.title: Newton solution of 2D Yee numerical dispersion and anisotropic phase error
math/pde_numerics|opt_discrete.gist: Solve the 2D Yee-lattice dispersion relation for the numerical wavenumber with Newton's method at each propagation angle, Courant number and resolution. Report the anisotropic phase-velocity error. Verify one point by measuring the phase speed of a plane wave in a 2D TMz FDTD simulation.

math/info_stats|ode.title: Continuous-time Infomax natural-gradient flow for separating Laplacian source mixtures
math/info_stats|ode.gist: Write the natural-gradient Infomax rule dW/dt = (I - φ(y)yᵀ)W as an ODE, using sample averages over whitened mixtures of Laplacian and uniform sources. Integrate it with adaptive RK45 and report the Amari index along the trajectory and at convergence.

math/info_stats|ode.title: Oja subspace-rule ODE versus SVD for leading principal components
math/info_stats|ode.gist: Integrate Oja's subspace flow dW/dt = CW - WWᵀCW for a sample covariance with a known spectrum. Compare the converged subspace to the top-k SVD subspace using principal angles, and estimate the convergence rate from the eigengap.

math/info_stats|ode.title: Brockett double-bracket flow diagonalizing a covariance matrix to sorted eigenvalues
math/info_stats|ode.gist: Integrate the isospectral flow dH/dt = [H,[H,N]] from a sample covariance matrix with a stiff-capable solver. Verify that the spectrum is preserved, that the off-diagonal norm decays, and that the diagonal limit matches the sorted eigenvalues from numpy.

math/info_stats|ode.title: Tikhonov signal denoising as Euler-Lagrange boundary-value problem with GCV
math/info_stats|ode.gist: Denoise data by minimizing ∫(u-f)² + λ∫u'², which reduces to the BVP -λu'' + u = f with Neumann conditions, solved with solve_bvp or finite differences. Choose λ by generalized cross-validation using the trace of the influence operator.

math/info_stats|ode.title: Kolmogorov-Sinai entropy of the Lorenz attractor from the Lyapunov spectrum
math/info_stats|ode.gist: Integrate the Lorenz equations together with their variational equations, re-orthonormalizing with periodic QR, to obtain the full Lyapunov spectrum. Estimate the KS entropy rate via Pesin's identity and check that the exponents sum to the phase-space contraction rate.

math/info_stats|ode.title: Block entropies and Lempel-Ziv complexity of Rössler Poincaré-section symbol sequences
math/info_stats|ode.gist: Integrate the Rössler system, detect crossings of a Poincaré section with solve_ivp events, and binarize successive return-map maxima. Compute the block-entropy differences h_n and the Lempel-Ziv (LZ76) complexity, and compare both to the positive Lyapunov exponent.

math/info_stats|ode.title: Entropy rate of sampled continuous-time Markov chain versus sampling interval
math/info_stats|ode.gist: Integrate the Kolmogorov forward equation dP/dt = PQ for a 4-state CTMC to obtain P(Δ) for a range of sampling intervals Δ. Compute the Shannon entropy rate of the sampled chain from its stationary distribution, and its small-Δ scaling, checked against expm.

math/info_stats|ode.title: Duncan I-MMSE mutual information for an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck signal in white noise
math/info_stats|ode.gist: Integrate the scalar Kalman-Bucy Riccati ODE to obtain the causal MMSE. Compute the mutual information between the OU signal and its noisy observation path via Duncan's theorem, I(T) = (snr/2)∫MMSE dt, and compare its asymptotic rate with the closed-form spectral formula.

math/info_stats|ode.title: Circadian period of the Goodwin oscillator from sparse, irregular Lomb-Scargle sampling
math/info_stats|ode.gist: Integrate the three-variable Goodwin gene-regulatory model to its limit cycle and measure the true period from Poincaré crossing times. Subsample it irregularly with noise, then compare the GLS peak period and bootstrap FAP against the ODE period as sampling density varies.

math/info_stats|ode.title: Prolate spheroidal wave functions by shooting versus discrete DPSS tridiagonal tapers
math/info_stats|ode.gist: Solve the prolate Sturm-Liouville eigenproblem ((1-x²)ψ')' + (χ - c²x²)ψ = 0 by shooting with parity conditions to obtain the first several eigenvalues χ_n and eigenfunctions. Compare them with appropriately scaled discrete Slepian tapers from the tridiagonal DPSS eigenproblem as N grows.

math/info_stats|ode.title: Multiscale sample entropy of Mackey-Glass delay equation versus delay
math/info_stats|ode.gist: Integrate the Mackey-Glass delay differential equation by the method of steps with RK4 and history interpolation, for several delays τ. Compute coarse-grained sample entropy over scales 1-10 and characterize how complexity changes across the transition to chaos.

math/info_stats|ode.title: Permutation entropy and complexity-entropy plane of the Hindmarsh-Rose neuron
math/info_stats|ode.gist: Integrate the stiff Hindmarsh-Rose bursting-neuron model across a sweep of injected current. Compute the normalized permutation entropy and Jensen-Shannon statistical complexity of the membrane potential, distinguishing periodic spiking, bursting and chaotic regimes.

math/info_stats|ode.title: Kalman-Bucy Riccati convergence to the steady-state Wiener filter for a damped oscillator
math/info_stats|ode.gist: Integrate the matrix Riccati ODE for a noise-driven damped harmonic oscillator observed in white noise until it reaches steady state. Compare the steady-state error covariance with the algebraic Riccati solution and with the MSE of the frequency-domain Wiener filter.
math/info_stats|ode.area: Wiener filtering and optimal linear estimation

math/info_stats|ode.title: Wiener-Hopf FIR predictor for a sampled continuous-time CAR(2) process
math/info_stats|ode.gist: Obtain the autocovariance of a stochastic damped oscillator by integrating its Lyapunov moment ODE and propagating the lagged covariance. Solve the Toeplitz Wiener-Hopf normal equations for p-tap one-step predictors, and compare the prediction error with the exact ARMA(2,1) innovation variance.
math/info_stats|ode.area: Wiener filtering and optimal linear estimation

math/info_stats|ode.title: Wormald ODE analysis of LDPC peeling decoding on the binary erasure channel
math/info_stats|ode.gist: Integrate the Luby-Mitzenmacher differential equations for residual degree-one check edges during peeling decoding of a (3,6)-regular LDPC ensemble. Locate the BEC erasure threshold by bisection on decoder failure, and validate it with finite-length GF(2) Monte Carlo decoding.

math/info_stats|ode.title: AIC and BIC selection between SIR and SEIR models fitted to epidemic incidence
math/info_stats|ode.gist: Generate Poisson incidence data from an SEIR model, then fit both SIR and SEIR to it by maximum likelihood, integrating the ODEs inside the likelihood with solve_ivp. Compute AIC, BIC and forward-sensitivity Fisher-information standard errors to select the model and assess parameter identifiability.

math/info_stats|stochastic.title: Monte Carlo calibration of multitaper F-test false alarms in AR(2) noise
math/info_stats|stochastic.gist: Simulate many AR(2) colored-noise realizations with and without an embedded sinusoid, compute DPSS tapers from the tridiagonal eigenproblem, and apply Thomson's harmonic F-test at each frequency. Estimate the empirical false-alarm and detection probabilities versus line amplitude and compare them with the nominal F(2, 2K-2) thresholds.

math/info_stats|stochastic.title: Adaptive multitaper spectrum of Gillespie-simulated telegraph gene expression
math/info_stats|stochastic.gist: Generate mRNA copy-number trajectories from a two-state promoter (telegraph) model with the Gillespie SSA and resample them on a uniform grid. Compute the adaptive-weighted multitaper PSD and compare it with the analytic sum-of-Lorentzians spectrum from the linear noise approximation.

math/info_stats|stochastic.title: Metropolis-Hastings Bayesian frequency estimation of two sinusoids
math/info_stats|stochastic.gist: Sample the Bretthorst posterior over frequencies, with amplitudes marginalized analytically, for two-tone data using random-walk Metropolis with tempered proposals. Compute posterior means and credible intervals and compare them with ESPRIT point estimates near the Rayleigh resolution limit.

math/info_stats|stochastic.title: Granger causality in a Gillespie-simulated two-gene activation cascade
math/info_stats|stochastic.gist: Simulate a stochastic cascade in which protein X activates production of Y with the Gillespie algorithm and sample the trajectories uniformly. Fit bivariate VAR models by least squares to compute Granger causality X→Y and Y→X with permutation-surrogate significance, and compare with the linear-noise-approximation prediction.

math/info_stats|stochastic.title: Dyson Brownian motion eigenvalues converging to Marchenko-Pastur law
math/info_stats|stochastic.gist: Evolve the eigenvalues of a Wishart (Laguerre β-ensemble) process with Langevin dynamics including log-repulsion, and alternatively sample them by Metropolis on the Coulomb-gas energy. Compare the stationary eigenvalue histogram with the Marchenko-Pastur density and edge locations for several aspect ratios.
math/info_stats|stochastic.area: Random matrix theory for covariance estimation

math/info_stats|stochastic.title: Cleaning Brownian-dynamics covariance of an elastic network protein model
math/info_stats|stochastic.gist: Generate conformations of a Gaussian network model protein with overdamped Brownian dynamics, then estimate the positional covariance from short trajectories. Apply Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage and Marchenko-Pastur eigenvalue clipping and measure Frobenius and eigenvector-overlap errors against the exact pseudo-inverse Kirchhoff covariance.
math/info_stats|stochastic.area: Random matrix theory for covariance estimation

math/info_stats|stochastic.title: Marchenko-Pastur spectra of autocorrelated MCMC samples and effective size
math/info_stats|stochastic.gist: Draw samples of a high-dimensional isotropic Gaussian with random-walk Metropolis, which yields autocorrelated rows. Compare the sample covariance spectrum with the MP law using the nominal sample count and with the MP law using an effective sample count from the integrated autocorrelation time.
math/info_stats|stochastic.area: Random matrix theory for covariance estimation

math/info_stats|stochastic.title: Codon-usage entropy under Moran mutation-selection dynamics via kinetic Monte Carlo
math/info_stats|stochastic.gist: Simulate the fixation dynamics of synonymous codons in a Moran population with mutation bias and selection on preferred codons, using an event-driven (Gillespie) scheme. Compute the stationary codon-usage Shannon entropy and effective number of codons versus Ns, and compare with the analytic Sella-Hirsh stationary distribution.

math/info_stats|stochastic.title: Simulated-annealing discrete bit loading for OFDM versus water-filling bound
math/info_stats|stochastic.gist: For a random multipath frequency-selective channel, assign integer bits per subcarrier under a total power constraint and an SNR-gap model using Metropolis simulated annealing. Compare the achieved rate with the continuous water-filling capacity and the greedy Hughes-Hartogs solution.

math/info_stats|stochastic.title: Diffusion-map reaction coordinate from Langevin trajectories on Müller-Brown potential
math/info_stats|stochastic.gist: Sample the Müller-Brown potential with overdamped Langevin dynamics, build a Gaussian-kernel diffusion map with density normalization, and extract the leading nontrivial eigenvectors. Compare the first eigenvector with the committor obtained from a finite-difference backward Kolmogorov solve, and the eigenvalue with the transition rate.
math/info_stats|stochastic.area: Manifold learning and nonlinear dimensionality reduction

math/info_stats|stochastic.title: Isomap and diffusion maps recover butane dihedral from Metropolis conformations
math/info_stats|stochastic.gist: Sample the butane dihedral under the Ryckaert-Bellemans torsion potential with Metropolis, build the 3D atomic coordinates, and embed them with Isomap (kNN geodesics plus classical MDS) and with diffusion maps. Recover the dihedral angle from the embedding and compute trans/gauche populations to check them against Boltzmann integration.
math/info_stats|stochastic.area: Manifold learning and nonlinear dimensionality reduction

math/info_stats|stochastic.title: Information bottleneck real-space coarse-graining of Monte Carlo Ising configurations
math/info_stats|stochastic.gist: Generate 2D Ising configurations with Wolff/Metropolis sampling near and away from T_c, and estimate the joint distribution between a 2×2 spin block and its distant environment. Iterate the self-consistent IB equations to trace the relevance-compression curve, and identify the optimal binary compression (the block-magnetization sign).

math/info_stats|stochastic.title: Integrated autocorrelation time of MCMC chains via Burg AR spectral fit
math/info_stats|stochastic.gist: Run random-walk Metropolis on a strongly correlated 2D Gaussian and on a banana-shaped target. Fit AR models to the chain by Burg and Levinson-Durbin recursions with AIC order selection, then estimate the spectral density at zero to obtain the integrated autocorrelation time and effective sample size, checking against batch means and the exact AR(1) result.

math/info_stats|quantum_ops.title: Estimating 1/f noise exponent from qubit echo decays with fluctuator ensembles
math/info_stats|quantum_ops.gist: Build 1/f^alpha detuning noise as a superposition of random telegraph fluctuators with log-uniform switching rates. Compute its analytic PSD, and obtain qubit coherence under CPMG sequences from simulated dephasing channels. Recover alpha in two ways and compare: by fitting a periodogram of the noise, and by inverting the scaling of T2 with pulse number N.

math/info_stats|quantum_ops.title: Instantaneous Rabi frequency of a chirped-drive qubit via analytic signal
math/info_stats|quantum_ops.gist: Integrate the Schrödinger equation for a qubit driven with a linearly chirped detuning to obtain <sigma_z>(t). Form its analytic signal by FFT-based Hilbert transform and extract the envelope and instantaneous frequency. Compare the result with the generalized Rabi frequency sqrt(Ω² + Δ(t)²), and quantify edge-effect errors under windowing.

math/info_stats|quantum_ops.title: FM demodulation of Ramsey magnetometry signal to recover time-varying field
math/info_stats|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate a spin-1/2 Larmor precessing in a sinusoidally modulated magnetic field, including T2 dephasing via a Kraus channel, and record the projective-measurement probability signal. Demodulate it with the Hilbert transform: unwrap the instantaneous phase and differentiate to reconstruct B(t). Report the reconstruction RMSE as a function of shot noise and modulation index.

math/info_stats|quantum_ops.title: Wehrl entropy of coherent, Fock, squeezed and cat states
math/info_stats|quantum_ops.gist: Build truncated Fock-space density matrices and evaluate their Husimi Q functions on a phase-space grid using coherent-state overlaps. Compute the Wehrl (differential) entropy by 2D quadrature. Verify that the Lieb bound (equality for coherent states) holds, check the closed-form result for Fock states, and test kNN estimates computed from samples of heterodyne outcomes.

math/info_stats|quantum_ops.title: Białynicki-Birula–Mycielski entropic uncertainty for harmonic oscillator eigenstates
math/info_stats|quantum_ops.gist: Compute position and momentum densities of oscillator Fock and squeezed states, using Hermite functions and an FFT to momentum space. Evaluate their differential entropies by quadrature and check the bound h(x)+h(p) ≥ ln(πe). Compare against Kozachenko-Leonenko kNN estimates obtained from simulated homodyne samples.
