math/info_stats|quantum_ops.title: Hamiltonian learning by maximum entropy reconstruction of transverse-field Ising Gibbs state
math/info_stats|quantum_ops.gist: Given measured local expectations <Z_i Z_{i+1}> and <X_i> from a thermal state of a 6-spin chain, minimize the convex dual log Z(λ) − λ·m using matrix exponentials and gradients from traces. Recover the effective couplings times beta, and compare the reconstructed Gibbs state with the true state via fidelity and relative entropy.

math/info_stats|quantum_ops.title: Maximum-entropy three-qubit state from two-body marginals: GHZ versus W
math/info_stats|quantum_ops.gist: Fit the maximum von Neumann entropy three-qubit state consistent with all two-qubit reduced density matrices, solving for Lagrange multipliers on two-body Pauli operators by convex optimization with partial-trace constraints. Show that the W state is recovered almost exactly, whereas for GHZ the reconstruction collapses to a mixture, and quantify the irreducible three-body correlation by relative entropy.

math/info_stats|quantum_ops.title: Gaussian process regression of shot-noise-limited Rabi oscillation data
math/info_stats|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate binomial projective-measurement counts from a qubit under a Rabi drive plus a dephasing Lindblad channel. Fit a GP with a periodic×squared-exponential kernel using Cholesky-based posterior means and variances, with hyperparameters set by maximizing the log marginal likelihood. Estimate the Rabi frequency and decay time with credible intervals.

math/info_stats|quantum_ops.title: GP surrogate of single-qubit gate fidelity landscape over control errors
math/info_stats|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the average gate fidelity of an X(π) pulse affected by amplitude and detuning errors, using the process (Choi) matrix and the Nielsen formula, at sparse points in control-error space. Fit a 2D anisotropic RBF Gaussian process with marginal-likelihood-optimized length scales. Predict the fidelity map and its uncertainty, and locate the 99.9% robustness region.

math/info_stats|quantum_ops.title: Permutation entropy of quantum kicked-top expectation values: regular versus chaotic
math/info_stats|quantum_ops.gist: Evolve a spin-j kicked top with the Floquet unitary exp(-i k J_z²/2j) exp(-i p J_y) starting from spin-coherent states, recording <J_z>/j over many kicks. Compute normalized permutation entropy and sample entropy as functions of kick strength k and embedding dimension. Correlate these complexity measures with the classical chaos transition and with the single-spin linear entropy.

math/info_stats|quantum_ops.title: Multiscale sample entropy of quantum jump records with electron shelving
math/info_stats|quantum_ops.gist: Generate fluorescence photon-count time series for a V-type three-level atom with a metastable shelving level, using Monte Carlo wavefunction quantum trajectories with jump operators. Compute sample entropy and multiscale entropy by coarse-graining over a range of scales. Contrast the bright/dark telegraph intermittency with Poissonian two-level fluorescence.

math/info_stats|quantum_ops.title: Quantum Bayesian filter for weakly measured qubit versus classical HMM filter
math/info_stats|quantum_ops.gist: Apply sequences of weak-measurement Kraus operators M_± ∝ sqrt((1 ± ε σ_z)/2), together with a bit-flip channel, to a qubit, and update the conditional density matrix after each outcome. Compare the estimated <σ_z> trajectory and its mean squared error with a classical two-state hidden Markov forward filter and a linearized Kalman filter, and check filter consistency using normalized innovation statistics.

math/info_stats|quantum_ops.title: Kalman tracking and RTS smoothing of drifting qubit frequency from Ramsey shots
math/info_stats|quantum_ops.gist: Model the qubit detuning as a random walk and generate single-shot Ramsey outcomes, with probabilities computed from the dephased qubit density matrix. Implement an extended Kalman filter on the linearized measurement model, followed by a Rauch-Tung-Striebel smoother. Assess estimator consistency with NEES chi-square bounds.

math/info_stats|quantum_ops.title: Lloyd algorithm codebooks for pure qubit states under infidelity distortion
math/info_stats|quantum_ops.gist: Design K-point vector quantizers for Haar-random pure qubit states, using infidelity 1 − |<ψ|c_k>|² as the distortion measure. In each Lloyd iteration, the optimal centroid is the principal eigenvector of the averaged projector within the cell. Compare the distortion of the converged codebooks with platonic-solid configurations and plot distortion versus rate log2 K.

math/info_stats|quantum_ops.title: Schumacher compression: typical-subspace fidelity versus rate for qubit sources
math/info_stats|quantum_ops.gist: For an i.i.d. source of nonorthogonal qubit states with ensemble density matrix ρ, project ρ^{⊗n} onto the span of its largest eigenvectors at rate R qubits per symbol, using binomial eigenvalue multiplicities. Compute the entanglement fidelity as a function of R and n, and show it converges to a threshold at the von Neumann entropy S(ρ).

math/info_stats|quantum_ops.title: Quantum Fisher information of GHZ versus product probes under local dephasing
math/info_stats|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the quantum Fisher information for phase estimation with N-qubit GHZ and product probe states passed through an independent dephasing channel on each qubit, using symmetric logarithmic derivatives obtained by eigendecomposition. Identify the optimal N at which the GHZ advantage over the standard quantum limit disappears, and compare with the classical Fisher information of parity measurements.

math/info_stats|waves.title: Mutual information function of genomic sequences via FFT correlations
math/info_stats|waves.gist: Compute the symbol-pair mutual information I(k) as a function of distance k for a long nucleotide sequence. All 16 joint pair counts for every lag are obtained at once by FFT cross-correlation of the indicator sequences. Extract the period-3 oscillation amplitude and the decay exponent of I(k).

math/info_stats|waves.title: Exact PWM score distributions and genome scanning by FFT convolution
math/info_stats|waves.gist: Build a log-odds position weight matrix and its information content from aligned binding sites. Scan a one-hot encoded genome by FFT cross-correlation, and get the exact null score distribution by FFT polynomial multiplication of discretized column score distributions. Report p-value thresholds and the expected number of false hits.

math/info_stats|waves.title: FISTA recovery of sparse spectra from random partial Fourier samples
math/info_stats|waves.gist: Recover a k-sparse frequency-domain signal from m randomly selected time samples using FISTA with FFT-implemented forward and adjoint operators. Map the empirical success-probability phase transition over (m/n, k/m) and compare it with the Donoho-Tanner curve.

math/info_stats|waves.title: Compressed sensing MRI with variable-density k-space undersampling and TV
math/info_stats|waves.gist: Simulate 2D k-space acquisition of a Shepp-Logan-like phantom with variable-density random undersampling masks. Reconstruct with a proximal-gradient total-variation algorithm using FFT data-consistency steps, and compute reconstruction NMSE and PSNR as functions of the acceleration factor.

math/info_stats|waves.title: OMP line-spectral estimation on oversampled DFT dictionaries
math/info_stats|waves.gist: Estimate off-grid sinusoid frequencies in noisy data using orthogonal matching pursuit over a DFT dictionary oversampled by a factor of q. Compute the mutual coherence as a function of q, and report frequency-estimation RMSE and support-recovery failure as minimum source separation varies.

math/info_stats|waves.title: Water-filling capacity of a frequency-selective OFDM channel
math/info_stats|waves.gist: Compute the Shannon capacity of a discrete multipath channel with coloured noise. Evaluate the channel frequency response by FFT and apply bisection water-filling of the power across subcarriers. Plot capacity versus total power and compare with equal power allocation and with the continuous-bandwidth integral formula.

math/info_stats|waves.title: Degrees of freedom and capacity of a Fresnel free-space optical link
math/info_stats|waves.gist: Discretize the Fresnel propagation kernel between transmitter and receiver apertures and compute its singular values. Count the effective communication modes and compare them with the Fresnel-number (Shannon number) estimate. Evaluate MIMO water-filling capacity versus aperture size and distance.

math/info_stats|waves.title: Entanglement entropy of a free-fermion chain from Fourier correlation matrices
math/info_stats|waves.gist: For a tight-binding chain at filling nu, build the subsystem two-point correlation matrix from the Fourier-space ground state. Compute the von Neumann and Renyi entropies from its eigenvalues (Peschel's method). Fit the logarithmic scaling coefficient and compare with the central charge c = 1 prediction.
math/info_stats|waves.area: Quantum information entropies and channel capacities

math/info_stats|waves.title: Delay-and-sum versus MVDR resolution of closely spaced sources
math/info_stats|waves.gist: Simulate narrowband snapshots on a uniform linear array with two closely spaced plane-wave sources plus noise. Compute the delay-and-sum beampattern via a zero-padded FFT and the Capon spatial spectrum. Determine the probability of resolving both sources as a function of SNR and snapshot number.

math/info_stats|waves.title: SRP-PHAT broadband source localization with a circular microphone array
math/info_stats|waves.gist: Generate broadband acoustic signals with fractional delays applied in the frequency domain at a circular microphone array. Compute STFTs and phase-transform-weighted steered response power over an azimuth grid. Report localization error versus reverberation-like noise and microphone count.

math/info_stats|waves.title: Shrinkage-regularized MVDR beamforming under limited snapshots
math/info_stats|waves.gist: Compare MVDR output SINR using the sample covariance, Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage and fixed diagonal loading when snapshots are few relative to the number of array elements. Analyse the sample-covariance eigenvalues against the Marchenko-Pastur law. Compute the SINR loss versus the snapshot ratio and compare with the Reed-Mallett-Brennan formula.
math/info_stats|waves.area: Random matrix theory for covariance estimation

math/info_stats|waves.title: Marchenko-Pastur analysis of Welch cross-spectral density matrices
math/info_stats|waves.gist: Estimate multichannel cross-spectral matrices of white and AR-coloured noise by Welch averaging over K segments. Compare the eigenvalue histograms of the per-frequency matrices with the Marchenko-Pastur law with ratio N/K. Use the MP edge to detect the number of coherent sources at each frequency.
math/info_stats|waves.area: Random matrix theory for covariance estimation

math/info_stats|waves.title: Spectral entropy production of a Brownian particle in a tilted periodic potential
math/info_stats|waves.gist: Solve the steady-state Fokker-Planck equation on a ring for a tilted cosine potential using a Fourier-mode spectral expansion. Compute the stationary current, mobility and entropy production rate versus tilt force. Verify against the Stratonovich closed-form integral expression.
math/info_stats|waves.area: Thermodynamics of information and Landauer bounds

math/info_stats|waves.title: Blahut-Arimoto rate-distortion with circulant distortion via FFT convolution
math/info_stats|waves.gist: Compute R(D) curves for sources on a circular M-ary alphabet with circular (modular) distortion. Exploit the circulant structure so that each Blahut-Arimoto step reduces to FFT convolutions. Verify the uniform-source closed form and the Shannon lower bound, and compute curves for non-uniform sources.

math/info_stats|waves.title: Bretthorst Bayesian spectrum analysis of a single noisy sinusoid
math/info_stats|waves.gist: Compute the marginal posterior of a sinusoid's frequency from the Schuster periodogram with amplitude and noise marginalized analytically (Student-t form). Obtain the Bayes factor between the noise-only and one-sinusoid models by numerical quadrature over frequency, and report posterior frequency width versus the Cramer-Rao bound.

math/info_stats|waves.title: Evidence-optimized Wiener deconvolution of blurred noisy signals
math/info_stats|waves.gist: Treat 1D deconvolution with a Gaussian prior that has a power-law spectrum as a conjugate Gaussian model diagonalized by the FFT. Compute the posterior mean and variance per Fourier mode and the closed-form log marginal likelihood. Maximize the evidence over noise level and prior amplitude, then check with grid quadrature.

physics/quantum_info|opt_discrete.title: Optimal two-mode photon-number probes for lossy interferometry
physics/quantum_info|opt_discrete.gist: Parametrize probes as Σ_k c_k |k, N−k⟩ and apply photon loss in both arms with transmissivity η by building the Kraus decomposition explicitly. Compute the mixed-state QFI from the spectral decomposition of the output state. Maximize the QFI over the coefficients c_k with L-BFGS on the unit sphere, then compare the optimum with NOON states and with the shot-noise limit.

physics/quantum_info|opt_discrete.title: Decoy-state BB84 key rate: optimizing signal intensity and finding maximum distance
physics/quantum_info|opt_discrete.gist: Implement the asymptotic vacuum+weak decoy-state bounds on the single-photon yield and error rate for a fiber channel. Inputs are fiber loss in dB/km, detector efficiency, dark counts and misalignment. Maximize the GLLP key rate over signal intensity μ with bounded minimization, then use brentq to find the distance at which the optimized key rate vanishes.

physics/quantum_info|opt_discrete.title: CV coherent-state teleportation through lossy channels with optimized classical gain
physics/quantum_info|opt_discrete.gist: Model Braunstein–Kimble teleportation with a two-mode squeezed vacuum resource of squeezing r sent through pure-loss channels, using covariance matrices and symplectic transformations. Compute the coherent-state fidelity as a function of the displacement gain g and maximize it with a bounded scalar search. Also compute the log-negativity of the shared resource and find the loss at which the fidelity drops below 1/2.

physics/quantum_info|opt_discrete.title: Closest CPTP channel to noisy process tomography via Dykstra alternating projections
physics/quantum_info|opt_discrete.gist: Start from a noisy, non-physical Choi matrix of a two-qubit channel. Alternate projections onto the positive semidefinite cone (eigenvalue clipping) and the trace-preserving affine subspace (partial-trace constraint) using Dykstra's algorithm. Output the converged physical Choi matrix, extracted Kraus operators, and the Frobenius distance to the input.

physics/quantum_info|opt_discrete.title: GRAPE optimal control of a qubit Hadamard under amplitude constraints
physics/quantum_info|opt_discrete.gist: Discretize x and y control fields into N piecewise-constant segments, propagate with matrix exponentials, and compute the analytic gradient of the gate fidelity. Maximize the fidelity with L-BFGS-B under amplitude bounds. Study the minimal total gate time for which fidelity > 0.9999 by bisection on the duration.

physics/quantum_info|opt_discrete.title: Solving CORPSE and BB1 composite-pulse conditions by nonlinear root finding
physics/quantum_info|opt_discrete.gist: Write the composite rotation as a product of SU(2) rotations with off-resonance or amplitude errors and expand the error to first order. Solve the nonlinear cancellation equations for the CORPSE and BB1 angles with scipy.optimize.fsolve. Verify the robustness by computing fidelity versus error-parameter curves against a naive π pulse.

physics/quantum_info|opt_discrete.title: Barren plateau scaling: gradient variance for global versus local cost functions
physics/quantum_info|opt_discrete.gist: Sample random parameters of a layered RY–CZ hardware-efficient ansatz and compute the parameter-shift gradient of the first parameter for a global cost (projector onto |0…0⟩) and for a local single-qubit Z cost. Estimate the gradient variance for n = 2–10 qubits. Fit the exponential decay rates by least squares.

physics/quantum_info|opt_discrete.title: Geometric measure of entanglement of three-qubit states via alternating power iteration
physics/quantum_info|opt_discrete.gist: Maximize the overlap of a three-qubit pure state with product states by cyclically updating each local qubit vector as the normalized contraction of the state tensor with the other two. Use several random restarts. Compute the geometric measure for GHZ, W and the W–GHZ superposition family, and compare with the known values 1/2 and 5/9.

physics/quantum_mech|quantum_ops.title: Half-chain entanglement entropy of free fermions in disordered Anderson chains
physics/quantum_mech|quantum_ops.gist: Fill the single-particle eigenstates of a 1D Anderson tight-binding chain to half filling and build the subsystem correlation matrix (the Peschel method, an exact reduced density matrix for Gaussian states). Compute the von Neumann entanglement entropy versus subsystem size and disorder strength, and contrast the area-law saturation with the clean-chain logarithmic growth.

physics/quantum_mech|quantum_ops.title: Fidelity susceptibility across the Aubry–André localization transition
physics/quantum_mech|quantum_ops.gist: Diagonalize the quasiperiodic Aubry–André chain and compute the ground-state fidelity |<ψ(λ)|ψ(λ+δλ)>|² and the fidelity susceptibility versus the potential strength λ. Locate the self-dual point λ=2t from the susceptibility peak, alongside IPR and left–right mode-entanglement entropies.

physics/quantum_mech|quantum_ops.title: STIRAP transfer fidelity with intermediate-state decay and dephasing
physics/quantum_mech|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate three-level Λ STIRAP with Gaussian pump and Stokes pulses using a Lindblad master equation that includes spontaneous decay from the excited state and ground-state dephasing. Compute the final state fidelity to the target state and the transient excited-state population versus pulse delay and area.

physics/quantum_mech|quantum_ops.title: Process fidelity of counterdiabatic STIRAP as a qutrit operation
physics/quantum_mech|quantum_ops.gist: Construct the Berry counterdiabatic term for the STIRAP dark-state Hamiltonian and propagate all basis inputs to obtain the qutrit propagator. Then build the Choi matrix and compute the average gate fidelity to the ideal transfer map, with and without the counterdiabatic field, versus total pulse duration.

physics/quantum_mech|quantum_ops.title: Fractional STIRAP superposition preparation verified by Pauli-measurement tomography
physics/quantum_mech|quantum_ops.gist: Use fractional STIRAP, with Stokes and pump pulses ending at a fixed amplitude ratio, to prepare a coherent superposition of the two ground states. Simulate finite-shot projective measurements in X, Y and Z bases, reconstruct the qubit density matrix by linear inversion, project it to a physical state, and report the fidelity and trace distance to the target.

physics/quantum_mech|quantum_ops.title: Spin entanglement generated by scattering through a spin-dependent separable potential
physics/quantum_mech|quantum_ops.gist: Solve the momentum-space Lippmann–Schwinger equation by Gauss–Legendre quadrature for singlet and triplet Yamaguchi potentials to obtain the s-wave phase shifts. Assemble the two-spin S-matrix and compute the concurrence of the outgoing spin state for product input states versus energy.

physics/quantum_mech|quantum_ops.title: Inelastic channel loss as a Kraus channel in two-channel Lippmann–Schwinger scattering
physics/quantum_mech|quantum_ops.gist: Solve a two-channel separable-potential Lippmann–Schwinger equation by quadrature for the 2×2 S-matrix and verify its unitarity above the inelastic threshold. Treat the open-channel elastic block as a non-unitary contraction, construct the complementary Kraus operators, and compute the absorption probability and the channel's purity loss versus energy.

physics/quantum_mech|quantum_ops.title: One-electron reduced density matrix entropy of H2 in a Gaussian basis
physics/quantum_mech|quantum_ops.gist: Evaluate analytic STO-3G overlap, kinetic, nuclear-attraction and two-electron integrals for H2, then run RHF followed by two-configuration CI. Build the one-electron reduced density matrix, diagonalize it into natural occupations, and compute its von Neumann entropy versus bond length through dissociation.

physics/quantum_mech|quantum_ops.title: Electron charge-qubit dynamics in H2+ from a Gaussian-basis two-state model
physics/quantum_mech|quantum_ops.gist: Compute Gaussian-basis overlap, kinetic and nuclear-attraction integrals for H2+ to obtain the gerade–ungerade splitting versus internuclear distance. Model the left/right localized electron as a charge qubit, evolve its Bloch vector, and add phase-damping Kraus maps to compute the decay of tunneling coherence.

physics/quantum_mech|quantum_ops.title: Linear entanglement entropy of helium ground state from correlated basis
physics/quantum_mech|quantum_ops.gist: Diagonalize the helium Hamiltonian in a Hylleraas-type correlated basis using analytic matrix elements and a generalized eigensolver. Then project onto a product Laguerre orbital basis to form the one-particle reduced density matrix and compute the linear entropy 1−Tr ρ₁², checking convergence against the literature value of about 0.016.

physics/quantum_mech|quantum_ops.title: Moshinsky atom entanglement by grid partial trace versus analytic result
physics/quantum_mech|quantum_ops.gist: Discretize the ground state of two harmonically coupled oscillators on a 2D grid and perform the partial trace numerically to obtain the one-particle reduced density matrix. Compute its eigenvalues, von Neumann and linear entropies versus coupling, and compare with the closed-form Moshinsky geometric spectrum.

physics/quantum_mech|quantum_ops.title: Spin–orbit entanglement of hydrogenic 2p states across the Paschen–Back regime
physics/quantum_mech|quantum_ops.gist: Obtain the radial 2p function and the radial expectation value ⟨1/r³⟩ by Laguerre-basis diagonalization of a central potential. Build the orbital⊗spin Hamiltonian with spin–orbit and Zeeman terms and compute the reduced spin purity and entanglement entropy of each eigenstate versus magnetic field.
physics/quantum_mech|quantum_ops.area: Bound states in central potentials via Laguerre bases

physics/quantum_mech|quantum_ops.title: Electron–nuclear spin concurrence in Breit–Rabi hyperfine levels of a screened atom
physics/quantum_mech|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the contact density |ψ(0)|² for a valence s state of a screened model potential via Sturmian/Laguerre basis diagonalization, which sets the hyperfine constant. Diagonalize the electron⊗nuclear spin Breit–Rabi Hamiltonian and compute the concurrence of each eigenstate versus magnetic field.
physics/quantum_mech|quantum_ops.area: Bound states in central potentials via Laguerre bases

physics/quantum_mech|quantum_ops.title: Maximum-likelihood estimation of double-well tunneling splitting from projective measurements
physics/quantum_mech|quantum_ops.gist: Diagonalize a 1D double-well potential on a grid and reduce it to a two-mode qubit. Simulate finite-shot left/right projective measurements of tunneling oscillations, estimate the splitting by maximum likelihood, and compare the estimator variance with the classical and quantum Fisher information bounds.

physics/quantum_mech|quantum_ops.title: Spin decoherence from which-path entanglement in Stern–Gerlach wavepacket splitting
physics/quantum_mech|quantum_ops.gist: Propagate a spin-1/2 Gaussian wavepacket in a magnetic field gradient with the split-operator method on a spinor grid. Trace out position to obtain the spin density matrix, and compute spin purity, coherence and the overlap of the two branches versus time and gradient strength.

physics/quantum_mech|quantum_ops.title: Quantum Zeno suppression of tunneling decay from a quasi-bound well
physics/quantum_mech|quantum_ops.gist: Evolve a particle initially in the quasi-bound state of a well with a finite barrier using Crank–Nicolson on a grid with absorbing boundaries. Interleave projective measurements of the in-well projector at fixed intervals and compute the survival probability, effective decay rate and Zeno/anti-Zeno crossover versus measurement interval.

physics/quantum_mech|opt_discrete.title: Thomas-Fermi neutral atom: shooting for the universal initial slope
physics/quantum_mech|opt_discrete.gist: Solve phi'' = phi^{3/2}/sqrt(x) with phi(0)=1 and phi(inf)=0. A bisection on the initial slope, judged by whether the solution diverges or crosses zero, gives phi'(0) ≈ -1.5881. Use phi to compute the total-energy coefficient E = -0.7687 Z^{7/3} and the radius enclosing a given electron fraction.

physics/quantum_mech|opt_discrete.title: Ring-polymer instanton for thermal tunneling in a symmetric double well
physics/quantum_mech|opt_discrete.gist: Discretize the imaginary-time path into P beads and find the periodic instanton below the crossover temperature. Use a Newton saddle-point search on the Euclidean action, seeded from a bounce guess. Return the instanton action and the fluctuation determinant from the bead Hessian, and compare with the exact rate exponent.
physics/quantum_mech|opt_discrete.area: Path-integral Monte Carlo at finite temperature

physics/quantum_mech|opt_discrete.title: Feynman-Kleinert variational effective potential and partition function for anharmonic oscillator
physics/quantum_mech|opt_discrete.gist: For each path centroid x0, minimize the Feynman-Kleinert upper bound over the trial frequency Omega(x0) and local smearing a^2(x0), using a self-consistent fixed-point iteration. Integrate over x0 to get Z(beta) and the free energy of the quartic oscillator. Benchmark against exact diagonalization and the harmonic exact result.
physics/quantum_mech|opt_discrete.area: Path-integral Monte Carlo at finite temperature

physics/quantum_mech|opt_discrete.title: Hard-wall circular quantum dot: Bessel zeros, level ordering and magic numbers
physics/quantum_mech|opt_discrete.gist: Find zeros j_{m,n} of Bessel functions by bracketing and Brent root finding, then sort the single-particle levels with degeneracies. Derive the noninteracting shell-closing electron numbers and compare the cumulative level count with the 2D Weyl law including the perimeter correction.

physics/quantum_mech|opt_discrete.title: Microstate enumeration of LS terms for equivalent-electron l^N configurations
physics/quantum_mech|opt_discrete.gist: Enumerate all Pauli-allowed microstates of l^N (e.g., p^3, d^4, f^2) and tabulate them by (M_L, M_S). Repeatedly peel off maximal (L, S) terms to obtain the term list. Apply Hund's rules to pick the ground term and J level, and check the counts against the total degeneracy.

physics/quantum_mech|opt_discrete.title: H2+ Born-Oppenheimer curve with variationally optimized LCAO orbital exponent
physics/quantum_mech|opt_discrete.gist: Using analytic 1s Slater overlap, Coulomb and exchange integrals with scaled exponent zeta, minimize the bonding energy over zeta at each R. Then minimize E(R) with Brent's method to obtain R_e, D_e and the harmonic frequency. Compare with the unscaled LCAO result and the exact values.

physics/quantum_mech|opt_discrete.title: Dynamical localization length of the kicked rotor from Floquet eigenvector fits
physics/quantum_mech|opt_discrete.gist: Propagate an initial momentum eigenstate with FFT-based split kicks until the energy saturates. Extract the localization length by a least-squares fit of log|psi(p)|^2 tails and from eigenvector inverse participation ratios. Compare with the scaling xi ≈ K^2/(4 hbar_eff^2).

physics/many_body|pde.title: Imaginary-time split-step Gross-Pitaevskii vs hard-sphere Jastrow VMC in anisotropic traps
physics/many_body|pde.gist: Find the ground state of N bosons in a cigar-shaped 3D harmonic trap with scattering length a. Use split-step Fourier imaginary-time propagation of the GP equation to get the energy per particle and the axial and radial density profiles. Compare these with the mean-field limit of a VMC energy from a Gaussian times hard-sphere Jastrow trial function, as a function of gas parameter na^3.
physics/many_body|pde.area: Trapped dilute Bose gas variational treatment

physics/many_body|pde.title: Vortex nucleation in a rotating trapped condensate via rotating-frame GP
physics/many_body|pde.gist: Solve the 2D GP equation in a frame rotating at frequency Omega. Use split-step Fourier imaginary-time evolution with the -Omega L_z term handled by alternating-direction FFT shifts. Compute <L_z>/N and energy versus Omega to locate the critical rotation frequency for single-vortex entry.
physics/many_body|pde.area: Trapped dilute Bose gas variational treatment

physics/many_body|pde.title: Bogoliubov-de Gennes collective modes of a spherically trapped condensate
physics/many_body|pde.gist: Obtain the radial GP ground state by finite-difference imaginary-time relaxation. Build the linearized BdG operator for angular momentum l on the same radial grid and diagonalize it to get the breathing (l=0) and quadrupole (l=2) mode frequencies versus Na/a_ho. Compare with the Thomas-Fermi sum-rule values sqrt(5) and sqrt(2).
physics/many_body|pde.area: Trapped dilute Bose gas variational treatment

physics/many_body|pde.title: Lee-Huang-Yang corrected GP density profiles at large gas parameter
physics/many_body|pde.gist: Solve a modified radial GP equation that includes the LHY term (128/3 sqrt(pi)) a^(5/2) n^(3/2) using finite differences with Newton or imaginary-time iteration. Compute central density, rms radius and energy per particle versus na^3. Quantify the beyond-mean-field shift relative to plain GP and to the hard-sphere VMC reference trend.
physics/many_body|pde.area: Trapped dilute Bose gas variational treatment

physics/many_body|pde.title: Madelung constants from FFT Poisson solves compared with Ewald summation
physics/many_body|pde.gist: Represent point ions of rocksalt, CsCl and zincblende lattices as Gaussian charges on a periodic 3D grid. Solve Poisson's equation spectrally with FFT and subtract the self-interaction to obtain the Madelung energies. Verify grid and Gaussian-width convergence against analytic real-plus-reciprocal-space Ewald sums.

physics/many_body|pde.title: Restricted Hartree-Fock for H2 on a 2D prolate spheroidal grid
physics/many_body|pde.gist: Discretize the axially symmetric (xi, eta) plane with finite differences. Iterate a self-consistent field cycle in which the sigma_g orbital is found by sparse eigensolving and the Hartree potential by a finite-difference Poisson solve with asymptotic multipole boundary conditions. Compute the HF energy at R=1.4 bohr and compare with the known HF limit and with the James-Coolidge exact energy.
physics/many_body|pde.area: Hydrogen molecule and H2+ variational studies

physics/many_body|pde.title: Pure versus mixed estimators from forward-backward imaginary-time propagation
physics/many_body|pde.gist: For a quartic anharmonic oscillator with a Gaussian trial function, propagate psi_T forward in imaginary time with Crank-Nicolson on a grid, mimicking a reptation path of length 2tau. Compute the mixed estimator <x^2>_mix and the pure estimator <x^2>_pure as functions of tau. Show the convergence of both to the exact value and check the extrapolation 2<A>_mix - <A>_var.

physics/many_body|pde.title: Fixed-node error from Dirichlet grid solves in a trial nodal pocket
physics/many_body|pde.gist: For the first excited state of a 2D anisotropic coupled oscillator, impose an approximate planar or curved node from a trial function. Solve the Schrodinger equation inside one nodal pocket with Dirichlet boundaries on a masked finite-difference grid using a sparse eigensolver. Obtain the fixed-node energy versus node tilt and compare with the exact excited-state energy, showing the quadratic error.
physics/many_body|pde.area: Diffusion Monte Carlo for anharmonic oscillators

physics/many_body|pde.title: Semilocal pseudopotential channels and nonlocal projection by spherical quadrature
physics/many_body|pde.gist: Solve the radial Schrodinger equation for each l-channel of a Gaussian-form semilocal pseudopotential for a one-valence-electron atom, using Numerov or finite differences on a logarithmic grid. Then evaluate the nonlocal energy of a trial orbital by Lebedev-type or icosahedral angular quadrature on spheres. Verify the quadrature against the exact Legendre projection as a function of quadrature order.
physics/many_body|pde.area: Pseudopotentials and locality approximation in QMC

physics/many_body|pde.title: Locality-approximation energy error for nonlocal pseudopotentials on a radial grid
physics/many_body|pde.gist: Compute the exact ground state of a one-electron Hamiltonian with an l-dependent nonlocal pseudopotential by radial finite differences. Separately, build the locality-approximated local potential V_NL psi_T/psi_T for trial orbitals of varying quality and solve its radial eigenproblem. Show that the locality error is quadratic in the trial-function error and can have either sign.
physics/many_body|pde.area: Pseudopotentials and locality approximation in QMC

physics/many_body|pde.title: Deuteron binding with the Malfliet-Tjon potential: radial finite differences vs VMC
physics/many_body|pde.gist: Solve the S-wave radial equation for the np system with the spin-triplet Malfliet-Tjon central potential, using a finite-difference sparse eigensolver with large-r extrapolation. Obtain the binding energy, rms radius and asymptotic normalization. Compare with a VMC estimate using a Hulthen-type Jastrow trial function optimized by grid quadrature.

physics/many_body|pde.title: Alpha-particle binding in lowest-order hyperspherical approximation with Volkov potential
physics/many_body|pde.gist: Project a Gaussian central NN potential (Volkov or Afnan-Tang S3) onto the K=0 hyperspherical harmonic for four nucleons to obtain an effective hyperradial potential by quadrature. Solve the resulting hyperradial equation with finite differences to get the 4He binding energy and rms radius. Compare with a simple Gaussian-Jastrow VMC energy.

physics/many_body|pde.title: Lattice GFMC with guiding function and reconfiguration for a discretized 2D potential
physics/many_body|pde.gist: Discretize a 2D anharmonic-oscillator Hamiltonian with a five-point finite-difference Laplacian, which defines a lattice hopping model. Run power-method Green's function Monte Carlo with a Gaussian guiding wavefunction and fixed-population stochastic reconfiguration of walkers. Compare the mixed-estimator ground-state energy with sparse Lanczos diagonalization and with the continuum limit as the grid spacing goes to zero.
physics/many_body|pde.area: Green's function Monte Carlo on lattices

physics/many_body|particles.title: First- versus second-order drift-diffusion splittings for an anharmonic trap
physics/many_body|particles.gist: For a particle in a 3D quartic-plus-harmonic trap with a Gaussian trial function, compare the Euler drift-diffusion propagator with a second-order symmetric (Chin-type) operator splitting of drift, diffusion and branching. Compare the time-step bias of the mixed DMC energy for each scheme against a numerically exact radial-grid eigenvalue.

physics/many_body|particles.title: DMC of Calogero bosons in a harmonic trap: mixed vs extrapolated estimators
physics/many_body|particles.gist: Use DMC with pairwise drift forces for N bosons in a 1D harmonic trap with inverse-square pair repulsion, starting from a deliberately detuned Jastrow trial. Compare the mixed, extrapolated (2·mixed − VMC) and exact values of the energy and of <x²>.

physics/many_body|particles.title: Fixed-node DMC of three polarized electrons in a 2D Coulomb quantum dot
physics/many_body|particles.gist: Model three same-spin electrons in a 2D parabolic quantum dot with Coulomb repulsion. Run fixed-node importance-sampled DMC using determinant nodes built from Fock–Darwin orbitals and a cusp-satisfying Jastrow, and quantify the fixed-node error against configuration-interaction reference energies over a range of confinement strengths.

physics/many_body|particles.title: Backflow Slater-Jastrow VMC energy gain for liquid helium-3
physics/many_body|particles.gist: Build a VMC wavefunction for liquid ³He in a periodic box: a plane-wave Slater determinant evaluated at backflow quasiparticle coordinates, multiplied by a McMillan Jastrow. Lennard-Jones/Aziz pair energies use minimum-image cell lists. Compare the energy and variance gains of the backflow trial over the plain Slater-Jastrow reference.

physics/many_body|particles.title: Two-determinant trial wavefunction for a stretched two-electron soft-Coulomb molecule
physics/many_body|particles.gist: For a 1D two-electron diatomic with soft-Coulomb interactions, compare VMC with a single-determinant (RHF-like) trial against a two-configuration σg²/σu² expansion with a Jastrow factor, along the bond-stretching coordinate. Quantify the energy and variance gains versus grid exact diagonalization.

physics/many_body|particles.title: Hybrid Monte Carlo auxiliary-field simulation of the half-filled Hubbard ring
physics/many_body|particles.gist: Apply a continuous Hubbard–Stratonovich decoupling to a small Hubbard ring. Evolve the auxiliary fields by leapfrog molecular dynamics, with fermion forces derived from equal-time Green's functions and stabilized matrix products, followed by a Metropolis accept/reject step. Measure double occupancy and compare it with exact diagonalization.
physics/many_body|particles.area: Determinant quantum Monte Carlo for Hubbard model

physics/many_body|particles.title: Bethe-lattice DMFT with ED solver and FIRE-optimized bath discretization
physics/many_body|particles.gist: Solve the half-filled Hubbard model on the Bethe lattice with DMFT using an Anderson-impurity exact-diagonalization solver. Fit the bath energies and hybridizations at each iteration by FIRE damped dynamics on the Matsubara cost function. Track the quasiparticle weight across the Mott transition.
physics/many_body|particles.area: Dynamical mean-field theory with ED solver

physics/many_body|particles.title: Spin-Peierls dimerization of a Heisenberg chain via ED-driven damped lattice dynamics
physics/many_body|particles.gist: Couple a periodic Heisenberg chain to classical bond displacements through J_i = J(1 − αu_i) with an elastic energy. Obtain Hellmann–Feynman forces from Lanczos ground-state bond correlations and relax the lattice with damped velocity-Verlet. Report the equilibrium dimerization amplitude and the singlet–triplet gap.

physics/many_body|particles.title: Truncated Wigner spin dynamics of an XXZ chain quench versus exact diagonalization
physics/many_body|particles.gist: Sample classical spin initial conditions from the Wigner distribution of a Néel state and integrate the classical XXZ equations of motion with a norm-preserving integrator. Compare the staggered-magnetization decay with exact Krylov time evolution of a small chain.

physics/many_body|particles.title: Classical spin dynamics on a Kitaev honeycomb cluster compared with ED correlations
physics/many_body|particles.gist: Integrate Landau–Lifshitz dynamics of classical spins on a periodic Kitaev honeycomb cluster using a symplectic sublattice-rotation splitting with a Langevin-thermalized start. Compare nearest-neighbor bond spin correlations and flux expectation values with exact diagonalization of the quantum S=1/2 cluster.

physics/many_body|particles.title: Path-integral MD of a quantum Lennard-Jones neon cluster with PILE thermostat
physics/many_body|particles.gist: Represent each neon atom of a small cluster as a ring polymer evolved in normal-mode coordinates. Integrate with symplectic free ring-polymer propagation plus a path-integral Langevin thermostat, using Lennard-Jones pair forces. Compute the centroid-virial kinetic energy and its quantum excess over the classical value.

physics/many_body|opt_discrete.title: Charge gap of the 1D Bose-Hubbard ring from fixed-N exact diagonalization
physics/many_body|opt_discrete.gist: Enumerate and rank fixed-particle-number Fock states with a combinatorial (lexicographic) indexing scheme. Build sparse Hamiltonians for N-1, N and N+1 bosons on an L-site ring and compute particle and hole chemical potentials mu_pm(J). Locate the hopping at which the Mott charge gap closes by root finding on finite-size extrapolated gaps.

physics/many_body|opt_discrete.title: Site-resolved Gutzwiller self-consistency for the disordered Bose-Hubbard model
physics/many_body|opt_discrete.gist: Solve coupled site-dependent Gutzwiller equations on a 2D lattice with random on-site potentials using damped fixed-point iteration. Classify Mott, Bose-glass and superfluid regimes from the distribution of local order parameters and the compressibility, averaged over disorder samples.

physics/many_body|opt_discrete.title: Fisher SDRG of the critical random transverse-field Ising chain
physics/many_body|opt_discrete.gist: Decimate the largest of the bond couplings J_i and fields h_i by cluster formation (h_eff = h_l h_r/J) or by bond elimination (J_eff = J_l J_r/h). Track cluster moments and the RG scale Omega. Verify the infinite-randomness scaling ln(Omega) ~ L^{1/2} and the golden-ratio moment exponent phi from log-log fits.

physics/many_body|opt_discrete.title: VMC optimization of a Jastrow wavefunction for a two-electron quantum dot
physics/many_body|opt_discrete.gist: Use a Gaussian-times-Pade-Jastrow trial state for two Coulomb-interacting electrons in a 2D harmonic trap. Minimize the Metropolis VMC energy over the Jastrow parameter with correlated sampling and a bracketing line search. Compare with Taut's exact energy E=3 at omega=1 and with the zero-variance property.

physics/many_body|opt_discrete.title: Classical Wigner-molecule shell structure and addition energies in 2D traps
physics/many_body|opt_discrete.gist: Find global minima of the energy sum r_i^2 + sum 1/|r_i - r_j| for N = 2-20 point charges, using multi-start BFGS with random perturbations (basin hopping). Identify the shell configurations (e.g. (1,5), (1,6), (3,8)) and compute strong-coupling addition energies E(N+1) - 2E(N) + E(N-1).

physics/many_body|opt_discrete.title: Automated Flyvbjerg-Petersen blocking of correlated VMC energy series
physics/many_body|opt_discrete.gist: Generate Metropolis VMC local-energy time series for an anharmonic oscillator trial wavefunction. Implement iterative pairwise blocking with standard-error estimates and their uncertainties. Detect the plateau with Jonsson's automatic hypothesis-test criterion, and compare the error bar with the naive one and with 2*tau_int.

physics/many_body|opt_discrete.title: Lanczos-Krylov imaginary-time projection and gap extraction for the Heisenberg chain
physics/many_body|opt_discrete.gist: Propagate a random state with exp(-dtau H) using Krylov-subspace exponentiation for a spin-1/2 Heisenberg ring. Monitor energy and ground-state overlap versus tau. Extract the singlet-triplet gap from a nonlinear least-squares fit of the exponential convergence, and verify it against direct Lanczos eigenvalues.

physics/many_body|opt_discrete.title: Eigenvalue-based Bethe equations for the Gaudin central-spin model
physics/many_body|opt_discrete.gist: Solve the quadratic eigenvalue-based Richardson-Gaudin equations for Lambda_i of a central spin coupled inhomogeneously to N bath spins, using Newton's method continued from zero coupling. Reconstruct the energies and central-spin polarization, and check them against exact diagonalization in the fixed-magnetization sector.

physics/condensed_matter|pde.title: Phonon focusing from finite-difference elastic waves in a cubic crystal
physics/condensed_matter|pde.gist: Integrate the 2D anisotropic elastic wave equation for a cubic crystal (C11, C12, C44, e.g. Si) on a staggered velocity-stress grid with a point-force source, absorbing sponge layers and leapfrog time stepping. Extract direction-dependent wavefront arrival speeds and compare them with the group-velocity surface from the Christoffel equation.

physics/condensed_matter|pde.title: Lamb-wave dispersion in a thin elastic plate by spectral collocation
physics/condensed_matter|pde.gist: Write the symmetric and antisymmetric Lamb modes of an isotropic plate as a polynomial eigenproblem in the wavenumber k, with traction-free faces and Chebyshev differentiation matrices across the thickness. Compute the ω(k) branches and the cutoff frequencies, and validate them against roots of the Rayleigh-Lamb equation.

physics/condensed_matter|pde.title: Acoustic phonon transmission across a solid interface from wave-packet simulation
physics/condensed_matter|pde.gist: Propagate a Gaussian longitudinal wave packet through a 1D bimaterial with a mismatch in density and sound speed, using a conservative finite-difference wave-equation scheme. Measure the energy transmission coefficient versus frequency and compare it with the acoustic mismatch model, including the effect of a graded interfacial layer.

physics/condensed_matter|pde.title: Néel skyrmion radius versus field in a 2D chiral magnet
physics/condensed_matter|pde.gist: Minimize the continuum energy of an ultrathin film with exchange, interfacial DMI, perpendicular anisotropy and Zeeman terms, using a finite-difference grid and damped LLG or gradient-flow relaxation from a seeded bubble. Compute the equilibrium skyrmion radius and its topological charge as functions of field and DMI strength.

physics/condensed_matter|pde.title: Flat Hubbard bands of a TMD heterobilayer moiré potential
physics/condensed_matter|pde.gist: Solve the continuum Schrödinger equation for a hole with effective mass in a triangular moiré potential V(r) = Σ 2V cos(G_j·r + φ), using a plane-wave spectral basis. Compute the top moiré valence bandwidth and fit nearest-neighbor triangular-lattice hopping t versus moiré period to show exponential band flattening.

physics/condensed_matter|pde.title: Nonparabolic quantum-well subbands with energy-dependent Kane effective mass
physics/condensed_matter|pde.gist: Solve the BenDaniel-Duke envelope equation for an InGaAs/InAlAs quantum well by finite differences, with a position- and energy-dependent mass m*(E) from the two-band Kane model. Iterate each subband to self-consistency, and compare the subband energies and in-plane nonparabolicity with the parabolic-mass result.

physics/condensed_matter|pde.title: Cross-plane thermal conductivity of a thin film from the gray phonon BTE
physics/condensed_matter|pde.gist: Solve the steady 1D gray phonon Boltzmann transport equation in a film between two isothermal walls, using discrete ordinates in angle and a finite-volume upwind scheme with source iteration. Compute the effective conductivity versus Knudsen number and compare it with the diffusive limit and with the Majumdar EPRT interpolation.

physics/condensed_matter|pde.title: Phonon second sound from the Guyer-Krumhansl equation in a heat pulse experiment
physics/condensed_matter|pde.gist: Integrate the 1D Guyer-Krumhansl heat-flux equations, which add relaxation and nonlocal terms to Fourier's law, with an implicit finite-difference scheme for a short boundary heat pulse. Compute the temperature response at a detector and show the crossover from diffusive to wave-like second-sound propagation as the resistive scattering time changes.

physics/condensed_matter|pde.title: Jackiw-Rebbi bound state at a mass domain wall with Wilson-regularized Dirac grid
physics/condensed_matter|pde.gist: Discretize the 1D Dirac equation with a kink mass profile m(x) = m0 tanh(x/w), adding a Wilson term on the finite-difference grid to remove fermion doubling. Compute the zero-energy midgap mode, its localization length versus m0 and w, and the convergence of the spectrum with grid spacing.

physics/condensed_matter|pde.title: Fermi-arc surface states of a continuum Weyl semimetal slab
physics/condensed_matter|pde.gist: Take a two-band continuum Weyl model H = (m - Bk²)σ_z + A(k_x σ_x + k_y σ_y) with nodes at ±k_0 and discretize it along z in a finite slab with hard-wall boundaries. Compute the slab spectrum versus (k_x, k_y), identify the surface states by their weight near the surfaces, and trace the Fermi arc connecting the projected nodes.

physics/condensed_matter|particles.title: Phonon lifetimes in thermalized FPU-β chain from mode-energy autocorrelations
physics/condensed_matter|particles.gist: Thermalize a periodic FPU-β chain with a Langevin thermostat, then run NVE velocity-Verlet dynamics. Project positions and velocities onto normal modes and fit the decay of each mode's energy autocorrelation to get lifetimes τ(k,T). Compare the result with the perturbative four-phonon scaling τ ∝ 1/(βT)².
physics/condensed_matter|particles.area: Anharmonic lattice dynamics and phonon lifetimes

physics/condensed_matter|particles.title: Size-dependent thermal conductivity of FPU-β chain with Nosé–Hoover end baths
physics/condensed_matter|particles.gist: Run nonequilibrium MD of an FPU-β chain whose end particles are coupled to hot and cold Nosé–Hoover chain thermostats. From the steady-state heat flux and temperature profile, compute κ(N) and fit the anomalous exponent κ ∝ N^α.
physics/condensed_matter|particles.area: Anharmonic lattice dynamics and phonon lifetimes

physics/condensed_matter|particles.title: Spectral energy density phonon dispersion and linewidths in Lennard-Jones fcc argon
physics/condensed_matter|particles.gist: Simulate a small fcc Lennard-Jones crystal with cell-list neighbors and velocity Verlet. Compute the spectral energy density Φ(k,ω) along Γ–X and fit Lorentzians to extract anharmonic frequencies and linewidths. Compare these with the harmonic dynamical-matrix dispersion.
physics/condensed_matter|particles.area: Anharmonic lattice dynamics and phonon lifetimes

physics/condensed_matter|particles.title: Temperature-dependent effective force constants of a 2D LJ crystal
physics/condensed_matter|particles.gist: Sample a triangular Lennard-Jones crystal with Langevin MD at several temperatures. Fit effective harmonic force constants by least squares on displacement–force pairs (TDEP-style). Diagonalize the resulting dynamical matrix to obtain renormalized phonon frequencies versus T.
physics/condensed_matter|particles.area: Anharmonic lattice dynamics and phonon lifetimes

physics/condensed_matter|particles.title: Phonon density of states of Stillinger–Weber silicon from velocity autocorrelation
physics/condensed_matter|particles.gist: Implement the Stillinger–Weber two- and three-body forces with neighbor lists for a 64-atom diamond Si supercell and run thermostatted then NVE MD. Obtain the vibrational DOS from the Fourier transform of the velocity autocorrelation function. Compare it with the DOS from the finite-difference harmonic dynamical matrix.
physics/condensed_matter|particles.area: Anharmonic lattice dynamics and phonon lifetimes

physics/condensed_matter|particles.title: Wavepacket transmission through a 1D diatomic phononic superlattice
physics/condensed_matter|particles.gist: Launch Gaussian acoustic wavepackets by MD into a finite mass-spring superlattice embedded in a uniform chain. Measure the transmitted energy fraction versus carrier frequency. Compare the stop bands with transfer-matrix band edges of the infinite superlattice.
physics/condensed_matter|particles.area: Photonic and phononic crystal band structures

physics/condensed_matter|particles.title: Band gap of a 2D phononic crystal with heavy mass inclusions
physics/condensed_matter|particles.gist: Model a square mass-spring lattice with a periodic array of heavy-mass inclusions. Compute the supercell dispersion by dynamical-matrix diagonalization along Γ–X–M, and the gap from the MD velocity-autocorrelation spectrum of a large thermalized sample. Report the complete band-gap width versus mass contrast.
physics/condensed_matter|particles.area: Photonic and phononic crystal band structures

physics/condensed_matter|particles.title: Zero-point Debye–Waller factor of a harmonic chain via path-integral MD
physics/condensed_matter|particles.gist: Use path-integral MD with staging or normal-mode thermostats to compute the mean-square displacement and imaginary-time correlation G(τ) of atoms in a periodic harmonic chain. Validate against the exact bosonic Matsubara sum over phonon modes as a function of temperature and bead number.

physics/condensed_matter|particles.title: Spin-wave gap of an easy-axis XXZ square-lattice antiferromagnet from spin dynamics
physics/condensed_matter|particles.gist: Simulate low-temperature classical spin dynamics of the anisotropic XXZ antiferromagnet on an L×L square lattice. Obtain the transverse S(q,ω) and measure the anisotropy-induced gap at q=(π,π) and the spin-wave velocity. Compare with the linear spin-wave result Δ = 4JS√(1−(J⊥/Jz)²).

physics/condensed_matter|particles.title: Classical spin dynamics versus exact quantum autocorrelations in small Heisenberg rings
physics/condensed_matter|particles.gist: For N=8–12 Heisenberg rings, compute the infinite-temperature local spin autocorrelation ⟨S^z_0(t)S^z_0⟩. Do this quantum-mechanically by sparse ED with Lanczos time evolution, and classically by averaging Landau–Lifshitz trajectories over random initial spins. Quantify the convergence of the two as the spin length S grows.

physics/condensed_matter|particles.title: Ehrenfest dynamics of a polaron drifting in an SSH chain under electric field
physics/condensed_matter|particles.gist: Add an extra electron to a dimerized SSH chain and propagate it with coupled Ehrenfest dynamics: Crank–Nicolson for the electronic orbitals and velocity Verlet for the lattice. Follow the self-trapped polaron under a uniform field and extract its saturation velocity and effective mass.
physics/condensed_matter|particles.area: Charge density waves and Peierls instability

physics/condensed_matter|particles.title: Weiss commensurability magnetoresistance in a classical antidot superlattice
physics/condensed_matter|particles.gist: Propagate classical electrons with a Boris integrator in a 2D periodic soft-antidot potential under a perpendicular magnetic field. Compute the diagonal conductivity from the Kubo velocity autocorrelation with relaxation-time weighting. Identify the resistance peaks at the commensurability condition 2R_c ≈ a and related orbit sizes.

physics/condensed_matter|opt_discrete.title: Self-consistent BCS gap and Tc for a 2D square-lattice attractive Hubbard model
physics/condensed_matter|opt_discrete.gist: Solve the mean-field BCS gap equation on a tight-binding square lattice by fixed-point iteration over a k-mesh. Determine the chemical potential at fixed filling by bisection, then find Tc as the root of the linearized gap equation with Brent's method.

physics/condensed_matter|opt_discrete.title: Andreev bound states in an S-N-S junction via real-space BdG self-consistency
physics/condensed_matter|opt_discrete.gist: Build a 1D tight-binding BdG Hamiltonian for a superconductor-normal-superconductor junction with a phase difference. Iterate the local pair potential to self-consistency (normal region has U=0) and extract the subgap Andreev levels and the Josephson current-phase relation.

physics/condensed_matter|opt_discrete.title: Inhomogeneous BdG gap suppression around nonmagnetic impurities in a disordered s-wave lattice
physics/condensed_matter|opt_discrete.gist: Solve the site-dependent BdG equations for a 2D attractive Hubbard lattice with random on-site potentials. Use linear-mixing fixed-point iteration for Δ_i and Newton adjustment of μ, and report the gap distribution and the local DOS at impurity sites.

physics/condensed_matter|opt_discrete.title: Two-band BCS superconductivity of MgB2-like model: coupled gap equations and Tc
physics/condensed_matter|opt_discrete.gist: Solve coupled two-gap BCS equations with intraband and interband couplings using damped fixed-point iteration over temperature. Locate Tc by bracketing the leading eigenvalue of the linearized kernel, and compare the gap ratios 2Δ/kTc of the two bands.

physics/condensed_matter|opt_discrete.title: Drude-Lorentz parameter fitting to Kramers-Kronig-consistent reflectivity of a polar insulator
physics/condensed_matter|opt_discrete.gist: Generate reflectivity, fit Lorentz oscillator parameters by constrained least squares (Levenberg-Marquardt with positivity bounds), and check that the fitted ε(ω) satisfies Kramers-Kronig by principal-value quadrature and the f-sum rule.

physics/condensed_matter|opt_discrete.title: Christoffel equation acoustic velocities and pure-mode directions in cubic and hexagonal crystals
physics/condensed_matter|opt_discrete.gist: Assemble the Christoffel matrix from Voigt elastic constants, diagonalize it for phase velocities on a sphere of directions, and locate pure-mode directions and acoustic-axis degeneracies by minimizing the eigenvalue splitting.

physics/condensed_matter|opt_discrete.title: Fitting cubic elastic constants from strain-energy curves of a Lennard-Jones fcc crystal
physics/condensed_matter|opt_discrete.gist: Relax the lattice constant by Brent minimization of a pair-potential energy, apply volume-conserving and tetragonal strains, and fit quadratic energy-strain curves to extract C11, C12 and C44. Then compute Voigt-Reuss-Hill moduli and the Debye temperature.

physics/condensed_matter|opt_discrete.title: Wigner-Seitz cell construction by half-space intersection for arbitrary Bravais lattices
physics/condensed_matter|opt_discrete.gist: Generate reciprocal lattice vectors, enumerate neighbor shells, and build the first Brillouin zone as an intersection of half-spaces via vertex enumeration with a convex hull. Return the vertices, face count and zone volume, checking against (2π)³/V.

physics/condensed_matter|opt_discrete.title: Thermionic emission diode: self-consistent space-charge potential minimum by Newton iteration
physics/condensed_matter|opt_discrete.gist: Solve the 1D planar Langmuir problem with Maxwellian emission by numerically integrating the Poisson-Vlasov first integral. Find the virtual-cathode depth and position by nested bracketing root finding, and return the J-V characteristic.

physics/condensed_matter|opt_discrete.title: Mobility edge in the Aubry-André-Harper model via transfer-matrix Lyapunov exponents
physics/condensed_matter|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the Lyapunov exponent of the quasiperiodic chain by QR-stabilized transfer-matrix products. Locate the localization transition in λ for given energies by bisection, and verify the self-dual point λ=2t together with inverse-participation-ratio scaling.
physics/condensed_matter|opt_discrete.area: Disorder, Anderson localization and transfer matrices

physics/condensed_matter|opt_discrete.title: Momentum-sector exact diagonalization of the XXZ chain: gap and entanglement entropy
physics/condensed_matter|opt_discrete.gist: Enumerate translation-invariant representative states with combinatorial bit algorithms and build sparse k-sector Hamiltonians. Use Lanczos to get the singlet-triplet gap and the bipartite entanglement entropy from Schmidt values, and locate Δ=1 crossover features.

physics/condensed_matter|opt_discrete.title: Locating the transverse-field Ising critical point from fidelity susceptibility maxima
physics/condensed_matter|opt_discrete.gist: Compute ground states of periodic TFIM chains with sparse ED using parity sectors, and evaluate the fidelity susceptibility by finite differences. Find its maximum in h by golden-section search for several sizes, and extrapolate h_c → 1.

physics/optics|particles.title: Luneburg lens focal-spot quality versus integrator order and step size
physics/optics|particles.gist: Trace a parallel bundle of rays through a Luneburg sphere n(r) = √(2 - r²) with Hamiltonian ray equations. Compare leapfrog, Forest-Ruth fourth-order symplectic and RK4 integrators, computing RMS spot radius at the antipodal point and conservation of the angular-momentum invariant.

physics/optics|particles.title: Fermat least-time path by damped elastic-band relaxation of a bead chain
physics/optics|particles.gist: Discretize a ray between two fixed points in a 2D graded-index medium as a chain of beads. Use spring forces plus forces from the gradient of the discretized optical path length, and relax with FIRE/damped molecular dynamics. Compare the converged path and optical path length with a shooting solution of the ray equation.

physics/optics|particles.title: Hamiltonian ray tracing and walk-off in a twisted nematic liquid crystal
physics/optics|particles.gist: Use the uniaxial dispersion relation H(x,k) = 0 with a position-dependent director field and integrate Hamilton's equations for extraordinary rays symplectically. Compute the local walk-off angle between the group and wave vectors, check it against the analytic uniaxial formula, and compute the transverse ray displacement through the twisted cell.

physics/optics|particles.title: Kerr electro-optic birefringence from rotational Brownian dynamics of polar molecules
physics/optics|particles.gist: Integrate rotational Langevin equations for an ensemble of anisotropic polar molecules (permanent dipole plus polarizability anisotropy) in a switched-on DC field. Compute the induced birefringence from ⟨P2(cos θ)⟩, the static Kerr constant (compared with Langevin-Debye theory) and the transient rise time versus rotational diffusion.

physics/optics|particles.title: Optical binding of two microspheres in counter-propagating beams
physics/optics|particles.gist: Compute coupled-dipole (Rayleigh) optical forces between two polarizable particles in counter-propagating plane waves using the dyadic Green's function pair interaction. Integrate overdamped Langevin dynamics and compute the distribution of interparticle separations, identifying the stable binding distances near integer multiples of the wavelength.

physics/optics|particles.title: Many-body versus pairwise-additive optical forces in a dipole chain
physics/optics|particles.gist: For a linear chain of N plasmonic Rayleigh particles under plane-wave illumination, compute the forces from a full self-consistent coupled-dipole solution and from a pairwise-additive two-body approximation. Quantify the force discrepancy versus spacing and N, and the resulting difference in relaxed equilibrium configurations from damped dynamics.

physics/optics|particles.title: Multiple-scattering density limit in a magneto-optical trap cloud
physics/optics|particles.gist: Simulate N atoms in a MOT with a linear restoring force and Doppler friction, plus the effective Coulomb-like repulsion from rescattered photons (Sesko-Walker), computed by direct pair summation with softening. Integrate with Langevin velocity Verlet and compute the cloud radius and density saturation as N increases.

physics/optics|particles.title: Relativistic electron figure-eight drift in an intense plane wave
physics/optics|particles.gist: Push an electron through a linearly polarized plane-wave laser field with the relativistic Boris integrator. Compute the longitudinal drift velocity and the figure-eight orbit amplitudes versus normalized amplitude a0, and compare them with the analytic drift velocity a0²/(4 + a0²) c.

physics/optics|particles.title: Collision-broadened spectral line and coherence time from hard-sphere gas MD
physics/optics|particles.gist: Run event-driven or velocity-Verlet MD of a dilute gas of emitting atoms with short-range repulsive pair interactions. Model each collision as a phase interruption plus Doppler phase shifts, and compute the temporal coherence function g1(τ), the line shape and coherence time versus density, comparing with the Lorentzian impact-theory width.
physics/optics|particles.area: Coherence theory and partially coherent light

physics/optics|particles.title: Dynamic light scattering from an interacting colloidal suspension
physics/optics|particles.gist: Simulate Yukawa-interacting colloids with Brownian dynamics using cell lists. Compute the intermediate scattering function F(q,t) and the intensity autocorrelation g2 via the Siegert relation, and extract the apparent diffusion coefficient D(q), compared with the free-particle value and the Cohen de Gennes narrowing near the structure-factor peak.
physics/optics|particles.area: Coherence theory and partially coherent light

physics/optics|particles.title: Turbidity and transport mean free path of a correlated colloidal fluid
physics/optics|particles.gist: Run Lennard-Jones or hard-sphere-like MD with neighbor lists to compute the static structure factor S(q) at several packing fractions. Combine it with Rayleigh-Gans form factors to compute the scattering mean free path, the transport mean free path and the turbidity, showing the suppression relative to independent scattering.

physics/optics|opt_discrete.title: LP mode effective indices and cutoffs in weakly guiding step-index fibers
physics/optics|opt_discrete.gist: Solve the LP_lm characteristic equation U J_{l-1}(U)/J_l(U) = -W K_{l-1}(W)/K_l(W) by bracketing between Bessel zeros with Brent's method. Return all guided-mode effective indices, cutoff V-numbers, and the Petermann-II mode-field diameter for a given fiber at 1550 nm.

physics/optics|opt_discrete.title: Optimal coupling for single-photon extraction in Purcell-enhanced cavity
physics/optics|opt_discrete.gist: Model an emitter in a leaky cavity with a Lindblad master equation and compute the photon extraction efficiency and indistinguishability from the time-integrated output and two-time correlation. Maximize the photon figure of merit over the cavity outcoupling rate with bounded scalar optimization (Brent).

physics/optics|opt_discrete.title: Iterative design of a phase-only hologram generating a vortex-array target
physics/optics|opt_discrete.gist: Use an iterative Fourier-transform algorithm (Gerchberg-Saxton with weighted amplitude feedback) to design an SLM phase mask that produces a lattice of equal-intensity optical vortices. Report the uniformity, diffraction efficiency, and the topological charge of each spot measured from phase winding on a closed loop.
physics/optics|opt_discrete.area: Optical vortices and orbital angular momentum

physics/optics|opt_discrete.title: Vortex charge counting via phase-unwrapping and dislocation tracking in speckle
physics/optics|opt_discrete.gist: Generate a random Gaussian speckle field, locate phase singularities by computing discrete circulation on every grid plaquette, and pair opposite-charge vortices with a minimum-cost bipartite matching (Hungarian algorithm). Return the vortex density compared with the theoretical value and the mean pair separation.
physics/optics|opt_discrete.area: Optical vortices and orbital angular momentum

physics/optics|opt_discrete.title: Coherent-mode decomposition of Gaussian Schell-model beams propagated through apertures
physics/optics|opt_discrete.gist: Discretize the cross-spectral density of a Gaussian Schell-model source, then propagate it through a hard aperture with Fresnel kernels. Obtain the coherent modes by Hermitian eigendecomposition, and compute the number of significant modes and the global degree of coherence after the aperture.
physics/optics|opt_discrete.area: Coherence theory and partially coherent light

physics/optics|opt_discrete.title: Kretschmann ATR resonance angle and Drude parameter fitting
physics/optics|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the p-polarized reflectance of a prism/gold/water stack with the three-layer Fresnel formula and a Drude-Lorentz gold permittivity. Find the resonance-dip angle by bounded minimization and the optimal gold thickness for zero reflectance by root finding, then fit ω_p and γ to a synthetic reflectance curve with least squares.
physics/optics|opt_discrete.area: Surface plasmon polaritons and Drude metals

physics/optics|opt_discrete.title: Equilibrium temperature and capture velocity in 1D optical molasses with MOT
physics/optics|opt_discrete.gist: Compute the two-beam Doppler force including Zeeman shifts in a magnetic gradient, and find the capture velocity as the maximum stoppable velocity by integrating the ODE and bisecting on the initial speed. Optimize the detuning that maximizes capture under a fixed beam size.

physics/stat_phys|particles.title: Lennard-Jones liquid radial distribution function and virial pressure via velocity Verlet
physics/stat_phys|particles.gist: Simulate a 3D truncated-shifted LJ fluid in NVE with velocity Verlet and cell lists. Compute g(r) by histogramming pair distances, and compute the pressure from the virial with tail corrections. Compare against the Johnson-Zollweg-Gubbins equation of state at a few state points.

physics/stat_phys|particles.title: Kob-Andersen binary LJ glass former: self-intermediate scattering and alpha relaxation
physics/stat_phys|particles.gist: Simulate the 80:20 Kob-Andersen mixture with a Nosé-Hoover thermostat at several temperatures. Compute the self-intermediate scattering function F_s(k,t) at the first structure-factor peak and extract alpha relaxation times by stretched-exponential fits. Fit tau_alpha(T) to a mode-coupling power law.

physics/stat_phys|particles.title: Two-dimensional melting of a Yukawa crystal via hexatic bond-orientational order
physics/stat_phys|particles.gist: Run Langevin MD of 2D screened-Coulomb particles across the melting coupling, with neighbor lists and Voronoi or nearest-neighbor bonds. Compute the local psi_6 order parameter, its spatial correlation g_6(r), and decay exponents. Locate the KTHNY hexatic window using the eta_6 = 1/4 criterion.

physics/stat_phys|particles.title: Hamiltonian mean-field rotator model: caloric curve and quasi-stationary states
physics/stat_phys|particles.gist: Integrate N globally cosine-coupled rotators (the HMF model) with a symplectic fourth-order scheme, using O(N) mean-field force evaluation. Compare equilibrium magnetization and temperature versus energy with the exact mean-field solution. Measure the lifetime of quasi-stationary states starting from water-bag initial conditions as a function of N.

physics/stat_phys|particles.title: Vicsek-type aligning self-propelled particles: polar order transition versus noise
physics/stat_phys|particles.gist: Simulate Vicsek alignment dynamics in 2D periodic boxes, using cell-list neighbor search within the interaction radius. Compute the polar order parameter, its Binder cumulant, and susceptibility versus noise amplitude for several system sizes. Identify the order-disorder transition and the emergence of traveling bands.

physics/stat_phys|opt_discrete.title: Self-consistent stationary density of the Desai-Zwanzig mean-field Fokker-Planck model
physics/stat_phys|opt_discrete.gist: For interacting particles in a double well with mean-field coupling, compute the stationary density as a Boltzmann factor that depends on the magnetization m. Solve m=F(m) by damped fixed-point iteration with quadrature, then locate the critical temperature of the symmetry-breaking bifurcation by root finding on dF/dm=1.

physics/stat_phys|opt_discrete.title: Coherent potential approximation for a binary-alloy tight-binding chain
physics/stat_phys|opt_discrete.gist: Solve the CPA self-consistency equation for the complex self-energy of a 1D A_cB_{1-c} alloy by damped fixed-point iteration at each complex energy. Return the configuration-averaged density of states and compare it with exact disordered-chain diagonalization.

physics/stat_phys|opt_discrete.title: Burning algorithm and matrix-tree count of recurrent BTW sandpile configurations
physics/stat_phys|opt_discrete.gist: Implement Dhar's burning algorithm, a graph traversal, to test whether a Bak-Tang-Wiesenfeld configuration on a small grid is recurrent. Count all recurrent configurations by exhaustive enumeration and check the count against the determinant of the reduced toppling Laplacian (matrix-tree theorem).

physics/stat_phys|opt_discrete.title: Manna sandpile avalanche exponents via discrete power-law maximum likelihood
physics/stat_phys|opt_discrete.gist: Stabilize stochastic Manna avalanches with a queue-based toppling algorithm and collect avalanche sizes. Estimate the size exponent by solving the discrete power-law likelihood equation (Hurwitz zeta derivative ratio) with Newton or Brent, selecting the lower cutoff by minimizing the KS distance.

physics/stat_phys|opt_discrete.title: Kramers turnover: friction maximizing the Mel'nikov-Meshkov escape rate
physics/stat_phys|opt_discrete.gist: Combine the energy-diffusion depopulation factor, evaluated by quadrature of the Mel'nikov-Meshkov integral, with the Kramers-Grote-Hynes spatial-diffusion rate for a cubic metastable well. Find the turnover friction that maximizes the rate using golden-section or Brent optimization.

physics/stat_phys|opt_discrete.title: Saddle-point search and multidimensional Langer rate on the Müller-Brown potential
physics/stat_phys|opt_discrete.gist: Locate the minima and first-order saddles of the 2D Müller-Brown potential using Newton iteration on the gradient with eigenvector-following steps. Compute harmonic Langer escape rates from the Hessian eigenvalues and the unstable-mode growth rate in the overdamped limit.

physics/stat_phys|opt_discrete.title: Directed percolation threshold from strip transfer matrices and phenomenological renormalization
physics/stat_phys|opt_discrete.gist: Build the exact 2^L-state transfer matrix for 1+1D bond directed percolation on periodic strips. Compute the survival decay time from the leading eigenvalue of the non-absorbing sector, and estimate p_c by Brent root finding of the crossing of scaled decay times for successive widths L and L+1.

physics/stat_phys|opt_discrete.title: Luttinger-Tisza and iterative-quench ground states of the J1-J2-J3 honeycomb Heisenberg model
physics/stat_phys|opt_discrete.gist: Minimize the Fourier-transformed exchange matrix over the Brillouin zone with a grid search plus BFGS to predict the ordering wavevector of classical O(3) spins. Confirm the spiral or Néel ground state by iterating spins to align with their local fields on a finite periodic cluster.

physics/stat_phys|opt_discrete.title: Domain-wall defect energies of a classical Heisenberg spin glass by local-field quench
physics/stat_phys|opt_discrete.gist: For a ±J or Gaussian-coupled classical Heisenberg spin glass on small cubic lattices, find low-energy states by repeated local-field alignment sweeps mixed with over-relaxation moves, keeping the best of many restarts. Compute the defect energy from periodic versus twisted boundary conditions and its stiffness exponent from size scaling.

physics/stat_phys|opt_discrete.title: Unstable periodic orbits of the Lorenz system by multiple-shooting Newton
physics/stat_phys|opt_discrete.gist: Locate the short unstable periodic orbits of the Lorenz attractor (symbolic labels AB, AAB, ...) by multiple-shooting Newton iteration on the period and initial points, with a phase condition. Report the orbit periods and Floquet multipliers from the monodromy matrix.
physics/stat_phys|opt_discrete.area: Low-dimensional chaotic flows: Lorenz and Rössler systems

physics/stat_phys|opt_discrete.title: Rössler period-doubling cascade and Feigenbaum ratio from Poincaré sections
physics/stat_phys|opt_discrete.gist: Compute Poincaré section crossings of the Rössler flow using event location with Brent root finding. Detect the period-doubling bifurcation values of c by bisection on the number of distinct section points, and estimate the Feigenbaum δ from successive bifurcation intervals.
physics/stat_phys|opt_discrete.area: Low-dimensional chaotic flows: Lorenz and Rössler systems

physics/stat_phys|opt_discrete.title: Subcritical Hopf point of Lorenz equilibria via Newton on eigenvalue crossing
physics/stat_phys|opt_discrete.gist: Find the nontrivial Lorenz fixed points C± analytically or with Newton, and compute their Jacobian eigenvalues. Locate the Rayleigh number where a complex pair crosses the imaginary axis by Newton/Brent on the real part, and compare with σ(σ+b+3)/(σ-b-1).
physics/stat_phys|opt_discrete.area: Low-dimensional chaotic flows: Lorenz and Rössler systems

physics/stat_phys|opt_discrete.title: Hard-core lattice gas on the Bethe lattice: fixed points and ordering fugacity
physics/stat_phys|opt_discrete.gist: Iterate the cavity recursion for occupation ratios of the hard-core model on a Bethe lattice with branching k to its uniform fixed point. Detect the critical fugacity of sublattice symmetry breaking where a period-2 orbit appears, and verify λc=k^k/(k-1)^{k+1}.

physics/stat_phys|opt_discrete.title: Fugacity series of hard-square pressure from independent-set counting and nonphysical singularity
physics/stat_phys|opt_discrete.gist: Compute low-order coefficients of the hard-square grand-canonical pressure series by counting independent sets on finite periodic tori via transfer matrices, then take the logarithm. Estimate the dominant negative-fugacity singularity (≈-0.1193) with ratio analysis and Padé approximant root finding.

physics/fields_astro|particles.title: Jupiter-Saturn secular eigenfrequencies from N-body versus Laplace-Lagrange theory
physics/fields_astro|particles.gist: Evolve the Sun-Jupiter-Saturn system for about 1 Myr with a symplectic leapfrog in heliocentric coordinates. Recover the secular frequencies g5 and g6 from the FFT of the complex eccentricity vectors and compare them with the eigenvalues of the Laplace-Lagrange matrix built from Laplace coefficients.

physics/fields_astro|particles.title: Width of the 2:1 mean-motion resonance mapped by test-particle integrations
physics/fields_astro|particles.gist: Integrate test particles near Jupiter's 2:1 resonance in the planar circular restricted three-body problem over a grid of semi-major axis and eccentricity. Classify each orbit as librating or circulating from its resonant angle, and compare the measured separatrix width with the pendulum-model estimate.

physics/fields_astro|particles.title: MEGNO chaos indicator for asteroids near the 3:1 Kirkwood gap
physics/fields_astro|particles.gist: Integrate asteroid orbits together with their variational (tangent-map) equations in the Sun-Jupiter elliptic restricted problem using a symplectic scheme. Compute the MEGNO chaos indicator and the Lyapunov time across the 3:1 resonance region.

physics/fields_astro|particles.title: Thomas-BMT spin precession of muons in a storage ring
physics/fields_astro|particles.gist: Co-integrate the orbit of a relativistic muon (Lorentz force) and its spin (BMT equation) in a uniform magnetic field. Extract the anomalous precession frequency from the spin-momentum angle, and isolate the Thomas precession contribution as a function of gamma.

physics/fields_astro|particles.title: Relaxation of a hard-sphere relativistic gas to the Jüttner distribution
physics/fields_astro|particles.gist: Simulate a 2D event-driven gas of relativistic hard disks whose elastic collisions conserve four-momentum, with each collision resolved in the center-of-momentum frame.
