Track relaxation from a non-equilibrium state and fit the final momentum distribution to obtain the Jüttner temperature.

physics/fields_astro|particles.title: Faraday rotation from a driven magnetized electron ensemble
physics/fields_astro|particles.gist: Integrate cold electrons in a background magnetic field driven by circularly polarized fields at frequency omega using a Boris scheme. Extract the R- and L-mode susceptibilities from the steady-state currents, then compute the refractive indices and the rotation measure, and compare them with cold-plasma theory.
physics/fields_astro|particles.area: Wave propagation in plasmas and dielectrics

physics/fields_astro|particles.title: Plasma screening enhancement of pp fusion from Yukawa OCP molecular dynamics
physics/fields_astro|particles.gist: Run thermostatted molecular dynamics of a one-component plasma at a given coupling Gamma, using Ewald or Yukawa forces with cell lists, and compute g(r). Extract the screening potential H(0) and the Salpeter-like enhancement factor for thermonuclear rates.

physics/fields_astro|particles.title: Tidal circularization of a hot Jupiter with constant-time-lag forces
physics/fields_astro|particles.gist: Add the Hut (1981) constant-time-lag tidal force and the corresponding spin torque to a two-body integrator. Track the decay of eccentricity and semi-major axis, and fit the circularization and synchronization timescales against the analytic formulas.

physics/fields_astro|particles.title: Tidal disruption distance of a self-gravitating rubble pile
physics/fields_astro|particles.gist: Model a satellite as an aggregate of soft-sphere particles with direct self-gravity and damped contact forces on a parabolic encounter with a planet. Determine the critical pericenter for mass loss and compare it with the fluid and rigid Roche limits.

physics/fields_astro|particles.title: Poynting-Robertson inspiral of dust grains in a stellar radiation field
physics/fields_astro|particles.gist: Integrate dust orbits around a star including radiation pressure (beta) and Poynting-Robertson drag. Compute inspiral times and blowout thresholds versus grain size, and compare them with the analytic PR timescale.

physics/fields_astro|particles.title: J2 nodal precession and sun-synchronous orbit design
physics/fields_astro|particles.gist: Integrate a low-Earth-orbit satellite under point-mass gravity plus the J2 acceleration with a high-order integrator. Measure the nodal and apsidal precession rates, and solve for the inclination that makes the orbit sun-synchronous at a given altitude.

physics/fields_astro|particles.title: Jupiter gravity assist in the restricted three-body problem
physics/fields_astro|particles.gist: Integrate spacecraft flybys of Jupiter in the full CR3BP for a range of impact parameters. Compute the heliocentric energy change and the deflection angle, verify conservation of the Jacobi integral and the Tisserand parameter, and compare with the patched-conic prediction.

physics/fields_astro|particles.title: Violent relaxation in cold collapse of a uniform N-body sphere
physics/fields_astro|particles.gist: Evolve a cold, softened, homogeneous N-body sphere with leapfrog and direct-sum forces. Measure the collapse time relative to the free-fall time, the damped oscillations of the virial ratio, and the final density profile and escaper fraction.

physics/fields_astro|particles.title: Thermostatted self-gravitating particles in a container versus Bonnor-Ebert sphere
physics/fields_astro|particles.gist: Simulate softened self-gravitating particles in a reflecting sphere with a Langevin thermostat. Compare the equilibrium density profile with the numerical isothermal Lane-Emden solution, and locate the collapse instability as the density contrast approaches the Bonnor-Ebert critical value.
physics/fields_astro|particles.area: Self-gravitating gas spheres and star formation

physics/fields_astro|particles.title: Phase mixing in the exact 1D self-gravitating sheet model
physics/fields_astro|particles.gist: Evolve N gravitating sheets with exact piecewise-parabolic, event-driven dynamics. Track phase-space spiral formation, coarse-grained entropy growth and virial oscillation decay from waterbag initial conditions.

physics/fields_astro|linalg.title: Penning trap eigenfrequencies from linearized Lorentz-force dynamics
physics/fields_astro|linalg.gist: Build the 6x6 linear first-order system for an ion in an ideal Penning trap (uniform B plus quadrupole E). Eigen-decompose it to get the modified cyclotron, magnetron and axial frequencies, check the Brown-Gabrielse invariance theorem, and compare against frequencies from FFT of a Boris-pushed trajectory.
physics/fields_astro|linalg.area: Charged particle motion in EM fields

physics/fields_astro|linalg.title: Paul trap stability diagram from Floquet monodromy matrices of Mathieu equation
physics/fields_astro|linalg.gist: Integrate the 2x2 fundamental matrix of the Mathieu equation over one RF period for the radial and axial ion motion in a quadrupole Paul trap. Use the trace and eigenvalues of the monodromy matrix to map the first stability region in the (a,q) plane and the secular frequencies.
physics/fields_astro|linalg.area: Charged particle motion in EM fields

physics/fields_astro|linalg.title: Schwarzschild quasinormal modes via hyperboloidal Chebyshev spectral generalized eigenproblem
physics/fields_astro|linalg.gist: Write the Regge-Wheeler equation in hyperboloidal minimal-gauge coordinates and discretize it with Chebyshev collocation. Solve the resulting generalized eigenvalue problem for the l=2 axial quasinormal frequencies, and use resolution convergence to separate physical modes from spurious ones.

physics/fields_astro|linalg.title: Regge-Wheeler ringdown evolution and matrix-pencil extraction of QNM frequencies
physics/fields_astro|linalg.gist: Evolve the 1+1D Regge-Wheeler wave equation in tortoise coordinates with an implicit Crank-Nicolson scheme using banded solves, and record the waveform at a fixed observer. Extract the complex fundamental and overtone frequencies with the SVD-based matrix pencil method.

physics/fields_astro|linalg.title: Pulsar timing model fit by weighted linear least squares on TOAs
physics/fields_astro|linalg.gist: Simulate times of arrival including spin frequency, its derivative, Roemer delay from position error, and proper motion. Build the design matrix and solve the weighted least-squares problem via SVD for parameter corrections, covariances, post-fit residuals and the implied braking index.

physics/fields_astro|linalg.title: Pulsar timing array Hellings-Downs optimal statistic with generalized least squares
physics/fields_astro|linalg.gist: Generate residuals for a set of pulsars with white noise, red noise and a common gravitational-wave background with Hellings-Downs correlations. Whiten each pulsar's data with Cholesky-factored covariance matrices, marginalize the timing model, and compute the cross-correlation optimal statistic and its signal-to-noise ratio.

physics/fields_astro|linalg.title: Rotating vector model fit of pulsar polarization position-angle swing
physics/fields_astro|linalg.gist: Use rotation matrices to transform a rotating magnetic dipole axis into the observer frame and derive the polarization position angle versus pulse phase. Fit magnetic inclination and impact angle to synthetic data by Gauss-Newton least squares, and report the parameter covariance and its degeneracies.

physics/fields_astro|linalg.title: Triaxial star cluster shape from iterative reduced inertia tensor diagonalization
physics/fields_astro|linalg.gist: Sample a Plummer sphere and stretch it into a triaxial cluster with known axis ratios. Compute the reduced moment-of-inertia tensor iteratively inside ellipsoidal apertures, eigen-decomposing it each step to recover the axis ratios and principal orientations.

physics/fields_astro|linalg.title: Orbit-averaged Fokker-Planck cluster evaporation with Chang-Cooper implicit scheme
physics/fields_astro|linalg.gist: Discretize the isotropic orbit-averaged Fokker-Planck equation in energy for a cluster in a tidal potential using Chang-Cooper weighting. March it implicitly with tridiagonal solves, using an escape boundary at the tidal energy, to compute the evaporation rate and mass-loss time in relaxation units.

physics/fields_astro|linalg.title: Mutual inductance matrix of coaxial loops and coupled RL decay modes
physics/fields_astro|linalg.gist: Compute self and mutual inductances of a set of coaxial circular loops from Neumann's formula with complete elliptic integrals. Assemble the inductance matrix and solve the generalized eigenproblem L x = tau R x for the current decay time constants and modal current patterns.

physics/fields_astro|linalg.title: Shim coil current design by Tikhonov-regularized least squares on Biot-Savart fields
physics/fields_astro|linalg.gist: Build a Biot-Savart response matrix mapping currents in an array of loop coils to Bz at target points inside a spherical volume. Solve for coil currents that produce a uniform field with Tikhonov regularization, using an L-curve to choose the regularization strength, and report field inhomogeneity in ppm.

physics/fields_astro|linalg.title: Lane-Emden polytropes via Chebyshev collocation and Newton iteration
physics/fields_astro|linalg.gist: Solve the Lane-Emden equation as a free-boundary problem by mapping to a fixed domain with the unknown surface radius xi_1 as an extra variable. Discretize with Chebyshev collocation and iterate Newton linear solves to obtain xi_1, the mass parameter and the binding energy for several polytropic indices n.

physics/fields_astro|linalg.title: Radial adiabatic pulsation modes of polytropes as a generalized eigenproblem
physics/fields_astro|linalg.gist: Discretize the linear adiabatic radial oscillation equation on an n=3 polytrope background with finite differences and appropriate center and surface boundary conditions. Solve the symmetric generalized eigenproblem for fundamental and overtone frequencies, and show the fundamental mode becoming unstable as Gamma1 drops below 4/3.

physics/fields_astro|linalg.title: Asteroid orbit determination by Gauss-Newton differential correction of astrometry
physics/fields_astro|linalg.gist: Generate right ascension and declination observations of an asteroid from a Keplerian orbit, including Earth-observer geometry and ecliptic-to-equatorial rotation. Iteratively fit the six orbital state elements with Gauss-Newton least squares using numerical partials, and return the covariance matrix and RMS residuals in arcsec.

physics/fields_astro|linalg.title: Dielectric Bragg mirror and Fabry-Perot reflectance via characteristic transfer matrices
physics/fields_astro|linalg.gist: Construct 2x2 characteristic matrices for TE and TM polarization in a quarter-wave stack of alternating dielectrics, including a defect cavity layer. Compute reflectance and transmittance spectra, the stop-band width, and the cavity resonance wavelength and Q factor.

physics/fields_astro|linalg.title: Coupled dipole approximation for clusters of polarizable spheres and effective permittivity
physics/fields_astro|linalg.gist: Assign Clausius-Mossotti (radiative-corrected) polarizabilities to small spheres, assemble the dense 3N x 3N dipole interaction matrix and solve it for induced dipoles. Compute extinction cross sections and the cluster's effective polarizability tensor, and compare with Maxwell-Garnett mixing.

physics/fields_astro|linalg.title: Pixelized source reconstruction in strong lensing via regularized semilinear inversion
physics/fields_astro|linalg.gist: Ray-trace image pixels through an SIS-plus-external-shear lens to build the sparse lensing operator onto a source-plane grid, then convolve it with the PSF. Solve the regularized normal equations with a gradient regularization matrix to reconstruct the source, and choose the regularization strength by Bayesian evidence.

physics/fields_astro|linalg.title: Binary microlens image positions via companion-matrix roots and light curves
physics/fields_astro|linalg.gist: Convert the binary point-lens equation to its complex fifth-order polynomial and find the roots as companion-matrix eigenvalues. Filter spurious roots against the lens equation, then sum image magnifications from the Jacobian determinant to produce caustic-crossing light curves for given trajectories.

physics/fields_astro|opt_discrete.title: Schwarzschild periapsis precession from turning points of the radial cubic
physics/fields_astro|opt_discrete.gist: For a bound timelike orbit with given E and L, solve the cubic radial potential for its three roots, the periapsis and apoapsis turning points. The periapsis advance per orbit then comes from the exact elliptic-integral expression and is compared with the weak-field 6πGM/(c²a(1−e²)) formula for S2-like and Mercury-like orbits.

physics/fields_astro|opt_discrete.title: Nonradial g-mode periods and period spacing in Cowling approximation
physics/fields_astro|opt_discrete.gist: Solve the two-point boundary eigenproblem for l=1,2 nonradial modes of a polytrope in the Cowling approximation. Shooting with root bracketing locates successive g-mode frequencies, which are labelled by node counting. The asymptotic period spacing ΔΠ_l = 2π²/√(l(l+1)) / ∫N/r dr is extracted and compared with the computed spacings.

physics/fields_astro|opt_discrete.title: Electrostatic field null points of discrete charge configurations via Newton iteration
physics/fields_astro|opt_discrete.gist: Locate all zeros of E(r) for a set of point charges, such as a linear quadrupole, a tetrahedron or random charges. Newton iteration with the analytic field Jacobian is run from a seeding grid, and duplicate roots are clustered. Each null is classified by its Hessian signature, and the null positions are compared with those predicted by the truncated far-field multipole expansion.

physics/fields_astro|opt_discrete.title: Polytropic Bondi accretion: critical point, accretion eigenvalue and Mach profile
physics/fields_astro|opt_discrete.gist: For spherical adiabatic accretion with index γ, compute the sonic radius and accretion eigenvalue λ(γ). The Mach number at each radius comes from bracketed root finding on the Bernoulli–continuity equation, with branch selection for the transonic accretion solution. Results are checked against the analytic λ(γ) formula.

physics/fields_astro|opt_discrete.title: Weber–Davis magnetized rotating stellar wind: slow, Alfvén and fast critical points
physics/fields_astro|opt_discrete.gist: In the equatorial Weber–Davis wind model, solve simultaneously for the Alfvén radius, the angular-momentum constant and the energy constant. The method uses multidimensional Newton iteration together with the regularity conditions at the slow and fast magnetosonic points. It outputs the terminal speed and the spin-down torque for solar-like parameters.

physics/fields_astro|opt_discrete.title: Lagrange points, Jacobi constants and zero-velocity-curve topology in CR3BP
physics/fields_astro|opt_discrete.gist: For the circular restricted three-body problem with mass ratio μ, find L1–L5 by bracketed root finding of the collinear quintic and from the analytic triangular points. The Jacobi constants at each point fix the critical energies where the zero-velocity curves change topology. The linear stability of L4 is also checked against the Routh criterion μ<0.0385.

physics/fields_astro|opt_discrete.title: Accelerated lambda iteration for two-level-atom line transfer in a slab
physics/fields_astro|opt_discrete.gist: Solve the non-LTE source function S = (1−ε)J̄ + εB in a plane-parallel slab using a short-characteristics formal solver. Classical lambda iteration is compared with Jacobi-preconditioned ALI and Ng acceleration. The outputs are convergence rates and the surface √ε law.

physics/fields_astro|opt_discrete.title: TE and TM guided modes of a dielectric slab waveguide from transcendental equations
physics/fields_astro|opt_discrete.gist: Find all propagation constants of the symmetric and asymmetric slab-waveguide dispersion equations. Brackets for bisection or Brent are placed between the asymptotes of the tangent. The outputs are mode cutoffs, effective indices versus frequency, and the group delay for each mode.
physics/fields_astro|opt_discrete.area: Wave propagation in plasmas and dielectrics

physics/fields_astro|opt_discrete.title: Rotation-curve decomposition: NFW halo plus exponential disk and bulge fit
physics/fields_astro|opt_discrete.gist: Fit an observed rotation curve with a sum of contributions: an exponential disk using Bessel-function formulas, a Hernquist bulge and an NFW halo. Nonlinear least squares with bounds is used, and profile likelihoods over the disk mass-to-light ratio reveal the disk–halo degeneracy. The fitted halo parameters give the virial mass and the concentration.

physics/fields_astro|opt_discrete.title: Bar corotation and Lindblad resonance radii in a composite galactic potential
physics/fields_astro|opt_discrete.gist: For a disk + bulge + NFW potential, compute the circular frequency Ω(R) and the epicyclic frequency κ(R) by numerical differentiation. Bracketed root finding then locates the corotation, inner/outer Lindblad and ultraharmonic resonances for a given bar pattern speed. The method also flags multiple ILR solutions.

physics/fields_astro|opt_discrete.title: Inverting Peters equations: initial orbit yielding a prescribed binary merger time
physics/fields_astro|opt_discrete.gist: Integrate the Peters coupled equations for da/dt and de/dt to coalescence, using the a(e) integral of motion and quadrature. Brent root finding then finds the initial semimajor axis or eccentricity that gives a target merger time, such as a Hubble time for a double neutron star. The result is compared with the circular and high-e approximations.

chemistry/md|ode.title: Trajectory-based shadow energy for an LJ13 cluster under Verlet
chemistry/md|ode.gist: Integrate an LJ13 cluster with velocity Verlet. Evaluate the second-order shadow correction (h^2/24)(2 p^T M^-1 Hess M^-1 p - grad V^T M^-1 grad V) along the trajectory using the analytic LJ Hessian. Report how much this shrinks the energy fluctuations and how the residual scales with timestep.
chemistry/md|ode.area: Shadow Hamiltonians and integrator error analysis

chemistry/md|ode.title: Event-driven hard spheres in a harmonic trap with analytic flights
chemistry/md|ode.gist: Particles move along exact harmonic-oscillator trajectories between collisions in an isotropic trap. Pair collision times are found by root-bracketing |r_ij(t)| = sigma on the analytic flight solutions, and a heap-based event queue processes elastic collisions. Compute the collision rate and the virial pressure correction relative to the ideal trapped gas.

chemistry/md|ode.title: Hard rods under gravity: event-driven parabolic flights and density profile
chemistry/md|ode.gist: Simulate 1D elastic hard rods above a reflecting floor in uniform gravity. Free flights are parabolic, and rod-rod and rod-floor event times come from quadratic roots processed in a priority queue. Measure the floor pressure from momentum transfer and check it against the total weight. Compare the time-averaged density profile with the Tonks-gas barometric solution.

chemistry/md|ode.title: Steep inverse-power collisions versus hard-sphere scattering and effective diameter
chemistry/md|ode.gist: Integrate two-body scattering on an r^-n repulsion with solve_ivp, using terminal events at closest approach and exit. Obtain the deflection angle as a function of impact parameter and compare it with the hard-sphere result. Extract the Barker-Henderson effective diameter and its convergence as n grows.

chemistry/md|ode.title: Rigid TIP3P water dimer dynamics with quaternion equations of motion
chemistry/md|ode.gist: Integrate the translational and quaternion rotational equations of a rigid TIP3P dimer with RK4, renormalizing the quaternions, using Coulomb plus O-O LJ forces and torques. Monitor energy conservation and evaluate a geometric hydrogen-bond criterion (R_OO < 3.5 Å, angle < 30°) along the trajectory. Report the fraction of time the hydrogen bond is present.

chemistry/md|ode.title: Luzar-Chandler hydrogen-bond kinetics fitted by integrating rate equations
chemistry/md|ode.gist: Generate hydrogen-bond population correlation functions c(t) and n(t) from a stochastic bond/near-bond switching model. Fit the Luzar-Chandler equation -dc/dt = k c - k' n by integrating it with solve_ivp inside a least-squares loop. Report the forward and backward rate constants and the hydrogen-bond lifetime 1/k.

chemistry/md|ode.title: Anharmonic O-H stretch levels of a flexible water model via Numerov
chemistry/md|ode.gist: Solve the 1D Schrödinger equation for the SPC/Fw-like Morse O-H stretch with OH reduced mass, using Numerov shooting and bisection on the energy. Compute the fundamental and overtone frequencies and compare them with the harmonic and analytic Morse results.

chemistry/md|ode.title: Breathing-mode frequency of an EAM copper nanocluster: MD versus Hessian
chemistry/md|ode.gist: Use Johnson's analytic EAM for Cu with many-body forces. Relax a 55-atom icosahedral cluster with damped dynamics, excite a small radial breathing displacement, and integrate with velocity Verlet. Compare the mode frequency extracted from the trajectory with the eigenvalue of the finite-difference Hessian.

chemistry/md|ode.title: Vacancy migration barrier in a 2D LJ triangular crystal via NEB
chemistry/md|ode.gist: Use the nudged elastic band method with spring forces, optimizing the images with FIRE damped dynamics, to find the minimum-energy path for a vacancy hop in a periodic 2D LJ triangular lattice. Report the migration barrier, use climbing-image refinement, and give an Arrhenius hop-rate estimate.
chemistry/md|ode.area: Point defects and vacancy formation energies

chemistry/md|ode.title: Vibrational density of states of a diatomic chain from Verlet trajectories
chemistry/md|ode.gist: Integrate a periodic 1D diatomic harmonic chain at finite temperature with velocity Verlet. Compute mass-weighted VACFs with FFT, apply windowing, and transform them into the VDOS. Locate the acoustic and optical band edges and the gap and compare them with the analytic dispersion relation.

chemistry/md|ode.title: DPD fluid viscosity from periodic Poiseuille flow profile fitting
chemistry/md|ode.gist: Drive a periodic DPD fluid with opposite body forces in two halves of the box, integrating with DPD velocity Verlet. Time-average the velocity profile and fit it to the steady Navier-Stokes ODE solution to extract the shear viscosity. Compare with the Marsh kinetic-theory estimate.

chemistry/md|pde.title: Split-operator Morse wavepacket: autocorrelation spectrum versus analytic vibrational levels
chemistry/md|pde.gist: Propagate a displaced Gaussian wavepacket on a Morse potential (e.g. H2 or HCl parameters) with the FFT split-step Fourier method. Fourier-transform the autocorrelation function C(t)=<psi(0)|psi(t)> and compare the spectral peak positions with the analytic Morse levels E_n = hbar*omega(n+1/2) - [hbar*omega(n+1/2)]^2/(4D_e).

chemistry/md|pde.title: Classical Liouville equation for a thermal Morse ensemble on a phase-space grid
chemistry/md|pde.gist: Solve the 1D Liouville equation for an initially displaced Boltzmann ensemble in a Morse well by Strang-split semi-Lagrangian advection in x and p. Compute the dephasing decay of <x(t)> caused by energy-dependent anharmonic frequencies and validate it against an average over many independent trajectories.

chemistry/md|pde.title: Crank–Nicolson Bloch equation for quartic oscillator versus Feynman–Hibbs effective potential
chemistry/md|pde.gist: Integrate the imaginary-time Bloch equation for a quartic oscillator with Crank–Nicolson to obtain rho(x,x';beta) and quantum thermal averages over a range of temperatures. Compare these with classical Boltzmann averages and with averages from the Feynman–Hibbs quadratic effective potential.

chemistry/md|pde.title: Smoluchowski-propagated umbrella windows and WHAM bias from incomplete equilibration
chemistry/md|pde.gist: For each harmonic umbrella window on a 1D asymmetric double-well PMF, evolve the Smoluchowski equation with a Scharfetter–Gummel finite-volume scheme and implicit time stepping to get time-averaged window histograms. Recombine them with iterative WHAM and quantify the PMF error as a function of the window simulation time.

chemistry/md|pde.title: Umbrella window relaxation times from Smoluchowski operator spectra for WHAM error estimates
chemistry/md|pde.gist: Discretize the biased Fokker–Planck operator in each umbrella window and extract its slowest nonzero eigenvalue to get the integrated autocorrelation time of the reaction coordinate. Use these times to weight WHAM histograms by statistical inefficiency and propagate the uncertainty into the recombined PMF.

chemistry/md|pde.title: Smooth particle-mesh Ewald energy and stress tensor for rock-salt NaCl
chemistry/md|pde.gist: Implement SPME: B-spline charge assignment, a 3D FFT Poisson solve with the influence function, and reciprocal-space energy plus virial tensor. Add the real-space and self terms, then validate the energy and pressure tensor of a distorted NaCl cell against direct Ewald summation.

chemistry/md|pde.title: Harmonic fcc crystal initialization by FFT normal-mode thermal displacements and velocities
chemistry/md|pde.gist: Build an fcc lattice with nearest-neighbour springs and compute its dynamical matrix on the reciprocal-space grid. Assign equipartitioned Gaussian amplitudes to every normal mode, transform back by FFT to real-space displacements and velocities, and remove the centre-of-mass momentum. Verify the mean-square displacement against the analytic harmonic result.

chemistry/md|pde.title: Hénon–Heiles quantum level statistics versus classical chaotic phase-space fraction
chemistry/md|pde.gist: Diagonalize a 2D sparse finite-difference Hamiltonian for the Hénon–Heiles potential and fit the unfolded nearest-neighbour level-spacing distribution with a Brody distribution in energy windows. Compare the fitted Brody parameter with the chaotic fraction of classical Poincaré sections at the same energies.
chemistry/md|pde.area: Ergodicity and chaos in Hamiltonian systems

chemistry/md|pde.title: Split-step discrete nonlinear Schrödinger lattice: Lyapunov exponent and thermalization
chemistry/md|pde.gist: Integrate a discrete nonlinear Schrödinger chain with a symplectic split-step scheme: an exact on-site nonlinear phase step plus an FFT hopping step. Compute the maximal Lyapunov exponent from tangent-space renormalization, and track normal-mode spectral entropy to measure the approach to equipartition as a function of energy density.
chemistry/md|pde.area: Ergodicity and chaos in Hamiltonian systems

chemistry/md|pde.title: Kramers escape mean first-passage time from backward Kolmogorov boundary-value problem
chemistry/md|pde.gist: Solve the backward Kolmogorov equation for the mean first-passage time out of a metastable cubic or double well by finite differences, using a reflecting and an absorbing boundary. Compare the result with Kramers' high-barrier formula and with Ermak–McCammon Brownian dynamics estimates.

chemistry/md|pde.title: Fluctuating hydrodynamics of transverse momentum: Green–Kubo shear viscosity on a grid
chemistry/md|pde.gist: Integrate a stochastic diffusion equation for the transverse momentum density with Landau–Lifshitz stress noise on a periodic 1D grid, using conservative finite volumes. Recover the input viscosity both from the Green–Kubo integral of the total stress autocorrelation and from the decay of transverse current correlations, checking the static structure factor for discretization bias.

chemistry/md|pde.title: Stochastic heat equation: Green–Kubo thermal conductivity from heat-flux autocorrelation
chemistry/md|pde.gist: Simulate the fluctuating heat equation with conservative stochastic heat fluxes on a periodic grid, using an explicit scheme and a stable time step. Verify equipartition of the temperature fluctuations, compute the total heat-flux autocorrelation, and integrate it to recover the input conductivity, studying the dependence on time step and system size.

chemistry/md|pde.title: Replica-exchange round-trip times from temperature-space diffusion boundary-value problem
chemistry/md|pde.gist: Model replica motion along a temperature ladder as diffusion with a ladder-dependent diffusivity derived from pairwise swap acceptance rates for a system with a phase-transition-like heat-capacity peak. Solve the mean first-passage boundary-value problem by finite differences to predict round-trip times, then iteratively optimize the ladder with Katzgraber feedback.

chemistry/md|pde.title: Two-replica coupled Fokker–Planck equations: spectral gap enhancement by temperature swaps
chemistry/md|pde.gist: Discretize the joint 2D Smoluchowski operator for two replicas of a double-well particle at different temperatures, adding a nonlocal swap term that obeys detailed balance. Compute the slowest relaxation rate from sparse eigenvalues as a function of swap frequency and compare it with the Kramers rate of a single replica.

chemistry/md|linalg.title: Integrated autocorrelation time from Yule-Walker autoregressive fits versus blocking
chemistry/md|linalg.gist: Fit AR(p) models to an MD energy time series (generated by an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck/Langevin oscillator) by solving the Toeplitz Yule-Walker system. Compute the statistical inefficiency from the AR spectral density at zero frequency and compare it with the Flyvbjerg-Petersen blocking plateau and the analytic OU result.
chemistry/md|linalg.area: Block averaging and statistical error analysis

chemistry/md|linalg.title: Generalized least-squares diffusion coefficient from correlated mean-squared displacement
chemistry/md|linalg.gist: From Brownian-dynamics trajectories, compute MSD(t) at many lags and estimate its full covariance matrix, either analytically for free diffusion or by block bootstrap. Fit D by generalized least squares with a Cholesky-whitened design matrix and compare the GLS error bar with naive OLS.
chemistry/md|linalg.area: Block averaging and statistical error analysis

chemistry/md|linalg.title: Harmonic phonon free energy of bcc versus fcc Yukawa crystals
chemistry/md|linalg.gist: Build the dynamical matrix of screened-Coulomb (Yukawa) crystals on bcc and fcc lattices using real-space lattice sums. Diagonalize it on a Brillouin-zone k-mesh and integrate log ω to get the harmonic free-energy difference as a function of screening parameter κa, locating the bcc-fcc crossover.

chemistry/md|linalg.title: Partial structure factors of binary Yukawa colloid mixture via matrix Ornstein-Zernike
chemistry/md|linalg.gist: For a two-component charged-colloid mixture with RPA/hard-core closure direct correlation functions, solve the matrix OZ relation S(k) = [I - ρ^{1/2} c(k) ρ^{1/2}]^{-1} at each k. Compute the Bhatia-Thornton number-concentration structure factors and the spinodal, where the smallest eigenvalue of S^{-1}(0) reaches zero.

chemistry/md|linalg.title: Force-matching coarse-grained pair force by least squares from LJ trajectory
chemistry/md|linalg.gist: From configurations and atomic forces of a Lennard-Jones liquid, assemble the linear system that maps a B-spline basis for a tabulated pair force onto per-particle forces. Solve it by regularized least squares (SVD) and compare the recovered force with the true LJ force and with the PMF obtained from g(r).

chemistry/md|linalg.title: Golub-Welsch Gauss-Jacobi quadrature for soft-core thermodynamic integration endpoint singularity
chemistry/md|linalg.gist: Generate Gauss-Jacobi nodes and weights by eigendecomposition of the Jacobi recurrence matrix, choosing weights matched to the λ^{-α} endpoint behaviour of <dU/dλ> for a soft-core LJ decoupling. Compare its convergence with Gauss-Legendre and trapezoidal TI against the exact free energy of a model with an analytic <dU/dλ>.

chemistry/md|linalg.title: MBAR free energies by Newton-Raphson with covariance from Fisher information
chemistry/md|linalg.gist: For samples from K harmonic oscillators with varying force constants along an alchemical path, solve the MBAR self-consistent equations by Newton iterations using the analytic Hessian. Obtain free-energy uncertainties from the pseudo-inverse of the information matrix and compare with the exact ΔF = (kT/2) ln(k_j/k_i).

chemistry/md|linalg.title: Preaveraged Zimm model relaxation spectrum with Oseen hydrodynamic interaction
chemistry/md|linalg.gist: Construct the Rouse connectivity matrix and the preaveraged Oseen mobility matrix for an N-bead Gaussian chain. Diagonalize H·A, symmetrized via H^{1/2}, to get Zimm relaxation times, and compare their N-scaling and the intrinsic viscosity with the free-draining Rouse limit.
chemistry/md|linalg.area: Polymer chain models and bead-spring dynamics

chemistry/md|linalg.title: Gyration tensor shape descriptors of FENE bead-spring chains in good solvent
chemistry/md|linalg.gist: Simulate a FENE+WCA bead-spring chain by Langevin dynamics. Eigendecompose the instantaneous gyration tensor to get averaged principal moments, asphericity and relative shape anisotropy, then compare them with known self-avoiding-walk and random-walk values.
chemistry/md|linalg.area: Polymer chain models and bead-spring dynamics

chemistry/md|linalg.title: Basin hopping for LJ13 and harmonic superposition heat capacity
chemistry/md|linalg.gist: Locate low-lying LJ13 minima by basin hopping with L-BFGS local minimization. Compute each minimum's Hessian, project out the six zero modes, and combine the geometric means of the normal-mode frequencies with point-group orders into a harmonic superposition partition function and heat capacity C_v(T).

chemistry/md|linalg.title: Eigenvector-following transition state search for LJ7 cluster rearrangements
chemistry/md|linalg.gist: Starting from LJ7 minima, use eigenvector following, uphill along the lowest Hessian eigenvector and downhill along the rest, to converge first-order saddle points. Verify that each saddle has exactly one negative eigenvalue and compute barrier heights and harmonic TST rates.

chemistry/md|linalg.title: Maxwell-Boltzmann initialization of a nanocluster with linear and angular momentum removal
chemistry/md|linalg.gist: Assign Maxwell-Boltzmann velocities to a finite bcc or icosahedral cluster. Remove centre-of-mass momentum, then solve the inertia-tensor system Iω = L to subtract rigid rotation, and rescale to the target temperature using the correct 3N-6 degrees of freedom.

chemistry/md|linalg.title: Kabsch-RMSD template matching to classify fcc, hcp, bcc and icosahedral environments
chemistry/md|linalg.gist: For each atom in a melting LJ configuration, align its nearest-neighbour shell to ideal fcc, hcp, bcc and icosahedral templates by SVD-based optimal rotation, after trying permutations of neighbour assignment. Classify each atom by minimal RMSD and track the solid-like fraction versus temperature.

chemistry/md|linalg.title: Wilson GF normal modes of Morse-stretch triatomic compared with MD spectra
chemistry/md|linalg.gist: For a bent water-like molecule with Morse O-H stretches and a harmonic bend, construct the G and F matrices in internal coordinates and solve the GF eigenproblem for harmonic frequencies. Compare these with peaks of the velocity-autocorrelation spectrum from NVE MD at increasing energy to quantify anharmonic red shifts.

chemistry/md|waves.title: P3M optimal influence function and RMS force error for random point charges
chemistry/md|waves.gist: For a random neutral charge system in a cubic box, build the Hockney-Eastwood optimal influence function with aliasing sums for a chosen assignment order. Compute P3M forces via FFT and measure the RMS force error against converged Ewald forces as a function of Ewald splitting parameter and mesh spacing.

chemistry/md|waves.title: Spherical multipole expansion of Coulomb forces in a charged ionic nanodroplet
chemistry/md|waves.gist: Represent a distant cluster of point charges by complex spherical-harmonic multipole moments up to order p, and evaluate far-field potential and forces with solid harmonics. Compare against direct summation and quantify how the error decays with p and with the separation-to-radius ratio.

chemistry/md|waves.title: Steinhardt q4, q6, w4, w6 polymorph classification of fcc, bcc, hcp and liquid
chemistry/md|waves.gist: Compute per-atom spherical-harmonic bond-orientational order q_lm from neighbour vectors, then the Lechner-Dellago averaged q̄4, q̄6 and the Wigner-3j invariants w4, w6. Classify thermally perturbed fcc, bcc, hcp and LJ liquid snapshots by these values.

chemistry/md|waves.title: Self-intermediate scattering function and Debye-Waller factor near Lennard-Jones crystal melting
chemistry/md|waves.gist: From short velocity-Verlet MD trajectories of an LJ fcc crystal at several temperatures, compute F_s(k,t) at the first Bragg wavevector and the mean-square displacement plateau. Use these to obtain the Debye-Waller factor and the Lindemann ratio, and locate where crystalline order is lost.

chemistry/md|waves.title: Chebyshev-expansion radial and angular descriptors for linear fitting of Morse-cluster energies
chemistry/md|waves.gist: Build Artrith-Urban-style descriptors by expanding radial pair distributions and bond-angle cosine distributions in Chebyshev polynomials with a smooth cutoff. Fit total energies of random Morse-potential clusters by linear least squares on summed atomic descriptors, then report test RMSE versus expansion order.

chemistry/md|waves.title: Power-spectrum discrimination of regular and chaotic Hénon-Heiles orbits
chemistry/md|waves.gist: Integrate Hénon-Heiles trajectories at several energies, apply a windowed FFT to x(t), and quantify the number of significant spectral lines and the broadband fraction. Compare this spectral measure with the largest Lyapunov exponent from tangent-space integration with renormalisation.
chemistry/md|waves.area: Ergodicity and chaos in Hamiltonian systems

chemistry/md|waves.title: Laskar frequency-map analysis of a coupled quartic oscillator
chemistry/md|waves.gist: Apply the NAFF algorithm (Hanning-windowed Fourier refinement of the fundamental frequency) to two successive time windows of trajectories of a 2D coupled quartic oscillator. Map the frequency diffusion rate over a grid of initial conditions to identify resonances and chaotic regions.
chemistry/md|waves.area: Ergodicity and chaos in Hamiltonian systems

chemistry/md|waves.title: Static structure factor and Bragg extinction rules for fcc, bcc, hcp and diamond
chemistry/md|waves.gist: Generate fcc, bcc, hcp and diamond supercells and add Gaussian thermal displacements consistent with an Einstein model. Compute S(k) on reciprocal-lattice vectors and spherically averaged, then verify the extinction rules and the Debye-Waller attenuation of peak intensities.

chemistry/md|waves.title: Gauss-Legendre thermodynamic integration of ion charging free energy in a periodic box
chemistry/md|waves.gist: Charge a single ion in a periodic box of point-dipole-free LJ solvent by scaling its charge with λ. Evaluate ⟨dU/dλ⟩ with Ewald sums that include the neutralising-background and self terms, integrate with Gauss-Legendre quadrature, and apply the Wigner-potential finite-size correction to compare with Born theory.

chemistry/md|waves.title: Charged vacancy energy in rock-salt with Ewald sums and Makov-Payne extrapolation
chemistry/md|waves.gist: Remove a Na+ ion from rigid-ion Born-Mayer-Huggins NaCl supercells of increasing size and compute the defect energy with Ewald sums and a neutralising background. Fit the Makov-Payne L^-1 and L^-3 terms to extrapolate the dilute-limit formation energy and compare with the analytic Madelung correction.
chemistry/md|waves.area: Point defects and vacancy formation energies

chemistry/md|waves.title: MSM implied timescales versus Fourier-spectral Smoluchowski eigenvalues on a periodic triple well
chemistry/md|waves.gist: Discretise Brownian-dynamics trajectories on a periodic triple-well potential into bins and estimate reversible transition matrices at several lag times. Compute implied timescales and the stationary distribution, then benchmark them against eigenvalues of the Smoluchowski operator solved in a Fourier basis.

chemistry/md|opt_discrete.title: Parrinello-Rahman cell relaxation of a 2D triangular LJ crystal under anisotropic stress
chemistry/md|opt_discrete.gist: Minimize the zero-temperature enthalpy H(h) = E(h) + P V - Tr(sigma_dev eps) over the 2x2 cell matrix h with BFGS, using analytic cell gradients built from the virial stress tensor. Report the equilibrium cell shape, the strain and the elastic constants obtained by finite differences.

chemistry/md|opt_discrete.title: Quasi-harmonic Gibbs energy minimization for LJ fcc compressibility as MTTK benchmark
chemistry/md|opt_discrete.gist: Build the dynamical matrix of an fcc LJ crystal on a k-point grid and form the quasi-harmonic Gibbs energy G(V) = E_static + F_vib + PV. Minimize G(V) with bounded Brent search at several T and P to obtain V(T,P), the thermal expansion and the isothermal compressibility. These serve as reference values for an MTTK barostat run.

chemistry/md|opt_discrete.title: Time-reversible MTTK integrator with fixed-point iterated barostat half-steps
chemistry/md|opt_discrete.gist: Implement the MTTK NPT equations for a small LJ fluid, solving the implicit coupled particle-velocity and barostat-momentum half-step by fixed-point iteration to a tolerance. Verify conservation of the extended energy, then compare the volume histogram variance with the compressibility relation <dV^2> = kT V kappa_T.

chemistry/md|opt_discrete.title: Farthest-point-sampled sparse kernel ridge potential with SOAP-like descriptors for LJ clusters
chemistry/md|opt_discrete.gist: Compute rotationally invariant Gaussian-smeared radial-angular power-spectrum descriptors for random LJ13 configurations. Choose sparse environments by farthest-point sampling and fit a sparse (Nystrom) kernel ridge model to energies. Set the regularization by golden-section minimization of the k-fold cross-validation error.

chemistry/md|opt_discrete.title: True minimum image in strongly skewed triclinic cells via Lagrange-Gauss/LLL lattice reduction
chemistry/md|opt_discrete.gist: Show that naive fractional-coordinate wrapping fails to give the minimum image in highly sheared triclinic cells. Implement LLL lattice reduction of the cell vectors followed by a bounded enumeration of neighboring images. Return reduced cell matrices and exact minimum-image distances, verified against exhaustive image search.
chemistry/md|opt_discrete.area: Cell lists and Verlet neighbor lists

chemistry/md|opt_discrete.title: SHAKE-constrained rigid water and the molecular versus atomic virial pressure tensor
chemistry/md|opt_discrete.gist: Integrate a small periodic SPC-like water box with SHAKE, solving the bond constraints by iterative Gauss-Seidel corrections to tolerance. Include the constraint forces in the atomic virial and compare the resulting pressure tensor with the molecular (center-of-mass) virial, showing that the time averages agree.

chemistry/md|opt_discrete.title: LJ liquid-vapor slab surface tension with Gauss-Newton tanh fit of interface
chemistry/md|opt_discrete.gist: From slab MD snapshots, compute the density profile and the normal and tangential pressure-tensor components. Fit the profile to a double tanh form by Gauss-Newton least squares to obtain the coexistence densities, the interface width and the equimolar dividing surfaces. Compute the surface tension from the integrated pressure anisotropy, including a tail correction.

chemistry/md|opt_discrete.title: Common neighbor analysis via longest bond chain among shared neighbors
chemistry/md|opt_discrete.gist: For each bonded pair, find the common neighbors, count the bonds among them, and compute the longest connected bond chain by graph enumeration to assign the (j,k,l) CNA signatures. Classify atoms as fcc, hcp, icosahedral or other in a melting LJ cluster and in stacking-fault configurations.

chemistry/md|opt_discrete.title: Hungarian-assignment Wigner-Seitz defect analysis and Lindemann index of heated crystal
chemistry/md|opt_discrete.gist: Map atoms of a hot, partially diffusing LJ crystal onto reference lattice sites by solving the minimum-squared-displacement assignment problem with the Hungarian algorithm under minimum image. Count vacancies and interstitials, and compute the per-atom Lindemann index from the assigned site displacements along the trajectory.

chemistry/md|opt_discrete.title: Calibrating DPD repulsion parameter to water compressibility by bracketing root search
chemistry/md|opt_discrete.gist: Measure the DPD pressure as a function of density from short virial-pressure simulations and fit the equation of state. Use bisection/Brent on the repulsion parameter a so that the dimensionless inverse compressibility matches that of water (about 16), and compare with Groot-Warren's analytic estimate.

chemistry/md|opt_discrete.title: Climbing-image nudged elastic band for adatom hopping on a Morse fcc(100) surface
chemistry/md|opt_discrete.gist: Build an image chain between adjacent hollow sites of an adatom on a Morse-potential fcc(100) slab with fixed bottom layers. Optimize the chain with NEB spring and tangent projections followed by a climbing image. Report the hopping barrier and minimum-energy-path profile, and verify the saddle point via a single negative Hessian eigenvalue.

chemistry/mc_thermo|ode.title: Bikerman steric Poisson-Boltzmann and camel-to-bell capacitance crossover
chemistry/mc_thermo|ode.gist: Integrate the modified PB equation with lattice-gas (Bikerman) ion crowding for a planar electrode as a BVP, at several packing parameters gamma. Compute the surface charge and differential capacitance versus potential, and locate the camel-to-bell crossover (expected near gamma = 1/3).

chemistry/mc_thermo|ode.title: Cylindrical Poisson-Boltzmann around DNA and Manning counterion condensation fraction
chemistry/mc_thermo|ode.gist: Solve the radial PB equation in a Wigner-Seitz cell around a charged rod with solve_bvp, for counterion-only and added-salt cases. Compute the counterion density and the fraction condensed within the Manning radius, and compare with the analytic Fuoss-Katchalsky-Lifson solution and the 1 - 1/xi prediction.

chemistry/mc_thermo|ode.title: Spherical cell Poisson-Boltzmann for colloids and Alexander effective charge renormalization
chemistry/mc_thermo|ode.gist: Solve the nonlinear spherical PB equation in a cell model for a charged colloid with solve_bvp at increasing bare charge. Extract the renormalized effective charge by matching the linearized solution at the cell boundary, and show that it saturates.

chemistry/mc_thermo|ode.title: Double-layer disjoining pressure between charged plates via PB and contact theorem
chemistry/mc_thermo|ode.gist: Solve the PB BVP for electrolyte confined between two equally charged plates for a range of separations. Compute the osmotic disjoining pressure from the midplane ion densities, verify it against the contact theorem at the wall, and compare with the weak-overlap DLVO approximation.

chemistry/mc_thermo|ode.title: Poisson-Nernst-Planck transient charging of a blocking electrode cell
chemistry/mc_thermo|ode.gist: Discretize the 1D PNP equations for a binary electrolyte between blocking electrodes under a voltage step, using the method of lines with a stiff solver (BDF). Compute the time-dependent surface charge, extract the charging time, and compare it with the RC time lambda_D*L/D and the equilibrium Gouy-Chapman charge.

chemistry/mc_thermo|ode.title: Wang-Landau density of states for anharmonic oscillators with Numerov energy levels
chemistry/mc_thermo|ode.gist: Obtain the single-particle eigenvalues of a quartic or Morse oscillator by Numerov shooting. Run a Wang-Landau flat-histogram walk over occupation configurations of N distinguishable oscillators to estimate the total-energy density of states, then derive the heat capacity and free energy and compare with the exact convolution and partition function.

chemistry/mc_thermo|ode.title: Wang-Landau free-energy profile along a reaction coordinate and MFPT rate
chemistry/mc_thermo|ode.gist: Use flat-histogram Wang-Landau sampling in a collective variable of a 2D model potential to obtain the free energy F(x). Feed F(x) into the 1D Smoluchowski mean-first-passage-time ODE, integrated by quadrature or as a BVP, to compute a barrier-crossing rate, and compare with Kramers' formula.

chemistry/mc_thermo|ode.title: Coupling-parameter thermodynamic integration of HNC excess free energy
chemistry/mc_thermo|ode.gist: Treat the excess Helmholtz energy of a soft-sphere or Yukawa fluid as an ODE in the coupling parameter lambda, dA/d(lambda) = (rho/2) * integral of u(r) g(r;lambda) d^3r. Obtain g at each lambda from a warm-started HNC/OZ FFT solve, integrate with an adaptive Runge-Kutta scheme, and compare with the Morita closed-form HNC free energy.

chemistry/mc_thermo|ode.title: Broekhoff-de Boer theory of capillary condensation hysteresis in cylindrical pores
chemistry/mc_thermo|ode.gist: Combine a Frenkel-Halsey-Hill disjoining pressure with curvature-corrected Kelvin terms for adsorbed films in cylindrical pores. Solve the film-thickness equilibrium and stability conditions (the augmented Young-Laplace ODE, then root finding) to obtain the condensation and evaporation pressures versus pore radius, and compare with the classical Kelvin equation.

chemistry/mc_thermo|ode.title: Lattice density functional relaxation dynamics tracing slit-pore adsorption hysteresis
chemistry/mc_thermo|ode.gist: Write a mean-field lattice-gas DFT for a slit pore with wall attraction, and evolve the layer densities by a gradient-flow ODE system dρ/dt = -M ∂Ω/∂ρ with a stiff integrator while the chemical potential is swept up and down. Compute the adsorption and desorption branches, the hysteresis loop width, and the equilibrium transition from the grand potential.

chemistry/mc_thermo|ode.title: Polymer adsorption transition from Edwards ground-state eigenvalue near attractive wall
chemistry/mc_thermo|ode.gist: Solve the Edwards ground-state eigenvalue problem for a long Gaussian chain near a square-well attractive wall with the Numerov method and shooting. Determine the critical adsorption strength and the bound-state width versus attraction, and benchmark the adsorbed fraction against configurational-bias MC chain growth for finite chains.

chemistry/mc_thermo|ode.title: Path-integral Monte Carlo of a double-well oscillator benchmarked by Numerov spectrum
chemistry/mc_thermo|ode.gist: Compute the exact energy levels and wavefunctions of a quartic double well with Numerov shooting, and use them for the exact thermal energy, kinetic energy and position density. Run primitive-action ring-polymer PIMC with the virial kinetic-energy estimator and quantify the Trotter-number convergence against the exact values.

chemistry/mc_thermo|ode.title: Master-equation spectral gap of Metropolis vs heat-bath dynamics for small Ising rings
chemistry/mc_thermo|ode.gist: Build the continuous-time transition-rate matrices for single-spin-flip Metropolis and Glauber dynamics on an N-spin Ising ring, and verify detailed balance and stationarity. Integrate dp/dt = Wp with a stiff solver from an ordered start, and compare the magnetization relaxation with the spectral gap from eigendecomposition.
chemistry/mc_thermo|ode.area: Detailed balance and Markov chain move design

chemistry/mc_thermo|ode.title: Fisher-KPP front speed: spatial Gillespie RDME vs method-of-lines PDE
chemistry/mc_thermo|ode.gist: Simulate A + X -> 2X with diffusion on a 1D compartment lattice using the next-subvolume reaction-diffusion master equation, and integrate the corresponding deterministic PDE with the method of lines and solve_ivp. Measure front speeds and show the slow, copy-number-dependent convergence toward the 2*sqrt(Dk) prediction.

chemistry/mc_thermo|ode.title: Kofke Gibbs-Duhem integration of Lennard-Jones vapor-liquid coexistence line
chemistry/mc_thermo|ode.gist: Integrate the Clapeyron ODE d(ln p)/d(beta) = -Δh/(β p Δv) along coexistence with a predictor-corrector or RK scheme, starting from one known coexistence point. Evaluate the phase properties at each step from a Johnson-Zollweg-Gubbins LJ equation of state, which stands in for NPT simulations, and compare with direct equal-pressure, equal-chemical-potential solutions.

chemistry/mc_thermo|pde.title: Committor and reactive flux on the Müller-Brown potential via backward Kolmogorov
chemistry/mc_thermo|pde.gist: Discretize the 2D overdamped backward Kolmogorov equation L q = 0 on a finite-difference grid. Impose Dirichlet conditions q=0 and q=1 on reactant and product basins, then solve the sparse linear system for the committor. Use transition path theory to compute the reactive flux and rate constant at a given temperature.

chemistry/mc_thermo|pde.title: Mean-field well-tempered metadynamics as a coupled Fokker-Planck bias PDE
chemistry/mc_thermo|pde.gist: Evolve the Smoluchowski equation for a 1D collective-variable density together with a well-tempered bias that grows as dV/dt = w exp(-V/(kΔT)) (G*p). Use implicit finite volumes and Gaussian convolution on the grid. Compute the free-energy estimate -(T+ΔT)/ΔT · V and its convergence error over time.

chemistry/mc_thermo|pde.title: Square-root approximation discretization of Smoluchowski generator and spectral gap
chemistry/mc_thermo|pde.gist: Build a rate matrix on a 2D grid using SQRA rates k_ij = (D/h²) exp(-β(U_j-U_i)/2). Verify detailed balance and the Boltzmann stationary vector, then compute the spectral gap and implied relaxation timescales with sparse eigensolvers. Compare the slow eigenvalues against a central-difference discretization.
chemistry/mc_thermo|pde.area: Detailed balance and Markov chain move design

chemistry/mc_thermo|pde.title: Finite-difference Poisson-Boltzmann site interactions for constant-pH titration Monte Carlo
chemistry/mc_thermo|pde.gist: Solve the linearized Poisson-Boltzmann equation on a 3D grid for a low-dielectric sphere carrying titratable sites, which gives desolvation energies and the pairwise site-site interaction matrix. Run Metropolis protonation-state Monte Carlo at each pH to obtain titration curves and apparent pKa shifts.

chemistry/mc_thermo|pde.title: Charge regulation of a planar acidic surface via nonlinear Poisson-Boltzmann
chemistry/mc_thermo|pde.gist: Solve the 1D nonlinear Poisson-Boltzmann equation by Newton finite differences, with a self-consistent Langmuir charge-regulation boundary condition for surface carboxyl groups. Compute surface charge density and potential versus pH and salt concentration, and extract the apparent surface pKa.

chemistry/mc_thermo|pde.title: H/D isotope fractionation from Morse oscillator imaginary-time split-operator propagation
chemistry/mc_thermo|pde.gist: Propagate the thermal density matrix of an O-H and an O-D Morse oscillator in imaginary time with the FFT split-step method. Compute quantum partition functions, mean kinetic energies, and the reduced partition function ratio that sets the equilibrium isotope fractionation factor versus temperature.

chemistry/mc_thermo|pde.title: Poisson-Boltzmann cell model equation of state for charged colloids
chemistry/mc_thermo|pde.gist: Solve the radial nonlinear Poisson-Boltzmann equation in a spherical Wigner-Seitz cell by finite-difference Newton iteration, sweeping over cell volumes. Obtain the osmotic pressure from the ion density at the cell boundary, and from it the pressure-volume equation of state and the isothermal osmotic compressibility.

chemistry/mc_thermo|pde.title: DNA bubble lifetime from Fokker-Planck dynamics in a Poland-Scheraga landscape
chemistry/mc_thermo|pde.gist: Build the bubble-size free energy from Poland-Scheraga stacking energies plus a loop entropy of the form c·ln(m). Solve the 1D Fokker-Planck equation in bubble size with a reflecting boundary at zero size via finite volumes. Compute the bubble size distribution and the mean closing and opening times versus temperature.

chemistry/mc_thermo|pde.title: Critical nucleus and nucleation barrier in a regular solution via string method
chemistry/mc_thermo|pde.gist: Discretize the Cahn-Hilliard (square-gradient) free-energy functional for a regular solution on a 1D radial grid. Use the string method with reparametrization to locate the minimum free-energy path from the metastable phase to the stable phase. Compute the critical-nucleus profile and the barrier height versus supersaturation, and compare with classical nucleation theory.
chemistry/mc_thermo|pde.area: Binary mixture phase separation lattice models

chemistry/mc_thermo|pde.title: Binder cumulant crossing in stochastic Model-A phi^4 lattice dynamics
chemistry/mc_thermo|pde.gist: Integrate time-dependent Ginzburg-Landau (Model A) Langevin dynamics for a 2D φ⁴ field with a finite-difference Laplacian and the Euler-Maruyama method, on several lattice sizes. Accumulate magnetization moments to compute Binder cumulants and estimate the critical coupling from their crossing points.

chemistry/mc_thermo|pde.title: Binary CO2/N2 breakthrough curves in a zeolite packed bed
chemistry/mc_thermo|pde.gist: Solve the coupled advection-dispersion mass balances with linear-driving-force uptake and a competitive dual-site Langmuir isotherm, using upwind finite volumes and method-of-lines stiff integration. Compute the breakthrough curves, the roll-up overshoot, and the dynamic CO2/N2 selectivity.
chemistry/mc_thermo|pde.area: Adsorption in zeolites and porous frameworks

chemistry/mc_thermo|pde.title: Schlögl model bistability via chemical Fokker-Planck stationary and switching analysis
chemistry/mc_thermo|pde.gist: Derive the chemical Fokker-Planck equation for the Schlögl autocatalytic reaction network. Compute its stationary distribution with zero-flux finite volumes, and from that the bimodal populations of the two states. Solve the backward MFPT equation for the switching times, and compare against the stationary distribution of the chemical master equation.

chemistry/mc_thermo|pde.title: Jarzynski free energy from Feynman-Kac PDE for a dragged Brownian particle
chemistry/mc_thermo|pde.gist: For a particle in a harmonic trap pulled across a double-well landscape, solve the Feynman-Kac-weighted Smoluchowski PDE ∂g/∂t = L g - β ∂_t H g with implicit finite differences. Show that its normalization gives exp(-βΔF), and compare with the equilibrium free-energy difference and with the mean work from the unweighted Fokker-Planck solution.

chemistry/mc_thermo|pde.title: Van der Waals vapor-liquid interface and surface tension from square-gradient theory
chemistry/mc_thermo|pde.gist: Compute coexisting densities from the van der Waals equation via the Maxwell equal-area construction. Solve the square-gradient Euler-Lagrange boundary-value problem for the planar density profile by finite-difference Newton relaxation. Evaluate the surface tension and interfacial width versus reduced temperature, and fit critical exponents.

chemistry/mc_thermo|linalg.title: Transfer-matrix titration curve of a linear weak polyelectrolyte with nearest-neighbor repulsion
chemistry/mc_thermo|linalg.gist: Model a linear polyacid as a 1D Ising-like chain of protonatable sites with intrinsic pKa and a nearest-neighbor charge-charge penalty. Build the 2x2 transfer matrix and use its dominant eigenvalue and eigenvector to compute the degree of ionization versus pH and the apparent pKa shift. Validate against exact enumeration for short chains.

chemistry/mc_thermo|linalg.title: Stationary distribution of a constant-pH Metropolis Markov chain for multi-site proteins
chemistry/mc_thermo|linalg.gist: For a small protein with N coupled titratable sites (pairwise interaction matrix), construct the full 2^N Metropolis transition matrix of single-site protonation flips. Obtain its stationary eigenvector and spectral gap, and check detailed balance against exact Boltzmann titration curves. Report site-resolved apparent pKa values from Hill fits.

chemistry/mc_thermo|linalg.title: MBAR combination of multi-pH replica protonation samples via Newton-Raphson
chemistry/mc_thermo|linalg.gist: Generate protonation-state samples of a coupled multi-site molecule at a ladder of pH values. Solve the MBAR self-consistent free energies by Newton-Raphson, using Hessian linear solves. Reconstruct a continuous titration curve and its uncertainties from the covariance matrix.

chemistry/mc_thermo|linalg.title: Committor and transmission on a 2D nucleation free energy surface by sparse solve
chemistry/mc_thermo|linalg.gist: Given an analytic free energy F(n, Q6-like order parameter) with a saddle, discretize the backward Kolmogorov (Smoluchowski) operator on a grid. Solve the sparse linear system for the committor. Compute the reactive flux rate and compare with the 1D cluster-size TST rate to quantify recrossing.

chemistry/mc_thermo|linalg.title: Transfer-matrix exact adsorption isotherm of an interacting lattice gas in a strip pore
chemistry/mc_thermo|linalg.gist: Model a slit pore as a width-W lattice strip with wall attraction and nearest-neighbor fluid attraction. Build the 2^W-state column transfer matrix in the grand ensemble and obtain loading versus chemical potential from the leading eigenvalue. Benchmark short GCMC runs and least-squares Langmuir fits against this exact isotherm.

chemistry/mc_thermo|linalg.title: Gibbs energy minimization of H2/O2 combustion products by the RAND method
chemistry/mc_thermo|linalg.gist: Minimize the total Gibbs energy of H2, O2, H2O, OH, H, O at fixed T and P using NASA-polynomial chemical potentials. Apply Newton iterations that solve the RAND linear system for composition corrections and element Lagrange multipliers. Report equilibrium compositions versus temperature and equivalence ratio.

chemistry/mc_thermo|linalg.title: Equilibrium composition of weakly ionized high-temperature air with charge-neutrality constraint
chemistry/mc_thermo|linalg.gist: Compute the equilibrium of N2, O2, NO, N, O, NO+, e- and related species at 3000-10000 K. Augment the element-constraint matrix with a charge row and use the element-potential method, a Newton solve on log-multipliers with SVD-conditioned Jacobians. Output the electron number density and degree of ionization.

chemistry/mc_thermo|linalg.title: Jacobian-free Newton-Krylov solution of HNC Ornstein-Zernike for Lennard-Jones fluid
chemistry/mc_thermo|linalg.gist: Solve the OZ equation with the HNC closure for a Lennard-Jones fluid using radial FFT (sine transform) and a Newton-GMRES solver with finite-difference Jacobian-vector products. Compare the convergence rate with Picard mixing. Report g(r), S(k), virial pressure and compressibility.

chemistry/mc_thermo|linalg.title: Binary hard-sphere mixture Percus-Yevick partial structure factors via k-space matrix inversion
chemistry/mc_thermo|linalg.gist: Solve the multicomponent OZ equation for a binary hard-sphere mixture with the PY closure, inverting the 2x2 matrix (I - ρC(k)) at each wavevector. Obtain partial g_ij(r) and Ashcroft-Langreth and Bhatia-Thornton structure factors. Validate against Lebowitz's analytic PY solution.

chemistry/mc_thermo|linalg.title: Site-site RISM for hard homonuclear dumbbells with intramolecular correlation matrix
chemistry/mc_thermo|linalg.gist: Implement the RISM equation H = W C W + W C ρ H with intramolecular matrix W(k) = sin(kL)/(kL) for rigid hard dumbbells, using the PY closure. Solve it by FFT iteration with per-k matrix algebra. Compute site-site g(r) and the dependence of the contact value on elongation.

chemistry/mc_thermo|linalg.title: Adsorption transition of partially directed walks via transfer matrix and PERM
chemistry/mc_thermo|linalg.gist: Model a polymer near an attractive wall as a 2D partially directed walk with surface contact energy. Compute the partition function by transfer-matrix products over height states and locate the adsorption transition from the free energy and the fraction of contacts. Compare with PERM sampling of the same model.

chemistry/mc_thermo|linalg.title: Gauss-Newton fit of Lennard-Jones and Kihara parameters to B2(T) data
chemistry/mc_thermo|linalg.gist: Compute classical B2(T) by Gauss-Legendre quadrature of the Mayer function for LJ and Kihara potentials. Fit ε and σ (and the core size) to tabulated argon second virial data by Gauss-Newton or Levenberg-Marquardt least squares, and report the parameter covariance from the Jacobian.

chemistry/mc_thermo|linalg.title: HP lattice protein folding kinetics from conformational master-equation spectrum
chemistry/mc_thermo|linalg.gist: Enumerate all 2D square-lattice conformations of a short HP sequence and connect them by end, corner and crankshaft moves. Build the Metropolis rate matrix and eigendecompose its symmetrized form for the relaxation spectrum. Extract the folding rate, check for a two-state spectral gap, and compute the heat capacity curve.

chemistry/mc_thermo|waves.title: Spectral-density-at-zero error bars for 2D Ising magnetization via Welch periodograms
chemistry/mc_thermo|waves.gist: Sample 2D Ising energy and |M| time series with single-spin Metropolis near and away from Tc. Estimate the asymptotic variance of the mean from the zero-frequency power spectral density, using Welch-averaged windowed FFT periodograms and an AR(1) fit, and compare it with block-averaging plateaus.
chemistry/mc_thermo|waves.area: Block averaging and statistical error analysis

chemistry/mc_thermo|waves.title: Henry coefficient of argon on graphite from Steele's Fourier-expanded corrugated potential
chemistry/mc_thermo|waves.gist: Build the Ar-graphite basal-plane potential as Steele's laterally averaged 10-4 term plus reciprocal-lattice Fourier corrugation terms involving modified Bessel functions K_{5/2} and K_2. Integrate the Boltzmann factor over the surface unit cell and height to obtain the Henry constant and isosteric heat versus temperature.

chemistry/mc_thermo|waves.title: Grid Henry coefficient of CO2 in a charged periodic framework via Ewald summation
chemistry/mc_thermo|waves.gist: Compute the electrostatic potential of a periodic array of framework point charges on a 3D grid by Ewald summation, with an FFT-based reciprocal part. Combine it with LJ terms to get the CO2 site energies, and average the Boltzmann factors over the grid and random orientations to obtain the Henry constant and the adsorption enthalpy.

chemistry/mc_thermo|waves.title: Fourier-accelerated hybrid Monte Carlo for a 2D lattice phi^4 field
chemistry/mc_thermo|waves.gist: Implement HMC for a scalar phi^4 lattice field using leapfrog integration in which the kinetic mass matrix is diagonal in k-space and applied through FFTs. Compare the autocorrelation times of the magnetization and the acceptance rates against standard HMC near the critical coupling.

chemistry/mc_thermo|waves.title: Leapfrog transfer-matrix analysis predicting HMC acceptance for Gaussian targets
chemistry/mc_thermo|waves.gist: Write the leapfrog map for a harmonic mode as a 2x2 ABCD transfer matrix and derive its stability (|cos theta| < 1) and the expected energy error as a function of step size and trajectory length. Predict HMC acceptance for anisotropic multivariate Gaussians and verify the predictions with simulated chains, using them to tune the optimal step size.

chemistry/mc_thermo|waves.title: Density-fluctuation structure factor of birth-death-diffusion RDME versus linear noise theory
chemistry/mc_thermo|waves.gist: Run a spatial Gillespie simulation of production, degradation and hopping of a species on a periodic 1D/2D lattice. Compute the static and dynamic structure factors of the copy-number field by FFT and compare them with the analytic linear-noise-approximation spectrum, including lattice dispersion of the discrete Laplacian.

chemistry/mc_thermo|waves.title: Green's-function reaction dynamics for diffusion-influenced bimolecular association
chemistry/mc_thermo|waves.gist: Propagate an A-B pair near a partially absorbing sphere using the exact Smoluchowski radial propagation kernel, expressed through erfc and series/Laplace expressions for the radiation boundary condition. Compute the survival probability and the time-dependent rate coefficient k(t), and compare with the Collins-Kimball analytic result.

chemistry/mc_thermo|waves.title: Frenkel-Ladd integration of 1D anharmonic chain validated by transfer-integral exact free energy
chemistry/mc_thermo|waves.gist: Compute the free energy of a periodic nearest-neighbor Morse or LJ chain by Einstein-reference thermodynamic integration, including center-of-mass constraint corrections, using MC sampling. Obtain the exact free energy from the leading eigenvalue of the discretized transfer-integral kernel to quantify the systematic and statistical errors.

chemistry/mc_thermo|waves.title: RPA spinodal of polydisperse polymer blend using Debye function structure factors
chemistry/mc_thermo|waves.gist: Compute the random-phase-approximation scattering function S(q) of a binary blend with Schulz-Zimm polydispersity using averaged Debye form factors. Locate the spinodal chi_s from S^{-1}(0)=0 and the critical composition, and compare with the Flory-Huggins mean-field free energy curvature.

chemistry/mc_thermo|waves.title: Pseudo-spectral SCFT of diblock copolymer lamellae: free energy versus period
chemistry/mc_thermo|waves.gist: Solve the 1D self-consistent field equations for an AB diblock melt by integrating the modified diffusion equation with the operator-splitting Fourier pseudo-spectral method and Anderson-mixing the fields. Minimize the free energy with respect to the lamellar period and compare the domain spacing scaling with chi N.

chemistry/mc_thermo|waves.title: Confinement free energy of ideal chains in slit via transfer-matrix and sine-series propagators
chemistry/mc_thermo|waves.gist: Compute the partition function of a lattice random-walk polymer between adsorbing or repulsive slit walls by repeated Scheutjens-Fleer transfer-matrix propagation. Compare with the continuum eigenfunction (Fourier sine series) solution to obtain the confinement free energy, segment density profile and partition coefficient versus slit width.

chemistry/mc_thermo|waves.title: Hindered-rotor partition functions in Fourier basis for combustion Gibbs minimization
chemistry/mc_thermo|waves.gist: Diagonalize the torsional Hamiltonian for a Fourier-series rotation barrier (methanol/ethane) in a free-rotor exp(im phi) basis to get the hindered-rotor partition function and its contribution to G(T). Use these Gibbs energies in an elemental-constraint Gibbs-minimization of a fuel-rich C/H/O mixture, and quantify the composition shift relative to harmonic-oscillator thermochemistry.

chemistry/mc_thermo|waves.title: GCMC methane adsorption in cylindrical pores with Tjatjopoulos hypergeometric wall potential
chemistry/mc_thermo|waves.gist: Evaluate the solid-fluid potential inside a cylindrical carbon pore using the Tjatjopoulos-Feke-Mann closed form in terms of Gauss hypergeometric functions. Run GCMC insertion/deletion moves for LJ methane to obtain isotherms for several pore radii, and fit Langmuir and BET forms to extract capacities and capillary-condensation pressures.

chemistry/mc_thermo|opt_discrete.title: NO2 dimerization in a hard-sphere solvent: nonideal reaction equilibrium
chemistry/mc_thermo|opt_discrete.gist: Simulate 2NO2 ⇌ N2O4 with reaction-ensemble MC in a hard-sphere host fluid. Compare the result with a bracketed root solve for the equilibrium extent that uses Carnahan–Starling (BMCSL mixture) fugacity coefficients, and quantify the shift away from the ideal-gas K.

chemistry/mc_thermo|opt_discrete.title: Müller-Brown transition state via string method and committor bisection
chemistry/mc_thermo|opt_discrete.gist: Find the minimum energy path on the Müller-Brown potential with the fixed-point string method. Then estimate committors at path nodes by Langevin shooting, and locate the p_B = 1/2 point by bisection along the string.
chemistry/mc_thermo|opt_discrete.area: Transition path sampling and forward flux

chemistry/mc_thermo|opt_discrete.title: Exact HP-chain enumeration: density of states and heat-capacity peak temperature
chemistry/mc_thermo|opt_discrete.gist: Enumerate all self-avoiding walks (up to symmetry) of a length-14 HP sequence on the square lattice and build the exact contact-energy density of states. Compute the folding free energy and Cv(T), and locate the melting temperature by Brent maximization of Cv.

chemistry/mc_thermo|opt_discrete.title: HP sequence design: exhaustive search for unique ground-state foldability
chemistry/mc_thermo|opt_discrete.gist: For all 2^N HP sequences of a short chain (N≈10–12), use enumerated conformations to find which sequences have a unique ground state. Rank them by energy gap and folding free-energy stability, and report the most designable structures.

chemistry/mc_thermo|opt_discrete.title: Replica-exchange temperature ladder optimization for 3D HP protein MC
chemistry/mc_thermo|opt_discrete.gist: Simulate a 3D cubic-lattice HP chain with pull/crankshaft moves under replica exchange. Iteratively adjust the temperatures until swap acceptance rates are uniform, then compute Cv(T) and the two-state folding transition.

chemistry/mc_thermo|opt_discrete.title: Stratified Bennett acceptance ratio PMF and Kramers dissociation rate of ion pair
chemistry/mc_thermo|opt_discrete.gist: Build an ion-pair PMF from fixed-distance windows connected by BAR free-energy differences, with each window solved by bracketed root-finding. Locate the contact minimum, solvent-separated minimum and barrier with Brent, and compute the Kramers dissociation rate.
chemistry/mc_thermo|opt_discrete.area: Potential of mean force for ion pairs

chemistry/mc_thermo|opt_discrete.title: Rosenbluth test-chain insertion chemical potential of lattice polymers versus Flory–Huggins
chemistry/mc_thermo|opt_discrete.gist: Insert test chains into a cubic-lattice polymer solution by Rosenbluth sequential growth to estimate the chain excess chemical potential. Compare with Flory–Huggins theory and solve its binodal by Newton iteration.

materials/semiconductors|ode.title: Hot-phonon bottleneck in GaAs electron cooling after ultrafast excitation
materials/semiconductors|ode.gist: Integrate stiff coupled ODEs for the electron temperature and the nonequilibrium LO-phonon occupation. Fröhlich emission and absorption rates drive the exchange, and LO phonons decay to acoustic modes by Klemens anharmonic decay. Compute cooling curves versus initial carrier density and the effective energy-loss time.

materials/semiconductors|ode.title: Quantum-confined Stark tuning of intersubband transitions in asymmetric step wells
materials/semiconductors|ode.gist: Use RK4 shooting with decaying boundary conditions to solve the Schrödinger equation for a stepped AlGaAs/GaAs well tilted by an applied field. Compute E21, the dipole matrix element and the oscillator strength versus bias. Fit the linear and quadratic Stark coefficients.

materials/semiconductors|ode.title: Photoconductance decay lifetime versus injection in silicon with SRH, radiative, Auger
materials/semiconductors|ode.gist: Integrate dΔn/dt = G(t) - R_SRH - R_rad - R_Auger with a stiff solver for flash-illuminated p-type Si. The Auger term uses a Kerr–Cuevas-type parametrization. Extract the effective lifetime τ_eff(Δn) = -Δn/(dΔn/dt) and identify the regimes where each mechanism limits the lifetime.

materials/semiconductors|ode.title: Non-steady-state SRH trapping kinetics in time-resolved photoluminescence decays
materials/semiconductors|ode.gist: Solve the coupled stiff ODEs for free electrons, holes and trapped-electron occupancy of a single deep level, with explicit capture and emission rates. Compute the TRPL ∝ np decay curves showing trap saturation and delayed detrapping tails. Compare the results with the steady-state SRH lifetime versus trap energy and density.

materials/semiconductors|ode.title: ABC rate-equation dynamics and modulation bandwidth of InGaN LEDs
materials/semiconductors|ode.gist: Integrate dn/dt = J/(qd) - An - Bn² - Cn³ for current steps and small sinusoidal modulation. Compute IQE droop versus current, the turn-on and turn-off transients, and the -3 dB bandwidth from the differential carrier lifetime. Validate the bandwidth against the numerically integrated frequency response.

materials/semiconductors|ode.title: Franz–Keldysh electroabsorption tail in bulk GaAs from Airy-equation integration
materials/semiconductors|ode.gist: Solve the uniform-field relative-motion ODE (Airy equation) numerically and verify the solution against scipy Airy functions. Compute the field-induced sub-gap absorption tail and the above-gap oscillations, including Lorentzian broadening. Report the electroabsorption contrast at fixed photon energy versus field.

materials/semiconductors|ode.title: Thermally stimulated current peaks of deep traps under linear heating
materials/semiconductors|ode.gist: Solve dn_T/dt = -e_n(T(t)) n_T, with or without retrapping, along linear temperature ramps T = T0 + βt using a stiff solver. Compute TSC curves for several heating rates. Recover the trap depth from the peak-shift (Hoogenstraaten-type) analysis and compare it with the input value.

materials/semiconductors|ode.title: Energy-balance velocity overshoot in silicon under a field step
materials/semiconductors|ode.gist: Integrate the momentum- and energy-balance ODEs for drift velocity and electron temperature. Both relaxation times are energy-dependent and built by Matthiessen-combining phonon and impurity scattering. Compute the transient velocity overshoot, the steady-state velocity-field curve and the effective mobility versus doping.

materials/semiconductors|ode.title: Ensemble Monte Carlo Hall mobility with RK free flights in crossed fields
materials/semiconductors|ode.gist: Simulate electrons in a nonparabolic valley undergoing acoustic and polar-optical scattering. Free-flight trajectories under crossed E and B fields are integrated with RK4 between self-scattering-sampled events. Compute the drift velocity, Hall angle, Hall factor r_H and magnetoresistance from ensemble averages.

materials/semiconductors|ode.title: Quantum-mechanical inversion-layer centroid and threshold shift in Si MOS
materials/semiconductors|ode.gist: Self-consistently solve Schrödinger (Numerov, longitudinal and transverse valleys) and Poisson equations in the triangular-like inversion well. Compute subband energies, the charge centroid, the inversion-capacitance reduction and the quantum threshold-voltage shift versus doping.

materials/semiconductors|ode.title: Zerbst deep-depletion relaxation and generation-lifetime extraction in MOS capacitors
materials/semiconductors|ode.gist: Integrate the ODE for inversion charge buildup after a deep-depletion voltage step, with SRH bulk and surface generation and charge-neutral gate-voltage partitioning. Compute the C(t) transient and build the Zerbst plot to extract the generation lifetime and surface generation velocity.
