materials/semiconductors|ode.title: Thermal rollover of a VCSEL from coupled rate and heat equations
materials/semiconductors|ode.gist: Integrate carrier, photon and lumped junction-temperature ODEs with temperature-dependent gain peak detuning, threshold, leakage and Joule heating. Compute L-I curves at several heat-sink temperatures, the rollover current and maximum power, and the thermal-impedance dependence of the results.

materials/semiconductors|pde.title: Persistent spin helix decay in Rashba-Dresselhaus 2DEG spin diffusion
materials/semiconductors|pde.gist: Discretize the coupled spin diffusion equations of a quantum well with Rashba and Dresselhaus spin-orbit fields, which include the Dyakonov-Perel relaxation and spin-precession coupling terms, on a periodic 1D grid. Time-step an initial spin grating and extract its decay rate versus grating wavevector and alpha/beta ratio, showing the long-lived helix when alpha equals beta.
materials/semiconductors|pde.area: Spin relaxation and spintronics in semiconductors

materials/semiconductors|pde.title: Second-order nonlinear susceptibility of asymmetric coupled quantum wells
materials/semiconductors|pde.gist: Use finite-difference Schrödinger solutions of an asymmetric GaAs/AlGaAs double well in an applied field to obtain the three lowest subbands and their dipole matrix elements. Compute the resonant second-harmonic chi(2) spectrum and its tuning with bias.

materials/semiconductors|pde.title: Two-pulse four-wave mixing delay dependence with local-field effects
materials/semiconductors|pde.gist: Solve the semiconductor Bloch equations on a k grid for two time-delayed pulses, and extract the 2k2-k1 signal by phase-cycling or a directional expansion. Compute the time-integrated FWM signal versus delay, including the negative-delay signal produced by Coulomb local-field terms.

materials/semiconductors|pde.title: Traveling-wave Fabry-Perot laser diode model with Langevin noise for RIN
materials/semiconductors|pde.gist: Discretize the forward and backward optical field equations coupled to a local carrier rate equation along the cavity, using a time-domain traveling-wave scheme with stochastic spontaneous-emission sources and facet reflectivities. Compute the relative intensity noise spectrum from the output power fluctuations and identify the relaxation-oscillation peak.

materials/semiconductors|pde.title: Carrier transport in separate-confinement heterostructure and laser modulation bandwidth
materials/semiconductors|pde.gist: Couple a 1D finite-difference ambipolar diffusion equation in the SCH region to rate equations for the well carriers and photons, including capture and escape. Compute the small-signal modulation response and show the transport-induced low-frequency roll-off and the reduced effective differential gain.

materials/semiconductors|pde.title: 1D FDTD reflectance of antireflection-coated silicon with dispersive Lorentz-Drude media
materials/semiconductors|pde.gist: Implement Yee-grid FDTD with auxiliary-differential-equation Lorentz and Drude polarization terms and absorbing boundaries for a Si3N4/Si stack. Compute the broadband reflectance from a pulsed simulation and validate it against the transfer-matrix result.

materials/semiconductors|pde.title: Bilayer organic solar cell photocurrent from optical interference and exciton diffusion
materials/semiconductors|pde.gist: Compute the optical generation profile in a glass/ITO/donor/acceptor/Al stack with transfer matrices, then solve the steady 1D exciton diffusion equation in the donor by finite differences, using a quenching donor/acceptor interface. Compute the short-circuit current versus donor thickness and the optimal thickness.

materials/semiconductors|pde.title: Free-carrier plasma-dispersion phase shift in a reverse-biased silicon PN modulator
materials/semiconductors|pde.gist: Solve the 2D Poisson and drift-diffusion equations for a lateral PN junction in a rib waveguide by finite differences to obtain the electron and hole distributions versus bias. Compute the Soref-Bennett index and absorption changes, overlap them with a Gaussian mode, and report V_pi*L and the loss.

materials/semiconductors|pde.title: Pump-probe Drude reflectivity transient from ambipolar plasma diffusion in GaAs
materials/semiconductors|pde.gist: Time-step the 1D ambipolar diffusion equation with surface recombination and Auger loss after an absorbed femtosecond pump, using Crank-Nicolson. Compute the depth-dependent Drude dielectric function and the transient probe reflectivity change versus delay with transfer matrices.

materials/semiconductors|pde.title: Exciton-exciton annihilation and anomalous spot broadening in monolayer TMDs
materials/semiconductors|pde.gist: Solve the nonlinear radial diffusion-reaction equation n_t = D Laplacian(n) - n/tau - gamma n^2 on a finite-volume grid, starting from a Gaussian excitation. Compute the PL decay and the mean-square displacement of the emission profile versus fluence, showing the apparent annihilation-induced acceleration of diffusion.

materials/semiconductors|pde.title: Exciton diffusion with distance-dependent Förster transfer to a 2D acceptor layer
materials/semiconductors|pde.gist: Solve the steady and transient 1D diffusion equation with a position-dependent sink k(z) = (1/tau)(R0/z)^4, which represents dipole-plane energy transfer to graphene or a monolayer acceptor, using finite differences. Compute the transfer efficiency versus film thickness and compare the result with the no-diffusion Förster limit.

materials/semiconductors|stochastic.title: Monte Carlo breakdown probability and timing jitter in single-photon avalanche diodes
materials/semiconductors|stochastic.gist: Simulate avalanche build-up in a SPAD with stochastic carrier ionization events and a current threshold. Compute breakdown probability versus excess bias, mean avalanche build-up time and timing jitter, and validate against the Oldham-McIntyre coupled breakdown-probability ODEs.

materials/semiconductors|stochastic.title: Gillespie simulation of generation-recombination noise spectrum in photoconductors
materials/semiconductors|stochastic.gist: Model the carrier number in a photoconductor as a birth-death process with optical generation and trap-assisted recombination, and sample it with the Gillespie algorithm. Estimate the current noise PSD by FFT of the trajectories and compare with the Lorentzian G-R formula 4I²τ/(N(1+ω²τ²)).

materials/semiconductors|stochastic.title: Stochastic photon arrival simulation for detector NEP and BLIP detectivity
materials/semiconductors|stochastic.gist: Generate Poisson signal and background photon streams plus Gaussian Johnson noise for an infrared photodiode, and estimate SNR versus signal power from many integration windows. Extract NEP and D*, and find the background temperature at which BLIP performance sets in.

materials/semiconductors|stochastic.title: Random-telegraph and 1/f noise from superposed trap kinetics in detectors
materials/semiconductors|stochastic.gist: Simulate many independent two-state traps with log-uniformly distributed capture and emission times using kinetic Monte Carlo. Compute the summed current PSD, verify the McWhorter 1/f slope, and determine the 1/f corner frequency relative to shot noise.

materials/semiconductors|stochastic.title: Brownian-dynamics photocarrier collection in p-i-n photodiode impulse response
materials/semiconductors|stochastic.gist: Track photogenerated electrons and holes in a p-i-n structure as drift-diffusion Langevin walkers, starting from an exponential absorption profile and including field-free diffusion tails. Compute the Ramo-theorem photocurrent impulse response, its FFT and the 3-dB bandwidth.

materials/semiconductors|stochastic.title: Random-walk Monte Carlo of diffusion-limited quantum efficiency in quasi-neutral regions
materials/semiconductors|stochastic.gist: Simulate minority carriers generated by Beer-Lambert absorption in the field-free region of a photodiode as 1D random walkers with exponential lifetime and a reflecting or recombining back surface. Compute the collection probability versus depth and the internal quantum efficiency spectrum, and compare with the analytic diffusion solution.

materials/semiconductors|stochastic.title: Monte Carlo internal photoemission yield of Schottky barrier photodiodes
materials/semiconductors|stochastic.gist: Sample hot-carrier energies and momentum directions in a metal film after sub-bandgap photon absorption, including elastic and inelastic scattering and film-boundary reflections. Compute the emission probability over the barrier and the yield spectrum, and compare with the Fowler law.

materials/semiconductors|stochastic.title: Single-valley ensemble Monte Carlo electron drift velocity in silicon
materials/semiconductors|stochastic.gist: Simulate free flights with self-scattering for electrons in a parabolic valley under acoustic and intervalley phonon scattering. Compute steady-state drift velocity and mean energy versus electric field, and extract the low-field mobility and saturation velocity.

materials/semiconductors|stochastic.title: Metropolis sampling of thermal effective-mass averages from k·p bands
materials/semiconductors|stochastic.gist: Build a 2-band Kane k·p dispersion for InSb and sample electron wavevectors from the Boltzmann distribution with Metropolis Monte Carlo. Compute the temperature-dependent average energy and the conductivity effective mass, and compare with quadrature.

materials/semiconductors|stochastic.title: Monte Carlo alloy-disorder broadening of 8-band k·p band edges
materials/semiconductors|stochastic.gist: Randomly sample local In compositions in InGaAs supercell segments and diagonalize the 8-band Kane Hamiltonian with composition-dependent parameters. Compute the distribution of band-edge energies, the Urbach-like absorption tail width and the mean effective mass.

materials/semiconductors|stochastic.title: Diffusion Monte Carlo ground state of excitons in quantum wells
materials/semiconductors|stochastic.gist: Use diffusion Monte Carlo with importance sampling to solve for an electron-hole pair in a finite GaAs/AlGaAs quantum well with anisotropic masses. Compute the exciton binding energy versus well width and compare with variational results.

materials/semiconductors|stochastic.title: Monte Carlo ray tracing of LED light extraction with surface texturing
materials/semiconductors|stochastic.gist: Trace photons emitted isotropically in a GaN LED slab with Fresnel reflection, total internal reflection, absorption and randomizing Lambertian textured surfaces. Compute light extraction efficiency versus texture fraction and absorption, and compare with the single escape-cone estimate.

materials/semiconductors|stochastic.title: Photon-recycling Monte Carlo of external quantum efficiency in LEDs
materials/semiconductors|stochastic.gist: Simulate repeated reabsorption and reemission events of photons in an active region with ABC-model radiative efficiency and finite escape probability. Compute the effective EQE versus current density, including droop and the enhancement from photon recycling.

materials/semiconductors|stochastic.title: Kinetic Monte Carlo of exciton diffusion and quenching in OLED emitters
materials/semiconductors|stochastic.gist: Simulate exciton hopping on a disordered lattice with Förster rates, radiative decay and exciton-exciton annihilation using the Gillespie algorithm. Compute internal quantum efficiency versus excitation density and the droop onset.

materials/semiconductors|stochastic.title: Gillespie photon-number statistics of a Fabry-Perot microlaser near threshold
materials/semiconductors|stochastic.gist: Model carriers and cavity photons as discrete jump processes with pumping, stimulated and spontaneous emission and mirror loss. Compute the second-order coherence g²(0) and the mean photon number versus pump, and identify a threshold for small β.

materials/semiconductors|stochastic.title: Monte Carlo thermionic-field emission across inhomogeneous Schottky barriers
materials/semiconductors|stochastic.gist: Sample patches with Gaussian-distributed barrier heights and integrate the thermionic and WKB tunneling current density over them. Compute the apparent barrier height and ideality factor versus temperature, and compare with the Werner-Güttler model.

materials/semiconductors|stochastic.title: Ensemble Monte Carlo of hot-electron injection over image-force-lowered barriers
materials/semiconductors|stochastic.gist: Simulate electron transport in a depletion region with scattering, then evaluate quantum-mechanical transmission at the image-force-lowered Schottky barrier. Compute the collected current versus bias and the effective Richardson constant reduction due to backscattering.

materials/semiconductors|quantum_ops.title: Indistinguishability of Purcell-enhanced quantum-dot single photons under pure dephasing
materials/semiconductors|quantum_ops.gist: Model a two-level quantum-dot exciton in a photonic-crystal cavity as a Lindblad system with a Purcell-enhanced radiative rate and pure dephasing. Discretize the emitted temporal mode, build the single-photon density matrix, and compute the indistinguishability Tr(ρ²) and the Hong-Ou-Mandel visibility as functions of the Purcell factor.

materials/semiconductors|quantum_ops.title: Strain-tuned fine-structure splitting and entanglement fidelity of biexciton cascade photons
materials/semiconductors|quantum_ops.gist: Model the exciton fine-structure splitting as linear in applied uniaxial strain through a deformation-potential coefficient. Build the time-averaged two-photon polarization density matrix of the XX–X cascade, including the FSS-induced phase precession and cross dephasing. Compute concurrence and fidelity to |Φ+⟩ versus strain.

materials/semiconductors|quantum_ops.title: Valley polarization of TMD photoluminescence under intervalley scattering channels
materials/semiconductors|quantum_ops.gist: Represent K/K' valley excitons as a qubit generated by σ+ excitation using massive-Dirac optical selection rules. Apply an intervalley depolarizing Kraus channel over the exciton lifetime distribution, then project onto σ± detection POVMs. Obtain the PL circular polarization degree versus the ratio of scattering rate to recombination rate.

materials/semiconductors|quantum_ops.title: Hyperfine-induced dephasing of a quantum-dot electron spin from Overhauser fluctuations
materials/semiconductors|quantum_ops.gist: Average the unitary spin precession over a Gaussian-distributed nuclear Overhauser field to obtain the effective dephasing channel. Compute the coherence decay, T2*, and the fidelity of a stored spin state, with and without an external longitudinal magnetic field.

materials/semiconductors|quantum_ops.title: Optical spin pumping initialization fidelity of a Voigt-geometry quantum-dot Λ system
materials/semiconductors|quantum_ops.gist: Model a charged quantum dot in an in-plane magnetic field as a four-level Λ system under resonant pumping, using a Lindblad master equation. Derive the per-cycle Kraus map on the ground-spin qubit and compute the spin initialization fidelity and pumping time versus laser power and field strength.

materials/semiconductors|quantum_ops.title: Photon-number POVM of a multi-pixel Geiger-mode avalanche photodiode with crosstalk
materials/semiconductors|quantum_ops.gist: Construct POVM elements for an N-pixel silicon photomultiplier that include detection efficiency (an amplitude-damping loss channel on Fock states), dark counts, and nearest-neighbor optical crosstalk. Compute click-number distributions for Fock, coherent and thermal inputs, and the fidelity of photon-number inference.

materials/semiconductors|quantum_ops.title: Sub-shot-noise photocurrent from squeezed light with imperfect photodiode quantum efficiency
materials/semiconductors|quantum_ops.gist: Model the photodiode quantum efficiency as a pure-loss channel, using Kraus operators on a truncated Fock space or a Gaussian covariance map. Propagate amplitude-squeezed light from a pump-noise-suppressed semiconductor laser through this channel and compute the photocurrent Fano factor and noise relative to the shot-noise level versus efficiency.

materials/semiconductors|quantum_ops.title: Incoherently pumped single-quantum-dot laser: thermal-to-coherent photon statistics transition
materials/semiconductors|quantum_ops.gist: Use a Jaynes-Cummings model with incoherent pump, spontaneous decay and cavity loss Lindblad operators on a dot⊗Fock tensor space. Solve for the steady state, take the partial trace over the dot, and compute the photon distribution, g2(0) and the output-versus-pump curve as functions of the β-factor.

materials/semiconductors|quantum_ops.title: Three-level QCL active-region density matrix: population inversion and gain spectrum
materials/semiconductors|quantum_ops.gist: Set up a three-subband Lindblad model with LO-phonon jump operators whose rates come from the subband energy spacings, plus coherent injection tunneling. Compute the steady-state inversion and the linear intersubband gain lineshape from the optical coherence under a weak probe, versus bias.

materials/semiconductors|quantum_ops.title: Electron-hole entanglement entropy of excitons versus quantum-well width
materials/semiconductors|quantum_ops.gist: Compute the exciton ground state on a discretized grid of electron and hole positions along the growth direction, with in-plane variational or Coulomb-averaged coupling. Form the reduced density matrix by partial trace over the hole coordinate and evaluate the Schmidt number and entanglement entropy from the strong- to weak-confinement regimes.

materials/semiconductors|quantum_ops.title: Layer pseudospin purity of interlayer excitons in TMD heterobilayers under electric field
materials/semiconductors|quantum_ops.gist: Build an exciton Hamiltonian on the layer⊗valley tensor space with interlayer hopping, Stark shift from a perpendicular field, and valley-selective σ± dipoles. Partial-trace over valley to get the layer-reduced state and compute its purity and the resulting PL polarization and oscillator strength versus field.

materials/semiconductors|quantum_ops.title: Strain-induced heavy/light-hole mixing and linear polarization of quantum-dot emission
materials/semiconductors|quantum_ops.gist: Diagonalize a 4×4 Luttinger-Kohn plus Bir-Pikus Hamiltonian with in-plane anisotropic strain to obtain mixed hole states. Compute dipole matrix elements with the conduction-band spin states and treat polarizer projections as measurement operators. Obtain the degree of linear polarization of the PL versus the shear strain component.

materials/semiconductors|quantum_ops.title: Noise-induced coherence enhancement of power in a quantum photovoltaic cell
materials/semiconductors|quantum_ops.gist: Model a Scully-type photocell with two degenerate donor excited states coupled to sunlight and phonon baths, using a Lindblad or Bloch-Redfield master equation that includes Fano interference cross terms. Compute the steady-state current, voltage and maximum power versus interference strength and compare them with the classical Shockley-Queisser-like limit.

materials/semiconductors|quantum_ops.title: Magnetic-field dependence of singlet fission via the Merrifield triplet-pair spin model
materials/semiconductors|quantum_ops.gist: Build the triplet-pair spin Hamiltonian on the 3⊗3 tensor space, including zero-field splitting tensors and Zeeman terms. Project the eigenstates onto the overall singlet to obtain singlet characters, then compute the fission yield versus magnetic field and the spin entanglement of the triplet pair after partial trace.

materials/semiconductors|quantum_ops.title: Spin-dependent SRH recombination current in silicon diodes under magnetic resonance
materials/semiconductors|quantum_ops.gist: Model an electron–defect-hole spin pair with Zeeman and microwave drive terms, and represent recombination as a singlet-projected Kraus/jump channel (Kaplan-Solomon-Mott). Compute the steady-state recombination rate and the relative change in diode recombination current on resonance versus microwave power.

materials/semiconductors|quantum_ops.title: Polariton blockade g2(0) in a semiconductor microcavity with exciton Kerr nonlinearity
materials/semiconductors|quantum_ops.gist: Derive Hopfield coefficients for the lower polariton from the exciton-photon coupling. Model the lower polariton as a driven Kerr oscillator with loss in a truncated Fock space, solve the Lindblad steady state, and compute g2(0) and the transmitted intensity versus pump detuning and the interaction-to-linewidth ratio.

materials/semiconductors|quantum_ops.title: Quantum detector tomography of an InGaAs/InP single-photon avalanche diode
materials/semiconductors|quantum_ops.gist: Simulate click statistics for a set of attenuated coherent probe states on an on/off SPAD with dark counts and saturation. Reconstruct the diagonal POVM in the Fock basis by constrained least squares with positivity and completeness constraints. Report the detection efficiency, dark-count probability, and fidelity of the reconstructed POVM to the true one.

materials/semiconductors|waves.title: Kronig-Penney minibands in GaAs/AlGaAs superlattice with BenDaniel-Duke transfer matrices
materials/semiconductors|waves.gist: Build 2x2 transfer matrices for one period of a GaAs/AlxGa1-xAs superlattice with mass-discontinuity boundary conditions. Solve cos(qd) = Tr(M)/2 for the Bloch dispersion, then extract miniband edges, widths and the miniband-bottom effective mass versus barrier thickness.

materials/semiconductors|waves.title: Bloch oscillations and Wannier-Stark ladder in a biased superlattice via split-step Fourier
materials/semiconductors|waves.gist: Propagate an electron wavepacket in a 1D superlattice potential plus a uniform field using the split-step FFT method. Compute the Bloch period from the FFT of the mean position and compare it with eFd/h. Recover the Wannier-Stark ladder spacing from the autocorrelation spectrum.

materials/semiconductors|waves.title: Finite-well subbands via plane-wave expansion with position-dependent effective mass
materials/semiconductors|waves.gist: Expand the BenDaniel-Duke Hamiltonian for a finite square GaAs/AlGaAs well in a periodic plane-wave (Fourier) basis, with the mass profile Fourier-transformed by FFT. Diagonalize to get subband energies and wavefunctions. Benchmark against the transcendental finite-well solution and test convergence with basis size.

materials/semiconductors|waves.title: Quantum-confined Stark shift in InGaN/GaN wells from polarization fields using Airy transfer matrices
materials/semiconductors|waves.gist: Compute the spontaneous and piezoelectric polarization difference for strained InxGa1-xN on GaN, and from it the built-in field in a single well. Solve the tilted-well subbands with Airy-function (Ai, Bi) transfer matrices. Report the emission energy redshift and electron-hole overlap versus well width and In content.

materials/semiconductors|waves.title: FFT Poisson solver for polarization-charge band profiles in AlGaN/GaN superlattices
materials/semiconductors|waves.gist: Place interface polarization sheet charges, set by Al fraction and strain, on a periodic AlGaN/GaN superlattice. Solve Poisson's equation spectrally with FFTs under a zero-average-field periodic condition. Return the conduction-band profile, layer fields and the Fourier spectrum of the potential.

materials/semiconductors|waves.title: Photoconductor impulse response from Fourier-space drift-diffusion-recombination Green's function
materials/semiconductors|waves.gist: Solve the 1D continuity equation for a photogenerated carrier pulse, including drift, diffusion and lifetime, analytically in k-space and invert numerically by FFT. Integrate the collected current to get the impulse response. Compute photoconductive gain τ/τ_tr, the transfer function and the 3 dB bandwidth versus bias.

materials/semiconductors|waves.title: Terahertz emission spectrum of a LT-GaAs photoconductive antenna
materials/semiconductors|waves.gist: Model the transient photocurrent driven by a femtosecond optical pulse, using sub-picosecond carrier trapping and Drude momentum relaxation integrated with ODEs. Take the far field as E ∝ dJ/dt. Obtain the radiated THz spectrum, peak frequency and bandwidth by FFT as functions of trapping time.

materials/semiconductors|waves.title: Shot-noise PSD from simulated Poisson photocurrent pulses and detector NEP
materials/semiconductors|waves.gist: Generate a photodiode current as Poisson-arriving carrier pulses shaped by a finite transit-time response. Estimate the noise power spectral density with Welch FFT periodograms and verify the 2qI plateau and its high-frequency roll-off. Combine with Johnson noise to compute NEP and specific detectivity D*.

materials/semiconductors|waves.title: Infrared plasma-edge reflectance of doped GaAs epilayers via thin-film transfer matrices
materials/semiconductors|waves.gist: Construct the Drude-Lorentz dielectric function of an n-doped GaAs layer on a semi-insulating substrate, including the plasma frequency and phonon terms. Compute normal-incidence reflectance with the characteristic (Abeles) matrix method. Fit the plasma minimum to extract carrier density and mobility.

materials/semiconductors|waves.title: Carrier-induced refractive index change in silicon via FFT Kramers-Kronig transform
materials/semiconductors|waves.gist: Build the change in absorption spectrum from injected carriers in Si, combining Drude free-carrier absorption with band-filling of the indirect edge. Compute Δn with a Hilbert-transform Kramers-Kronig relation implemented by FFT. Compare with the Soref-Bennett empirical fits at 1.31 and 1.55 μm.

materials/semiconductors|waves.title: Broadened 3D Elliott absorption and dispersive index via FFT convolution and Kramers-Kronig
materials/semiconductors|waves.gist: Evaluate the bulk Elliott formula, with the discrete hydrogenic exciton series plus the Sommerfeld-enhanced continuum, for GaAs. Broaden it by FFT convolution with a Lorentzian or Voigt kernel. Use a Hilbert transform to obtain the excitonic refractive-index dispersion near the gap.

materials/semiconductors|waves.title: Harmonic distortion of a Shockley diode via modified Bessel function Fourier expansion
materials/semiconductors|waves.gist: For a sinusoidal voltage superposed on a DC bias, expand exp(v/nV_T) as a Fourier series whose harmonic amplitudes are modified Bessel functions I_k. Verify the result against an FFT of the time-domain current with series resistance solved by Newton iteration. Report harmonic distortion versus drive amplitude and ideality factor.

materials/semiconductors|waves.title: Frequency-dependent diffusion admittance of a pn junction with complex diffusion length
materials/semiconductors|waves.gist: Solve the small-signal minority-carrier diffusion equation in the frequency domain, with complex diffusion length L/√(1+iωτ), for a long-base and a short-base diode. Compute the complex admittance, the diffusion conductance and the capacitance versus frequency. Compare these with the quasi-static Shockley diffusion capacitance.

materials/structure|ode.title: Kink-pair saddle configuration and activation enthalpy for screw dislocation glide
materials/structure|ode.gist: Solve the boundary-value problem Γ u'' = V_P'(u) − τb for a dislocation line in a Peierls potential using shooting with RK integration. This gives the critical bulged kink-pair shape at each stress. Compute the activation enthalpy versus stress and fit the Kocks law exponents p and q.

materials/structure|ode.title: Dynamic Hertzian impact of a nanosphere: contact time and peak force
materials/structure|ode.gist: Integrate m δ'' = −(4/3) E* √R δ^{3/2} for a sphere striking an elastic half-space using an adaptive RK solver with a contact-end event. Compute the contact duration, maximum indentation and peak force versus impact velocity. Verify the analytic v^{-1/5} scaling of contact time.

materials/structure|ode.title: Viscoelastic creep during nanoindentation hold and its bias on Oliver-Pharr modulus
materials/structure|ode.gist: Model spherical indentation of a standard-linear-solid material with a hereditary Hertz ODE. Integrate it through load ramp, hold and unload segments. Then apply power-law Oliver-Pharr fitting to the unloading curve to quantify the error in the extracted modulus as a function of hold time.

materials/structure|ode.title: Zero-temperature string method for adatom hop on a corrugated surface potential
materials/structure|ode.gist: Evolve a discretized string under the perpendicular gradient-flow ODE with periodic arc-length reparametrization on a 2D periodic adatom-surface potential with two inequivalent sites. Obtain the minimum energy path and migration barrier, then the harmonic TST hop rate from the Hessians at the minimum and the saddle.
materials/structure|ode.area: Diffusion pathways and nudged elastic band

materials/structure|ode.title: Intrinsic reaction coordinate from a vacancy-migration saddle in a model potential
materials/structure|ode.gist: Locate the saddle of a 2D LEPS-plus-harmonic model of vacancy-assisted migration by Newton iteration. Integrate the steepest-descent IRC ODE dx/ds = −∇V/|∇V| with RK45 from both sides of the unstable eigenvector. Report the path length, energy profile along s, and curvature at the saddle.
materials/structure|ode.area: Diffusion pathways and nudged elastic band

materials/structure|ode.title: Differential effective medium moduli of porous and cracked ceramics
materials/structure|ode.gist: Integrate the coupled differential-scheme ODEs dK/dφ and dG/dφ for spherical pores and for penny-shaped cracks, using Eshelby polarization factors. Compute effective bulk and shear moduli versus porosity and crack density. Compare with Mori-Tanaka and Hashin-Shtrikman bounds.

materials/structure|ode.title: Effective bulk modulus of particles with a radially graded interphase
materials/structure|ode.gist: Solve the radial Lamé ODE with r-dependent Young's modulus in a functionally graded shell around a spherical particle using shooting or solve_bvp. Extract an equivalent homogeneous particle bulk modulus and insert it into Mori-Tanaka to obtain the composite effective bulk modulus.

materials/structure|ode.title: Gap labeling of periodic approximants of a quasiperiodic Fibonacci potential
materials/structure|ode.gist: For rational approximants F_{n-1}/F_n of the Fibonacci chain, compute Bloch band edges by Numerov shooting with periodic and antiperiodic boundary conditions. Evaluate the integrated density of states in each gap and verify it matches labels of the form p + qτ mod 1.

materials/structure|ode.title: Anomalous wave-packet spreading in a Fibonacci mass-spring chain
materials/structure|ode.gist: Integrate Newton's equations for a harmonic chain whose masses follow the Fibonacci sequence, using symplectic velocity Verlet from a localized initial displacement. Compute the time-dependent mean-square energy spread and fit the anomalous transport exponent, comparing with the periodic chain.

materials/structure|ode.title: Cooling-rate dependence of a 2D binary Lennard-Jones glass quenched by MD
materials/structure|ode.gist: Integrate the Kob-Andersen-type 2D binary LJ mixture with velocity Verlet and a Berendsen or Langevin thermostat ramp at several cooling rates. Minimize the final configurations, then compute the inherent-structure energy, partial radial distribution functions and static structure factor S(k).

materials/structure|ode.title: Fitting Morse parameters to Numerov-computed vibrational levels and lattice constant
materials/structure|ode.gist: Compute vibrational eigenvalues of a Morse pair potential by Numerov shooting with bisection. Fit the Morse D, a and r0 by least squares against reference dimer level spacings together with an fcc pair-sum lattice constant. Report the Jacobian-based parameter sensitivity and correlation matrix.

materials/structure|ode.title: Tracking lattice-invariant shears by Niggli reduction along an integrated deformation path
materials/structure|ode.gist: Integrate the deformation-gradient ODE dF/dt = L F for constant simple-shear velocity gradient acting on a 2D or 3D lattice. Niggli-reduce the deformed metric at every step and detect when the reduced cell returns to the original lattice, giving the lattice-invariant shear magnitude. Also identify the Bravais types encountered along the path.

materials/structure|ode.title: Euler buckling and post-buckling of a compressed graphene nanoribbon elastica
materials/structure|ode.gist: Solve the nonlinear elastica boundary-value problem θ'' + (P/D) sin θ = 0 for a clamped graphene ribbon of bending rigidity D using shooting with RK integration. Compute the critical buckling strain and the post-buckling amplitude versus end shortening. Compare with the linearized eigenvalue.
materials/structure|ode.area: Defects and mechanical properties of 2D materials

materials/structure|pde.title: Spectral gradient-flow solution of the Peierls-Nabarro equation and Peierls stress
materials/structure|pde.gist: Find the misfit displacement of an edge dislocation with a sinusoidal gamma surface. Relax the PN integro-differential equation in time, evaluating the Hilbert-transform elastic term by FFT on a periodic grid. Extract the core width, then the Peierls stress from the lattice-sum misfit energy as a function of dislocation position.

materials/structure|pde.title: Two-component Peierls-Nabarro model of dissociated dislocation in fcc aluminium
materials/structure|pde.gist: Use a coupled edge/screw displacement PN model with a generalized stacking fault surface (a Fourier fit along <112>) to compute Shockley partial splitting. Relax both components on a 1D FFT grid with explicit pseudo-time stepping and compare the result with the Eshelby partial-separation formula.

materials/structure|pde.title: Phase-field dislocation loop expansion under applied shear with FFT elasticity
materials/structure|pde.gist: Evolve a phase-field slip variable on a 2D glide-plane grid with a time-dependent Ginzburg-Landau equation. Combine a periodic crystalline energy with an FFT-computed elastic interaction kernel. Compute the critical stress for loop expansion versus initial radius and compare it with line-tension theory.

materials/structure|pde.title: Relativistic contraction of a moving screw dislocation in sine-Gordon continuum
materials/structure|pde.gist: Integrate the 1D sine-Gordon equation for a screw-dislocation kink with explicit leapfrog finite differences and absorbing boundaries. Measure the core width and energy versus kink velocity, and verify the Lorentz-contraction scaling relative to the shear wave speed.

materials/structure|pde.title: Multislice HRTEM image simulation of silicon along [110]
materials/structure|pde.gist: Build projected atomic potentials from Gaussian scattering-factor parameterizations and slice the Si[110] cell. Propagate a plane wave through the slices with an FFT Fresnel propagator, then apply an objective-lens contrast transfer function with defocus and Cs. Compute the image contrast of the dumbbells versus thickness and defocus.

materials/structure|pde.title: Thickness-dependent Bragg beam intensities in SrTiO3 [001] via multislice
materials/structure|pde.gist: Propagate a 200 kV plane wave through a SrTiO3 [001] supercell using the multislice method with band-limited FFT propagators. Track the intensities of the direct and low-order beams versus thickness, and extract the extinction distance from the Pendellösung oscillation for comparison with two-beam theory.

materials/structure|pde.title: CBED disk pattern of MgO by multislice with convergent probe
materials/structure|pde.gist: Form an aberration-free convergent probe with a finite aperture semi-angle and propagate it by FFT multislice through an MgO [001] crystal. Compute the CBED pattern, then quantify the intensity variation across the 200 disk as a function of specimen thickness.

materials/structure|pde.title: Takagi-Taupin X-ray section topograph of a bent crystal in Laue geometry
materials/structure|pde.gist: Solve the Takagi-Taupin equations for a Si 220 Laue-case reflection on a characteristic-coordinate finite-difference grid, for a crystal with uniform strain-gradient bending. Compute the exit-face diffracted intensity profile and show how the Pendellösung fringes change with curvature.

materials/structure|pde.title: Föppl-von Kármán nanoindentation of a suspended graphene membrane
materials/structure|pde.gist: Solve the axisymmetric nonlinear membrane/plate equations for a clamped circular graphene sheet under a point load, using finite differences with Newton iteration. Compute the force-deflection curve and recover the 2D Young's modulus and pretension by fitting the cubic indentation law.

materials/structure|pde.title: Phase-field crystal grain boundary energy versus misorientation
materials/structure|pde.gist: Construct bicrystals of two rotated hexagonal PFC lattices in a periodic cell and relax them with a semi-implicit spectral time integrator. Compute the excess free energy per boundary length versus tilt angle and fit the low-angle Read-Shockley form.

materials/structure|pde.title: Crank-Nicolson wavepacket dynamics on the graphene tight-binding lattice
materials/structure|pde.gist: Propagate a Gaussian electron wavepacket on a finite nearest-neighbour honeycomb lattice with sparse Crank-Nicolson time stepping. Measure the group velocity versus central wavevector direction to reveal trigonal warping, and compare it with the analytic band gradient.

materials/structure|pde.title: Klein tunneling through graphene p-n barrier by split-step Dirac propagation
materials/structure|pde.gist: Solve the 2D massless Dirac equation for a wavepacket incident on an electrostatic barrier using a split-operator Fourier method. Compute the transmission probability versus incidence angle and compare it with the analytic Katsnelson formula, including perfect normal transmission.

materials/structure|pde.title: Effective adatom diffusivity from Smoluchowski equation versus transition-state hop rate
materials/structure|pde.gist: Solve the steady 2D Smoluchowski (overdamped Fokker-Planck) cell problem on a periodic square-lattice surface potential with finite volumes. Obtain the effective diffusion coefficient versus temperature and compare it with the Kramers/TST hop-rate prediction λ²Γ/4, where the barrier comes from the saddle-point energy.
materials/structure|pde.area: Diffusion pathways and nudged elastic band

materials/structure|pde.title: Cottrell atmosphere formation around an edge dislocation by drift-diffusion
materials/structure|pde.gist: Solve the solute drift-diffusion equation on a 2D finite-volume grid, with drift from the hydrostatic-stress interaction energy of an edge dislocation, using implicit time stepping. Compute the time evolution of segregated solute and compare the early-time result with the Cottrell-Bilby t^(2/3) law.
materials/structure|pde.area: Diffusion pathways and nudged elastic band

materials/structure|pde.title: Fisher-model grain boundary diffusion profile and Whipple-LeClaire analysis
materials/structure|pde.gist: Solve coupled bulk and thin grain-boundary slab diffusion on a 2D finite-difference grid with implicit time stepping. Compute the layer-averaged concentration depth profile, then extract the product sδD_gb from the slope of ln c versus y^(6/5) and compare it with the input.
materials/structure|pde.area: Diffusion pathways and nudged elastic band

materials/structure|pde.title: Tortuosity of a voxelized porous framework by finite-volume Laplace solve
materials/structure|pde.gist: Voxelize a porous crystal (for example, a cubic array of overlapping atomic spheres) into accessible and blocked cells for a given probe radius. Solve the Laplace equation for steady diffusion with finite volumes and a sparse linear solver. Compute the void fraction, effective diffusivity and tortuosity factor versus probe size.

materials/structure|stochastic.title: Kinetic Monte Carlo adatom diffusion on fcc(100) with NEB-derived hop barriers
materials/structure|stochastic.gist: Find the hop and exchange minimum energy paths of a Cu adatom on a rigid fcc(100) pair-potential slab with NEB. Convert the barriers to harmonic-TST rates. Run rejection-free kMC to obtain the tracer diffusion coefficient and its Arrhenius parameters from the mean-squared displacement.
materials/structure|stochastic.area: Diffusion pathways and nudged elastic band

materials/structure|stochastic.title: Langevin escape over a sinusoidal Peierls barrier versus Kramers and TST rates
materials/structure|stochastic.gist: Integrate underdamped Langevin dynamics with BAOAB for a particle in a 1D periodic substrate potential. Measure hop rates and the diffusion coefficient as a function of friction, and compare with transition state theory and Kramers' low- and high-friction rate formulas.
materials/structure|stochastic.area: Diffusion pathways and nudged elastic band

materials/structure|stochastic.title: Kink-pair nucleation kinetic Monte Carlo of screw dislocation glide
materials/structure|stochastic.gist: Model a screw dislocation line as a chain of segments on Peierls valleys. Assign stress-dependent kink-pair nucleation and kink migration rates using a line-tension enthalpy, evolve with Gillespie kMC, and compute dislocation velocity versus applied stress and temperature.
materials/structure|stochastic.area: Diffusion pathways and nudged elastic band

materials/structure|stochastic.title: Monte Carlo electron trajectories for backscatter coefficient in bulk targets
materials/structure|stochastic.gist: Simulate keV electron trajectories in C, Al, Cu and Au using screened-Rutherford elastic scattering and the Joy-Luo continuous-slowing-down energy loss. Tally the backscatter coefficient and penetration depth distribution as functions of atomic number and beam energy.

materials/structure|stochastic.title: Superlattice reflection intensity across Cu3Au order-disorder transition via Kawasaki Monte Carlo
materials/structure|stochastic.gist: Run nearest-neighbor Ising-type Kawasaki exchange MC of an A3B fcc alloy. Compute the L1₂ long-range order parameter and the (100) superlattice structure-factor intensity versus temperature, and locate the first-order transition temperature from the energy histogram.

materials/structure|stochastic.title: Warren-Cowley short-range order and diffuse scattering in a disordered bcc alloy
materials/structure|stochastic.gist: Equilibrate a 50:50 bcc alloy with nearest- and next-nearest-neighbor pair interactions above its ordering temperature using Metropolis swaps. Compute Warren-Cowley parameters for the first few shells and the resulting diffuse intensity map in the (hk0) reciprocal plane.

materials/structure|stochastic.title: WWW bond-switching Monte Carlo of amorphous graphene and ring statistics
materials/structure|stochastic.gist: Starting from a periodic honeycomb lattice, apply Wooten-Winer-Weaire Stone-Wales bond transpositions accepted by Metropolis with a Keating-type energy. Compute the resulting distribution of 5-, 6-, 7- and 8-membered primitive rings and bond-angle deviations.

materials/structure|stochastic.title: Fitting radial symmetry-function linear potential to Metropolis-sampled Stillinger-Weber silicon
materials/structure|stochastic.gist: Generate diamond-Si configurations at several temperatures by Metropolis MC with the Stillinger-Weber potential. Compute Behler G2/G4 atom-centered symmetry functions, and fit a ridge-regression per-atom energy model. Report train and test energy RMSE and transferability to a higher temperature.

materials/structure|stochastic.title: Lindemann melting of a 2D Lennard-Jones triangular crystal with BAOAB Langevin dynamics
materials/structure|stochastic.gist: Thermostat a periodic 2D LJ triangular crystal with BAOAB Langevin integration over a temperature ramp. Compute the Lindemann ratio, the bond-orientational order |ψ6| and the MSD, and locate the melting temperature where the Lindemann parameter diverges.

materials/structure|stochastic.title: Path-integral Monte Carlo zero-point displacement in a quantum anharmonic Einstein crystal
materials/structure|stochastic.gist: Simulate a single atom in a quartic-anharmonic Einstein cage with discretized imaginary-time PIMC, using staging or normal-mode moves. Compute <u²> and the Debye-Waller factor versus temperature and Trotter number, and compare with the exact harmonic quantum limit and classical equipartition.

materials/structure|stochastic.title: Mori-Tanaka stiffness of randomly misoriented spheroidal fibre composites via orientation Monte Carlo
materials/structure|stochastic.gist: Compute Eshelby tensors for prolate spheroidal inclusions in an isotropic matrix. Average the rotated dilute strain-concentration tensors over Monte Carlo sampled 3D-random and planar-random orientations, and assemble the Mori-Tanaka effective stiffness versus aspect ratio and volume fraction.

materials/structure|stochastic.title: Commensurate-incommensurate transition of a Frenkel-Kontorova epitaxial monolayer by Metropolis MC
materials/structure|stochastic.gist: Model an adsorbed atomic chain or 2D overlayer as harmonically coupled atoms on a sinusoidal substrate with lattice misfit. Use Metropolis sampling to compute the discommensuration (soliton) density, mean registry and structure factor versus misfit and temperature near the critical misfit.

materials/structure|waves.title: Polychromatic transmission Laue pattern simulation with ray-traced detector spots
materials/structure|waves.gist: For a cubic crystal (e.g., Si) at a given orientation matrix U, find every reflection (hkl) whose Bragg energy lies inside a white-beam band. Ray-trace each diffracted beam to a flat detector and weight its intensity by |F_hkl|^2 times the source spectrum, merging harmonic overlaps nh,nk,nl into a single spot.

materials/structure|waves.title: Warren-Averbach separation of size and strain from FFT peak Fourier coefficients
materials/structure|waves.gist: Synthesize two orders of an X-ray line profile (e.g., 111/222 of Ni) from a lognormal column-length distribution and a Gaussian strain distribution. Compute the Fourier coefficients A(L) by FFT, then separate ln A_S(L) and <ε_L^2> through the order dependence and extract the area-weighted size.

materials/structure|waves.title: Anisotropic Williamson-Hall with dislocation contrast factors for cubic crystals
materials/structure|waves.gist: Compute average dislocation contrast factors C_hkl = C_h00(1 - qH^2) for edge and screw dislocations in an fcc metal from its elastic constants. Fit the modified Williamson-Hall relation ΔK vs K C^{1/2} to simulated breadths to obtain dislocation density and the edge/screw fraction.

materials/structure|waves.title: FFT spectral solver for a periodic dislocation dipole stress field
materials/structure|waves.gist: Represent an edge dislocation dipole in a periodic isotropic cell as a plastic eigenstrain on the slip plane. Solve the Mura/Khachaturyan elastic problem in Fourier space with the isotropic Green tensor to get σ(x), compare it with the analytic Volterra field, and compute the Peach-Koehler force on each dislocation.

materials/structure|waves.title: Wigner-D harmonic ODF of a Goss texture and recalculated pole figure
materials/structure|waves.gist: Expand a Gaussian Goss orientation component on SO(3) in symmetrized generalized spherical harmonics, with Wigner-D coefficients C_l^{mn} up to l=16, using cubic crystal and orthorhombic sample symmetry. Recalculate the {100} and {111} pole figures from the harmonic series and compute the texture index.

materials/structure|waves.title: Strained graphene tight-binding bands and Dirac point shift under uniaxial strain
materials/structure|waves.gist: Apply a uniaxial strain along zigzag or armchair to graphene and modify the three hoppings with t_i = t exp(-β(d_i/a - 1)). Build the Bloch Hamiltonian, locate the shifted Dirac point by root finding of f(k)=0, and compute the gap-opening threshold strain.

materials/structure|waves.title: Pseudo-magnetic field of a Gaussian graphene bump via spectral differentiation
materials/structure|waves.gist: Define an out-of-plane Gaussian height profile h(x,y) on a periodic grid. Compute the strain u_ij = ½(∂_i h ∂_j h) and the gauge field A ∝ (u_xx - u_yy, -2u_xy) using FFT derivatives, then evaluate B = ∂_x A_y - ∂_y A_x and its threefold-symmetric peak magnitude.

materials/structure|waves.title: Structure factor of a random close packed sphere configuration via periodic Fourier sums
materials/structure|waves.gist: Generate a jammed monodisperse packing at φ≈0.64 with a Lubachevsky-Stillinger or force-biased algorithm in a periodic box. Compute S(q) directly from ρ_q over allowed reciprocal vectors, sine-transform it back to g(r) with a Lorch window, and report the first-peak position and split second peak.

materials/structure|waves.title: Pair distribution function of a continuous random network silicon model from S(q)
materials/structure|waves.gist: Build a periodic Wooten-Winer-Weaire a-Si network and compute its total S(q) via the Debye sum with periodic minimum images. Fourier transform it to the reduced PDF G(r), including termination-ripple analysis at finite q_max, and extract the coordination number and bond-angle-related second-shell distance.

materials/structure|waves.title: Ewald-summation Madelung constants computed on Niggli-reduced cells
materials/structure|waves.gist: Reduce arbitrarily skewed input cells of ionic structures (NaCl, CsCl, rutile) with the Niggli algorithm. Evaluate the Madelung energy by Ewald summation, splitting it into real-space erfc and reciprocal-space Gaussian sums, and show the result is invariant to the cell choice while convergence improves after reduction.

materials/structure|waves.title: Many-beam Bloch-wave thickness profiles for a systematic row in silicon TEM
materials/structure|waves.gist: Build the structure matrix A_gh from Doyle-Turner electron structure factors for the 0, ±g, ±2g... beams of Si(220) at 200 kV and diagonalize it to get Bloch wave eigenvectors. Compute beam intensities versus thickness and the extinction distance relative to the two-beam value.

materials/structure|waves.title: Takagi-Taupin rocking curves of a bent or strain-graded X-ray crystal
materials/structure|waves.gist: Integrate the Takagi-Taupin equations for the incident and diffracted amplitudes through depth in a Bragg-case Si crystal with a linear lattice-parameter gradient. Compute the reflectivity rocking curve and compare the unstrained limit with the analytic Darwin-Prins curve.

materials/structure|waves.title: CBED Kossel-Möllenstedt fringe analysis for TEM specimen thickness
materials/structure|waves.gist: Use two-beam dynamical theory to compute the intensity across a convergent-beam diffraction disk, with minima at s_i^2 + 1/ξ_g^2 = n_i^2/t^2. Locate the fringe minima numerically and fit the linear plot (s_i/n_i)^2 vs 1/n_i^2 to recover thickness and extinction distance.

materials/structure|waves.title: Phonon focusing caustics from Christoffel group-velocity ray tracing in cubic crystals
materials/structure|waves.gist: Solve the Christoffel equation over a dense sphere of wave normals for Ge or Si and compute group velocities from eigenvalue gradients. Ray-trace the energy flux onto a detector plane and histogram it to obtain the phonon focusing pattern and its caustic directions for the slow transverse mode.

materials/structure|waves.title: Rayleigh surface acoustic wave velocity on anisotropic cubic surfaces via Stroh formalism
materials/structure|waves.gist: Construct the Stroh sextic eigenproblem for a cubic crystal surface such as Cu(001) along [100] and [110]. Select the decaying partial waves and find the Rayleigh velocity as the root of the traction-free boundary determinant, then compare it with the bulk transverse velocity.

biology/quant_bio|pde.title: Telegrapher equation for persistent random walk and MSD crossover
biology/quant_bio|pde.gist: Solve the 1D telegrapher (Goldstein-Kac) equation for a run-and-tumble cell using a second-order leapfrog finite-difference scheme. Compute the mean-squared displacement from the density moments, locate the ballistic-to-diffusive crossover time, and compare it with the analytic MSD 2v²τ(t − τ(1 − e^{−t/τ})).
biology/quant_bio|pde.area: Cell motility and random walk statistics

biology/quant_bio|pde.title: Keller-Segel chemotactic collapse threshold in a 2D radially symmetric domain
biology/quant_bio|pde.gist: Solve the parabolic-elliptic Keller-Segel model with a positivity-preserving upwind finite-volume scheme in radial coordinates. Detect finite-time concentration by tracking the peak density. Determine numerically the critical total cell mass separating dispersal from collapse, and compare it with 8π.
biology/quant_bio|pde.area: Cell motility and random walk statistics

biology/quant_bio|pde.title: Unstirred chemostat washout threshold via principal eigenvalue
biology/quant_bio|pde.gist: Model a diffusive (unstirred) chemostat: Monod consumer and substrate obey reaction-diffusion equations with Robin inflow/outflow boundary conditions. Compute the critical washout parameter as the zero crossing of the principal eigenvalue of the finite-difference linearized operator at the washout state. Verify persistence or extinction with implicit-explicit (IMEX) time stepping.

biology/quant_bio|pde.title: Monod substrate penetration and effectiveness factor in a biofilm
biology/quant_bio|pde.gist: Solve the steady nonlinear diffusion-reaction boundary-value problem for substrate in a planar biofilm with Monod uptake. Use finite differences with Newton iteration, a no-flux substratum, and a diffusive boundary layer at the surface. Compute the effectiveness factor and penetration depth versus Thiele modulus, and compare with the zero- and first-order analytic limits.

biology/quant_bio|pde.title: Spatial Levins patch-occupancy invasion front speed
biology/quant_bio|pde.gist: Integrate the reaction-diffusion Levins model p_t = D p_xx + c p(1−p) − e p with a method-of-lines finite-difference scheme and a stiff integrator. Measure the asymptotic speed of the colonization front from level-set crossings. Compare it with the Fisher-KPP prediction 2√(D(c−e)) as the extinction rate approaches the colonization rate.

biology/quant_bio|pde.title: Critical patch size for persistence in a hostile-matrix habitat
biology/quant_bio|pde.gist: Compute the principal eigenvalue of D∂²ₓ + r(x) on a bounded habitat patch with Robin boundary conditions representing matrix mortality, using finite differences. Find the critical patch length by root-finding on the eigenvalue. Recover the KISS result L* = π√(D/r) in the Dirichlet limit, and test the result with direct time integration.

biology/quant_bio|pde.title: Sinko-Streifer size-structured PDE versus discretized integral projection model
biology/quant_bio|pde.gist: Solve a continuous-time size-structured population PDE (von Bertalanffy growth, size-dependent survival and fecundity) with a conservative finite-volume upwind scheme. Compute the asymptotic growth rate and stable size distribution. Compare them with the dominant eigenvalue and eigenvector of a midpoint-rule integral projection model built from the same vital rates, including mesh convergence.
biology/quant_bio|pde.area: Integral projection models for size structure

biology/quant_bio|pde.title: Drug penetration into a tumor spheroid driven by two-compartment PK
biology/quant_bio|pde.gist: Couple a two-compartment plasma pharmacokinetic model, solved by matrix exponential, to the radial diffusion equation with linear binding in a spherical tumor spheroid. Use Crank-Nicolson with a regularized r = 0 condition. Compute the time-concentration AUC at the spheroid center versus the surface, and the dose interval needed to keep the core above a threshold.

biology/quant_bio|pde.title: Transdermal drug permeation lag time through the stratum corneum
biology/quant_bio|pde.gist: Solve the 1D diffusion equation across a skin membrane with partitioning at the donor interface and a sink receptor, using Crank-Nicolson. Compute the cumulative permeated amount. Extract the steady flux and lag time from the linear asymptote, and compare the lag time with L²/(6D), including a finite-dose depletion variant.

biology/quant_bio|pde.title: Turing patterns in the Brusselator mass-action network by pseudo-spectral ETD
biology/quant_bio|pde.gist: Derive the Turing instability region of the reaction-diffusion Brusselator from linear stability of its mass-action steady state. Simulate the 2D system with a Fourier pseudo-spectral exponential time differencing (ETDRK4) scheme on a periodic domain. Compare the dominant wavenumber of the emergent pattern with the fastest-growing linear mode.

biology/quant_bio|pde.title: Wave-pinning cell polarity with mass conservation in a bistable reaction network
biology/quant_bio|pde.gist: Simulate the Mori wave-pinning model: active and inactive GTPase forms with unequal diffusivities, bistable mass-action-type kinetics, and no-flux boundaries. Use a conservative finite-volume method-of-lines scheme that preserves total mass to machine precision. Compute the pinned front position, and compare it with the Maxwell equal-area condition determined by the conserved total.

biology/quant_bio|waves.title: Harmonic balance limit cycle of the Goodwin oscillator
biology/quant_bio|waves.gist: Expand the Goodwin negative-feedback loop's periodic solution in a truncated Fourier series. Solve the Fourier-Galerkin residual equations for the coefficients and the unknown frequency, using FFT-based evaluation of the Hill nonlinearity at collocation points, and validate period and amplitude against direct ODE integration.

biology/quant_bio|waves.title: Lomb-Scargle detection of circadian genes in irregularly sampled expression data
biology/quant_bio|waves.gist: Generate unevenly sampled noisy transcript time series from a mixture of rhythmic and arrhythmic genes. Compute Lomb-Scargle periodograms over 18-30 h periods, assign false-alarm probabilities, and apply Benjamini-Hochberg control to classify circadian genes and estimate their periods and phases.

biology/quant_bio|waves.title: Noise-induced spectral peak in delayed negative autoregulation
biology/quant_bio|waves.gist: Simulate a protein that represses its own production with a fixed transcriptional delay, using a delay-Gillespie algorithm. Compute the autocorrelation and power spectrum via FFT, and compare the spectral peak position with the linear-noise prediction S(ω)=|1/(iω+γ+k e^{-iωτ})|²·D below the delay-induced Hopf bifurcation.

biology/quant_bio|waves.title: Multi-copy gene protein distribution via FFT convolution of FSP marginals
biology/quant_bio|waves.gist: Solve a truncated chemical master equation for single-copy protein production with a sparse stationary solver. Obtain the total protein distribution from N independent gene copies by raising the zero-padded FFT of the single-copy distribution to the N-th power. Report the Fano factor and the tail probabilities.
biology/quant_bio|waves.area: Chemical master equation finite state projection

biology/quant_bio|waves.title: Molecular motor drift and diffusion from Fourier-Bloch circulant generator
biology/quant_bio|waves.gist: Model a processive motor as a periodic N-state Markov jump chain on a lattice. Construct the Bloch-twisted generator L(k) and compute the long-time velocity and effective diffusion coefficient from the derivatives of its dominant eigenvalue at k=0, checking against the Derrida closed form and Gillespie trajectories.
biology/quant_bio|waves.area: Chemical master equation finite state projection

biology/quant_bio|waves.title: Quasi-cycles in stochastic SIR with demography: LNA spectrum versus simulation
biology/quant_bio|waves.gist: Derive the linear-noise approximation around the endemic equilibrium of the SIR model with births and deaths, and compute the analytic power spectrum of infective fluctuations. Compare it with Welch FFT spectra of Gillespie simulations, then extract the resonant period and amplification as functions of population size.

biology/quant_bio|waves.title: Spiral waves in spatial rock-paper-scissors May-Leonard model by pseudospectral ETDRK4
biology/quant_bio|waves.gist: Solve the cyclic-dominance reaction-diffusion equations in 2D with a Fourier pseudospectral ETDRK4 integrator. Locate the spiral wavelength from the radially averaged 2D power spectrum and compare it with the linear dispersion relation of Fourier modes about the coexistence fixed point.

biology/quant_bio|waves.title: Diffusion-driven instability of spatial hawk-dove replicator dynamics
biology/quant_bio|waves.gist: Couple hawk-dove replicator dynamics to population density with differential diffusion of the two strategies. Compute the Fourier-mode dispersion relation λ(k) around the mixed ESS to find Turing thresholds, then verify the predicted pattern wavenumber by FFT of a 1D pseudospectral simulation.

biology/quant_bio|waves.title: Periodogram analysis of measles seasonality and biennial cycles
biology/quant_bio|waves.gist: Simulate a seasonally forced stochastic SEIR model with term-time transmission over decades. Detrend and log-transform the weekly incidence, compute windowed FFT periodograms and a short-time Fourier spectrogram, and track the transition of the dominant peak from annual to biennial as the birth rate changes.

biology/quant_bio|waves.title: Frequency response of Michaelis-Menten enzyme under sinusoidal substrate input
biology/quant_bio|waves.gist: Drive a substrate-enzyme-complex mass-action system with an oscillating substrate influx. Compute the steady-state product-flux amplitude and phase at each forcing frequency via FFT of the converged periodic response, and compare the linearized low-pass transfer function and the QSSA prediction, quantifying harmonic distortion versus Km.

biology/quant_bio|waves.title: Environmental noise reddening by Leslie matrix transfer functions
biology/quant_bio|waves.gist: For an age-structured Leslie population with stochastically varying fecundity, compute the frequency-domain transfer function (e^{iω}I - A)^{-1}B. From it, predict the power spectrum of total population for white and AR(1) noise, and compare with Welch FFT spectra of simulated linearized dynamics to quantify spectral reddening.

biology/quant_bio|waves.title: FFT-accelerated MAFFT-style anchor detection before Needleman-Wunsch alignment
biology/quant_bio|waves.gist: Encode two protein sequences by residue volume and polarity, and compute their cross-correlation at all offsets with FFTs to identify high-scoring diagonal anchor segments. Then perform affine-gap Needleman-Wunsch alignment restricted to a band around the anchors, comparing score and runtime with full dynamic programming.

biology/quant_bio|quad_models.title: Beverton-Holt yield-per-recruit with von Bertalanffy growth: F_max and F0.1
biology/quant_bio|quad_models.gist: Evaluate yield per recruit as an age integral of fishing mortality, survival exp(-(M+F)(a-tc)) and von Bertalanffy weight. Compute the integral by Gauss-Legendre quadrature and compare it with the Beverton-Holt cubic-expansion closed form, then locate F_max and the F0.1 reference point by root finding.

biology/quant_bio|quad_models.title: Ricker stock-recruitment fit and exact MSY reference points via Lambert W
biology/quant_bio|quad_models.gist: Fit R = a S exp(-bS) to spawner-recruit data by log-linear regression with a bias correction. Compute S_MSY = (1 - W(e/a))/b in closed form with the Lambert W function (Scheuerell 2016), then derive U_MSY and the MSY value, and compare against Hilborn's approximation.

biology/quant_bio|quad_models.title: Wright stationary allele-frequency distribution under mutation, selection and drift
biology/quant_bio|quad_models.gist: Build the stationary density φ(x) ∝ x^(4Nv-1)(1-x)^(4Nu-1) exp(4Ns x) and normalize it by quadrature, checking it against the Beta function in the neutral limit and the confluent hypergeometric 1F1 closed form. Compute the mean frequency, the expected heterozygosity and the probability mass near the boundaries.

biology/quant_bio|quad_models.title: Temperature-dependent R0 for mosquito-borne transmission from thermal performance curves
biology/quant_bio|quad_models.gist: Assemble the Ross-Macdonald next-generation R0(T) = sqrt(a²bc exp(-μ/PDR) EFD pEA MDR / (N r μ³)), using Brière and quadratic thermal response functions for each mosquito trait (Mordecai et al.). Locate the thermal optimum and transmission limits by root finding, and compute the seasonally averaged R0 by quadrature over a sinusoidal temperature year.

biology/quant_bio|quad_models.title: Reproduction number from growth rate via generation-interval moment generating function
biology/quant_bio|quad_models.gist: Use the Wallinga-Lipsitch relation R = 1/M(-r) for gamma, lognormal and empirical histogram generation-interval distributions, computing the Laplace transform by quadrature where no closed form exists. Compare the results with the SEIR closed form R = (1 + r/σ)(1 + r/γ).

biology/quant_bio|quad_models.title: Multi-group SIR final epidemic size from next-generation matrix
biology/quant_bio|quad_models.gist: Construct the next-generation matrix for a proportionate-mixing activity-structured SIR model and take its spectral radius as R0. Solve the coupled final-size equations z_i = 1 - exp(-Σ_j K_ij z_j) by Newton iteration, and validate the homogeneous case against the Lambert W closed form z = 1 + W(-R0 e^(-R0))/R0.

biology/quant_bio|quad_models.title: Metapopulation capacity of a continuous habitat strip by Nyström discretization
biology/quant_bio|quad_models.gist: Model a habitat with spatially varying quality along a 1D landscape and an exponential or Gaussian dispersal kernel. Compute the metapopulation capacity as the leading eigenvalue of the Fredholm integral operator using Gauss-Legendre Nyström quadrature, check convergence in quadrature order, and determine the critical habitat length for persistence.

biology/quant_bio|quad_models.title: Levins model with rescue effect: equilibria and exact occupancy trajectory
biology/quant_bio|quad_models.gist: Extend Levins patch dynamics with a rescue effect (extinction e(1-p)) and an Allee-type colonization term. Obtain the equilibria in closed form, integrate dp/dt analytically by partial fractions and check against quadrature of dt = dp/f(p), and compute the time to reach 90% of equilibrium occupancy.

biology/quant_bio|quad_models.title: Telegraph gene-expression model: confluent hypergeometric stationary distribution versus FSP
biology/quant_bio|quad_models.gist: Evaluate the exact Peccoud-Ycart stationary mRNA distribution of the two-state promoter model using Gamma functions and scipy.special.hyp1f1. Compare it with the null vector of a truncated CME generator, and report the total-variation error and Fano factor as functions of the switching rates.
biology/quant_bio|quad_models.area: Chemical master equation finite state projection

biology/quant_bio|quad_models.title: Bursty protein distribution by numerical generating-function contour inversion
biology/quant_bio|quad_models.gist: For protein production in geometric bursts with linear degradation, write the closed-form probability generating function. Recover P(n) by trapezoidal Cauchy-contour quadrature (FFT on a circle of tuned radius), compare it with the negative binomial and with an FSP stationary solve, and quantify round-off versus aliasing error.
biology/quant_bio|quad_models.area: Chemical master equation finite state projection

biology/quant_bio|quad_models.title: Over-represented DNA words: Markov-model expectation, overlap variance and Poisson p-values
biology/quant_bio|quad_models.gist: Fit a first-order Markov chain to a genome sequence and compute the expected count of a k-letter word. Compute its variance including the self-overlap (autocorrelation) term, and evaluate exact compound-Poisson and Poisson tail p-values via the regularized incomplete gamma function for observed word counts.

biology/quant_bio|quad_models.title: Lander-Waterman shotgun coverage statistics and k-mer-level assembly gap prediction
biology/quant_bio|quad_models.gist: Compute the expected number of contigs, contig length, gap length and fraction of genome covered from Poisson coverage formulas. Extend this to effective k-mer coverage for de Bruijn assembly, and find by root finding the minimum read depth for a target number of gaps, checking the result against simulated read placements.

biology/quant_bio|quad_models.title: Goldbeter-Koshland zero-order ultrasensitivity: response coefficient and effective Hill exponent
biology/quant_bio|quad_models.gist: Implement the closed-form Goldbeter-Koshland function for a covalent modification cycle with Michaelis constants J1 and J2. Compute the response coefficient R = EC90/EC10 by root finding, the corresponding effective Hill coefficient, and the logarithmic sensitivity, and show the loss of ultrasensitivity as the Michaelis constants grow.
